reviews.comment: The class is discussion based; thus, there is no lectures. The countdown papers are tedious at first, but you start getting a routine as you do them. Participation matters, if you don NOT talk and add value to the class discussion, expect a B tops. Make sure the only technology out is your computer for the class discussions. Overall an easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof Ackall definitely grew on me as the year went on, but her class was very hard and you definitely have to work for it. Weekly papers that take a lot of time to complete if you actually want a good grade and participation is graded very hard which hurts when it is 25% of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Participation is 25% so pretty easy class if you are okay with speaking up, all discussion-based, no lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: She starts off seeming like a hard and strict teacher. Once you get to know her, she is a very caring teacher that wants us to succeed. Though she does push us in some areas and sometimes it feels like busy work, it is never unbearable. Overall, her class was enjoyable
Participation is a major part of your grade, so make sure to show up to class everyday as skipping will hurt your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The class was fun. The professor really made you as the student think and we had meaningful discussions in class. The homework was honestly not that bad. It's about what you would think for a college class. We wrote quite a few papers but they weren't really that bad. I enjoyed the big group conversations that we had.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Ackall is a great professor. If I were to describe the class to someone, I'd say that the class isn't the hardest at all. The only issue I had was APA formatting, but once you get that down, the class is great. All discussion when in class, and small papers to write outside of class. The topics discussed are interesting as well.
Weekly two page essay and participation is required. Great teacher and was funny and kind to her students.

She is very particular on how she likes her papers, and you have one once a week; however, they don't take a lot of time to complete. The class is fun because it is mostly discussion. She tries to make herself super available to help and responds to emails fast. Nice lady who really wants you to do well if you put the work in.

Ackall does her best to make the class enjoyable for everyone. Attendance is mandatory, as there are participation grades every week, but if you participate in class it is an easy grade booster. Just be respectful, participate, and follow the rubrics and its a pretty laid back class that is not difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Good teacher if you are willing to show up and do the weekly writing assignments. Strict on APA format but not hard grading on writing material itself. Super easy if you show up and willing to participate
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: she grades you hard and never tells you what you did wrong or why it was wrong, especially w conceptional things. extremely biased, yet likes to act like she isnt. not funny but tries to be. the class is manageable and you can do well, its just hard bc she it doesnt feel like she is there to help you learn. class is also so boring. dont take her

One word: NIGHTMARE!!!! Every test was a guessing game with multiple interpretations with each question. The matching is insane and the short answer is very specific. You are set up to fail. Beware if you ever have her in another class, she plays favorites and is spiteful towards her students. Capsim was a waste of time, not worth anything!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: One time as a kid I tried to hold my breath until I passed out, this was a more useful than any lesson Ackall "taught" the entire semester. The majority of her job is taught by the students for a grade which has no real guidelines other than if she likes you(be a white preppy guy and you're good).
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is the worst Professor in NEELEY! The class is horribly structured, she doesn't prepare you for the exams that are always left up for interpretation with scenario based questions! Study for 24/7 straight and you still won't be prepared for these bogus exams!She might be racist, judgingby the way she treated the minorities that were in my class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: She thinks that HR is at the equivalent of the Bible. She really doesn't teach and even makes her students teach chapters as a project. What did I learn? Nothing. Does Ackall really deserve to be a professor? No.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She has a assignment due almost every class and makes the class much harder than it needs to be. I wouldn't take her for any class and avoid it if at all possible

Ackall unnecessarily makes her tests extremely difficult and assigns an irrelevant group project. She is a VERY rude person and comes off as arrogant which deteriorates her persona from being professional. I do not know why she is "teaching" at TCU. Please avoid taking her class. Worst professor I have ever met and taken at TCU- I mean it.

Her class is so hard,and the test are incredibly hard. She gives out a group project which each group is suppose to present over the chapters, at the beginning of the semester students teach the class over the chapters while she sits there and does nothing. Students are doing her work for her! I REALLY RECOMMEND TAKING SOMEONE ELSE if not good luck
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Ackall is very rude and disrespectful her class is very hard, and test are even harder. She gives you a group project to do starting at the beginning of the semester she basically is letting students teach her class! Then gives out the hardest test Ive taken at Tcu. I wish I had never taken this class all it did was hurt my GPA!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Ackall is a great person. She is super nice in the classroom; however, her tests are incredibly hard. There is a curve but with how hard the tests are, it does not really make a difference. You NEED to read and you NEED to go to class. Start preparing for tests about two/three weeks in advance and do not bother trying to memorize.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She treats us like fifth graders, even though she has the mind of a fifth grader. Worked in HR and acts like that is the most important profession in the world, when it is a fallback for everyone that I have ever talked to. However, it is probably the easiest class in the business school. Take her for the A, not her disgusting personality.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Better of the two evils. She gets a bad rep but Professor Ackall is actually very helpful and teaches the material well. Her tests are very hard, but you can get A's because of her curve. She practically does CapSim for you if you go to her office hours, so do that. She's challenging but the better professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I think that Ackall is the better choice of the 2 foundation professors. Although, Ackall is really snarky, she really wants her students to succeed. The exams are hard, but they are curved greatly. So if you study a lot, you will most likely get an A on the exam. She grades really hard on the group project so make sure you go to office hours.

gorgeous bombshell of a lady, but class is easy if you understand the basic material on business, read chpts and listen to what she says. Some graphs/figures on book can be on test. so study those too. Awesome teacher. pretty tough but always available office hrs. Team groups/Capsim is the one that can really hurt you. test straight foward if study
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I think I heard that foundations is going to cease to exist soon, but in the meantime, I would not recommend this professor. The material the class covers can apply to your future in business, but her lectures add nothing new, yet attendance is a MUST. Also, the test are way harder than they need to be.

People give Ackall a bad rap, but she's actually really nice. She cares about the students in her class and is always good abut answering questions and clarifying things. There is one big group project that is graded pretty hard, but its not the end of the world. Make sure to read and do online quizzes and study study study for tests.
You will be in a nightmare if taking this class with her for sure
Makes class harder than it needs to be
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: First ever professor I have had that genuinely roots for her students failure. It sad and not at all helpful to learning the material. Makes tests as difficult as possible . Doesn't teach the material at all.
Tests are ridiculously hard. She cares more about making snarky comments than actually teaching her students. Do not take for foundations!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She grades her exams without a point system. In her essay questions, if you don't say exactly what she wants, she will count it wrong even if it had the same meaning. Very strict attitude,

Makes her tests incredibly difficult. You can get 100% on Cengage quizzes but will still fail her written exam. Her class average is a 68%. I would recommend looking for another professor for this course. She is also very hard to talk to because she has a very negative attitude. Constantly talks down to her students.

Ackall is the best choice for this class. Tough grader and even tougher human, but can be nice and funny. Group project is a ton of work but as long as you do the work you will get a good grade. Tests can be difficult, so study hard.

Great teacher, made tests hard so she could curve like 20 points and the project was easy. It was okay to miss class sometimes and she kept class very enjoyable. Definitely a good teacher to take for foundations.

Makes class harder than it needs to be. Tries to make tests hard so class average isn't very high. Try to memorize definitions for short-answer portion. You must attend class or you might miss an in class assignment. These assignments are worth a lot of points. I would suggest taking someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I can not recommend him enough. This is the 2nd time I have taken him and he is easily one of my favorite professors at TCU. So caring and understanding. The courseload is very managable as well.

LOVE LOVE LOVED his class so much!! One of the most understanding and helpful professors I've had. This class is super easy and helpful, he explains material so well and the assignments were actually fun. I definitely recommend taking this course!!! 10/10 class and 10/10 prof!!
LOVE this class, professor is super caring and understanding, he actually teaches things that would be useful in life !!! 10/10
Professor Bhusal was an amazing professor! He makes sure all the work you do in class is simple but also meaningful. I have never had a better teacher. I would take him 1000x over!

Very nice guy; class is easy and straightforward. Designed for those just looking to get the core credit. Not essay heavy in the slightest and no final, just a project that involves "revising" a previously submitted assignment.

By far the easiest class I've taken. As long as you follow the guidelines, you'll earn full credit. It's an easy A, and he is extremely kind and understanding. He canceled class fairly often and usually ended early as well. Highly recommend—take him if you can!
So easy. Has very loose deadlines. Would take him again.
One of the best professors I have ever had, absolutely loved him. Easy A and he is the sweetest. Grading criteria is extremely clear.

Easily my favorite professor at TCU. He acknowledged that his class was a mandatory core meant for freshmen. I genuinely had fun completing his assignments as they were not just essays. I would take this class over and over again. Take him!!!
One word: Free

Best professor I've ever had at TCU. He is so caring and really takes the time to make sure his students understand everything in the course. There were no set due dates for any of the essays and I got to write about topics I was interested in. Highly recommend going to every class and not taking advantage of what an amazing professor he is.
great guy and help students a lot.
The best teacher ever
Probably the easiest prof at TCU. He grades on submission which means you just have to submit your assignments and you will get an A.

The best professor ever, he is super caring and accommodating with deadlines. He does not give much homework, so everything is mostly done in class. He is an easy grader and cares so much about his students. He usually lets you go early and does not take the full time of his class. I would 10/10 recommend his class to everyone.
Absolutely loved him. Very kind and understanding teacher. As well as the course is easy and straightforward.
He is the greatest and the kindest professor ever. Take him.

BHUSAL IS THE BEST!!! I am not smart, but got 100%. If you don't get the grade you're happy with or are confused on something, he is so willing to help and will always acommodate no matter what. He's so sweet, so easy, can be boring at times, but he doesn't keep you the whole class and you gotta just love him. Take him, such an easy A!

Best teacher hands down. There are a couple of assignments but he is so lenient about the due dates and grades super easy. Its almost impossible to get a bad grade. He cancels class often and does not usually hold the whole time. He is so understanding and nice. TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN.

Take Dr. Bhusal if you can! The nicest gu, a great teacher, and super super easy class. He has very few projects throughout the year (and even then are super easy to do.) He is very lenient and understanding. TAKE HIM

Easiest class and teacher. It felt easier than high school English. You spend the entire semester researching one topic of your choice and he's very lenient on deadlines and gives you a LOT of time to complete each assignment. He ends class early mostly every class.

He is an amazing and easygoing professor. He truly cares about his students and makes it super easy for everyone to succeed. You always know what you will be graded on. As long as you try and show up as much as possible you will get an  A. One of the sweetest professors ever.

Dr. Bhusal  has helped me so much, and I am very grateful for the time he took reviewing my work and providing very helpful feedback.  He responds to emails very quickly which helps if a question pops up a day or two before an important assignment.

I enjoyed the lack of pressure he put on assignments. He is encouraging in the writing process and gave us class time to work on assignments. I liked how open he is to answering emails and making sure we all understand what is going on. Together this all gave me confidence in writing.

Mr. Bhusal was SO easy. I skipped most classes and did most all of the work from home and he didn't mind. He has an accent can be hard to follow sometimes, but its not bad. He gave 100s on everything as long as the basic requirements were met. SUPER EASY 100% recommend.

I love how the class was structured. Professor Bhusal is a great professor and did all he could to make sure we learned and got enough writing practice. He was kind, thorough, and always willing to help students.

Professor Bhusal is awesome. His class is very light work and even if you mess up, you can make it up by resubmitting the assignment. There are a a few reflections in the class, and some discussion posts which are VERY easy work you gotta do and it's an easy A. For final, you can make an inforgraphic and write a final memo and boom, you're done.

Great professor! Very kind and understanding! Sometimes things could get a little confusing and not super clear, BUT you can talk to her about it, and she will be very nice about it! Just wants to see her students succeed. Pretty easy for the most part! So many extra credit opportunities, so take them even if you don't think you need them!
Professor Brown is a very understanding and caring professor. I would recommend her to everyone!

I love her so much! I took the 8am MWF and it was so chill. class is usually let out early and she offers so much extra credit. she really just wants her students to succeed. Short lectures and mostly out of class easy work tho. I would take again in a heartbeat. #GPA on da rise

If you want a very easy Intermediate Composition class, TAKE HER! She offers lots of extra credit, cancels class a lot, and is super chill on grading. There are many mini assignments that are very easy and for the projects (only 2 of them) all you have to do is just put the mini assignments into one. Professor Brown is very lenient and caring.

TAKE HER!!! She's the best. She offers extra credit if you submit your notes and if you submit all of them you do not have to do the final. There is busy work but she is super lenient on due dates. I have turned them in late and havent received a point deduction. She also cancelled class multiple times.
this is the best professor TAKE HER she offers extra credit and will allow you to do you papers in class making the homework less stressful.

Professor Brown is the easiest English professor at TCU! There are three big papers which are super easy as she helps you with many activities. Only around 5-10 mins of homework a day but helps to boost your grade. DO THE EXTRA CREDIT!!! 5% boost on essay grades if you go to the writing center which guarantees an A anyway. She does take attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Top G take her

Professor Brown was my favorite professor freshmen year. She have excellent feedback on all your essays, and she would provide resources for extra credit. She cared for her students and how we were doing in class. Attendance was mandatory, but she made class very good. Definitely would take her if you can.

Professor Brown is great and truly cares about her students. Class is broken into 3 major papers that are given with lots of time to complete and she will walk you through them every step of the way. Only downside to her class is that she gives a lot of fluff/busy work to better "build" on the projects which can lead to overload if not on top of it

Professor Brown delivers the class content in a way that is easy to understand and will gladly take the time to help you out if you have any questions. The workload is very manageable, and she's flexible with absences and late work as long as it stays on a once-and-a-while basis. If I had to do it all over, I'd gladly take her class again.

If you're taking Intro to Comp take it with Professor Brown! You do 4 essays total & have like a month to do each one, with small assignments in between that are very manageable. I am a Biology major & loved taking this as a CORE class because it didn't consume all of my time. You also get extra credit if you send your essays to the writing center!

Loved taking Professor Browns writing class, she cares for everyone of her students and is very understanding of things that may pop up. Her class is broken down into 4 projects but she is very helpful with each project. Would recommend anyone to take her class!

One of the nicest people ever. she is so kind and explains things so clearly. minimal work required and you get to choose your topics about what you write. ask her anything she loves to help. take professor brown!!

Professor Brown is a very sweet and considerate woman, and the class is not necessarily hard. However, she assigns an incredible amount of busy work which can pile on top of one another if you aren't careful. She isn't organized on D2L which makes it even more confusing to catch up on missed work. Overall those are the only negatives.
Very good class. You write 4 papers over the whole semester and the work load is really light. Most work is done in class and she grades on completion for smaller assignments.

Professor Brown truly wants her students to succeed and shows that through her teaching. She teaches in steps when writing our papers to ensure we can get the best grade possible and does many activities to help improve our writing. She is so sweet, and class is mostly filled with working on your paper and learning ways to improve. Take her class!!

Such a great and nice professor, and really made this class the best intro writing class to take. Fun and interesting essay topics, and not too many graded projects in the semester. Wish I could take this class again.

Professor Brown is an incredibly compassionate teacher. She cares for both her studies and students. Unequivocally, this has been the best class I've ever taken. I missed class multiple times but she provided me opportunities to make it up. She gives fantastic feedback on projects and wants her students to succeed. TAKE HERRR!!!!

I am currently taking this course and I am very disappointed so far. The material often feels more complicated than necessary, especially the case studies, which lack clear expectations. Instructions are often unclear, making it difficult to understand what is required. Grading also seems inconsistent. I would not recommend this course to anyone.

Attended office hours constantly for a filler class, yet still struggling with my grade. After a 2-week approved leave, communication vanished. I sent detailed emails and got 2-sentence replies. She promised I could skip an assignment, then took it back and blocked the submission. Seems cool at first, but lacks communication or clarity.

so annoyed, supposed to be a fun elective to boost GPA. I ended up working hours on long reflections, heavy projects, and group work at home which is the entire grade. Feedback is vague and tough usually saying "go deeper", no matter the effort spent. Your class grade is based more on what you submit than your actual participation/effort in class.

Interesting content but gets repetitive. Workload isn't bad except one big project, which isn't hard just a lot of work. In class case studies are my worst nightmare, she has VERY specific expectations and tough grading. Feedback is very critical and she can be mean and passive aggressive. Overall easy class, she just makes it hard to enjoy.

This class is really frustrating. Grading feels inconsistent, and while the material is easy, it's extremely boring and repetitive. The no phone or laptop rule makes it worse, and most discussions just repeat the same point. It doesn't feel like you're actually learning much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is a great professor who cares for her students and values us learning about the topic over loading us with homework. She had really interesting topics and we got to watch mini documentaries in class. Easy and definately recommend!

Dr. Salopek is so kind and truly cares about her students. She always makes class enjoyable and entertaining. She's extremely helpful when a student needs clarity on an assignment. I would definitely take her again.Take her!
She grades really hard. She is not an engaging public speaker either. I would not recommend taking her class.

She doesn't believe in giving 100's, even in participation. Honestly takes the fun out of watching TV shows. Grades assignments way too harshly for a "non-majors" class. Don't expect her office hours to help you complete assignments, as she'll give you the wrong info. Advice for her exams: write everything you can to fulfill her requirements.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Major is relatively nice, but she grades an intro TV Studies class like it's your PhD thesis. She also doesn't believe in giving 100s and claimed “you can't get a 100 for attendance & participation.”

Would highly recommend her for a fine art credit. She gives you everything you need to know. It is critical that you go to class and participate in lectures as well as watching assigned films. As long as you keep up with the weekly assignments you will succeed in this class. She is a very understanding professor. Wish I could take her again!

She was ok. For a class designed for non-majors, the material was very niche. Tests were graded hard and there were 3 of them. Lectures were kind of boring, but we got to watch tv series clips which was fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Although this class was not my favorite, Dr. Major is an amazing teacher. She made a very safe and fun classroom and was very willing to help with any confusion. Don't be scared of the readings and reflections! She explains everything in class. Not a tough grader at all she is very fair.
Course required for film majors and minors. Long, dense, readings assigned. Doesn't really explain stuff well. Wish there was another prof to teach this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Participation is not mandatory, but you have to attent lectures in order to do good in this class. Overall, I had a great experience with him. Explains everything in details, gives lots of examples and sometimes gives real life examples which makes it more interesting. If you want to take Elementary Statistics, he is the one you are looking for!
If you also hate math, definitely take him! He makes class easy to understand, posts the notes, does the reviews in class and will help you succeed.

Posts solved guided notes online, posts study guides with questions very similar to the exam, works through the worksheets in class, does in-class review sessions before exams. The lectures are boring but Dr. Ali is about the best you can really ask for when it comes to math for non-majors. The class is very reasonable and you can get through it.

Attendance is not required, you can skip everyday and still end with an A. The homework outside of class is very short and easy, tests are 15 question multiple choice exams. Dr. Ali is very nice and recommended his course, it is very slow at times though, emphasis really is on the "elementary".
He is a fun and easier teacher to have for Elementary Stats. Only 3 Exams that are JUST like the review. Make sure to do all your HW and worksheets because grade opportunities are limited.

If you need to take a stats professor take this class! I hate math and this class was a breeze. He's a caring professor who always tries to make jokes in class and have fun teaching. The reviews before exams are almost identical questions to the exam itself. It's an easy A for anyone who puts in the slightest bit of effort

You need to show up to class to understand, but he doesn't take attendance. Online at home quizzes, and worksheets are done in class with him. Three exams throughout the semester but they aren't too bad. He's funny and always willing to help! I would definitely recommend taking him! Not bad compared to other stats professors.

Dr. Ali is a great professor for Elementary Statistics! He is willing to make the time during class to answer any questions or concerns. He does run through the lecture pretty fast but he goes over the work step by step.
Professor Ali is very chill. He's super nice and understanding. Lectures are good and clear, there is very little homework. Easy class!

loved taking elem stats with ali. he leaves all homework assignments and quizzes open throughout the semester and doesn't take off points for late grades. As someone terrible at math, he makes the class super understandable and allows you to use notecards on the midterm and exam. such a great prof. take him if you can!!

He literally does all assignments with you in class. He never tries to trick you, there are 2 exams (midterm and final) that you get notecards for. All questions on the review were almost exactly like the exams. He's hilarious and such a kind person. 10/10!!!!

He is probably one of the nicest professors at TCU, but he moves at a fast pace while teaching and doesn't explain clearly if you don't have a background in statistics. There are take-home assignments that are easy, but the midterm and final are imperson and worth 60% of your final grade. Overall, there is easier stats teachers to take.

LOVE Dr.Ali he is such a good professor he walks you through everything you need to know. His grading is very clear, you have 3 tries for the quizzes. He is so caring and if you something going on he is so understanding. You will learn a lot from him take stats with him!

Very approachable teacher. Grading system is very clear and easy to follow. Many attempts allowed on online quizzes, 1 midterm and 1 final which are both in person, and various homeworks that are online and he goes over them in class. Not hard to do well in this class at all! Go to class because he gives answers.
He is very kind and lenient. Aside from this, he works to make sure all of his students understand and never failed to ask how everyone was doing or try to make some joke. I loved him!

He was very easy and clear with how to do well in the class. If you have previous experience with the course you will do well and as long as you do the homework at some point, you will get full credit. Midterm and final are exactly the review, the quizzes you can take up to 3 times, same questions, and the homework he works on in class and are easy

Such a sweet, caring, helpful professor! I always sucked at math but all I did was show up to class and sometimes office hours and ended up with an A easily. Class setup is made to help students succeed, and he does quizzes/hw/worksheets in class. You get notecards for tests that are based on review. The best math professor I've ever had!
I have never been good at math, and Ali Ahmed taught everything really well, and allows a notecard for all exams along with goes through homework with the class

I love Dr. Ali! He is super kind and understanding. There are weekly quizzes and worksheets that are at home, online, and have no lockdown browser. You have three attempts for each of these. He also only gives out two tests, which includes the midterm and the final. I would definitely recommend!!!

So so nice, cares about his students so much. Really good at teaching. Take him if you can. 3 attempt on every HW and quiz which are all online and open note/book. 3 take home exams no lockdown browser and 2 in person (midterm and final) which he gives a review for that is almost identical to what he gives you for the test.

Easy class if you pay attention, open note quizzes, h.w and exams(except final). Majority of the class has a B or above. Very helpful professor wants you you succeed. U don't have to buy the calculator if it's too pricey for you, just download its trial version on your laptop(google it) and borrow the calculator from another class for your final.

Dr. Ali is a walking teddy bear. He is a very loving guy, and makes learning stats fun. If you are confused or need help, he is very quick to make sure you're taken care of. I recommend him to every person who needs elementary stats. He allows make up work for unsatisfied grades. Dr. Ali goes out of his way in lecture to ask us if we are happy.

Ali is super sweet and funny. All he wants us to do is talk to him and participate during class. His lectures aren't the most interesting but that's due to boring content not him. Overall he explains math very well and is very clear. I recommend

dr. ali was awesome! he really goes the extra mile to assure you understand the material! if you go to his office hours he will always try to help you out! there are homework and quizzes due every sat/sun but they are super easy and will help boost your grade! in class midterm and in class cumulative final!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Ali is a great teacher! The best way to excel in class is to go to office hours. You can do your take-home tests with him and he will give you the answers. There is a lot of homework but it's nice because the due dates are consistent. Every test/exam is take-home except for the midterm and final. Overall, His class is the best.

Seems like a caring professor but the online format makes it pretty hard to do well. The homework and quizzes are pretty easy but the tests are much more difficult and the lectures don't feel like they correlate well.

Dr. Ali is such a great professor. He gives so much opportunity for understanding what hes teaching and gives extra credit or opportunities to prove you know what your doing on the tests, but missed by a .01 decimal for a remake. Hes very nice and breaks it down simply.
Best professor
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: If you are ever one to believe in signs. LET THIS BE ONE! There are too many other stat profs for you to take this one. Not one of his 3 exams let alone the final was over the average of a 78. Never met a prof who teaches so little & expects so much from a student. I know its easy for me to sound like a bitter student but please save your GPA 4 me.

Dr. Ali is great! Online quiz & HW are super easy and make up a good chunk of your grade. If you don't do too well on a test go to his office hours and he'll help you out. Idk if attendance is "mandatory", he will look at it at the end of the semester if you're on the verge of a letter grade though. Great professor, highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Ali is an absolute sweetheart. He is such a great professor and has my ultimate respect. He makes the class very simple, and you can tell that he is extremely passionate about statistics. He explains everything in detail, and will not let you fall behind. He makes sure that you understand everything, and his reviews are just like the test.

He is the nicest professor. He helps me with Math and those hard Stat problems. Everything from TESTS is exactly the same on the STUDY GUIDE. Weekly homework but easy to work with. Ask him if you have problems solving hw, he help you right the way. If you want to expand the deadline, tell him the reasonable excuse. TAKE HIM!!!

Great guy, BUT if you're not willing to do work and ask questions then DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS. You have homework and quizzes due online every week, and it seems as if his lectures and tests are nothing like the homework. He does care about his students though, but is rarely accessible besides in class.

Dr. Ali really cares about his students. He wants you to have a good time and love learning in his class. As far as learning, I didn't learn too much. The first test was all about taking the average but the second was more difficult. The reviews are identical to the tests so do the review and you should be fine.

Such an easy class, lots of homework and quizzes, only take 2 tests and 1 final. Tests are way easier than the homework and if you ask him a question he will give the correct answer on the test. He isn't the clearest teacher so if you aren't decent at math I would take a different professor.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He is a great professor I've ever met. He is really nice and understanding. I have learned a lot from him.

Dr. Ali is literally so great!! If you don't pass the class or do well, its definitely because you didn't try or show up. He is flexible and understands that a lot of us have to take this class as part of graduation requirements. Highly recommend taking his class

Definitely, take him for stats. I know some people say he is not a great teacher but if you ask for help or take an extra 5 min to look up a problem online, you'll be fine. Finished with an 88% in his class and emailed him because I had a 90% going into the final and he said he would round my grade up! Only 2 tests WITH notecards & online quizzes!
Loved professor Ali! His class is so simple and he makes everything super easy to learn. He also gives study guides for every exam that have the same layout!! For sure take him if you can

Nice teacher who loves participation in class. Very easy stat class that he helps you out with. Go to class as much as you can because he only talks for about 20 min then helps you on homework and understanding it. Tests are the exact review with different numbers. You also get a notecard on every test. EASY A!!!!!!!

Elementary Statistics - always hard. DONT BUY TEXTBOOK. Doesn't teach that well but will help you if you need help and actually explains it. GO TO CLASS!!! I did not often and it was really difficult for me to teach myself. Sometimes he takes roll but I honestly dont think it even counted toward anything. He also helps grades at the end of year:)
Really easy tests but homeworks and quizzes aren't as easy as the tests. Really funny and nice guy, he's really understanding when it comes to late assignments.

He really cares that you learn the material and will help you get an A. He's a very funny guy and an extremely accomplished mathematician. Textbook is helpful but not necessary at all. He gives study guides and lets you bring in notes on an index card. I'm bad at math but I earned an A. I HIGHLY recommend this class.
A really funny guy that really cares about his students. If you are struggling he will 100% help you get an A. Super easy class.
Makes learning stats very clear in the easiest way possible! Gives great study guides to prepare you for the test. 10/10 would recommend. Super nice guy

HE IS AWESOME! He is so understanding and very helpful. Make sure to get to know him because he is an awesome professor. He gives study guides and helps us a lot! Make sure to go to class not only to learn the materials but also to hear his jokes. FUNNY DUDE
He is super helpful if you don't understand a concept and gives you good study guides for the test
He is a great teacher, always wants his students to have fun and be happy. Not hard to make a good grade. Definitely recommend
TAKE HIM! HE IS AWESOME

Dr. Ali is a fun guy, but is kinda all over the place. There are no study guides for tests, so make sure you know how to do the homework. He teaches directly out of the textbook, so get that because sometimes it is easier to understand than his lectures. He gets confused and doesn't know how to do problems sometimes. You can easily manipulate him!
professor Ryder is a great teacher, I looked forward to his class everyday and he's very passionate about what he does. He's also very understanding.

Dr. Ryder is super knowledgeable and makes lectures really easy to understand. He take complex subjects and theories and breaks them down. His class is super easy and makes you want to actually learn. If you do your assignments (weekly discussions, 2 essays, 1 presentation), you'll get an A. I wish I could take him for every class, he's the best!

LITERALLY THE GOAT!! Dr. Ryder is a very thoughtful and knowledgeable professor who is well-versed in diverse social issues and applies real-world examples in his class. Cares about all his students and loves participation: 2 major essays and a 10-minute presentation on the topics in class. Literally the goat, and would love to retake him.

My second time taking Ryder's class and I love it each time! His FSM class was very inspiring and I love his broad topics, very diverse and respectful to all beliefs. He is extremely educated in many things and shares milestones about his life. Class is fairly easy with a couple of discussion post and 2 major essays. Take him and leave inspired!
Provides a space for fair dialogue about social topics recent and old. Even presents far right and far left beliefs in a respectful manner. You will learn in here. A fun, good, and easy time

Dr. Ryder is a very relaxed and kind guy. It's a discussion-based class, and he really does a great job of creating an environment to have interesting conversations about current political issues. Graded by attendance, weekly discussion posts, and two papers, but the overall workload for the class is incredibly light.
He's the goat, very easy and interesting class. Grades mostly on discussion with 2 papers and a presentation being your assignments for the semester. Very understanding person.

Dr. Ryder is the best. His class is very discussion based and only has a few assignments, but the topics are always interesting and he really cares about them. I took FSM with him and it's great because it fulfills multiple core requirements + honors credit. Dr. Ryder is super easy to talk to/reach and he cares about his students.

Professor Ryder is a very learned man. He is very articulate and informative. His class is discussion-based and easy to get an A. He talks about very interesting political and social events from history or present and then highlights the element of religion in it.10-12 discussion posts, midterm and final 4-5 page papers, 1 class presentation.

Professor Ryder was a very well-spoken Professor, he was very engaging with the class and let us participate. There was one presentation that was only 10 minutes and we had 2 papers to write. Take him, get an easy A, and leave with knowledge!

This is my 3rd class with professor Ryder. He is a great guy. Cares about his students and is very understanding. The topics he discusses in lecture are quite interesting. If you have taken his other classes there will be some overlap, so you already have some discussion points ready. The final paper is a little tedious since it is 8 pages.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Just loved taking this course. It was an upper level honors course and focused on the study of outlaws. I enjoyed the topics so much and learned a lot. I highly recommend taking any class by Prof. Ryder. Very fair and gives good explanations on what he expects from us. Be prepared for lots of group discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: I took a class with Dr. Ryder my first semester here at TCU. He teaches the class for the student to truly learn, as the entire class was engaging and thought-provoking. As long as there is active participation and effort, earning a grade with Dr. Ryder is a non-issue. Thank you for the great experience, Dr. Ryder!

Dr. Ryder is great!! I took two classes with him and they were my favorite honors credits at TCU. He is an engaging professor that makes the class both fun and interactive. By attending & participating in group discussions and putting effort into papers, you can easily get a good grade. Best professor - I highly recommend!

The best honors class at TCU. Take it if you can. I got a 100 in the class. Grade based off of weekly discussion posts (300 words) and two final papers. Attendance is mandatory (pretty much) but you'll enjoy going to class. Participate, take notes on discussion, and pay attention bc it makes the 2 papers a lot easier to write.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you have the opportunity to take a class from Ryder, do it. You're not gonna find a more engaging prof with such little work. Grades consist of participation in class, weekly discussion posts, and two papers.

Grades are easy, one weekly discussion, a midterm essay, a presentation, and a final essay is all. Easy grading with clear criteria. Attendance is taken and he likes to do group discussions. 10/10 would recommend, show up and do your work and you will make a good grade. He is also a very nice, understanding professor.

There is lots of reading, but it is not essential to read it in order to participate in class. Once a week discussion post and its basically a completion grade. He is kind and knowledgeable about religion and current political issues.

Professor Ryder is a great guy who really knows what he's talking about. His class is actually interesting, and although there's a lot of reading, he's an easy grader. If you do the work, you will get a good grade. Only 2 papers in the class and you will get good grades if you put in the effort. Would highly recommend taking this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Ryder has been my best prof so far at TCU. There was a good amount of reading, but the material was all really interesting. There are only 2 papers and he grades fairly easily. Participation is mandatory but really easy to get. He is super knowledgeable on everything discussed in class and very accommodating! Would highly recommend taking him!

Dr. Ryder is a great professor who has a passion for the subject he teaches. There is a lot of dense reading required, but he is a very easy grader as long as you show him you have learned something from the material in your papers.

Prof. Ryder is a good professor. Some of the topics are inherently political, and in this he does show a bias. Other than that he is a fair grader, and a good person. Recommend taking his class, just be prepared to participate.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ryder is a great professor. Some of the topics are very political but he does a good job of bringing in fact and a variety of outside opinions. He is a really fair grader and as long as you participate in class an A is attainable.

Professor Ryder is a fantastic teacher so far. It is easy to pass his class if you do the work, he values, respects, and looks for different perspectives, and he is clearly passionate about what he does. Faith and Social Movements is rather Christian centrist at first and a bit left-leaning, but I still HIGHLY recommend taking him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Obviously very passionate about faith and social movements. He leads the discussions very well in class. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this class for Honors students!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: As long as you put in the effort, do the work and participate in class, you will get 100s on all your assignments. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Ryder is a really interesting guy and Faith and Social Movements is a really interesting class. Hes an easy grader as long as you get your work done. reviews.comment: If you care about the topic and pay attention to the homework and lectures, you should be in a good position for the test. accounting is hard and no matter what professor you get you will have to learn the material. sure, her tests might be harder and more thorough than others, but I believe the homework assignments prepare you well.

By far the worst professor I've ever had in my life. I hope TCU lets her go because she is an abysmal teacher. She doesn't even teach. She's basically a glorified proctor. TA would do a better job than her.

Extremely poor teacher, often rambled about personal stories instead of teaching, and was unclear in explanations. reviews.comment: if you are someone that needs to work problems out in class as a group dont take tasby. she doesnt physically work any problems out in class. all you do in class is check the work u were supposed to do at home.

I can't stand her teaching style. She is basically just a proctor for the tests because she doesn't actually teach anything ever. She also assigns double the amount of homework.

She makes accounting very difficult and doesn't offer much wiggle room. Overall a pretty unforgiving professor especially if this is your first experience with anything accounting related. I'd recommend taking a different professor for this subject.

I had no choice on my accounting teacher when I enrolled because I had to fill out a request form and when I was given Tasby, I looked at her reviews and she didn't seem like a good teacher. Don't pay attention to all of the negative reviews about her she isn't that bad. She tries to make class interesting and if you apply yourself you are going to be fine. Gives partial credit on exams and extra credit is offered.

Acct is hard regardless of your professor. But her class is very Straightforward and she wants to help you do well. She explains things well and prepares you for the exams. I definitely would take her.

reviews.comment: This was a required course for my major. I recommend Tasby for acct. She very organized and explains things very well. I was expecting acct to be much harder. If you keep up with the class, you won't have a problem at all. I definitely would take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You will learn accounting the reviews don't really matter since the tests for accounting are the same material for any class and you will most likely utilize McGraw Hill for any accounting class at this level. She is a good professor who wants you to succeed. The tests are difficult if you don't take the work seriously. There are lots of ways to get extra credit but you have to do the work. reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: There are packets we do in class that become homework. There is online learnsmart and online homework due for each chapter. Probably two hours of homework a week. The tests are hard but she curves them a high amount. She is an easy A if you get the gist of accounting. In this class you just need to do better than other people in the class for an A.

Tasby got a bad rep her first semester teaching but I took her during her second semester at TCU and she was not nearly as bad as what I had heard. Accounting is already a crappy subject but I survived the class and she will take the time to work with you if you are making an effort. Tests suck but that's accounting, man

Professor Tasby is not the easiest professor, but then again accounting isn't the most intuitive subject for most people. She is always positive and loves teaching. She expects her students to take the initiative in learning once she points them to the right direction. She cares about her students both inside and outside the classroom.

As long as you go to class and do your readings and homework you will pass. By no means is she easy, but you will be prepared to ace the final. If you need help understanding something go to her office hours and she will help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Tasby is the best professor I've had since I've been at TCU! It's tough to be an Accounting Professor in my opinion, due to the fact that the subject is one of the toughest. However, Tasby prepares you all semester for the Final exam that's given by the Neeley Accounting department! She is inspirational, kind, and will help if you needit

Ok, Accounting is difficult! it is not a blow-off class, however, the key is to read,read,read,read! I know Tasby gives advice "to not read the book instead read her notes that she gives online." Don't listen to that, read the book, you have to understand the conceptual part of accounting before you can start to making that A that we all strive for

She doesn't teach in class, she expects you to be an expert on every thing in the class before your supposed to learn it. she is a great person but she doesn't prepare the class enough for tests and quizzes. The final really is not as hard as she makes it sound. If you like teaching yourself a subject go for it, do all the hw and learn smarts.

If you need help she's willing to help you at an agreeable time if office hours don't work for your schedule. Put in the work and you'll get an A.

Professor Tasby has a great sense of the Accounting world and brings lots of outside knowledge to her teaching. She has improved greatly since her first few years at the college and makes herself available for help if needed. You need to go to class though. You won't understand accounting if you don't go to class period. overall solid professor.

I was nervous going into this class, but Tasby did a great job to prepare us by giving us many opportunities to practice outside of class as well as taking time in class to answer the harder homework questions. She grades tough, but, if you do what she tells you, you shouldn't have a tough time doing well in the class

Professor Tasby goes above and beyond to help her students succeed. She has real-world experience in accounting and a deep passion for it. It's truly impressive to see a professor get hyped up every morning for such as subject as accounting. She offers many resources to help students as well. I recommend her for any ACCT class you need to take.

Professor Tasby is amazing. She is very knowledgeable and is always willing to help. She offers her students the opportunity to give her feedback and suggestions to implement in class so you succeed. Her tests are really hard, and you have to master the content before going in. They are all multiple choice so no partial credit is given. She does offer extra credit and gives very easy HW quizzes.
Dr. B is a great professor and takes time to help her students.  Go to office hours!  It makes a difference.
She goes pretty fast in lectures but she is very nice and willing to help. Has not been too bad, 3 exams and cumulative final.
All these good reviews must be her writing them. By far one of the worst professors for this class. Just avoid taking her.

Professor Bourgeois is very accessible outside of class, which is nice.  My biggest recommendation is to go into office hours starting at the very beginning of the semester- it will help.  Quiz questions all come from homework problems.  It is so hard to finish all problems on tests unless you are a statistics expert.  She goes fast in lectures.

Well folks, even though I got a D+ in this class and I failed I think it was due to me not putting in the effort to learn. I regret it because professor Stacy is a very nice professor. She's accessible outside the class, she tries to help you learn. She's very passionate about Stats and will help you learn and improve. 5 exams and 4 quizzes.

She is a nice lady, and you can tell she cares about the class, but if you do not know how to use excel before the class, it is going to be difficult. She moves very quickly, and did not let our class ask a lot of questons. Tests and quizzes are open online, and notes, but they are still difficult. Do not miss class a lot, you will fall behind.

For a class like statistics it is a hard class , but she makes the class a little bit more enjoyable. Pay attention in class, take very good notes and GO TO OFFICE HOURS ! I can't stress it enough how helpful going to office hours and getting to know the teacher has been ! One of my favorite teachers this semester .

I love her. She always goes through every problem and topic in class and therefore the homework is easy to understand. the quizzes and exams are open note and very fair. go to office hours! This class is difficult in general yet she makes it very enjoyable and easy to understand and learn the topics. Would 100% take her class again
Attendance is mandatory but it should be for a class like this. Nice teacher, quizzes are based on homework and the exams are very fair.

She moves so fast in her lectures. She barely gives you any explanation for problems. Barely gives feedback if you email her, sometimes not at all. Didn't let our class ask questions about the last homework assignments until after we took the homework quiz.

Graded by 5 Exams, a final, and a group project. Exams are open google, open note, open anything you want. They can still be hard though. She expects her students to know statistics coming into this class. She's a nice lady and goes over a ton of problems on class. Best part is that you dont need the textbook to get a good grade in the class
Take him!! He is very funny and assignments are not difficult at all!!

OMG. I love him so much. There were 4 big assignments and easy grading on those. There were also 5 discussion post and still easy grading on those. He gave us 4 free absence this semester and he also accepted late work. He is the best professor my first semester in TCU. Also, he is very supportive and willing to help.
Easiest prof at TCU

the easiest writing professor ur gonna have. he is very easy even tho the lectures r super boring. still, recommend take him with your friends and ur gonna have A. 4 freebies absences, no exams, only assignments.

Anyone needs an easy class with least effort hear me out. TAKE HIM. Class is not that fun but very VERY, and I mean VERY, easy and chill. All you need to do is show up. Assignments are easy and low effort. Just submit and A is guaranteed. But PLEASE be nice to him he's such a caring prof. Show up and don't use AI. Attend with friends is more fun
Very good professor. Definitely take him if you can! His assignments are fairly easy, as long as you turn them in you'll be guaranteed an A!!
Great core class to take, such a breath of fresh air from every other class i'm in! Just do the assignments and your'e good!
Very nice and funny. cares about his students and if you submit your work you will receive an A.

I took comp 2. Shuva is super sweet and his class is very easy. He cares about his students and is clear about what he wants from an assignment. Easy A, no quizzes, no exams. Mainly essays and discussion posts. Required attendance but you get 4 skips. He lets the class pick due dates.
Easy class and easy grades but no real new learning. Choose your poison pill carefully.
Literal goat. you have to try to not get a 100% in his class.
Take Dr. Shuva for Comp 1, he is the best professor at TCU. You will get a 100 on assignments if you just complete them and put effort in.

Professor Rana Bhat is the best english professor! He cares about his students and wants everyone to succeed. He gives feedback on every assignment and I definitely left his class a better writer. You get time in class to complete homework and he is very helpful. He is very engaging. and his class is a lot of fun!

Professor Rana Bhat was one of the best professors I have had at TCU. He tries to relate to all his students and understands everyone's struggles. He would always review our essays for the big assignments to ensure a good final grade. There is homework, but it is not too much to handle. Overall, I would definitely recommend him for Comp 1!

Absolutely love professor Rana Bhat! I took him for Introductory Comp my first semester in College and he is still my favorite professor at TCU. There is no final. The class includes creating an e-portfolio in which you will display all the work you do throughout the semester. He makes every class fun, so go to class!!

Dr. Shuva is awesome! He really cares about his students and wants you to do the best you can. Deadlines are soft and he allows the class to choose them. Grade is participation, a final presentation, 10 discussion posts, lets you choose if you want to do either 2 or 3 4-6pg papers, and he gives you time in class to work on them!
He is such an amazing professor and really cares about his students.

Amazing professor. Wants everyone to succeed and is always willing to help. Made the class fun and always understood if we were absent for any reason. Deadlines are almost up to the class the entire time and will have plenty of time to submit your work. Would highly recommend him as he is one of if not the greatest professor at TCU.

Best English professor ever. Such a nice guy, so funny and kind. Got a 100% on everything i turned in. Very understanding on deadlines and lets you choose your own. Also a lot of class time to work on assignments, so I pretty much finished them all in class. Take this class if you can.

Easily one of if not THE nicest professor I've had at TCU. All you have to do is show up to class and do your work. The workload isn't heavy at all. He's very understanding and lenient with deadlines. He greatly appreciates those who come to lecture. He's also kind of funny sometimes. I would take him for every class if I could.

Professor Shuv is a great person. He cares a lot about his students, will always give feedback in order for you to succeed in his class, and will always make jokes in class. Best English professor by far.

Dr. Rana Bhat is the best! Such a kind professor and so easy and understanding to work with. If you need an easy class where the professor is able to give you a lot of positive feedback this is definitely the class to take. Would highly recommend you also engage in his class. it makes it less stressful to not be called out in class and he likes you
Great professor, laid back class, not too much work, nearly all done in class. TAKE THIS

Professor Shuva is one of the best English teachers. If you do the assignment on time it is almost guaranteed you will get 100% of everything. There are 3 papers and 5 discussion posts all semester. He is really just a great guy that genuinely cares about his students. He makes everything easy and is overall just awesome.

Professor Shuva is awesome. He cares about his student and let the class choose their own deadlines. You only have to do 5 discussion posts and some super easy assignments.
Take his class!

This professor is honestly the nicest human being I have ever met. He cares so much for his students and wants everyone to succeed. Professor Shuv is not strict at all about due dates and if you have a reason to miss an assignment he is very understanding. His lectures are amazing!!! overall a 10/10 and you will get an A+ in the class.
Shut was one of my favorite professors here so far, never had any tests or quizzes just a few papers and projects. Highly recommend taking his course!

Shuv is one the best professors at TCU. Super caring and understanding of all his students. No tests just a couple papers but is very lenient with grading. You can tell he actually wants his students to do well.
Shuv is great. His lectures can sometimes be a little boring, but he is such a nice and funny guy. As long as you do each assignment, you will get an A. Minimal effort is required. Take his class!
Shuv is the man, and this class has been extremely easy and useful.  He is extremely lax on due dates and loves every student.  If you have the chance to take intro comp with him, do it.

Professor Rana Bhat is a caring, kind, and personal professor. He is genuinely interested in the students and what they have to say, especially when it comes to workload. He has students turn in a first draft and then provides detailed corrections for the students to improve their work.

I took him for Intro to Comp and he really helped me out. I am a terrible writer yet I aced the class. As long as you you try and write the paper its an automatic 100. I didn't go to every class and he didn't mind. Truly a great teacher. GOATED!
Shuv Raj for intro comp was awesome. Easiest class, best prof, truly a goat. MUST TAKE
My favorite professor ever. Very nice guy who wants you to pass. Take him!!

This may well be the easiest class you can take at TCU. I received a 100% on every single assignment. Shuv is caring about his students well being. Attendance is not mandatory, there are no deadlines for assignments, and you write about 3 papers the whole semester plus a few simple discussion posts online. Take Shuv if you can!
He is my favourite professor at TCU so far. He does not care if you hand in your work late; as long as you hand it in, you will get 100. Not mandatory attendance. He is so nice and caring as well.

Professor Bailey is awesome! She likes people who know what they are talking about, and she scared me the first few times I raised my hand. Would definitely not recommend if you're sensitive, but I loved her!

Lectures contain a lot of information, and you may believe she is trying to trick you by putting tiny slide details onto tests. Will put 6 figures on a presentation and expect you to remember the significance of them all weeks later with no access to them online. Be prepared to lock in. Nice.

She was pretty solid. She isn't the easiest accessibility wise & makes things seem like it's your fault when it's not. She's pretty funny, & no hw, but she made me scared to ask her questions because of her attitude & persona. Overall, taking her isn't a bad option at all, but if you're super sensitive, I don't think she's the professor for you.

Is very nice and engaging, however will not discuss your grade what so ever. The entire semester I had an A and on the final it dropped my grade to a B+. I was .1% away from an A and did not want to try and  communicate about it. She's nice though don't be like me sigh.

Professor Bailey is an incredible professor who cares deeply about the success of her students. Although not mandatory, attendance is vital for success, and her lectures are very engaging. She is a fair grader and very accommodating as long as you communicate well. I would definitely take another course with her!

Dr. Bailey is a great professor! Her lectures are very engaging and informational. She doesn't post the lectures online, so while attendance isn't mandatory, it's very helpful, as there is a lot of information in the textbook that isn't in the lecture and therefore isn't on the test.

She was an amazing professor! Class is super easy and as long as you attend it regularly and take good notes you will be just fine. She has extra credit opportunities and as long as you read the syllabus for dates you will be set. 10/10 recommend this class. Read over the textbook and understand the quizzes and it's an easy A.

Don't let bad reviews scare u.Professor Bailey is a great professor. Her class is NOT hard, and if u hear any different, the students prob 1. didnt go to class or 2. didn't take notes. as long as u take notes on all topics mentioned in class, including graphs, ur fine. don't bother reading textbook, only need to study what's mentioned in class.
expects you to information that she goes through super quickly, can be sarcastic and rude, and just doesn't give enough information about anything like a good professor would.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: not great, doesn't give any study guides or info to study, tests are tricky and hard, take another teacher

Not a great teacher at all, tricks you a lot and expects you to understand things without her saying. Have to take a lot of notes each class, doesn't ever post much information online and isn't very helpful. Doesn't tell you when class is canceled and tbh doesn't make it clear when there is a test. her tests are hard and too specific on graphs/data

I think she is probably the best professor I've had at TCU. All you have to do is pay attention and particpate (which is not hard because she makes it interesting) and you will do great. She really connects with her students and will be super helpful if you just pay attention and try in her class

The class is pretty easy, but really boring since it's just lectures and quizzes. The exams have some bad test items like "what year did xyz happen" which is just arbitrary memorization which is really stupid and pointless so beware of that. You can skim through the textbook and be fine, just know the vocab and take notes in class if you can.

Overall I think that professor bailey is a good teacher and really does care about pushing the class to be better. If you are going to take her you should beware that she can often be kinda tricky. Make sure you write down everything in class, even the graphs.

Bailey is not a nice woman at all!!!! Although attendance is not required, you should go to get participation points. Every time you talk, it is 0.25 of an extra credit point. She grades hard and expects you to write at a master's level. If you turn in assignments early, she does let you redo and resubmit by the due date for a higher grade.

Nice lady, but not a great professor. 90% of her lectures are her asking students to figure out what a concept means before she explains it herself. Doesn't post slides and there are no study guides for any of the 5 of her exams. And there are SO MANY charts and graphs no direct/clear definitions to know. The content was easy just not taught well.

The class was so easy but I actually can't stand her. Her lectures are basically all graphs that she expects you to know, then DOESN'T post them. Like what? Her office hours are no help. She posts ten million announcements at like 3 am that are so pointless- like just telling you to study or posting a meme. Relatively easy class but annoying.

Professor Bailey is a must take. For being a core class, she makes it so fun and interesting. My biggest advice is to read the syllabus and just listen during class. Chances are if you listen well while in class you'll be just fine when it comes to tests.

She taught very well and very rarely did I feel the need to teach myself something outside of class. It is a very lecture heavy course, but her test questions are very straight forward if you listened. Sincerely, this was a fun elective so don't be scared of her!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you love mind games, sure, take this professor. She doesn't put any instructions on TCU Online, cancels class without telling anyone, and grades harshly and unfairly. If you show up to class every day and become her favorite, maybe you'll get an A. She drained the life out of me. Save your sanity and take something else.

This class lacked good communication. Class was cancelled over three times without telling the students. there is no rubric or outline for ANY of the work. Her teaching style is asking students questions on things we haven't discussed yet rather than teaching directly. I've never experienced a class like it. DO NOT TAKE!!!

Professor Bailey is a must take. The class is not hard at all as long you attend class. I went to class every period and barely had to study, it's all common sense to be honest. The class is points based which is great. The quizzes are take home and the tests always have extra questions for more credit. She just wants to see you do well.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She makes boring content interesting but expects everyone to participate when she asks questions which she does a lot. Takes attendance but makes a huge effort to know everyone's name. Is a little scary when in front of whole class but very nice and caring when 1 on 1. In person tests on scantron, final online tho

I would not recommend taking this professor. Attendance isn't mandatory but you must go to class to know about any assignments and due dates. She only discusses assignments in class, there is no rubric or instructions on D2L. Quizzes were online, but the assignments are a pain as she is a tough grader. She is also unreachable outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I do not recommend taking this professor. She seems to grade students based on personal bias rather than actual work quality. Many students have noticed unfair treatment, which is unacceptable. She does not teach effectively instead of explaining concepts, she expects students to figure everything out on their own.

Professor Bailey is really nice and very passionate about what she teaches and the class is often very enjoyable. She doesn't share lecture slides which is frustrating but pay very close attention to graphs because there are questions on the exam about them. She is heavy on participation so be ready to hear "What do you notice about this map?"
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Bailey is honestly great! Make sure you read the textbook because she calls on people in class to answer questions from the reading. There's a project for the semester, but if you work on it early, then it is so easy! Although attendance isn't mandatory, things you need to know for class don't get posted, so I would show up!

She was my favorite professor. Easy quizzes at home from the textbook and exams in person are easy. Her lectures are not shared so attendance is important. She is personable and fun to listen to. She made my 9 am fun to go to! She holds people accountable and teaches ways to be successful.

Gets off track and off on topics that have little to do with the lesson. Often there is too much time spent on common sense ideas. Reading the textbook is required, but very little of it is then gone over. Does not share slides, and much of the needed information is said rather than written down. Expects you to memorize every chart shown in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: loved this class. She is so nice. Explains amazingly, and is easy to understand. I advise you to read and study before class and quizzes. Exams are hard but studying more than a week before helps a lot. She takes care of her students not just academically, but in all ways. She becomes my favorite professor at TCU. She gives extra credit opportunity
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Ask questions during lecture, so read. Take advantage of extra credits given beginning of semester. There are reading quizzes due at the beginning of class when starting a new chapter. Exams are in-person and can be tricky as there are sometimes questions that go in-depth on graphs presented in class, so take notes while she goes over various data

Lectures were always engaging, and I found the material interesting. Online quizzes for every chapter, but they weren't difficult. The unit exams were sometimes frustrating because some questions would be over very specific data that was briefly mentioned rather than the application of what we actually learned regarding theories/terminology.

Professor Bailey was fun in class and accessible outside of class. The only kind of frustrating thing is that when class was cancelled she wouldn't tell the class, which I thought was super annoying and not necessary. Other than that, its just reading quizzes and four tests. pretty chill
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Bailey is an amazing professor who cares about her students. She is available outside of class. If you do the reading and take good lecture notes you will do fine. There are reading quizzes based on textbook material, 4 unit tests based on lecture material, and extra credit opportunities, and a cumulative final.

Don't have to go to class or have the textbook to get an A. The entire class is papers/"annotations" based on external scholarly resources. The final for me wasn't hard because I did annotations well. She's a chill, respectable, intelligent professor! I'm not liberal and passed with an A, just be able to back up your beliefs! Always willing to help
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Social Problems is an easy class until the end of the semester. I feel that you are a grader by the amount you participate and whether or not she likes you. If you have different views from the rest of the class be prepared to not finish with an A. If you are a liberal you should be fine!

She thinks her class is a lot harder than it actually is. You don't have  to go to class to get an A. Reading quizes are at home and online. One midterm taken at home as well. Final project was graded very harshly for most in my class. Offers tons of extra credit. Not a hard class, just hard to sit through when you could never go and get an A.

Professor Bailey was a great professor for Intro to Soci. Online reading quizzes, four unit tests, with an online final, all of which are multiple choice. Some test questions are a little tricky, asking for specific percentages on graphs discussed in class. However, if you put in the work, and take good notes, you can definitely get an A.

Professor Bailey expects a lot in terms of in-class participation, but quizzes and tests are all multiple choice, and quizzes are online. (we also had zero writing assignments or projects). If you show up, ask questions, TAKE NOTES, make quizlets, you will get a good grade. She also drops the 2 lowest quiz grades. I didn't dread going to class!

tests are inperson on paper but all info is straight from her lectures. she does not post her lectures so you have to come to class. textbook is provided. quizzes are open note online out of class. no homework other than quiz and reading. very easy. def recommend. she is super funny too

I have had a great experience with Professor Bailey so far this semester! Her lectures are very engaging and she lays out her expectations for the class on the first day. She offers many opportunities to earn extra credit. She is also accessible outside of class and goes out of her way to help you with issues that may not even relate to the class.

overall the class was alright. All the quizzes and tests were online and you didn't have to go to class. Personally I found myself dreading going to her class because sometimes I thought she was a little rude and in a bad mood. She wont round up at the end of the semester which sucks because her class grading is off points because of that I got a B
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved her class. She is so welcoming and I learned so much throughout the semester. Make sure to read the book and take notes and you will be fine! She is inspirational :)

I would recommend taking her intro to sociology class. The class structure is very simple; read the textbook chapter, take online quiz, come to lecture, repeat a few times and then take online unit exam.
