Her informative lectures and chapter quizzes greatly prepare you for the exams. If you put in the effort you can easily make an A in this class.
Very discussion based class. She allows for lots of open thinking and still gets through all material. Have to get a 94 to make an A, but very highly doable.

Prof Bailey is very knowledgeable about sociology she cares about what she is teaching. She is super funny and a little sassy. She makes class enjoyable and her personality makes the class much more interesting. I recommend taking her.

Prof Bailey is absolutely amazing! Attendance is encouraged but not required! I loved her Intro to Soci! It was very informative and the material was easily presented and she was also very easily accessible outside of class for questions! Definitely make sure to participate in class because she does give out extra credit for that!

Pretty easy since all the exams/quizzes are online and no lockdown browser but she's very sassy and kinda rude. I hate going to the class cause she's always in a bad mood it seems. If you need an easy A I'd say take it but it's a decent amount of work and I hate going to the classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I had her for Intro to Sociology and she was so well informed on the subject. class was once a week for a few hours, she took attendance but I never saw it affect my grade. Lecture heavy, she does her best to engage the students. weekly online quizzes and 4 online tests, which were pretty easy. a plus if participate when she asks questions.

interesting class. But very lecture heavy and will restate everything you were assigned to reads in textbook 2 weeks before. Only a midterm and a final project. Easy class, but you will most likely get bored a few weeks in. Grades are not clear in why you got the score.

Ive had the honor of having Bailey for Intro Soc and Social Problems. The reason I took both is because of how much I loved being in her class. She is hands down the best professor Ive ever had here! Such a caring and sweet woman! There were 10 question quizzes every week and a bunch of extra credit. She makes it so easy to get an A!

Professor Bailey is great! She makes class engaging. There is usually an online pre-class quiz once or twice a week. The readings are kind of long, but if you take in depth notes, the quizzes are not bad. Tests are online and not on lock-down browser. There is a ton of extra credit from the quizzes and tests too!

This second-level sociology class was extremely easy and it was overall very educating. Not a lot of assignments so they count much more but she is available for feedback! It was very fun to have her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is an overall great prof! She seems to really care about her students and is very understanding. She gives sooo many extra credit opportunities and none of her tests or quizzes are very hard at all. Her lectures are very interactive and interesting. Overall I really loved her!
SUPER EASY CLASS. Quizzes every week but you do them online at home and there is no lockdown browser. No homework either and only 4 unit test that you take at home.

Bailey is an amazing professor!! Book is mandatory but she sends a PDF link for it so it's free! You read about one chapter a week, there's a super easy 15 q quiz with e.c. every time. 4 Unit tests that are based on past quizzes and in-class lectures. She is funny and down to Earth and is easy to understand. Very accessible outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Bailey is amazing. The class is super easy, you just have to read the book. She gives so much extra credit, always has extra credit on all quizzes and papers. Attendance/participation was not mandatory bc of covid, and your grade is based on quizzes and tests, but they're pretty easy. TAKE THIS CLASS !

Professor Bailey is amazing, so much so that I am taking her other classes offered. Her lectures are interesting and most of the test comes from the lectures or previous quizzes. Super easy to get extra credit, almost every quiz has bonus and exams as well. Weekly quizzes over the chapter, but they are not difficult at all. Love her the most
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Ms. Bailey is a nice lady, but her lectures can get boring at times. The class period I took was long, so it was hard to focus the whole time. The class itself is super simple and easy to pass. Just read and take notes in class, and you'll do great!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Yes, you have to read the textbook for quizzes. Her lectures are not the most entertaining but you also need to attend those because the test will have questions that only come from her lectures. Also, you have activities you do randomly in class that you get a grade for. Overall, I would highly recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Bailey is rude. She talks to you as if you are stupid when asking questions to her. Office hours are early in the morning and she is not accessible after office hours. Often gets off-topic and does not talk about Sociology so it is hard to know what is on the test. Do not try to write an email to her, she will respond with one sentence.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Worst teacher I have ever had. Rude, does not allow for a make up of anything including participation even for illness or family death. Condescending and makes you feel uncomfortable speaking or answering questions--even though that is something you get graded on. Never take this teacher, I would give a -1 if I could.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Bailey was a great sociology professor. You have to do readings for weekly quizzes and very lecture heavy but she's so funny and makes the subject interesting with a lot of class discussion.

Professor Bailey is one of the best professors I've had so far. She is very funny and finds ways to make the material relatable. The tests are all multiple choice and there are weekly quizzes based on the textbook reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Bailey is honestly my favorite professor. She is so funny and make her classes fun. Her test and quizzes are pretty straight forward, you only need to study a little. Very easy B for sure but might have to study a little bit for an A. Would highly recommend her. She's the best.

Prof. Bailey is hands down one of the best professors at TCU. Her lectures are genuinely interesting and she is HILARIOUS (seriously she's amazing). We had really interesting discussions every class (it's not mandatory to speak up tho) and I learned SO much from her! Quizzes and tests are very straightforward and easy if you study a little!
He is a good teacher, but class was not interesting at all. Feel like he could have engaged with students more

Dr. Chico is very misunderstood. I have had him for multiple classes and have never received any low grades. He is very caring and will always be a good resource for you, offering to write recommendation letters and helping his students find internships. His class is entertaining and very easy.

Chico is willing to help you no matter what both in and out of the classroom. Don't worry about your grade, just take the class, go to it, and you will be fine! You will actually learn valuable insights. If you actually enjoy marketing, TAKE CHICO! He is iconic
It's so fun and chill, Chico loves his students and if you get to know him it will be worth it. everyone on his is DRAMA. plus it was easy.
He's got great connections but does not do a good job teaching. Class is not worth it
Stay away from him if you actually are wanting your moneys worth.

Loved him! You can tell he is genuinely passionate about teaching/marketing. We had a semester-long group project--he was a tough grader, but was also very reasonable and good about adjusting grades and talking through grades with students. Weekly quizzes and discussion posts on an online textbook. He's easy to reach and wants students to do well!

Do not take this class if you actually want to learn marketing or if you like life. He uses AI to grade everything (and I mean literally everything). Had to get projects/assignments regraded so many times because his AI program didn't grade it properly. Had about 10 friends take the class with me and all hated it. Trust me, do not take this class.

Chico is great at marketing and passionate. He is not meant to teach. His grading criteria for the group project is unclear and graded harshly. He wants to push you to be industry ready but can't offer clear instruction on how to do so. Advocate for your grade if you have to take him. Everything else is easy but take the project seriously.

Chico was great for marketing, I think he can get a little carried away with non related stuff sometimes but he really does mean well. I would take this class again, just go to class and you should be fine, the tests won't be challenging as long as you go to class and pay attention.
I dreaded coming to this class everyday. Very dry speaker and cares more about himself then the students.
He grades very very tough. Cool guy that seems to care a lot about what he does, but cannot teach to save his life.

DO NOT TAKE HIM! Listen, Chico is passionate about marketing (and good at what he does) BUT he does not need to be a professor. He is an insanely tough grader on the group project. The instructions are too vague.
Avoid him at all costs
I really enjoyed taking Professor Chicotsky's class, he had very engaging lectures, he definitely cares for his students, and would get back to you quickly over email.

He was positive and clearly cares about his students. Brought energy to each class and tried to make the material engaging. I felt like much of the course relied more on deductive reasoning/ common sense rather than structured learning. The project was graded harshly, & because many of us are not business majors, the expectations felt unrealistic.

He had a lot of critiques from prior years. Since the start of the year he has been adamant about fixing what people did not like and being better. Lectures are engaging and he has great knowledge and expertise. He grades hard on the project but rationalizes it by wanting us to be able to use it for our portfolios. He cares about his students a lot

Very passionate about marketing and wants his students to succeed. He made the lectures interesting so you stay engaged and there was homework but it wasn't heavy. He is a tough grader when it came to the group project but overall a good class that was manageable. Brings really good guest speakers and applies a lot of his teachings to real life.

Chico was great I enjoyed Marketing the most out of all my classes I had this semester If you're looking for something more than just a marketing credit he's the guy has great connections to the business world as well.

I don't know why he doesn't have great reviews-- he has been one of my favorite teachers if not my favorite at TCU. His tests are pretty easy and the only big project is a group one and its kind of fun to do. I really reccomend taking him he really is great!!!

Don't take his class. He is unavailable to his students, takes weeks to respond to emails, and grades very harshly. For a project gave everyone in the class a 70, but he expected us to do things on the project that he did not teach, nor was on the rubric. He graded harshly and took off points on things that were correct. Lazy yet harsh grader.

He just told us in class to go and write a review so that people would think he's not crazy. Ummm. Easy assignments because he uses AI to grade everything except the group project which will make or break your grade because he is an insane critiquer. His only instructions were on a doc and he didn't teach us anything related to the group project.
Dr. Chico was a nice professor who was flexible with deadlines.

Dr Chico was one of the most passionate and enjoyable professors I have had at TCU. He has a lot of knowledge from his crazy life experiences and loves to share them during class. The only thing I wish was changed was the toughness of grading. He gives tons of feedback but does not grade fair enough after changes according to his feedback are made.

Chico knows his rate my professor is bad and he is actively trying to be a better/easier teacher. He was super nice and helpful, and his first exam was super easy. Gave study guides and even filled them out sometimes. Semester long project but not too hard. short quiz and discussion post due before class once a week but again, not too hard.

Terrible professor. Had favorites, the class was a joke, did not show any enthusiasm about actual marketing concepts. Very disappointed, was so excited about this class but would ramble about his own life. Brought in ponzi scheme speakers, that always talked about nothing. He talked ALOT about NOTHING. The presentation of the semester was a joke!!!
One of TCU's worst hires. He would often just ramble about random things and did not teach any marketing I was hoping for.
He is a great professor who genuinely care abouts his students. His quizzes and tests are super easy and he lets you use AI for lots of different things.

The lectures could've been better, but the voluntary semester project was one of the most valuable things I've done in a class setting. Great team experience, challenging but doable, and it's been helping me stand out during recruitment! Highly recommend. The overall class is fairly easy as long as you read. I feel that Chico wants us to succeed.

I had heard great things about his class going in, and he seemed like he was passionate. However, he changed his class so that the exams are comprised of random information from other peoples' group projects. He tried to course correct because the class was too easy, and now it's hard in the worst possible way because it's straight-up unpredictable

I took Chicos class this spring semester and was extremely upset with the way he constructed it. I thought I would come in and learn how to apply marketing, but half the time it is our own classmates teaching who don't know anything. Guest lectures were hit or miss, and the class could've all been done at home.

Even though the class is easy, his lecture style is very hard to follow. Extremely all over the place with copy and paste slides. I did not learn much and was hoping for a more engaging experience. I hope TCU reconsiders someone else because Chico is clearly not the right one for this class. Great businessman, terrible professor

Was not a fan of how he taught the class, especially with his slides. Often went on to talk about things completely different from chapters and ranted. Class could've been done virtually and learned on my own. Very upsetting considering we pay so much for “top tier” professors.
Attendance is only mandatory on guest speaker days. Pretty lackluster lectures I could've learned on my own. As long as you do the work the class is easy, but you learn nothing.

Actually somewhat surprised by the negative feedback from other students, but I do understand. This is a tough neeley core class. Unlike others, you actually do have to learn and pay attention. I will admit, either Chico is incredibly accomplished or is capping, lol. HOWEVER you will really have to work to earn above a B,B+  The class was helpful
Just a bad class with a professor who doesn't care. The only Neeley class I dreaded going to because of his lectures. Drags on the class for long periods of time.

He is a really nice guy who tries hard, but I just don't think has the skill to teach such a large class. He makes himself unavailable to many students, which is why no one gets to know him. Tests are easy if you study for them. Well suited for business, but not teaching. Very sad
His nickname should be called “The Midnight Sender” because he would send out emails extremely late at night and expect us to read them. Absolutely ridiculous. Good luck underclassmen with him.

1 Group Project + presentation with a couple tests. That's not the issue, its the professor. I could have taken the tests and done the presentation without showing up to a single lecture. Professor Chicotsky should have no place in Neeley as teacher. The guest speakers could have taught the class better. Extremely frustrating for a nice guy.

So glad to be done with this class. He cannot explain anything clearly and overcomplicates the easy topics. Truly ridiculous how Neeley students have to pay extra credit for his class. Waste of time and money.

I gave Chico a 2, but my review got taken down, so now he gets a 1. He's a good dude, but a horrible teacher. He belongs in the real world, not in a classroom. He uses overly ambiguous words that don't make sense. I didn't learn a thing. Genuinely, I don't know anything about marketing after taking this class. He's the only option, so good luck.

I used the tag "Hilarious" and not because I'm tickled pink. What's also hilarious is the four consecutive 5-star reviews you see if you scroll down... strange. Newsflash: Don't say the class isn't mandatory but then email us at midnight requiring us to come with questions for those poor guest speakers. It's desperate.
Easy to get a grade but you will learn nothing with his rambling. Very dry class that get tedious with no actual marketing involved. TCU needs to find a new professor

I did not wear my seat belt when I was driving to this class everyday, in hopes that if i was flung from my car seat, I at least would not have to endure his class for that day. This describes this class. 

Thanks :)
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I won't say much in the hopes that this doesn't get taken down like many of the other bad reviews have. I'll just say I apologize in advance if you have to take this class. This class should be called memorization management or guest speaker yap session management. (Re upload #3, every time you take this down Chico, I'll bring it back)

Esoteric language without much substance in the class. You won't learn much in this class, except for how to make simple concepts seem complicated. Unless you want to be a morally corrupt consultant, I wouldn't suggest putting this class off and hoping TCU finds another marketing professor.

This class is not well structured and all over the place. You learn nothing because half the time he brings in guest speakers since he is incapable of teaching himself. TA's do most of the work. Optional project at the end which is a lot of work and lands you a mid-tier internship. Not worth it

3 in-class, lockdown tests worth 65% of your grade. Small easy group project-15%. You can opt to do a big group project to replace the 2nd and final test, it's a LOT of work, but you pick your group and you learn more from it. Class not mandatory unless there's a guest speaker, but there are a lot of guest speakers and you get last minute notice.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Terrible way to teach this class in a 200+ lecture hall. Exams were difficult. Optional project to be exempt from Exam 2 and the Final.

This is definitely not a fun class. His lectures are so dry and unappealing, which is why he has to bring in guests because he can't teach himself. Gets repetitive towards the end. Sad because he seems successful, but doesn't know his way with students.

Worst course I have taken at TCU. Chico doesn't teach at all, he just blabbers about himself and let's other people lecture. His tests aren't good, and he doesn't round anything ever. Not a hard class, but Chico makes it unbearable.

Professor Chico doesn't teach a lot because there's a lot of guest speakers and the simulation and exams are hard for no reason. If you're interested in marketing, do the project because you'll learn a lot and it's a lot easier than the exams.

Class is a waste of time because half the time it's guest speakers, then half the time you are not required to show up. I wish he would put more effort into the actual lectures because this could be a really interesting class.

Very personable guy, just doesn't teach. Guest speakers come almost every class and you don't learn anything but you have to come or you get a grade deduction. Wish there was another professor that teaches this course.

Chico is a great guy, very personable, but he is not a good teacher. Class mainly consists of group presentations and guest speakers. He spends less than 20 minutes per class actually teaching. He also makes it clear to not contact him directly, and he doesn't offer extra credit and refuses to round up a grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Chicotsky's guest lectures offer valuable insights into marketing levels, benefiting both classroom and real-world applications. I highly recommend the Market Research Project, which enhances understanding and allows you to opt out of the Mid-term and Final exams. It requires effort and can be enjoyable with the right group. Great class!

Mr.Chicotsky is the most passionate teacher I've ever had. He truly cares about what he teaches and wants the best for his students.His D2L and lectures are very organized and straightforward. He is easily available outside of class and is very caring. Highly recommend taking advantage of the extra opportunities he offers! 100% TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN!

Attendance was only required some days, and he usually canceled class before breaks. The first test was easy, then got harder, but overall, the class isn't too difficult and there's not much work. Group project was graded easily. Simulations are repetitive but manageable. He's very supportive of his students and is always willing to help.

The only reason kids rate him badly is because he makes the students work hard for a good grade. He is so smart, and is so willing to always help if needed. He is very well connected, and if you need any help, he is an awesome resource. Take him!!!

There's one big group presentation with exams mixed in. The lectures get extremely boring 2 weeks in and he loves to talk about random topics. Bad news is he is the only professor and you have to take him. Get ready to fall asleep.
He seems very knowledgeable about marketing, but is a terrible teacher. Does not know how to structure a lecture and teaching is just not his thing. Only a few exams so make sure do good on them.
Lecture style. Attendance is sometimes nessesary sometimes not. Exams are proctored. Easy going class. Just rlly got to study for the exams cause thats honestly all ur graded on.

He gives a marketing "simulation" during the semester that is not clear at all. Can really lower your grade if you don't make the right decisions. He doesn't even know how to give us advice and always says "Email Stukent if you have any questions." Very frustrating for a professor who doesn't know the material he's assigning to students.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you want someone who has a PhD about how to talk about nonsense, he is the perfect professor for you.

For a guy who is big about branding, his personal brand seems to be very low. The class is so bad, the guest lectures are somewhat interesting. The test are not too bad, it is just the worlds most boring class. I swear he just gets on stage and word salads. Unfortunately he is the only teacher. He seems like a good guy outside of class however.
Awful prof, awful lectures, exam questions aren't even about marketing. Saved by a few interesting guest speakers, but you will be tested on them. Unfortunately you cannot avoid him.
While I agree he is not the best teacher, the class itself is super easy. As long as you do the assigned work and pay attention, you will get an A. Exams are a piece of cake.

This class is completely optional and only requires you to attend during guest lectures. Dr. Chico is nice, but this class needs a replacement. Seems like he barely puts in any effort and is more focused on trying to hire people for the sales center instead of teaching the class.
This is going to be a loooooong semester. I kept pushing off this class until I finally had to take it.
Super chill compared to what everyone said. Only have to show up to class for a guest speaker. I still go to his regular lectures, but they are extremely dry and bland. Workload is manageable.
Class is a big waste of money. Easy, but makes you pay for textbooks you barely use.

Don't listen to the bad reviews. Chico is a great professor who truly cares for his students. Sometimes the lectures are boring but he does everything he can to relate marketing to the real world and brings in numerous impressive guest speakers. Chico wants his students to do well and provides countless resources for sucess in and out of the class.

Chico is a great professor that genuinely cares for his students and wants them to succeed. He is very adaptable and often sought feedback from students on how to improve the class. The workload is very manageable and he truly made this class as easy as possible

Don't understand the bad reviews. A very nice guy who cares for his students and wants them to succeed. He listens to feedback given from students and actually uses it to improve his class. Super understanding and very straightforward on what is expected with assignments. I thought he was a great professor with lots of outside knowledge.
He is not the best professor. Did bring in a lot of good speakers who provided good info about business overall. Chico is a professional rambler and rants about nonsense.

Maybe it was just me, but I could not stand the way he ran the class. Sits back and makes students teach the class instead. Then will come up and ramble for the rest of class. I hope there is consideration about how to make this class more effective for students.

Great guy, he really loves TCU and Neeley students he has a lot of energy but having 200 people doesn't help with this class. He changes A LOT there is only 1 group presentation which isn't bad, and my favorite part was that he brough amazing people to come speak to us about their companies and he is just such as character. Great guy!

2 exams (midterm and final) that are straightforward. He seems fun outside of the classroom, but does not know how to structure a large lecture hall. Hard to create a relationship with him because he ignores email and makes TA's respond.
Class is very easy, but his lectures are straight misery. I don't know many times I counted the tiles on the wall when he was talking about random topics.
I changed my major out of marketing because he made this class so miserable.

I really hope that Neeley can adjust this class or try a new professor. Great guy, but just don't think he is meant to teach in a large lecture setting. The class is easy work, but his lectures are all over the place.

Professor Chico was an awesome teacher. He is a generous grader and a kind person. He cares so much about his students and has a lot of valuable insight. I feel prepared from this class. So many grades put into the grade book so it all averages out well. Midterm was so easy, final will be harder. Hope he will take away the big group project.

The class is easy if you do the work. The lectures are SO BORING and impossible to follow. There are group presentations by different groups every day, giving you the material. He doesn't necessarily TEACH the material as much as he just regurgitates what is said in the group presentations. Upset that I spend tuition for other students to teach me.

Better Professor for more advanced marketing courses. Lots of fluff and not the most organized class. Much more Quantitative than Qualitative when it comes to grading. I don't feel the best about him and my opinion is very neutral but i think that has to do a lot more with the class size being so large.

Marketing isn't my fancy, but I think he is willing to adapt to student feedback. Show up, do the work and you will get an A. Class sometimes feels long, but the material is super basic. Was not blown away with his teaching in any way, but it is manageable to sit through.

For an intro marketing class, he is decent. I think he would be a great teacher for upper level classes, but as an intro teacher, he is not the best. Lectures are just repeating from the textbook. No organization and drags the class on forever.

One group project/presentation with easy homework every class. He's a cool guy, but just not my style. Seems like he is always bragging about nonsense, but he is very knowledgable and has good connection.

Chico is a great professor that tries to make class fun and engaging and has a lot of real world insight. He is funny and gets a lot of cool guest speakers. He is a good teacher and the homework isn't hard and doesn't take that long. There is a big group project but it is not that bad.
Its not that bad. One group project, quizzes after class. Easy to get an A

The rater who said Chico was narcissistic does NOT know how to use that word in context, nor do they know the definition. Chico is a fantastic professor who cares so much about the success of his students. People need to stop complaining and being lazy - we go to a great business school.
Don't love him, but don't hate him. He's chill and does assign pointless tasks, but I guess that's his job. Quiz every day after class but if you show up he gives you the answers.

Really cool dude who really cares about his students. It seems like it's a lot of work each week but it's really not and people are over stating how much it truly is. Easy A- if you just do the work and come to class.

This class is easy if you just do his quizzes and work. Lectures can be super boring, but sometimes he brings in speakers. I feel if the class were smaller, it would be super interesting. He changes the class each semester.

Marketing is mostly common sense so naturally the class is easy. His lectures are pointless as he tends to ramble on about something that is not pertinent to the lecture. He brings in some cool speakers but they usually don't have anything to do with the material. Assigns pointless work after every class along with a quiz. Sadly the only option.
This class has potential but with his style, it will never be done. Chill dude, but lectures are pointless. I learned more from the book then his hour long ranting.

I adore Chico. He goes above & beyond for his students by bringing in incredible guest speakers and always being open and available to further our professional development in any way he can. He is truly so selfless! It breaks my heart that people are taking his effort & true passion for his students for granted... He is the best! #JusticeForChico!

Chico is getting way too much hate. He is so impressive and genuinely wants to give us good insights. His style of teaching may not be for everyone, but getting an A in the class is 100% achievable. He brings in cool guest speakers and is flexible with changing project criteria and is understanding of student needs. #JusticeForChico
There are the good and bad of him. Mostly bad. He has had some good speakers come in, but other than that, nothing about this class is fun. His lectures are just him going off on a tangent.

Chico is a nice guy and I think he genuinely cares about students. That being said, his lectures often derail in to personal stories and anecdotal advice that is honestly not always good advice. The work in his class is tedious but he is an easier grader than he lets on to be when it comes to the group project.
Lectures seemed to go on and on and on with his rambling. Makes you spend a ridiculous amount of money on materials you barely use in class and is a waste of time.

Chico is a professor who brings a ton of real-world experience to the classroom. He can ramble during his lectures which makes it unbearable at times. Studying the textbook will make the exams fairly easy. He does require attendance which is exhibited by making us take a picture at the beginning and end of class. Overall, I felt I learned a lot.

Attendance 100% mandatory with 2 photos at the beginning and end of class - only 1 absence grade is dropped. Midterm and final are purely textbook material but can still be tricky despite studying. He talks for all 1.5 hours of class but you still don't learn much. Project can be graded harshly but definitely a useful experience overall.

Class is a whole waste of money. I couldn't stand how he made it literally impossible to contact him unless you sprinted up to the classroom after lecture. Beware of the syllabus quiz as well. That thing took me forever.

Not my favorite class, but definitely pretty easy. Class is around 100 kids and would definitely benefit more if we had smaller sections. Nice professor, but makes you take a selfie each class as proof of attendance.
Class is mostly common sense but there no clear grading guidelines at all. TAs were not helpful when I asked questions about the group project.

Has great connections in the business world, but is useless as a professor. No grading guidelines and DOES NOT provide any help at all. Unfortunately the only professor for this class. Feel bad for future students.

Really nice guy, but did not like this class at all. The lecture information seemed irrelevant. The attendance policy was strict and you had to take a selfie everyday. The grading and guidlines were very unclear for the project and you would get points off for very small things. The midterm and final were not easy.

Very cool guy with good stories that are very inspirational but extremely confused the majority of the class. Very difficult to know what he wants on the intervals and the final/midterm are stuff we have barley talked about in class.

It was really hard to do well in this class. He is SUPER picky on the intervals which should've weighed more than they did for how he graded them. He doesn't prepare you well for the exams either. Chico's teaching style would probably be better for only upper-levels like seniors and graduate students than sophomores and some freshmen.

Requires attendance which is annoying considering he just talks about his success or has his friends come in and speak and nothing from it is on the exams or relevant to coursework. The group project is way too overwhelming for a core class, and has no little criteria. The textbook load is super expensive and is hardly used, fairly suspicious.

This class is required for pretty much every business major as far as I'm concerned which is a huge shame. Brandon is an arrogant professor who loves talking about his success. The class itself is pretty easy and easy to get good grades on. This was the first semester where he gave a midterm and final which were both free points. Overall, painful.
Class is fairly easy, but is a waste of money. Have to pay $200 for the textbooks alone. Also is impossible to reach Professor through email.

Loves to talk. Talks the entire class and nothing he says is on the tests. Semester long group project that is extremely time consuming and overwhelming. Constantly says to submit "business work" and not school work, but provides NO clear grading criteria. EXTREMELY picky grader and will take off for the way you worded something
Chico is super nice. However, there is not a clear grading criteria for the group project. Also make you take a selfie for attendance, which can be annoying.

Interesting for sure. Attendance check-in's were through selfies at the start/end of each class. This was the first semester Chico gave a midterm/final, but they were relatively easy if you read the book. The main grade for this class is based on the semester-long group project. Tough grader but gives in if you set up time to talk outside of class.

Lectures have nothing to do with the project or assignments. Good guy, but he just rambles on and on and has no grading criteria whatsoever. Impossible to contact because he makes you talk to the TAs.

Favorite professor I have ever taken. If you're an aspiring entrepreneur or very interested in business I would recommend. Relevant group project that you can put on resume and really teaches you how to market and perform market research. Great class, mostly everyone gets As

Dr. Chico is extremely enthusiastic and highly involved with his students. He brings a great energy to the classroom and is very accommodating. The class is based on one group project, but he is a great resource to use with whatever issue you run into.

As a marketing major, I did not get much out of this course and it caused me to want to switch majors. You will spend so much money on textbooks and have to pay $100 to give ideas to a company seeking marketing advice??? Makes no sense. Lectures are random and nothing correlates. I hated the group project. No guidance and very harsh on grading.

You have to spend so much money on websites and books to use. You pretty much have to guess your way through every quiz, and he gives little guidance on the semester long group project. He grades very harshly and is extremely nit-picky, for example my group got points taken off because he didn't like the color we choose for our presentation.

Don't take this professor unless you want to guess your way through the semester-long project with no guidance  and forced to use your own judgment and then graded harshly on expectations that were never given.

I love professor Chico, he is my favorite professor at TCU. His attendance is mandatory but he makes class fun. There are no tests just some quizzes related to readings we had. The whole class is basically just one big project all semester long, but since it's in groups it is not hard. He brings in guest speakers and wants all students to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Attendance is technically mandatory but you can check in and not go. Majority of the grade is based on a semester long group project with multiple deliverables with huge groups up to 8 people. He gives vague feedback and horrible instruction. Also 5% of your grade is paying 190$ so that you can do 3 quizzes in two textbooks one of which he wrote.

He is very smart and knows what he's doing. The main part of the class is the group assignment. If you have a good group and communicate well, you will get a good grade. Classes normally include a 15-minute lecture, and hour-long inspirational speech on Professor Chico's business experienes, and time to work with your group on the project.
There are so many grades, to begin with. He releases feedback so slowly and isn't responsive. His intervals are graded harshly. Definitely not as easy as everyone else thought it to be.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Attendance is mandatory but lectures are engaging and he has lots of cool guest speakers. All of the weekly assignments are super easy and the rest of your grade is the group project. As long as you follow examples you will do well on that part of the class. He loves networking so definitely make an effort to build a relationship and hell love that
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is an entertaining lecturer and no tests. Just a group project that is applicable to real life. He will sometimes bring in fun guest speakers. Take this class with your friends and it is really fun/easy. However you do have to spend $100 to pay a group instead of a textbook which is annoying.

Professor Chico's experience in the field makes his lectures so engaging and insightful. The individual weekly workload is manageable, and the semester long project is too as long as your group doesn't save all the work for the end. He also provides lot of networking opportunities so take advantage of connecting with the guest speakers!

I'm only giving this a bad grade because for an unexplained reason he tanked a lot of people's grades on a marketing simulation that was supposed to be easy points and inputted it the day of the final. My grade dropped 9% despite working really hard and there was zero explanation as to why so many people failed it.

Dr. Chicotsky's classes are cool - they're not traditional college classes where you read a book and take tests. Classes are him giving ted talk-style stories of his crazy life. The books are written by actual businesspeople that you'd read in your spare time, not 200$ textbooks.That said it's not a blow-off class, there are a lot of projects.

Chicotsky is a nice guy and all, but there are so many grades, to begin with. He releases feedback so slowly and isn't that responsive (I know he's a busy one). His intervals are graded harshly because an expert guy grades it and expects students to be of "industry standard." Definitely not as easy as everyone else thought to be.

Dr. Chicotsky is an amazing lecturer. For this class, you will most likely work in groups. Main grades are 5 "intervals", or marketing brief, final pitch, some online quizzes that are on quizlet, marketing simulation (around 100$ total), participation (graded mainly on in-class assignments). You will work with real-life clients, but overall, easy.

Dr. Chicotsky is one of the best professors Ive had the privilege of taking at TCU. He cares deeply for his students and will go to great lengths to help you succeed. In addition, its clear that your professional success is one of his top priorities. I cannot recommend his class enough. Hes a stand up guy and incredibly impressive.

Professor Curtis is an amazing professor who cares deeply about his students. His lectures are interesting, and he creates other examples of the concepts on the slides. He creates a mock scenario to help you understand everything in a trial, which is fun and engaging. Great person, and I would absolutely take him again.

Professor Curtis is genuinely a wonderful instructor. You can tell he really cares for his students and the material he teaches. His lectures are very engaging, and class participation is encouraged. I have taken 2 of Professor Curtis's classes and have enjoyed every minute of them!

Professor Curtis is very informed on the law and the criminal justice process. You'll learn how the process works in-depth through his powerpoints, lectures and guest speakers. He notes when you participate, and those marks turn into points he'll add to your final grade. Tests are thorough and specific. Super fun, chill class.

participating matters in this class, thankfully he makes it super easy and hes a great guy. you can tell he really cares about his students and what he teaches. he assigns a but but honestly as long as you go to class and are an active participate you wont need it. I did get it but I would have done the same whit it
Absolutely loved this professor. He has a lot of experience and is very smart. Class was genuinely interesting and easy to pay attention in. Can't recommend him enough!
Amazing professor. His class is very fun and engaging. TAKE HIM!

10/10 would invite this guy to my family Christmas. Such a good person and so enjoyable in class. He will work with you on anything and gives out TONS of "free passes" for homework. I got like four. ABSOLUTELY TAKE HIM!

Great guy and great professor. His Critical Issues in Crime and Justice class is really easy. If you go to the class and turn in participation point assignments every week you're already at like 40% of your grade. The rest is papers which he grades very easily and 2 exams which are very straight forward. Definitely recommend this class.
Take him. I took him twice and he is by far the best professor I have ever had. His class is easy because he has such a great teaching style. Super cool and caring guy. Take his classes if you can.

Professor Curtis is absolutely the best professor at TCU. His background as being both a criminal defense lawyer and prosecutor makes for very interesting class discussions. He is so kind, funny, and a very lenient professor overall. Definitely take him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Curtis is an amazing professor who is very enthusiastic and successful. You can tell he truly cares about CRJ and his lectures are very engaging. He is very approachable and engages with the class. Graded by 2 papers and 2 exams mostly, all of which are very manageable. Definitely recommend!

Professor Curtis takes time to truly hear out all of his Students. Professor Curtis created a stress-free class and environment throughout the course. I learned a lot about the class through his 30+ years in the CJ field. Highly recommend taking this class.

He is very enthusiastic about his teaching, and it keeps everyone engaged. Your grade is based on tests and labs, but it is hard to do badly. His study guides are detailed and clear. Even if science isn't your thing, his class is fun to sit in and you always learn something new.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is very enthusiastic about his teaching. He is always making sure the class understands what he is saying. He gives detailed study guides, and if it is not on the study guide, then it is not on the test. This course grade is solely based on tests and labs, but it is still hard to get a bad grade.

I took Dr.Bonde for Physics I and although the material is challenging, he was able to explain topics well. Your grade in the class is based on 3 exams and a final, yet he explains common mistakes in class and gives partial credit on exams. He is easily available outside of class with office hours/email. Great guy and really cares about students!
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing professor who is so caring and available for all his students, however very test heavy class.

I took Dr. Bonde for Phys I, and he is a great and easy professor. His lectures are clear and engaging as he incorporates relevant applications of the lessons, and the problems worked in class are exactly the same as on the test. He also tells you what concepts he will ask on the exam, so you know exactly what chapters/problems to use for studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I think hes the best intro physics teacher you can take. You CANNOT miss lectures. He explains how to solve every problem, and common mistakes people make. Also posts a lot of extra practice, and even has a youtube where he solves many for you. Physics is harder than i thought it would be, but extra credit given on the final allowed me to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved this class but if you're not a good test taker absolutely do not take it! Your entire grade is only from 3 short response exams and the cumulative final. Also don't take if you don't wanna go to class, because everything he writes on the board is what you need to study for those exams, so if you miss it you're screwed. He's super nice tho!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE!!! Does not give back exams so you dont know what you got wrong. Lectures are very confusing and there will be material on exams that is never discussed in class. 3 exams and each exam is on a month and a half of class notes with no study guides. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS !!! I had this professor for intro to astronomy which is supposed to be an easy class. He bases your grade off of 3 exams and the final which is also cumulative. His exams are 30 short answer questions and he does not give an actual study guide. I RECOMMEND NOT TAKING THIS CLASS !!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great person as an individual, but his teaching did not match the level of the class. He taught it as if students had extensive knowledge on physics already. Some explanation was given for new topics but a lot of it requires outside resources and clarification. Not many resources in class for studying or review.

DO NOT TAKE THIS. He is not a very nice guy and his course is very hard. Has a no phone or electronics policy so only paper notes. Grades very hard and the only grades are tests. Avoid this course at all costs!!!!

Claims that all notes he write will be on the exam which is partially true, however on exams there is content he doesn't write. if he teaches multiple classes they each get different notes so studying for his exams can be worrying because you don't know exactly what to study. He is nice and approachable so if his notes aren't clear you can ask him.

Bonde was great, a really caring guy and would give great lectures. I will say tests are a bit difficult if you have a hard time memorizing/studying but everything is off the board. Tests are all open ended but usually pretty straight forward. Cool guy would take again, unless your a bad tester.

love Dr.Bonde! took him for cosmic origins + intro astronomy—both were great. super helpful in office hours and gave me life advice when I was undecided about my major. told me to each out if i needed more advice, and still says hi when he sees me! Exams are straight from the board, so if he says it's important, study it! Flashcards helped a lot.
Great lectures, decently easy tests, just an all around awesome guy. I highly recommend Bonde.

I don't know why he has so many low reviews, but he is an amazing professor. If you pay attention and study a decent amount your golden. His tests are THE EXACT THING he writes on the board, no tricks. He is a very good lecturer too, keeps you very entertained!!

Just go to lectures and pay attention and you're all set. Lectures are engaging so it's not hard. He doesn't do +\- so if you get above a 95 in the class or so he lets you opt out of the final. Dr. Bonde is the goat

Very interesting class and topic and he's passionate about it, but your grade is based solely on 3 (20-30 short answer question) tests + 1 (40 question) cumulative final. I studied 12+ hours for each test and would barely get a decent grade. If you're not a good test taker, don't take this class.

Teaches an Introduction Course but grades like you're a 4th year graduating in Astronomy. This isn't an intro course by any means. I don't recommend taking his class. The classes are lecture heavy and everything rides on 3 Exams + 1 Cumulative. So if you don't do well on one you might as well drop the class if you don't want a B or anything lower.

All of the content on our 3 exams + Final is taken directly from his whiteboard notes during lectures. if you copy them down word-for-word, ask for clarification on a few weird definitions, and study to memorize the content (quizlet is 100% recommended), you'll get an A in this class. If you don't put in the work, you won't get the grade you want.

This class was so hard for no reason. I took his intro to astronomy class for one of my core credits and had to P/NC it. He is such a tough grader despite all his test being short answer response, and your grade all comes from just 3 test and a final. I would study 10+ hours for all of his exams and would get lucky if I got a decent grade.

Dr. Bonde is a very caring and knowledgeable professor. Attendance is not mandatory, but you need to show up to class to take the necessary notes to pass the tests. Each test is around 30 short answer questions, but he gives extra credit questions to make this more manageable. If you study, you will get a good grade in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Bonde is the GOAT. He is very nice and caring. His class inst easy but can be if you study and watch his example videos. He will help you out if you ask. Take him if you are a engineer for the physics classes. Great guy.

This class is not the right fit for you if you need General Physics. TAKE ANOTHER TEACHER!!!! There are only 4 regular exams, 1 final exam, and a lab grade for the semester. If you fail more than 2, you are screwed. He does offer office hours that have been helpful at times, but overall not the best professor I've taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Our whole grade for physics 1 came from 4 exams and a cumulative final. I did awful on the first 2 tests and dropped. Prior to dropping, I went to office hours so many times and he was very little help. He has been my least favorite teacher at TCU so far.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Cosmic Origins is a hard class, he doesn't take attendance but you should go to class as his notes are materials for all the exams. There are 4 exams, 5 quizzes and lab. Exams are hard and you really have to put in efforts and learn a lot by heart. Quizzes are based on assigned readings and labs aren't so hard. Good class if you're hard-working!

This is by far the worst class I have ever taken! This is a level 1, course and he treats it like everyone is senior astronomy majors. All exams are free response and impossible to prepare for. He also is not accommodating to anything life throws your way. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS and DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!!!

Mr. Bonde is so sweet and nice, but this class was so hard. The only grades you receive in this class are 4 tests and lab grades. The tests are 30 short answer questions, no multiple choice or extra credit. He is a very tough grader as well. I would not take this class again because I did not like the grading and I did not think it was fair.

Dr. Bonde is not a considerate professor. Do not take him. The lectures are long and boring and I didn't get anything out of them. The tests are long and you have to rush through them to finish. I would avoid this class at all costs.

Loved having Dr. Bonde! Everything you need to know is covered in the lectures, and if not, he provides textbook readings and articles as supplemental material for exams. He was always engaging in lecture and made several movie references that I thought were entertaining. He provides extra questions on exams to boost points too!

Dr. Bonde tries to make the course entertaining, and his lectures are engaging. He does not allow any electronics in his class. His tests are very tough. The 4 exams count for your entire grade. Exams are about 50 questions ALL SHORT ANSWER. When grading he does not provide information on what you did wrong.

Dr. Bonde is a nice guy however, this class was extremely difficult. I never missed class, took notes on everything he wrote on the board, and studied 15+ hrs for every test to get a low B/high C on them. No hw or extra assignments so your only grades come from the 3 exams and final (plus your lab grade). Would not recommend for core credit.

Do not take this class if you have no prior knowledge of astronomy. Very vague teacher with vague test outlines and lectures, but he still expects you to know exact and specific details about topics. Review guides are not helpful at all. Slowest grader I have ever had, and does not like if you email him asking about your grades.

Very few grades in the grade book. Unwilling to give any extra credit, homework, quizzes, etc. He only gives 3 tests throughout the semester in addition to one exam, and they are all short answer. If you do not understand the basics of astronomy before this class it will be very difficult for you. I had to P/NC this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tests are all short answer, about 35 short answer questions must be answered in only 50 minutes. Covers so much material in lectures and does not explain much if you don't have prior knowledge in astronomy. Very unclear about what is on exams. You will be able to survive this class with this professor but other professors are so much easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is an incredible professor who always brings energy and passion to class. Tests are relatively easy, but you HAVE to take notes on literally everything he writes down on the board. He will assign some reading but there is usually only one question from them. I never did the reading and always got above a 95 on each test.

If the test tells you to go south, you better not go southwest. It doesn't matter if you got the answer correct in his test, he wants you to explain the question as if a kindergarten would understand. question btw. He tells you to write short answer and you don't need to be specific but trust me, be VERY SPECIFIC.
Only get graded based off tests and lab. No homework. Study guides are very vague and there is stuff on the test that is not on the study guide. Very difficult class with not much teacher help.

I loved Bonde! Does his best to make lectures funny/engaging and he really cares about his students. I was intimidated by the class at first because the grade is made up of only 3 tests, the final, and the lab. But, the tests are not that difficult if you go to all of the lectures and take good notes.

Easy A if you are actually willing to try. All the tests are written responses but if you just study the notes from class well you should be fine. However, you do have to really study and basically memorize the notes because the only grades are 3 exams and a final plus your lab grade. Go to his office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's an amazing professor, his tests are open-ended but he gives extra questions to give room for extra credit. The tests should be easy if you study the notes he gives you. He is very enthusiastic about astronomy and his lectures are interesting and engaging.
The tests, on the other hand, are difficult. He frequently includes questions that we did not cover in class, but he also includes additional test questions so you can get a few wrong.

If you aren't willing to take notes on paper, avoid Bonde (and most of the Astro department, lol.) Otherwise, he is a great professor. He explains the content clearly, meaning good notes = good grades. 4 Exams worth 20% each and Lab makes up the other 20%. Material is very interesting which makes this class very fun.

Dr. Bonde is a really cool and nice person. However, I didn't like his teaching style, as he went very quickly through the example problems and at times left everyone confused. He only went through the easy problems in lecture and left the harder ones for the homework. Also, get ready to wait a while before getting any grades back.

The only reason I do good in this class because I to learn about the universe and you will learn a lot. The material is heavy. No electrical device in class, 5 HW quizzes, 3 test and the final exam is cumulative. Exam has 25 question all short answers but he has extra credit in every exam. LOTS OF MEMORIZATION. Take good note or fail

I took Dr. Bonde's Energy class and it was great. 

There is no technology allowed (except maybe an iPad to take notes if you ask). No homework at all, just make sure you take good notes of what he says and review them over the semester a bit. He gives good reviews and exams are kind of tough, nothing crazy though.

Definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Bonde for phys 1 and 2 and I loved him! Physics is tough, but he does his best and honestly wants everyone to succeed. If you watch the videos and ask questions you'll do great. He also gave some extra credit that saved my A!
Dr. Bonde is so nice. He's very caring and wants everyone to succeed. He is a strict rule follower, but he's a jolly guy. I only had him for lab and not class but he was awesome in lab.

The material and the courses are hard but he simplifies it pretty well and solves multiple examples for each topic. Sometimes it's hard to keep up with his pace during the lecture, but he's accessible outside of class and responds to emails pretty fast. He's understanding and reasonable.

I took both Physics 1 and 2 from Dr. Bonde. I would struggle on literally every homework assignment and he would sit and explain over and over until I finally understood and was able to solve the problems for sometimes the entire office hours. You are graded on weekly quizzes and homework; the quizzes are really similar to the examples. He's great!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Bonde is a good guy and is available on Zoom whenever you need help, but he's a very difficult grader and he only tells you what you need to know for the test during office hours and tells you useless information during class. If you want a good grade in the class, YOU HAVE TO SEE HIM DURING OFFICE HOURS.

He doesn't let you have any electronics ever and will tell you to get off it. Must take written notes on what he hand writes on the board. Study guides are exhaustive and doesn't properly prepare you for the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Every class is a lecture however, he makes it clear what should be known for the exams. If you are confused about a topic, he is available often for office hours. His tests are almost entirely short-answer. The information tested comes from lecture notes and 2-3 questions on outside readings. On tests, there are many opportunities for extra credit.

The negative reviews of Dr. Bonde really surprised me! He makes his lectures engaging & is always willing to help. He always asked if we have questions over material at the start of class, and does review questions at the start too. Never had homework either, and provides a study outline for exams. Go to class and take good notes & you'll be fine.

At first, I did not like this class because I had a hard time understanding the concepts, however, Bonde made me really love it. He makes physics sort of enjoyable by sharing fun astronomy things at the beginning of class that had nothing to do with physics.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I have never studied harder for a class. Ridiculously hard grader. You can have the correct answer that we were taught in class, but he somehow marks it as wrong on exams. Not approachable outside of class. Takes a very long time to grade exams. So much material for a test that is all short answer. DO NOT take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The worst teacher I have ever had. His taching style is horible and makes you feel bad. Unless you have taken this course you will have zero chance of passing. 1 micro mistake and thats 20 points off. The smartest kid in the class even did not like this teacher what so ever. Please take my advice and save yourself from this guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The grading structure of this class is conducive to failure. Only 4 exams which are all fill in the blank (and over 20 questions) over content that is not easy to comprehend. People with other professors don't have the same problems as people in my lecture section. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Profesor Bonde was a horrible profesor everyone was failing this class for the majority of the semester. So many people had to talk to the head of the science department about him. The only people who did well in this class were Astro physics majors. The class is nothing like the description and even the graduate TAs struggles helping Us.

I had some difficulty with his quizzes due to the lockdown browser thing not working and that's why I got a low grade but other than that it's an alright class. However, sometimes he was mean to the kids and it gave me a bad impression of him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There were times when students would ask genuine questions looking for help and he would demean or dismiss them. He only started explaining things and helping people when 1/3 of 90 students dropped and 1/2 of the 60 left Pass/Failed the class. Constant testing, no notes. Go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr bonde is very friendly and approachable. You can tell he enjoys teaching. The class can be hard but he offers office hours and always takes questions in class. As long as you pay attention to the notes you will be fine, plus there are two extra credit quizzes at the end of the year.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Bonde is the worst professor I have ever taken. He never responds to emails or tries to even help his students. The work load is unbelievable for an intro core class that's worth a History credit not a Physics one. DO NOT take this professor. You will fail or your GPA will be lowered heavily. It's fast lecture heavy and you have a ton of quizzes.

you have a quiz every monday over the previous weeks notes, it is lockdown browser, face tracking/ eye tracking, not allowed to use your notes, mostly free response questions and you have 15 minutes to complete 10+ questions. If you are not a astronomer, do not take this class, i have not gotten above a 50 on a quiz. This is NOT an Intro class....
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Physics is insanely hard and Bonde is a very stern guy who takes a while to warm up to. If you go to his office hours and participate in class he will like you and you will start to enjoy the class more. Tests are SO hard with reactively low averages for the class but he most of the time allows for revisions. Work hard and you can get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr Bonde's lectures are super interesting, never found myself bored in the class. hardly ever any homework outside of some easy readings.

Dr. Bonde makes it very clear about what's going to be on the tests. Must read the textbook. Lectures are spent explaining some concepts in the textbook. The first time he teaches, it might not make any sense, but he simplifies the content if you ask him to re-explain something. Very passionate about what he teaches. Large curve at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Bonde's teaching strategy is to provide us with a formula and then give us several problems to practice using it. These were helpful, but I wish he'd also taught about the concepts themselves. To prepare for the tests, you have to do a lot of outside studying, but he provides lots of office hours to go in for help!

He is a nice and helpful professor. He is willing to help and he is not a tough grader. You can still get a lot of partial credits on exams even when you do it wrong. If you want to get at least a B, try to understand the examples he gives in class and do the homework. Before the exam, do the study guide and suggested problem.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Do not take Bonde. Take anyone else but Bonde. His lectures are confusing and his tests are harder than the examples in class. He makes everything so much harder than it needs to be. He's very smart and cares about astronomy but is a very poor teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He's a really nice guy. Lectures aren't bad since he's pretty funny. Tests are HARD. All short answer and need to explain so much
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Bonde's lectures are entertaining and make waking up for a 9 a.m. less difficult. He is strict in class, but cares is passionate about physics. If you take his class, take the time to get to know him outside of class. He is always willing to meet for office hours. I've gone in many times to ask one question and taken a tangent. Loved his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The guy really cares about physics. However, the problems done in class are 110% easier than anything you will see on an exam. Also, he will try something new on an exam and then everyone will fail. Since everyone fails everything, he had to give tons of extra credit, which is great, but created way more work for both him and his students.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Super cool dude, very chill. He's one of those professors that will give you like an 88-92 on everything though so if you're grinding for an A it could be rough.

I had Dr. Chapman for UNLF and he was the easiest professor ever. We have had a couple of short papers about our experiences at TCU and a couple of short reflections that are super easy. Most classes get canceled or we get let out 40 min early every time but attendance is mandatory when there is class. He cares a lot about his students.
Prof Chapman is the best. He is so chill and does not waste your time. Class always gets out early.

Dr. Chapman is the absolute GOAT. He is by far one of the best professors I have ever had. He truly cares for each student and truly want to see everyone be successful. The class is fun, and the work is super easy.
He truly cares about his students and does not waste your time with pointless projects!! Class is interesting and never lasts the entire period! Take this class if you can!!!!

Dr Chapman is probably one of the best professors at TCU! He is very engaging with his classes, easy to reach, and genuinely cares about his students. There is a bit of busy work for this class which is kind of annoying but you get used to the flow of it as the class goes on. If he says not to stress about grades, believe him!
One of the best professors I've ever had. He cares a lot about his students and is engaging and funny. His classes rarely go the full hour and a half.

This is the best Business Professor at TCU. Take him for business skills development or any courses he offers. He does not want to give a lot of work, he has great advice/insight, and is a great resource to have outside of class for any questions about class or life.
He is truly great and understands what students are going through outside of class. Take this class

I had Professor Chapman for the 1 credit Business Skills Development class. It is the easiest class that has no stress tied to it with the best professor. We still get the outlined assignments done but they are easy and beneficial skills. You can miss one class without penalty if you must but I still recommend going to class if you can!

Professor Chapman holds a very fun and interactive class. He is very nice and funny while doing a good job instructing the class well. Directions are stated clearly in D2L and grading is very standard. He does allow you to miss a couple classes per semester, and will cancel as well. Overall he's a great professor, definitely take this class.

Professor Chapman is one of the best professors I've had. He genuinely cares about the success of his students and makes learning as fun as possible. I would recommend taking any course he offers. The work is manageable and as long as you do what you are asked in the class you will do great!!
Take him. Its just attendance pretty much but then he cancels half the time. It's a joke but its a requirement.
Best teacher, never goes over 20 minutes.
He's the goat...the goat.

Awesome professor! As long as you show up and complete the one weekly assignment you will do week in the class. He truly cares about all of his students and only keeps you for 30 minutes of the class typically. Attendance is an important part of your grade but he never keeps you for the whole class  Highly recommend !

I LOVED Prof. Chapman. I wish I made a better connection with him as a professor because he is such an awesome professor. You can tell he truly cares about all of his students and wants us to thrive out in the real world. Participate in the in-class activities. They aren't graded. My class didn't participate and I felt so bad because he is so nice.

Super fun Professor and class, never stayed the whole class He always lets us out early. Assignments are the same all year, you'll start finishing them in 30 min by the end of class. His lectures are always engaging and quick enough to keep you focused. The Final is a group project. A great class to make some friends and raise your GPA.

Chapman is my favorite professor at TCU. He is so funny and tells the best stories. Our class is supposed to be 1.5 hours, but we never stay longer than 45 min. Usually 1 big writing assignment a week, he always gave me low 90s scores with no suggestions to improve, so that's my only complaint.

Professor Chapman is incredible. Coolest teacher here that understands and connects with his students. If you have him as a professor be prepared to have the best semester ever. Honestly going to miss his class a lot.
Best professor hands down. He cares about you and is super understanding. I have that class for an hour and a half Tuesdays and Thursdays but he lets us out after 20 min pretty much every day.

Chapman is by far the easiest professor I've had at TCU. He randomly takes attendance and gives extra credit to those who are there that day. We had to write a few papers that were super easy. Class would let out early all the time. Take him because it will be the easiest A you'll ever get here.

Chapman is the absolute best. He always lets us out of class early, the assignments can be tedious but easy overall, and is just the coolest guy in general. Definitely take a class with him if you have the opportunity.

Professor Chapman was a great start to my years at TCU. He was the first class I took here and was always telling us how chill he is and also how he wants us to do well an does not want us to stress over the tests or essays...super easy A just show up and smile:)

Dr. Chapman is the best teacher TCU has to offer. He does not waste time in class. Class is very informative if you pay attention and do the work. Very clear with his assignments and is on a consistent schedule. One assignment a week with 2 papers and a final project. An A takes effort but B+ takes completely assignments timely.
No BS, just take him. Lectures get over early, no classes on friday mostly. Great person, and very easy grader if you put in the work
Dr. Chapman is a great professor, who is here at TCU to make your life great and easy. Trust me, you want to take his class(es) as a business major.

Hands down best dressed and overall greatest professor at TCU. He is very understanding and his class is fun, fairly easy and very informative. Really makes you think outside the box without adding stress. Youll be sorry if you miss out on the opportunity to have him in your corner.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: MUST TAKE! By far my favorite professor in my first semester at TCU. Show up, participate in your groups and you're golden. There are 3 papers, but not too crazy on grading the 1st one, 2 and 3 more strict, but use the writing center, main points off is formatting. The curriculum is standard for all Business in Society courses but he makes it fun!

FR1 is a difficult class in general there isn't really an easy way around it, however, I think Professor Chen is a solid choice and makes it a bit easier. The lectures can drag but the practice MCQ's and FRQ's are VERY similar to the test so you feel well prepared. He is also very accessible and accomdating. I would definitely recommend him.

Professor Chen does a good job conveying a lot of information, but class can become boring at times. Majority of grade (~60%) depends on 2 midterms & the final. His MCQ can be tricky, but review past quizzes that are open-notes/practice tests he provides. FR1 is challenging but if you actively study & go to office hours, it's very manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: A very good option for FR1 but does require effort. He lectures quite a bit however if you come to class and listen you will have no issues understanding content due to how thorough it is. It is also very important to study more than necessary for all quizzes in the class as they can be tricky if not taken seriously.

Dr. Chen really knows what he is talking about. The course is lecture-based, and grading is made up of homework (online), quizzes, and 3 exams. The only problem I have with him is that he can be condescending sometimes and gets fed up when students are not grasping the information during class. Show up to class and you should be ok.

Although his lectures are boring, its just the material. He does a great job in being accessible for his students and easy to email. The homework is online and its difficult, but the quizzes and tests are way easier. There are many quizzes, but I think they are great studying tools for the exam and they help see where you are at on the concepts.

Great except if you come from taking a super helpful ACCT 20153 class. He is very confusing and the lectures can be very boring.His quizzes are VERY HARD they are 8 questions and most of the time you get a 6/8. This starts to tank your grade. The exams are doable and if you memorize the answers from the practice they are on the exam word for word.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Chen is one of my favorite professors. He is by no means easy, but that's what is expected with intermediate accounting. He is so accessible outside of class and is always willing to help. The quizzes are hard, but they help you understand the material and prepare you for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I am an accounting major and taking his class has made me second guess my choice of being an accountant. There are quizzes EVERY WEEK. He offers an exam review that gives you no help whatsoever. A few of the multiple choice answers come from the review, but all of the short answers he changes and makes 10x harder.

This is tough material. The weekly quizzes are difficult, but the exams seem to be more manageable.
