Dr. Chen's lectures can be hard to sit through but he does prepare you well enough and seems to really want to help you pass his class. Nice guy. I struggled, but could have been worse. I would take him again.

Dr. Chen is truly a great professor. FR1 is naturally a class where you will have to study and do the readings. However, Dr. Chen was very straightforward with what he expected and very fair in how he graded. He cares a lot about his students and genuinely wants you to do well in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: He's a solid choice for FRII and teaches the material well. However, he is a tough grader and the tests can be challenging. Additionally, he had multiple choice quizzes roughly once a week that can be tricky.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Tough class but Chen explains the material very clearly and the powerpoints are well organized. He tells you exactly what will be on the exam, with a few multiple choice coming from the quizzes and short answer similar to the in class exercises. Would take again
The easiest class ever.
Just take him trust

Riggs is the goat. Pretty sure he commutes from Houston, so class is held ~8 times the whole semester. Exams are out-of-class no lockdown and homework takes 30min tops. Super nice guy, even opens up zoom during exams and will help you out. Class takes an average of 45mins and you're outta there. Best stats prof by far!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Actually the goat. If you have the opportunity you have to take his class.

He is an amazing professor who genuinely cares about his students. If you pay attention in class, it's very easy to do well. Warning: If you lack prior stats/Excel experience, I recommend a tutor. Tests and homework are online/at home, but the final exam is in person.
TAKE HIM!!! I could have not picked a better professor.

He rarely holds class, and I don't think he's teaching again, which is probably good because he's so busy. He's really nice and all the tests were open internet which is really nice. If he pops back up again in later semesters, take him, its an easy way to get the stats credit.
If you are looking for a review to help you pick a professor. Select him now, thank me later.
Professor Riggs is the best! I don't know how he doesn't have so many more reviews. He is so cool, and understanding, and knows most of his students are not majoring in statistics. Take him!!

The best professor to take for Statistical Analysis! His three-hour night class typically lasted about an hour. Tests were relatively easy and homework was always due the day of the test. One group project at the end of the semester but very easy.

Professor Riggs has a 3 hour class and lectures for 40 minutes for Stats. He gives open note/book tests and the homeworks are due when you take the test. Tests are easy if you can read a textbook. He doesn't really teach or care about you learning stats, but you will get a good grade in the class if you use your notes.

This class is just very boring. Lots of lectures, and she gives quizzes over the textbooks. The information itself isn't that difficult, I think she just makes it harder than it needs to be. She herself isn't mean or anything, but the class itself in her teaching style is very boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lectures are not the most interesting, but I think that I didn't like the class overall. She is very considerate, but you have to do a lot of readings and many pop quizzes. Most of the time she warms you about the quizzes, but if you're not paying attention/ doing the readings then messing up one of these quizzes can ruin your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Don't take this class, it's so boring, and she does pop quizzes on the readings. Her lectures are boring and very hard to follow. There's also a project, exams, and a presentation. Made me want to drop my sociology minor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: SUCH A HARD GRADER for no reason. Her lectures are so boring and don't teach you anything. I challenged a grade and she proceeded to dock my grades even harder the rest of the semester. Take anyone else in the department. There's also a final presentation, paper, and test.

She could be worse, she's approachable. The topic isn't hard; it's her teaching style. Textbook HW, online quizzes, online HW, in-class quizzes, and 4 cumulative exams. Attendance isn't mandatory, but trust me, you'll want to be there. Manageable if organized, but could use more engagement to make it less monotonous. Good for learning fundamentals.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I feel like she goes out of her way to make cost very difficult. Her conceptual questions are very difficult, and I'm not the biggest fan of her teaching style. Too much work. HW, online quizzes, dothejob, in class quizzes, and 4 tests (final is cumulative). Hardest class I think I've ever taken, but definitely do-able, and she's a good person.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This was the hardest class I have ever taken. She knows the material well, but test covers so much material it is super hard to study for

Cost accounting is a cool skill. I learned recently it's not really even on the CPA. Not sure why TCU has this as a requirement, maybe other accounting programs do too. I liked this professor; she is very cool. A little intimidating at first but it's so clear she loves accounting.Notsureif 
there is a secret to costaccounting or not. It'sreallyhard
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It can be a hard class but she is very helpful with the resources she provides. Homework is optional which is nice. We did one project throughout the semester which was graded tough and instructions were kind of vague so that's my only knock. But her tests aren't too difficult and she provides you with the resources needed to succeed.

Good teacher and very knowledgeable. Obviously FR3 is hard but she will help you if you need it. Take her if you can! Not sure why some of her ratings are low I think she is the best option for the class from what I've heard from friends with other teachers.

Very subjective and inconsistent grading. Learned a lot but the writing rules were so strict and unrealistic. I never used any of those rules in my internship. Not impossible but will frustrate you. Get another teacher if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take Janice Cobb. She gives an extreme amount of homework and is super unforgiving when it comes to work in the class. Moves extremely fast and this will hurt your GPA. Puts you at a disadvantage as a student.

Professor Cobb truly understands how to teach accounting. You will not have to study for exams if you follow the assigned readings and homework. Students who are complaining likely put off readings and assignments until the last minute and haven't yet learned that accounting takes practice.

This class made me question my entire life. She makes it impossible. Directly contradicts herself in class and the feedback she gives makes no sense. However, your grade will end up okay in the end. I got a 50 on pretty much everything and ended up with a B+. I get what Cobb was trying to do, but the execution is horrible. Take Walters.
Some people just want to watch the world burn.

I don't care what other people are saying, Cobb is such a great teacher. Just need to see her outside of class and it goes a long way! FR1 is a tough class no matter the professor. Would take her again! Def take her!

Cobb is the worst teacher I've ever had in my life. Within the first 2 weeks of class, she assigns you probably 12 different assignments. If you do not do the assignment exactly how she wants, she gives you a 0!!! Additionally, she barely explains her very complicated class structure and expects you to perform on Cost Acct material immediately.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Fr3 is hard itself but Cobb is nice. Our class was very small so in my opinion it was better. Dont skip otherwise you will not understand anything. Your final grade doesnt matter. As she says an 94 is not an A in her class. she does give a lot of work but I honestly learned a lot from her.

FR3 with Cobb sucks. It will be the hardest accounting class you ever take. It is very frustrating and disheartening because she is very strict and has high expectations. HOWEVER she is genuinely a great woman who wants her students to succeed after graduation. You will learn a lot in her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Unless you want depression, sleep deprivation, and high levels of stress and anxiety dont take Cobb. Shes terrible. Doesnt teach you anything. Gives you a thousand assignments throughout the semester which cuts into your grades for your other classes. Her grading system is terrible and youre gonna get a lot of 0s for assignments you turn in.

FR3 is a hard class plain and simple. Be prepared to commit 10-15 hours outside of class. You will be stressed constantly because reading and interpreting accounting code is not easy. Dr. Cobb has high expectations but wants you to appreciate the learning process. I learned a lot in this class and actually got a lot out of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I have never had one single class consume so much of my time. I spend about 3 to 4 hours before every class doing the required homework and she knows that's how much time it takes. Her quizzes are so unfair, 5 min for 10 questions that require so much reading its impossible. Even if you get an A you will not think it is worth it. DO NOT TAKE

Cobb is a great teacher. Her expression of her knowledge is hard to understand. She curves the class so much because everyone does so bad. Highest grades on tests are usually an 85. If you don't spend at least 5 hours a week outside of class on a normal week, you will be incredibly behind. Tests are in a foreign language, even if you study hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You really have to work for every point you get. Cobb gave extensive notes on every hw assingment, make sure to actually address them. She is incredibly caring and often pushed back assignment deadlines to make sure she received quality work. Be prepared to commit at lease 15 hours outside of class a week if you want to do well in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Pros: -I learned so much in her class -Accessible outside of class -Will do what she can to help you/your grade if you are actually trying Cons: -Incredibly difficult class (especially for someone who is not an accounting or finance major). -Hours of homework each night. Get ready to WORK -Test heavy: I think we had 5-6 exams
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: the worst teacher ive ever had. spends way too much time doing her P90X and milking her cow and not enough time teaching. on a scale of 1-10 janice cobb is a -240. I would rather get slapped across the face for 50 minutes 3 times a week than ever go back to her class.
DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS! Amazing professor, but literally 3 hours of homework before each class. If you take her, you'll remember this post.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Cobb is by far the best professor I've had at TCU (I am a senior). She makes you work for an A but it's achievable if you work hard. Her class is about more than Accounting; you will learn about critical thinking and research which you can apply in other fields as well. She is great and always willing to help her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: cobb was hands down the best professor ive had at TCU. I think I learned more in her class than all other classes combined. SO much work and grading was very harsh but very worth it. Grades mostly consist of participation and papers - no exams. Definitely the harder FR3 class to take but you'll get a lot out of it
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: After class we need to spend 3-4 hours to work on assignment and quiz everyday. Not much lectures during class, only discuss about homework. And we need to submit a reflection paper after the course. Test is tough and requires to fill in the space as well. Will definitely be a tough course for those who don't have accounting background.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor Cobb is the best teacher I have had since starting college. She is very tough and makes you work hard, but you will learn more in this class than with any other teacher. She loves to help and truly wants her students to learn the material. Get ready to work if you want to succeed.

This is not an easy class, and Professor Cobb really makes you work for your grade. She assigns a lot of homework each day, but it is very helpful to do all of it because the tests follow the same format. She's a great professor and is willing to help. She cares about the students and wants everyone to do well in the class.
Tough class but doable. Best if you want to really understand the why, how and when of accounting. If only trying to check a box on your degree plan, skip it!

As a dedicated accounting major I tried to have a good attitude in her class, but it just isn't possible to enjoy Cobb's course. Cobb's materials are written by herself - Red Flag #1. Sometimes this can be helpful in a class, but in Cobb's case it is just indicative of a massive ego and poor teaching capabilities. This course lacks structure.

DO NOT take this class. Too much homework, impossible short answers on the tests, etc. Hell you can't even study for the short answer. You could be an "A" student for basic accounting conceptsprinciples and then fail the short answer half of tests, landing yourself with a "C" every time. She wants people to learn, but she just induces stress.

You will have over two hours of homework due every class, with a pop quiz almost every class or every other class. The test are impossible, she is the only  Financial teacher to have short answers on her test. The short answers are impossible and no way to really study for them.

Do NOT take this class. She writes all of her own materials and the homework is a pain in the ass! Way too much of a time commitment with no reward. Terrible teacher. In addition, if you need to use the bathroom, get water, or are on your death bed .... You will see a 15 point reduction in your grade! Just don't do it to yourself.

Very difficult class, but Ms. Cobb is extremely helpful and wants all students to succeed. She expects a lot of work from her students, but she is very rewarding if she knows you put forth solid effort. Very approachable and knowledgeable about accounting! Take her if you really want to learn and retain accounting concepts!

Too much homework. Does not use a standard textbook - which makes it difficult to follow. Online homework was always incorrect due to technical errors. Definitely NOT my favorite organization for an accounting course.

Her Financial and Managerial Acct classes are manageable but her  Intermediate II class is almost impossible. I learned a lot but her tests are difficult and the footnote tests are ridiculous. Tough class.

I am an accounting/finance major with great grades, part of the PPA and I enjoy accounting. DO NOT TAKE HER. Her book is terrible, her tests have grammar mistakes/are not clear, and she does not teach you. She just asks questions. Horrible teacher. Accounting is difficult, but is impossible when you have an incompetent teacher.

Mrs. Cobb is awesome.  She is super-helpful and really cares about her students and tries to make as many as possible leave as accounting majors.  Now, she is tough, but if you read the book, ask questions in class and pay attention it is completely possible to get an A.  One of my favorite professors at Neeley.

Best professor I've taken at TCU! Yes, there is a lot of homework outside of class and pop quizzes, but it's all so worth it. She truly wants you to succeed and will work with you as much as possible until you understand the material. Class time is well spent and she explains everything very well. MUST TAKE.
Tough professor !!! Try to get your grade as high as possible before the final project due. It will slash your grade

Cost Accounting !! I learned so much from her class. Take her if you want to actually learn something. She will make you learn. She cares about the students a lot and genuinely want you to success. She's also good at teaching and explaining things. However there's a lot of homework so be prepared to work hard. The project is brutal .

Professor Cobb is an excellent professor and the way she teaches makes a difficult class much better.  The class is more difficult and requires more homework than other professors, but you will learn much more.
SO. MUCH. HOMEWORK. If you hate homework don't take it. She teaches it like a high school class and treats you the same way. Good teacher, just was too much homework for a college class.

The only reason she has any bad ratings is because her class is so incredibly difficult. However, Cobb is a fantastic teacher. She teaches everything in a very practical way which really helps come test time. She literally wrote the book on accounting, so she is really smart. Overall, she's the best teacher to take accounting with.
Cares a lot about her students. Tough class but she will work with you

She's a challenging professor. Nice, but a little aloof and odd. The class is time consuming and somewhat hard. Tests aren't terribly difficult, but the writing project is. She grades it very strictly and many people fail it. I got a B on it and ended up with an A in the class. Good for accounting majors, but maybe not the best for non majors.
I really like her ! Her class is tough but she's a good professor and explain things very well ! I would recommend her if you consider major in accounting ! You will learn a lot

Very difficult and rigorous class. You have to keep up w/ the material and study often to do well. A lot of work throughout the semester, but I think it will be beneficial to you. She may seem tough, but she a good teacher and only wants to help you. Take her if you want to learn.

Great Professor. She just redid her entire course which has really made everything clear and easy. Goes straight from her textbooks and uses an online supplement. Tests are not too bad but if you dont pay attention in class and do the homework you will not do well. If you do what she says, you will get an A, no doubt.

I'm not an expert in acct, but until Cobb, all the profs I'd had explained the material a # of ways (everyone learns differently). Cobb insists that her way (and the mandatory text and website which she profits from) is the ONLY way to learn the content. Most professors treat you like a college student-Cobb treats you like a 3rd grader. Avoid her.
Very demanding teacher and you must put in about 5 hours each week. You will learn a lot though, and will be thankful looking back

This class is by no means easy. There is a LOT of work. I don't know what my grade will be yet, but right now it is a B+. Do the work, ask her questions if you have them, and it'll be fine. I suggest her if you want to learn something.

Oh Jcobb...lets just put it this way she is a clear proponent of the push towards lower grades in the business school. Best strategy for cost is to get your grade as high as possible before the final project before she slashes your grade. Also this class is the most work ive ever done for a class. Also she won't round up your plus minus...sweet

She is awesome if you put some extra work. Do your homework and keep up with her stuff and then it's an easy class. It's a lot of work but her hw grades and extra credit opportunities bumps your letter grade!

Class took waaaaay too much time up!  Not that hard, just consumes all your time.  Avoid if possible.  Beware the writing assignment, it doesn't seem hard,but she will fail you. She has her own website (and text)and you'll spend alot of time copying down questions from it to prove you are studying. -15 pts if you have to go the bathroom duringclass

Great professor! If you are an accounting major then you should take her. She is challenging and by no means easy, but you will learn everything you need to know. Teaches more details than other professors.

Very challenging class.  Make sure you go to class every day and pay attention.  Tests are very challenging and too long. Also make sure you put a lot of effort into the writing assignments because Cobb, unlike other profs in the Acct department, actually cares about them.

the class is hard and cobb blames bad grades on tests on people not studying which is undermining when i studied almost everyday for this class! my advice: go to her office and she will be a lot more helpful, study every day, dont miss class and use the website!

I do not like how Cobb teaches Cost. The online material was somewhat helpful but the notes packet is worthless it's basically the website with 3 cases. It teaches you how to fill in boxes not learn formulas which does not help for exams because there are NO boxes!! GOOD LUCK!
Did not enjoy her class at all.  She taught the material way to quickly and did not explain things thoroughly.  The accounting department should do something about her.

I can name at least 10 people who had to  REPEAT this class! Every lesson is a guessing game.  I have never had to pull so many all nighters in my life. She doesn't explain things, is very intimidating, unhelpful, and expects too much out of you.

Accounting is by far the worst subject of all IMO. However, Cobb is a very good professor and the website is absolutely crucial. I would not have made an 'A' without doing the practice problems. There are some god-awful accounting profs at TCU..she's not one of them.

These entries below are a bunch of idiots who were just looking for an easy class. Cobb is tough and expects you to understand the material. However, she wants you to pass and is very helpful. Her tests are hard, but as long as you study and use the website, you can pass. I hardly studied and still pulled a C. Could have made an A by studying more.

Not very helpful, expects way too much. She thinks accounting is very easy and straight forward. She wants your life to be accounting. Try to take Intermediate in the fall; she does not teach then. She has limited compassion and no understanding for students. She lives in a box and doesnt know how to relate to college students. AVOID!

The person who commented before this must be her fav student or weirdly passionate about acct. You have to learn off the website, which does a POOR job of explaining concepts. Goes through things way too fast in class. Tests= hard. Final=ridculous. Doesnt realize that not everyone gets acct as easy as her or that we also have other classes. AVOID.
Best teacher ever.  If you have a brain, which surprisingly lots of college students don't, you will make an A in any of her classes. Very helpful and straight to the point.

Ms. Cobb is basically running a scam.  She charges you for her class notes and access to her webpage, which are basically the same thing.  You also have to pay for one of the assignments that you do at the end of the course.  Most teachers are happy to give students notes and assignments for FREE! I didn't learn a thing in her class!

Worst teacher and class I have ever had. No texbook; you use her website that you  subscribe to, her horrible notes package that you buy, and a case you have to buy for the last days of class. Does not really teach; is more concerned with number crunching. Tests are hard. She's the only teacher otherwise I'd absolutely suggest someone else.
She's terrible and  over-complicates  accounting. You basically have to teach yourself.

I would recommend her over any other managerial teacher. yes, the accounting in general is boring but I have heard only about how hard the other teacher's tests are.  she has her own text book so she uses her own examples which are helpful.  offers extra credit quizzes once a week

She's alright. She doesn't exactly make the material easy, and she teaches at the speed of mach 5 centripetal force. She's smart, but not approachable (sometimes she's even scary). She's well organized, and she offers a lot of "study" material, but I'd suggest taking someone else, if possible. Attendence is a must.

Ms. Cobb is very helpful when it comes to teaching. Always in her office to answer questions. She is tough but fair when it comes to grading. Use her website and practice hard tests to study. Tests are applying what you know. Final is basically one question. She does have curves for some tests. Tickelope case is boring and pointless though!

Cobb is average for TCU accounting dept. Her class is very hard and she is not very approachable. She is very comprehensive and does a good job "preparing you" for the accounting profession. Given a choice, I would take somebody else.

Overall she is pretty good. I had to put some effort into this one in terms of doing hmwk and reading, which was very helpful at test time. I would put her in that hard but fair category. One more thing GO TO CLASS! She does alot of examples that appear, in a harder form, on the test.

She is a WONDERFUL professor! I learned so much in her class. If you go to class, pay attention, and maybe spend an hour reviewing for the tests you will be fine! She really wants everyone to do well! I really like this class.

she's a great teacher.  definately the lesser of the evils in the accounting dept.  she creates this binder for you before the semester and it has a copy of basically every quiz you will take.  i went to her one day during her office hours and told her i didn't understand something and so she gave me the lecture over again until i did!  TAKE HER!

She's just awesome. The class seemed extremely overwhelming at first (contrary to what others said, at the beginning she DOES give you homework before she really explains anything). There is alot of homework - but it's a completion grade. If you pay attention in class, and do the work - quizzes and tests are a BREEZE! Her binder is SO helpful too!

*sigh...this is a difficult class and if you are not a business major don't take her.  She moves very fast-her office hours were after class.  When you asked for help (and somethimes just didn't know what to ask because you were confused) she told you to study harder and would leave you.  She is very good about responding to e-mails

she is amazing! she defines the words and unlike a lot of acct professsors, she teaches you and then gives u hw instead of vice versa! her binder is a big help. she is nice and respectful and makes class fun. acct is not an easy subject, but if u have to take it, take her!

Great teacher, but the class is a difficult. She randomly takes up the homework, and there are quizzes every week, which means you have to keep up on your work. The case studies are also tough and take up alot of time. Class is hard, but worth it.
Wonderful professor!  Always working to help students succeed.  One of the best you'll ever find.  Take her for sure.
Scares the crap out of you in the beginning few quizzes and tests, but everything works out in the end. she makes it to where you can make up for bad test grades. Good teacher, prepares you a lot.

Take her for sure. Anyone has a chance to make an A in that class if they do the material out of her white folder and hw is easy because you can do it ("copy")right before class bc she waits awhile to take it up.
Great teacher. She is very patient and very helpful. Wants to make sure you learn the stuff.
Cobb is one of the best professors at TCU.  But that does not mean she is easy.  She ISN'T!!!  Go to class and study like crazy.  You will learn so much and it will prepare you for INT. II.
Very good teacher, If you do your work, you'll be fine. Plus, she's very helpful and easy to contact.
Cobb is one of the best accounting profs at TCU.  The class material is tough, but she works with you to make it so that it is understandable.  The project and the paper can really boost your grade.

The class is very rigorous (ie, Cobb), but really not difficult.  Do your work and you will be fine.  Final is complicated, so know your stuff...Still nothing compared to the int. II final.  After Int. II (w/cobb), this class is a breeze.  Cobb is by far the best to learn accounting from at TCU.

I'm trying my hardest in this class and still barely getting a D... everytime I talk to her, she just beats around the question and that really isn't helping in my paper writing. Tests are just crazy. I think she means well, but she needs to reexamine some of her methods.

She is an awesome teacher. She makes it very easy to understand and you know exactly what will be on the tests. It is so possible to make an A. You just have to go to class, do hw before class, and study for tests. It isnt that bad at all.
SHE IS FREAKIN STUPID.SHE TRYS TO BE ALL PROFESSIONAL BUT DOES NOT WORK.JUST CRAZY.I DONT WANA USE THE WORD BUT MAN.NEVER SEEN SOMEBODY LIKE HER

Cobb is probably one of the best professors I've had at TCU.  You do have to actually learn to do well in her class, but she makes that so wasy to do.  Cost is an EASY A... VERY EASY A...just dont be lazy like these other people who gave her bad ratings probably were
No Comments

Cost is such an easy class but she makes it too confusing.  DO NOT TAKE HER unless she is your last option and you have no other choice!  She thinks her class is the only class that exists and there is something due EVERY CLASS.  Good class to take ALONE, bad for every other reason!

Might as well go to TCC where for a lesser tuition you may actually learn something instead of simply memorizing.  She leaves out all the important details and then questions you about those details on her exams. Nice person but worst teacher b/c unless you memorize everything youself, you wont pass

We aren't all accounting geeks and that's what she thinks we are. The most ridiculous professor I have had here. Loves leaving out details and giving an insane load of homework. Also picky and anal with EVERYTHING.
she is just insane.She expects that you are only taking her class.Does not tell what she wants in the assignments.DONT TAKE HER

Not too found of her at this point... she has given us an insane workload, and then tells you what she wants on the papers, but leaves out details that she wants you to question. Then when she corrects the papers, she writes sarcastic remarks, like we are stupid. That's pretty condesending.
dude dont listen to these people.She is a killer.She will make sure that you will change your major.if you are taking her do not accept to take anything else.I promise.stay away from her
Awesome teacher, impossible class.
Top five hardest class as TCU.  From day one the work load is insane.  She is a good teacher though and she bypasses the book.  DON'T GET BEHIND!!
I cannot say enough about her, she is so helpful, and really wants you to succeed. She has the interest of her students high in her regaurds. Expect to work hard, but you will love her.
She knows what she is doing. The class isnt for everyone, lots of busy work. Lots of people drop. Tests seem hard, get good grades though.

Mrs. Cobb (Mrs. Brightwell) is excellent.  I had her for Inter 1 & 2, and Adv Acct. Stay on top of your homework and study for the quizes.   The finals are very hard. She will prepair you for the real world.  I wish all my Professors were as good.

Although most people think she's hard, she only wants u 2 stay on top of things. I managed to get an A in her class. I advice u to take her class if u really want to learn. If you are willing to work in her class, then ull have no problem gettin an A too.

Prof Cobb is THE BEST professor at TCU, hands down. She has been the CFO of a few companies, so she knows what she is talking about. She is very difficult, but if you put in the time, and GET HELP, you can get an A. I'd go with her over any professor.

teaches really well.  Expects a lot.  Make sure you do your homework, it helps!  Hard class but it's just a hard subject.  by far the best teacher at Tcu.  Very fair.  Final is unexpectedly hard.  She expects you to know the hardest stuff

Cobb is amazing If you are going to be fin or acct you should take her for intro fin acct. You will be happy you did later.  Hard class, labor intensive, but she is with you the whole way.Make your grades early;Final is death. She is as fair as can be
Very good
Professor Cobb is probably the best teacher I have had at TCU. Her class is difficult, but it forces you to learn the material.
Cobb is an AMAZING teacher. Probably the BEST accounting teacher in TCU. She really knows her stuff! The class is very hard though, but you'll learn a lot! She's also ALWAYS there for help!
Great teacher, will do what she can to help you understand
It is very hard and challanging but she is easily aviable to meet outside of class.  And she goes really really fast.
The class material is hard, and the class goes fast, but she will do anything she can to help you get through it.

She is very good at her job, has very interesting lectures, and goes into detail. Her tests are very hard; she purposely tricks you on her exams. You need to completely understand the context to do well on her exams, not just definitions, but examples and how they work.

reviews.comment: Dr. Currier made lectures enjoyable. It can be challenging if you're not interested in intl politics. We had a quiz in every class, mainly over the textbook, so READ IT! reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Currier is the best lecturer I've ever had at TCU. She makes her lectures so entertaining and interesting, often stopping to ask questions and welcoming discussion topics brought up by students. She also does not care whether you come into the class knowing everything about Chinese politics or nothing - she treats all her students equally.

Dr. Currier is incredibly knowledgeable and clearly cares about what she is teaching. I did well in this class but had to work for it. I truly think her bad reviews are people upset about their grades. Tests are hard, so be prepared, but you get the opportunity to bump up your grade with a group project and paper.

She is a very nice lady who wants the best for her students but loves hearing herself lecture and talk. I've had her for multiple classes and she manages to fall behind in all of them while lecturing for all the available time each week. If she could give information concisely, she'd be one of the best professors here.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There's daily quizzes but they're super easy and only 1 question and 3 points. Just do the reading and you're guaranteed 100%. TLDR the content is difficult but she makes it manageable.
Her tests are too hard and she will not help you out if your grade is struggling. Do not take if you do not have to.

Dr. Currier is incredibly smart, I loved her lectures. Before we had even submitted any assignments she told me she thought I should drop her class. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Currier is an absolutely outstanding professor. I genuinely believe that the people who have had negative experiences with her are just upset about the grade they received. It's obvious that Dr. Currier is an expert on all the material she teaches and keeps lectures super entertaining. Build a relationship with her and you'll love the class!!

Very tough grader but work needs to be put in outside of class to keep up. Very enthusiastic professor which helped me stay awake and engaged during her 2.5 hour class. She is accessible outside of class and is a great resource to be used to go over exams or papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Currier really cares about her course and students, but it is extremely difficult. Tests are very hard and worth large portion of grade. Dr. Currier is a very engaging teacher who helps you understand concepts well. This being said, her tests are weighted heavily and are extremely hard. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

Dr. Currier is a great professor and very knowledgable about this subject. However, this is a very dense class and I would not recommend taking it just to fulfill hours/credits. Dr. Currier is a really energetic passionate teacher. I love her. Definitely would take her again. She grades pretty meticulously and so be sure you turn in quality work.

hard class unless you need it for your major and are actually very interested you will get lost when I asked a question (over zoom) she obviously thought it was a dumb question if you have anxiety its not for you

reviews.comment: I'm not a political science major but I did end up learning a whole lot in this class. reviews.comment: I loved taking her class and tried to take her again next semester but unfortunately could not fit her class into my schedule.  She assigns a lot of reading and has pop quizzes, but if you skim the reading, you will be fine.  Her lectures are also amazing.

Other than that I loved having her and her classes are actually pretty interesting. PS put in a random course code sorry

Professor Currier was by far my favorite professor my freshman year. Her International Politics class was very challenging but SO interesting. She made her lectures fun and is really sarcastic. Dr. Currier's class is ridiculously hard and if you want to make a grade higher than B, you should not consider this class. She went over the slides so fast that you won't even be able to take the notes.

I took Dr. Currier for International Politics. She is a brilliant professor and is very helpful towards her students. Attendance and participation are part of your grade. There are weekly readings and pop quizzes, but nothing too difficult. I've gotten high A's on her exams with only a few hours of studying. Highly recommend taking her class!

DO NOT take Currier if you want your GPA to rise or even stay the same. I study for many hours only to get a high C. Just stay away if you can, trust me.

Amazing Class! If you have any interest in the world and it's politics and the way it works take this class! The first few weeks are really tough but it gets better! She is great to talk to and if you come to class and STUDY you will do fine! Just don't go in without knowing your stuff! And don't listen to those who says she's mean! she isn't!

Witty and sarcastic professor. She is very smart and certainly knows the subject. As stated previously you must attend class and take notes. Not too hard to make a B if you attend class

She's very funny and a good instructor. However, she's definitely not easy. You have to go to class and take good notes. Her quizzes are easy and her tests are fair. If you're interested in PoliSci and will actually read you can get a B+ without too much extra effort. An A isnt too very hard. If you're not really going to do the work dont take her

I took her International politics class and it was a complete GPA blow off. I took her Chinese Foreign Policy Class on my first semester at TCU. It is enough to say I did horrible in her course. Everytime I visited outside of class she didn't help. Her grading was not fair. Since her course I've taken other POLSC classes and done great!
Excellent instructor

DO NOT TAKE CURRIER!!I REPEAT DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS ENLESS YOU ABSOLUTELY HAVE TO!If you do not heed this warning I am sorry for you.  DO NOT TAKE HER! Take Dorraj or anyone else you've heard is hard over her.

The material is interesting and she knows what she's talking about, but the grading on papers is not fair.  Also, she is not helpful if you visit her ouside of class and is more likely to make you cry than anything else.  Not a class to take if PoliSci isn't your life, because she takes it that seriously and you will suffer if you don't too

Took her International relations class... great professor, but it is not a blow off gpa booster class. Only take her if you are actually interested in the class and willing to do the work. dont be fooled into taking this honors class for interest only. very difficult and you will work for a "c". I dropped after I realized it did nothing for my major...and she annihilated my first paper...will EAT you alive if you fall asleep in her 8am!

I think she is a very unfair teacher! Yes, the class is really interesting if you love politics, but her grading is hoffific! I studied non stop for that class, and nothing good came out of it. She is not fair. The class is so broad that you don't know what to expect from her. There are 3 tests; 16 mutliple c& 7 short answers. She will not help you

Dr. Currier is amazing and extremely qualified at what she does. Great sense of humor at 8AM. Map quizzes will help your grade, A LOT! Got to class or you'll miss 3-5 pages of notes. Tests are hard, but you must study. Not a blow off class. Don't get on her bad side. She WILL help you if you're in need of it. She really cares about her students.
Too much work, you weren't able to keep your tests afterwards. She would try to trick you on the tests. She made her political views public.

REALLY knows what she is talking about. make sure you go to class or you'll miss 50 pages of notes. map quizzes once a week are easy grade boosters. great sense of humor about current issues(ie: Bush). does give class participation & attendance grade so make sure you read the newspaper and contribute to the lecture. NOT a blow off class!

The best professor in the Poli sci department, if not all of TCU. She is tough, but you will learn a lot and retain much of the information. Her tests are hard, but fair, talk to her before them! She also grades tough on the papers. Awesome professor, LOVED that class!
Lots of info packed into each lecture, but its a good class.  Tests are hard, but fair. She's hot and the class is worth it.

I think Currier is a good teacher.  She is clearly intelligent and cares alot about the course material.  Her unfortunate downfall is that she picks favorites, and it affects the way she grades. Currier is incredibly intelligent, she pushes you hard, and she knows her stuff. She will teach you more about the world's politics and influence in one semester than you could ever anticipate. It is a hard class and you don't particularly need the text book. Read this issues book and ALWAYS go to class her slides are on the tests almost always...

I worked hard, but she's very smart and successful, and I enjoyed listening to her lectures. Am planning to take her again. I hated her map quizzes though. Despite what she  advised, I never read the textbook, just the arguments book, and I still got an A.
She's a great teacher. Very knowledgeable on her subject matter. Tests require some preparation but aren't impossible. Can be a little curt with students sometimes, but makes up for it in hotness.
AMAZING prof! Lectures are engaging and interesting. Tough exams (study weeks in advance if you want a B), but don't worry, the papers will help your grade tremendously. I highly recommend her!

Great professor.  I dont understand the viscious comments, yes shes hard but its really a matter of I care to learn and care to go to class than "I cared to study."  Paying attention in class and taking notes is the way to pass.  If you do that and study, an A should be no problem at all.  Best teacher I have had.
she is crazy! do not take her....unless you want work your ass off and still fail this retarded class!!!

This professor was great at first with only map quizzes, but when exam came along. OMFG it was so hard, i can never finish the test. Loved her! Not at all a blowoff but you learn a ton. Do well on the map quizes because they will save your grade in the long run. She'll help you out as much as she can if she sees you're putting in the effort. Basically memorize her powerpoint slides for the test and you should be good. Great prof and I'd take her again.

good professor, smart very knowleadgeable but a very complicated class. Too many readings and she expects too much out of the students. you have to work very hard and follow the neverending guidelines she has, to be in her good books. But you will learn a lot. Dont recommend for non-majors.

Great prof! Take her if you want to learn. Not a blowoff class at all, but she is very helpful and gives you a chance to make a good grade with map quizzes and pretty easy essays. Wow, this class was A LOT harder than expected.  Want to know what grad school should feel like?  Then sign up for this class!  It is interesting but pretty difficult to get an A.  I didn't read the book but studied the notes hard for 2 days and got a low B on the test.  If I had it to do over again, I would probably pick something else.

Take good notes and READ.  The quizes can hurt your grade so be prepared.  VERY helpful, but picky, make sure you read guidlines b/f doing papers and Response Pieces.  Really good lectures that keep you interested.
Speaks faster than the speed of light!
Best professor in polisci department! The class will kick your butt, but your learn an immense amount of info. work hard, take good notes, and participate to get a good grade. Highly recommend her.

In all honesty, she's a good teacher. I hated the subject, and I didn't do very well in the class, but she's good. Talks a little fast, but always tries to adjust to the class' needs. She is very helpful and likes for people to go to her office hours. Lots of reading, and tests are kinda hard, but overall an ok class.
My fave prof. here!!  She made the subject so much more interesting and easy to understand.  She also has a great sense of humor!

AWESOME CLASS.  dr. currier is one of the best profs i have had in college.  she is brilliant, and an excellent teacher.  this is the type of prof that TCU needs more of... meaning those that actually like to teach and know what theyre talking about. highly reccomended.

Very interesting; learned tons of facts. Expect dull "theoretical perspectives" stuff, categorizations & definitions not explained through induction. Map Quizzes can really help grade. Tests difficult-Memorize her bullet-pointed PowerPoint slides & Rourke readings, & regurgitate w/ current events discussed in class & historical examples in textbook
GREAT Prof!  Very funny and interesting.  Not very hard class if you just pay attention and do what she asks.  Very clear about what she expects on tests, papers, etc.  Highly recommended
good class, lot of info.  not too hard.
absolutely loved this class.  there is a lot of class discussion and you need to do the review sheet/ read the chapters to do well on the test.  go to class and take notes.
lot of info, tests are broad with big general questions.  overall good prof, fun class.

She's a good teacher.  Take her review sheet and study it! But also take the terms off of the review and know more stuff.  Not everything in the tests are in your notes, but most of it is...so just know the material and youll be ok!  Good teacher overall though. Even though she's liberal, she's open
she knows her stuff. likes participation. go to class and you will do well. she loves the environment and is a liberal feminist. take her class, but be prepared to write fast and read a lot.

not all that hard, demands participation in class and it often gets very awkward sitting there with the other 6 people that decided to come to class that day, very very boring and shes got a lot of feminist tension
great prof!  hard grader, but knows her stuff and cares about teaching...

She is a very good teacher. Her tests are difficult but attending class makes them easier. She gets a little upset when attendence is low. She also likes it when you go to her office hours. She was an amazing prof, def take her.incredibly intelligent. i would love to take more of her classes. encourages discussion daily. tests are a lil tough, study hard.
I think she is too conservative!
This is a very liberal teacher.  I don't recommend this class to conservative.
Such a nice guy and genuinely just wants to students to engage with him and the material. Group project takes up huge portion of grade. Provides review slides for exams.
His class isn't what it used to be. IGNORE other ratings

Solid Prof. Not a difficult class in general, but with him its the difficulty level is nonexistent. Sneaky midterm though. Not the most exciting professor, in fact, it's actually a very boring course that is more often than not just death by PowerPoint.
One of my favorite teachers at TCU. Makes the class interesting by relating topics in class to his previous work experiences.
One of my favorite classes, his sales background really shows and he is willing to guide you. The group project is a good chunk of your grade but be willing to coordinate and you will do well.

McTighe is a fantastic professor. He really cares about you and he cares about what he's teaching. The group projects aren't that bad and he grades everything easy. He essentially gives you the answers to his exams because he wants to see you succeed. He's also a really great dude who you can talk with.

Professor McTighe is awesome. He lectures most classes but is interactive and expects participation. The grades are made up of two exams (midterm and final), 3-part presentation project, and weekly quizzes. The project is pretty simple and he grades pretty easily. I would definitely take hime for global business.

Very entertaining and nice professor. Class is two exams and a group project that you work on all semester. He grades it very easy. He gives study guides for the exams which makes it easy to study. He is the best professor for global business. Take him!

TAKE HIM!!! Professor McTighe is the best professor by far for Global Business. He doesn't require attendance but you do have articles to read once a week that you will talk about in class. He clearly outlines what will be on the two exams which are very easy if you show up to class. He truly cares about his students and their success.

He is a great professor. Mid-term and final are easy. He gives a PowerPoint for review and most of the test is word-for-word from the slides. Semester long group project but if you get a good group it's not too bad and he is an easy grader on it. He really cares to connect with his students and is just overall a great guy.

dennis is the man. he never failed to make us laugh on a monday morning. very relatable guy and makes the class so easy. i dont think i got anything below a 100 on any of the group project assignments or presentations. 2 exams both of which are easy

McTighe is the best professor to take for Global Business. There is a midterm and final with a study guide that mimics the exams. The group project has three parts and consists of an essay and presentation, both are straight forward if split correctly. Overall, a great guy who loves to interact with students in class. Makes the 8am class easy!

Class consists of a semester-long project with a team that he selects. His class is so easy. If you review the material and become familiar with it then exams are not hard. One mid-term and final exam, the rest of major grades come from presentations part 1,2 &3 and then weekly quizzes. Super caring he wants you to succeed!

One of the best professors at TCU. He is so understanding and passionate about international business. There is a semester long group project but its not hard. There are weekly quizzes due every week but theyre open note. The 2 exams are pretty straightforward. Just take notes during class and you will do well!

Absolutely loved him you have a group project, split into parts that you work on throughout the semester. You have weekly course work through the textbook that is very easy. Sometimes he has you read an article before class that we then discuss. But he makes the class enjoyable and tests are doable and he does a review for each. Take him if you can

Dr. Comer is a great professor that cares about his students. While the class can be sometimes challenging, he make sure that all of his students understand the material. reviews.comment: People are so dramatic about Comer; he is genuinely concerned about his students doing well and will sit with you in office hours if you need. If you have taken Intro to Statistics or AP Stats, Data Analysis will be an EASY A. I sometimes find the class boring as he works through it slowly, but he wants to make sure that everyone understands!

Extremely frustrating 2000-level CJ course. Expectations for exams and assignments were consistently unclear, and lectures did little to explain complex material. Professor Comer struggles to communicate effectively, and office hours rarely provide clarity. I dropped before the deadline. Would not recommend. This class is exhausting and poorly run.

Dr.Comer put effort into his students during this semester. Some extra credit(which wont do much if you dont understand the material) and friday study sessions that helped a lot. The issue is the material for a 2000 level course. It was overwhelming to say the least and if you get stuck on something, goodluck. I would avoid if possible.Not worh it.

Dr. Comer does care about his students and provides opportunities for extra credit/assistance. The quizzes and exams can be difficult if you don't study, as there are many parts to each question, and he is pretty tough on grading. Sometimes he lacks preparedness for lectures, and his final exam was too long. Most of the class did not finish.

Dr. Comer is passionate about teaching but can be way too much sometimes. I've found he's hot and cold, very unpredictable on whether he will help or totally degrade you when you ask for help. Unfortunately he is the only one that teaches Data in CJ. He knows his stuff, but can be intense. Come with an open mind.

Unless you have to take Research Methods, don't take his class. Makes you feel incompetent during office hours and doesn't answer questions. This is a level 2000 course and he treats it like a Master level class. Feels like he is trying to prove himself by making the class unnecessarily difficult.

He struggles to communicate effectively with students. Despite this being a 2000-level course, it was by far the most challenging CJ class I've taken. He provides minimal guidance on assignments. I would not recommend this class to anyone. I wanna believe he means well but sometimes i think he enjoys his students struggling.I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND!!

Awful class all around. Gives absolutely NO direction prior to an assignment or an exam just “concepts” you should be familiar with which sounds straight forward enough but is actually incredibly frustrating. Even more so, HE MAKES EVERYTHING A TRICK QUESTION. I thought we were learning research design not how to solve riddles.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A very frustrating class. The exams are meant to trick you - I have never had a professor purposely do that in such a stupid way. He won't tell you whats on it, always says he forgot as if he didn't write the test/assignment. The lectures are so boring and never posted. He makes easy subjects incredibly hard for no reason. He doesn't want A's.

he teaches you what the research is but doesn't necessarily tell you how to find. He briefly explains what's on the exercises but doesn't exactly prepare you for it. The exams I thought I did great on, I did poorly. He is an extremely tough grader and if it not what he is looking for it is wrong. If you miss class, get notes from a friend.

nice professor very to the point. Exams are just like the slides but you need to memorize everything because he overelaborates on whats not really relevant on exams. He made it seem like some info was on the exam when it wasnt so studying was more difficult than it needed to be. WISH he made a review. For a 2000 level class the grading is hard

Criminological theory is my favorite class I have taken. The material is fascinating but unavoidably dense, so use office hours if anything is confusing. His seminar style teaching is not for everyone, but if you are willing to put in effort and enjoy learning, critical thinking, and higher-level discussions, I highly recommend this class.

The frustrating thing is hes genuinely a great teacher and I learned a ton in this class.  He just grades so unbelievably hard and there are minimal assignments that are all graded at the end of the year and graded very harshly.  I like that he pushes you but the amount of effort you put towards it may not reflect in your grade

Dr. Comer is a good guy but his research design class is tough. Changed online tests to in person scantrons when the class did good on the first test. The material is difficult and he flies through it quickly. Attendance isn't mandatory but if you don't show up you're cooked. Praying I pass this class because im screwed if I dont

Dr. Comer is an overall good guy and makes his students feel welcomed and respected. However, his Criminological Theory class is pretty difficult. He assigns lots of readings from the textbook and the class is only graded on 2 exams and homework. The homework is easy but it is all due at once toward the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: You have to show up and listen to lectures but if you do, you should have no issue. He grades article analysis pretty hard but I still got an A in the class and I am not a straight A student. Attendance is mandatory ofc you can skip a couple times but basically go to class and you'll be fine. He gives a ton of feedback on assignments

There was no depth to his lectures, quizzes every Friday, spends time on middle school level info, and glosses over difficult concepts. Don't even expect an A on the article analysis. He makes you feel dumb for asking for help. Would not recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He adjusted assignments for the grade book halfway through the semester, but the first half of the semester had already messed up our grades. Quizzes are every Friday and require memorization of his PowerPoint lectures so either study during the whole week or have no Thursday night social life. Unclear grading criteria. Pen to paper, no notes ever.

I loved Dr. Comer. He is by far one of my favorite professors at TCU. He rearranged the class halfway through the semester because his students voiced their concerns about their grades. He is very engaging and respectful. I would argue that he does assign a heavy reading load, but he did lessen it over the semester. I would take Dr. Comer again.

He is a nice genuine guy. We reformatted the whole class half way through the semester and it made it much more manageable but if you talk to him he is always willing to help and love Criminal Justice. If you are going to take him just be ready to read and understand the details but he will always be there to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The whole class is memorizing the textbook he wrote. Know the textbook and its smallest of details, do well on the tests. He only answers questions in lectures and briefly goes over topics are in the exams. The class was incredibly challenging, and the tests were tough.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He seems like a nice guy. I wouldn't be surprised if he has autism. Lectures are pointless, and he'll tell you that. You basically have to memorize the textbook that he wrote, and that's really annoying. The class is pointless and it doesn't prepare you for the MCAT or anything, but all pre-health have to take it.

I truly believe it brings this man joy to get students to drop. You better memorize every word in every chapter if you want to do well on the test, he doesn't want to help you, he just wants to feel smarter than you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you got a 5 on AP Bio and can memorize his textbook from front to back, you'll be ok. You will think you know all the stuff that will be on the test, but you won't because he asks random things that are in fine print in the textbook. So many tests, and your final grade is purely based on your test scores. We had a test and midterm in same week!

Professor Mark Demarest is very knowledgeable and approachable, especially since he wrote the textbook. He encourages questions through an anonymous in-class app and always takes time to answer them. Reading before class is essential, as lectures are mainly review. Quizzes closely match exam questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: One of the best biology professors at TCU. He wants his students to do well, and cares about them as people rather than just students. He writes his own textbook, so quiz questions show up on exams. Attendance isn't required and is a supplemental tool to memorizing the book. The class is hard, but he gives you the tools to succeed.
lectures aren't good; flipped classroom style. if you know the textbook back to front you will be okay.

He is a great professor who really cares about his students succeeding; although he expects you to know almost everything in his textbook. His lectures are helpful the day before the test because he usually gives practice exam questions. Overall would take again
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: His lectures were very laid back and he is someone who truly cares to see you suceed. As long as you show up to class and read a very easy to read and short book you'll earn an 100.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: He goes directly off of the textbook he created online, so there's not really a reason to attend class unless you need extra clarification. All multiple choice tests and gives you chances to replace tests and drops a couple too. Personally, I wish he would teach more rather than just expect you to memorize the whole textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really nice guy. He really wants his students to succeed, no matter what academic standing or major. Yes, the textbook and course material can be a lot but he explains it so much better if you attend his lectures. He also gives advice before almost every lecture that is actually helpful. Would recommend.

If you can memorize his personally written textbook then you will do good, he is a cool dude but essentially just wants you to know and love his textbook from cover to cover. Lecture isn't really helpful he barely goes over anything from the chapters.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: No point in attending early morning lecture, the class is based on memorization of a textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of my fav bio classes was Marine Science. A BIG portion of class is group work (in assigned groups) like weekly quizzes, 3 exams (including the final), & a project, but made it fun & helps boost grades. Lab is very chill & usually gets you extra credit on exams. And overall Demarest is really caring and very open to feedback, would recommend.
most of your grade will be test-driven. tries to help you improve. can come off as a little insensitive but if you show up to office hours he will explain everything with a lot of detail

Dr. Demarest is an amazing professor and really considerate, but this class is a lot of work. Tons of readings, detailed weekly quizzes, and lots of content you have to teach yourself. flipped classroom, so be ready to study a lot—studied & stressed more for this class than all my other bio classes this semester. Labs are chill though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I understand why the class was so difficult. It prepares you to study. As a bio major, the topics were interesting but so hard to grasps sometimes. With that being said, I got a C doing everything I could to pass. Office hours, peer tutors,etc. Lock in from week 1 and thug it out and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: READ THE TEXTBOOK!!! He wrote the textbook and knows the content like the back of his hand. You need to know if well. If you read and do learning catalytic you will do good. He's a super kind guy so super reachable for questions. Super chill but BORING lectures

I took his Intro to Pre-Health class. He was very chill in that class and was knowledgable on the material. There are discussions on the book that you can skim through if you're really short on time (like I was, oops). The final is a paper. Class was P/NC and I got a P. Overall, very chill class, nice professor. 10/10.

This class literally revolves around the textbook. You have to literally memorize tiny details from it. Class attendance and lecture is much less relevant (altho you have to sign in). Make study guides off the learning objectives given and learn every bolded word. The tests are the only thing graded and are detail driven; study hard but doable!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: hes not an easy grader

My schedule said Demarest but I ended up with the GTA Vuong who was very condescending and aggressive. The exams were decent. Majority of the material for exams were on the handouts and notes that we were provided. Just beware it might say Demarest but you could end up with a GTA in my case which had an extremely negative impact on my experience.
Truly does care for his students and wants them all to succeed. great guy, really tough class.

I promise this class is one of the easier ones you'll have to take, but take it seriously. Yes, read the textbook (or have it read to you with the online version). Yes, you will want to take the homework seriously. It can be super easy, but try to ask yourself if you really understand the material and what he could test you on based on that.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Demarest is such a nice man but his class is unreasonably hard. I read, studied, and annotated the text book cover to cover and wasn't able to perform well on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: his course is not built in a way that allows the average student to be successful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Demarest is very kind and willing to help his students when you go to him for help. By the final you'll pretty much need to know the textbook front to back. Read your chapters before class and again before tests. Ask questions in office hours. Draw the systems. Tests are 90% of your grade, only 35ish questions, and pretty detailed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Be ready to teach yourself everything... take notes on all learning catalytics, read the entire book while doing quizzes, and memorize everything. If you don't memorize most of the content you will not do well. Some quiz questions are on exams, but everything else is random minute details from the book, which is very hard to comprehend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His lectures don't really help on tests, you're better off just reading the book on your own instead of going to lectures. Attendance is mandatory but also online so you can do it from anywhere. He's a nice teacher overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Class is very material heavy, but lectures are very helpful. There is always excess time at the end of class for Q&A and even some classes dedicated to just this. You are able to retake tests once and are able to retake quizzes as many times as you would like. He wants his students to succeed in and encourages them to come to his office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Demarest is very nice and cares about how you are doing outside of class. If something is going on, he will be mindful of struggles and do his best to help. The class itself is very hard. 3 exams, each with 2 attempts (lowest dropped), 12 chapter quizzes, and daily in class participation. The content tested is a lot of memorization. STUDY!
The professor is really nice and approachable but the class is difficult. Most percentage of grade comes from exams. Exams are based on the textbook and lecture. A lot of memorization.
Do not take marine with him, it's too hard for what is supposed to be an easy upper division course.

Insanely nice and approachable. The class itself is hard. There is a lot of material that is covered and because of that, constant textbook reading is necessary. This class is very time consuming and memorization heavy. The professor does his best to make himself available for questions etc. but the learning itself is very independent.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Memorize the textbook and you'll do well, his exams are just random facts pulled from the textbook and lots of repeat questions from quizzes. He is very nice and approachable but his lectures don't even teach what is on the exams. Made me rethink my major many times as this was the first bio class I took at TCU.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Demarest is very nice. We got three attempts on exams. When we had three attempts for every exam, they were spread out throughout the week, and we did not have class that week. But his exams did not correlate with the lectures. The exams were very specific, and hard to earn a good grade.

Demarest is kind and hardworking. He gives you a ton of information that you need to know pretty perfectly, but with 3 tries on every lockdown exam and quizzes being open note, its hard not to do semi-well in his course. Just make sure to read EVERYTHING he posts, from his lectures, LC questions, cognella, and more.

Dr. Demarest is very approachable but the class is very heavy on the pre-readings so it can be hard to keep up with that when you don't have weekly quizzes to keep you on track. 90% of your grade comes from 4 exams. You do have three tries at your exams which is nice to have.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor & funny guy. 90% of your grade comes from exams, so you have to study a lot, but there is 3 tries per exam so only the highest grade counts. Take VERY detailed notes on the reading, study those (I used quizlet), then reread everything several times directly before you take the exam because questions are specific & easy to overlook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Dr. Demarest is a wonderful professor. 4 exams total (last exam being the final),3 attempts on each exam (except the final exam) during the semester. You will pre-read the material, go to lecture, answer questions during lecture. The only issues is that there is no practice tests you can take to prepare yourself for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: One of the nicest profs and he genuinely cares about you and wants you to do well. He is very approachable if you have any questions.

Lots of modules. Know what is in the modules and you will be fine. Write down learning objectives at the beginning of each module and know the details of the big concepts. No surprises on tests and Dr. Demarest is always there to help but you do have to put in some work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The prelectures are so long and then in class we don't go over them in detail. Most of the class was wasted because my group would finish the Learning Catalytics quickly and then sit there for 45 minutes until the review. Very detail-oriented tests which seems pointless. He's passionate about the subject and responds to emails though.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Awesome class with awesome professors (Demarest and Misamore). I wish I could take this course again.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He's a nice guy who seems to care about his students. Your grade relies on 4 tests and a final (each worth 20%) He teaches using a "flipped Classroom" meaning you learn most of the material before you come to class. Class is spent reviewing. It is sometimes really tempting to skip class but don't because it is much more valuable than you think.

Being in a flipped classroom it's easy to feel like this class is easy. However, do NOT underestimate it as any bio class has its caveats. He gives 10 extra points on the final if you participate throughout the semester. He's a pretty cool guy who genuinely cares about the student succeeding. Take good notes and come to class w questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The one professor in a Pre-Med required course that was not "out to get me". All grades come from tests so be prepared to study long hours, but his tests and grading system is extremely fair and just. He leaves tons of time in class for questions, so ask away. He gives super funny science lectures, so try to get him to crack a joke or two.

Dr. Demarest is one of the nicest biology professors at TCU. He cares about his students! The class is challenging, but he is pretty fair. The lecture attendance is not mandatory, but you should always go if you want to pass/make a decent grade. The only thing I didn't like was that his lectures are online modules so its flipped classroom setting.

Literally the worst. The entire class is online and you basically have to sift through the information to even find what you need to actually know. Tests always have a large amount of questions regarding minuscule content he put on one specific slide in one specific link that you would never think you would need to study. Absolutely awful!

he truly cares about his students. he spent hours with me in office hours going over past tests to make sure I understand this info. He trys to cater to your learning style as much as possible. He knows that this is a lot of info and loves feedback he trys to condense the info every semester. I spent on average 7-9 hrs prereading for each lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Demarest is one of the worst professors Ive ever had. Going to class it totally pointless as all of the learning is done through wordy, repetitive online modules outside of class. His tests are filled with pointless facts that dont relate to understanding the material. He expects you to memorize every single powerpoint he posts. Horrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is an enigma. Studied a ton for every test and got a C on EVERY single one. He does not lecture for notes in class. Instead, he assigns volumes of content on online modules where you have to "find" the important information. Most ambiguous and worst prof I have ever had. Made the first C in my life on this class. Also boring class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: For Bio 2, Professor Demarest was wonderful. He was engaging, and didn't drone on during lectures. But be prepared to put in some reading time. He doesn't expect you to memorize everything, but isn't always clear in his expectations, this way you'll learn everything. Wonderful teacher, but be prepared to read!

It truly was one of the most interesting classes I've taken, and I did learn a lot. However, the class required hours and hours of preparation before going into class. He expects you to know all the materials before coming into class, which often times is highly unrealistic. A lot of the times, the exams had random facts that you wouldn't expect
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Way more memorization and material than bio 1. You'll have to learn so many random facts. If you take notes (which I'd recommend), be prepared to spend HOURS taking notes before lectures especially for the animal unit. His online notes aren't organized well, are repetitive, and so wordy. He's interesting but lectures can be pointless.

Basically all learning is done outside of class, and he can definitely make the pre-lectures extremely long. Going to class is pretty much pointless, but he'll ask questions about things covered in class to trip some people up. 4 exams and the final, which are all worth the same. He doesn't curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Coming from a horrible Bio 1 teacher, I really enjoyed Demarest's nice demeanor and the way that he lectured. Although going to class is pointless, I really enjoyed it when I did go. All learning is done on your own through online led homework which actually helped me a lot. He's fair in what he puts on the test, it's just a lot of info to cover.

This style of class was not my favorite. All useful info comes off of the online homework and I frequently found myself sitting in lecture bored/dreaming of a nap/doodling. The easy material is covered in lecture, but any tougher concepts are on your own. I am not a fan of online learning, so this was not a class I really enjoyed. Funny guy though
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS
