This class was definitely challenging and reading heavy, but so worth the work. If you want to take a class that will impact you beyond the classroom, take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: An absurd amount of weekly reading. The entire class is graded on progress updates for the final research paper. The workload is manageable; unfortunately, there is no clear direction give which results in largely subjective grading. By far the worst grade I will receive in college.

Dr. Farris is brilliant. She's my favorite professor in the political science department. Class is very interesting and she handles tough topics like a champ. You work for your grade, but it's nothing too difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof Farris is handling the move online really well and is providing such clear guidelines and criteria. This isn't an easy class, but I really respect how she knows we are all deal with tons of weird stuff from COVID. She's tough but worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Farris is one of the most intelligent professors I have had. She really makes you work for your grade, so expect to put in a lot of effort. A majority of my semester was focused on this class, so plan accordingly. She gives good feedback on each individual paper so you should feel confident in the material by the time of the final paper.

POSC 39013 with Dr. Farris is one of the most difficult classes I have ever taken. She makes the class harder than it should be with very subjective grading. If you take this course you better not be taking any other classes if you want to receive a good grade.

Look: you need to do the reading and come to class. If you do those things and study and participate, you are going to get a lot out of class. But it is NOT a class for lazy people or people that just want to cram at the last minute for an exam. Take someone else. If you do keep up, she's really well organized and interesting. A+
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof. Farris's class was difficult, but SO worth it. She expects you to do the reading and participate in class--you definitely have to come prepared. This is NOT an "easy A" type of class. But if you want a professor who really cares about learning, and will work with anyone who shows up and TRIES their best, this is the one for you!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Farris is HARD, but the class is interesting. She calls on people if they haven't done the reading. She tests on the readings too - very difficult tests. Basically, if you don't read and come to class, you won't get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Farris expects you to do the reading and come to class prepared. You need to participate in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Love Dr. Farris, she's super funny and you can tell she cares about what she's teaching. The class is pretty fast paced, with a lot of information thrown at you. Only 3 tests including final, the first one is worth less so don't get discouraged. Get ready to take rigorous notes, and work hard for a good grade, but overall I really enjoyed the class
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Farris is one of the most BRILLIANT professors I have had at TCU. She genuinely cares about her students and sets high expectations because she knows you can achieve them. She is not discriminatory against conservative students. that's BS. I am a strong republican and earned an A in her class- work hard and you'll be fine. TAKE HER CLASSES!!!

I have taken Dr. Farris two times the first I could not stand her and the second I really enjoyed the class. I found out the trick to taking her classes though and her liking you. 1) Show up to class 2)" Participate" this is a big one. We had pretty conflicting views, but still enjoyed her class and actually enjoyed her as a professor round two.

Mr. El-Youssef makes learning fun and breaks down difficult concepts well. However, the three tests are essentially your entire grade, so you need to do well on all of them. If you work hard and can commit outside of class time to homework and studying, you can make an 'A'.
AMAZING PROFESSOR. Always open to meet you, really wants to see you do well.
very very good

Prof. El-Youssef's Statistical Analysis is probably the best offered at TCU. He cares about his students, knows a ton about his subject, and is super available. Almost everything is in excel (pretty much an excel + stats). Everything is understandable, but the tests can be a bit tough, especially if you aren't good with/don't catch on to Excel.

The material is obviously difficult, but he wants you to succeed. If you have questions go to office hours and make sure you participate in class, it helps. One of the best professors I have had at TCU.

By far the best professor I've had at TCU. He really cares about his students. Our finals are coming up this week, and he just took his own weekend time to schedule two extra virtual office hours so we could ask any last minute questions. Great professor, even greater man.
Tough class for sure.
Best professor I've had at TCU. He genuinely cares about his students. His exams are open note. He explains the course content extremely well and the exams are easy if you pay attention in class.

I'm not sure why everyone chooses this guy; they always end up regretting it. He has changed his grading criteria; his tests are harder now than before. He doesn't drop your lowest grade. Most people don't see his bad ratings because they have dropped the class, and don't care to rate.
The best professor at TCU, great teaching style and methodology. He makes sure everyone understands and no one is left behind. Always available to help students. Highly recommend his classes.
Attendance is not required but highly recommend going to his classes or you will get lost. Great professor and very available to help you outside of class
The best professor I have taken. I took him two years ago and visited him today. He taught me things not only about statistics but also about life.

Took him earlier in the spring and I was reflecting on the class. That alone should speak volumes on how great of a professor he is. This class is not gonna be better with any other. Easy to understand and just a very good teacher. If confused go to office hours, he is always going out of his way to help. 10/10!

This is the best professor I have ever had. The way he carries himself is fantastic. He is always available outside of the class and I couldn't recommend anything more. His office hours are where you learn the most and connect with him. He really rewards effort and participation and both of those make the class more rewarding for you.

Hands down the best professor I have had at TCU. I thoroughly enjoyed going to this class just to hear him speak. The class itself seemed very easy compared to other stats classes Ive heard about. Homeworks and test were pretty simple and are also completely open note. Rewards participation, get to know him and he will help you succeed. Take him fs

LOVE HIMMM!!! Taking his class has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my academic journey. He is, without a doubt, the best professor I've ever had. Not only is he incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about the subject matter, but he genuinely cares about his students and their success.

Best Professor I have ever had. I am so lucky to have gotten the chance to know him and take his class. He is very caring and helpful if you put the work in. Goes out of his way to make sure students understand the concepts and he builds relationships.

Such a nice guy. He rounded my grade up so much and really cares about his students success. He really values participation and helps you out a lot if you participate. Don't miss class because you will have no idea what is going on if you do. Tests are ok, can be hard sometimes. Make sure you have your templates ready. Would def recommend taking.

Prof Youssef is one of the most caring teachers i know. Build a relationship with him!!! If you participate in class and show you care about what he's teaching he is so understanding with grades at the end of the year. The tests get harder each time, so reach out for help and you'll be better off. TAKE HIM FOR STATS!!!!

He is such a great professor who really cares about his students learning. My best advice is to participate in class, ask questions, and go office hours. Make sure you really understand the subject before tests because the wording can be confusing. I would take his class again.
Professor Rami is such a great professor. His lectures are great and he gives us a lot of his time. Hopefully I can take another class with him.
Amazing professor, simply the very best at TCU!

This professor is the greatest professor I have ever taken in my whole academic career. He is not only kind and caring, but you can tell he goes the extra mile to help his students. This class is generally not easy, but professor Rami makes it a walk in the park.
The only thing in the gradebook are quizzes and tests. While they are all open note the exam questions are poorly worded and difficult to understand. Do not take him.

TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. He is so caring and understanding of his students and you can tell he really wants to help his students. Three exams and a final along with three quizzes. GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS. His tests and quizzes are all open notes and slides. Best professor I have ever had at TCU.

Rami is a great teacher, as someone who already took stats in high school, class was pretty easy. He gets fired up when the whole class is participating and asking questions. Hw are ungraded but are needed to take the quiz. Tests are open note, open slides. Some trick questions are on the test, but not too bad. Take him even if its a bad time.

Contribute to class discussions because he will boost your grade. He cares about his students and adjusts his grading to help them. There is a homework assignment for each chapter, a quiz and exam for each unit, and everything is open-note. I love him so much; he is so sweet. TAKE HIM FOR STATS!!!

He clearly cares about his students. Lectures may become confusing but the concepts are so easy that if you have any confusion, he will clear it up if you just ask. His tests are also fair. Only complaint is the class was a bit dead, and he would go on side rants about nobody participating or greeting him. That's fair, but better ways to do that.

Took Professor El-Youssef last semester, he makes a difficult class easy. Take advantage of office hours and ask questions, he is more than willing to help. 10/10 professor literally cannot say a bad thing about him.

Super sweet professor! This class is difficult and I'm sure there are easier professors, but Professor El-Youssef truly cares about his students. The tests are difficult but not impossible. This is NOT a super time-consuming class which is a plus. Definitely go to office hours before tests and participate in class to understand the material better!

Dr. El-Youssef is so kind and really tries to make his lecture engaging. While the course can be challenging as the bulk of the grade depends on 3 tests (open note, no using AI or a friend) + the final, he is very reasonable and wants to work with students to help them succeed. Make sure to actively participate during class and ask questions!

Very nice guy and a great teacher. He can be standoffish, and his tests are difficult and fast-paced. Ran out of time on 2 of 4 tests. The only thing I can say is he is a great guy & cares, and you should take him, but DO NOT EVER miss class. 1, Attendance is mandatory & 2, It will be impossible to prepare for the test over the material you missed.

TAKE HIM!!!!! He really cares about his students and tries to help them as much as possible. There are 3 exams and 1 cumulative final. The exams can be a bit difficult but if you pay attention and practice, you will do great.

Rami is very kind and wants to see all students succeed. His class is based primarily on 3 exams, all covering a different unit, and a cumulative final. His lectures can be somewhat boring and he expects participation. He can also be a little difficult to reach outside of class, if your schedule conflicts with his. Pay attention or you'll be lost.
Hands-down best professor at TCU. Caring and respectful, he finds a way to make each lecture engaging.
Words will not do him justice, a professor that not only cares for his students but is also great at teaching.

He is a good professor who wants you to do well and makes himself accessible for help. However, test questions are worded very poorly. You will know what you're doing in class and his test questions will make you confused on the test.

El-Youssef is funny, caring, and cool, but his exams are tough despite being open-note—they're super conceptual with unseen questions. Homework quizzes are easy, as they're pulled from classwork. No calculators, only Excel. He bans AI use, unlike other Stats classes. Take him if you want a challenge, but there may be easier options for an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Just a wonderful professor and an even better man. I am so grateful that I had the chance to meet him and have him as my professor.

El-Youssef is a professor that helps you understand all of the material and wants you to do well! His tests are all open note but are difficult in which you need to do the optional homework to understand the material. There are not many opportunities to bump up your grade because of the test heavy focus but an interesting class that I enjoyed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, very helpful and open. Use office hours when lost and try to go early in the semester if you need any help. Ensure you have your TEMPLATES ready BEFORE the exam, very important! Exams go by very fast so you want to make sure you're prepared. Overall, great class and a new perspective on math :)

Go to office hours! Get to know him! Speak and engage in class! Don't do it for your grade, just do it because he is genuinely one of the best people and teachers you would have the privilege of meeting so make the most of your experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Take him. Nice guy and his class is not hard. Open-note exams that are incredibly easy if you have templates prepared.

A very kind and friendly professor who puts effort into getting to know all of his students and inspiring students to do well. He is also very knowledgeable about the subject and makes it easy to understand. Lectures are often entertaining, as he has a great sense of humor.

El-Youssef is a true example of what it means and takes to be a professor. His class is not supposed to be easy, but if you put in the work, your efforts will be rewarded. Don't miss class and go to office hours. He's super caring and understanding. He knows all of his students and supports them equally, but you have to put in the effort.
Professor Elyoussef is truly different, so knowledgable in the field and isnt hesitant to share. Not only a great professor but such an even sweeter person.

Great lectures and he really cares about how much his students understand. Statistical analysis is difficult but El-Youssef made it entertaining and explained it as well as possible! Very little homework, quizzes are questions from the homework and tests are all open note open book. Definitely take El-Youssef if you can!!!

He's a great professor, tries to make difficult subject as easy as possible. I feel like he genuinely cares about his students, and he is fair person. Participate, do your homework and you'll be just fine.

THE BEST PROFESSOR I HAVE EVER TAKEN! TCU if you guys are reading this, give this man a serious raise. He goes out of his way to help and is super knowledgeable in this field. The best professor I have taken here and it is not even close.
Homework due at the end of the unit. Quizzes are 5 direct open-note homework questions just so he knows if you did the homework or not. All tests are open note. He just makes sense. Take him!
Amazing professor, very caring and helpful. Teaches the subjects well and has alot of knowledge in general. Probably the best teacher at TCU.

Stats is hard no matter who you take. He was amazing and truly cared about his students. Really wants to hear you participate, even if it's the most simple answer. If you go to his office hours alone, he will reteach the topic to you if you don't understand which was extremely helpful.  Tests are hard but if you do the homework you will be fine.

This is not an easy class but he is by far the best professor. He is a nice guy that also cares about the students. There is 4 exams plus the final and before each exam there is a homework quiz where you just copy and paste some of your answers for an easy 100. You have to spend time outside of class to do well but I highly recommend taking him.

He genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Always available at office hours and is super helpful. He understands the material is hard and confusing and will ask for students' opinions to improve the outcome of the class. If you have to take this course, TAKE PROFESSOR EL-YOUSSEF.
Best professor I've had at TCU

Dr. El-Youseff is an amazing professor! He really cares about his students and is super accessible through office hours and email. Make an effort to go to office hours and connect with him, it will help you SO MUCH in class. By far one of the best professors I've had at TCU. I would take any class he was teaching
By far the best professor to ever grace TCU. If you like or don't like mathematics, Dr.Elyoussef is definitely the best.

He is so far the best professor I've taken at TCU. BStats is a hard class but he made it so much more fun. He is very kind and caring and went out of his way to make sure every student in the class succeeded. He appreciates students who participate in class. Just focus on lecture slides and homework questions for the exams and you should be good!
By far the best professor I have taken at TCU. Very caring and understands the subject on another level..he genuinely wants to see you do good.

Stats is a difficult class no matter what, but professor El-Youssef works extremely hard to help you through the course. He makes his lecture slides as clear as possible and wants you to really understand the material. He offers office hours multiple times during the week and works one-on-one with students to answer any questions you have.
He is so nice and so willing to help his students understand the material, go to office hours!!! If he can tell you care and try he will respect you so much more

FR 1 with Erickson was good!!! Pay attention and REVIEW for exams. I got good scores on all my exams, and I personally feel if you had good experience with foundations (i felt like that class was more difficult) you will do well in this one. The final was the worst part since and the most difficult thing in this class. He was really sweet.

Super knowledgeable teacher and very intelligent. Lectures are sometimes tough because he is so smart and goes fast and assumes students already know certain things. Exams are challenging but you learn a ton.

Genuinely nice guy who knows his stuff, really cares about our success, and will do anything to help. Work load was also fair. However, his explanations were often unclear and confusing, class felt disorganized, and the lectures didn't feel like they added much. This was also his first year teaching tax at TCU, so maybe these will improve over time

He is a very nice guy, but I do not recommend for tax. He is very passionate about the subject and wants to help but doesn't know how to.There are no review packets, study guides, or test outlines and expects us to review hundreds of application problems before every exam. This was overall a very disorganized class and I do not recommend.

Nicest professor ever, I really enjoyed his class. Cares about his students. It is important to pay attention to lectures in class because FR1 material can be pretty difficult. We work problems every day in class that help. Also gives helpful test reviews!

Nice guy, but doesn't explain things well. Just reads off the slides and adds nothing extra, if you don't get it asking doesn't really help. Quizzes every other class. Clear he understands the material, just doesn't relay it.
the class is simple. if you want to learn this is not the class for you.and the speakers he brings are cool. class is usually canceled
Took this class last semester and really enjoyed it. Lots of guest speakers which is really inspirational. Great guy!
This guy is a wonderful human with interesting topics and lectures. He gets great guest speakers, and you never have to go to class. 3 papers all year and an easy grader

Not sure why he is rated so poorly when he is one of the best criminal justice professors at TCU. His classes are incredibly hard to get into but worth the effort.Taken several courses, my favorite being critical issues, he is very knowledgeable and passionate about what he does. The assignments are really short and basically participation grades.

Pretty easy material, but she is a weak lecturer. She doesn't speak clearly and just reads off slides, but there are graded in-class activities so you have to show up. None of the in-class assignments have substance, and she makes you do a group project that has no real point. Decent person, but not worth the money.

Honestly so boring. Also, when she was talking about depressive disorders, she said people with PDD were "just a bummer to be around". I have accommodations and had to talk to her about it since she didn't read them the first time they were sent to her. The tests are easy but in general you won't learn anything you can't get from Google.

Lectures were long, and she simply did not lecture well, especially because she said "uh" or "um" between literally every word and didn't explain the content well. Personally, I really did not like the way she handled the course, but overall, the class and exams were easy, so do with that as you will.

Dr. Broom is the sweetest! So funny and cares about what she teachers. Be prepared for long lectures, but still would recommend! Exams are remote lockdown and not too hard. She gives pop mini assignments to make sure you go to class. Easy group project at the end. Not a bad class to take just not as interesting as I'd hoped :)

Dr. Broom is the goat. She is hilarious and incredibly smart. I have never had a professor give lectures as easy to listen to as Dr. Broom's. She is very engaging. Tests are online and not lockdown. There is just an occasional attendance assignment. She is the kindest and I couldn't recommend her more. TAKE HER!

She is very sweet but does pop assignments so you have to go to class as this will tank your grade. Her tests were pretty hard and based on what she said in class, not just study guide/ textbook. She is way harder than any other into to psych classes, but she's very nice and if you go to class you will be fine.

Passionate professor. You can tell she cares about what she talks about, which is great for a professor teaching in your major. Provides ppts before class and study guides, and the exams are online, open-note, BUT the exams are often old. There were typically questions that were repeated, and others that were never in lecture, nor the textbook.

She is really caring. lectures are super interesting. I would tell my roommates about her tips for mental health but it's really alot of life tips Exams are online at home. no camera because she told us she believes in privacy and doesn't like that we are recorded. You walk out of class feeling better about your life and coping with stuff.

Decent lecturer. 4 exams are worth most of the grade, which isn't a great setup for psych. Exams are online. SONA hours, obviously. I think she made it a bit more difficult than an intro class needed to be and I think there are better, nicer, and easier professors to take for intro psych at least.
She reads off the slides and expects you to know more material than what she goes over. She's a nice lady but defiantly not an easy class. All tests in person on lockdown bowser and cumulative final.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Her exams are not too difficult if you study a little bit and she usually curves them afterwards. She is very sweet and keeps class interesting.

This class in general is more difficult than most however, I truly enjoyed this class. She is amazing... a great person and professor. The tests are average but you still need to study. Attendance is taken by in class assignments, they are very engaging and I appreciated that.

Dr Broom is a great teacher and passionate about teaching us about mental health and disorders. She talks about how to manage depression and anxiety and has helpful tips for life. My roommates ask about this class because she gives good advice that you can use to be mentally healthier.

Professor Broom is an excellent teacher. The class was interesting, long lectures but she keeps you engaged. Notes matter in class, occasional assignments in class to see if you're present to count for a grade. Some online exams, some in person. if you go to class and take notes, you will get an A.
Make sure you listen and take notes on her lectures because a lot of it will come up in tests. She cares about her students and is passionate about what she is teaching!

Dr b actually cares about her students. She met with me when I didn't do good on her test and I explained about a family situation making it hard to study. She emailed me before the next tests and helped me review and would ask how I was doing the rest of the semester. Ask her to help and meet before tests and go to class and you will get an A.

Professor Broom is very passionate about what she teaches. She gives real life examples to many topics which helped a lot. My only frustration was that in order to meet with her you had to meet with the TA first and she only held office hours for 1 hour and for one day of the week. If you take notes and pay attention, you should be fine.

Dr.Broom is a sweet professor and a kind person. She basically reads off the slides every class which is annoying but will hint at what is going to be on exams. Her exams are application based with some definitions and there can be questions you never went over which is annoying. If you take notes and study and know your stuff you should be fine.

Broom is super sweet. Attendance isn't mandatory but there are occasionally in class assignments which are all your graded on besides exams (all in person). If you pay attention and take good notes you can do well on the exams.She makes lectures engaging and connects the material to a real world example which makes it easier to understand concepts.

Professor Broom is awesome! She always has interesting or funny stories to tell that go along with her lectures! Her tests can be a bit tricky, but as long as you review her lectures and take good notes, you should be fine. Graded by 3 exams including final, 1 easy group project, and some in-class participation grades here & there.

Awesome. Hilarious. Fun. Dr. B is such a great professor & is extremely understanding. She also is a complete ditz sometimes but it's great bc she laughs at herself & laughs with us. Would definitely recommend her if you hate boring professors.  3 m/c exams, 1 group project (easy), "pop extra points" for videos watched in class & take notes. 10/10

She is such a funny and sweet professor! she gives lots of extra credit and all the tests are taken on your own time at home. You can miss class but she gives out in class assignments for participation points.
Awesome professor! Super clear grading criteria and expectations, and a super kind person to talk to.

I love Dr. Broom. She's probably my favorite professor I've had. She's so sweet, and if you show up to class and don't completely blow off the course, it should end up being a relatively easy one. She values actual learning over tough grading. Take Dr. B if you can!

I can't even BELIEVE anyone could rate broom less than 5/5. This woman is hilarious and lectures are very entertaining. She brings in pop culture references to explain mental illnesses and really does a great overall job of simplifying everything. Beware of random in-class assignments that count as points! Other then that would recommend.
Professor Broom was great! Her lectures were very interesting and engaging!  Loved the class, and as long as you paid attention in class getting a good grade was achievable!

She's a good person but not a professor. If you enjoy learning, she makes it hard to understand since it sounds like she isn't even prepared during her lectures. She goes off the pre-readings and adds her examples. Her test is pretty much lecture heavy. Even though the exams are open notes, they are still somewhat challenging.

Prof. Broom is great! Easy class and attendance is not mandatory but she sometimes gives in class work so you have to be there to get credit. Tests arent too bad and they are take home. Definitely best option for core psyc class
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: SHE'S AMAZING!!!! attendance is not mandatory but I recommend going because sometimes the exams contain lecture info. She also lets you use notes during the exams but make sure you study because the questions are about application not about memorization. I honestly did not use the textbook at all and did fine but it's all about preference.

Dr. Broom's class is very interesting. Tests & quizzes are all online but are a little difficult. She usually curves them. Attendance is not mandatory but there are a few SEA assignments that are in person & sometimes online. She teaches things in lecture that aren't on the powerpoint so go to class! She is my favorite teacher so far at TCU!
Lots of extra credit, online exams

Professor Broom is amazing! She really cares about all of the students and will take the time out of her day to make you feel better. Her classes are interactive and if you are going to take a psychology class definitely take it with her! MAKE SURE YOU DO SONA! It's not hard, but required for all psych courses.

Professor Broom is always a great way to start my mornings. She is engaging even with a larger class size. She always is understanding and reasonable with grades. Most of all she always has a funny or relatable story to make her lectures interesting. I would highly recommend taking her class.

Dr. Broom is a great professor. She uses her experience as a psychologist to help teach Abnormal Psych. Her tests were open notes and she treats her students with respect (NO LOCKDOWN BROWSER!) I highly recommend taking Dr. Broom and will be taking her again in the future!
She let us use our notes on our exams, very cool. She also made our assignments crystal clear and gave out plenty of extra credit opportunities.

Dr Broom is easily the most lovable person ever. She's very attentive and funny. Make sure you do your 3 hours of SONA credits (they're mostly surveys and LAB stuff but easy), turn in the SEA assignments. She can be a bit messy sometimes with grammar errors in test questions but overall, you don't want to miss out on Dr Ellie Broom!
Dr Broom is really helpful and actually cares about students. She did a good job of teaching and was actually concerned about us with COVID.
She really is the BEST!!! Lectures are interesting and she cares about her students. Dr. Broom is passionate, knows her stuff, and pretty too! TAKE HER.

Dr. Broom is a super sweet lady who will always try to help you! The class grade is mainly based on tests, but there are a few assignments randomly given during class. Pay attention during lectures and read the chapters assigned and you will do just fine. Dr. Broom is super funny too; her jokes are the best and keep class interesting!

please if you can TAKE DR. B. she is THE SWEETEST lady and is such an adorable prof. by far one of my favorite profs at TCU. her class is the perfect balance: the right amt of challenge and fun! any negative reviews are ridiculous, and whoever wrote it probably didnt put in effort to study. you will not regret taking this class!!!
Dr B is the best! You have to show up for class activities but lectures are super interesting so its worth it. She really cares about her students and passionate about teaching.

Dr. Broom is well liked since so many people have to take intro psych and she is pretty active on campus outside of class. She is super nice, but... honestly not the best professor ever. She doesn't always organize her lectures well, imo. She does do a good job of making things understandable with lots of examples, though. Also, not a hard class.
Awesome class. Best intro to Psych professor.

How to get an A in this class: 1. Start SONA hours early. If you get 15 hours it boosts your grade up 5% 2. If you are gonna miss a class don't miss Friday. That's when she gives out handouts which goes towards your activity grade. 3. Fill out lecture notes its the test 4. Go to office hours. She is super helpful. Lets get this bread guys

Broom is your best bet for intro psychology. She makes things interesting and real to life. She is super nice and funny and cute. Go to class, pay attention, and do the extra credit and you will get an A.

Broom is the best teacher for Intro psych - she is super straightforward and gives great study guides in prep for each test. She does sometimes give out worksheets that are due by the end of class but drops the lowest one. Doesn't take attendance just make sure you don't miss more than one in class assignment! Also gives EC for a 5% grade boost
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is a great professor. Her notes are fill in the blank and if you know them you should do good on the tests. She goes into great detail about things and makes the class enjoyable. There is also great opportunities for extra credit.

Very nice professor. Passionate about psychology, and she makes lectures interesting. If you show up and do they study guides before the test, you will get an A. Also, there is opportunities for extra credit.

She's awesome! She really helps you understand the material. There are clicker questions in class for points & her lectures are clear/easy to understand. She is super caring & makes the class SO interesting! I loved learning about everything in this class because of the way she presented it. If you go to class and actually listen, you will do well.

This class was very simple and straightforward. The lectures can be somewhat boring, but Dr. Broom really seems to be passionate about the material. Sona (psych experiments) can be annoying, but can help your grade a ton (up to 5 points EC). Review the study guide and mark your notes when she says something will be on the test.
This class was amazing! Interesting topics and even better when she gets off topic because it is like going to therapy.
Lectures are interesting and she makes it relatable to real life. You can tell she cares about her students. Show up and do the study guide and the sona extra credit and you can get an A.
She makes the lectures interesting and provides her presentation with fill in the blank areas. Lectures are easy to follow, but exams are a little more difficult. Do the SONA hours for extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I actually looked forward to going to her class. Make sure you print out the chapter notes before class so you can take notes (fill in the blank notes). Do the study guides for the tests. Dr. Broom is the best. Loves talking about her sons.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Intro Psych was straightforward- everyday a lecture, then prep for a multiple choice test. In class handouts! The tests were sometimes tricky, but definitely manageable to get an A. Do all the SONA extra credit! I got an A without ever opening the book. She is a kind person, but basically just reads the powerpoints. It can be hard to pay attn.
Great class. Broom is really straight forward and willing to help students. Topics were interesting and she is really passionate about what she does.
Great class. Show up and pay attention and you'll pass with an A.
Lectures are interesting, and she doesn't take attendance but gives out activity grades at random. Overall pretty easy class, just study the night before exams and you'll be fine!

She is a great professor and makes her lectures interesting. The material is very easy and all notes are fill in the blank style. If you need to take a general psychology course she is the one to take. Busy work is often given but it is not that bad.

The class is really interesting, but she is so chill and nice that you think it will be easy. The tests can be hard because they are application. Mrs. Broom is really helpful and really nice if you go to her office hours before a test. Go to class and do the extra credit and you can get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Made the mistake of thinking this class was an easy A. Go to class because she does random assignments for credit. Listen to the examples she gives in class because they will help you on the test. Do SONA hours and do them early, you'll want the extra credit. Nice lady but tests are harder than they should be in my opinion.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Mrs Broom is a great teacher!!! You learn a lot because class is really interesting and she is good at explaining things. Draw back is the class is too large, but she does a good job of making it feel small. Do the extra credit experiments and go to class and you can easily get an A or B. Changed to psych minor because of this class!

Broom is a really nice teacher and the class is pretty easy. She uploads her PowerPoints with blanks in them online so you have to go to class to fill them out. Pretty easy to get a B if you go most of the time and an A is definitely attainable.

SHE IS GREAT!!! She uploads powerpoints with blanks & you fill them in during class when she lectures. It is important to go to class because you never know when there will be something that you have to turn in for credit. There is extra credit if you do extra SONA hours! The lectures were always easy to follow but then her tests were weirdly hard
Abnormal Psych is great!! LOVE this class!!!!!!!! Waited forever to take it and so worth it. Broom knows her stuff and class is always interesting. Honestly I adore her and this class!

The class was not as easy as I anticipated, however it was not extremely hard. Do the study guides and look over notes before tests. Attend class for activity grades, and sometimes she will point out things that will be on the test that are not in the study guide. Do the SONA extra credit hours! Can be condescending but also sweet and caring.

LOVE BROOM!!! Interesting lectures and she really cares about her students. Go to class, do SONA for extra credit, and study for the exams, and you can get an A! She is super helpful if you go to her office before an exam too.

Show up to class and study the night before and you can get a B. Put in effort and do extra credit and you can get an A. You do have to go to class, but Dr Broom is a really good lecturer and you have class discussions and iclass activities. Take her! Favorite class this semester!

Mrs. Broom is a solid teacher for psych. She knows her stuff. Her class is lecture style and she reads off a powerpoint. She gives powerpoints to use but leaves some lines on slides blank so that people have to come to class to fill them in. She also will randomly give handouts during class that get turned in when class is over (skip0).
The class was super simple and she only gave multiple choices tests.  Also, it was easy to get five percentage points of extra credit outside of the classroom.  Would highly recommend for an easy A.

I loved the set up of her class- no homework, lecture notes with blanks online to fill out in class, videos during lectures, and I never even opened the textbook. You can tell she knows a lot about psych and wants to help us learn. There are class activities you have to be present for to get credit but I never minded going to class!

Love BROOM!!! Classes are interesting and she talks about interesting studies and even relates it back to stories with her kids. So it is funny and easy to understand. You learn a lot and can easily get an A if you just show up and study for the tests. TAKE HER!

Changing my major to Psychology. Broom is awesome!!! Go to class and study the notes and you will be fine. She is super helpful if you don't understand. Just go to her office hours. Extra credit with SONA studies too. Take her!

Abnormal Psych was a great class!!! Her lectures were really interesting. I didn't do so great on an exam, but when I met with her afterwards she was really helpful. She also met with me before the next exam and I did tons better. She def cares about her students and you will learn interesting stuff!  A fun group project . Def take her!!!

Her lectures are really interesting and she always made you feel like she was glad you were there. Wish the class was smaller so you could get to know her better because she seems really chill and fun!

She is a good lady and understands we are in college. Make a little bit of an effort by going over notes after class and then when the tests come you won't have to cram 4 big ass chapters for 60 multiple choice questions. DO THE SONA EXTRA CREDIT! I had a D- and did 12/15 SONA hours and it brought me up to a C-

HARD TESTS, YOU REALLY NEED TO GO TO LECTURES AND STUDY NOTES AFTER EACH CLASS. THE TESTS ARE LIKE 60 MULTIPLE CHOICE QUESTIONS WHILE THE FINAL IS 75. 4 "TESTS", 1 FINAL. NO QUIZZES, ONLY ONE 1 PAGE PAPER. I SLEPT THROUGH FINAL AND SHE STILL LET ME TAKE IT TWO DAYS LATER AND ONLY TOOK OFF 10 POINTS. SHE KNOWS YOU DON'T WANT TO BE THERE, BUT HAVE TO

She is an okay teacher, she seems kinda sarcastic at times and says she is there for the students but because her classes are so large she expresses that she is busy and seems very unhelpful!! she will not give you lecture notes if you miss and her tests are kinda tough. But, she does give ALOT of SONA extra credit that can help ALOT!!!
Broom is awesome! Abnormal psych was so interesting and I never wanted to miss class!

Broom is SO cool. She's always so nice and approachable. Tests are completely fair and not hard if you have the notes and studied. There are some random in class assignments that she collects for a participation grade but she drops one in case you miss and you're given the chance to add 5% to your total grade. TAKE HER she rocks

Loved Professor Broom!! She's so funny and her lectures make getting up early on Friday worth it.  If you go to office hours for help before a test she will basically give you answers, also has a study guide.  Occasionally gives class participation (especially Fridays) and also test answers in class.

She is a great teacher clearly very passionate about what she does.  Her tests are not too bad given you put in the effort!  You can receive up to 5 extra credit points by doing extra SONA hours.  She's  keeps lectures interesting and is always willing to help.

Dr. Broom is so freaking sweet and hilarious. She was definitely one of my favorite professors. Her tests are pretty easy as long as you study the lecture and she also provides a study guide for every test. SONA allows you to get extra credit and thats what help me get an A in the class.
Her final exam is tough, but she is a really dedicated and awesome professor. Lots of extra credit with SONA. She cares about her students! Plus, she has that hot mom thing goin' for her.

Dr. Broom is one of my favorite professors at TCU. She's super helpful and great at what she does, and she's always willing to help as long as you put in the effort. She has random activities that count for a grade throughout the semester, so go to class for those. Plus she sometimes gives out test questions on days where no one shows up.
Really good professor! I never want to miss class. She really is a good teacher and cares about her students.

She makes the class and lectures so interesting! You print off thePowerPoints and fill in the blanks in class. She gives study guides for tests. Random "activity grades" so show up to class, but one activity grade is dropped. I studied for like 2 hours the day before and got a 96 on the test. Optional final and you can earn up to 5 points from SONA

I really love this professor. Her lectures are powerpoints and you just fill in the blanks. The test info is straight off of the powerpoints, she gives a great study guide.  She keeps lectures interesting and has that cool hot mom kind of feel.

Go to class, participationattendance is worth 10% of your grade. The lectures give you a better understanding of the notes. The tests are all application problems and really hard, you have to really know the material, not just be familiar with it in order to do well on the exams. The final is optional, and replaces your lowest test grade.

I loved her! She was very approachable and her lectures were interesting. You also just have to print the notes offline. The tests were slightly difficult, but you can get an A or B if you study your notes. The online quizzes were manageable and show up to class for activity grades. You can also add 5% to your overall grade. Take her!

Loved this class! You can get up to 5% added to your grade with extra research hours that are really easy to get! Her tests can be hard but she normally throws in a curve! Loved the course and she always made it interesting!
Probably your best bet if you're looking to take General Psychology. She puts notes online that you get to print off. Easy class but her tests can be deceivingly difficult.
Dr. Broom is great! She's incredibly helpful and wants you to do well in her class. Take her class!
I wasn't particularly interested in the class when I signed up but I ended up really enjoying the class. She's a wonderful person and her tests are very straight forward.

Dr. Broom is amazing woman! She is always there for her students. Her lectures are swift but not difficult to comprehend. She doesn't like for students to struggle. I wouldn't say her class is easy but it also isn't difficult. She wants all her students to be successful. So just come to class, ask questions, and study and you're good.
I love her! She's great. Just study and you'll be fine.

Wat too hard for a general psychology class.  She is a very nice person but makes her tests and even open book quizzes nearly impossible.  Asked for help and was told to find someone in my class who was doing well - really?  Not much help at all - very disappointed because I was actually interested in this class at first.

She is very enthusiastic, but the class is deceivingly challenging. The quizzes were very hard, if she does them again make sure to take them in a large group. The tests are helpful if you look up quizzlets and study the notes from the powerpoint.

amazing teacher that cares about her students and is passionate about teaching. The tests can be a little difficult but she sends out guides which are very helpful. She does activities that really help to understand the concepts and that boost your grade. Offers an insane amount of extra credit. Lectures are easy and interesting

Dr. Broom is a very upbeat and positive professor. With that being said, you have to print out the slides and bring them to class. You will fill them out in class. Didn't come to class, you will have to ask a friend for the notes for that day. Her tests are EXTREMELY hard! Hardest class fall semester!

Sweetest and nicest professor I have ever had! You can truly see she enjoys teaching students.  Class is not an easy A though!  Have to study and pay attention in class!  One of the more challenging classes this semester.
Makes her tests super in depth on a broad range of topics which makes it really hard to study. Her optional final is impossible. Forget about even trying to take it

Not a hard class, but not a very fun or interesting one either. It's mostly all lecture. Attendance not required but you take notes during class. Textbook is really only needed for the 4 online quizzes. If you're good with memorization you'll do well, if not study hard. Tests can have a lot of information to remember.
She gives you power points that you need to fill in to make you come to class. The assignments are easy and she gives you study guides, tests can be difficult, you just need to study
She is awful and penalizes you for wanting to learn. Don't ever second guess her. She can't be corrected.
AWESOME PROFESSOR. She's so helpful. Just go to class with the power points and you'll be golden! Offers a ton of extra credit. Highly recommend!

Best teacher I've ever had! She is sooo nice, really helpful, and funny! She offers lots of extra credit too! She is also an inspiring person. She's a role model, TAKE HER CLASS and you'll see why everyone loves her!
Study for her exams. You do not want to take the optional final. She's nice and kept class interesting.

Easy class ! Make sure not to skip a ton of her classes because she does random activity grades . She does drop one of the activity grades so that is nice. An A is extremely easy on the test as long as you know the details of every big topic covered in class. The study guide that she gives you before the test is VERY helpful.

Very interesting. Slides for chapters posted online. Very straightforward. I basically skimmed the chapters to look for things not in the slides. Tests are somewhat memory intensive but far from grade killers. Highly recommend this prof!!!

Easy class, great professor! Makes the lectures interesting. Lots of opportunities for extra credit. Notes are posted online with blanks, go to class to fill in the blanks. Must study for exams, still an easy A!!

She was a really fun teacher but just read off of the powerpoints which made it hard to memorize everything for the tests. I ended up just talking with my friend all class but had to study a lot for the final to get an A. A lot of extra-credit opportunities!
Great prof! Very helpful, but tests can be hard. If you go to class and do the extra credit SONA you can easily get a B. If you try, you can get an A!

Dr. Broom is a great professor! She puts fill in the blank notes on eCollege. If you study and do the extra credit SONA, you will definitely make an A. I recommend taking this class with Dr. B for a CA credit! She is willing to help you if you don't understand. Just e-mail her and she responds quickly.
Super Prof! Final exam was really hard, but extra credit will help! Go to class because it helps and she is funny.

TAKE THIS CLASS. you don't need to buy the textbook and tests are off the powerpoints. she gives you some answers in class, so go to class. she makes psyc interesting and gives you alot extra credit opportunities. if you need extra help shes more than happy to help. overall everyone should take her

Great prof! I agree that tests are hard because they are application but if you go to class she gives out test questions. She also has participation grades which boosts your grade if you are in class when she has an activity. She is funny too!

Broom is the bombbb! She is awesome and keeps the class interested. If you actually go to class, which you should because there are random class assignments, you should do fine on the exams! You also have great extra credit opps too! TAKE HER!
Tests are too hard. They are mostly application. I missed some days because I was sick but she said I had to get a doctors note to make up the work and it is impossible to catch up now.
GREAT PROF! Test questions can be hard unless you go to class. Also, participation  grade. Go to class!
AWESOME everyone should take Broom and general psych. amazing teacher and easy class. nearly impossible to get lower then an A
She is a great teacher! Very interesting!!! She gives away test questions in class and has very straight forward test reviews! I would highly recommend taking her!!! One of my favorite teachers!
Dr. Broom is such a nice lady. She makes going to class fun and enjoyable. She gives examples that students can relate to and will even give you test questions on certain days. I love this class

Dr. Broom is the best for intro to psych! You do not need to buy the book nor attend class. The tests are straight from the notes. She also offers sona extra credit!However, if you are going to be a psych major, do not take her! Because her class is so easy, it will hurt you in the end.
Good prof! Willing to work with you, but tests are hard.
It can be really hard if you don't go to class much. Don't take the early class because you probably will skip lots.

You better attend class! My sister had her 3 years ago when she gave an entire letter grade of extra credit if you did experiments, but now only 1/2 a letter grade. Hard to catch up if you miss class and don't do good on (epic fail) the first exam. I am taking her again and will go to class. DO THE EXTRA CREDIT!

Professor is super awesome. Studying for the exam is easy because it's straight off the slides or videos. Extra credit points given can boost you a whole letter grade. There is no reason for you to fail this class if you attend. Also, she gives away answers to the exam if you come on certain days. Take her!
Super easy, definitely take broom, go to class and do Extra Credit sona hours. Dont blow it off, if you try youll for sure get an A

Learned a lot and there are a ridiculous amount of extra credit opportunities. 20 points of your grade (out of 220) are just for showing up to class and getting a completion grade for doing activities. During reviews she literally tells you everything that's on the test. Very helpful professor!
Highly recommend this class!!!! Easy A.

Dr Broom is such a nice teacher! Very helpful and good at explaining things. She gives test questions out in class so make sure you go. Study the review, do the activities, and sona and you should make an A. Definitely my favorite class this semester. Take Dr Broom!

General Psychology Dr. B is freaking fantastic. She is very passionate about psych and about life, both of which make the class a real joy to take. Reviews for her class make the test VERY easy as long as you come to class and pay attention. She is fair in everything. One of the best classes I have taken at TCU. TAKE THIS CLASS. It's worth it!!

TAKE THIS CLASS! Not only is Dr B an extremely good prof, she is very nice to look at. Very down to earth, very good at teaching, tests are very fair, she's very very nice and she's gorgeous! Study the powerpoints and do the 5 extra sona hours and you should be able to pull out an A without too much effort.
If you go to class, fill in the notes, do the activities, and study for the tests, you will get a good grade in the class.  Definitely do the extra SONA hours.  soooo worth it
If you go to class, fill in the notes, do the activities, and study for the tests, you will get a good grade in the class.  Definitely do the extra SONA hours.  soooo worth it
Dr. Broom was a great teacher and I really enjoyed having her! She went out of her way to make sure that we knew what we needed to know to do well in the class and she made it fun!

Dr. Broom is great! She really wants you to pass and get something out of the class at the same time. Go to class to fill in the slides and get test questions. If you study the exam review terms, then you will have no problems getting at least a high B. If you enjoy the material, it will be an easy A.

I love Dr. B :] She is amazing! All of her test questions come from the slides that she teaches from in class. Is you show up, she gives free test questions in class. If you review the study guide you will do fantastic! She is extremely nice and helpful :] She is perfect for general psych! She really wants you to pass and helps you out.
Very straightforward in the teaching, but the tests can be confusing.  Easy B but you really have to study and try to understand the questions to get an A

Take this class!! She is great!! I love it, I have a B in the class without much studying at all. You can get 10 extra credit points by doing extra psychology study hours, so it's pretty easy to get a good grade. If you have a friend in the class with you, it's possible to switch off which days you go because she gives out test questions some days
GREAT! TAKE HER WITHOUT A DOUBT! Not too much work and very easy to understand!  tell you EXACTLY whats on the test! Don't take for granted tho.
Teacher is really cute and cool. Easy A. Just study powerpoints

Broom is very nice and the class is not very hard. It's really easy to do well if you go everyday or at least know someone who has the notes there is no reason to not get an A. There is lots of extra credit and she is willing to work with you to get a better grade. Top notch prof.

I took gen psych with her. She is very stylish and gives lots of examples. Attendance not mandatory but I would go, she gives answers to tests when you go. Notes are easy from the powerpoint. Tests aren't that hard. great prof

Dr. Broom makes coming to class really interesting! She teaches off of powerpoints, which she posts online but you have to go to class to fill in the blanks. GO TO CLASS! If you do you won't  have to read the book and you will get to hear her application examples which almost always appear on the tests. Great class and teacher!

Dr. Broom is so cute and sweet! TAKE HER CLASS!!! It's ridiculous how easy it is. You really don't have to go to class, she does power points posted online and then you go to class to fill in the blanks.  She gives you a study guide for the exams that tell you whats on the exam. DONT BUY THE TEXT BOOK!

So easy. You would have to be brain dead in order to not make an A. Her test questions may be application ones, but the answer is intuitively obvious. Don't listen to that review below this one. Her class is easy and Dr. Broom is amazing and sweet! I love her. (And she never wears the same clothes more than once)
Really sweet lady! Tests are more application than definition, but she warns you about that and will answer any questions you might have.
tests are not too hard... I've gotten A's by only doing her test reviews the night before

If you study, it's very possible to get an A but I know some people who would study a lot and barley pass the tests. you have to go to class for the activites &you don't need the book.  Dr. Broom is such a sweet lady and very interesting. TAKE HER! :)

Awesome, easy A. I you mad B in the exams do the expriments 10 hour it would be A. No text use,do class activity the date for activities are in the last page of each chapter in powerpoint, so you know when is activity. make she gives examples for everything remeber examples because her test questions are application questions and difinations.
She is a fun and easy teacher, go to her class, the tests are 50 q's off slides.  Class activities, and is willing to work with you for your grade!  An extremely easy A and ridiculous non-thinking B!

EASY A!!! lots of extra credit. Dr. Broom is the best! Wish she taught more classes! GPA booster! Attendance not mandatory but helps. All multiple choice tests, come from her powerpoint notes that you fill in in class. SO EASY!
Easiest class EVER!! Dont buy book, you never use it. Attendance not mandatory. Easy extra credit. Interesting, enjoyable class. Dr. Broom is so sweet & funny. Take this course, EASY A!!!!
Easy A!!! Take this class!

Dr. Broom is great! I loved her- very helpful and makes the material interesting. She puts all powerpoints online w/ fill-in-the blanks for notes. Exams are pretty easy and Dr. Broom gives study guides. She's always willing to talk with you. plus, on another note, its fun to see what she wears- its always cute. TAKE THIS CLASS WITH DR. BROOM!

Dr. Broom is a wonderful teacher. Easy B if you go to class and pay attention to the slides. Attendance not taken, but there are some activities for grades in class that cannot be made up. Textbook is not needed - all test info comes from powerpoints and videos in class. She's willing to help you and is eay to talk to. TAKE THIS CLASS!
Easy class! Easy A. Like the teacher, highly suggest taking the class, or any class with her for that matter!!
Gives good lecture notes.
Easy class, boring material for the most part! Dr. Broom is a great prof though and makes it as interesting as possible. She is super nice and always willing to help! I recommend her!

This is the best psychology class to take! Dr. Broom is very nice, and the tests are extremely easy because she gives you a study guide that tells you exactly what to study, and you don't even have to read the book because she gives you power point notes that tell you everything you need to know. You do need to go to class for participation points1

This is a VERY easy class.  Just study the power points she gives out and you can pass the tests easily with the study guide.  And if you don't do so good on the test, you can get "participation" points...even though attendance isn't taken, sometimes there were easy activities that you got points for.  Watched alot of vidoes. TAKE THIS CLASS!

this is the easiest class i have ever taken. she emails you notes and gives you a study guide from the test. you just highlight whats on the study guide in your notes and youre set! i never once even opened the book and I got an A. easiest psych teacher ever.

Every lecture I went to was rushed & left my mind blank,along with most of my classmates.Chemistry is hard as is but she made it way harder.Every time I crossed university dr to get to her class,I was hoping to get ran over.I get ptsd every time I see her & get flashbacks of pure confusion, panic, & the overwhelming urge to drop the class all over.
Lots of people will say to take Dr. Conrad instead of Dr. Fry, but I lowkey disagree wity that. I surprisingly did a lot better with Dr. Fry than Conrad. Judt wanted to put that out there
I had Dr. Conrad first semester, and TAKE DR. FRY! Truly an angel. Chem at TCU sucks in general, but Dr. Fry is an amazing teacher, and her exams are more fair

She can be knowledgeable on certain subjects but sometimes lacks depth in her lectures. She is very smart and knows what she is talking about really well but she sometimes does not know how to explain it and can leave her students very lost.
I like her teaching style, but she makes the exams really tricky and on top of that she is a really tough grader.
Take gen chem somewhere else if you wanna be stress free.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: It's the worst thing that has happened to me. She makes chemistry 100 times harder than it is

Worst class ever. Chemistry isn't even that hard, but the professor makes it feel impossible. Lectures are rushed, quizzes are brutal, and exams are poorly organized. She offers no real help and suggests retaking the class if you fail. I dropped it after two months and my life instantly improved. Seriously, avoid this class unless you enjoy stress

The class is extremely diffcult but the teacher is available and cares about you. But more often than not her feedback wasn't always helpful to me but for others it was. As long as your willing to put in the hours you'll be succeful but it's a daily effort otherwise it'll  be hard to do good. My advice is to seek help as soon as you can!

This class was the bain of my existence!! Tests are not like the practice tests she gives and are weighted very heavily. She gives weekly quizzes which are helpful but there's so much studying required. Good luck to everyone taking this class, you will need it!!!!

Dr. Fry is and amazing professor and person the class is difficult no matter who you take it with but fry provides clear slides, lots of practice, and great feedback with lots of available times for office hours. Go to office hours they are extremely helpfull. She will make sure you know the information for future classes not just future tests.
Concepts are explained clearly. Exams are fine if you review your class slides. Participation is 6%.

Take Dr. Conrad. Dr. Fry's tests are significantly harder. The problems you do on the worksheets and PowerPoint are nothing like the test questions. The exam questions are extremely difficult. Conrad's tests are easier, and she tells students what is going to be on the exam. Dr. Fry is a smart and caring professor, but her class is too hard.

Unless you are Albert Einstein, do not take this course. Fry is very difficult to understand and responds to every question as "higher-level concepts that I can't explain to you". Dr. Fry is the epitome of super smart but a terrible teacher. Lecture heavy but you need to learn everything on your own. Accessible in office hours and super nice though
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Fry is a very good professor if you want to learn chemistry and have a very strong foundation for future chemistry courses, especially at TCU. Her class is difficult, if you study and put in effort, getting a B is still relatively difficult. Basically she will teach you very well at the expense of your gpa.

Overall nice person but feels like she doesn't want people to succeed. Purposefully puts trick questions on quizzes and tests. So many ppl drop. Take Conrad, she tells you exactly what's on every quiz.

Julie Fry is an amazing professor! Yes, if you do not put effort in or study, you will not succeed in this course. If you have a basic understanding of math and will READ THE TEXTBOOK!!! you will do fine! She is so nice, engaging, helpful, and wants to see y'all succeed. Take this class if you want to be set up to succeed in later chem courses!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof. Fry's class is challenging but manageable with focus and effort. The lectures are fast-paced, so self-study and using resources like Unstuckstudy are key. Attend office hours - she's very helpful! Overall, a tough yet rewarding class.

Dr. Fry was extremely condescending and demeaning in class if you asked a question and even more so in office hours. The material covered in class and AktivChem problems do not prepare you for the exams. It's a weed-out course and half the class dropped my semester. I dropped the class and my roommate got a C.

This had to be one of the worst classes I have ever taken and I don't mean this lightly. I ended up changing my major because of how hard this course was and made this class into a Pass/No Credit. If you are not refreshed and haven't done Chemistry in a while, I would recommend taking at a Community College then transferring the credit in.

Dr. Fry is super nice but her class is near impossible. Her lectures do not help, as she reads her slides word for word. Everything in this class is self taught, and be prepared to study 15+ hours a week for tests. Studying a week in advance and around 20 or so hours would give me 60% on her tests. Know it well enough that you could teach it.

Lectures were not helpful, they were often rushed and tried to cram 5 slides in the last 2 min. I would have to watch her videos over and over and learn on my own to finally understand. Make sure to do ALL the practice she gives and in the textbook. She is very sweet and wants to help but she wasn't that great of a professor
10/10 do not recommend

I enjoyed Dr. Fry's Gen Chem 1 class. We learn a lot of content in one semester, so many of the lectures are very rushed. Be prepared to have to go back and relearn some things on your own. You only use the textbook to do practice problems, no actual readings. Dr. Fry is very accessible outside of the classroom and always willing to help!

Dr. Fry is super sweet and office hours are helpful when needed. Her lectures are good but they can be rushed. Sadly most of your grade is made up of the exams, and there's not really required homework so it's very self-guided and takes a lot of work outside of class. Chemistry is a hard subject but you can do well if you put in the effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
All the bad reviews are true. Do not take her. 
Apparently, Conrad is kinda better
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I wouldn't recommend taking Chemistry with Dr. Fry. She makes the class way harder than it has to be and your expected to learn around 30 slides every class. You have 10 minutes to do around 7-8 questions on quizzes. I would recommend taking chem outside of TCU.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lecture heavy and expects you to know things that weren't even covered in previous classes. Incredibly smart woman but does not know how to teach. Lots of notes and you are expected to know everything on powerpoints (keep in mind this could be the smallest of texts in the 80+ slide powerpoints there are at least 2 or 3 powerpoints per unit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is tough, but Dr. Fry is super available outside of class. Use her and the TA's as a resource and PAY ATTENTION IN CLASS, and the class is doable. Dr. Fry genuinely cares about her students and their future success.

Just don't take chem at TCU all. The lectures are easy to understand, but quizzes and tests are near impossible. The HW isnt graded and she doesnt take attendance, so your entire grade is tests and quizzes, with a very small participation grade. Unless you're willing to devote your whole life to this class, dont take her

Dr. Fry is very nice woman and she really does care about her students. She is engaged and tells jokes and stories during lectures. Naturally, the material her course covers is complicated, but her video lectures are helpful and slow paced. She isn't too tough of a grader either.

The course itself is very difficult, but doable. Dr. Fry is available in office hours frequently, which is a good resource. Homework is optional, but it is the only way to learn outside of class, so you will probably end up doing most of it. The tests are very constricted for time, so I you should paractice for speed once you know the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class made my life pretty miserable but I'd feel bad saying it's Dr. Fry's fault. She is sweet, but this class is impossible unless you dedicate your life to it. Don't recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr Fry is so mother and very accessible outside of class but not the best at conveying information. The content is very difficult and very fast-paced which is to be expected with this course. Go to office hours even if you don't have any questions as she usually goes over a lot and you can even ask other people there for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr.Fry is so incredibly sweet and caring and wants you to succeed. Don't be intimdated by these bad reviews, she's amazing. Her tests are definitely hard, but if you put in the work and the hours, it is possible to get a good grade. Office hours are pointless sometimes because of how many people are there.

Dr. Fry spends 20 minutes rambling on about one slide and just briefly touches on 15 slides in the last 3 minutes of class and says "oh btw all of that is on the exam." There is no homework, so the whole class is graded on how you do on exams and quizzes, with a tiny percentage coming from participation on Aktiv Chemistry.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Fry is so sweet and a great teacher! Her exams are very difficult, but I strongly recommend attending her office hours for outside help, preparing a little every week, and textbook problems, and you will do great! She is great at answering questions; I loved to sit in her office during office hours and study and ask her questions as needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr.Fry is a good person, I think people hate her just because Chemistry is hard, but no Chem class at TCU is easy. If you put in the work and hours, you will succeed ( book problems). Office hours were not the best because there were 15 people in a very small office and it would take 45 minutes waiting in line to get a question answered.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Fry is a very knowledge professor and is extremely well at Chemistry. However, sometimes her lectures can be difficult to follow, leaving you confused outside of class. In order to be successful, you have to put many additional hours outside of class, including going to her office hours and doing practice problems from the book.
Dr. Fry's class is challenging, but she wants to see you succeed. She makes her takes very hard but is very encouraging if you go to her office hours.

Dr. Fry has trouble teaching. Her lecture style is just talking at you for 2 hours and never explaining anything. I'm leaving Chem II to take it somewhere else over the summer. When the class average was 54%, it was not considered her fault. It's difficult, but half the class failing is a red flag. It's possible if you're good at math side of chem.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was an extremely difficult course. Fry is a nice person and is very helpful but her lectures can be hard to pay attention to. I wouldn't recommend taking this course with her unless you really need to. I've heard other teachers are better.

Dr. Fry is such a kind & caring lady, but her class is extremely difficult. I only took Pre-AP Chem in high school so I was so unprepared for this class. If you have more prior exposure to chem, it will help. The only grades in her class were weekly quizzes, 4 exams, and online practice questions, but she has many office hours which help a lot.

Dr. Fry has an undeserved bad reputation around TCU. She is definitely more difficult than Dr. Conrad, however if you have plans to take upper level chemistry, you should take Fry. She is very approachable during office hours and will help you however she can. She does her best to prepare you for future classes and truly wants you to succeed.

Dr. Fry is an amazing professor. I think she can come off as very cold and not caring, but in her office hours she has the times to explain topics in depth that class time does not offer. Go through the lecture prior to class just to get foundational knowledge then review, review, review after class. Don't wait till a few days before the test.

After being a straight-A student most of my life, I barely passed this class. I attended every lecture, I read every book section, I went to office hours repeatedly, and I did HOURS of practice problems. Every time I went into office hours and asked for help, I was just referred back to the textbook. I don't feel like I was TAUGHT in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Fry is sweet and really wants you to succeed but I think she is so smart she has trouble explaining information to kids who don't understand chemistry. If you love chemistry she is the professor for you but if you struggle to understand conceptual chemistry take conrad. I don't think her exams are fair ofter we had questions we had never seen befor
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Fry is a difficult professor. She is harsh and her work is heavy. Her lectures are extremely fast paced, and will force you to learn a lot on your own. She does give partial credit which helps a ton. If you go to her office hours and form a relationship, it will pay off. Start studying on day 1 or you will fall behind and it will bite you.

Dr. Fry's class is pretty tough, especially if you do not have any prior experience with chem. She has office hours almost every day and the TAs are super accessible and helpful for any questions. You definitely have to be studying weekly and the quizzes can be a grade booster if you do enough. She also teaches chem 2, so learn her teaching style.

Dr Fry is kind and helpful outside of class, but she expects you to work so much outside of class doing practice problems. She teaches a lot very quick, and it isn't very clear. Always go over the presentation before class, and if you do not understand something figure it out before next class. I suggest Conrad instead

This class is a pain. Try to get Dr. Conrad because she is a lot better and will save you many useless nights trying to understand something Fry didn't explain well in lecture. She can also be rude during office hours if you are slow to understand something she is teaching you. And some things work until they don't in her class so be ready.

This class was extremely hard no doubt about it, but Dr. Fry is so sweet and really wants to help you. She is definitely the harder teacher because she teaches gen chem II also so she is trying to prepare you. Her tests are very hard and quizzes are important, but they really pull from her powerpoint and book problems so definitely do them!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Fry herself is very smart and qualified to do her job, but the class is just so big and there's only so much she can do. Chem at TCU in general is not great, so just make sure that you do as many practice problems outside of class as you can. She has a lot of office hours but won't be helpful unless she knows you've tried on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Attendance is not mandatory, but is highly recommended. If she posts old recorded lectures it can help. Sometimes she can be nit picky on grading, but gives a lot of partial credit.
