Don't get excited about the "no tests" aspects of this course because the papers you write instead are long and graded pretty narrowly. Dr. G is always willing to help and emailing him is encouraged.
You must go to this class, because there is a quiz on the daily readings every time we had class

The class is focussed around 2 major essays, one at midterm and one at the final. There are no tests! However there are daily reading quizzes, These are easy and only worth 2 points, so even if you bomb it, you'll most likely get a 12. If you need to miss class you can just email him and he will let you take it next class. Participation also matte

Find a different elective. Hist of Econ Thought requires a lot of work and reading. Quizzes were difficult and the papers were harder. Dr. G keeps instructions open on the papers, but grades them very hard. Open instructions made it harder. Personal Connection assignments are ineffective, we listened to students give their "feelings" on readings.

Very interesting class, great professor who truly cares about his students and his work. Always available to help/answer questions. The only problem is that he grades the papers really hard, and does not specify what he wants them to include, so the papers are fairly difficult.

Dr. Garnett is a great teacher. He holds many class discussions and encourages participation. There is reading nearly every day but it is almost always interesting. The daily quizzes will help your average a lot if you do the readings. He grades the essays hard but tries to help. Not an easy A.

Didn't do as well as I had hoped on the first paper, but improved my grade to an A after going into talk to him. He puts a lot of work and thought into his teaching and if you take initiative, he will help you. The content is important, but more importantly he teaches you how to think. Highly recommend, one of my favorite teachers at TCU so far.

This class is a great take! An A takes effort, and you can't get by without reading, but Dr. G is a GREAT professor and if you have a chance to take him you should. If you aren't sure what he expects, he'll tell you. Don't take the class because it's easy, take it because you WILL learn if you put in the effort. I RECOMMEND

Dr. Garnett gives an extremely interesting class that provides different perspectives on economics matters.  If students take serious the readings and put forth effort then Dr. Garnett will work with you.  If students choose not to read assignments, it will hurt double-fold: once on the quizzes and then on the papers.

Two words: he cares. About economics, about his class, and about his students. Easily my best professor so far. He keeps readings short and will sometimes change them if he thinks they'll be boring for us. Rubric sounds intimidating, but it's awesome. Papers can be graded toughly, but the 50% weighted quizzes and participation cushion it fairly.

Tough class, but a great professor to have for it. Each class period is engaging and interesting. Daily reading quizzes + 3 short papers instead of tests. Keep up with readings and it's an awesome class with one of TCU's best
He's a great prof, really clear in his lectures. I recommend him
I loved this course. He is a great professor who is very eager to help. You must put in effort to make an A but this class is a great to take!

Awesome professor goes above and beyond to make sure you understand every class lecture. There's alot of reading and daily quizzes that you'll have to keep up with. You can easily make a good grade if you put in the effort.

Excellent class! Dr. Garnett really made learning about different schools of thought interesting and easy to understand. NO TESTS! Only quizzes each day that aren't bad, and papers. If you can show you know what the topic is about on your paper you will be fine. The class exercises your mind each day. I highly recommend Dr. G and his class!

This was my favorite class this semester because of Dr. G! He gives weekly quizzes which help to make sure you know the material, but they definitely aren't easy so they can bring down your grade.  He is very helpful though and always available and does a great job making the class interesting. He is also quite possibly the sweetest professor here.
One of TCU's best ECON teachers. Not the easiest professor, but always willing to help, and very engaged in his students/teaching.

May I just say that Dr. G is probably the best economics professor that TCU has to offer! He isn't the "easy A" but he is definitely the guy if you want to actually learn the subject matter. He's a very passionate man and wants to see success in his students. Study well and I highly recommend!

Contending perspectives changed the way I see economics and the world. Dr. G was an incredible professor whose dedication to his students and to the subject matter are both awesome. Do your reading, go to class, and you will get the grade you want along with actually learning something really valuable.

This class is actually pretty interesting. The professor is extremely helpful and understanding, and if you have questions, he is more than willing to answer them. Lectures are interesting, but do not really follow the book, so you really have to attend class.

I highly recommend this class for econ majors and minors. I enjoyed the format of this class as well as the assignments. Reading quizzes forced me to keep up with the reading, but I preferred them to tests. Dr. G. is an amazing professor. His encouraging teaching style makes this class interesting and worthwhile. He values feedback and respects all

The discussion nature of the class sometimes made it hard to follow along and contribute, as well as decide what notes are important to take if you have trouble understanding the readings. No tests, only quizzes and two papers, which are straight-forward. Dr. G was always available for questions on the papers. Would take him again if I could.

Dr. Garnett is a great professor! You can tell that he is passionate about his subject and makes even "boring" topics interesting. He is very fair and straightforward about what to expect on the tests and quizzes, he wants his students to succeed. Readings aren't too bad and he prints handouts and tells you what you will be tested on. Take Dr. G!

Extremely nice professor, very helpful during office hours. Sometimes is so smart he has trouble getting points across, but lectures are easy to follow. Mandatory readings followed by quizzes,   generally once a week, but most are engaging. Highly recommend his class to all econ majors, I actually feel like i learned useful things.

Really really nice guy also really knows his stuff and cares about what he is teaching. He does a great job keeping the material relevant. Some times gets too excited about a topic and teaches it really fast and not so clearly
Awesome teacher, lots of help, tells you excTly what will be on exam. Very good teacher.

No test, only papers and quizzes. No textbook per say, Just some readings he assigns from a binder. Do the readings, there is at least 1 quiz a week. He notices if you miss, but attendance isn't mandatory... Easy B... read and try and should get an A

Contending Perspectives in Economics.  Dr. Garnett is passionate about his class and wants everyone to do well.  He is available outside of class.  We had reading quizzes everyday, which were very easy and helped my grade quite a bit.  I did not find the class very interesting, but I strongly recommend him to anyone.  He is a great teacher!
Dr. Garnett is the best professor at TCU. He is clearly passionate about what he teaches. His classes are engaging and thought provoking. I highly recommend his History of Economic Thought.

Dr. Garnett's is the best Economics professor at TCU. I was in his summer Contending Perspectives course and there are daily quizzes so class attendance is a must. Readings are sometimes difficult to understand but Dr. Garnett is very clear and helpful. There is no textbook and he tries to keep the readings light.

I was in Dr. Garnett's contending perspectives in economics during the summer and overall he was a very good teacher. Though the class was not mandatory we did have quizzes most everyday based on the readings. There was no textbook required so all the readings were given in class. All exams were take home and written. He is a reasonable grader.
I think Mr.Garnett is a great professor, he is always giving short lectures for homework and the next day we have a quiz on those readings. Perfct way of teaching Econ students

Contending Perspectives Summer Class - Class is very straightforward, daily quizzes over readings and papers over content. Much better class than the one taught by Harvey, focuses on understanding the different aspects of Economic thought instead of memorizing a book.

Dr. Garnett is one of the best professors at TCU. HistEconThought is an extremely manageable class if you attend class and do the readings. Garnett knows you are not just taking his class and he assigns readings accordingly. I highly recommend this class if you want to learn and develop your ideas.

Dr. Garnett is one of the best professors at TCU by far. His class discussions are very stimulating. The class is very reading and writing intensive but Dr. G has it structured very well so that you can stay on top of everything.  I highly recommend taking any class Dr. G has to offer!

Great Professor and the nicest one I think I've had at TCU.  Dr. Garnett actually makes you think.  You have to read because you spend class discussing the reading. I didn't have much interest entering the course but it turned out to be interesting because of Dr. Garnett. Take this class.

Dr. Garnett was, without a doubt, the best economics professor I had at TCU. His history of Economic Thought class is by no means easy, and is very writing intensive, but if you put in the effort you will learn a ton about the foundations of the economic discipline. Dr. G is very helpful and has his students best interests in mind.
History of Economic Thought: Was a great learning experience and the professor is extremely helpful. Definitely recomend this course for any ECON major.

Highly recommended,extremely nice&helpful prof. Roundtable discussion style, do participate as it helps everyone.Fill-in-the-blank handouts are given to take notes,so you wont have unnecessary info.WEM class,3 papers/question prompt-no workscited:you'll be well prepared if you attend class.Daily reading quizzes help grade so be on time.Great class!
very nice guy and a great teacher. no complaints.

Mr. Garnett is an AWESOME teacher. The material is hard, but if you go to class and take notes and really try to comprehend the concepts you will be alright. An A is hard to get, a B is definitely common and doable. GO TO CLASS and be prepared for all the quizzes (weekly reading). Great professor!

Awesome professor!! He knows what he is talking about. The material is pretty straightforward, but if you don't do the work you wont pass. I missed a few classes after the first exam and it definitely hurt my grade. Go to class, do the work and you're guaranteed a high b/a.

Awesome professor! I dreaded waking up for my 8:00am's last semester, but this class really isn't that hard. Do your  work or you wont pass. But you're guaranteed a high b/a if you do since it's so straightforward. (incoming freshman - go to class!)
Good teacher, hardest grader on the planet, quizzes easy, test are 10 questions and hard.

Good teacher, makes material understandable and gives lots of helpful worksheets, quizzes are easy, BUT, he is the hardest grader on this planet, 10 questions test. If you study methodically you can be a B tought to get an A I think

One of the best professor at TCU! Extremely nice and open to all of your questions. Come talk to him if you have any problems. Respects his students and cares about your grades as well. Tests are not really hard - read the book and do all of the HW and assignments carefully, you'll get an A. He gives the best short answers I've ever seen!
Very kind and understated. Loves what he teaches and definitely made me at least kind of like Micro. Go to class and read what he tells you to read. He'll ask you about it!
you will learn a lot.  not easy but his test reviews help so go to them.  tests are short answer

I have taken Dr. G for intro macro and Contending Perspectives in Economics. As a graduating senior, I would say he is one of the most intelligent profs I've had at TCU and he truly makes an effort to relate current economic issues to his students' interest. This is a dynamic and rewarding course as long as students dedicate their time and effort.

I took History of Economic Thought with Garnett. The class calls for a lot of reading and involvement in class discussions. If you don't put in the effort you will do poorly but the class can be very engaging if you stay on top of the course work. You will be exposed to a lot of different economic ideas that make the class enjoyable.

Took intro to macro econ with him. Was my last class at TCU. Easy class, just know the workbook inside and out and your golden. He's a smart guy who knows his stuff and the class teaches you to look at how the economy works in a different way. Great class, take him.

He is a very nice guy, and obviously knows his stuff about economics, but he has absolutely NO business teaching.  He doesn't know how to explain the material well and he will start to explain something then in the middle of his lecture he will stop and go on to a completely new topic.  He makes it harder than it really should be.

Dr. G was awesome. I had him for summer school. If you are reading this review because your a seeing which teacher to take..take him. just make sure to do his workbook stuff and jot down some notes during class and its a for sure B. I hate micro and he made it easy to understand and interesting

Very interesting because you learn economic theories that you mght otherwise never read on your own. Lots of reading and writing (no tests, just papers that are fairly short), but its manageable. Being a discussion leader is not as bad as it seems, and he helps you out. Class also allows you to comparevarious theories & "think like an economist"
Grades papers fairly, explains material very well...you dont really need the textbook, bu the workbook is vital. if you do the workbook and tudy, youll be fine. Take him!
Very good professor, he teaches in a helpful way and you will learn a lot.  Buy his workbook and use it!
Cool class (not what I expected), helps me understand current events.  Good lectures. Tests aren't bad if you go to class and use his workbook.

He really wants his students to do well in his class.  Completing the workbook is mandatory if you want an A. Do not wait until the last minute to study for his exams! You can boost your grade by writing strong papers when they are assigned.

As long as you attend class, and keep up with the workbook work you should be fine.  Professor Garnett presents information in a way that is easily understood for non-economics majors.  He is easy to talk to and willingly answers all your questions. He is a wonderful professor and you SHOULD take his class if given the opportunity!!

The summer course was surprisingly entertaining.  Dr. Garnett moves at a pace that allows you to keep up with another class or a job and still gives plenty of grade opportunities.  I would wholeheartedly recommend his summer class for anyone who has to take this.
explains material very well, very patient, will not ask anything on the test that he has not lectured on, open to all questions, great professor.

It is clear that he LOVES economics but his lectures are SO boring it is very har to sit through the class. The only reason I went to class is because you can only miss one before he stats taking points away.  His tests are all short essay format and it is difficult to answer exactly how he wants you to.

Very good professor. Extremely helpful withs lots of office hours. Class is pretty easy if you do the workbook questions and take notes. But definitely do the workbook questions!!!! Tests are very similar to those. Plenty of office hours, and he has review sessions before tests. Essays aren't too bad either. I would definitely recommend this class.

I really liked Dr. Garnett's class.  You can tell that he really has a passion for what he teaches and for teaching in general.  Really cares about student's perceptions and input.  Lectures can be long sometimes but I feel like I learned a lot from them especially since he relates it so much back to the real world. I'd recommend Dr. G!

Very nice and helpful guy. Not an easy class, but not super difficult either. Go to class, take notes and do the workbook. He doesn't give a final, just a 5 page paper at the end of the class which was very nice! I'd recommend him to anyone who has to take Macro.

Dr. Garnett is a wonderful teacher.  econ is a hard subject for me and Dr. G helped me so much! Teaches in a clear manner and relates subject matter to today's world.  gives lots of handouts which is awesome and has a workbook that resembles a lot of the test questions.  I highly recommend taking Dr. G!! easy to talk with and an awesome teacher!

Rob is a great professor. I was not looking to another econ class after my previous semester with a terrible teacher, but I ended up really enjoying his class. He explains concepts clearly and is willing to help if you have qeustions. He provides most of the material so if you study that you will make a good grade.

Dr. Garnett is an excellent professor.  He clearly conveys economic concepts.  He also works with students in and out of class to explain these classes further.  He is flexible when it comes to rescheduling assignments if the concepts have not been clarified in class.  The assignments are challenging but clearly relevant to the ideas being studied

One of the best professors Ive had so far. Makes class interesting and easy to understand. Lectures are easy to follow. Lets you know whats covered on each test and has a review session before each test, which really helps out a lot of people. Papers are graded fairly and usually help your grade. Very accessible outside of class & willing to help

The lectures are very well structured and helpful. Class notes are the most important resource to study for the test. The tests are essay style and the best strategy is to just write everything you know about the question. He is helpful and cares about his students.  He is one of the better econ professors at TCU. I recommend taking his classes.
Excellent teacher, takes the time to make sure his students understand the material.  I would highly recommend him to anyone that has to take macro

Professor Garnett is a great teacher! If you work hard and know the material it should not be hard to get an a... this is one of the few classes that I believe I actually learned something useful in! Take him for sure!

Phenomenal Professor!! Definitely take him for ANY economics class- I took him for macroeconomic this spring. He is extremely nice & personable and really wants his students to-do well. His lectures are clear and understandable in a way that makes the material easy to grasp. He combines the basic fundamentals with current examples in the economy to
Took his Intro Micro during Summer Session. Good teacher, does not usually keep whole time. Learned a lot, 4 tests, just go to test and will do fine
Amazing professor! I'm taking him for Macro in the spring! TAKE THIS PROF!! so helpful, cares about his students, nice guy!
Very good professor. Do the workbook and you will do well in his class. Lectures are clear and  he is very approachable/helpful. Highly reccomended.

Dr. G is an awesome professor. He teaches economics in way that makes it easy to understand. He showed real world applications and examples that helped relate topics to how they will be used in life so you felt like you were really going to use what you learned. He is always willing to help if you need it and practice problems aid on the tests.

Took Intro to Microeconomics during the 5 weeks summer session and it was great. The workbook is awesome for preparing you for exams and he covers the material in a way that makes coming to class not boring. He is very approachable and willing to help with any Q's, you just have to ask. Dr. G's Intro to Micro class is highly recommended!

Dr. Garnett is the man in economics. In his macro course he covers about 4 broad subjects and explains everyone very thoroughly. He makes sure the class really understands. He even holds an extra class before a test to answer any questions. He is a great teacher and I recommend him to everyone.
Hey, disregard the bad rating below. He's really a great prof I just clicked 1 instead of 5 for helpfulness!

Excellent class.  Professor Garnett is hands down one of the best teachers at TCU.  If given the opportunity to take his class, then sign up immediately!!!  In addition to a learning environment that stimulates learning, Professor Garnett is fun, challenging, and a joy to have.

History of Economic Thought 40233: An amazing class, extremely thought-provoking & 100% worth the work. No tests,only reading/ quizzes/papers and he is always willing to assist! You'll get out of it what you put into it-Great method of teaching based primarily on discussion; Dr. Garnett never just lectures so you'll never be bored. Take this class!

Dr. Garnett is the best teacher for economics at any level. His class requires committment but you learn a lot.  For anyone having to take an economics course, History of Thought is highly recommended and gives you a whole new outlook on economics.  Even if you do not have a love for economics, he makes his classes interesting and relevant.

History of Economic Thought is a MUST for any econ student. Although, I recommend anyone take it. Dr. Garnett is absolutely wonderful. He does an incredible job at explaining the course material and getting students involved during class. This course was truly eye opening because it really illuminates how much more we have left to learn in econ.
Took Hist of Economic thought with him. Great Prof, really helpful, great guy. Class not too hard. Goes the extra mile to pair the reading down to the useful stuff.
good professor, study out of the workbook and know main ideas and you should be fine...probably the easiest and best way to get through macro at TCU

Dr. Garnett is a great professor.  Attendace is important but the lectures are interesting so it's not difficult to go to class.  Test reviews and a work book prove to be extremely helpful.  Definitely take him for macro.  He's one of the best professors that I've had at TCU.

Dr. Garnett was a fabulous professor...I really enjoyed going to class every day. I learned and retained tons of useful and applicable information from his class lectures alone. If you go to class, pay attention, and keep up with the homework,you will really enjoy this class and learn a lot!

Dr. Garnett is the NICEST and most intelligent professor at TCU... I took research methods with him (which isn't a fun class), but he made it very interesting. It was probably the class I've learned the most  (and this is my 4th year). Don't think twice, take Dr. Garnett for ANY class, you won't regret it :)

Dr. Garnett is a wonderful professor. He mostly teaches from his manual and if you keep up with that and class notes which are basically the answers for the manual. You will do just fine in his course. He also does not like final exams so you have to write an easy 4-6 page paper. Take this course.
Great teacher, very willing to help. Tests are not that hard, but I recommend going to class and keeping up with notes. Minimal homework. I highly recommend Dr. Garnett.

Dr. Garnett is one of the best professors I have ever had. His teaching method makes his lectures easy to follow and quite clear. The workbook he provides for the class is very helpful when preparing for his tests. I recommend taking Dr. Garnett over any other econ professor.

Dr. Garnett was by far my favorite econ teacher.  His style of teaching is very clear and easy to follow.  So easy that you almost forget you are learning!  This class made macroecon interesting and applicable to everyday life!

Macroeconomics with Dr. Garnett is such a great class! He has a very clear, specific teaching style and that he never tries to "trick" anyone on tests.  Dr. G gives you exactly the information the class needs to know, and teaches in a way that is understandable for all his students.  Dr. G has even written his own workbook which is VERY helpful!

Dr. Garnett is a great asset to TCU.  Not only does he make every class fun and interesting, but makes an already fascinating topic even more interesting by providing real-world examples to the learning process.  Test are challenging, but he teaches in a way that makes them easy if you put forth the effort to soak up the material.  A+++ Teacher!!!!

Dr. G was incredibly knowledgable, interesting, and an overall great teacher. He is very helpful, and willing to meet or talk with students whenever they need him. I high recommend his class, it is not impossible, and is very worthwhile! One of the best in the econ department
One of the best prof. I have had.  You really learn alot in his class.

Dr. Garnett is such a nice man.  He really loves economics and will make it as interesting as he can so you begin to like it too.  Just attend class, pay attention, study about 2 hrs. for each exam and you will definitely get an A.
I love this guy. He's the best in the world, easy a's.

I liked the class and really liked Dr. Garnett most of the time.  He became very difficult to contact and wasn't helpful with the final paper assignment.  He would've been better if he hadn't been preoccupied about getting out for the summer and getting married.  He never returned e-mails, so you have to catch him before/after class.

Dr. Garnett is the perfect example of a quality professor. He will challenge you, but does so in a way that will interest you in economics and he will be very clear and fair in doing so. I highly recommend Dr. Garnett for any class, for you will take a lot of out of his class and the work load will be very fair. Great Professor!

Dr. Garnett excels as a professor because he WANTS you to learn Macro.  He relates the subject matter well, will help you anytime you are confused (which is rarely because he explains himself well), and prepares you for all of your exams.  If you have the chance, don't pass up Dr. Garnett.  If you are motivated, you will do well.

He is a very nice man.  He is a long-winded lecturer.  He rarely lets class out early, mostly because he says everything at least twice.  He works hard to help students do well.  His tests are short answer and fairly hard.  There are 5 reading quizes that are amazingly tough.  Attendance counts for 10% of the grade.  So go to class.
He is really nice and approachable and he teaches really well. I'm bad at any kind of math so it wasen't easy for me, but he made it as simple as possible.

This class was very well structured.  It is a good upper level Econ class.  The writing assignments required a lot of effort, but improved my writing and research skills.  Dr. Garnett is an extremely approachable professor.  The class helps with understanding the real world application of Economics.
Great class, lots of discussion on interesting topics. Great professor, very intelligent. One of the more interesting econ classes.

This is a MUST take class!  It is set up as a class discussion class and you talk about contemporary topics and their relation to economics.  This class gives you great tools in critical thinking and research and is a real eye opener.  Going to class is fun...take this course!
i studied 3 hours before each test and have made above a 93 on all but 1, that we havent taken yet
His lectures can be a little boring, but he's always organized and gives amazing study guides.  Very willing to help if you don't understand.
great prof
Challenging but fair.  Interesting class.
good teacher and really hot... will keep a girl's attention!!! extremely helpful and extremely easy... loved the class.
No Comments

I'm an education major, and have never taken an economics class before, and am not good at math...but Mr. Garnett did a great job explaining the material, and you can tell that he cares about his students and wants them to do well!! I would definately take him again, he's a great teacher!!

I was surprised at the work that I had to put into this class. He had quizzes over reading every Tuesday(5 questions over 160 pages of reading or so) and had a lot of writing to do. It wasn't bad, I just had my expectations a little to high for a little simplicity. He's a great guy my fav prof @ TCU
pretty boring class but straight forward. tests are all short answer but pretty easy if you study. attendance and participation is like 15% of your grade.
He is a tough grader on your research proposal but gives a lot of helpful tips and gives you 3 chances to improve upon it. If you give it effort you can make an A or at least a high B in his class.
I took Klopfenstein and then Quinn, and finally Garnett over the summer.  Alright, I'm not good at econ, but I did well in this class and I recommend him for micro econ.
Boring. I don't think I can emphasize that enough.
He is a very nice guy, who will help with anything. Very personable and wants you to do the best you can.
Garnett is special -- tough grader but very clear and always helpful.  If you really want to learn economics, he's the man.
He is a very smart man that loves economics!  Will help you with any question if ASK for help!  Gives study questions many weeks in advance.  Work hard and you will get the grade you deserve.
I LOVED HIM!!!he is the best teacher ever. You can get a B easily, but do have to work in order to get an A. He is willing to help you if you have a problem or are not clear in something.

This class is good for all of you with no short term memory, cause he goes over the same things for three class periods, one chapter takes you 2 weeks to do. If you go to every third class, you will miss nothing, but his tests are still hard.
I had to use the book alot because he put me to sleep, class not too hard, same amount of effort like any other class, you cna easily make an A with some effort.

You have to try, but he will do anything to help.  Pretty easy B, an A will take some work.  Has gotten a little meaner since his divorce.  Don't argue with him over questions in class wait till after and be respectfull.
study hard and its an A. Easy B, nice guy, will help you out a ton.

I had him for Micro and loved him, the class, b/c it was simple and relatively easy, so was expecting the same when I took him for Macro.  But that wasn't the case.  He was unorganized, unclear, and a significantly more critical grader
Good teacher, covers topics throuroughly, tests come straight from class lectures, nothing to tricky. He's also quite cute.
This guy is an aweful professor.  He pauses a lot when he speaks and he speaks to the board.  He definitely plays favorites.  If he doesnt like you, then you will not do well on his tests.
great teacher and class
Garnett is probably one of the best teachers in the econ department.  His class is not difficult if you listen to him and show him that you care.  Some test questions may be considered subjective.
No Comments

This guy explains everything really well in class, and gives you questions from old tests.  But when you get to the actual test, they're worded really tricky, and he is the most subjective grader I've ever seen, he'll dock you points cuz he feels like it.
an easy class if you listen and do his problems in his work book, the  real  micro book isn't nessary at all for the class do not buy it it is wasteing you like 70 dollars
No Comments
His course requires work.
No Comments

Take this for English credit. Grade is based on 4 projects that he grades extremely easily. I looked forward to going to his 8 am class, and he makes class fun and encourages participation. Grants 9 absences for the entire semester, and no homework besides projects.

Professor Tristain is a more laid-back professor.  He's flexible with due dates when needed and gives you plenty of time to complete your writing assignments.  During class, he's engaging to listen to and explains things in a way that's easy to follow.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: You need to volunteer 2 hours per semester for community service for a huge final project. There are many other projects on top of this as well throughout the semester such as creating a PSA video and writing a song. This class is very time consuming, but if you do the work, you will get an "easy" A.

Professor Graney is super cool. There is a big project and volunteer work out of class, but if you do the work you will get an A. It's an easy A if you participate and it's a fun class in my opinion. He also is young and teaches interesting lectures that aren't boring like a lot of other core classes that we have to take

On day 1, he changed the entire curriculum for this semester. He broke the class into 4 projects with one of them requiring students to complete service hours outside of class every month. Considering this was an English class, it didn't feel very writing based. I did more work in this class than in any major class. Don't take for easy core credit.
Best professor I've had. Really wish I could take him again

Very easy comp 2. You get 9 absences in the class, and he let us out early a lot of the time. There are 4 major projects/essays, including the final, but they are well laid out and easy. Not a hard grader at all, either. I would definitely take this class for an easy comp credit.

The best Professor I have had since I've been at TCU! I absolutely loved this class, had it at 8 am, but he made it such a great class. Also very easy to get an A in this class. Would definitely recommend!
Loved Mr. Graney! He doesn't overload with busy work and he is really flexible. He actually listens to feedback and changes things to make class better for students

Mr. Graney's strength is how approachable he is. He always encouraged us to ask questions in class without any judgment or fear of honest opinions. The class was fun but I learned a lot and truly became a better writer. He was aware that this is a required class, but made every effort to make the class engaging and worth our time. 100% take him!
Mr. Graney is the best! So nice and really loves talking about music. I'm not an english major but I have become a much better writer from his class. Take him!!

Professor Graney helped me gain confidence to continue writing this semester. I was nervous for the class at first, but he is such a great, caring, and patient instructor, that I felt comfortable asking questions and clarification. The projects are sometimes challenging, but Mr. Graney gave a lot of time to work on our essays and projects in class.

I loved Professor Graney, he is young and really cares about his students. He is a fairly easy grader and allows you to make corrections for a better grade. There are a good amount of essays you need to write but they do not take long and he gives you time in class to work on them. Would definitely recommend his class.

Her grading criteria is kinda all over the place. She's nice and approachable but sometimes I don't even think she knows what she's trying to say. The class itself is fairly straightforward and the work isn't too hard but she kinda makes it harder than it should be. She definitely does like to pick on students in class and HATES phone usage.

Nandi likes to pick on students in the class and has little to no grace with her students. I would not take her class ever again. Work is pretty straightforward, with 4 projects throughout the year and simple reading responses. The class itself wasn't bad, but the professor was.

Miss Nandi is a great professor! She gives lots of helpful feedback and the 3 major projects help with your writing styles. The projects were pretty interesting to do and they are pretty straight forward.

Ms. Nandi seems intimidating but the other reviewers on this page probably got bad grades which reflected in their poor judgement words. I learned so much from this class and feel more prepared to take upper level classes moving forward. She gives great feedback and if you work hard, you will do well. I would take her again in a heart beat.

The class was rather uninteresting, leaving most of us with a sense of not having gained much knowledge. While the prof isn't terrible, she falls short of being truly engaging. The 50 minutes in class seemed to drag on, making the prospect of entering the class every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday quite daunting.

Absolutely terrible Professor. Did well in the class but learned absolutely nothing about writing. Most boring classes ive had in a long time. She unfunny, has no chill, and hate people who dont pay attention or give effort. Most of the work is project based and she grades easy if you write well. Hard to gain anything from this class. Easy pass.

He was always kinda tired during our class so the lectures got boring sometimes. Fully open note exams (you can bring anything physical). He doesn't do study guides and the slides don't have enough info most of the time so you'll have to take good notes in class. Overall pretty chill guy tho and interesting material (creativity).

Repasky is the GOAT. He wants everyone to do well. Tests are open note. If you can spend just a few hours and can be intentional compiling your notes you'll do completely fine. Super helpful inside and outside of class. Just a really cool guy tbh. Highly recommend him for creativity!

Lectures are kinda boring but he will give extra credit to those who show up if people start fading it. Tests are take home, open note, open book, and no lockdown. Good teacher too he tries to make the lectures engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hard class but interesting content. Exams are open-note/book, but very hard. Make sure to get and read the textbook. He does curve exam grades and is super helpful with going over exams. I recommend sitting in the front and asking a lot of questions. Also, pay attention and take good notes because exams are based on what he says in lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very interactive and engaging lectures, Repasky is very light-hearted and cares about his students. He does his best to make the class as easy as possible. You'd have to try really hard to not make an A in this class.

Repasky is a great lecturer! He's hilarious too. Gives so much extra credit that it's basically impossible to fail. Tests are online and no lockdown browser but kinda tricky questions and short time limit. The papers and in class assignments were easy As. Definitely start the SONA hours asap and go for the multi part studies! Take his class fs!!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Love Dr Repasky. He makes class fun, attendance isn't mandatory and his exams are available to take at home. He is really funny and very knowledge in his field. Definitely take his class!
The class is very interesting. Also the exams are worth 4/5s of your grade and 4 mandatory attendance days are worth 1/5 of it. He gives extra credit too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very nice and respectable professor. All the tests are take home hand have 1 short easy paper per unit. Definitely take this class  he is great.

Loved Dr. Repasky. Took him for a core credit, and would love to take him again. He makes his classes fun, and is genuinely a nice guy. Tests are online, and although we have in class activities once a week, they are very easy. He is an amazing lecturer as well. Couldnt recommend enough.

Super relaxed class! tests were online and you can take them anywhere. attendance doesn't matter, but there will be in class activities online that you get graded for, but overall take him, hes the best!!

Super chill professor this class was basically my study hall. Tests are open note, open Internet, online, and no lockdown browser. Only four short one page papers and four exams including the final. If you don't get an A, you weren't trying. Just stay on top of SONA hours they fill up fast so check the sit consistently!

Great teacher I will be sad to leave this class. He cares for his students, a very nice, humorous guy, who makes the class a lot of fun if you participate in lectures/activities. Attendance isn't mandatory. theres a activity/quiz once a week. He also allows open notes during exams. Easy class, turn everything in on time, you have a guaranteed A.

I litteraly love this class and repasky he is the BEST. Attendance is not mandatory but the in class activities will bring your grade down if you are not there to do them. The content is interesting and there are really only 3 assignments which are easy. For sure take this class!

If you are taking this class for a core, it will be the easiest A of your TCU career. Attendance is not mandatory, and all tests are non-lockdown, and you don't have to be in class. There are weekly quizzes, and he doesn't tell you when they are, so watch out for those. Otherwise, super easy.

TAKE HIS CLASS! Attendance is not mandatory, tests are online no lockdown browser. Pop quizzes are attendance but are online. I would recommend doing the alternate assignment for research credit, way easier.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a great psych professor. He is very knowledgeable about the topics and wants his students to succeed. Class attendance isn't mandatory but there is one in class activity a week thats open note/internet. There are 4 take home exams that are open note/internet including the final. There are four 1 page research assignments that his TA's grade.

This is such an easy fun class. Turn your papers in on time! We have a in class assignment once a week but your friend can tell you when it is. Some of the other psych teachers are super hard and this was one of my most favorite and non work heavy classes
Live laugh love Dr. Repasky. Super nice and an easy class. Get on your SONA hours early though, because they fill up at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: very hard not to pass his class. gives you everything needed to succeed. you do have to write a small paper every so often but nothing to bad

Great professor for intro psych. Keeps it simple. Online exams not taken in class are super easy. Even if you don't do well on exams, there are actual assignments that will provide your grade a cushion, but your exam grades will be fine, trust me. Very nice guy who will work with you.
If you show up to class you will be fine. You can look up all the exams, the in class quizzes which are done for attendance, and the papers are less than a page. So easy
Easy A. A few papers are doable, as well as pop quizzes. He drops your 6 worst quizzes, so you're guaranteed to have a good avg. quiz grade. Exams are online no lockdown. Take him

Professor Repasky was great! His class is extremely easy as tests are taken outside of class and he allows you to use notes, the textbook, and AI. Very few assignments other than research hours and a short written assignment per unit. His lectures can be boring at times but overall he tries to make them interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: class is sooo easy. there is four tests, all online on your own and you can use all your notes/the internet. his class is not mandatory (really boring) and he just goes through his lectures (which are posted online).

This is an easy class to cover core or good if you're interested in psychology. Attendance is not mandatory, but there are some in-class quizzes that you'll want to be there for to get credit. Overall, Repasky is a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Lectures can be boring but tests are so easy and u just need to take notes. You get extra credit for coming to class is not a lot of ppl are there. TAKE POB very easy science credit.

Repasky is amazing. He has a good sense of humor, and his lectures are quite interesting. Tests are take home, and they are open note. You will have quizzes throughout the semester, but you can work with classmates and he drops some of your lowest scores. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Repasky was mostly entertaining (the lectures could get a bit boring, though). There were many pop quizzes so you need to show up, but you could use your notes and the internet + they're super easy. No homework, online open-note tests, super fair grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Prof Repasky was mostly entertaining in his lectures (it could get boring sometimes) and there's no homework. He did random pop quizzes, so you have to show up, but you can use your notes and the internet + they're super easy. There were some essays, but he graded pretty fairly, and the tests were all online and open note.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: TAKE HIM FOR INTRO!!!!! This class saved my gpa. Everything is online and open note. He does 14 surprise quizzes throughout the semester but drops 4, and has an exam and written assignment for every unit. Such an easy A I highly suggest him!!!
Great professor! All tests were online and open note/google. He gave no homework and you really could never go to class. He was a great teacher and had some great teachings.

All quizzes and tests open everything except you can not use someone else in the class. I loved his lectures. They were easy to follow and if I needed to clarify he was happy to answer. He also posts all lectures online. There are only 4 assignments (1 page of writing each month). Attendance not mandatory. I would 100% take this again.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Dr. Repatsky seems to be the easiest intro psych professor. All exams are open note/online, pop quizzes happen sometimes but you can work with others and use notes, and short essays for each unit are basically completion. I'd reccomend!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Repasky is amazing! He is extremely intelligent. His classes are extremely chill and attendance is not mandatory. He doesn't give dates for upcoming quizzes though so if you are absent on the day of a quiz, you will not get credit. He does drop the 4 lowest quiz scores of the semester if you happen to miss a quiz. Great person too!

Class is very doable and he is great! Can use notes/textbook/resources for online tests/quizzes. Quizzes-can work w/peers & usually @end of each unit. 5% grade boost if do 10 extra hours of research (start doing research when posted immediately bc limited studies) or a research paper instead. 4 quizzes dropped. Highly recommend for chill class!

Dr. Repasky is the best and it's clear he loves his students and what he does. The class is what you make of it, don't go in thinking you can just breeze by without showing up because you'll definitely need your notes for the tests. There are 3 different extra credit opportunities so I would definitely do those because they boost your grade a lot.

Repasky is awesome. This was a psych elective (creativity) I loved the class. Tests are open notes, but hard at the same time, attendance is only mandatory for tests and in-class assignments. 3 XC assignments, highly recommend doing all of them, can help boost my grade so much. Very interesting class and he does a wonderful job of teaching it!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Attendance is not mandatory, however, there are 12 quizzes randomly throughout the semester he assigns in class (not graded) but it's his way of doing attendance so I would recommend going as much as you can. Tests and quizzes are open note and book, not too bad as long as you are familiar with the content because it can be specific sometimes

All tests and quizzes are open book and open note and you do them outside of class. I found his tests hard to get a phenomenal grade on, despite them being open note. Pretty boring class. He only lectures. Grades come from tests, unit submissions, and quizzes. Definitely the best option for intro to psych!

TAKE THIS CLASS!! This is quite possibly the easiest class I have ever taken at TCU. Everything is online, open note/book, and there are only two assignments per unit. His lectures are entertaining and easy to follow, and quizzes are graded very easily. If you just do the assignments, you will get an A, I cannot recommend this class enough!

Don't take this class. Yes, the test is open note but it is very difficult and specific. There is literally no way to study for such a test. The lab is like a lecture and very long. Once again don't take this class, take something else. Good luck
Repasky is a laid back professor. Attendance is not mandatory for every lecture, but there are many pop quizzes that count as attendance just graded by completion.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I found his lectures to be a bit dry. His quiz and test questions are often really specific and can be confusing. All the power points online and everything is open book. This professor definatly knows his stuff and you can learn a lot if you put in the effort. Don't take if you just need an elective or easy A, but it's not bad at all.

Dr. Repasky is not engaging at all and the class is extremely lecture heavy. I took the honors portion of the course and he made us write an APA research paper with no guidance at all and not very clear instructions on what he was expecting. The grade is based in only 5 grades 4 which are exams that are not well formatted and very specific.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Repasky is super lecture heavy and not engaging at all. Tests are online but super hard and specific, you need to remember everything he said to do well. The only grades are the 4 exams and the lab grade. No room for improvement.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Although I preferred Dr Centanni for POB Dr Repasky still held very interesting lectures. This class is lecture heavy, but he always explained things very clearly and gave great examples of certain concepts. You can get 5% extra credit for sona study participation. I suggest skimming the text book, and paying close attention to the lectures

Class is all lecture based with slides which are posted online. Most test questions come directly from the slides. Tests are open note and online. There are four tests and a few research assignments spread out through the semester. 5% extra credit SONA hours (surveys and tests) can be achieved. I rarely attended class and still got a high A.

This was a decent class. There were times when it was easy and times when it was hard. Repasky is engaging and funny, however I felt that there were questions on the exam that you had no way of knowing the answer to unless you had paid attention to (and remembered) every word he said in lecture. Tests are open book and HW isn't too bad.
Repasky is very passionate about his work and lectures, however, they are very long and wordy. Sometimes it is hard to decipher what he will test over.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Repasky is cool. The class is open note, open book and his PowerPoints cover everything you need. At first the grading structure was confusing but he makes it so it really works for you. If you show up to class, you'll do great. Attendance isn't necessarily mandatory but he has attendance quizzes.

I liked him fine. sometimes hard to follow but he posts power points so youre fine. gives you 7 unexcused absences (plenty), lots of ways to get your grade up. DO SONA! start as soon as possible and get the 15 hours. it is worth it. with all the extra padding I think it will get my grade up to an A.

He's one of the best professors you can get for this class. Attendance isn't mandatory, but there are 1 question in-class quizzes, so if you don't go to class, check TCU online during class time. They're not graded on accuracy. Tests are online & are open note/book. Do extra SONA studies and get them done early. You can get 5% added to your grade!!

Dr. Repasky is a laid-back, lecture heavy professor. The Introduction to Psychology course I took with him was interesting and a very easy class to succeed in. He is lenient with his students and takes the time to help them with any issues they may have in the class. The tests are take-at-home, open note, open internet and are entirely based on his
Super solid prof. Makes class interesting and as long as you study and put in basic work you'll get an A.
Many opportunities to boost your grade. Very kind and relaxed.

Take this class for psych - there is not better professor! If your class is online, it is open note and you don't even have to really attend class to do well. His tests are largely based on his ppts, and they are open note, but because of this they are actually pretty difficult. Reading the textbook helps a lot, and he gives EC. Overall so easy.

Dr. Repasky takes his intro to psych class very seriously. Most people expect an easy A in such a course, but you do have to put in some effort in order to get the A. He does help you A LOT with extra credit. Exams are a little challenging but if you do all the extra credit you should get an A. He is very helpful and loves to answer questions.

His lectures are his power points which means that you can study before and have questions. Psychology is normally a super simple class, but his tests make you think (usually it's more than one answer choice type jazz). Overall, he is super nice and caring, and I would 100% take him again. He is not out to get you, and he is really fun to talk to.

Repasky is a very laid back teacher. I took him for Gen Psych and it was my only B that semester. All the other Gen Psych classes are easy A's. I would not recommend his class. He does not give any reviews or study guides and his tests are very difficult. I did 20 hours of SONA extra credit and still made a B. This class is not worth that much time

He's great. But, his tests are literally the type of questions that you debate two answers for the entire time and end up overthinking and getting it wrong. Aka (A and c) (a and b) (all of the above) (none of the above). it's honestly quite ridiculous.

most chill professor on campus! long lectures but takes time to explain material and makes it relatable so you don't lose interest. loves to crack jokes. book only needed for online quizzes. lets you know about "pop quizzes". as long as you take them you receive 100. DON'T FALL BEHIND ON SONA HOURS! study A LOT for exams as they cover much material

Dr. Repasky's lectures are not the most interesting but if you go to class and fill in the slides and halfway pay attention, you will be fine for the exams as long as you study. His final is optional so if you take it he drops the lowest test score. He gives 5% bonus on overall grade for extra credit. I highly recommend this class.
Boring lectures

Greg is awesome, I would 100% recommend his intro to psyc class! He's SUPER chill and funny. He usually provides lectures online, so if you miss class it's not the end of the world... But still go lol. Tests come straight from lecture pwr. points. He offers SONA study extra credit which can rly boost your grade, so take advantage of those!

General psych with Dr Repasky was great! He makes it simple enough for non-majors to understand, and the material is interesting. Just pay attention and look over lecture notes before tests and you'll be fine

Tests are super easy as long as you pay attention to lectures and read your textbook. Pop quizzes every week but are a participation grade so it doesnt matter how many you get correct. Does have extra credit opportunities that are super easy and give you a lot of points at the end of the semester

Dr. Repasky is a great professor. His lectures, though monotone at times, are very informative and essential to performing well on the test. 80% of your grade comes from 4 tests, so make sure you study for those. His tests aren't difficult if you go to class and study for a couple hours. If you're taking this with other hard classes, don't worry.

Repasky is really nice and very knowledgeable! Super easy A. Great core class for non psych majors. His lectures can be a little long sometimes but his class is honestly so easy, you would have to try to fail. Easy A if you show up and put a little effort in. Doesnt give - grades only +

Gregory is a nice man. However, his lectures are the most boring and dry lectures that I have ever experienced. He also takes 10 million years to grade SCANTRON TESTS. The class itself is so easy, literally you can cram the night before and be absolutely fine. Attendance is sorta required: 5 (out of like 7) required in class participation quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tests are his lectures! You can print the notes beforehand so it's fairly simple. He gives attendance quizzes, you only need 5 and he offers 7 but he tells you what weeks they will be, so they are impossible to miss. Easy class, def take Repasky!

Take Repasky for Gen Psych! He is such a cool person, and the class itself is not hard at all. Attendance is not required, but if you want an A, I'd recommend showing up to class! I would also highly recommend getting SONA done at the very beginning of the semester; everyone tries to do it last minute and there are no studies left.

You do not need to even show up to class to pass. He doesn't add anything in to lecture that isn't in the powerpoint slides (which he uploads to D2L). His tests are made for you to do well-- half of the answer choices are bogus anyways so he makes it relatively obvious as to what the correct answer is. Seriously, don't go to class. Sleep instead.

Coolest professor at TCU. Show up to class (not mandatory); most of it revolves around powerpoints/ lectures but he puts them online anyway. Tests come from powerpoints; you don't even need the textbook, and he tells you that. Just study the powerpoints & he loves helping outside of class. It's a shame if you don't get an A in this class!

He's pretty lenient. There are quizzes but you don't have to take all of them because you get to skip one. He does not care if you show up to class or not but don't expect him to give you all the materials because the ones he posts online are blank sheets and you have to be in class to fill them out. His tests aren't super easy but not impossible
He's a pretty good teacher a little boring but not bad, hella extra credit which is nice tests are slight hard.

I really enjoyed taking this class, it was very interesting and fun. I learned so much throughout the semester. Repasky is the best professor ever! His lectures are lecture heavy but he goes through each point and explains it, giving examples you can apply to the concepts. He has the best dad jokes ever! Has a great sense of humor during class!

I really liked this class it was interesting, fun, and super easy. If you show up to class and take notes, you'll know everything on the study guides. There are quizzes but the dates for them are on the syllabus and they are only for a completion grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Nice funny guy, but very few grading opportunities. Try to do as many SONA hours (5 was required for the class, but you get extra credit for doing more).

DEFINITELY take him for general psych! He makes his lectures interesting with examples and videos. Quizzes are participation only and the exams are straight from the powerpoint- I never even bought the book. Fun class and easy A

Professor Repasky did not require you to be in class, but it was helpful to show up for the simple fact that it was little things you should  know from class that aren't covered in the notes. when he gave study guides it was very helpful. Do the 15 sona credits because it boosted my grade from a C to a B which was great!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Repasky is literally the best professor I've had at TCU. The class is pretty lecture-heavy, but he makes them so much fun. I'm not even a psych major and I absolutely loved this class. Would definitely take any other class he offered in the future!!

Boring and lazy professor that always shows up late to class and it takes him forever to grade tests, even though they are scantron. It's an easy A, however, so you should take the class just don't take this man seriously as a college professor.

The class was boring, but not very hard. Repasky is pretty dull but has a sense of humor and is super chill. He just reads the Power Points. 6 papers and 3 exams, one presentation at the end. None of the assignments were that challenging, there is EC and other grade boosters. Worst thing is he is the slowest grader ever and rarely updated ecollege.

This is my second time taking a class with Repasky and I would definitely take him again! He's kind of a dork and laughs easily which makes class pretty fun. The material he has to cover isn't the most interesting, but he makes it bearable. 2 long papers, 4 short papers, 3 tests, and a presentation sounds like a lot but it's not bad at all!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Gen Psych was a great experience with Prof. Repasky. He's a fun and enjoyable presence in the class and has a great sense of humor. His lectures are easy to follow and are really interesting. If you feel like skipping, just ask a friend for their notes. Tests are super easy to cram for and his bonus points from SONA make the class an easy A.

Dr. Repasky is a great professor. He was super helpful if you ever had any questions about anything and he listened to the needs of the class. However, lectures are pretty boring.  You can't even take notes on the lecture because it's literally just what's in the powerpoint. One minor thing, he speaks in upspeak, but overall, interesting class.

Dr. Repasky is a super cool guy and a good prof. He's fresh out of school so he's really young and totally understands our college struggles. Tests aren't bad and he basically reads off of the powerpoint verbatim during lecture. P.S. He brings candy for tests and offers bonus points for SONA :)

Tests are hard if you don't study and know the material, but this class is a breeze. Don't buy the textbook! If you do 15 hours of Sona, you will get 5% added on your overall grade. You don't ever have to go to class, but he randomly takes attendance. Make friends who will sign you in if you miss it. Drops a test at the end, so final is optional!

Dr. Repasky is an amazing professor and is absolutely hilarious! He makes the material interesting and memorable. There are only 4 tests so there is not much room to mess up, but extra credit is offered if you bomb completely. He is very understanding and wants to get to know you. I would take his class a thousand times over just to look at him.

DON'T BUY THE BOOK. Just memorize his slides, study a little, and you'll easily make an A. Do as many SONA hours as you can. Definitely worth the extra credit to bump your grade. Start SONA as soon as you can, it can be difficult to get studies because of the number of students participating & how you answer on the prescreen.

DO NOT BUY THE TEXT BOOK OR WILEY PLUS! This class is straight memorization of the slides he gives during class. DO AS MANY SONA HOURS AS POSSIBLE. Final is optional if happy with grade! Finished with 86 but SONA Extra credit it put me at a 92% and I didn't have to take the final. He's very helpful during office hours! Lectures get long and boring.

he's a great teacher! he gives so much extra credit and genuinely wants you to succeed. he also doesn't give out minuses, only pluses! (so if you get an 81, you have a B, if you can an 86, you get a B+). he will explain everything to you if you ask and he'll make sure you understand. such a great teacher and i would love to take his class again!!

Not the easiest subject and whoever likes scientific writing is crazy pants. 2 long papers (min 8 pages) to write, 4 article assignments (2-4 pgs), 3 MC exams, final is a presentation on one of the research papers you wrote. Offers extra credit thru participation with SONA. Makes it interesting and relevant. VERY HELPFUL! Highly recommended.

took him for general psych and liked him so much that i took him for behavioral research as well even though im not even a psych major. he is a great professor who understands students and his class is easy as long as u study for the tests. attendance is not mandatory and powerpoints are online so you dont really have to go. u dont need textbook.
Energetic young professor. Up front an honest, clearly explains concepts, and has a massively overcrowded class. You should definitely attend.

Lectures are super engaging so you don't get bored.  He tries to keep the class as fun as possible while still teaching at the same time.  If you pay attention to the power points in class and go over them before tests you will definitely be successful.  Show up to class to take the socrative quizzes!
Repasky is a graduate student but knows what he is talking about! Every class you take a short quiz for attendance online. Pay attention to power points because they are NOT online. Tests are hard!
In General Psychology there was no homework. Don't buy the book, it's a waste of your time, you just need to review the power points for the tests and you will pass easily. He's super chill and nice.

Greg is an amazing professor who knows how to make the lectures interesting and keep the class engaged and involved.  Offers extra credit for the tests!  There is no homework for the class and the final is optional.  Even though the work load is very minimal you still learn so much in the class.  Take this class!

Super sweet and great teacher! Uses socrative to take attendance so if you don't go to class just have your friend login for you to show attendance. He knows his stuff and explains it well. No homework and an optional final. Have to do 5 psych study hours but can do more for extra credit. TAKE REPASKY FOR AN EASY A!
Excellent professor that keeps the class engaged.  If you show up for class and pay attention you will have no problem making a good grade.  He offers extra credit!  Take advantage.

Do not take this class with Prof. Hedrick. She zooms through the material and by the time you write down the problem she's onto the next. Is not very good at explaining things. Her exams and quizzes are not like the homework. They are the hardest possible questions that you have NOT gone over in class.

Generally won't be your best option for the class but you can do much worse. Main appeal of her is that she allows for test corrections which is very nice, and she's willing to admit if she made a mistake on a quiz or exam, however sometimes can take a while to post solutions or notes which can make it frustrating to study.

She doesnt care if you pass or fail even if you go to office hours every time she offers it. She does give quiz corrections which is nice. However when you go to her for extra help just know what shes telling you to know will not be on the quizzes.
She gives really understandable lectures and curves exams by a lot. Take her for Math!

worst teacher ive ever taken. ever. doesnt explain anything. notes suck. gets mad when u ask questions.  puts the hardest question on the exams and DOESNT LET YOU USE A CALCULATOR. homework is nothing like the quizes or exams. dont take her im probably gonna have to retake calc bc of her.
Great math teacher! Weekly quizzes but they prepare you for the big exams

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. I'm constantly miserable bc of this class. I'm probably going to have to drop and I've never made lower than a B. She's going to be the reason I can't get into Neeley. She focuses too much on why calc is the way it is and not how to just do the math. she also grades hard. AVOID AT ALL COSTS

Her lectures are very confusing and hard to follow which makes it difficult to succeed in the class. She knows the math so well that she goes through material extremely fast. She is accessible in office hours and that helps some, but I would avoid this class unless you are willing to put in 10 hours of work at least.

She is not good at explaining concepts unless you work one on one with her which there is no time for in class. She writes her notes and examples on the board faster than you can write them down and by the time you copy down what she wrote she is already explaining the next thing.

Get ready to work! She is kind, but her class is very challenging. I took honors calc in high school yet still had a very difficult time. She does not spend much time breaking down concepts, and her notes are hard to follow. Does not use simple problems, and honestly makes things harder than they need to be. Avoid if possible, but is a good person

Her notes aren't good and are hard to follow if you haven't taken calculus in high school. She doesn't allow a calculator, like all the other applied calculus classes. Homework doesn't help on quizzes and exams, and she will give you more complex and more difficult problems on the quizzes and exams than what she goes over in class.

Do not take!!! Probably the hardest class I've ever taken bc of how awful a professor she is. Her notes are confusing with no explantation of concepts. Tests are so hard/nothing like the homework. Can't use a calculator and tests aren't open note. So frustrating when other classes are making easy A's bc they have a good professor.

I didn't realize this professor would be so bad. I took applied Calculus with her and it was one of the hardest classes i've ever taken. I was an all A student in high school and she made me immune to failing. Her tests and quizzes are NOTHING like the homework's and her notes are so confusing and not helpful. Don't take her class unless needed!!!

Lockdown quizzes every Monday and even if you come to every lecture and highlight all the things she says will be on a quiz, you won't get 100%. Exams are so difficult for no reason even if you memorize the past quiz questions and go over all notes. The projects are easy but sometimes she'll give you points off and not really explain why

DO NOT take her if you are looking for an easy core. the WEEKLY quizes  are lockdown and impossible to cheat, she treats it like if we were all musical theater majors very difficult for no reason. i would just choose another professor tbh

We have a quiz ON LOCKDOWN BROSER every single Monday. Every other class that is doing the same thing did not have one quiz and they didn't have to go to class. She is a very sweet teacher but just she is teaching a honors course to non honors kids. This was more like a Senior Level class. Do not take this teacher.

If you want a easy core class do not take it. You have a quiz every Monday on lock down browser, although you do watch this cool show called smigadoon every monday before the quiz. She gives you 8 minutes to do 7 questions. The tests, Impossible. Confusing. I would recommend another teacher if you have to take this class.

There are quizzes every monday but she provides notes and she will say “this will be on the test” and you highlight it. I didn't study for quizzes, just looked at the notes before class and got 100 all of them. If you are in the honors class, there is more work but worth it. She is a fair grader and is understanding about a lot if you communicate.

I loved this class!! You watch a TV show and then talk about all the theatre references it makes. SO fun! I was never bored. Exams are in person lockdown but super easy if you take notes. She says exactly what will be on it.

If you take the honors lab, it's just ok. The work stacks up towards the end (research paper!!) but I'd still recommend!
10/10, she is the best. So sweet & funny, and is always willing to help. Actually looked forward to going to this class every MWF. Only took attendance on Mondays for the weekly quiz. TAKE HER !!

Easy core class as long as you show up. She quite literally hands you what you need to know for the exam on a silver platter. Anybody who gives a low score for Professor Humphrey was just lazy and didnt show up to class. Weekly quizzes were tough if you didn't put in a little effort, but Midterm and final just compiled quiz questions.
if you want any easy class, don't take it. she is a very hard grader and takes it very seriously for a core.

If you want an easy class for core, don't take. All the test questions are on very specific details from her lectures so if you dont go to class you will miss it. her quizzes are hard and it was difficult to get an A.

Professor Humphrey is a great professor! She is kind and approachable. I took this class for my fine arts credit. It was very easy. One project, one paper, 2 exams, 10 quizzes, and a final.
if you're not a theatre major don't take her
