reviews.comment: I LOVE MRS HUMPHREY. Her lectures were the best to start my day with because they are so fun and lively. Her exams will seem impossible if you don't show up to class because she tells you what you need to know and write down to ace every quiz/test. She posts notes for you to follow along with and she's so passionate with what she says.

I loved professor Humphrey she made class so enjoyable, but you really need to attend her lectures to get a good grade. The test questions are very specific to what she teaches and if you don't know it you won't do well.
TAKE THIS FOR YOUR FINE ARTS CREDIT!! So fun and so enjoyable!! As long as you go to class, you will get an A. She literally tells you exactly what you need to know for the test!!!

If musical theater is not your passion avoid this class. No attendance, but you need to go in order to have all the details she tests you on. All the test questions are on very specific details from her lectures. Not super understanding, either. If you are not a theater major, I would definitely avoid it.

I LOVE profesor Humphrey! She is the cutest human ever! We watch an episode of a tv show every monday, followed by an 8 question quiz from the previous week's lecture. She tell you exactly what you need to know and if you study youll do great on the quizzes/exams. There one paper and one video presentaion. Humphrey is so sweet and very passionate!

Professor Humphrey is a super sweet lady. You don't really have to go to class, she doesn't take attendance. The quizzes and exams are online but in person so you need to study a little (they are easy). There was one project at the end of the semester, which I felt like she graded pretty strictly, but I still got an A.

TAKE HER! Amazing class, so interesting and fun. I learned so much and genuinely looked forward to class EVERY WEEK! Not only is the class amazing, but Prof. Humphrey is super kind and caring. She loves what she teaches and it shows. Super approachable and willing to geek out with you over any musical lol. Quizes are easy too! 100000% recommend!

her lectures help absorb the material, especially since there's a lot to memorize. Even though the class is optional, attending regularly makes the memorization process much easier. A musical theatre background can help with understanding, but it's not a deal-breaker if you're willing to put in the work. It is not an easy A, but its super doable

Prof Humphrey is a very sweet person and is passionate about what she teaches. She gives us the notes and tells us everything we need to know from them for the quizzes/exams. There are 2 quizzes, 2 exams, 1 documentary paper, and 1 performance project. She also offers extra credit. Take if you're even slightly interested in musical theatre!

This class is a super easy and entertaining fine arts credit. There are 4 tests but she tells you everything you need to know in lectures. Exams are in person with lockdown browser but studying should only take 30 mins. There is also a documentary essay and project due but she is a very easy grader if you put in some effort. Take this class!

Overall, this was an easy class! She is super nice and entertaining. She tells you exactly what you need to know for tests and quizzes during class, so I would recommend going. Everything is on lockdown browser, but as long as you pay attention and study a bit, you will be fine. It's definitely the most fun fine art credit there is!!

Take Professor Humphrey!! She is so  fun and her lectures are engaging. 4 tests, one paper, one project, and extra credit opportunities, so overall  chill class. Did require some studying but it is so straightforward so if you read over notes you are good. Also the structure of the class is based on a TV show which we actually watch in class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was interesting at times, but the quizzes and tests are lockdown browser, in person, and kind of hard. I didn't fail because she grades the one big project really easy. She's low key passive aggressive and quirky. Not an easy pass, but you can barely pass with not trying or going to class.

Such a fun and interesting class, especially if you like musical theater. The course is structured around a TV show which helps make the lectures so easy to understand. There are 2 tests and 2 quizzes as well as a paper and project. All are super easy and spread throughout the semester. Definitely recommend!

Humphrey is a very nice professor and the class is a fun way to get your fine arts credit. The class has only 4 quizzes (including the final), a documentary paper, and a project. Just study one or two days before the quizzes and you will probably end the course with an A. There are also extra credit opportunities.

This class is so much fun for a FA credit (especially if you like theatre)! She gives a lot of in depth info, which can be daunting but she tells you exactly what to highlight in your notes to study. Tests are in person on a lockdown browser, but if you come to class and study the material you will do well!
Amazing lectures!! Tests are online and you do need to study but she gives everyone the notes and tells you what you need to know.
This class was always my favorite to go to! Show up to class, highlight what she tells you you need to know, and you'll have no problem acing everything. Definitely a fun and easy fine arts credit.
No homework and she makes class so fun! You have to study for the exams but they are not hard if you study

Each class has lectures with a lot of fun videos built into them. Attendance is not mandatory but she tells you what to study for tests during the lectures. Quizzes are easy but tests are pretty hard given the amount of information you are expected to memorize. She offers extra credit with Pocket Points and if you attend a musical.
Doesn't take attendance, but you have to take notes and pay attention in class. Test can be difficult, but if you study it is doable.

She's such a nice lady and is so knowledgeable of everything musical theater. The class is graded on 4 or 5 quizzes, one (easy) paper and one project, but nothing is even close to hard. The lectures take the whole class but are always so good and interesting. Such an easy fine arts course to fill requirements. Take if you can!!

Professor Humphrey is such an amazing teacher! Her lectures are not mandatory but she does tell you when you should listen up/ write notes for upcoming exam questions. As long as you pay attention you should do relatively well on all the exams. You have one small paper, along with a creative video that was very fun to do! The Exam isn't cumulative!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Jessica Humphrey is very nice and has a very fun personality. As a person, she is a great professor to take a class with. Her survey of musical theatre class was extremely hard, however. Her tests are unnecessarily hard and the whole class is memorizing hundreds of tiny pieces of information. The class was way too hard for just a fine arts credit.

reviews.comment: This class was amazing. Literally so fun every time. There were four tests, and the final was not cumulative. Information for the tests was all given in lectures so they are very easy if you pay attention. Attendance is not mandatory but I'd recommend going so you have a leg up on the tests. We also wrote one paper and had an easy project.

Humphrey is an amazing professor. You definitely have to go to class to do well but technically it is not mandatory. Her lectures include video examples and sometimes personal ties to actors we talk about. She is very energetic and she loves what she teaches. Overall I recommend this course it is fairly easy.

I LOVE PROF HUMPHREY!!! She is the kindest and most passionate woman you'll ever meet. No homework, just a couple small projects/papers throughout the semester. Coursework was super light! The only thing is that the tests were harder than I anticipated. You have to study for hours for them, because its all memorization of names and shows. TAKE HER!

Humphrey is such an amazing professor and she is so passionate about what she teaches! This makes class super interesting. Her lectures have lots of video examples in them that keep them entertaining too. Test questions come straight from her lectures so as long as you take notes you will do well!

This is an easy class, but you kinda have to go to do well. I have gone to every class and I have an A, but my friend in the class skips fairly often and has a C. reviews.comment: Take this class if you need a credit. Professor Humphrey is the sweetest lady ever. She is so passionate about her class and about her student's lives. Her quizzes and tests are word-for-word from lectures, so take notes and study those. The work is very easy, and the lectures are very entertaining. You will not get bored.

Jessica is one of the most engaging and talented professors at TCU. She loves her musical theatre class so much and cares for the student's learning. You can earn a great grade in her class if you engage in her lectures and only minimal studying is required. Do not miss out on this class if you have the slightest interest in musical theatre.

LOVE THIS CLASS!! I attended like 50% of the classes but still ended with a high A. There's 4 quizzes and 4 tests plus a super easy project and research paper. It's also super entertaining overall!

I LOVE professor Humphrey. While this class is just a lot of memorizing people and names of shows the lectures were so engaging and interesting. Professor Humphrey is the sweetest and most entertaining woman. This class is perfect for a fine arts requirement. No work really outside of class and easy to skip and get notes from a friend!

you can do fine on tests and quizzes without attending, but she tells you what you need to know for quizzes and tests In class. she makes class very fun and upbeat. gives extra credit opportunities and is very nice

I put in minimal effort and feel that this class was a breather. It focuses on the history of musical theater, so if you prefer that to doing plays this class if for you. She has a very cheery demeanor and encourages participation (but is chill).

Dr. Humphrey was one of my favorite professors! I really like musical theatre so I found her lectures really interesting and she has a great personality. The lectures cover all of the test material. Super easy A. Love Humphrey!!! She is super passionate about musical theatre which makes it fun to learn about.

super into it

I loved Professor Humphrey's class! She paralleled the class lectures with a TV show, which made it very interesting and engaging. In addition, she is a working actress so she brings a unique perspective. She included lots of videos, pictures, and fun facts in her lectures.

Prof. Humphreys lectures were informative and fun... I got more out of this class than I thought I would! Highly recommended :)

If you love/like Broadway this class is perfect for you.

she is a TCU gem!

Holmes is the best! One of the few professors that really cares for her students. It's not hard to get on her good side but it really pays off. Start off strong with effort and attendance. Dr. Houston is so kind and down to earth! You will have a decent amount of homework each week (anywhere between 4-8 briefs) but once you get in the swing of doing them, it's manageable. Definitely take her! The lectures are so engaging and actually fun since they're discussion based.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took her for Judicial Politics and ConLaw: Equality and have loved Dr H and her classes! She usually lectures but is interactive and has a great personality. Grades are based on briefs (2 pts each) and the midterm and final which are 200 pts each. I highly recommend but be ready to read and write several briefs if you're taking a conlaw class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I did not know anything until I came to this class. She is by far one of the best teachers I have ever had. The classes are fun and there is a lot of classroom discussion. The homework is simple and prepares you for class. If you scared to take her class, don't be she's amazing!

Her class setup is about 2/3 case briefs per class (super easy, just a little tedious) and then one take home midterm and one take home final. She's so chill about turning things in late and wants the best for her students. No textbook needed and all the cases are in her d2l

You'll do some case briefs, for sure, but they're not too bad when you get the hang of it. Don't be too scared of the Midterm and Final. Clear guidelines for these exams are given and she can accomodate for anything that you have going on. One of my favorite professors at TCU. Highly Recommend!

Dr. Houston is AMAZING! She's very accommodating and truly cares about what she's teaching. Class is made up of case briefs that you submit before class each day, and 2 take-home essays where you create an argument based on the briefs. Show up to class, participate, and ask questions, and you'll be fine.

Such a great professor!! Her lectures are entertaining and captivating. You only have 2 exams the entire semester, which are fun to work on, and you write a paper arguing for or against the topic she gives. The homework is to do 2-3 briefs each Tuesday and Thursday, which aren't bad; you just need to read a little bit. Definitely recommend taking!

I LOVE professor Houston, I'm about to take my fourth class of hers. Her conlaw classes have two big papers and weekly assignments, she is a tough grader on papers but you'll do well if u show you're thinking through every part of the arguments. She's also hilarious and so easy to talk to, and her lectures very are engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Houston is an amazing professor to take for Intro to Public Law. Her lectures are fun and engaging, and she includes many activities throughout the PowerPoints to get students involved. Lots of fun group work that really gets you thinking! I could not recommend her enough!
The best professor just show up and review is the same as the test. Online quizzes and excels are easy. This guy is the best.
Def take for Micro hard to understand but you do not need to focus

Such an easy and kind professor, he is happy to answer questions and concerns after class. All you have to do is SHOW UP, that is literally it. You mark your attendance then you can do whatever you want during class. He lectures but all the quizzes are online, and the tests are pulled straight from the study guides. Easy A.

Professor Cocchi was honestly one of my favorite professors. He's caring and super willing to help out when you need help with the weekly excel assignments and quizzes - he'll basically just give you the answer. The study guides are basically the test too. I didn't learn too much, but it was a free A.

Great teacher. Free A. Just do the quizzes and look at the study guides he gives before exams, as a lot of the questions on the exam are pulled from it. He has a thick accent, but it gets easier to understand over time. Great guy as well.

He explains every topic very clearly, but he does spend a ton of time on each thing, which can get super dull and repetitive. Weekly online quizzes and excel are super easy (he shows you how to do the excel step by step every week), and he gives study guides for the exams which are basically word for word the questions. A bit boring, but he's nice.

He is a very sweet professor who cares a lot about this topic. However he does have a thick accent but don't be scared away by it because it gets easier to understand and also he gives you reviews for the test that are almost identical to the exam. Easy good grade but would recommend someone else if you want to learn more in depth.
Very easy class. No homework, only online weekly quizzes that are easy and 3 tests including final. He'll give you study guides for each test. Overall easy A

Your grade is based on 3 exams, he'll give you study guides for each
Weekly online quizzes and super-easy Excel assignments
Overall easy A
Impossible to understand if you really want to learn Macro. If you want a free A take him though. He is super nice and caring too

Professor Cocchi is very caring about his students, class is super easy. He gives reviews for exams which most of the question will be on the exams. He has quizzes every week that you take at home they are super easy, and you have two attempts. I will totally recommend this professor and especially if it's a requirement.

His accent is on the heavier side but you get used to it. People say you don't learn anything, but obv you won't from quizlet answers. If you actually pay attention to the questions some are basic common sense. The ones you don't understand he explains them. If you go to his office hours he will help you the best he can, like on the ExCr he gives.
I pay a lot of money to attend TCU.  While this professor is an easy A, you don't learn anything.  If you only want a grade then take him.  If you want to learn take someone else.

Professor Cocchi is an absolute dawg. He is a sweet older man who clearly has a strong passion for what he is teaching. All of the quizzes are online and the test questions come from the Quizzes. If you dont perform well he will work with you and make sure you get an A. You are doing yourself a disservice if you do not take this class for a easy A
Speaks gibberish. Participation not mandatory. Easy A.

Hard to understand a single word that he says but he is a great guy that tries to make the class enjoyable. Quizzes online at home with 2 attempts which are very easy. Tests are in person and around 75 percent of the quiz questions are on the test. Grading scale is Test 1 = 20% Test 2 = 20% Quizzes = 20% Final = 40%. Final is worth a lot so study.
Hard to understand but such a nice guy. Also such an easy class. 100% recommend

TAKE THIS CLASS!!! You will not understand a word he says but he is the easiest professor at TCU. Quizzes are all online with 2 attempts. No other homework. Exams are very straight forward. This class is test heavy but they are so easy that it doesn't even matter. Would not recommend if you want to learn Macroeconomics. Easiest A of my life though!

Professor Cocchi's Econ class is excellent for an easy A. I don't recommend him if you want to learn about macroeconomics. He has a thick accent, making it difficult to understand him. There is no homework other than take-home quizzes with multiple attempts, and all of the answers can be found online. Test are not difficult.

I haven't understood a single word he has said the whole semester because of his strong accent & no one learns anything. However, the class is so easy as the quizzes are at home and the tests are exactly the study guide. If you are just taking this class for general education it is perfect. But, I wouldn't recommend for business and econ majors.

He really likes macroeconomics which is why sometimes he looses track of time and lets us out a bit over the time, but he cares about his students. All quizzes are online and the exams are in class and on paper but they're basically the quizzes combined, but he also gives a review about a week before. There's also extra credit assignments.

A good professor, but takes a long time to get through the lectures. He's spent the entire lesson on three slides before. No assignments, but quizzes once a week, two tests, and one final. Tests are super easy, just a recap from the quizzes. Don't need to buy the book, pdf version is free. 
Very nice, just slow lectures.

I'll admit at the start I was a bit frustrated as his lectures can be a bit hard to understand if you don't have great ears and aren't paying full attention, but Prof Cocchi is really a caring guy who seems to love what he teaches. Quizzes are super easy and the exams are literally just the questions straight out of the quizzes. He's a chill guy

I'm taking macroeconomics with Professor Cocchi right now. We have online quizzes once a week that are pretty easy. His lectures are pretty short and his presentation are all online. There are only two exams and one final. He wants you to do well so there are extra credit opportunities to raise your grade. Overall I would recommend this class.

I took him for macro this spring and he was awesome. There is usually a quiz once a week but it's online at home and all the answers are on quizlet. He has a super strong Argentinian accent which makes it difficult to understand him but he still tries to make class fun and enjoyable. He has two tests and a final but all questions come from quizzes.

New to TCU this year. Easy class but do not really learn much. Quizzes are online and tests are similar to the quizzes. Gives a review sheet before tests. Does not take attendance and lectures are a bit boring. Sometimes difficult to understand because of his accent. Overall, really nice and caring.
Yeah hes actually the goat, he goes to baylor tho rip. Honestly come to class once a week, take attendance quiz, do the monthly assignment and your chilling.
He is the best teacher for Sociology hands down. He does grade kinda hard on the writing assignments so make sure to do them well but other than that the class is a piece of cake.
Easy class, no exams and only a few easy assignments. Attendance is taken.
Easiest A ever take this class and you will thank me later!!!!!!!
This class is an easy credit! Only like 4 papers and one exam at the end. He isn't really clear on grading and feedback for papers, but the papers are easy, nevertheless.
TAKE THIS CLASS FOR AN EASY A!! He is so sweet and makes sure the work is manageable. Lectures can be boring, but NO test, and it's an overall easy class!

Mr. Yang is easygoing and assigns no homework. He doesn't like tests so the only test he gives is the final exam simply because the school requires him to. Don't buy the textbook, he gives it to you online. Easy class and I didn't do any work other than the 3 essays he has assigned throughout the semester that take an hour MAX to complete.

Super nice and lectures usually end 20ish minutes early - he aims to take 1hour not the full 1hour 20. 
All you have to do is write 4 papers which are all due 1month apart so low workload. Lets us take the final wherever we want. Gives extra credit a lot, and attendance only taken once a week.

easiest A, 4 papers in total and no test except for final exam where he goes over all the questions with you. Attendance was only mandatory 1 a week out of the 2 days of class. goes over everything in class. no homework besides the 3 papers which are all the exact same outline. a very easy chill class.

Easiest class I've ever taken. Talked about important material and ended class early every day. Only had 4 papers to write (very short and easy) the entire semester and that was the whole grade. Final is open note and he shows you the questions. Attendance was only mandatory one of the two days of the week.

His classes are boring but they are very easy to fallow along. There are not exams only three papers plus the final paper. He takes attendance based off of a quiz at the end of each lecture but he goes over the quiz answers before you submit them.

I almost crashed out every night trying to sit through this lecture. He just yaps for three hours. I can not stand it. He goes on and on and on and its just irrelevant stuff. You could easily have made this class 45 minutes MAYBE even shorter. Its an easy A if you can bear sitting through the most boring lecture ever known to man.

I loved taking professor Yang's class. He had a hard time speaking at first, but after that he was awesome. There aren't many assignments and most of the class is open conversation. I felt I learned quiet a bit about sociology as well!
Genuinely sweetest person ever - I think she may be done teaching, but if you get an opportunity to take her class do it. She's amazing & we love her.

Hanna is the best! She is the sweetest and most caring professor. The class is project-heavy, and the instructions are sometimes unclear. She tries to make the classes pretty interesting and will include activities. If you put the work in, you will get an A.
She is so great! I learned a lot and the homework was spaced out nicely. there are 4 reading response papers and 4 project papers throughout the whole semester. just a really great and easy class
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mrs Sanders is honestly my favorite professor ive had so far. She is so understanding and really cares about her students. The assignments were really fun and you have a lot of flexibility with them. She will 100% work with you and help you achieve the grade you want. She also responds to emails super quick and is always direct to the point.

She is awesome. So kind, caring and understanding. She has the millennial humor which is so funny. All assignments are easy 100's as long as you follow the rubric and aren't stupid. You can miss like 10 class periods and it won't count against you.
She is so nice, take her! 100's on every essay and fun in class activities.

I loved professor rogers she genuinley cares about her students and is super accessible outside of class. I got a C, but I have struggled with math my whole life, so if you are even halfway decent at math take her. Review is direct, 5 question exams, drops lowest. 1-2 question quizzes, drops 1 out of 4. LOVE HER

I took Elementary Stats with Professor Rogers, and she was great! She really wanted to make sure you understood what was going on so don't be afraid to as for help. Theres weekly homeworks assigned Friday due Monday night. Also, theres 3 tests and 3 quizzes, and she'll drop your lowest score for each.
She is a very caring professor, but her class is difficult she moves really fast and she does wait for students to catch up sometimes but it's very hard to actually learn the concepts.

She is very caring and always reinforcing her office hours to her students. To be quite honest though, she is a bit hard to understand, and she moves at a very fast lecture pace throughout class. She has a few quizzes and tests but some of them will only have 2-5 questions on them, making up most of your grade.

Although she does care a lot and wants her students to succeed, the truly just sucks. 9 AM Monday Wednesday and Friday absolutely suck and her lecture pace is SO FAST. Very hard to understand her and the class is not worth taking at all. Avoid this class it is not easy at all and there is much better professors to take.

Dr. Rogers is an outstanding Professor. She clearly & thoroughly explains calculus problems and wants to help her students understand them fully. 4 Quizzes, 3 Midterms, with the ability to drop one quiz and one midterm grade. Study guides are thorough and reflect what will be on the quizzes and midterms. Gracious on exam points. Highly Recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor is good and knows a lot about the subject. However, the whole class is lectures, which is not ideal for a Calculus class. The homework takes forever and are assigned on Fridays, due on Mondays. The tests are like five questions and make up so much of your grade. This is definitely a tough class, but if you study, you can make an A.

This professor is extremely strict with grading, often to the point where it feels disconnected from the actual learning objectives of the course. Expectations are not always clearly explained, yet points are deducted heavily for small or unclear issues. The course feels more focused on catching mistakes than helping students learn the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Rogers really does care about how you do in the class. I have been able to set up multiple meetings with her to help explain content, she really does make time for her students. It is a hard class in general, but that depends on how well you are at math. I worked really hard, and being bad at math I got a C.
Great class because the information is explained really well. She is available to help you outside of class and wants you to succeed. As long as you study a bit, you will be fine.

Good professor who explains concepts well. HW is on Pearson and is assigned weekly on Friday's. Some of the HW assignments will take 90+ minutes to complete if you actually do them. 4 quizzes and 3 midterms, she drops the lowest one of each. Overall fairly easy for a calc class as well.
Amazing teacher! She gives you so many opprotunities to do good. There is alot of homework but in the end it helps your grade sooo much. Also she drops your worse midterm and that helps alot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor explained concepts clearly, was always willing to help, and made the subject easier to understand. Her passion for teaching really shows, and she cared about their students' success. I'm very grateful to have taken her class!

Professor Rogers is one of the best math professors I've ever had.  She explains complex topics clearly and is always willing to help students understand the material.  Her passion for teaching really shows, and I've learned so much in her class.

Had her for Elem Stats. Lectures are VERY DULL and she's monotone. She very upfront and hard to explain but she is smart. If you dont understand you will Definitely need to attend office hours. She's bad responding at email after the first 2 weeks. Final is full review so pay attention.

TAKE HER!!! You must go to class but it is super helpful. The study guides are super similar to the tests and she is really clear on what you need to get done. She likes it when you ask for help. I am pretty bad at math but did well in her class.

Took her for applied pre-calculus/calculus. Has quizzes during last 10 mins of class every other week, multiple midterms, and a cumulative final (all paper). Provides study sets similar to the exams. Online hw. May be easy to get lost if you are not good with math, but she is very willing to help. Encourages us to ask questions.
She cares about her students success. Her homework and lectures match the tests really well. Homework is on Pearson and is usually pretty short.
all the lecture notes are posted online, only homework is on Pearson questions, gives study guides that are the same problem types that will be seen on the tests.
Quizzes and exams were fine, you can do well just by reviewing the slides. Lecture content is not much, but there was an immense amount of homework just for an lower-undergraduate level class.

One of the smartest people at TCU. He is excellent and can answer any questions you have about the content. The classwork is challenging but it is helpful to review class notes (which are posted) or the textbook. Weekly quizzes that are very helpful for test preparation. Tests are majority of grade (2 midterms worth ~20% each and the final is 35%).

Beware at the beginning of the course you might have a hard time understanding him with his accent but after the first few weeks, you get an ear for it. He is super nice and if you genuinely put effort into his class you will get a good grade.

I went into the course hearing about how kind this professor is and how great his courses are, but I experienced the complete opposite. I struggled with the tests, and when I went for help (after the very first test), I was told that I should've already known how to do everything and to "do better next time." I think that says a lot. NOT RECOMMEND!

This was the hardest math course I have taken (above calc 1,2,3), but it was made manageable by Dr. Igor's lectures and decent pace. The class can feel foreign at times but doing the homework diligently and going to class is necessary. Tests and quiz are simple compared to the homework. Dr. Igor is a wonderful professor who is passionate and funny.

Simple mistakes are not tolerated. I urge you to pace yourself & carefully scan for errors as he will take off pts. He still cares about his students & his teaching is very straightforward, so half of the battle is being perfect. He gave me an A despite barely getting a 90 for the final + class average instead of an A-. Truly a wonderful professor.
Dr. Igor is really funny, and a nice guy, but man is he a tough grader. Get ready for absolutely 0 partial credit and no extra credit. The only thing that will save you is studying really hard
Dr. Igor is great to have and he is very knowledgeable about what he teaches. This class was challenging but simple thanks to how predictable his teaching style is.

nicest professor ever. he's so prepared and so organized with his notes. he's open and accessible if you need help. so smart. a kind and funny professor. calc 2 is hard but he makes it easier to understand. this class does require a lot of effort to do well but you can do it! take Igor!!
Dr. Igor is great! He is always willing to meet with you outside class time. Be ready to work, though, because there's a lot of homework.

Professor Igor is very hilarious. His lectures are very thorough with concepts and examples. If you don't get any part of the materials, just ask him - he is willing to help you. He also has nice handwriting too. You have to study a little for quizzes and exams, but they are all based on homework and lecture notes. Very recommend taking him :)

Dr. Igor is super nice and funny. He has a thick Russian accent and he enjoys making Russia comparisons. Homework is due once or twice a week. The tests and homework are exactly like example problems in class, so in my experience if you show up and pay attention, you'll learn everything you need for an A.

Dr. Igor was an amazing teacher for Calc 2. He's clear in his lectures, gives simple expectations with the homework, and the tests are easy to anticipate. If you don't do the homework, you won't pass. Plus, he has some great math jokes!
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I really like igor! the best math professor at TCU

The material he teaches is challenging, but he is very knowledgeable about it and is willing to help if you go to his office hours. Also, he has incredibility neat handwriting and his accent shouldn't affect your ability to understand him. If he is ever teaching a course you need, take him!

I really loved Igor as a professor. He was incredibly helpful, and he's super passionate about math. Sometimes he's not very clear when lecturing. The homework is harder than the tests. Every time there is homework due, there is a quiz. He doesn't make it easy, but he is always there to help you.

I'm currently taking Dr. Igor for Calc II, and it's a pretty challenging course. However, Dr. Igor is a really great professor and tries very hard to make concepts simple and help students understand. He's Russian and has a pretty thick accent, but you get used to it. I'm taking him again next semester for DiffEQ.

Absolutely love Igor! He is so passionate about what he does in a funnydorky way. 3 exams, homework and a final. His homework isn't too bad, minus some proofs here and there but you can go ask for help during his office hours. He doesn't try to trick you on exams and he gives you a study guide and offers a study session too. Take him if you can!

You don't need the textbook because the pdf can be found online, but you do need some form of the textbook.  Now to Igor, he may be one of my favorite teachers of all time.  And everyone feels this way. Everyone loves Igor and Igor loves math and that's the best combination you can have. Take him if you ever get the chance to, no question about it
Very hard grader, hard to understand what he says. Easy to fall asleep in his class
Goes over many examples in class. Tests are easy and straightforward-they are designed to asses understanding, not to make you fail. Gives keys and goes over homework/quizzes in class.

Great teacher. Very dedicated to his art and is extremely helpful. Always available in his office. Wants you to succeed. Exams are straightforward, slightly challenging. Keep up in class and you will do fine. I would recommend him and I am taking him again. Final exam above 95 gives you an A in the class.

This is one of the best professors I hv seen in TCU. His exams are not hard. All the exams problems are HW type. If u go to every class & do ur HW you can make an A. Don't ever skip his class. He made course look much more easier. He gives lot ways to make up ur grade, extra credit, grade replacements. You gotta take this guy.

This man is goofy and pretty funny.  He is russian and his accent takes a little time to get used to, but it makes you pay attention to understand him which is good.  not ridiculously hard and bery helpful.  i enjoyed Dr. Igor a lot! had him for both calc 1 and diff eq he teaches diff eq the best its his fav class!

Took him for Diff. Eq. and he explains it well. Once you get over his thick russian accent, it becomes more clear. Tests aren't hard, but HW is graded extremely hard. Had a 95 test avg. but HW brought me down to a B.

A lot of homework, harshly graded (depends on TA, I got a harsh one). Igor explains well and is pretty funny. Makes fun of Dr. Addis! hah... Tests aren't bad although I did not like how he handled homework. He wouldn't fully explain homework problems in class, especially the hard ones (you can ask him in his office hours tho).

Igor is a good guy, he really cares that you learn the material. In the classes where the material is more abstract, it gets irritating when he fumbles over his words. He's helpful in office hours and exams are very similar to HW sets. He covers a lot of material in his classes so there's a lot to retain for the cumulative finals.
Not looking forward to this class at all, but he explains everything really well. He is picky when grading.  Lots of homework but the tests aren't bad at all if you study.
Great Teacher! I highly recomend taking him if possible.  Very helpful, and a great teacher.  Awsome sence of humor, keep the stories comming Igor!
Dr. Igor gives explains stuff really well.  He is almost always in there to help you.  His courses are a lot of work, though, and tests are usually hard. Classes--diffeq,applied1,real1,real2
Dr. Igor explains things very well and is always available for helf.  Tests are hard, though.
easy class if you go all the time he randomly quizzes and dosent accept late homework but he explains everything
This is a hard class. However, we like igor. His accent rocks. He is one of the better math professors available at TCU. However, in courses higher than diff eq he gets rough.
Very good teacher, but has a thick russian accent. He's also funny so has a good sense of humor.
Professor is very sweet, but very unorganized. Gives a lot of last minute assignments, but easy grader. Accepts late work.

She is VERY sweet but even more unorganized. Assignment heavy in the beginning but eased up at the end. She doesnt grade anything until finals week which is hard cause you dont know where you stand in the class- however she grades easy. She's very lenient with late work and has a good amount of easy filler assignments. Didnt learn much but got an A
Senora Mozuliova is wonderful. She is very caring and nice. Her class is very easy, and you actually learn Spanish with her. Take her Personal to Public class, she is a great teacher!

She's a sweet lady and the class is super easy. I did P/NC because I had bigger fish this semester and there's a lot of busy work I didn't want to do. I did nothing the whole semester and have an 80. Expectations occasionally unclear. There are last minute changes to homework (even hours before class) that you're expected to accommodate.

She was a great professor, encouraged participation, and played a lot of Kahoot. Multiple small homework assignments due every week, and only a few exams.  It's easy to get an A in this class if you keep up with the homework.  Attendance is graded but she is forgiving.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: OK - Mixed emotions - Her lectures are EVERYWHERE and her instructions are super unclear. She's a kind person but not a great teacher. It's easy to get a good grade, but is just an awkward class. She didn't even have a syllabus, so it was hard to know exactly what was coming next.

Professor Mozuliova is SO SWEET but the class is really unorganized. No syllabus which makes it difficult to stay on top of assignments. There are a fair amount of assignments, but due dates are pretty flexible because they aren't organized. Assignments also aren't graded quickly but it is an easy course. Had her for SPAN30503 which wasn't listed.

Irene is a great Spanish professor. She cares about her students and will make time to meet with you outside of class. Most of her classes consist of small lectures or busy work and she will always explain the answers during class. English isn't her first language, so sometimes her explanations are unclear, but nothing you can't figure out.
She's super easy if you just do your homework and pay attention in class, but there are tons of handouts and her flow of teaching isn't that great.

I absolutely adored her in Intermediate Spanish II, she was very kind and wanted everyone to succeed. I really struggle in spanish and she really helped me talk better in spanish. Her class isn't too work heavy, I considered it normal for the level we are at. She is a fantastic teacher and you should definitely take her if you get the chance!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: While she is extremely nice and caring, I struggle to enjoy this class. Class consists of lectures and group conversations/work, and homework is mostly compositions and prep for conversations in the next class. I feel bad for leaving this review because she is so nice, but she has only graded TWO assignments and it is November

Sweetest person ever. Easy to get an A, but department requires 94%. Exams and quizzes are easy, oral exam is not a big deal, and she makes sure everyone is up to speed before tests. Homework is on VHL but never a ton. Small classes and she will make everyone participate, but it is not a big deal. Lots of kahoots.

Irina is literally the sweetest person alive & she makes class very easy. She is a great listener and helps her students when they are struggling. This course requires an online textbook & VHL is where most assignments are to completed. There are lots of little quizzes but they are not hard. Participation is not mandatory but going to class helps.
Very easy class if you pay attention. Her lectures can be boring but they are bearable. She wants you learn and asks questions.

Fairly easy Spanish class but she's lowkey rlly strange (not even in a bad way). There's a quiz almost every class so u gotta show up. Honestly, I'm pretty bad at Spanish but I've been putting in minimal effort and have an A. She over explains everything, so as long as you sorta pay attention you'll be fine. Would def recommend!
Great teacher. Always there to help her students. Ask her for help during office hours if you have questions!

She is really nice but honestly her lectures can be very boring. She is not the best at explaining things. If I had not already taken this class in high school, I probably wouldn't have done nearly as good. Her class was fine, it was just super boring, so I didn't want to show up.

Mozuliova is a great professor. She is very kind, caring, funny and her lectures are easy to sit through. She offers the textbook and SuperSite to her students to get a better understanding of Spanish. There are lots of quizzes but only 3 exams. She drops your lowest grades as well. I would highly recommend her for beginner spanish!

Professor Hobbs is so sweet! This class is not hard at all, but there's lots of vocab to memorize which makes sense for a language class. There were some pop quizzes, but they were never hard. Just participate and you'll do fine.

Wait until class to get the book, she provided a link to a cheaper book. She covers some sections of online homework in class so it pays to stay up to date on all the online work. There is no reason you should fail this class unless you genuinely don't try at all. She is very lenient during the oral exam. Be prepared to participate during class.

I took Advanced Spanish Local Global. The class wasn't very hard, but it also wasn't very interesting. I would check my email most of class time tbh. The only way I learned was from writing the essays (4 total) and doing preparation for the oral presentations (3 total, all pretty easy). Idk how much I learned, but I respect her a lot. Nice lady.

Professor Hobbs was the best Spanish professor I have had. I took the intensive, 8-week class with her. Showing up to class is necessary to do well, but no attendance was taken to my knowledge. Tests are written by the Spanish department, not her so they can be difficult. There were 3 major tests, an oral exam, and weekly (but easy) assignments.

Material is tough (linguistics), but prof hobbs makes it much easier to understand. She is really good at working with both very fluent speakers as well as non-fluent, so don't be worried if your Spanish isn't great. She really cares about her students, so get to know her! Listen in class and take notes on her practices and exams will be easy.

Prof. Hobbs is the sweetest! I absolutely love & adore her. She makes Spanish really easy and is super helpful in helping you learn it. She talks in both English & Spanish (mostly Spanish, but will translate to English if you don't understand her). The class is participation heavy but Prof. Hobbs will guide you to the right answers. TAKE HER CLASS!

Hobbs is an amazing Spanish professor. She makes connections with each of her students and is there to offer help whenever you need it. Her class actually helps you learn how to speak the language, not just memorizing vocab. One of the best Spanish profs to take.
Tests are exactly like the reviews given the class before. "Tarea in Clase" are often given for attendance, and count the same as a quiz grade.

Dr. Hobbs is super helpful as a Spanish Professor. The whole class is in Spanish, but she will help you if you get stuck. She is clear on what will be on the tests, and if you know the study guide well, you will do fine. She is always at her office hours ready to help, and she will answer your emails as best as possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Ms. Hobbs was a very nice and easy teacher. I definitely learned a lot of Spanish, and she would never get upset. Her tests and quizzes were fairly easy if you have a basic understanding of Spanish. I would recommend her for sure.

I had Professor Hobbs for Spanish Linguistics and she can be a little all over the place at times but she is so sweet and a really good teacher! She is always willing to specify confusing areas and if you go to class and take notes and study even a little bit, an A is totally doable.
Señora Hobbs is SUPER sweet! Her class can be a little tough even if you've had Spanish experience in the past. The tests are a bit challenging but you can make it up through homework or online work.
She just isn't that great of a teacher and her tests are pretty hard for a basic level spanish class
Tests are pretty tough, and there are lots of assignments for homework.
She's a fine teacher, doesn't give extra credit and is kind of boring

Easiest A ever. I agree that if you have never had Spanish before you will have to work extra hard because she moves quickly. (Tip for mini essays, just ask her to look over it and she gives you the corrections needed)

Dr. Hobbs is a really nice lady who knows Spanish.  She is always down to help during her office hours.  Take advantage of them.  It is a beginner's class, but ALL Spanish ALL the time is not practical.  Material is easy, quizzes are kinda hard, exams are TOUGH and mostly all of that is because she grades with no mercy.  Take her class seriously!

Span 10203: Great teacher and class! As long as you do your homework, pay attention and study, it isn't hard to make an A. She speaks in Spanish most of the class, but it’s easy to understand her. As long as you study the concepts on the review, the tests aren't very hard either. Loved both her and the class!

I was extremely excited to learn Spanish when I signed up for this class. I do not feel like I learned all that much and did not feel encouraged to keep learning. She is extremely nice just not the best Spanish teacher. I struggled understanding what she was going to expect us to know on a test. Overall very sweet, not the best teacher.

Class 10203: Great professor! Kept the class interesting and used the book regularly in class. You really do have to work outside of class though, but it's not too bad and she makes and effort to be as helpful in class in speaking as little english as possible - but don't let that scare you! It makes it easier, and she explains when she needs to.

Her Writing in Spanish Class was super easy. We wrote small essay everyother week about what our favorite animal was, making pretend reservations at hotels, etc. She's really scatter-brained with her lectures, but if you figure out what she wants, it's a super easy class. I didn't learn that much though...

Loved her! Uses textbook during every class.  Use book to study! I usually only studied the day before and day of test and made B's. Was annoyed at beginning of semester because she spoke Spanish all the time and it was a beginners course, but I realized it was actually helpful.

This professor was terrible! She hardly had any idea what day it was or even the time ever!! Dont even bother asking her how to prepare for a test.. all she says is, " I dont write the tests so, I don't know!" You will be teaching yourself Spanish which is not easy!! Avoid unless you are naturally linguistic
This class was so freaking easy! i showed up for class like 1 a week and it was ridiculously easy... take this class!! easy A.

Overall she is a nice person, but a terrible teacher. Lectures are boring, and she expects you to understand even if you don't. Quizzes and tests are graded very hard, and there is no make-up even if you were sick. There was a lot of busy work that did not help and overall as a student I didn't grow.

She is fabulous. She can be a little spacey. but she is great. She doesn't take attendance, but notices if you miss a lot of class. She will bump your grade up if you didnt miss class a lot. She announces quizzes and prepares you for tests.
Spends a LOT of time on conversing. Quizzes are very straightforward and easy. Basically, if you listen in class and do the work (minimal), you won't have a hard time.

SPAN 20103. Very nice & helpful. Tests are somewhat difficult, but she gives vocab & verb quizzes prior to test, which can really help your avg. Daily homework, but doesnt check them (as w/ every Span class). Exempts from final for 92+ avg. No Span class is easy, I worked hard, had an A prior to the final & got exempt.

NICE, doesn't cut it with your grade! she is unbelievable when she grades. its frustrating especially when you work your butt off and she doesn't care. don't take this class there are better spanish teachers out there who will take it into consideration of your hard work and make time for you outside of class. she's always late and busy
she's nice but doesn't know what she's doing or how to teach. dont take this class

I would not take this class. She does not know how to teach and that becomes very frustrating. She grades you off for all the little things, it's not just 2 pts but 5  off. She comes in late a lot and is very unorganized. she doesn't know what she is doing and she will teach new things when she doesn't have time left in class even b/4 final deff no

She is a horrible teacher she always runs in late and she is behind . she is very unorganized and she grades very hard. i would not recommend her for a spanish teacher. She assigns a lot of home work and never picks it up or goes over it,  if she does its very brief and fast because she is so far behind in her lessons. she never has time to for u

Dr. Hobbs is SO nice & very patient with students and I wish that was all I had to say. BUT, she's also so disorganized, a lot of class is busy work and she arrives about 5 minutes late to almost every class, which I think is kind of disrespectful considering how much tuition is these days.

Spanish 3: She's a great teacher. If you don't understand, she's willing to help you. If you do the homework assignments and listen in class, you shouldn't have a problem. I would definately recommend her!

SHE IS SOOO IRRITATING! Even though i got a B the class was sooo confusing. To start she is a great teacher in part. She knows how to talk in espanol in class with you beign able to understand it. This just confuses you because you study hard for the exams and then you think you understand it by what she says in class and then the exams are soooo h
Study vocab and grammar sections in the book for tests.  What she says will be on the test will actually be on there!
Very good teacher!  A little more work that wanted, but homework is definately necessary to learn the language in such a short time.  Very helpful!

Great class!  I'm a major and it comes naturally to me, and it has been a piece of cake.  Just do the readings and listen in class and you should do fine.  For compositions she highlights the errors and lets you correct them for points.  She is also one of the most warm, kind people I have ever met in my life.  You should definitely give her a try.

If you are taking this class...SHOOT YOURSELF... not really... but seriously she sucks. Her tests are rigged 75% of the class failed every quiz, and she just moved on as if everyone passed with ease. She doesn't care she just wants to get throught the book. Also don't sit on the front row... SHE SPITS.
this class sucked. shes not very nice and doesnt care about you or your grade... so if you care to learn ANY spanish dont take her.

Not a very difficult class if you're good at Spanish.  If you find the subject difficult, you can get lost easily.  She speaks in Spanish 90% of the time, even when defining a Spanish word, which can make things really confusing.  She's a really easy grader, though, so turn in as much as possible.  Oh, and don't take it at 8 in the morning.

This class was extremely boring! Completely unnecessary to attend since you need to teach yourself everything out of the book anyway! If you had taken Spanish in high school it wasn't too bad, but by far the most boring class!
She is really nice and friendly, but won't budge on some things. This is not an easy class, but also not very hard. Go to class and study a lot on your own and you will at least get a B.

She is such a sweetie! She makes class SORT OF fun...she doesn't make 50 minutes feel like 3 hours. Her tests are sort of frequent and random, but they are never overly hard and she gives you ample opportunity to practice what is on the test. Go to class and you'll be fine. You will enjoy her!
Nice professor and definately an extrovert. Found the class a little harder than I expected- I had 4yrs. of high school spanish and still found her class tricky. Not an easy A.

do NOT take her for spanish 1.  She teaches you nothing. Everything I learned in spanish 1 came from the textbook.  She showed up for our final exam 20 minutes late and consistantly would be unorganized and un-prepared for class.

She is SUPER nice, but so disorganized! Unfortunately the class was part online, and she was terrible about posting assignments in a timely manner. Lots of worthless busy work to do. Like I said, she's nice, but I don't recommend her as a teacher for this class!

I was okay until about the 3rd chapter, then everything went down hill. She worked out of the book in class. It would have helped if she gave homework out of the book consistently everyday. If I had more chances to practice it I would have done better, but there wasn't anything else to practice.
This is an intro class.  She should not be able to not cover 8 pages in a chapter and put the information on the test.  You are supposed to teach!
She is a very nice prof. Her first test was kinda rough, but the others weren't that bad.  HW and quizes are worth a lot, so go to class. If you study, you'll do well.  If not, you might still pass.
she is super nice but just didn't connect with her as far as learning. still passed though!
She's a great person but kind of a hard teacher, and I speak spanish, so yeah.  She won't budge on some things, but she's really nice overall.
I didn't enjoy this class at all and I love spanish. Homework grades bring you down. I've always gotten A's in span and can't seem to get above a B on anything in here.  Do not recommend
She's a great person and a great teacher!  At first her tests seem kinda long because you have to write a paragraph, but she gives you the paragraph beforehand (its in the notes).
Easiest A of my life

I had her for spanish one and now i am preparing to take her for spanish 4--i wish i could have taken her for two and three!  spanish one was like kindergarten en espanol.  SHE IS A SUPER NICE PERSON!
She is probably the best Spanish professor I've had in a very long time. She understands that students are still learning and doesn't assume we are fluent.:)
She is the best Spanish teacher that I have had so far at TCU.  She is really nice and encouraging.  Take her.
No Comments

Dr. Ireland is incredibly caring, fun, and intelligent. Ive never seen a professor put so much effort into lectures and the job in general. Attendence is mandatory and you will have to put a lot of time into the language if you wish to actually speak it. If you just want the credit than he is rather leniant with grades so long as you participate.

I LOVED DR. IRELAND!!! The sweetest professor ever, and I feel like I could talk to him about literally anything! It is clear that he actually cares about each of his students. He reaches out to you directly, which is so kind. I took this as a freshman and benefitted a ton from it! Helps with scheduling, internships, LinkedIn, etc.!!
Such a happy and caring professor. Really recommend his class!

ABSOLUTE MASTERCLASS of a professor and human being. Dr. Ireland is the most intelligent, caring, and passionate professors I've had in my 4 years at TCU. Definitely worth the 80K tuition just to have taken a class from him. His seminar changed my perspectives in life. Forever grateful for his teaching, genuine love for students and our learning.

I have him for Japanese and it is by far my favorite class. Japanese is a hard language to learn but he makes it interesting and engaging. Tough grader but there is so much you can do for extra credit and the tests don't count that much towards your final grade. TAKE THIS CLASS!!!

Ireland is AMAZING, I have never learned so much French and genuinely enjoyed his class. As long as you go to class, participate, and do your homework you will get a good grade. He has a lot of opportunities for extra credit so if you don't do great on quizzes or tests, you'll be ok. You will be required to participate though!!

I absolutely loved Dr. Ireland. He was a caring teacher who genuinely wanted everyone to do well in class. He gives so many extra credit opportunities, especially in class with fun games and things. I highly recommend him as a teacher, I wish I could take this class with him again.

Dr. Ireland is an excellent French teacher! He teaches concepts in understandable ways, is engaging in class, and is very open with providing extra credit to help your grade. The class is semi-difficult, but that is more a product of a thorough coverage of content than it is any grading or instructor choice. Study hard and you will get an A.

Dr. Ireland is amazing! He is extremely helpful during office hours, so take advantage of the advice/insight he offers when you are writing papers. Definitely not an easy A, but if you put in the work, come to class and participate, you will do well. Also, Dr. Ireland is really understanding so don't be afraid to reach out when you need help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Ireland is truly one of the most caring professors at TCU. He is an amazing professor who makes you work to learn French but also wants it to be as great of an experience for his students as possible. There is a lot of homework which I HIGHLY recommend doing, and tests/quizzes aren't easy unless you study, but he is available outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Ireland cares so much for his students and always takes the time to help! His classes are difficult, but are well worth the time and effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Ireland really cares about his students and genuinely wants to see them succeed. Learned more in his course than any other French course. The papers were distributed throughout the semester and the class was never overwhelmed with the work load. You are allowed rewrites and he is always willing to help.
The greatest teacher I've had in my academic career (for a multitude of reasons). If anyone says something bad about this man, be highly skeptical. Would recommend 100%.

You will learn an insane amount of French in one semester. The homework is good practice and he sends out practice quizzes/tests as study material, makes the grammar understandable, and is generous with extra credit. Professor Ireland is an amazingly passionate, caring, and intelligent individual with a heart of gold and a gift for teaching .

If you ever have the chance to take one of his classes, PLEASE do so!!!!! Whether you are a beginner or are working to become fluent, he wants to ensure you improve and enjoy French. He makes his lectures tangible, hilarious, and gets down to the nitty gritty grammar. Just make sure to put in time outside of class. I'm sad to be leaving this class.

Dr. Ireland is among the best that TCU has to offer. He is young, enthusiastic, and really understands French and how to teach it. I entered this class not knowing a single word of French, and left confident I was prepared for French II. If you are going to take French at TCU, you have to take Ireland. He is everything a professor should be.
Very amazing professor! Easy to talk with and very understanding! Work with him and he will work with you!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Assigns weekly coding labs that don't have a clear grading criteria so be prepared to lose points for things not in the instructions. Kind of hard to work with and doesn't follow up with his plan from time to time. Lectures are flown through. majority of learning comes out side of class. Not the worst intro professor here at TCU

If you don't have any experience using Java, this class will likely be difficult for you. If you read the textbook, practice coding regularly, reach out to Professor Ipser and attend office hours, you'll do much better. His classes were not very stimulating for me because I didn't understand much, and he went quickly. He's a really nice guy though.

Daily quizzes, kinda hard but just read the textbook you'll be fine. don't like the lectures but you should probably have some java experience anyway you won't really need his lecture. the textbook is super helpful too. He's easy to reach outside of class and really understanding- gave me a few extensions and gave a test retake to raise grades.

Mr. Ipser is a great guy but since 2024 Fall was his semester year teaching, he relied heavily on rushing through slides for our CS lectures. You only really learned if you read through the online textbook, or if you asked him specific questions. Labs are 40% of our grade, and if you participate in the daily quizzes for attendance, you'll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Ipser is a very nice guy, very helpful if you reach out to him. He is willing to do zoom calls any time you need help. Quizzes every class but they are just for attendance and actually really helpful. I was a beginner in programming, and I found the course a little challenging at first but he is willing to help which made it easier for me

You have quiz everyday but don't worry it's just a way for him to take attendance. There's coding assignment every week which can be challenging but you will realize you can do so much. If you don't get a good grade on the exam, you can do a bonus that can up your grade to 30 points. Definitely a good prof for such a foundational course.
Dr. Iddrisu is awesome! He gives good feedback and posts rubrics that are very clear about the expectations. I would definitely take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I have created this account to make this review because Dr. Iddrisu's class is fantastic. In his Writing as an Inquiry class, we had 4 projects all semester, and he was available to help all students whenever necessary. Very passionate about his work and his students. Highly recommend!

Great professor, great class, and great discussions. Professor Iddrisu was always there to help and the content was very informative and interesting.  He cares about his students and provides great feedback!

I absolutely loved this class. Dr. Iddrisu is the kindest caring teacher who really loves his students. Never scored below a 90 on the papers and he made sure all of his students are happy and successful in his class. I am taking him again next semester because of how much I loved his teaching method!
She's nice but there is so much unnecessary information unfortunately. Just go to class and study, you'll be fine .
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I am not an econ person at all, but I really enjoyed her class. Always wants to help and is accessible outside of class and is very kind. Just go to class and pay attention and you will be set for the homework and exams. Homework was once a week on none exam weeks and the final exam had a cheat sheet. The class was lecture heavy, but not too bad
Very reasonable teacher. easy to do well with minimal effort. Wish i could take her for macro too. Final exam has a cheat sheet. Super quick emailer and always wants to help you
Very nice and kind
She is a great professor; as long as you attend class and pay attention, you will receive a good grade. All the questions in the exam are related to the slides; the final has a cheat sheet.

She is new here, but great lectures. homeworks once a week and none during the exam weeks. she also got you learning curves to study for the exam which are very helpful. exams are not too hard and lock down browser, just go to the class, pay attention to it, do the hws and you're all set!

If you need to take micro I'd definitely take her, she's a great teacher. She is so caring and just genuinely wants you to succeed. Theres an achieve assignment every week but its not that bad and she drops the lowest one, but if you need help with it she always answers emails. 3 midterms that are very straightforward to what she lectures on!

Accessible outside of class but that's really the only good thing. Basically have to learn everything yourself because he speeds through the material in class. Doesn't really help you when you need help too, really short with you. You're better off taking someone else because I have to retake this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Class is hard, but Ingram is the best professor to take. He gives lots of homework (not graded). There are 6 exams throughout the year, each with 4 questions directly from the homework. Attendance isn't required, but helpful. He's not great at explaining, so definitely have to figure stuff out on your own. You can also get out of the final exam.

He does not teach the course whatsoever. You are expected to fully teach yourself 15 physics units in one semester and there is a cumulative final. The only nice thing I have to say is that he is always available by email to answer questions. However, he is short with you and is not helpful whatsoever when answering.

Do not take a class with him if you have anything else somewhat going on in your life. Class consumes your life. Makes you study 60 essay questions every test only to ask you 8 of them on the actual test. His grading style is EXTREMELY picky as well.

Take a different professor. The class is only exams and there are 7 of them and it's luck of the draw for how hard your exam is as there are different versions. He doesn't teach and just expects you to know everything when you show up to class and he flies through the problems in class. He makes you feel stupid for asking questions in office hours

He grades the class entirely by a few exams and your lab average (which is counted as only slightly more than an exam grade) and there are no other grades than those. The exams are only 8 questions each and his grading is pretty subjective, but the questions are word for word from the practice questions if you can memorize hundreds of problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This guy is AWESOME!!! He doesn't give graded homework but does give tons of practice problems for you to do outside of class. The problems are harder than the test so if you do lol the homework you will know exactly what to do on the exams. The class is graded on,y by exams so keep that in mind!

He immediately began the class with little to no clarification of his expectations.   I failed his first exam, then I got A's on the next 5 but since he didn't have ANY grades other than the tests,  I ended with a B.   I went to his office hours, but he was mean and rude. Boring lectures too and all the work is done outside class. Harsh grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!! Gives 5 quizzes with 8 questions from a 60 MODULE QUESTION. You need to memorize 300 questions throughout the semester, it is horrendous. He is not accessible AT ALL.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Attend the lectures even though attendance is not mandatory it helps on the tests.

I love him. I have learned so much in this class and have actually really enjoyed it. Basically you read the articles or watch a video that he assigns and answer a few questions, then in class he answers those questions and the test is exactly those questions which is just straight memorization. I'm not a science person but I have done great!

Professor Ingram loves to teach astronomy and his sense of humor makes the class more enjoyable. His class consists of several quizzes filled with questions that come straight from the Homework questions. He allows you to ask your questions in lecture regarding the homework and through email. He gives you the tools to succeed from the beginning.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Ingram is an excellent teacher. He gives you homework questions once a week. If you choose to do them on time, you can email him your answers and he will give you feedback to correct your answers. These homework questions are the exact questions on the weekly quizzes so if you do that, you are golden. If you put in the work you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Simple and straight forward professor. He gives out worksheets and homework that are harder than the test. If you keep up with the homework and show up everyday then you will learn everything you need to know. Lectures are problem based and he teaches you how to do the problems instead of teaching about the background that no one cares about.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: DO THE STUDY GUIDES. Ingram has a 50ish question study guides for each of the three exams he gives and he picks out 8 to put on the test. You can email him up to 5 study guide questions per day for him to check or you can go to office hours and he'll check it all at once if its not to busy. Go to lab and do your study guide and you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He wasn't a hard professor but the work that was given for the class was too much to handle. You're given a study guide that consists of 50+ questions, don't wait until the last minute to get the questions checked because you will not pass the test. If you don't like doing work and studying that takes up most of your time, then don't take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Archaeoastronomy grade is 80% Lecture and 20% lab. The test questions are word for word from the test review, but it takes an extremely long time to do the review and get all of the questions checked. For the tests, you just memorize the review. If you can memorize 60 multiple choice Qs easily, then the class will be easy, if not take another class

TAKE HIM! He is the only professor in the department that can teach Physics, believe me. Lectures are inspiring and clear-cut. Tests are just modified version of the homework, though you really need to work to get the grade you want. Barely need textbook. Easy A. He even exempts you from finals if you have at least 96% expected grade.

I loved Dr. Ingram's intro to astronomy so much that I took him again even though I wasn't a physics major. Very engaging. Make sure you do the homework questions because that's what you need to know for the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: No empathy at all. Even after I had two funerals in one week, he was rude and dismissive. Instructions were unclear, and he often grew angry or upset when students asked questions. The class felt disorganized, stressful, and unsupportive from start to finish.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Way too difficult for a religion class. Large assignments but no due dates on D2L, so if you aren't super organized, good luck. Unwilling to work with you to improve grade in any way, and rude if you try, automatically shoots you down and is disrespectful in communication. Difficult tests, boring lectures, just don't take this class. Trust me.
Just don't take this professor. Trust just don't
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Miles is the sweetest, most caring professor I have had in TCU so far. He new everyones name by the third day of class. There is a lot of material but if you pay attention in class, keep up with emails, and study for the exams you will be fine! This is college we should expect classes like this, not just ones that you can use AI.
The exams are way too hard and it's so much material to study. Lectures don't really have what is gonna be in the exam. Besides that the assignment are pretty easy

Professor Miles's use of D2L is awful, and he doesn't tell you when any work is due. If you don't check your emails and the syllabus regularly, then you're not going to do well in the class. There's also so much reading that he ends up going over in class. He's a nice enough guy, but his rubrics and assignment prompts are awful.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The key to being successful in this class is to throw out any bias you have towards a particular religion -- whether you are Christian, Jewish, etc. Start with a clean slate and be ready to take notes b/c 95% of his tests are from his lectures. Also, you'll have to do a site visit -- bring a friend. Visit his office hours and chat with him :)

Avoid Dr. Miles if you can. I came from a strong theology background and still struggled. While he's nice, he's too deep into the subject and doesn't allow for outside-the-box thinking. I spent hours emailing and meeting with him, and it felt like a waste of time. Not worth it. Regret not getting the Dean's office involved. DO NOT TAKE!

He is not as bad as the reviews say. He does lecture and you need to take notes, but, he gives extensive study guides that are just like the exam. Study that and you can get a hundred. Final exam is 25% of grade. Have to do a site visit. Otherwise, go to class, take notes, laugh at his jokes, he is a good professor! I would take again. Not hard.

For a core class, this was one of the most work heavy and difficult grading classes I've had all year. All of the classes are lectures, unless you are doing a group project that day. The lectures tend to be unclear on what is tested, so take really detailed notes because exams cover an insanely large amount of material. Thanks for ruining my GPA!

Lectures - however unclear on what is important vs. rant. Very specific/un-memoizable quiz/exam questions. Lots of group projects, online respondus quizzes and so much reading (lots of textbooks). Doesn't have clear guidelines, posts about HW/assignments, expectations. Very unorganized class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's not as bad as the ratings suggest, but don't expect a blow-off class—you'll need to put in effort. Lectures are clear and engaging, and if you attend, take notes, and stay involved, you'll do fine. He provides study guides and includes lots of group/class activities, so be prepared for that.

So. much. reading.VERY UNORGANIZED, you have to check online and the syllabus and emails he sends to see what is due because one place is likely missing an assignment. Assigns group projects without much class time- assigned a group project over thanksgiving break. I aced all the tests but still got a low A because I missed daily assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's nice but has insane expectations for a subject barely anyone is majoring in. All the quizzes are on respondus and the questions are extremely specific from the bible which you won't be able to refer to at all, so if you don't study you will not pass. The exams are in class and are specific to what was said in the lectures, and he says a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy
