reviews.comment: Her Understanding Religion: Society and Culture class was very manageable, she cares a lot about religion and is so sweet. She loves when you participate and the readings are not heavy and interesting. Please take her! Her midterm and final are kind of hard but the classwork can get full points as long as you do it!

Dr. Quesada is great! The class itself wasn't for me, but that doesn't necessarily have to do with the professor. She is very sweet, an easy grader, and all tests (for my class) were open book and online. She does expect your attention and will call you out in class if you aren't paying attention, but she isn't rude about it. Would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I think that Dr. Quesada was very passionate about the course materials. The tests and quizzes were fairly easy, however there is a lot of reading for a 10000 level course. The subjective variables were graded on the harsher end, but all in all I enjoyed the class alright.

I'm an international student and studied Dr Quesada online. In the beginning I used to struggle a lot because I didn't know the most proficient studying methods but she helped me a lot. She's quick with emails, remember to ALWAYS read and study notes/guides on D2L. Participation matters and talking/ turning on camera in class will make her happy!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I love her! she is seriously so nice and really knows what she's talking about. I had her online and it was kinda annoying when no one would turn on their camera so make sure to turn it on! She really likes when you do. Make sure to do the reading and take notes during class and you'll do just fine on the quizzes and test. I would recommend her!!

Dr. Quesada is so kind and caring. She is a bit quirky but I found that endearing. As long as you do the reading and are respectful to her in class (don't leave or go on your phone she will call you out) you will be just fine. Do the readings and you'll do fine on the exams. She is prompt with getting back to you via email. I would recommend her.

She is the nicest person, and I'm sure I would love her in a different class. I took Interfaith Understanding with her and was not a fan. I loved that the class was primarily discussion, but you were put down if your opinion didn't match up with hers. Might not be the best class for strong willed people. She does not like to be disagreed with.

I LOVED Dr. Quesada's class. I wasn't really looking forward to taking religion, I had heard it was really hard. Dr. Quesada made the reading doable and really knew her stuff. The tests were simple if you just studied for a few hours. I learned more than I ever thought I would in my Bible class

Dr. Quesada is one of my favorite professor at TCU. She is super nice and does everything she can to help you succeed. This class is very hard, if you are looking for a religion core class that does not require effort, do not take this class. Do all the reading guides and you will do fine. She gives extra credit that is worth 10 points on any test.

Dr quesada is so kind - unless your whole class never does the reading ... then she gets REALLY frustrated (as she should). She takes the time to learn everyone's names unlike most professors. if you do the readings and take notes in class you're guaranteed at least a B. attendance policy is you can miss 8 classes and then u won't pass
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Quesada is an amazing professor that will take her time to make sure you're doing well in her class. If you read what is assigned before class and then review and take notes in the lecture, you'll be more than fine. She's very passionate and knows what she's teaching. Extremely smart. TAKE HER!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Quesada is a very very kind prof! Her class is a ton of information, but you can do it! As long as you read (most of it) and take good notes, you will be fine! The tests can be pretty hard so be sure to study! She knows it's a lot and will give extra credit, you also get to drop lowest test! There are 6 tests overall. Take her!!

If you're great at reading really old writings, then this class is for you. The worst part about this class is the hour or more of boring reading for every class, but if you do all the homework an A should be pretty obtainable. The entire grade is quizzes/tests, but most of them aren't too tricky. Takes some effort though, so I pass/no credited it
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Quesada is an amazing professor. I can say I genuinely looked forward to her class. She is kind and cares about how well her students do. If you do the required readings & take notes in class then you will do fine on the tests because they are mostly MC, fill in the blank, and true/false. She is also SUPER knowledgeable about the material

I took Dr. Quesada for Spiritual Autobiographies. There are 6 books to read over the semester, but they aren't too long or bad- 1 paper, 1 creative project, 1 final. You can tell she absolutely loves teaching this material and she does a wonderful job at it. I would definitely recommend this class for your religion credit. Get ready to read, though
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Ms. Quesada is the sweetest teacher!! She teaches in a manner that makes it interesting. If your struggling she will go out of her way to help you and is very passionate about religion! She is overall a great teacher!! the tests can be difficult at times but if you study it will be okay. Every test has an essay you have to write but she gives topic

This was the most difficult class I've ever taken. She does not explain things well and there is A LOT of reading assigned every class! Her 4 tests are near impossible and she only gives 5 extra credit points max for the entire semester and that's only for those struggling to pass like myself! If you skip class, chances are you will miss a quiz too

Dr Quesada is great. Show up to class every day though because she gives a lot of test questions in class. She expects participation but I didnt do the readings every time and was fine. Really nice and helpful. Didnt have to study much and made an A!

Show up for class, do the readings and youll be fine. Quizes will save your grade, gives extra cdredit at the end. DO the READING GUIDES, not mandatory but they will help you get an A in the course. (the reading guides are the test reviews)

If you do the reading, the class is fairly easy and an A is very doable.  If you don't do the reading, you'll struggle.  He lectures are engaging, and goes over the key concepts from the reading in class.  Overall an enjoyable class.

Not always the most fun class, but she knows the material and she does a very good job at relaying it to her students. If you go to class regularly, do the readings, and pay attention, it is not difficult to do well. She is very nice and she genuinely cares about her students.

Her class is on and off challenging. The quizzes vary from easy 100's and True/False quizzes. Her class is boring, and can seem like forever. If you went to a private school i would recommend this class. She is not as hard as i heard about religion classes.

not exactly a fun class, but not bad compared to other TCU religion classes. random easy reading quizzes that are a total grade booster, and if you just do the reading and study a decent amount a high B or A is doable. she's super sweet and approachable

Nicest professor, I'm a big fan.. Incredibly helpful especially with office hours. There isn't an easy religion class, but this is the one to take. Learned a ton. Managed an A, but it took a lot of studying despite having some biblical knowledge. Prepare before class and USE her reading guides. Drops 3 lowest quiz grades. 10 points extra credit.
Class is fairly hard if you don't know the bible well. Make sure to read and do study guides and you should easily get a B. Hot

Just do the reading guides! If it's on the study guide, it will definitely be on the test. The tests have essay portions, but she gives you a choice of prompts prior to taking the test so you have time to prepare. Very knowledgeable, sweet, and helpful! You have to attend class because there are pop quizzes but they're only worth 10% overall.

Very knowledgeable and really knows what she is talking about. She's super friendly and sweet and will help you if you need it. She cares about her students. Weekly quizzes normally on Fridays so that you go to class but they are SUPER easy as long as you do the reading. Drops your lowest quiz score. Tests have essays but she gives the prompts.

Not bad at all for the required religion class. Keep up with the reading though and do the study guides she gives you. Offers extra credit and curves the tests. Lots of athletes were in my class. TAKE HER! She's very nice and knowledgeable but can be a bit boring. Easy if you do your work and reading

Good teacher, knows her stuff, and very helpful. Helps if you already have a basic understanding of the Bible, but if you do the readings and study guides you'll be fine. One of the easier religion classes at TCU.

I never did the reading guides and I got an A on every test. If you're familiar with the Bible you will do fine, if not, it may be hard. Read the text book, way more helpful then reading the assignments from the Bible. Also, the final is not cumulative, and is weighted the same as the other 3 tests.

Very sweet lady, class is very dry and gets worse the closer you get to the end of the semester. Lots of outside class work, be prepared to spend a lot of time on homework readings and guides. Not the easiest core class but completely doable if you are willing to work! weekly friday easy reading quizzes.
Nice teacher. Not bad as far as religion classes go

She knows her stuff! Lecture can be dry near the end of the semester. Last half of the semester the readings were SO long and drawn out. Expect to spend a couple hours each day just reading both texts! Be thorough in reviews, tests aren't bad. Quizzes are super easy if you read or even just use common sense.
Great teacher, even better person, take her

Wayyy too much work for a core class. I'm a business major and had more homework and studying to do in this class than any of my business classes. I've taken religion for 14 years and I read every textbook and bible assignment there was and I still ended up with a B+. She gives pop quizzes sometimes and drops your 2 lowest quiz grades

RELI 10033 - Great prof! I enjoyed her class. She does require a lot of reading but she provides study material. Periodic quizzes are easy if you read the assigned material prior to class. Tests are medium but if you put a little effort into studying the study guides and your notes, then you will do well.

Take her for your religion credit!! She loves teaching and is passionate. Compared to other religion classes - she is the easiest. It's still hard but 95% of what's on the tests and quizzes is straight from the book. She wants to help you learn and do well. Know the reading guides, have an opinion in your essays/class discussions, & you'll do well!

She is very helpful and accommodating and very intelligent. If you're lazy and don't read your assigned reading this class is not for you. You have to go to class take good notes, do the readings, and work with the study guides she so nicely provides for you. If that is too much for you to do, don't take the class.

in my 1st semester @ TCU this was my FAV class by far. super interesting! wanted to take a class that pertained to my religion this was IT! goes through the bible at a fair pace. lots of reading, but if you just follow the reading guide you can skim. weekly quizzes SUPER EASY if you read whatsoever. HIGHLY recommended, nicest lady and a great class
expects you to memorize every detail and covers it very quickly for a basic religion class.

This class is not for those who are not extremely interested in religious history.  I thought it would be a fun class requiring little work, but it is quite demanding.  I would read all of the daily readings and still made Bs on the tests.  She tries to make the class interactive, but the lectures are still rather dry.

Dr. Quesada is very friendly & passionate about teaching. I heard she was the easiest for religion, but her class was VERY hard. Daily reading assignments, which are very long & boring. ~15 quizzes from readings & drops lowest 2. 3 tests which are very difficult & each has an essay question (luckily, gives essay prompts prior, so u can prepare).

Professor Quesada was a really good teacher to have for religion. i actually enjoyed her lectures and even though i did awful on her tests, i made a high B. Do the writing assignments. they make your grade.

Awesome professor. The test are very easy as long as you do the assigned reading. She has three test and then quizzes. Make sure that you read everyday! This is the total of what you will need to know for Quizzes and test. Best teacher I have had at TCU yet!

good teacher! she's very nice & her class is interesting. you have to read and actually make an effort but thats every class. She is funny too. Turn cell phones off and dont text during class. She is willing to help during office hours, she helped me. I made a 100 on the first test and an A in the class with effort. TAKE HER!

Quesada is a good teacher and her class is interesting.  She does a great job of keeping her personal beliefs out of her teaching.  You must do the reading in this class in order to do well on the tests, which requires and hour outside of class per class meeting.  She expects class participation and I would encourage going to her office hours.

Dr. Quesada is one of the best professors I have had at TCU! She is so nice and helpful. If you ever have a question, she is more than happy to answer it. Her tests are fairly difficult, but the study guides she gives and the in-class notes are extremely helpful. If you just review the notes and keep up with the readings, you can get an A.

Dr. Quesada is one of the sweetest professors I have ever had.  She really cares about her students and is always willing to help.  You can tell that her heart is in it!  If you keep up with the handouts and pay attention in class you will do well... oh and study for the tests!!!

She acts like a mother while teaching.  If you're eating in class, talking or maybe asking someone the page number .... please believe she will point you out and ask you why you were talking or not to eat.  Do NOT TALK in class and please do not text message.  Otherwise, she's cool. She knows her material pretty well and her tests are not too bad.

A great religion class, Dr. Quesada is extremely helpful in and out of class. A lot of reading however, and although the tests are not culumitive they do get harder as the semester goes on.  She gives you amazing study guides, though so as long as you do your part you should be fine. Take advantage of the quizes! they add up to another test grade!

good teacher!!  give u readying guides that are the study guides for the test.  As long as u read ur h/w u'll get a b.  if u try a lil harder for a A but not too hard. Takes attendence & the final is NOT cumulative. gives 15 quizzes and take best of 10!!  4 of them are like attendance grades!!

One of the sweetest professors at this place. She runs a very FAIR class. What you put in is what you get. You go class, read and study you'll get an a. The oppisote is also true. If you are a major, take her for sure. She is prob the nicest in the department.
great prof. really cares about her students. Do the reading, it helps a lot. Some of the tests are kind of tricky but she is super helpful and gives reviews.

i LOVE dr. quesada's class. she is such a great teacher, and she keeps it interesting. she's kinda quirky but she's funny. if you do the readings and the handouts, you'll get an A. she gets to know the students and is available outside of class.

Dr. Quesada is so nice, and such a sweet professor! She makes learning about the Bible fun and interesting. I did'nt know much about the Bible before that class, and I have learned tons! Just keep up with your readings and go to class- she takes attendance. Her lectures are great and you'll learn alot if you put in the effort. Take her class!!!
good class

Great professor probably the best in the department Cares about students both in & out of class. Make sure you keep up with the readings or else you're in trouble. Tests are multiple choice with one essay. An A is possible if u put in effort. I really loved her class. Would highly recommend her.!!!
She is so nice and really helpful.. Tests can be difficult BUT if you study the notes you will do fine. She also provides study guides tahta re tremendously helpful!! TAKE HER!!!

Dr Quesada is a sweetheart!  She is great teacher.  Her class isnt too rough if you do the readings and pay attention in class -- you should get an a.  She knows what she is talking about and cares about you as a person! Take her!

Dr. Quesada is very smart and her class was great.  I made an A.  Study lightly and an A is definitely attainable.  Her afternoon class was writing focused, while her morning classes were more objective.  I would definitely recommend her to others.

This class has a light work load but that means the tests are worth more, and yes, the tests are fairly difficult.  Be prepared to study quite a bit for each and take detailed notes.  She is very nice and presents the material very well--academically and unopinionated.

She is a nice professor, but be prepared to study a lot. She doesnt give any slack in her class with grades. You have to have at least a 90.6 in order to round up to have an A. Overall very challenging but nice professor. Reccomended if you like studying the Bible ALOT!

Study = A. She is an interesting teacher. Go to class because attendance is taken. Take good notes and go over assigned readings for A. She'll work with you if you need help and offered up to 10pts xtra credit on your lowest test score at the end of semester, really helps with only 3 tests in all.
nice teacher, hard class. tests are hard, homework load is light, GO TO CLASS (she takes off for absences), study your face off for the tests. shes nice though.

She's great!  I learned so much in her class.  The tests aren't hard at all if you as long as you are breathing in class.  She covers everything in class and doesn't throw anything new at you.  She is very willing to work with you on absenses and make up work.  I HIGHLY recommend taking this class!

Great teacher! I was afraid of a religion class being preachy, but Dr. Quesada kept everything fun and interesting with famous catch phrases such as: "Events like Sodom and Gomorra have symbolic messages beyond don't gang-rape angels." A lot of reading and easy opinion papers, but a lot of learning!

Great Professor, knows a lot of USEFUL things about the Bible.  Unlike the other professors how they will teach you useless knowledge (son of ???? Which you will never use.)  She will actually teach you specific dimensions of the Bible. Great person in general. Strongly recommend.
I Loved this class. She knows her stuff and if you like studying the Bible it is an awesome class. Just do all of the reading and know the information and you should at least make a B.

This class has a light work load, but the tests are hard. She does not help very much in her lectures.. Hands out the essay before the test, so that helps a lot b/c essays on tests are over 1/2 the grade.

This Prof. likes to teach her own opinion! Beware!  She SAYS she doesn't want to trick you with exam questions but she does.  Study your tail off if you want to make a decent grade, but I recommend just taking WORLD religion instead.

Better than my professor who received the Chancellor's Award this year.  As a sophomore, I am glad I waited to take her and highly recommend her to all the freshmen.  If you are a religion major, you might try to find someone harder if that's your cup of tea, but this is what I needed.
She is so Hot right now...so Hot.  In fact I'd date her if she wasn't married.

nice woman, tries to help you out as much as possible, tests are some what challenging. Material for tests comes from book, bible, and lecures equally. If you come to class and listen fairly well you should get a b.
She does all she can to help you. She's fair and concise.
Very good and FAIR teacher!!!
GREAT TEACHER!!!  She doesn't try to TRICK you on tests.  She expects a fair amount out of you but she's good and more than willing to help.
Very informative class.  She really knows her stuff.  Study all notes as it is amazing how much stuff she can test you on.
very, very boring

i love studying religion, but it was hard for me to do that in this class. it's an EASY B...if you study good you can get an A.  She likes you if you talk in class....and she makes you talk if you don't

I really enjoyed this class and she made it really interesting.  I've been a Christian forever and I learned all kinds of new stuff.  You do have to read to keep up in class or you will be lost and the tests are more over concepts than over definitions.
She's awesome, coolest teacher ever.
She is very sweet and I enjoyed the class. Lots of reading assignments and the tests can be hard, but she is very helpful in return.
take full advantage of the lecture and study groups and you should be more than fine. if you study for the tests like you should, you'll do very well. very nice lady
amazing teacher--go to class, at least read the text book and pay attention. if you ever have questions, she's more than happy to help!

I loved her class.  Its not easy but if you study and go to class and participate you can easily get an A.  Also get a study group and study the night before a test!  She is an awesome teacher and makes the course really interesting and you learn alot.
Although her class was very difficult for me, she was so helpful and nice. If you have any questions or conflicting schedules, she is very understanding.

One of the nicest and most understanding teachers you will ever meet.  Religion is a tricky subject to understand, but she is there to help.  The small class sizes help create a more stimulating atmosphere.
Fun class, awesome teacher.  Cares so much about the subject as well as the students... take home tests! yipee! (but they still aren't effortless). I definently recommend
wonderful lady.  very nice and willing to help and cares about her students.  she is exteamly knowledgable about the bible-highly recommended
Class is pretty easy. If you study you can make an easy A. Take notes and do the readings and you should be good. She is a nice teacher and cares about her students.
This class is the best...Loves to debate the Bible, and really sheds some light on different aspects of religion.  Cool teacher.

This could be the most interesting class that i have ever taken.  Her tests are hard (if in doubt the T/F are always FALSE) but she gives you enough to study for them.  Incredibly smart and helpful teacher.

Her tests are lengthy, and have essays. But she gives you test reviews, so you know what to study for. I am not a religion major, but I thoroughtly enjoyed her class. She is very nice and easy to get along with.
very dedicated.  cares about the students.
Easy if you put a little effort into it. I didn't and took a B. Just make sure you show up for class, she starts to really reduce your grade when you skip.
great teacher - interesting class. very enjoyable.
Best class I have ever taken!

Very nice and very helpful.  Tests aren't too bad.  There are daily writing assignments, but as long as you turn it in (and it's not BS) you'll get full credit.  Pretty easy if you go to class and pay attention.
She is really nice. I would say take her for Bible and you won't be so bored.  And plus she'll bring you donuts.
The class is good...but VERY HARD.  I'be heard its better than Grant's.  The tests are extremly difficult and have really random questions.  A lot of material is covered.
You learn a lot in the class because she is very knowledgable, but have to work for it. Her tests are difficult. Can skip 5 classes before your grade starts to suffer.

her tests are kind of a little too detailed for a class that is pretty much required for freshman... its not like we're religion majors.  so if you have a lot of HW in your classes that actually have to do with your major then i wouldnt take this class.
No Comments
condescending

Professor Russel gives great lectures and helps students apply macroeconomic terms to the real world. Your grade is mostly made up of 4 tests and a final, the lowest of all these grades is dropped. You get to bring a 3 x 5 notecard with whatever you want written on it to every exam. I feel that I have truly learned a lot after taking her class!
Really good if you actually want to learn economics

DO NOT TAKE. Tests are extremely difficult and she assigns so much homeworker. She wants her students to participate but gets annoyed when people ask her questions. Her lectures are super long and boring. She walks around the room randomly to make sure you are taking notes. I studied so much and never did well on her tests. STAY AWAY!!

There were 5 exams including the final and one of them gets dropped. They are very manageable if you prepare for them. She also posts all her lectures on D2L so you can go back and has practice quizzes that have some of the same questions on the exam. Homework is easy but sometime time consuming. I loved every lecture and would recommend her!

Do not take her if you don't have to!!! I thought she would be a decent professor because of her other reviews but they are outdated. She doesn't grade on a +/- scale anymore so it really impacts your grade. She clearly loves Macro but does not explain it well and is rude to her students. It is very difficult to do well even if you try and study.

Good professor, lectures are boring but pretty good. I would recommend participating in class. Tests are  very manageable if you prepare. Homework very quick and easy. Probably not the easiest macro professor but I didn't mind it.

Pros: Homework doesn't take long, study guides are helpful, and ends class early sometimes.

Cons: She is EXTREMELY rude and disrespectful to her students. Cold calls a lot, very unforgiving, and it's hard to set up one-on-one meetings with her because she is rarely on campus.

Not the end of the world if you have to take her, but try not to.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She has a clear passion for Macroeconomics and wants to teach you everything you need to know about it. However the only grades you receive are test grades, and she only uses a Scantron. She cold-calls in class. It is a lot of challenging content, but she tries to go over it in extensive detail so that you understand.

Class is very lecture heavy. The homework take at least an hour usually two a week. She has a horrible attitude and is very condescending at times. She loves to cold call. I took this class in high school, however these tests were very hard and there is no extra credit option. She only uses A B C D F (no + or -), this ruined my first quarter gpa.

Personally, the language of this class was difficult for me to follow along with. I spent a lot of time on the homework and studying for the test, but always got Bs and Cs, which is unusual for me because I'm usually an A student. She wasn't bad, just not great or very forgiving.

I thought Ms. Russel was very clear and a great teacher. Homework is very light, and doing it greatly helps understand concepts. Our Final was optional if we needed the grade boost. I payed attention and studied which is all you really need to do to do well, nothing crazy.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her classes are mainly lectures. In order to do well, make sure to ask her questions because if you don't, she assumes that you understand the material. The homework wasn't bad, just two assignments per chapter.
She can be kind of rude during lectures, but overall, her tests are super straight forward and if you do the homework and notes you will be completely fine. I'd recommend taking her.

If you care, you will succeed. Tests are 70% of grade, but if you study hard and understand the material, you'll do fine. Homework takes a couple hours a week to complete. Lectures are long, but her notes are very helpful. She has online study guides for tests and you get a notecard for each test. A very doable class for meeting only once a week.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Had to drop because of how difficult the tests are

Dr. Russell is an amazing lecturer who explained concepts so well.The class only met once a week, yet homework is the same each time, 2 online assignments, and they were very manageable with multiple attempts allowed on each. For exams, there can be some tricky questions, but overall they are straightforward. She often lets class out early too.
She is so sassy

She has been my favorite teacher thus far!!! Her class is hard and you definitely have to try and study hard for exams, but her studyguides were extremely helpful and everything was posted online, including all the lectures! Felt like I actually learned something. Definitely recommend, loved her.

she always says to ask her anything but she can be very rude when you don't understand but helpful at the same time. exams are not that easy but the final was easy. she allows you to have a 4x6 notecard which was definitely helpful. homework was so long but it helped you. take her!

Russell is a great professor and I feel like I learned a lot from her. There's weekly homework assignments that sometimes take long to complete, and the lectures can get very long and tiring, but as long as you study hard for your exams you should do fine. She lets students use a notecard as a cheat sheet during every exam and is willing to help.

The majority of your grade comes from exams and she does not offer extra credit. She does not have office hours so you have to set up a time out of class to meet with her which isn't with your time (I asked a question and she told me to google it). She will not round grades, for example, I was .01 from having a B in the class. I don't recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took her because of good reviews and was disappointed. One of the hardest macro professors at TCU. If you can get into another class try to.

It is easy to succeed in this class as all the homework is online and she always lets us out early.  If you pay attention and practice the online optional quizzes, that is what makes up most of the test.

I took Russell for a 3hr once a week lecture and she always let us out an hour early. It's important you attend class because she does not provide notes elsewhere. All of her exams consisted of the practice questions she gave us to study. Study the practice questions and it is an easy A. She even made the final exam optional. TAKE HER.
She was a great teacher and person! Her class is very easy if you pay attention in class and read the textbook.

ECON has been one of my favorite courses solely due to Professor Russell's instruction. Her lectures are long, but she does her best to keep the entire class engaged. She provides great examples in class, lots of practice quizzes, and very clear study guides. As a bonus, she lets you bring a notecard (front and back) to each exam. 10/10 recommend!

Professor Julie Russell is a phenomenal Macroeconomics professor. She continues to engage her students, creates a positive environment, and gives real world examples that help to further her students' knowledge. I like that she gives us practice problems at the end of the session in order to confirm that we have grasped the topic.

Julie Russell is a great professor. The class is very test heavy but if you go to class and pay attention you will be fine. She explains the lectures well and makes them easy to understand. I took her night class that ends at 8pm but she always let us out early. You can bring one notecard to use on her tests front and back which is helpful.

Professor Russell is a sweet lady who cares for her students as she used extra lecture time to provide students more time to review concepts with her. She is pretty lecture heavy, but that is expected from an economics course. Her tests are relatively easy to study for as the homework she requires is very beneficial to do well in the class.

Julie Russell is a great professor. In class, she is engaging and explains the material well. She allows ample opportunities to ask questions in class and will gladly go over something again if you ask. The work required in the class is very manageable. You are allowed to bring a notecard for tests which is very helpful and the tests are easy.

not sure why the bad reviews, she was super sweet and caring to everyone. I had her for intro to micro. Grade was four non-cumulative tests and weekly homework. people complain about the amount of hw but every micro prof gives out the same. She gives out test question packets that contain a lot what will be on the test in the exact format.

I took her Thursday night class from 6:30-9:15 but she always let us out around 8:45. Go to her classes because her lectures are important, she gives online slide notes and after each class a practice worksheet to help go through the lesson. She also gives out study guides and allows notecards on the test!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class reminded me of my highschool economics course. There are 4 in-person tests throughout the semester. She provides a study guide and allows you to bring a notecard to the exam. She lectures for most of the class and then we work out problems that are similar to test questions. There is a lot of homework but it brings up your overall grade

very rude and not at all caring for the TCU students. She definitely doesn't want to be at TCU and would rather be at the TCC college. homework and learnsmart every week- not to hard and takes about 2 hours. get ready to be talked down to. she acts like everyone is dumb and gets pissed if you talk but also gets pissed if you don't answer questions.

Professor is rude to the class. Doesn't put effort into her TCU students bc she teaches at another campus. LOTS of homework and tests are difficult. Lectures are 3 hours long and she lectures the entire time. Wouldn't recommend this class for anyone who can avoid a night class.

VERY difficult class. The tests became increasingly hard and since the teacher is part time at TCU and another school, she isn't very accessible nor does she seem very invested in the class. Sometimes felt as if she was rude to the class. Entire class time is long lectures. Only nice part of this class is she would give quizzes for extra credit
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Loved Mrs. Russel!!! Each week you have a homework assignment and a Learnsmart assignment to do, but there pretty simple and are usually easy points. Has 4 tests and drops your lowest one! Is really sweet and helpful.  Only downside is that she usually teaches at TCC, so she is not always available to meet with face to face. Overall great class!

I really enjoyed her class, but the only thing to be concerned about is keeping up with each step of the long form. Please stay on track, and there are presentations for each step as you progress through your long form. Make sure you get started sooner rather than later, because you do not want to cram your interviews and research at the end.

Dr. Loke was an amazing professor! Her issues in news class was amazing. Yes there's homework almost every class, but most of it is not long at all. So many opportunities to keep your grade good, and she gives great feedback. Very accessible outside of class and wants you to succeed, you'll learn a lot about objectivity in journalism.

Dr. Loke has given us lots of time over the semester to prep for our final story at the end of the year. She has helped us a lot with ideas, people to interview and questions to ask. She is understanding if you miss class if you explain why.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Loke is amazing. Attendance isn't mandatory. She's incredibly understanding and flexible. She gives detailed feedback that actually helps you grow as a writer, and she's always available if you need guidance. She doesn't follow the syllabus word-for-word, but she communicates what's due and when. I don't get why she has bad ratings.

This professor is not supportive in the slightest. Students are expected to learn on their own and teach themselves. Many issues with the servers used for this class and websites, with a lack of technical support and compliance. Get ready to spend hours and hours on assignment's with no help.

I came to this class for an education, and all I got was a headache. Professor Loke is someone I genuinely wish would quit teaching so the poor souls who take her class wouldn't have to endure what I did.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment:
I didn't wear my seatbelt driving to this class hoping I would die before I got there
It sadly never worked

Longform with Dr. Loke was frustrating and stressful. She did not follow her rubrics and would change/add assignments often hours before the deadlines. She constantly canceled class and wouldn't respond to emails or texts from multiple students. We worked in groups but she provided no accountability or guidance. Class did not match description.

DO NOT TAKE DIGITAL STORYTELLING. I know this might seem like just another student complaining - but I'm being nice by just saying it's awful. IT IS A CODING CLASS, not a design class. The workload is a lot, you have to pay over $100 for a website you're only going to use for one semester, and she doesn't respond to emails. Easy A, but not worth it

Professor Loke is quite literally the worst professor I have ever had. She chooses favorites and will belittle you in class if she does not like you. She has no idea how to use technology and only lectures straight from the book, yet the tests do not relate to the book. The way she grades makes no sense and she will not help you outside of class.

Dr. Loke is the most unorganized professor. My whole class agreed that we had to teach ourselves the material. Lots of busy work. Not available outside class. Barely teaches. Cannot grade has not graded over 10 assignments and the class is over. She does not know how to use technology and seems like she doesnt want to be teaching. Rude in emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Loke is a great professor those who complain aren't used to the big boy rules she puts into place. She expects you to do your work and do it well. NO waiting till the last minute. She is a great professor and very caring. Highly recommended.

Dr. Loke is a great teacher with an incredible class. Be aware that the class is entirely group work with a few lectures here and there. Not very many quizzes or tests. Most grades are papers, presentations, and projects. Easy if you do the work. Dr. Loke is also a bit technologically challenged and not very organized. Great for an easy GA credit
reviews.rating_tags: SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Lots of group work, not super organized
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Loke is a very nice woman, but she is very unorganized and never lectures, so there is no learning going on in the classroom. Cancels class a lot. Final Project is a lot of work but isn't too bad. The material is interesting, but Loke is unorganized, repetitive and waits until the last possible minute to grade ANYTHING. Good class, bad teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Loke is a great teacher at TCU, highly recommend taking her. She really cares about her class and gives good lectures. The final is a group project that is presented, it is ALOT of work but if you make a good group you should get an A.

We had a group project as our final, but nothing we learned this semester prepared us for the project. Then she asks us to buy a book at the end of the semester for the project. We literally didn't meet for a whole month so we could "work on our group project." She wasn't really prepared for class and put off grading our assignments till last min.

Honestly have no idea what is going on in the class. She does not give clear grading criteria or feedback, and is very unprepared. We have barely met as a class in the past couple months, and I do not feel as if I am prepared to progress into my major.

Dr. Polzer is an amazing professor! Attendance is not mandatory, but all exams come from her lectures, so attendance is encouraged! She is engaging and makes this class enjoyable. Her lectures are very entertaining, and she genuinely cares about her students. She uses textbooks that are easily accessible and shows a few documentaries during class.
The 8am part was brutal but super fun class and she is lecture heavy. We had 2 required books which you can find online. She is very easy to reach outside of class and super kind and understanding

Dr. Polzer is an amazing professor! She is so funny and engaging during class. Class is only graded with three exams and one paper, but the exams are directly from the notes from class. Two textbooks were assigned, but the tests never asked about the content from them. Such a fun class and would take Dr. Polzer again for sure!

Dr. Polzer's class was amazing! Your grade is composed of 2 tests, 1 discussion post, and 1 final paper. Tests aren't hard if you STUDY, pay attention in class and take notes. Discussion post & paper aren't hard if you do the readings & take notes during lecture. She's nice, cares about her students, and teaches you a lot about the justice system.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Polzer has been my favorite teacher here - SO caring, kind, and wants you to succeed. Her lectures and in class contents are SO interesting & she doesn't take attendance, but lectures are not posted online and that's what she tests on. Two tests, two papers, no homework in between! Highly recommend this class & getting to know Dr. Polzer.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is super fun and a great teacher. However, you are only graded on a few major things but they are easy if you just go to class and pay attention. The only thing you have is in class notes and that is all you can pull from for tests. She doesnt post slides so you have to go to class but it is easy and entertaining. I did not feel overwhelmed.

Criminal violence at 8 am could be tough but Dr. Polzer is such a chill and funny professor. She is so caring and her lectures are so fun. We had three tests and a paper but as long as you go to class you will get an A. Her tests are straight from the slides but she doesn't post them so you have to go to get the info

Took it online in the winter. I like criminology, so the topics were interesting. I would just get on Zoom and then take off, so you don't really need to sit through it for 4 hours. She was nice and accepted my late work!

Dr. Polzer is knowledgeable and passionate about what she teaches. Her lectures are full of content, and if you pay attention - or take good notes - you will do well. Study for the tests - she gives review topics/questions.

Professor Polzer is caring and sweet. She tries to make class fun and interesting. Class is lecture heavy, there are very few assignments that go into the grade-book. She doesn't post slides or anything to help for test, you have to completely rely on your notes for test. Great person but it's difficult for those who aren't great note takers.

Dr. Polzer is an amazing professor! She keeps students engaged and is hilarious. Attendance is absolutely necessary. All of the material comes from lecture slides (which are not posted) and from the readings. Easy class if you show up for class and take good notes. Grades come from three exams and a final paper. Definitely recommend taking!

Dr. Polzer is so strong and so kind. She had a lot of personal things going on outside of class, yet she still showed up and put our learning as her priority. Classes consist of lectures and documentaries and the class is graded on 2 papers and 2 tests. That being said, they are easy to get a good grade because she gives study guides and rubrics!

She is amazing and very understanding. Lectures are pretty interesting but she doesn't post her lecture notes so you have to attend class or get notes from other classmates. Only graded on 3 in person m/c exams and a final paper that is super easy.

I really enjoyed having professor Polzer. I had her 8am for three days a week but she always made class so interesting. You only have four assignments in the grade book, so tests are very important. She mainly lectures along with videos throughout the slides. If you ever miss a day she is extremely flexible with getting you the notes.

Professor Polzer is an amazing professor and I would recommend taking her whenever you can. She only teaches at 8 am, but I would recomend getting up early just to take her class. I found the material very interesting and we only had 3 exams, and she puts extra credit and freebees within the exam itself. The final is also only an essay.

Professor Polzer is THE BEST. She was not only my professor but also my advisor and she is awesome at both! This class is easy, but is also very important to listen and take notes on everything because the class material isn't available. She is super chill and caring and will always be willing to help in and out of school.

She's very nice, her lectures are mostly from her powerpoints and there are days where we would just watch documentaries for the whole class. The only thing I didn't like was that she only grades by 2 exams, 1 discussion on D2L and 1 short paper. If you do bad on one, you're likely to be done. Also, 94 for an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: She is honestly one of my favorite teachers that I've had at TCU! She was always happy and in a good mood. She jokes around with the students and doesn't make the class boring. I would love to have another class with her. If you get the chance, take a class with her.

Professor Polzer is ABSOLUTELY AMAZING. I genuinely wish I could take her again but this class wasn't even my major. She is so cute and funny and the absolute best professor I have had a TCU. If you have to take this class for a core requirement TAKE HER. You will NOT regret it!!!

Great teacher, very sweet and clearly interested in what she is teaching. Very few opportunities to earn extra credit and very few grades in general. If you mess up one test, you're screwed. However, I would still recommend her. She makes an 8am much more bearable!

Easiest class I've taken at TCU. If you miss a class she gives you the lectures, and all the lectures are just straight copying down what the powerpoint says. Tests are easy, just memorize the powerpoint. Doesn't take attendance. Super chill, really funny and lectures are easy to follow. Makes a boring subject interesting.

This class could be difficult because there are only four grades: two tests, a presentation and a paper. If you do well on the tests, you will get a good grade. The presentation and paper are grade boosters if you make an effort. She is really cool and in tune to current events and culture. Easy lectures to pay attention to.
Dont need to read the books, no homework and no attendance. Two tests that are easy multiple choice if you go to class and watch the movies

Took her criminal violence class. Didn't need to read anything, just go to class and take notes. Take notes on the videos too. Tests aren't hard if you study. Easy A. Amazing teacher, really funny and very interesting. Definitely a good class to take

I had her for critical issues during a maymester and it was one of my favorite classes I have taken in my 3 years at TCU.  She is an amazing teacher, I learned a lot, and the class wasn't made unnecessarily hard.  We need more professors at TCU like her!

Polzer is one of the most enthusiastic professors I've taken at TCU. She's passionate about what she teaches, and she relates very well to her students. I took her for critical issues, and the class really opened my eyes to things..the class is easy, and you learn a LOT. Highly recommend!

No complaints from me. I can honestly say that this class has really made me interested in all the materials covered. Not only was the class interesting but it was straightforward enough to get a good grade in. The final grades were returned in a ridiculously short amount of time. I checked back in about an hour after the final and they were there!

Pretty interesting class, and she makes it easy. She is pretty cute, and the class really is fun. Lot of discussion about criminal justice issues. Recommend for anyone. I'm not CRJU, but I am thinking about taking another class with her.

Pretty easy. No one goes to class, but I'd suggest going to class but not reading (except for the case reports). The two tests are 80% of your grade, so make sure you're ready for them. They're just multiple choice, though, so memorize basic facts. Make sure you see the films and know WHERE the films took place.

This class was very interesting (even at 8am). Great discussions. Easy Grader. Even the paper is easy. No roll. But occasionally she will make a question up for the test and if you aren't there you won't know the answer. Class is definitely worth it if you need it or have any interest in criminal justice whatsoever.
Polzer is awesome! Not a CRJU major, but still enjoyed her class. Come to class and get involved and you will do well.
Pro: movies, pizza, movies, more movies, ridiculously easy A, easy to look at. Con: you learn more watching discovery.

Easiest A you will ever get at TCU. Polzer lectures straight out of the book & watches a ton of movies. Class is a joke and you'll learn next to nothing, but fun and easiest exams ever. Just read the slides and you're set.

I had her for intro CJ at 8 AM but it was so worth it b/c it double dips the core and she's a ridiculously easy A, she takes attd @ random and near the end you just stop learning and you watch movies the whole time, even better she basically tells you whats on the test, everything comes STRAIGHT from her slides, so if you know those you're good!
Best prof at TCU! I have taken her every semester! Study a little and its an easy A.
Take. This. Class.
This class was super easy and really interesting.....awesome teacher, take this for an easy A if you know anything about CRJU
extremely nice and fun! tests are easy. response papers are graded fairly. easy A

There isn't much homework. If there is homework, it is to watch a documentary at home. The tests are very detailed, so you definitely have to study to do well. She really engages with the class and brings in great guest speakers with diverse perspectives. Highly recommend!

Dr. Bowen is a great professor and is passionate about what she is teaching. Class grade is mainly from 2 exams, 1 project, and 1 paper. Attendence is mandatory, and you have to speak in class to get the participation points. Exams were pretty specific with slideshow/lecture content, but you can do well if you study enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I think Professor Bowen is an amazing instructor. I have had her for 2 classes now and I really enjoyed both. She is very engaging in her lectures and I like that she shows us videos and movies as well. Definitely recommend her classes I have learned so much in both of them!

Dr. Bowen is a wonderful professor and she is very knowledgeable. I took her for two classes this semester and I don't regret it one bit. The lectures are super interesting and every class was enjoyable. I recommend her 100%!

Dr.Bowen is a great person! But She gives 3 assignments for the whole semester which are 2 exams, & 1 creative activity project. So if you fail 1,you fail the class. No extra credit.Mandatory Attendance.Exams are confusing and tricky.Exams are in person on paper. No study guide for the exams.Every lecture are powerpoint, slides are a bit confusing.

I've had Dr. Bowen for 2 classes and I truly cannot recommend her enough! Not only is the material extremely interesting and engaging, I have also come to Dr. Bowen countless times for career advice, class planning and more. If I could take every class wirh her as the professor, I would!

Professor Bowen is amazing, and I really enjoyed this class!
