reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Don't take her if you want to have a relaxed freshman year at TCU. She makes it seem impossible to just be diligent and get good grades. The tests were extremely intricate and tricky. My year, 60% got F, and only 10 got A. I got 77 first exam and 52 second exam. Then I dropped it. But right pass deadlight, she curved everyone 10 points.

She really knows her stuff but there's just so much that it's overwhelming. You need the textbook. She gives a ton of small assignments that help your grade a little - a little - but her quizzes are much harder than the lecture material. Must read and pay attention to detail or you will fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Intro Bio is tough, and Dr. Luque makes it interesting and fun! The class is difficult, don't get me wrong, but she is a great professor that wants to help you do well even in a class of 150, always enjoyed her lectures. Tests aren't horrible, participation/the online homework are good grade boosters, but the final is cumulative and very difficult.

Harsh rating on easiness because it's Biology, nothing against Luque. There's a TON of material and exams are very challenging, a lot of the questions are conceptual and involve critical thinking which is tough. She is a very sweet lady! Very welcoming and easy to talk to. Good lectures, pretty easy to understand. Get ready to work hard for a B.

Dr. Luque is such a solid professor. I rated her as being pretty hard because that is simply the nature of intro bio. However, she does a great job at lecturing and has a very organized layout for each day. She is also super easy to talk to during office hours and for advising. Definitely take her if you can.

Dr. Luque is a great teacher and lecturer! She was very clear in her explanation and if you had difficulty understanding a topic, she was always available to ask questions. Very understand about life circumstances and a genuinely great person. Would take again.

This class is ridiculous for an intro to biology class. She made her test so specific and difficult that the average was either a D or C each test. Her online quizzes are the only thing that allowed me to keep a solid C average. I would study weeks and weeks in preparation for the tests to only get a C and in one instance a D. Don't take this class
tests are very hard. lectures are unclear sometimes

She is general is a great lady and teacher. The online quizzes are mostly all on quilt and you have three chances to pass them, but they are the only reason I'm not failing the class. Exams are way too difficult and specific. I have yet to pass one and ended up dropping. Everything about the class is fine for a biology class, but the exams

BEWARE. Dr. Dunn is a very kind teacher, and is very enthusiastic about Art History. If you LOVE Art History, you will probably like her. BUT. She is a very harsh grader, and her lectures have SO MUCH INFORMATION. She gives no context outside of what she says in class, and she will test you on the small details. Doesn't grade a lot of things.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: do. not. take.

Professor Dunn is a very hard grader for tests, quizzes, and papers. The class consists of only lectures and even if you write down every single word she says, the quizzes will still be confusing and seem like they were meant to make you fail. I cannot stress enough how confusing the test and quiz questions are.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Dunn for Women and Gender Studies. She was enthusiastic every morning, really sweet, and understanding. She wrote my transfer recommendation letters, and was willing to help me with other forms she had to fill out for my application. I thought her class was engaging, and she works hard to have people participate in discussion. Loved her!

This class is pointless, you have to memorize 50-60 pieces of art with dates, time periods, artists, and what they are made of for every test, and SPELLING COUNTS. You'll forget everything you memorize 5 minutes after the test. Her lectures are dry and she speaks way way too fast. Don't take this class even if its for core.
Very knowledgeable and passionate about art history. Pay attention to the lectures, take good notes and definitely make flash cards.

She expects way too much out of her students.  There are between 65-84 slides on each test, spelling counts, and you must memorize first, middle, and last names on artists.  If they are french paintings then you will need to know the french spelling.  In lecture she talks incredibly fast and sometimes in French. You'll spend 1-3 hrs on reading HW.
Alright class. Material was interesting. Didn't really enjoy the professor.

I personally wouldn't recommend this class. Unfortunately took it as a night class so i had nearly 3 hours in one sitting. Lectures were very boring; Barely anyone payed participated during class so there would be long moments of silence when she would ask questions.
Interesting course. Tough grader. Really long and dry lectures.
Intro to art history was by far the biggest joke class I've ever taken. Dunn takes off for spelling and punctuation errors... Don't take this class, save yourself from a guaranteed B or lower.
Ive taken 40k courses that required less effort to get a B in than her course. If taken, you will waste your life memorizing dates and names of paintings you will forget about the day after the exam.

I took her for Intro to Art History, and from what I have heard about other professors in the field here, She's not bad, and it's not impossible to do well in her class. That being said, you will have to put in a lot of time studying and you have to go to class. Her lectures can get pretty dry, but then again, that's art history.

I really would like anyone who wants to take Linear Algebra with Prof. Spice to reconsider. I spent days preparing for each test and did not pass. Had a tutor, got good homework grades. Not enough time on quizzes. I got a therapist after taking this class. He gives the hardest questions possible for each test and all content is "game". sos.

A lot of respect for him. Really caring for his students inside or outside class. Willing to answer to every questions, asking if his students understand it or not. Lots of homework and quizzes. Other than that, if you put effort and pay attention in class, you will be able to achieve good grade

Teacher is very passionate and nice. I struggled in this class, failing every test and half the quizzes, I actually failed (69.2) but he passed me. And I had a 96% in Calc 1. The material he teaches in class/on quizzes isn't hard, however, make sure you know how to solve EVERY hw problem because tests have very hard problems and I often got stuck.

Concepts are explained clearly as he makes sure everyone are following. Attendance is not required because you can review the slides yourself. Lots of extra credit for each exam (the actual exams are much easier than the ones he uses for preparation). There are weekly quizzes which are tight on time. Helpful during office hours. Bad handwriting.

very passionate and his lectures make sense. everything is open note, and quizzes aren't bad but don't skip class or you won't understand (bad handwriting). tests are IMPOSSIBLE even with notes. they're nothing like the quizzes or in class problems. i would drop but i cant
Best teacher I've ever hard.

Amazing professor! His lectures are engaging and he takes the time to make sure that students are following him. He is thorough, but he also moves on quickly, so pay attention. 2 HWs & 1 quiz each week, but its are manageable if you stay on top of it. The exams are difficult, but fair - the practice is harder. Brush up on Trig before this class!

Best professor I've ever had. He cares about his students and wants them to do well. He will put the effort in to help you do well if you show the same effort. A good amount of homework, practice exams for all midterms, and will on occasion let you earn back some points on exams. Exams are fairly difficult but much easier than practice exams. GOAT.
Spice wasn't a terrible teacher, there are definitely better options but overall if you choose him as a professor be prepared to work for your grade.

He is very good at calc 2 and is great at explaining things (plus he's nice and hilarious). His class is impossible if you underestimate it, though. Know that you are enrolling in an intense course and need to pay full attention during lecture. Work HARD from the start. Weekly quizzes and 2 homework assignments a week. Tests are hard, but possible.

Do not take for applied calc! I took intro to Calc in high school and already knew almost everything we learned in this course and still struggled a lot. Lectures make it seem so easy and the homework is easy but tests are super hard. I almost failed 2 of the tests. I would strongly not reccommend... trust

Dr. Spice is very kind and I like his sense of humor. His class is very predictable with weekly quizzes (that can be stressful), and homework due before each class. He is very accessible for office hours and responds to emails quickly. He is also generous with partial credit and bonus points. I think he is easier on exams for applied calc students.

Do not take for applied calc! I took AP calc AB and BC in high school, and still struggled in this course. Lectures go so slow and examples and very easy, but tests are WAY harder and nothing like the problems in class. There are also quizzes every friday with a 20 minute time limit that can be difficult to complete without time running out.

The workload is more than average but manageable. Uses Pearson mylab for homework twice a week and a quiz every Friday. Explains topics very thoroughly which can get boring but is useful, except that you will learn the most in HWs and quizzes since he only goes through easy examples in class. Overall a professor who cares about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Spice is a nice man but there are so many easier calc profs. He is accessible outside of class and cares about his students, but with attendance being mandatory and tests being really hard, its not worth the mid grade. Online homework twice a week that is painful, and the tests averages around 70%. Test questions harder than they should be.

Wonderful professor! Very accessible, responds to emails quickly and is helpful in office hours (3/4 hours are on Zoom). Sometimes goes fast during lectures, but will stop to take questions and explain things further. All examinations and quizzes are very difficult, but he does give generous partial credit most of the time. Happy to have had him!

Professor Spice is very nice and wants to help his students. His tests are insanely hard however. He is very generous with partial credit which makes up for the hard tests a little but his lectures are a little boring. He wants his students to do well and is very accessible outside of class.

Extremely passionate about his subject and extremely knowledgeable about it as well. Presents information extremely well. Will let you use a cheat sheet on tests, but will also use the hardest example of any concept on his tests so beware.

Professor Spice has arguably been the best math teacher I have ever taken. His class isn't easy and so dont expect an easy A  unless if you're not a math wiz. Go to office hours, do your homework and you will learn more in this math class than you have ever before.

Very understandable approach to a difficult subject. I hated having homework due every class, but it forces you to attend lectures and participate. Homework was graded very poorly by whatever grader was hired, but the exams were very fair and Dr. Spice did a good job of letting you know what to study. Show up to class and you'll succeed.

Professor Spice is a very detailed and articulate teacher that tailors his curriculum according to how the class is progressing. His lectures may seem redundant at times, but he is perfect for students that like to start at the basics and gradually move into harder material. 10/10 recommend him for Applied Calculus.

reviews.comment: gives very understandable lectures while also being very open to questions. expectations are very clear. Generous with points on tests.  the pace was kind of slow at times but for someone who is brand new, it is the perfect pace for understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Spice is a great teacher! he is very clear in his lectures and doesn't go too fast and also won't hesitate to answer questions. hmwk after every class but it is helpful in understanding the previous material better. we got a full page cheat sheet for every test which was God sent. Go to class, do hmwk, and take time preparing cheat sheet

reviews.comment: Avoid at all costs!!

reviews.comment: Dr spice is easily one of the kindest professors I have ever met, his passion for teaching is obvious, like bob ross for math. reviews.comment: I took this class in Fall of 2017. I have since referred to this man as Thanos with a full Infinity Gauntlet.                        Please just dont.

Professor Spice is there to help you learn: dont be afraid to ask questions! Discrete is tough, but he is very helpful in office hours and is receptive to questions over email. Homework is due at the beginning of each lecture and you have a Quiz at the end of the week. The material is not easy, but if you put in the effort, you can get an A.

Dont take any class with this professor, avoid at all cost. He takes easy topics and makes them unnecessarily hard. He is super condescending and not helpful at all. Class averages for all tests where 50s or low 60s. My other friends taking the same class with a different professor had 85+ averages on their tests.

Loren Spice is a good person, but not a great professor. My applied calculus class had 3 tests, and of those, 2 of them had a failing class average, one of which being a 52 class average. The material seems easy enough from his lectures, but his tests really dive into the hardest questions regarding the material covered. Try to stay away!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is helpful and dedicate. If you want to got an A, read the text book and put effort on doing homework. The test is not so hard, and he gives chance to recorrect it, which means that he really wants students to get better grade. Dont be lazy and everything will be great. Email him if you want to ask something, he definitely answers back quickly.

I had already taken AP Calculus in high school so was able to get an A-. If I hadn't taken Calculus before I would have probably gotten a C at best. He is a nice guy and caring if you follow his rules, but he gives very basic examples in class, and the tests are very difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: His tests are insanely hard. Good teacher but his class work does not compare to what he puts on the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Easily the hardest class I've ever taken. The tests were unnecessarily difficult, covering some material we've never even covered. He geared the class towards people who have taken Calc before. The lectures were extremely confusing and he over-complicated much of the material. Test averages were anywhere from 45-65%, but he does allow corrections.

He is SO helpful in office hours and will go through every question with you and make sure you understand it. The amount of extra credit means that it is 100% possible to get an A but you have to earn it. Spice is very caring and will go out of his way to help you with ANYTHING. Get to know him on a personal level because he is super great!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I couldn't understand why people didn't like him at first. His lectures are great, and I found them easy to understand and easy to learn. Unfortunately his tests are simply unreasonably hard. If you study an average amount, you can make something in the low 70s. Compared to what you are learning and what you need to know, they are just unreasonable

I had Dr. Spice for calculus 3; it was the hardest math course I've ever taken. The beginning starts out okay but then it gets worse as the semester continues. The tests are deadly. Dr. Spice moves through topics extremely quickly, and if you get behind you're stuck. He is super nice and helpful in office hours, but know what you're getting into.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Don't even think about it. His exams are impossible. The homework and quizzes are doable but seriously the exams are a different language. Just don't take him.(super nice guy though)

It's rare you have professors who go out of their way to help you as much as professor Spice. He responds to emails quickly, and has frequent, helpful office hours. His tests are hard,  but he offers different forms of extra credit. Also, he's such a good teacher that his difficulty is more than made up for. Would highly recommend!!

Dr. Spice has an undeserved bad rep. Yes, his exams are super hard, but he lets you redo the problem you received the lowest grade on for full points, which often bumped up my exam score a letter grade. If you don't understand a concept, go see him during office hours, he's really good a breaking things down and making them easier to understand.

Dr. Spice is nice and an exceptional teacher but has the hardest tests I've ever taken. He wants students to learn, is willing to help at almost any time, and offers opportunities to improve test scores when the average is low. Which is often since he seems to pride himself on inventing the most devious test questions imaginable! Hard but worth it.
His class is not easy so don't expect it to be, he expects a lot conceptually but if you study and keep up with what is going on you will be fine.

I had him for differential equations.  It was a very challenging class but you can tell he genuinely wanted us to learn the material.  He answered questions throughly and was very helpful during office hours.  When the whole class did poorly on a test he gave us the opportunity to correct the whole test and receive half the points we lost.
Worst class I have ever taken. AVOID LIKE THE PLAGUE!!!!!

The class seems to be tutored towards kids who have already taken AP calc in highschool because they all foundt his class easy. If you have taken calc go for it but if you have no calc expierence stay away. Our class had a huge divide of kids failing and kids getting A's, and it was between the kids who had and had not taken this course before.

Granted I took calculus before college but I have an A. If you actually do the HW this class is not that hard, there is no trig, just got to office hours if you need help. You are in groups for hw so you can have people to study with.
Class requires a lot of outside hours but i definitely doable.  Definitely helps if you took calc in high school. Go to office hours! and do all the homework!

Very challenging teacher, stay away from him if you have the chance. He is not very helpful with explaining the homework and the homework ends up being nothing like the tests. I took calc before this class and am still lost, he makes applied calc seem like calc 4.

class required A LOT of time outside of class. 2 homeworks and one group weekly homework due each week. he has office hours 4 times a week and you have to attend all of them if you even want a chance of passing the course.

Had him for applied Calculus. Very difficult class overall. Must stay on top of the material or you will fail. He has a lot of office hours available. Takes the basics and fundamental material and applies to problems that can be very difficult to comprehend.

Dr. Spice is a great professor. Well I didn't really like his teaching style, but the homework each week was really helpful and he gives a lot of extra credit. We have two dailies and a group weekly each week, which has a huge impact on your grade. Three Midterms plus a cumulative final. I'd recommend going to office hours. It sounds hard, but not

2 daily hw's and 1 weekly hw each week. attendance is required but none of the notes even help. must go to office hours, which he has four days a week, to even come close to passing. must offer test corrections since everyone fails the tests. nice guy but too smart to teach.

I took his Applied Calculus course, and I found it to be relatively manageable. His assignments are tough, particularly at the beginning, but he offers plenty of extra credit opportunities (including test corrections) along the way. As long as you tough out the first month and keep up with HW assignments, it's a very doable class.

The way he phrases his questions are absolutely horrible. Ask him a question and he'll reply with another question. He's never to the point and he's very difficult to understand. Test questions are never similar to the homework he assigns.

This man is ridiculous. He likes to show off how smart he is rather than using words and vocabulary his students will understand. Even sitting in his office I couldn't understand some of the words he was saying. Maybe its because he is relatively new, I don't know. The other professors are in the math department are absolutely amazing. He is not.
Homework homework homework. If you love to spend 12hours a day doing home work, take his class, you will love it.
difficult class. Lots and lots of homework.
HARD...good luck

This professor comes of as nice but DO NOT BE FOOLED. He loves to dish out homework like you have nothing else to do in your life. Plus his exams are nothing like what he teaches. He always surprises you with stuff he never taught. Office hours are useless. You will come out of his office with the same knowledge he had wen you entered. BE WARNED...
HARD. DO NOT TAKE HIM. IF YOU DO...I WARNED YOU....

He loves to give home work. He has daily AND weekly homework which requires a lot of time to complete. His exams are nothing like the stuff he teaches. If you are like Albert Einstein, take this class. If u are a smart person, working hard and just trying to make it  in life DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. This dude will destroy your GPA!!

Had him for Calc 1 and got an A+. Had him for DiffEq and got a D. EXTREMELY hard and very pointless teaching. Office hours are a waste of time because even when a technique is wrong, he will make you try it anyway and waste time.This should be a 5 hour course the way he teaches it. No matter how smart you are, DON'T DO IT. He will murder your GPA.
if you LOVE hw and love to be confused than this is your class..if not ..RUN!! don't do it.. i repeat ..DON't DO IT!!!

I hated this class! i dropped it after the first 3 week. In 3 weeks he never showed us how to work an equation and kept on giving us more and more hw without showing us how to solve the equations. He just showed off how smart he was. One of the worst math prof. i had ever had in college!

He helped me so much...I hated math but I went to his office hours weekly and managed an A with hard work. Class was kinda confusing but he'll bend over backwards to help you. I'd take another math class just to have him again. He really does care about you on a personal level as well as academic

Great professor. I took his HIST30543 class and it was not difficult. 
-3 quizzes over 3 books. Clear reading guides. Open note/book. Timed.
-One large project that is throughout the semester. There are milestones that build up. Not difficult. Counts as the final.
-5 In class object analysis. Easy.
Not a hard class, but fun if you like history.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Meier is an awesome professor. For the History Major Seminar, he demonstrated to us students that he truly cared about our research and our time. He often sent me emails with sources he thought might benefit my research. He treated every student with respect and gave them their due time and provided great feedback. My favorite professor at TCU.

This professor is a great and genuine guy, but the class structure made zero sense. There are weekly papers that are almost impossible to get an A on. He also lectures in great length about subject matter that has no correlation to the papers, midterm, and final. Terrible class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Hes g good guy/teacher. But grades very hard. Graded on weekly papers which were very difficult to get a good grade on. If you do take this class get ready for the reading.

Great guy, very good at lecturing (maybe that's just because I like history). He grades pretty easily if you know how to do what he wants, however, the assignments can get very tedious and time-consuming. If you take this class, use a P/NC on it so you can avoid wasting time doing so many weekly papers and readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --So many papers

reviews.comment: I had Meier for HIST10223 and don't regret it! History is usually boring for me, but Dr. Meier made it enjoyable. His lectures occasionally get boring, but that is because of the material, not him. If you put in effort on the weekly writing assignments and pay attention, this class is pretty easy. He is such a great, smart guy who cares about us.

One of the best professors at TCU. Cares about this students and is always available to help. Lectures are typically engaging, and he knows when he's going on a tangent and will throw in a Tupac reference or something hilarious to get everyone back on track. He assigns a lot of reading but mostly from interesting short books - no textbook.

Nice guy, but my God does he assign a lot of reading. You never get a chance to relax in this course. I'd say an average of 50 (very long) pages per class period. Even gave us a 300-page book to read for just ONE class period. If you can help it, don't take this class. My opinion would be very different if he drastically cut the assigned readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: A intellectual snob quick to critcize rather than give constructive advice
He is oddly really cute idk why. He's a passionate teacher who wants you to succeed. Papers due weekly but tests are easy if you study his lectures and take good notes during class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This is the only interesting, enjoyable history class I've ever taken. The only grades in the class are several easy quizzes and short essays. Tests are essays. He's clear about grading, so it's not a surprise that he isn't a super easy grader. Wound up with an A in the class.   Also, he's super hot and has a very attractive vocabulary.

Very smart guy, he's young and engaging! Lectures are straight-forward and there is no general textbook. You read smaller books on history instead which makes it more interesting. Keep up with the readings and prepare for the exams (80% essay) and you will do fine!

Meier comes off as he wants to help you but never really does, he kind of talks around your questions. Lectures are super boring. I felt like once he made a decision about what kind of grade you should get thats what you got. We had weekly essays and some i would work really hard on and some not so much, always received the same grade. I would avoi
Don't take the class if you don't have to.  A lot of work and a tough grader.

He is very sweet, and willing to to go the extra mile to help you. Very approachable and easy to relate to. He's kind of a dork, though. There's two tests (no final) but a rather large final paper and weekly responses. 5 of these are to full-length books, but reading is not really necessary - I only skimmed. I liked him a lot.

20th Century Britain. Very cool professor-- adorkable. Very accessible, loves to work directly with students. Would take him again. Weekly 1 page response paper on books/articles (skimmable), three short answer/essay tests, and a 10-page research paper. Keeps you engaged despite all the work. Not easy, but worth it!
He is a great teacher. Hard class but is so willing to help and very easy to approach

I took European history and I loved this class and Dr. Meier! The class was entirely discussion based so you have to do the assigned readings and use them in papers and on the midterm/final essay!! His goal is to make you a better writer so he grades the papers tough, but you generally see improvement. Overall it was tough but I enjoyed it!

Dr. Meier Seems like a nice enough guy, but it is pretty much a front.  I have sought help from him and he basically wrote me off as unintelligent because I didn't receive a stellar grade on my paper (Which he grades INCREDIBLY harshly).  I love history, but I will not take another history class at TCU because of him.  Avoid at all costs!!!!

I took British Commonwealth. It was his first time to teach it so he took our recommendations at the end. There is one mid-term test, and a research paper for the final. Also two book reports with weekly quizzes. He can be a bit long winded but is very friendly and helpful. Be prepared for LOTS of reading from the book and primary documents.

Dr. Meier is a great European History teacher. I took his Honors European History class this semester and made an A-. This class is a lot of reading and writing, and he is a pretty hard grader. Grades will get better over the semester, but it is difficult to make anything above a B+/A-.

Not too hard, but there are better teachers to take if it is just for your mandatory history core class. He will help you learn but you have to attend class. The lectures are informative and helpful for the test but not always interesting.

Not phenomenal, but good. You have to write fast to keep up and there are several books to read, but it's manageable. Nice enough guy and wants to help you. Listening to lectures is like reading a textbook. Very to the point and not very exciting, but they are clear and very educational. I recommend him if you're looking for a good Euro teacher.

Good teacher, really wants to help you learn. If you're looking for an easy A then don't take this. 2 papers and 3 tests, the tests were essay and memorization. Lots of pop quizzes so you have to go to class
What everyone else is saying. No grades inputted, no clear rubrics, no feedback, and exam reviews are NOTHING like the exam.

NEVER responds to emails or puts grades in to D2L. Incredibly unorganized and will wait till the last minute to give you instructions (that she posts in 10+ minute long videos on FRIDAY NIGHTS) for something due Sunday night. Worst professor I've had at TCU. AVOID AT ALL COSTS. If she is only teacher avail. take over summer online to avoid!!!

Be ready for zero rubrics, unclear grading criteria, and god forbid receive full credit for an assignment. Exams are lockdown in-class for Strategy, and Quizzes are lockdown out-of-class for OrgBeh. Big projects have no rubric. She acts like your friend, but can be very demeaning. Participation and attendance are mandatory. If you want an A... pray
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good professor despite some bad reviews. Quizzes were graded a little harshly but they aren't lockdown. Still made an A despite making 2 B's out of the 3 quizzes. Big on group work and projects and no homework. As long as you show up and participate in class, you'll do well. She's really nice and tries to make class fun and engaging.

Good professor, and super easy class. Only 3 quizzes and the majority of work is class-time based or group proect based. I had this class as an 8am, and I genuinely wanted to go, which is usually not common for an 8am. She was always upbeat and asking how we were, defintely made the class more fun. Also quizzes are not lockdown.

Honestly looked forward to her class in the morning. Always a chill class, and she makes lectures interesting and looks for lots of contributions. Quizzes were super easy, and the group presentation was interesting and super chill. Definitely would take her class again.

I cannot emphasize this enough- DO NOT TAKE!!! Get ready for unclear criteria and points taken off for no reason. Class is chill, but she is a VERY tough grader and does not give any instructions for assignments.

Tries to come off as cool and chill, but grades very harshly. Does not provide any instructions for project or assignments, and then takes points off for random things. Lectures felt disorganized and lacked any depth- everything was discussion based and there was never an objective. Didn't learn 1 thing. I would not take again.

She is a nice lady, tries to be the “cool” professor. She is kind and easy to listen to in class. But she won't ever give you a 100 and get ready to just get loaded with 90-93s on participatory grades. Meaning she's a hard grader and it's hard to get an a. I would take her if you can't get the 1st or 2nd option.

She is a hard grader and gives vague criteria for assignments. Rarely gives out A's. Kind of disorganized. Constantly changing the things we do in class. Spent 30 min of our final talking about things we've been talking about over the whole semester. Waste of time. I would have taken another professor if I could've.

DO NOT take Dr. Wright for Strategic Management. She makes the class a lot harder than it should be, so take any other professor because their classes are way easier. She is a tough grader, gives terrible feedback on assignments. Also, she is a very unpredictable grader and nothing ever is good enough or pleases her.

Took her for Organizational Analysis and Problem Solving. Amazing professor, but don't think this is an easy A. As other comments have mentioned, she is a very hard grader, very rarely does she give out A's. She will even tell you in week 1 not to expect a perfect grade in her class. Just do the required work and you WILL pass. Easy class overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: All tests and quizzes are online in class. Lectures are very interesting and she is a very caring professor. Participate and the class will be easy. There are occasional papers and a group project at the end. Professor Wright has genuine care for her students and just wants to see her students succeed.

Take any other teacher if you can. She is the hardest grader and does not give clear instructions on any assignment. She does not give any feedback and expects you to know what she wants on the papers. I wish I could drop this class.

favorite teacher at TCU so far. Incredibly caring, always letting students pick when they need assignments due and understands outside life. I have learned so much from her about being a leader, and how to better myself in order to preform to the best of my ability in teams and work life in general. seriously so awesome, not one bad thing to say.

Professor Wright is the best professor I've taken at TCU. Compassionate, caring, and most of all PASSIONATE about Management & you can tell. I switched my major from Marketing to Management because of her, already enrolled in other courses with her ahead. She is very conversational and the easiest person to talk to about anything. TAKE HER.
I took professor wright for business skills development and she was great. Awesome personality and made class fun. Highly recommend.

Best teacher I have ever had! She really cares about her students and makes class a comfortable environment to learn in. She is very understanding and really tries to connect with her students. I am typically a quiet student in class and am very introverted, but she made class a comfortable space to talk and participate more.
Very participation heavy. Doesn't like to "give out As". I complete every assignment fully and correctly and never get an A. Only take her if you're fine not getting an A.

Dr. Wright is one of the most caring professors I have ever encountered. She relates her class to the workforce and life really well. She very clearly demonstrates the value of the class. Most classes are a lecture with class presentations. If you participate in class she will like you. I would recommend taking her.

I wish I took a different professor for this class. I like her as a person but not as a prof. The class is very participation heavy and she grades her assignments very strictly. I would try to always speak in class and follow exactly the guide to do my assignments and I did not do as well as I thought I should have. Take another teacher if you can.
Dr. W is a nice caring professor. She tried to make sure you understand the underlying reason behind everything we did in class. It could get confusing sometimes as for grading and instructions.

I really enjoyed the content in this class however, this professors grading was ridiculous. She grades VERY hard and hardly EVER gives a perfect score. Her instructions on assignments were very vague but then she would penalize you for not following instructions. If you have the option to take someone else, I would.

Professor Wright is an amazing professor to learn from! Course is structured very well with engaging lectures. She makes an effort to get to know her student's names and engages.Grades are composed of mainly a midterm and final, mostly multiple choice with some short answers. Also a book project at the end. Changed my major to mgmt because of her.

He's super nice and a great guy. This class in general is just boring, he makes it more enjoyable though. There are daily quizzes based on the lecture from the last class and that is considered your attendance for the day, and other than that not much goes in the grade book except for a few projects and the mid term and final

100% take Morman if you can!! I've taken 3 of his classes and genuinely enjoyed all of them. He is such a kind professor and truly cares about all of his students. He lectures every class but always makes it super engaging and entertaining. If you go to class you'll get a good grade! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

TAKE HIS CLASS. The best professor I have ever had. Actually look forward to his class. Super engaging and interesting class. Every class starts with a quiz from the previous classes lecture but its common sense. If you can, definitely take this class.
A really sweet professor who genuinely cares about his students. Lectures every day, but he makes them very engaging and personable. I would recommend taking him if you can.
He is the best teacher. He has the sweetest heart and soul and really cares about his students. He is willing to go out of his way to make sure you understand. Recommend this teacher 100%

Best teacher I have ever had. Being able to go to his class was the biggest gift. He is SUCH a valuable asset to TCU and my experience would not have been the same without him. He changed my entire perspective on life and truly cared about every student. He has lowk restored my faith in the world.
Hands down best professor I have had at TCU. He is truly amazing, so kind and caring. I love his lectures and actually look forward to going to his class. Amazing person and an even better professor.

The easiest class I have ever taken at TCU and the sweetest professor on earth!!!!! I highly recommend, yes there are papers due every week but they are over personal experiences which makes them super easy to write about and also just use chat GPT for help. I really recommend this class!!

Professor Morman is incredible. His lectures last the whole class, but if you follow along you can learn something new each class. His exams and homework are all based off of his lectures, and he will make sure you have all of the information ahead of time so you are prepared. If you go to class and do your work it's impossible to not get an A.

My favorite class EVER, hands down. Mark is one of the best profs I've ever had, he is hilarious, cares about his students, and makes you want to come to class & learn the material! Quizzes were easy and helpful to recap content from the previous class. Tests line up exactly with the lectures, and study guides are super helpful!

He always made class super fun and the content was easy to understand with the examples he would give. Mark makes it to where you WANT to come to class, and his lectures line up perfectly with exams and the daily quizzes. 100% would take this class with him again!

Mark is the best!! Took him for Interpersonal and ended with a 97 because his lectures perfectly line up with the tests! His lectures feel long but he is so funny so they are entertaining. Definitely the most i've ever learned in a class at TCU and really set me up for success as a COM major. HIGHLY recommend Mark!

Dr. Morman is an incredible professor who genuinely cares about his students. He loves it when everyone participates in the conversation but won't force you to talk. He often lectures the entire class, but it's interesting and fun if you participate. The tests are breezy if you take the time to study the study guide he provides. Highly recommend!
There was a serve language barrier so understanding him was very difficult, as well as understand the wording of the exams. The book is required but not used as often as a resource as it should be.

The class lectures are very heavy, but he is very willing to further explain any material that we, as a class, were unsure of. I have also met with him one-on-one to seek advice on study strategies and to ask questions about material I was confused about. He wants each individual to succeed in the class!
DO NOT TAKE. Our entire class is failing. I genuinely don't know how he is still a professor. He does not care if we do terribly. very sweet old man but should not still be a professor here!!

Do not take him. Very hard to follow lectures, uses his own textbook that is required. We were all about to fail his class so he had to make the last 2 tests open note (which doesn't actually help that much...). This is not a class you want to take if you want above a C+ or B- (literally everyone dropped this class or is failing it)

I can confidently say this is both the worst professor and hardest class I have ever taken. Other psych professors talk down on him. The College of Science and Engineering literally changed the requirements so that you don't have to take him anymore. Please I'm begging you, don't put yourself through this.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Papini isn't evil, he is a nice guy. Unfortunately, he doesn't care if you live or die on his tests. You will not do well. If you're a straight A student, prepare for a C. If you're a senior with one semester left, pray. He really isn't a bad guy. It's an exam only class and over 80% of the class got below an 80%. That is the truth of this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Your grade relies solely off of 5 exams, plus an additional 5% EC for attendance. He genuinely is an amazing professor, be prepared to apply yourself as the content is difficult, but he is more than willing to help his students because his passion for this subject is so evident. TAKE THIS CLASS OVER ANY OTHER IN AREA B.

Your class is going to be hard, but it is SO worth it. Dr.Papini is so helpful if you just ASK questions in office hours. He is one of the smartest professors I have ever had. I know the class is intimidating, but if you go in with the mindset you have to work hard it will work out I promise. 
ITS EASIER THAN SO MANY OTHER COURSES IN THE AREA!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
Dr. Papini is one of the best professors I have had at TCU. 

Yes, the class is super hard. It's stuff you have probably never learned before but he is SUCH a good teacher. He cares SO MUCH about his students and his office hours are SO helpful. He actually really wants his students to do good and is so intelligent. TAKE HIS CLASS.

Like someone else said, I did not find him as terrible as the earlier reviews made him out to be. He's actually nice and funny in his own way and genuinely cares about the content. That being said, doing well requires showing up, reading the textbook, and studying. Graded entirely on tests/attendance, you must study for tests. B is very achievable.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Everyone makes him sound so BAD. He's not evil, he's actually really sweet. I only really read the textbook for studying and I got a solid B on every exam. Motivation is a complex topic, you do actually have to try in this class. He gives extra credit for attendance. His exams are not impossible, they are reasonable if you apply yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I know a lot of students don't share my sentiments but I really liked this class. The only grades in this class were his exams which were 40 multiple choice questions. I thought that they were fair and easy enough if you paid attention and class and did the readings. You also get extra credit just for showing up and it equates to an extra 5%.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tests are unnecessarily difficult and lecture is not helpful. You get extra credit for attending, but he focuses on content that is not needed. The textbook is helpful, but the chapters are incredibly long. I heard from multiple classmates that they were failing the course. The material is interesting, but the course is not. Avoid if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
- only uses test grades
- no extra credit 
- everyone dropped
- tests made no sense, questions were all confusing 
- he didn't care that we did poor in the class
- I got one of the highest grades on the 1st test and it was a 63
- out of 30 something students only 6 finished the course

This is the worst class I have ever taken in my four years at TCU. Dr. Papini is unhelpful, dismissive, and disrespectful to students. I have never had a professor act as if they want their students to fail until I took this class. I knew this class would be difficult but it was also demeaning and ironically, demotivating. Do not take!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved this class! The content was super interesting and Papini makes it easy to understand. Your grade depends upon the five exams you get throughout the semester but if you pay attention during the lectures and read through the corresponding chapters in his textbook, you will do well. Studying is required!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Papini is a super nice guy, but his class is definitely a challenge. There's a lot of reading from the textbook and even though attendance isn't mandatory, it's best not to miss out on them to prepare for the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: a nice guy but awful professor. he offered no curves and made his whole grading on 5 exams and his questions on those exams were SO VAGUE. hard to understand him and in order to pass the class you literally have to read the whole textbook because his exam questions come mostly from the textbook not the lectures that he talks about the whole time.

Comparative psych was by far the hardest class I've ever taken. The content of this class makes no sense, and you need to know everything that he says in class and the entire book (which he wrote) for the exams. 5 exams and that's your grade, no curves. The tests are impossible and it is so frustrating, do NOT take this class.

He lectures all class, every class and it's not clear what material is on the exams. 5 exams make up 100% of your grade and half of our class dropped this year before the drop deadline. He is a super nice man but would not recommend his class at all.

Papini is the hardest and worst professor I've to date. His exams are ridiculously difficult, vague, and poorly worded, and are the only way to get points. At least 60% of the class failed the first two. He's very quiet, so it's hard to hear in his lectures, and the assigned textbook is his own. If you value your sanity, skip this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I am currently in his comparative psychology class and this may be the hardest class I have ever taken. He does not grade on a curve or give out study guides for his tests. The only way to earn points in his class is through exams. I honestly wish he gave us homework because maybe most of his students would do better in his class.

DO NOT EVER TAKE A CLASS WITH PAPINI. There is a reason his classes are always the last few that are open during registration. Currently taking him and we just took our second exam which over half our class failed. I have never felt more stupid in a class and if you don't sit in the front you may as well skip because you can't hear a word he says
Good guy

Have to agree with how difficult this class is. His tests are VAGUE and if you didn't read the book, pay close attention to his lectures, ask a lot of questions, you will have a hard time passing. I made a C in this class, and it's my first C in my college career. Record lectures, print the slides, or just take class with a different professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I have never rated a professor before but I felt the need to. I received my first C of my college career as a senior in his motivation class and unfortunately had comparative with him as well and had to drop it along with 1/3 of the class. His tests are impossible and he does not offer any other graded opportunities. Would not recommend.

Do not take this class or any other taught by him and save yourself the trouble. I took his class and I regret it very much. He is the worst professor teaching at TCU, the tests are impossible to do well on and if you have questions on how to do well, good luck because it must be your fault and not his.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Worst class I've taken at TCU. Has no office hours so you can't ask questions. Can't even teach yourself the material because he wrote the textbook for the course and it also makes little sense. Each test is 40 multiple choice questions but impossible to study because of all the useless information you're given in lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Papini is quiet and his accent is hard to understand but he is brilliant. If you show interest in the class he will definitely grade you easier. Always sit on the first 2 rows though so you can hear him. I would study the day of the tests and made an A.

Dr. Papini is very productive in publishing and has an above average intelligence.  He surpasses his colleagues and should be teaching at an Ivy League university where he would be supported and recognized for his accomplishments.
Hated it, boring and hard
No Comments

This class was not for my major and I have other courses with heavy courseload, because of how much of the class is weighed on one project that I was late to submit my grade got ruined. I emailed her to communicate with her what happened, but I never received a response. So beware that she NEVER responds to emails when you need her to the most.

SUCH AN AMAZING PROF! You can tell that she truly cares about her students. Her exams are a little challenging however if you prepare than you will be fine! She lets you know what subjects are on them in advance.
She is a great professor and very passionate - her class was not too hard but you need to review your notes to get an A, but the content she teaches is interesting and she uses engaging examples.

Currently in PSYCH 10213. Took this class as a senior needing general credits. However, I have spent more time on psych than any class that is in my business major. Maybe I just don't like psychology as a subject, but I have never enjoyed a class less than this one. I have actually studied and gotten very poor grades on both exams.

Dr. O is so amazing, she makes a meaningful connection with each of her students since the class size is smaller. Her feedback on our paper was always clear and she was very helpful no matter how many questions you have. We had one paper that we worked on throughout the semester and we had many classes dedicated to working on it. 100% recommend her

Absolutely loved him for natural history. Genuinely so sweet and kind and is there for you to learn and actually get something out of the class. Lab assignments are manageable and actually help learn the material and open ended questions on exams. Couldn't recommend more!
Professor Sawey is awesome!

He is a kind person and overall good and knowledgeable professor and a lot of the complaints are not his fault. TCU is forcing the in-person exams and trust me I hate having to take a science course too but you can thank core curriculum. This is probably the easiest NSC credit but just be aware that you will have to take exams on Lockdown Browser!
These class tests are on very niche topics, and they're back in person, and they're hard for no reason. DO NOT TAKE!
In person and Lockdown browser Exams are back

This lecture was always fun. Bio is usually hard, but he made it fun. Attendance is mandatory, and the textbook quiz is graded but super easy. All exams are taken at home for the lecture, but lab ones are in person.

Lab is very easy! Attendance is mandatory, and there's a group assignment in every lab. Tests are in person but very straightforward if you go through the study guide + slides beforehand, and go to TA's office hours if you need help. Very easy to get an A if you put in just a little effort!

Prof Sawey was great! Overall grade is combined with your lab grade! There's a 5-question quiz due before each lecture (very easy) & 3 tests, including a final, and they're not difficult if you go to class. There's 2 attempts, and they're take-home. Attendance is mandatory and part of your grade. Lectures are entertaining, and you learn a lot.

Tests are online except lab tests. Lab tests are pretty simple and very logical. Not a tough class to get an A and I'm not good at science. Lectures participation is important but you can join them online from anywhere, so it's not really a problem.

Dr. Sawey is amazing - such fun and entertaining lectures. Textbook needed for taking lecture quizzes but they are easy, and tests are online. Just be sure to go to lab (also easy), and you'll be good! Lecture slides are posted but usually have fill in the blanks, but this course overall is so easy and interesting!

He was really chill, and as long as you attend all your labs, you're good. Most of the lectures you can do from your dorm, just get someone to send you the access code for the class. Very nice person and a great professor!

He takes attendance based off of who is logged into his lecture so as long as someone send you the code you are chill. He is the BEST teacher to take for this course. He made the lectures supper engaging and enjoyable. Exams and finals are all online.

I loved Professor Sawey. He made his lectures interesting most of the time and I actually learned some things I never knew. I got a good grade in his class and he's just a funny, caring guy. I recommend taking his class for bio, it was chill and wasn't too stressful for me with all the other classes I had going on in the semester. :)

For starters, I don't like Bio. That being said this is probably one of the easier and more engaging NSC classes you could take. Exams are not at all bad they come straight from lectures and labs. All I did to study was walk through slides and just put everything into my own words then quiz myself on quizlet. Overall great class and professor!

I had a great experience. Exams are not meant to trick you and he pulls exam questions straight from his lectures. He is SO nice and very easy to get ahold of outside of class. Whenever I had a question he emailed me back right away. I have always hated biology but Sawey made it super interesting and relatable! I would 100% take this class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is a must take! I was nervous coming into bio after not taking it for several years and it was far more engaging than in high school! Prof. Sawey was very accommodating during the course and really wanted us to succeed. If you need a NSC credit, look no further!! Excellent course overall!

Not worth taking the class anymor Should be an easy A  but it isn't They wanna make the class hard for no reason by having in person lockdown exams which is crazy because every student is in the class for the NSC credit not to learn bio Labs are also a joke and unnecessary for the class. They want to get students in trouble for the use Ai stay away
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Okay so basically I kind of cheated the system. You don't really have to go to class if someone can give you the code to the lecture. DONT DO THAT. Go to class and take notes because the exams are not open note and are randomly generated. He is very excited about his teaching. If you go to class and study you should be good. I P/NC and passed.

HE COMPLETELEY CHANGED HOW HE HAS DONE IT PREVIOUS YEARS. First of all the labs are a waste of time, it feels like im in 8th grade . Second his lectures is just him talking over a powerpoint that doesnt even relate to the exams. Its 3 exams all in lab except for the final. The questions have no reference to the text book and is majority true/false.

All exams are now in-person and lockdown browser. He just reads off of slides for the entire lecture and VERY fast at that. Three exams that cover 8 chapters at a time plus four labs, it is literally impossible to take in and remember all of the information. Trying to study is impossible. No study guides or guidance. I would avoid this class!

I would not take this class. You could study for hours and the test are still hard and all in person. They are true or false questions that all seem true and so niche even if you understand the material it still is extremely difficult one of the toughest classes of my life because of the test. Fade but good lectures.

Do NOT take this class! The tests are so hard, and he makes the questions so niche. The tests are online, lockdown browser, and once you answer a question, you can't go back to change it. The professor is really nice, but this class is not worth taking.
BTW guys.... I know your'e registering rn, and the exams are no longer online! They are in person and you only get one attempt. They are not super hard but do require A LOT of studying!

BIOL 30613: This class was absolutely amazing, take it if you need an easy A. All the tests are online, there's one group project and a field trip! I had an amazing experience with Dr. Sawey and would defintely recommend others take him and this class!

Easiest A ever!!! All exams are online, including the final. You have daily online quizzes that are straight out of the textbook. Attendance is mandatory, but you don't have to pay attention in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Sawey is the easiest professor at TCU. Has weekly quizzes for both lecture and lab that are open note. 3 lecture exams that are online, at home, and you get two attempts, and 2 lab exams that are in-person. Hardest part is lab exams, but study guide is provided. Take this for your science credit!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is super engaging and makes every lecture really fun. All of the things he talks about are very interesting and applicable to everyday life. It is one of the few classes that I have taken that I can apply to most of my life. There is a lot of reading in this class, but most of it is really easy to read and very interesting.

Great class! Definitely recommend for a science credit, weekly quizzes are easy as well as the online exams. The class was interesting and I genuinely enjoyed it. Labs were also super simple and we often times left after 30 min.

Super super easy credit. 2 quizzes outside of class per week easy 100, attendance but lectures are interesting and he is funny which makes it easy. Topics are very surface level. No need to study for tests, got all 95+ with no studying. Lab is also easy and requires no outside work. strongly recommend
Good overall, and makes it clear what he expects. All grades are online and very easy to get 100s on. Only thing is he can be a little hard to understand at times.

He's a nice professor that makes his class interesting. The only thing that I didn't like about this class was the tests. They were a little to difficult because most of the questions are free free-response and he grades hard on each question. If his tests were multiple choice this class would be perfect. Overall he's a great professor.

This man is absolutely hilarious and kind-hearted. He loves what he is teaching and you can tell as soon as he begins lecture. His lectures were always entertaining, and I do not usually enjoy science this much. The hardest part of this class was the lab, taught by the TA, that he could not control. The tests are a little hard so study.

He is a little hard to understand but easy overall. You get two lab skips and an extra credit opportunity for 100 points which is the amount of a lab. if there is one thing to take away from this class, submit every lab as a PDF or else you get an automatic 0. Really easy grader for the most part.

If you need a natural science take this class. It is so easy and all the tests are online on your own time the day of. There is not a lot of reading or homework and you get 4 absenses. His lectures are pretty engaging and interesting. Sometimes the labs were a little boring but overall this was a super easy and pretty interesting class.

Definitely take if you just need a natural science! Super easy as long as you follow the syllabus and do your lecture and lab hw before class. All tests are online and straight out the online textbook. Super sweet and funny teacher too!

I love this class! Professor Sawey makes it so fun and engaging. There are three tests that are online. There are two online quizzes per week which take about 5 minutes. He makes lectures fun and is great at his job!

Like other people have said, if you are looking for a NSC class and looking for good professors... just stop. Enroll in him asap. Labs are all TA's and its easy group work every time. Just a goatted prof, and easy class

Super nice guy and super easy class. Online quizzes and exam that are so easy. He does take participation through the online text every lecture though so make sure you don't miss. You also learn a lot of actually relevant science stuff too which was cool. Overall, definitely one of the best and easiest natural science credit classes at TCU.

You are disservicing yourself if you don't take Sawey for NCS credit. There are 4 exams all taken on your own time on a designated day on a lockdown browser (no camera). The final is not cumulative. Uses an engagement feature during class, but attendance is not mandatory. The lab is so easy. Homework assignments take 5 mins and are all on quizlet.

I took Contemporary Issues in Biology with him in Spring 2023. The class was lecture based with short online readings and 5 question quizzes due before the class. He makes sure to keep students engaged. His tests are taken online at your own time the day of the exam. Although they are long, they are pretty easy if you stay caught up on work.

Had him for contemporary issues in biology lecture. He is super kind and very passionate about biology. Does a really good job using visuals in his lectures and tries his hardest to keep us engaged. Not a hard A, just online quizzes before each lecture and lab and 4 tests (including the final).

Sawey's lectures were always hilarious and I was always learning. We had quizzes before each class, participation polls, and Tests are big chunk of grade but online/out of class and 2 attempts. Interactive teaching style and we were always entertained in class! Def recommend taking for natural science core!

Professor Sawey is an AMAZING professor with very interesting and relatable lectures. He is funny and doesn't make the class feel so serious. All tests are taken outside of class on lockdown. Your grade is made up of the tests (kind of hard), text book quizes (taken online outside of class), and participating in the pulls during class.
Makes lectures interesting. 4 exams and simple quizzes due before each class. Lab was also simple and interesting. Highly recommend for a natural science credit.
He has great lectures. Attendance is based on participation through online polls. Material is interesting and he is very funny and good speaker.
Take Sawey. Guys legit. Barely did anything and ended with an A. Nuff said.

I really enjoyed this class! Professor Sawey is super funny and helpful. 4 tests that are 75% of the grade. Tests are online and 100 questions in an hour. Labs aren't horrible if you find a good group to stick with. If you study for the tests you will be fine.

This class is recommended because the atmosphere is pleasant and the instructor strives to keep students engaged. He does a good job of disseminating the material, as the quizzes are simple and the exams are not particularly difficult.

He is super chill and super nice. I enjoy his class a lot. All the tests are online and so are the quizzes, I would download the power points in advance though because he talks pretty fast. Great class to take for science CORE credit

He is great! So nice and was very understanding when I had a family emergency right before the finals. Only homework is online textbook readings and a short quiz before each lecture and lab. Do all of them, study for the tests, and you will get a good grade. Lab is easy and there is almost never work outside of class for it.

Took this for my natural science core credit this summer. So soo happy I did, and honestly would've loved to hear his lectures in person. He makes biology so fun and interesting and that's coming from a journalism major and someone who was dreading taking this. Lecture and lab quizzes with readings due before every lecture, but so easy if you read
Easy NSC credit - hes so funny too. Tests are online and take home

Super nice professor. He livestreamed the class so not everyone came to class every day but if you take notes from the powerpoints and study a little, the exams are super easy. Definitely recommend for an easy natural science credit.

Great class, highly recommend taking it because its an easy core class. You have to take a quiz before every class but its basically open note. Then the test are lock down browser but as long as you study and have notes you will be fine.
In online class his lectures were simple and straight to the point. I liked his teaching style, good prof.

Easy class just go to the lectures and take notes. Sawey is very understanding + lots of dad jokes. I took it online so it might be a little harder in person but everyone agrees this class is easy. Very test heavy so you need to study but he teaches the material well and he is such a great professor! Knowledgable and approachable

Sawey is such a sweet and caring professor. It is clear that he is passionate about the subject and his lectures are interesting. However, his tests are incredibly hard even if you study. I ended up P/NC this class because I tried so hard on tests and kept getting the same grade.

Professor Sawey was very kind and polite, had great jokes, and kept class interesting. The class was basically a PowerPoint that he just went through and posted before class. Tests are very easy and just the info on the powerpoints and common sense. Super easy, you don't really even have to go to class, just look at the slides.
Amazing professor, his lectures are nice and you learn if you pay attention. Tests are really easy if you do the homework. Recommend this class if you need the credit

Love Mr. Sawey. Great professor with tons of knowledge. The lectures he teaches are very interesting and not too difficult to understand. This is a great class to take if you aren't a bio major and want to get your core credit.
you have to show up bc he has clicker quizzes. His lectures are great, and he is really funny. He helps a lot during office hours.
Easy B, makes you work for the A. Must go to lecture to get clicker points. Lab is an easy A if you go every time. It helped my lecture grade.

Mr. Sawey is really cool professor. He made classes more interesting because he's super funny. However, his tests you need to really prepare for. They're very heavy on info from the numerous powerpoints. You won't get by in this class by just reviewing them.

The exams are hard but he posts all of his powerpoints online so thats good for studying. You have to use your clicker every day and the readings are sometimes annoying for before class. If you like bio you will do great. If you dont like it so much you may have to work harder for an A.
His exams are incredibily difficult and he wont test you what he taught you
The tests start out hard, but then get easier. It's important to do well on the first 2 tests so that you don't receive a bad grade.

He has good lectures and he posts them online which is helpful. The tests are worth a lot and they cover a lot of material so if you want to do well it is best to start studying the week before. Other than that his class is pretty chill and he is a nice guy, I recommend taking him for science credit or any biology course.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: So funny, great professor

He is really amazing and is passionate about what he lectures. The only part of this class that I would approach with caution is studying. You NEED to study about a week ahead because most tests have 6-9 lectures on them. The lab that corresponds is really easy. He is really funny and awesome

This teacher is very good at explaining the course material. He gives out weekly readings before class and quizzes you through clicker questions. He gives you all the information and slides and very little additional notes are needed. The class was fun and educational.

Sawey was great for getting my non-major science out of the way. I am in no way good at science related things and this class was a solid B just by listening in class. I didn't study for the first two tests and made an 80, and after studying the next two tests were A's. super easy if you listen and study a little. super nice guy and class.

Sawey is such a great teacher, his lectures are interesting and he's so funny! Attendance is required unless you have someone take your clicker for you, however, all his lectures are put online. Should get an A if you put in the effort and study not the day before, otherwise suuuuper easy B!

Very straight-forward teacher, only uses powerpoint and lectures to teach. He gives good real life examples and really only talks about real-world applicable material. His tests are pretty straightforward, only multiple choice, but are pretty extensive. Each of the tests have a lot of material on it, but he doesn't ask tricky questions.

do not take this class!!! this class is usually taken by non science majors to fulfill a science credit, save yourself and take an easier class like geology or something. tests are ridiculously hard and detailed, he uses really unfair questions, and tries to confuse you on tests. i havent learned anything from the class other than how much i hateit
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is a great professor! Very nice and funny guy. He keeps the lectures interesting. Grade is based on participation via iClickers, labs, lab quizzes, and tests. His lectures are consistent and he knows what he is talking about.

Like everyone else has already said, Mr. Sawey is awesome!! His class was probably the most fun and interesting class I've ever had. His tests come straight from the powerpoints, so be sure to study those. The first test is the hardest, so be sure and keep up as best you can. My lab TA sucked horribly but that's not really his fault! Manageable A.

One of the best teachers at TCU! He is so funny and makes the lectures SO interesting. All you need to do is show up (print the powerpoints out before class), listen, and reread the powerpoints to study for tests. Lots of my friends struggled with this course (as in, it wasn't an "easy A") but as long as you listen you will be great!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Since the class is in a lecture hall, if you need help, seeking it outside of class is the only way to do it. Professor Sawey is goofy and gives good lectures. Go to class to answer the clicker questions because that adds up in the end. Tests are multiple choice and not too difficult if you review the lecture notes.
I LOVE SAWEY! So sweet and helpful. I hate science and got an A in the class. The format of his tests are tricky but other than that I really enjoyed this class.

His Contemporary issues in biology is the easiest way to get a natural sciences credit. If you completely avoid HW and studying for tests, you'll pass, probably by a decent margin. Has in class quizzes but they're super easy and count for little. If you study and do the (minuscule amount of) reading, you'll get high marks

Sawey is super funny and makes the lectures interesting. Attendance isn't mandatory but there are iclicker questions every day that count towards your grade. The tests are not that easy because they are mostly truefalse questions and they include material from not only the lectures but also labs.

This class is easy to get a BC, but hard to get an A. I worked hard in the lecturelab to get an A in the class. I would recommend doing the extra credit assignment, this is what brought me from B to A. Tests are manageable, ?'s come primarily from lecture, but also from reading, lab and lab readings. Interesting class and I recommend it.

HES AMAZING! Take him for contempt issues, he is literally an angel and the class is so easy if you go and pay attention. He is super nerdy and so funny which made the class so much fun. There are 4 tests which are his power points from class. During the power points he gives quizzes that are easy A's. Absolutely take this class if you need a core!

4 exams (including final). Easy lab. Gives study guides for some tests. Super goofy and fun. Requires iClicker 2, which is used to take quizzes during class so he knows who isisn't in class. Doesn't require textbook, assigns short articles to read online for every class. Each class is 0.50% of grade, each lab is 0.62% of grade. Lots of athletes

Sawey is amazing. He is there to educate students about current topics and knows to put it in a way that is interesting. I've learned so much from him so far and he is one of my favorite profs I've ever had. Inspires you to be aware of your surroundings and yourself and teaches in a non-bias way.

No textbook. All from lecture that he posts online and lab. Attendance is important because you use iClicker. Mr. Sawey has been my favorite core professor thus far. The class focuses on already interesting issues and he makes the more interesting. Interactive, funny, approachable, and knowledgable!

Sawey is the man. Will not bump you up, but provided lots of EC. Most students are borderline B/C and choose to Pass/Fail. I'm getting a C most likely, but it has nothing to do with him. Follow PowerPoints to the T and you'll get a B for sure. Study a little harder and you can get an A.
This class was actually pretty interesting. And I really like prof Sawey, he is very fair and helps you when you need it. Definitely the easiest science class you can take.

Really enjoyed his class...tests were easy if you studied and questions came right off the powerpoint. Attendance isn't mandatory but you get a grade for questions answered with and iClicker everyday. Easy class overall.

Contemp. Issues is literally the easiest science class you can take. I took the class as P/NC and even just studying the ppt. the night before for an hour I made 90's on the exams. Attendance is through the iclicker over previous lectures and readings but super easy points for your grade. Labs are annoying but easy. Don't buy the book.

Enjoyed going to class everyday and listening to his lectures. He gives you all of his power points and he is very clear in explaining. Clicker points for going to class. Lab is boring but very easy and you usually get out an hour early. Definitely recommend Sawey for Contemp. Issues to anyone seeking a Natural Science Credit.

He is such a funny teacher and makes lectures fun! Definitely go to class because you get clicker points! I had to work for my A, but it is very attainable. Lab is boring but its pretty easy points so make sure you go! I recommend this teacher for sure!
Sawey was hilarious! His lectures were always interesting, and the lab portion was easy. As long as you study the powerpoints, you shouldn't have any issues with the tests.

Mr. Sawey was a great professor! He made sure everyone understood the requirements. Make sure to go to class everyday because he does clicker questions that give you extra credit throughout the semester. You have to make sure you understand the questions he asks because they are tricky! No cumulative final either!

For someone who is bad at science take this class. he is one of the best professors ive ever had, makes class interesting and is always upbeat. he has clicker questions everyday so don't miss class. the lab is taught by a TA and theres a short quiz at the beginning, super easy if you read before. DONT BUY THE BOOK you dont need it.

Sawey is legit, goofy, but he knows his stuff. Clas is easy, just show up to class, you dont even have to pay attention though. Lab's are easy and taught by TA's just remember to study for the quizzes in the LAB. And for test all you do is study the PP he puts online

Sawey has one of the best teaching styles I have ever seen. Very upbeat and for the most part easy to understand. You have to go to class. Lab is done in a comp lab..VERY easy.
