Tests were the hardest part and were worth I want to say like 75%. Interesting class but not an easy A. Sawey is a great guy, funny too.
Contemporary issues in Bio is really easy. Show up to class, listen and go to lab. You do not even need to take notes because he puts everything.

Great guy. Class 10% of grade and lab 15 % of grade so have to go to those. Tests are easy just read powerpoints like 10 times before and get an A. had an 88 and bumped me up to an A for final so sawey is the man. Never rated before but had to for this guy cus he deserves it. Take this class!!

Sawey is such a sweetheart! Daily attendance is crucial (short quiz at beginning of class but they're super easy and you also use iclickers for a participation grade). Lecture material is really interesting. Lab can be tricky. With a little effort and regular class attendance, an A is definitely achievable

He is an amazing professor! I enjoyed going to class because it was so interesting! He is a great professor and puts a lot of effort into helping his students. His tests are a bit challenging, but they are fair. You will do fine if you study the powerpoint and go to class.

Very interesting class, Mr. Sawey really cares about the well-being of his students, willing to help. Go to every class and do well on quizzes, tests aren't too bad but definitely have to know it. Lab quizzes were harder.

Great natural science credit. Pretty easy. gives you information that every person should have. You dont have to be a science person to get it. You can easily make an A but you have to go to every class because attendance is mandatory and there are (easy) quizes every class.

Mr. Sawey is a great teacher but the class itself is a lot of material. I got a B and I went to class every day. Btw there is a quiz every single class- its his attendence. The tests are very difficult so you have to study them a lot. hes a great guy and you do learn so i would take him again if i needed another biology credit. good thing i dont.

Great Teacher! He really cares about what he is doing and cares about your success as a student. The lab for this class was pointless, but he said they are in the process of making it better. Test are difficult if you don't study. Go to class and listen, and you'll do fine. I would strongly reccommend him.

Fantastic teacher. I hate science, but his class is awesome.  only lecture hall class this semester, but it was alot of fun. tests seem hard at first, but study powerpoints! highly recommend this teacher.

You do have to study for tests and come to class, but compared to astronomy it's a walk in the park. Material is straight forward and I learn useful stuff all the time. It's my favorite class this semester b/c lectures are so fun!

Sawey is so awesome! Science is my worst subject but Sawey makes it fun. I actually love going to class! Lectures are really interesting and he has a really cute daughter that he brings up a lot. Great way to get your science credit.

Professor Sawey is a great bio teacher...I hate science and he made the class interesting and easy to understand. No textbook is used, just articles to read. Has quizzes everyday, so go to class!! Very nice guy, very helpful.
Mr. Sawey is my favorite professor at TCU so far! He is so passionate about teaching and is always in a great mood! He cracks jokes and keeps the material fun. I HATE science, but LOVED this class :)

Take Sawey for your NSC credit! Very nice man! It's all applicable knowledge too!The tests might seem hard at first but you get used to them and they are a breeze by the end. Lab is easy too. Any diligent student who does the readings and comes to class for the quizzes will get an A no problem. I acutally enjoyed coming to class and I hate science!

Michael Sawey is great! You take a three question quiz every class over easy readings. Teaches from PowerPoint, but you will not be bored. This class is designed for non-science majors, but this is stuff you'll actually need to know about. Very willing to help. Lab is required with class, which isn't oo bad. Overall, Sawey gets an A+!

Take Sawey! He is the nicest, sweetest guy and he only teaches what he thinks will be interesting to you. There's no textbook, and he gives easy 3-question quizzes almost every class, so it's good to show up. I highly recommend him.
Great teacher - a lot of fun and made learning interesting!

Amazing guy! He is funny, interesting, and makes class super enjoyable. EASY A! Just do the short readings and study your notes a little. HIGHLY RECOMMEND! And I really gained so much applicable knowledge!

I love this man. He is quirky, funny, and adorable! He is passionate about what he teaches which makes it interesting to learn. The material is easy and actually applies to life. Quizzes everyday but they aren't bad. Tests aren't terrible and he is willing to do ANYTHING to help. Plus he offers extra credit. take him for contemp. issues!

Great teacher, easy class. He will work with you as much as you need. He is very understanding. Downside: quiz everyday, but if you do the short readings you will make 100's on all of them. Funny teacher! Take him!!!!

He is into what he does. If you need help he will help you, or stop in a lecture the answer questions. Tests are difficult if you dont KNOW the information. Attendance not required, but there is a quiz every day.

Sawey is adorably awkward.  He loves what he's teaching and puts forth a great deal of effort to make the information accessible to anyone, not just Bio majors.  Anyone who wants to do the work (read the article before class, and look over your notes once in a while) can make a solid B or higher, no problem. Good sense of humor!
BIS with Nelson is so easy. The exams aren't that bad, as long as you have a decent understanding of the content and know what he is looking for in the short answer.

nice guy, class sort of sucks tho and is a waste of time. exam #1 is really hard so expect to do bad on it but exam too is way easier and the average was a 92. group project themed class so hope you get a good group, 95% of the class is getting an B to A-, honestly not possible to get a A+
I dont know whats up with all these comments, hes a great teacher and very empathetic, a super nice guy and great teacher
The group project is a big part of your grade. The class is straightforward and there are lots of article reading assignments. I think he's a great professor for BIS.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Nelson is a great guy and he is such an easy grader. Easy 100s on presentation and only had 3 exams and a final in the gradebook. Tests are tough but all BIS classes have tough tests. If you can't get Bradley take Nelson
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: you will get a grade if you do the assigned readings. Stay on top of the group project and ask him questions.
Uncaring grader with repetitive reading assignments every week
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Overall, Dr. Nelson is a super sweet man and very willing to help you learn. The class is just a hard class, and the tests were difficult to understand and study for. I think the second test we took the average was a 74. The entire semester you spend working on one group project that makes up a majority of your grade. He grades you harsh on it.

This class was pretty chill and easy. Nelson changed the test to be multiple choice this semester, so the test were much easier than before (from what I heard). Semester-long group project that is worth a lot. Attendance is mandatory.

Professor Nelson is a great professor for BIS. There is one big group project throughout the semester but he helps you stay on top of things so you know what to expect. He is really passionate about the subject. His tests aren't too difficult if you do the readings. I found the class really interesting and Prof Nelson made it very enjoyable.

Prof Nelson is extremely smart & a great professor. He explains material well and will help you if you need it. This class is not hard and you spend a lot of time working with your group throughout the semester on your project. Would've gotten an A if it weren't for the SQL exam, which was completely my fault. Study & stay on top of your project
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Good professor and teaches class material well. You will do well in this course by completing easy homework assignments, studying for exams, and working on group project. I had a good group that worked on the major group project with me so that helped me a lot. Easy to communicate with by email and always responded to me.

He is a nice guy and makes a boring class enjoyable. The class is test-heavy but does have HW that is completion graded, so free 100%. An A is achievable if you just go to class, do the work, and try to study a little for tests. Class is an easy A- but you have to work for an A. If you get a good project group like I did, the class is easy overall.
nelson seems like a nice guy. he is very rude in emails. is not very friendly. doesnt know ur name. grades based on comparison so if you dont have the best answer ur grade tanks.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nelson is very picky in who he likes and if he doesn't like you, don't expect to get an easy grade. Very test heavy and if you are not one of the top performers in the class, he looks down on you.

Very sweet man. He is one of the best BIS teachers. Homework is always 100% but tests are hard and weighted heavily into your final grade in the class. There is also a semester long group project that is a lot of work, better get a good group or else you're screwed. Don't mess with the tests, they'll make or break your grade.

Tests are hard and you need to show up to class to get information. Attendance is mandatory and you will receive a percentage off your whole grade if you miss more than 3 classes. Lectures are boring and there isn't enough time to complete semester long group project in class

Nelson is a really sweet man that cares strongly about this topic. Class could be a little boring but he gives you a lot of project work time which was really helpful. There are two tests with 4 free response questions. Tests are not that bad unless you know the material pretty well. The questions are very straightforward. I would def take again

Sweet old guy who is very passionate about what he teaches. Class isn't the most fun and revolves around a semester long group project. 2 FRQ tests, he grades harder than you would expect. But he reminds me of my grandpa so be nice

Dr. Nelson is a teacher that isn't the most difficult but can be difficult at times. He does not give many opportunities for feedback on the group project and lectures are a bit boring, but the material is not too difficult and tests are manageable as long as you study. Make sure you keep up with the group project all semester do not put it off.

Love Dr. Nelson! Lectures were a bit boring but very informational. First two tests are free response only and the third is over SQL but he gives a study guide. Group work is difficult and you'll need to do a lot outside of class. Great professor and homework load is very manageable!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Mr. Nelson is a great professor who is willing to help his students. Don't be afraid to ask him any questions. He will give you article(s) to read weekly. He will ask you to create a study guide using some of the articles. 3 tests using the knowledge from the articles. 1 big group project for the entire semester. 1 3-minutes tech presentation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: Super unpredictable grading, on exams and the semester long group project. I got lucky with my A, the exams are difficult, open ended questions and you have to be crazy detailed to get a good grade. Not a super heavy workload other than the project, short articles to read online and homework assignments sometimes. No extra credit, takes attendance.

This is a very easy class and A. For the first 2 tests, I looked over the PowerPoints once and scored well both times. 3rd exam is over SQL and as long as you did well on the hw, you will be fine.  The only fallback with the class is the group project but that is for all sections, so there is no reason to penalize Nelson for it.

Class is a short lecture and you can find everything he talked about online. I think you get 3 unexcused absences. Homework at the beginning of the semester is a lot of reading/summarizing. Two tests are short answer; not bad if you review all of the topics from his PowerPoints. 3rd test is easy coding. Not hard to do well if you put in the work.

Everyday is lecture and 3 exams - 2 are answering 4 questions total - write as much as possible for a good grade, the other test is over SQL. Big group presentation at the end for the final, work on the project throughout the whole semester. Assigned groups. Everyone gives one mini presentation throughout the semester that is an easy 100%
Really good professor. The tests are essay responses but easy if you read and study the material. He lets us out early all the time and gives lots of time to work in class on our assignments.

He is a good professor and teaches an intro class, but the group project is a huge part of your grade. If you get a bad group, good luck. The tests are a hit or miss. I recommend seeking help after the first test because he grades students against each other, not a rubric. Not that helpful in office hours, but my grade improved after going.

Nelson is a great guy who will make time to help with anything you may need. He has 4 exams, two of which are writing, and the other two consist of softwares that you will learn. Nelson is a very tough grader for both the written exams and the final project. You are graded relative to the top performers in the class.
Nelson is a very tough grader on tests, as your work is compared with others, and your grade is assessed from there. The class itself is interesting but mosts of the work is on a big group project.

The class itself isn't necessarily difficult - he's just a strict grader. I recommend finding a different professor if you can.

Prof. is overall a kind IT dude. The group project is a big chunk of your grade and if you are stuck in a bad group, do not expect much. The exam is an open-book test but I do not like the grading system he is unfair.

Don't fall for older reviews. Attending classes online and in person is a lot different.

Very clear expectations and detailed lectures. Easy to understand what you are supposed to do in this class. Kind of boring but I think that he is a nice guy. Exams are open-notes and open ended questions about the readings. Second half of semester is all group project where there are a lot of check points to stay on track. Professor Nelson’s class was one of the most informative classes I have taken at TCU. By far the worst professor at TCU!!! This guy is a terrible teacher and an awful human being. He has zero sympathy and grades harder than anyone! The class is 40% the final group project and I'm convinced if you don't have a cure for cancer then you will not get better than a C+ on the final.

Loves to meet and talk for office hours, I think he's a pretty lonely guy :( Lots of quizzes, but easy/fair questions, tests r similar to quizzes, he clearly outlines topics. My last class w him, 9/10, took 3 classes from him and would do again
He teaches pretty fast in the lectures, and there are lots of quizzes and homework, fortunately, these are good review, but time-consuming. He is funny and very kind.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: For Discrete 20123 Nollet was very fair. If you go to office hours he is always happy to help. Lots of homework which is graded, and quizzes on each section 2 classes after concluding it. Not too difficult if you put in the time and ask questions. My classmate likes to say that he hands out quizzes like halloween candy. Great class overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Calc 3 - Weird in the best way, owns hundreds of Hawaiian shirts, stutters and overclarifies random things, but it's entertaining. Homework and quiz on every section, explains answers and examples well, will clarify if needed. Respected, very broad office hours. Overall eccentric nice guy- 10/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Nollet is the best. Thats all. You will be doing yourself a great justice if you take any of his classes. Hes a true genius. His ability to convey the material understandably is astounding. Math flows naturally to him and by taking his courses it will feel more natural to you. Do yourself a favor. Take Dr. Nollet.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Really nice professor and man, not an easy class by any definition of the term, but he was accommodating, and I liked his lectures. fairly eccentric man, but in a good way.

Dr. Nollet is a good first year teacher, especially for Discrete. People have also said good things about his Calc 2. He is a little scatter-brained, but it isn't so bad that you can't understand him. He also enjoys teaching the class. Homework at the end of every section, but it is very manageable, and it helps you study. Quiz with each homework.
He's just an awesome dude.

Dr. Nollet is one of the best professors here at TCU. He makes math easier and is hilarious and very approachable. He is super clear about what he expects on quizzes, tests, etc., and he is one of the most understanding professors I've ever had. If you get the chance to take one of his courses, you definitely should. He has made DIFF EQ so fun!

Definitely recommend this professor! He is super nice and wears cool shirts. His exams are straight forward and his homework assignments are reasonable. Typically there was a quiz when there was homework due, but sometimes he would skip the quiz, which was nice.

If you have the chance, take his class! Tests are straightforward and your grade is cushioned by homework and quizzes (he drops the lowest quiz for every 10-15 quizzes.) Make sure that you double-check any homework because it is graded for accuracy and not completion. I found that he was super approachable during office hours and willing to help.

Dr. Nollet is an amazing and memorable professor.  Yes, a VERY quirky guy, stutters sometimes and wears flamboyant hawaiian shirts, but he is weird in the best possible way.  He is always down to help outside of class and his examples and explanations in class are always straightforward.  Quizzes easy, HW managable (MUST do), tests a little harder.

Pretty good math prof, but not the best. Just go to class, take notes, have quizzes often (about 2x week), 3 tests, and final. The only thing I found frustrating is that the same day that you turn in a hw assn, you have a quiz on that section, so you never get to see how well you know it or ask questions before the quiz. Will help during office hr
Do the homework that's is the easiest way to keep your grade up. Best math teacher I ever had.

Prof Nollet is kind of weird? but pretty okay. He's super straight forward. Attendence isn't mandatory but there are LOTSS of quizzes, but they're not difficult at all, and the tests are basically all of the quizzes with different numbers. Difficult, but super straight forward. He isn't a big help on homework... but you don't really need it.
if you come to class and pay attention you will get B. if you put more effort you might get an A. he is tricky in the test's Questions but he is good.

Good teacher. Can be unclear sometimes, but will answer any question you have not only for his math class, but for any other one you are taking. Test questions can be on the hard side, but then again when are they not.
Nerdy and difficult to understand. Very strange

I hated this class.  His teaching style was so confusing, I just started to only show up on the days we had quizes because I would leave class more confused than I was before I went.  Stay home and use the CD that comes with the book.  I did this and ended up with a B.  I don't know how he has a job at TCU

HE is awful. DO NOT TAKE. he blocks the board with his body so you can't see his examples. He stutters all the time. Very rude when asking for help. I got a B in the class only because I had taken precal my senior year.

He is a really good professor...seems a little nervous at times but the class is enjoyable.  He gives great notes and as long as you do your homework the class is pretty easy.  He really cares about the class, awesome guy.

he was okay as a teacher. wears really weird clothes to class but will help you out if you need it. if you can work on your own i would recommend just teaching yourself because it's easy and the class is real boring. plenty of times you can skip!!!
He did a great job teaching a hard subject. The homework was never too long but it was enough to get you prepared for his tests. I recommend him.
Great guy who will be willing to help you whenever you need it.

This class was amazing. I hate math but he made it really easy, and as long as you keep up with the homework it is not hard at all. He is very willing to meet with you and help, and the quizes/homework really prepare you for the tests. He is hilarious and his Hawaiian shirts are awesome! definitely take him for math!

Prof. Nollet was a crack up!  Great teacher, and definitely knows his stuff.  Makes the material easy to understand and keeps the homework to a manageable amount :).  He's such a goofy guy and just a pleasure to have in class.  His Hawaiian shirts will crack you up too.

Amazing teacher. He explains everything to everybody. Tests are not easy but if you pay attention in class and do all homeworks the class will be very easy. Really nice guy. Very funny hawaiian shirts.
One of my fav prof's @ TCU. Would actually help me out with math homework from my other classes. Very friendly, very helpful. And his dog is pretty cool.
Love use of examples to illustrate material.  Often funny, goofy.  Wears loud Hawaiian shirts.
Great teacher, lots of quizes and test are somewhat difficult should be an easy B and with a little more effort an A.

This is a difficult class but Dr. Nollet makes it easier!  He's very willing to answer questions during class time, especially if several students are having a hard time.  Really awesome professor, and a great person overall!
Good Teacher! Nice Guy... with a little effort, easy A
Really nice and funny guy.  Lots of easy quizzes and will explain stuff if you have homework questions.  But focuses a lot on theory kinda and test questions are really hard!!!
Really knows his stuff and is passionate about teaching.  Extremely helpful in and outside of class, really easy to talk to and always willing to explain.
Sometimes really funny.  Loves to teach.  Dedicated.  Will help you if you seek help.
excellent teacher for a hard subject, great sense of humor

easiest stats teacher by far, test are online and you attendance not required. also if you ask for points back on a project, he will help you earn them. only thing that sucks is that your group can be really bad that your placed in

Dr. Obitade's class isn't hard. You walk out with easy A, but you really won't feel confident to write "fluent in Tableau and Alteryx" on your resume. Learn those software from YouTube or other free courses would be better, since you can learn at your own pace. Don't waste your limited credit taking this course!

He uses AI to grade assignments. When I spent 10+ hours to do my real work and make it flawless, I was graded poorly, but when I tested the system and submitted an assignment I finished in an hour with AI, I got a stellar grade. Maybe it's a pro for some people, but I want to learn and it feels futile. I even asked for office hours and he said no.
Very good professor.

He is hilarious, but hard to understand. Told us class wasn't mandatory, but then got upset when only a few students showed up towards the end of the semester and started to grade harder and made attendance mandatory. HW graded easy, MC tests online open everything, semester long group project graded harder. If you get a bad group, it's awful.

Homework every week. Tests are online and out of class. Tuesdays are in class lectures, Thursdays are group project meeting days for the semester long group project. Use AI as instructed and that will be helpful. This guy is SO FUNNY and will help with anything you need. Take him for sure. Easy grader too.

Semester long group project which he grades very generously. Tests are open everything and online from home. Class is Tues/Thurs but only have to go Tues, Thurs is a meeting with your group which obviously will never take long. Very funny and realistic, has experience

The funniest teacher I have ever had. You have little assignments due every week which are easy and repeatable. The 4 exams are open-everything and very easy. The group project requires a bit of work, but he grades them fairly and generously. You only meet once a week as well which is so clutch. His accent and jokes make him absolutely hilarious.

GOATTT. Best Machine Learning Prof. Dude is hilarious. We met M/W for hour and half but Wednesdays are just meeting w ur group for the WHOLE SEMESTER. Obvi week 3 you don't care about a project due in 4 months so you talk to your group for 15 min and leave. Great class, walks through the weekly HW every week. Learn a lot too
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Loved ML with Prof Obitade. Highly recommend if you want a fun class for FINA major or fintech certif.

Obitade is the best Machine Learning prof you can take. You learn a bunch and classes are engaging and walk you through the weekly homework, so when you follow along it makes HW easy. Exams are super easy (online no camera), and there's a semester-long group project that is cake. Highly recommend if your doing your fintech certificate and need ML.
High recommend. She is very caring and understanding and discusses any quiz questions before hand.

Very sweet! She cares about her students and wants everyone to succeed. There are 3 short answer essays with a lockdown browser, but she makes sure you feel very prepared for them. Extra credit opportunities. I don't love British lit, but she picked cool stories.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lightest teacher at TCU. Didn't show up for weeks and still got an A. Does readings but goes over them in class. Gives quiz questions and answers beforehand.

If you want to have an amazing teacher who cares about you and your success as a student, take Profesor Oubre! Her class is interesting daily, and she is a very kind grader and very understanding if you have any questions or do not understand something. By far the best teacher to take for this course.

Fantastic, wonderful, and very insightful of the students she teaches. It was an honor to take her class. She is very ahead of her career as a teacher, talking about what ever fictional topic she chooses for the semester, I never liked reading, but taking her class absolutely changed my perspective. If you happen to spot her name, do not hesitate!

I had her for a core class and she is actually my favorite ever. She really cares about what she is doing and the books but also totally understands that we are all students who have our own lives. She is super chill and I just listened to audiobooks in the morning for what we did that day. Shes really fun too!

TAKE THIS CLASS. I love Ms. Oubre. She is clear and intentional with what she expects from you and what you will be graded on. This class is super interesting and I love the way she teaches. I highly suggest taking this class, you won't regret it!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Easy class even without reading everything. The 10 reading responses are self paced and the 4 main projects are not hard. She grades easy and provides good feedback before you submit.

Enjoyable class. 10 reading responses throughout the semester, so you can go at your own pace. 3 projects and 1 final. I will say that class discussion could be scarce at times because not many students read the assigned texts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Ms.Oubre is an amazing professor, she's funny and makes her class enjoyable. Pretty easy assignments as long as you know what's going on. TAKE HER for english credit!

SHE IS SO NICE AND EASY CLASS! Take her if you need a literature credit. There are weekly reading responses but you don't have to participate in class since it is only 5% of your grade and she allows for a lot of absences. Only one final exam at the end. She is very understanding and you can do revisions on essays and projects.

She is a very nice person and works with you as long as you're open with her and she is always available and wants to make sure that you are successful in her classes. I would definetly reccomend her for Intro to Fiction!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Easiest H/LT course. She is one of the best professors ever. It is so hard to do bad in this class. No tests. 10 self paced reading responses. 2 papers. Easy final project. She is very understanding and will give you extensions if you email her. TAKE HER CLASS!!

Professor Oubre is the BEST! Take her for LT/HUM credit!! Only 10 homework assignments for the whole semester and they are just reading responses. There is 2 essays, but she takes the time to help you and set up meetings if needed and isn't a tough grader. 1 final project and you do anything you want for it! Attendance is NOT mandatory, easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class for LT/HUM credit. Handouts every class online, but you don't have to complete them in person. 2 bigger assignments, 1 essay, and a take home final. No tests or quizzes. She is also very nice about late work and will give you full credit.

She is amazing. While attendance is not mandatory, she provides all the answers to the handouts in class, so it is a good idea to go. You do not actually have to read the selections just look up the SparkNotes before to have a general idea of what is happening. Also, she will help you so much with the two papers and midterm assignment. Take her!

This class is the best to take for literary traditions. She doesn't take attendance, but if you go to class you get all the answers to the worksheets (1 worksheet that's done in class due at the end of the week). She is super relaxed, doesn't care if you turn in stuff late. The readings are all online. The final is take home. Midterm is a project
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Trust me and take her for your Comp 2 class.

I love Mrs. Oubre. I think she is only teacher comp one more year and then moving to Literary Traditions courses. She is fun and easy. Give clear outlines on papers and more than enough time to get them done. If you do what she asks in the paper and finish your assignments you should get an A. I missed class a couple times and was fine.

Shelby is my favorite English teacher I have ever taken. She enjoys teaching the material and is very understanding. The class consists of four essays and she gives you a lot of time to work on each one.Super easy grader and she gives you the chance to explain why some areas in your paper are not as strong. Take this professor!!!

I would recommend taking Writing as Inquiry with Professor Shelby Oubre. She was extremely helpful because she gave each student opportunities to meet with her individually to talk about their writing. I felt comfortable asking her questions and for clarification on assignments because she made her classroom an open and inviting environment.

Professor Oubre was a great professor for Intro Comp. She was very understanding and was a reasonable grader. She put feedback on her papers and explained why she made the corrections and gave the grades she did. She also really seemed to enjoy the material she was teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Such a great teacher for writing as an inquiry. Gave the best feedback on all of the papers and made requirements very clear. Very reasonable grader and one of my favorite English teachers Ive ever had. She makes this class easy and interesting. Not too much work outside of class. Take this professor!!

Dr O'Neil is AWESOME. If you need a religion credit, take his class. It is a technology free class so come ready to handwrite notes but lectures are so engaging it doesn't matter. Whether you are Christian, atheist, or any other religion, he will not push beliefs on you and teaches about religions in an objective way with real media examples.
The best, most caring prof. This man needs tenure asap. He is so engaging, never boring, inclusive of all religions and beliefs and not pushy. Super unbiased, will make sure you succeed.

Take him!! He's an amazing professor, and his lectures are literally NEVER boring. I took Christianity and Pop Culture with him, and I was alway excited to go to class. The exams are extremely easy because he gives out practice questions (most of those practice questions are what make up the exam).

Dr. Oneil was one of the best teachers I have ever had. He cares SO much about his students and building connections with them. There is a no phone policy, but the class is so fun and interesting it really never was a problem. Take this class with Dr. Oneil, he is seriously the best ever!!!

O'Neil is probably the kindest professor I've had at TCU. He cares so deeply about his students and wants everyone to succeed. Pop Culture and Christianity was so interesting and I was always excited to go to his class. He takes attendance often, so It's a pretty big part of your grade. If you show up and listen, you'll do totally fine.

Best professor at TCU. Takes the time to get to know all of his students and is super passionate about what he teaches. Keeps class interesting by tying together content with pop culture and current events. Lectures are engaging and interesting while assignments are simple and easy. I would often leave class feeling inspired. Take him 100% if u can

Do not take this class. The professor overshares personal and psychological issues, creating a very uncomfortable environment that feels like he wants students to feel sorry for him. He misrepresents certain religions, making class difficult to sit through, and with no electronics allowed, you're forced to take notes on paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class. Reading outside of class but it's very easy. Only 2 tests and a few quizzes, if you pay attention in lecture you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. O'Neil makes the religion class interesting in a good way. He brings in his experiences and ties it to to what we are learning. There is a no phone policy, but it's mainly to make sure you're paying attention. Be prepared to take notes and do the readings before class because there might be a short reflection or class discussion about them.
I would pay him to talk to me for hours. I love this man so much. Best professor I've ever had. I highly recommend taking any of his classes.

The most amazing professor I have ever had. I don't think I've ever been so excited for a class every week. He has a strict no technology policy, so don't take his class if you want to zone out the entire time.

Dr. O'Neil is one of the most compassionate and caring professors I've ever met. He covers a wide variety of topics and faith backgrounds and is very welcoming to all students. Coursework is very manageable and the tests are fair.

Dr. O'Neil is an amazing professor caring, inspiring, and genuinely passionate about teaching. The readings are simple, and his lectures are always engaging. He requires phones to be put away, but it helps everyone stay focused and interested (it's honestly quite refreshing to see people alert). Highly recommend this class for your religion credit!

Great instructor! He was very kind, approachable, and made the class feel manageable and low stress. The material was interesting, and as long as you keep up with the readings, you'll do well there are occasional in-class assignments based on them. He does take attendance, so make sure you're showing up, but it's nothing unreasonable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is the sweetest man and his lectures are super engaging and interesting. If you show up, take notes, and participate, you'll be fine. Good amount of reading, but it's not too long or difficult. Not too many assignments outside of class. Overall, learned so much and would take him again.

o'neil is by far one of the best professors ever. i've heard bad things about religion classes being super hard, but his lectures were so engaging and interesting. never wanted to miss his class and found myself constantly thinking and talking about his content.

#1 RELIGION CLASS! He emphasizes that his class is descriptive not prescriptive and gives a full look on different religions, history, media, and what goes on in the world today. It is lecture heavy and there's only a few assignments, but he's very personable by using meaningful examples from his interesting life so you won't want to miss class!

Dr. O'Neil is one of the nicest people! He genuinely cares about all of his students and their perspectives, and he wants to see you succeed. I took his Christianity and Pop Culture section, and he made the most bizarre but awesome connections that kept the class interesting! I've heard other religion courses can be rough, but I loved this class!

Dr. O'Neil is such a great professor, and he really makes the course interesting. You are graded on attendance, but exam material comes primarily from the lecture so it is important to go. There are in-class writing assignments over the reading he assigns, but the reading is completely manageable. Participation is important in this class.

Dr O'Neil's class was super easy, enjoyable, and interesting. We had assigned readings, but there were hardly ever any assignments that went with them. The tests were online and you could use notes, the readings, and the internet. Make sure you attend every class as your final grade reflects your attendance.

Professor O'Neil is an amazing individual. I had his class as an 8am but his lectures were worth it. However, his exams are pretty confusing. They are all over the place and his study guides are overwhelming. Besides that he is very caring and inspirational.

I loved his class. Very easy and you had up to 12 free absences. He is kind and funny and his lectures are really good for a religion class. Exams aren't too bad but you do have to read to understand some things.

Genuinely one of the nicest professors i've ever had and he truly cares about his students. Lectures were usually very interesting and he always found a way to relate religion to sports/pop culture. Grading is confusing and attendance is required but I would definitely recommend for religion credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: O'Neil has been one of my favorite professors this semester. His Christianity in Pop Culture class makes Religion fun to learn about. He assigns some reading, but for the most part its super interesting and he does a really go job of going over it explaining it and connecting it to the class lectures. He makes the class engaging, personal, and fun.

Professor O'Neil cares so much for his students, and it is evident through his lectures and engagement with the class. Reading is required but it's not a lot and it genuinely helps with preparing for lectures and tests. If you take good notes the test questions come up multiple times in discussion down to the exact answer choices. 10/10 class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. O'Neil is so kind and caring. I enjoyed learning about religious appearances in popular culture. I did not enjoy that the content we learn is not connected. It became difficult to organize my notes by the end of the year because of this. Minimal outside of class work, besides occasional readings, and tests/quizzes are easy.

Professor O'neil's class was not one I'd recommend taking. On the first day of class he started crying and made the first few classes feel quite awkward. I found his exams and reading assignments to be very difficult and sometimes his lectures seemed all over the place, but I liked some of his up-to-date pop culture connections to religion.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr O'Neil is amazing. If you have the chance to take him, do it. He truly changed my experience learning about religion. His exams are hard, but you barely have homework, except for reading.

Attendance is mandatory but its ok because you wouldn't pass if you didn't go to the lecture; the information is actually super interesting; a lot of the class is watching movies/TV shows/ documentaries; super caring prof and very inspirational.

Although it can be intimidating taking a religion course, I've never met a professor that cares more about his students than Dr. O'Neil. His lectures are very in depth and interesting while keeping things fun and loose. There is a lot of things to study for on his tests, including readings, but the study guides he creates help a great deal.

HE'S THE GUY! Great guy with awesome lectures. He talks about his own life and tries to relate it to us, he really cares about his students! It's a tad confusing at times but tests have study guides and I barely studied and did well. Do your homework (which is only occasional readings), pay attention in class and participate. Made me cry twice!

I enjoyed coming into class and learning about religion in pop culture today. Can feel overwhelming at times becasue this class does cover so many different topics but study guides are provided for each exam. Dr. O'Neil is great and his powerpoints are very creative. Would recommend this class.

This professor is good but his lectures are all over the place. At first it seemed like an interesting class but then he would make us read 100 pages of a book per class for homework. Nice guy, but confusing. His tests are also worded very difficultly and his final review has about 200 terms and ideas to memorize.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Realllyyyyy great professor, very clear that he cares so much about what he is teaching and his students. participation is important, very discussion heavy and interactive class.

Such a caring professor. I think this is his last year at TCU, but his Religion and Pop Culture class was a favorite this semester. Participation was mandatory but it's so worth it for the discussions we had. Dr. O'Neil is such an easy person to talk to and genuinely cares about all his students. So glad I had this course for my TCU religion credit
I took Professor O'Neil for my Religion course. Religion, Society, and Sports - best class and learning experience. Definitely take him for your TCU Religion course.

Dr. ONeil is truly a funny person! I think this was his last year at TCU, but I truly enjoyed him. His lectures were my favorite and he was always so nice in class. Before corona, we only had 3 tests and then 20% of our grade was participation. He started doing the most during tcu online but I still liked him for the most part.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: pretty much all of my classes stayed the same level of difficulty when transferring online except for this one, it got 10x harder. we didn't have a heavy course load when we were still on campus so I was surprised when he made online class so difficult. Lectures are entertaining, wish he would have done zoom instead of just uploading stuff
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Sean is a great guy. I don't think he is going to teach next year but he is a really good person. You do have to read quite a bit and just make sure to make your voice heard and he will like you. There's hardly any grades and I P/NC the class thinking I would get a C. Its not that bad. Just stick it out and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class wasn't hard but you do have to try. The teacher is very easy to get along with and actually wants to help you out. Easy B for sure but you have to try for an A.

I hadn't taken any religion classes or anything before college so I was worried about this one, but O'Neil made it easy. Pretty funny so lectures don't feel as long and moves at a good pace with PowerPoints to help. Class is graded mainly by tests and quizzes, but as long as you study what he says (he gives exact test questions) , you're fine!

Dr. Pinon is a good professor who cares deeply about his subject. In every class, you can expect a lecture, but he also uses some good opinions and videos to develop deeper ethical thinking. The tests are difficult, but straight off the study guide, and are take-home. With good notes and class attendance, you can make an 'A'.

Professor Pinon is a very caring, dedicated professor who breaks down philosophical texts in a very simple and understanding manner. He is also very understanding of us being college students and would occasionally give us credit for assignments due over the weekend! I highly suggest taking him if you need an easygoing professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is so sweet and really cares about getting the class engaged in discussions! Lots of extra credit opportunities, but you do need to pay attention and take notes to do well in his class but it isn't impossible. However he does not reply to emails when you have something to say about grades. He does not completely go off the syllabus for grades

Dr. Pinon is so kind and really cares about his students. There were no tests, and the bulk of one's grade relied on a few group projects, but he allows you to choose your group and does not grade hard at all. The class was super interesting, and Pinon fosters an environment where all opinions are welcome; easiest religion credit, take this!!

TAKE THIS CLASS! Professor Pinon is amazing. He is so kind and talked about his dog during office hours after we finished with my questions. The class is very interesting. As a warning, some of the topics can become uncomfortable and strange. It is an ethics course. However, if you are looking for a religion class for core credit, take this one!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: As a non-religion major, I enjoyed the lectures and interpretations of the bible he pointed out. Easy online discussions. One short essay. Three exams plus a final, all online and open note. He does care about the students and easy graders.

Professor Pinon was the best! He is so understanding of issues outside of class and has a very clear lecture. There are discussion posts but they are easy and he is lenient with grading. Take him if you can!!

if you are looking for the 'holy-grail' easy religion course at TCU, this is it. Super easy professor understands that if you are not a religion major, you don't want this to be a hard class. Online tests, and easy discussion posts, highly recommend.
Super easy, tests are online, and only one discussion post per week. Attendance is mandatory. Only take religion at TCU if you have him!

Professor Pinon is my favorite professor at TCU. He is such a funny guy and very attentive to all of his students. Discussion posts weekly and offers a lot of extra credit. All tests are open, yet still have to pay attention in class to do well on exams. I 100% recommend taking this for your religion credit!!!

His lectures always keep the entire class engaged and laughing. You need to take notes constantly on lectures because he'll say things that are on the exams but not in the PowerPoint. If you're looking to take a religion class for credit, I highly recommend this one.

This class was super easy! There is no homework other than a few discussion posts and some reading. Otherwise, you get most of the information by going to class. Tests are online and short and easy if you pay attention in class. He does not accept late work (late discussion posts) but overall he is super nice and I would take the class again.

Dr. Pinon is one of the nicest professors I have ever met. He responds to emails quickly and understands the effect that COVID-19 has had on students. There are weekly discussions that have clear grading criteria and a fair amount of outside reading. You are guaranteed an A if you read and listen to his lectures (and copy his PowerPoints with them)
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: If you're looking for a class that fulfills your RT credit, but you want to talk more about politics and social justice and less about Christianity, take this class. Easy grade, sometimes exhausting, lots of reading for weekly summaries. Exams were open book and open note, but timed. I'm no longer pursuing a religion minor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Odd class. We barely talk about religion, more so just hot political topics

His class was super easy, but his tests don't cover what you talk about in class. His tests focus on little details from the lectures and the books. He gives reviews but they don't really help because they are long and the tests are super short. Nice and funny guy, but his tests were difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Pinon is a great professor. I had him for Latino Religion and then took him for an Honors Colloquia course. His classes do require a good amount of reading, but the material is extremely interesting. He has a great sense of humor and tries to make class fun and enjoyable. I learned things in his class that I have truly been able to apply!

Santiago Pinon was the less caring professor I have met at TCU. He never replied to my messages. The class itself is not hard and the test either, but its hard to success in a class where you have such a low support. I reached him out several outside class and he is not supportive at all. If you want a pain in your back take him. Worst professor

Do the extra credit, get the book and read (its like 3 pages at a time). Take good notes, you will get an A. Laugh at his jokes he likes that, he is a great guy who keeps the class fun. Tests are straight from the lectures and he usually tells you whats on it. Wont regret his class.
Loved this man. Books are interesting, kinda odd and weird but good. Class is mainly discussion! YOU ARE NEVER WRONG IN HERE.

Brilliant and funny guy! Took Pinon for upper level RELI course. Very clear grading when it comes to papers. Don't skip. Very caring, but don't mistake his kindness as an excuse to walk all over him. One of the hardest As I've had to earn at TCU.
Avoid this class, he is a tough grader and not willing to help students outside class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Basically go to class and whatever is in his lectures is what will be on the test, also remember the definitions of religion. Sit at the front and participate in the discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: so lit

He is a really sarcastic yet nice professor. He takes attendance and he has two exams, a midterm and a final. Do the discussions and that will help your grade by 22%. His lectures are thought provoking, and his class is easy 100s except for the exams. He requires many books to be purchased by I only skimmed them.

I'm so glad I took this class. His lectures are very interesting & thought provoking. He connects it back to your life & explains why this stuff matters. He really takes the time to help his students & wants you to succeed. He doesn't try and trick you on the tests & if you pay attention/listen to him you will do well. Take his class, I enjoyed it!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Pi?on taught my honors Nature of Society: Citizenship class and he was FANTASTIC! The first day he is very intimidating but the depth and the understanding of the issues of immigration and citizenship and the interactions our class had the opportunity to experience with the authors of the texts we read was an unforgettable experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. P is a really funny guy. I had him for a Maymester at TCU for Understanding Religion: Latinos, Religion and Social Critique. He is easy and we watched a ton of movies basically every class. Since you need a RT credit this class is perfect because it double dips with a HUM credit as well. Go to class and participate in class discussion
Dr. Pinon is the best. He's down to earth, intelligent
Must read the textbooks and show up to class. Discussions are a must if you want to do well.  Not an easy course, but possible to get an A.

DONE TAKE THIS RELIGION CLASS WHATEVER YOU DO! He changed the format of his class this semester and is incredibly organized, never answers questions, doesn't reply to emails, etc. If you need an A, don't take this class!!! He does not care about grades, does not stay up to date on grading, and doesn't take your concerns seriously.

Great class and great professor.  There is a lot of reading every week, but the articles and reading books are interesting and relevant to current times.  Dr. Pinon expects everyone to come to class prepared and to contribute.  He is very knowledgeable about the subjects we were learning about and I enjoyed the class.  Would highly recommend.

Dr. Pinon was a great professor. I enjoyed class and going over the books we read. Interesting and engaging class discussions. Book summaries aren't bad, books are easy to follow so it's not too difficult. He's good at giving any feedback or answering questions.

Online threaded discussions are easy to do and so are his 2 projects. His exams are a bit hard to study for since he changed the format on all 4 of them and they only became more challenging. With that being said, it's important to go to class. He'll work with you so go into his office hours. Easier religion class for sure and I recommend taking.

I had a lovehate relationship with Dr. Pinon because his class is extremely unorganized and his is very unclear about his expectations. Changes his test from semester to semester and is overall confusing about assignments but if you do the journals, you WILL get an A.

he is a funny teacher his test are not to bad you just need to get the notes from someone. Has weekly assignments that are easy and worth a lot. I recommend him as a teacher definitely easier religion class i recommend him.

Pinon is a very intelligent man but with that being said, his lectures are extremely confusing. He assigns readings that are very intellectual and make no sense. That being said, 80% of the class is threaded discussion that you get full credit just for doing them. So overall it is a very easy religion class

I took his Latino Religion Class and it was an awesome class! (I'm not Latino) I genuinely enjoyed getting up to go to this class. He is super funny and makes the class really enjoyable. Make sure you do your graded discussions online and on time! They are worth almost 80% and are super easy. Tests aren't hard if you study his guides.

Dr. Pinon has been my favorite professor at TCU by far! Not only is he hilarious, he really cares about your success in the class. You read a few books but as long as you go to class, listen, and take notes, the tests are not hard! definitely recommend!!
Great professor! Take this class!

Hands down one of my favorite professors! He really cares that his students understands his material and wants to see them succeed. He is extremely funny so he makes his class interesting and he really helped deepen my faith. TAKE THIS CLASS!

As a Latino I was not very sure how I would have approached a class that evaluated my culture & general religion. Honestly, I expected it to be a very dull course and not require much work on my part. However, I was wrong. Dr. Pinon's course does require careful reading & attention to lectures. But it is a very interesting course & very manageable!

LOVED this class!! The professor is really cool and will always talk about his personal life so you can get to know him more. He is really clear and will talk about the readings in class. Extra credit opportunities, class assignments and group projects help your grades. He is really nice, and will always try to help. Also he is really funny.

Great Class, Great Professor. I would recommend this class to anyone. He is clear, easy to follow, and very supportive. In order to succeed, KEEP UP WITH: the Readings, Notes, Lots of Extra Credit Opportunities, and Online Discussions and you will be guaranteed at Least a "B." An "A" is hands down achievable!!

I loved Dr. Pinon's class!  If you have to take a religion course I would definitely suggest him!  His lectures are very interesting and I really enjoyed the class!  He is funny too! His stories about his kids are hilarious!

Dr. Piñòn is one of the best professors I have had at TCU! His passion in teaching comes out in his lecture and even though he might seem intimidating he is always willing to make time and help out students outside of class. He will definitely make you look at the world from a different perspective!

This teacher is terrible! He tries his best to get you involved but its a waste. He doesn't seem to know what he is talking about either since he contradicts himself all the time. There is no way of understanding his methods of test making, so be prepared to be frustrated beyond reason. You go in thinking it's gonna be a religion class, but its not

Dr. Piñon is by far one of the best professors at TCU. I had him in Latino/a Spirituality, and Dr. Piñon made the class such a blast by interjecting his wit and humor into the material. He really wants his students to do well and if you work hard, you will do well in the class. TAKE ANY CLASS WITH THIS PROFESSOR, IT IS TOTALLY WORTH IT!!!

Pinon has a wicked sense of humor. He's a great teacher, and has this incredible ability to be hilarious one minute but very serious the next. The class I took focused on women in Latin America. Very interesting. Study hard, though. The class gets more difficult as the semester progresses. And whatever you do don't use your phone in class!

Dr. Pinon's lectures are insightful and he gives a new perspective on things. Its a very interesting class! He is extremely helpful and is available to talk if you have any questions whatsoever. He will provide a study guide if you ask for one and he will explain anything you don't understand if you ask as well. Always read before class!

Easily one of the best professors I've had here. He is so willing to help you with any concerns you may have, and honestly wants you to do well! He's so passionate about his content and you can tell he knows exactly what he's talking about. It isn't an easy class, but an A is attainable. Must be willing to work for it though!
Professor Pinon is really funny and makes the class fun. You HAVE to read and study a lot, but if you do, you'll be fine!
Really enjoyed this class. I did not know what to expect coming into it but definitely think that it was worth my time and that I will take away a lot from it. Take this course!

Pinon knows exactly what he is talking about, I never felt like he was making things up. Though I definitely had to work for my A. Read the books, study for the tests, ask for help if you need it, and you should be fine. Though Latino Religions wasn't really about religion, I do recommend it for RT credit.

GREAT CLASS, GREAT TEACHER! showing up to class is definitely important because you learn a lot in class that will help on the tests, and just read the book! Pinon is so helpful outside of the class and is THE BEST professor at TCU. HIGHLY recommend this class for RT y'all!

TAKE THIS CLASS! Pinon is my FAVORITE teacher at TCU! He is so hilarious and makes class so interesting by keeping everyone involved and not just reading off the power points! Getting an A/B is definitely attainable, and Pinon wants you to do well, he's not going to try and hurt you! This class it's so worth taking. a lot of reading but so fun!

Professor Pinon is fantastic! If you read, come to class, and understand the material, you should get an A. He's so helpful and easy to get along with and funny. I definitely recommend this class for your RT

Professor Pinon has been my favorite professor at TCU! He is kind and funny and he is ALWAYS willing to help you. I really struggled at the beginning, but I talked to him after classes and went into his office hours and he helped me tremendously! He is genuine, really cares about his students, and he truly wants you to succeed. TAKE THIS COURSE!!!

Pinon was the best teacher I have had so far at TCU. He is so interested in what he teaches and it reflects in everything you learn. Although it is a religion class he plays devils advocate, not taking sides, which allows people to share their own opinions without ramifications. He is also hilarious and very willing to help you!!

GREAT TEACHER!! he is not out to get you at all and wants everyone in his class to do well and succeed. He is always willing to meet with you prior to tests and answer any questions you might have. READ the chapters before class this will help you understand the powerpoints and notes for class the next day. I REALLY LIKED THIS CLASS!

GREAT PROFESSOR! He really wants to help his students and wants them to do well.  You can tell he is very passionate about what he teaches and is willing to work with you to get a good grade.  All religions are hard but this one he actually wants you to learn and do well!

Professor Pinon became my favorite professor this semester.His passion and knowledge for the information he teaches makes is awesome. His intro Latino Religion class is not easy. But if you read the important information and  study well for tests, getting a B is easy, and an A is achievable with a little bit of work.

Pinon is so enthusiastic about what he teaches, he has a GREAT sense of humor and is very personable. Don't be afraid to talk or ask questions, it will boost your grade. Also if you struggle on the tests he will do study sessions so ask him!
Great teacher. Always willing to help your grade. Hard class, but makes it interesting. Participate in discussions and he will like you, want to help you even more. One of my favorite teachers.

Great teacher. Very understanding of students' needs. Leads student discussions instead of lecturing endlessly. If you read, which isn't an extreme amount, you will do fine. Was not interested in the material at all but it became very interesting.
important to go to class. moves very quickly and lots of reading and information. tests get gradually harder but A/B range grades are attainable. lots of films but be aware its a LATINO class

Ok first off, this is a latino culture religion class! All you do is read a ton about pointless things. The only thing I like is that he gives online discussions that boost your grade. His tests are impossible, dont let the first one fool you. I got an A on the first one and failed the third one. It was all fill in the blank & no word bank.

My favorite professor at TCU! Have taken 3 classes with her now, and have loved every one! She's very educated and well spoken. Has engaging lectured and activites to really get you thinking. Lots of opportunity for grades: exams, reflections, in class activities, hw. Take her!!!

Sweetest professor! Taking at 8am was a struggle but still really enjoyed her class! Super caring and understanding! Her lectures are pretty interesting and made material easy to understand. Need to do the reading (not hard) to understand content. 2 assignments weekly you have to be there for. Exams are short and in-person but mostly short response

Her lectures are interesting but the tests don't really match up with the material she says will be on it. I'd do the study guide and know the answers to every question and still end up doing bad on tests. Annoying but a fine class.
I loved this course

Great teacher who had a clear and structured class. One thing I loved about her class was that she would have extra credit days after tests, and you have one class period to answer questions and get some points back on an exam. Make sure to study a lot and exams are online but in person monitored on lockdown. She is very sweet!

Dr. O'Mealey is the sweetest person. She cares and sets reasonable expectations. Allows for group testing and is an easy grader for in-class activities. Super engaging lectures and explains clearly. She takes feedback and improves her class based on that. Take her!
Dr. O is awesome!! Such a kind person and very reasonable expectations for students. Take her!
10/10. Love her. She is amazing and wonderful. Very caring and engaging too.

I like O'Mealey as a person, her class is fun and entertaining. But the tests are not on the material, they are about application. I find the questions extremely unfair, and unrelated to learning about dev psych. Super frustrating considering I LEARNED about Psych development and was tested on things biology related. So be warned of stupid tests
She is super sweet! Not a super tough class, but you do have to study. Reading the textbook helped me a lot, but I was fine if I missed a chapter.

I love this woman! I have taken three classes with her so far and I am taking another one with her next semester. She is one of the most caring professors I have had at TCU and she is so knowledgable about the things she is teaching. O'Mealey is one of the reasons I made Child Development my second major- I can't recommend her enough!

Dr. O'Mealey is such a genuine professor. I've taken two of her courses and both were straight forward. Dr. O's courses are one of the reasons I decided to minor in child development. She teaches what you need to know, puts effort into gaining personal relationships with each student, is very understanding, and always has a positive attitude.

Dr. O is one of my very favorite professors at TCU. Her class is very engaging and I love how QRCs get the students involved. She is hands-down the most caring professor I have taken and she genuinely cares about her students and what they take from her class. Take this class! You won't regret it!

Professor O'Mealey has been one of my favorite professors at TCU! It is easy to see she cares immensely about the well-being of her students. She not only wants her students to succeed but also wants to build relationships with them along the way. She makes class so entertaining and is an amazing teacher. I defiantly recommend taking her!!

Dr. O'Mealey is hands down the best professor I've ever had. She cares so much about her students, and makes sure that her class is always fair and achievable. Her lectures are so interesting, and she teaches the material very well. Take her class!!!

Ms Obsorne is the sweetest teacher ever and cares so much about her students, she is so understanding. The assignments are not hard if you do them you will get an A! I wanted to show up to class just to see her!
She is the BEST professor. She genuinely cares about each of her students and puts in the time to thoroughly read through all your papers and give helpful feedback. Take her!!!

She sometimes takes attendance but if you tell her before that you will be missing class, she won't mark you absent. There is 1 paper about a personal artifact, 1 partner paper about a place, 1 podcast about any topic you want, and 1 reflective presentation about the previous 3 projects. She gives everyone A's if you turn in solid work on time.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Osborne is an amazing person. She's smart, funny, and extremely kind. Her lectures are very interactive and she often develops personal connections with her students. She is very understanding of peoples' tough schedules and is always willing to accommodate her students' needs. Without a doubt my favorite professor at TCU so far.

One of my favorite professors at TCU! She is so kind and caring. Very easy grader when it comes to papers. One of the best parts about her class is that you got to pick the topic of your papers. Take her for intermediate comp!!
THE BEST PROFESSOR EVER. TAKE HER.
By far the best professor on campus! I have never met someone more caring than her. She has also been kind enough to write me 3 letters of recs. Loved the class and had fun lectures!!
one of the nicest professors on campus

Professor Osborne is great. One of the most friendly professors on campus. Super eager to help and make sure everyone's needs are met. Papers get tedious, but what do you expect. She lets you pick your topics, which does make the work a bit easier to get through.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Osborne is very kind and always wants to help you, but the class can get extremely boring and lectures drag on. We are 3 months into the semester with only a few weeks left and only have 1 grade back. There are a lot of writing assignments so it is frustrating to not know how you are doing in the class. Besides that, the class is not bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is so sweet. The class has 4 projects (the last one is a group project). She gave detailed feedback and was not a tough grader. For the peer responses, as long as you submit them, you get full credit. You will have extra credit of 5% overall grade if you come to the writing center. Best professor ever!
She is so kind and sweet but she does mainly lecturing in class and never releases the grades! The whole class was waiting on her grades for the whole semester...

She's so sweet and LOVES to talk! Very lenient on grading, doesn't take points off for grammar, formatting and so on, but she specifically hates 2nd person view and starting/ ending essays with a quote so avoid that. The only reason I'm not giving a 5 is that she's not very organized, grades very slowly and lectures a lot, otherwise definitely best

I don't think she teaches this course often but she is amazing. Each class is a discussion on questions she gives you beforehand and you just have to contribute. The conversations are really fun. There are 3 essays written throughout. No attendance but you will have to show up often so you can take quizzes otherwise you will get a zero.

I took Profe O'Donald for Spanish Cuisine and Culture. She brought food to class for us almost every day to every other day. She uses English some times for clarification. Her goal for her students is to CHAT with each other in Spanish. It's about being comfortable with the language and pure learning, without too much homework. 10/10 gal

Sra O'Donald is one of my favorite professors I've had at TCU. She's super funny, caring, and very knowledgeable. Her exams can be slightly challenging if you don't take good notes during lecture, but she incorporates other projects/assignments into the gradebook too. Looked forward to going to her class every single time!

I love this professor. She is so funny and she is so genuine. She speaks clearly and slowly, and is super helpful in learning spanish. She cares for each student individually, and sets you up for success. She evaluates your growth, not your talent. Work hard and you will do well. And have fun, she is so amazing
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Such a great teacher who wants each student to grow and do their best. Some reading and work outside of class but it is all important to the course. Participation is important so make sure to answer questions and discuss during class. There were 3 papers during the semester but you could prep ahead of time and the 3rd was written outside of class.

I've taken her for three Spanish classes at TCU, she's amazing and her classes are so fun. I've learned so much and she's really good at keeping her class engaged. You can tell she really cares about her students.

O'Donald is a very good professor. She is very knowledgeable about what she teaches and does an amazing job educating her students. She is also very kind, caring, and funny. Her class is one of the only classes I actually look forward to attending. She does give quizzes every day, but they are very short and an easy grade booster.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Inspirational--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor O'Donald is the BEST Spanish professor I have ever had and I've taken Spanish for 8 years. She provides a guide to write notes down during her lectures and there are a few presentations and chats throughout the semester. You are always prepared for tests. I wish she could be my professor every year. Literally SO amazing and funny!

Super engaging lectures and is so passionate about what she teaches. Her tests definitely require a firm understanding of her lectures, but aren't the worst, quizlet is super helpful. Makes class relevant to students and does a lot of real world application.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great class! Pop quizzes once a week, funny professor, and loves to help. You will need to practice Spanish to do well. Pay attention at the beginning to not be behind as there are around 18 different grammar pieces you learn. Go to class so you aren't behind. Speak up in class for participation and for presentations don't read a notecard = A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. O'Donald is the best language teacher I've ever had. The class is easy to engage with and offers a lot of chances to practice and get more comfortable speaking, reading, and writing. Practice and some homework outside of class are important but not heavy grade wise.

Professor O'Donald goes FAST. I am a spanish speaker myself but the pace of her spanish was fast even for me. What is going to be on the exams sometimes is unclear and it is always open response, rarely any multiple choice.

I am not a nursing major but I took Span for Health Professions b/c it sounded interesting. I learned more Spanish in this class than any other class I have taken b/c you listen and talk so much. She teaches in Spanish only but is great with gesturing. Her tests are challenging and I recommend really memorizing and studying hard (they are the guia)

i love this class, probably one of the easier classes i had this semester. proffesor o'donald is so sweet and caring, she's super funny and her class is really interesting to listen to. we have quizzes maybe once a week and sometimes we have readings, but they're really easy. pay attention to lectures, and you should do good on tests

Nothing bad to say about her! My favorite professor at TCU so far. I learned more Spanish in this class than in every previous class combined. Professor O'Donald also took the time to recommend a path for my future in Spanish classes and studying abroad (she was much more knowledgeable than my advisor). She is hilarious and makes her class fun.

She is normally available outside of class and always wants to help. Her teaching style is lecture based, but they are not hard to follow and she is very entertaining. There is generally a quiz or some sort of graded assignment every class so you need to go to class, but they are normally that difficult.

I absolutely LOVE Professor O'Donald. She made this class so fun and easy to follow. She is super knowledgeable on all the material, explains it clearly, and is open about what you'll be tested on. She is an amazing professor shes so nice and so funny I took her for health professions 1 and 2 and I wish I could take her again. TAKE HER IF YOU CAN!

Prof O;Donald is such an amazing Prof. I took her for Health Prof 1 and I was expecting the class to be much more difficult. She taught in 70% English and was very clear with what she wanted you to do. Her quizzes and tests can be a little hard but If you study outside of class, even a few hrs a week, you will be great

She is super funny and I always enjoyed going to her class. If you're taking the class online, she doesn't use lockdown browser for her exams. She gives out study guides that you just fill out during lecture and they're really easy to follow along with. Fun class; i'm taking another one with her next semester.

Prof O'Donald has been my favorite spanish teacher so far. She has a great personality and really cares about her students. The assignments were consistent but she is a very friendly grader. Overall one of my favorite classes at TCU because she was a great professor.

Best Spanish teacher Ive ever had and I only had her for a month in the summer for Intermediate Spanish 2. Shes so funny and uses a lot of gestures which makes understanding her easy. I learned a lot and she made Spanish so fun. She loves participation and really cares that you understand the material. I love you Señora ODonald!!

Very poor time management skills; She'll ramble on a mile a minute in Spanish in class (good luck if you can't understand her; she doesn't write anything down) and forget to tell you about assignments and give quizzes. Also doesn't care if you're sick; Your butt had better be in her class.

I LOVE her! She's hilarious, caring, and a great teacher. Span. for Health Prof. is such an interesting class! She lectures completely in Spanish but is easy to understand and gestures a lot. The Spanish itself isn't hard but its a TON of memorization. I also got a lot better and explaining and different ways to communicate a concept in Spanish
