These classes are based on +/- scale so keep that in mind. I had taken a break from a Spanish class for a semester, and it was hard to participate in class because she speaks all in Spanish. I personally didn't like the way the class was arranged. She is very helpful but wasn't available for a lot of the days.

Señora O'Donald is SUCH a great professor. I took her Spanish for Health Prof. course and learned so much material without having to kill myself for an A. She is hilarious, kind, and her tests are over what she lectures. Just show up to class and do your part and you will have such an enjoyable experience with her. She's simply the best!

Senora O'Donald is a great teacher! She does all in class assignments. You have quizzes but you are always prepared for. You don't use the book except for vocab and the online homework. The first exam was an adjustment, but she is so helpful outside of class. She's funny and a great woman. 10/10 take
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: I was so sad to leave her class and actually considered taking her for another class even though I am done with my minor. That should tell you a lot

Great teacher. She's very funny, teaches well, and obviously cares a lot about her students. Homework isn't bad at all, but sometimes there is a lot of class work sheets (which is actually beneficial because it really helps you learn the material). She grades very fairly too. I definitely recommend taking her.

I HATE spanish but had to take it for my major, but she totally made this class worth it. She is absolutely hilarious, and bc of the small class size, she really got to know each of us individually (she even has an oral exam where she asks you about your life and stuff). Her tests can be tough but she really wants you to succeed & helps you out!

I absolutely love Señora O'Donald! She is one of my favorite professors at TCU. She tries really hard to make sure that her students understand spanish. There is a quiz every class, but they are super easy. Beware, her tests are harder than her quizzes. There are three tests, three papers, many quizzes, a final, and an oral exam.

Karla is a super nice lady that is very chill and cool. You can joke around with her in class and she tells you really funny lessons she learned throughout her life. Karla O'Donald is so chill you come into the first test thinking it is as chill as she, but they are like any standard test. Listen to her lectures!
LOVE HER, such a funny teacher and so helpful, quizzes everyday and tests arent bad if you study, she's such a good teacher SERIOUSLY recommend and i'm not even good at spanish

Prof. O'Donald is a BABE.  She is one of my favorite professors of all time, hands down.  She helps you out so much on class assignments and quizzes and tests, just be sure to go to her office hours and form a relationship with her.  She really ups the ante in intermediate 1, but if you work hard an A is achievable.
Mrs. O'Donald is a great professor and an even better person. She is very fun to be around. Take her if you have the opportunity

I took Intermediate Span 2. Enjoyed much more than int span 1. No pop quizzes and during class she explains grammar concepts. Very helpful and she has a good sense of humor. She is a native speaker but is easy to understand. I highly recommend her. There are three tests, three timed writings and one oral exam at the end and cumulative final

So much better than my intermediate 1 professor. Dr. O'Donald is super-helpful and she takes the time to really help you.  She also is up for having class discussions about parts of the Spanish language that's not in the textbook.  If you can, take her.

There's no textbook which is kinda annoying but she makes the class soooo much FUN! and you end up learning alot. Just fill out the reviews for the tests while she lectures and try not to miss class because all the information on the tests are from lecture. Overall really good teacher!
Outstanding teacher who makes learning FUN, keeps you laughing. If you take Spanish at TCU I highly recommend her!

Great professor she knows her stuff and is a great professor that is willing to help you out. Visit her in office hours if you are struggling and she will really work until you get it...she made learning spanish fun, challenging, and rewarding all at the same time...hands down best spanish professor.

Hands down the best prof I've had! Makes learning so fun, always engaging and relates easily to students. Never in a bad mood. Easy to understand, willing to help in English but prefers Spanish. Very helpful. Makes the language seem less intimidating to non-native speakers. Never used the textbook - just buy the Quia code!

She is the sweetest teacher i've had and will help you whenever you need it.  Attendance is needed because quizzes will be just about everyday, but they aren't hard.  She tells you exactly what is going to be on the tests and makes class time enjoyable!

WONDERFUL TEACHER, WONDERFUL PERSON. Great teacher and great sense of humor. Always in a good mood and willing to help. She is in no way intimidating. Daily class quizzes. I would take her again in a heart beat!

Best Spanish instructor I ever had in college! Explains the concepts well and repeatedly so that they stick. Great sense of humor, willing to work with you, and an overall nice person. It is incredibly helpful that she is a native speaker and can give a better perspective on the vocab and slang. HIGHLY, HIGHLY reccommended.

Great teacher and very funny!! Her class was in no way intimidating and she is okay with speaking English. I really enjoyed her as a teacher and have yet to find a Spanish teacher as good as her! The only problem was I didn't have to put forth much effort and the way she taught allowed me to memorize instead of learn. I wouldn't use any other prof!

I will be having her as my professor for the third time in my college career. She is hilarious, very willing to help with what you don't understand, and puts effort into making sure you understand the concepts. I highly recommend her as a professor especially if you are nervous about your Spanish class.
Awesome Teacher.  I've had her for 2 classes now, and she is by far the best at TCU.  If you need Spanish, take her!!!
No Comments
She's hilarious. She doesn't always understand parallels between english and spanish, but does a good job in explaining the grammar and language. I would definitely recommend this class.

Great teacher!! Class is awesome because she is actually from Mexico (but speaks fluent English), so she can explain the actual reasoning behind the Spanish language instead of straight out of the book (many time she will explain how the book is wrong!) Oral presentations are awesome; we did videos and powerpoints instead of 1 on 1 interviews

Best Spanish professor I have ever had!  She is so helpful and I feel like I have a very good grasp of Spanish 2 now.  I would take her for every Spanish class if I could!  And, if your grade is high enough you can be exempt from the final.
BEST TEACHER AT TCU! She is so helpful and so easy to understand. I felt like I learned a LOT in her class! VERY NICE LADY! Take her if you are going to take spanish!

She is the best teacher i've ever had! She is very funny and will keep your attention the whole class period. The class is easy if you go and put in effort. You have a mini quiz just about every day at the end of class, but it's about what you learned that day. Test are easy if you look over material. This class is worth taking.

She is a really dedicated and knowledgeable teacher. It's a hard class that requires a good amount of work but if your dedicated, then you'll get it, and if you don't she'll help you as much as you need.
She is an amazing teacher. She knows how to explain things in a way that makes sense. She is really easy going and is very willing to help her students.

Great professor! She is so helpful and if she knows you are working hard then she will help you out. There are quizes every day so don't miss class and study hard. The tests are a lot more difficult than the quizzes but if you study you should do ok.
Great Teacher! Wants to help you out! Quizes every day, so you might need to study. If you get into class discussions you'll do better. She has an awesome sense of humor!

she made the class fun, if your having trouble just talk to her and she'll help out. always go to class because she quizzes every time but its really not that bad definatly do the thing that gets you credit for span 1
Awesome teacher. She is hillarious and always makes class interesting. Highly recommended.
One of my favorite professors! Explains everyting extremely well. She has a great attitude and is always willing to help. I accidently signed up for spanish 2 and new nothing and made an A.
She is a really good teacher. She is really nice and will help you, you just have to ask. you just need to go to class. She is really nice and makes the class fun.
Great teacher, really enjoyed her class!  She is so funny and helpful.  I would definitely recommend her class.
Really fun class.  She's not too demanding and is really helpful.  Since she's a native speaker she actually knows what she's talking about and really wants you to learn.  Take her!!

She is a great teacher. She is funny and very clear about what she wants for essays,tests and quizzes. If you are having problems, she is willing to help you. Class is entertaining and she likes to tell stories about when she visits Mexico. Overall, a great teacher for this class.
Great lady, very helpful and passionate.  THe class is interesting and easy if you know any spanish at all.  The first 2 spanish classes I learned in high school and found them really easy.
Karla is by far the best teacher I have had at TCU.  Her class is fun, test are noy bad if you study.  Great lady, take her for every Spanish class you can.
I love this lady. She always makes me laugh, she makes learning fun, and she teaches you all about her Mexican adventures. If you take a spanish class at TCU, take her.
ABSOLUTELY AWESOME- this prof is amazing! she makes it so much fun, and teaches alot about culture. if you make a 94+ no final. shes hilarious and so sweet, young and loads of fun.
Bad ass teacher who loves teaching. Fun to talk to, will discuss culture all the time. Outgoing, funny. Teaches in different mediums so you make sure and get it.

BEST TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD IN MY LIFE!  She is an incredible teacher and loves to help her students.  She is amazing in teaching and caring.  She truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed.  I love this teacher!  :)  She totally rocks!

Great teacher - go to class, dont bomb daily quizzes, ask questions - she is the most helpful teacher on campus. Take advantage of easy oral exam, its a grade booster. She is awesome and really funny in class.
Best teacher I have had at TCU.  Do the little she asks and she will take care of you.  You will want this woman to teach you every class.
Great teacher, plus funny and sweet.  Loved this class- her comments were always entertaining and she really helps you to learn the basics. Should make an A if you go to class.
SHES AMAZING! SO SWEET AND FUNNY! MAKES CLASS REALLY COMFORTABLE FOR EVERYONE AND JOKES AROUND A LOT. TAKE HER. EASY A BUT YOU LEARN TOO!

i love her!  her class is fun and you also learn lots.  she will help u lots on the tests when u need questions answered and doesnt make you speak it except for the oral.  lots of quizzes, but she tells u what the are about the class before.
Great teacher. She really knows how to teach and is interesting to help you pay attention

I loved this class.  I learned more from her in this semester than the 3 years I took it in high school combined.  Very good teacher.  She's a native speaker, but slows it down enough to understand.  I highly recommend taking her for spanish.
great teacher
she's really funny. no points off if you don't go to class, but you will miss the daily quizzes. its a long class, but we get off topic every now and then :)
Great class!!! Super sweet and helpful lady.  Tests are a good representative of class. Easy to go to class and enjoy.
No Comments
Fairly easy class.  The tests are easy.  She is very funny in class but the class can become boring since they are an hour-twenty minutes long.  I have learned quite a bit in this class.

Professor Shevchenko was the sweetest professor ever! You could tell that she really loves what she's teaching, and she wants you to succeed. I would say do your work and you should do well,but still pay attention and study. She is always willing to help you succeed. 1000% recommend taking her for stats.
Dr. Shevchenko was a very supportive and nice professor. Her class wasn't easy but for a calculus class it could've been much more difficult. She cares about her students and is there to help.

Mrs. Shevchecnko is so kind and really wants her students to succeed. The entire course, homework's, tests, and quizzes are through an online platform, Pearson, so you are prepared for tests. All tests multiple choice and she drops the lowest score. She offers tons of extra help to anyone who wants it. Great teacher!! Definitely recommend.

She is actually the goat; you can take homework and quizzes as many times as you want until you get a hundred. Tests are weighted heavily so you need to make sure you study hard, however she drops the lowest grade. Super sweet lady and knows what she is talking about, take her if she's available.

She is the easiest out of all the freshman math teachers. The class itself, particularly if you haven't taken AP calc is difficult, but almost all other freshman math teachers are very difficult. Also, tests are weighted very heavily so make sure to focus on them and actually study.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved Shevchenko, calculus isn't easy but she made it very easy to get a good grade. Very accessible outside of class. Her accent really isn't that thick she is understandable. Go to class and you will get a good grade.

Professor Shevchenko is great at explaining calculus and will answer any questions her students have. The subject itself can be a bit boring and tedious, but she has a comprehensive knowledge of it and cares about her students. I'm not a math person and I used Chat a lot to tutor me and prepare for the tests, which I was able to be successful on.

Very thick russian accent. I took her because of her reviews on here since I'm not good at math, but I underestimated how hard it was to understand her and how hard the exams were. Id say that you should take her if you have the drive to self teach yourself or sit through her accent, but if you struggle in math, I would try to find someone else.

Great Professor. Just know that you will have to put in effort and work hard in order to succeed. I had never taken calculus before and was not used to her teaching style since I have had the same teacher in high school for 4 years with pre-cal being one of them. 
*Review Quizzes are VERY similar to actual tests, although not exact.*

This is definitely the easiest math class and teacher you're gonna get here at TCU. Everything is online, and nearly everything besides exams and some quizzes have unlimited attempts. Super easy, kind teacher, definitely take if you need an easy base math credit.

4 exams, cumulative final. biweekly quizzes. hw two times a week. easy class. multiple choice questions on exams. really nice, approachable professor. she does everything to ensure student success. take this class if you want an easy A!

Dr. Shevchenko is so sweet. Her class is literally so easy, you do not even have to show up. I skipped class everytime (except for exam days) and got a 99 in the class. You do not have to actually know the stuff she teaches, all the answers are found online. This class is literally just an easy A

TAKE PROFESSOR SHEVCHENKO!! She was amazing and by far the easiest math teacher to take for Applied Calculus. While there is homework after every class you have unlimited attempts and on the quizzes there are also multiple attempts. The review quizzes are extra credit and can help boost your grade. Her notes are also posted online.

TAKE HER SHES THE BEST! 4 exams and a comprehensive final, she allows a notecard front and back and all multiple choice!! quizzes and hw and all exams on Pearson. She is very helpful as well. Makes notetaking easy as well

Best professor for Applied Calc. Assignments are all planned out for the whole semester and grading is very clear. All work is done online on MathLab. Her lectures/ notes are very clear. She is an amazing teacher and all her quizzes and tests are straight from the notes. Definitely recommend taking Shevchenko.

Take her if you need the credit. All work is done i th text book. You get unlimited attepts on the HW and 8 attempts on the quizes. The tests are multiple choice and she gives yu practice quizzes that are identical to the tests. Easy A if you make sure you know what your doing.

All of the work in this class is in the online textbook. So as long as you are aware of what is going on in the class, and take the time to study for tests, it's an easy A. Attendance is not mandatory, except for test days. She allows a notecard for all the tests as well. I recommend her if you need to get a math credit out of the way.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The only issue is that it is hard to get one on one help because there are so many students and such little time in class so I did get a tutor just for extra help. Although, she is such a good professor and really cares about the success of her students. If you are not the best at math, I would say this is your best option for a professor at TCU.

Schevchenko was a great applied calculus professor. The course is on Pearson, there are unlimited attempts on homework, 8-unlimited attempts on quizzes, the review is just like the test, the test has about 20-25 multiple-choice questions. The lowest test grade is dropped. This class is an easy A if you just do the work and practice the problems.

She is not the GREATEST math teacher but her hw, quizzes, and tests are so easy. unlimited attempts on hw. 8 attempts on quizzes. and review is the same as the test. her tests are also all multiple choice. If you are looking for an a take her. if you need to learn the material take someone else.

Have taken Applied Calculus with her. She is a very nice and friendly professor who will give you a clear idea of the material needed assessments. She provides notes in advance of lectures to preview and follow along with throughout classes. Grading is prompt and she is very accommodating for meeting regarding content or grades. Would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Shevchenko is a great professor who ensures that her students understand the material. Whenever I have a question or trouble over a part of the material she takes the time to break it down step by step so that I can fully understand it. The optional study guides she provides for exams really do help and I recommend going through them.

voice is annoying and just does notes in class. takes attendance for 0 reason, not part of final grade. does not speak English well and if you ask her a question she doesn't know the answer unless its from the notes she teaches from. easy A but horrible teacher.

Professor Shevchenko is super sweet and approachable. You will need to buy the textbook because the assignments are attached to it, but the quiz and practice quiz questions are the same as the test. Attendance was not mandatory but helps. Take her if you want an easy class, but don't expect to learn too much in order to advance into harder math
Professor Shevchenko is a sweetheart and always willing to answer any questions. Her class is really easy if you do your homework and do the reviews before exams.

Professor Shevchenko is very sweet and helpful. She is always willing to answer questions in class or out of class. She will walk you through things. The homework has unlimited attempts. Quizzes have 3 tries. Tests are just random questions from the review which you could go through to see all the possible questions.

Ms. Shevchenko is the sweetest professor I've ever had. Her lectures can be a bit long and slow so it can be easy to zone out but that is honestly the only downside of this class. She is extremely helpful and supportive with any questions. All hw/quizzes/tests are on pearson and are very easy to follow. I am terrible at math and loved this class.

Easy A. Everything is online through my lab persons. She takes attendance in class but if you miss it won't affect your grade. The exam review are the same questions as the exam itself, basically everyone gets an A. I never went to class besides exam days and did not complete all the homework assignments and still ended her class with a high A.

Professor Shevchenko is one of the nicest and easiest professors I have ever had. Her class is very easy as long as you complete all the homework. The test reviews are literally a combination of all the possible test questions. The more you do the review you will always get an A on the exams. I highly recommend this professor super sweet and easy

Professor Shevchenko is the sweetest! It was the easiest class and I highly recommend taking her if you have to take Elementary Statistics. The review she gives for the test is the exact same as the actual exam, so as long as you study that you'll be fine!! Math is not my strong suit, but she makes it easy to understand! The HW isn't hard at all!
Easy class for math she is really direct like literally how can you fail.
great professor! one of the easiest math classes I've taken

Dr. Shevchenko is literally the best Math Prof you can ask for. Online this class is open book/note for exams. She will replace your lowest test grade with the final if you do better on it. She gives test reviews before each exam which help. Every assignment is through Pearson and she doesn't put a time limit and extends due dates. Take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: This class was so easy. I showed up to class and worked on the online homework because she just stands at the front and reads off the powerpoint. She posts a "test review" before every exam which is an exact copy of the test, so instead of studying formulas, I studied the answers. I did not really learn much but this class did boost my GPA.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I cannot oversell how much to take this class. Prof Shev. puts up an exact copy of the test a week before you take it and it's all multiple choice. I got a flat 100 on every tests and you don't actually need to go. Easiest professor you will ever take 100%

Constantly reaching out for help and not receiving it. Blaming being behind as a reason to not support students on exam corrections. Late grader. Supposed to pay attention and take notes in class, but "the slides aren't enough" to study for the exams. Only 3 exams, reading quizzes, and participation. If you are ready to read, write and learn do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I would not take this professor again by any means. You have extensive pre-class reading each class, and a daily 4-question quiz that is pretty tough. Also, expect a 50-minute lecture every single class, and if you do not take good notes, you are in a bad spot. The three exams make up 60% of your grade, and are in-class essays and SAQs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The tests are pretty straightforward, so if you pay attention to lectures you'll know exactly what is on them. He also allows you to get 2 bonus points on each exam. There is a quiz every day in class over the reading, but it's only 4 questions and you can miss one and still get an A on the quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The style of writing he wants from his students is very unique, but he is still an excellent professor and it's a very manageable class if you take solid notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Changed the class this year to all hand written exams and quizzes, not a bad thing but he takes ages to grade them. You will not know your grade in the class til the very end of the year. There is a quiz each class on the reading which aren't too hard as long as you got the main ideas from the reading. Participate for easy points during lecture.

He did not grade a single assignment, quiz, or test on time the entire semester. After I took the 20 quizzes of the semester he had inputed 3 into the grade book and now going into finals Idk my grade. He never grades tests on time either. He also is making our final the Monday we get back from Thanksgiving break instead of during finals week.

He's VERY lecture heavy. I normally be confused as to what he be talking about until the end of class. If you skip classes time to time, he's not for you, he does pop quizzes almost every class. Imo, the topics wasn't debatable as expected to participate in class fr. Your grade mainly relies on quizzes and essay exams. Really caring professor tho
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lots of pop quizzes and can be a tough grader when it comes to tests. However he is always willing to work with you and cares about his students. Participation is strictly graded so make sure you stay on top of that and lots of reading and pop quizzes. Overall not a hard class and he's very entertaining and enthusiastic. Would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: You can tell he cares about what he is teaching and your success in the course. He does give daily grades on participation where you need to hit a certain quota throughout the semester. Essay heavy. Wants students to call out and challenge and question topics taught in class so everyone can learn for the better. Best teacher I've had in college fs.

Professor Moreira is a great guy and really cares about his students and their learning. The class can be pretty consuming if you are looking for an A, but it is far from impossible. It helps a lot to care about the subject and put in effort when doing the readings. He has quizzes almost every class and 4 essays, as well as participation points.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very good teacher
It can be a little busy with the daily quizzes but he is an amzing professor
Good guy who really wants what's best for students. His class is not hard at all but there are daily readings with quizzes so it can feel a little busy.
Amazing Professor. Will let you know what you need to know for quizzes. Quizzes are half individual and half group. Very much wants you to succeed and is very approachable.

I think she is a great professor. The class itself is hard but she does a great job teaching the concepts in a way that is easy to grasp. She actually would work through problems unlike other Neeley professors which I loved. It's nice when they teach and not expect you to learn it on your own. Recommend her although there are very few grades!

Great professor. Very tough topics, but she taught the material well and was able to explain it in multiple ways so everyone could understand. If you pay attention in class and work hard, you'll do fine. Our only grades were participation, 3 exams, and the final.

You MUST learn the material backwards and forwards.  Learn every little detail, every little formula, absolutely everything in the book.  You think you understand the homeworkin class problems and then her tests come out of left field. She is not helpful and questions are extremely challenging and vague, as if she wants you to fail. AVOID HER.

Great Professor.  Tough but manageable class.  Her power points are a great guide to the exams.  Nice lady and easy to get office help.  Tests are pretty brutal but she seems to always curve AND gives extra credit.  I would take again but it was definitely work to get a B+.

She does not teach the material, but merely grazes over all of it. Of all the Reporting classes, I feel that ours is by far the hardest. She's a nice lady, but would not recommend her. It is the hardest class I've ever taken in college.

Mrs. Proell is the best teacher you will take. She is very helpful and teaches from lecture (you will definitely not find this often in Neeley and it really helps people learn). Proell will give you the proper foundation of accounting knowledge you will need. Take this class for sure.
Tests are hard, hwk is really easy. Do all the practice problems she gives you. Listen to her recommendations on studying... Would take her again

TOUGH BUT GREAT TEACHER, do the work for a B, put in effort, get an A. Tests and Quizzes are tough, Multiple choice is almost impossible, but straight from book and class work. HW is tough but by completing not by actual score. I would recommend her if you wanna learn the material and do well. Not a blow off class
Financial Accounting 20153.  Dr. Proell was an AMAZING teacher.  She is very knowledgable, organized, and wants everyone to do well in her class.  I highly recommend her!

I don't recommend this class, I took this class for my FA credit please just take another class. She is a though grader and requires a lot of work from her class, her work is weekly discussions, annotated bibliography, group presentation, a solo presentation, a research-based essay, and a final group dance.
muy pesada, pide mucho para ser una clase tan simple y es muy exigente con todo

DO NOT TAKE. Extremely rude and lets her emotions get the best of her in class. Treats everyone as if they are still in high school. I would NOT recommend. She does way too much for a class most people take for the credit. If you are looking for an easy fine arts credit, then RUN away from her.
Worst Teacher I have ever had. Very disrespectful

Nice class but its a lot of reading get ready to spend at least 4 hours to read stuff and the class is just discussion the readings of the week meaning participation is KEY in this course. You do have one group project but its pretty easy. The only downside is she's unorganized and sometimes her class was very tough at sometimes but not as bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ended the class 100/100. Do the assignments, show up and participate. It was overall pretty interesting. Only complaint is she makes snarky comments about white people
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Fun class, pretty easy. Weekly writing. Grades easy. No tests. You do have to dance in the class.

She's good, her D2L is a mess, but just ask ppl in ur class for clarification and you will get it, but projects are so easy and you will get 100 as long as you have all the content within the assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There are no tests or real homework, just project and presentations, and you need to participate. But shes super fun and makes it easy to participate

No tests, only graded on weekly discussion posts, one group project, and one final essay. I got 100s on every assignment. She says you have to read the textbook but you don't. Easy A if you do the work and show up to class.

Overall, this is an easy class. There are no tests or quizzes, just a weekly discussion post, and a few projects. The class is mainly just discussion, and occasionally, we dance. She can be a bit of a mess, but nice.
A nice lady.  Sometimes all over the place with technology and a very very slow grader.  Very easy to do well in the class though, and the dance days are super fun.

This class was so much fun! Lecture content was interesting and guest artists (movement classes) coming in weekly was a great way to start the day. You only use the textbook for your group and individual research presentations. No tests or quizzes. Final paper is a reflection based on the experiences with guest artists. Take this class!
Would definitely have her again. Made this class so fun and had guest dance speakers which made the class very interesting. Easy grading and the easiest projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: UNLF in itself is a boring class, but she gave us more work compared to other unlf teachers and her rules and guidelines for assignments did not align with all the other teachers. Very frustrating.

Class has been updated since 2019 - no quizzes, just discussions, group project, and wonderful hands-on guest instructors who teach cultural dance. She is kind and clarifies instructions. Easy and fun FAR credit where I learned a lot. The final project was attending and writing a reflection on a panel with all the dance artists. Would recommend.
Dr. Puente is very clear about how to succeed in her class and supports you through words of encouragement and different ways into the information.

Dr. P is the best. I've learned a lot about cultural dance throughout the semester. The classes are really hands on as she brings in guest dance instructors to teach the styles of dance you are learning about. Not to mention she is a pretty funny person, although some might mistake her sarcasm as being rude. She's my favorite professor at TCU.

Dr. P is overall frustrating. Her UNLF class rules does not align with any other UNLF teacher. Amount of work compared to other classes is absurd. Take any other teacher! She wasn't necessarily hard but just too much work for a 1 credit course. She's also weirdly rude. I never look forward to going to this class when it should truly just be fun.
This class is super easy. Only a chapter presentation, midterm, and final project. No exams or homework besides weekly discussion posts. Attendance is mandatory and counts for your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Puente was a great Professor. She does a wide variety of different activities such as guest instructors, group projects, and documentary days. There are weekly observations over the textbook chapters, but that is literally it. Attendance is mandatory. There is a group project, midterm and final presentation as well. I highly recommend this course.

I took Dr. Puente's Brazilian Cultural expressions class in the dance department. She was a great instructor and made the class a lot of fun. Capoeira was not easy to learn but through her continued instruction I felt as if I at least got a good introduction. I would recommend this class to anyone looking for a fun stress reliever.

Although Dr. Puente is a very nice person, her class was so hard. Two huge group projects and a 200 word reflection page and quiz due every week. Be prepared to read the book for the quizzes. There are no exams. Points off for attendance. I tried hard and still struggled with this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: She is one of the most unorganized professors I've ever heard. She is a nice woman but made this class unnecessarily hard. The online quizzes are so tough and they are 35% of your grade. This class should be an easy A, take with anybody else!!! I barely scraped in with an A- and I worked HARD for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: super helpful and caring. office hours have been so helpful to me. he wants students to understand concepts than focus on exams.
The professor explains concepts clearly and keeps lectures organized. His teaching style makes the material easier to understand and he encourage questions to help students learn better.

I am taking Data Science with him right now. Just wanted to check his rmp and then seeing mixed reviews, I wanted clarify. He enforces student learning, that's his primary goal. He is just awesome. Period.

I thought the tests were very on par with the lectures, there were never any super tricky questions. He offers lots of extra credit, but you have to be in class to do the assignments. He kind of forces you to pay attention in class by having in class exercises that he makes you do. I found that really helpful.

Not a traditional professor. Tries his best to make class interactive and leaves no questions left unanswered. Exams are difficult if you missed the lecture as there's no way of knowing what those figures and equations means when you just look at the slide. For me it was the best class I took in a while.

Nothing nice to say except he offers extra credit. Misleading about what to study. Says no calculations before a quiz, then proceeds to include them. Instructions were vague, lectures unclear, and he went on tangents. Slides were straight from Andrew Ng, who taught far better. If you need to take his class, prepare to teach yourself everything.

There are so many opportunities for extra credit but he doesn't announce SOME of them so be sure to show up everyday. In lectures he will go along with the class to help you learn and leaves a lot of room for questions. The content can build on itself fast so be sure to study and keep up. His midterm and final are straightforward. Just do your part
This guy is AWESOME!! Took him once a week for a 3.5 hour class and we never stayed the whole class. Easiest grader ever, will always open up assignments past due, and is so funny. Take him!!
Such an easy comm class, stayed an hour max each day for a 3 hour 1/week class. So nice and will give you an A no matter what.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing comm professor, he gives easy As and our class period never went full time. He's seriously an amazing guy and hilarious, seriously such a chill classroom environment and makes the thought of public speaking way less daunting - love him.

Professor Yang is one teacher I will absolutely never take again. She grades excessively hard, favors certain students, and will not understand anything you say to her. She expects students to start studying for exams 3 weeks in advance. Our class was doing so bad as a whole, she had to curve everyone's grade so that at least 10 students got an A.

This is a very challenging class and requires a lot to get an A. Professor Yang is the cutest and sweetest lady who really wants her students to succeed but doesn't exactly set them up to succeed. Her lectures are entertaining and make sense but then the tests are different to the study guides and material from class. Extra credit but not much.

Prof Y receives good reviews due to her amiable personality. Nonetheless, her course is exceedingly challenging. The exams are not like her study guides or the textbook. Despite my strong work ethic and high grades in other subjects, I found her class unnavigable. I advise seeking a different prof. Her T.A. grades her essays and is a tough grader.

Yang is such a great professor. I am one that struggles in school an,d she was always offering to help me when I needed it and would make sure I knew the material before I took the test. One of my favorite professors I've ever had at TCU!!

Yang is a great professor. She cares about each individual student and will even offer to meet with them to ensure everyone gets a good grade. She is very funny and uses great examples in class. Take professor Yang!

Dr. Yang is a good professor and really wants her students to succeed. The people who don't like her are those who don't try or reach out for help if they need it and then get bad grades because of it. This class is hard but if you make even the slightest bit of effort it's an easy A or B. She also gives a lot of extra credit.

Dr. Yang is a very organized professor. Yes, it is a relatively hard course, but it's pretty much all just memorization to do well on the exams. I never read any of the textbook yet I probably did better than 95% of the students in the class. Those complaining about her on here probably have a poor work ethic, she's an above average professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Yang is a great professor. COMM Theory is a hard class no matter who you take it with but Dr. Yang does her best. She gives you a study guide for each exam so memorize everything on them and you should do fine on the tests. The first test is the hardest, she will tell you that and you should study like crazy for that one. Yang is great!

Dr Yang is a great person, and cares about her students. However, this class was very complicated. Its a lot of information, and the tests are very challenging. It is also kind of hard to understand her online. Overall, she is very nice, but I would never take her again due to the course work load and the level she grades at on assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Yang is a very caring professor! She cares a lot about her students, but her test hard and very detailed. You really need to start studying for the test a couple weeks before the actual exam day. She gives 5 assignments that are relatively easy however she is a very tough grader. The test are very very detailed so make sure you read the book.

Not sure how anyone could have anything negative to say about Dr. Yang! She is truly one of the kindest professors at TCU. Yes, Theory can be difficult, that's not her fault. If you put in the effort, do the reading, and study for the tests, it's absolutely possible to do well. Those complaining probably did poorly and need someone to blame.
I hated the class. No one in the class could understand what she was teaching and would have to meet up everyday to teach ourselves. She is also a super hard grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Yang is absolutely a professor at TCU for all to emulate. She is super caring and fair. She will set you up for success and wont let you fail as long as you apply yourself. She is understanding about personal matters and family emergencies and will not let you fall behind. I recommend anyone at TCU to take an class Dr. Yang offers.
She is super understanding and really cares about all of her students. There are 4 exams, 5 short assignments, and a final paper. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: AWESOME professor. She truly cares about every single one of her students. She has truly been so amazing this semester. The tests are the powerpoints and review. We talked her into having a notecard for test 3 and then she allowed it for test 4 which was super helpful. You have to really study for her tests though. The final project is worth a lot.

Honestly, a really cool and funny professor. Lectures were clear, and he explained things very well; you just have to take good notes. Study guides are decent, and he tries to make class engaging. First time in a while I have genuinely enjoyed and gotten interested in learning history. The books he requires you to read are also really interesting.

If you have any interest in history at all you should take Prof Worthing. He is so knowledgeable and makes learning clear and fun. He is very very funny and I genuinely enjoyed going to his class, he got me out of bed in the morning MWF. He is kind of a tough grader, only reason I got a bad grade is because of myself and has nothing to do with him.

such a caring funny professor. had to buy like 4 books & a course packet. exams and book quizzes super clear and was an easy grader but just a lot to read and study. if u take him (which u should) he will make references to many movies and ask abt the campus and what not, pls respond I felt so bad when no one would say anything!

Dr. Worthing is incredibly engaging and obviously very passionate about what he teaches. Always willing to help and answer questions. You won't do too well if you don't do the readings. Don't miss a lecture if you can help it - slides are posted but very vague bullet points, so rely on your own notes. Few grades so keep up!

This man is so sweet and definitely loves his job. I took this course over the summer and it was very easy. We watched video lectures every day on our own time and the papers were fun to write. Highly suggest his class.

The professor is very knowledgeable and clear with instructions and grading. The professor does require daily reading which is necessary to do well on assignments and tests, however, the reading is straightforward and he provides daily lectures that are helpful for preparation. I would definitely take this professor again!

Great  professor. I had him last fall for the Modern Chinese History as well. Amazing lecturer, and worth your effort. This is not an easy class, and attendance is mandatory. If you looking to learn and grow academically, take his classes. If you are want an easy upper level course, look else where.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Worthing is the best. This class had the potential to be so boring but he is so passionate about what he teaches and really cares about his students. He has 3 exams which are pretty difficult but as long as you memorize a bunch of information you'll be ok. Overall, he makes the class fun and loves to involve his students which makes it fun.

He was a great professor! Very engaging, welcoming environment, easy to ask questions and participate, but not required. Takes attendance, but class is the same format every time and easy to sit through. Every class is lecture and there are 3 reading quizzes and 3 essay tests in class. Very hard tests that you have to study a lot for.

He is a very nice person that makes class really interesting, but his exams are really hard. He makes you write 2 essays and 4 identification terms for each exam, so get ready to write and read, because he also makes you read 3 books for the class AND IT WILL HAVE QUIZZES about it. Not a bad professor, just a boring subject.

This guy is amazing but the tests are very hard and you have to take good notes in class to get a good grade. Office hours are very helpful and he gives a bank of words he might test you on beforehand which is helpful.
Great teacher. Great references to pop culture. Cares about what's happening in student's lives and things happening on campus. Very passionate about topics. Would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is the best professor ever. I don't know why some people rate him low, they probably didn't show up to class. You will learn a lot in his class. He explained things so well and gives example so that everyone can understand. He makes it so simple, even middle schooler will understand. Everyone show up to class because they all like his lecture.

AMAZING professor. If you get the chance, take him. All of his classes fill up so fast because he is so good. His lectures are so interesting and it is not that hard to get a good grade as long as you show up and pay attention. He wants everyone to do well. TAKE HIS CLASS you won't regret it

If you have a free elective, find a class taught by professor Worthing. This man is the reason I am a History minor. His lectures are engaging and he throws in, jokes and, similies to spice things up. He values attendance and participation in class. I cannot recommend him enough. Get ready for 80s movie references!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Worthing is the most incredible professor I've taken at TCU. IF YOU CAN GET INTO HIS CLASS, TAKE IT. Easier on attendance than most. Fascinating lectures, fair grading, respectful class atmosphere.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the best professors at TCU! He is so passionate about what he teaches and is extremely engaging in class. He is fair when it comes to grading but everything is papers so if you don't mind writing then definitely take this class. Also study up on 80s movie references!

Professor Worthing is absolutely amazing. He is so passionate about the Vietnam War and his lectures are extremely interesting and informative. You will have to buy several books and there is a lot of reading but the class doesn't have any written exams, just analytical papers and a take-home final exam essay. Definitely have to work for your grade
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Worthing is a fantastic professor and easily one of my favorites at TCU. Pay attention during lecture and email him if you have any questions. He can answer almost any question you ask him about China, and he makes a lot of 80s movie references. He's super cool and 10/10 would recommend everyone to take a class of his.

Dr. Worthing is such a great professor and makes the lectures really interesting. There are very few grades in that class, but as long as you go to class and pay attention you can do well. He was very passionate about the topic and that showed each day in class.

I'm a history minor, so I've had a few history professors. This guy is one of the best TCU has. Only complaint is he might be too easy of a grader, I wrote a terrible essay on one of the tests and still ended up getting a B on the exam. However, you do have to put in considerable work to get an A. I highly recommend Professor Worthing.
The best.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you are not a history, lit, or English major this is difficult. Structure of assignments revolves arond tech gained through those majors. Extreme detail is needed. extra non main course assignments that you will be tested on. It's not that the course is hard its not welcoming to outsiders which can affect your grade neg despite knowing stuff.

Professor Worthing is seriously the man. I don't even look at the clock during his lectures. He's super knowledgeable and makes the subject he's teaching extremely interesting. Definitely the best survey level class I've taken, if not favorite history class. He's super "cool" in my opinion... he said "I was bee-bopping around campus the other day."

Prof. Worthing gives amazing lectures,and chooses interesting materials. His musings over the purposes of learning courses like "History of Modern China" are really relevant and carry important messages.
He is amazing. The class is so interesting that we dont even look at the clock. Tests are not so easy but definitely worth taking this class.
Good teacher, really knows a lot about China. quizzes are hard but grades fairly on papers.
He's really and truly the greatest professor that I've ever had. You'd have to be a dummy not to take his class. He's also super charming and ridiculously smart. Take his class!

Dr. Worthing is a really great teacher. He's not easy, but you learn A LOT about China from his class. A lot of writing (DO YOUR RESEARCH), but very interesting class. Highly recommended. I'm a history major though, so I actually LIKE history.

Took modern china from him. Was interesting and informative: I knew virtually nothing about China prior to this, but he taught it very well. Great teacher. Only teacher to ever cause me to question my sexuality.
Best Teacher at TCU.  Vietnam class is challenging, but informative and fun.  His slides are well organized and he lectures at a moderate pace, making it easy to stay engaged.

Hands down, the best teacher at TCU. His lectures are extremely interesting and are easy to follow. This could easily be a boring class, but Prof. Worthing makes it interesting and fun. The tests are hard, only because he wants you to write down everything you learned. The books you read are intersting as well. Take this class.

Dr. Worthing is a tough teacher, but I enjoyed the class nonetheless. The exams were the hardest, but that's partly due to me studying the night before and not being a history fan. For tests, he wants you to put ALL the information you learned in class into the essay responses/IDs on the exam; don't worry about eloquent writing, just put the info!

GREAT TEACHER!  Took 2 classes from him and my grades showed progression meaning he actually teaches.  Very helpful with any questions and truly wants you to understand material.  Picks interesting books but grades hard.  Use the writing center to help.  Can be difficult but rewarding when you do well.  Interesting class and incredible teacher.

Dr. Worthing's great! Tests are all essay, and you should prob prepare a week before b/c of all the info. 4 outside novels to read in which you have an in-class quiz on two, and an outside paper on the other two. Quizzes are very easy grade boosters as long as you read the book. Difficult grader sometimes. He's a grammar nazi, so proofread!!!

Difficult grader, but it makes you feel great when you actually do well.  Tests off of lectures which flow well and make sense.  He makes each class interesting and worth attending.  He is very willing to help and reassuring.  Passionate about history and making us understand.  Definitely take him if you have the chance.  Highly recommended.
Excellent lectures, but he is a very tough grader! If you write well and are capable of retaining lots of info, this class should go well for you, otherwise it will be a very difficult class.
He is a great teacher, he is really interesting and he really knows his Asian history. Class is fun but the tests are pretty hard and he is a tough grader.
Great prof. Always helpful and has a great teaching style. Makes great use of powerpoints and his subject matter is incredibly interesting.
Worthing's hot.
This guy is terrible.  He is pretentious and rude.  He is not interested in helping you. He is only interested in proving you wrong.

Worthing is an amazing professor and keeps class interesting.  Uses PowerPoint slides at beginning of class with keywords for the lecture (makes note taking easier at 8am).  I AM NOT A MORNING PERSON, but he kept me awake about 95% of the semester because he is enthusiastic/energetic!  GREAT PROF!
Best professor/course ever taken. Lots of material, fairly difficult tests, but the way he presents it makes it worth getting up before 8. Wish I could take him again.

Loved this prof. Great guy, he learns everyone's name. Teaches off overheads very concisely, presents material very clearly. Has more enthusiasm than any other prof I know at TCU. Tests are about as difficult as they should be.
This man is one helluva teacher. Keeps students involved in class lecture. Although this is a rigorous course, this prof makes it enjoyable.
Gets excited about course, material. Presents in many ways. Personable, fun, energetic. Will go extra mile to help you understand. Learns names. Take whatever he offers.
Wonderful lectures! Interesting and very easy to understand. Essay tests are hard but if you pay attention in class and study you will be fine. Great class!
His essay tests are intimidating at first but just study your lengthy notes and you will be fine.

I absolutely loved this class! Best teacher ever at TCU, wished he taught all my classes. Don't take this class if you're lazy...tests consist of essays only. Skip class and you will pay for it dearly. Very funny yet dorky, knows his asian history!

He is one of my favorite teacher. His classes are fun and interesting. I learn a lot from it. We have lots of work, but they are not very hard. If you study, the tests will not be hard. I would recomend you to take his class.
Very cool guy.  My favorite teacher.  Could use a better TA though

Best Prof at TCU!  He makes an 8oclock totally worth the lack of sleep.  His tests are fair but all written.  Go in with your papers and he will proof them for you.  Written me many recs and is whilling to help with other history classes.

By far the best prof I've had, he keeps things interesting with his enthusiasm (and hand gestures). He knows his stuff and if you pay attention you'll do fine in the class. Too bad his TA grades the papers, though; he is completely unfair.
Great teacher. Test are a little hard, and you have to read 5 books, but he makes the class fun with his personality.  if you want to sleep through a class this is not it.
Excellent teacher, knows his stuff. Watch for interesting hand gestures! There is a lot of information but it is worth learning, and the class is fun.

He is an excellent teacher that explains everything very clearly. He also knows his stuff because of his experiences overseas. It is a great class to take if you are in Honors Program. Best teacher so far at TCU for me.
He is an excellent Prof.  If I could I would take all my classes with him.  If you get an opportunity definetly take one of his classes.
I worked SO hard in that class and was poorly compensated for it.  He relied on an incompetent TA for grades.  The harder I studied the worse my grades became.  Made me drop the honors program.

He was great. He was very informative and gets his point across in a clear and fun method. His classes are really interesting and he makes sure that everyone gets involved. I would definitely recommend this professor.
He's really enjoyable to listen to, and really makes the class fun and interesting.  The tests are hard, and the notes are long, but he's really worth your time.
Very hard prof, but you will learn so much!! He tests hard, but he is fair. If you study and read you will do fine. He is always available outside of class and will help with any problems.
THIS MAN IS NOT UNDERSTANDING AT ALL!! HE IS REALLY HARD AND DOESNT HELP STUDENTS.

Definitely a hard teacher but I learned more in that class then any other...  he knows how his stuff and knows it well..  just don't be stupid and skip a lot and you will like him and the class a whole lot..

One of my favorites! He explains everything very well; is knowledgable & passionate about what he teaches. He's been here since Fall '02, but many people want to take any/all his classes. Watch out for the essay tests; he takes off for dates and years!

An amazing teacher.  Easily the best teacher I've had at TCU.  He explains everything really well, and I actually wanted to go to his lectures, this guy knows his stuff and he knows how to teach it.  The tests are a little tough, but not bad.
Best teacher I've had at TCU.
No Comments
took history of china with him...it was ok, the only history class at TCU that i have ever had that i had no clue what the hell was going on in.  hes smart, but not the best teacher...
w/ him, a must take class. Class is enjoyable, lots of material, but managable.

Dr. Qualls is an amazing professor, while her class may be harder then some of the other options, its well worth it due to how good of a teacher she is, if you take her class you will understand the content enough difficulty won't be a problem.

I have had Dr. Qualls for two semesters, soon to be three, and she is the best! Exams are hard but show up to class, take notes, and you will do well. Does small in class assignments but gives you the answer to them. Highly recommend taking her because she wants you to succeed.

Dr. Qualls is one of the best Engineering Professors that I have had. I had her for MATLAB and Solids 1. She is a great lecturer and explains all the material well. She does do In Class Assessments (ICA), for both of her classes that I have taken her for, however these are more just for attendance because she tells you what the answers are.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Qualls is one of the best engineering professors at TCU! She genuinely wants you to succeed both inside and outside the classroom. However, for statics, it seemed like there were few grades - ex. no quizzes to help balance out bad test scores. I still would 10/10 recommend her, though!

He is the rudest professor I've had at TCU. So full of himself and just lectures what the book says. He randomly calls on you and then makes fun of your response. Participation in the class is a must. Over 90% of students get a 70% for participation and 1% get a 100%. Would easily take someone else for this class.

Dr. Q is amazing! He teaches real-world success, not just textbook. Class is interactive and engaging with low-pressure participation. He is NOT there to fail you: he gives exam reviews, bonus points, and highlights exactly what's on the test during lectures. He genuinely cares and respects your time. Take him for critical thinking and a blast!

He is a chill guy that cares about teaching. Go to class to fully understand what will be on the final. There is a chill group project. I recommend taking him if you want an easy global business class.

His class and syllabus are super confusing and unorganized. He communicates mostly everything in class so even though he doesn't take attendance it is still important to go. He can be condescending and he cold calls but I think he means well and he is a fun professor to have who gives great real world advice. And his tests are pretty easy.

Quigley is an underrated professor. Great advice and lectures that give you real world knowledge. If you contribute occasionally and stay on top of the group project you will have a great semester with Quigley

Talks about himself a lot, but he knows his stuff. Wants to help you learn the material, tests are easy and although closed note, he tells you exactly (and I mean exactly) what is on them. Relatively easy grader as well.

No idea why Professor Quigley gets poor reviews. No homework, no quizzes, and no exam—just a weekly quiz you can easily Chat. He gives you a review for the midterm and final, and it's nearly identical to the actual test. If you're just trying to get credits without stress, this class is perfect. I'm a regular finance bro, and this class is perfect.

Dr. Quigley is an amazing professor that genuinely cares about his students. He teaches a class that he can actually relate to due to all of his life experiences. 1 midterm that was free if you study at all and a final thats not comprehensive. Participate a little bit and you just got yourself and A. Best professor ever. Take him!

Quigley is the best Global Business professor at TCU. In my experience, he truly cares about his students and their success by showing a genuine interest in us. He will give you real-world tools/advice to apply to your life. His class is easy if you pay attention, and he does not try to trick you on tests. He's my favorite professor this semester.

Please do not waste your money by taking this class. He plays favorites so if you're not one, he basically picks on you for the whole semester and will grill you with questions. He had a few students who he would relentlessly call on - it was weird. Everyone agrees that he's a waste of time. Crazy to think that Neeley hasn't fired him yet.

-From day one, it's clear he has favorites - if you're not one, good luck
-Vocal about who he likes, even offering them jobs, while others feel judged or dismissed
-Guests promote pyramid schemes
-Leave class feeling dumb/angry, often embarrassed for answering wrong/too slow

Honestly, his behavior is embarrassing for a prestigious business school.

I absolutely hated this class, but I know he can't help that the material is uninteresting. Tests come from the textbook/slides, nothing is really taught in class because he just talks about himself and his lime farm. He acted like a genius for predicting Bitcoin going up. Going to class feels like a waste of time but you need participation cred.
Quigley is the best
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Quigley is awesome. This is one of those classes that you get out what you put in. It's not going to be a hard class at Neeley by any means - but if you apply the material to what you're learning its worth your time. Professor is very knowledgeable in life skills and investing. One con, some of the guest speaker decisions were just okay.

Prof. Quig has engaging lectures and a positive spirit. Open-book/online weekly quizzes. Easy grader for the 5-part group project- he wants to give you the best grade possible. Vague exam study guide from the PPTs, but I got a 100. He does cold call and keeps a mental note of participation (10%). Probably the only downside since it's subjective...

Dr. Quigley's class was enjoyable and not too strenuous. I learned a lot, and his investing advice and tangents made the class engaging. Builds personal connections with students, which I appreciate. Group projects were doable, and movies were fun, tests were tough due to random questions and vague reviews. I'd take again but want clear exam prep.

Dr. Quigley is a good professor with a lot experience, such as the Air Force and running multiple companies. He talks a lot about investments in class, which helps the class with exposure to investing concepts. The group project is not super hard, but does require your group to be active. His exams can be challenging, but you just need to study.

Very boastful & doesn't teach anything related to the course work. Only talks about investing and guest speakers had nothing really to do about the course work. Group project was fine but he does not prepare students well for the mid term or the final. Overall rude, and there was multiple times where he didn't show up to class without warning.

He's a great guy who will share a lot of knowledge with you. However, its mostly stuff that doesn't relate to the course at all. Weekly quizzes over textbook chapters are online and easy. The group project is not very difficult. The only exams are the midterm and final, which can be hard because there's not much guidance on what to study.

Tests are not as hard as Students are claiming. I barely attended the first half of the semester due to a family issue and got a 70. If i had attended and paid attention a 90+ would be very likely. The complaining about the test(s) being hard is a byproduct of people seeing "Ethics" in the title and thinking its a free A. High EQ and Kind.
Would not recommend. He has a tendency to boast about himself and typically just reads off the slides. Tests asks questions about miniscule details.
Class just sucks. Everything bad about neeley wrapped into one! Super harsh grader for some odd reason. Lots of kids failed the midterm. And oh yeah, spot reviews aren't anonymous so be careful

He's overall a great dude with a TON of professional experience. He was in the Air Force, started multiple of his own companies, and just has so much down-to-earth wisdom. Make sure to participate in discussions, and read the weekly case studies from the textbook, because they will be discussed at the beginning of each class. Would def take again.

Quigley loves to talk about himself and his personal success, very egocentric. Quigs will say midterm is easy and not to study much, ITS NOT EASY. He also gives a participation grade, I missed 2 classes and spoke often, got an 82. While a girl (very attractive) I sat next too got a 100 and didn't raise her hand more than 5 times in the class.

Great Professor. Quigley has an extremely impressive background and often drops random knowledge that I find really interesting. He lectures very well and its easy to take notes. Exams are very difficult. Group project is much easier than exams.
awesome name

Probably one of the worst professors I've had at TCU. Basically reads off of premade slides and talks about investing rather than book material, yet exams are all book based and very specific. "Study guide" he gave left out key concepts for exams. Overall rude if you ask questions, gives confusing instructions on group project. Take someone else.

He was really nice and the lectures were engaging but he didn't grade anything until after the final was due. Graded everything the day grades were due and I had no idea what my grade was until after I was home for break. Gave barely any feedback but doesn't grade that harshly.

He didn't grade 75% of papers until after final so I didn't know if I was doing well or not in the class. He grades way too harsh for only teaching half of the time. Do not take unless you are a PERFECT writer.

He was rude and condescending towards students, graded everything late (including final grades) so we didn't have helpful feedback, and didn't respond to any of my emails. Moved the midterm date up last minute. 

The class was essay heavy but he is an easy grader for those. 

Hated going to his class because of him, not the content.

He is very condescending towards students, graded everything really late so we didn't have helpful feedback, and didn't respond to emails. 

No study content whatsoever, not even lecture slides. 

Hated going to his class because of him, not the content. Lots of essays but the class wasn't too difficult, just frustrating.

TBH I didnt learn ANYTHING new about the criminal justice system through this class. we spent the first MONTH introducing ourselves and after week 6, lectures had nothing to do with textbook it was all just philosophical debates that dont prepare you for the exams. slow grader. take with someone else if you can. otherwise youre wasting your time
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: EASIEST A EVER. He encourages and strongly emphasizes your need to get and read the textbook but honestly I only read 2 chapters and never touched it again and was just fine. All of the lectures are discussion based where he prompts you to answer a moral question and the whole class will debate the topic.TESTS ARE NOT LOCK DOWN BROWSER.

Papers every WEEK, and 50+ pages of reading 2 times a week.Lectures were never over textbook material. Discussions were intriguing but not helpful in preparing for the midterm. The midterm was over 8 chapters and all you could do to study was re read the 400+ pages. ALL GRADES weren't posted till OVER an week after PNC. Super nice guy though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Didn't love this class. Lectures are straight-up discussions and he'll randomly call on you multiple times a class. Gradebook is all papers, literally had a paper or two a week and he simply doesn't put the grades in. Midterm is impossible bc the class is all discussion so barely anything to study- told us to know the entire textbook for the test
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Q was great. Lectures were not lectures but rather discussions, kept me awake and engaged. My only complaint is that he didn't assign our papers throughout the semester so we had 2 big (5-8pg) papers and 2 small (1-3pg) papers in the last 2 weeks. Tests online, 4 big papers 8 small papers. I really enjoyed this class and his teaching style.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --So many papers

reviews.comment: Being in Q's class this semester was a treat - the lectures were insightful and Q brought in a bunch of various guest speakers to talk about their experiences in the criminal justice system. Most importantly, Q actually took the time to learn each of his students by name and actively enabled a safe space to discuss controversial topics. TAKE Q!!!

Quinton is a great guy and this class is a SUPER easy A. Grades are literally only 2 tests, two essays, and a few critical thinking responses. the tests do not have a lockdown browser and all the answers are on quizlet. however lectures are beyond boring and we did introductions for the entire first month of the semester (no exaggeration)
Super easy class. Only a midterm and a final and an essay. Lectures are super boring but its an easy A

Q is an amazing professor! His classes were entirely discussion based and he allowed us to have meaningful conversation about difficult topics while being a unbiased moderator. The class required us to do readings from a textbook to prepare for these conversations and there were two pretty difficult exams about obscure elements from those readings.

Q is an above-and-beyond-great professor. His class is entertaining, and the activities are super fun. He has no bias. He does not push any opinions. all papers and class activities are learning experiences and create a comradery within the class. I have zero bad things to say.

Highly suggest taking Prof. Q. His class is mostly discussion based, and there are very little assignments and only 2 exams, which are super reasonable. Class is mandatory, but it is entertaining so its not hard to attend.

The content of his lectures was interesting but the structure of this class is horrible. Also felt a certain agenda is pushed on you, and definitely made it known he liked certain people more than others
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Q is easily one of the best professors I've taken, although attendance is mandatory this class is pretty enjoyable to attend and the homework load is very light. There are a few papers, a midterm, and a final. I'd recommend him for criminal justice.

Dr. Queen is one of the best professors I've had, and I'd recommend her to anyone. The class is interesting and very applicable for business majors. She uses both the provided textbooks and online articles well. Group projects are easy and interactive, and she's very understanding, even canceling class during busy times

Super super easy class, great teacher too. You can tell she cares a lot about her subject. Only thing that is the downside is the attendance policy which gives you 2 absences and then drops your final grade 2% afterwards. Still a great teacher.
Dr Kristen Queen is the best!
would not take this course again
Super easy arts class to get an A and the professor is amazing!! Definitely recommend taking her class!
Take her! She is awesome and really caring. She helps a lot by teaching things that we may use in the future. TAKE HER!!!
TAKE ANYTHING BY DR QUEEN. She is so amazing and genuinely cares. No busy work and every reading is short and to the point. BEST TEACHER!

Professor Queen is SO nice and caring! She works with you for any deadline or assignment that you might need extra time on. Her class was very boring and the 80 min lecture felt like eternity but it was an easy fine arts credit!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Incredibly kind professor. She truly cares and is a great lecturer. Very easy assignments. We do have to do a lot of reading but it was possible to not read and do good in the class. I liked how she taught and used powerpoints along with her lectures. Highly recommend for a fine arts credit!

This professor is a super easy A. This class is probably the easiest fine arts credit you can get. She assigns a book at the start of the semester and has weekly readings that you discuss in class, but you don't actually have to do the readings. She has easy journal reflections that are super chill. She is also super nice and understanding.

Professor Queen is a very nice and understanding woman who cares about all of her students. The material is fairly interesting and is a perfect introduction course for arts majors or business majors who want to fill the core requirement. There is a bit of reading in the class and she is always willing to give constructive and helpful feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Queen is so nice and understanding, she gives such good feedback and truly made coming to class easy. Intro to arts leadership and entrepreneurship is fairly interesting and easy, perfect for an art credit or a business student interested in art or non profit

TAKE HER! Easiest FAR credit without a doubt. She's so nice and cares about students. There are two books, but I never read any of the assigned readings and was fine. Only two exams - midterm and final - and both are super short and easy. There are a couple of presentations but they are again short and easy. Highly recommend.

LOVE her. She has completely changed the ARLE program for the better. The class had interesting convos about vulnerability & emotions and had guest speakers. She brought snacks and was super approachable I felt like I could come to her with anything and I respect her so much. Definitely a role model and amazing teacher

I took an Honors colloquia with Dr. Queen. She is an amazing professor that truly cares about her students. She prioritizes learning and growth over grades - if you participate in class, you will get an A. Highly recommend!

Dr. Queen is amazing. UNLF is considered an easy A class, but she makes it feel worth your time. She is so respectful and caring. It is obvious she loves her job. Made the class enjoyable, and I looked forward to it just to see her. She is very accommodating as well.
The class was interesting and we had good conversation in class. You write an essay in parts so it makes it doable. He was very invested too!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Quiñones was great! His class on technology really helped me think more critically and each class I learned something. The essay helped me with grad school. Great class.
The professor has no idea what he is doodling or what i going on in class. It disorganized and he comes unprepared to class. He decides things on the spot and students are always confused.

I loved this class! Professor Quinones is super down to earth and chill. Class is based off three essays regarding a technology of your choosing, 5 mini speeches (90 seconds really easy), 2 group discussions (also super easy), and a final creation project. I put minimal effort in and ended with a 98. Highly recommend

Dr. Shi was extremely nice but this class is way harder than it should be. You will get points marked off for your essay questions on exams if they do not match exactly word for word with the answer sheet given to the TA's. There are also 6 exams so basically one every other week. This is not the way to teach a course, I'd recommend someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Oh my gosh. This class. I love Dr. Shi, but wow. Very understanding professor and easy to contact, but your exams are 80% of your grade. there are 6 of them.
