She has a ton of extra credit opportunities, but it's because of how poorly my class performed initially. I know someone who took advanced Developmental Psych and said it was easier.

The class material is interesting, and she's a nice person, but she made the class unnecessarily hard by not curving exams and lecturing the entirety of every class period. Would not recommend taking at all.

The homework is really important, it tells you exactly what will be on the test. There is a quiz every week and it's a bit hard to stay on top of that, but the actual quiz content is never that difficult. He also really cares that you do well in the course and is always willing to help.

also had him for calc 2. best math professor/teacher i have ever had. his lectures are funny and clear. very generous grader. quizzes and exams are very straightforward (problems are similar to the ones in the notes). very helpful and caring in office hours. still have to put in a fair amount of work but trust me it will pay off. just take him.
My go-to professor for advanced theorical math courses, really try his best for students to understand things and get good grade

There is quite a bit of homework, but it definitely helps prepare you for the exams if you put work into it. Very funny. He made the class genuinely pretty enjoyable. He isn't the best at answering questions, but the lectures are good. If you're a math person, he's the prof for you. If not, find a prof that explains concepts more in detail

Dr. Zhang is very funny and makes lots of jokes which is why he has such a good rating. I would not say he explains the material super well in class, though. I basically had to teach myself everything before each test. He did let our class redo all our tests at home minus the final and he averaged the 2 tries which boosted my grade.
Zhang is a great professor with informational and accessible PowerPoints. Homework is due every other day and three exams. Would recommend taking him for elementary stats.

I would say he's a nice and compassionate person. There are 3 exams you must study in advance after you learn the last unit of each of them; besides the final. If you struggle...PLEASE go to office hours. P.S. going to office hours helps with building relationships with your professors...more grace too ;)

Zhang is an awesome prof but I struggled at the end of this course. There are weekly quizzes and homeworks but they dont really affect your grade, it is majority graded by tests. The final is worth 30% of the grade and killed my average at the end. Its kinda tough to ask questions because of the language barrier, but not too bad.

Dr. Zhang is funny and keeps class interesting. He is a good teacher and wants you to succeed, but be prepared to put in the work. You have homework after every class, but it's really beneficial to your learning. 40% of your points on quizzes are from writing your name. Tests are difficult but doable. No extra credit.

Zhang was an amazing professor. Although Statistics was hard for me (because I'm not a math person) Professor Zhang was so incredibly helpful in making sure his students feel known in his class, and he gives many opportunities to better understand the material he is lecturing. He's very funny, caring, and open-minded to new ideas. TAKE ZHANG!!!

His English is good while teaching, but has trouble when responding to questions. He over complicates his lectures, but provides lots of examples/exercises in class. There is a quiz just about every week (every 2 lectures or so). HW does not always align with lessons and sometimes has questionable grading on tests (miss one mc question  -1.5 pts)

Calculus II is a challenging course, but Professor Zhang is extremely organized with the course schedule and assignment due dates. Professor Zhang combines his great sense of humor with thorough lectures, which has made him one of my favorite professors. If you have to take Calc II, you MUST take Professor Zhang!
Best math professor I have ever had! Definitely take him!

He's charming and well-organized, his lectures and explanations are easy to follow, and his jokes are undeniably hilarious. He gives homework every day, which actually prepares you well for quizzes and exams. Attendance is not mandatory, but his quizzes are not pre-announced. He gives extra credit in exams and final. He must really have a fan club!

Dr. Zhang is hands down one of my favorite professors at TCU. He has a really charming personality and sense of humor, and most importantly to me he's extremely organized. All of his lectures are quite easy to follow, and while his tests aren't easy, differential equations is not an easy class, and he gives you a fair amount of preparation.

Prof Zhang is the best option for Calc 1. Gives partial credit on tests/quizzes which is helpful. Homework assigned every night and its due every Monday/Thursday. If you have problems in class, tell him and he will be happy to help. Make sure you go to class because all of his quizzes are pop quizzes BUT you start out w/ a 40% just from your name!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He has an accent (often mispronouncing 'require' and 'special'), but it is no problem. You will soon realize he is very easy to follow. Lectures are clear, and the tests are straightforward. He even gives extra credit for tests. Take him if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I take him and this is my bad choice. His exam is not difficult, but he made it complex and take off a lot of partial points because of your outline, assumption, conclusion, formula... I think they are trivial problems, he should omit them but he didn't.

This was my second class with Dr. Zhang, though statistics was much easier than calc 2. He is hilarious and definitely one of the best professors in the math department. There are three tests throughout the semester, then a final which is about a third of your grade. Study hard and you can do well, and actually enjoy math.

Dr. Zhang teaches a pretty tough subject in calc 2 and does it with tact and a respect for his students. He is more than willing to help out with any questions people have about the class. Three tests and a final, plus homework and occasional quizzes. He is easy to listen to and is one of the best the math department has to offer.

Great teacher!  He has a way of getting the point on all areas across.  C- is a 60 and above.  Calculus II is not an easy class, but he seemed to make it very doable.  Homework due twice a week.  Test are from homework and quizzes.  By far one of the best teachers at TCU.

Professor Zhang is a more fast paced professor. I didn't really like his teaching style. There is homework due every class. However, if you ask questions about the homework before you turn it in at the end, he'll do it in class.. that saved me a lot of points. The tests are slightly easier than the homework, and you MUST study for them.

Extremely organized.  Provides online lecture notes afterwards that are easy to read.  He is very accessible outside of class, and although he has an accent, he is easy to follow and interacts with the class to assess which areas are being understood and which areas need to be re-explained.

Professor Zhang is very nice and helpful and will usually go over any homework problems people have questions on before the beginning of class. Tests are graded fairly and partial credit is given if you show and explain your work. He will also give random quizzes that give a good idea of what the tests will be like. Overall it was a great class.

You have to show up every day because he gives out quizzes but for the most part the quizzes are easy. Study the quizzes for the test and you will do really well! Not very good in math and still received an A in the course he is actually kind of funny and helpful for the most part.

He is great at explaining concepts, and his accent is not a problem at all. The class itself isn't too hard, and the tests are more than fair. Outside of class, he's a super nice guy and he is willing to work with students so that they can understand exactly what they need to know.
Easy class if you need a math class. Made his lectures funny and enjoyable.

Zhang is super passionate about what he is teaching. He will put mathematical terms into English for a better understanding. His accent is difficult though and his grammar isn't great, but he is a super nice guy and his stats class is not hard at all.

I love his class. I am not a math person but his lectures are not hard to follow. He has quizzes every class but they are not hard and they really help prepare you for the test. He is really adorable and makes little jokes during class to keep things interesting. His test are hard but if you study hard and know the material you will get an A.

A great teacher, he explained every topic clearly and was more than willing to give the class a refresher on a topic if many of us were fuzzy on it.  From what I have heard, he is one of, if not the best Calc III professors here.

Great professor. He will help you out if you are having trouble with some of the material during his office hours. He has an accent but you will get use to it. Make sure you attend class or you will fall behind. Also homework gets lengthy.

Dr.Zhang is one of my favorite professors. Do not worry about his accent, you will get used to it. Calc 2 is tough but he is generous with partial credit and it is possble to make an A. He likes to keep his Calc 2 class test average at a mid-C.  Calc 3 is alot easier, but gets tough around the end. I give you 42 seconds to sign up for this class.

Dr. Zhang is a great teacher. He teaches the class in theory and then you go do your HW which is not always helpful or fun. But, if your taking this class you are good at math and chose to be there, so won't be an issue. Attendance not mandatory but go to class bc the book can't always teach you tricks you missed out in class. Great teacher!

Zhang is a very helpful teacher. He teaches things clear enough to be able to do well on the hw, quizzes, and test. The class is tough, but it's math, so practice is necessary to make a good grade. Go to his office hours as much as you can, he will help you. He also gives plenty of partial credit. Take him for Cal 2.

Calculus 2 is not an easy class, but zhang is one of the best teachers in the math department. Gives so much Partial Credit which is great. Homework everynight, which is not that bad. If you want to do well then you will do fine.

He is slightly hard to understand at first because of his accent, but you get used to it quickly. He is very helpful and i found the way that he explains the concepts to be extremely helpful! I tested out of Calc 1 and had no problems in his calc 2 class because he did enough review at the beginning that i was able to recall the details. Very good!

Calc I: Oh my gosh i love Dr. Zhang! He's very generous when it comes to partial credit! He is very clear with explaining things and he's very helpful! You can tell he's very smart, but he does a good job of bringing the material down to our level.  3 tests plus the final. Homework due once a week. He's such a cutie!

Calc 2: Omg I love Dr. Zhang! He has coined some of my favorite new expressions. And he always reminds me--have fun! His tests can occasionally be a bit tricky but no worries,he grades leniently. He also is very very happy to help you during office hours and cares about his students. Clear lectures, homework mostly straightforward, VERY smart guy!
Awsome professor.  An A is possible, all you need to do is practice, practice, and practice.

Class is hard in itself. His lectures are proofs, which do not help with homework and test problems. Learned more by going to his office hours. I suggest taking someone else, but he knows what he is talking about.
Horrible teacher, never ever tke his class. I learnt everything by myself If u listen to him he'll confuse u more. N he only teaches the proofs and very little example.

Very nice and will help you during office hours. Spent majority of semester doing proofs which confused the whole class but after talking to him he started to give more examples. I would recommend to take him now that he shows how to do problems instead of proving them. Go2 class, comm w/ him and show you want to do well,u will at least pass

Dr. Quinn was a great, outgoing teacher who makes light out of some pretty boring topics. He was very engaging and if you read and participate once or twice a week you will do fine. Keeping up with reading is important and taking time to write your essays carefully and creatively is the key to success.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There were only four grades the entire semester. I attended every class and I'm an A student, but I still ended up with a bad grade. He makes it difficult for students without a strong finance background to fully understand the material. Challenging class, especially for an elective. He's nice, but the class really made me lose confidence.

Very sweet professor. The readings are a little boring, but he thoroughly goes over the material in class with a very interesting lecture. There are two papers in the class and a small written quiz over each paper to make sure you know the material. Very nice professor, read and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Weekly hw is creating an Excel chart and 4 papers total. He is highly enthusiastic and funny, provided you can follow along. I did not talk too much, but he remembered my name and was friendly.

Best Professor. Economics of financial markets has hands down given me the most applicable to a career knowledge. Quinn knows so much and you can tell he really loves the material. I only regret that I didn't go see him outside of class more. I'm a Finance minor and this class taught me more real life and in depth info than any Neeley fin. class.

Dr. Quinn is an amazing professor who is clearly very passionate about what he teaches. This grade is based on three papers, with the opportunity to do a fourth to replace one of the two midterms. It is absolutely imperative that you attend class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Quinn. He enjoys teaching Financial History so much that you will feel his excitement in every lecture. Very temperament, it takes time to get used to his way of lecturing. Lots of reading, but overall a great class with 3 big papers and 3 short analysis.

Took him for Financial History and he takes the WEM portion of this class very seriously! There are a series of articles assigned for each class, he'll outline the readings the following day. These articles will be used as sources for when you make your own argument based on a prompt.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Quinn is great. He is very understanding of Covid-19. There is no textbook in financial history but a series of readings that you can choose to use or not for each paper. Favorite Prof
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Quinn is one of my favorite professors that I've had so far at TCU. He really loves the topic that he's teaching and always brings a ton of enthusiasm to class every day. There are no tests in this class but you are graded on 3 major papers and a presentation. There is a great deal of required reading that you will be quizzed on weekly.
One of the best professors in the department. His course is organized, which helps you grasp the big picture at the end. He's also a funny guy.
Dr. Quinn is the best professor I had at TCU. Incredibly helpful and does a tremendous job of teaching one of the harder classes within the economics major. I would take him for any class he teaches.

Dr. Quinn keeps class interesting and even makes topics like econometrics cool and bearable. Very eager to help and he actually wants you to learn. Very personable too. Passionate about teaching and his students. Great guy, great professor, take him! Exams are hard, but it's all inclass material.
Very good teacher. Didn't understand what i was doing all semester and still got a B. Put in the effort and he'll reciprocate. Very helpful out side of classroom.

Attendance not mandatory but highly recommended. Dr. Quinn is awesome. Has a great personality and sense of humor and does almost everything he can to keep class interesting. Very open with office hours and is extremely helpful as long as you reach out to him. Highly recommend.

Dr. Quinn is an amazing teacher! He is so passionate about economics, and he cares more that you're interested in the class and understand the material than taking the traditional teaching route. Definitely worth taking his intro to micro class! Definitely attend his extra study hours before tests- they're definitely worth it!
Easily one of the best teachers at TCU.  He actually cares that you learn the material and does a great job of keeping the course interesting.  If your an Econ/ Business major you need to take him.
Hands down the best teacher that I have had. Makes all of the material very easy to understand. Tests can be difficult, but the best microeconomics teacher that you can get.

Great guy, passionate about what he teaches. Doesn't require attendance but is helpful if you don't know the stuff. Tests are straightforward and not overly difficult. I would highly recommend taking it with him!!

a really great professor. he is very helpful outside of class and presents the material in a way that is very easy to understand and learn. he does alot of activities and gives real life examples for the material we are learning. his class is not boring!

He taught micro in a very interesting way. He tried to simplfy things alot but sometimes it jsut made it even more confusing. I recomend taking the final f you are close to getting the higher grade; i thought it was the easiest of all his tests.

Took his micro class & he did an amazing job teaching it.I recommend the 055 section cuz its taught completely different than any other micro class on campus.He gives u many different scenarios to help u learn.His tests were hard & tricky,but he gives u a lot of study material so that if u work hard,u will make a good grade.Very fun guy & helpful

Dr. Quinn is the best teacher I've had at TCU. The only advice would be to attend his classes, though sometimes not interesting, everything you need to note he writes on the board himself to stress. If you miss classes it is difficult to catch up but not impossible, I missed 3 classes before one unit test and got a C+, go and its an effortless B.

He is a really good teacher. He is very clear in explaining the material and also about what will be on the test. He is always available to help and his study sessions before the tests are VERY HELPFUL. This class is not extremely easy but it also not impossible.

He is very passionate about what he teaches and always excited about class. He wants everyone to do well and is available if you need help. I never thought I would like Economics until I took him. Stay ahead with the lectures; do the practice problems he gives for each day. He sometimes gives extra points on the test for attending class.

Best teacher i have ever had at TCU. EXTREMELY helpful, always around even though he has kids, wants you to learn the material and be excited about class. Some tests questions are a little vague, but if you are a business or econ person, take him, he is great and makes class fun.

This guy is AMAZING. I absolutely loved his energy and his teaching style. This class is hard, for sure, but you can pull off an A. Do all the sample work he has on his website and read the book. Most of all..go to class! He knows all his students and he is so helpful!
Awesome teacher. His Financial History class was one of the best courses I've taken at TCU. Definetly recommend to anyone. (even if you're not Econ!)

Yes, he's got energy...but that's what keeps his class flowing! Never did I think I could be interested in something like microecon. I actually took his class for honors, and I found it to be tough. BUT, if i could go back and re-choose my professor...I wouldn't! Just study for his class, pay attention in class, and gave group study sessions.
this guy is a true genius. the best professor i have this semester by far. if you actually want to learn and get something out of a class, Dr. Quinn is the way to go

He is very energetic. HOWEVER all he does is bounce around all class. He makes everyting VERY complicated. There is not book that he goes by so if you can't figure out what he's talking about in class you have no book really. I thought it was VERY hard. Study a TON. Do the "sample problems" as classes go on. BAsically i didnt like him or the class!

Very energetic due to high coffee consumption.  Pay attention to lectures, work the study problems off of the internet.  Multiple choice/short answer tests.  Cumulative, not mandatory, final. Show up to class everyday b/c u never know when he will have a class activity which gives u extra credit points on you test.  Ask if you need help.
You will love this class, plus he has the most gorgeous eyes you have ever seen!  Put it this way...you'll learn a lot and it's nice scenery!
He has SOOOOO much energy but is a great teacher.

Very nice man, somewhat crazy during lectures. Keeps you interested and entertained through the class.  Not too hard, but have to give him what he expects. Tests are all short answer and problems(in the honors section) but he gives partial credit.Test material comes primarily from lectures, not the book.

(Honors section) Dr. Quinn is an awesome professor- he makes the class interesting by involving students in games that illustrate the topic, and his tests are not too easy but my no means impossible either. He doesn't take attendence but it really helps going to class. Homework is not turned in, but is very helpful for exams. Funny guy too!

Hard for first time students who know nothing about microeconomics. He's very animated and speaks in regular language, as opposed to being technical and vauge. Sometimes it felt like his tests were specific to what he metnions in class and not what is in the book.

extremely knowledgable prof who really likes what he does, for a freshman with little economics exposure, class can be pretty confusing, he teaches things that aren't normally taught at intro level, stufy the tests online ad youll be fine. Get to know him and go to his study groups.

He is an AMAZING teacher!  Keeps you interested and really helps you to understand the material. He makes class fun and often offers extra credit points just for showing up and participating.  Test can be a bit dificult, but not too bad. This is a great class!!!!
Nice guy, but I wasn't particularly interested in the topic. Study and I think you will do well. He is very understanding and helps out alot. Bumps up grades if necessary.
Great teacher, always willing to help and talk outside of class.  Class was hard because it was the first time it was taught, but Dr. Quinn is an awsome teacher.

I only went to class 5 times but somehow ended up with a B so I guess this class wasn't too hard. You can pass his tests by just studying the old ones. Funny person, may seem like he's on speed most of the time but that's just how he is.

Really great guy and he teaches really well.  He teaches the class so that you really understand the concepts you're learning.  If you're looking for a good intro to micro class that isn't too hard, this is it.
Learned alot.  Nice professor.
he are t3h pwn best teacher ive seen at tcu yet

if you have to take micro, he's the best guy to take it with.  very likeable, entertaining.  tests are easy if you read and come to class.  gives you last years tests to study with--and they're very similar.
Dr. Quinn is AMAZING! He teaches through creative methods that make economics so much easier to understand!!! Two thumbs up!
He is an awesome professor, class is a lot of fun, not much homework involved and if you pay attention and study a little, you will make an A
Top Professor at TCU! Definitely take his class for microeconomics.
Best professor I've ever had.  Extremely intelligent individual.
BEST teacher I've had in 2 years @ TCU!  always willing to help:)
One of the best Micro Professors.  His activities help make sense of things.
great sense of humor, excellent in class activities

Very important you go to lecture you will be very confused if you don't. The material may seem hard at first but Dr.Roche is very good at helping students understand the material. He does offer zoom meetings if you need extra help on material.
Don't take this class unless you have to. Very difficult class and the professor is bad at explaining complex subject matter and gets easily annoyed with students who have trouble understanding it.
The concepts are confusing but somehow they always end up clicking before the tests. The material is very interesting. Prof Bill is chill and funny.

He is super funny! Attendance is not mandatory, but class moves at a fast pace so you will want to be in class. There are 4 tests, but the tests are not hard if you study the material he puts on D2L. He always makes jokes, and is super personable. There is reading that he posts online, but it is not too much.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This guy is the goat, you need to actively study to do well but he is super funny and flexible

Professor Roche is an amazing teacher. He is super funny and entertaining and clearly wants his students to succeed. The class moves quickly so attendance is important. However if you miss a class he is very willing to help you catch up. I wouldn't take this if you want an easy credit unless you are willing to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Roche explains concepts really well and tries to apply the content to parts of our lives/majors to show us why it really matters which is great. He's also very funny and easy to talk to if you need help. The concepts can be daunting when they're first introduced but get much easier as he explains. 4 tests, but you'll know exactly whats on them.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: easy core class graded on four tests. Nothing he says really makes any sense, but if you memorize the concepts the day before, you will be fine. He gives a practice test almost identical to the actual one. he's also always mentioning beer for some reason

For those who have taken Scope and Methods (Political Science), critical reasoning is essentially the equivalent. The only grades in the class are 5 tests. I didn't really study much until a day or two but I studied a lot. Topics are difficult to understand at points. Tests get more difficult after each test. Make sure to do well early on.

Dr. Roche is a very entertaining and captivating speaker who is able to keep student's attention for the entirety of class. You are graded on 4 tests, and they get progressively harder as the semester progresses. As long as you go to class and study the night before tests you will do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Roche's class is hard but doable. If you miss one class you will be lost, so make sure you show up. There are 4 total exams and that is all you are graded on but they are not hard. It just gets a bit difficult at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A really challenging class at first but once it clicks you'll do great. Dr.Roche is honestly really funny at times and he knows what he's talking about. He allows a notecard with you for tests which is so helpful. He is also willing to work with you if you are confused. I personally really enjoy the class and recommend taking it with Dr.Roche.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The material is challenging, but Roche has detailed lectures that explains it well. I didnt do very well so I used a P/NC, but many friends got As. I learned a ton and looked forward to going to class.

This class was very difficult, but Mr Roche is a pretty easy grader. He can be very inappropriate and weird you out at times, but it does keep you engaged. His biggest drawback is that his handwriting is illegible. I have spent a lot of time trying to decipher his numbers and letters, making me miss some of the lecture and making me more confused.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nice guy, but class is extremely difficult.  Will let you retake tests but is rarely on campus for you to do so.  Very knowledgeable but just expects everyone to understand quickly like he does.  I would not recommend this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would highly reccommend taking Professor Roche. If you are willing to put in the work, this class will not be terribly difficult. Your grade will mostly depend on tests, and he will also pop quiz on assigned readings later in the semester. Overall he is an amazing professor and super funny as well.
Dr. Roche is super funny, class lectures are confusing and boring, but tests aren't super hard and he's not a very tough grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Roche definitely knows what he is talking about. Critical Reasoning is definitely not easy but if you do the practice exercises they are exactly what's on the exam. If you are good at math this is a good class for you or you can just memorize your way through it. The exam essay is given to you ahead of time so there arent any surprises.

With only three essays to be graded off of, I think that his course was very challenging to succeed. It is a kind of teach yourself class, because he moves very quickly and leaves little explanations for the work. However, I think that he is a very funny professor and I did learn a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Bill is a great guy. The content is very difficult but he has very thorough lectures and gives examples. You can miss class (you won't be penalized) but missing a day can set you back in terms of the lecture. Don't get the book- there's no need. Tests get progressively harder. No homework really. Still not an easy class.

Dr. Roche's lectures are pretty clear-cut and he knows what he's talking about. He's very charismatic, laid-back and funny and I never had any problem paying attention to his lectures. He is helpful and approachable and I would take another class from him
Makes sense sometimes. He's kind of awkward. Not my favorite phil professor but definitely not the worst. He's alright
He tends to have hand-outs with examples with what he may be lecturing about today.

This is NOT an easy humanities. Do not take this class unless you have to. Everyone says its an easy A but its not. He isnt very helpful and hes a very vague teacher, a class over something you will never use again. The worse class Ive taken at TCU besides religion.

Take Bill! He's a great professor. I had never taken a philosophy class before him and got an A. Great at explaining difficult concepts, interesting lectures, witty, and ridiculously good-looking. Tests aren't too bad & there's one term paper. Go to class, revel in his beauty, and learn yourself some philosophy.
If you go to class and pay attention then you will make an A.  If you don't go to class and write a good ending paper then you will make a C.  Very understanding teacher and he is super hot.

Critical Reasoning--very useful class for analyzing texts in just about all other disciplines. Roche is very clear in lecture and his online lecture notes are great.  Only six brief, easy homework assignments and two essays.  Tests are straigtforward and he tells you of the format beforehand.  Understand the concepts and you'll do fine.

Critical Reasoning. Dr. Roche is very organized, great at explaining concepts, and patient. He's obviously smart, but is not in love with the sound of his own voice and he teaches every class very purposefully. He's also pretty funny and always keeps class interesting. Minimal homework, tests are not bad at all if you get the concepts.
This class is a lot of fun and he is easy to understand.
He is a good teacher. Easy to take notes. He is funny so he keeps it pretty interesting.
He is so hot... looks like Orlando bloom with short hair and glasses...makes philosophy semi- interesting
TAKE HIM! He is fun to listen to.... and to look at. Cool guy! Not hard when I had him, which was his first semester teaching.

Really hot! kind of in that artsy way but whoa...... i went to class just to see if he would be teaching that day! Seriously! and i ended up with a B in the class and i didnt really try as hard as i could have so it was Ok.
absolutely gorgeous. take a class of his just to look at him. whoo...

Critical Thinking. Cool class.  Learned very useful and interesting things.  Roche tries hard to make sure everyone understands it, so sometimes you spend too long going over and over and over things he taught the previous class or were plainly in the reading for all the lazy morons.   Not saying it will be easy for everyone, but if you like logic or if you just spend time to absorb what is going on, you will be fine.  No homework, just a little reading, tests, and one paper.  Looks a little like Orlando Bloom: nice!

Great at explaining, which is absolutely a must in philosophy classes.  Offers excellent examples and really can help anyone understand the various theories.  If you're taking the 1st year class, you'll only have him for 1/3 of the semester.

Dr. Burns cares a lot about his students and genuinely cares about teaching. Attendance is not mandatory, but his tests rely heavily on lecture material. I would absolutely take Dr. Burns again, and I changed my major to CRJU because of him. If you have the chance to take him, do it!

Great Professor and class isn't hard as long as you put in the effort and show up. He does however require you to buy his textbook which is pretty expensive. Overall I would take his class again. He's also very kind and respectful
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mr. Burns cares a lot about his students and criminal justice, he wrote the textbook which is used in class. That said, your grade in the class is based purely off exams (84% of your grade) and 5 semi-random quizzes (the other 16%). Half of the content from each test is out of the textbook and 100% of the quiz is textbook. Difficult to pass for me.

His jokes and anecdotes keep you engaged during lecture. Only one extra credit opportunity but I didn't really need it. Super approachable and loves to get engagement and feedback from students. The quiz/test q's are textbook heavy, which trips a lot of people up, but you definitely can cram the night before and get a high B. I learned so much!

Dr. Burns is the best. Only assignments are tests, and (4) unit quizzes. He does do extra credit. Lectures can get boring, but he is really funny and sarcastic. Participate and go to class, he appreciates that! Definitely going to miss being in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Burns is an amazing man. He is not an easy professor, but he is a caring one. He pushes you and as long as you work hard you have nothing to worry about. He is always responsive and ready to help you out in literally anyway. I will always recommend him. One of TCU's best.

He had random quizzes but would tell you the class before. His tests were straightforward. He does use the textbook and it is his, however it was an amazing resource. I loved his class, I learned so much and would recommend others to take this course. He does in depth reviews before the tests and they really help.

Mr. Burns was great! I had him for 8 am and while it was hard to stay awake sometimes, he does make the content very clear and easy to understand while he's teaching. He wrote his own textbook so he often asks questions that seem really specific from there, but as long as you show up for class, read his book, and study you'll be fine.

Dr. Burns is a really funny guy, and he engages with us. He gives a couple extra credit assignments which were really easy. Biggest thing is you just gotta stay on top of the reading chapters. He does talk monotone a lot, so sometimes it was a little hard to stay awake for his 8am. Midterm and final are only unit exams, so big plus.

This teacher is passionate and a good one if you are truly interested in criminal justice. The exams and quizzes feel like they should be common sense but when you get your grade they are not. He wrote the textbook so he knows everything. Your grade is only based off of tests and quizzes. It is an 8am too which is hard to attend. VERY HARD.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Burns is indeed hard prof. While his class is all lectures, the only grades are tests and quizzes. Very few opportunities for extra credit. Maybe 2. Tests are definitely hard but he has a repetitive style he uses so you get used to it. Attendance isn't mandatory but definitely would recommend going to class every day if you want good test grade
He is an amazing professor, but the exams are very hard. Study well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: d. burns is a great teacher and explains the lectures extremely well but fails to realize the expectations he is putting on his classes. the tests feel impossible and always have a class average of 70-80%. i spend over 10 hours studying for each test and have gotten 2 75's and an 88. there are way easier teachers to take than him that give free A's
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Only grades in the grade book are 5 quizzes and 4 exams. The exams are 50% from the lecture and 50% from the textbook. No homework except readings which take FOREVER. Burns is really nice though and is funny. I enjoy the lectures. There are easier professors for this class. It not that he is a hard professor its just the exams can be difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you are taking this for a core credit do not take this professor. His class is purely lectures only. The only grades in the grade book are tests and quizzes which are in person scantron and are extremely hard. I took this class hoping for an easy, but also entertaining class and ended up barely passing this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: he is great but the class is impossible

Professor Burns is a good teacher. His lectures don't have a lot of info but still listen & pay attention. Attendance is not mandatory but if you miss, get the notes from someone. There is A LOT of reading. The modules in the textbook are time consuming & you must take notes/read because there are pop quizzes & the exams are 50% from textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Burns is a good professor that cares about his students. He makes criminal justice interesting for an 8am. Although, make sure you read the readings assigned because there will be pop quizzes from time to time. If you study hard for the exams, you will be fine for the exams.

Mr. Burns is easily one of the best professors I've had in TCU. I had him for my 8 am class and he always made the class interesting and fun. When I took the class I had 0 interest in criminal justice, but with him I genuinely found it very interesting and fun. Get ready to read before each class and watch out for the pop quizzes and exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This is the absolute worst class I've taken at TCU so far. I go to every class, take notes, study for about 6 hours on days leading up to a test, and still manage to get Ds and Cs on tests. I HIGHLY recommend taking another teacher his test are impossible good luck getting above a C. No curve, Friend took a different teacher and had test curved 20%
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Burns is a sweet guy! Super nice. However, his tests are IMPOSSIBLE. I studied so hard for each test and never made above a C. You have to know the ins and outs of criminal justice to do well in this class. He also does not curve at all or offer any extra credit. Class test averages were always C's... Impossible to do well I felt like
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Not a +/- class and is really easy to get a B with minimal effort, but requires a lot of time put into memorization for an A. Your grade will be determined by the work you put in. He tries his best to make the class interesting at 8 am which is very nice to have.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Burns rocks! With three tests (non cumulative), one essay, and one presentation along with a few participation points. You do have to read as the tests are half lecture and half material from the textbook. He is a very fair and understanding professor and gives great feedback on your work if you ask to meet with him. Definitely put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I enjoyed this course and think Dr. Burns is a great professor. However, the class is based solely off of tests and pop quizzes so you really have to be on top of it. Its pretty hard to get an A in this class but definitely manageable if you put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Burns is a great teacher and great person. Say what you want about how he teaches but you cant say he was a genuine caring teacher. Go to class as much as possible. Get a friend who takes good notes. Not a lot of room for error on test and quizzes so stay on top of it. Wouldnt recommend for a 1st semester freshman.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: My favorite professor I've had so far at TCU! I took the 8am Intro to Criminal Justice class and he made the class so engaging and interesting for an 8am. The tests are heavy on content from the textbook with some questions coming from the lectures. there were 4 tests and 5 pop quizzes from the readings. Do the readings and study & you will do well
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Great and humorous professor, makes a 8AM class enjoyable. Would recommend if taking CRJU course. Not an easy class, if you make sure you stay on top of reading an B/A is achievable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Burns is the best! He made 8am lecture more enjoyable with his own stories and experiences. We had 5 "pop" quizzes, but he pretty much told us which days they would be on each time. He was super easy to meet with outside of class for extra help. Be sure to read the textbooks AND pay attention to the lectures because both will be on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class was not easy for me. His tests questions come mostly from the readings but they come from very specific portions of the reading. The only grades in this class are 4 tests and if you don't do well, there is no way to get your grade up.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Burns rocks. I had a high B half way through the semester and went to his office hours and he helped me so much with preparing for tests. He made an 8 am something to look forward to.

Burns is an amazing and cool professor. There is a lot of reading from the textbook but if you take good notes on the readings and during lectures you should be fine. This class was very interesting and I learned a lot from it.

The readings are long but match up with the lectures really well. Take detailed notes over the lecture and readings and study from those really well and you will find the tests easy. I balanced his class with freshman bio and chem and still got an A, so it's doable!
Great teacher, funny guy. Must go to class everyday if you want a B or better. An A is tough to get, you will work hard for it. Definitely reccomend Burns
Very easy class. Do the readings and you will do fine. He takes 50% of questions from lecture and 50% from the book.
Would not recommend. Very unclear and lectures are filled with meaningless material.

He is sooo interesting. The class is at 8 am and he makes it interesting enough for you to want to go. You must read the 2 txtbooks to do good on the tests. Not an easy A but if you study you can make an A
most test info from book. kind of hard to study notes when eveything is a graph or chart and he says don't memorize numbers.  nice guy, hard to know what he wants though.

Federal Law Enforcement. Burns is very nice & helpful. Class is interesting; but info is probably taken off Internet. 1 research paper = easy. 1 book report = easy. 3 exams covering info from 2 textbooks, in-class videos, & lectures. Exams are difficult! But, if study, can get an A.  But, not an easy A. I would reccomend Burns.

Burns is amazing. He's funny, energetic, and he has a good sense of humor. I didn't do well because I didn't try, not by any faults of his. He lent me his lecture material when I missed class. The class is hard, but if you actually study and somewhat enjoy the material, you'll pass.
good teacher. makes the class interesting. tests multiple choice half book half lecture. LOTS of reading but overall great class

Professor Burns is seriously good looking.  He really loves his job and it shows.  He is very respectful to his students and encourages them to do well.  Definately take this course, or anything with him.

GREAT PROFESSOR, he is always talking about his kids and telling stories of his childhood.  do the reading, its a lot but interesting at the same time.  tests are easy if you know the material.  i loved his class, it was fun, entertaining, and educational
Burns is the best, most outgoing, and well versed professor for Criminal Justice and Police theory classes.

I had him for Critical Issues, too. Both classes were challenging- you'll work for your A. However, if you graduate without taking him, you'll be missing out! He is funny, entertaining, insightful, thoughtful, and dedicated to making your class experience a great one. I looked forward to his class every day. Hands down, the BEST PROFESSOR AT TCU!!!
hilarious guy. great class. read the book
Hilarious guy. Makes lame jokes, but they're funny. Learned alot in the class- great professor. Very concise lectures.  One of the best professors I've had so far.
He tries to make jokes but he is pathetic. He likes lists, I didn't learn alot of useful information. Book knowledge but no street knowledge!!
Good guy, makes an otherwise boring class interesting with cheesy jokes, I got a C, but it was my first semester of freshman year
Fun class. Hilarious teacher. Makes you give speeches in the end and write 2 papers throughout the semester.
Funniest professor I ever had. Looked forward to going to class. Work is easy but a little excessive. Highly recomend for critical inquiry credit
He is entertaining and he is not even like an authority figure.
Awesome Teacher!!

Very funny and very cool. I like this guy a lot. Im not making a good grade in this class but Im not the sharpest knife in the drawer. Tests are fine if you take notes. Very nice guy and will help you if you need it. Take this class.
"Good stuff...Good stuff."  Great class, lots of fun.  Makes lectures fun and interesting.  You can write about Buddhism on test essays and still get at least 60% credit.  Best CJ prof ever.
Funny guy, straight to the point..not tricky on the test..mostly notes and definitions. Nice guy
Funny and Fun guy.  If your going to take this class take it with him
His lectures are very clear and interesting. I never thought studying CRJU would be this interesting. Very good professor.
GOOD GUY...GOOD PROFESSOR
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments

Dr.C is extremely knowledgeable and lectures are very manageable. While you can miss class, tests are open notes, and the powerpoint slides she posts don't contain most of the information that she says in class. Its a fairly simple class with online tests you just need to take notes to do well!

Dr. C gives amazing lectures and is very knowledgeable. I'm not a neuroscience major, but still didn't have too difficult of a time in the class (and all tests are open note.) She almost made me want to change my major!

Do not take this class for a lab credit. It is literally a neuroscience class and every non major is barely passing. It is the most difficult class I've ever taken. The entire class grade is only on four test which are timed and extremely hard to understand. DO NOT take this class unless you're a pre-major.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I enjoyed her Neuropsychology course although her lectures are extremely fast. If you record the lectures on your phone you should be fine. 4 tests online that are all cumulative and open note, but you are able to drop 1. 13 easy in-class assignments but you can drop 3. Up to 5% for 10 hours of SONA. Take this professor!!!!!

Dr Centanni gave fascinating lectures, and she always started off class by play a song to set the mood. There were times where she would let us leave early or have class online the day before break. However, she grades tests hard, and most of the grade comes from tests. Make sure you watch the online videos and look at her exam content sheets.

I loved taking her for Introductory Neuropsychology! She makes sure her students understand the material and is willing to work with them. I would definitely recommend taking her for psychology courses.
Hardest grader Ive ever had. No flexibility for COVID. I would avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are great (you think) but then sometimes the tests are weird. She's nice though, but she is not too accessible outside of class. You only have tests and the lab grade to help you. The good part about is this that the lab is super easy and fun so you get a grade boost there minus the lab quizzes. Overall, she's great her tests are just meh.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Amazing lecturer! Her material is extremely interesting and I ended up learning far more than I expected. Tests are hard and you need to be able to apply what you learned. Don't overthink quizzes. Read the book, highlight/post it notes and just know where to find things and you will be golden! Answer the questions that you know and then check!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: HARDEST CLASS I'VE EVER TAKEN. & I THOUGHT I WAS TAKING A REGULAR PSYCHOLOGY CLASS WHEN IT WAS BASICALLY A NEUROSCIENCE CLASS. DO NOT TAKE IF YOU ARE TRYING TO GET NATURAL SCIENCE CORE OUT OF THE WAY. TA for lab was a joke too. She had no idea about anything, and every time I would ask her questions about my test, she had to look them up on GOOGLE
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: AMAZING lecturer. You must come to class, listen to her lectures, and take good notes in order to do well, but she is very good at explaining things and gives many opportunities for you to ask questions and elaborates if you are confused. I have learned so much in a semester and I will definitely be taking Centanni again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you aren't in the major DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. I took this class just to fulfill my science credit & it was the worst mistake. All of the nonmajors were literally failing. It is a large lecture so its hard to ask questions/ understand content and my TA wasn't helpful at all. I studied more for this class than any other & still barley passed it.

Dr. Centanni is an INCREDIBLE lecturer. I always felt comfortable asking questions if I was confused. Test reviews were posted about a week in advance. We would always have in-class review time before a test where we could ask questions or she would just go through the review.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I did not take Dr.Titus for 10143. I took Dr. Titus for her Honors Colloquia class, and she was great! I knew nothing about the subject, and she explained the material very well. She is an easy grader and the assignments are more reflection based than testing your knowledge. There is a lot group work, but it was manageable.
She is the kindest prof ever and is very passionate about the subject. Also probably the easiest class I've ever taken. Study guides/the blookets she made were very helpful in preparing for exams.

Prof. Titus is a very nice person and cares about her students.  The lecture is SOO boring, and attendance is not mandatory, so its easy to skip. She says "um" at least 5 times every sentence, and sometimes seems like she doesnt know what shes talking about.  
She's not the worst professor; her class is manageable; it's just extremely boring.
Great professor. Easy class, didn't try very hard and made an A. She gave us solar eclipse glasses which was fun!

Professor Titus is a nice and sweet lady. I love her but it is true that her lectures are not very engaging (they are mostly pictures with little notes). However, I highly recommend going to her office hours, she is willing to explain the concepts to you until you get it. Her class is manageable A if you study hard and go to her office hours.

Professor Titus is a sweet lady but very difficult to understand. She's not particularly well at making explanations for things and her slides are mostly pictures, making it difficult if you wanna look back at them to know exactly what is going on. I definitely recommend taking the course as a science credit, just not having her as a professor.

Really sweet professor who seems to love what she does. Answers classmates' questions with enthusiasm and if she can't give a certain answer she will try her best and explain it in a way that most can understand. Study guides for exams though the exams aren't exactly a walk in the park. Barely any homework besides the occasional online quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ms. Titus is very sweet and nice, but is not the best professor. She does not put any real information on her powerpoint slides and the test are rarely related to what we did it class. Even in doing the study guides, it is hard to do well on the test. The lab went well, but a TA teaches that. Overall, super nice, but I would not take again.

DO NOT TAKE HER! She is a new teacher. She cannot teach and does not lecture well. She reads off the textbook and cannot speak in full sentences. Her powerpoints are just pictures and she cannot explain graphs. Tests are very specific over random facts barely discussed in class. This class was doable but it was too much work for a core credit.

Took his Portuguese for Spanish speakers (20503) and was able to learn so much from just one semester. He usually speaks portuguese for the whole class time and clarifies anything in English if students are not understanding. He is passionate about the topic and wants students to learn and do their best.

Is a very nice and understanding person and is passionate about what he teaches. However, the class can be very monotonous at times. The readings and lectures can be difficult to understand, but he is a fair grader and that is reflected on the quizzes.

Dr. Sloan really cares that his students are participating and getting something out of his lectures. The content is not very engaging but he tries to keep things interesting. The quizzes/tests can be a lot but he is very accommodating with how he grades and the study guides are helpful. If you show you care and are listening you'll do great.

reviews.comment:
I was actually in his Portuguese for spanish speakers (20503) 
He is a great person very kind. Not really any homework other than this one thing that you will always get a 100 on. He speaks in portuguese the whole time, but if you speak spanish, you will be just fine. 
He is a very nice grader on tests. Never got below a 90
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Pretty difficult and the only reason I have a good grade was because it's all online. If this class was in person I def would've failed. It's boring, difficult and a lot of work. There's a lot of easier professors in the TCU Spanish department so I would highly suggest taking someone else - he's like the only hard professor in the whole department.

I love Spanish and decided to take his advanced Spanish grammar class to fulfill my Spanish minor. Although he is a nice person, his lectures are very confusing. He speaks in Spanish the whole time (which is perfectly fine at this level), but would would not explain any confusing concept in English. I would recommend a dif. professor if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I had to self-teach the entire course. None of my class ever knew what was going on, and he still never slowed down to explain anything. He explains difficult concepts in Spanish, and when you need him to answer it in English he will not do it. I used to love Spanish, but this professor has honestly pushed me away from it. I do not recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The class is an extensive review of previously learned concepts. There were all many new nit-picky concepts learned to perfect our spanish. Overall, he's a great teacher if you pay attention in class and use his office hours to go over tests. If you don't know spanish well though, I wouldn't suggest this course.

Pretty much left each class wondering what was actually learned, the guy is all over the place and uses the most difficult way possible to explain things. It is a hard class and I ended up going to previous Spanish professors for help because he wasn't doing it for me. I regret taking him.

No no no. entire clas is in Spanish, had us take a survey to talk about what works and doesn't. He blew off all recommendations made by students. his answer if you need help: "You can find help on the internet."

He really gives a variety of formats that can appeal to different types of students, but the tests were horrible for me personally, made a C on 23 of them. Got A's on everything else, easy to pass, get a B, but getting an A is challenging. His lectures are boring but he is very understanding how our spanish isnt gonna be perfect. Sweet man too
He's a good teacher but just sooo boring in class.  He really drones on and doesn't promote engagement that much.
Advanced Span Grammar: 1 chapter in workbook each night and quiz about once a week. If you do the workbook activities, should be an easy B and a manageable A.
Great teacher and a good class. His entire class was in spanish, which is i guess the idea behind a spanish class
Lots of reading! but he's a great professor! keep up with the assignments and you'll be fine! I highly recommend him!!

I REALLY enjoyed him!  He is a sincerely nice and gentle person, with a very laid-back manner of running the class.  He'll take you at your level in Conversation class and help you improve wherever you are.  HIGHLY recommend!

highly recommend him, very nice and makes the class interesting. watch a movie every week and discuss the themes.  not a very hard grader and not picky on grammar issues as long as he gets your idea, take him for conversation
really interesting class, not very hard. and yeah, he's super cute ;)
I learned a lot in his class and... he is cute!
Prof Sloan is very good. I just loved his Culture class. he helps a lot. take him!!
good class. the movies we were required to watch were interesting so it made class a lot easier. definitely take him for conversation.
No Comments
This class is an easy A, but Sloan is crazy.  He always wants to discuss politics and force his liberal views onto you.
No Comments
I was really impressed with him and he was very interesting. The only problem is that people in the class were dumb and didn't understand anything. Otherwise he is easy and engaging!

Very nice guy. Easy to understand, but you've gotta get used to his Spanish accent first. Class is very easy, a lot of people complained but that's because they sucked at Spanish. Only thing I hated: the Oral Exam!!

She is an incredible lecturer and genuinley care about your learning. This is an incredibly interesting class, and I learned a ton. The tests are quite difficult; you have to have a clear understanding of the material and think beyond what she teaches. It is possible to get an A. I recommend going to her office hours for extra clarification.

She is awesome, but overall the class is extremely hard. The tests are take home online but the questions are very specific with answer choices that all sound the same... Its a fine class but not one you want to take if you need an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall, this was a super interesting class. It's very lecture-heavy, but she records and posts them all. Tests are take home lockdown but she might be changing that. I recommend taking her if you are a psych major the course and info we learned is super cool

The lectures are SO long, but the information was interesting! Exams are open note and remote but don't be fooled you should still study! The exams are application and can be really hard! Know the studies backwards and forwards! She records all lectures if you miss. Take good notes and you'll be fine.

Professor Tauber is very kind and cares about content a lot, but her class is unnecessarily difficult to attain good grades in. She grades on an A-B scale (no plus or minus) and getting an A has been impossible for me (as someone who has all A's in classes). All i have to say is if you want to keep a high GPA don't take this class

Memory and Cognition with Tauber is a difficult course however it is one of my favorite I have taken. She is a wonderful professor and is so kind and helpful if you just reach out and ask. The material is rich, in-depth, and challenging so this class may not be the easiest but if you genuinely want to learn something then take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this professor for memory and cognition and found it to be unnecessarily difficult. She really is a great professor and lectures are interesting, but it seems to be impossible to make above a B on the exams. If you're looking to have an A in the class, just don't take this one.

To keep things short and to the point, honestly just dont take her. She does not take into consideration any students concerns or questions. And if you have to take her, be careful. Things can go south real quick. But please try your best to not have her as a professor. Its for your own good. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Uma is super nice and approachable. Lectures are very clear and easy to understand. Very minimal book use. If you do the study guides, exams should not be too difficult. 3 exams, and 2 large research papers which are lots of work but about what you would expect for a WEM class. She's passionate about her work and knows what she's talking about.

This class is pretty challenging for me; no matter how much studying I do I can't seem to make a B on any tests, even though she has a study guide. I only crack open the book when I'm doing the study guides. Attendance isn't counted but if you skip idk how you'll understand the material otherwise. Uma's a great professor & class is v interesting!

GREAT TEACHER. Her Memory and Cognition class is fabulous. Even if you are not a psych major or minor, you will get a lot out of this class. The tests are kinda hard, but go to class and take notes and you will do well. Some extra credit opportunities are available. You do need to go to class or you won't understand the material.
Amazing professor.  Her passion for psychology comes through in her lectures.  Although it's a lecture-based course, she keeps it interesting with videos and examples.

Uma is great, she is very clear and knows what she is talking about. Class is basically 3 tests and a non-cumulative final. Come to class, read the book (optional) and do the study guide, you're set. Tests aren't hard, everyone does well. Very friendly, funny, and quirky. Loved this class, highly recommend it.

If all you want is an A in the class, take her and do the study guide. Personally, she kinda drove me crazy because she would let the class go on tangents that were so obscure and would spend 20 minutes on one slide and I was so bored. And she would do this every single class. But it was so easy, and she doesn't have very high expectations

Dr. Tauber is a wonderful professor that cares very much about her students.  Attendance is not taken but you will learn a lot from her if you go to the lectures!  Highly recommend taking her for this or any other class she teaches! She's also easy to look at which never hurts!

Dr. Tauber is one of the best professors the TCU Psychology department has to offer. She is so invested in her students and has a way of making the information applicable and understandable. Highly recommended!!!
He is the founder of Piano Texas and we respect him very much. But he needs to retire. TCU and Piano Texas are not the same products. Now he is too old to focus on teaching students.
He is not very good at teaching piano because he is not a performing pianist
One of the greatest piano professors in the country and a wonderful human being. Inspires you to reach your full potential and get at the heart of the music.

Uhl-Bien is nice, but do not take for an on-level class. She over-complicated the whole class. She's incredibly intelligent, but she just made the exams way too complex. Group presentations are pretty standard. Speaking in class and attending class matters. 2 exams are 40% of your grade.

Dr. Uhl-Bien is always looking for ways to co-create with the class to create the best learning experience for us. She operates a flipped classroom, so there are many reading quizzes and homework, but it all integrates into the class discussions well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Mary is SO smart! If you have the chance to take a class with her, DO IT! She is experienced in business and academia and amazing at explaining extremely complex subjects about management/ leadership. Her class is hard and lots of work, but helpful and relevant for beyond college. No busy work. She lets the class lead the discussion.
Great teacher. Best in the Kine department. He's like every ones grandpa. EPIC STASH!

Great Teacher! Very funny and sarcastic :) As for the class you have to get a feel for it. Coming to class will probably help and having a tutor but overall once you get used to it your good and you get lots of extra credit!!

Dr. Upton is an amazing professor & an extremely impressive person.He's knowledgeable due to life experience about all he teaches.His downfall may be that his lectures follow the ppt which make attendance unneccessary.However, he is more than willing to help anytime and you can pick up on a lot of information outside of the curriculum if you listen

He is by far my favorite teacher. Yes, he gives a lot of work but is incredibly helpful for any question you ask. If you don't want work, don't take personal fitness when you don't have to. For kines though, he's fantastic.
insane amount of work for one credit.  he also expects you to lose weight when he's fat himself.  One should lead by example.
Great class + Terrible Teacher = Wasted Opportunity. He takes no interest in his student's concerns.  Worst teacher in the Kinesiology Depart. by far! AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!
Dr. Upton is my favorite teacher, and the best teacher in the kinesiology dept at tcu by far!! All other postings are completely inaccurate!  He loves what he does and is great at it!!

Whoever said he is arrogant or that his class is waste is totally wrong.  He is so knowledeable and has tons of real world experience. He is a great assest to TCU Kinesiology. And, seriously, who cares if that class is only one hour if you have to take it anyways? Take him, get to know him, he's a good guy and will be willing to help you.

He is not arrogant at all. He is a great teacher with a lot of skill.  This class will give you a lot of great hands on work. Study and you will do well. You may think his one hour is a waste, but you could get a lot out of it if you give it a chance.
I wish I had known what I was getting myself into.  Do not take this class if you don't have to.  He is boring and long-winded.  Labs are a waste of time but easy.

Biggest waste of my time...Dr. Upton is very knowledgeable, but he expects you to lose weight in 6 weeks without a nutrition program...and your improvement physically is a part of your grade!! If you take this class, be prepared to do ALOT of outside work.
i agree. ridiculous amt of work for one hour of credit.  prof is arrogant.

Dr. Upton is very knowledgable but you should expect taking as much time as a 3 credit course to study and complete your outside requirements even when this is only 1 credit.  Not WOrth ONE CREDIT!!!!!!!!

I couldn't recommend Shrop enough! She is by far my favorite professor at TCU. Her class is so entertaining and she cares so much about her students. If you are truly interested in marketing, you would love this class. The workload is so manageable!
Best class I've ever taken! Such a manageable class and so entertaining if you truly are interested in Marketing.

I took Customer Insights and International Marketing with Shropshire and I enjoyed every bit of being in her class (at 8AM). I recommend disregarding low reviews, as it is likely that those students did not put forth an effort and/or come to class. The projects are fun and you will learn along the way. I cannot recommend her and this class enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great Professor, would take this class again if given the opportunity. Read the book early.

super nice lady with kinda dry humor, but BOY is she a tough grader. read the book like everyone says (its actually interesting ngl) but idk if she really has to be such a hard grader and not explain why you got points off (they're literally subjective) she always talks about herself which is annoying and gets old but whatever

Professor Shropshire is my favorite professor that I have taken at TCU. She deeply cares about her students and creates genuine relationships. There are a couple of papers, but they are not hard. There is one test over a book however, the book is an easy read, and she goes over almost everything in class. Take this class!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --So many papers

reviews.comment: Lectures are chill, (always relates it to her personal life), but I don't think I actually learned anything from this class. There is one exam at the very end and it is brutal. Read the book ahead of time. Participation is easy money, the papers aren't. She is a tough grader, even if you think it's A-quality, trust me, it's not.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Updating this because these ratings are incredibly outdated. Shrop is amazing and by far my favorite professor at TCU so far. Took her for Customer Insights and the couple of tests were hard but she prepares you well and you can make up points on individual and group work. Truly funny and there was literally never a boring day with her.

Professor Shropshire is the BEST professor I have had at TCU. She really cares about her students and creates such an unique and close bond with them. She is absolutely hilarious, so genuine, and down to earth. She applies class concepts to real life and shares stories about her own kids and husband that really makes the concepts stick.

This class was much harder than it needed to be. Her tests were impossible, though she curved the first one, and shes absolutely no help for the group project. She doesnt tell you what she expects, but grades very tough.

Shropshire is a great teacher and makes the class material interesting. Definitely puts a lot of weight into the semester long group project. The tests are fair if you complete the reading but are not tests that you can cram for the night before. Also does pop quizzes but are pretty easy if you stay on the reading

At first I really liked professor Shropshire because she is hilarious, but then you get to her tests and they are awful. She wanted to keep a 70 grade average, and never curved a single test not even by one point. I wouldn't take her again, her class lowered my GPA and this class is not supposed to be so hard.

Her class is not structured at all. She is so disorganized. She takes weeks correcting the exams and uploading them into e-college. Her exams are super hard, even if you read, you will probably still do bad. She gives pop quizzes and lets you use a flashcard, still doesn't help. Talks about her family all class, funny at first but it gets annoying.

Professor Vartabedian is a very inspirational and kind professor! Class is very discussion based with lots of readings, there are lots of readings before class, and pop quizzes. There are two main projects instead of exams. Lots of guest speakers and fun activities during class. Definitley recommend as a good colloquia class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Inspirational--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I took her “Perfecting Your Pitch” course last year and it is my favorite class I have ever taken at TCU! She taught me how to achieve public speaking on a level I never I thought I'd get to. Great teacher with great connections!

Dr.V is the BEST! Super nice and funny professor who cares about you and wants you to learn more about unique subjects and topics that you won't learn about in other classes. Participation does matter and there are some presentations but it's all fun and she has clear grading and instructions. Resilience was an awesome class and she's the GOAT!

TAKE HER!!!! The only reason I did not get an A was that I bombed the midterm. She is an amazing teacher who makes class super interesting and engaging. Even though there is reading before every class, make sure you read because chances are there will be a surprise quiz over the material.
TAKE HER!!! Her classes are so manageable and fun. Definitely my favorite class this year and she is the nicest teacher ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super nice lady, the reading prior to each class can be a lot but she isn't trying to trick you with the pop quizzes. She will ask fair questions. It is very participation heavy with a midterm and a few other assignments, but overall, she is fair and accessible outside of class. She wants you to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Democracy and Deliberation

I don't like politics at all and didn't know going in that she had chose the class to be Democracy and Deliberation. The class isn't super hard but their are a few creative writing pieces and then pop quizzes based on assigned readings. If you are creative and like being pushed out of your comfort zone, then take it
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr.Vartabedian is an amazing professor. Her class is mainly class discussion. She did have pop quizzes, but you get to drop your two lowest grades. Additionally, you do have many projects but she is an easy grader. Highly recommend taking her class.

Dr. V was AWESOME for the philanthropy class. I will take another class with her, just because she's teaching. She inspires so much group conversation and respects every single student. Our class was a 3 hour time block one day a week, but it didn't drag on and put me to sleep. I felt more energized after class ended than before. TAKE HER!

Dr. V is one of the most brilliant, entertaining, knowledgeable, witty professors I've ever had. Convinced she could teach about rocks and make it fascinating and hilarious. Have never wanted to skip class. You have to turn in questions based on readings most days but it's not bad. Does an awesome job at cultivating discussion.

She is very knowledgeable about her course subject and has a lot of experience. She made her lectures very interesting and engaging. Only one test which was not too hard. She is very accessible after class and this is a perfect class to take for honors.

She's an amazing teacher. She is fun and intelligent. The class is mostly discussion based. She is a very understanding professor and likes to form relationships with each student. The projects are fun and relatable. She's the kind of professor that is in your corner and wants the best for you. I highly recommend taking any class that she teaches.

Dr. V is a fantastic professor. Her class makes you examine the world in a whole new way. Her lectures are really just class discussions so if you do the reading and participate, all the graded material is easy. Pop quizzes are general questions about the readings. Take her if you can!

Dr. V has some of the most interesting lectures I've ever attended. I never wanted to skip class and didn't even mind any of the course work because it's all very applicable and never a huge work load.
