Only really graded on tests and he is very lenient on test grades being dropped or changed so a bad grade isn't the end of the world which is rare for test heavy classes. Overall, just sit through the lectures, and do some studying, and get your credit.

He's a wonderful professor, his lectures are very organized and everything you learn in the lab/lectures will be on the test. You don't get any homework, paying attention is key to passing! He responds to emails and is a nice guy. I would take him again!

Take him for understanding the earth! if the majority get a question wrong on the exam he will drop the questions. open book weekly quizzes. no homework. attendance is not required. exams are easy just make sure to read the highlighted words on the slides. he gave extra credit probably 2-3 times if you attended class. He is so sweet!

The class is pretty straight forward, all memorization. Exams are multiple-choice and based off lecture slides and exam reviews. Dr. X posts lectures and reviews, so attendance is not necessary, but he would randomly give extra credit for the people who showed up. 25% of the class is lab grade, which is dependent on your TA.

Xie cares about his students but his lectures are extremely boring and his english is terrible. The tests require a ton of studying. Even if you study a ton for the tests, he will still put things on the test that he rarely discusses. Geology is also very boring and requires a lot of memorization.

During his lectures he basically just reads off the slides that he posts online. He randomly assigns quiz dates during class and doesn't post the dates on the syllabus. The quizzes are open note online and only stay open for 24 hours. The exams require a lot of studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: posts all the slides and gave review questions before exams. exam material comes directly from slides, not very difficult/mostly memorization. i rarely went to class except on exam days. lab is hit or miss depending on your TA, but the material is straightforward.
I never once went to the lecture besides when it was for a test. The tests are in person and the lab is hard. I passed no credited it. Overall boring
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Zhou loves geography and his class is overall easy, but busy. Weekly essays he grades kinda strict but his exams are straight from the review. Overall, would take again and is an easy A if you just do the work.

His knowledge in geography is excellent and generally communicate core ideas of the lecture smoothly during class. Pretty much everything in his exams is just in the lecture slides, and he does not expect you to read the recommended textbook. However there are weekly video essays but they are overally easy.
Very sweet professor and very passionate about geography! Attendance and doing assigments are a big part of the grade and not test. He is also a pretty easy grader!

Dr. Zhou is unorganized, very smart, but good in the field not the classroom. He does not do open note/ Open book. These people before 2024 got the easier version on WRG. Still an easy class but proof that not every PHD needs a teaching position.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof was good overall he primarily just read of powerpoints and expected you to learn the rest. the test were half open book and half closed book make sure you study for them and overall he is very passionate about geography.

If you get the chance to take Zhou for Micro, definitely choose him. The tests are very easy, all mcq. The homework is also very easy and you are given more than enough time to finish it. Nice teacher, you can skip up to 5 classes.

I had Intro to GIS with Professor Zhou. It was the most difficult class I have ever taken at TCU. The tests, especially the final exam, were completely unreasonable and we were not given nearly enough time to complete them. Dr. Zhou is extremely intelligent but this class completely extinguished my interest in learning GIS, at least from Dr. Zhou.

Not super clear on grading criteria, not very organized. You will ever rlly be able to see what your grade is in the class. But class is not hard and worth taking for a double dipping core. Tests are open note but questions are obscure and class doesn't rlly have clear notes so they are difficult still.

Professor Zhou is so wise and very well-spoken. I learned so much in his World Regional Geography class and would recommend it to anyone because we learn applicable and relevant information. There is little out-of-class work, and the exams are open-note/open-book. Awesome course!

If you have the ability to self-study then I would definitely recommend Dr. Zhao!! His lectures were boring but the materials were easy enough for me to self-teach myself. Attendance is mandatory and we never really ended class early. His tests are very easy (it's basically similar to the homework) but they do weigh a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very exam heavy. Stay up to date on the homework but he is more than willing to help! You get a few unexcused absences but other than that attendance is mandatory. Would take him again!

Dr. Zhao is a super nice, caring professor who wants the best for his students. I totally forgot to turn in an essay and the day after it was due he emailed me saying I could turn it in for full credit if I did it that day. Lectures can be a little boring but outside of that, I would highly recommend taking him.
I love this him a lot, he is really sweet, caring, and willing to help. He provided a lot of study materials so that we can catch up whenever we need

Zero surprises with grading. Everything is clearly laid out in the syllabus, and it's easy to stay ahead on homework. His lectures are understandable, though English clearly isn't his first language, so he speaks slowly with a lot of “uhs” and “ums,” which can make it easy to zone out. Overall, it's not hard to keep a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: THIS PROFESSOR IS AMAZING. This class is my favorite economics class I have ever taken. Clear grading criteria, great instructor, the reading and textbook homework actually prepares you for the tests. This class makes me reconsider my major and possibly want to major in Econ or take an Econ minor. He wants everyone to succeed
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Zhao is a great professor for micro. He has lots of homework so it helps averages out the exams. The homework is super easy and basic. The exams are exactly like his homework, and lock down browser in class. Not to bad if you study and understand the formulas. Hes super nice and straight to the point. Def the best professor for micro
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: This guy is the goat. Best teacher at TCU. Super intelligent, go to his review days, and you will ace the tests. He is super caring and always willing to help. Definitely recommend.

Dr. Z is so nice and a great professor! A lot of homework assignments but you get unlimited attempts through TopHat and it helps your grade so much! Attendance is mandatory but if you show up and take notes you will do well on the exams. He drops the 3 lowest quizzes as well! Take him!
Hes pretty chill. Attendance mandatory. Drops a test and homeworks. still pretty easy

There are 2 essays and 2 mandatory discussions, there's also simulative discussions but he grades pretty easily. He's a super knowledgeable guy and you can learn so much from this class. He's not so chill but if you work what you're expected to then you're fine.

I loved Professor Z! This class is easy as long as you actually pay attention and read the chapters assigned because they aren't very long and pretty easy to understand. He drops so many grades and allows a cheat sheet on the exams (which are very easy if you're prepared). I loved this class bc I learned so much without a ton of difficult work.

he drops so many grades so its easy to get your grade up. tests are in person but if you study the textbook questions your fine and you get a cheat sheet. lectures a lot and can be hard to understand. Very clear about expectations so easy to suceed.
uses online textbook. can look up answers to all quizzes. just lots of reading and homework/note taking. Also isn't native English speaker and I cannot tell what he is saying ever.

Zhao was very knowledgeable when it came to macroeconomics. I learned a lot this semester and found it pretty easy to get a good grade in his class. The lectures could get pretty boring, but contained important information that built on what we learned in assignments out of class. I would for sure recommend taking Zhao for macro
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took him for macro and micro freshman year. He put the test lockdown browser, which made the class harder, but not horrible. There are a ton of easy homework assignments and quizzes to help with your grade. Definitely one of the easier economics teachers, TAKE HIM!
He started using Lockdown halfway through the semester, which made the class a lot more difficult. But overall still an easy class with a chill professor

Everything in this class is online. There is homework every week but it doesn't take too long to complete. There are 3 tests throughout the semester that are online with no lockdown browser. The lowest test grade is dropped and the final is optional if you are satisfied with your grade. There are 6 pop quizzes but they are take home & online.

Gives three tests and an optional final. Lectures can get boring and long sometimes but if you take notes and look over them tests are easy. He drops lowest grades in most categories at the end of the semester. 6 pop quizzes that you can take online after class throughout the year. Was an easy A overall I would definitely recommend.

He's a nice guy but the lectures are really confusing so self teaching yourself from the textbook is your best bet. Only 3 tests and an optional final, the homework is graded and there is a lot but it really helps with the test and learning the material. Some writing assignments in the mix, sort of tough on grading those.

Professor Zhao is a really sweet man but does not engage the class at all. There is zero class participation and everyone is on their phones the whole time. He doesn't stop to ask questions and talks and moves through lessons really fast. Everything is online - tests, homework, pop quizzes, etc. Attendance is mandatory.
Really good teacher with about thirty minutes of homework a week. Only lectures, but quizzes and test are online and no lock-down browser. Would definitely take him again.
Amazing professor who cares about his students, very straightforward lectures with adequate resources! Great Professor, 10/10

Dr. Z was an amazing professor. I was warned this class would be very hard. But, Dr. Z made all the information accessible and easy to understand. He gives weekly homework, class discussions, a few short writing assignments, and 6 pop quizzes. His lectures can get a little dull, but overall he is one of the best professors I've had at TCU.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Zhao was a very kind man. His tests are all online with no lockdown browser. You had to complete tophat homework twice a week which was super easy. His lectures were short and he is pretty leniant with attendance. I recommend Dr. Zhao for Macro economics.
If you pay attention in class and attend, you will succeed. He is kind and understanding.

Professor Z attempts to deliver a thoughtful class but the execution isn't as masterful as he might think. He uses an attendance app and an app for homework which also contains your textbook. Both apps halfway through the semester weren't working properly and the updates the developers told me to download were no longer available for my device.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: As a person, Dr. Chen is nice. As a professor, one of the worst professors. She is very strict on grading each paper. There's a huge research paper at the end of the semester that she brings up suddenly. She wasn't very accommodating when things were going on at home. The exams aren't too bad if you attend class everyday. Don't recommend.

Such a harsh grader but always has vague rubrics. We used to same rubric for all the essay assignments besides the research paper and she would never give me anything higher than a 90. She barely mentioned the huge research project we had at the end of the semester, too. I almost thought we did not have to do it. Lectures are kind of boring.

Really amazing professor. I took both of her international politics classes and shes great. Mostly papers on films due throughout the semester. only 2 exams and theyre super easy as long as youve been listening to lectures.

I have nothing but good things to say about professor Chen. She is a very intellegent professor who you can tell cares about international politics and cares about her students. I think she does a fantastic job of remaining unbiased while presenting debatable political topics. I apprecaite her respectful response to every question and opinion.

Professor Chen is very knowledgeable about the course. The negative reviews don't reflect how she is in class. The class is lecture-based and there are a few assignments but they are spread out. The class is structured and she's very accessible for office hours if you do fall behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Chen is one of the kindest professors you will ever take. She is always open to help students reach their goals in the class. Just show up to lectures and work hard on the essays and this class will be easy. Also she offers a great extra credit opportunity that everyone should take advantage of.

Professor Chen is an amazing professor. If you put in the work you will do just fine. Her exams are not hard at all. She is a tough grader on essays but she even provides us with an extra credit opportunity. She always made sure to be available for us outside of the classroom and always explained everything thoroughly.

I have nothing but upmost respect for Professor Xi. Not only does she teach the material  straightforward, her intelligence, compassion, and resourcefulness is guaranteed to set you up for success. The bad ratings are complete BS and anyone that doesn't enjoy her as a teacher is lazy asf. Please take this class!!!

Idk why her ratings are so bad. As long as you study the study guides before the exams you will do fine. You don't have to listen in class. Yes she talks quietly but its just because she is a shy person and she's actually very nice and was understanding when I was out sick.

reviews.comment: I took this class to learn more about international relations/politics. I had taught myself more than she had all semester. I would only take this if you have some background in the subject.

reviews.comment: Dr. Chen was a very bad professor. She is very hard to understand during lectures and she is always so confused which makes class chaotic. Her grading on papers is ridiculous, I don't think she gave out any A's the entire semester. She grades on participation, but when you raise your hand to participate, she talks over you. Take another professor.

Taken for Financial Reporting II: Majority of class grade is three exams and a final. She takes random attendance on six days per semester; you get points if you are there. Lectures are hard to follow, but she is very accessible outside of class. Tests are similar to practice exams and in-class problems.

A very great professor for an upper-level accounting class. Class lectures are very detailed, and topics are often overexplained. Grades are based on 3 exams and a cumulative final, a few homework assignments that are not too long, and attendance on some days. The concepts for the class are difficult, but Professor Wen does a great job.
THE BEST! Her lectures are easy to follow and if you understand them you will do well on the exams. Homework due about once a week and random participation days.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: There are random days where participation is taken. She gives practice tests but the actual tests are a good bit harder.

He has great lectures if you listen to him carefully. He is helpful outside of the class and he is funny. Everyone in the class loved him! His handwriting is bad, so feel free to ask him what he writes on the board.

I love his class, he is a knowledgeable person, sometimes make nice jokes and can be really helpful on his office hours. You have homework every week but they can be done in one sitting. His tests are more difficult than the practice tests but if you focus idn class, he will probably have some of the test questions ( similar style ) on board.

DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS. He is not a good math teacher. He has a strong accent and very hard to understand.  His handwriting has room for improvement. Half of the problems he does on the board he gets wrong. He gives practice tests but the real tests are ten times harder.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This is the worst instructor I have ever had.  Definitely avoid this teacher.  He specifically doesn't list a grading scale, but then assigns arbitrary grades at the end of the semester.  He is horribly unorganized and does not attempt to prepare students for exams or assignments.  He chooses not to utilize any online website or e-college.
Xixi is an Objective instructor. She gives a clear outline for your speech. She is somewhat strict and you learn lots of things from her teaching.

I worked so hard on my assignments, but still, she gave me low grades. She does not offer extra credits, yet she takes so many points off for small mistakes. She's the worst teacher that could ever teach you. Avoid her no matter what!
the average GPA is really low. I study so hard that I cannot sleep every night. But I also get low grade. I am so sad. really sad.
I study really hard for this class, but I still get a really sad grade,  I even doubt about my academic  ability.
Sucks. Worst teacher. Strict GRADER!!!!!!!!!!!!
She is soooooo strict in class, and a really tough grader, sooooo many homework, I will not take her class again.

She is the most horrible and terrible teacher I've ever met. I won't take her classes any more. Lots of homework but low grades. She is so strict to give her students a good grade. The worst teacher in Cas100.

Will look for the smallest mistakes to take off points and will make them up if they're not there. Teaches speech and her English still needs some work. Worst teacher I've had in my life, and that's not at all an exaggeration

XiXi is so passionate about teaching and really funny. She makes class engaging and fun. She's a tough grader when it comes to speech outlines, but there is a clear rubric you can follow. Tests are tough but the way the class is run, the teachers aren't really responsible for covering all that material- because of the flip classroom setting.

Her house is far away from TCU so she is not available ofthen but she is willing to answer your questions via e-mails even on weekends. Read the book and it's easy to get an A. Ask her in class if you have any questions.
Economics is hard enough at TCU, but she is difficult to understand, doesn't explain things at all, and there are only 3 tests for your grade. So if you screw up, you're practically done for.
Hard to understand, doesn't answer questions, hard tests, your book is your teacher.

DON'T TAKE. She is very hard to understand because she has a thick chinese accent. She knows the material, but that doesn't matter because you can't understand her. A lot of the problems on her tests are math related. Do the reviews. Attendance is graded. I'm usually a good student but i fell asleep almost every class period. Boring and very hard.

This is the worst teacher I have ever had in my life. she has the social ability of a grain of salt. You might as well ask a 5 year old a question about economics before you ask her. Don't take this class.
Do not take this class. She is so hard to understand and its the most boring class in the world.

Honestly, you really cannot understand half of what she is saying. When you ask her questions about her lectures, she gets annoyed and acts like your stupid. She asks people at random questions and if you dont know she gets frustrated. You need go to class to get the notes and she checks at random times for a grade. Seriously, Take someone else.

She takes attendence at 10 random times throughout the semester at a random point during the class, she is the worst teacher i've ever had, i enjoy economics,her class is beyond boring,3 tests 3 hw's, if ur good at econ and wanna just learn from the book its easy to get a B even if u take a 0 for attendance,you'll have to learn from the book anyway

Her teaching style is very cut and dry with every class based on power point lectures. She has a strong chinese accent and is difficult to understand. All of her tests are pretty easy multiple choice questions with NO short answer questions, you just have to be able to teach yourself the material by reading the textbook.

By far the worst teacher I have ever had, amazed that TCU would hire her. I have had better teachers at community colleges. Reads straight from the powerpoint presentations and is not able to speak the English language clearly. I found it best to ignore her lectures and just read the book.

One of the WORST teachers if not the worst teacher I have ever had. Can't believe she got hired. Doesn't know how to teach or even speak English, boring, reads directly from powerpoints. I studied off her notes for a test and got a seventy then didn't pay attention in class and only took notes out of the book and got an 85. Terrible teacher.

One of the worst teachers I've ever had. I depend on the textbook to teach myself the information. She also comes off as rude sometimes and will often call out students to answer questions. Naturally, since no one is listening because we aren't fluent in chinese, NO ONE answers and she still doesn't get the hint that teaching is not her calling.

She is perhaps one of the least enjoyable teachers that such a prestigious school could produce. She is knowledgable in the subject but has little to no teaching or explanatory skills. She enjoys questions but is not clear or helpful in her responses. The class is based 100% around PPTs and her knowledge is limited outside of the info they provide.

She is sort of hard to understand, because she has a heavy chinese accent. I find the material really boring, but she does know what she is talking about. Ask questions; she likes that. All tests are multiple choice/scantron. This class is easier to understand when you really teach yourself through the powerpoint slides and the book.

She is the most dull/boring teacher I've ever encountered. It is impossible to pay attention for the entire class and she seems to not understand anything we ask her. The entire class is like she's having a conversation with herself. Hasn't taught me anything about econ that I couldn't have learned by reading a textbook. Worthless class.
no habla espanol

I would drop the class if you get her for a teacher- and try as hard as you possibly can to get another teacher- she is the worst teacher i've ever had... I would stay away from her by all means possible

DON'T TAKE HER. Class is beyond boring, and you'll have to read the text book to understand anything. Homework is similar to tests though, but there's only two tests before final. Would not recommend.
a very big language barrier
You need to read the text book to be able to stay with the class you will not understand everything that is being said.
Doesnt clarify anything she says. Just read the textbook and zone out in class but dont get caught using your laptop or you cant use it for the class
She is probably the worst teacher I've ever had to be completely honest. You cannot understand a thing she says and she speaks in monotone. Liang is the most boring teacher I've ever listened to.
language barrier
this is a good class and its required for CJ majors. make sure you go to class or you'll be lost. you can look at the posted notes online but its not the same as in person.

reviews.comment: Dr. Young is super cool. Pay attention in class because quiz and test questions are similar to the slides and can be kinda difficult. Good vibes only from here shes dope.

Dr. Young is goated. Chiller. No attendance and quizzes online on some fridays. Tests are actually pretty tough but if you study and write down the key points at the end of every class they are manageable. Quizzes help boost grade. Take her

Certified chiller is accurate. She is incredibly kind and helpful. Has no issue helping you outside of class if youre struggling, which i was because I was going through things but otherwise her classes are super easy and straight forward.

Certified CHILLER! Dr. Young is SO intelligent yet still approachable. She tells great stories and I feel like she can really relate to her students. She genuinely has a good time connecting with the class. I could tell this woman my deepest life secrets and trust her with anything. Type of woman I want to be my mom.

Great professor! She wants her students to do well, and will help in any way possible to make sure you understand. Slides are detailed, so if you need to miss class you can refer back to slides. You don't have to read outside of class. Easy quizzes every week that help you prepare for exams. One final paper, which she helps you write!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Young is a fantastic professor.  Her lectures are interesting and easy to understand because she doesn't just give a single example but numerous examples.  There is a single paper in the class that is worth 60% of the grade but she gives you example papers, and a clear outline to follow.  Answer the questions on the guide and you'll do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is very personable. She is also a great lecturer.

Professor Young was a great professor for Research Design. Since there are only two tests and a paper for your final grade, she does make the tests a little difficult but presents the material in a way where you can understand it if you make the effort. Overall, I would recommend to take RD with Young and she is very accessible outside class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Young is a great professor. She is very understanding but by no means gives you the grade. This class is difficult in that it is an upper level course but it's easy to pass if you just do the work and pay attention. She posts the lectures following each class so that helps a lot to be able to go back. Brings in guest speakers which is cool too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Young is a new professor but she is very caring, understanding, and accommodating. You can tell that she really just wants all of her students to succeed. There was one major paper, two exams, and several discussion boards. You do not need the textbook to pass the class because her lectures cover all exam material.

The class I took was ENGL 30693. Very nice lady, all you really gotta do is do two writing assignments and then the final project. I will say though while do a reading, she would say some questionable things and repeated some words that shouldn't be said. Overall, she really just talks most of the class, so if you want to have a break, take her.

reviews.comment: She is very caring and helpful when writing and coming up with what to write about. I recommend doing the readings before class; they are not that bad, and discussions are way easier if you know what's happening.
So amazing, extremely understanding and allows you to pace yourself with the assignments. Take her.
Clearly cares about her students and so nice. 3 essays and 1 group project all semester.

Professor Yu is very kind and puts her students and their wellbeing before anything else! Only a few assignments throughout the year and nothing that was ever overbearing. Would definitely recommend her for Comp 2!

I LOVE PROFESSOR YU!! She is literally the best! There are 3 PRA's and then a final writing assignment all that you can do multiple times. She gives the best feedback on what to fix to get a better grade. Her lectures can be a little boring, but you need to go because in class discussions are a huge part of your grade. I highly recommend her!

Professor Yu was the GOAT. Easiest class at TCU by far. 5 assignments and some discussion post. Barely any writing. Got 95 or above on every assignment. She doesn't take attendance. Showed up to class the day before Spring break started, and was one of only 4 who showed up, and she promised us all A's for just showing up. Take her! Easiest A ever!!
She's very nice so I hope everyone respect her/the class time

She is super sweet and has great lectures and great topics. Lots of extra credit opportunities, accept late work, easy grading, no exams, easy assignments. Very chill class and atmosphere. Only dropped it because I didn't need the CC.

Just wonderful. She is so funny and respectful. Our ENGL 20803 was a blast and super interesting with a focus on learning about indigenous peoples. She's a foodie and a horror movie fan so the discussions in class were so much fun. Just waiting until I can take another class of hers for ENGL credits. There's a reason they fill up so fast.
I love Professor Yu. She is so sweet and funny and really cares about giving you feedback. 3 essays and 1 easy presentation the entire semester. Very low stress unless you procrastinate.
Take this class, you won't regret it. 3 essays for the whole year and 1 easy group project

TAKE THIS CLASS!!! Dr. Yu is an amazing professor and lets you set the deadlines for your work. All assignments were due at the end of the semester so you could submit anything when you wanted. Attendance was not mandatory but her lectures actually made me want to go to class.

I LOVED DR. YU! She was so funny and made the class enjoyable. The class is laid out completely in the syllabus and there are no surprises. 3 papers, a group project, and a semester reflection - no exams. You can do an extra paper for extra credit. She doesn't take attendance but she occasionally does discussion posts in groups in class. TAKE HER!

Easily the best professor on campus! I couldn't tell you enough to enroll in this class. She is very lenient and understanding. There are 3 essays you have to write but it is very doable and USE OFFICE HOURS. The class material was very interesting and she explained in-depth and very well.

She is the best professor I have on my first sem at TCU!! We have 8-10 discussion few first weeks and three big essays (it takes you 3 weeks to do well and get A grade). I love her so much and office hours are really work for me, just email her and she will reply promptly!!!

10/10 Best prof ever. made my life better. genuinely learned a lot. class is easy and I used content in my other classes. Very helpful and just overall great human I hope to take classes with her many times in the future. 3 essays, all easy, lots of freedom. class content sets you up well for essays. a little bit of reading each week. take her!!!!!

I liked Professor Yu, although she's a pretty tough grader. To put it into perspective, I'm a pretty good writer but I've gotten a B on both essays. She lets students revise essays after they're due to improve their scores & is very lenient on due dates. There are 3 required essays & the final is literally a revision of 1 of them.

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher , caring and would recommend

A great professor who actually cares about the well being of her students. In class you watch documentaries that are interesting but keep in mind that attendance is not mandatory at all. I would definitely recommend taking her !

She is great and super understanding. She respects student's feedback on curriculum and takes action to help us. She will guide you through every paper you write and is very helpful. Very much recommend her class.

Professor Young did a really good job incorporating his real world experience into the examples in the lectures and reviews. This insight was very helpful for learning. Although there isn't many grades, he provided a lot of reviews leading up to the final exam, and was always available for help. Overall, great professor.

reviews.comment: He's super nice and understanding, I really enjoyed having him as a professor and I would definitely recommend. I would definitely recommend him as your professor for financial reporting 1, he's really helpful if he sees you putting in the work.

Professor Young is a very engaging and welcoming professor. He listens to his students needs in how we best learn and will help do practice problems or display scenarios to better help suit his students preferred way of learning. As well he makes class enjoyable as it feels like he truly enjoys being there and enjoys engaging in discussion.

I learned a lot this semester in Professor Young's class. The subject was challenging for me since it's outside my major and covered a lot of material, but Professor Young's real world industry experience and openness to questions made a huge difference. I gained real value from this course, and much of that is thanks to Professor Young.

Professor Young will work with you if you speak up. I told him I'm a visual learner and needed clearer examples, and he immediately adjusted his teachings by adding more visuals to lectures/reviews. He listens and is open to improving his teaching. If you communicate your needs, he'll make an effort to support you which I genuinely appreciated.

Professor Bhagwat is very unorganized and not clear with instructions. She didn't put our D2L page up until 2 weeks into the semester.
