reviews.comment: Make such to really look at the text book and to study a lot for the exams. But overall I enjoy the class.

Dr. Witworth is an overall great professor. Sociology is a subject that really makes you put everything you do into perspective. Great teacher with a great background for this class. Loves what he does and you can see it in his teaching. Dont miss any class and youll pass.

Dr. Whitworth is a great professor. As an international student, I find his exams are hard. And you have to read, do 3 assignments per week. But everything worths. I like the teaching way that Dr. Whitworth lectures us in class.

Dr. Whitworth really cares for his students but he makes sure that if you want an A in his class you have to work for it. The writing and application assignments are easy points but take up time. reviews.comment: Dr. Whitworth is such a caring professor! Super nice and gives you extra credit that boosts your overall average grade. The only reason I rated him a 4 is because he uses +/- scale, so I got an A- in that class, but I didn't really try in that class. Before each test, he tells you what to study--TAKE IT SERIOUSLY!! Final is also not cumulative!

Attendance is very important because 20% of your grade will be from in class activities.  He give you the chance to make up 3 missed assignments by extra credit opportunities.  You can also join a volunteer program called Cycling Without Age and get +1% to your overall grade.  4 exams  (20% each) makeup the rest of the course.  Would take again!
Great

Prof. Whitworth overall is just fine. His online textbook's chapters are very long and he expects you to read all of it. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I like Whitworth. I took his Intro to Sociology class. It's pretty easy, and also pretty interesting.

Whitworth is a pretty straightfoward kind of guy. He's kind of quirky, but his lectures are interesting and you actually learn while not having to kill yourself for an A. Gives you a studyguide and a quizlet for exams. If you put in the work and do the studyguide, you'll be fine. Don't bother with the extra credit.

Intro to Sociology: Overall, he's a pretty good teacher. He offers extra credit, but you have to attend 3 events and do write-ups for only a 1% grade boost. He goes off-topic frequently, but his grading policies are fair. He gives you study guides and quizlets before each exam that are super helpful, and the final is non-cumulative.

Whitworth is a helpful guy, even if a little quirky. He's very helpful and is willing to answer any questions and facilitate discussion. He's very hung up on the assignments in his online textbook, but most of the notes you need for the test come from his lectures. For the most part, I enjoyed his class, and learned a lot. I would recommend him.
He's great! Such a great professor and person. Take his class!

You have to buy a textbook and an access code for online materials (MySocLab) though his lectures do not focus on the content from these sources. His lectures are boring. This is not a class where you come to learn seriously.

I enjoyed taking this Sustainability class because I learned good life lessons. There is a quiz once or twice a week online and 4 big tests that are very hard. Overall nice teacher. Get ready to study, A's and B+ do not come easy. Just read material and ask questions, you will do fine. Also a two easy group projects.

I thought at the beginning of the semester that I wouldn't like him, but I was wrong! He is very nice and helpful! You can email him before tests for clarification and he is very clear on what will be on the test. There is a 3 question quiz every single day over the reading, but if you read, they are really easy and great grade boosters.

Dr. Whitworth is a decently kind professor and the class itself is easy, as is the first exam, however, the 2nd, 3rd, and final are absurd and even if he says just to study certain things, you must study everything. Also, you must go to class even if you're sick. He's difficult to work with if you miss.

The Syllabus changes a lot, way to much actually. He also changes things after the fact. I did all of the extra credit to get my grade to an A and the last week he told us we could only get 25 points. I did all of that work for nothing and it brought me down to a B+.

Do NOT take this class! Teacher was confusing, unhelpful, unfriendly and not nice. He is a rigid grader yet it is extremely confusing to figure out what he wants so you can not discern what guidelines he is actually imposing and what he really wants! Please save yourself the time, money and aggravation and not no take this course!
Dr. Whitworth is a great teacher. Study for tests and do his assignments and you should get an A. Only complaint is the syllabus changes a lot.

Do all of the assignments on time and do the study guides before tests, and you'll probably get an A. Pop quizzes, so come to class/read for those. Sometimes he assigns things that aren't in the syllabus, so that can be annoying. Would be better as a small class instead of in a big lecture hall, but what are you gonna do?

Whitworth is a good person but class was frustrating. He was very hard to get in contact with and constantly changed assignment guidelines/dates on the syllabus. In fact, he did not grade our class's first exam until May. There were so many reading/daily assignments I felt it should have been a writing emphasis. Class was informative but redundant.

I had Dr. Whitworth for sustainability. He is wonderful! He is so sweet, and he really cares about his students. An A should be achievable if you turn in all of your homework assignments on time and complete and look over the study guides before tests. This class really did change me because now I don't use plastic water bottles. LOVE WHITWORTH!

Dr. Whitworth is great! I took his sustainability class and his class is so interesting! This class is somewhat related to environmental issues. Also, this course if life changing! Just complete your assignments and also try to attend many extra credit events as much as possible. Getting an A is manageable.
Great course! I felt like I learned a lot. The tests are pretty easy if you take notes in class and he also points out what needs to be studied in the textbook.

Had him for sustainability. Extremely NICE professor. The class is easy. Exams are easy when you study for them. There are assignments due everyday, but the assignments are usually only 3 questions. I would recommend this class as an Easy A.

Dr. Whitworth is a very interesting professor.  I never thought I would find sociology so fascinating.  Tests come from his power points and the book.  Overall, not a difficult class.  Oh, and don't take bottled water into his class.
uses a variety of approaches to teach sustainability. ideal college course that makes you think, and think about changing your non-sustainable ways!

a bit scatter brained but an easy class if you take notes and pay attention to the videos in class. most ecollege assignments are just graded on completion so easy points. don't buy the textbook because the online version comes on ecollege

I love Dr. Whitworth! He keeps the class really interesting and pretty easy. There are a lot of assignments to complete, but they are not hard. Just grade fillers to cushion your test grades. He gives reviews for the tests and they get easier every time. Show up, he takes attendance every day!
Starts out hard then gets easier. Take him if you can.
I really enjoyed his class.  If you stayed long enough during the final he will do his best to help you.  My favorite class over 3 semester at TCU.
Very Knowledgable, Gets the Class Motivated to participate. Knows everything on the Vietnam War. Understanding. Funny and very worth taking!

Dr. Whitworth is a nice guy. His class is easy if you read the tiny amount he goes over in the book and listen to lecture. EASY Multiple choice tests, but can be trick questions. Overall, if you're taking Intro cuz you have to, Whitworth is good.
Extremely nice, intelligent professor, but his tests are pretty tough. Most of the questions are true/false and based on obscure facts from the lectures and book. Take him if you want a challenge.

As a generally "A" student who enjoys learning and using her brain, I disliked the way he conducted the sustainability course. The guest lecturers were interesting, but he himself was unprepared, he lost interest in his own course, and he did no critical thinking of his own. He seems like a nice guy, but class with him was frustrating.
good
Great Prof. Class is awesome when he teaches. The other guest speakers... not so much. You'll love it if you love sustainable things, if not... don't be that guy that wants to argue...

He has a LOT of guest speakers. Whitworth is actually really interesting, I wish he would have talked to us more. I had almost no interest in this class prior to enrolling and I actually appreciated the information I learned and found it very useful. Whitworth is a great guy - very respectful and he really practices what he preaches.

Class seemed unorganized at times, but that was almost certainly an exception due to the lack of a TA this semester. Dr. Whitworth was enthusiastic and engaging. I would have appreciated more time spent on lecture, but the class was genuinely enlightening, which is rare. I feel like I got a  lot out of this class.
Great class to take.  Learned a lot and i was not even interested in the class before taking it.

Professor Whitworth is very nice and hlpeful.  He is willing to meet students outside of class and is most interested in the student actually learning the material.  He lectures about stuff not in the book, so attending class is mandatory.  The tests are over class notes and the textbook, which needs to be read more than once to be prepared.
Awesome and easy class!!1

Environmental sustainability =admirable, and Whitworth's passion is obvious; he's kind, shows vested interest in his students. BUT, grossly unclear/conflicting with stats and numbers (needs scientific co-teacher?); undermining anecdotes (using University "top faculty" award $ for turtle traps, etc), thus lost student confidence...great guy, tho!

This class was extremely interesting! Although I did not necessarily agree with everything it broadened my knowledge so that I could make my own informed decisions. TED videos were great! Just keep up with all the exploration and simplicity assignments and you will get a good grade!
He is by far one of the BEST professors I have had! He genuinely cares about his students and has a passion for what hes teaching!! TAKE HIS CLASS YOU WILL LOVE IT!!!!
Professor Whitworth is one of the best teachers at TCU! i was actually interested in his class and his jokes at the beginning of class were a nice way of easing us into the 8 am class.

this was my favorite class! very interesting and made me want to come to class..even at 8am! tests are short but tricky so you need study everything, especially things said in class. dr. whitworth has been my favorite teacher & i cant wait to take more of his classes!

He's a really great professor.  I really enjoyed coming to his class everyday, even though it was early.  He's genuinely interested in the subject and he's never boring.  Definitely take his class!  Tests aren't too hard and explorations really bump your grade!

Professor Whitworth was a great teacher to have. I took his intro to sociology course to get required credits out of the way, and ended up enjoying it very much. He makes the class interesting. Test materials draw from the book and some in class stuff, making attendance necissary at times but not manditory. Its not easy, but its a fun class.
This class was so much fun. It was the only class that I actually looked forward to going to thi semester. Professor Whitworth is an amazing educator and a wonderful model for his students.

Dr. Whitworth's class is easy if you do the Explorations & come for lecture, which can get extremely boring. His tests are way easy if you know your stuff & understand broad topics & statistics. His jokes are lame, but laugh so he stops telling them. Although he's a little corny & easy, he's a very well prepared professor & an excellent teacher.

Loved this class!. Very interesting and never boring. If you want a class that challenges you but is still fun, I advise yo to take this class. The only downside is that there is a good share of reading material and article reviews but I think it is worth the time.

Would definately recommend this class. I learned a lot. If you just go to class, pay attention, and read from the chapter you'll do well. Tests were short, straight forward, and fair. Definately worth taking.

Dr. Whitworth was definitely a favorite professor this semester. If you follow his lectures and highlight the important sentences, the tests won't be hard at all. This is one of the funnest classes I've taken in TCU. I highly recommend Whitworth. The tests aren't hard, just subjective. He can get a little moody but overall he is pretty easygoing. A lot of assignments but its all worth it. I made an A! I'll miss this class next semester.

Read the book! Dr. Whitworth is a great professor but loves to test on details. This course is pretty hard for an intro class, so don't be fooled. He expects a lot out of you which is both good and bad. Do the extra credit, read the book and study, and you will be fine.
Great professor.  It's true- he's tough- tests can be difficult, but it's a class well worth taking.  One of the must-take classes at TCU during your stay.

Yeah, his computer was a great professor.  Seriously though.  His tests are terrible.  It's not that they're hard.  Multiple choice and fill in the blanks are known for their ambiguities.  You can read the chapter many times, and you'll still do bad on them.  Don't take him for the intro class.

He is an excellent teacher and I loved his blend of using computers and technology in class.  (A.L.A. The clickers for the on-screen quizzes, the powerpoint presentations and, eCollege with all it's  threaded discussions.)  2 Thumbs up.
Alot of the test material is from the text book.

Great Professor, very nice.  Tests are tricky and not representitive of what you really know.  He makes the class interesting and has a variety of teaching methods that help you "understand the world we live in".

Dr. Whitworth is a good professor, and the class was interesting and worthwhile.  However, his tests are very hard--- you need to study.  He does offer extra credit options throughout the semester to help you out, though.  Overall, its a good class, but you have to work.

Keith is a great teacher! He loves what he does and it shows. The tests are pretty tricky so make sure you read the book a couple times and you'll be okay. There is a lot of grades so it is not hard to do well in the class as long as you do all the work but don't take the class for a blow off.
Decent class but tests are unnecessarily tricky.  You can study hard and still not do as well as you hoped.  He will keep you busy but makes the subject at hand about as interesting as possible.

This class has more work required than I have ever had in my four years at TCU.  Moderately interesting but this is not a class one would expect to make an A in.  By the second week, about 8 people had already dropped out of 40 and I should have been one of them.

Its actually a pretty fun class, but he spends too much time trying to get the class to like him that he doesnt cover the material.  Tests are fairly easy, takes roll, pop quizzes, lots of out of class stuff.  Overall, way too much time commitment for an intro course. Freshmen seem to love him.

GREAT TEACHER!!! His tests can be tricky but just make sure you thoroughly read the book and take good notes and you'll be okay. His lectures are always very funny and his jokes are a great way to get the class started each day! Definately take him if you have the chance, its worth the work!!!

Keith is amazing! He is so cool.  Every class comes with a discussion on real life stuff.  He is a little bit difficult but if you use common sense it's not too bad.  He is my favorite teacher by far.  He will come off as difficult and mean but don't drop it and you will like him in the end.

Very interesting class.  It is a good class to take if you're not sure on how to study or manage your time, it has helped me a lot my freshmen year.  It is a really interesting class but takes time out of class to complete assignments. He is a great professor.

This class takes up a LOT of outside time! He does a good job of including movie clips, games (including Monopoly), field trips, and examples to illustrate points. He provides extra-credit activities throughout the semester.  I'm making a low A and have not had to study a great deal for the tests.

He is a nice guy that is willing to help you out. The tests are really hard because of the multiple choice format, very confusing. You have to study a lot for the tests to make a good grade. Dont take this class for a gpa booster because it is a gpa buster.I had to struggle get a c, good luck!!!

Dr. Whitworth was an awesome techer but the class was hard to follow.  I felt like maybe if i were a sociology major than maybe i would have been able to keep up.  I thought that this was an introductory course.

Prof. Whitworth's class is very interesting and easy to enjoy...but there are several aspects of the class that are very time consuming such as the out of class projects, but I think that it makes the class worthwhile. I don't like his exams because they lack clarity and fairness.

He is a great educator. Although the class is not easy, you will learn a lot. This class is one that I would recomend if you are looking to learn. If you want an easy A don't take this class, it is a good deal of work. He will help you understand the subject.

He is the best professor I have had at TCU.  His lectures are NEVER boring, and you always leave class wanting to know more.  His tests are pretty tricky, but if you learn to apply the theories, you will do fine!!!!
Professor Whitworth is an awesome teacher!! - probably one of the best I've ever had, but his class takes a lot of preparation and the tests are difficult.
Dr. Whitworth is a great teacher and explains things very well, but his test are pretty difficult. He also expects a lot out of you.
So far I am enjoying the class, he makes things easy to understand.
If you are expecting a free grade think again. This class requires alot of participation and effort. All of the difficulty is worth it, you learn so much and will undoubtedly have alot of fun.

Dr Whitworth is an awesome professor.  You can tell that he definitely loves his job.  I thoroughly enjoyed going to class.  Making an A in his class is almost impossible, but you can definitely learn a lot from him.  I highly recommend this class.
Lots of threaded discussions on e-college.  Took a lot of time outside of class to do service learning projects.  Gives some extra credit, though.
Dr. Whitworth is great!! His class is kinda hard, but it's really interesting and it's totally worth it!
Awesome teacher! Learned so much from him. Friendly, open, understanding. ONLY teacher I will ever take Sociology classes from. Definitely would recommend!

Sadly, he has homophobic views. He once said that he and a friend asked his wife to take down a pink painting (gift from Granny) that once hung above his son's cradle. He said that pink painting would make his son gay. I expect more from a sociologist!
Great teacher, class is hard!! I would tell anyone to take this course very fun and interesting. Learn a lot!! hard A!
Mr. Whitworth without a doubt has been my favorite professor at TCU.  The classes are fun, interactive, and you learn a lot about the real world.  If you do the work, you'll pass... Simple as that.

Alright, I'm a 4.0 pre-med and I think this is one of the hardest classes I've taken, not because of the material but because the tests are really nit picky, so it's possible to get an easy B, but if you care about your GPA, this class will make you work

Dr.Whitworth is a great professor! You can tell that he really loves teaching and he's always there if you have questions or need help. He's a real sincere teacher and I would recommend the class to everyone.
He is a really nice guy and if you study for the tests and go to class you will do fine. Definately read the book it helps alot.

Dr. Whitworth has been the best professor I've had since arriving at TCU.  His classes are really interesting (don't skip!), and he really wants you to learn.  I reccommend the class to everyone, but make sure you study for his hard tests.
was a good teacher and cared how his students were doing

Super nice guy! Knows a lot of interesting stuff about your everyday life and the challenges of the future. Class is hard, however.  His test are very difficult and require nice amounts of studying.  But class is fun, and it was at 8!
He was a great teacher. If you attend class and read the book and your Socnotes you can easily make a B. Study hard and make an A. He is an extremely nice guy.
Good teacher. Very friendly and helpful. Interesting but definitely not a blow off class.
keith is an extremely great professor.  he is there anytime you need help be it in or out of class.  he is very caring about your success in the class and is willing to help in any way he can.
No Comments

This class is an excellent class. I have learned so much and Dr. Whitworth is a great teacher. Do not enroll in this clas if you are not prepared to work to learn... this class is well worth it if you are a hard worker and DO NOT SKIP CLASS!

I enjoyed his class a lot. He made his lectures interesting and you come out feeling like you learned something. His jokes weren't always the best, but at least he gives it a shot. I would recommend his class for your Social Science credit.

This prof takes little to no info for the tests from lectures and recommends that you read the chapter three times!!  Internet activities enhance the course!! Nice as a person...but test are horribly hard!!

One of the best professors I have had.  His class is challenging and you do have to make at least 90% of the class lectures but he teaches so well the time flies.  Great teaching methods...overall the class is just a great experience.
great guy but the tests were a pain in the ass. some of the questions came from little boxes in the book.  make sure to read about all the cases

He is so nice and extremely intelligent.  He seems to really care about the students, and truly makes an effort to get to know everyone.  The tests were difficult, and sometimes the information was a bit scattered, but overall I got a lot of the class.
I think he is a good teacher, but he is not very on top of things, when it comes to his ecollege course.  He does not get back to people very quickly.
Great professor! Compassionate and understanding yet stretches you at test time. On-line activities enhance the course.  He has definitely broadened my view of healthcare!
Health and Illness is a very interesting class.  Dr. Whitworth is a great guy, he really enjoys his job and it shows.

cool prof. starts every class with a joke. tests can be trick because answers come in the form of a,b,a&b,none of the above, all of the above. so look out for those. Easy class if you read the chapters and come to class.
Tests and quizzes are very tricky in my opinion because of the wording, but teacher is a very nice guy.  Starts every class with a joke!
Class is interesting. Be prepared to keep up with online quizzes and short writing assignments on your own. Tests aren't bad if you read the chapters and go to class.
This class was very helpful, but the test are extremely difficult. Other wise, great class.
the tests were a little tricking with the wording and too many true/false. overall a good class and good teaching!
This was an interesting class but the tests weren't exactly accurate measures of what we learned. There was too much online crap to do.
Dr. Whitworth is great, he really opened my mind to new concepts and ideas.
Intro Soci is an interesting and easy class.
One of the kindest people I know. Great teacher with great people skills.
He made the class more enjoyable than I thought it would be.
Great prof. Great guy.
Great class! The 1 hr and 20 minutes always flies by and involves great discussion

Professor Whitworth is an awesome teacher and you can tell he cares about what he teaches and his students! The tests are hard and more in depth than you think they will be so you HAVE to know the material really well!

Keith is a great professor, and an even better mentor.  He is so helpful even with topics not related to class.  I am going to miss him after this May, but I will always keep it touch.  Thank you Keith!
Great Class!  Professor Whitworth is an amazing professor, but his exams can be really tough.  I recommend this class to everyone.
good professor, does his best to help out his students.  kind of liberal for my tase though
I really enjoy lectures and all the work he puts into teaching
He is nice and really easy to pay attention to.

Dr. Whitworth is an EXCELLENT teacher. Not only does he throughly teach the information, he is a pleasure to be around. He truly cares about his students and that is reflected in his work. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND HIM.

I have taken three classes with Keith now.  He is very dedicated to you as an individual.  You must read carefully, study well, and keep up with weekly assignments.  If you like to slack, he is not the prof for you.  Great guy!
His bright attitude and extensive knowledge makes the class very enjoyable.  Make sure you take really good notes, and DO read the chapters at least twice to do well on his *hard* exams.
His bright attitude towards what he teaches makes me want to learn and listen to him.  I really enjoy his real life examples and use of outside resources.  They help me really understand the subject.

His tests are tricky so you have to read and really understand the material, but Prof. Whitworth knows how to keep your attention in class and keeps things fun.. especially with his jokes!! If you have to take this class... take it with him!!

His true false will get you.  It doesn't matter how many times you read the book.  You will learn a lot, but your grade will not reflect how much you really learned.  His jokes keep  the class from getting too serious.

He is thought-provoking, respectful, interesting, and funny, but his class is not a breeze. His exams can be tricky, but as long as you read and put forth effort, you can do well. He is a great person and professor, and I highly recommend his class!

He is a really great teacher and makes the class very interesting.  However, don't expect an easy A, you HAVE to read the book to even try to do well on the tests!!  His class is really fun, and look forward to the daily joke, even if they are really dumb

Without a doubt my favorite teacher on campus! He is such a great guy, and his class is really interesting!! His tests aren't that hard... IF you study. Reading is a must if you want an A. Such a great class... definitely recommended.

Keith was an excellent teacher.  The class is not that difficult if you read the assigned work and study carefully!  Puts statistics and specifics on tests. Passionate about what he teaches so the class is good.Sarcastic..don't be offended!

Very Interesting and Fun Teacher. Hard Tests because of difficult multiple choice problems. "Funny" Jokes. Very Interesting! Really wants to show everyone all the things that can be done with a Sociology Major.

He's a great person to get to know, but his tests are super hard, and he's not always clear about what you should focus on for the class. This is frustrating; especially during finals. For his tests, everything is up for grabs, so be ready to study HARD.
This teacher is very hard and he doesn't round grades up- i had a 79.4 and he gave me a C. Don't take this class if you want an elective.

In my 4 years at TCU this may have been the hardest prof I have ever had.  At the time I was taking all 4000 level classes and Whitworths Intro Sociology class.  His class was 10 times harder than all of my other classes.dont take him if you want an A
One of the best professors I've ever had.  The class isn't easy, but it's actually enjoyable.

Keith is one of my favorite profs!  His classes are fun and interesting, even though the tests are kinda hard.  He has a great concern for his students and is always willing to help with anything!  Everyone should get to know Keith!
No Comments

Dr. Whifworth is teh rockz1!1!! I took his class and was all liek 'omg tihs is hard!1' but it was OK bcuz he explianed it well but like his tests is kind of hard but just STUDY well and u'll be kool! i was like 'i'm gunna fail' but it was all good.

i've had him for intro and for health illness and medicine.  he is a very nice guy and obviously cares for his students.  i love the material in the classes and it is all very interesting, but the tests are SO DIFFICULT.  great class, hard tests
this teacher is the coolest guy. the classes are fun. Although the test are dang hard. Keith Withworth is by far the best teacher at TCU!!!!
i've decided to be a sociology major because of this class. It's so interesting that i enjoy reading the textbook (most of the time)
No Comments
He is a great teacher, and makes the information very clear.  Uses many different teaching methods and that helps the students not become bored by the end of the semester.  Great Guy!
Good teacher, good man in general. He is helpful and his class is fun and his approach to teaching makes for a very enjoyable experience.
No Comments
He is a great teacher that cares about his students and their lives.  Just beware of the tests, and read read read!!!
No Comments
I love his jokes!!!  He is just a great, down to earth teacher who loves what he does!
Class is great.  His lectures aren't boring and keep me involved.  The only problem I have with the man is his tests.  They're freakishly hard and that's killin' me.
He is a really good teacher.  He is down to earth!  I like a professor who can bring in his personal life in the classroom and be honest with us.

I love this class. Dr. Whitworth makes class fun for me. It is challenging but also interesting. I am really learning alot and I think he is one of the best professors that I've had in my college career. Keep up the good work.
No Comments
He has made me a better person!!!!!!
No Comments

It is a very interesting class, but it is very important to read. On tests you have to know the material and not just definitions. Lectures are very interesting and he includes examples from everyday life.

An intelligent and enthusiastic professor.  Those seeking an easy A may wish to apply somewhere else.  Students who desire knowledge and a more scopious and analytical view of society should consider taking his courses. Plus his beard has da magic powa.

An amazing teacher.  Really love his subject.  Be prepared to read the chapter a few times if you want the A.  Tests are tricky.  Other than that a great guy who is not only interested in you progress in the class but you as a person as well.

I was a Busi major until I took Intro Soci w/ Dr. Whitworth.  Everyday in class was different and interesting.  He makes going to class fun, and worth your time.  I have learned so much from him, and he always helps out any way that he can.Great Professor
A very good teacher but watch out for his tests.  They're often very tricky.  But a very fun class and a very fun teacher.
Fun, but keep up on your reading and you'll do fine.  Class isn't always nessary to go to, most of the test is right out of the book. But be sure to pay very close attention to the book.
Very kind and intelligent professor. He influenced my decision to major in Sociology.

Very funny and friendly professor... makes coming to class interesting! Great personality and sense of humor... but this is not a blow off class, be prepared to study well for the tests -- but the material is interesting so it's worth it!
very tough, but fun and cool, worth the tough class, but take it pass/fail
Increidbly nice guy! (Good father too!) Tests very tough, but doable if you study a little
good class, tough tests
No Comments
Very friendly, familiar, and quirky. Very personable.

Adame's class was so fun and easy if you come to class; she takes attendance. Weekly quizzes with identical questions on tests. Her lectures can be lengthy but the information is interesting and she tries to keep the class engaged. Extensive word-for-word review game before each online test.

Dr. Adame is a great professor! Her class is very lecture heavy, so going to class will be beneficial for exams and quizzes. However, her exams and quizzes are very straight forward and easy to be successful in. She is caring and understanding as well.
She makes this class enjoyable, the class is lecture heavy but the tests and assignments are word for word what she teaches and what is in the book. She is a good teacher and you can tell she cares.

Professor Adame is a very easy going person. Her quizzes are weekly but at home along with her exams supper easy if you read the online textbook. Her class is very interesting and she can be funny. Honestly this is my favorite class she actually makes me want to go. Group competitions before exams are also very fun!! Take this class 100%
Quizzes and tests are taken online not in class. Lectures in class, takes attendance every class.
This is an ideal class, everything is online. Professor Adame makes the 3 hour lectures work but sometimes they can be a bit tough to power through

Dr. Adame did a great job of giving lectures that drew lines between the material and real life applications and naturally encouraged active participation. Her expectations were made clear regarding assignments and understanding the material. Exams/quizzes are easy if you read the textbook thoroughly.

I really liked this class. Sometimes it was hard to pay attention because I had a late section and the lecture always went for the full three hours. There were a few extra credit opportunities. The tests were open note and lockdown browser was not required. We only ever had to write one paper. I would definitely recommend taking sociology with her.
Adame is a great professor she is super lecture oriented however as long as you show up to class you'll be fine only two exams and 1 paper super easy never gotten below a 100 on an assignment
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
Professor Adame is nice but that's it. Class is annoyingly boring. She reads off of slides and seems to lack confidence teaching. Didn't learn much. Sometimes she seemed a little clueless about what she was talking about. Seems like a cool person to know, but not a professor worth paying TCU prices for

Easy class if you don't mind not learning.
This class is long with very long lectures. Its an easy class thought so its fine to take along other classes.

Professor Adame is a super nice person, but this class was soooo boring. I always dreaded going to class, it was super lecture heavy. She mostly just read off of slides, I don't think I really learned anything. Sometimes she seemed a little clueless about what she was talking about, but like I said, overall a sweet professor.

I have taken both Macro and Mirco with Adam and I think he is great. The homework is easy and he gives a helpful study guide before every exam. It is a very low maintenance class and attendance not required. I rarely went and got an A. I highly recommend him for any type of student.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took micro with Bahr and I thoroughly enjoyed it. I attended every lecture because he made them interesting. He gives a good study guide before every exam that is SUPER helpful. Homework is easy and doesn't take long. As long as you take notes and study you will do well. He is also funny and understands the life of a college student. Recommend!

Professor Bahr is a great microeconomics professor. He covers the material in depth and is passionate about the material. I would definitely recommend him to any student looking to take a microeconomics class. If you follow his reviews for tests, you should do well.

Bahr is a pretty enjoyable guy and makes some good jokes here and there. His homework can be a little difficult at times but the way they are graded makes up for them. As long as you pay attention and study it's not bad
There is a lot of homework, but its easy. He is approachable and kind and loves Econ. His lectures were interesting considering the content, and he made the material easy to understand.

Adam is awesome. He is by far my favorite prof of the semester and I would absolutely take another class of his. I took his Intro to Macro class and now I am considering a minor in economics. Obviously, it isn't the most entertaining class but he made it enjoyable.

ONE OF THE MOST CARING TEACHERS I HAVE EVER MET! Attending class is apart of your "Participation" grade along with a few easy homework assignments that are graded for completion. That equals like 25% of your grade! I would email her at the most random times and she always responded fast! I would also tell her when I was struggling and she helped!!!

Professor Bezusko was my favorite class this past semester, she keeps class interesting and although we read 4 books and watched 3 movies, the assignments were very manageable. She is very understanding, has a true passion for what she is teaching and is constantly checking on her students. Take her you won't regret it!

Dr. Bezusko is one of the best professors I have ever had. She truly cares about her students, especially this semester as we are online. She is incredibly smart, socially/politically aware, and passionate about literature. Her intro to fiction class consists of 4-5 books, a couple movies, and 5 essays. NO tests. Need to be a strong writer.

Dr. Bezusko is one of the sweetest and kindest professors I have ever had. She is so understanding and a great professor. I enjoyed her class and found the workload to be manageable. There are 2 main papers and one final project. For the papers you will have a conference to get suggestions from her before turning them in.

Definitely very passionate so she can get fired up in class. If you come across engaged in class you will succeed. Not very available outside of class, but try to meet with her for feedback and she will tell you exactly what to do. Ask questions, be engaged, and show up on time and she will like you which is crucial. Kinda crazy but solid option.
Counts tardies, but didn't tell me about it until after the third one. Seemed biased against different groups of students. Very difficult grader. Doesn't treat everyone equally.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class is a required CORE class, but I loved Professor Bezusko. If you go to class, visit her office hours, and get your work done on time, you will have no problem getting an A. There were a lot of papers, but if you plan out your time it is very manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--So many papers

reviews.comment: This was her first semester at TCU and I highly recommend. She expects a lot of her students, but if you are active in class and do the readings, it will be an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: If you go to her for feedback on papers, she will tell you exactly what she is looking for. She really likes participation, so make sure you always go to class. There are only 4 major projects with some smaller papers. Highly recommend if you will put the effort in!! One of the most understanding and caring professors.

Jabang is knowledgeable and clearly experienced in African development. He cares about his students and encourages participation without putting anyone on the spot. 5 reading reflections (lowest dropped), a midterm essay, final essay, and a presentations with plenty of time and feedback Don't leave WM without taking a class with Professor Jabang!

His class is one of those that is easy to get an A in, but it just is a process. We had 0 tests, 0 quizzes, and basically 0 homework. We had two essays and 2 group projects making up majority of grade. He gives lots of extra credit. The papers are long, but I got great grades on both and wrote both in a day. I got a 97 in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I highly recommend taking a different professor. He grades extremely harshly when I spend 5-6 hours minimum writing a single essay for a beginner class. I also emailed him for help, and his email was passive aggressive and didn't answer my question whatsoever. What he says in class compared to rubrics/instructions is very contracting and confusing.

He takes forever to grade. Everybody was confused what grade they were going to get. It was extremely unclear and stressful. You have to go to every class. It was his first semester so maybe he will get better but I'm pretty disappointed with how this class went. Final is 2,000-2,500 word essay graded harsh.

He grades way too harshly for a freshman level class and does not grade anything for weeks. And, he is very nit picky about assignments. I wanted to see what I got on the mid-term paper (due mid October) before deciding to P/NC and as of Dec 5 (past the P/NC deadline) it is still not graded. I P/NCed the class anyway.

Don't recommend, he takes forever to grade and is way harsh for a core class. Attendance is mandatory. I found the lectures to be long and boring. There are so many easier professors that will be better.

All the exams/quizzes are at home. Homework assignment based on the reading each week but they're not hard at all. One group project that's pretty easy if you get a decent group, a little strict on grading with the presentation part of it. Only problem is she isn't very good about answering her emails.
Such a great professor! She is super chill and all the assignments are straightforward. Before each exam there is a review where she tells you questions.

TAKE HER CLASS! I've switched my major to social work because of this class, I don't know the last time I felt this optimistic for the future. She cares about all her students and is willing to do whatever she can to help you succeed. TAKE HER!

literally can't stress enough how much y'all need to take her. prof t is the best professor I've ever had. her reviews are games where you win extra credit, she plays music and gives us manifestations before class, and she's always willing to answer questions. TAKE HER.
Take this class.

TAKE THIS CLASS. Professor T is the nicest woman I've ever met, and her class is literally so easy. She's insightful, makes class engaging, and truly cares about each student. I was actually DISAPPOINTED on days that class got canceled, that's how much I loved this class. TAKE HER!!!
SO amazing! she is one of my favorite teachers i have had at tcu and is so kind and really cares about how her students are doing. Exams and quizzes are online and very clear.

Ms. Terrell made me fall in love with Social Work. She has such a passion for what she does and she loves her students so much- she makes her lectures engaging and all tests are open-book. Easy class that I always looked forward to. Love her so much!!!

It's easy to see from the start that Dr. A is incredibly passionate about what he teaches. With that being said, his lectures and exams are HEAVILY based on the reading. For an Intro class, it is ROUGH. You could write a 3 page paper full of details to answer a question on an exam and he'd still ask for more. But he does offer a lot of extra credit
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This class is supposed to be introduction course but is very extreme. Took this class because it double dips in credits and this was the biggest mistake of my life. Lots of reading, lots of pop quizzes, the review guides do not give much help, and the grading is very tough. He offers some extra credit but thats the only positive.

Very difficult class (I've heard this class its harder than ANTH upper levels). I would only recommend if you have a STRONG interest in the subject/and are a strong student or its a requirement for your major. His grading is difficult. Reading will seem like a lot if you're from a department that doesn't read. Extra credit avail. Fun labs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: As a 2nd semester senior I decided to take this class to fill up an elective credit for an easy A. Big mistake! Lots of reading, pop quizzes, and study guides in poor detail. Attendance is weighted heavily and on the 2 days i missed he held pop quizzes. Half of the class is a snooze fest only focused on American Indians. Waste of time/rigorous.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He is a super tough grader, the exam reviews are three pages long with questions to answer. There is no humanly way possible that a human can memorize all of those questions within a week. He doesn't care to help you. I have a problem with understanding assignments and I asked for his help and he blew me off and was rude when I asked him for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. A is a pretty chill and nice instructor. However, he really is strict on grading so getting an A is challenging. Participation in the class is very important since he writes down the names of the people who participate. He really cares and is passionate about what he teaches. I would recommend taking his class only if anth is your major.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Hes super cool but makes you work. Some people get pissy about it but he deeply cares about what he teaches and his students.

This class was very difficult, it was during COVID, online course. I loved the daily meditations as a class. The readings were very heavy, multiple books to read, hard to balance with other course work. In class questions were difficult to understand. Exams are tough as well. Very peaceful man, intelligent and passionate about what he teaches.

Don't take this class unless you want to hate yourself. He grades SO hard and an A was simply unattainable. SO MUCH READING at least 80 pages per week of tedious and useless stuff. Science major with a 3.95, and I barely passed. My comment is here to save your GPA and sanity. HE IS SO BAD!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This course was a LOT but it was really rewarding. Dr. A was respectful and caring about his students and was always well prepared. Very discussion based, lots of reading beforehand. Attendance and participation are mandatory but there are lots of opportunities, and some extra credit assignments. Would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. A is awesome. His class is hard, has lots of reading, but is fascinating. Dr. A is a kind person who is understanding, funny, and clearly really cares about his students. 10/10 would take again.

BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES. He's a really cool dude and very passionate about the subject. His quizzes are very specific so take notes on the readings and look them over before going to class. There was one group project before the final, but it's not difficult even though it involves a group presentation. He wants to hear your voice.
Dr. A is tough but very fair and grades on a curve. Takes the tims to discuss topics with you and address concerns. Be professional and be treated likewise.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: The worst teacher I have ever had.  I would go see him for help and I would get the same answer every time. NO HELP AT ALL!  If you don't read the textbook everyday you won't pass because you have pop quizzes at least once a week.  He also writes down the names of kids who answer questions in class, so if you don't like that, DONT TAKE THIS!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Dr. Aftandilian is a wonderful man and professor. He is very knowledgeable of what he teaches. If you are interested in the subject go ahead and take this class. However, you will be forced to read a lot in order to pass the pop quizzes. He is a tough grader in tests and quizzes but if you work hard you will do fine. Not easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He takes detailed notes of when you speak during class, and then is extremely tough grading participation.  I suggest talking at least twice in class every class and writing down each time you spoke and what you said if there is any reason you need to fix a participation grade. Good guy and all, but I wouldn't retake this class.

I am not an anthropology major, but I needed this credit for my degree. Dr. A. is incredibly passionate about what he teaches, extremely knowledgeable, and very enthusiastic. I took intro to arch. and it was INCREDIBLY hard. If you are a non-major, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!!!!!! If ANTH is your major, he knows his stuff and I highly recommend him.

He's a great guy and will absolutely help you, but the class is very difficult. You have to do every reading before class if you want to do well. If you have time for the readings, the class is absolutely worth your while, but don't take this class on a semester where you already have a big work load. You have to work, but it's manageable.

Professor is extremely helpful- for every test or quiz question you miss, he actually goes and finds the answer in the book, writing the page number and an explanation on your paper. The study guide for each chapter is made up of the questions off the final exam. so if you answer those as you go, your review is done early.

Tons of reading. Biggest workload of any class. Passionate about his course and profession. Felt very pressured to participate in class because after every question answered, he would take a break and jot the name of the student. That could be distracting at times. Very tough grader. Have to get things worded exactly.
I loveeee Dr. A!!! Awesome guy, really informative and entertaining. Enjoys teaching, but def one of the hardest 'A's I've worked for but totally worth it!

Aftandilian is one of the best professors I've ever had! He keeps things interesting and I learned so much from his Native American Religions & Ecology class. I love how he teaches, though he can be a tough grader. However, his classes are totally worth it. He is quite possibly my favorite anth. professor.

Such a nice and helpful professor! He's not hard if you do the reading and go to class (because he gives pop quizzes). If you know you won't read you shouldn't take him because you HAVE to read to do well! He's very helpful, good humored, answers lots of questions, does in class activities, and will do just about anything for his students! LOVE HIM

Dr. A was a good professor! Friendly and helpful. Halfway through the class he gave us a survey asking what we thought of his teaching style. He actually listened to what we said and adjusted his class to help us learn better! However I took Intro to Arch and it was difficult. I passed/failed it. The material is extensive and he gives pop quizzes

Dr. A is undeniably awesome! He is incredibly informative, but still interesting to listen to, he really does care about his students and his field of study. A great professor, but an even better person.

Really cool guy who knows his stuff, lots of reading, all you have to do is read ALOT for your two blogs a week, write 3 papers, and do a group project. Easy B and the class is like a triple dipper, but HE REFUSES TO GIVE AN A.

LOVED HIM! He is seriously one of the best teachers I have had here. The class is tough. Definitely not an "Easy A", but worth it if you have any interest in Archaeology. He is very helpful and open to questions. Personally, I think he is kinda cute haha.

Aftandilian is the nicest guy! He's extremely helpful, doesn't make you feel stupid for asking questions, and he will work with you if you are having trouble. There's pop quizzes over the reading some days, a couple worksheets for homework, a few tests, and a group project at the end of semester. overall an awesome class i thought, learned a lot!

Aftandilian absolutely rocks! Take his class if you can. There's a lot of reading but it's all really interesting. You get graded on weekly online journal entries. Besides that there's only three 3-5 pg papers, midterm & final. Tests are easy if you've been paying attention! He's a really nice guy and great professor. Extremely helpful too.

He's a really nice guy and pretty helpful.  He's new though, and seems kind of unsure of himself.  He seems to know what he's talking about though. Very helpful. I emailed him and asked if we would have a study guide and he wrote back "thanks for asking the question. I'll either have an in class review or give out a study guide."

He's a really nice guy and pretty helpful.  He's new though, and seems kind of unsure of himself.  He seems to know what he's talking about though. Very helpfuly. I emailed him and asked if we would have a study guide and he wrote back "thanks for asking the question. I'll either have an in class review or give out a study guide."

I enjoyed Professor Gomez for my religion class. I definitely think that he can be a lot for students but personally, I think he was very respectful of everyone's opinions' and perspectives. Lots of pop quizzes, but they are quite easy if you pay attention in class. The readings are easy to understand and lectures cover readings as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This could have been a very interesting class, instead the class was very opinion heavy and not very religion centered. He inserted his own opinion on social and political issues which I found inappropriate given the class was a religion course. Pop quizzes are also given about every other class so make sure to read before class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Class may seem like a lot of reading but they are all very short. One of those classes that as long as you simply do the work you will be completely fine. Professor Gomez is very knowledgeable and passionate about native american religions and teaches a great class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This was a great class and I definitely would take again. There was a lot of reading, however, in class you discuss the readings with groups so it was really easy to bounce ideas around and get a better understanding of all the material. There are pop quizzes every once in a while on the readings which is why it is important to do them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Gomez is very passionate about native american religions. Only homework is reading for the next class he gives pop quizzes but are 3 questions and drops 3 lowest. If you listen and participate just a little you will do good. Two tests and two Harkness discussions very little studying required. Gave an extra credit opportunity for 5% of your grade
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr.Shipp is super nice and knowledgeable, but the class is pretty difficult. She is a very hard grader and doesn't give very many guidelines so its hard to know what she is expecting. The semester project was a lot of work but ended up boosting my grade in the end. Be prepared to read and do research

Shipp comes across as smart and engaging but she contradicts herself often and gives little to no guidance. A semester-long project that she purposefully leads you in the wrong direction on at the start. She is a very harsh grader and never gives out 100s. Don't recommend this class in the slightest.

Dr. Shipp is very knowledgeable and receptive to feedback on her class, however, is strict and methodological. Be prepared to do a lot of teamwork and get grades that might be disappointing to you. The team project was very vague and broad, which made us work much harder outside of class context and material. Overall the class took a lot of effort.

I am surprised that Shipp has good ratings on here, because she has been nothing but a mid teacher. She likes to make sure that you know that she is better than you by NEVER giving a 100 on any assignment, no matter how great you think you did. I believe she is 1/2 teachers who teaches this course so get into the other one if possible.

Very meticulous on grading. The first papers are graded by the TA that you never meet. She loves to take off points for super small things. One time she gave my team a 4/5 on something because we "raised our voices at the end of sentences." She thinks she is so amazing, but is overall confusing. Haven't gotten anything out of the class.
Professor to our MBA cohort. Very easy to listen to and actively encourages participation and discussion. Great experience.

Abbie is an amazing person! She has years of experience and really cares that her students learn the material. Her tests are not terms/definition type, but rather application of material learned during lecture. Be ready for questions like "what is the MOST effective way....." Buying/reading the book is not necessary at all.
At first it seems like there's going to be alot of writing but trust and wait it out. She grades very easily and helps out a ton. 100 percent take this class if you can.

Professor Abbott was a great teacher. Her class was very easy as long as you meet all the deadlines and follow the rubric clearly. There are a lot of papers, outlines, and projects throughout this class but is very easy grader. Would take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Abbott is a fantastic teacher. She was always helpful outside of class and was very quick to answer. She will have you text her; you shouldn't be afraid to. She will respond within the hour and give extremely helpful feedback. She acknowledges that her class may not be a top priority and is very flexible with deadlines. Loved her class!

DO NOT TAKE! This professor is genuinely the most boring lecturer I have ever taken, and it seems like he hates the class just as much as his students do. Tests are worth a decent chunk, and each has 50-60 questions over the 10 slideshows he does per test (each contains 33 slides). Tests are T/F, multi-select, and matching. AND group projects.
Lectures are super boring. If there is an easier teacher or better class for the RELI credit, take it. If you're stuck, don't worry too much.

Dr. Mengestu is incredibly hard to understand. Every class he woud just read directly from the slides. This class requires you to teach yourself. Tests are online. Attendance is mandatory. Do not take him.
He is not a great professor, but a solid option for your religion credit. His tests are not super easy and will require a decent amount of effort (also the questions are worded weirdly).

This class is information heavy with tests that are difficult to understand. To get a good grade, multiple hours of studying is required but he uploads his notes so they are accessible. Gives very little homework and assignments so grade is majorly dependent on test scores. Very nice teacher but lacks easy to understand concepts in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Mengestu wasn't terrible but wasn't amazing. He can be difficult to understand at times and is very lecture heavy. Group presentations are not difficult but be prepared for his feedback and questions on your topic (sometimes good or bad). Tests were difficult but if you keep up with completing his study guides, you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He was a decent teacher- not bad but not great. The classes are lecture heavy and sometimes his accent is hard to understand. Tests are online with lockdown browser and webcam. arent too hard but a lot of content. 2 group projects that arent bad. He is sweet and passionate about religion, but I was taking for core and wish it was a little easier.

Dr. Mengestu is very sweet and caring. Unfortunately, his accent is very thick and lectures are extremely boring as they aren't interactive. Exams are difficult but not undoable. If you enjoy religion then I think you'd like this class as he is very sweet and loves what he does! Just can be very long and boring.

Professor Mengestu made a very interesting religion course. Lectures can be long, but he provides study guides for ALL quizzes and tests and if you just listen to the lectures and write down notes in the study guide, you are prepared for everything. Attendance is required and there are group projects but he's an easy grader. Loved his class.

Professor Mengestu was nice at times but he was also really rude at times. after group presentations he gives both good and bad feedback in front of the whole class. he can be hard to reach at times, but he was nice through email. Attendance is a part of your grade and he can be hard to understand at times. Hes is a hard professor but not the worst

Thought it would be harder than it ended up being. Lots of quizzes but he would announce them if class participated. Mostly graded by group projects and tests, but he was an easy grader for the projects. All tests and quizzes are online as well. Do well on the 3 exams and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you have the option to take him, do not. One of the most unforgiving professors at TCU. Doesn't care at all about his students. The lectures are supremely boring and the material itself is rather uninteresting. All quizzes and tests are online but conducted under a LockDown Browser.

Was an easy grader, but I thought it was going to be more difficult than it was at first. Majority of grades are from group projects so be able to make them at least somewhat good, but he typically gives 100 if you meet all the grading requirements. Midterm and Final were a little difficult, but if you study the information it will be fine.

Really tough grader and doesn't care about the students in my opinion. Says he's going to be available by email but he isn't. Don't take this course if you value your GPA at all. Lectures all class nonstop. Doesn't engage the class and makes his test questions impossible. Horrible teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I enjoyed the class overall. I don't like group work, but he grades very easily on those assignments. The quizzes are easy. The tests are a little harder, but a lot of your grade comes from the group work anyways. His study guides are very similar to the tests/quizzes so you know what to expect. Class is lecture-heavy, but I found it interesting.
ALL GROUP WORK. long lectures and no extra credit. too many papers and presentations and tests are difficult

Mengestu was decent. class was only lecture. 5 pop quizzes but he will tell u in advance as long as there is class participation. Can be nice, but stern. Thick accent, but didn't bother me. 1 midterm and 1 final. Very information-heavy. 2 textbooks but only used 1 for the 8 group papers & the 2 presentations. 1 group for the entire year

He is a nice guy but basically reads off the info packed slides for 90min.The class is heavily group work so it sucks if you're in a bad group but he is a very easy grader.The tests and quizzes relate directly with the slides but there is just SO much information in each lecture and having it at 8am is even worse. Definitely don't need the textbook

Haven't seen a full accurate response to this guy. He lectures the entire time and he gives you the PPTs to annotate. SO MUCH GROUP WORK, pretty much everything besides the miterm and final. He test are hard, he gives you a review & the review relates well to exam. But his exam questions are very tricky. Out of all religion classe, not the worst

Mengestu is a pretty nice person overall, but his class is completely lecture only. He has such a thick accent that I honestly didn't know what he was saying all semester. All he does is read off the slides so going to class is almost pointless. The midterm and final and jam packed full of information. Easy grader though so homework boosts grade
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is mostly busy work. It's very boring and the professor spends an hour reading from slides. Its a ton of group work, so if you get a bad group it really sucks. Quizzes and tests are just from the slides. He doesn't care about his students, takes forever to respond to emails, overall not an easy person to go to. Don't recommend.

His class is boring and reading/material heavy. He assigns a ton of group projects/presentations and has several quizzes toward the end of the semester that are over 60-80 slides and the assigned reading. He just covers too much information and his lectures are monotonous. I would not recommend taking his class. Too much reading and busywork.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: All he does is read from slides, so if you don't make it to class, just take the PowerPoint notes. It's a TON of notes but reading through them before quizzes help a lot. A TON of group work so if you get a bad group, it really sucks. Final and midterm are similar to the study guide, and reading is needed only when doing reports and for the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Mengestu does not care for his students. You are just another object sitting wide-eyed in his class. He does not let you go back to previously answered questions on quizzes. His tests make you contemplate the answer for 10 minutes with "all the above" "a and c" and "none of the above" options on every question. Do not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You can tell Dr. Mengestu is a professional in what he does. However, there is so much material to go over that it is a lecture only, with not much time for discussions. He tells you when pop-quizzes will be and gives out a study guide. Lots of reading reports, group projects, but it is a manageable class.

Had him online and had group assignments due twice a week if not more, had to buy 3 books and used them for the assignments. Only a midterm and final but still somewhat difficult for a core class. Powerpoints are paragraphs long. Hes also hard to understand sometimes but easy grader on assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Don't take this class especially if its online. Homework almost every day, pop quizzes, group projects, multiple presentations, and grades on the +/- scale which makes the perfect recipe for an annoyingly difficult class. Always very condescending especially during the presentations but you usually cant understand his thick accent anyway

If online, be prepared for 10 group reading reports and 2 group projects. You have to present these and be prepared to be roasted. He will then lecture from the powerpoint the rest of class. He posts his power points and will give you study guides for the exams, so as long as you study those you're good.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Do not ever take this guy or this class. You can't understand him half the time due to a heavy accent, he lectures for 98% of the class time, the material could not be more boring, and he assigns a huge amount of homework that is honestly just busywork and nothing more. If you have a hard time paying attention, this guy is not for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Mengestu's class was quite easy! It was VERY lecture heavy, which could be a lil much but he def encourages participation to amp things up. DO PARTICIPATE! If he has class participation, he will tell u when the next quiz is! Also, his study guides are the same as the midterm and final. Save your money when buying the books dnt really need them
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Mengestu mixes up the homework so it does not get boring. He also gives breaks from extra homework one week per month by just assigning a post to the discussion board with 3 responses. There are several grades to earn so if you mess up on something you can still do well. Final paper is 12 pages. Books are needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: The class is the same thing everyday, a powerpoint lecture. It was a pretty easy class, but just long at 8am. Just beware of quizzes they will get ya but if you do well on them it will really boost your grade. He gives study guides and if you know that info for the test you are solid!!
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Really easy World Christianity class. Take him if you can, even if the class is at an early time. Worth the A. He does give "pop" quizzes that are all announced the class before, they do not have many questions so study up what he presented on from the class before. Also, quizlet, use it.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Lectures are very detailed and sometimes hard to sit through so early in the morning because the material is pretty boring, but I would highly recommend his World Christianity religion class - people say religion is hardest at TCU but he gives you all of the questions that will be on tests/quizzes ahead of time. Gotten an A on every exam so far.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He does have a very thick accent, and it can be difficult to concentrate on him reading off his power points at 8am. However, the reviews for his tests and quizzes are nearly verbatim the test, and all you need to do, if your goal is merely to get credit and move on with your life, is memorize the review.

Not a hard class, but the subject matter isn't the most interesting. Tests and quizzes are memorization questions formatted in T/F, multiple choice, matching, and a few fill-in-the-blank. Attendance is 5% of grade.

I took this class to fulfill a religion credit and really enjoyed it! His class was at 8 am and he is lectures were kinda boring because he reads from the slides, but he made everything very clear and it was easy to follow even with the strong accent. He has pop quizzes that he'll tell you about before hand, do the review for test, and go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He lectures directly from the powerpoints & no engagement with students. If he would pose questions prior to the readings, which w/ a class like this, it is info. overload it would be easier to engage his students. He did give study guides but 1/2 the time was not on the test. If you're a kinesthetic learner you'll need to turn the headers into ?'s

TAKE HIM! This class is an easy A from day 1 if you pay attention. He posts all the lectures online, his tests are multiple choice or t/f, and he gave one pop quiz but actually told us about it beforehand. He is so nice and I really found his lectures interesting! By far one of the best classes I've taken at TCU.

If you take this class seriously from the beginning, it's an easy A. His tests are matching, t/f, multiple choice, and short answer. He gives out study guides before the tests and they're basically made straight from the questions on the test. His accent is strong, but you get use to it. He is so kind and really cares about his students. Take him!
Class was easy but insightful. He really knows his stuff and wants you to get it too. Super nice and study guide given before test if you do it you'll pass the tests.

He's really kind and apologetic for his (practically non-existent) accent. Study guides are all you need. Three "pop quizzes" ended up being announced the class before, along with the material is would be on. No final, just 4 tests. He takes attendance. It's worth the 8 am to get this easy A!

HORRIBLE. Her lectures are straight from the book so theres no need to go to class if except she takes attendance. NO CLEAR GRADING CRITERIA. She will send you and your group on a wild goose chase the entire semester changing her expectations and grading criteria. DO NOT TAKE MARKETING WITH HER. Gives TERRIBLE feedback. Would NEVER take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: One of the easiest classes I've taken at TCU. I studied for an exam the night before & got a 92. If you show up to class & fill out the sheets, you'll automatically get participation points. You do have to put in work on the group mini-projects but they're relatively easy. The way she talks is patronizing but if you can get past that you'll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Easy class, study a little for the tests and you will do fine. Take group project seriously (even though they seem like a joke). Get individual paper done at beginning of semester. Only bad thing: She grades harder as semester carries on to manipulate everyone's good grades which is frustrating. Won't bump grades (ex A- to A).

Customer insights is such an easy class. The material is somewhat interesting. She set it up to have 3 smaller group projects instead of one big one - which I think was easier and more fun. Tests come from the book and lectures, if you show up an pay attention you should get an A no problem

Abdinoor is a solid choice to take for Marketing Management. Her class isn't that difficult, but you do have to put in the effort to receive a decent grade. She grades the group project pretty tough but going to class was a good portion of your grade. Class was 3 tests, 3 papers (2 for group project/1 case study). Overall would recommend.

He is a great professor, with interesting lectures. There about 6 papers to complete. The final and midterm make up a huge percent of your grade so it is necessary that you attend class to prepare for those. If you are a person that likes to put in the minimal effort, this class will make you go above and beyond.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Navarro is so caring and knowledgeable and has been one of my favorite professors at TCU. I was not too excited to take this course, but I am so glad I did. Do the work, put in effort, and you will be just fine. Don't take this class if you don't do your homework or don't go to class because it will be hard for you to succeed.

Super clear on what you need to do to succeed. Definitely not the easiest course but not hard at all, tell you exactly what is on the test and goes over it in class a lot. Just pay attention and you will do fine. Super knowledgeable and interesting lectures that makes keeps you focused.

I wasn't very excited about this class but it ended up being my favorite this semester. Professor Navarro is the nicest and most caring professor, and he wants his students to learn and do well. The class was extremely manageable and had minimal reading and homework. It was organized very well. I would definitely recommend taking a class from him!

This class can seem super daunting but at the end of the day, Navarro is a concise and clear prof. Being straightforward & having a good argument in the papers is key b/c he just wants to see u understand what's going on. TA grades them harder. He gives great feedback and hefty lectures that are the only way to pass/ do well on the final.

Dr. Navarro is such a caring professor DO NOT be intimidated by the essay papers THEY'RE all doable. He gives feedback too so you can improve your papers I got 1 paper with a 80 and the rest were 90 and 100. He also gives you the questions he asks before the test so you have time to prepare. Only reason I got a B is because I did 2/3 of the final.

His class is very manageable. There were only 2 exams (midterm & final) and 8 short papers.  He is very nice and flexible if there is any conflict and you need an extension on a paper. It is a very lecture-heavy class so take good notes, which will be on both exams. He explains everything very well and hands out outlines of terms for each unit.

Be ready to put in 110% effort to earn above a 90%. He is a caring professor, however, he is a tough grader and you really have to pay attention. Take notes the whole class period and study hard for the midterm and final exam. There is about one paper per week.

A very good professor, in my opinion, makes class fun to be in. Most of the class is based on readings, both in the textbook and outside sources so there's a lot of reading to do. Most class time is based on discussion, so reading really helps in that regard. Really excels in helping students improve analysis of sources through essays.

PROFESSOR NAVARRO IS AMAZNIG! I took him for both his colonial and national period classes and they were both so engaging. It is a lot of reading and writing (like 10 papers total) but they are only 2-3 pages. He makes the material interesting and relatable. He is a gem at TCU and if you are not a HIST major but need a free elective take his class
Awful. He has no idea how to teach an intro level course. Papers due every week, readings are as big as the ones in upper division courses. And he grades extremely hard. Never again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Aaron is a good teacher. He knows what he is teaching. But the course curriculum terrible. Its simply too much readings for a intro level class. On top of that he harshly grades the paper. He expects the students to be ON POINT and there are RESPONSE PAPERS due every week. Save yourself some hassle, dont take this class.
He's awesome. Take him!

Great professor for ENTR that has a lot of experience. He will challenge you to be better as an entrprenuer. Class is centered around one main project that he walks you through and gives a lot of help with. 100000% reccommend taking him
