Akin is a great guy and I feel I got a ton of good worldy and business information from the man. He has a good heart, but strays alot and gets off topic, it's a very fun class but it ended up much harder in the 2nd half than the first. I was expecting an A- or possibly an A and ended up with a B
if you'd be happy with a C or worse, take this class.

If you want a "B", take his class. If you want anything else...or just want to learn something, avoid him. He loves to name drop and tell stories, but never actually teaches anything of substance. Assigns projects with very subjective rubrics and no set grading system. Take another marketing class if you care you about getting anything out of it.

Great Professor that cares a lot. He is really hilarious and makes class fun. Really easy going. If you don't get a lot out of class, the book offers a great online tool to help study for tests. He also lets you bring a 4x6 note card to each exam.

Akin is an enigma. He can be good and bad, depending on how you like to study. I didn't like his teaching style, he would tell stories to explain his points (which I enjoyed) but then, didn't give any set rubric to help with tests. Also, he gives no preparation or time to help with group projects. Be prepared to work on your own with your group.

I mean the class is easy and you're likely to get a high B or A, but Akin picks his favorites and it's super annoying. He doesn't prepare you for the project and then drills you on the presentation. Class is pointless but he takes attendance. Quizzes are what will bring your grade down so read after each clss.

Genuinely cares for students. Don't expect to take many notes; he teaches via stories &conversation. Read the texts he suggests; he doesn't test on them, but they will help when you apply his lessons out of class.Pay attn to his stories, there are reasons he tells them. I have never felt so respected by a prof. His class is the high point of my day

This class is like having someone read you the powerpoints that come with the book while Fox News is playing in the background. He sets you off on a project that he hasnt prepared you for, ignores email and then grades harshly.
Great guy, fun to be in class. However the class is pointless. You wont learn a thing. Still it is fun to be there

Great teacher, but can be a jerk to students he doesn't like outside of class. He definitely favors the athletic and assertive types, but you'll love the class even if he doesn't really like you. He loves TCU, and that's fun.

I know the person who left the 12-17 comments. They were in my group. They brought the group down. Did nothing to help. This rating is not a fair representation of Akin. He tries to help, the project was good. It really helped me understand. He tries to use humor to break down a barrier between studnets and Profs. Will hammer you if you don't care.

Tries to be the "cool teacher." A name dropper and plays favorites. Loves to talk about partying and sports, so if you are in a fraternity, sorority or an athlete, you already are ahead in the class. He cancelled many classes and ends ones he does have almost always early. However, he has good advice, great speakers and easy tests.

Akin is the best! The namedropping was kind of annoying at first, but he really grew on me. The guy is EXTREMELY sweet and helpful, and absolutely hilarious! Just show some interest and ask questions, and you'll do very well. He made a 9am class more than enjoyable!
Yeah take Aiken!  He's so funny and going to his class in enjoyable!!

Great class!! I abostutley loved him, made the class interesting & excited to cmoe to class.You learn useful real life information based from his successful experiences. You have to put effort into his class but it is worth it Everything you learn in here you can use in the real world to help build relationships & sell. Personable & easy to talk to

This was a really fun class. It doesnt really feel like a class room. Bob is very fun and wants the students to get excited about the material. He is a really nice fun guy and I enjoyed going to this class. I would defintaly take this class again

Completely unhelpful. Never returns emails and class is kinda pointless. He has def favorites and if you dont loooovvvvveee drinking, talking about alcohol and being ****, inferring you got **** last night then he will not give you the time of day. My parents are paying TCU to talk about getting **** for at least 2 of the 3 hours in a given week

I loved his sales and selling class. I felt that of most of my classes his was the most informative. He made us use selling tactics in real world projects. Yes it is hard to make an "A" in the class if you don't make an effort. Yet, if you do the work to your best ability than you will get an "A". Best class and one I recommend. Loved this class.

the projects are fun, but the class overall is a waste. he cancels class almost every day, pretty lazy guy i think. i definitely did not get my moneys worth. the final was over material we never covered in class so even thought the class is easy, it's hard to get an A.

Okay, for all those that post that Akin is the coolest teacher and that you will learn soo much - its a lie! He is cool because you do crap in his class, he rambles on and on and yes - tests you on stuff he's never discussed in class. He loves to drop names and talk about how great we are. But do you learn anything - NO

Pretends to be student's best friend. Gives you little workload, easy projects, you learn a lot. However, he is totally two-faced. He gives an impossible final, which only effects those who are not athletes or are Chi-Os. Lectures go completely off topic. One of those I'm the boss, but I'm still like you guys. Name-dropper.
No Comments
awesome guy, have had him twice now.  you will learn a lot from his classes and enjoy going to class.  definetly take one of his classes if you can!

Bob is a good guy.  He wants to help students learn and lives by the believe that business is not taught in the class room.  This class is new and he is still tweaking it which explains the lack of direction in his lectures.  Take him as a professor if you can because you will enjoy it.
He is sooooo awsome. I meen he is the best. and he golfs!!! wow. great teacher learned a ton. Akin 4 ever
Akin is awesome!  If you have him, he will become your favorite professor and an awesome friend.

I never studied, got a horrible grade...but he was the coolest professor I have ever had. If you talk to him with some sass (in a respectful way), you will gain his favor. He and I still talk even after a year.
Awesome teacher awesome class.  Probably my favorite class @ TCU.

If your not a sorority girl or a frat guy you won't do well in his class.  All he likes to do is talk about his drinking days at Tech and about how he is so rich. Sorry to all those who have to take him

akin's class was great! it was the one class i looked forward to going to. the final presentation was kind of intimidating but it turned out to be a good learning experience and he graded very fairly. would recommend to anyone who wants to learn and have a good laugh every class.

Class is fun, and crazy. He doesn't teach very much out of the book. Akin gets on tangets but there not boring. Quizzes and Tests are easy b/c you get a 5X7 Notecard and can write whatever you want on it. BUY THE STUDY GUIDE and BE READY FOR TESTS AND QUIZZES you'll make a descent grade.

Personifies the TCU personality: loves partying, socializing, and being buddies with the fraternity and sorority people more than he enjoys teaching class. Class is easy anyways, just take notes, study them and the book, and you should be fine.
No Comments

Akin makes you WANT to go to class. His real world example make it easy to learn, however the test can be slightly tricky, SO don't blow them off! The Project was  one of the best learning experiences! He is there for the students and always has a open door (literally)! Great Teacher and Friend!!

Akin is awesome! You learn so much in this class. Tricky test but the project is great. Very real life. He knows a lot about what he talks about and he is not just a professor, he is also a friend that you can talk to and ask advice to anytime.

I know the person who typed the 1-17-05 rating. They have no right to say those things. If they would have tried in the class instead of relying on their group to do ALL of the work they could have gotten the grade they hoped to get. You cannot cruise through this class. You will learn a ton in here
He is a great teacher. He is very helpful and his class is a lot of fun. His lectures apply to real life situations.

Terrible teacher. He tries to come across as a "humble" successful businessman but in all reality he is full of himself. Don't go to class because he only looks to see if the hot girls actually made it to his lame class. He tries to teach you but you will only learn that he sold a bug business

He is a great prof b/c he will meet with you anytime that works for you. Test questions come from the study guide and the quizes.  The project in this class takes alot of time so don't slack on it and ask him for help.

Lots of great marketing experience and information to add, but the class is disorganized. I have no idea how he determined grades. Easy B, hard to get an A. Great teacher and very nice and smart. Fun projects

If you are a sorority girl and miss class a lot, do not worry, you will still get an "A".  Seems as though class policy is not forced on the sorority girls.  Has a plethora of awesome marketing information.
Test questions are often unrelated to material covered in class.  He is a fun professor though and brings a lot of 'real world' experience to the classroom.
akin is very clear in class i understand at most pionts but get a bit cufused from time to time hes very clear and very cool
Akin is the essence of charisma. Quite theatrical, but relevant. He'd probably rather be outside golfing. Provides real-world expertise with poignant teaching style.
He's superficial and close-minded.

Wont learn anything in this class except campus gossip because he has no teaching qulaifications but if your looking for an easy B, this is your class. And unless you are blond/in a sorority/a beer drinker - you will be ignored!

Absolutely the best professor on TCU's campus. Up front with class at the start that he's not an academic weenie. Lectures are fun and entertaining. Brings in the best speakers i have ever had in college. Great class period. Sterling

The most entertaining and informational class I have taken in the Business school.  It Should be required for all students to take at TCU, you will learn alot about business if you listen to him speak, and the the guest speakers are amazing.

This professor is the most charismatic and energetic from TCU. Not only will be lecture on real life scenarios, but when it comes to question time he offers real world advice. And I have to disagree, not any monkey can get a B. Emu
Awesome teacher. Tells you how to do stuff in real life. Yes, it is easy to get a B in the class IF YOU WORK! Highly recommended. Get to know him because he's a good guy too.  -Junker
Great teacher who will incorporate the real world into his class through guests speakers, skits, etc..overall the best prof in the business school hands down!

Easy Class.  Selling and Sales management class consited of 1 group presentation (200pts), 6 two page papers worth (600points), 3 tests (300pts).  Lets you use a note card on each test.  A monkey could get a B in his class.

This is my second semester to have Bob.  He is great.  You will actually see him eating lunch with his students.  It is pretty hard to get an A, but a B is no problem.  Good if you want to LEARN about the business world - not just what the books tells you
He is a fun teacher, but he sure does a lot of name dropping. Needs to be a little more helpful in preparing for the first exam b/c of the poor averages of the exams. Overall, pretty good.

Very excited and informed about what he is teaching. Makes an active effort to get to know all his students, includes everyone in class discussion to get the entire room involved and listening. Funny guy that brings his humor into the learning experiance.
Akin really tries to get to know his students.  He never acts above his students.  His lectures are easy to sit through, he'll make you laugh at least 3 times a class!!
This guy is awesome, he is the coolest teacher I have ever had, also, the class seems easy but come test time, they can get pretty difficult.
Best professor in the business school.
No Comments
Made this class GREAT! Tries hard to help students in and out of class. Lectures from personal experience. Brings "real world" to the classroom. I wish he taught more classes I need.
Most fun professor I have had in college
Easy going and likes to have fun.  Very easy to talk to.

She is awesome. I really liked her and had a good relationship with her. She does care if you try. You do have to try to do your work. The only thing is her grading system is C meets expectations, B Exceeds, and Idek what an A is, so it is a little hard grading. I was very vocal in her class and and did well, but ended with a B+

She assigns way too much work.This one single Intro Lit class had more homework than rest of my classes combined and im a STEM major.Still ended up with a B,wanted to kms

Thinking about all time and effort I wasted still makes my blood boil 4 months later

Only take her if you are sure literature is your calling cause she is really passionate
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is super sweet and will help you with your essays. She is super funny and keeps the class engaged. She provides good feedback as well.

Expect A LOT of work. It was manageable, but there were two large essays, a very large project, and a reading report due pretty much every week in the class. It was a heavy workload, but if you understand the material, she's a pretty good grader and will give you the grade you deserve.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I really enyoed this class and Ms. Atkinson is great.

Professor Atkinson is one of the most caring teachers I have ever had. There is a lot of reading but if you don't have time to do it you can read detailed summaries and still do good. Paying attention in class is also important for the midterm and final. She is always willing to give an extension if needed and just cares about her students a lot.

Professor A is given the wrong reputation of being hard and blah blah blah. In reality she is the most caring teacher I have ever had that is willing to help you and break things down. The class can be tough if you don't do your part. Homework is very easy and you are given more then enough time to complete it.

She is super nice but her class is a lot of work for no reason. There are 3 papers and a massive final project about what you think constitutes good writing - the project is an essay, 3 reflections, and a presentation. Highly recommend meeting with her abt your papers. There are definitely easier teachers for intro comp
Troutman wants you to do well! Super accessible outside of class and will answer all your questions. Reading the textbook to study for exams helps so much. Take her!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is nice but she makes the test guides and reviews nothing like the test, which is misleading. Unless you are good at accounting and teaching it on your own, don't take this lady. She does not even give us clear like things to study, I felt so confused on what was going to be on the test. Would not recommend her at all, regret taking her.

nicest teacher ever. tries to keep it interesting but as an intro class every one is boring. easiest accounting teacher u can take. I got 100 on the first test but the second one was a lot hardened and required more studying. no extra credit and says attendance is mandatory but not sure if she actually takes roll. take her for fundamentals of acc
Amazing professor who cares for her students. She really wants you to learn and succeed in the class. Attendance is not mandatory but is beneficial to go.

Troutman is possibly the best professor I have ever had. Extremely caring for her students and wants you to succeed. Accounting is a hard class but she does everything she can to make sure you understand everything. I took accounting another semester and compared to that experience Troutmans lectures are a masterclass, great test reviews as well.

Troutman is one of the sweetest and best professors at TCU!!! Get her for accounting if you can!! She makes the material easy to understand and is so accessible after class...she gives out her personal phone number. The tests are hard, but the reviews she gives for them are very comprehensive and will help you a lot.

I took accounting twice so take it from me, Troutman Is the best professor. She is always available on the phone and on Zoom and she teaches in a way that is so easy to understand. Her lectures are enjoyable and I actually looked forward to going to class even though it is MWF. ITS WORHT IT SHE BRINGS DONUTS TOO
Troutman is legit the goat. She explains things so well and prepares you well for the exams.
tests are a lot harder than hw and review guides. like a lot harder.

Accounting is a tough subject, but Professor Troutman does an excellent job breaking down concepts and using examples. She's incredibly patient and will spend as much time as needed during office hours to ensure you understand the material. She genuinely cares about her students and wants to see them succeed.

Troutman is a great professor! This is a difficult class, but she tries to make it easier. There is about 3.5 hours of hw and reading every week, and to succeed in the class you really need to read each chapter before the week starts. Tests are difficult but not impossible and she curved on 3/4 of the tests.

Amy is a sweet lady and a great professor. If you do not care enough to read the book and learn the basic concepts, do not blame anyone but yourself. If you do make an effort to learn, her lectures are very helpful in filling the gaps in your knowledge. This is a straightforward class that you should invest heavily in before taking FR-I & FR-II!

She is good at teaching the material. Sometimes I'd have trouble understanding the textbook but she'd quickly make it make sense in class. Preps students for exams really well with lots of practice problems and study guides. She's also very nice and I like her sense of humor. Tests were curved to a class average of 82, so curves can be generous.

Definitely a hard class but Troutman makes every student feel very supported by proving a lot of outside resources and extra office hours before tests. Really nice lady and cares about her students and wants them to succeed. Makes the class very engaging by telling real life stories. I would def take her if you can, very worth it.

Accounting is hard regardless but prof Troutman is amazing! She makes herself so accessible if you need help. I've had trouble in the class but going to tutoring, office hours, and putting in the extra work has definitely helped. Smartbook and HW every week plus 3 exams and the final. One personal memo thats a nice grade bump. Take her if u can!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I LOVE this woman she is AWESOME. Accounting is hard regardless, but she is so nice and just wants you to do well. You have to put in a LOT of effort and do all the homework and go to her and the TA office hours, but if you put in the effort, it isn't so bad. She is by far the best option though.

Troutman is a great professor. Accounting is gonna be a hard class for certain people no matter who the professor is, but Troutman will probably make it the easiest for people who struggle with it. Very straightforward class. She's very nice and understanding and thoroughly explains all concepts. Take her!!!

Professor Troutman is amazing! If you have to take principles of accounting and you have a chance to get into her class, take her. She explains things very well and gives  helpful reviews for her exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Troutman was the best professor I've had at TCU yet. Lectures are very engaging and she get students involved and often out of their seats. Tests are pretty easy and curved to the moon. If you listen in class and actually do the homework yourself, you'll get an A. Only thing that sucks is tests are sometimes on Friday.

LOVED her. Accounting itself is just a hard class, especially because of how the department at TCU structures it, but she makes it a lot better. I was so scared going in, but she eased my nerves. She's super caring, always willing to meet with you, and is genuinely such a kind human. Of all the accounting profs, take her!!!
Yes, take her the best professor and teacher ever. She is so well loved by everyone in Neeley and by her students she also heads the PPA program so if you are planning acct major I recommend

PLEASE READ
A lot of people recommended this professor but I would not take her again. She is really nice but I feel like she makes the class harder than it should be. She uses certain problems in class which are similar from those in the homework but once you get to the quiz and the exam they are totally different. I have straigh A's and struggled

Accounting is difficult for any teacher, but Troutman is one of the best. She really cares about making sure everyone is prepared but practicing problems on your own is the best way to study for each unit along with doing the homework. She has lots of office hours and gives good feedback on tests and quizzes.

Absolutely loved Professor Troutman!! However, accounting is a very hard course and the exams are not easy. Professor Troutman is always there to help her students and understands how hard the course is. Loved her just a very hard course. Very helpful in office hours as well. I have heard Kelton grades easier, but not sure what's true.

By far the best professor you can take for Fundamentals of Accounting. There are 3 quizzes, 2 exams, homework and smartbooks that aren't bad, a super easy professional interview, and a cumulative final. You have to put in the work to get an A.

She cares for her students & their grade, is accessible outside of class, has more tutoring hours during the second half of the semester, & if the class average isn't high for any quiz/exam, she automatically curves it. Accounting isn't an easy class for most people, she acknowledges that, & tries to make the class as fun and laid back as possible
Professor Troutman truly cares about her students, and although this is a very difficult course she will do her best to make sure you pass and do as well as you can.

Professor Troutman is an amazing professor. She takes her job seriously and cares that her students learn the material. There is a good amount of homework but isn't too terrible if you sit down and actually try to complete it. Last thing I will say is that there has never been a class of hers that I dreaded going to. Take her, you won't regret it.

Amy is the best choice for intro to accounting. I would highly recommend taking the time to study chapters 1-4 in depth. By that I mean revisit those chapters throughout the year, even on breaks. Those are the building blocks for everything else. Don't stress though. She prepares you really well for the final.

When I first walked into Accounting in August, I was terrified, as I heard Accounting was a brutally difficult class. However after meeting Troutman, my fears were quelled immediately. She explained things clearly and I always knew exactly what I needed to get done for class each day. She also really cares about her students success. Take her!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Accounting is an extremely challenging class, but Troutman makes it understandable and manageable. She cares a lot about her students and goes above and beyond to make sure you are understanding the material. Take her, put in the work,and let her help you when you need it and youll do fine. Would definitely recommend for all Sophomores.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Highly recommend Troutman. Genuinely cares about her students and sets them up for success. Makes lectures as engaging as possible considering its accounting. Provides a lot of test practice material and prepares students well. Wants to develop relationships with her students and is available for help and questions. Great professor, great woman.

Best professor at TCU. Really cares about each student and always wants to help! You do have to put in effort, but she will reward you for hard work. She's really available outside of class too. If you want an A/A-, it's definitely do-able, just takes a lot of studying and time - let her help you!!

One of the best and most caring professors I have ever had. Accounting is a sucky class but Troutman makes it a lot more enjoyable and easier. Her lectures are great and explains things well. She is generous with partial credit on tests and quizzes. She really cares about her students and makes class fun. Highly recommend!

ACCT is already a very hard class, but she is dedicated to seeing her students succeed. Would go out of her way to help you understand a topic. Study for the quizzes the same you would for a test (same level of difficulty, just over less material). Also, go to class! She explains everything in detail and the in-class problems helped me a ton!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Troutman is new to TCU, and she is an amazing accounting professor. A really tough intro class, but Troutman makes sure you learn it. She is very clear when explaining tough concepts and is highly accessible outside of class. Also, she really wants to get to know each student, TCU is lucky to have her!!

Dr. Esping is awesome! She gives very interesting lectures and keeps everyone engaged constantly! She's very friendly and open outside of class for extra help. There were about 5 assignments the entire year, so make sure to study ahead of time/write early. I would 100% recommend taking this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: take this class!
Amazing classes. she is a wonderful teacher and just overall a wonderful person. I reccomend all of her classes. You will leave knowing and truly understanding the material.

Dr. Esping is wonderful. You can see that she truly cares about her students and is excited for them to learn. She is always smiling and happy to be there. Her class structure is awesome in my opinion, the grades are roleplays, which actually make you learn the material not just memorize it. Very enlightening class.

I LOVED THIS PROFESSOR! I took her class twice because I love her so much. She grades based on four role plays and two essays(no min word count or pages) the class is lecture and discussion based. It wasn't hard and didn't require too much time out of class. You can't use technology but its not bad because the class is interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a great professor and I would take her again, the role plays are intimidating at first, but once you read and practice, they are easy!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is absolutely fabulous and is a wonderful teacher. I highly recommend her for both Ed Psych & Child and Adolescent Development!!!

An amazing professor and great at encouraging classroom engagement. She is very caring about her students and amazing at giving lectures. The content covered is very interesting, so the class is really engaging. Not many assignments and there are no traditional quizzes / exams, she grades based off of attendance and participation.

You will only have a few graded assignments and she gives detailed instructions to pass. There is no textbook, but she does give out readings you need to do to get an A. She makes class as easy as possible with her lectures. You can miss two to three classes before it affects your grade as well. Dr Esping is the best! Definitely take her class!!

I love Amber, and it is so easy to pass her class! She lays out exactly what needs to be done to get an A, and if you pay attention in lectures, you will be fine. Also, super easy to meet with outside of class and is great to talk to! This class is also just really interesting, so I would recommend taking her even if you aren't an education major!
She is am AMAZING professor! She really makes sure you understand the material and will work with you if needed. She's so sweet and is a great teacher!

SHE IS THE BEST AND SO INSPIRATIONAL. you learn SO much that the exams come easy. 3 exams that are oral, online, and group projects. always get 100. one final paper. Ive had her twice and Im so sad I wont be able to have her again. take her if you can!

The Professor is incredible. She wants her students to become great educators. Read the assigned textbook chapters and have a group prepared for exams. Study for the oral exams and pay attention in class; you will do well. She is such a provocation and inspiration to her scholars.

Dr. Esping is the most kind-hearted, compassionate, and understanding professor. She wants all of her students to succeed. As long as you study for the oral exams and pay attention in class, you will do well. She is such a motivation and inspiration to her students. She cares so deeply for all her students. She is the BEST!

Dr. Esping is an incredible professor! I had Educational Psychology with her and really enjoyed the class! She's very approachable and understanding. Her lectures incorporate a variety of activities, like videos and games, that make the lessons engaging and fun. Exams are oral and done with partners. They're not bad as long as you study!

Dr. Esping is incredibly kind and makes her Resilience class engaging and meaningful. Some of the discussion topics will apply to different students more than others, but I would recommend her and the course.
Esping is so much fun. You learn a lot in her class and it's pretty easy as long as you do the work (which isn't much). You'll love this class!

Dr. Esping is super funny and really wants to have a relationship with her students. She is more than willing to help her students outside of class. Beware of her midterm, it could be kind of tough if you don't study enough!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Esping is the perfect teacher. She engages her students and makes it fun to learn. You are actively involved every week in class with either a new activity or assignment. They are fun! You have one written tests, some papers, and a project, but the class load is not very heavy. Read. Study hard for the test. Don't just memorize. Know!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This was my first honors colloquia at TCU and I have to say I absolutely loved it with Dr. Esping. She is one of the nicest professors I have ever had and class discussions were easy and interesting. There were a lot of weekly readings, but only a few short assignments, a big group project and an essay at the end. Definitely take Dr. Esping!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Esping is wonderful!! By far one of my favorite profs!! Class is great and material is useful. Esping is always willing to help when it is needed and is there if you just need to talk.
Favorite professor at TCU! I'm going to be a Senior next year and I absolutely loved this class. She is amazing, she's passionate about what she teaches, and it's so interesting! LOVELOVELOVED IT!
FAVORITE PROFESSOR AT TCU. You must take Dr. Esping's class- any class she offers.
TAKE ESPING FOR ANY ED CLASS YOU NEED! BEST PROF AT TCU

Dr. Esping: always prepared for each and every class. Amazing powerpoints that are available to you. Utilizes ecollege to the fullest. She really knows what she is talking about and is not pretentious. She continues her studies and is always learning. The best thing about her is that she listens to what her students need from her and she adapts.

I LOVE Esping! She is so sweet! Two tests- essay style, and two papers. She always gave my class 3 essay topics the week before then chose 2 for the actual test but she tells you where you can find your answers and you don't need to worry about making your papers really long, just answer the question. Easy A if you just read the instructions - I go

I love Dr. Esping! She is so sweet and funny. Her classes go by really fast even though they're a night class and she's really understanding if you have to miss a class. Two tests are both essay style but she gives you the questions a week before and tells you where you can find the info. Other two papers aren't bad either. TAKE HER!
Only class I learned and remembered anything from this semester. Actually, so interesting that heavy studying not required. I just remember everything she says with no notes!
Wonderful teacher! By far, one of my favorite classes I have taken at TCU. I loved the class material and would recommend this class to anyone interested in child development.

Dr. Esping was without question the best education professor I had at TCU. She knows her stuff really well. She really helps you create your own person teaching philosophy by providing you with all of the theories and beliefs that others have had and there usefulness. She is awesome. One test, a few papers, and a couple of creative type projects.

Dr. Esping is a really nice person, but an extremely vague professor. She does not always specify what she is looking for in an assignment, which can be problematic. She tells you to trust her with grading but what student trusts their teacher to give them a good grade? Overall, she is really nice but her class is difficult.

She is a phenomenal professor to learn teaching from.  Her strategies aren't the normal lecture style, so if that's your learning type, don't take this class.  If you like a more hands-on approach with an insightful teacher and example, she's perfect. :)
Just bad. Big no.

I've never had a professor as oblivious and stubborn as this one. I thought I had bad time management skills until I had this woman. Her deadlines for assignments were different from other professors who taught the same class, which made it unfair for my class specifically and she was not open to changing it. This 350-character limit is saving her.

I had her for Color and Light Theory as well as Intro to Creative Practices actually. She was amazing. Had one quiz and the final for color/light, which was so easy. None for Creative Practice. She is such an understanding professor and really tries to help you. Couldn't recommend her enough. She's very much a school mom type of teacher!

Really easy class all points come from small homework assignments that you get 100% on if you do them. Many easy quizzes. Class is pretty boring but she's so nice and the class is an easy A. Outside of class events are required along with field trips. Cumulative final at the end is the only test.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: She is very passionate about her job. Lots of home work, quizzes, only 2 tests at the end which is the final. Fairly easy, you have to show up to class if you miss more than 3 days she takes 5% off your overall grade for each day your absent or 10 mins late. LOTS of out of class field trips, which makes it hard to get to your next class after.

She is AMAZING. She cares about her students and genuinely wants everyone to succeed. She's honest, real and compassionate. I've never had a professor that was more understanding. She's easy to reach by email and there's SO much extra credit (attending a sports game for example). The tests are straight from the slides and in class activities.
Super chill class, one of the easiest As I've had at TCU. Exams are light, speeches are light, only downside is final was lockdown browser with webcam which is pretty lame.

Definitely an easy class if you really try but 3-4 exams either in person or lockdown with camera and no notes. Tests have reviews that do not match the questions on exams. Hard to reach outside of class and started to be more detailed with deductions on speeches. She seems like a very nice person just know it is not a blow off class.

Take communicating effectively with her! She makes the rubric for speeches crystal clear and grades nicely. She doesn't make you buy the textbook and there are a million extra credit opportunities. We were never in class for the full amount of time. I'd highly reccomend!

easiest professor I have taken at TCU so far. She is caring and funny and makes her class really fun. -1 point everytime you say um on a speech but she isnt super strict about that. I had to drop my communicating effectively class last semester becuase of the professors grading, but will finish with an A+ with arrambide.

Best OCO professor. Easiest A of my life. 3 presentations where she is a super easy grader. She wants you to succeed. She does take off 1 point whenever you say "Um" doing a presentation. The tests are online and straight from the textbook. Take her.
Easiest A ever. It was a 3 hour class and it never went past 45 minutes. Absolute lock of an A. Nuff said.

Very easy speech grader, just don't say "um" or you'll get docked 1 point for each time you say it. Does take attendance, but class never goes for the full time. Was able to do tests online and use notes. She's super understanding as well. Highly recommend if you're looking for an easy speech class.

She keeps the lectures short and provides you with all of the information you need for tests. She grades pretty easily on presentations, but you will get docked 1 point every time you say um in your speech. She takes attendance every day, but the class goes by quick and you learn everything that will be on tests and information for presentations.

This class was awesome. As long as you don't say "um" in your speech there's a good chance you get a 100, she provides clear reviews for every exam, and there hasn't been a single time this year where the class lasted the entire 1hr 20mins. Definitely recommend.

She's really fun and nice! Great class, and it's very therapeutic! The one thing I didn't like was her grading style, for example the highest you can get is a 10, and she will give a 9.9. So her grading is confusing, but other than that she's really good, work is easy, and no exams!

Dr. Allison is absolutely incredible. Her class is very easy going, well paced, and she genuinely cares about her students success. If you are an art education major, you will have to take her class. But even if you are just looking for a credit, it's an easy class with a really wonderful professor.
Professor Allison is very nice and helpful. You do not have to be experienced in the art to take her therapeutic arts class. I learned a lot from this class and enjoyed the experiences we had.
Dr. Allison is by far the most amazing professor at TCU. She gets her students in a way no other professor does and the projects are so much fun. You spend a lot of time exploring yourself.

Amanda is a great person and seems to care very much about her students. I've been very successful in this class and it will be a GPA boost. However, the content kinda sucks. May just be because it was online, but doesn't do the greatest job of actually teaching how to do the art projects that she assigns. You won't learn much but you'll pass, easy
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Allison is an absolute gem. She is funny, caring, talented, and inspirational. Her classes were honestly the highlight of my week. I looked forward to every single class. She was born to teach and truly made a difference in my life! I will never forget her.
She's amazing, passionate, influential and willing to understand you as a person. I've never been more inspired of fond of a teacher in my life.

By far the easiest class and most relaxing to be in as well. On days when there's not much work she lets you out way early! I learned to appreciate more things around me from this class and she helps you find it further develop your identity! Highly recommend even if you aren't into arts and crafts. And you don't even have to buy a textbook!

Dr. Allison is amazing; she is by far one of my favorite professors at TCU. Everything in her class is done for a reason and I have learned valuable information that will help further my career from her classes. She creates a community in each of her classrooms and by the end of her class you will feel like a little family. Take her class!!!

This is the best teacher i had in college. She is so passionate and knowledgeable and will help you with anything including finding you a job! You have to attend class but you wont want to miss a thing. I took 4 classes with her and I wish i could have taken more!

she is a really nice professor, she makes sure you understand the assignment and is more that welcome to help you in any way. the art projects are really fun and she grades really fairly. you will never be bored in that class
No Comments

Great professor! I see a lot of old reviews on here from 2022 that are dragging down her score, but I genuinely loved Dr. Stewart a lot. She's very kind, and I have her for both Ear Training and Music Theory. There is a lot of homework for her music theory class, but they're truly meant to help you, and not just busywork.
Attendance is mostly mandatory, but the lectures are available online later. A large chunk of your grade is based on a group project, but it was not graded harshly.

This class is so easy. Attendance is a big deal, but paying attention is not. Assigned group at beginning of the semester and you can help each other out on everything. EVERY answer for the 3.33% exams are online. Like 6 extra credit opportunities. I did not even need to attend the final because it is 3.33% of your final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Class was super easy. Definitely take it if you need a fine arts credit. iClicker questions almost every class along with group work, but you get five free absences so it isn't bad. Easiest class I've taken, almost no work. Tests are online and open book, not stressful at all. Pretty boring class tho

This class is fairly easy. There was a lot of required reading and a fair amount of projects, tests, and homework. The tests are online and open book but are hard if you don't pay attention in class. Overall this wasn't my favorite class but is good if you're looking for elective credit.

Theres a lot of group work which can be fine or sucky depending on your group. Each exam is only worth 3.33% of your grade so they really arent too stressful. You have to go to class to do clicker questions for participation points, but you get 5 freebie days to miss. Overall I got an A but didnt really enjoy it too much

TAKE ROCK2BACH! Best fine arts credit out there. Exams are take home & super easy. Listening exams (midterm & final) are hard asf though and no one gets over 75s typically. However I still have a 96 due to them only being 3% of your grade. TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOU CAN
Highly recommend! all exams online except midterm and final which are pretty hard. participation grades so GO TO CLASS!

Dr. Stewart is passionate about what she teaches. You get up to four missed classes without penalty but if you miss more than that you will not do well in the class. The tests are online and she does not make them hard. There are two listening tests but that is the hardest part of the class.

Extremely frustrated with this class and professor. Assigns a group that you have to do a project with that's worth 40% of grade and most of the time since this class used to be labeled "easy" you'll get stuck with people who don't care. Studied extremely hard for listening exam and failed, and she puts songs on there she says she wont. Hypocrite.

Youre assigned to a group that you do a class assignment with every week. As long as you pay attention and complete assignments, you will do fine. Dr. Stewart is incredible and passionate about what she teaches!!!

Professor Stewart is very caring and always glad to help a student. She is very passionate about what she teaches and wishes her students to collaborate and succeed. There are extra credit opportunities and LOTS of group work but in total only two group projects. There are also four song reflections you have to read and daily clicker quizzes.

Dr. Stewart is really passionate about the subject. However, you get put in groups & have to stay w/ them for the entire semester. Group projects can be a nightmare- especially if you get stuck with people who don't care or know much about music. Make playlists for listening exams & you'll be fine. My music taste ended up expanding bc of this class

Dr. Stewart is one of the coolest and most competent professors I've had to date. Her lectures are fun and also informative... The midterm and final requires preparation if you don't have a singing background, but she grades pretty forgivingly, so even if you make mistakes you should get a decent grade if you practiced the material.

I took this class and expected to get an A all year. But, you are graded as a group the entire year so if your group doesn't put in the work, you won't get an A. Listening. exams are hard if you don't have a background in music. You have no idea what song she will play and you are expected to know exact details. Nice person, but i didn't like her.

Rock to Bach is not a hard class. However, the group projects are annoying, as kids really dont care so it falls on one person to pick up the slack. Also, everyone makes the same grade which is stupid. Really interesting class if you are into music (particularly classic rock), but they get long and boring fast. Test are take home, and overall easy

Very easy A for a fine arts credit if you can drag yourself to class. The group projects aren't hard, but they are annoying because even if one person does all the work the group gets the same grade. You are also with that group for the whole semester. Overall, none of the assignments are hard, but she is a tad annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Super easy class. Lots of graded activities so if you forget something you have room to make up for it

This class is super easy and doesnt require you to may too much attention. There are pop quizzes every so often on iClickers and a few group projects that are not hard. Tests and listening exams are extremely easy as well.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class is very easy if you put effort into assignments and show up for class. Attendance is taken everyday through the iClicker and she randomly does activities for participation grades. All the unit exams are online and there are two in class listening exams for the whole semester. Very easy class that I would recommend for a fine arts credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Stewart is SO nice! This class is pretty easy, and your grade mostly depends on your group projects. They aren't hard as long as everyone does their part. Take advantage of extra credit opportunities. You can get up to 5% of extra credit just by going to a concert and writing a short report. Would definitely recommend taking this class!

Very Easy A if you show up to class and take the assignments seriously. She is very passionate about the subject and the course is interesting. The exams are not hard and the unit quizzes are online. Recommend for a fine art credit
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Really easy class! If you need an A to boost your grade this is the class you should take! Two exams, two group projects, song reflections, and participation iclicker points make up your grade in the class, all of which are super easy.

Dr. Stewart is extremely caring- easily one of my favorite professors I've had. However, her class is very difficult if you have no background in choir. It's hard to keep up if you're in a class with people who have had years experience in sight singing, etc. in choir. However, Dr. Stewart provides a lot of extra credit opportunities.

Amy is great but the class isn't structured well. It's an easy A because so many people don't show up. That being said, her lectures are interesting. The group projects are awful though, like one person does all the work and everyone gets the same grade. Her tests are pretty easy, study your notes and listen to the songs. Go to class and do EC!
If you do all the assignments, show up to class, and review the material you shouldn't have a problem passing. But if you don't like working in groups, I don't recommend taking her.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Working with a group kind of sucks but this class is so easy. iClicker questions and song reflections boost your grade and there are tons of opportunities for extra credit. I never studied for tests and always made high B's or low A's. This class is super interesting and Dr. Stewart wants you to do well. Take this class.

Rock to Bach was one of my favorite core classes based on subject matter. You do have to go to class to get participation credit every day. She gives you a study guide with names/topics on the exams, so if you read the chapter you should be prepared for the tests. Song reflections and group projects easily raise your grade. I ended with a high A.

This class isn't a blow off like some people say it is. You have to put in some work to get an A. The tests aren't too difficult, but you have to read cause not all of the test information is covered in class. The extra credit was really easy and brought up my grade 4 points. The final is also not accumulative which is a plus

Amy Stewart is so sweet and willing to lend a helping hand to those who need it. Heed my warning, this class is not a blow off. Mixtape projects tend to be tedious because of how much work it is, but as long as you stay on top of your work you should be good. Amy Stewart gets an A+ from me!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I don't understand why reviews are so bad, I enjoyed rock to bach and thought it was an easy A! Group project "mix tapes" and song reflections raise your grade. Lectures can sometimes be dull, but the hardest thing is the TESTS! Never been able to make an A. They are tricky! However, she offers extra credit and I have a HIGH A in the class!

She said the course was redesigned for this sem. and you could tell. She lectures but half of the test questions are stuff we never covered in class. Don't take this class if you're a visual person. She puts you in a set group and you have to do projects and sit with them the whole year. I would not take this class again.
class is ok but the projects lower your grade. many people in my group did pass/no credit and stopped showing up to class
dont take if u dont like group projects or meeting with ur group outside of class

most of your grade is based on group projects. you have the same group all semester and you don't get to choose your group members. you also have to meet with your group outside of class which is difficult since it is a large group
Way too much group work. Lecture is boring even if you like music. Lots of students so she grades you based on your group. Its hard to make an A in this class even if  you study.

Definitely love the material taught, but I hate the set up of the class. All seamster you are stuck in these awful groups where most of them people in the class are pass/failing so they never show up.

I love Rock to Bach, it is one of the most interesting classes Ive taken. Stewart is really into it and you can tell she loves what she's teaching. There are group projects but they aren't bed and tests are not that bad, I got Bs and a couple A- on them. Take this class for your art credit, I don't know why other reviews are so low.
requires participation in class and tons of group work. dont recommend
She redesigned the course and now it is hard. I felt like I had no control over my grade because she takes points off your grade if other group members do not rate you good.
This class is not what I expected. She assigns way to much work for fine arts credit. You have to meet outside of class for group projects and she is strict with grading them.

There are 4 group projects worth most of your grade in the class. She stresses the importance of "working in a group" but you don't learn anything about the class in the group projects and they bring your grade down. The good ratings for her are from before she changed the course content. This class is hard.

Group projects all semester long!!!!!! Your grade is determined based on how other group members grade you. If they don't like you, you lose a whole letter grade!!! This class is a communication course in disguise. Its not at all about music. Very difficult to make an A.

This class is easy if you show up to class because there are things you can't learn through the book and power points if you miss.  You also have iClicker questions every class which are a grade almost like participation.  She  is a great teacher and keeps lectures interesting.  I would recommend if you need a fine arts credit.

Best fine arts credit at TCU. Tests are based on PPTs, attendance is necessary due to the iClicker questions, and study guides are posted online. Overall she is really helpful and it's a fun, easy class!

Dr. Stewart is a great professor and makes the class enjoyable. She'll play lots of music during the class, so it's really laid back. The material on the tests are straight from the study guides and powerpoints she goes over in class. Dr. Stewart is really helpful and offers extra credit. You can tell she truly enjoys teaching about music.
Best fine art credit at TCU! Professor Stewart is excited about class and makes it fun. Book is mandatory, but definitely helpful! Tests are based from powerpoints!

Attendance isn't mandatory but there are iClicker questions every day worth about a percentage point of your grade.  She makes this class really fun and obviously has a passion for music which makes her an amazing teacher. Take this class and take this class with professor Stewart, you won't regret it.
Coming to class is part of the grade. Tests are the exact same as the study guide. Can have computers in class. Easiest class ever. So much fun. She's a great teacher and she makes it fun.

such a boring class, in a huge lecture hall.  130 kids in there, and its just so boring.  You can't skip because she does daily iclicker questions which she also counts for attendance.  2 words: boring and annoying. tests aren't that hard though, she gives a study guide.  I've heard this is the easiest fine art class.

Stewart is an overall great teacher. Attendance is mandatory, and there's daily iClicker questions. The material is simple enough, and you often get to listen to music. You can tell that she's passionate about music, but doesn't always seem to understand that her students don't feel the same way. Overall, this class is an easy A.

Introduction to University Life is made to be an easy and relaxing class and Ms. Apperson did a good job teaching it. She helped me with my resume during office hours which I am extremely grateful for. She gives good advice and is open to helping her students.

Elisabeth taught my UNLF class and was a great, understanding instructor who connected the class well. She tailored the course to support our development throughout the first semester. I'd definitely recommend this class because you learn about many campus resources you might otherwise miss.

Had a 99 in the class until she told me she would only give me a C at the end of the semester bc I had been absent so many times.I asked her if she would work w/me on it and maybe I could do some extra work and she said no.The reason I was absent so many times was that I was working to be able to have money to pay for school & money to live off of
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Apperson was one of the best professors I have taken. I highly recommend taking her. There was only like 5 assignments total in her class.  She gives great feedback and helps you with any questions you have. She is very caring and respects her students. She loves participation and engagement.

I loved her class! Even as a non-business major now, I really feel like l learned a lot about building a professional brand during this class. She was super chill and really encouraged everyone to follow their desired career path. She had a TA who was super sweet too!

I took Apperson Fall 2021 and she was a great professor. She makes the class easy and understandable, while making it fun and guiding you into the Neeley opportunities. She is also a part of the PDC so a great person to know after the class as well. Make sure you show up and do the few assignments and you will do well.

She is a very easy and engaging professor who provides good feedback to her students. She wants everyone to succeed in the business world and I believe she sets all of her students up perfectly by allowing us to do personal pitches, mock interviews, career tests, etc. I would definitely recommend taking her class!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Elisabeth has been a fantastic business professor! You learn a lot about the business world and practical application. For example, you create a LinkedIn, practice virtual interviews, make a personal pitch, and help with networking. She is so helpful and will answer any of your questions. She spent an hour helping me form my resume outside class.

Very chill! Lectures are basically just workdays. Lots of guest speakers. Cancels class often and is very easy to get along with. Exit tickets for attendance but they dont happen every class and she doesnt take attendance. Same assignments ever week so you know what to expect. Super easy work you just have to try a little bit.
The class is interesting and you'll learn a lot. A little unorganized but you will come out with an A.
I enjoyed this class. I found her lectures to be interesting and I didn't think anything was too difficult. I would definitely take her again.

I took Dr. George's diversity course, and she is definitely a respected and knowledgeable professor. She applies a lot of what she has learned in the real world to class. Only drawback is her instructions can be very confusing on assignments and can cause you to miss points. Otherwise a very sweet and smart woman.

The class itself is easy, but the assignments are so random and unnecessary. She randomly comes up with assignments to do and says "you know the drill" when we have never done it before. We had to read a book and did nothing with it at all. I have done so many assignments and there are no grades for them. A waste of my time and very confusing.

Dr. George is truly a very nice woman, but she is not a good professor... The lectures have nothing to do with the assignments given and she frequently does not follow the syllabus leaving students confused and scrambling to turn assignments in. There is only two sections of diversity this year and neither class has a clue what's going on.

She is a very sweet woman she just is a bad professor. Doesn't know when due dates are, unclear about what she wants in assignments, and doesn't give feedback on grades. Very bad at responding to emails. Doesn't answer questions directly just talks, and doesn't really teach. I feel bad writing this because she's so nice, but don't take her class.

She is very nice she is just not a good professor. Very unclear about deadlines and projects, and talks in circles. Very confusing about what exactly she wants from us and she repeats the same things in different ways. You will not be reminded about due dates, and she grades really hard for what she's asking for. Very sweet woman though!
I reallllllly dont undeestand why her rating is bad. I loved this class and it was easy easy easy. Take her!
THE LITERAL WORST. RUN AWAY -- DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. run far far away

Dr. George is an awesome professor. She is so nice to respect all students from different cultural background. She would like to hear and accept different ideas and  comments from students. She is proficient in the academic fields of crisis management and global communication campaigns. I learned the knowledge of creating crisis communication plan.
Good feedback! Team Work!

In this class, I learned much knowledge  in terms of  crisis  management. Many assignments are useful in the real word. She is soooo niceeee and patient!The textbook written by her includes many international cases study. She knows more many details on the book than others cuz she is author! MoreTakeToher GetBetterGrade!

she's impossible to avoid for JOUR/COMM majors, so the best you can do is get a really good group for projects. completely helpless when you ask for help, rude and off-putting. she lost my test and accused me of lying about it. watch out for test material she never addressed in class

This class was a waste of time. Unfortunately, it is required and Amiso is the only one who teaches it. She does in class assignments occasionally, tests are an EXACT copy of the study guide. I did not learn one thing from lecture. Test material is strictly from the book.

Not as bad as I thought. From the comments, I was scared I would fail but without too much effort I pulled off a B. Do study guide and make it into flashcards. Put effort into group project and start early!
Very unclear on expectations for tests. Lectures are common sense - you'll feel like you didn't learn anything by the end of the semester. Get a good group because your grade depends on it!

Just don't. I mean you have to, but don't. Worst class I've ever taken. I can't say anything good about this class. Good thing it's only worth 1 credit hour. If you don't come to class and just do the mandatory crap required, you'll get a C and deal with it.

This class is a joke. All of the material on the tests comes from the book, which she doesn't teach in class. Very unhelpful, incomprehensible instruction, and lots of group projects that never get graded. You will teach yourself, and all her tests are fill in the blank short answers.  Sadly, it is a required class for journalism majors. Terrible.
Most worthless class ever! Her tests are fill in the blank from random sentences in the book. Like we have time to memorize the book word for word. I didnt learn anything in this class. Sucks.

It's hard to rate a professor that doesn't teach! All you do is group projects/presentations the whole semester while she sits and watches. Tests aren't hard but she is completely unhelpful and can't keep track of tests and projects. The class is structured horribly but everyone has to take it. Idk why she hasn't been fired yet.

I HONESTLY DO NOT KNOW WHY SHE HASN'T BEEN FIRED. TERRIBLE teacher. I had her for PR principles and HATED IT. Now I HAVE to take her again because I have a mandatory class and she's the only one who teaches it. Avoid her if you can. Trust me. Let's all unite and complain, all these negative reviews can't be coincidental.
you will teach yourself. you will not learn a thing. you will not know what your grades are. she looses everything. good luck.

You'll never understand her directions with assignments or projects. She is not at all helpful. Her classes are boring. She has terrible teaching methods. I don't even understand how she is still a professor. I hated her class.

WORST WORST! She is a terrible teacher. However, you HAVE to take her because she "teaches" mandatory classes. She has hard tests, goes all over the place, the class is not organized. You never know what's gonna happen.. she's a MESS... AVOID

Required for all comm and jour majors and she's the only one who teaches it, it's is just plain unfortunate. Tests are straight off the review, but the psycho ta grades them and no matter how hard you study you will likely fail them all. Take every test in to get points back, it's the only way to an A. Prepare for hellish group projects.
Worthless class, students give presentations every class period which you don't need to listen to because they are not on the test--I was interested in race, gender relations but HATE this class.

HORRIBLE CLASS! It is completely unorganized and the teacher has no idea what she is doing. Her tests are ridiculously hard and the class is a joke. If you don't have to take this class then STAY AWAY! I have all A's in my other classes and right now I have a D in this class

Worst teacher I've ever come across. Completely unorganized, not helpful and the class itself was a joke. Her tests are ridiculous, she claims there not memorization, but half of it is. Grading is horrible, I had a question about my grade and emailed her after the class ended and had to track her down. If you don't have to take this class DONT!

I absolutely ABHOR this class. Her accent makes everything she says incomprehensible, and the group project is a joke at best. Also, I don't understand why she chose Lion King to exemplify stereotypes..all the ones that come to mind can be attributed to the fact that the movie takes place in AFRICA, so duh. It's ridiculous this class is required.

Anybody who has lived a charmed and happy life and is maybe feeling guilty about it, take Dr. George. Also, anybody who is self-loathing or into masochism, should also take her. For everybody else, DON'T!

i would never again take this woman. i dont doubt that out in the PR world she was very good at what she did... the problem is that not EVERYBODY should be a teacher. This class was an absolute mess and I left learning nothing and feeling very dissatisfied
Worst I've ever had. Will NEVER take another class with this women. What I received from her was simply the feeling that I had wasted my time and my money. awful.
I would NEVER take her again if my life depended on it... I would literally drop out of college. I feel like I wasted about 10 grand last semester on her classes.

knows her stuff, but is completely unorganized. Looses grades, isn't consistent with e-college, and is unclear with assignments. I think Dr. George could do much better with her teaching style and how she communicates with her students. Overall, i would never recommend this professor to a friend.

She is very unclear and disorganized.  She spent at least 20 mins every class trying to get it together. Material not difficult, just PC and stupid. Tests come straight from the textbook, which by the way is a joke. I guess she's nice, but doesn't run a class very efficiently, especially one with 120 students. Most annoying class I've ever taken.

Media I is easy with her and she has alot of useful info for you.Intercultural and Internat'l Comm.is worth taking because it was interesting to hear her point of view and was an easy A.  Overall, if you talk to her when you are having problems she will help you and do the little assignments as they are fluffer grades and great grade savers!
No Comments

Very experienced, knowledgable prof, but terrible at getting her points across. Grades, objectives, everything is very unclear on all assignments. Tests are extremely tricky, and be prepared for a very detailed, important group project worth a HUGE portion of your grade. A's are probably not possible in this class...

She was completely unclear in what she expected and how she graded... it's hard for her to understand and be understood... she was absolutely impossible to get in touch with and not at all accessible outside of class... rarely accessible IN class... I thought I had an A in the class but when grades came out, I had made a C...
The tests kind of sucked but its easy to get a B if you do well on the project. Make sure you visit her office hours and suck up to her so she remembers your name.

Sometimes we would just sit in class and do nothing, the lecture is pointless as long as you download the powerpoints then there's really no reason to go to class. She's very unclear about everything..but as long as you do well on the project it's an easy B.

this class was pretty weird- boring and i always felt lost. luckily pr isnt rocket science so u cant complain too much. unless it is rocket science for u! study for the tests, work hard on your project. there is no final. act like you care and u will be fine. bring a crossword though cause lecture is really boring. nice lady though, she does try.

Dr. George is one of the worst AD/PR teachers at TCU.  Her classes are boring and she is very unclear in her teaching style.  I left classes thinking I had just wasted an hour and a half of my day.  She is not consistent in her grading and she is unhelpful outside of class.  She is extremely intelligent, but doesn't communicate well with students.
She is horrible!  She is so boring and confusing- partly because she doesn't speak English very well.  Don't take her, but if you have to just don't go to class- it makes no difference!
Very confusing and unclear.
Loved her! She was so fun and easygoing. Discussion board and online test every couple of weeks but really easy.

Professor Applewhite is very straightforward about her expectations! She always had hilarious commentary to add and informative lectures. Graded by discussion posts, a few online exams, and a group project. She also gave super easy weekly extra credit assignments. Take her!

TAKE HER!!! This class is so easy. There is no final, tests are all online and open note. There are also weekly discussion posts, but they are not bad. Dr. Applewhite is so caring and understanding. Do yourself a favor and take this class for an easy A.
chill teacher

This was one of the easiest classes I've taken at TCU so far. The homework is so easy and basically the same every time. There are discussion boards to post but they are quick and easy to complete. The group project at the end of the semester was SO easy, tests can be a bit harder, you just need to know what you're doing.

Take her for Criminal Justice! I enjoyed this class because she made our lectures so interesting by using real world examples.Only 1 discussion board a week(easy as long as you read some of the chapter),1 weekly at home quiz(all answers in the textbook),and 4 at home tests(answers can be found in the textbook). The final is a group presentation!

dr. applewhite is extremely sweet and caring. she has weekly discussion boards based on the textbook, but they're easy to write even if you don't read them. all her tests are online and take home but have extremely specific questions from the textbook making it hard to get an A on them. overall the class is extremely manageable.

Dr. Applewhite is really passionate about criminal justice. She assigns a short/easy take at home quiz at the start of the week, a discussion post at the end of the week, and 4 tests taken at home throughout the semester. Attendance isn't mandatory which is nice because the lecture's aren't necessary to do the assignments.

Dr. Applewhite is extremely opinionated and sometimes it interferes with the subject she is teaching. All assignments are easy and little to no studying is required to pass the class and as long as you listen in class you will do well. Most of her quizzes are straight from the book or are online.

There are mini quizzes before class (for credit but multiple tries), discussion boards at the end of the week, and then take home exams. She is very understanding and if you care you will do well. There is a group project at the end of the semester, but it is fairly easy.  There are normally bonus opportunities. Take her!

Dr. Applewhite was an amazing teacher. She was funny, captivating, and intelligent. If you are taking her for a core credit, I suggest you do so. Her class is manageable and not hard. Exams are all online and only thing you really have to do for homework is a weekly discussion board. Take her!

Weekly discussion board, but takes less than 30 minutes to complete; 4 exams; very charismatic; attendance is not mandatory; final group presentation; the only thing I didn't love was that she uses her personal opinion a lot but other than that class is very easy

Don't take that professor in any case! Sounds like an easy class, but it's just the opposite. Lots of readings that are not even matching her lectures. She is so weird with her jokes and the way she teaches. Talks a lot, but never says meaningful things. Not only she doesn't let the class finish earlier, but we stay more than the class takes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I LOVED DR. D!! Her class was honestly my favorite class at TCU, and I am currently a senior. Lots of guest speakers and field trips and the content is very interesting. Very minimal outside of class work. Attendance is mandatory but sometimes classes are via zoom, and she doesn't keep you the entire class time every week.

I LOVED Dr.D! She is so passionate about what she teaches and really enjoys connecting with her students. She always checked in on us students and if an assignment was overhwhelming she would work with the class to help you! I definetly recommed talking her class for your religion credit!

one of the BEST professors at TCU! If you need a religion credit take Dr.D! Super caring teacher, and really easy to reach outside of class! Not a typical religion class and has online midterms and exam! Really awesome teacher ands takes feedback from the students and implements it into class!

Dr. D is such a great and caring professor. She is very passionate about what she teaches and the class structure makes it easy to stay on top. Graded by some group activities in class as well as a midterm and final.
Seemed to be focused on only her lecture material
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. D was an absolutely amazing professor! She is super passionate about what she teaches. Her classroom always feels like a safe place for questions and discussions, which I recommend participating in to get the most out of her class. Amazing religion credit and I wish I could've taken more classes from her.

Dr. D is one of the best professors I have ever met. She demonstrates a clear love/understanding for the material she teaches and that shows so well through her lectures. Her kindness and care for her students is on a whole other level. She cares more about our education than the final grade which reflects in her grading policies. Take her class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: If you are looking for a doable, interesting religion credit, Southeast Asian Religion is the way to go. I had to take this class because it was the only one left open, but I am glad I took it. Dr. D is passionate and understanding. As long as you pay attention in class, do the work, and turn in your assignments, the class is easy.
I took Goddess Traditions of India, Dr. D cares a lot about her students and is passionate about what she teaches! She grades easy and there wasn't a single test.

Such a solid professor. She enjoys what she does and actually cares for her students. Lecture heavy, but assignments and quizzes are super easy. Class kinda blows but you cheat can on everything. 9.3/10

Professor DeNapoli was great! She is always caring and respectful when it comes to homework. She is also very lenient, allowing students to make up an assignment, and cares for the overall well-being of the students over their grades. I would definitely say one of the best professors at TCU for Religion.

Professor DeNapoli is rigorous but the most caring and compassionate professor I've known. She deeply cares for her students and expects them to be accountable to their learning. She lectures a lot, but she also gives class exercises that are fun, and they're easy. If you want to expand your horizons, then take Prof. DeNapoli.

Overall great professor with lots of care and easy accessibility for students. The class is very heavy on reading but passable if you put in the effort to read and pay attention , as the answers to written assignments or quizzes are literally in the powerpoints.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. D is very passionate about Asian religions, and a very nice lady overall. She assigns a lot of writing assignments, but they are short and easy. She also provides more than enough material with which to complete the assignments. Best part of all, she provides a thorough and clear outline of what will be on her quizzes and exams. Great class.

She is great. Shes so passionate about what she teaches. Very lenient grader on quizzes (tells u what to study) and assignments. There are lots of grades but nothing too demanding. She knows everyones face and name so you have to go to class or shell know that you missed. She assigns class prep every class but its not really necessary to do it.

Dr. D is such a king, caring professor! Lectures run long, but that's only because you can tell she has a true passion for the topic she's teaching. She always puts her students first and checks in to see if they're doing alright! Love her!
Lectures are painful, but she is a really sweet person. She cares about her students and wants you to do well. A lot of work, but not too hard. Reading isn't really necessary
Excellent professor. High recommend her class for RT core.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I'll admit there's a lot to learn in this course, but Dr. D makes it easy and fun! Although she gives a good amount of homework it's all fairly quick and she grades easy. Get ready to listen, she is lecture heavy, but tests and quizzes are straight from what is said in class. Overall, one of the best professors at TCU! Would definitely take again.
