Professor Appel is kind and means well, but the class was tough. His lectures ramble, and the PowerPoints are hard to follow. He expects a lot on essays but gives very little direction, and he doesn't follow the syllabus closely, which makes the course confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Appel has good intentions and values; however, in terms of teaching, it does not correlate. Professor Appel makes it difficult for students to succeed due to a lack of proper instructions on major assignments and inconsistent grading on assignments. It will require 200% of your effort in order to maintain a decent grade in the course. DO NOT TAKE.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Writing assignments are graded extremely hard - but there is little to no instruction on prompts & blames bad grade on you just not understanding. Feedback is little & most of the time not useful and rude. If you disagree with him he'll say his opinion & never let you rebuttal. Do yourself a favor and don't take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This is one of the most difficult classes I've taken, not because of the content but how his class is set up. He doesn't follow the syllabus whatsoever. There are multiple readings a week on articles that are 10+ pages in length. The papers that are due are graded very harshly with little to no feedback. Avoid this class at all costs.

He provides poor feedback making it difficult to meet his expectations. If you ask a question, do not expect a clear answer, but watch as he skillfully rewords your question and never answers it. 4 weeks till semester was over he changed the final exam from a paper to a cumulative exam. He reads directly off ppts and relies on tedtalks to teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Our class average going into the final is a 68. Content and lectures are impossible to follow. Due dates change on short notice and he doesn't tell you when they do. The hardest grader I've seen at TCU, never communicates what he is looking for in papers and gives 70's with little to no feedback. Take this class if you enjoy being frustrated.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: DO NOT take this class. Possibly the most confusing lectures / PowerPoints I have ever experienced at TCU. Does not adhere to the syllabus at all and the students have to pay the price for it. Also tries to force his religion on you when it has nothing to do with the content. Syllabus says lowest 2 grades dropped but he changed policy mid semestr
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: NEVER EVER enroll in one of his classes. Worst teacher Ive ever had at TCU. Changes his syllabus throughout the semester and is extremely rude to students on feedback for his journals and papers. I feel like his goal is to confuse students as much as possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is an incredibly frustrating professor to have. His syllabus changes throughout the entire semester, due dates are never posted ahead of time, and participation is mandatory but the class format doesnt support it. Participation is a good portion of the grade but he doesnt give opportunities to talk.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof. Appel (my opinion) is a very caring teacher. spoke with him a lot outside of class and he is tough on grades because he wants his students to be better writers. My writing has gotten SO much better from his papers. BEWARE: you will never stop writing in his class it is literally so much. If you can think deep, dont take his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Does not even abide by his own syllabus. Says he drops 2 lowest journal grades so youd figure dont do two of them right but no 6 weeks in he decides to say that all journals have to be attempted which is not stated in his syllabus. Class average is a 67.7 in November. Extremely hard grader and looks for unnecessary reasons to count points off.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The worst teacher I have had at TCU. Haven't learned a thing and his comments on assignments are very rude. Does not have a teaching plan and it is obvious. There's no benefits to taking this class and the professor makes class a nightmare. The class average is 65% with only a few assignments left. Seems like he used to be a good prof, not anymore.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS. Has changed his syllabus and required assignments 4 times and we are only in the 7th week of the semester. 10 journals(500wrd)- extremely hard grader- not everyone is a philosopher. Questions about readings- unnecessary. No semester plan- unorganized. Lectures about his religion constantly. this is your sign not to take it

The class was interesting, however you MUST participate. In my class he called on really the same 5 people so my participation grade was trash. Weekly "journals" that are written like academic essays. The readings for the week are crucial or you will have no idea what to write for your weekly journal. So much work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Great guy - means well you get to learn a lot about him. His papers are specific and graded very harshly. Paper prompt always changed - towards the end of the semester, it was hard to keep up with the change from a somewhat casual journal to a paper/essay. I considered myself to be a good writer and detailed oriented however that changed quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Participate!!! Do not take the class if you do not like to talk. He will call on you. One of the best classes I have taken at TCU. Makes you think about culture differently. Not an easy A. Makes you work reasonably hard. Easy to talk to. Make time to visit outside of class. Definitely loves what he does and it shows.
Great professor! Good class. Show up and ask lots of questions. High expectations. Quizzes are hard. Journals every week. Not a blow off course.

As far as writing emphasis classes go, the workload is about the same as any other WEC. Keep up with the lectures and do the reading prior to the lecture. My grades on the quizzes improved dramatically when I read before. No midterm and no final! He provides students with his PowerPoint lectures. Likes Ted Talks. Not easy. Go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Weekly 500-word minimum journals, video project, one big paper, quizzes, and participation. His grading is unclear and his lectures can be all over the place. He can grade papers harshly and the quizzes are on tiny details from readings. The class is doable, but her really makes you work for it.

Amazing professor, probably one of the sweetest human being I have meat. His class is hard, and you will not pass just being in the class. You will have to work for it. Everything on the test is covered in class and given reading the material. Intercultural communication class teaches a hard topic, not necessarily that he is making the class hard.

he is ALL over the place as a professor, which makes it very hard to learn things. I worked hard all semester and ended with a B. quizzes are very hard and extremely specific- the best grade I got on quiz each week was an 80 (even after studying for hours). he makes average participation grade a 70 which is not right.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Journals and Quizzes every week. No tests and 1 final project. Participation is worth 250 points and the average grade was a 73. He says he doesnt take attendance but participation and attendance obviously matters to him. Very controversial in his topics
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: "journal" essays every week, quiz every week, two big essays, only one test. A's are for exceptional work, B's are good work, C's are for average work. I made A's on every single essay and still made a B in the class. Miss class? 5% deducted off your entire grade each time (yeah, terrible). Not much reading at all, and you earn a ton though!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Professor Appel is a good guy. He uses politics as a metaphor for the differences that exist between cultures. He also loves politics. I will never see culture the same way again. This class should be required. It is the TCU motto "lead on."
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: He is a great professor who really cares not just about the subject material, but also about his students. Weekly quizzes but they take the place of tests which makes the class very manageable. There are two papers right at the end of the semester but as long as you plan ahead there is no reason to not do well. Thankful to have had this class w/him

Dr Appel is a great fit for Intercultural Communication. He makes his possible to create an interactive learning environment and invites students to keep reflecting outside the classroom. Although the class can be challenging, it gives students an opportunity to mature. If you want a good grade do no content yourself with shallow papers; think deep

Literally worst class I've taken at TCU. He calls out students for no reason, gives quizzes every week that are basically tests, gives 3 major papers in the last 3 weeks of classes, and is honestly just rude and obnoxious. He goes off on tangents that are not relevant at all, and I have not learned much from this class. Good luck if you take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Loved professor Appel! Fun and interesting class - definitely take for Intercultural Comm.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took him for Intercultural Comm. & I fairly easily got an A. 4 papers, (that he grades REALLY easily), quizzes every week out of book, & midterm & final that he gives you a review for that helps a lot. He is kind of all over the place but gets the point across. He will work with you is def. worth taking!!

Please, PLEASE take him. He has impacted me in such a positive way & is such a tremendous inspiration. I love how we could discuss tough topics with ease. He is funny, honest, and real with you and someone you can trust. Because of him, I am considering pursuing research in intercultural communication. One of my most favorite professors I have had.
Great teacher, even better person. Learned a ton from his lectures but more from how he treats his students. Take this class, keep up with the journals and get a lot out of it.

Professor Appel is a great professor. He brings a lot of energy and passion to the material. This is not a blowoff course by any means an attendance is critical. If you're struggling, go see him and he will help straighten you out. He cares about his students and wants to work with them however he can. I strongly recommend this class.

Intercultural was a very interesting class. He is a difficult grader, but better once you figure out what he is looking for. Lectures are rambling and hard to follow if you are an organized note taker, but you end up learning alot. Lots of papers, but research papers were both cancelled, and no tests until the final.

nice guy, but I didn't like the class. He's VERY type A, if you are too it'll be ok but if you're chill he will probably frustrate you. Tests and quizzes can be oddly specific. ex: I missed a definition b/c a word I used wasn't in the book, even though they were interchangeable. I just studied the book.
Prof Appel is good at lecturing but terrible at explaining what he expects in the papers and even worse at grading them.
Professor Appel is very unclear about what he expects and then grades way too hard. He is good at teaching, but not at grading papers.

Intercultural Communication has been my favorite class in the department thus far. Professor Appel is the perfect person for the class. He is very passionate about what he teaches. His enthusiamsm makes students want to learn. You have to work hard,but that should be expected because it's a writing emphasis course at the 3000 level. Awesome class!
"I guess I am just one of those teachers who thinks a C is a good grade," - DIRECT QUOTE! He means well but his unreal heavy work load and trickiness just frustrated everyone.

whoever ranked this guy bad is just horrible. i had him freshman year and i still think he was great. saw him a few months ago in reed and even remembered my name and asked all about how everything was. on facebook (which is ok for him cuz hes a cool prof) most caring guy. just work in his class. big deal.

I just read below.  Prof. Appel gives real life examples of communication.  Fun to listen to...  Good teacher; doesn't put up with excuses at all.  Will result in a bad grade.  As a teacher, about an 8.5/10

AWESOME prof! He really cares about his students and is always willing to help. He's fun and makes class interesting! I gained a ton of experience through his class and will take him again! I reccomend his class to EVERYONE. He is AWESOME!!!
awesome teacher!!! he helps so much with speeches and papers! he really cares about us and I would love to take more classes from him!!
Good teacher.  He cares a lot about his students and you must approach him.
Good teacher.  Attend classes and do the assignments and you will do fine.  Obvious he cares a lot about his students and you must approach him.

I don't understand how Mr. Appel has bad reviews.  He is a great teacher and everybody should take him.  His class has a lot to do with relationships.  The class was never boring.  Go to class, which won't be hard because he keeps it interesting.

Amazing class. Not only was the class on speech but communication and relationships and how to maintain them. Everybody thought of him as like our shrink becuase the knowledge was amazing. Don't skip too much as points are taken away from your speech. Read book as well for quizes. Great teacher!

the guy who wrote below me is an idiot. this prof is awesome, interesting, nice, class is a lot of fun and not too hard. you can't skip too much but going is not bad bc he is so nice. good stories too which keeps class good. definitely recommend speech class with this guy!!
Guaranteed a D on the first speech. Gives no help with first speech and little on others. Changes syllabus 5 times.

Professor Koss is one of the most frustrating instructors I've had. His grading is extremely harsh and often feels arbitrary, making it nearly impossible to earn above a B. Also, disagreeing with his views can negatively impact your grade. He brings politics into class in an uncomfortable way, creating a biased environment.
So so so many uncomfortable lectures about topics that 1: nobody wants to talk about 2: only vaguely relate to our homework/reading. Big dawg just in it for the love of the game.

AVOID. Lectures have absolutely nothing to do with essay assignments. I learned absolutely nothing in this class. Does not allow any technology. Dude. It's 2023. reviews.comment: Super liberal and strict professor, doesn't feel like a learning environment morelike a class where he'll find any excuse to mark off your grade, never take a class from him

Personally I believe you can do well in his class if you read the books (which are interesting) and participate in class! There's a lot of reading and some pop quizzes, but it's easy to bs. This professor literally sucks do not take him.

I've loved every single teacher at TCU besides Koss... and I am a straight A student who loves English. He is unkind and rude to students. STAY AWAY!

Attendance is mandatory - if you miss more than 3 it will affect.

reviews.comment: Definitely take for core credit! He is a police officer who mainly talks from his experiences, which are really interesting to listen to. There are 4 tests including a final, all pretty easy, in person no lock down browser. He does a review before test days and basically tells you what will be on the test. One short essay too. Take him!

Loved Mr. White as a teacher. Mostly lecture-based, but he has exciting real-world experience to speak on. Tests are lockdown but are very easy to study for. He has a few speakers come in and share super interesting stories. Would definitely take again.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a great teacher, no homework or quizzes, a couple of tests but he gives multiple extra credit opportunity to get 100s on the tests so you don't even have to take them. He doesn't have mandatory attendance but some of the extra credit opportunity he only tells the people in class.

This class was one of my favorites!! Officer White is so kind and understanding and has great law enforcement experience. His class is so engaging. Three tests and a paper for grades- overall really chill and fun class

He's just alright. He doesn't teach the course material, pretty much only tells stories about him being a cop, which is great and all but not useful for getting a good grade. Says he makes review guides, but doesn't. Low effort class but if you actually want to learn something good luck. Might as well be a self-directed online course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is strict about actually showing up to class and he likes us to be engaged in class discussions. Not the easiest class but not the hardest either. He taught me things that will actually be useful in life.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This man is amazing! Such an easy A. I think there was 3-4 test total that are very straightforward and the answers come from the textbook. Gives a review for each test which is exactly what is going to be on it. You go on a field trip which is so fun! Take this class if you would like an easy A!!

TAKE THIS CLASS! Professor White has such interesting lectures and really cares about his students. Professor White is funny and keeps his students engaged. This is my favorite class I have ever taken at TCU. I have nothing but good things to say about Professor White and this class.

10/10 recommend Professor White! He is super funny and is open to all opinions about the criminal justice system. Lectures are interesting because it consists of mainly discussion and his stories as a detective. He makes sure you are well-prepared for exams, there is no homework, just an open-ended paper at the end of the semester.

He is a sargeant at FWPD and tells super cool stories about his time as a police officer in class. Exams are super easy and he gives you an idea of the questions beforehand and there is one open-ended paper for the semester. Super easy and fun class for a CSV credit.

Out of all of my professors he was my absolute favorite professor. He truly incorporated everyone's views. He is a detective for the Fort Worth Police Department, and he gave amazing personal experience and insight in his experiences. Even though he is a detective he kept his personal bias out the whole time. He allowed us to create our own views.

Professor White really cares about you as a student and wants to see you succeed in his class. Exams are not difficult if you take notes and go to class. He answers my emails really fast. lectures are good and he's a detective so his class discussion is interesting and it made me think about things. Great professor!

Lectures are wastes of time, insane amount of tedious busy work. Mandatory attendance just to watch students present AI slop projects and Dr. Sloan go on random irrelevant tangents. At least the connections projects were kinda fun and free 100s. But, overall, get ready to waste a significant amount of free time and learn absolutely nothing.

Dr. Sloan is the best and the sweetest lady ever! She genuinely wants to connect with her students and is so funny. Easy quizzes and discussion posts with 2 group projects. She is also pretty understanding with grades!

Dr. Sloan is passionate about the literature that she has you read, and wants you to like it as well. You will do two projects throughout the whole semester, and the rest is discussion posts and quizzes.
She cares about attendance, make sure to use sign in sheet. Otherwise you will have to take the final.

Dr. Sloan is the sweetest Professor on Campus!!! She wants nothing more than to have conversations with those in her class and has a wonderful sense of humor. You want her on your team and as long as you participate (basically joking around with her) and listen like 20% of the time she will love you!!!!
Super sweet and understanding. Very flexible with deadlines. Highly recommend for an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The sweetest person on campus, she's a really quick grader.
She is the sweetest little old lady. As long as you participate you will get an A!

Dr. Sloan lectures the whole class and reads off of slides. Lectures are super boring, and hard to attend. Most work is group discussion posts and group projects and I learned absolutely nothing. Has no idea how to use online and deadlines are extremely confusing because of this. Try to take a different teacher if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She does not care about students grades. And not willing to compromise. She lectures only and everything we did was group work. Did not learn a single thing.

Sloan is the GOAT. She is willing to compromise with each of her students on assignments and wants everyone to do well. Show up to her class as she posts assignments that you wouldn't know how to do without being in the class. Essays are easy to get a good grade on. I took this class for the sophomore year English and was my easiest class.

Relatively easy fiction class. There are discussions every week, online quizzes every other week and 2 presentations. Discussions are quite easy as long as you take a look at her materials, quizzes are manageable and presentations aren't so tough. She took attendance randomly so it's safest to go to class. Overall, she's a nice professor!

Dr. Sloan is nice enough, especially to those who engage and make conversation in class, but she is incredibly disorganized. I never know when things are due, as she changes due dates often and doesn't always post updates. She also doesn't know how to work the D2L page, which is an issue.

Dr. Sloan is a really good professor. She is super nice and really fun if you get to know her. If you do your work on time and literally turn in something for rough drafts and format things correctly your grade should be good. The weeks where essays are due feel like a week off. She tells you what to do on the final papers as well.

Dr Sloan is awesome!! Communication can be difficult at times as she works on her own terms, but overall such a good class compared to other teachers I have heard of. There are little assignments daily in class, but if you miss they are always posted online, and she accepts late work. Overall, this class is an easy A if you do the assignments.
Ms. Sloan is the best teacher of all time no question. Every class she brings so much joy and positivity to the classroom. Her class doesn't feel like a class, it feels like a family.

There are group discussion posts due every class and a quiz due after class (open note). Good amount of reading you were supposed to do but nobody ever did it. Two group presentations due for the semester. No final if you had over a 90% in the class. Definitely recommend for an easy A.

This class is awesome. I did not enjoy the content and did not have to grind for an elective. This is a super easy A and Dr Sloan will work with you. There is no way to end with a bad grade. If you have above a certain grade, there is no final. No tests and lots of easy assignments for potential grades.

She was such a funny teacher. You have assignments pretty much every class but if you miss the class she accepts late work usually. She's very understanding and willing to help you out anytime she can.

Doctor Sloan is adorable!! She is a super reasonable grader and is really nice about giving full credit if you miss an assignment or are late. She's really funny and is constantly making jokes and talking about back in her day. She's a good sport and a smart woman.

ENGL 20803- Dr. Sloan is pretty laid back. We do in-class assignments and there are 3 big assignments. Two are essays, less than 1000 words. 3rd project is an infographic and a simple slide show. This is also the final. She gives feedback on each rough draft too. I recommend taking her class, it is not super difficult.

Dr. Sloan is super laid back and so funny. Shes not a very serious person and that can be a good and bad thing, but overall I really enjoyed being in her class. She is a hard grader at times but it will turn you into a better writer. She is extremely understanding and a very kind person overall. I would recommend!

She's an amazing person. This class is abysmal. Everything is application based, so you have to understand it all to an insane extent. iClicker is your attendance grades, but you don't have to be in the lecture hall to do them. There's so much content and I was always confused.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing professor that cares about her students, unity sucks though

Take her for unity! Material is tough but Lakoduk is always there and open to help. She does not only want you to succeed as a student but also as a person. I went to her in one of her 1-1 sessions because the class seemed impossible and I didn't know what I was doing wrong. After talking to her she made me feel so much better and my score doubled.
Amazing professor, extremely hard course. Definitely go to office hours!! My favorite professor at TCU, she truly cares.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Lakoduk is the best! If you have any questions she will answer emails quickly and stay after class to help students understand course content. Dr. Lakoduk makes learning the content so enjoyable, and she has an amazing sense of humor. Just know what you are getting into taking bio at TCU, it will not be easy no matter which professor you take.

This professor is the worst I've encountered in college. She was unable to teach effectively, and I failed her course. She requires additional teaching training. It was a waste of money, time, and mental energy and mental energy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class makes you want to hate school every day.

UNITY BIO: Lakoduk was so so nice and clear in her lectures. I went to her office hours all the time and really developed a connection with her which helped so much. This class is hard but if you take Lakoduk, then watch Luques lectures, you get the best of both teachers. The exams are the same for both teachers but I loved Lakoduk.

She is a nice person. She is willing to help you if you need help. my only complain would be the amount of pre-lectures and post-lectures and length of those videos on top of having to re-listen to the in class-lecture recordings. Cell with Luque hardly has pre-lectures, she mainly covers content in class so thats the main difference btwn the two.

Dr. Lakoduk is very intelligent and explains concepts in lectures well, but I found this class incredibly challenging since the exams are way different from the lectures. The exams are complex and conceptual so you really need to understand every little detail from the lectures to do well on them. Exams are like Dr. Luque's Unity and Cells class

Dr Lakoduk is easily accessible outside of class whenever there is a topic you're stuck on. Exams are very in depth, but the course has a curve. She explains things clear during lectures, and will answer any questions. There will be some pre-lectures and post lectures that you should definitely keep up with

Dr. L is great! The tests and quizzes are based on her lectures. I had difficulty with the first test because I found the questions confusing; however, that might be because I am not a native English speaker. I did not read the book- lecture based! I got my first B (sadly) because the course had a lot of content, and I was taking 18 credits.
Lakoduk is by far my most favorite stem professor at TCU. Although the contents are very heavy, but she often relieves the stress by making some jokes at the middle of the lecture.
Bro take her. Each lab got out within 20 mins. No lab quizzes taken inside the lab. Super funny, genuinely best teacher at TCU.
She was funny and kept lectures short and entertaining.
Lakoduk was a funny professor for Contemporary. Issues in Bio. The class itself isn't that fun but she cracks jokes which is great. The tests are hard but study and you will do great.
Great Professor, works well with students, passionate, easy quizzes, easy tests.

Dr. L is incredible. Her class is very difficult but she's one of those professors that is so sweet you want to do well to make her proud. She is very accessible outside of class and will do anything to help you, even come in early or stay late to accommodate your schedule. She is awesome.
Dr. G is AMAZING! Such a nice and smart guy. He makes it possible to get an A in Advanced Fin Man. Going to miss him! Highly recommend taking him for anything he teaches.

I LOVE DR. G! He is so kind and sweet! Tests are not weighted that much, and you can have a cheat sheet front and back! He is SO knowledgeable and wants to help you succeed! Teaches Adv Fin man and I want to take the class just so I can have him as a professor again!! Take him!! He is the GOAT!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor G is a great guy. His class is fairly balanced between exams, projects, and small assignments, and he drops the lowest exam grade out of 3. He goes over reviews before exams to help us prepare and allows us a handwritten cheat sheet for all exams. Not a super easy class, but Professor G makes concepts understandable.
Dr. G is the goat. He explains concepts very well and offers to help students when confused. Drops lowest exam.
Dr. G's class is well organized and not test heavy. His lectures are amazing and would spend time on class going over problems which really helps. Take him if you can.

Dr. Palmer was an amazing professor. She doesn't believe in grades, so as long as you show up to "mostly all of the classes", participate, and communicate when needed, you can confidently give yourself an A at the end of the semester. One major project, weekly reflections every Monday, and a weekly book club (not all semester long).

Dr. Palmer does not believe in grades throughout the semester but you can provide your feedback at the end of what grade you think you deserve and why. She is very caring and helps every student a lot with their project and work. She really wants to help so utilize her outside the class if needed!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is the sweetest most understanding professor I've ever had. She truly cares about each one of her students. She dosen't believe in grades, so as long as you show up, do your work and put in the effort you will end with an A. I cannot recommend her enough. Take this class with her you won't regret it.

Dr. Coles was a great teacher overall and she is very accessible to all her students. She loves when you ask questions and visit office hours too. The class, in my opinion, is a little hard for a core credit especially but as long as you do your work and pay attention in the class, you will be fine!

Professor Coles was very understanding and helpful in and outside of the classroom. The class was made up of online quizzes which were straight forward and iclicker questions everyday that were easy and she would allow you to discuss with a partner sometimes. For labs and our profile project, she would go over your work and leave helpful feedback.

Professor Coles was an overall good teacher. She cares about her students and wants them to do well. There are a bunch of quizzes that are open note. The assignments are manageable and interesting to do.

Dr. Coles is a good professor. All her exams/quizes are open book and very easy to pass. She really needs you to understand the concepts and provide examples in writing assignments. No exam retakes but does allow 2nd attempts on some review quizes for partial credit. Video lectures before class and iClicker questions during class. Take the class.

I think she changed up her course between fall and spring semester. The class setup was nice, lots of grades go into the grade book which is good, but she is also strict about how you explain the course concepts. Before class watch the lecture videos, then practice questions in class, which is nice for test prep. Just do the work for a good grade.

Dr. Coles' online Physical Geography class was amazing! She replaced the finals and midterms with bi-weekly quizzes and gave you two weeks to study for them at a time. She will always be willing to meet and is very knowledgeable about her subject! Very caring and will check over your labs to ensure you have a 100.

Shes a great professor in that she knows exactly what shes talking about, but expects you to read between the lines or catch specific wording when it comes to quizzes and tests. The labs are hard with vague instructions. Especially the profile assignments and Arcgis. We have to ask a lot of questions to help us get the answers.

Dr. Coles is a nice person who is clearly passionate about the material . However, she is a super picky grader and has very specific ideas of how she wants the stuff in class applied. This class is tough and takes a lot of time to do well in... reading, homework, in class participation... it's interesting material and an easy B-, but NOT an easy A

I have enjoyed Dr. Coles' class very much but the labs are more difficult than expected. This is usually okay since she is there to help and group work is allowed but the wording and data is sometimes bad and the labs are not the most pleasant thing in the world. Great instructor, very kind, but the labs are no fun.

Dr. Coles was pretty great. I wasn't expecting much out of an intro geo class, but I really ended up enjoying it. She is friendly and has lots of cool anecdotes on different regions from traveling and living abroad. Class has A LOT of grades, which is a nice grade buffer, but also kinda annoying. Very easy pass, little effort for an A.

I took world regional geography with Dr. Coles to fulfill a core credit and enjoyed having her as a professor but not the class specifically. Dr. Coles is so understanding and very accessible outside of class. However, this class requires a lot of work for a core class and its hard to maintain an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you're looking for an easy NSC for your core DO NOT TAKE THIS. One of the hardest classes I took which is ridiculous considering this is a freshman level class. Acts like you know everything about geography. 3 test - 25 MC and free response that come from at least 20 pages of lecture notes. Labs are busy work and three are formal write ups. HARD
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: It's an easy class, but she assigns too much work for a core credit. There are more days with quizzes than without and the writing assignments are graded by the TA who thinks he is an English prof. She prepares you well for the test but it is honestly way too much coursework. A is attainable if you put in hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Easy A if you attend class and take notes. She gives a TON of extra credit so make sure you do them. She has outline notes and all you do is fill in the blank and study those notes. Clicker questions help a lot. Just be on task and you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Do not take this teacher! I have heard so many good things about other geography teachers. She is not flexible at all and does not work with you. If it weren't for all the extra credit she gives out you would think she wants her students to fail.

Dr. Coles is by far one of the greatest professors I've had at TCU. I dreaded taking world geography like many people do but she changed my opinion on it and I learned so much from her. If you have the chance to, take her class! It is not an easy A, but a manageable workload and you actually get an amazing teacher who cares for you! 10/10 recommend

By far one of my favorite professors that I have taken at TCU. You have to go to class for daily points but her class is so interesting! You do have to label a map every week over the region you are covering, they aren't hard as long as you study alittle bit. Her tests are very fair and well structured. She gives you guided notes for class as well!

Dr. English is an amazing STCO professor! Her case studies class was super informative and taught me so much about crisis communication. She truly cares about her students and makes the material engaging. Take her if you get the chance, you won't regret it!

Had her for STCO Case Studies and I'm so glad I did! She is so organized and provided reminders during the semester because she cares about students. I walked out of each class knowing that she wanted us to learn the material but for us to also be seen. Breaks down big assignments so you have a checkpoint and helpful feedback. If you can, take her!

Dr. English is one of the best professors I've had. She's incredibly helpful outside of class, highly engaging, and provides insightful feedback that really improves your writing skills. If you're considering taking her class, don't hesitate, she truly wants you to succeed!

I took her twice and would take her again. She genuinely cares about the well-being of her students and does weekly check-ins to make sure the workload isn't too much. She will adjust assignments to fit the pace and needs of each class. Her lectures are engaging and she is so fun and loving. I also enjoy working with a real company in class.

English was my favorite professor this year! So energetic, personable, funny. Assignments are straight forward and as long as you pay attention to details, you'll be fine. She has attendance requirements but I knew if I missed class, I'd be fine. She's also very easy to reach outside of class! She cares about her students.
Professor English is such an awesome human being. She grades your papers hard but she gives good feedback and if you go to her office hours she is super helpful. I would highly recommend taking her!
Sometimes she lets out early... like an hour early. There was a class where we were there for 8 minutes and then she let us out.

Everyone commenting likes her class, she just doesn't give out A's usually on assignments but it's possible to improve. Her classes are always fun, and she likes fun too. She can always answer any question. Business in society is meant to be more difficult with the grading because the program has specific requirements.

She is a nice lady but gives 0 feedback. She gave me the same grade on every homework assignment, beside doing better as the semester went on. She also takes the class so seriously and you can tell she is lazy.

cook is super nice and BIS is not a necessarily hard class, but she gives very lengthy homework assignments every week and then grades them insanely hard. there's also 3 group projects that suck if you have a bad group. very unlikely you'll receive an A on anything you do, despite being an A student in all other classes.

Ms Cook is allergic to an 'A' grade. She is a very tough grader so if you want an A, I wouldn't take this class. BIS is supposed to be easy but she makes it SO HARD to get an A. This all being said, the class wasn't that bad. Just is not as easy as BIS is supposed to be. She values participation SO much. You have to be so so so talkative too.

Avoid Cook. Insane grader on homework, which is 30% of your grade. You will very rarely get an A on an assignment. 3 group projects and no tests, which she also grades harshly. Showing up to class feels completely pointless, but attendance is mandatory. Absolutely no reason a BIS class should be this difficult. Do not take with her.

Class is pointless which made it hard to want to be there. Lengthy assignments and you MUST participate. Big group projects so good luck if ur group sucks. Not lenient on anything. Grades are given based off of who she like the best.

Professor Cook is Extremely sweet and kind so it pains me to write this. DO NOT TAKE HER! She is easily the hardest grader I've ever had during my time in college. You do everything right to end up with an 85 despite spending 3 hours on the assignment. Assignment every week that is extremely lengthy and harshly graded. Worse than a math class!!!!!!

Attendance is mandatory when it shouldn't be. Not lenient on late work. A tough grader, not to mention she grades HEAVILY on participation. Goes around and asks students what they think their grade should be for it??? Homeworks are VERY time consuming. Assigned seating. 2 presentations, business attire, no notes allowed, timed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Lengthy homework assignments and no lenience on late work. DO NOT ever take her at 8 am. Participation is very important for your grade. Corrections are unhelpful. You never know what grade you are going to get and it seems like she gives A's to her favorite students and B's and C's to her least favorite. She's new so enroll with another professor

Cook knows what she's talking about and is very well-spoken. But you never know if you're going to get an A or C or fail on an assignment, and the group projects are very lengthy. She's not flexible on deadlines at all and if you get a bad grade, I recommend talking to her, even though she's very hard to reason with. DO YOUR READINGS BEFORE CLASS.
She changed my life.

I LOVE Professor Seale. Before I took this class I read her review and got a little nervous because of the conflicting opinions but I'm so happy I was proven wrong. She is more than happy to help her students and ensures you know the right stuff. It actually cannot be any easier than this. She is also my clinical instructor! Shoutout SEALE :)

Professor Seale is an amazing professor and human being!!! She cares deeply about all her students and is passionate about behavioral health. Her lectures are never boring and she tells you the information that's important to know as a nurse. Consider yourself lucky if you get her as your professor!

This is a woman is one of the best role models ive ever had in nursing school. She is kind, compassionate, and incredibly genuine. She brings a warm light to class that you actually will laugh and smile during class. Psych was so interesting Seale made the class so amazing. Go to class and soak everything up as much as you can.

Wow! What an accomplished women for starters. She is one of the kindest souls out there who truly truly cares about her students. I look forward to her lectures everyday as paying attention is easy in her class. She is funny, captivating, and so educated. She is a role model! I'M GOING TO MISS HER

there are simply not enough words to describe how AMAZING professor seale is. she is compassionate and has a true passion for teaching and the field of psychiatry. i looked forward the her morning classes everyday, and wish they were longer since there is so much to learn from her. she is truly inspiring and a great remodel in the nursing field.

Professor Seale is amazing! I thought I wasn't going to like her class but she makes everything so interesting a shares so many crazy stories. She gave us all her number so we could text her for literally anything. Whether it is a question or something personal she is so easy to reach out to and get help! You can tell she is such an amazing nurse

Seale is the light of my life! I've never had a professor so in tune with the realities of nursing school. She doesn't waste your time, she teaches what's on the test, and she's so honest about life. Her lectures are fascinating. If you are engaged and show up to class she will love you and give you all the test answers and tell you cool stories.

Seale teaches to the exams which is a relief in nursing school and has honestly helped me learn more than I ever have in any other nursing class! Not only that, Seale is one of the most empathetic and insightful professors I have ever met. Her heart for others and unconditional acceptance of everyone is truly inspiring. you need her as a professor!

Seale is the best teacher I have ever had at TCU!!!!!  I did not think I was going to like psych but it was my favorite class.  She is so kind and will make you laugh the entire time. I wish I could have Seale for every class. Take her if you get the chance. If you pay attention in class she will tell you exactly what's on the test. She's the BEST

LOVE THIS CLASS!!!! Seriously, one of the most interesting nursing classes I've ever taken. Seale makes the class so much fun and truly wants us to succeed. I've never known a nursing professor to actually teach what is on the test!! I also had her for clinical, and she makes clinical so much fun and I truly feel like I learned a lot!!

Seale is quite literally an angel. She cares so much about her students so much and is so support of us both in her class and even of our lives outside of school. She prepares us so well for tests and the NCLEX! Show up to class! She shares so many stories and ways to remember things so the only way you will do poorly is by not going to class.

Literally one of the best professors out there. Professor Seale consistently keeps students engaged in class and never fails to make us laugh. The knowledge and passion that radiates from her is truly inspiring to me and made me consider behavioral nursing as my practice when I graduate. You can't find professors better than her ANYWHERE else!

Seale is by far the best professor I've had. She's the most caring and kind person ever. Her lectures are interesting and never boring. You can tell she is so knowledgeable about psych and extremely passionate. She really takes the time to make you feel welcome because she wants to see you succeed in school but also on the NCLEX and in your career.

Seale is by far my favorite professor I've ever had! She cares so much about her students and makes our mental health a priority over anything! Her class is focused on us walking away with knowledge and remembering it rather than just working for a good grade. An A is so doable if you just show up to class. So thankful I got to learn from her!

Dr. Seale is easily one of the most caring and knowledgeable professors in the nursing program. It's evident that she values her role and the impact she has on her students. Attendance is mandatory, but she's extremely understanding if you need to miss - all you have to do is shoot her a text! Her wit and compassion make class fun, even at 8 am.

Professor Seale was one of my favorite professors I've ever had while at TCU. Her tests are easy! She wants to help in any way she can! When I read the comments about her before taking her class, I was terrified, but I honestly don't understand how anyone felt this way about her. My entire cohort adores her and I will miss her class so much!

Professor Seale is one of the best nursing professors I've had so far. Her lectures are super interesting and she teaches to the test which I appreciate. I had her for behavioral health clinical as well and you will never meet a clinical instructor as caring and respectful of your time as she is! I utilized the ATI e-book and did well on tests!

Dr. Seale is a great professor. She is super caring and yeah she may seem a bit intimidating, she truly is not. She prefers to be contacted via txt and also this course is usually taken alongside Adult I. Even though Adult I is difficult, def do the work for this course and show up. This class is just as important as Adult I. Get the small version.
Class is OK, but the professor is kind of a bully. I never felt comfortable asking her for help.
Not a good class and she is not a nice person.
Do not take her class! She is the meanest professor I have ever had. She doesn't care about her students feelings and you will hate going to her class. Do yourself a favor and steer clear.
The most entertaining lectures ever! You will be hurting from laughing so hard. The content can be difficult, but because of the stories in her lectures, you will remember the material.

Professor Arguello is amazing! She is very caring and wants her students to understand and succeed. Easy homework assignments and a few movies to watch throughout the semester but they were all interesting. Make sure you participate! The class is small anyway and you get to know your classmates so everyone participating makes it much more fun!

I cried after the first class because I could not understand her, but I am so happy I didn't drop the class. She made the content fun and understandable for nonnative Spanish speakers. Super encouraging and made me want to improve my Spanish and participate in class. Mainly graded on one presentation, one Midterm in-class essay, and a final essay.
Great professor would take again.
shes really sweet and a fine teacher, she just gives a lot of busy work but is super nice and an easy grader and will help when you need it

Genuinely cares for her students and is passionate about spanish cinema. Grade consisted of two relfections, group presentation, midterm, feedback forms, and a final paper. Very easy lectures and class and please participate so there is no silence she is the sweetest!

I loved this Spanish class!! I learned so much and Arguello is really kind and helps you understand content. Sometimes the homework is unclear, so ask for clarification and read the syllabus often!! She's an easy grader, but still do the homework and try your best in her class! I would 100% take her again.

Truly such an amazing professor and one of the best in the department, in my opinion. I loved this class and would recommend to any Spanish minor/major who needs an upper level elective. She is very understanding if you need to miss class as long as you let her know and always willing to help out students. The class is also very easy.

I absolutely LOVE Prof. Arguello! Very minimal homework with a Spanish discussion board each week and group project/paper instead of tests. Loves to discuss the discussion boards in class and offers lots of extra credit. SHe is very understanding if you are sick or can not make class and is always available! Take her if you can!

Absolutely love Dra. Arguello. One of the best Spanish professors in TCU's Spanish Department, who genuinely cares about her students success in the classroom and out as well as their mental health. Definitely worth taking her course!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Arguello is one of the sweetest people ever. She is super encouraging during class and it is clear that she cares about her students' success. I feel like I improved so much in Spanish during this semester, mostly thanks to her help. There are a couple of partner presentations and a partner final, but it's very manageable.
She is an excellent teacher and can make any topic interesting!

Dr. Balizet is AMAZING! Her class is so organized and she finds a way to make old literature relevant and interesting to talk about. She makes you think about a lot of different things and cares more about your growth and participation. Her grading is very fair and as long as you complete the work and try your best, you'll do great. 100/10!!
Fun class good discussions. Some reading quizzes with notice ahead of time but mostly essay based.

Dr. Balizet is the best kind of professor, truly. She is kind and cares for her students wellbeing above all else. Despite taking this class online she managed to keep students engaged and discussing material but also left time for social engagement. Assignments are easy discussion posts, open book/note quizzes and final. Attendance is almost 30%.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is a professor an ALUMNI told me I should take when I was in the airport. As a non English major it was awesome. Not super hard and she makes class fun. I highly recommend her!
Great teacher, class was interesting and the assignments weren't too hard. Paper we're graded easily with the chance to edit one as another grade. Random in class quizzes over reading

Wonderful, interesting professor and class. It was very obvious that she is interested in the subject, and cares for her students. Most grades come from the papers, but she is great with giving suggestions and also comments after grading. I always looked forward to this class, the discussions were great and it was very refreshing.

Dr. B is an amazing professor. After taking two classes since she began at TCU she has grown incredibly as a professor. Her classes are fun and she loves all the underlying innuendo within anything the class reads. Great sense of humor and very fun class! Do the work and you will definantly be rewarded with an A.

LOVE this class! Balizet is intersting and always gives students a great perspective on material. Notices when class begins to drag and will readjust accordingly. Wonderful teacher, and just a great person!

Very, very interesting class. The reading is just plays, not novels, so it doesn't take too long. Lab about once a month, and you just watch a movie. A couple of 3 page papers, one 8 page one, and essay tests. She can be a tough grader, but you'll learn a lot.

She is one of my favorite professors at this school. She is really passionate and loves to share her knowledge. It really is intro to shakespeare and incredibly basic but easy to follow. Lab is fun too because you get to watch a movie based on each play. She grades essays easy and tests and quizzes are pretty straightforward. TAKE THIS CLASS!!!

Dr. Balizet is a wonderful and extremely intelligent professor.  She knows so much about her subject and is interested in what she's teaching.  Read the books and go to class to make a good grade.  She's extremely fair and helpful.  She's also gorgeous...seriously, she's like a model.

Dr. Balizet is a fantastic professor--an excellent addition to the TCU English Department.  She is extremely intelligent; passionate about her subject; and always willing and eager to help students.  She makes every minute of class worthwhile!

Dr. Balizet is great. She's a pretty easy grader, but her class requires a decent amount of work. You can do fine just reading Sparknotes though, if you so wish. She gives 2 tests and the final is a 3-5 page essay. Classes were mostly lecture based and they could drag on at times, but I had her class at the end of the day. Overall, I recommend her.
Very gorgeous, insightful professor!  Lots of reading and writing but not hard if yu pay attention and do your reading!  Always there to help, no matter what!!

Dr. B is an amazing professor. if you have any interest in Shakespeare you MUST take a class with her. It is not remotely a "blow off class" there is some work (like reading the plays and weekly paragraph responses) She has a lab where you watch modern versions of the plays which makes it easier for interpretation. TAKE HER CLASS!!!

Intro to Shakespeare was a fun class. She keeps it very interesting and fun. You do have to show up to class and read on time because of quizzes and ecollege posts. It is a fun class for people who like Shakespeare and a good class for people who just need to pass to get credit but it is not a blow off class.

Intro to Shakespeare was a good class if you've never had any experience with Shakespeare, but very boring if you know more than the basics. Wonderful professor, interesting,and intelligent. Glady takes your opinions into account.  Notes written on board are erratic, but not really necessary to success in class. Strict attendance policy.

Really nice. A lot of reading but easy class. Really enjoyed her, I would totally advise anyone to take her. Her lectures are very clear and interesting, if you want to learn anything about Shakespeare!

Professor Aranda is a nice professor, but he is very specific on how assignments need to be done. Even if you follow his exact instructions, he will take off points if it isn't exactly as he wants (which is impossible to know). It's an easy class, with boring lectures that do not really get to a point. My advice: follow the rubrics FULLY!

Professor Aranda is a little bit of a tough grader, but he gave extra credit which helped a lot. He is so sweet and easy to communicate with. If you don't understand something he will take time after class to go over things with you until you understand it. He will work with you if you communicate things with him which does a long way for me.

Aranda is a nice teacher overall, and is understanding if you are a good student in his class. However, he is a harsh grader if you don't follow his rubrics so READ THE RUBRICS for the speeches thoroughly if you take his class. He is unresponsive on emails and hates using outlook. Overall, a fairly easy class... participate and check D2L often.

This class is so easy compared to other Comm classes. There's only two big speeches, and we work on those for a while. I will say he is a bit unreliable, and his lectures are a bit boring. I would take with him for an easy A though.

Its a very easy class if you follow the rubric for the presenatations but he is a really annoying grader. I saw some people give great presentations and still get sub 80 grades back. He is also so boring and you dont do anythig in class. I wouldnt reccomend taking him.

I will say he is a hard teacher to get a hold of email wise, but if you talk to him in person he is a really understanding and caring teacher. 2 big speeches and one mid term that is a lot of points for the grade book. Show up to class, get involved, do the work and you will get an A.

Nice professor, but was never consistent on anything. Grading did not make sense, nor does his advice—SO MANY GRADES. Slow grader and NEVER responds to emails. He says to buy the textbook, but you do not need to. I would take a different professor, but the only good thing is that he does not use the -/+ scale. End of the sem is a group project.
He is a really nice teacher and means really well, but he is just so hard to get a hold of. He does not respond to emails, and he grades insanely hard to the point it makes no sense.

I made an account just to rate this class. He never responds to emails and provides little to no guidelines on how he wants work done. He will then proceed to get frustrated when the work is not to his liking. He edited one of my speech topics to something incredibly niche then punished me when I could not find enough research for a presentation.

He is very vague in his teaching, and gives little assistance on assignments. He is a tough grader, it is hard to understand what he expects, even when asked, and his grading is unclear. Seems like he takes points off for the purpose of taking points off. Everyone I talked to in my class felt similarly.

Lectures are long, boring, and repetitive. The class is mostly based on two major speeches. The outlines for the speeches are due quickly after your topic is approved. No helpful guidance given for the outlines especially since they are graded harshly. Can't use D2L very well and doesn't respond to emails quickly. Take with another prof.
Awful teacher. Not a lot of work but almost impossible to get an A because he doesn't provide any structure to the course so you never know what's due. Do not take him. Any other teacher is better

I just took this class and he is not great. He will NEVER respond to your emails to the point where you are stranded. He barely provides any guidelines for the speeches and assignments. D2L is not organized at all. He puts bare minimum effort into his class. He is an easy grade and not much homework. Just seems kinda like a lazy class for me.

DO NOT take this class with this professor. Seems very unorganized, takes forever to reply to emails, and doesn't explain assignments well. He wasn't mean, but I absolutely would not recommend him, my whole class was constantly confused.

Dr. Arnold is an excellent professor who genuinely cares about his students' success. I'm in his honors section, and it's definitely one of the most reading-intensive classes I've taken at TCU, so expect regular reading quizzes. I'd especially recommend his class if you're pre-law, though I can't speak to the non-honors section.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: You are well prepared by him as he pushes you very hard in class so that you are well-experienced for competitions.

Super nice guy. Lots of reading and discussion posts, but you don't have to do all the reading to do the posts. He drops a lot of discussion posts, so you don't have to do all of them. Tests are mostly graded based on an essay portion. Can be kind of boring in lectures. Overall, not to difficult to get an A if you study for exams. Would recommend.

Prof Arnold's honors political theory class is so fun! A lot of the stuff you read is really interesting, which partially makes up for the fact that there's A LOT of it. At first it seemed like it would be a lot of work, but once you get the hang of it, it's easy to manage. And he drops a lot of grades which is nice. Overall I highly recommend him
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Arnold's class is super interesting, and he makes difficult, boring texts into understandable and relatable ones. Before every class there is a discussion post you have to do about the required reading. Besides those posts, there are two exams (midterm and final) and a long essay that is graded pretty hard. Great professor, tough class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Arnold's honors political theory class and it was great. His lectures are engaging and interesting. There are 2 exams and a huge argumentative paper worth 35% of the grade. You have readings and discussion posts before almost every class, but they are a completion grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Arnold is an amazing professor. This class is a combination of philosophy and political science. There are readings before every class, and if you want to make an A you should definitely do the readings which take about 30mins-1hour before each class. Participation is an important factor in this class, so be prepared to talk. I learned so much!

TAKE PROFESSOR ARNOLD! He makes an honors class easy and enjoyable. The readings can be a lot, but he always goes over them in class so if you didn't read you can catch up. I would take him again 100%. The topics are pretty interesting too and test are super easy and straight forward a few multiple-choice questions, an essay, and open note.

Great professor. Has great lectures and class discussions where everyone gets involved. Class is fun and keeps you involved. He is a tough grader when it comes to any political theory papers you write and covers a lot of content in his classes and hard theories to understand. A lot of reading outside of class, and a post due before every class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor! His class is really fun and engaging. Online discussions every week and one group debate on various topics. Take the class.

One of the best classes and professors at TCU. Extremely engaging and clear lectures and encourages participation while remaining neutral. Genuinely nice guy and not very hard to get an A if you take even a small level of interest in the class. Would absolutely take again.

TAKE PROF ARNOLD!! If I have any advice for Political Science majors at TCU it would be to take Professor Arnold. I seriously cannot say enough nice things about him. Arnold gives such amazing lectures that are so thought provoking- he is a tough grader but teaches in a way that is fair for his grading. Do yourself a favor and take Arnold!

I would definitely recommend taking this professor! I was nervous about this class at first because I typically have trouble with philosophical concepts, but Dr. Arnold explained the content very clearly in a way I could understand. He's very accommodating and accessible outside of class if you need help with assignments.

Dr. Arnold is very kind and as his class can come with controversial political topics he makes sure to let everyone share their opinions and does not let his own political views influence his grading or view of his students. He is an all around great professor and I highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Had Dr. Arnold for Moot Court this year. He is a great professor and is really passionate about seeing students grow in their argumentative skills! He really made me feel important and helped me notice the improvements I made in Moot Court. 10/10 recommend Moot Court as well as Dr. Arnold. He is also very accessible outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! Knows all the students in class by name and truly cares about you as a person rather than just a name on a roster. Fair grader and gives clear study guides and instructions. 2 exams and one paper. Paper is not too difficult if you are a good writer and he gives example papers. Definitely take him!

10/10! He's so kind, caring & is the best! We have 2 tests & the second one is the final exam. The tests are essay based questions, but he gives you prompts to study and practice. Our homework is discussion and comprehension posts about the readings for class, but you can skip 4 comprehension and 5 discussion posts, so they aren't hard to complete

Dr. Arnold is a truly excellent professor. I never thought I would be able to understand political theory, but he made it easy and fun, and I learned a ton from his class. He's a great lecturer, and I really recommend him.

Best political science professor I have ever taken. He makes the class light and really teaches the material and is open to any questions. Attendance is not mandatory but recommended because majority of test material is spoken about during the lectures. He is awesome and I highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Arnold is one of the best professors at TCU. Super smart and interesting. His classes are discussion heavy and he really makes you think and question your beliefs. Don't take this class if it's not with Arnold. He's very nice carrying and very funny.

JUNE 4-WEEK. Dr. Arnold was great, he was attentive and ensured we understood the information. Sometimes, class would go all over the place as any political discussion would. A good amount of reading and pop quizzes used for participation. Exams were just a choice of 3/4 essays, but are easy to do. Awesome class, will take some effort to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: AMAZING!!! He is awesome!!!! I took him for Honors Political Theories & he just rocks. Class is kinda hard but definitely manageable
He explains everything in depth, and really makes it so youre actually learning something in the class. This is probably the best teacher I had in VPS
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Arnold is really great. If you're interesting in the content of his course then you will probably do well in this class. Reading the content and understanding it is key. All tests are short answer/essay and there are also major papers. A pretty tough grader and the course content isn't easy to understand. I hated the class but he was cool.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Arnold is my favorite professor at TCU. Taking global justice was great, you have awesome discussions and Arnold is all about free flowing dialogue and discussion of ideas. Two papers and two tests, with somewhat regular reading quizzes. If you get the chance, take Dr. Arnold. The man is truly a gem of a professor.

Dr. Arnold is a very knowledgable and respectable professor. One thing to keep in mind is that he is very well versed in political philosophy and if you're not even slightly interested in the material - DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. I'm not a political science major and this class is incredibly boring and if you don't understand the material it is hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Hard topics. Political theory is no walk in the park but he gives great thought experiments and funny examples that grounds the lecture/reading. Summer means no papers! This was required for minor but I would love to take Dr. Arnold for upper division. Must read everything given! You will be quizzed.

His honors political theory class was amazing! Definitely my favorite class so far at TCU. The reading is heavy, but very interesting. The class makes you think. Most of the grade comes from two papers, so do well on them and do well in the class! Loved it overall!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Discussion-based, w/ Arnold facilitating. He kept us on task & considering different perspectives. He does a great job of taking difficult readings and making them simple. There are two papers each worth 29% but he is willing to help.  I was really intimidated by this class and it ended up being one of my favorites.

Dr. Arnold is one of my favorite professors I have had at TCU. He is really passionate about the subject. The only issue is that regardless of how well you do he will never give you 100% on anything so that makes it a little harder to get an A. Study hard for his tests and include as much information you can. All of the test questions are essay.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Arnold is my favorite professor I've had at TCU; I think everyone should take his political theory class. Two papers make up about 60% of your grade, so do well on those and it's not a hard A. Very interesting and engaging class, Arnold makes sure everyone has their voice heard. Amazing class and professor, I would take it again in a heartbeat.
Great Prof! Definitely recommend. Makes class interesting and very down to earth. Pop quizzes-yikes! 2 papers that are worth a ton (29% each)
Dr. Arnold was the second best professor I've had. HIs classes were interesting and he took a genuine interest in his students. If you worked hard, he rewarded you with an A.

Really tough grader regardless of how often you go in to speak with him regarding your paper. An A is not impossible, just make sure you do well on the two tests (essay questions) and the two papers, doing badly on one will keep you from an A (93.5 for him). Interesting class, though.
I am totally in love with the course content & materials. Professor Arnold is also a great teacher. If you want to make most of this class, then (1) DO THE READING & (2) PARTICIPATE IN CLASS!

Dr. Arnold is by far the best professor I've had at TCU. I took his Honors Intro to Political Theory class and I loved every minute - I'm in his Justice class now. Outstanding lecturer, very helpful, not too hard of an essay grader. Take this class if you have any interest in political science at all.

I am generally not one to participate in class, but Dr. Arnold changed that. The material is so enticing it is impossible not to join the discussion. He offers viewpoints that really stimulate your thoughts. Great class and professor
Professor Arnold is an excellent teacher.  The course material is difficult, but he makes it clear and relevant.  He is accessible and helpful and provides extensive feedback on papers.

Dr. Arnold is fantastic. The class structure makes the material interesting, with a nice mix of lecture and discussion. He provides great feedback on essays. I became a better thinker because of this class.

Dr. Arnold is young, engaging, thought-provoking, and extremely open-minded/empathetic. He loves his job and is good at it. His courses aren't easy by any means but for an upper div poli sci class, I would take him again.

Political theory is complex stuff but he's engaging and though provoking. Only grades are take-home tests and essays. Grading is tough but fair, and he literally writes a letter summarizing your essay and telling you how to improve it. Very nice, helpful, open-minded professor. Do the reading and you'll learn a lot.

Hands down one of the best professors I've had! So intelligent, and really loves his field. He's so helpful, and loves to talk with you about your papers! He's a very hard grader- tends to find things he doesn't find when you're talking with him, but this class is totally worth it.

Shes super sweet, and one of my favorite professors here at TCU. 1 online test, you take in class, and group presentation. Has weekly discussion post due on Sundays, but not difficult at all. Take her!!

She cares a lot about her field, and it shows. The weekly assignments are a drag, but they are very doable. Exams are easy if you listen to her lectures, and the group project is based on concepts learned in class (I recommend working on it once it is assigned). The workload is heavy, but VERY easy.

Very nice woman who really cares about the class and students. The class is fairly easy with a semester long project with some kind of complicated excel stuff but she helps a ton with that and then weekly discussion posts and then an easy mid term online exam with a cheat sheet. She wants you to learn about the topics not worry about the grade

Her lectures are boring but she's nice and very accommodating. 1 online exam (easy), weekly discussion post, and a big group project. She gives easy A for almost every assignment if you puts a tiny bit of effort into completing it. Very lenient grader. Group project and the class in general is heavily data/ people analytics.
Dr. Arendt is my favorite professor. This guy gets so into it. He's the GOAT. Take his class!

Professor Arendt is a good and funny teacher but his class is difficult. Class is straight lecture. Not much homework but multiple papers, weekly quizzes, three tests, and a project. Hard grader and the tests are very difficult.

Lots of work for a core class. 2 tests, 2 book reports, a final project, and a final test. You can only miss 3 classes but not every much is on the slides so you need to go to class. Good lecturer, but a hard grader. There is definitely an easier teacher but his class wasn't impossible.

Arendt is so passionate about what he teaches, which makes it easy to care about the class. He's super accessible and wants to help. Lectures are engaging but he goes fast so stay on top of it. Can be a tough grader but if you're actively going to class and listening you'll be fine. Would definitely take again!

Professor Arendt is a great history teacher. Truly cares about his students and is very willing to help you outside class. Lecture heavy but he makes them engaging. Grades are straightforward and getting an A is very achievable if you are willing to put in some work. Genuinely one of the best history professors I have had.

The class is easy if you show up to class and pay attention during lectures! The slides are accessible online but a lot of what he says isn't on the slides so showing up and paying attention is a key part, you can read the textbook if you don't which has a good amount of the stuff he will lecture on. I highly recommend!

He lowkey graded so much harder then expected. Reading quizzes weren't to hard , they were based on Vocab straight from the book, but he grades the paper and exam kind of hard..
NIce guy but lectures are boring if you don't like history.
Class is mandatory and its super lecture heavy so even with 2 free skips you would miss a lot of content.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is such a nice guy who genuinely cares about teaching and his students learning about history. He grades fairly easy, he wants to give you the points. He wants his students to get a good grade and will work hard to make sure they've learned what they need to succeed. Lecture heavy class, but I think he makes them pretty interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Arendt is a great teacher and super passionate and knowledgable about US history. It is all lecture based but he does a good job of making them entertaining. Gives 2 exams, 2 papers, 1 project, and a final. There are weekly reading quizzes but only based on a textbook vocab list. Going to the lectures is important to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of my favorite teachers. Nicest person ever, he cares so much for his students and wants u to get an A. I hated history before this class but he makes it so interesting i just love him. Pay attention (not hard to). 2 exams, 2 projects, 2 papers, reading quizzes sometimes but NICEST grader + not confusing/hard to study for like other histories

Professor Arendt makes it very easy to earn a good grade. The class grade is based on chapter quizzes, which is basically vocab quiz directly from the textbook, 2 tests, 2 essays, and one project. All are doable if you just pay attention. He wants you to succeed and his PowerPoint don't have words so don't rely on them for all your notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class
