reviews.comment: Great professor, super caring and understanding. His lectures and quizzes are straight forward and easy. Would recommend this class 100% for an easy religion credit.

Professor Feldman is amazing! His classes mainly consist of lectures and presentations, and is graded mainly by quizzes, one midterm, and one final paper. I P/NC the course due to the difficult of obtaining an A, but is fairly easy to earn a B with effort. He's very passionate and has a great sense of humor!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is very understanding and kind. The class is lecture heavy but tests are very easy if you take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Archer was amazing! I would love to take one of his classes again. I took his composition 1 class fall of 2022. The class was super easy, the lectures went by fast, and he made class fun. He's super flexible, grades super easy, and is not strict on grammar. There's little homework and plenty of opportunities for extra credit.

Professor Archer is a really nice guy! The grade is dependent on 4 papers, but I have not felt that this is extremely impactful on the overall grade, he also allows revisions for half points missed. His classes are very simple and he really attempts to improve his course throughout the semester for his students. He is also very approachable!

Prof. Archer's ability to connect with students makes it a class that you want to attend despite attendance not being mandatory. The grade is based on only 5 papers which can be an advantage or disadvantage for students.

Prof. Archer is one of the best guys you will ever meet. His course is very paper heavy, as you will have to do many rhetorical analysis, but he spaces them out so you have ample time. He is very caring and flexible, pushing back due dates if he feels he is putting too much on the students. Took him for ENGL 18083 and haven't had any regrets.
I took Professor Archer first semester of my freshman year and the man is a treasure at TCU. He is what a teacher should be and is aware that the student has things to do for other classes too.

This man is an absolute blessing. He is a great English teacher and really wants to see his students succeed in his class. If your looking for a great first year english class you would be insane not to take this.

Take Daniel. He is writing his masters thesis on gaming... trust me he is the best teacher you could have for Comp 1. Very chill, understands what it's like to be in our shoes, wants nothing but the best for his students. You will not regret it.
Archer is awesome! he's super chill and understandable. there are three essays you have to do and not one of them is difficult. DEFINITELY TAKE HIM!!!

Professor Archer has a great personality. He is reasonable when it comes to workload and is a very funny guy. Probably my favorite teacher since I have been at TCU. Definitely would recommend for everyone!

Professor Archer is an amazing professor, if you are a freshman looking for a good professor who knows what it is like to be in your shoes, take him. Very relaxed class and I was able to still learn a few things. Great Professor!!!!
Best teacher to have. Let you out early a lot. Super chill guy. Fun class

Professor Archer is a gorgeous man, but even more beautiful than him, is his elegant proficiency in teaching English. His caring, joyous, and hilarious teaching style made me actually enjoy English class. Best professor at TCU by a large margin. 10/10 highly recommend!

If you the opportunity to take any class with Pro. Augsburger, do it! Took EA&P with him, extremely knowledgeable about everything KINES. He made his class very hands on, learned so much from his class, and the material stuck with me.

Im only a freshman but I already know Garrett is definitely going to be one of my favorites. He is very knowledgable and knows how to make things easy to understand. He takes into consideration our worries and concern. Although anatomical Kines is a little tough to digest he gives us real world situations to help us fully understand.

Dr. Augsburger is an outstanding professor who truly cares about his students' learning and success. His passion for exercise science is evident in every lecture, and he goes above and beyond to make topics understandable and applicable. I appreciated how he incorporated hands-on learning, real-world examples, and guidance throughout the course.
TAKE HIM!! one of the best professors at tcu, truly cares about his students and want them to do well. I took his anatomical kine class and it was my favorite by far!! 10/10
Garrett is an amazing professor. He cares about his students and will help you succeed. Some of the concepts are hard and require memorizing, but he will help you if you need it.

Garrett is AMAZING! Take his class if you can! He always gives his students a chance to give their feedback on due dates and assignments. He truly cares for his students' success and understanding of the content. Class is never awkward or boring due to the engaging, respectful, and fun environment he creates. I would take his class 100x again!

Garrett slaysssssss. I can't recommend his classes enough. He is super knowledgeable and really wants you to learn and be able to apply his class to whatever profession you want to go into. There are weekly labs which involve assessment of yourself as a patient. The work is really manageable and usually really interesting.
Garrett is a great professor for this class since he owns a company that focuses on making workout programs. Lectures are very interesting and he is very knowledgeable.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: garrett is a slayer! take his class! lectures are easy to understand and most grades come from labs that he allows you to make up half points on, if you miss anything! very knowledgeable and fun!

Take this class with Garrett! He truly cares about his students and is willing to help in any way that he can. He cares about this class and this content and because of that makes the class super engaging and fun. I have learned a lot and it has not been at the expense of my grade. One of the most fun, personable, easy-to-understand profs at tcu!

This is not an easy class and I was able to get an A because I already had background knowledge about the material. However, Professor Boone is very intelligent and is able to explain the course material well. The course material is posted online which makes studying much easier. It is very lecture heavy though, which can get dry.

This class was definitely harder than I expected it to be. I personally wasn't a fan of how she lectured and often found myself more confused after leaving class and had to read the book. That being said, the class isn't impossible. Homework and quizzes help make up for exams (which she gives a lot of partial credit on).

Professor Boone is the best professor you could take for financial management by far. The classes are very lecture heavy, but printing out the powerpoints make it a lot easier to pay attention and take good notes. Homeworks and quizzes are online and lowest grade dropped. She is very accessible outside of class and wants her students to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Smart professor, however, can be pretty rude at times if you ask a question that she finds dumb. She also will stop lecturing and stare at you extremely passive-aggressively if you show up to class even one minute late. Tests sometimes include material that wasn't discussed in class. I wouldn't take her again, even though she teaches pretty well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Finance is a difficult class to take with any professor, but Boone makes it not so bad. She is a little goofy but also does a good job preparing you for what will be on the exams. If you take the time and study and do practice problems on repeat you will do well.

Although this class is difficult and 3 tests make up the majority of the grade, Dr. Boone is a gem. She is obviously very passionate about what she teaches, and will go the extra mile to help students and explain concepts in further detail if needed. I would definitely recommend taking her.

Boone is very knowledgeable and a great resource. However, I found that I had to teach myself a lot of the math problems as she taught in a way that was hard for me to follow. If you are a visual learner, the math will be difficult for you to learn. It is an easy B, but you will have to work for an A.

She is very accessible to help outside of class. However, the class is made harder than it needs to be. She goes over each math problems with words so if you are a visual learner I do not recommend. Had a lot of trouble following problems because of the length of written explanation. Perhaps working the problems on the board would be more helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor to our MBA cohort. Advanced Financial Management is the best course I've ever taken. Dr. Boone is absolutely brilliant and does a great job explaining complex topics in an easy to understand way. Wish she taught more courses for us!
Amazing professor that knows what she's talking about. Real world experience and it shows. Her class is a great opportunity for someone really interested in getting something out of class.

Only grades are (4) hw's, (3) quizzes, and (3) exams. Exams are pretty challenging but its not impossible. I didn't try very hard and I got a B. Her lectures are boring and soemtimes they arent clear, but the subject is not the easiest. She was very nice and cared about the students understanding...I would take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Boone is awesome, she really knows her stuff about finance and if you go over the practice problems she provides before the exams, you'll easily get an A. She also gives you a formula sheet and a note card for the exams. She does have some book homeworks/quizzes but they're easy to get 100% on and she's always willing to help you outside class.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Augustine is one of the best General Psychology professors at TCU. She is very clear in her notes and test reviews. Attendance isn't mandatory, but it is the only way to get the notes. Tests are exactly like the notes, so just study those beforehand. 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: General psych with Augustine is easy. It's all tests and quizzes, and if you want an A you have to go to class and take notes. Lectures aren't posted online, but attendance isn't mandatory.

Very likeable and a good professor. You are only tested over material presented in class on the slides - so go to class (she doesn't upload them online). Offers extra credit through extra SONA studies. She always throws a few jokes into lecture so its not too bad to sit through. 100% recommend for a gen psych class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Augustine was honestly so amazing. Her lectures are long, but she usually has some sort of comedic relief within somewhere in the middle. she is very personable and so nice. I'm not a psych major, but I might take her abnormal psych class just to be in one of her classes again. Definitely take her if you have the chance:)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Augustine is a great psychology teacher. The textbook is not needed as she lectures over the textbook. The best way I found to do well is to have quizlet open during class and write terms and definitions. Study that until it's muscle memory and you'll be golden. Class is fun and interesting topics are covered. Huge extra credit opportunity too!

Easy A, but you have to go to class.I had her for multiple courses and she is by far one of the best professors. She is new, but she is great. She is a great teacher, and gives great lectures. She usually ends classes early.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Augustine's class was very informative, but it's definitely an easy A. She is very funny and has a great personality. Fair warning, she has a really quiet voice, so if she doesn't have a microphone in class, make sure you sit near the front or you won't be able to hear her.

Dr. Augustine was funny and did her best to keep the lectures interesting and entertaining. The class itself is very easy-no homework, no reading, class got out early most days, tests were straight from powerpoints. Make sure you do the research part of the class, some is required and you can get extra credit for doing more!

Very easy class, with no homework or reading, and the tests were really easy and were taken straight from the powerpoint. Got out of class at least 5 minutes early most days, earlier on Fridays. Dr. Augustine is funny and keeps things interesting. If you have the chance, definitely take this class, it's an easy A and you get core credit.

No homework, no textbook, easy tests, and let class out early often! Extremely talented. Notes weren't excessive and they weren't rushed, I always had plenty of time to write. Professor Augustine made every class interesting and I actually looked forward to every one of her classes. One of the best teachers I've ever had!! A true gem!

Nice but not tech savvy at all. Her lectures get derailed and are incredibly boring. She rarely has a clear class plan for the day and gives absolutely no criteria for any group work or projects. Made an A- but it was only because I had to ask a ton of clarifying questions to her personally since she never specified. Overall kind of a pain
Lectures get derailed with fun stories and a bit borrowing but the material is simple, she's very chill, easy to pass the class, test are simple and its only a midterm and final.

Her lectures are extremely boring, but this class is an easy A. She gives a notecard for the tests, which is super helpful. Her quizzes are online. You can get by without the book, but it is helpful for using on the quizzes. From what I have heard about the other ethical business classes, they have to do a lot more work than we do in this class.

Nice lady who is teaching a God-awful course. She is not technologically savvy and is not as sharp as many of the other professors I've taken at TCU. The group project is AIDS, everyone in my class (including my group) had very unimpressive projects and presentations. There may be easier professors, but if she likes you, you'll be A-OK ;)

Do not take. Provides no clear criteria or rubric for group projects, she just says what to do and is very unclear. Does not teach well, asks questions that make no sense and expects the class to understand what she means. Waste of time

Professor Moon is a really caring person, she just doesn't have clear guidelines for the group project. She also does not respond to emails and the MC test is pretty hard. It's pretty easy to get an A on the project, but she does take off points for weird things.

Did not give a rubric for our semester long final presentation. 10 minutes late to every class. No clear grading criteria. Does not respond to emails. Doesn't teach anything and wastes class time and grades extremely slowly. Take literally any other professor, Moon is not worth taking at all.

Professor Moon is a very kind woman. She is soft spoken so it can be a bit hard to hear her. She really tried to get the class engaged and can tell she is very passionate about teaching. The class is a simple structure, online cengage quizzes that are easy, two exams that are medium in difficulty and a semester long group project.

She is a very boring lecturer and mumbles while she talks. Not very good at teaching, but her class is super easy. She does a sign in sheet for attendance. Cengage chapter quizzes all on quizlet and you can study them for the test. Go to the review session before the test because she will tell you what is on it.

She's nice but her class is tedious and she's always confused about what she says. Disorganized and doesn't respond to email, but class workload is pretty chill. Group project and exam essays are graded easily, but exam multiple choices are pretty tough. She gives extra credit for uploading discussion posts too.

Don't believe the bad reviews about Professor Moon. She is a very nice and caring person who wants students to succeed. The class is a bit unorganized but the group project is not difficult and takes up a big portion of the final grade. We don't do very much work in class and listen to the lecture, then outside of class there is little work.

3 weeks into class and want to drop. She is so unorganized and doesn't even know her own schedule. She tries really hard to make class interesting which I respect but there are so many busy work assignments and class lectures are boring.

This is not a difficult class. If you put in the bare minimum, you will get an A. The exam questions are all online. The papers and group project are easy and not time-consuming. However, she is very confusing and boring. Again - you will get an A but be ready for a long semester in her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: For this to be an online course, she was ridiculously inaccessible outside of class. I emailed her several times throughout the semester and did not get a response to a single one (I have peers who did not have this issue though). This was extremely frustrating but I made a decent grade in the class, and it was pretty easy overall.

Do not pay attention to some of these comments as they are very misleading. Professor Moon is amazing really awesome caring professor. Easy, but I did take her over the summer. The only things you need to study are the readings and powerpoints in order to pass. Amazing discussions held in class. I would recommend her over all the ethics professor.
Attendance was "mandatory" but was taken on a random basis. Tests were straightforward but there are pop quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Moon is a great teacher. She really cares about there students and tries her best to make the class interesting, but remember its Business Ethics: It's bound to be a little monotonous. She really enjoys what she teaches and is really participation oriented. Tests are not bad bc she gives a review the class before test day.

Moon is a very nice woman who knows ethics because of how long she has been teaching. Her tests and quizzes are all off of powerpoints that she posts online. The group project is pretty easy as long as you stick to the guidelines. Go to class and study the powerpoints and an A is very achievable.

Mrs. Moon is very nice but obviously not a native english speaker and she can trip up on her words sometimes which can make her explanations hard to understand. I took this class in the summer so there was no textbook and the tests were all based on PowerPoint, with some of the multiple choice questions being tricky. It's really not a bad class.

Moon is honestly a terrible professor. She will repeatedly contradict herself , which makes the class extremely confusing. She does not possess the ability to clearly explain anything. Avoid taking her class if at all possible.

Artemis is an interesting character...she is very difficult to understand because she often has trouble finding the correct words to form complete sentences. English is obviously not her primary language and she's not transitioning well. Nice lady, but her lectures are as boring as they are hard to follow. Did I mention she writes her own tests?

AWFUL! Reads straight from the PPT so class is boring. Under 10 grades total so if you screw up one test/quiz you're kinda SOL. Very unclear about group paper and what will be on tests. Only 2 tests too, so each are over roughly 7 chapters (think of Foundations tests). You're going to have to teach yourself the material, but passable with a B.

Attendance is mandatory, but everything can be learned by looking at the slides online making class boring and annoying. She never finishes her sentences so its hard to understand what she's trying to say. Obvious language barrier. She never explains when she wants things due so everyone is always confused about assignments.

She is one of the most unorganized teachers I have ever had. She is never clear about what is due for the next class. Everyone in class was always confused about what she was asking us to do. Overall this was one of the most frustrating classes I've had at TCU

One of the worst professors when it comes to communicating. Hardly ever know when shes telling you an assignment is due next class & can easily misunderstand whats expected. Sucks at labeling PP on ecollege, boring lecture, hard 2 figure out what will be on test even after she "reviews". avoid if you can but ironically easy 2 pass with atleast a B

great professor,  do not argue with her in class. A bit unclear in what she wants.  Ask questions prepare well for  exams and also ask her to explain if you do not  understand something, getting A is possible. I got a A- , but i showed her my work. Prepare well for the group exposition. She will grade hard on the group job.

BUSI 20153 :She is the nice lady, really care about her student. The 3 hours class is a little bit boring but it's OK. There is no quizes, only 1 group project, some homeworks, and 3 test. Possible to get A or at least B

Ask lots of questions because she is unclear about what she wants. She is nice unless she doesn't like you, and she doesn't like you if you try to argue with her. Seems like a blowoff class, but you have to study and do well on project. No big paper like the other ethics teachers assign
Nice teacher

She's actually pretty nice. Just watch out for the test questions, don't overthink them. To be honest, ethics is subjective and it can be hard on the tests but use principles/ideas talked about in class to support your argument. The group project will help your grade and it's pretty easy. Be sure to talk to her about what she wants, she doesn't say

WORST PROFESSOR AT TCU! She is the most contradicting professor ever. On our writing assignments, she says to write more but we have a certain length the paper has to be! Her tests are impossible. She hates giving out A's. The group project is graded very harshly. Our group spent weeks on it and we got the best grade in the class: an 89.

Professor Moon makes BUSI 71528 much harder than it should be.  I thought the class would be easy but quickly learned that because of the way she teaches, it's not.  She can easily be proven wrong and although she will admit to it sometimes, the subjectiveness of her grading drastically effects your grade.  She could be the most frustrating teacher

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! everything she tells you in class is completely subjective. She takes off for things that are correct and asks opinion questions that ask "what would you do?"... and there is supposed to be a correct answer? JUST DONT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!
This ethics teacher lacks ethics and values. She makes absolutely no sense and contradicts herself. Do not take this professor under any circumstance. She is terrible.
horrible professor. Does not use TCUglobal as much as other professors. She leaves half of the points til finals week so you can have a B before finals and end up w/ a C or D. don't take course.
DO the readings and you will be fine. Class is mostly discussions, can be boring if no one talks but not that bad. Use the terms from class in the homeworks, she looks for that.

I love this little Greek Goddess. And for some reason I think shes kinda cute.  Her accent makes her funny at times, and lets be realistic, how can u teach business ethics for a semester. Everything u learn could be taught over a weekend seminar. Grades fairly easy on Hw. Mult choice on tests are tricky. Id take her over the others teachers though

Good teacher, really likes the subject. Have to go to class she takes attendance. Classes pointless though, she asks a lot of questions and likes discussions. Tests easy if know class powerpoints and readings. Project doesn't require much time, pretty easy.

Pretty easy class, not much material. She's a scatterbrain but her online notes are easy to follow and that's all you need to review for exams (plus the articles)...book's not that important, easy project. She's really helpful outside of class and she lets you go early a lot. Definitely an asy class & shes better than the other ethics profs!

Yes, the class is extremely boring. The first test was hard just because I didn't know what to expect. Answer the questions very bluntly and make sure you use the terms that we discuss in your short response. I would recommend having her go over your first 2 homework assignments.

boring class, easy A, she is confused easily, but almost any answer she will say is correct.  If you get her to point out specific slides and use them to study you will do pretty well.  The project is a joke and you can BS*** your way through it If you cut and paste textbook answers throughout.  Language barrier is a major problem.
Nice lady, get to know her. Class is not that interesting, however go to class to get attendance points.Exams are not hard, if you study the review questions, you should make an "A"
Honestly one of the oddest teachers in the school. Very nice but you can never tell what it is she wants from you, its way beyond the language barrier. I learned more from the speakers then from her.

Has a very good teaching style, and makes it pretty easy for you to make an "A". Yes, classes are boring (i.e. lots of slides), but I would sacrifice it again for a fairly easy "A". Talk to professor Moon outside of class and she will prepare you for the tests.
Study the slides for tests. I liked the subject a lot, but the professor makes it kind of boring. Make sure you talk to her outside of class- she will give you hints about what to study for tests.

Wow, this could very well be the most boring, lazy, Bull**** business class offered. Tests are straight from the book, and you grade depends on the country project, which I don't think she reads. You can take a dump in the middle of the pages and she'll give you a soild B just as long as you do it.
Seriously, if you have this class, GET OUT!  She doesn't speak English, is sooo boring, and her tests are based on absolutely nothing that she lectures on!!!  RUN and run fast!!
Straight from the book, so people who don't study need to take someone else.  Easy if you study.  Quizzes are easy, and she is nice.

Nice lady, pretty easy class.  You will have to study the online slides to get good grades on the tests because the lectures are not very interesting.  Take if you need to lighten your semester with a business elective.

After the last day of class, I went to my car and cried because the class was over. Never in my life have I ever enjoyed a Professor so much. You will certainly learn about how to treat addictions in the course, but along the way he will inspire you to become the best version of you. You leave his class with the confidence you can change the world!

Professor Gregg is absolutely awesome! I learned so much in his classes! He has a really fun teaching style. He teaches in really engaging ways. I learned a ton of useful stuff. He shows how things connect to each other. I left inspired every week! He mixes in jokes and can explain complex things! Highly recommend his classes!

Dr.Gregg is AMAZING. He is very inspirational. 4 group assignments that aren't too difficult. Lots of opportunities for extra credit. Only one permitted absence. Open note final exam. Lectures aren't boring. Would highly recommend taking him. As long as you complete the work, you're guaranteed an A.

This is the single best professor I've ever had in my life. This class honestly changed my life. I walked away genuinely inspired and genuinely prepared to be a therapist. Absolutely top tier professor!

Take ALL of his classes! He will blow your mind with the way he teaches the material. He makes it meaningful and unforgettable. You will leave these classes a better therapist and a better person. Despite being incredibly smart, he presents in a way that inspires your soul. Incredible professor. Life changing professor! LOVED this class!!!!

Professor Gregg is a different breed of professors. He has a laid back style and can present on complicated topics in a way that is very easy to understand. He's quick to add in a few jokes along the way, which makes the class very enjoyable. He's one of the best professors I've had and highly recommend taking his classes.

His Addictions class was one of the best courses I've taken in my MSW program. He has a laid back style in the classroom which makes it easy for us to talk, discuss, and interact. His lectures are entertaining and he is quick witted which makes the three hours pass by quickly. Highly recommend this professor you wont be disappointed!

I literally heard about Professor Gregg's class in undergrad and chose TCU for my masters degree in social work just to take his classes, AND THEY DID NOT DISAPPOINT! He has real world experience that he brings to his lectures. He's also very personable, pretty funny, and engaging. HIGHLY recommend taking ANY class he teaches! 10/10 recommend.
TAKE THIS CLASS! It was seriously the easiest/most interesting class I've taken at TCU so far. Gregg is the best and he is so understanding. Take this class, and I promise you will not regret it.

I honestly may have learned more in this class than in my actual major classes. He has real-world experience and brings those examples to every class. He's also pretty funny. This class flew by and I honestly enjoyed it. Would take it again. If you ever read this Professor Gregg, thanks for everything!
Professor Gregg is undoubtedly one of the best professors I've had in my undergraduate degree. His class is enjoyable as well as easy to pass. I definitely recommend him for any class he teaches!

One of the best classes I've ever taken. Highly recommend anyone to take any of his classes. He is hilarious and extremely sharp. Presents difficult material in a way that's understandable. I actually attended every 3 hour lecture and looked forward to it every week!

Don't buy the book, you won't need it. Lecture slides cover all necessary material. Review days cover all material on the exams. The final consists of a group project writing a research paper. Grading is very fair, and classes are usually not the full 3 hours in length. I would highly recommend this class!
He made a 3 hour lecture at night my favorite class! He is a great man and teacher. He does everything he can to make the class non stressful.
Very understanding and is very well versed in many literary areas. Very helpful with writing tips and publishing information.

I have made A's in every other literature class in college. I read all the stories and participated in class, but still received a C. She will not change grades on the test even if you look up the right answer and show her. Terrible class and teacher.

First the first part of the semester, she would just stand up at the front and drone on about the stories she assigned.  The second part she sat at the back of the classroom and let the students present power points over the stories.  Participation is key in her class!  She'll either pass or fail you on that alone.

She is very unclear about what she wants from you and even if you give her what she says she wants, she will find a way to mark you wrong and is NOT willing to compromise in the least. This is the worst class I have taken at TCU and advise everyone to avoid classes from her.

She is a sweet lady. But she does not give you clear expectations on the tests. Tests are one short answer question and a take home essay. I had no clue what she was looking for on the tests! DO NOT TAKE HER. She is not willing to help either.

Tarver is a sweet lady but I don't recommend her class. You do have to do the reading and she will call you out in class if you aren't paying attention. She asks random questions and calls on people so do the reading and be prepared to talk about it, because you will have to. She is VERY vague with what she says and won't answer questions clearly.

OH MY GOOD LORD DO NOT, WHATEVER YOU DO, TAKE THIS HER CLASS. I took MAW with her and I wanted to scream every day I went into this class. She is not at all clear about how she gives you your final grade and her tests seem like they are going to be easy? Lies. Hardest English test I've ever taken & English is my major.
She does not communicate well, or clearly state her expectations, or how she grades.

DO NOT TAKE HER - take someone, ANYONE else. She is extremely vague and it is IMPOSSIBLE to get a straight answer out of her, yet she will always disagree with anything you say. The highest grades students get on tests are Bs - many fail. My entire class grew extremely frustrated when she refused to answer our questions about the tests. AWFUL PROF.

i hate her. Just spare yourself from her class. It is not worth it-you will learn absolutely nothing. She is horrible when it comes to grading because nobody know what the hell she is doing (and then she will not explain it to you). Your grade at best will be a C. WORST CLASS EVER. It is impossible!!

I took Major American writers. Her class is impossible. If you ask for help she'll try to help you, but she is very unclear on what she wants. She is seriously the worst professor I've ever had in my life. It doesn't matter how much you learn-you will most likely fail. Don't put yourself through this class. She is THE WORST prof you could take!!!

This teacher is extremely easy when it comes to work, but don't be fooled, you will probably fail her class due to her ridiculous methods for grading.  She acts all sweet, but she will count as much wrong as physically possible.  She is also a teacher that will avoid you and your questions so you can never learn what she wants and how to be prepare

DO NOT TAKE IT. I had a 4.0 and I got a 50 something on the first exam. EVEN IF YOU LOVE ENGLISH DO NOT TAKE IT! Worst class I've ever been through. Everyone is taking it pass/fail. Oh, and she wont help you if you ask for it.

If you saw her office you'd understand...  It's SO cluttered!  There are two desks crammed in that sardines can of an office with papers, files, and books piled halfway to the cieling.  hated advising with her.  good luck...

She does not know how to teach at all. In fact, she usually makes her students get up in front of the class and teach it for her. Her answers to your questions are very vague; I never had any idea what she wanted from me. My entire class got C's on all our papers. Please spare yourselves from this boring class. You can't win no matter what you do.
Do Not Take This Class!! It is all essay and her prompts are very unclear as to what she wants, and she is not very helpful when you ask. This was probably the worst class I have ever taken.

I really enjoyed this class and Ms. Tarver..she is the sweetest old lady! You don't always have to be prepared to class and it is all class discussion. Her essays aren't so much graded on grammar as much as interpretation. If you can't interpret a novel than you will not do good on the essays.

Very nice lady, but an incompetent professor. Unclear class ran by students' discussion. On the essays, no matter how well you argue your point, as long as she doesn't agree with you then she won't grade you very high.  She is biased.  Consider taking another prof for English.

This was the worst class i have taken at TCU. She is very unclear, takes forever to grade and take role. Her tests are unbelievably hard, even when you put 5 examples to prove your point, if she doesnt agree with you its an automatic C-. Avoid at all costs!!!!!!!

Possibly the worst professor that I have had at TCU so far. She is a nice lady, but her teaching style does not work for me (or for anyone else in my class). She grades hard on tests, and takes forever to hand them back. Be prepared to teach the class- she often makes students teach more than she does. I don't suggest taking this. Take something el
This is the worse class I have taken so far. I don't understand anything she teaches. Nice lady but the class just sucks. Don't ruin your semester by taking her classes!
She took a long time to return things to us. Nobody had any idea what was going on in class.
No Comments

She is a very nice lady who is very interested in literature.  However,she is often vague and her tests are equally vague.  Do not take her class if you are really into English because you will be disappointed.

I don't think you really understand how bad her class is... absolutely the worst class I've had in college. I am a good writer and I got C's on my papers because I didn't agree with her. Nothing in class is on the exams, and yes, it took her over a month to get each paper back to us. Please don't put yourself through this class.

I do not recommend this class at all!  She does not tell you anything during class, and leaves all discusion up to the students.  Her tests come from her opinions which you will never know.  Very hard...however she is a sweet lady, not a good teacher.
I do not like her

Always late to class. She doesn't teach, instead, has students come to the front of the class and ask questions while all she says is "Oh, how interesting!" Tests are very vague. Nothing ever mentioned in class is ever on the tests. Nice lady, but horrible for a professor.

It's a great class if you enjoy reading fiction. Most students struggle with her tests because they don't understand that she's NOT looking for personal opinions or they're stupid. She wants students to be able to follow the language and  interpret what the words mean...NOT OPINIONS!

Don't take her.  You have to agree with her opinion, she doesn't help you at all.  She is so slow,it's boring and she won't tell you want she wants.  You wait months to get a paper back and then you get bad grade because you didn't know what to include.
The nicest professor I'm met at tcu! so sweet, very helpful if your having trouble. lots of reading, but not that bad if you pace yourself.

shes such a sweet lady but you do the same exact thing every day and theres NO guidance on the papers. she loves english but the class is really boring and she either likes you or she doesnt and that determines the grade. and you get soooo far behind.....

class is very unstructured and she never clarifies what she wants out of her essay only tests, even in if specifically ask.  U'll prolly pass if u speak up in every class and agree with her unless u have at least 5 pts to back up ur counter arguement.

Only do well if you agree with her opinion.  Rephrases your answers to fit her agenda.  More a multicultural class with a lot of essays instead of novels.  Hard to follow and not very organized. Never know what to expect each, class she falls behind.
I really enjoyed her classes. She encouraged independent thought and fostered an appreciation of the subject matter. That's what makes a good teacher. She was one of the best I had at TCU.
okay class..some good books--and she's the nicest woman.  Yet, you never know what the hell she expects--flighty too
She doesn't like boys.  If a boy and a girl would have the same answer, the boy would get it wrong.  Expects a lot of class participation and tests are completely essay.  Don't recommend.

Great professor! Dr. Atwood works from an outline that he puts on the board before class so he stays on topic. I found him to be very entertaining, but only because I love dry humor. Coming to class every day is crucial to get all of the notes (a lot). For tests, focus on the vocabulary terms from the book that he lists out on the study guides.

Dr. Atwood is an excellent professor. Attendance in his class is mandatory, however he is very understanding if you miss a class with a good reason. His lectures range from interesting to eh..not so much. The assigned readings are a must do if you wish to pass with any semblance of a good grade in his class.

taught in a very unorganized and usless style. did not tell you how class was graded. tested on ridiculous terms as oppose to important ideas of Religion. unless you want to learn about his kids but be tested on nonsense, don't take this class

Dr. Atwood was a great teacher to have. He knows his stuff really well. Class is designed around a lecture frmat, with the majority of tst material from class which makes attendance manditory. Big part of calss is vocab from diff religions. Know the vocab and go to class and you'll do fine. 3 tests and 1 optional paper determine the grade.

Dr. Atwood is a wonderful man & great teacher! I loved going to clas & listening 2 his lectures. However tests are VERY hard. There are 3 tests total & 1 optional extra credit paper. What makes the tests so hard is how much info they cover; it's difficult to memorize so much at once & the vocab words very similar; must go 2 class its apart of grade
dude is a great teacher, go to class and you will be fine.  hard to make an A, but very possible, just study a little before the test.
Great class. Amazing professor. I wish more professors taught like him. Don't miss an opportunity to take his class!
No Comments
Interesting class just be sure and read and follow the study guides.  The class isn't hard, just show up and take notes and you'll be fine!!
The first part of the semester can drag on, but it gets better. The class is easy enough. I have a 98 and got to exempt the final. But I worked for it.

Dr. Atwood is a very thorough teacher. The first 1/3 of the semester is spent talking about the defintion of religion and is very hard to get through but if you make it through that the rest is fun. His tests are pretty easy as long as you read the book and do the study guides. His lectures are fun.
He is a great teacher.  He makes the class very interesting.  If you study your notes and look up the terms in the book, the class isn't bad.  He is one of the best teachers here at TCU!

He is one of those guys that after you meet you think "wow, that is one amazing man".  His class is based on actually showing up and taking notes. However, he is very clear with how he structures everything, giving studyguides for the homework readings and telling exactly how his tests are set up.
I would say his class is a tad boring, but very straightforward. There are 3 test and thats it and thye require studying but they are mainly multiple choice. He is a good choice for religion!

Dr. Atwood is no doubt a difficult teacher but he is a great one.  His lectures are to the point and he is also quite humourous.  But what really makes him an awesome professor is his willingness to talk to his students at any time.  He WANTS you to do your best and will help out in any way he can.
very good teacher!! very easy to follow and take notes with. you have to read the book, go to class and take notes. you have to study. it is a hard class but pretty interesting

This teacher was terrible. His class was extremely hard and studying did me no good. I studied 14-19 hours for every test and still didn't make above a 70! He is a good teacher but you will not make an A in his course. It's just crappy! 3 test. THAT'S it!
He is so easy! There are NO paper and NO reading...all you do is take the notes! I HAVE AN A!
His test are way trickey unless you really know the material. You MUST read the books to pass.

He doesn't use any form of technology. He doesn't use power points or TCU Online so if you miss something covered in class you better get it from someone. Theres no way to see what your grades are online so yo can't tell where you are in the class. He also talks super quickly but also very monotonously and quietly and it's hard to hear him in class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Only have 3 grades in the class which are all tests. Does give the option of an extra credit essay. No quizzes or homework

Dr. Atwood is very interesting to listen to and he's such a kind professor who really cares about his students. I thoroughly enjoyed his world religions class. The class was just 3 exams and an optional paper. If you show up to class and write down what he says to write down, the class isn't difficult at all. Would recommend this man certainly

Just 3 tests & an optional paper if you need it to boost your grade. Such a sweet man who lectures the whole class with adorable dad jokes mixed in. He puts everything you need to know for the test on the board or in his reading guide, so if you take notes, look up the terms, and study a night or two before you can get an A no problem.

Great guy! So nice and wants you to succeed, but his teaching style is just talking at you. With such a monotone voice it's really hard to focus and he can kinda jump around topics making notes a little messy. Along with that, you HAVE to read the textbook cause he will throw questions at you that you've never heard before. Tough class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Easy way to get religion requirement. 2 tests and a final all weighted equally or 3 tests and a paper if you choose. All you have to do is show up to class and take notes over the terms he presents during lecture. These are the exact terms on the tests. Gives you 5 essay prompts that of which 1 will appear on the test. Great teacher!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Great professor. Funny, wise, and easy class. Only three exams or optional 3 exams and essay, you choose. Tells you what you need to know for exams, and to remember ALL key terms. Only studied the night before and I got A's on all my exams. Great guy teaching a surprisingly interesting course. Take him for your RELI requirement.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor.  Easy to communicate with.  Pay attention and write down the terms from the board and pay attention.  Not any outside work.  Do really well on the first 2 tests and then you won't have to take the final.  I got a 95 and 98 on my tests without studying that much and don't have to take the final.  Take him for your religion.

Dr. Atwood is a fantastic professor, tests are very manageable if you study the terms on the board and the terms on the studyguide and think about the essay questions beforehand you will pass easily. His tests cover a lot of material so don't take them lightly, but if you put in the time you can get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Jim Atwood is an amazing professor, he is always willing to go over anything that you didn't understand. Only three tests so you have to study hard for them but doable.

Sects & Cults; I absolutely loved his class. He is a fun professor, and he is more than willing to meet outside of class. Make sure to the readings and go to class because his tests can be tricky if you haven't studied. However, the class was very interesting and so that makes it all worth it.

Although I found Dr. Atwood to be an interesting, fun teacher, I found the class next to impossible. There were questions on the testing things i had never seen before. Reading is a MUST. If you talk to him and let him know where your coming from he wil do his best to help.

He is such a good teacher and I find the class interesting! However, you do need to go to class, but when you go to class the course isnt too hard. He only has 3 tests, but for each tests he gives you 6 optional essay questions and one is on the test. I loved him!

Sects & Cults: Dr. Atwood is a magnificent professor. He expects you to put forth your best effort. He has a great sense of humor. You do have do the assigned readings in order to perform well on his tests, which are essay responses. Very interesting class. Take it.

I loved this class! It was very interesting material and the professor knows his stuff. You have to go to class and pay attention or else you will find this class hard. All his questions on the test are based on material from class. But he is always willing to help, and it very understanding. He grades on three tests and one optional paper.

Dr. Atwood is the BEST! He is an amazing man & I loved going to class to hear his lectures. However, be ready to study. Religion is hard no matter who you take, but I highly suggest Atwood. This was one of my hardest classes at TCU, but one of my favorites because I learned so much from Dr. Atwood. You must buy the book & you must come to class.

AMAZING PROFESSOR! Best class I have ever taken. It is hard to get in because it fills up immediately. Information was fun and exciting, he presented everything clearly and wrote out an outline along with key terms. Tests are flexible, allowing you to demonstrate knowledge in specific areas that you enjoyed/ understood well. Dr. Atwood is AMAZING

I really don't know how this prof is rated  high. The way he organizes his class is terrible, only 3 tests, so if you mess up on 1 you're screwed. Rambled and rambled about unimportant facts. I really enjoy humanities and learning about different cultures, so this class was very disappointing. My GPA is a 3.65 so it's not as if I'm an incompetent.

LOVED him, HATED his tests. Great guy. Hard class. Must attend all classes. Takes roll & knows everyone's name. 3 tests, extra credit paper (not easy e.c., much research required.)Enjoyed listening to his lectures but tests are AWEFUL!! Must read books. Overall, awesome person, dreadful tests!!

Dr. Atwood is awesome!!! Take him for religion. His lectures are very interesting. To be successful, know the terms on the study guides and on the board, and know all his essays. If you have a high A, you don't have to take the final!!!! He rocks.
Very nice guy. Write down everything he puts on the board (esp. the key terms), do the study guides, and read the book (if your one of those people). Good class, I learned alot.
Atwood is great. He keeps you interested for the whole class time. Book not used much, explains all terms. Terms are heavily used on test. Is willing to help for anything.

SO nice!  Interesting class.  Gives study guides for each religion discussed in class.  Three tests, optional paper to help grade.  Keep an A and good attendance before final and exempt.  Definitely recommend him!

Dr. Atwood is a great professor! Pretty easy class. Go to class, take notes; he gives possible test essay questions.Gives study guides for readings-know the terms and you don't really have to read much. If he keeps his policies the same: gives option of research paper to help grade and if you have an A going into the final, you are exempt from it!

Dr. Atwood was the best professor ever! If you study the definitions that he outlines for you and review the essay questions that he gives you in advance, then you will have no problem in the class. He is EXTREMELY nice, knows what he is talking about, and always willing to talk
His lectures are easy to take notes from.  I never read the book and made a B, if you read, its an easy A.

Had Atwood for World Religion and it was the best class I took this semester! He repeats the things that will be on tests and gives great study guides. If you pay attention in class, take good notes, and look the vocab for each chapter you will do fine! He's a great professor and very helpful!!!! I got an A in this class. Tests are pretty easy too.

Repeats everything that he says, talks in loops, should have stayed in business and not gone for his religion doctorate and then started teaching.  I have to get an A so I am working, but it is a lot of work for a world religion class, good luck and I am sorry.
Gosh: Dr. Atwood is one of the most amazing teachers I have ever experienced.

GREAT teacher! he really knows what he is talking about and cares about your grades. He allows an extra credit paper that i got a 95 on! the tests are hard, and you have to study, but it's worth it, i learned alot! GO TO CLASS! He notices, and talk to him after! He is very willing to help you out!

He's a great teacher!! Don't worry what others say you don't have to devote your life to this class!! You have to read a little for the first test but I didn't read much and did great in the class. . .always he's a nice, funny guy and talks about his little boys (tells stories about them)
Atwood is very engaging.  He seamlessly incorporates humor into his lectures and challenges students to think critically.  He's also a really good guy.
Yeah... one word... NO    I am an A/B student yet carry a D in his class... unless you plan on dedicating your life to his class only, don't take this class.  BORING and HARD

Great teacher, and a great man.  So insightful, go by and just talk to him, he's interesting to listen to.  He genuinely cares, wants to know his students.  Class is an easy B, but a hard A because the grading scale is 91-100 as an A.  Worth taking though, I've learned a lot.

the most well spoken teacher that i have had at tcu to date.  he loves what he is doing and knows more than you can imagine.  wants you to do well and ask questions.  go to class and you can do well!  read and you will do great!
Jim brings together faith and reason like no prof I have in college.  I loved his insight as well his love for students.

amazing teacher, lots of notes but draws straight from them for the tests which are all essays. two papers that he does not grade that hard and an overall very interesting class, my favorite at tcu by far
Good teacher!! loved his class.  wasnt the easiest in the world but very fun teacher, enojoyed his class.

lots and lots of notes.  three tests, but he gave an optional paper to count as a 4th.  he trys to present the info in a pretty straight-forward manner.  only occassionally was his bias apparent.  i was interested in the info, so i enjoyed the class.

Dr. Atwood is extremely intelligent. He ALWAYS cites his sources too--very scholarly.  He proved to me that religon scholars could be social scientists.  However, do the readings if you want an A--tests are relatively mild if you do; lots of notes too.
He's a great teacher.  He's entertaining and informative.  I really learned a lot from him.  Two thumbs up!
AWESOME TEACHER IF YOU  DO WELL ON FIRST TWO TESTS YOU DONT HAVE TO TAKE FINAL, LIKE ME!

really good teacher! always was clear, and its an easy B, at least.  just come to class take notes and know the key terms.  you don't really have to read the book, just the terms that he gives you from there.  he is funny, but somewhat of a smartalic!!!

He is one of the greatest profs. i've ever had. Always making sure you know clearly what he's saying.  BUt make sure you NEVER miss class, ALWAYS ask questions if your confused...if you know the key terms, your golden!
you take tons of notes, he is not always clear on what he wants you know, you have to study a lot for test, cant miss class ever!! he is a good guy

Dr. Atwood is easily the best professor I've had at TCU. He's willing to talk to you about anything you want. World Religion is pretty easy, but Sects and Cults can be tough, but both are definitely worth taking. You're missing out if you haven't had him.
His class was easy, informative and interesting.  I definitely recommend it.

Dr. Atwood is awesome.  Yes he's going to make you study, but at least you can understand him and his voice level doesn't spasm like Lahutsky.  He's always available to talk to, and if you do well on his tests you don't have to take the final.
He sucks!  I would not recommend taking him at all if you want a life during the semester
She has very high expectations for the material from class, but she does not do a great job explaining things.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: SO easy, just sit in class and you will get an A, you dont need to take any notes just listen, easiest A ever

She is hilarious during lessons. Easy A class if you participate well enough. Attendance matters. I understand that there will be people who don't like to be callout during classes, but she only does that when the class is loud and there were people chatting.Very interesting lectures too.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class isn't necessarily fun but it is easy and the quizzes are all take home. She wants her students to succeed

Easy fine arts credit! The plays can be hard to follow, and she does call on people randomly. Definitely show up she takes 10 points off your participation if you miss. Quizzes aren't too bad, and the two extra credit chances help a ton. Overall, I ended with over a 100 if you pay attention and do extra credit you'll be fine!
Kind lecturer and easy class
This class is pretty easy. I never paid attention or read the plays so I didn't do well on some of the quizzes but she gives lots of extra credit which makes up for it.

This was a super easy fine arts credit. All quizzes and tests are open note and take-home. I really enjoyed most of the plays we watched/read as well. She does call random names to answer questions and takes attendance every day. I definitely recommend Penn for an easy fine arts.

Professor Penn is super funny and very understanding if you communicate. Her survey of MT class is very laid-back and does not require any studying at all. You have to purchase one book that you can get off Amazon for cheap. You watch a lot of films/movies. Take her class!

Professor Penn is very caring and loves for her students to interact within the class. She lets students have 2 extra credit opportunities for attending a play and writing a short essay over it. This class is very easy and Professor Penn is great. Don't know why she has any bad reviews... All tests and quizzes are open note. Take her!

Professor Penn is a great professor. The content of her class is super interesting and she makes sure to stop and make sure you understand what's going on in each piece of material before moving along. She gives you two opportunities for extra credit and all quizzes are online. Very strict on attendance but as long as you show up you'll be good.

Professor Penn loved to hear herself talk and was such a bummer. I hated going to this class. The way she talks to students makes you feel like you are a third grader. She yells at people if she thinks they aren't listening to her boring lecture. This is such a joke of a class and she knows that.

Professor Penn is so caring and sweet. You can tell she is very passionate about theatre. She is very strict about attendance and getting a letter for a missed class. She also pulls names out of a bucket, which is not great. The class is overall very easy as long as you show up and say something if you get called on.

Definitely an easy class. Professor Penn does pull names out of a bucket for participation and if you don't have an answer you will lose points, but there is lots of opportunity for easy points. All the tests/quizzes are at home and online.

Penn is a passionate professor, but too strict. She is not lenient at all with deadlines. She cares a lot about the course, but too much to the point where it does not seem as though she understands the students have lives outside of school. The course itself is not too bad, I would just recommend another professor.

This is a fairly easy class as long as you show up and pay attention. You watch a lot of plays but she'll stop the play to ask questions, and she picks your name out of a bucket. All of her tests are take-home and pretty easy.
You just need to go to class and pay attention to get an A. There's tables to complete for every play we watch/read but other than that it's pretty easy. I highly recommend.

You can't miss many classes to keep an A. Extra credit def recommended (going to see school plays). All plays watched/read cover race and gender topics. Pulls names out of bucket for participation. Condescending. Large class sizes. Make sure you turn in assignments on time, no mercy for late work.

Professor Penn is overall an easy professor. The only things is that she draws names out of buckets for participation and if you aren't there to answer, you get -25 points for your attendance grade. She is condescending to her students and tries to make people feel dumb. She shows plays on controversial topics like race and gender.

Professor Penn is extremely passionate about theatre, but she understands that the majority of her students take the class as an easy core. If you show up, participate, and do the homework, this course will be very easy. She picks names out of a bucket so make sure you come to class or your participation grade will suffer.
The class is easy and if you do all the assignments you will easily get an A so not super stressful.
This class was okay. You only need a 90 for an A which is super manageable and saves you a lot of time, but beware the class has Shakespeare and covers a lot of racial/gender topics.

Attendance is not required but if you get called on while absent she will subtract participation points.

If you show up, participate, and do the homework this course will be extremely easy for you. She calls names out of a bucket and if you get called on and aren't there, your participation grade will suffer. Other than that, homework is easy and she gives tons of extra credit.
Penn is rude and makes you feel stupid. also she uses a bucket of names and randomly calls on people. its terrifying.

Took class fall semester and was pretty easy. As long as you pay attention during class youll get the answers. Exit responses and quizzes are mainly all true-false questions. The actual class isn't terrible, just do the exit responses & read directions carefully- she grades tough (esp on discussion questions). Quizzes are confusing. survey of theatre was pretty easy. professor penn requires an exit response for every class which isnt hard but is a big chunk of your final grade. the discussion responses are a pain to write but she grades them easy. at the end of the semester you have to do a 4-5 min monologue in front of the class so beware if you dont like public speaking

Easy fine arts credit, would recommend Prof Penn. Her curriculum tied together throughout the semester. We had exit responses after every class which ended up being a significant part of the grade so watch out for those. Assessments also varied throughout the semster from essay questions to multiple choice.

Prof. Penn tries just a bit too hard for this to be an intro class. You can tell she is very passionate about the subject which is fine but makes the class way harder than it needs to be. I love Dr.Barth and would take any class he teaches. This class was more than I bargained for but its ok. If you need psych elective, take it and be cool with a B. Barth is the sweetest guy though and I really would recommend taking any of his classes.

Class is extremely boring and hard to pay attention.  Tests are not too hard but must attend class to do well.

Parapyschology- this class is awesome and so interesting..he only offers it in the summer.  Make sure you read the book he gives you because theres one test on it and you have to know everything about it.  Its the most fun class ive ever taken!

Barth's lectures are kind of boring and don't really apply to anything else your studying but just go anyway for the 100 quiz grade.

easiest class i have taken in my life. i think my kindergarten class was harder. labs are super easy doesnt even take the full time, i always finished an hour early. exams are literally so easy js memorize the info in the slides and you will get 100. doesnt use plus or minus so 90 above is A. js take him if you want a free A.
Bro is the best teacher here. He is literally walter white.
gives quizzes every other week.

This class was perfect even though I was not a student athlete. He made every content day interesting, and we kept up with current NIL events which was awesome.

When you hear his classes fill up quick, they really do! Way too fast! I've taken two of his classes and they surpassed every expectation. Class is very well structured and you learn a lot.

Banos' class was unique because of the learning environment he created through humor, real life examples, and promoting self-accountability. One of the best (if not THE best) classes I've ever taken. Real world and real life stuff. I learned so much. Always looked forward to being in class. Not an easy class, but not hard. Work is very doable if you keep up with the pace that Banos suggests. Highly recommend it to everyone. Very thankful I had a chance to be in his class.

The BOMB! He is so chill and actually fun. Even though attendance is not really mandatory, I would still find myself actually looking forward to going to his class because it was so fun every time. The class is basically just a semester long individual project about yourself. Take this class. You shoot nerf guns for extra credit.

I don't think I have had a professor that genuinely cares for each and every one of his students more than Banos. No exams, couple of projects, fun and interactive classes. Best professor for this course for sure.

Honestly, best professor at TCU. I took his new venture development class and his nil class. Always looked forward going to class. One of the best, if not the best classes I've taken. Professor Banos is very knowledgable, understanding, and makes his classes very engaging. Professor Banos is one of the best professors at TCU. His class was life changing. Professor Banos is truly an amazing professor with years of actual experience. He brings all of that into every class. His energy and joy for teaching are contagious.
