He understands the subject so well that E[β̂₁]~β₁ is crystal clear to him, but greek to his students without explanation of the symbols. This is the simplest ex I had, but he'll do this on higher levels. So it was hard for me to grasp concepts.

Bista is great at posting everything about the course and upcoming assignments. He is fair and all quizzes and tests have zero surprises. If you aren't in class to take notes his slides won't help much. But he doesn't actually teach great and doesn't speak plainly, he talks like a high IQ professor cliche. Teaches as if you already know everything

International Trade was not the most difficult class I've taken at TCU, but it definitely wasn't the easiest. The only grades in the class are quizzes and tests and you always tend to do slightly worse than you think. He isn't an awful teacher of the material but sometimes his approach can seem over-technical and gets confusing.

Econometrics is hard, but Professor Bista does everything he can so you can understand the subject. He posts all his materials on D2L and quizzes are open notes. The best econometrics teacher at TCU by far.

I dreaded taking econometrics, but Dr. Bista made the class super interesting. The class itself is definitely hard and sometimes the lectures can be overwhelming, but Dr. Bista makes sure everyone has a clear understanding of each concept - if not he is easy to communicate with outside of class and constantly shows he cares for his students.

Overall a good professor. Definitely very knowledgeable and you learn a lot in econometrics with him. I won't say it's easy, but that's the nature of the material. I would take him again and he's a great communicator - always emails quickly and clearly. As good as Dr. Bista is, if you don't HAVE to take econometrics, I see no reason to
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Bista is a fantastic professor who is very clear about what is required and how to succeed in his class. He communicates constantly through email so you always know what's going on. He tends to move very quickly so make sure you print out the Powerpoint presentation before class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I didn't expect a fiction class to change how I see the world, but it did. We talked about fiction but also real stuff. Prof actually cares about what you think and pushes you to go deeper. Not an easy A but totally worth it. No quizzes, 3 projects, group work, extra credit. She gets it if life happens, but don't slack. You'll grow if you show up.

Mrs P is a great proffessor, you do have to earn your grade. She does want you to succeed and is someone that will try to understand you. She really helped me while I was going through some struggles.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was one of the most eye opening I took. Ms P makes you feel heard no matter where you come from. The readings are sometimes hard but really push you think way past high school stuff. Talk to her if u r goin thru stuff. The bad reviews here sound like venting for personal reasons. If u want to learn and b treatd like adult, take this one.

I really liked this class Learned a lot about fiction and how it connects to race, gender, and identity today. Ms. Biswas really cares and helps you grow. You gotta work to earn your grade. it's not the easiest class, but you'll learn a lot from it and she's there to help you the whole way. made me think about things I never thought about before

She is very difficult understand and seems to be very clueless on many things. She also is a very slow grader and there are not many grades in the grade book and she is a very harsh grader, especially is she doesn't like you. Tried to show our class explicit content and steered away from a lot of the coursework to teach other things.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You cant understand what she is saying. She never answers questions clearly leaving the class curious about what any assignments mean. She comes at you very defensively if you don't participate even though some people aren't comfortable public speaking. tried teaching our class about LGBTQ and showed explicit movies when its a FICTION class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This class is the best LT elective for an easy A. I took her for her Fiction class and you can get through the entire class by summarizing the books from ChatGPT. 3 Projects but all very easy and grades super easily! No homework otherwise. As long as you participate once per class, she will like you and give you good grades. Mandatory attendance
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Loved Ms. Biswas! Course was very manageable and she helps you along the way. I had some bumps during the semester but I communicated and she was very understanding. More visual lectures which were very helpful. Do the work, put in the effort and ask for help when you need it = easy A+. Did not struggle whatsoever. She's very kind and approachable!
Super easy class. She is super passionate about inclusion. Very elementary class. Boosted my GPA with minimal effort just have to appeal to what she is saying. have to go to class

Ms. Biswas was a very caring and kind teacher for Intro to Comp. The class was composed of 4 big projects that were all very manageable. She is very helpful, understanding, and easy to go to with concerns. She definitely wants all of her students to succeed. I would for sure recommend her, especially compared to other professors I have heard about.

Take Ms. Biswas. This class was easily structured with 3 projects throughout the year. All of the projects are easy to do and easy grading. She's very helpful when it comes to assignments. This lady is so kind. I emailed her at the end of the semester with a concern of my grade and she revised it. Go to class and you'll do great!

I took Ms. Biswas during my first semester of my freshman year for intro to comp. While the content of the class is very straight forward and the work is easy, the class experience in general is very poor. She sticks way to much to the planned time and often cold calls. Additionally she can be very condescending. Take another professor for 10803.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Ms. B is one of the sweetest humans I've ever met. I 100% recommend taking her intro to comp class. She gives 3 major projects throughout the semester, all incredibly straight forward and easy to follow. Classes go by very quickly, and she's a very easy grader and gives great feedback. Could not say more amazing things about this women!

You'll have to teach yourself everything in class. It blows my mind that this guy is the department chair! He never posted a single grade in D2L, not ever, I never saw my for anything except tests which you have to be in class to see your grade when he returns them. Never anything posted to D2l, I'm sure this has got to break some TCU rules.

Bizjak is all over the place as a lecturer, and he assumes you know things that you really don't know. That being said, the class really isn't that hard, the exams are just like the homework/practice problems. If you have a decent understanding of algebra and accounting then you'll be fine in this class. I'm sure there are worse fin man professors.

Dude's lowkey schizo, never seems to know what going on. Doesn't put any grades in d2l. Lectures are almost incoherent with the way he teaches. I don't even know what else to say about him but take someone else if you can!

Bizjak is a goofy guy who cares about his students, but I would not say he is a good teacher. His thoughts are all over the place and does not put any grades in the grade book until after the final exam. For the 2 exams and final, I would study the practice problems he gives and the homework problems as well. You may have to teach yourself...

Like others have said, Bizjak is all over the place. lectures are not clear and he gets annoyed when he cold calls and students don't understand. Exams aren't awful bc he posts review problems that are very similar to how he asks questions on the exam, plus you get a notecard. But I do not recommend. Take someone else if you can!!!

This class was the worst pre-requisite class that I have taken at Neely. The professor loves to cold call on you every class as a way to engage students' learning, but when he calls on the students, most of the time, no one even knows what he is talking about or asking. He is all over the place with his teaching, it becomes very difficult to learn.

I would say professor Bizjak is the worst professor I have ever taken. I don't know how he is be teaching at TCU for the quality of education Neeley is. He is incredibly scatter brained, constantly confused on what he is teaching and ends up just not teaching anything the whole class. Hard tests, calls on you in class, avoid if possible. good luck

I highly advise against Professor Bizjak. He knows what he is talking about(sometimes) but is lacking in being able to teach it. As another reviewer said, he is all over the place. He frequently makes mistakes in class, teaching incorrect information then later saying becoming mad at the students, saying we are not listening when we get it wrong.

He never knows what he is talking about. He doesn't answer our questions and doesn't teach you how to use the financial calculator. He is rude when you try to ask questions. You should never take this professor. He is all over the place. Sometimes he gives us incorrect information. He's VERY confusing and he has ISSUES.

Always says he doesn't want to complicate things and then proceeds to make them complicated. Lectures a lot and uses pearson online for quizzes/homework. Does a lot of practice problems (which help for exams) in class so attendance is beneficial. Struggles to answer students' questions in class.

not the best but not the worst. nice guy and cares a lot about his students. lectures are boring and tests are really hard but that just comes with finical management. compared to other professors for this classes hes pretty good

Financial Management is a hard class in general, but Bizjak does a good job of explaining the content during lectures. He posts a lot of practice problems and is very accessible outside of class. The class is also curved at the end and he is very transparent about grades. If you study the practice problems and lectures before the test you're fine.
Nice guy but he was a horrible teacher online. Really inaccessible for help and seemed to try and trick students.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Bizjak is a little scatter brained in his teaching style. But, as long as you pay attention in class and know how to use your financial calculator, you should be fine. Do all the homeworks and quizzes and the practice problems he gives before for exams, and an A is very achievable. Project is super easy too
Good teacher. Lectures can be boring but overall he is clear and fair.

I wish that every professor would teach like him!  He will make sure that every student with a question understands the topic with clarity. He spends the first 15 minutes talking about what his last lecture was about.

Took financial management with him. He's very confusing & when you ask questions in class he says he'll answer it later but never does. He thinks you know way more than you do and is awful at explaining the material. Take someone else for financial management if you can. He also doesn't enter his grades on ecollege & makes up his own grading scale

You would be hard pressed to find a professor as passionate about what he teaches as Dr. Wei. Lectures were always inspiring on account of the energy and life he brought to the material. Exams were very reasonable and the class was an overall pleasant experience.

He is a good professor, but what makes him unique is how he cares for the students. Provides a lot of feedback and wants everyone to learn. He is the most loved professor in tcus computer science department. He also works with modern technologies and frameworks in his classes, which makes his classes most up-to-date and useful in real life.
Quite vague with feedback although is helpful once it is clear you don't understand the concept

Professor Bing teaches with so much energy and enthusiasm. His lectures are fun to listen to and the powerpoint notes are clear. There are a lot of assignments, but he does a pretty good job of providing clear guidelines. It's very easy to reach him outside of class if you have any questions. Take his class if you have the option!

Moncrief is a TCU legend. The man still consults for numerous Fortune 500 companies, so he's well respected. Great lectures that make class time breeze by. Only three main grades (project, midterm, final) and two quizzes. He will curve your grade as long as you don't miss more than 3 classes. There is a book, but I never opened it once.
Lectures are amazing and based on personal stories. Grade based on semester project, midterm & final, and two smaller papers. Very interesting class, highly recommend

Professor Moncrief is simply amazing. Since the beginning of the semester he tells you the class average will be A- and he lives by it. Lectures are really interesting and he'll catch your attention for the whole period. 2 Exams which are easy as long as you pay attention in class. He has so many stories you'll be amazed.

Dr. Moncrief is hilarious and will make your lectures interesting. Whether or not you are a marketing major, this class is fun if you take it with Moncrief. The exams are all essay and you basically need to know the textbook and his lectures. The concepts aren't hard though.

Dr. Moncrief is an awesome professor. If you have a chance to take him for marketing management, do it. His lectures are awesome cause he uses his own personal stories and he gives a shortened project so it's not too bad of a class at all. Made the maymester so enjoyable. Highly recommend.

I definitely struggled in this class. Moncrief is hilarous and makes class interesting and fun, but his tests will hit you like a freight train. Go to class becuase he pulls test questions from specific things he says and then just memorize the book. Literally what I did!
HOT. He is the God of the Business school. Everyone else is lame.

Moncrief is one of the best profs in Neeley! He has great stories and you learn a whole lot about marketing and business in general. Would take again and again. Go the extra mile in assignments and the project bc it will pay off. Read and study for the tests and you'll be fine.

Moncrief was my favorite professor at TCU! He has so many great stories and does a good job relating to college students. You definately have to learn your stuff in class, but it is really not that bad. Good text book too.

His tests are hard and you must study a lot for them but the class is very fun! he tells lots of stories and makes a point with them. I would recommend taking this class but be prepared to work! Especially on that final project!

Awesome guy. Really knows his stuff. Go to class and you'll be fine. Has great stories. Get to know him and you'll love the guy. Makes it too easy to get jokes off of him. Project is time consuming so dont wait until the last minute or you will die!

Great professor! Tests are pretty easy, make sure you come to class, stay for class, and don't let your cell phone ring! Doing a commercial in the project does give you a better grade, and make sure you present like a PRO!
Best I have had yet!
Tests are hard because theyre standardized!! Get to use notecards on quizzes if you have them. Class is fun and he tells lots of stories! Project is time consuming, dont wait til last minute!!
No Comments

One of the most entertaining classes I have ever taken. His stories make abstract concepts have real life implications. Beyond that get the study guide and you can pull a hard A or easy B. Also he is like the God of the business school so I suggest treating him as such, I am pretty sure he could make you disappear if he wanted too.
I didn't like the class, he really doesn't teach, all he does is go through the slides and skip many of them. Tests are not good either.

Moncrief is an awesome professor! He has a lot of experience in the field and provides plenty of real-life examples to explain the lessons. He is very funny and has lots of stories to share. Get the study guide for the text (or even in place of the text) study it hard, and you will be golden.
The assistant Dean, get to know him and.  He is helpful and likes to tell stories.  Study the guide for his exams and on the presentation, do a commercial.
One of the best at TCU...use the study guide and do well on the presentation.
Great teacher...get to know him!  He'll help you with recommendations, etc.  Studyguide really helps.
His tests are easy if you study the study guide like crazy.  If not, you will fail them like I did on the first two.
He's awesome! I never want to miss class.
The professor values his own authority above practical guidance, making the class more about his opinions than students' learning

Hes really all over the place and doesnt explain things. If you dont understand the answer to a question, he doesnt provide any feedback just gives the right answer and says youre wrong. Lots of papers, and the Zoom lectures are no fun. No definition of course material, expects us to write everything he says but goes into long tangents
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Disorganized - all communications have only been through email and there are so many emails with different files. He does not ensure that you have a fundamental foundation of what the lecture is on, and even worse, there is no textbook or handout that actually provides clarification. Time is not respected as he begins class early. DO NOT TAKE HIM

The most intelligent professor I've had. Ferrandino expects a lot from students, but he genuinely cares about their success and the classes he teaches. I've learned more from him than any other teacher in my career. He's just plain brilliant.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Awesome professor who cares about the progress of his students and is very helpful
Wonderful professor and great guy. If you get a chance to take any class with him, take it. He makes theory fun!
A wonderful teacher! I really enjoyed his class and learn a lot!
Very very very smart helpful man.

No doubt my favorite professor at TCU. He treats all of his students as adults and knows how to have fun in the classroom. He is extremely intelligent and always knows exactly what he's talking about.

Dr Ferrandino is probably the most intelligent musical mind I have come across thus far.  He knows anything and everything about music theory. I really recommend taking his class but only if you love music theory and really want to learn and apply new material.  Otherwise, let someone else get the chance to study under him. Don't waste his time!
such a knowledgeable man! know everything... willing to help you outside of class if you make an appointment... sense of humor... great teacher!

Ferrandino is amazing. From freshman to doctoral students, every musician I know that is interested in learning loves him. He looks a little like a goat which is funny, but you'll still respect him. He has so much patience and is always willing to work with students in and out of class. Brilliant man! work hard for him; he'll do the same for you.
He is a nice guy and always say: "do you all get it, frogs?" and His music theory class is the best one in TCU...choose him!!
Yes he is intelligent but he KNOWS he is intelligent and can come across rude to students that don't understand the material.... Havent enjoyed it so far...
He's a great prof!  He knows his stuff!
A brilliant man! (But at times a real ****!)

Increadible!  One of the best teachers I've ever had (in 6+ years of undergrad and grad school).  Very helpful, but he expects a lot out of you.  Will challenge you in ways you never thought possible.  Changed my perspective on learning and higher education.

The man is an absolute genius.  You are in college to learn, and luckily for TCU, Ferrandino is one of the top teachers in the country.  If you think he is rude, then frankly, you need to study more, or change your major.  Blessed are those who can take from such and amazing intellect.
Ferrandino is great. Very intelligent. knows from the beginning of class exactly how and why he will arrive to his goal.
This guy is a genious, and the best communicator in the department.
He's awesome
He will do anything he can to help you understand, couldn't be more clear.  I have never witnessed any rudeness or condescending behavior.
He knows his stuff, and is an interesting professor. The class can be slow sometimes if you understand theory easily.
Excellent teacher, not excellent person. Can be rude, but you definitely learn a lot. If you keep up, the class isn't that hard.
No Comments
He's the most condescending and rude man ever.

Blackwell gave my class cookies or cake or sweet bread every single class. If you take her night class she will always bring a sweet treat for the class. She is just a nice old cat lady who can sometimes go on random tangents in the middle of her lectures. She is a tough grader tho, so don't expect to get a 100% on anything you write.
such a tough grader you wont get an A even on participation stuff

I really liked Professor Blackwell as a person because she was very sweet and caring, I would not recommend her as a teacher. She was an incredibly tough grader, her instructions for essays were not clear at all, and she was extremely nitpicky when it came to feedback.
agressive grader and weird topics
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: The most boring class I've ever taken. A bunch of unnecessary work. She didn't explain things clearly and the assignments felt pointless. It was hard to stay engaged. She never wants to help+she never rounds up grades. She doesn't seem to care about understanding your perspective or giving any extra support. It was a frustrating experience overall.
Avoid at all costs!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. B is a great, caring, and helpful English teacher! We wrote and revised four papers over the semester to later create a portfolio. She provides general feedback and is accessible for specific feedback. To get an A, pay attention to feedback and revise accordingly. One-on-one feedback sessions with other students occur at least once per paper.
I attended every class, met with her outside of class to review papers, did well. Ended with an 89.47 and she wouldn't round. Her feedback is not clear and the prompts are all random. DO NOT TAKE.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't take this lady. She's mean and the hardest grader ever. You will never make full marks on an assignment and the points stack up and screw you in the long run. Class is 3 papers a weekly writing grade and a final portfolio for writing as an inquiry true crime. Lot's of much easier teachers than her. If you have another option take it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took the true crime section. The content was very interesting. But the papers were very difficult to do and she is a very tough grader. She is a super interesting person. Her only grades are a participation grade, 4 papers, and a final portfolio. So it is hard to recover if you get a bad grade on a paper.

Prof Blackwell puts in a lot of effort and time into her classwork.  The class was mainly lectures and we had to write 3-4 papers throughout the semester.  She always gave constructive feedback on papers which also helped improve my writing.

Blackwell does not give helpful feedback, and it it is impossible to get a 100% on your weekly participation, which you cannot improve upon because you do not get feedback. She forgets that her students are new to the concepts in her class unlike her (a professional) and a lot of the time her powerpoints will barely match the reading.
good and interesting class but she is a HARD grader. she does take attendance and has many in-class assignments a week. class is so interesting tho
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: We can start with the course structure. We covered a high variety of topics per unit and then proceeded to write compositions unrelated to half of the topics we covered. I joined this course thinking that we would be reading a variety of true crime novels and writing in inspiration from those. This course, however, turned into a case study course i

I took the Sherlock Holmes writing class; If you cant stand to read 1800-early 1900 British Victorian literature, dont take this class. The online summaries were my savior. There were four papers and each were very unique to write (I liked writing them a lot). Her grading scale quite tough. She is vague (on purpose) when assigning papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: class is extremely boring and assignments are so weird. they are so random and don't make sense with the class. teacher does not make you feel excited for class, usually hated going. don't read the books just read the cliff notes and you'll pass everything. essays are basic but time consuming
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Fun class, very clear guidelines on how to do well. Read the syllabus and the grading rubrics she gives you, and you'll do great. Some of the quizzes are a little tough if straight memorization isn't a strength, but they're only a tiny part of your grade. She gives great feedback, too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: IDK what everyone else on this thread experienced but I can say this class was great. Show up to class, participate, and be prepped for the quizzes and you'll do great. A super good way to get a credit out of the way and you get to watch movies and eat baked goods every day. Tests are a bit tough but nothing anyone at TCU can't handle just review.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The only thing sweet about her is the treats she brings. Still not worth it. Super unorganized and unable to include everyone in class. I didnt take the review that said she has favorites seriously, but man does she. Worst class taken at TCU by far and I thought it was going to be the best. Really disappointing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This professor is rude and belittles her students. Her tests are unreasonably hard and she has unrealistic expectations within the time limit of the test. I would not recommend taking her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class was extremely film-heavy. Not ONCE did we bring our books to class and discuss passages (I'm an English major so I hated this). You'll only ever discuss the movie adaptations, and even that is very opinion-based. Don't take this class if you're looking to immerse yourself in the novels. More geared toward students familiar with film.

Dr. Blackwell is a tough grader on most of the papers. But, if you go to her office hours she will give you good feedback and tell you how to get an A. It is important to participate in class because she grades you on it. You watch a lot of movies which is nice, but the paper prompts can be difficult. Overall, she's not really a people person.

Absolute worst teacher I've ever had at TCU. Do not take any of her classes. She is completely disrespectful to students, shames students, embarrasses them in class, and praises some of the students for being smart, while others are called out for not talking enough in class.

I enjoyed the content of the class but I did not have the best time with her. Just talks in rambles quite a bit. But she is very knowledgable about what she does! I really dreaded this class sometimes though.

I can't stand this class. Way too much work. She cant explain the assignments. We had to write 2 essays totaling 1000 words on the exam. Wouldn't recommend to anyone. Expect to not have a life if you take during the summer. I couldn't imagine having her a whole semester. She is nice though.
Her may semester English class is extremely easy. We watched Sherlocke Holmes movies everyday. homeworks were easy readings and she graded the essays fairly

Extremely devoted and intelligent - if you don't plan on working hard don't take her, but she is my favorite professor. Each class taught me something new and made me a better writer. Talk to her if you are having trouble, show your interest, she will help

A lot of writing to not be a WEM credit,but overall an enjoyable class. She often brings treats to class and discussions are interesting, only downside is impromptu essays on readings. Test is 3 essays. She doesn't give out many A's, but I liked the class.

Do not take any class with Blackwell. She is a narcissist and plays favorites from Day 1. If you do A work and she does not like you (because you do not suck up enough or laugh at her repetitive jokes) then she will give you a B or worse. Doesn't respond to emails, loves to humiliate, loves to act like you are burdening her with stupid questions.

This professor comes off very sweet and nice but beware, there is a wolf under there.  She clearly has her favorites that take all her classes.  She has expectations that students know film.  She grades very subjectively and will make biting remarks. I agree with the fact that if you don't agree with her, you're wrong.

Decent lecturer, but grades very harshly and deducts point if you voice an opinion than is different from her own. Do not ask for clarification about assignments and course policies or she lowers final grade. Even if you perform well in the objective portions of the class, she docks you on participation if you aren't her favorite.

Title of class deceaving- It's Gothic but called Restoration & 18th Cent. Lit.  Prof. worst teacher ever.  If she disagrees with you, she grades you poorly.  Likes to discuss her sexual preferences.  Not appropriate, and shows inappropriate films.  I'll never take her again.
All writing but not a writing emphasis class. If you write about your own opinion and it is not the same as hers be prepared to get a bad grade.

This professor was TERRIBLE! If you have an opnion that does not border hers then you will automatically not be on her "good list" Her tests are objective so you dont have a chance either. I dropped it before she failed me. Just dont take this class if you want to enjoy your semester

Class and reading material are interesting. The professor gets off topic and is hypocritical at times. Don't expect your opinion to matter if it condradicts hers; she will judge you for it. In-class writings are easy as long as you read, give textual support, and write from a strictly objective perspective. She forgot to post readings online a lot.

I enjoyed her LGBTQ Literature class immensely. One book we read became one of my favorite books. However, she's not a perfect prof. Whenever you answer a question, it's hard to tell if you got it right or not based on her facial expression. She's not a harsh grader if you do the work, and I do recommend her Shakespeare class.

Great professor. She's primarily an English professor but I took her Women's Study class. I loved it. She's definitely a strong feminist. She gets a little off topic sometimes, but it's always a good story. Lots and lots of reading, but they aren't very hard. In class writings are usually easy. She grades fairly. Take this class!

Great teacher! So funny and makes the class a breeze. We'll have readings from 2 pgs to 40 but they are so interesting and eye opening. Class is intended for mostly girls or men who are extreme feminists. She made me want to be a WOST minor.

You read the novel, watch the film, talk about the film, and then she tests you on it. The tests are short answer and essay. All the movies had gay inuendos and were slightly disturbing. I do NOT recommend this class. I have never worked so hard in a 1000 level class and I'm a senior. Freshman level classes are suppose to be easy A's...it's not.

I can't believe how many negative comments this lady has. I took into to poetry in a minimester, studied for 30 minutes everyday before class, took it pass/fail, and still had a 90 going into the final. You don't have to be an English major to ace this class - I'm Management. If you actually do the readings and show up sober, you'll make an A.
Challenging professor & wonderful individual.  Took her Satire course & REALLY enjoyed it.

Dr. Blackwell comes off a little harsh at times but she's really a nice person. She does grade hard but you come out of her class a better writer. She also bakes for the class sometimes. She really is a sweet person, she just expects a lot, as she should, c'mon we're in college we should take it as an insult when we're not challenged.

One of the most unprofessional teachers I've encountered at TCU--a great disappointment.  She's biased, inconsistent, and blatantly plays favorites.  The English Department is full of many fantastic professors:  she's not one of them.

Straight laced woman who expects A LOT (underline) out of her students. She is very by the book and seems like a control freak. If your not familiar w/ film the class is rough. She acts as if you know all the film terms, actors and directors. She has a "guideline" of how she grades participation, but it's really on if she likes you or not.

Dr. Blackwell is extremely disorganized. She is also one to play favorites. If you read the textbook, but don't give insightful answers to her questions then you will not get an A from her. You can make a B with a good amount of work, but if you expect a A then you must answer questions in class and make her think that English is your world.

She comes off as unfavorable at first, but she knows what she's doing. She grades hard on grammar, but hopefully one knows how to write before coming to college. She's funny in an intellectual way, which often doesn't work because it's not blunt and people don't understand it, but all in all she's a god teacher

watch out for this one, she will throw your cell phone out the door. she likes to cuss because she thinks it will make you like her. her feminism is out of control and is very frustrating to learn from her random insequential teaching style. Notes will not help, it is a lost cause.
Avoid at all costs! She chooses people to like within the class, and does not give others a chance. I thought I was good at English...according to Blackwell I am not!

I took Shakespeare with her.  It was terrible.  She favors english majors and RTVF majors. She doesn't explain things to non majors very well.  There are quizzes once a week.  Make sure you read the plays and make sure you know ever detail of the plays and movies like the color of their costumes...  Beware non english majors!

Only haters will have something negative to say about Dr. Blackwell. She's amazing. She's quirky. She's smarter than your mom. She's got this Uma Thurman sexiness thing going on. She's excited about what she teaches. Yeah, she grades you on grammar; you're in college, and she's an English professor. Don't just work hard in her class; think hard.
Be prepared for occasional sidetracking but overall she knows what she's doing. It doesn't help that this class has 3 profs and a T.A.

Nice,but weird & can't stay on topic. I don't really care for English,but she made class interesting because she's so out there. No final. Four papers. I made an A....can make an A or B as long as you attend class and the screenings. Some paper topics are confusing, but two of them focused on documentaries that we watched. Don't get on her bad side

Intelligent scholar, but in my opinion, an inaccessible teacher. Her personality distracted me so much I couldn't pay attention. Disorganized lectures littered with irrevelant comments.  Nice person, teaching style could be improved.

The class is interesting, but her overall attitude toward students is very rude. She is not very helpful during office hours. Oh, and NEVER wear Greek letters to her class. She will make mean comments about you in front of the whole class.

Great teacher! makes class fun! She will work with you as long as you participate and show up to class. I'm not saying its easy, you do have to work for your grade, but the class is not boring.. highly recommended  In film adaptation you right 4 papers... a few quizzes and thats it... no finals...

She is very challenging and grades very hard. But, it is very easy to get her off topic and you can spend a whole class talking about nothing that relates to what you are learning. She brings her dogs to class, and doesn't give a lot of quizzes. She also will fail you if you don't attend class.
Dr. Blackwell is a very challenging teacher but it is absolutely worth all the effort that you need to put in.  She makes class fun and has a unique perspective.  She is quite inspiring.

Blackwell whipped me.... ...... Most of the classtime was dedicated to discussing her personal life (as well as the intimate life of one of the more candid students in my class). I felt I would have gotten more out of the class if the readings were supported by some sort of genre-reader -  as it was B.B. basically contrived the cirriculum.

Bonnie is the best!  I have never taken a class that I have enjoyed so much.  You actually have to work to make a good grade, but she puts in a lot of effort to help you learn the material.  I really love Literature and she introduced me to things I had not read before.  Do not leave TCU without taking her class!
I loved Professor Blackwell.  Her class was one of the most original, interesting and thought-provoking courses I've ever taken!

fun class made me want to come to class in the mini-mester.  but she is hard, and she expects alot from you.  but if you can memorize good, you will do fine in the class.  she brings her dogs everywhere with her, so if you hate dogs, or are afraid of them then do not take the class.
No Comments

I took this class as a freshman, and have to say that Bonnie is one of the best teachers at TCU. I just graduated and she stands out to me. She is SO smart. Her tests aren't easy, and it's in your best interest to meet with her about your paper. You MUST take a class from her before you graduate!
The film adaptation seminar is fun!

This class is a must if you are in any way a thinker. She is cynical,extremely interesting, and quite funny.You will leave this class thinking(usually not about the projects at hand).   oh.... you wont make an A unless you give up your life to writing. Still, awesome class.

She is very opinionated and does grade papers for grammar a lot.  She is nice and funny, but she rambles a lot and goes off on tangents.  I often found her difficult to understand; however, if you talk to her outside of class about your papers, you should do fine.
She's funny and she does give A's.  She's a cool teacher, plus she brings her dog the classes always feel inviting and informal.

Love the subject, highly disliked the teacher.  She made me feel like I was back in middle school.  Not a good flashback.  She will put you down in front of everyone and thinks that only her opinion is correct.

As has been stated, she's ovely opinionate and not terribly fair in her grading, but it could be worse. The class itself is extremely difficult, though; don't expect higher than a B, so if that will kill your GPA, beware.

like most hhit professors she wants you to meet with her outside of class to talk about your paper before and after it's due but she will help a lot, she's got a sense of humor, very refreshing, and liselott [the dog she will bring to class] is sweet
Worst Class EVER!! She is really smart and knows it.  This class made me want to shove my head in a toilet.

difficult class, she is very opinionated, luckily the other professor makes it understandable. She grades papers heavily on grammar as opposed to content. I had 4 run on sentences, and 3 mispelled greek words and she took off 10 points. but an 88-89 = a B
A wonderful class and great teacher.  I had her as a junior--she's tough, but well worth the effort and the money.  You will assuredly learn something in her classes.
Very difficult class, def not recommended.  Nice lady, but very opinionated and only likes her own opinion.

Class is pretty interesting. She grades pretty rough and picks favorites. She says some pretty shocking things in class sometimes, which are funny. She is very smart, but makes the class feel stupid. Over all the class is not too bad.

I'm a senior and her class was one of the best I've taken at TCU. She's challenging, but if you work hard, she notices. She's down to earth, so freaking smart and well worth the money to take the class. Don't expect to skirt by without making an effort.
Very smart, very fair, challenging, and muy caliente.
No Comments
Excellent prof. Great intellect. She teaches the way she lives... Perfectly!
Unwilling to work with students, very picky on essays (she will change a word she doesn't like with a synonym and take points off), flirts with too many students.
She makes excellent use of class time and the assignments not only teach the material, but also are enjoyable.  She's brilliant and beautiful--what's not to like??

If a class could be any closer to hell, this would be it.  She tells terrible jokes and gets mad when no one laughs, she writes horribly belittling comments on your work and brings her dog to class.  She's hard and not worth the effort.

MMM with Galvin and Hestir. LOVE them, but the class is time-consuming. Grading was fair with personalized feedback; however, there was so much writing. Still, you get what you put in so anyone can get an A. Readings are unnecessary since lecture covers everything and many ppl didn't even show up to class since papers are the only things graded.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Hestir is a wonderful lecturer, and really takes time to answer your questions or clarify confusion regarding the texts from class. Him and Galvin will alternate each lecture, so make sure to take good notes each class and to pay attention. While the papers can be difficult to write, both professors and the TA are readily available to help.

It is clear that Dr. Hestir loves what he does, especially within the content of MMM, but it is so monotone. As the semester went on, his lectures became more and more boring, and they never seemed to have an end goal in mind. Take this class if you are ok with reading and writing tons of papers about things you most likely won't care about.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hestir is the best!!! Lectures are so interesting and he's genuinely a really funny guy. I plan on taking him again ASAP!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hestir is the most amazing human on earth! as an econ major i was weary to take this but he makes it so worth it! he really cares about all of his students, especially our mental health. he makes his expectations clear but also clear that if you are struggling and need an extension or help he his more than willing to work it out. 11/10 recommend!!!
You really have to read a lot, and take good notes! You use those notes for the papers
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: The classes were discussion heavy with a lack of structure, however all of the material was very interesting and you can really tell Dr. Hestir's passion. You do need to get the reading materials and read, but there are no quizzes on it (just occasional discussion posts).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: A fantastic professor who genuinely cares about the education of his students. Ask any question you want, he enjoys dialogue with his students. Stay up to date with the reading and you're golden.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Hestir is an amazing person! He tells super interesting stories/anecdotes, is very relaxed, a fast grader, and an engaging teacher! There is real passion in what he does, and he guides you through complex ideas in a fair and moderate way.

Dr. Hestir teaches beautifully! Took his Existential Phil class and loved the delivery. He encourages class discussions by not shutting down ideas, rather uses what makes sense in your response and uses that to expand. Lots of reading, of course, you're in college. Ended the course with a visit to the Modern Art Museum. Highly recommend.

Dr. Hestir is an amazing person. He's incredibly passionate about what he teaches. One of the first classes, we went in and did meditation exercises for most of the class. That's not to say the class is a joke -- you definitely work and learn a lot, but he goes beyond in trying to improve your general well-being. He's a very positive and fun guy.

Hestir was my professor for the 1st term. He's a really passionate guy who knows and cares about what he's teaching. Unlike most classes, this course is actually fun to pay attention to. Quiz was open book. Take notes (1 page a day) to do well on the test, what he talks about is exactly what's on the test. HW was readings, about once a week (easy).

Dr. Hestir is one of the most understanding professors I've ever had at TCU. He genuinely wants you to succeed and takes time to get to know you personally. He is an excellent professor and writes all the important information on the board during his lectures. The tests are tough and you HAVE to do the readings, though!

I took Intro to Philosophy from Dr. Hestir. I didn't care much for philosophy in general; however, this class was a good humanities credit. There is a good deal of work, but if you do it all and study regularly you should have no problem making a good grade. Dr. Hestir's lectures are funny and engaging and he makes the material interesting.
Out of my 4 philosophy professors, he was one of my favorites. One of the only ones who made the class interesting and understandable.  The class itself it's waaaaay hard. He's funny though.
i cant even begin to explain how awesome this guy is. take this class. it is hard but really fun and he helps make it interesting

Very difficult Honors class if you struggle understanding philosophy. A lot of material, work, and readings. Is interesting but wanes as the semester goes on. Hestir is interesting a good teacher though
He is very funny and makes philosophy interesting.

Hestir is a pretty funny guy that is nice and easily approachable for help. The Philosophy One course was a little on the difficult side due to multiple readings and on average one 1 page response paper per week. The class is very interesting and he makes it enjoyable.

Dr. Hestir is an amazing teacher. I really enjoyed how light the class was and he usually cracks at least 5 jokes each class. Really intersting material and if you EVER have a question about anything, he always replys back to your e-mails quickly. Take one of his classes!!
Professor Hestir is by far the best philosophy teacher at TCU. I took existentialism and learned a lot. It's a tough subject, but if you take the time you'll do well in the class.
Very interesting and laid-back professor.  Class with him was always intriguing and fun.  He makes taking notes easy.  Plus, he's incredibly attractive...like a mix between Snape and Hugh Grant.

great lectures. you could interrupt him mid-sentence and let the class turn into a discussion. also was real lenient when i had to miss my final exam and term paper-he omitted those grades and gave me whatever grade i had in the course at the time.

Hestir has interesting lectures and puts good notes on the board so you know what's important. However, you can be positive you understand the philosophy but still make crazy inconsistent grades on the test, so it's advisable to talk with him prior about his interpretations

He is very entertaining and keeps your attention throughout the lecture. His teaching style is easy to follow and you can take good notes from his lectures. I recommend you take a class from him at least once.

Amazing. Tests are based on lectures and he puts lots of notes on the board to help out. At times a little vague, but the class was Existentialism which is vague in and of itself. Easy to reach during office hours or through e-mail. Enjoys talking to students about the lectures and films he uses. No doubt my favorite professor at TCU.

Extremely interesting professor! He is definitely unique. Lots of response papers and quizzes. You will probably either love him or hate him. I had a good time listening to his views. Extremely easy to take notes with him as well.
Hestir is an interesting character. This class is a lot of work and he is not always make a lot of sense during his lectures.  He grades moderately on essays and tests.

He is a fantastic professor. So funny and cute, so its easy to pay attention. The test questions come straight from the notes, so if you show up and take good notes, you will be fine. He loves his Guinness too! Offers review sessions prior to the exams which is extremely helpful. I took Honors Philosophy 1003 from him and hope I get him again.
Brilliant!! Loveeee the class

Awesome awesome teacher. By far my fave of the philosophy teachers. He knows his stuff and his material is organized so it is easy to take notes. Test questions are easy but they are looking for very specific and well written answers, so you really have to think about how you word your answer. Take this class if you dont mind a little challenge

He is so incredibly smart!  He has a great teaching style and is a really neat guy!  HHIT is extremely difficult though...you pretty much have to write all the essays before hand and memorize them word for word.  Don't leave out anything or use synonyms for words...you must use the exact right words.  Very interesting though.  Also, he is really hot!

dont always have to do the readings.this class is so intersting it makes you look at life in a different way, some of the stuff he teaches is **** but sooo interesting! he is always talking about his guiness beer and tripping on LSD.  what a great class! the TA sucks thou, but you dont have to worry she wont be back next year! pop quizzes too.

Out of the four intro philosophy professors, Hestir is by far the best.  He's funny, interesting, and is the only professor who could keep me awake in that class.  His teaching is clear and precise, and he answers questions clearly.  He keeps most of his lectures virtually unbiased and very informational.

Blake is an awesome guy.  He loves Guiness (who doesn't), knows all his stuff well, presents good arguments.  He's still pretty young, causing him to contrast well with the other older profs.  Class will teach you something if you're willing to learn; if you're a myopic bible-beater, you're likely to hate it.
impossibly tough on grading. expects your essays on tests to be perfect. UGH!
****ing awesome. Do it.
Blake is hot and he is the only one who makes sense

What was that class about again????  This was the only class I went to all year that I dreaded.  If you love random babble about a lot of nothing, then join up.  Stick with classic greek philosophy....I can't get enough of Socrates...but existentialism..........NO.....
A brilliant and awesome teacher. Lots of fun, open and frank personality. (And quite the looker!)

Brent is so hot! I heart him. And if you get the chance, go watch his band play- it rocked my world haha. Anyway, Ho hit is friggin hard, but it is really interesting, especially with the guest lecturers. You will learn a lot and your writing will improve with all the response papers.
No Comments

Great professor, really nice guy.  Makes information interesting.  Grades pretty hard, but if you work hard you will be fine.  Also had him for Honors Intellectual Traditions, I would send him my papers and he would give me very helpful feedback.  Definately reccommend taking one of his classes.

Hestir was a really nice guy.  He was very helpful during office visits and tried to help.  I just did not enjoy the class because of the subject matter - philosophy is not really my thing.  Grades hard on papers, especially on essay questions on the test.
Great guy, hilarious, loves his Guiness. What more could you ask for? oh yeah hes a great professor too.

I love Brent and Blake.  They are hot and I am taking their religion and Philosophy classes next semester just to look at them.  If you ask them to help you with your paper you will do a lot better than if you don't.  If you get the TA Jeff you are sooo lucky he rocks my world.

I love Blake! He's the coolest teacher ever. He's very interesting, entertaining, and laid-back, making HoHIT a million times easier. Brent and him are a great team. I'm taking Philosophy just to be in his class next semester!

He makes philosophy interesting.  He does grade hard, but he is very helpful when you visit him in his office.  Take good notes in class and talk to him during his office hours to clear things up and you will be fine.
Good prof.  Lectures are interesting.  Grades very hard on papers.  Make sure you get help from him before you turn one in.

Probably the best professor of the Phil department. I had him for IntroPhil, which is team-taught by all of the faculty. Go to the review sessions. Always attend class on time for the quizzes. Work hard on the papers.
I never thought logic would be this enjoyable.  Extremely engaging professor, and quite the looker... I wish my current college had any professors half as hot as Blake Hestir.

Kind of pretentious, but he really knows his stuff and will make the hardest concepts easy to understand.  After taking this course, I got complimented by future profs on how clearly I understood Plato and Aristotle.  I recommend it.
not very clear in class, and he doesn't really explain what you missed on the 'all essay' exams.  he really wants you to come to his office outside of class to discuss your work
fairly difficult class if you make it hard like i did. if you do the reading and take good notes, the class is an easy B and a possible A. They grade on a curve, so an 88-89 might actually be an A.
Takes the complicated literature of Plato and Aristotle and makes it easy to understand.  Can't wait to take his ancient philosophy class.  I recommend him very highly
Very smart,interesting man - the only problem with the class are the 3 others professors that taught it with him-they were a total bore!!!
He expects you to understand philosophy as well as he does, but not as bad as Franzwa.  He definitely is nice to look at...making Plato and Aristotle worth it.

Dr. Hestir is an awesome professor! He's not extremely hard but he expects you to work hard and think. He is very willing to help and very friendly. And he has a great sense of humor! Awesome professor -- highly recommended!

Dr. Blessinger is an amazing music theory professor! He is very funny and his lectures will keep you entertained. Since it is a theory class, it is a bit more difficult to grasp concepts immediately so the homework, while it can be a lot at times, actually helps with building up the skill needed to understand music theory.

Dr. B is really cool, and does give good lectures. He's funny, and I do think he genuinely cares. My main issue is that he is a TOUGH GRADER. I've had homework, quizzes and exams where I've missed maybe one or two little things and gotten around 20 points taken off. To me that's a bit ridiculous, but I still enjoyed the class and I hope to improve.

Easy to understand lectures. Easy quizzes. Impossible homework that he gives very little feedback on. You will never know what he wants for an A, and if you ask, all you get are vague nothings. Personally, I would not take another class with him.

Good class overall, but the classroom environment can be really hard to deal with during lectures - people talk constantly and he never tells them to be quiet. This is a problem in all the classes I've taken in the theory department at TCU

Dr. Blessinger is an AWESOME teacher! You can tell he really cares about his students, and he makes a class that could be rather boring very enjoyable. He is also very willing to help; you can even message him on facebook. His class is challenging, but you will learn alot from him. He is also hilarious! You will have a good time in his class.

Dr. Blessinger is a great teacher and person! The only reason people don't like his class is because they don't try. Of course he gives a lot of homework, but in the end you retain almost all of the information you study. He is always available to talk about anything, even homework and papers due the next morning. Great guy!

Dr. Blessinger reminds me a lot of Jim Halpert from the office. I had him for my 8am class, but it was painless because of his humor. The class wasn't too difficult- a lot of easy sightreading and dictation. All in all I would recommend Dr. Blessinger just to get to know this great guy!
Great person but gives way too much homework. If you don't like spending a lot of time sitting in your room doing homework, this isn't the class for you.

GREEATT teacher! you will love taking this class. He makes the class very intersting and quite funny! More than willing to help on any assignment, and will most of the time not move on to the next topic in class until everyone understands! TAKE THIS CLASS!
Great teacher. Lots of fun. I've learned a lot too. Keeps ear training exciting.

Took her for International Business Management. The biggest thing in this class is participation. The sooner she knows who you are the better off you will be. Assignments are fairly easy, but the group project can be a big workload if you don't have good teammates or wait till the last minute to complete. Great professor overall and an easy A.
Dr. Bluntzer was very good with sharing her knowledge and challenging her students.

Awesome professor! It's her first time teaching undergrads, but it does not show. Her style of teaching makes the class seem almost too easy, but I have honestly learned a lot from this class. It is obvious she if full of knowledge and effectively engages the class by making the activities and lectures fun & interesting. There's no tests! Take her

By far my favorite professor ever at TCU.  Classes are discussion based, no tests, and 6 short newspaper articles.  She makes class interesting and I actually going to ethics class in the morning.  She is always available to help students whether it's with school or life in general.  AWESOME PROFESSOR!!

Professor Block has to be one of my favorite professors here at TCU. She is by far the most caring professor that I have had and her level of dedication is clear throughout each class period. Moreover she is a great person in general. She loves what she does and brings that same energy to class everyday.

Professor Block has a very kind heart and genuinely wants to work with students. she is passionate about what she teaches. HOWEVER, she is disorganized and I didn't genuinely learn much in this class because the class was pretty unstructured. I don't think I would recommend taking this class with this professor.

Professor Block is highly knowledgeable, cares deeply for her students, and always is prepared to pour into her students. I appreciated her organizational skills and her intentional lectures. Lectures consisted of material, scenarios, stories, and even allowed you to run through scenarios to get a real world feel to being an entrepreneurial leader.

This course was transformed by Professor Anna Block, an international professor who inspired us by understanding and addressing the challenges immigrants face in building their professional identity abroad.

Professor Block cares a lot about her quality of teaching and the impact it leaves on her students. There was a lot of concepts she shared that I found important in the Entrepreneurial Leadership space. She is very open to questions and wants a clear understanding for her students. When I had any issues with a subject, she was on top of it.

Professor Block cares about her students doing well and their success. She was always happy to sit down with me if I was struggling or needed some extra explanation. You need to make sure to keep up with the syllabus because due dates can sneak up on you. The lectures were interesting and related to real world examples.

I like Block she was very nice and helpful to students, myself included. The class was confusing but it was a new class which caused some hiccups. The checkpoints would sneak up on us and be confusing at times causing problems for students and professor block. There was also a language barrier which can be tough but her help offset the pains
This class was very engaging and had lots of outside sources as well as projects to help learn the material.

I strongly discourage taking a course with Professor Block. Her lack of clarity, consistency, and fairness made the learning experience needlessly difficult. I hope future students can find a more positive and supportive learning environment elsewhere.
Not very consistent with lessons.
Needs to learn the fundamentals of how to professionally treat students. Do not share personal info.
Easily the most unprofessional person I have ever met.
Very energetic and fun to work with, easily understandable, appreciative.
I was a freshman when I took this class and it was one of my hardest classes that semester. Don't take him he expects you to learn everything at a fast pace. There are better classes than this one.

reviews.comment: Dr. Blackburn is a very fun teacher. He likes to get off-topic and will talk for the whole class. The quizzes are easy and are over each chapter. The majority of your grade is three tests. READ THE BOOK TO DO WELL IN THIS CLASS.

reviews.comment: I would not recommend this class. He is a very quiet person so it is hard to hear him. He gives gives quizzes online with multiple attempts, two tests, and a final exam. The test are very difficult to understand because of how he words the questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He did not teach me anything. 1 or 2 online quizzes every week. Exams are difficult (he words the questions super weirdly). Attendance is not mandatory.
Tests/quizzes open note. Gives lectures. Hard content but nice teacher.
Attendance is not mandatory, and I did not learn anything. I would not recommend taking him, but I know there are worse econ teachers.

I had Prof Blackburn for Micro and liked him! Attendance was not mandatory, he had a zoom every class and posted the recording after. Tests and quizzes were all open note. He just goes over powerpoints in class and is lecture style. As long as you take notes you will be fine!
Dr. Blackburn is a terrible lecturer. He is very boring and I learned nothing from the lectures.

Blackburn is a nice professor with experience in Econ field. I enjoy his lectures although they can be tedious and boring sometimes. In terms of teaching, not too great, but in terms of a person, 100% gotta know him. His class is easy and most contents are online. I didn't put in too much effort and still got A.

Here's the thing. Professor Blackburn is an amazing person. He's likable, will make grandpa jokes and gives good stories. BUT... The content is very hard and he has photographic memory and thinks we all know it like he does. It's hard to learn anything becasue he is very quiet and lectures the entire class. Tests are HARD. Nice man, hard teacher.

reviews.comment: Did not learn a single thing from one of his lectures. I totally had to self-teach this class and never attended lectures after this first exam. Pretty easy content to grasp but he fails to actually teach.
Easiest Intro Macro class at TCU. Honestly you dont even have to show up, Chegg and Quizlet guarantee you at least a B or more. Nice guy.
Professor Blackburn, is a super nice. He does not require you to go class and sometimes gets off topic. All his quizzes and test are online.

Easy class, you dont even have to show up, his exams and quizzes are all open notes, but one of the exams this semester we had an average of a 55 yet he curved it 7 points, he says he wont curve but he curves all the exams
He's a bit boring ngl, but his quizzes and exams online are doable. Pay attention to the study guide on Pearson, they are helpful for his class.

Ignore the hate from the people who didn't study. I have to agree that Dr Blackburn is a bit boring and you have to self-study for the exams, it's actually pretty easy to get an A from him! Focus on doing the Study Plan on Pearson and note down important concepts and you'll do fine. His Sunday quizzes on Pearson have answers on Quizlet!

If you don't like reading a poorly written textbook, then taking quizzes and test that don't match up with that then don't take this class. The lectures were pointless, he was not helpful at all. I sent an email to go over a test and all I got back was a rude email. Ended up dropping the class because self taught Macro is not fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Blackburn is like your real grandfather! (He's the same Don Blackburn at Texas at Arlington if you need more infos). He does kinda heavy lecture but he always tries to dad-joke you, sometimes it is hilarious! He has quizzes every Sunday on Pearson but they arent that hard. Great prof I hope he doesnt retire soon

Very good professor! I took Data Structures class with him. He explains the material clearly and logically. Goes through every step and gives lots of different examples. He got me into programming and made me like it more. Helps about topics for exams. Overall very good experience with him.

Bo is a funny guy who does a nice job laying the foundation for a difficult subject. He takes roll randomly throughout the year and gives 1% extra credit, making an A that much more achieveable. Don't even think about cheating because he'll bust your cherry and give you a 0 on the final in front of everyone like he did to this one kid in my class.

Dr. Mei did an excellent job of comprehensively teaching Android app development in a bottom-up manner, and particularly did a great job of making relatively foreign concepts accessible to newcomers to mobile app development. He was also more than accessible outside of class and gave plenty of useful guidance when it came to completing projects.

I took Dr.Mei in the Fall Semester of my Sophomore year. He is the best computer science teacher I have ever had, his lectures consist of going over the slides. You are assigned a Project which is the core of the class. He is extremely accessible during office hours and is always willing to help. Take him please if you have the option to!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor is very nice and explains information well during lectures through accessible PowerPoints.  Would recommend this professor.

Dr. Mei is a very good professor. As someone who had never learned anything about computer science before he presented the material in a way that really helped me understand it. He is very willing to answer questions and is not a tough grader at all. His class is very straight forward.
If you have the chance to take any of his classes (especially the mobile app dev class), DO IT!!! He is super helpful and willing to answer questions

Dr. Mei did an excellent job of distilling the course material to the essentials and teaching us only what we needed to know to succeed in the future and in the course. Understands the complexity of the material and works with students accordingly to ensure their success. Clear lecturer and very helpful professor. Meaningful assignments as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
Took COSC30403. It was decently easy, but the homeworks (mostly projects) are very hard. However, they aren't really used on the test *that much.* 

It was pretty easy though, he went over exactly what was going to be on the test before it. And we get a cheat sheet to use on the test. So the test wasn't that hard and it was fine

Extremely kind professor who wants his students to succeed. You are allowed to bring an entire front and back sheet of paper for tests. Lectures via PowerPoint and teaches the concepts very clearly. The textbook is not necessary at all. Even if you know nothing about Computer Science, you should be able to succeed in the class without a problem.
If you're wanting a good intro to programming class without any prior experience, this is your guy. All of the material he lectures over is posted in slides as well
He really cares about his student and always wants to ensure that the whole class understands his lectures. Take advantage of his office hours and you will be fine.

reviews.comment: Really smart & cool professor. Clear grading and super straight forward.

reviews.comment: If you ask him a question, he will spend hours helping you until you understand the problem. He tries his best to help the students. Also, he allows you to take notes to the exams which I believe should be a mandatory practice for all computer science classes. Cool dude.
it starts off easy but then it gets tough, hardly anyone goes to class and when they do no one pays any attention, you get to use a cheat sheet on each test which is nice

reviews.comment: He is a very good professor who really cares about the students. reviews.comment: This professor taught for the first time in 2018. He is pretty good, who also allows students to take their notes to tests.
Take his class yes its a lot of work but its easy and he is very linient and helps you out a lot actually wants you to suceed!

Bro, his accent is bad but he is so funny. I laugh every time I go to this class, he always has something to say and its so funny. He also will give u full credit back for late work. The work is also super easy, like everything can be done with Chat GBT and even without it, it is so easy.

I think he's a good teacher, he grades really good but his lectures can be confusing sometimes. The work is simple and easy, you will have many group projects but they aren't hard. He can come off as rude but when you get to know him he's a great professor and cares for his students.

Super underrated professor. He has a super thick accent and can speak fast at times but other than that he is amazing, it only took a few classes for me to understand him fine. As long as you get your work done which is easy and can read basic instructions youll be fine. He lets you leave class if youve done your work and attendance not mandatory.

reviews.comment: Lots of assignments, but as long as you follow the instructions he does not grade harshly. I got a solid 100 in the class. Very easy to get a good grade, but you need to go to class, pay attention to instructions, turn in assignments on time.
