reviews.comment:
Not a class that I looked forward to at all. The course consists of mostly busy work every week and if you don't mind a good amount of pointless assignments then you're good. The in person class meetings are largely pointless and kinda just act as a study hall.

A big saving grace was that he was open to corrections and would award points back.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: So many assignments and enforced class participation when you literally sit there and he gives you a work period. Final was a documentary... all of which you had to reflect on like 12 times. Its manageable and overall easy. Just be nice and get on his good side and you will be fine, still a little frustrating at some times. You can do it, promise!!

Looking for a reason to stay in bed? Look no further than Dr. Boakye. He's a fair grader but won't provide clear reasoning for grades. He is extremely disorganized and very hostile towards students. He also said, "Don't waste my time by revising. Take the grade and learn your lesson". Take my advice and don't sign up for any classes with him EVER.

DO NOT take him unless you want to feel angry and overwhelmed for the whole semester. He is extremely unorganized, assigns 2-5 papers per week, and is all over the place. Even though he is not a hard grader, it is not worth it. He sounds like he is yelling, and his tone is not friendly. I would not recommend this professor.

Dr. Boyd's class felt more challenging than expected for an introductory management course. Participation expectations weren't always clear, and some exam questions seemed designed to be tricky rather than straightforward. I did end up receiving a generous final grade, but the structure of the class made it more difficult than it needed to be.

He has you participate at least 4 times a week as a part of your grade. He graded us so hard on our group projects for no reason. Also this class is a joke but somehow the tests are not easy. If you go up to him and ask questions about the test it can help you. Also show him your projects ahead of time so he can help you get a better grade
Don't listen to the other reviews. His class is very easy compared to other classes and as long as you participate and study, you will do well.

He's not terrible.. I've definitely had worse professors. Just come to class and talk 4 times per week along with discussion posts. Also, the group you pick at the beginning of the semester, pick well because  you will be stuck doing assignments weekly with them. Lots of busy work

Honestly don't listen to the other reviews, just participate twice a class and do discussion posts every class he added that this semester to make participation grades better. As long as you do those two things, you will be able to get an A, just takes a bit of work, and project grades are free high 90s.

Do not listen to the rest of these reviews, if you participate during class and spend a decent amount of time outside of class studying you will get a good grade. He always comes prepared to teach and has a great attitude about teaching. I fully recommend this professor.

I would 110% take another professor... the class is very boring, and he makes immature comments. I felt like I was in high school again, and makes you stay the entire time almost always.  Is very big on in-class participation, and group work.
wouldnt recommend. Unfair grader that provides 0 feedback

His feedback is terrible. He never presents any reason for his grading decisions, and you never get to access your past quizzes/tests. Dr. Boyd is a nice guy but is not fit to teach. Would definitely NOT take this class.

Save yourself the trouble and do not take this class. There is so much unnecessary busy work and quizzes are impossible. You also HAVE to speak multiple times PER class, and if you do not it is major grade deductions, so you can basically never miss class. Professor is also rude and does not seem to take student feedback into consideration.

Save yourself some trouble and avoid Dr. Boyd at all costs. Extremely confusing quizzes over a lot of useless material, and does not let you review them afterwards. The structure of the participation is very annoying as well. Makes the class a pain compared to other upper level business core classes.

Unfair Grader who cannot justify his grades. Only person I've ever known to make common sense uncommon. Life-long academic, so very liberal. He has a PhD, but he's not the sharpest tool in the shed. Overall a terrible professor and not fit to be a professor in the Neeley School of Business.

I would not recommend this instructor. His grading is inconsistent, and his lectures lack structure, making it hard to prepare for exams. Participation is emphasized, but the exams are unclear, with confusing questions. Despite being a nice person, he's disorganized and unhelpful, making both individual and group exams frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not very good

probably the worst professor in neeley. His class is a joke and he thinks he is above you. Gives low grades for no reason or explanation. seems like he hates himself so he takes it out on students with low grades. very liberal.

Dr. Boyd was amazing for his first semester at TCU.  Easiest professor you'll have for OrgMan, and he's super caring.  Participate often, it's a big part of your grade. Lots of group work so choose a good group from the start

Dr. Boyd appears like a good professor at first but then towards the second half of the semester his demenour changes, clearly prefers certain students. The grading for participation is like a battle to get the most slips, and the group exams had an average of a D with no further explanation or curve. DO NOT TAKE BOYD!

Shes very personable and is a really good Spanish teacher. She does move between chapters a little fast but the quizzes and tests are easy. Every day there is a small in class assignment so you have to go to class, but if you miss it's easy to make up. She's a really good professor altogether and she makes the class easy to take

Learned more about culture than language. She is very clear about assignments and expectations. Majority of grade are papers, one group presentation, and speaking exercises. As long as you try and participate occasionally then an A is attainable. Very accessible to reach via email or through office hours. Attend class to be successful.
Dr Boxwell is the sweetest Spanish professor I've had! So understanding & patient & wants everyone to do well. Class was super easy and if you're confused she explains things very simply
Take Dr Boxwell if you can. She presents the material in a very accessible way. The class was one of the easiest to follow Spanish classes I have taken.

Took her for advanced Spanish, very nice and fun professor and she makes class very interesting and interactive. No exams, just papers and projects, and she doesn't grade very hard. She did tend to get more disorganized as the semester went on. Overall take her for any class if you can!
She was a pretty good professor and I enjoyed going to her class, as well as her assignments being pretty good at teaching application.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Easy A. There are a lot of assignments but she makes it easy to stay organized and is very clear on instructions. LOTS OF EXTRA CREDIT. Lots of dropped grades and Dr. Boxwell is very understanding. Class can be boring but if you stay on top of the work you will get an A.

She is overly ambitious with the schedule. Tries to fit far too much into each class; we don't spend enough time on any topic to actually learn it. There's been work due every class period. Valuable time for me to do work for my classes in my major is spent on pointless assignments for this one. The material is not difficult but the class is taxing
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I LOVED Prof. Boxwell! She made local to global so interesting and always prepared us. Some grammar hmwk, 2 boomalangs, 2 in class writings (but tells you prompt/gives glossary), and extra credit! She was so sweet/caring and if you put in effort you will get a good grade. 100% recommend and I wish I could take her for all my Spanish classes!
Professor Boxwell is a great professor! Take her if you can. She is very approachable. There is a lot of stuff to cover in her class but is manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Boxwell is great! She make the information understandable and easy to understand.  I find Spanish a hard subject, but she has made it easier to understand.

Boxwell is a super nice and helpful Spanish teacher. It is very easy to follow her class on D2L and stay organized throughout the course. She is quick to respond to emails. She grades assessments quickly and offers occasional extra credit opportunities. I would highly recommend taking her Spanish class in the future.

There are lots of things Professor Boxwell does amazingly. She is very understanding and will help you work around things and make up what you miss - to a reasonable extent. She does use an online textbook that you MUST have because there are online assignments through it. Class is taught in both English and Spanish at times.
She is very sweet and has good intentions, I would take her again. a lot of extra credit opportunities, you should go to class.

Recommend her for this class. Pretty tough grader but gives feedback so you can learn from your errors. Not a ton of assignments and class isn't that demanding. Participation is graded so definitely do not miss class and try to ask questions/volunteer a lot.

This is one of the easiest classes I've ever taken. Profe Boxwell is extremely nice, chill, and understanding. There are opportunities for extra credit on every test, and she makes the quizzes really easy. However, I felt like I didn't truly learn a lot because we didn't talk in Spanish, and I only memorized the information for the tests. Easy A.
I skipped beginner 1 and 2, and this class was easier for me because I took Spanish in High School. This class was made even easier by that she is a good professor and not a very difficult grader.

Professor Boxwell was great. I had no prior knowledge of Spanish and i learned so much. Attendance is necessary if you want to get an A. Gives study guides and exams are very straight forward. She makes learning a foreign language fun. Would definitely take her again.

Fun professor to take and really like her as a person, but takes forever to grade things. I like a lot of her in class activities though because it mixes it up from the usual lecture style. Gives extra credit if you take advantage of it and is a fairly easy grader! Definitely suggest taking her!

Had to make an account just to let everyone know how awesome this woman is.  I was nervous since it'd been 2+ years since I took Intermediate 1 (which I struggled with), but Profe. Boxwell made learning Spanish really fun and easy.  Ended up getting an A.  Show that you're eager to learn in class and do the extra credit, and you'll be golden.
Very helpful, participate in class and do supersite for homework. You write two papers and you have an oral presentation. Offers extra credit for each test. Not a lot of work. Very easy class!!

Boxwell is amazing! If you go to her office hours with supersite questions she will walk you through it and give you the answers, which helps your grade SO MUCH. She also offers 3 extra credits points for EVERY exam. Don't buy the paper textbook, just get the access code because you only really need the online text and activities. Take her!!

Intermediate 1 is basically a review of Spanish for Beginners 2 at TCU - I think I learned one new thing that I didn't learn in Beginner 2.  While easy, Boxwell is super fun and nice, and emphasizes more on speaking. Most of the class will be in Spanish but she makes it so it's not intimidating and easy to understand.

I love Boxwell! She's so incredibly nice and the most laid-back Spanish teacher I've ever had but she's still a great teacher!! She gives lots of opportunities for EC, she writes her own tests and gives study guides so they're pretty easy and the majority of the hw she assigns is supersite which is definitely manageable. This was my fav class!

She's one of the easiest spanish teachers I've ever had. I ended up with a 94 in the class.  She's super understanding, laid back, and wants you to do well.  There are frequent oral presentations but they're not hard. She speaks a mix of spanish and english during class, and she makes it clear what she's saying.  She likes to have fun in class!

literally the best and easiest professor I think I have ever had! i got a 98 average, didnt study for the final and got a 97. I also forgot to turn in like 3 hw assignments and she let me turn them in late without point deduction. It was super fun and I never got bored in class! Easy A, i would totally recommend her!

She was my favorite professor last semester. She made me much more confident in speaking Spanish by making us participate in class. I got a decent grade on every test even when I didn't study too much. She cancelled class several times, however, if you want to be super lazy, don't take her. There is a lot of homework due, but most of it is easy.

Great teacher all around! So sweet, easy tests (with study guides before hand), and easy participation points if you are actively involved in class. Take the time to get to know her in office hours and she will answer any questions. Would take her again in a heartbeat!

Great teacher. Funny, helpful, clear, and is wants you to succeed. She pretty much collects all the homework, and requires online homework too (easy). Just stay on top of vocabulary, do your homework, and make sure you understand the grammar and you'll have an easy A. She also offered us multiple extra credit assignments. Great class!

This professor is the one that will be there for you in and outside of the class. I have asked this professor for recommendation letters and she is quick to respond and help me. The is very clear in her instructions and makes sure that all of her students are successful. She will make your Spanish experience fun and interesting!

Great teacher, I really learned a lot! She was really helpful about going over tests and materials, and will work with you until you understand it. It isn't an easy class but an A is doable if you put in the work. She's fantastic and I would definitely recommend taking her!

I loved her! It was not an easy class at all, but she was great about going through work with me and answering my questions. She cares a lot about how you do and legitimately wants to see you learn. If you didn't do well it's probably because you didn't try. I really enjoyed her class and would definitely recommend taking her!

She's a very helpful person and she would always answer my questions clearly in class and office hours. She cares so much about her students and I would highly recommend. Homework is due almost everyday but that is just how the class is structured. If you are really interested in Spanish and want a great profe take Boxwell!!
Boxwell is so awesome and super helpful! She is very flexible really only wants to help you do well in her class.
Boxwell is awesome! She is very understanding of students and will review material until everyone understands it. Homework is minimal and tests are easy if you study! I would recommend taking her!

She was honestly one of my favorite professors at TCU. She is so nice and never makes you feel bad for asking a question. It's important to learn the material when quizzes come around, because that is what will be on the the tests… I love the structure of the class, because each section has the same assignments. You can't help but learn!

If you're looking to get the easy A, put zero effort in,  and retain nothing,then don't take her class. But if you want to be able to fluently negotiate your way out of an awkward misunderstanding with the Mexican drug cartel, or price haggle for a sketchy hotel room in Mexico City, then pull up those pants, return Rosetta Stone, and take Boxwell.

She is a nice lady, but not a very good teacher. She tries to help, but I ended up getting a tutor to help me through the class, and I had received good grades in high school spanish classes. There's a lot of homework, but that isn't really a big deal. She just doesn't teach well. She expects you to know everything already, and/or teach yourself.

DO NOT TAKE! Nice lady, bad teacher. Too much busy work and irrelevant class activities. She clearly gets upset/flustered with the class when there is a lack of enthusiasm or understanding. That results in her assigning more useless homework to the list. I learned more from google this semester than I did from attending every class this semester.
I found her to be very nice but she doesn't teach very well. She expects that everyone already knows the material. I would NOT take her. Find someone else!!

If the class as a whole is struggling,she gets flustered & assigns more hw/quiz. Insane amounts of h.w., difficult tests, and irrelevant class activities. Do not take at 9 am, it will be that much worse. Nice lady, but easily my least favorite spanish class/teacher.
She is very nice. attendance is important. I made a B and I am not fluent. Study textbook and you will be fine.

Very friendly and tries to help. Reviews concepts in class. Tests are extremely difficult. Points will be taken off for grammar mistakes even if they are unrelated to the material you are being tested on. Email to have her check your work before tests. Requires a lot of studying. Must know all tenses and vocab well.
She is a very nice woman but I didn't learn much in the class. She spoke in English for most of the class and didn't really teach
Organized like a high school spanish class with homework due almost every day. She's a cool person, but the amount of work she asks for is beyond a freshman level spanish class.

She is very nice, funny, but this class is strange. There is so much information and the tests are impossible to preduct what is going to be asked. The prof tries to help as much as she can with letting you know what's gonig to be on them, but it's still so strange. Her lessons are fun but they don't teach for the test. It was frustrating.

Nice woman & means well but we would spend most classes talking about things that we were never quizzed or tested on. more of a review of the material than actually teaching it so if you know the material prior to the class its probably pretty easy.  otherwise teach it to yourself and find online sites for studying.

I can confidently say that Dr. Lucero is the worst professor I have ever taken at TCU. 75% of the class had dropped by day two. She is rude and condescending, and flaunts her knowledge in her subject area. Going to class felt like walking on glass while barefoot. Absolutely do not take this class if you value your sanity. TCU needs to fire her ASAP

reviews.comment: You can end with an A. However, she is evil.

Genuinely the worst prof I have taken at TCU, extremely annoying and nitpicky and has way too much time on her hands. Assignments are long and pointless and usually have no clear guidelines. Don't take for history core.

Do not take this class, Dr. Lucero is definitely well educated in her field but teaching is not her thing. I would recommend you stay away from this class. There are much better core options that fulfill this credit.
She is very rude and degrades her students. DO NOT take her.

reviews.comment: I took her for a freshman-level course for a core history class, and it was extremely hard and time-consuming. She is rude to students and refuses to listen to feedback. The assignments are insanely long and take so long to complete, and participation is extremely necessary. Do not take unless you LOVE history.
Genuinely started to look for who does the hiring for AddRan to talk to them about firing her.

I took Latin American History during colonial times. While I didn't enjoy the class the most, it's definitely doable. There's a lot of reading, but if you skim through it, you'll be fine. Dr. Lucero ensures you understand the material—she may seem intimidating at first, but she's actually a sweet and passionate professor.

reviews.comment: This professor was extremely rude and condescending towards students. She would grade harshly without explaining why points were taken off.

reviews.comment: She is the WORST!! If you forget to turn something in the minute you step out of class your grade will drop. Her class is so much work she doesn't seem to understand that we have other classes.

reviews.comment: She is very passionate about the History of Cuba and gives amazing lectures. This is a more difficult history class that will definitely push your limits. Participation and Attendance matter! 4 unit exams (final included).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took Ms Brister for Disability Studies this semester and she is the best!! Super nice and chill and very understanding with her students. Everything is very managable. She has a few take home quizes and 3 exams along with a final and one current event presentation but super eazy. I highly recomend taking her! Very interesting class.

I took Ms. Brister for Disability Studies, and she's one of the most understanding and kind professors I've had. The class includes a few quizzes and tests, plus one presentation, but everything is very manageable and the material is really interesting. Take her!

Acts like she wants to be your friend, but is unwilling to help when needed. Talks the whole lecture repeating the same idea. Unclear what the whole point of the class is. Random pop quizzes you can't make up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class was easy and there was not much reading at first but toward the end of the semester it started adding up. If she distributed the reading more evenly across the semester it wouldn't feel so rushed. Quizzes and Exams were easy if you kept up with your reading they would be a breeze. Best option for intro to fiction
Professor Brister is a very funny and sarcastic person that makes class entertaining. She makes her tests quizzes very fair and has a well organized course schedule.

Professor Brister is amazing! She gives you a grading contract that the entire class negotiates on. It is so hard to fail this class if you put in any kind of effort. 4 total assignments that are all based on the readings, no more than like 4 pages on each. If you need an easy A take this class!

She is so responsive and doesn't use a letter grading scale. Wants everyone to end with an A! She wants to hangout with her students and makes this credit so easy to achieve. No busy work and 3-4 projects a semester. She does take attendance/notice when you're gone. THE BEST EVER! We love Brister.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Absolute Sweetheart. Super nice to students and very flexible schedule. 3 projects and 2 discussions all semester. One of the best professors Ive had at TCU
She is so sweet and really wants her students to succeed. Her lectures are super fun and interesting.
She is the best! The assignments are super creative and the lectures are fun!

Amazing professor that really values her students and always makes class fun. Comp is required but Ms. Brister knows this and makes a great effort to make every time new and interesting. Definitely take!
THE BEST PROFESSOR!!!! She is my absolute fav. Easiest class and so much fun! She is so funny and super considerate.
was not my favorite. i am a decent student and finished with an okay grade. there are other engl teachers i wouldve preferred for sure. try for the other teachers before this one.
She is a great teacher, who cares for all of her students.
so much homework. so many short essays right off the bat. first week will have an essay due
grading is so weird. you get so many random points off with no explanation. will not get any better and writing

reviews.comment: The BEST professor, she is so sweet! My favorite teacher! Easy A

She is one of the best professors, and you can tell that she cares about her students. Weekly group assignment and final is an essay over a movie. Attendance is graded but her classes are super engaging. She often asked students throughout the class how we felt about everything and would be super accomodating to our feedback. Take her!

Great teacher, so funny, and very caring. Assignments aren't that hard, and class is pretty engaging. Take her If you can for Org man. Group work is every week but the assignments for it aren't that hard.

Awesome professor, and one of the nicest people I've ever met. She cares about her students, and changes course if something is deemed unfair by students. Extremely positive experience, with engaging group work instead of boring tests. Can't recommend highly enough!

Professor Richter was one of my favorite professors at TCU. HR can be boring but she makes it interesting. Had group discussions once a week, weekly journals, two short papers (3-4 pages), 2 longer papers (7-8 pages). Shes very funny and often pushed back paper deadlines. Would highly recommend taking her.

This is the easiest class I took this semester, yet we still covered a lot of material in class. There was a weekly group discussion after which one group member needs to submit an overview, and a weekly writing assignment. None of the assignments were difficult and she grades fairly, mainly making sure you understand the material. Great class!!

Her teaching method doesn't follow the traditional lecture-exam, instead, there are a lot of in-class and small-group discussions about short readings to do at home and papers to write each week. Definitely one of the best professors I've met at TCU. Great professor and great human being. Highly recommended!

Breinn is one of my favorite professors at TCU. She truly cares about her students and is invested in our personal lives (literally had an open invite to her house for Thanksgiving dinner) She is wicked smart and challenges everyone to think more openly. I loved this class, not incredibly difficult because she makes it fun.

LOVE BREINN! She teaches HR which can be annoying for most people but she makes it bearable. There are portfolios that you have to add to each week but if you read the articles and do the bare minimum you'll be just fine. It's a WEM but the papers aren't too difficult! Would definitely take any class with her!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Take him! He is very lecture-heavy and goes from start to finish, so you're not getting out early. Truly cares about his students. Very chill, his class gets a little tiring time-wise, but it's worth it.
Doesn't often provide the best instructions but overall a great professor.  you do have to pay for some powerpoint website which is something I've never had to do before and it wasn't cheap.

Def take Social Problems with him! Super nice and understanding. It's mostly lectures without a lot of homework, just some reading before class at times so you can talk about it in class. Nothing bad to say.

Professor Brown is a really great guy. This class is very manageable but participation heavily matters which is a good thing! If no one participated it would take away the meaning of this class. I really appreciate his feedback, he really cares for his students, he wants to build connections not just speak at you. GREAT CLASS
Amazing guy, very interesting.

He is the best professor at TCU. He is very understanding and his class is fun. Lectures can get long but thats the only thing. Learning checks are easy but you still have to do the homework because participation is graded.
TAKE HIM!! He is so nice. He lectures a lot but some of the stuff is super interesting. Overall he is a really caring guy and understanding.

Professor Brown is a great teacher, very knowledgeable. I enjoyed his class, although his class would get to be a bit lecture heavy. Most of his topics are very interesting though. 3 papers, 2 exams that were take home, and a take home final exam. He encourages participation during lectures as well, just sharing your thoughts or opinions.

Mr. Brown is the best professor I have had yet. He is super caring and extremely passionate about his class. His tests are open note, but you still need to know the content. There is sometimes a lot of homework, but it's never too much. 100% would recommend this class to anyone who needs a credit and is willing to engage just a little.

I love Gary! He goes a little off topic in lectures but he is SO funny so it makes up for it. If not many students come to class, he gives super easy quizzes that are equivalent to "What color is the sky?" As for tests, just do his practice tests and go to his review sessions and you will be fine because he tells you exactly what you need to know
He is a great professor; he just ventures off when lecturing but is pretty straightforward on what's on the exam and he gives bonus points at random for showing up to class.

Gary is a great professor. The only con is that you have 4 exams and 2 papers due at the end of the semester. He lectures past the class time, so I am usually late to my next class. You have to really listen and take good notes. His exam reviews are two hours long, so buckle up. Either way, the best neuroscience professor. In-class/no note exams.
would take his course again!

Dr Boehm is the best. He is kind-heart hilarious and explains things in a clear manner. Content in this class gets very in depth and requires lots of memorization. However, quizzes are easy, there is lots of extra credit, and he puts a big curve on exams. You can take it as long as you had intro psych. Definitely recommend this is you want an A

Dr. Boehm is my favorite professor I've had. I had him for intro neuro, neuropsych, and neuroanatomy, and every course was incredible. He is engaging, funny, and brilliant. Neuroanatomy is difficult, but he is very clear about what you need to know and does review sessions. If you are going to take a neuro course, take his classes. Best professor.

As a graduating senior, Neuropsych with Gary was the single best course I have taken at TCU. While the course was very challenging, anyone is more than capable of making an A if you attend class, take good notes, attend the exam reviews and study hard for exams. I learned more from this class than others combined. TAKE THIS COURSE!

Dr. Boehm is funny, welcoming, and easily the best professor I've ever had. He doesn't use the A- grading scale, gives extra credit opportunities, and gives the fattest exam curves ever. If you're type A, his frequent lack of organization may stress you out, but it's a manageable and worthwhile experience. Take his class. You won't regret it.

Boehm is an amazing professor who is so hilarious. He is so passionate and knowledgeable about neuroscience and I feel like I've learned so much from him. He keeps you engaged with side stories along with the PowerPoint he goes through. Before the exams, he has a review session that helps you prepare and posts study guides. I highly recommend him.

Dr. Boehm is the best professor I've had at TCU in STEM, also is one of the most inspiring people I've met in my lifetime. Dr. Boehm's views are different and may not align with mine, but I do not disagree with him on any point he makes. Gary sees life from a different perspective, after meeting him I try to view life through the same lens. TAKE!

One of the best professors I had ever taken during my time here at TCU. Dr. Boehm's lectures are super hilarious and engaging, it's hard not to enjoy your time in class! You can also tell he cares about the success of all of his students, so don't hesitate to reach out to him if you're struggling-- he'll make time for you!

Dr Boehm is a hilarious professor who wants everyone to wind up with success. He adds heavy curves to the 4 exams. If you are a neuroscience major you'll be ready, but if you are a Psych Major this class would be much harder than ones you've taken so far. Has review sessions. The exams are in depth but some questions can be really easy

He will give curves if class is struggling, but you have to study. He also holds review sessions that you NEED to listen to and will provide you with tests from past years that you NEED to look at (he pulls lots of questions from these). It isn't the easiest class, but with effort, it is very achievable. He is super nice, funny, & understanding.

Don't get me wrong this class was very interesting and Boehm is really engaging and his lectures are actually fun to listen to. However he speaks so fast and everything he says can be on the test. The test are the most confusing questions I don't even know what to study because his questions make no sense. Thank god for curves. Barley got a C
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I would say that Gary is one of the best teachers you could ever have. It is professors like him that make college a place to learn and really enjoy new things. I had him for Neuroanatomy and must say he is simply the best. Just put your work in and listen to his lectures and you will be fine. Lectures are funny and he makes learning exciting!

Gary is hilarious and I loved the guy as a person. Although the class was pretty hard and I struggled to pull an A. He's super reasonable though and really wants his students to understand the material. Shoot him an email or stay after class and he's always extremely happy to help. The tests are specific but correlate to things he says in class.

Gary is amazing! His quizzes/tests are heavily based off his lectures, so it's important to pay attention because some of his questions are difficult! He is always willing to answer questions after class and wants everyone to succeed! If you pay attention and are willing to meticulously follow the material, then the class will be a success for you!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: FAVORITE professor at TCU, and this is also my favorite class. I read the book for background information, but the tests/quizzes are totally based on his lectures. This is why if you do not show up, you will not pass (he also keeps a mental note of who is not coming). Furthermore, he stays after class each time to answer questions! Best ever!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Boehm is an expert in the field of neuroscience. His lectures are captivating, but you need to pay attention to his wording. He will talk about the importance of specific attributes and functions of a neuron to the point where you understand it, but on his quizzes and exams, he is tricky. Ask questions. Read. Pay close attention to the lecture

Awesome guy, so knowledgeable and passionate about neuro. Tells lots of jokes and stories to keep it fun. That being said, neuroscience is tough and this class takes a ton of work. He offers lots of extra review sessions and curves exams -- he's not trying to weed anybody out, and he wants you to pass. Slowest grader EVER, but I recommend him.
Boehm is amazing. loved this class. funny. hot. helpful. loves the material. not easy but worth the work. not sure you need book- mostly lecture material on exam. take him!

He is really an awesome professor! he makes it almost impossible not to do well, he curves, he gives you old exams, and study guides. He is very firm in his beliefs and hilarious. If you're a neuroscience major you'll be seeing a lot of him so get ready.

Super easy class. Gives you copies of the exam from last year and reuses a bunch of questions. Curved each exam by about 10%. Lab quizzes were slightly difficult, but also curved in the end.  4 exams and a presentation in lab is the bulk of the work. Does not take attendance daily. However, sometimes gives "pop quizzes" for attendance once or twice

He is a really great person, but beware of this class. It is extremely difficult. You really need to be passionate about the brain and all of the details because Gary likes to go extremely in depth (and even prove the textbook to be wrong!). Insane amount of studying and a ton of memorization. Don't take if you want an A because that is HARD to get
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: LOVE this prof! So much fun. HOT too. Hang around & talk with him sometime- he's really interesting
Thought I would hate the class, but I really liked it instead. there is alot to cover, not easy but he made it really interesting. Lots of funny stories. TAKE HIM!
Great class!

Great Professor who's really passionate about Psych. He goes off on bunny trails every class because there's just so much he loves to talk about on the subject. He gives extra credit if he takes too long grading the tests (which happens every time) and also through SONA credits. LOVED HIM!!! Take his class if you get the chance :)

Dr. Bohem is amazingly intelligent. I had him years ago; his semester to teach at TCU.  I am coming back to write this review because I still remember his class to this day!  He is passionate about the material and really wants  you to learn it.  He puts everything into lecture so you must attend class.  He's also easy to talk to.  Recommend!

Take him! If you want to learn something, take him. He's tough and it's hard to keep up sometimes but he's amazing and so knowledgeable. He's funny and you'll never get bored in his lectures (which you cannot miss, not even once, if you want an A). He's hot and he gives generous curves and study sessions. Take him! HOT HOT HOT

Neuropsychology is by far the most interesting and rewarding class I've never taken. He's very knowledgeable about everything neuroscience. At times it's hard to keep up. I have to record the lectures and listen to them later in order to not get lost. Although you don't understand what he's saying at first, everything makes so much sense later on.

He is a really intelligent guy and knows what he is talking about. However, I think he forgets that we do not know as much as he does. He gives you all of this information but doesn't lay down a good foundation. I study my butt off and am still struggling but let's be honest neuropsychology is challenging.

This class is tough. I study 5-10 hours for every test, but I do very well. I never study for quizzes, and I do fairly well on those as well. Make sure to be in class, his powerpoints do not contain very much info, it is ALL in the lecture! I learned so much in this class, and it was probably my favorite one this semester.
Great class! I have taken all his classes; wish there were more.
The class def held up to expectation, learned so much, & it was fun doing it! Was tough, but do-able, and Boehm funny, hot, very nice to everyone & always helpful. Take his classes!!!!

LOVE Dr. Boehm!  He is the only professor that I actually understood neuroscience from....truly he makes it interesting - and I believe that's what a teacher should do.  He is a great, great instructor!  Take his class!

If you're a bio major, you'll have no problem. If you haven't taken biology since high school, you'll struggle a little more, but it's more than possible to get an A in this course. Go to all the lectures, take notes, ask him for help, read the book... basically work hard, and you'll be fine.

Dr. Boehm is the best teacher/professor I have ever had.  He makes the topics discussed absolutely fascinating and easily understandable.  His passion and expertise of the subject matter are obvious when he lectures.  Not an easy class, but he cuts a lot of breaks and will help you out if you need it, no matter what.  Take him!!
Genius. One of the most difficult A's I've ever earned. He is so helpful and wants every one to do well.

Hes so much fun makes you not wanna miss a 90minute class. Very knowledgeable and willing to talk to all his students & once he does, wont forget you. However very hard course, read the book & attend review sessions, also has a generous curve. Dont miss quizzes, pretty easy. Did i mention hes really HOTT, nice to look at. Youll love him in general.

Probably the most knowledgeable prof on campus in terms of knowing the topics and conveying them to students. Lectures are enjoyable; it's easy to be lost in large class sizes, but he takes a genuine interest in his students & is Very willing to help. Getting an A can be tough for some, stay on top of the reading in book &go to the review sessions.

Boehm is awesome. I took intro to neuroscience with him after he talked me into it, and I couldn't be happier. He's funny and makes listening to a 90 minute lecture actually entertaining. He's also super intelligent. Making an A takes some work, but read and go to the test reviews beforehand and you'll be fine.

He is hilarious! Great professor and lectures but tough class/exams! Definitely not an easy anything (A,B,C). However, I learned so much in his class so I'd take his class again in a heartbeat even with knowing the difficulty level. Boehm is THAT AWESOME.

THIS CLASS WAS LEGIT. Take him for general psychology!! You will not regret it! He is so awesome and you learn A LOT, no matter what your major is. It's stuff you seriously can use in all aspects of your life. I highly recommend him! An A is very possible and it does not require INTENSIVE efforts. Also, don't bother to buy the book! Study lectures.
This prof is amazing! Loved the class, and the dude wasn't bad to look at either (he is ripped!)! Was funny and very helpful. Not an easy class though!

Boehm is a really cool teacher. He is energetic, always ready to teach and his lectures are really interesting. He is also unbelievably intelligent...people ask questions all the time and he almost always had an answer. He is like a dictionary of knowledge. Tests can be hard if you have a lot of other class work but good class overall.
I took a class called Genius Minds and Broken Brains with him. He is extremely intelligent and knows how to teach where the students want to learn. Easy reading, but its very interesting. Great prof.
PERFECT, HOT, FUNNY, SILLY, BRILLIANT, CUTE/ADORABLE, KIND, INTELLIGENT.....did I mention sexy??!! Oh and his teaching and the class..... priceless. The best class and professor I've ever had!!

Took Stress & Health in summer and it was cool. It was a lot more neuro-biology than I thought it was going to be but I haven't taken bio since HS and I still made an A. Read when he tells you to and make an effort and you will be fine. I learned a lot and would recommend this class cause it is very interesting.
Great lecturer! Currently taking stress class and enjoy it. Study for quizzes!

Listed as Psyc, but is actually a professor in neuroscience.  This can be a problem for some psyc students that are unprepared for the amount of biology that they are exposed to within the context of the class.  Classes are relatively difficult, but with proper effort good scores are easily attainable. Very fair and helpful/available to students.

Great teacher!!! The material was hard (it's a senior level class...what do you expect) but he explains everything really well, and he is always very willing to go the extra mile to help you understand the topics.  DON'T GRADUATE WITHOUT TAKING A CLASS FROM HIM!!!
This man is awesome! I learned a lot in his class! I was considering majoring in psych. before I took his class and after taking his class I have decided to do it! Funny and laid back! TAKE HIM!
he is a very good teacher. i really enjoyed this class. it is terribly hard, but its more than interesting. loved the class!!
I love his class so much and I learned more in his class than I will ever learn! Come to class and participate and you will make an easy A!!! He is the best teacher every!!
what a cool dude! he is the best prof. that i have ever had. he is funny and down to earth. everybody should take a class that he teaches. you will learn a ton and have fun doing it!
AMAZING teacher. take him. take him. take him! best professor ive ever had. by far. participate in class and get to know the guy. hes AWESOME.
Amazing teacher.  Probably the best at TCU

He is a great attentive professor who goes above and beyond for his students. He is great to get along with and lots of fun. But warning: this class is VERY hard. If you are not required to take this class I say spare yourself some money and don't take it, especially if science is not your field. Take an easier science class or another Boehm class.
No Comments
One of the best professors I've ever had.  He is hilarious and very helpful when you have questions. He makes his lectures really interesting. Great guy.

best teacher i have had so far. he is a really great, laid back man, who knows his stuff, cares about his students, and cares about his students learning.  he is a funny guy and a compassionate man and has a real level head on his shoulders.  i recommend him 2 everyone no matter what your major.

oh my goodness - boehm is the best professor i have ever had! i would take any other class from him in a heartbeat...he's so laid back and easy to talk to. he's also soooo smart! you will have totally missed out on your college experience at tcu if you don't take dr. boehm!
Very enjoyable class. Dr. Boehm always livens things up. I heard his other classes are very hard, but the Fresh. Seminar isnt' too bad. He is very intelligent and opionated. Great Proffessor
not an easy class.  work very hard to get a good grade.  dr. boehm though is the smartest man i've ever met.  very funny and charming.  but gives very hard tests
Great instructor! He really knows what he's talking about and although there is alot of information to take in he won't hesitate to make himself avalible to you.

He is amazing! By far one of the best professors I have had at TCU. He knows everything and will work with you to make sure you are successful. He also makes an effort to get to know you and will remember you even years later. Take his classes!
this professor almost influenced me to change my major to psychology. incredibly interesting lectures and also very useful knowledge for everyday life. one of the best professors at TCU.
Had him my freshman year for general psych and havent had a professor like him yet. He knows who you are and does his best to make you successful. I loved him!

Great class and he does a great job teaching it.  If you do all the extra credit possible, and work hard you can make an A.  He is always willing to help and learns who you are very fast.  Class is worth going to because he makes the subject fun.
Great teacher! Very informative and knows what he's talking about! I highly reccommend taking his class!
the best teacher at TCU. He is hot also. Very charming, very smart, funny as well, and just cute as hell. Take his class, you will fall under his spell, I am sure.
THis guy is one of the best teachers ever.  He is so easy to understand and he works with you whenever you need help.  I would totally take him for another class

Probably the smartest person I know--period. His class was difficult, but with hard work it's very possible to get an A. Works very hard to get students to understand his material. Class is entertaining b/c he's funny as well.

Incredible teacher! So intelligent, funny, underdstanding, and flexible. More than willing to stay after class and talk, geniunely enjoys teaching, and I enjoyed being in his class, one of my all time favorites at TCU.
He is funny. He is very passionate about the subject matter, and he is easy to get along with.

Incredible teacher. Very intelligent, near genius! He loves his job and his research. Best teacher I've ever had. The seminar wasn't terribly hard but I've heard many say his other classes are. It is worth it though.
No Comments
His classes are kinda hard, but he is the best professor I've ever had.

Class is broken up into 3 sections, each with 5 online quizzes, a test, and a group project. The group projects are easy and are created in a way that guarantees everyone in the group is prepared. The tests are extremely term-heavy, but you get a cheat sheet. Averaged B's on tests, A's on projects, and have a 95. Lectures are extremely repetitive.

The best!!! Definitely cannot forget about or skip his class, and his test can be challenging (I got 80s on the exams and still got an A). 4 presentations, 3 exams (w/ cheat sheets), 3 case analyses, 15 quizzes, that's it. But he is so energetic at 8 am and will remember your name after the first few weeks! Best org man professor
Nice professor and brings funny and interesting examples to class. Work is not challenging, and you learn about how the workforce operates.

Yes there can be a good amount of work for the class but Professor Brightenburg makes it really interesting and he is just a great guy. I really enjoyed his class and the way he presents information. A couple of group projects and some long readings but the work isn't hard and it is not hard to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Brightenburg is the man! He is caring and super engaging every class! Weekly Quizzes, 3 Case Studies, 3 Presentations, and 3 Exams. Rubrics clearly outline his grading criteria. You get a one sided cheat sheet for exams; however, study extra as some questions are tricky. Pay attention to examples in class. Put in effort and you will succeed!

Brightenburg is an awesome dude that really cares about you. He'll give you a ton of work (like a TON) but if you do it he'll grade you pretty easy, especially on the group projects. As long as you're coherent and do what he asks during group projects, you'll get high A's on everything.

Great professor, but he does take the presentations in his class very serious, the environment changes when its presentation time we once had a girl faint because of the stress. He is a nice man if you get to know him, he will try to have everyone's name memorized by the end of the 1st month. Good guy just wished we didn't have 3 presentations.

I think the workload is more intense than other profs: 3 group projects, 1 individual project, 3 tests (with cheat sheets) and weekly quizzes. In spite of that I actually really liked the class. The material is pretty interesting and easy to understand, and I like his energetic personality. One of my favorite classes this semester.

He is honestly very nice, and really is a genuine guy. He knew everyone's name by the 2nd week and wanted to get to know you. The 4 presentations were pretty easy, but the exams can be a little tricky (cheat sheet allowed). If you put in a little effort to actually read and learn, an A is definitely achievable if you try. I highly recommend him!

Everything in this class is based on 3 group projects pretty much. He is a very nice guy and always wants his students to do well. He is a farmer on his off days. For whatever reason though his class always felt way too serious. We have had 2 kids pass out in his class during their presentations because the energy of the room is just so intense.

Prof. Brightenburg is great and really does care. However, the class is so much more difficult than it needs to be. There are online quizzes which can have tricky wording. The exams are easy if you remember the quiz questions. HE ASSIGNED A GROUP PROJECT OVER THANKSGIVING BREAK. I think he's a great guy, but I strongly recommend another prof.

Professor Brightenburg really cares about his students and wants them to do good. Really cares about the material that he is teaching and is heavily invested in it. There is 3 group presentations and 1 individual presentation. Simple quizzes over each chapter. You will need to study for his exams though, he allows a cheat sheet for each exam.

Professor Brightenburg is a very caring professor. His lectures can be repetitive, but he is enthusiastic about what he teaches. The course is centered around 3 group projects and 3 exams. The group projects are not that difficult and the instructions are pretty clear. The exams can be a bit difficult but achieving an A is not hard.

I really enjoyed this class. Since there are a lot of assignments, there is less pressure to score high on all 3 tests. He lets you know the exact textbook sections that will be on exams, and the last one is not cumulative.  There are 3 group presentations and 1 individual one. Great professor for an upper level course- an A was pretty attainable.

Professor Brightenburg is a great teacher. Super nice guy who is very transparent about assignments and grading. You will be doing a lot of presenting and groupwork in this class, but outside of that there is no homework. Only negative of the class is that the exams can be a little difficult. Would for sure take him again

Great professor overall nice guy. Very easy to do well on presentations if you follow his instructions and hit all of the points. Students get 3 unexcused absences. Quizzes are online and generally not too difficult. Tests are fully textbook material/definitions but can sometimes be tricky. Not too heavy of a workload, would 100% take him again.

Not an enjoyable class. Extremely work heavy for an organizational management class. Lectures are boring. 4 presentations, 3 tests, 3 case studies. Not impossible to get an A but you have to really work for it. I found it difficult to put so much effort into such a dull subject.

3 easy team projects/presentations and 1 individual presentation. Relatively easy chapter quizzes online taken remotely - about once a week. MCQ exams aren't crazy difficult, but you should study/quizlet. Allows 3 absences, otherwise attendance is mandatory. Overall, pretty great guy who is eager to help and gives pretty solid feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Brightenburg is the best & easiest teacher to take for Org Man. The midterm & final exams are terms straight from the textbook. You have four group and one individual presentation that are generously graded. If you read the textbook every week and show up for your group projects, you are good. I made a Quizlet for each exam and got an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Brightenburg is an awesome professor! Easy A if you give your best work and show up to class. Assignments were divided into 10 easy online reading quizzes, 4 case study discussions with group presentations, 2 in-person exams, and an individual presentation. This class improved my public speaking tremendously. Highly recommend this professor!

He is a good guy who cares a lot about his class and the students. He takes attendance every class and you get 3 misses and you have weekly quizzes online that are easy. You also have 4 group presentations that are not that hard. His lectures can be boring sometimes but you need to pay attention to the midterm and final exams. Would take him again

Brightenburg is a really caring guy, his class isn't easy but if you put in the work you'll be just fine. He just lectures in class and theres one 5 minute presentation per class by a student (everyone does 1 for the semester). 4 group case studies, switch groups each time, pretty straightforward. 1 Quiz a week at home on D2L. Take him!

Such a nice guy. Really cares about students and the material. You get a page of notes for exams so that helps a lot. There's 4 group case studies, but as long as your group communicates and splits up the work you'll be fine. Easy grader. Take him if you can!

I have professor brightenburg for my organizational management. Brightenburg has very clear expectations when it comes to assignments. He makes the classes incredibly engaging so it is easier to want to stay engaged. You have four case studies with a group, four test (with a cheat sheet), and four integrative essays. You also do a presentation.

Only took him cuz my friends recommended him from the semester before, but he completely changed course layout. 4exams plus final, 3essays, and a massive group project in semester. Hard grader, but an overall nice guy. Had to grind for an A- cuz our group got poorly graded on certain things. Take someone else but getting a good grade is possible.

Tedious lectures every class, but I talked to him a few times and he's actually not bad of a guy. The class itself can be really tough in the beginning, but in the end he starts to give you bonuses and opportunities to improve your grades. I had an 88 before the final weeks and ended up with an A thanks to all the extra credits stuff

Went to his office, had a few conversations, thought we understood his expectations but then gave us a B for not following his weird instructions. Group projects are weird as well with so many team assignments (4 plus bonuses). If you want to do strictly team stuff all over and over take him otherwise don't. He's a nice guy but his class sucks.
Brightenburg has so many assignment, all of them are so detailed and demanding that you cannot understand his expectations on your own, unless you go to office hour. Highly not recommended.

Brightenburg's lectures are informative because they can help explain some of the material. He interacts with the class very well. He does round up grades within the class pertaining to the outcome. Toughest part is following the formatting for assignments but he does give clear instructions and will answer your questions. Will accept late work.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's not too difficult of a guy, but definitely would take someone else if I had a choice. Lectures a lot, so many assignments and exams for a semester and has super odd instructions that I have never seen any other professors at Neeley use (footnotes, endnotes for APA?).

He lectures a lot and has so weird writing guidelines and expectations for every assignment. If you want a good grade you have to go to office hours before every assignment or else you will not make more than a B+. A lot of grades and different guidelines for everything seriously just drain you out. One of the worst professors I ever had.

Many grading materials: 4 exams, 3 essays, 6 group assignments and a presentation. Exams are easy as long as you follow the book chapters, but the group assignments and essays are tiring. He lectures a lot and it's boring sometimes, his writing guidelines are SUPER specific and weird so make sure you always format everything like his instructions.
Brightenburg is very nice, his lectures can be pretty boring cause his voice kinda puts you to sleep. His test are super easy as long as you read the sections in the book he tells you to.

The worst part about this class is that he cold calls on you but you get used to it. Weekly quizzes are super easy because you can look at the online book during them. You also have a semester long project with one group that has lots of presentations and long essays and his writing guidelines are really specific.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The worst part about this class is that he cold calls on you but you get used to it. Weekly quizzes are super easy because you can look at the book. You also have a semester long group project with lots of presentations and long essays and his writing guidelines are really weird and specific.

He's a fine professor. He lectures a lot and its not very engaging. It's not super difficult to get an A in the class, especially with the extra credit. All of his tests have open notes and your overall test grade is inflated if you have a note sheet.
Brightenburg is a good professor and fair grader. Everyone I know in the class has an A or high B. Overall, I would recommend him!

Prof. Burnell is young and has a very engaging class. I think he has a different approach to his teaching but it works.  He's very open to feedback and wants to help you in any way.  He assigns readings, and you have a quiz/entry ticket over them each week. very organized and would highly reccomend.

Great professor that makes every class super engaging and fun. He is passionate about entrepreneurship and you can expect to learn a lot. 3 main group projects + quizzes: pretty easy but he does grade pretty specifically so you can't expect to do the bare minimum and get a good grade in the class. Apply yourself and you'll succeed. Highly Recommend

Love professor Burnell! Hes a young new professor and he makes class so fun! He really cared about everyone of his students, and wants you to succeed. Tests were not hard if you studied. Group project ended up being very fun! Love him!

Super fun class with lots of student engagement. Young new professor who is excited to teach about his research. Class material gets repetitive but overall easy class with fun vibe. ALWAYS got out early too.

He's pretty easy if you read and make sure you understand the D2L content/study guides he gives you before tests. His lectures are boring and he gets sidetracked a lot but he's a pretty funny dude which keeps it a little more engaging.

He's funny and gets side tracked a lot. Others on here say he's difficult but I swear to you if you go thru the d2l modules and read the assigned chapters once thru, you'll do fine. The tests are your whole grade but they aren't that hard. Show up to class(can be difficult) and he may even give extra credit. If you have basic study skills its easy.

Every day is a lecture, but he is so unclear that you never know what to write down. He is funny, but gets very sidetracked, so it is very difficult to follow. He does not use D2L (AT ALL), so if you have to take this class, keep track of your grade. He hasn't replied to either of my emails or my friends. Do not take this class if you want to pass.
i dont even know how to describe

WORST CLASS EVER. I was in this class for two days and oh my gosh. No clear notes and lectures, random quizzes that he grades/won't know if he grades?, and lastly.... You dont know what your grade will be ALL SEMESTER. If you have a sliver of hope left in your life, do not take Douglas Butler. Also he goes around class barefoot.
So confusing, no grades ever put in. Just avoid him if you can.

Quirky guy who I really enjoyed having. Class is pretty straightforward if you attend lectures and actually pay attention to what he's saying. Also, be sure to read the assigned chapters from the multiple textbooks he requires (not a lot of reading) because he will put that on his exams. Lastly, keep track of your grade yourself, doesn't use D2L.

He did not put in literally any grades until a week ago. He is a very kind-hearted man but because I didn't know my overall grade or my first test score I wasn't able to get an A. His content is fairly straight forward, just pay attention and read the material he posts, and go to office hours. He isn't the worst possible option.
IGNORE BUTLER AT ALL COSTS!!! You will never know your grade in the class which is so frustrating. Does not respond to emails and is extremely hard to reach outside of class.

Professor Douglas is genuinely so sweet despite getting off topic a lot. He doesn't respond to emails and you can't see your grades throughout the semester. He teaches interesting stuff so if you just ignore the rambling and take good notes, you'll be fine. Quizzes are relatively easy as well.

There is reading that you should do if you want to understand! He doesn't have slides, so pay attention in class. Accessible by office hours and it's helpful to ask questions/go over tests. If you pay attention, study, and ask questions you will be okay but if you are trying to get by with minimum effort this class is definitely not for you!!
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Butler is nice and funny, but he can get off track during lecture and is unorganized. He does not put in grades all semester so keep track on your own end.The concepts in the class are not difficult, and the 4 exams count for 80% of students' grades. They test concepts from lecture heavily, so make sure to attend class and take good notes.

Professor Butler is a kind guy but when it comes to teaching he tends to go off topic in class. It is hard to follow what he is trying to teach and I often have to teach myself the material outside of class. He assigned a few homework assignments so your grade is primarily the test, so make sure you do well.

grade is mostly based on exams which are kind of hard tbh; u kinda have to pay attention in lectures which is hard because there aren't slides or anything, just him talking about the concepts; attendance not mandatory; very funny guy and def worse profs out there but not a favorite

Dr. Butler is one of the best professors I have ever had. As long as you show up (which you often get extra credit for on Fridays) you will pass. The tests are most of the grade but as long as you write down the basic idea he will give you full credit for the question. He always has bonus questions during the tests. Take his classes.

Fun professor and pretty easygoing, class is pretty easy if you pay attention to his lectures. He takes roll randomly and attendance is only around 6% of your grade, so show up 2/3 of the time and the class is a breeze. Most of your learning is from the book or common knowledge, but there's no homework, only tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Butler is a pretty cool guy if you pay attention in class.  Most people think the class is hard only because they have no attention span.  If you show up 2 out of 3 times a week and listen to him, he basically tells you exactly what he's putting on the test.  There's like 3 tests and 2 homeworks though, so do well on them.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a nice guy, but very much all over the place. As long as you read through the textbook you will be fine. He does not post grade online so you kind of just have to keep track of where your grade is at on your own.

If this is your first econ course, I wouldn't take him. If you have a basic understanding of econ, then the class is pretty easy. Lectures and D2L are all over the place. Tests are multiple choice and just like the review. 3 tests and about 3 homework assignments are ALL you're graded on. I did not use the textbook, he posts everything on d2L.

Dr. Butler is a nice guy, but an awful professor. His lectures, much like his D2L page, are all over the place. There's very little to no organization at all. His lectures are 90% side-tangent and 10% actual material. There's only four exams and four homeworks given for the entire year. While concepts are basic, I had to learn it all out of class.

Professor Douglas is a nice guy and always has something funny to say, however, his lectures are chaotic and often times irrelevant to the information. When he is talking about economics he explains it really well, but this is relevant for 5-10% of a class period. His tests are very much based off the readings he has on his D2L and class examples.

DO NOT take Butler for Intro to Micro! He lectures about random stuff the entire class. It is impossible to follow him, even if you are paying attention. When you ask questions he jokingly says "I think you all know that". In office hours he is scatterbrained and confusing. When we get our tests back, he doesn't know the questions and homework.

Dude gets a tough break by people with limited attention span. The people in my groupme just hated on him because they didn't want to pay attention. His lessons are a little scattered but you actually can learn a ton from him if you listen. I never got lower than a 97 on a test and studied 3 hours total outside of class. Easy A, plus can learn too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class wasn't very difficult and attendance is optional. However, with that being said, a lot of important information, such as homework assignments and test dates, are only announced or changed in class. The lectures were dull and he often repeats himself and rambles on. He didn't seem to be very organized.

Dr. Butler was too boring for me. His class was easy, but it wasn't fun like I'd hoped (I'm an econ major and actually like econ). You don't need to buy the textbook. Anything he wants you to read he puts on D2L in a pdf. His D2L is a little scattered. Almost no homework but the readings on D2L. Tests are easy if you spend 2 hours studying.

Dr. Butler is a great guy and although his class can be a little unorganized and he goes off on tangents, the tests are very straightforward and directly from the lectures. He barely goes from the textbook and there are no slides so it is crucial to attend class. So, if you go to class and put in a little effort when studying, you will do well.
Do not take his class, he talks about nothing every day does not guide you to resources you need to study, and is unreachable by email. One of the worst classes I have had
Dr. Butler is a nice guy if you get to know him. Literally anything he says in class is bound to be on the test, so write it all down. Definitely an easy A.

the most terrible professor in my academic career. he does not do the slides, so there is no way you could review for the exams besides your notes. attendance is not mandatory, but do not miss a freaking class otherwise you wont even pass it. he enjoys taking things that are absolutely off the topic........ OMG, he is just too terrible...

Dr. Butler is definitely an unconventional professor, but if you pay attention in class he really does go over everything you need to make an A on the tests. If you can do the example problems he works in class and the homework problems, you should make an A easily. The textbook is very unnecessary in my opinion. Good option for Intermed Micro.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He doesn't use lecture notes or Power points so his lectures are hard to follow. When he seems like he's going off on a tangent that same material can show up on a test. Your grade is pretty much all tests so definitely show up to class even though he does not take attendance because he actually does explain some concepts pretty well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a really nice and funny guy. We didn't learn much because his lectures were always the same and very off topic most of the time.

This class was pointless. Hardly learned anything because we did not cover much material. Lectures basically consisted of him going off tangent. It was not clear what to study for exams, and he only directed on a few things to focus on but that was not the whole exams so you still have to listen to his so called lectures. NEVER replied to emails

Joke of a class I really have no clue how to rate him because it was almost pointless for me to take this class. If you are an ECON major I would NOT take him because you will learn nothing besides whatever random thought he has in his head that day. His lecture/class has 0 structure and is very hard to follow. He is a good guy, but a bad teacher

Douglas is the worst professor I have had in my academic career.  His lectures are painfully unorganized, illegible, and he has wasted countless classes talking about random and useless topics.  Regards to grading, he marks off 12 points for missed multiple choice questions because "you don't deserve an A if you don't understand the lesson"

Great Prof.  Keeps class fun and interesting!  Read his articles!! Pay attention and do the readings, easy A. One of the most fun professors I had this semester!  Great honors course to have first semester if you are a business major!

Very good professor, I would certainly take him again. There are only 3 parts of your grade. Homework which is due every class, a final test and a quiz every 2 weeks. The material isn't hard and he make the class fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the best economics classes I've taken at TCU. He genuinely cares about his students, wants them to succeed, and is very available to help. It is a challenging class but if you do the work it's manageable. There are a fair bit of quizzes but no exams until the final. I would definitely take him again if I could!

You're entire grade is quizzes every other week and the cum. final exam. Quizzes were pretty difficult, kind of like riddles unless you really understood the material. He's nice, but isn't that great at explaining things. Problems on quiz are different from problems you do in class, many of us failed most quizzes. Was one of my worse classes at TCU

Professor Butler is a decent professor - very knowledgeable and respectful. Just ALWAYS do the homework, take notes and use both your notes and how he did the homework in class to prepare for the 6 sem quizzes. Class is very interesting so I recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is extremely knowledgeable and an easy grader. There are only small quizzes during the semester, but the class requires effort. If you want to succeed he will help you succeed. Overall, very caring, but the class can be challenging sometimes.
Hardest class I've ever had to take at TCU
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Butler is one of my favorite professors here after taking him. His lectures are amazing and does so many example problems in class almost identical to the ones on the tests. He really cares about everyone succeeding and grades very fairly. He offers lots of quizzes but only keeps your best 5 to try and help improve your grade so he drops 3-4.
Dr. Butler is a fantastic professor. He is really good at explaining the material and making sure the class understands. He grades fairly leniently and ultimately wants every student to succeed!

Take intro micro with Butler if you can.  He is very open to questions from students and cares about everyone doing well in the class.  Naturally, Micro isn't easy for everyone, so studying will be required to do well in the class.  I liked this class and Butler is a great dude.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Butler is such a great lecturer! He does a great job of explaining concepts. There is no homework or reading, except for the occasional online homework quiz. His test/quizzes are tough but totally doable if you put in the work to study. He is reasonable with is grading and gives credit for improvement. Overall sweet guy and great professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Butler is amazing, easily the best professor I have ever had at TCU. He's an expert in his field but is really good at breaking down the material to make it more understandable. Tests can be challenging but if you go to class and do the homework you should be fine. Dr. Butler is more than willing to help you out and make sure you understand!

Great professor. The class meets at 8am on MWF though, and there is a quiz every Friday and about every other Wednesday which can get tough. Very little textbook use - pretty much every thing comes from lectures. The group project is fun and not too hard, yet accounts for a large percentage of the grade. I would take Butler and this class again.
Horrible Professor

Dr. Butler might be the best professor I've ever had. The classes are short, you get let out early, and he explains everything excellently over lectures. He works with you, wants you to do good, and will try to help you on tests. Show up, do the homework, there's an occasional pop quiz, but if you want an A, you can get an A.

GREAT professor!  Very friendly, awesome explainer, makes complicated issues easy to understand.  One of the best teachers I've had so far at TCU! Class attendance is necessary to do well. Tests mainly based off notes, experiments, and some from supplementary reading.  I took this class in the summer and can honestly say the 8 am classes were fun!
Love the Elvis bonus questions :)
Do the HW and show up to class, you sould be fine.

Best teacher I have had so far in this major.  Subject can be difficult, but he explains everything as clearly as possible.  The best part is that he WANTS you to do well, so he will help if you are having trouble.  Great teacher, I would take him again if I could, for sure.
No Comments

Great micro teacher! If you go to class then you will learn a lot and be in pretty good standing for the tests. The only thing is that there are always a couple surprises on the end of the exam that he puts on to see how much of it you can do which makes it hard to get an A. As long as you go to class you he will make sure you understand.

This is a fairly hard class, but Dr. Butler makes it at least less painless.  I don't know that he is the easiest Econ teacher out there but I think he is overall probably the best.  You will learn a lot if you pay attention in class.  If I had it to do over I would take Dr. Butler again and you should too.

He's great. Intermediate Micro is a tough subject but he makes it bareable. He teaches well and gives plenty of opportunities to keep your grade pretty high (High B, Low A) with all the quizzes. If you put effort into it, an A is possible.

Awesome guy and good professor. He's funny and energetic and fair in his grading. If you have general knowledge in economics then you can do well in the class as long as you go and do the homework and keep ahead.
Teaches well. Majority of grade is based on quizzes, final is the only test.

I really like him. No tests except final. If you go to class the material is very easy to learn. No reading textbook required, only used for in class and homework problems which are minimal. I recommend this class to everyone.
More interesting than Intermediate Macro in my opinion and much easier.  He helps you learn the material better.
TIPS for an A. BE IN CLASS. Do homework, ELVIS is the answer to his bonus questions, and final is freakin impossible so have your grade secured before it.
Class is not that hard and you do not have to do much work outside of class.  Final is weighted heavily though.

Outstanding.  Did my Master's research under Mike. A very helpful and caring professor, now Dean.  Always treated me fairly and listened to questions.  Good explanations in class and willing to help outside of class as well.
no exams (except final) - just weekly quizzes.  easy - just like the hw probs worked in class.
