I don't know how she is for lecture, but if you have the opportunity to take her for lab, DO IT. She is very clear in what she expects and is the SWEETEST lady ever.

Dr. Crenshaw is SO NICE. She makes it very clear what she will test over, but her tests are SO HARD. The information is very briefly covered and the majority of the class is outside work. I've heard she's amazing for lab, and as for lecture she is so nice, which makes the class bearable, but it is extremely difficult.

Professor Crenshaw is probably the best A&P professor out there. Her tests are hard and you definitely have to put in the work, but once you figure out how to be successful, it gets easier. She is always willing to help and definitely cares about her students, but would never bump your grade. Highly recommend her if you actually want to learn!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: don't be fooled by her good ratings here. every person i've spoken to in real life does NOT like her. The teacher for her course should be called McGraw and Hill because she does not TEACH. she copy-pastes everything from the textbook. instead of quizzing you on concepts, she asks deceiving specific questions that are inconsistent with lectures.

She expects you to know and teach yourself ALL the content before you even step foot in the classroom each day. She brags about this too and thinks it makes her class extra advanced, but in reality it strips students of the opportunity to learn from a teacher. You might as well just buy an anatomy textbook and read end to end.

Professor Crenshaw is amazing. She cares deeply about her students and wants them to do their best. The classes she teaches are challenging, but her lectures are engaging and positive. She always brings a bright smile and is willing to help you with anything.
Best Anatomy professor hands down, but also the hardest and most thorough! Work with her and you will learn so much and make it through, she is an AMAZING lady who makes a great class
I learned a lot but EXTREMLY hard
Very hard class

sweet professor, very knowledgable when it comes to anatomy. always willing to answer questions and is kinda accesible out of class. her tests are pretty hard, you're going to have to really study since there's only 2 lab exams. overall, i like her for lab, she does practice quizzes at the end of every class to see if youre getting the info down.

I had her for lab and she was great!! The most helpful for lab for sure. The class will be hard no matter what professor you have, but she is so approachable and helpful for lab and really wants to ensure her students' success in the class. She provides study tips and tricks and will answer your questions in depth. Definitely recommend her for lab!

This class is very difficult no matter what. You spend all the classtime lecturing powerpoints and doing practice comprehension questions. Your homework consists of watching lecture videos and doing lecture quizzes. Tests are very hard and content heavy. Be prepared to study a little bit each day to not fall behind.

I enjoyed Professor Crenshaw, you can tell she loves what she does! She is a good teacher, but her tests are very hard.  She will ask for very specific details on tests, so make sure to study weeks in advance for lecture exams.

I absolutely loved Professor Crenshaw, she was so sweet but her tests were extremely hard. I studied for so long for each test, yet I still wasn't able to get above a C. I am now in another teachers class this semester for Anatomy and I am doing so much better. Crenshaws tests are 60 questions and do not contain a lot of pre-lecture quiz questions.

Professor Crenshaw is one of the sweetest people at TCU. I had Crenshaw for lab not lecture but having her for lab was such a blessing. She was super knowledgeable and helpful. Wants to see her students succeed in lab and I had fun in this lab.

Anatomy is the hardest class I have taken. However Professor Crenshaw does ease this as she is a really good professor. The tests are doable as long as you study and know the powerpoints. Go to office hours and study everyday and every night if you want to pass. The class is over the top hard for no reason no matter who you take. Study study study!

I loved Mrs. C, she was so sweet and really tried to help students in anyway she could. A&P is a hard class no matter who you take it with, however, she made it 10x harder. I would suggest another professor but if you do take it with her make sure to study at least every night because it is a lot of information.

Mrs. Crenshaw made anatomy so interesting. She genuinely cares that you understand the concept and is so welcoming to answering questions. She never makes you feel dumb and is so eager to help. By far one of the best professors I have ever had! Class is difficult but very reasonable. Make sure you take down notes and study powerpoints!

Mrs. C is one of the nicest biology profs at TCU. She cares about her students and their success and is easy to access for office hours. Her exams are difficult and require lots of studying and practice, but she is more than happy to review with you during office hours.

Take Crenshaw if you can! She lectures a lot, but takes time for questions/explanations. The material is detailed and the tests are very specific, but it's possible to do well in the class if you keep up with notes and work ahead. Exams are the majority of grade, so make sure to study far in advance.

Mrs. Crenshaw is one of the kindest professor's I've had, however, this class is SO hard. Anatomy is designed to be hard, but Mrs. Crenshaw takes it to another level. I felt like it was even harder to take online, and not much sympathy was given for that.

I have nothing but great things to say about Professor Crenshaw. It is a given that Anatomy is one of the hardest courses ever, however Professor Crenshaw does ease away the toughness of this course. She's amazing and I recommend taking her!

Mrs. Chrenshaw is an angel sent from heaven. It is no secret that this is a tough class, but Mrs. Crenshaw is so caring and so helpful and genuinely wants her students to succeed. She is the kindest professor I have ever had, she is seriously amazing. She will answer any question you have and will help you in any way to pass the class.

Mrs. Crenshaw is hands down one of the best professors. She is highly intelligent and knows what shes talking about THOROUGHLY. She is also extremely caring and is always there to assist you if needed. This class though... is SO HARD. You wont pass without really applying yourself and studying a ton. Go to office hours and never miss a lecture.

Crenshaw is hands down one of the best professors I will ever have! She is so kind and truly passionate about teaching anatomy. She will go above and beyond to keep you interested in lecture and make sure you understand. The class is difficult (and some say Garcia for lecture is easier) but I would 100% recommend taking her over over anyone else.

Crenshaw is very knowledgeable and passionate about A&P and it shows in her lectures and when you talk to her in office hours. She also genuinely cares about all of her students and will do anything to help. Lectures are very informational and she throws in jokes a lot to keep the mood light. Overall, an amazing professor.

Professor Crenshaw is an outstanding professor and person overall. She is so kind and is very passionate about her work. She will gladly make time to meet with you outside of class if her office hours don't match up with your schedule. This class is very hard and her tests are extremely difficult but there are some ways you can bump up your grade.

Molli Crenshaw is AMAZING! This class is super hard, but if you work hard and figure out a way that you study best, you will pass. Crenshaw genuinely cares about her students, and even though her class is hard, you will get so much out of it. Amazing, 10/10 recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: loved Ms. C, she really is amazing, but i can't even put into words how much I hated her class. If this was the only class you took, you'd still be a pretty busy student. you'll have to spend 3+ hours a day, not including class, in order to do well. That's also not including lab, but you can handle that during the period itself

Anatomy will be very hard regardless of which teacher you have, but Ms. C is easily the best. She's the most knowledgeable and passionate professor I've had so far. However, her class will destroy you if you don't prepare. It's 2+ hours a day every day of studying or just making flashcards. Lab is also very challenging so don't just cram for it.

I had Crenshaw for A&P I lab and lecture and loved her so much! She truly cares about her students and their success. A&P is not an easy class, but Crenshaw doesn't make it harder than it needs to be. She gave 6 exams but it was great because one bad grade wouldn't bring you down. I would take her for every nursing class if possible!

The best BIOL20204 prof. She makes genuine connections with students and is always available for office hours or scheduled appointments. The content is extremely difficult, but the more you communicate with her the easier it is to study.

Mrs. C was the biggest blessing in my nursing career. I failed the first few tests and started working with her and putting in the effort I hadn't in Wallace - studied every night, went to every office hour, asked so many questions, and managed to pull off a C. The best human and always pushed me and believed in me - so smart and so caring.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Crenshaw is the sweetest and really cares about her students. A&P is a hard class in general but she tries hard in lectures to make the material easier to understand. Be prepared to study tons for this class. Daily quizzes that do add up towards the final grade. Lectures the whole 1.5 hours. Powerpoints are long/detailed. TONS OF READING/STUDYING
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This lady is an angel. Anatomy is obviously going to suck but she is the sweetest lady. Go to office hours because she really will help you!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Anatomy is not an easy class. However, Mrs. C knows this and wants you to make it through. She helps you and is available for office hours GO TO THEM!!! The tests are hard and require days of preparation because of the amount of material. Study every day after class! Nicest teacher. GO to class bc you have a quiz every lecture but every class does
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Crenshaw is the best teacher I've ever had. She is SO good at explaining complex things in minutes. That being said, the class is really tough. The tests are okay, as long as you memorize ALL of the material. Study 2-3 hours a night just to keep up. You learn a TON of material so I would recommend going to class, otherwise you'll be stressed.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is such a sweet lady and good teacher. She makes the class as interesting as possible and wants everyone to make a decent grade for how hard the subject is. Do the study guides as you go through each chapter, as long as you keep up with the material you should pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: So hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: LOTS of work outside class. Get ready to study, I have never had to learn so much information for a class, but Mrs Crenshaw is incredible, accessible outside class, and really wants her students to succeed. Overall very interesting but very difficult class. Be prepared for quizzes every day, and don't fall behind if you want to pass!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Really great teacher , does really well at explaining concepts. This class is very difficult. It requires alot of work outside of the class. Be very prepared for quizzes every period.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lectures are kind of boring. Memorize the powerpoints for the tests and youll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Mrs. Crenshaw is a great teacher. It's hard to make this subject easy, but I would say she does a good job breaking the lessons down. Class is required for quizzes, but she records all of her lectures which come straight from powerpoints so you can skip sometimes. The key to passing this class is study repetition. IF YOU TRY TO CRAM, YOU WILL FAIL.

Mrs. Crenshaw knows just about everything about anatomy! Although it's a tough class, she does want you to succeed and really learn the information. There's no study guides so memorizing about 300 slides of info is tough but if you put in the effort you'll get rewarded. But DO NOT expect to ace this course! I got a B- and my advisor said good job.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: A&P is one of the hardest classes you will ever take no matter what teacher you have.  But I LOVE Crenshaw.  She is so sweet and has a great personality.  Everything on the test comes straight from her ppts. She is super clear what will be on the test. She gives weekly quizzes like Wallace does, STUDY for them b/c they prepare you for the test
She is an amazing teacher always there to help and make herself available. My biggest tip is to utilize that! The class is VERY tough but she is a great teacher.

Mrs. Crenshaw is a sweet lady. However, A&P is absolutely a weed out nursing class. Her lecture is a little harder than Wallace's but her lab is a little easier. Anatomy is tough no matter what but Crenshaw is always willing to help explain anything for as long as it takes you to understand it. Study as much as possible & DO NOT cram/ procrastinate
Don't need to read the text book at all. Just do the online activities, go to class and study for each quiz-it helps you stay caught up.

I can not say enough good things about Mrs. Crenshaw. One of the hardest classes I've ever taken but she is one of the best teachers at TCU. She explains things so clearly and genuinely loves to help her students. Go into her office hours, it helps! You have to study everyday and work hard to pass, but if you're going to take A&P, take it with her!

Mrs. Crenshaw is my favorite teacher here at TCU thus far. I can't imagine having taken this large lecture course, a prerequisite for Nursing, with anyone else. It was difficult, but Mrs. Crenshaw was the difference maker between my understanding and my confusion. She is MORE than willing to help and so easy to confront! Good luck!!
Mrs. Crenshaw is an amazing lecturer, but her class is extremely rigorous and tough. Tests are very detailed, so learn the majority of what she puts in her slideshows.

Professor Crenshaw is an amazing teacher. The class is rigorous and tough so go in to office hours. She is so helpful and really wants her students to do well. She is very fair and reasonable and brings life to her lectures. She always finds a way to make us laugh and keep you interested in the material. She is real and super down to earth.

She is by far the best teacher I had during freshman year. Her tests are extremely difficult and her lectures are very detailed but she is engaging and makes the class interesting. She makes it relatable to real life and clinicals She is so approachable and helpful in so many ways, I couldn't imagine having anatomy with any other teacher!
I loved her as a teacher. Her tests are hard and you need to study some everyday or every other day to keep up. Making flashcards and rewriting difference processes will help you pass the exams.

Mrs. Crenshaw is a phenomenal professor. A&P is extremely difficult, but she does her best to make the topics as clear as possible. She responds to emails quickly and answers any an all questions. If you have to take A&P she's your girl. GO TO CLASS!

A&P is very very hard and a weed out course for nursing majors. However, Mrs Crenshaw is a wonderful teacher and will teach you so so much.  Her tests are very difficult so study for the weekly 5pt. quizzes because they keep you from falling behind and can easily save your grade.  The lab practicals and lab quizzes are also good grade boosters.

Mrs. Crenshaw is your girl if you have to take A&P.  This is a very hard class but she makes it worth it.  She is approachable and helpful.  Go to office hours and ask questions.  The tests are all extremely hard.  Her quizzes help and she tries to make it fair by dropping the lowest 2.  Prepare to study your life away but you'll learn A LOT!!!
Great teacher, you can tell she loves to teach. Don't be fooled by how nice she is, it's a hard class. More people failed her class than Barcelona's

Anatomy is hard because of the material. Ms. Crenshaw makes it super interesting and more enjoyable. Quizzes once a week help make you study a lot (important if you want to pass). She is very helpful and accessible. HIGHLY recommended

This class is very hard, but as long as you pay attention and study you should make a decent grade. Need to work EXTREMELY hard to make an A. She is very helpful though, and has good ways to remember difficult material.

This class is superrrrr hard but Ms. Crenshaw is the best possible teacher for it.  She seriously knows her stuff and is so prepared for every class. Her powerpoints rock and she makes printable outlines for every chapter too. You have GOT to study all the time for this class but Ms. Crenshaw is always available for help and very personable.

Mrs. Crenshaw is the BEST. made anatomy fun to learn. VERY helpful and nice. hard class and lots of studying though. test are multiple choice, short answer and fill in the blank. quizzes help and she drops 2. class is mandatory if you want to do good, its manageable but definitely hard!

I took his class freshmen year and it wasn't my favorite. I enjoyed the map quizzes because I find it useful for the future however, the mapping assignments is what did it for me. They were unnecessarily difficult and took up a lot of time. The tests were fine, all online, but I would not have wanted to do them in person.

Dr. Crotty is great! His class is definitely not a blow off class, that being said you will do well easily if you do the extra credit and do average on the tests. Really read the feedback on the mapping assignments, he gives the keys to doing better on the next one. Overall I would take again, very rewarding and interesting.

Dr. Crotty was a great professor and it is very easy to get an A if you attend lecture and complete the assignments. He also offers a lot of extra credit (up to 10% of your final grade). The tests are very straightforward and the map quizzes are simple as long as you take the time to prepare. This is a great class for the core requirement!
Don't take this class if you are pressed for time. The work is deceivingly time-consuming and the class is unnecessarily difficult for a core. There are better options to get your core done.
very knowledgeable
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: One of those professors that is super extra and annoying for no reason with everything, which makes the class a lot harder than it needs to be/should be. I would not take anything with him, unless it is absolutely required for your degree.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Crotty is really cool, very funny guy. The class is much harder than you expect it to be, so be ready to study for exams or just drop the class.

I took this class as a senior looking to have fun and learn about beer and wine. This is not a fun senior course to take at all. There is an insane amount of content that makes studying for the test impossible. The lectures are boring and the class work is very time consuming. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.

He's a good teacher overall but the class itself was a bit harder than i was expecting. His "mapping assignments" were created by him and the instructions were easy to follow but it took up a lot of time. The questions at the end of them were hard to answer. The tests were fine and the quizzes were super easy. He does not respond to emails!

An easy class to take and get an average grade on. He has two midterm exams and a final exam. They are not easy exams, but you can take as much time as you need on them. His lectures make no sense and his slides are vague and not good for review. He does offer a lot of extra credit. Also, he will NEVER respond to your emails no matter what.
Professor Crotty is very clear about how to succeed in his class and supports you through words of encouragement and different ways into the information.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class has map quizzes that are super easy, tests that do not really reflect the lectures, and mapping assignments that take up time but are super easy. The great thing is he is really easy to talk to and offers a bunch of extra credit. You can do well in this class even if you aren't good at taking tests.

I would definitely recommend taking this class. It's a super easy first semester freshmen course. The class is literally just lectures with no participation and all the notes are online so missing a class won't hurt your grade. You could literally fail every test and still get at least a B in the class with the amount of extra credit he gives out.

Crotty is a great teacher and very straightforward. Very lecture heavy and you have to be paying attention constantly because the slides barely have any information on them because he tells information not on the slides during the lecture. Great guy but tests are difficult and he offers a lot of extra credit which I would recommend doing.
His class was honestly an essay-based economics class. I put so much effort and got so much help to still get a C in the class.

I took this course for TCU core and I got an A, I think its a relatively easy core class. By no means is it an easy A though. Crotty has a lot of extra credit opportunities. Definitely dont go into this class thinking youll get an A from minimal effort. He doesnt take attendance but I would recommend sitting though his lectures.

Crotty is fairly arrogant, he will not respond to you and does not let you see your quizzes that always have grading issues. On the quiz if you are wondering how you got some wrong you are positive were right, sorry, he will not respond to you nor will he let you see what you got. He takes grading as a power trip.

Crotty's online quizzes always have grading issues, he will not let you see what you got wrong and if you email him about it he will NOT respond. Crotty is a good teacher but when it comes to grading and feedback he is worthless. On graded essays he will give positive feedback saying you did great then also give you a C and refuse to explain why.

This class is basically only lectures but I found them very interesting. It is clear that he is passionate about what he does. He does not take attendance or require participation in class, but on random days he will take attendance for extra credit to the students who show up. He offers A LOT of extra credit but also doesn't take any late work.

Crotty is a great guy with a great sense of humor. He's very passionate about geography and his lectures are pretty interesting. He's a hard grader for exams but pretty lenient on everything else. Map quizzes are easy and he gives a lot, and I mean a lot of extra credit which is super helpful.
PS... all these good ratings are from his Geo of Wine and Beer classes. I think that class is probably actually interesting... but GEOG1003 is not.

You can only miss one class before he heavily drops your class attendance/participation... I skipped ONE class and received a 80% for clicker points. Don't even get me started on his "accessibility".. because he isn't. Doesn't remind the class when quizzes are (also you have to teach yourself the material for quizzes AND tests). Boring lectures too
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The only positive thing about him is he gives a lot of extra credit... that's the only good thing I can say. I learned nothing from the lectures, so when it came to studying for exam I had to teach myself everything from the book. The lectures are also sooo boring, he talks for the entire hour and 20 minutes, its not engaging at all. Don't take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Sean Crotty is the worst. Literally do not take him. His class is terrible and incredibly boring. I literally only went to class cause of clicker questions and it was the biggest waste of my time. Had to work so hard to get an okay grade.... he offered a ton of extra credit but that takes a ridiculous amount of time
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Crotty is a funny guy and he knows alot about the material. Lectures can be intense as the slide shows have over 80 slides. The tests are multiple choice and there is a study guide (not very useful). Bad grades on the test can be recovered with extra credit. takes some work to get an A but its worth it. Good stuff to know about beer and wine.

This class was really cool (Geo of Beer and Wine) and I felt like I learned a lot. Each class is a lecture. There are some time consuming assignments and readings. Tests can be hard but there is a TON of extra credit available so if you are willing to work for the A, you can get it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Crotty is really passionate about the material and offers a lot of extra credit. Biggest issue was studying for midterm and especially final, which was 15 essay prompts and you only end up doing 2 of the 4 he puts on your test so you end up studying 13 essays that don't even help your grade. Tough course but not impossible.

Dr. Crotty is the OG professor. I considered changing my major to Geography because of his course. He is sarcastic but truly cares about the material. Also, lots of extra credit is available. Definitely recommend. Funny dude, chill class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Not a bad professor. Please realize you are in college and should be expecting this class to be a little more challenging. There is A LOT of homework/assignments due constantly, but definitely manageable. Not an easy A, you will have to work for it, however, he offers extra credit which I would highly recommend.

At first I was unsure of this class, because I thought he was a bit strict. Once the semester progressed, I realized Dr. Crotty is one of the most genuine professors I have a taken a class with. He is so fascinated by geography, which is inspirational to observe. He genuinely cares for the students' performance. Crotty is the  GOAT
got an A, but really had to work for it. He grades hard on essays on the test, but gives a lot of extra credit

Tons of assignments and quizzes, but they aren't very hard if you study for them. You have to go to class for *rolls eyes* clicker questions, which are taken for a participation grade. He's not a bad teacher, and what you learn can be pretty valuable. But you do have to work for it. It's not the worst class, but not easy.

If you're looking for a blow off class, this is not it. You have to do the assignments and study for the quizzes and tests. He does give a ton of extra credit though that is definitely worth doing. It brought my grade up significantly in the end. You come out of the class learning a lot, you just have to work for it.

I only had Dr. Crotty for half a semester as he filled in for my previous professor. I thought his lectures were interesting but entirely too long. There were take home maps and quizzes every week which were challenging and time consuming. If you take time to do his multiple page study guides, you should pass the test. However, I recommend pf.
The tests are difficult, however the map quizzes are worse. But if you pay attention in class and do some of the extra credit you will pass this class.

For the love that is all good in this world, don't take him. I'm just trying to save you here. Those test reviews he gives you are not even a little helpful. You'll wind up writing a 50 page review for the test. He makes the course much harder than it needs to be.

He is very informed on the information, but the class takes work. There are map assignments, map quizzes, and two tests. The assignments and quizzes are pretty easy if you do them or study. The tests are pretty hard but he gives you a review. He gives lots of extra credit opportunities, so take advantage of those!

Young teacher, not too helpful when you email him or ask questions in class. You have to attend class or you will miss out on assignments and the tests are very hard but as long as you do the key terms and take advantage of every extra credit opportunity and show up to class then there is no reason why you can't make a B in the class.

He is honestly the most useless professor I have ever had! He makes you not want to go to class! Also, it is apparent that he doesn't care at all because he doesn't even take the time to proofread anything he hands out. If you have the option DO NOT take his class. It has been one of the worse academic choices of college so far.
Mr. Crotty is very nice, but this was such a boring and useless course I had to drop it.  It's really just a memorization course with a research paper.

He's on the younger side, so he probably feels he has something to prove. He was pretty nice to the kids who didn't sleep through every lecture and punished those who did with tricky tests.Skim the textbook and half listen to lectures you'll survive but you HAVE to do his test reviews. Google them verbatim & look at Quizlet to save time.

This is a harder class. His lectures are interesting if you find cultural history and modern issues intriguing. The tests are basically the key terms, so go through the textbook to define them and you will do well, while it is time consuming. Do all the extra credit and work hard and an A is attainable. Very friendly, but does expect effort.

Worst teacher I have had at TCU. Is not respectful of students and is rude and sarcastic. The class is difficult and he does not give clear instructions. Tests are hard and specific and don't even follow the study guide. Don't take him.

My absolute worst class. Lectures are beyond boring and the tests are impossible. Basically have to P/NC because nothing he talks about in class is on the test and he gives you no direction on what to study. Gives a lot of extra credit but a lot of work. Take a different teacher!!!!!

I like history and geography and thought his basic World Reg Geog class would be good. NO. Learn a lot, but super hard. Way beyond a freshman-level class. Had to P/NC it. Have to study a lot for basic map quizzes worth hardly any points. Tests are super hard too. Take another professor if you can

Very slow grader! It is the day before the final and our grade on ecolloge is "out of 47% complete" when we have turned in 85%. He offers extra credit which helps, but you have no way of knowing whether he gives you credit until after your final. He makes an otherwise interesting class unbearable and difficult to know where you stand.

Lectures are extremely boring. Tests are very difficult. 10 hours to complete a review and maybe 2 questions are on the tests. Read and study the chapters and you might have a chance. Or follow around campus and the city for the ample extra credit opportunities. I suggest take someone else!
very helpful and gives lots of extra credit! Go to class and you will do great!

Ok so heres the deal with this Crotty character, class was literally the worst. The lectures were extremely difficult to follow. The tests were even more challenging, I failed both tests but was able to get an A- because of the curve and extra credit opportunities. But I had to go to every one he offered. Try to take a different prof.

I took this class because it was required for my major. I was actually excited about taking it because I like geography but Crotty changed that.  This is one of the most boring classes I've ever taken in my life.  The lectures are dry and tests are difficult.  Hardly anybody comes to class because it's so painful to sit through.

For first semester teaching it wasn't bad. Nice guy and not too bad of a class but the tests are literally impossible. His study guides aren't really much help as a good amount of the information on the test is not on the study guide. He does give lots of EC opportunities though. Overall not bad and Im sure he'll get better the more he teaches
Lectures can be a be a bit dry, but it is not too bad. The tests are pretty easy as long as you read the textbook and don't just rely on notes from lectures. Tons of extra credit opportunities.

He's easy to understand, and his lectures are interesting. Attendance is not mandatory, but if you want to do well, you should attend  class. His tests are a bit difficult, but he's curved every test. We also get a ton of extra credit opportunities.

Crotty is a very nice professor but his tests are extremely hard and take more than reading the book and going to class - you really have to think outside the box. His map quizzes are do-able if you look over them a day or two in advance. He is very helpful and gives tons of extra credit! was not an easy A for me though :(
Class not very interesting but if you follow the key words you will do fine on the tests. Requires a descent amount of studying to get a good grade.

He is a nice guy, but doesn't really make the class that interesting. Basically just lectures every single time. Map quizzes aren't too bad, but you have to study. Chapter tests are rather difficult but he curves the tests and lots of extra credit!

Tests are super hard, other geography profs give word banks he does not. He expects way too much of out you when it comes to his map quizzes. My suggestion  is to take a different teacher if you want a good grade.

He is a very nice professor but is kinda hard. He gives tons of extra creadit to help you though. He understands that most people are not geography majors and tries to make the class interesting. His test are not the easiest but they are not impossible. You will have to study and go to class but combined with the extra credit you can get an A.
Easy class, easy speeches

genuinely the worst professor I've ever had. She is extremely blunt, very disorganized, and does NOT know how to work anything technologically. She's spent multiple classes trying to figure out what to do on her computer. This class was an utter waste of my time. She gives terrible feedback and often doesn't tell you why she took points off. AVOID!

She is super nice and SUCH an easy grader. She wants everyone to pass (if not get an A) and so she basically gives out A's on all the speeches. Only 2 speeches and a super easy group project at the end of the year. The only downside to her is she is very disorganized and has a hard time figuring out how to imput grades. Cancels class a lot too.
She is super funny and really easy. Definitely take this class!!!! The class doesn't last for longer than an hour and a half!
Easy comm class. Only graded by 2 speeches, 2 exams, "participation" (which is just these easy online things), and a easy group project
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easiest comm class you can take at TCU. Class consists of 2 exams, a group project, and 2 speeches. Quizzes each week are for participation only and questions are used on exams. Class almost always ended very early except for when we had speeches. Very chill class. Take her for comm!!

This class is simply the easiest communication course at TCU. Lectures are boring, but the class takes 1 hour and a half at most. Class is canceled a lot and as a result, we end up taking discussions at D2L. Tests are extremely easy, everything comes directly from the textbook and speeches are a joke. If you want an easy A, take her.

One of the easiest classes I've taken at TCU. It's a night class but I don't think we ever went over an hour because she even says she doesn't want to be there teaching. The speeches are a joke and the tests are common sense. If you somewhat pay attention you will get an A. Also her stories from work are pretty funny.

Three speeches and two exams are the majority of your grade but do not expect to hear from her for awhile after you email her as she is not very good with communication. Speeches were easy but exams were difficult as she didn't tell us what to study for the first one and gave us the wrong material to study for the final. Don't expect her to round.

Overall grade is comprised of 3 speeches, participation activities that you just have to show up for and two exams. She has canceled 4 times this semester and the class is only once a week. The class never goes longer than an hour. Easiest Speech professor at TCU.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Hands down the easiest speech class at TCU. She grades the first speech hard, then its easy sailing on the last two. Both the midterm and the final she gives you the questions and answers before to study. Our three hour night class was always either cancelled or lasted an hour. Hilarious professor and super helpful when you have questions.
3 hour night class never went more than an hour an half. Weekly online assignments that took 5 minutes, and she gave a take home exam. She makes it near impossible not to get an A.

Did I learn anything? No. Did I get an A? Yes.  The first speech was graded the hardest, but after that is was smooth sailing. She does not post powerpoints, so go to class and take notes and you'll get an A.

Took 3 hour night course on Mondays. Very easy A. Need textbook for tests. Class was let out an hour early all but once. She grades first speech hard then mellows after that. I definitely improved my speaking abilities by the end. Take it with a friend

A good communications class. I took it once a week on wednesday nights and we get out early every week. As long as you FOLLOW HER DIRECTIONS you will get an A. Much less effort needed for this class than a regular communications class
Decent teacher, classes aren't too bad if you've got a buddy but her communication skills especially on e college and emails is poor. Don't expect an A.

Dusty is so funny and has a lot of knowledge to share. Very easy grader if you have everything done on time. There is some time to work in class but most photography has to be done on your own time. Well respected in the department and a good person to have on your side.
He gives good feedback, a pretty easy grader, cares for his students

Not great at aesthetics. More into business and such. His computer classes are lacking in the instruction department. I could learn by myself without going to class and come away just as knowledgeable. Be prepared to learn on your own.

Prof Cobb is one of the nicest teachers I have ever had. I would say that she is one of the harder profs for communicating effectively. The in class quizzes were nearly impossible and the speeches were difficult too. She is a good teacher and a very nice person but if you want an easy A, take someone else.
Ms.Cobb is the sweetest prof I have ever had! You spent half a semester learning things in the textbook the another for 4-5 speeches. Relatively easy grader. Would love to take her class again!

This professor is relatively new to teaching, but she is still good at it. She lectures a lot in the first half of the semester, relying heavily on class participation for content. You MUST read the textbook, especially for the quizzes. Speeches are clearly graded and relatively simple.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is the sweetest professor I have ever had. She genuinely cares about the well being of her students. We do 4 speeches throughout the semester and she makes you feel comfortable. Definitely take her if you can she is awesome.
LOVE HER & LEGIT WANT TO BE BFFS WITH HER! Lots of in class group work & we also play games sometimes. Take her if you can!

I did not like professor Craig. Unless you are an english major or a teachers pet, she will not like you. She picks favorites and makes that known. She teaches this class as if everyone is an english major and loves english as much as her. Its easy to get an A in this class, but you will leave with a new enemy.

I do like Dr. Layne, I just don't like her class. Seems like a lot of busy work and she rambles for the full class period. She is nice, wants to help, and gives great feedback on assignments. It isn't a terrible or super hard class, I just wouldn't take it if I could go back. If you have to take this class its not THAT bad otherwise avoid it.

Professor Craig makes disability studies so hard to get an A in. She clearly picks favorites and it is impossible to get high As on any paper. For how much this class is about "self reflection" she grades you as if your ideas are wrong or you're simply not smart enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: I had Dr Craig for disability studies. Its an interesting class, not too much reading. She is a very strict grader for a core class. It is almost impossible to get a 100 on any assignment but I was able to get mostly 90-94's on everything. If you put in the work you can get an A but if you're looking for an easy core, look elsewhere.
Its participation heavy but not difficult. You need to read for every class. There is a lot of lenience for due dates and assignments. Tests are simple and she wants everyone to have a good grade.

She was a great professor that graded pretty easy and straight forward. There is alot of reading but the lectures in class make it alot easier to understand whats going on. The quizzes/ exams are open note taken at home outside of class and are very straight forward,
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Mrs. Craig is a great teacher, but it is very book heavy and there is a lot of reading assignments due before class. She is also a tough grader when it comes to writing assignments. I recommend going to her office hours if you do take this class because she is very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This class is surprisingly hard and she makes it all about opinion rather than fact. Every assignment is graded ridiculously hard for no reason and the exams are impossible.

There are 4 discussion posts (400-600 words), one midterm essay (600-800), 2 exams, and one final project (essay and presentation) its not a hard class but you definitely need to read for the exams and the essays. An A is achievable but you have to work hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Overall, I enjoyed Dr. Craig's Disability Studies class. There is a lot of assigned reading, but you can often get by in class if you haven't done it. She grades tests and essay very thoroughly, but also gives good feedback. She is a pretty caring professor and is willing to work with you if any issues come up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Craig is really nice. Shes a hard grader on essays but if you go to office hours she definitely helps. She gives you the option to receive the class through zoom or in person. Not an easy A but achievable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She doesn't do the best job explaining the actual facts and definitions of "disability studies". There is a lot of reading, discussion posts & self reflections that THOROUGHLY grades. She holds in person class as well as zoom. She does not hesitate to call on you in class, so be prepared for that. Overall this class was interesting but not my fav.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This class is really easy, but she makes it an awful class. I expected to read case studies actually about medicine, but instead she made it super political and pointed out all of the negatives in the medical field. Also, if your mask isn't covering your nose she will yell at you to "fix your face". It's impossible to get an A on discussion posts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took her for lit and med. The class was very reading heavy, but you could easily pass without doing it bc she discussed everything you needed to know in class. You dont have too much homework, but she grades things so harshly. You have take home quizzes which might sound easy, but she makes it hard for you to get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You will be called on to answer questions so if you do not like participation, this class is not for you. Lots of reading is assigned and she has very liberal beliefs if that is something that attracts you or turns you away. She's a nice lady but I personally would not recommend her class and would not take another one of her classes.

She was my favorite professor my freshman year. Attendance wasnt required but I wouldnt miss too many. Reading the books or sparknotes (the analysis side REALLY helps with the exam questions because she likes to go into deeper meaning) is a MUST. Participation wasnt graded but I found discussion helped a LOT with the quizzes/exams. 10/10 class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tough grader--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Craig is a really nice person! Her Bloomsbury class has a lot of interesting information, but she didn't really deliver it in a way that was engaging (at least for me). There were a lot of breakout rooms that I felt was unnecessary. I wouldn't take a class by her again because she grades really hard, but it was a decent class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Craig doesn't take attendance but if you show up to her classes you will do better. Her class is easy even though its a lot of books but honestly you can just spark notes. She grades hard on individual assignments like essays and projects, but quizzes and exams are straight forward. Overall her class is easy I just dont like how hard she grades

I really loved literature and medicine! Yes, you read a lot, it is an english course, but all the readings are very interesting. I would certainly recommend her for core because she also is available to help you.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: I loved my literature and medicine class that I took for core. It was interesting and she made it fun. As long as you keep up with the readings you will do go on the quizzes. She grades on participation so speak up. Really nice lady and would definitely take her again.
She is seriously the best. Not super hard but you do have to read (or sparknotes lol) and you will do just fine in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: shes my favorite english teacher of all time. shes really non-judgmental which is rare of writing teachers. She gives great feedback on material. If you complain about her, you're probably just a lazy student because she goes beyond what she should as a college level english teacher. IMO shes too nice, but shes also adorable and i loved her

She's such an amazing Prof! A lot of the class focuses on class and group dicussion. There are only 2 tests and one partner project as the final. As long as you keep up with reading and do the assignments you will definitely get an A

Thought this would be a super easy A... it's not. This isn't an impossible class though. If you read, take time to write papers and study for test you'll get a fine grade. But, she definitely makes you work for it.
Craig is not very engaging in class which makes it boring and when going to office hours she is intimidating and not too helpful. Recommend different teacher for this course.

Dr. Craig is a tough grader but she will definitely help you out with your essays if you go into her office hours. No tests but get ready to write 4 essays. You get one revision but what will save your grade is if you go into office hours! Wonderful personality and willing to help!
WONDERFUL PERSONALITY, ALWAYS WILL TO LISTEN AND HELP.....READ THE BOOKS, DO ALL ASSIGNMENTS AND YOUR A+ IS A GUARANTEED.
Tough grader and boring class. She doesn't engage well with students and isn't specific with what she wants in the papers. Make sure to speak up in class.

Major British Writers. Really easy class, 5 novels assigned, only read 1. Had a couple essays, but they were pretty easy. If you ever need help, go to her office and ask her, she is friendly and really helpful. Tests were easy, just essay and short answer (which were usually about a sentence). Overall, strongly suggest Dr. Craig. Got an easy A.

Hes so fabulous I can't even begin. He meets student where they are at, is extremely knowledagble on content, and truly wants you to successed. I didn't follow course guidelines 100% and still ended with an A because he was open to hearing about how a diff. plan worked best for me! He rockssss!!!!

Dr. Rode is very kind and strives to help everyone in class. Coding in the humanities is an easy course with minimal homework and one project (group or solo) at the end of the semester. You have full creative freedom for the project and are given all the material needed to complete it. This is a great course for fulfilling a humanities credit!
This is the second class I have taken with Dr. Rode and he da bomb. Very caring and motivated to help you succeed.

Dr. Rode is seriously one of the best professors at TCU! His HTML & CSS (coding) classes have taught me more than I ever imagined and I'm doing things I never thought I'd be capable of. The workload is super manageable with plenty of in-class work time and you grade your own work—an easy A if you put in the effort!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Coding/Humanities was a great course with Dr. Rode, just make sure to be on track with following Colab notebooks and ask for help when necessary. Easy to fall behind, but reach out to both professors. You are graded based off your effort and explaining it. Pick a reliable group for the final, don't be intimated, class is as fun as you make it.
You grade yourself but basically only because everyone would fail the class because he sucks.

Professor Rode is an incredible person. He is understanding and willing to work with you outside of class. The material can be challenging, but he ensures that you will learn it and it's exciting to see your websites come to life. As long as your assignments are on time and done to the best of your ability, you will do fine.

Great class! Despite the class was online and with pretty long lectures online, the professor did a good job making everything enjoyable. Read the readings assigned, and take a couple of office hours to talk about your writing. The professor is absolutely willing to help if you demonstrate you care!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Rode is one of those professors that you wont forget. He is very interesting and really cares about his students. His sense of humor is great and its very easy to talk to him. He is a fair grader and wants you to succeed. Tests were a bit difficult but if you study you'll be fine. Would highly recommend taking any class with him if you can.

Get ready to discuss in class in order to get credits for attendance. Tests are hard because you have to match some words with the poems that were discussed in class. Overall, you will get an A if putting your efforts.
Was kinda salty towards lack of participation, so be ready to talk in class.

Dr Rode's class is challenging but really rewarding and interesting. There are two projects and two tests/quizzes. If you study and put in the time - the class is pretty breezy. Class is very discussion based so make sure to participate! Rode is super cool and willing to help and give feedback wherever he can. I totally recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Rode is pretty out there. His attendance policy is a little weird because he's strict on the syllabus but doesn't go out of his way to take attendance daily. Loved his lectures, they were always very discussion based and he made a huge effort to cater to everyone, even people that didn't like poetry initially. Tests are OK, need to study for them.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Tough grader. The whole class is discussion, but good luck if you do not agree with him politically. He waits until the last minute to post grades.  He wasn't really clear about deadlines and the syllabus changed significantly by the end of the semester. Tests were kind of hard since we had to match two word quotes with the stories.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He took a while to post grades. He was willing to work with me on a couple of issues I had. Tests were ok.

Great Professor, Super Easy to work with. Only problem this seamster would definitely be clarity. there were many times were no-one in the class did the assigned reading/ homework/ or threaded discussion because it was never mentioned in class or the syllabus changed. He was definitely good about fixing these issues but it became a bit stressful

Rode is entertaining and he knows what he's talking about but he's not the most personable professor and sometimes loses his temper. He's been known to throw out half the class for not doing the homework. Class is hard. And if you want a letter of rec from him, forget about it. I was a hardworking student but was treated like I didn't exist.
Great teacher! Offers a lot of extra credit. I would highly suggest this class and professor.

If it wasn't for the 1 test worth the majority of the class I could deal with the fact that his lectures are long & politically driven. Made us match direct quotes to the poets-  but the quotes were only 2-3 words& could have matched most poets. The rest of the test was short answer and essay. Be aware- would not take again & talk always!!!

NOT a professor you want to take. I was looking for a class I would enjoy before I graduate&I thought this would be it. NO. He has made the class so strict and we do nothing. But somehow, that "nothing" manages to turn into an impossible exam. He has insanely high expectations, and we all talk about how miserable we are before he shows up for class

Took him for Fiction Writing. It was a good class and I definitely improved in my writing. Not too much work, you can get by without doing the reading. Every now and then he's in a bad mood and will call a student out in class.
total hottie!

I had him for literature.  I know he also teaches english.  He is a real nice guy, a little odd at times, but is always willing to help students with papers and other questions they might have.  You learn quite a bit and its not too hard.  Take this class
Dr. Curtis is very kind and knows each and every one of her students by name. The content is hard but doable. If you want to do well, master the content and study weeks leading up to the exam.

Curtis is a very very sweet and caring professor, but unfortunately she is not a great teacher. She is very smart, but she just does not teach content wel (in my opinion) or answer questions effectively. I would take Jones, especially if you're nursing and need to do well. Content is also weirdly over different chapters.

Dr. Curtis is very knowledgeable and explains material clearly. There is a lot to cover, so expect frequent lectures and long videos. The tests are tough, but the final is not cumulative and there are many assignments and quizzes. Jones might be easier, but I am not sure. She is very helpful in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Be prepared for the flipped classroom model. The course is heavy on memorization and critical thinking. The questions on Learning Catalytics and the weekly Thursday quizzes are formatted very similarly to the exam questions. Dr. Curtis is always open to answering questions or addressing concerns, and she genuinely wants you to succeed.

Microbio is a hard class but Curtis is so caring and wants you to do well. She is very accessible by email and office hours. There is a quiz every Thursday. If you finish your assignment early in class you can leave whenever. I rarely stayed the entire time.

Buckle up- this class is not easy. No deep thinking, but a TON of memorization of specific information. Flipped classroom with 1-3 hours of videos. Lab is short, Dr. Curtis is very kind and understanding. Grading can be difficult since tests are weighted heavily. Tests are mostly written, can't rely on multiple choice. Ended well, but difficult.

Mid-level difficulty... Book only needed 2-3 weeks. Beware of the flipped classroom model. 1-2 hours of videos to watch at home at worst, plus she adds more content in the lecture. Loved the quizzing structure and tests were fair. Be ready to work for your grade, but an A is doable. Lab quizzes are crazy specific and LONG repetitive lab lectures.

Microbio is really tough because the material is hard but she is an amazing teacher, you can tell she knows what she is talking about and cares for students. Pay attention to the lectures and pre-lecture videos. Study way at least a week and a half (preferably more) for tests. I was on the verge of failing but she bumped me up, which was very nice.

Dr. Curtis was the best professor I've ever had. It is a hard class, but she explains information well and has lots of office hours available. Go to lecture and watch the pre lecture videos and be prepared to study a lot for this class by reviewing the PowerPoints. Lab quizzes can get tricky, so be sure to know the information well before taking it
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Her class is very difficult but she is super accessible outside of class. She will set aside time for students aside from her office hours and is very caring and encouraging. She gets to know everyone by name in her 75 student lectures and really wants her students to succeed.

This class is very hard! I found it way harder than anatomy. The tests are not straightforward and require a lot of applied knowledge. There is a ton of information to know for each test. I've heard rumors that Jones is supposedly way easier, but Curtis is very nice and really gets to know you.

Dr. Curtis is extremely smart and someone I look up to. Microbio is hard but her office hours help a lot. There are 4 tests and no cumulative final. You watch at home lectures before class. Almost every Thursday there is a quiz. First you take it alone then with the group. Not too hard and helps you stay on top of the material.

Dr. Curtis was by far one of the most caring professor. She is so smart and strong in her field and really wants us to succeed. This is a VERY difficult class but always makes herself accessible. She is very approachable and was often a go-to person for me. I spent a lot of time in her office and she really helped me strengthen my grade to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: A very challenging class. I put in multiple hours of studying a week. No matter the teacher, this class will take a lot of studying. I tend to study individually so lecture teacher did not make a difference. No cumulative final which is nice.

One of the harder classes I've taken here, but Dr. Curtis makes it manageable. Lab always gets out early, quizzes every thursday, nightly video lectures ranging 20-70 mins. You have to put in lots of work to do well, but you may as well do it with Curtis. She's super kind, willing to help, and gets to know her classes.

This is easily the hardest class I have ever taken. The test are difficult .Many students have to drop this class but it is due to the course load. She is a great professor , but be prepared to put in 2-3 hours a day minimum if you want a high grade in this course. Study daily and do all assignments and you will most likely pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: At the start of the class, I asked how to be successful in her class. After telling me how her class/exams work, she goes "but I have a lot of students who come back & tell me that I told them incorrect information." Girl .. then fix it! She couldn't even explain to me why I got the questions wrong just said "seems like you didn't understand"
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Best prof at TCU. So kind and genuinely cares about your success. Great at lectures and explanations. The material was tough but she made it bearable. Super approachable, patient, and she knew everyone's name in a huge class. The quizzes are representative of the exams. Makes the lectures interesting and engaging with lots of group discussions.

Dr Curtis is an amazing professor. I had her for lab and lecture. Her class is very difficult though. If you don't put in the work you won't pass. I had to drop this class because I wasn't putting in the effort and was going to fail. She provides all the resources and materials for you to pass, you HAVE to put in a lot of extra effort yourself.

I loved taking lab with Dr. Curtis! She is a pretty easy grader, and always happy to answer any questions. Micro is a difficult class, but many of her explanations stuck with me. She is super understanding & very sweet!

Dr. Curtis is truly amazing. I had her for Micro lab but I wish that I had her for lecture as well. She definitely wants her students to pass and helps in anyway that she possible can. If you have her for lab, get ready to read a lot as there are also weekly quizzes over the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I had Curtis for Micro Lab, and wished I had her for lecture. She is so sweet and caring, and she really got to know students in class. The tests were detailed, but very fair, and she explained material well. She is very accommodating to meeting during or out of office hours, and she makes sure to give you all the time you need for help.

Dr. Curtis is someone I want to be like when I'm older. She is so accessible, go to her office hours and she will help you SO much! Micro will never not be hard, its an overwhelming class but she is incredibly willing to help. She explains everything clearly. Her tests are detailed, so study everything but she wants you to succeed!

Dr. Curtis is the easily the best professor I've had since I've been at TCU. She is super down to earth and understands her students. You are not just a number if you participate & go to class. Please go to office hours! She loves seeing your face out of class! Curtis is a tough grader & class is test heavy. Study every day and you will do well. :)
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Curtis is probably the sweetest human being I have gotten the chance to learn from. Her class is pretty tough but she is always there to help you. If you cannot make her office hours she will find time for you. Her tests are pretty rough and you really need to study and put a lot of time into understanding the material and not just memorizing.

Dr. Curtis is one of the best professors I have had at TCU. She is kind, caring, and very very approachable. She has spent a lot of time answering questions for me, even outside office hours to make sure I have a concise and clear understanding of the material. Really will prepare you for future nursing classes if you study hard.

I loved Dr. Curtis for microbiology. She made things clear and was always open to questions. The class takes a lot of work but she truly wants students to do well so going to her office hours is super helpful. She was also great for lab, because she explains things clearly and is overall very sweet and helpful.
Dr. Curtis is a great teacher. She is very helpful in office hours and does a great job explaining anything that is confusing. If you get a chance to take her for a class, do it. She is awesome!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Curtis is amazing! This is a very hard class and demands a lot of attention and time . However, Professor Curtis really cares about her students and if you show her that you care about the course she will help you. I always went to her office hours and it was very beneficial. She really rooted for me! Test are hard so study every night
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Curtis was so sweet and always willing to provide help. Take her for Basic Microbiology!!! She makes it so much more enjoyable and understandable.

She is so sweet! She genuinely wants her students to do well in the class and is very clear about what she wants you to know for the test. She explains everything very clearly and gives good feedback in the labs. Also, she knows every student by name! I really enjoyed this class and would totally take her class again.

Dr. Curtis is awesome! microbiology is hard but she gives you all the info you need to know if you go to class. no study guides and MC/short answer test that are pretty tough. But overall super approachable and caring, def recommend her over any other micro bio professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Curtis is possibly the nicest professor I have ever met. She clearly cares about her students and that they grasp the full meaning of her lectures. Tests arent easy and a lot of studying is involved, but she made micro so enjoyable. High recommend her:)
Dr. Curtis is awesome! Took her for micro. Like everyone else said, she is pretty much the nicest person in the world and super helpful. But you definitely have to study for her tests.

Microbio was not an easy class at all, but Dr. Curtis made it much more doable. She is patient and willing to explain stuff. Her lectures are very organized, and she kinda put a study goal on each lecture note so you know what to prepare for tests. Her tests are clear, but you should expect to study for anything on the slides and during lectures.

TAKE HER!!!! I was unsure at the first of the year because she was new, and I did't know anything about her class whatsoever.  She is the best teacher and nicest person that I have ever met in my life.  Literally sad that the semester is over....

Microbio is difficult but Dr. Curtis is an amazing professor. If you feel lost go to her office hours. She is so approachable and easy to talk to. She really wants her students to succeed. She is a huge assest to the biology department. Just read the chapters and lecture notes and you will do fine! Go to class, you get points for clicker!

Adore this man. He is very caring, loves his job, and definitely keeps you entertained. He has the perfect way to teach information and it is also quite engaging. The tests are a little difficult but you can definitely do well if you pay attention in class. The lectures are fun and entertaining.

I love him!!!! So so sweet and is such an amazing professor. I took his class last semester and was so excited. He definitely exceeded my expectations. The tests were average, you definitely had to study but even if you are bad at taking tests, you will still do fine. I would definitely take him again.

Professor Cureton was one of my favorite professors at TCU! Teaching criminal justice classes from a reasonably unbiased perspective isn't easy, but he did it with grace. Easy A in my opinion! Attendance matters, he does roll call every class, but if you're sick or have something he's very understanding.

Professor Cureton is such a nice man who wants all his students to succeed. I recommend this class to everyone who wants a laid-back class where they can still learn things from it without thinking it's a waste of time. Take notes on his powerpoints and this class is a breeze.

Professor Cureton was amazing. He is very experienced and his lectures are interesting. The exams were straightforward and taken at home. Very well-respected and gives lots of extra credit options. Never stressed over this class. Take it!!!

Very good professor. He is a federal judge in Fort Worth so he's very respected in his field. He offered 2 extra credit assignments for 6% back on your grade. Most tests are online. 3 discussion topics throughout the semester but other than that no homework. I came up 0.5% short of an A+ and he was more than happy to help me out at the end.

Cureton is a federal magistrate judge in Ft. Worth and teaches night classes. Lots of interesting information in lectures, open note, online quizzes/exams, and extra credit is attending his real hearings downtown. He is SO kind and lets you out early most nights. Cureton cares about his students and wants them to do well in the class.

Judge Cureton is a fantastic professor. He is very good at lecturing and really knows what he is talking about. The course is very easy, and attendance is mandatory but does not count for much of the grade. The course itself is very easy.

Judge Cureton has been an outstanding professor this semester. He is extremely passionate about the justice system considering he is a full time judge. I believe this was his first year teaching Criminal Justice and he did an outstanding job! Quizzes and tests are mostly online and open-note. Would recommend if you are passionate about CJ!

Dr. Curry is definitely a tough professor. The class is very interesting, but Curry really makes you work for your grade. I didn't read the book and only studied her powerpoints and did fine. Be prepared to study hard though! I didn't like Curry at first but she definitely grows on you.

Dr. Curry is my favorite professor I've had at TCU so far. She is an awesome fundamentals lab instructor and wants you to do well and succeed. She is very helpful and makes this 6 hour lab so  much fun!!!! You should be super excited if you are lucky enough to have her as a lab teacher!

Dr. Curry is a difficult professor, sure, but I never hated her or her class as most seem to. You have to study the powerpoints and stuff she says in class, in addition to the book. I found that reading the chapters of the book right before an exam helped a lot. If you go into her office and talk to her she will give you help!

Powerpoints and info in the book are completely inconsistent. We never did anything in class even though attendance is mandatory. I was always confused on what would be tested because she never taught anything relevant and was never clear when students asked questions. Avoid taking her as much as possible.

Dr. Curry is a very tough teacher. You need to attend every class and take notes on everything she says. Memorize the power points and the info in the book that goes alongside it. Her tests are very difficult (the wording is confusing). Be sure to answer her questions and set up meetings so she can get to know you (helps in long run). Very tough.
THIS CLASS IS AWFUL.  DO NOT TAKE IT WITH THIS TEACHER. she is unreasonable and makes you do so much work for no reason..harder then A&P!! RUN!!!

Dr. Curry does everything to help you be prepared for her tests. If you show up to class, study the powerpoints, and read the book, you will get a good grade in the class. I went in and expected this class to be tricky based on the other comments but her tests are so straightforward and straight from her pp. I definitely recommend.

Dr. Curry knows what she is talking about. Her lectures are clear but the tests are short and tricky. You have material in a course manual, the textbook, handouts, bulletin board information, and powerpoints, so it takes a great deal of effort. And finally, beware of the group bulletin board project. It's 5% but it can be a killer.

I did bad. She is defiantly one of the worse professors I had in college. I like her as person however, the class is extremely unorganized; Lots of busy work and unclear instructions. In the end you never know what to do to memorize the material or know what she wants you to turn in.

I did bad, horrible test questions, tricky, hard and confused qs, a lot effort in order to do good, use pp and text and handout,project, homework,reading, not clearly explanation of the text or pp, final comprehensive ridiculous. not recommend her??????
Oh, how I hated this class. Prof. Curry is so condescending and sometimes rude. She's not the worst nursing professor, but it's definitely not the best.

Dr. Curry makes this class absolutely painful. The topic of the class is actually very interesting but is ruined. Dr. Curry is condescending to her students. When a question is asked in class (whether about the material or your grade) she never directly answers the question and just likes to hear herself talk instead of assisting students.

High text and p p use, not helpful, mandatory attendance, not clarify material, need hard hard work, confused question,not recommended,hat her colon and what she wear, she try to be fair but she is nooot. Easy to talk always.

Horrible prof! Not helpful at all, needs to have tutors lined up but she has no clue who could tutor you. She trys to make you know way too much (over loaded with info)- news to her no one can actually know that much in a short time of a semester!!! Tests are really confusing and hard to describe.

Curry reminds me of my hair-brained grandmother. She is always on a different topic and is easily distracted. OVERHEADS ARE ESSENTIAL TO TESTS! Only read the book if the overheads don't make sense. If you can take this somewhere else in the summer DO IT!

Human Development should have been an interesting class...it wasn't with Curry. She focused on what interested her and changed up her teaching style this semester (maybe thats what made it worse). Her tests are very hard to study for. You never know what to expect. Answer her questions and she'll love you.
She talked about things that my prood ears have never heard.  Very offensive and just plain gross.

i hated her growth and development class. half the class was her just rambling about her grandkids, not delving into the material that we needed to know. i dont recommend her in any way. not helpful when i went to speak with her. just bad, bad, bad.

THIS CLASS IS HARD! You MUST be there to take down her every word, read the book, and her overheads are essential. She pulls lots of questions form them. I have an A (its possible!!) but its been a battle. She does curve the tests so that helps but it's time consuming. The final is non-cummulative and is worth the same as the normal tests.
If you want an A you have to know EVERYTHING. It's a pretty tough class. She's an ok person, but this class is definately not an easy A.

Make sure you read because there are detailed questions on the test. The online source is also a helpful tool. Make sure you read for the quizzes because that will really help your grade and try to be there as much as possible because those who are not absent get points added to their grade.

She was an extremely nice teacher and very helpful if you came to her office.  I don't know what people are complaining about. . .this is college you do HAVE TO WORK!  Yes there is a lot of reading but if you try to get ahead you'll do fine and stay up with the class.  Tests are easy and quizzes are a breeze!!
Way harder than it needs to be! Not helpful at all.

I worked my tail off in this class.  A lot of reading.  If you read the chapter summaries, the quizzes are a breeze.  I got a B.  I think this is much harder than a freshman-level course.  Dr. Curry is one of the most compassionate people I have ever met, and made me want to do well in this class.
She is a wonderful  teacher and I dont know what people are saying...you have to work though and read your book... if you go to class and read the book you can easily make a b.
Read the book and take good notes - write down everything she says and you will do just fine.  The key is to READ the book!

She has switched to a new book, so it's not as bad now. Not hard to make a B. She's a little unorganized, but the class isn't impossible anymore. Can make a fairly easy B. Lots of reading though, and lots of quizzes. Sweet lady if you get to know her outside of class.
Clas was way harder than it should have been.  Not to mention, she doesnt know how to teach.

She is one of the WEIRDEST people you will ever meet. She says random stuff, is never clear and ugh!!! But you're stuck with her- she's the only one who teaches Growth and D! I dropped it thinking there would be a way, but I still have to take it:(

She doesn't know what she's talking about and neither will you!  I learned more about her grandchildren than anything else. The annoying thing is that her lecture doesn't have anything to do with the test...or reality!  Prepare for frustration with Curry.
Not impossible. You never know what will be on the test.  Lots of reading.  Random talker.  The book is your teacher.
No Comments

This teacher is not willing to explain answers that are questionable on tests.  Her tests are mainly from notes, but it requires a lot of work.  She is not very helpful though she pretends she will be!
Sucks..pulls stuff out of mid-air...you have to guess what's on the test..and her perfume reeks
Cares about his class and their understanding of the material. Very funny and engaging. Seems like he really enjoys what he does. Take him!
