Very easy class! I enjoyed every single bit of it! Loved how he delivered the content, this class is project-based but they are SO FUN and EASY! He is a very caring, funny professor, he even sang and played the guitar for us on our last day!! Take him if you can! :)

I enjoyed his class not only because of the material covered but he seems devoted to teaching his students and always provides help when needed. There was a lot of times in class where he would make us laugh with his jokes. Fun fact he is sings pretty good and plays the guitar.
Very caring and nice, he wants the best for each student. Be ready for an easy course with a loving professor.

Curby is one of the nicest professors I have had. He truly cares about his students and the work he does. The class revolved around building a digital portfolio and had no busy work. He always leaves helpful feedback on projects his class has hands on activities. Would recommend.

Dr. Alexander was one of my favorite professors this last semester, he had the best lectures ever and it was impossible to get bored in class. Instead of exams he does "role plays" and they were actually so fun and simple! I genuinely feel like I learned so much this semester because of the way he set up his assignments!!

Dr. Alexander has been one of my favorite professors at TCU, he was very caring and the class was actually interesting. He gave lectures but had a good mix of lecture and allowing us to engage with each other during class. Instead of exams he has an alternative which felt really intimidating at first but was actually way better than having an exam
Curby is awesome!!! Highly recommend! He's extremely caring and a great professor
Great prof, doesn't accept late work, but the work load isn't tuff so you should be able to do it any ways. MF inspiring.

Dr. Alexander is the most personable, enthusiastic, and easy-going professor I've had. This class is one of the easiest class that I've taken and it is very interesting and helpful if you're interested in teaching as a career. There are take home reading quizzes which are extremely easy, short essays, and short-answered exams. Take this class!

Professor Alexander is such a sweet professor who genuinely  cares about his students. The class is long, and his lectures feel long but he does a good job of keeping it interesting and engaging. Some of the class is also field work. He is so nice and very understanding of meeting your needs/helping you out if you need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr.Alexander is a super good lecturer however you HAVE to pay attention in class for the exams. There are quizes every other week online about the text book. The tests are open response in person but he provides a study guide which is super helpful. A super interesting class - i would take again.

Dr. Alexander is the reason I changed my major to education. He is so kind, compassionate, and adores his students. He wants all his students to succeed. He makes lectures interesting which helps everyone do well on the final exam. I wish I could take his class again. One of the most caring and kind professors at TCU.

I heard great things about Dr. Alexander but I was sadly disappointed. I was told he was a relaxed and lenient professor and easy grader--none of that was true. He didn't give feedback on papers yet graded them poorly with no reasoning as to why. He's personable to the class as a whole but not individually, though his lectures are great!
Good teacher, hard grader. Attendance mandatory.
Sweetest person ever. I wish I was able to take his class again!

This class was mostly lecture-based, but it was pretty interesting because of the coursework and the fact that he was charismatic. There was a homework assignment due every week, but never anything hard. The tests were taken online, and we got the potential questions beforehand (and we could use it while taking the test).

Absolutely adore Prof. Alexander. He genuinely cares about this students and makes this class very interesting. I am not an education major but I still think this class was great. As long as you listen and participate, you will do very well in this class. Highly recommend!!!

I love Prof Alexander!! He is really passionate about the subject and makes lectures so interesting! He takes the time to know each student's name and gets to know us in class! If you take good notes tests won't be hard because he gives you the questions before hand! This class requires effort but he is the best! 10/10 would recommend

Mine was a 3 hour long class so it was hard to pay attention, however there are 4 classroom observations that are shorter than 3 hours. Weekly assignment which is easy bc some are done in class, some are papers ab observations in class and your own opinion. He is so funny and sweet and I definitely recommend taking him! I have a 99.7 or similar.

Dr. Alexander is my FAVORITE professor at tcu. Im not an education major, & his class was the one i looked forward to most all semester. The course work is fairly simple and youll learn a lot!! Tests are open ended and he gives you the exact questions on the review. Take ANY class taught by him, you wont regret it. Great person&fun environment

Dr. Alexander is my FAVORITE prof at TCU! He was amazing this year. He has so many funny stories and really helps you get excited about becoming a teacher. The homework is once a week and is normally completed in class in a group discussion setting. Easy A and I skipped a few times and ended with a 96. TAKE HIM, YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT.

He's a fine teacher. It's a super easy class but he can be such a jerk. he's been so passive-aggressive in emails and is the opposite of caring. He doesn't care about his students, you miss one class and you might as well never go back because he'll hate you. Wouldnt take him again but the work is easy

This class with Curby is a must take. I was not an education major but I thoroughly enjoyed this class. Curby is one of the best professors I've had because he shares his teaching experiences. Only one lecture a week (Monday), school observations on Wednesday, and small group discussions on Friday. You will not regret taking this class.
Dr. Alexander really cares about his students. He practically gives you the tools for the tests and most things are graded by chill TA's so its easy to get an A if you apply yourself at all.

He is a really nice guy and the class is overall very easy. The lectures and discussion groups can be boring. He is a hard grader on the reflection papers and takes off 5-10% for incorrect formatting. Additionally, the tests are difficult because he doesn't provide a study guide, only a "blueprint." However, going and observing classes was so fun.

I loved Dr. Alexander! His lectures were actually my favorite part of class--they were really interesting and he did a great job with all of them! He has a dry sense of humor that can be really funny. He's naturally a quiet person, but is really caring and loves to get to know his students. This was a great class!

I absolutely loved Dr. Alexander. His class was so interesting and I loved the field experience. His lectures can be kind of boring and you have modules you need to complete before every class but other than that I would highly recommend him. His class is great to take if you are interested in early childhood education.

He is a nice guy but for someone who is literally teaching us how to be good teachers, he is not very good at it. Tests are hard and questions are usually matters of opinion so if you disagree with his opinion you are wrong, lectures are extremely boring, only good part of the class is the school observations.

Dr. Alexander is a great professor, and if I had really studied for the tests and completed all the modules on time, I could have easily gotten an A. It is a fun class when you get to visit the schools, but the lecture days are very long and can sometimes get boring.

I loved taking Mr. Alexander's class. He is such a personable teacher and just a really quality person. You can tell he loves what he does and know so much about the field of education. He is very funny and entertaining. I highly recommend taking his class.
Super Awesome professor! Probably the best teacher to have for an intro education class. His TAs were super helpful and if you ever have to miss class he is really accommodating.

Dr. Alexander is so great!!! He is perfect for the Intro to Education class and makes lectures so fun. He has dad humor and laughs at his own jokes which really helps those early morning classes. This class was so enjoyable and solidified my beliefs in wanted to become a teacher!
Dr. Alexander is very caring and wants his students to do well. However, there is a lot of busy work given out. There are 3-4 papers that have to be written and his tests are difficult.
I love him!! Hes so funny and kind and his teaching is awesome.
Hands down my favorite professor at TCU. He is super funny and he makes the long lectures fun. 10/10

This class will definitely tell you if education is a good fit for you. The beginning of the semester is very difficult and there will be lectures every day until you start observing, then they spread out to once a week; the first test is the hardest because of this. The papers are graded fairly easy. The TA's are awesome and are very helpful!
He is so nice!! Such a funny and caring guy. I would definitely take one of his classes again!

My favorite professor at TCU. You get graded on attendance and doing homework, but if you go to class and do the homework it is an easy A. He is super funny and I love going to his class. The observations are fun. The papers sneak up on you so make sure that you start on them early, but he is an easy grader. Love this professor and this class!

He is awesome!! One of my favorite professors at TCU. He makes the class really interesting and adds his own personal stories. The observations are easy, and I really liked the discussions. There are modules due quite often but they aren't bad. He does a google chat review which is SO helpful before exams!! Overall a great teacher and great class.
Observing in schools is great and the lectures are not too bad. However, essay assignments sometimes catch people off guard so keep up with the syllabus.

This class was so awesome! It is the perfect class to take if you are interested in being a teacher. There is homework(online modules) due every single Monday. You get graded on attending class and off campus school observations. The tests are very manageable. You will do well in this class if you take good notes and be attentive.

He is a great professor, the 1st exam is the hardest grade in the class. Make sure to prepare for that ahead of time. Otherwise the class was a breeze. The class was very interesting on the other hand! The observations are interesting and the discussions were great too. I would highly recommend this class and this professor!
Super nice and funny. You can tell he loves what he does. TAKE THIS CLASS.

Monday's are lecture, Wednesday's are observations, and Friday's are discussions. Pretty easy and fun class. The tests are over the lectures and he gives an online review before the tests. You will have to read two books, but they are really interesting to read. Loved him and the class!
Make sure to check the time slot as it is six hours of class a week not three.  Observations and discussions are easy.  Tests are hard and pull out minute details.

Dr. Alexander is a great professor. He can be long-winded on lectures, but it makes the tests easier. Just take notes, come to class, and pay attention and you will do well. No textbook necessary. Also, the TAs are pretty great too.

Easy class! Tests are made of information right off the powerpoints. Copy the text on the powerpoints exactly and you should be fine. No need to read the textbook. He grades easy on essays, and classroom discussions are an easy bonus grade. If you just make the effort, you will get an A.

Dr. Alexander was definitely one of my favorite teachers this semester. His class is not that challenging, the tests are fair and straightforward and it's easy to get 100% on observations if you show up and do the questions. He's really nice and makes the long lectures on Mondays as interesting as possible because sometimes the content can be dry.

He is very kind! Dr. Alexander goes above and beyond to make sure his students have what they need to succeed and listen to their comments and suggestions. He also works hard to grade things quickly and get to know many of his students by name (and I am in a class of over 100). His class is structured wonderfully and he is very clear when teaching.

Dr. Alexander is truly one of my favorite professors at TCU. This is the second class I have taken with him and I enjoyed every second. We only met twice a week and I feel like I will use what I learned when I have my own classroom. He is very good with technology and has a huge heart. I highly recommend this class.

Dr. Alexander was such a sweet professor. Mondays are lecture days, Wednesdays are observation days, and Fridays are quiz days. The quizzes weren't difficult at all and you don't even need to read the textbook! He made an effort to know every student and I really enjoyed the class. Perfect for students interested in becoming teachers!

I took Dr. Alexander for Child and Adolescent Development. He is a very kind man and knows a lot about his field.  He listens to his students' suggestions about the class and is very helpful when you go to him one on one. I do have to say the class was a bit bland, but that's not his fault. Great guy!

Dr. Alexander is a wonderful professor!!! I took his Critical Investigation of Teaching and it was a pretty easy class. I really learned a lot and the class was totally manageable. Dr. Alexander really cares about the students and he keeps the class interesting by adding stories from his public teaching days. Take this class!!

Dr. Alexander is a wonderful professor! I took his Crit. Investigations of Teaching and Learning, and this has been my most enjoyable class so far. You'll visit a wide variety of schools, so attendance is mandatory. Weekly exams, but if you attend Monday's lecture and read the chapter you'll do great. All assignments are manageable.Great professor!

Dr. Alexander is wonderful! My favorite prof. at TCU. This class is the first class that gave me knowledge and resources relevant to the classroom. His class is interesting and helpful. He gives good assignments (that aren't too hard) and they are things you will actually use! Great prof. and class!!!

Had her hybrid TCC TECA 1311 course and she was amazing! You can tell she is super passionate about teaching! Definitely apply to school districts as soon as possible so you can get her observation hours and your portfolio done in time. Easy time-consuming assignments, but she goes over how to complete them and gives you plenty of time to do so!
Nice professor. Waller is just complicated when it comes to your state mandated observation hours. So very particular on how they need to be done. Choose someone else if you can
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Pretty easy grader and nice. Lots of textbook reading but does presentations on the readings anyway
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class was interesting, and I think that was because she used a lot of anecdotes from when she taught and let us talk about past teachers we've had. The class is mostly lecture-based but is also a lot of in-class group assignments. There are 4 assignments that take a good bit of time, but they aren't hard, and you get a week to do each one.

Professor Hanes is an alright professor. Her lectures are pretty boring (it's accounting after all), but her tests are relatively easy if you can do and understand all of the homework. I didn't read the textbook, just did the homework and got an A pretty easily. Would not recommend her simply because she makes a dull topic even more boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: A very kind lady outside of class but is a real pain during class hours. Lectures are quick, boring, and aren't helpful. Tests are extremely difficult and she wants the class average to be a C. Careful with earlier ratings because the acct dep has made her change her leniency. EC is just her fixing her wording mistakes on tests. Take someone else!

Professor Hanes is an awesome professor and extremely helpful. Always answers e-mails in a timely manner and is available all the time to answer questions. Going to class is essential because she does a lot of practice problems on the board that show up again on exams. This class is a time commitment, but Hanes is the best professor to take for it.
Great teacher. She is very helpful, she will answer any questions by email. Her tests are a little hard, but not hard to get an A. Do the homework before class and the quizzes and tests will be easy

As long as you stay on top of the readings (they are brief) and do the online homework, an A is very possible. She does give weekly quizzes but they are only worth 1% and she drops some, and she gives out lots of extra credit opportunities. She is also very helpful in office hours and responds to emails quickly. No complaints, I'd take her again.

Professor Hanes is a pretty good professor. Her lectures are based off of the homework, so if you don't do the homework you're basically screwed for the class. Do the homework and stay on top of the reading and you should be fine in the class.

Professor Shearer's class is a great option if you need the credit and have a busy schedule. Regarding the tests, two of the three have been take-home exams, which she grades very generously. She is great; if you want an easy A, take her.

LOVE HER! She is very clear with grading and is very lenient when things are due. Take this if you have a busy schedule, we had a film unit which was very interesting, and most tests were sketches that you can take home and write stress free.

CRWT 20103: This class was amazing especially if you have a packed schedule, the work consists of a reading and a response each class that can easily be done ahead of time. There's a few essays but your graded mainly on the daily work so as long as you get that done, it's an easy A.

super easy class as long as you just do your work. you don't have to pay attention during her lectures, although it definitely helps, to do the writing assignments. She's super lenient with when things are due and takes into account that students may be busy or have outside things going on. one of my favorite teacher's i've ever had at tcu
don't take!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Taking her currently, I do not recommend. She does not use D2L so I do not know my grade, writing assignments are very long and the class is just overall very confusing (probably because there is no D2L)

Throughout the semester we had assignments (argumentative essay, annotated bibliography, FAQ, etc) that were useful towards the website that we make for the final. If you put in the work during the semester to do the assignments well, the final website is super easy. Boring lectures though, they are kind of a waste of time. Super sweet lady!

Professor Shearer is a true gem at TCU. My class focused primarily on researching a particular topic of our choice and developing a call of action for the topic, which develops into creating a website for your final. This was great and I really enjoyed it. She is also pretty lenient with deadlines and not a tough grader at all. Take her if you can!

She is kind and caring. She gave interesting lectures and required you to show up but other than that, she can be lenient about the due date. I really recommend you to take her for the writing cores because you can still learn a lot without being freaked out about the deadlines and assignments. The amount of writing is not too much.

Professor Shearer is by far my favorite professor I've had. She is very caring and wants the best for her students. Usually an assignment due in class but very easy and the readings assigned are interesting. She gives feedback on essays before final draft is due so you can get the best grade possible. I recommend her at any chance I can get.

The class was pretty simple and easy. There were no hard deadlines for any assignments or essays. She was very confusing though when discussing assignments and how to do them, what she expected of us, or when they were due. Her lecture style is also extremely boring. I would probably avoid taking her for this class.

She is a great professor with kindness and caring attitudes. She helps me a lot with my writing and reading. She is very helpful and accessible outside of class. She is very understanding and opens with a diverse cultures. She listens and cares about individuals. Love her!

She is one of the best professors I've had. The books that we had to read were so interesting. For our papers were could hand them in and have her edit it before the final draft. we had one group project. She really cares about her students. If you do the work and participate its an easy A. A lot of times she canceled our Friday classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: She was AMAZING. Im pretty sure everyone in my class got an A. She simply wants you to do well and will go out of her way for you if you show you care. She loves participation and loves self analysis (if its good) in your papers. I would recommend her to anyone English major or not. You will love her I promise.

Shearer's Intro Comp class was the best class I have EVER taken (and I hate reading and writing). Class was let out early practically every day, if you need an extension she will give it you no questions asked, there are short readings for homework with "quizzes" to make sure you read (easy). Class is all about food! Less work than on syllabus.

AMAZING teacher. If you can take her, do. She teaches in a way that makes it interesting and engaging and she is super helpful and caring towards all her students. She genuinely cares about you doing well and understanding. Super easy class because she wants it to be. Understands the strains of being a college student and is amazing all around.

She is literally the greatest. Due dates are not a thing, she is so nice and laid back and is helpful if you have questions. All we do is talk about food. She cancels class like once a week and most times class lasts like 20 minutes (I had her MWF). TAKE THE INTRO COMP SEMINAR WITH HER
Really nice teacher, but not very consistent. As long as you show interest, put some effort into your work, and talk to her about your work you'll do well. Not too much work in this class.

Easy teacher but doesn't provide a list of grades or days you've missed. Says she takes attendance but can't even tell you what days you've missed. Grades are based on essays and lots of unecessary daily work that don't even help with writing the paper. Easy A if you actually go to class but it would be a waste of time.

By far my favorite professor (because she attempts to not act like a professor at all). Those who have not taken Shearer before might not understand that she is not a hard grader. She is more interested getting you to write fiction. She usually has you do less at the end of the semester than what was required. You'll enjoy her no nonsense approach.

Despite the fab reviews, I pass/failed this class because I never had a clue what my grade was. By the final exam we still had two papers ungraded, more than half the grade up in the air. Homework assignments were a total mystery. Idk if she forgot she assigned them or they weren't for a grade or what.

Shearer is about as legit as it gets.  Her stick-it-to-the-man philosophy means no textbooks but instead having a lot of assignments with plenty of creative flexibility.  Very helpful and willing to help you find your potential.  Easy grader, to boot.

She's a cooky lady, but so much fun! The work is easy, you hardly ever open a book. As long as you enjoy writing, you'll enjoy this class. She's flexible to a fault; deadlines are practically non-existent. No tests.
Awesome teacher. I recommend her.

She is absolutely wonderful! If you are at all interested in writing, take a course taught by Professor Shearer! Every class was interesting but not at all hard. Assignments were fun and we always got feedback from her and the class. I have decided to (double) major in Writing, thanks to her and her Intro to Creative Writing course!

Amazing teacher! Take this class if you can! We were told we were required to write 5 papers... we  wrote 2 and a take home final paper.. She usually lets you go about an hour early, if she doesnt cancel class. Shes a great teacher and actually cares about her students. If you have a heavy payload of work on your sholders, she will postpone assignm

WONDERFUL teacher.  She is awesome...it's fun to just discuss the random stories we read at times, and not have to worry about memorizing quotes and themes for tests.  LOVE her.  Makes Comp. interesting and entertaining!

Mrs. Shearer is a very nice lady, who is very understanding and wants to help all of her students be better writers. She allowed people to write in their own styles and gave TONS of time for papers. The class itself was interesting, she let out early almost everyday, and was very accessible outside of class. I would recommend her to anyone.
thisteacher is so strcit when she grades papers! it so hard to get an A in the regular paper! other wise ok teacher

MY FAVORITE TEACHER THIS SEMESTER! she only gives you 5 papers to write and plenty of time to do them. classes get over on early, and if you turn in small homework assignments and do things in class she will give you an automatic 100% on whatever you turn in like that. nicest person and most classes involve discussion of personal opinions!

she is the best English teacher i have ever had!  she gets that students have a lot going on and does not want you to stress about her class.  you will get out early every day.  she is a tough grader but an amazing teacher.  i would take her for every English class if i could.  she will be your favorite teacher.  TAKE HER CLASS IF YOU CAN!

I've had Dr. Williams for an undergrad course, an abroad course and this graduate research course. She has a genuine passion for research and education that makes her class very meaningful. The research course was definitely challenging but the objectives covered in the class were essential to know through my graduate experience. I would recommend!

She is very passionate about research and it shows in her lectures!  Made me enjoy the topic.  Makes complicated research terms and data analysis relatable and breaks them down to where you can understand.  Projects have clear guidelines and you know what is expected.  Is very approachable and willing to work with you outside of class if needed.

She is a wonderful woman and I enjoyed this class so much. Gained so much direction career-wise. She is so helpful and genuinely enjoyed teaching our class. Not too easy, but not too difficult either. Especially loved the in school observations, she even got me a meeting with one of the school directors!

She is a simple teacher. Didn't learn much for my minor. Received a rubric for a project 2 days before it was due. Seems kinda clueless. Mentioned the first day of class that she "doesn't know what she wants to do" in regards to her career. It showed in the overall class. Very easy class though. Attend and basically walk out with an A.

Williams is a great teacher who is extremely helpful!  She definitely helps prepare you for getting ready for future teaching positions and more specifically, in this class, preparing and taking the TEXES certification exams.

Dr. Williams was my student teacher supervisor and was very helpful with suggestions. She emailed promply and was easy to get in touch with. I also had her for Early Childhood, Intern which was a placement. She or her TA's were interested in my leanring and achievment. She is a great professor to have. You will work hard in her classes.

Dr. Williams is a great teacher.  Her classes are easy, but you do learn a lot.  Not necessarily a class you can blow off, but very manageable.  She is a great person to have on your side.  She has supported me all the way from my freshman year to my senior student teaching.  Wonderful person and professor!

Dr. Williams is extremely knowledgeable and does a great job teaching you the somewhat complicated subject (educational research). She is the type of teacher you want to have. I highly recommend taking any class she is teaching! She makes things interesting and worth while. You will actuall learn something. She is a genuinely nice person and cares.

Dr. Williams is one of my favorite professors at TCU. She has a very relatable way of teaching that makes class interesting- her tests are very fair. She's a very genuine professor and is extremely easy to get in touch with. The field experience provided is incredible- this class finalized my decision to become an elementary school teacher.

Dr. Williams is my favorite professor in the Co. of Ed. She taught the class well, made it engaging, projects were well spaced, tests were minimal and over material that you should know. Her intro to early ed class is valuable to all future teachers. I suggest her to anyone! So easy to talk to, and available for help via email or in person.

Was uncertain learning in this class would ever take place. But after the snow days and the teacher returning from another job of hers we were able to start studies.  Classes were centered on learner and current-career focused assignments. Overall good class-could have been even better...but it was her first time teaching the subject.

Dr. Williams is a wonderful professor. She may come across shy, but once you get to know her, she is an extremely valuable and helpful resource. I learned a lot in her class and even though I already knew most of the information, it was a good review. I would definitely recommend her!

This class is great for education majors! If possible, I would recommend taking C&A Development before this class because alot of the information overlaps; however, i didnt take it before hand and still made an A. It is such a great experience because you actually get to work in a school all semester. Also, Williams is always willing to help out!

This class was great! I am an education major and this class went along great with what i was learning in my other classes. Williams is a great teacher, and she is always willing to work with you! Her syllabus is not complicated, but make sure you stay on top of everything form the get go! I got an A and I would highly recommend this class!
I really enjoyed taking classes with Dr. Williams! She is approachable and ready to help her students!

Dr. Williams is wonderful. I have taken two classes with her, Intro to Early Childhood and Child & Adolescent Development. I also studied abroad with her to Italy. Has both textbook knowledge and practical knowledge from teaching and parenting that helps class discussions. She has an open door policy too so if extremely approachable! Great classes!

Teaches almost straight from PowerPoint, but rushes through faster than students can take notes. Most of her "expertise" in her field seems to come from her personal experiences as a parent. Does not engage students in any sort of discussion. Does not keep track of student progress.  Tests are easy - skim book, study PowerPoint (available online).

i took educational development with her. it was by far the easiest class i have taken at tcu.  the only time i ever studied was about an hour for each test and i made an A+.  she is a really nice teacher and expects very little from her students
She left one month before class was supposed to end for a trip so that was great! she had us do a presentation that she gave no explanation for though. Other than that.. EASY

I had her for my first 3 semesters of German.  It's not an easy language, but Cynthia Chapa teaches it the best out of all the German profs at TCU.  She is also very easy to contact outside the classroom.  Lectures are very thorough as are the tests.  So, if you do your homework, show up to class, and study the material well, you will be fine.

The class itself is easy. Do the work, get the credit. Tests are straightforward. She lets you know exactly what to study. ALWAYS study your book!! That being said, think hard before you take German. Much like any other language, it is difficult and requires a vast amount of time. Awesome professor!

Frau Chapa is such a sweet woman! Attendance counts so go to class. As long as you keep up with your work and demonstrate that you're trying, you'll do great. She's really understanding and answers emails quickly. Her German is also very easy to understand and she comes up with a lot of fun projects!

She is wonderful!  Took her German 1st sem. course and loved it.  Very helpful, very clear and friendly. Works with you to understand the material. Tests are true to the material taught and homework is easy and worthwhile. I highly recommend this course and professor.

Highly recommended. She is good at explaining stuff and is very helpful. Classes are easy. She gives out a review sheet 2 pages long with what is on the test, you just have to learn it. Very patient with dumb students. Easy A.

Somewhat difficult class, but her teaching style pays off in the end. She's pretty nice and helpful, you may sometimes get the feeling that she's putting you on the spot on purpose, but she does that with everyone. Tests are almost impossible to fail, i never got anything below an a B. Studying the vocab really pays off.
A really great professor! She knows her stuff and is willing to help you outside of class. The class is actually fun and goes by quickly! I highly recommend this class!
Great Professor! She really knows her stuff, and really cares about her classes. She is extremely helpful.
GREAT TEACHER!!! she really cares about YOU and your GRADE...as long as you go to class and study you should have no problem with doing well!! Highly suggest taking one of her classes!

Great teacher.  Really cares about you and your grade.  Pretty easy as long as you go to class and do the homework.  She makes things really clear and her tests are easy if you study.  She reminds me of my grandma...

Wonderful professor! She is super awesome. She makes you think without overloading you with busywork. Deadlines for papers are negotiable and if you have another paper due in a class she'll let you turn in the same paper to her. Take her if you can!

She is great! Had her for intermediate composition and she was very straightforward in her lectures. She is very helpful! I went to her office hours to discuss any concerns about my essay and I ended up doing well! Easy grader and easy A. Take her if you have the chance.
Great teacher, very helpful and knowledgeable. easily accessed outside of class and willing to help with anything. take all the classes you can with her!!

She took a class I was really looking forward to and made it miserable. Such a waste of time and you don't do or learn much. She's a nice person just for conversation, but if you want to become a better writer, her class is not the answer.

the most wonderful teacher @ tcu. she is quite helpful and she is open to everyone's viewpoints. she let's you out of class as soon as she covers everything that needs to be covered, which is a plus, b/c she will NOT keep you in class unnecessarily. AMAZING professor. TAKE HER CLASS!! she is SOO helpful!
Take her class!!! Very very helpful, if you have trouble at all (which you won't). Paper topics very open, very interesting topics. Fairly easy grader. Class hour and 20 min long....get out in 40
take class with her

He seems nice, but he is genuinely the definition of a mansplainer. Lectures really aren't important and most people don't go to them. The exams are random information, and hard to study for, but aren't worth much. Labs are fine, just fill out your notebook before the lab otherwise you won't have anything to base it off of.

Labs weren't always set up correctly/not enough materials. Procedures not written well. TA's were confused about what he wants. I don't think he knew what he wanted half of the time, some of the lectures weren't science related, it was impossible to study for exams because even he didn't know what was gonna be on them. He never answered my emails.
Tests are so confusing, and lectures do not clear up any information, I stopped going to them. Class is so unorganized, and it really depends on what TA you get.
Professor lectures makes no sense, and its impossible to study for the lecture exams because even he has no idea what is on it. Lab days also did not line up with the syllabus at all.

Had him for the Bio Investigations lab. A great guy, but not the best at teaching content that appears on exams. The exams are made by Lakoduc and Luque so it is never clear what is on the exams. Grades are exams, the surprise notebook checks, skill checks, and projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Lectures are pointless, honestly I never go. Attendance isn't mandatory. Tests are nothing like the lectures and he isn't clear on what exactly to study. I only passed the first exam because of my knowledge in diversity. Not sure why that was on the test when this isn't diversity... Dr. Thomas is a nice guy tho.

For BIOL 10523- Unorganized lectures and goes on and on about stuff that's not relevant at all. Also is rude to students when he says "if you don't have friends to study with, then talk to a wall." You could skip the lectures, since they're all posted online and a waste of time and he doesn't take attendance.

BIO 10523- Super disorganized and lectures were never helpful...Unclear on what is on exams and memorizing slides isn't enough. Wasn't impossible or a horrible class, just felt like lectures were a waste of time.

he made bio really easy but also really forgettable. he's a genuinely nice guy he just stumbles over himself talking sometimes which makes it hard to follow along. online quizzes before every class period using your textbook and attendance is taken every class period. glad i got the science credit but not much else to say

He didn't answer a single one of my emails the whole semester and 2 of them were regarding my final grade which I needed a response back on but never got one. The one time I emailed him he responded a month later. In lecture he seemed unsure of what he was talking about and made it difficult to pay attention.
Nice guy! I had him both for lab and lecture and he was funny. textbook is online and you have reading quizzes before every class and that's your attendance.

Extremely easy way to get a natural science credit. There are short quizzes before every class that can be tricky but all tests are online and on lockdown browser! The lab is also really easy and never takes the full amount of time. I recommend!

I had Professor Thomas for Lab and honestly, he was easy. You are mainly graded if you show up and do the activities in class and for the exams. I hated science in high school and this class was no problem for me.

Dr. Thomas is amazing! Seriously do not be scared by these reviews. His course is extremely easy and manageable. I had him for lecture and he was awesome! Only hard thing about the bio classes at TCU are the Lab Exams.

I was nervous to take his class based off of the reviews but Thomas was super chill. Yes, lectures were boring but he was just going off of the content he was required to teach. Participation is required but you get a few skips. Attend lectures, do quizzes before class, and you will pass with flying colors.
This guy blows
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: I only had Thomas for lab and he was great!! The previous reviews scared me off a little bit, but Dr. Thomas is super easygoing and will literally help you if you need it or ask. The tests are not terrible whatsoever and lab group assignments are interesting/ fun at times. As a non-stem major, this was one of the most manageable classes ever.

Really easy class. Make sure to do the quizzes with the readings before every class. The tests are take home and the attendance is mandatory but I think you get three skips. The only grades in the book are the tests and the quizzes with every reading. The quizzes are kind of tricky so take your time
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Teacher is absolutely terrible. The first half of this class ( taught by a different professor) was enjoyable, challenging, but overall achievable. Dr Thomas has no clue what he is doing. He does not explain the material well at all, he will literally say uhhhh and read directly from the slide and then be like uhh yea next topic. Never prepared!!!!

Good class. Fairly easy. Tests/quizzes are frustrating as they pertain to minute details that surprise most students. Not a hard class but because the teacher runs through extensive lectures & creates little involvement, hard to retain all the knowledge. great guy, not the best educator. Exam grade heavy. 3 quizzes a week before class.

He is good, the lectures are boring and not super easy to follow. You will do well on the exams if you use the study guide, but the in-class quizzes are very hard. I would take him again the class was just not my favorite.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He changed the class this semester so that you either have a reading quiz or a writing quiz every single class. This made it hard to skip class and the tests were honestly kinda hard. hes nice and offers a lot of extra credit but I would take an easier history
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Davis was super nice and friendly in class and office hours. This class wasn't difficult but I got a lot more out ofit than I ever expected. My favorite thing about this class was it always felt safe to talk and he let us come to our own conclusions on a lot of historical law cases. Would 10000% take again

Such a fun class. It was a seminar class so the structure was mostly discussions based on that day's readings. Such an easy grader and is so kind and assessable. Has an extreme wealth of knowledge and is a great lecturer.

really chill professor. if you are a hard major and need a super light history class take this class. no exams or quizzes. only 2 response essays that need to be at least two pages and other writing assignments which are easy. we literally talked about the top 50 hip hop albums in the first week. just take him.

I really liked Dr. Davis. There were never any tests. we had 2 response papers that only had to be 2 pages. There was a reading response due almost every class but it only had to 2-3 sentences long- it was an easy 100. We had TAs that did all the grading in the class and one of them was very picky. Other than that I would recommend this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: LOVED Dr. Davis. Classic dialogue based class where you are expected to read before and then speak about it in class. He does something called "minute around" where you speak to the class about the reading. He's an easy grader, flexible on dates, and overall a really cool guy. TAKE WITH HIM!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I loved Mr. Davis's class ad always enjoyed going. His lectures are engaging and never boring. He sometimes references movies and music so it is always interesting to listen to his lectures. He is a super nice grader and always responds to questions and emails if you have any.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: very interesting class, super nice professor and isnt too tough about grading. cares about his students and not too much work

Pretty easy class. No tests or final. but its a lot of reading and writing. You're grade is heavily weighted by the 2 response papers you have to write throughout the semester, but he gives you plenty of time to do it and it only has to be two pages
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is really not as bad as these reviews make her seem. Lectures at a slower pace but helps you understand the material better, she knows what she's talking about.
Pretty good teacher, knows what she is talking about, engaging. Study for the exams, because that's the only thing you're graded on.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is extremely boring but Dr Dahlquist is a very nice person and the class is pretty easy. Her slides do not have much words so pay attention in class but the exams are exactly like the lectures if you take good notes.

She is nice, knowledgeable, and helpful. However, she is extremely boring. Her exams are very difficult, and you will have to take notes over every bit of content she teaches in order to do well. I haven't got much out of this class. She's a very nice lady, but she makes this class more difficult than it needs to be. Take someone else if you can.

Very lecture-heavy and they are BORING. Also, she walks around the first couple rows hella which always had me switching tabs and was very annoying. No hw for the most part but the tests matter even more because of that. The test aren't too bad, you get to bring a cheat sheet... but this class was far from the highlight of my tuesdays and thursdays
Had her for international finance class on my study abroad. Honestly really chill teacher but she lectures for a while.
Sitting through a Dahlquist lecture is the most boring thing you'll do at TCU. The exams are easy if you take half decent notes.

If you actually want to learn about anything that is useful then do not take her. She does not provide any notes or slides after class. Excessively lectures which are extremely hard to listen too then test you on random questions which could have more than one right answer. Also only 4 exams so no way to make up for one bad exam score. Awful!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Actually the sweetest lady. She lectures a majority of the class, but all homework is super easy (just readings from HBC). Her tests all come from what she says in class, and you get to have a cheatsheet. 100% will be taking her for international finance. Definitely overhated, people are just annoyed they have to actually show up to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Be prepared for lectures. She is incredibly nice and tells you exactly what you need to know for test that are 40 question multiple choice. 4 test with 1, 30minute long project that is a free 100. No homework and I show up to class 75% of the time but just make sure to grind studying for exams and you can easily walk away with a B+/A-
Suuuuper boring class. Just sit there on your computer counting down the minutes. Ms. Dahlquist is pretty cool tho
Overhated tbh, tests are easy. She lectures for whole class period, but not the worst option.

Class lasts the full 3 hours. Weekly quizzes so you have to go to class and drops 2 lowest ones. 2 exams that count for most of the grade. Studied for the 1st exam for a week and still got a 65 because her questions are confusing. You are allowed a cheat sheet, front and back. One big group project. Not nice during office hours or helpful at all.

Lectures the entire class. Doesn't have quizzes anymore so the majority of the grade is just exams. The only other assignments are a Beige Book presentation and a 500-100 word paper than only count for 2% each. She is not helpful and is not understanding at all. You are allowed a front and back cheat sheet during the exams. They are difficult!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Would def take the other professor. Some pdfs to read but tests are all on her lectures and they are hard if you don't have an extensive finance background/knowledge. 40 MC and no curve or partial credit. Lectures last the whole class and the PP slides have nothing on them and she make you take notes on paper only. No quizzes anymore either.

The worst professor at TCU by far- don't take any class with her. She's no help at all in office hours, has barely any information on the slides, and overall just not a good teacher. Not very knowledgeable on the in class topics either, find literally any other professor. Wouldn't recommend her to my worst enemy.

Take any other teacher for M&B. Shes nice but her lectures are boring and meaningless. I thought I was going to learn something; I was wrong. She is really good at taking a definition and rambling for 30 minutes until you forget what she is talking about. Most boring and pointless class. Test is hard and she doesn't teach the content properly

Snail's pace of a lecturer. Took a night class with her and it could have ended an hour early if any other instructor taught it. Intl Finance is such a simple class but was overcomplicated with her teaching it. Take an easier elective, with another professor.

Her class is pretty much all lectures and taking good notes is a must. Attendance isn't necessarily mandatory, but if you do not go to class, you will not understand half of the material on the midterm and final exam. I went to every class and took notes on everything and was still confused with many of her exam questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She lectures the whole class and her PowerPoints are just graphs or have few words. For quizzes, if you pay attention and take notes you will do fine. The exams are very tough, she only gives a list of terms for a study guide but you can use a notes sheet. The final is worth a lot and could bring down your grade. She is just okay, not great.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take this professor. Her lectures are awful and her exams are impossible. She has next to no information on her slides making it hard to study for exams.
She really is a great teacher and knows what she's talking about. You can tell she really enjoys teaching this class. However, lectures are difficult to stay engaged in and quizzes are very hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her lectures are painful. The class is not difficult she is a boring presenter. We have 4 quizzes and a final that determine our grade. The quizzes can be difficult especially if you don't pay attention in class.

such a sweetheart. gives multiple attempts on weekly, open note quizzes, 45 minutes for 10 easy multiple choice questions. cumulative final, but you have 3 attempts. semester-long group project, but it's minimal work. you don't have to do every assignment, you get to pick and choose which ones you want to do. highly recommend this class!
He grades on very little; however, everything he assigns is really easy. Easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super sweet guy and a very chill class. Posts class slides online and doesn't require almost any participation.

He is the kindest soul and truly cares about what he is teaching. He does not try to force any religion, but merely gives the facts and history about each. Really interesting and extremely knowledgeable.
He was one of the sweetest teachers I've taken and was always nice during office hours. There isn't much work but there is an attendance grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Brockman is very knowledgeable in his field. The course itself is not very demanding, nor difficult. I wish he was more respected by student, however, I can understand how easy it is to lose focus. Overall, easy course. Difficult to stay engaged if you are not a fan of religion and/or politics.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: His expertise in the field is undoubted; his lectures are clear and organised. Students are expected to do the required reading before class. There are several quizzes throughout the course but just do the reading and you will be fine. Discussions require more thinking and writing but there are clear grading criteria and helpful feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is the sweetest professor ever. Attendance is mandatory but there are some days where he doesn't take it because he wants to get right into teaching. All the assignments are super easy and do not take long at all. Take him for your religion credit because you will not regret it.

Professor Brockman was AMAZING and so nice! No homework, besides textbook readings which he goes over extensively in class. No tests, just a few quizzes in which are take home/open note. If you take good notes in class on what he says then you will do good. Attendance is mandatory. Definitely take him, by far the easiest religion class!!!

I absolutely LOVED having Dr. Brockman this semester!! He was so caring and genuinely a great human. He really cares about what he is teaching, and is willing to help his students. I would 100% take his class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was so easy. Super great religion credit and he is such a nice teacher. Make sure to keep up with readings as there are a few online quizzes here and there. Definitely take this course.

This class is fairly easily as long as you take good notes and go to class. The grades are a mix between online quizzes and in class assignments/discussion. The professor is very passionate about what he talks about and is very approachable if you have questions. Overall, I highly recommend this class.

Dr Brockman is super sweet and very caring, however the class itself is a little dull. pretty lecture heavy but nothing too crazy. Quizzes and discussions are the only grades but they are relatively easy. Attendance is mandatory so all you have to do is show up and you will be good

He is a very nice man. You don't really have to do anything in class except show up because attendance is mandatory. There are 3 online quizzes and 3 discussion posts. Classes are not super engaging because he reads out of the book and lectures constantly, but it is an easy A.

such a nice man. really wants you to succeed. not much to do if you pay attention and take some notes you will do good. There are online at home tests as well as a few discussion posts. You will pass the class if you write what's on the power point. Buy the online textbook so you can command F and find certain passages
Best religion professor at TCU! Overall pretty easy and no outside work. A large percentage of your grade is attendance so you have to make sure to go. 3 quizzes, 3 discussions, final exam.

So sweet and caring. The class can be boring, but take notes you'll need them for the quizzes. He really cares about what he is teaching, so he lectures the whole time. The quizzes weren't bad and the journal responses were easy just took time. It didn't require much other work. I would for sure take him, he's prob the best option for religion.

Shes honestly hilarious, but for a student with ADHD the way she lectures and organizes her slides makes it so difficult to pay attention, and study when the time comes. She's unclear about what will be on exams vs what wont, and dont be fooled by the easy first exam, her questions are extremely specific.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Davis is so sweet and is really passionate in nutritional health. The tests are pretty hard and a lot of the topics can be pretty confusing and she wasn't very clear about them in class.

Lots of content covered and can be confusing at times. Provides study guides for exams, but they are not very detailed making it difficult to study sometimes. Very kind and listens to her students and is very kind during office hours.
shes really not a great lecturer and just reads off the slides in more confusing ways, you can do fine in this class without showing up and just teaching yourself honestly

She's a very good professor who breaks down topics at a very simple level. She gives class breaks and shows us fun videos or tells us funny stories. Overall, really passionate about what she teaches, good at teaching, and easy to be successful in her class. You'll learn a lot and have fun. Take her!

Dr. Ford is a really good teacher, and you can tell she wants her students to do well. Attendance isn't mandatory, but she gives extra credit points through iClicker. Tests are hard, but she gives study guides that have everything you need to study. She gives breaks throughout her class, which is very nice.

This class is difficult but she gives study guides which has exactly what will be on the test. She wont know if you dont attend class but the iClicker each class counts for extra credit. There is a textbook required becuase of the assignments that go with it but I never actually read it.

Helpful study guides given for each test. Fill those out and be able to explain the material to someone else.She really wants students to fully grasp the material. So going into her office hours and explaining it to her and having her fix certain parts is key to success. I started with a D and finished with a B so you will be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Davis is incredibly sweet and always keeps class engaging! The material itself can get heavy which is why I kind of fell back a bit on my grade but if you study and understand the material deeply then you should be fine. She gives lots of breaks and meditation moments during class which was great. Overall, she is loves what she teaches.

This class is lecture heavy, but Davis makes it enjoyable. She offers extra credit which is basically just attendance and answering a few quiz questions (does not have to be correct to earn points). Her lecture slides can be a big confusing by how they are formatted. If you study for exams you will be fine, she gives kahoots as well.

She is so kind and makes a 200 person lecture feel personal, the class is easy just do the weekly assignments and when tests come follow the study guides and kahoots she makes. You do need to go to class though because she says things in person she puts on the tests.

She is great and very knowledgeable about what she teaches. This is a difficult class, but if you have taken Anatomy 1 & 2, you should be prepared for the heavy studying for these tests. Take notes on the lectures! She does give points for attendance through iclicker. A lot of the content overlaps with Anatomy and Microbiology.

I loved Professor Davis! She was incredibly sweet and engaging during her lectures, making it one of my favorite classes. The material itself isn't hard, but the tests are definitely tricky. Reviewing the slideshows helped a ton. It's easy to get caught up if you miss a class. She shows funny dog videos as a little break in class.

Very qualified and nice person but her slides can be very disorganized making it hard to understand the main points. Her tests are very straight forward in what they ask but her answer choices definitely try to trick you. I really did appreciate her very healthy view of food.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Davis is incredibly sweet but this class is very difficult. Extremely important to stay up on studying and reviewing after class. In the end I became burnt out and my grade suffered but the load of info was overwhelming at times. 4 in person exams + mandatory final. Dont go into this class thinking you can pass it without working for it!

Nutrition is a hard class, but Ms. Davis made it very enjoyable. Her exams are challenging, but you can definitely do well if you study for them. There are weekly assignments that are short and boost your grade. She takes attendance with iclicker, but it's technically extra credit points. She plays dog videos to keep the class engaged as well.

Overall, she should not teach a class of 150 students, instead, she should teach a class of 30 students. At times, the class felt disorganized and sometimes the material was rushed. You pretty much have to teach yourself the material, which is frustrating at times. Her final is accumulative and there isn't another professor who teaches this course.

Good professor but difficult class. You HAVE to stay on top of your studying and Mindtap activities. If you make a mistake it is VERY HARD to come back from it. The tests are difficult if you do not spend a lot of time studying. Bonus points from Iclicker help a little.

Professor Davis is definitely qualified to teach this class, but strictly reads off of the slides. I attended class for two weeks and realized it was a waste of my time, as I was able to complete iClicker outside of class. Was that most responsible? No. However, I still ended with an A because she strictly reads off of power point slides.

She is nice and gives breaks, but her exams are extremely hard. The answer choices are confusing and often entail choices such as "b and d", "a and c", and "all of the above", just in one question. she is very lecture-heavy, uses iClicker, and often is very unorganized and all over the place. Ended with a B.
Davis is the only teacher offered to take this class. Only a lot of work the week of the test when you are studying. Lots of memorization. Cumulative final.

Professor Davis is awesome! She is so passionate about nutrition, and she gives us breaks every lecture to just relax our minds. This is not a blowoff credit, however. You have to study and put in the work to succeed.

Professor Davis was great the whole semester. She is very lecture based, but she is so passionate about nutrition it made it easier to learn. She also gives you breaks in between with animal videos to keep you alert. As long as you study and put in effort you will be fine. I learned so much in her class. She also provides extra to boost your grade

Professor Davis is amazing! She is so understanding of outside situations and understands you have more classes than just hers. 

However, this is not a blow-off class, you must study if you want to do well on exams. If you put in the work you will be just fine. Make sure to get an Iclicker for extra credit.

Great professor and super sweet! It is very lecture oriented, and you need to take notes in class. The tests are difficult if you do not study. Attend the TA review sessions for the exams. You also need an iclicker for participation points.

Professor Davis is so funny and knows the material very well. If you take good notes on the PowerPoints, go to class, and write out the material on a whiteboard (or study your own way) thoroughly, you will succeed.

Davis is really sweet and classes are fun, but the slides can be confusing. I recommend saving the powerpoints and writing notes during lecture directly on the slides to connect the dots. not a hard class at all if you just put in some effort!! I ended with like a 96. its a lot of info but definitely not too hard

Professor Davis is terrible. The class itself is not that hard but she is not a great professor. Test are hard for no reason and her lectures/powerpoints are unorganized and all over the place. I came to her with a concern and she was not helpful and hardly let me speak. She is not very sympathetic towards her students.

Ms. Davis is super nice and funny. She gives study guides for the tests and is more than happy to further explain concepts to you. Attendance isn't mandatory but is definitely important and you get extra credit for participating. Be prepared to study a good amount- this is not an easy A but is very doable and an overall interesting class.
Loveeeeee this lady! She is amazing at teaching the material. The tests are hard, but if you put in the allotted time to study for the test, you will do just fine.

Loved the professor and she was super fun, but hated the class. The tests are beyond difficult, I studied days on end and never received higher than a 80. You must know everything from lectures which consist of 80+ slides. Nutrition is interesting to learn about, but the tests are ridiculous.

Professor Davis is a really great professor, her lectures are actually engaging and she is a really kind person. For what could be a boring class, she keeps it engaging and loves to play animal videos for little breaks. She also explains things super well. Make sure you don't forget your iClicker though, if you do she won't help you out.

Makes everything way more confusing than it needs to be, powerpoints are so unorganized, her reviews normally leave things off and are too broad, her tests make no sense and are formatted in the most awful way. She's really sweet, but makes the class more difficult than it should be.

Dr. Davis is horrible professor. She does not care for the individual success of her students. My worst college nightmare was taking this class. Tests are extremely hard. She is not willing to help you no matter how hard you try. Whatever you do throughout college, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!
Good professor but difficult class. Stay on top of your studying and work. If you make a mistake there may not be coming back from it. Good extra credit opportunities.

Mrs. Davis is such a sweet professor. Do the study guides but study the power points too because that's where most of the test questions come from. Very interesting lectures. Most of the information she wants you to memorize because she knows you'll use it in the future, especially in the medical field.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Tbh Prof. Davis is a great person if you wanted her as a friend as she is very sweet and caring, however her lectures are entirely MESSY. She doesn't know how to work zoom nor can she organize her lectures. Her test reviews are also not helpful for the tests as well. The only positive thing about her class is that she gives lots of extra credit.

I would be careful when studying for tests. You have to know the material to do well. Online with her was nice because you can not focus really easily, make sure you take the PowerPoint notes!! If you do the study guides, make sure you do them in-depth, don't just do the bare minimum because you won't do well. She's sweet but all over the place
She is not a good professor. She side tracks and is hard to follow. She sets you up for failure. Would not take her

Professor Davis cares about her students success! She is such a nice lady and is passionate about nutrition. There are 5 tests, but a lot of extra credit. She also gives credit for iclicker points for participation. She makes a study guide for the tests and her lectures are based off of what she tests on. This class requires work but is reasonable.

Very sweet and caring professor. Lecture heavy so take good notes. If you put in the work an A is achievable. Little work outside of class. Emphasizes info that will be on the test. Tests are more difficult than expected because they have "2 or more answers are correct", "all answers are correct" as multiple choice options that can be confusing.

Prof. Davis is so caring of her students. She is by far one of the most devoted teachers I know. She gives a ton of extra credit and her exams are straightforward and no trick questions. She likes to give us a break by showing us dog videos in class. The material itself is really interesting and if you have any questions she loves answering them.

Professor Davis is so sweet! She really cares about her students and knows her stuff for sure. You can tell nutrition is her passion, but she teaches at a level that her students will understand. Her tests are harder than you would think, but if you study an adequate amount you'll do fine.

Davis is a SWEET lady, but TERRIBLE professor. She is a professor who makes extremely generalized study guides and makes the tests SUPER detailed. The study guides/notes barely help when you take the test. You can receive SOME extra credit points. This class is ridiculous for no reason and expect to do poorly on her tests. TAKE ANOTHER PROF!!!!

Davis is a very nice person, but teaching wise I would not recommend. Her lectures are kind of all over the place. There are also 5 test throughout the semester. Test are difficult and are more detailed than her lectures and power points. Although, clicker points do help bringing up your grade so attendance is highly recommended.

She is a very thoughtful and kind teacher. She uses clicker quiz points as extra credit which is amazing! Her lectures are interesting and all though attendance is not mandatory, it is helpful. Her tests are a bit difficult, but if you complete the study guides and pay attention in class, you'll do fine. Would recommend!

I love professor Davis! She really cares about her students and tries to help everybody get an A. Go to lecture, its not mandatory but it helps a lot and she gives extra credit for attendance. Her lectures follow the textbook perfectly so if anything is confusing its easy to figure it out later. She is always willing to help outside of class :)
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: She is very nice and knowledgeable. She gives so much extra credit/bonus that can take your grade above a 100. Her tests are very straight forward and right from the notes. You only need to read through the powerpoints once to do well on the exams. It is also an interesting class to take (intro/basic nutrition)

Professor Davis is amazing! She is really funny and makes jokes along with the lecture to make it more interesting. I'd say her class is pretty easy (compared to A&P for nursing majors) and if you do your work you should get an A. The iClicker questions are used for extra credit and the MindTap assignments online really boost your grade.

Loved the class & learning the info, but it was hard to understand what she wanted some of the time. Go to the class & get the clicker points. No matter how much I thought I understood the material in class or knew the information for tests, it didn't always translate into a good test grade. She means well and is a very nice lady & tries her best
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very kind and enthusiastic teacher and has such a cool accent. Refers to nursing majors as "nursing types". Fill out study guides to study for tests, but tests will still be confusing regardless. She likes to put a lot of "two or more answers" or "all of the above" as answer options. Don't need to go to class, but go for EC iclicker questions.

Dr. Davis is a horrible professor. I emailed her THREE times about my final grade and she didnt have the decency to email me back. I find it incredibly rude to not answer your students, especially about a final grade. Dont take her.

Attendance isn't mandatory but she gives extra credit for going. Don't bother paying attention in class though, her lectures make no sense and the powerpoints are even more unorganized. She is great as a person, but try to not have her as a teacher. She makes nutrition more confusing than it really is.

She is super passionate about the subject, but she does not explain anything well. You're better off teaching yourself the material, which truly is not that hard. If you're taking A&P at the same time, it lines up nicely with her course. Go to class to get extra credit clicker questions, they really help!

Mrs. Davis is very nice but her class is extremely hard. There is no reason that a nutrition class should be my lowest grade all semester. She acts like the test will be super easy but she puts random things and makes most of the question have "two answers are correct" as a choice. Wait for the other teacher if you can hold off a semester!

I was not expecting nutrition to be as hard of a class as it was for me! I really like professor Davis as a person, she is always very nice and ready to explain things, but her way of teaching is very confusing and is very lecture heavy. Her powerpoints don't make a lot of sense and she makes the tests way harder than I expected.

attendance isn't mandatory but there are pop quizzes. they are fairly simple just know you're stuff. class gets out early most of the time until we starts the TRAS then we will be staying about 4-5 classes for almost the full class period. she brings in people to talk to us which is great. and she has great stories !!

she is amazing. she brings in a. lot of people in out c career path and out opens your eyes to opportunities and careers you might have not considered. there is no formal attendance but all the guest speakers are a must.

Professor Schroeder is amazing! She knows the material front and back (she helped write a lot of it) and makes a night class enjoyable. She brought in a lot of great guest speakers, too. She is very accessible and truly cares about her students. I would absolutely take her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Love love love her. She's so sweet. Only 3 assignments, and guest speakers. No exams or quizzes. She is very helpful with criminal justice careers! I recommend her!

Wonderful! She is so funny and caring; I loved her and am taking her again next semester! Fun guest speakers, lots of pop quizzes, but online and open-note tests. Her sex crimes class has allowed for cool opportunities. Overall an easy class, but would recommend going for sure because of the pop quizzes, as there is not much else in the gradebook.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's really stubborn, so if you're an A student, expect a B. She don't round grades. Lots of guest speaker. Great Networking! I had her 5pm, and she came in late a lot and would keep us passed the time that the class ended.

I really like Professor Schroeder as an individual but as a teacher, she is stubborn. If you are an all A student, expect a B. She is non-negotiable about grades but the class really isn't difficult whatsoever. You get what you get and you don't throw a fit.

Professor Schroeder is awesome! She brings in great guest speakers and has great connections. Graded by several simple pop quizzes over previous lectures, 2 exams, and a creative activity which she will help you with. This class was so interesting and fun even though heavy topics were discussed. Take her!

She's amazing. Took her for career planning and learned so much/made great connections. She genuinely cares about each and every student, and has clear expectations for the class. Overall, I highly recommend taking her and wish I could again.
Heard great things, so I decided to take her. Best decision ever!!
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you can take her for career planning, do. She is so kind and experienced n the criminal justice field and has excellent resources and networking!!!
She assigned a 7-page paper single-spaced on a topic that you can barely write about double-spaced and gave us a week to turn it in. She does not use TCU Online and does not respond to emails.
She is the sweetest professor ever. Really enjoy her class. Even though its 3 hour long class, usually get done in 1 hour. Big group project. Only two test but so easy. Take her if you can.
Loved her class, very practical. An expert in probation!
Amazing. She brings in real life speakers, she's so, so funny, the tests are MC and beyond easy, one group project, a few quizzes, I absolutely would take again!! Easy grade booster. Love her
Loved her!! Gets to know students really well and wants everybody to succeed. Learned about real life issues and gained a lot of prospective from the class. Super easy tests if you go to class!

I loved this class. struggled in other criminal justice classes due to confusion on some topics. She was very clear, fun, and kept me on my toes throughout class. All in all, I loved this class with her as the teacher.
He makes me feel included and valued in a classroom. I have so much respect for him.
Very kind, allows days off if you don't want to show up.

I truly felt like I mattered to Professor Johnson. He started every class with a check in and created a classroom environment where none of us felt alone in how we were feeling. This class was 50 minutes and I wish it were longer. He loves TCU and makes himself available to us. He deserves praise and awards for being engaging and passionate.

Prof. Johnson is awesome! He truly cares about his students and gets to know each one personally. I took him for Introduction to University Life (it made me put music). He created a great classroom environment and was really engaging when teaching. Lots of classroom involvement so be prepared to participate. I definitely recommend taking him!!!

Nothing bad to say about De'Evin. He cares about TCU and cares about each student on a personal level. His experience teaching high school shines through in how he makes sure every student feels heard and valued.
He also cared for more than just our academics, he insisted that we take care of ourselves and I appreciated his care of us as humans.

The professor is truly caring about students. There is a good amount of extra credit on every exam. There is a textbook needed for quizzes but one was given to us online. The lectures can be long at times but she makes them engaging. She is a hilarious teacher who will make you laugh during every lesson.

Hands down the best professor I've ever had at TCU! She's lecture-heavy but makes it so entertaining. She has such a fun and real personality. There are a few D2L quizzes, but you have 2 weeks to complete them. Exams are straightforward. She allows a cheat sheet and does an in-class review that mimics the exam. Great class 100% recommend.

I loved her class so much. She understands that the students in her class are fulfilling a requirement most of the time. Her lectures were interesting. When she walks in dancing to her rock music, you know it is going to be a good day.
