Amazing!!! She was a great professor and was clearly passionate about what she taught. I'm sad I finished the class a little. Easy tests where she gave reviews before that were nearly the same, a fun create a culture project, interesting lectures.

Easy A if you show up to class, especially on exam review day. The tests mirror the review almost exactly. It's lecture-heavy, but she's extremely sweet and passionate about what she teaches. Just don't miss a quiz—she won't open it back up no matter how creative your excuse is.

I choose this class not knowing what I was getting into, and I am so happy I took this class. She is a great teacher! Grades are from quizzes from readings, 3 exams and a final but you can have a one-page cheat sheet and there is a final project but it's very straightforward and easy.
I LOVE PROFESSOR HEACOCK! I could not recommend her enough! Such an easy way to cover some core classes, and she is the kindest professor ever. And absolutely hilarious! TAKE HER!

I loved Prof. Rinewalt, but the class wasn't for me. Be wary of long and confusing lectures, and only a few tests and homework assignments. Otherwise, hes an amazing person, and is truly passionate about teaching. Hes just not the most tech savvy and writes all his notes by hand (including most code).

His lectures are pretty bad. If you have to take his class you might as well just ignore his lectures and learn everything at home from online resources. His tests are really not that bad, they're easy as long as you understand the concepts. Definitely the best part of his class. The lab assignments are pretty tough, however.

Not the best at explaining topics in his lectures so utilize his office hours. From time to time he can overcomplicate easy topics by not really explaining them. Exams he kind of grades strictly but he does admit he makes mistakes so you can argue FEW points back. He is nice but there is probably going to be a lot of self learning outside of class.

He is a great professor you just have to pay attention to what he is saying. It is easy to get lost in class but you can always go to his office and he is more than willing to help you. He never makes you feel stupid for asking questions and is super patient. You just have to put effort and actually go to him for help if you need it.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He doesn't have a lot of work for both Techniques or Data Structures so there isn't much to grade. He takes long for grading labs, but he's fast with exams. Lecture can be confusing but he is always willing to explain during office hours. He's just a jolly guy who wears ties with keyboards on it. Don't let the low score intimidate you.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class is passable however expect labs to not even be close to what you learned in class. The notes he writes to learn are so confusing and even he doesn't plan ahead because he will get lost in his own notes. Exams are graded awfully and claims to be a lenient grader but does the opposite. Claimed a topic wouldn't be on the exam it was.

If you have background in computer science you will probably be fine. nothing like the intro course at all, grades the lab assignments way too harshly for how unclear his lectures are, and he doesn't post the notes, just a bunch of random codes he makes up in class. was a comp sci minor but dropped that after taking this course. Just don't.

This is NOT a class you take directly after the intro course. The lectures might make sense at first until you get your lab assignment. There's little correlation between what you learned in class and what you're supposed to complete. Unless you have previous experience in CS, you will likely consider dropping or switching majors.

Horrible teaching style. There are no notes or powerpoints available, he will only display code onto the screen then lecture. He also makes many mistakes. Studying for exams are near impossible because you only have his codes to study from. What he teaches in lecture is completely different to what will be on the assignments so you WILL need help.

Avoid this professor if you can. If not, make sure to prepare to teach yourself the majority/all the material. Find a study group and work the homework as a group. This is not a BS class. Take it very seriously or you will be taking it again next semester or will be a different major by the end of the semester.

Almost zero continuity between this class and the previous introduction course. You are expected to know so much more computer science knowledge than previously taught in the prerequisite course. Although he is good at answering questions during lecture, his topics will almost never cover the Lab/ Exam. You will have to teach yourself the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very bad teaching style. Very passive in Office Hours. Help Sessions with students are helpful, they teach better than the actual teacher. Assumes you know everything when your only experience is an intro level course. Very bad preparation for tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The quizzes can be pretty difficult, but he does give some easy 100 quizzes. The way mine was, we were graded solely on weekly(ish) quizzes- lowest 2 were dropped- labs, and the final. Quizzes are always pop so you don't know which classes to show up to. He also DOES NOT GRADE TIMELY so don't expect to know what grade you currently have
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Rinewalt was a great professor, the material just never stuck to me no matter how much I studied. Don't bother trying the tutors, they won't be any help.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Good Computer Scientist- not a good professor. Very confusing unless you get help sometimes.

Unlike some others, I thought the exams were fair, if you memorize and understand the programs we write in class you'll be okay. It's definitely not an easy class and you'll have to really work for it but if you work together with other people in the class you'll make it through. I do agree though that he asks a lot of us and grades super slowly.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Don't expect to get your grades back until the finals week.

Takes actually the entire semester to submit any of your grades online so you will never know where you stand in the class even if you ask. Can be very passive if you meet with him outside of class and you are lost. He EXPECTS you to just know what to do and do it in a short amount of time. Not even the help desk can save you here.

Rinewalt is a real gem of computer science. He is a very nice professor and very smart. His projects are clear, but you should start them ahead of time. Many people start the night before, so they become an impossible mission. Ask questions, go to his office hours and try to do good in the labs since the tests are very hard. You will love him!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class is super tough. Its important to ask tons of questions in class or you will be lost. Don't worry about sounding dumb, nobody knows whats happening in that class. If you ask enough questions though, he will help you on the projects and preparing for the exam. He's super sweet, but get ready for a really difficult class.
He's a very good teacher! People say it's hard but most likely because they don't study hard enough...or underestimate the test. I only need 55% in the final to make an A...

Dr. Rinewalt is a human code-compiler - can code anything on the spot from memory without any bugs! His courses are VERY tough, but he does a good job. It's not his fault, but his voice really does hypnotically put you to sleep!  Get lots of sleep and drink caffeine in order to pay attention - would not recommend him at 8am due to the sleep risk!
Dr. Rinewalt knows his stuff. He can be hard to listen to in class sometimes, but he is generally quite helpful and receptive to questions. You won't get an easy 'A' out of his class, however.

Dr. Rinewalt knows his material. Many of the students coming from the 10403 class found this course to be overwhelming and rightfully so. Dr. Rinewalt expects the students to care about his class and to work hard since it is only required for COSC and CITE majors. He works fast to cover a ton of material that is useful for future computer classes.
He seems like a very intelligent guy, but goes way too fast and crams way too much into the class. I got an A in the Intro Course and am going to be lucky to pass this one!?!?!
Very smart teacher but asks alot from his students.. too much of a jump from the 10403 intro class, but very helpful if you seek him out.

Easy class and a good one to take for those who need  extra CITE hours.  Supposed to have tons of labs but only had one.  He will help you and is involved with material. No real background info needed.
really interesting class if you are interested in computer science. if not, then its gonna be hard.

If you think this is a blow off class think again! He is a very smart professor, but He does ask far to much from his students, especially since their only experience thus far was an intro class. Pay attention or prepare to be constantly depressed.

Lectures tend to be boring, but cod is emailed. By email he answers questions very quickly an clearly. Sometime he will almost write the lab for you if you ask the right questions. Tests are a bit hard even with all your notes and the book.
This egghead may well be a genius.  One warning...come to class late in the day, hyped up on caffeine, because his voice will put you to sleep.
Brilliant man!  Knows how to program very well.  Expects a little too much out of students on some things though.
He's very helpful and patient. His class is interesting and it teaches alot!
Amazing professor, the reason why I got into CoSc from the beginning. Pay attention, though, because his classes are not blowoffs!
His classes are not easy, but he is extremely knowledgable and helpful.
the class is a bit tough, but he's very helpful
He codes during class and projects it on a screen and e-mails the code to us.

Literally the goat, probably the best mathematics professor at Tcu. There's a quiz every week but they come straight from the homework. Same goes for the exams. The work is pretty straightforward; actually teaches you instead of making you watch a video, unlike some professors, and has pretty clear grading criteria. 100% def recommend taking him
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He was an amazing teacher who helps explain all the concepts clearly in the lectures. Attendance isn't mandatory but if you just go and pay attention you'll be fine. He has a way of making complex calculus concepts feel like common sense.

Class was pretty straightforward and chill, I only lacked at the beginning but went to office hours and got my grade up. The exams and quizzes are directly proportional to the questions that you do on the homework, so you won't expect anything different. Just make sure to study and go to office hours if you need help.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
Disrespectful and inconsiderate. 

Does not explain things clearly. 

Strongly discourage any students from taking a class with him.

He is very passionate about teaching, however, there is always at least one quiz a week, and most of the time there will be at least one question, usually a bigger one where there is a lot of work that needs to be done. We started with almost 30 students and now we are down to 15. If you are not good at math I recommend taking somewhere else.

Dr. Ledis is incredible. I took him for Pre-Calc last semester and loved his class so much I took Calc 1, too. His lectures are thorough and understandable. There is sort of a lot of homework, but it helps to understand the topics, and the weekly quizzes are only over the simplest topics covered. The tests are basically the quizzes combined.

"AHHHH" is what I would say while spending hours working on the VERY tedious homework assignments, but honestly I learned a lot in this class. Ledis is a great professor and is quite silly, just be prepared for a quiz every week. Show all work on quizzes or you won't receive credit. Also, I would strongly advise against skipping lectures!!

Amazing lecture! He's super kind and funny. There are weekly quizzes, so read through your notes and you'll be fine. Exam are similar to the quizzes. Homework took forever to complete I hate it so much, but he accepts late submissions with a penalty. He might adjust the weight of the final exam if your grades improve. Take him you won't regret it!

Prof Ledis teaches everything so clearly that even though my high school teachers sucked, I understood everything. There is kind of a lot of homework, but it really helps you understand the material. He had quizzes every week but they were only the easiest things he taught, questions straight from the homework. Tests are the same.

Prof Ledis is incredibly kind! Attendance isn't mandatory. You should show up bc the material builds on itself. Homework is insanely painful to do. Weekly quizzes are manageable if you attend class, take notes, and do the homework. He's also very accommodating if you need to reschedule a quiz. Reviewing quizzes will prepare you well for the exams

Such a great experience! Didn't talk personally to him too much but very welcoming and nice guy. He is AMAZING at teaching especially with topics that can be confusing. Tests are very straightforward and usually build off of previous quizzes. Lots of homework but helps to learn. Quizzes every Friday but it also helps to understand better for tests!

The quizzes are pulled directly from the homework the numbers are just changed, so doing the homework prepares you really well. He explains things so well I barely had to do any learning outside of class. Tests are pretty easy too.

Professor Ledis is a fantastic teacher who explains the topics in understandable ways. He is also very good at communicating outside of class when you need help on assignments or miss a lecture. His course is not difficult if you put in the minimum required effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Ledis genuinely seems like he enjoys teaching, and that makes the lectures super engaging and easy to follow! Quiz every Friday and VERY (not exaggerating) long homework assignments due on quiz days, but they are helpful for me since I learn from practice. Test questions are similar to previous quiz questions, so keep your quizzes!!
Gives the most ridiculously long homework assignments of all time, absolute waste

Professor Ledis is an amazing professor. He is so nice, and makes his lectures very detailed and helpful. Just study for the quizzes and exams. He usually re-uses quiz questions on the exams, so it is very easy to catch on. Could not recommend a better professor!

Ledis is an INCREDIBLE prof, but that doesn't mean this course is easy. Prepare to shed tears over how long some of the homework assignments are. He is a fair grader, and easy to talk to. Tests can be a bit of a nightmare though. His lectures are amazing and easy to understand, if he told me the world was flat I would believe him.

reviews.comment: Best math professor. Wants to see you succeed. Good amount of homework, but it's math, the more you practice, the better. TAKE HIM!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Ledis did a great job conveying knowledge. Calc2 is definitely not easy, and it takes effort to understand the materials, but it is most important to do homework and go to office hours. Prof. Ledis is easily accessible, willing to help, and exam questions come from homework, so ask questions and do the homework and you cannot get a bad grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Ledis is an OK professor for me. On the bright side, his exams and quizzes are fairly easy, consists of similar problems of the homework or in class work but easier. On the down side, he gives tons of homework, and by tons I mean it would take you around 6-8 hours per week to have them done. He's nice but don't take him in a busy semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I got a bad grade because I didn't always go to class and barely did the homework, but best math professor I've ever had. Makes the material seem easy and makes it very clear.
Dr. Ledis is a nice guy, but wow was this class awful. He gives an absurd amount of homework and quizzes, neither of which are anything like his exams. Take any other professor for calculus

Best math teacher I have ever had. After dropping calculus the first semester, I was wary of taking it again. Professor Ledis is so engaging that I developed a deep interest in calculus. Tests are just the quizzes combined. His course is extremely straightforward. Take his class!

TAKE HIM FOR APPLIED CALC! The easiest calc prof, super accommodating if you need to take an exam or quiz on a different day. Quiz almost every week that are super easy and exams are basically j the quiz questions put together. Save yourself and take him!

Super nice guy. You have quizzes every week or every other week. His quizzes are the test which is super nice. Study the quizzes and you should get an A on every test. Also, he will work with you if you need help or need to take a quiz another day.

Fairly easy math class, especially if you show up for class. If you do the homework, pay attn in class and review your notes before the quiz you will be fine. Not a hard math class at all but you do need to put in a bit of work. He is super nice and a funny guy but his lecturestend to be boring sometimes. Overall a pretty good teacher!

nice guy. you don't have to interact. doesn't take attendance but showing up to class def helps grade. do homework, show up on quiz days and listen to his reviews and you'll be fine. not a tough class if you're decent at math. good freshmen class
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Honestly, I hate anything related to math but to me this class was bearable. This professor was super nice and understanding. Attendance wasn't mandatory but it's hard to catch up if you miss because you are learning something new every day. Lots of quizzes but he prepares you well for them. Overall, would take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: His teaching style was not for me. Very easy examples then you had to teach yourself the rest. He's a nice person I just wish he would teach more in depth, the homework also doesn't match the quizzes so the wording was different and that was confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Ledis has a straightforward teaching style - here's what you've learned, and here's how it relates to what we're learning now. It's very nice to see how math builds upon itself. Definitely take him if you can!!

Every week you are given 3 or 4 lectures and then a quiz that is due the following Monday. Instead of meeting 4 days out of the week, it is split up between 2 days where you meet and 2 days there is a recorded lecture. The lecture material doesn't always match the homework. If you take notes and do the homework, you will pass.

Do not take this class with this Professor. Worst mistake of my college career. The way he speaks to students and treats them is terrible. The content of the class is barely taught at a pace where students can learn the material. He is rude and condescending during office hours. Stay away.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr Ledis is a very nice, shy and geeky guy. The whole class would laugh at things he said that weren't even funny, his personality just makes you want to laugh.I will say that sometimes he goes fast when giving lecture, but just raise your hand and he will clarify what you need as best he can. Hands down easiest professor for topics in math.

Dr. Ledis is great! His lectures are easy to follow and he is willing to help you understand. He is super nice too. The homework is online and there it can be annoying to finish it all, but his quizzes and tests are doable. Take him for precalc with trig!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Extremely easy class! Ledis is very clear in lectures. Homework from the book is assigned but it is optional and not taken up. Dont even buy the book, I didnt open it once and made an A+. He is very friendly and makes lectures fun. Only grades he gives are on quizzes and exams, but they are very straight forward.

He was awesome!!! Goes above and beyond to explain topics in many ways and takes your questions seriously. Math is my worst subject and I only took him because I needed a math class but Im so happy I did! I got Ds in high school math but got an A in his class. Pay attention and youll pass. Made me enjoy learning math
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures--Clear grading criteria--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Ledis is a good person and given the choices at TCU, he's probably the one you want to take. This class is not easy by any means but it's literally not impossible to make an A. Don't expect EC but if you show effort and go to office hours, you will pass the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Ledis is a great professor. I had him for my 8 AM MWF and he always made the class enjoyable for an 8 AM. easiest math class I've ever taken. Have background in Calc Honors from high school so this wasn't too bad as a freshman. 9 quizzes and 3 tests on the three units and if you pay attention in lecture, take good notes, and study the night before, you'll get an A easy.

reviews.comment: good professor. don't worry if you bomb the quizzes. they are only 15 % of your grade and the tests is made directly off of the quizzes! so just study your mistakes and you will be okay! I did get a tutor for this class along side to help. better to do earlier than later.

Dr. Ledis is an EXCELLENT professor! You must pay attention in class. He usually only does basic problems in class so the homework requires effort and self-teaching at times but the quiz and test questions come straight from the homework so DO IT. It's not an easy A, but you will learn a lot.

reviews.comment: Great teacher. definitely would take him again. he tries to make the class as fun as possible, but you have to keep in mind is Calculus lol

reviews.comment: Calc 1 : Not a math/engineering major, and was really dreading taking this class for my major as a senior. reviews.comment: I will say that this class was not of interest to me because Im not a math lover, but technically it wouldn't be hard if you appreciate math. Homework is optional, but offers extra examples and he may put some on a test. He does reserve time to work out problems you may have struggled with. Perfect class to satisfy essential competencies.

Dr. Ledis is an incredible teacher! He really makes the material understandable. I got a C in calculus in high school, but in his class I have an A. Never once was I confused what was going on. There's usually a weekly quiz but it comes from in-class examples or homework. Homework is pretty short, and there's not too many tests. take him!

Nice teacher and is really good at explaining.  You need to go to class in order to do well on quizzes and tests.  Homework is optional but quizzes come from homework and test problems come from quizzes.  He is very helpful during office hours. Take his class!!!!

He is an awful teacher and does not explain well. He only gives basic examples in class and than the homework and test questions are always the exceptions. If you ask a question in class that he doesn't know the answer to it never gets answered or he tells you its to hard and don't worry about it. But than you will see something like it later.

Best Math prof! Was always there to help, adjusts office hours to see you, never postponed or delayed helping a student. Responds to emails 247! Helped me work problems not in the book. Lenient test grader! You won't want to miss class, his examples ARE THE TEST.

The best math professor I have had. I did not pass stats with a different professor at TCU and took Ledis my second time in the class! SOO much more helpful and tests are a hundred times easier! super nice guy! take him!!
Such a great professor really helps if you need it, he's slow which is great, uses tons of examples I got an A and am considering taking him this semester for stats.
Mr. Ledis is extremely helpful. I was a little worried taking my first college math class, but he made it easy. Do the homework and take notes and you'll get an A.
Prof. Ledis was awesome! I was  about nervous to take math as it is my worst subject but he made it solo easy! I loved his class and he is a great prof. TAKE HIM

Chill professor and there are only like 3 assignments the entire semester. His study guides have the exact questions that will show up on the quizzes! Allows up to 3 unexcused absences which is helpful since the class is only offered at 8am. Slept though it a few times but was an easy A regardless

Super nice and flexible professor. I came to class late a lot and he never made it a big deal. He posts study guides, and if you go over them, the quizzes are easy to ace. There are 2 journal reviews, which are also pretty simple. We also had guest lectures often, which made the class more fun. Overall, an easy class with a kind professor.

TAKE HIM!! He was the best professor I had by far. as long as you pay somewhat attention in class and study a little bit, you will get an A. Not to mention he is the nicest person ever and really cares about what he does and his students
He was such a great person and cares a lot about his profession and is very knowledgeable. He does not grade hard at all and every class we pretty much got out early

Absolutely great. There was not too much work, and the exams were easy as long as you followed the study guide he provided. He gave fascinating lectures and would also bring in guest speakers. I really enjoyed his class; I wish I didn't have it at 8 a.m., though.

Survey of communication disorder was based on lectures. Study guides are copy and paste from the information he would use in lecture. If you study well and memorize information, you'll do great. Few assignment but very interesting topics with guest speakers.

She is one of the best teachers I have had! She is so sweet and very clear on instructions and what she wants from you. There are 4 big projects and some short essays but she is a light grader and so helpful if you have any questions, and gives you plenty of time to get everything done. Would 100% recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Ms. Dickson is a very caring teacher willing to help students outside of class. There are three big projects, along with a few more short essays. However, they are graded lightly. I strongly recommend taking here class. She is awesome.

Love this teacher! There are three big writing projects and a few smaller papers. I found them all pretty easy and she is an easy grader. I never worried and usually turned in my first draft. Definitely some writing outside of class but she also gives time in class. One of my favorite teachers, the nicest person, and really cares.

Nataly is an outstanding professor for Writing for Inquiry - my very first class at TCU! She has really helped improve my writing from being super structured to much more flowy and relaxed. The assignments all have an element of personalization, and she is extremely accessible should you ever get stuck... wish I could take her again in the Spring!

Pretty chill teacher. Had a bit of extra credit but not much. She was a very easy teacher to get along with. Didn't learn much so if you want to actually learn, might have to choose a different professor but good for credit. Would take again, she was great.

Her classes are incredibly easy. It is nearly impossible to get anything below an A assuming you go to the classes. If you are actually trying to learn something, you should take another prof. The class is taught like high school and most assignments are decorative at best. No lessons ever go past surface level and some lectures are irrelevant.

I LOVE DR DIAS!!! She is actually the best teacher ever and has been so helpful this whole semester. She has online lockdown browser tests that are take home but are quite challenging. You'll do good if you stay on top of all the homework, go to class, and pay attention/ take notes.

This is my second class with Dr. Dias and she is amazing! I love the way she teaches and connects with her students and does a great job at providing lots of resources for all of the class projects and assignments. She is really great and I highly recommend taking her class because you will get a lot out of it not just a class credit.

Dr. Dias was a phenomenal professor. She gets to know students if they care to get to know her, and has funny anecdotes. There were options for extra credit, but she is strict on late work and phones in class. Attendance is not mandatory and tests were straightforward. If you are a decent college student, it's an easy and interesting course!

I took Diaz for Cog dev. She offered tons of extra credit and exams were open book. Her lectures were normally interesting. We had multiple writing assignments two of which were annotated bibliographies, which were the hardest part of of the course. She isn't the easiest grader when it comes to writing, but she is caring and willing to help.

I love taking psychology with Professor Dias! She is super nice and makes class fun! We do lots of small group discussion and she lectures, but they are interesting. Her only homework is weekly chapter reflections which are easy to complete. Her tests are online without a lockdown browser! Take professor Dias, you'll love her class!

Do the work, go to class, and you'll be ok. I'd rather take a class that doesn't have a ton of time-consuming assignments. If she sees your phone, you have to write a 5 page single space paper. She takes at least a month to grade work. I wouldn't take her class again, but if you don't mind doing a LOT of assignments then take it.

I love Dr Gibson so much. She makes the lectures really interesting and easy to follow along the whole class period time. She is so fun, caring and well respected by all her students. All the tests are multiple choice and not difficult, if you pay attention and study a little bit, you'll do well. A LOT of extra credit opportunities.

Dr. Dias is a great professor who is super caring for her students. I took her Intro to Psych class and it was very easy. Most of the exam questions and answers were given to us on the D2L extra credit quizzes. There are also many extra credit opportunities. We only had one paper throughout the semester which was graded easily. Great class!

Her Intro to Psych class is insanely easy and fun, and she was great at explaining everything with her presentations and lectures. All the exam answers could be found on the class website, and there were TONS of extra credit opportunities. Even though it was a lecture hall of 100+ kids, she still made it feel like you were important.

Dr.Dias is a fantastic professor. She does excellent lectures that follow the textbook, so you can get by without reading it. The textbook is free and is online. The tests are kind of difficult and sometimes ask questions about the small details. Her final is extra credit. For every chapter there is an extra credit quiz. She is great!

Dr. Dias is the best! She is so caring and genuinely loves all her students. There are chapter reflections every Sunday, which can be a lot to some, but I actually liked them. They helped me understand the material. All tests are online and you get 3 tries to take it. There are also extra credit quizzes for every chapter. Take Dr. Dias

Such a great class to take. The tests are all online and extra credit quizzes are available for every unit. You have unit reflections due every week but they aren't hard if you read the textbook. The class itself is very chill. You are split into groups sometimes, and other times you sit and listen. Overall she is a great teacher and I recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Dias is amazing! Tests online, has simple assignments, and makes her classes so interesting. I want to continue to take her courses here. She is an amazing educator and person and wants everyone to succeed. In class assignments go towards grades but forsure take her courses!!!

Dietrich is very caring and wants to get to know her students. However, she gives very timely assignments that just feel like busy work. Participation matters. She keeps track who participates and you must participate at least three times each class period. You must ready a story/book before each class which is annoying.

OMG she is an amazing person! Full disclosure I did not intend to take this class to begin with but I am so happy that I did! She truly cares about her students and even has conferences with her students. There is a ton of reading and writing and be prepared to participate in discussions, but what else can you expect from a literature class

Dr. Dietrich's class is such a fun course to take; she is the nicest professor too! She grades super easy on the projects throughout the semester which count for the bulk of your grade (& oftentimes you can work with a partner of your choice). Come to class having read the material and ready to discuss it/participate during class to be successful.

Literally easiest class I've ever taken at TCU. Professor Dietrich is the most kind, nurturing woman EVER and really cares about the wellbeing of her students. Short, easy readings, no homework only 3 projects during the semester (one is the final) and they're so quick and easy.

MGMT 5710 UNT: Provided no lectures videos from herself. You read & teach yourself or watch other TED talks & other professor's videos. You will have a discussion post every week that will takes thought & time, but it does help you understand the material. Large CSR video project required, get started on it early. Just overall an "eh" class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Loved her and loved her class, but it was hard and was a lot of work

Dr. Dietz is pretty cool. She enjoys getting to know her students. Test can be challenging if you do not read the text book. Talk to her after classes. She does take a grade for participation so attendance is necessary.

Loved Dr. Dietz! She was so helpful, and was always available and willing to help after/outside of class. The wording on exams could be confusing at times, but overall weren't too bad. She is definitely passionate about Social Work, and it makes the class a lot of fun. Was my favorite course of the semester.

Dr. Dietz is a nice lady but I really didn't enjoy the format of this class. There were SO many guest speakers I would say she probably taught class about 25% of the time. An A in this class is a 93 which is somewhat hard to achieve if you aren't making consistent A's on the tests. Her multiple choice questions are poorly worded. Study the book

Treats tests like its the SAT so basically like cheating children which is annoying in college. Attendance is checked everyday. TONS OF TESTS, lots of guest speakers which are on the test. Very nice lady but for a 1000 level class its a lot of work.

Dr. Dietz is so precious! She's super nice and helpful. She seems interested in students that seem to care, so making an extra effort to get to know her will help you. She likes feedback on the difficulty of tests and alters them if needed. Attendance is mandatory, but she's definitely worth taking.

Awesome professor, she expects professionalism all the time.she will not tolerate missing class or lateness. Very helpful and kind.i love her bc she doesn't tolerate foolishness. If u want an A go to class on time and study the material.

Make sure you go to class because the guest speaker information will be on the test. It is very easy and if you contribute to discussions you will be recognized when it comes to asking for help. I did poorly mainly because I did not attend class as much.

This teacher enjoys the subject. She sometimes made mistakes on the test but fixed errors. Class is mandatory and helpful as there are many guest speakers and their presentations are on tests. If you show interest and participate in class discussions you will be memorable in her eyes.
I got an A-. I studied more than everyone else in the class. Everybody cheats. If you aren't good at cheating or too scared to you will be at a HUGE disadvantage compared to everything else.
It's extremely frustrating to study and study and study and come to class, and everyone just cheats on everything and does better than me. If you are good at cheating you will get an A.
Don't do it. Trust me.

This professor does not teach, he clearly knows what he is talking about but has no idea how to relay that to his students. One of my biggest regrets in life is convincing myself that he would not be as bad as his ratings said
Worst professor of all time

DO NOT TAKE HIM WHATEVER YOU DO. seriously I did not understand a thing when I was in his class and the only way to get a decent grade is if you study the entire textbook. questions on the test are impossible and he doesnt teach anything. He is the worst teacher you will ever have. so many complaints to the dean about him and the dean did nothing.
Don't take him.

The living, breathing, teaching example of why tenure should not exist. The worst teacher to learn finance from. He cannot form a coherent lesson or even explain how to properly study for exams. What he says to pay attention to in class is no where to be seen on the test. So difficult to learn from/listen to. Take literally anyone else, or get a C-
dude thinks hes him

Some people are soft on here. I think the classes was smooth as butter.

He's pretty chill, but his lecture is extremely boring. Tests are hard and require lots of reading. You basically learn on your own again because his lecture doesn't help much. Online HW is due at the end of the semester.

reviews.comment: Dombrow really is a nice guy but perhaps the most boring lectures of all time. Exams are ridiculously hard and I wish that with all the time he spent lecturing some of it would translate to the test but no.
great guy. easy.
I liked Dombrow, his class structure was very nice. And he was hilarious. EZ class

His RE Valuation course is a complete joke. Talk about a waste of money. We had 1 grade all year which ended up being our final presentation. There was no guidance, no organization, no structure.  Don't get me wrong, the class is very light. But for the amount of money TCU charges, it's embarrassing.

Dombrow is by no means the best professor I have ever taken, but certainly not the worst like people make him out to be. His tests are difficult but have a strong curve. If you attend class and study, you can easily get a B or better.

Good prof. Course is difficult but if you attend his classes its not too difficult. He explains things very well through visuals and detailed explanations. Tests may be difficult but he is generous with rounding.
Don't take Dombrow. The test are so hard and he doesn't even teach on what you are tested on. You basically will be teaching yourself the whole semester.

FOR THE LOVE OF EVERYONE AND ESPECIALLY YOURSELF, DO NOT, AND I REPEAT, DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR! I almost feel bad because I know Professor Dombrow likes what he does, but he just CANNOT TEACH. He reads straight off the slides but does not show you how to work problems out. This is a heavily TEACH YOURSELF OR YOU WILL FAIL class.

DO NOT TAKE HIM. The class has no structure and he makes it impossible to pass the tests. He lectures for the full hour and 30 minutes and it's brutal to sit through. Take literally ANYONE ELSE but him. Genuinely a nice guy but the class is brutally boring.

reviews.comment: Horrible professor. Will put you to sleep each and every day. You will not learn a thing. Don't waste your time or money

reviews.comment: Get ready for the most boring lectures of your life where she sounds so condescending.The material is so bland and exams were actually pretty hard. Get ready to memorize SO much. Exams are in person and lockdown and you actually need to study for them. Lab with Evans was super easy and fun. It's a fine natural science but it's not an easy A.

Great class - impossible tests. Make them way harder than they need to be and screws everyone over. Sucks because the material is so interesting but she decides to kill your GPA with insanely niche test questions that aren't discussed in the lecture. No plus or minuses for your final grade either. Worked so hard to get bashed by an impossible final

This professor is absolutely terrible. Please do not take this class. There are much easier sciences. I took this class because I thought it would be fun but it most definitely is not. The professor is quite literally impossible to communicate with, and super rude in emails. She literally is one of those people that just likes to hear herself talk.
Don't take this class if you think it's a real easy core credit. Being so real this is a pass no credit class

Really Nice Lady, but do not take this unless you are looking to go into nutrition. 90% of the class is there just to get the credit and learn something, but she makes it unreasonably hard for an Intro Course. The exams are ridiculous, and you end up spending way too much time studying for information that is irrelevant.

if you are not in nutrition major DO NOT TAKE. overwhelming info you study for this class as much as you would for other classes. There are easier natural science classes i WISH i would have taken. Professor is nice but that doesn't matter for your grade. 
Exams are in person lockdown browser

I took this class as a business major to fulfill my natural science credit, however she made the class very interesting and enjoyable. Pay attention to lectures, use her study guides, ask questions and you'll be just fine! She is a genuine and caring professor, loved her!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This intro to nutrition class really bummed me out. I took this class over the summer for core credit and it was ridiculous. You need to study for hours to do well and there was a test every Friday. It should not have been this difficult, even when I studied, I did bad. She is non-negotiable and not very helpful with feedback.

I love Professor Dority! She made contemporary issues in nutrition my favorite class. You are graded mostly on 2 exams and a final but if you have basic study skills and can memorize things you will get an A. The lab is so much fun it is basically a cooking class.

She is so incredibly sweet. I loved taking this class for my NSC because it wasn't too much science and it was interesting to learn. The labs are so fun. You just cook!! The lecture tests take a bit of studying but they are not impossible. I highly recommend!!

Professor Dority is amazing! It's clear that she's passionate about her lectures and is knowledgeable. She gives time in class to answer questions so don't be afraid to ask. She gives extra credit opportunities that are very easy to complete. The class mostly relies on 2 tests and a final, so be sure to study, but they are straight from the notes!

Very knowledgable and is very clear in lectures with content that should be prioritized in studying. If you show up and pay attention very easy class. Graded by exams throughout the semester as well as weekly quizzes.

It is obvious that Professor Dority is passionate about what she does, and her lectures were so interesting. The class itself had no homework, instead optional weekly quizzes for extra credit and 2 large exams which count for the bulk of your grade. The tests are not difficult though as long as you study and memorize the material.

For a NSC class, a little harder but very interesting. All the test info is on the slides, and the tests are not hard if you fill out the review. Interesting lecturer and I would definitely recommend!

Professor Dority is amazing! Your grade relies, essentially, on 2 exams and the final, but she gives a study guide and extra credit opportunities. The exams are not easy, but if you study what is in the study guide you will do well. Her lectures were engaging and the labs were super chill. If you can take this class I recommend it!
She is amazing and I absolutely loved her lectures. Would definitely recommend taking her classes. She provided an extra credit opportunity that can help boost your grade a lot.

Attendance is not mandatory. You really dont need to buy the text book or read. All info is in powerpoints. The tests are in person and online. Lockdown browser and multiple choice. There are some trick questions which was frustrating. Can volunteer at a food bank for 30 extra credit points. 3 quizzes (open note) and 3 exams. no HW
Take this class! So interesting and the lab is so much fun as you just cook! There's an extra credit opportunity and every single test has a study guide. Super easy A

Professor Dority was a great professor. Show up to class and you will do fine. She offers extra credit and her lectures are very clear, concise, and informational. Take her for Nutrition!! Great and easy class for TCU Core Science Requirement.

Dority is a great professor. Contemporary issues is a very surface level class and the information is pretty straightforward. She always gives time to answer questions and lectures never felt rushed; she wasn't going over more information than she could during class. No homework and there are easy extra credit quizzes, but tests are the main grades

I am not a nutrition major, but really enjoyed this class.  Professor Dority makes the class accessible to all majors, even for me who is not into science.  The tests are challenging, but all multiple choice, and as long as you study hard you will do great.  There are also easy chances each week for extra credit, with points going onto the exams.

Mrs. Dority is a great professor who gives insight on almost everything nutrition! I took this for NSC, and don't regret it one bit. Make sure to study your slides consistently and take notes of what she says. Go to the labs, finish weekly quizzes, study / practice flashcards and you will do well. Very applicable class for all majors!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Dority is amazing! Her PowerPoints are very informative and the lectures are interesting. Study guides are long to fill out but help for the tests. There is a big extra credit assignment and labs are just cooking food for 30 mins. Make sure you study for the tests for a while as one bad test will ruin your grade. No outside homework too!

This class is not bad at all. Easy NSC credit plus the labs all you do is cook food. Graded by 2 tests and a final which are pretty easy if you study. I made high A's on all of them and studied for about 5 hours the day before the test. Class is optional and there are no homework assignments.

She says buy the textbook, but all the information is in the lectures, so you don't need to. She gives really great explanations and I really loved learning in this class. If you choose not to read the textbook, you have NO OTHER HOMEWORK. Highly recommend.

Prof. Dority is very caring and good at teaching. Exams are in class/closed book, but if you study you'll be fine. She also gives multible extra credit opportunities. Her lectures were very informative and her power points were helpful. I thought her lecture pace was easy to keep up with and enjoyed them. She is also accessible outside of class.

Dority is a great teacher and her lectures aid in understanding beyond the info on the ppts. Lots of opportunities for extra credit. Test reviews are very similar to tests. I am not a science person but I like to cook and learn about food so this class interested me. COPY PPTS BEFOREHAND, makes it so much easier to actually listen to the lecture

She is really nice and passionate about nutrition. I struggled a bit with exams but that's because I am not a fan of science and not that great at it. She does give opportunities for extra credit throughtout the semester, so overall you should be fine.

Professor Dority is an okay professor. She goes really fast in lecture and sometimes doesn't fully explain things to the extend she expects you to know. Tests are hard - if you don't study hard there's no way you get above a C. Nice lady but teaches too fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Dority was such an amazing and clear Professor in terms of what she expected. Attendance is not mandatory but if you do not go to class, you will be confused on the exams as she explains concepts super well. This was definitely not a walk in the park but your lab is 25% of your grade and an easy 100% as you basically just cook foods.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Such a sweet woman, really cares for her students. Gives you bonus points for showing up to class and answering her iClicker questions. Tests can be hard so take notes, otherwise the class is super interesting and she is funny and relaxed.
Loved this class! It was super interesting and relevant to anyone regardless of your major. If you study her study guides the test will be a breeze. AND she gives extra credit for being in class.

Best NSC at TCU. She is a great professor and the class is super interesting even if you aren't a nutrition major. Very easy to get 100% in the lab (all you do is cook with one volunteer shift at the food bank) and the tests are all right out of the lecture notes. Highly recommend.

No homework. The class is lecture heavy, but she makes it very interesting and is so knowledgeable. Go to the lectures and you will easily get a B. Final is cumulative, but the other 4 tests are very easy. The best NSC class you can take at TCU. The lab is all about cooking.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The BEST natural science class you can take!! Professor Dority is fun to listen to because she is so engaged and knowledgeable. I learned A LOT of worthwhile information and it was not overly difficult. If you go to class and work through the test study guides, you will succeed! Highly recommended!

Mrs. Dority was the sweetest professor! She was very conversational and easily approachable. Class had 4 tests including the cumulative final. Lab included was very easy and made some interesting dishes.

The class is very informational and interesting. Don't be afraid to ask questions, she loves answering them and is very knowledgeable about nutrition. great professor and I love her class. Also, there are clickers for review questions. you get points for participating not getting it right and she gives you points back on your tests.

No hw besides studying for tests. Daily iclicker questions in class gives you bonus points on tests if you answer them. This class is very interesting and Mrs. Dority does an awesome job teaching it and is very helpful if you don't understand something. The tests are easy if you review the powerpoints. By far my favorite class of Freshman year!

Contemporary Issues Nutrition: The science part of nutrition with lectures and technical jargon are difficult if  not  an NTDT major, makes exams that much harder. The nutritional lab parts are easy depending on your personal kitchen proficiency. Exams 70% Labs 30%. Group projects are assigned for presentations/kitchen.  She will help you if asked!

I was expecting an easy A, and this was not the case. The class is interesting and not terribly difficult, but requires a fair amount of studying outside of class. There is basically no homework or reading, but that means that the tests are basically your only grade.

Her class is not too hard as long as you make sure to study the notes. You can get up to 1pt on an exam of EC for attending class and answering the ?'s right. Make sure to do really well on the exams before the final because the final is very challenging and I did fairly well on it because I studied alot for it.

Gives extra credit--an extra point to your test for every day you show up. The lectures are straight forward and the test reviews are basically the test so just study those. The labs are super easy, but there is one group project at the end so chose your group wisely or it'll be a lot of work at the last minute.

LOVE HER. Such a cute and nice teacher. Extremely clear on what you need to know for tests with study guides. Study just a touch and you'll be successful. Offers extra credit for showing up to class. Lab portion isn't bad either, a lot of cookingeasy computer work.

I'm terrible when it comes to anything science so I came in thinking about PNC this class. But Dority is a great teacher. Her lectures can be boring but she posts them on ecollege so coming to class is optional (cuz she doesn't know who you are). But you should go to class to get 1 point EC on your test each day (clicker questions). Test are good

She is a wonderful, very approachable person! Her test are straight forward from the material. She is not out to get you. She is just passionate about the subject and wants you to learn as much as you can. Love her! Highly recommend!

Don't take this if you're just looking for an easy science credit. However, she made the class interesting and has a lot of personal experience to share and stories to tell. She won't make you learn anything that she deosn't think is relevant, but you might have to do some serious studying for her tests.

She is wonderful. She has a stressful role as an educator of a class that is group based because while it is hard on her to see us suffer when group mates don't do what they are supposed to, she helps us to learn through the hardships and adjusts the grades as she feels acceptable. (which are very justifiable).

Dr. Dority's intro to nutrition class is really hard. Be ready to work. You will need to buy the book for your weekly lab. I would not suggest this class if you are not interested in nutrition. She treats everyone as if you are in middle school which is never fun. Multiple choice tests are a plus, but still really tricky. Not the best class at TCU.

Took her contemporary issues class, super easy! Class is very interesting and relevant to everyday life. It is hard not to understand the material and all her power points are online so you don't even have to go to every class though I would suggest it. Shouldn't be hard to get an A!

She is a really nice teacher! If you need any help you can just go to her during office hours and she does whatever she can to help you! Class is actually really interesting but you dont have to go and lab is really easy too! Definitely recommend this class as an easy science!!!

Her intro to nutrition class is fun to learn about however it is hard and you have to learn a lot of information. She does have a extra credit assignment that counts as a test grade but the final is cumulative and there is a lot of information to remember. She talks really fast and covers the material fast too. Overall good class but somewhat hard.

Love her! She is so nice & helpful. There is a lot of material on tests but it's not too difficult. She uses powerpoint notes. Lab is easy & fun. Great class to take to get science core! Can be hard to get into this class if its not your major or minor.

Professor Dority is one of the nicest teachers I have had while being at TCU! It's hard to get into this nutrition class-but if you get permission/the code then for sure take it! It's an easy class because there is no outside reading, no attendance, and the labs are EASY. However, there is a lot of material on her tests, but study then you're fine
She is very likeable and teaches her subject well. But I don't agree that this is an EASY science class. There is a ton of material you have to know to do well on the tests. Textbook rarely needed.
Easy class.. tests are somewhat tricky. Must study for all tests. No attendance taken. easy science class.

I loved this class! She is such a great teacher! I would definitely recommend it to other people. You do not have to come to class, but I did. She will post all the power point notes on ecollege for you but in class sometimes she will tell you specifically if you need to know things for tests or not. She does give you study guides for the tests and

She posts the lecture notes online and if you read the notes and do the test reviews you'll do fine. For the Contemporary Issues class, she has a lot of random stories that pertain and makes it really interesting.

I learned a lot in this class, but he grades our essay questions and project so subjectively. He talks for an hour and a half straight, so if you can't pay attention and take good notes you will not succeed. You have to show up to class to get the notes. Lectures can get super boring and not engaging. I did well on exams and still got an A-.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Such a nice guy but a tough professor. Lectures are very long and kinda boring if you don't already have a little understanding of foreign policy. It is very important that you do the readings and if you have questions he is very good at explaining things during office hours. As long as you study and do the readings you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Nice man, awful prof. Boring, the class is entirely him lecturing and he goes on tangents that make the class fall behind schedule and he'll assume you can make up what he didn't cover outside of class. Tests are MC ?s and an essay portion; the essay's grading was so subjective & vague. Only reason I'm glad I took was its triple dipping CORE reqs

I would never take this prof again. We finished our final exam and didn't have 3/5 of the grades graded for the course. We had no idea what our grades were going to be. Grading is heavily bias and you get punished for sharing too much and not knowing everything about it. Exams are 100% hand written and grade is terrible. Nice guy, bad prof
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nice enough guy but lackluster professor. Midterm was returned a month and a half late (past the p/nc deadline) curved significantly and people still failed (20s and 30s/100). Lectures are boring and poorly organized which hurts your grade. Lower division classes of his might be ok, but avoid any upper division if you care about your grades.

This class is very lecture heavy. Typically this would be fine, but little class participation is encouraged. There are only 4 exam grades, and 1 group presentation. Tests can get very specific, and essay grading is sometimes harsh. If you're looking to take the class just for a GA credit, I would not recommend. I pass/no credited this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you need to take International Politics (POSC 20303), take Currier or especially Carter, not him. A boring, lecture-heavy class where your only grades are 3 exams and a group project. He's incredibly smart, but doesn't know how to convey all of his knowledge to his students. If you don't have a background on 20th century events, you'll struggle.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Your only grades in this class will be 3 exams and one oral exam nothing else. He grades ridiculously hard on the essay portion of the exam. He is always at least 5 minutes late and will ramble during lecture. The whole class is just him talking with slides, but he doesn't follow the slides at all DO NOT TAKE if you can't pay attention

Prepare to have the most boring class of your life. Lectures are hard to follow and he goes on tangents about random things. Class is extremely boring and he doesn't show a lot of respect for your time, coming nearly 20 minutes late sometimes. VERY LIBERAL leaning. Only 3 hard exams and one presentation.

The only grades in this class are two exams, one final exam, and one oral presentation. He is so boring and very hard to sit through his classes and follow what he is saying. He consistently rambles and does not have a straight line of thought. He shows up late all the time and does not feel bad about it. I pass/no credited the class.
You need to put in the work but he is an amazing professor

Love Dorraj and have taken him twice. Is lecture heavy and traditional in his teaching, but is inspirational and clearly a master of what he teaches. Know study guides for test, ask some questions in class, and go to office hours for clarification, and there's no reason you shouldn't do well in this class. Will be taking Dorraj again!

He is clearly a genius in his field, and I've never met a more qualified person to teach a class. You will have to take tons of notes and listen to him ramble a lot, but you can learn so much. He's a very sweet guy and is obviously very knowledgeable and passionate about the curriculum he teaches.

Probably the smartest person i've ever met. Very interesting class if you like the subject matter. Class can get a little boring at times since its all lecture. If you like this stuff take the class you'll learn a ton and find it cool, if not don't take it you will struggle.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very very kind, but too difficult. Only graded on 4 things (exams & group project). Hard to understand his thick accent during lectures (not his fault). A LOT of reading. Exams are extremely hard. I dropped the class it was so difficult.

Dr. Dorraj knows a ton about the material he is teaching, so his lectures tend to be long and fast. Prepare to take lots of notes as his tests are very specific to lectures and reading. He has very few assignments (3 tests and a project) so each assignment is worth a lot of your grade. He takes attendance at the start of every class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Dorraj is a super nice person and the smartest professor i have had. dude is extremally intelligent and you can learn a lot. all of the test material is covered in the lectures and you do not need to read unless you want clarification. he can get boring if you dont like the lecture material so drink some coffee if you have him in the morning.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Dorraj was excellent in this class. His lectures were thoroughly interesting and the material on the test was mainly covered in lectures. If you attend class regularly you will succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Love him as a person. Took 2 of his classes; they are painfully unengaging. His lectures are unorganized and difficult to understand. There are literally 5 grades for the entire semester. He does not grade essays fairly. Got mad at us when most of the class failed a test. Did not have a single grade entered in the grade book until grades were due.

Dr. Dorraj is a great professor who cares a great deal about his students. However, if you are not a political science major, do not take his class (Unless you do P/NC). You have to, you must take notes in class because his power points do not have enough information for the exams. Exams are pretty tough, you have to be very specific.

Professor Dorraj is extremely knowledgeable, passionate, and experienced in his field of study. His class is extremely lecture heavy and be prepared to take A LOT of notes. DO NOT RELY ON THE POWERPOINT SLIDES. There are no assignments in his class, only exams and a group project. Also, you dont know your grade until the end of the semester.

I took him for Developing Nations. The class is interesting. The class is lecture-heavy! There are 2 exams, a paper, and a presentation. He is a hard grader. He DOES NOT put in grades. I left for break only knowing what my first exam was. Never put in grades and only submitted final grades to the registrar's office. I honestly do not recommend.

Dr. Dorraj is a knowledgeable professor, and I enjoyed his perspective. However, this class is lecture heavy, and because he is so specific on every topic and his lectures are unorganized, it is often difficult to narrow down what you need to study for the tests. He also strays from his syllabus often. If you take this class, make sure you read!

Dr. Dorraj is hands down the smartest person I've ever met - which means he expects a lot from his students. Lectures are very interesting but you need to read the textbooks to fill in the gaps. Tests are hard but there are only three of them. Overall, a hard but interesting class with a great, caring professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Very intelligent professor specializes in middle eastern politics. His class is VERY lecture heavy and he does not encourage student participation in class. The tests are difficult but you can get a good grade if you study enough. I would not recommend his class unless you are very interested in politics and are willing to put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: nice guy and very smart. I definitely learned a lot from him. beware you probably wont know your grade in the class until the day grades are due (3/5 assignments were not graded until the day of which was really frustrating). Exams were pretty tough in that I felt I never had time to finish (all short responses/essays).
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Dorraj is very knowledgeable and his lectures are extremely informative and interesting. He does only grade on a few things, however, and it's really important to take notes in class and write down everything you know on the tests. But he is an excellent professor I would take again even though his guidelines and grading can be vague.

Dorraj is a very knowledgeable professor and will answer any question you might have, however I think the online classes took a toll on his lectures. Be prepared to take notes and read to textbook to succeed in the class.

The lectures are extremely unorganized and he is not specific on any requirements for tests or the research paper. He has a good heart and really cares about his students, but he does not know how to show it in class. The only perk is he gives exam reviews that will help a lot on the test... once you locate the proper material.

Great class - I learned a ton. Be prepared to work really hard though - it's not easy. The papers are really tough but make sure you start early. Don't ignore the readings because they are important for the essay tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Dorraj is the best specialist on the Middle East at TCU. I learned A LOT from this class. He cares about you. Get ready to make notes, write down everything he says - it will help you on the test. Start on 15pg research paper early and ask him if you are doing it right. Tip: criticize Trump, Saudi Arabia, Israel, Pompeo - he doesn't like them))
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Dorraj is really great but he's sometimes hard to understand. His class is LECTURE HEAVY and if you don't know how to take notes, you won't pass. His tests aren't hard, multiple choice, true/false and an essay. He's really helpful in office hours. His lectures can be pretty boring if you aren't interested in the stuff he's talking about.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: DO NOT take this class if you do not know how to take notes. He does give a lot of reading assignments, but honestly your test will consist of two questions form the book. Everything else including the essay portion will come form lectures. His paper is easy just be detailed he doesnt grade for grammar or format. You will be graded on details.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The most boring lecturer Ive ever had the displeasure of taking. Very nice and caring man, but not a professor in the slightest. You will feel like you are understanding everything while taking the class (albeit boring as all get out) but on the tests essays you will not pass. If you dont put every single thing he wants, you will not pass.

My biggest issue I have with this mass is that he assigns book reviews and research papers that are completely unnecessary. He doesn't give a reason why he wants you writing 20 pages of which he'll probably only skim 2. He spaces out his exams randomly. It's easy to disengage. If you're looking for structure and active learning, do not take.

Dr. Dorraj is very intelligent.  The class isnt difficult as long as you put effort into the projects, BUT, he has no problem injecting his personal political views into all of his lectures, which I found very inappropriate. If youre conservative minded, be prepared to bite your tongue because his facts are weak at best in many cases.

The class grade is based off of three energy briefs, a timeline, a 25 page research paper and a written 20-25 page final exam. He's a slow grader and there's not a chance in hell he reads the last two assignments. Your grade is either the four previous grades or if he knows and likes you gives higher grades to people he likes over those who earn it

Dr. Dorraj is an awesome professor & is incredibly intelligent! Attendance is not mandatory. However, if you want to do well you should go to class. There are only 3 tests (pretty easy if you study) and 1 book review. He requires a lot of reading, but it is up to you if you really want to do it. Manageable A if you give a decent amount of effort.

Dr. Dorraj aka the sandal man at first seems like a pain in the rear professor, but is actually one of the nicest professors I know. He does have his downsides not tech savvy and lectures can be a bit boring, but he is one of the smartest professors if you are looking to learn a lot take him. Get to know him he will help you go far. Manageable A.

No joke just like everyone else states this man is one of the smartest people I've ever met. Very nice and understanding, but at times can be unclear about specifics in his assignments. Get to know him and it will help you out a lot. 3 Energy briefs easy. 20 plus page paper easy but time-consuming. Final 15 page easy but during finals week.

Dr. Dorraj is the most adorable and most intelligent man on this Earth. It is true he talks fast and lectures may get confusing, but he is more than happy to clarify anything. Type every word he says, it made all the difference for me. He is absolutely on your side and cares so much, and WANTS you to succeed. He is your best resource! TAKE HIM

Dr. Dorraj is one of the smartest professors you will ever meet. With that being said, his classes are tough, especially upper level classes. Midterm and final are the only tests and require hours upon hours of studying. Usually a research paper and a presentation, which both require a lot of work as well. Definitely hard, but you will learn a ton.
Thick accent, hard to understand. Very hard, boring class. Int. Politics is my major and he still made it completely uninteresting. I suggest taking someone else.

very hard and time consuming class, but if you are interested in the subject you will enjoy it! Dorraj is a genius, a good lecturer and is very approachable! just lots of studying and a very tough A. but come to class and take careful notes and you'll be fine

Dorraj is an awesome professor. He is extremely approachable and personable. PAY ATTENTION TO LECTURE! If you pay attention, take good notes, and study really hard for the tests, you should do well. Read the book and write a halfway decent research essay and it'll be an easy grade boost. Just work hard and you'll do well.

Very Hard Class. Dont get me wrong, Dorajj is a Genius!  However he is also very hard to follow and often goes on tangents. His tests are also fairly hard as well as he expects you to know every little detail. While I learned alot, It is not worth taking if you are taking 15 hours due to his ridiculous research papers and tests.

His developing nations class is hard. No other way around it. You have to take really good notes. Recording lectures helps the most. Tests are all essay, make sure you study at least a week ahead of time. There is a final 20 page research paper. But if you go to him for help, he's more than willing. He's just a really really smart guy.

He is the wide knowledge prefoessor, gives a lot of good example in class. willing to help student. He changes the structure of his test to help student get higher grade. However, it is not an easy class to take if you an non major in Political science.

Dr. Dorraj is a very nice man. He really wants his students to succeed. Sometimes it is hard to follow him and it can be very confusing. The book is very hard to understand but you have to refrence it on your tests and they are all essay. He does help you to understand the material. You will have to work hard for your grade but he is a great prof.
One of my favorite polisci professors! Brilliant and interesting!

I had his international politics class and it was pretty good. His tests aren't that hard if you know that material he lectures on. The format of his class is good because he has an outline for everything.

Yes, its a hard class. Yes, you will have to work your toosh off. Yes, he talks as fast as an auctioneer and yes you will need the quickest hands in the west, but he is extremely helpful and is always available to talk. You can skim the book, but study the notes well well well. You learn soooo much though and its helpful for majors/minors.

I adore D. Dorraj. He's brilliant and truly cares about his students. Classes are SUPER hard, tests are SUPER hard... but go and talk to him during office hours, study the study guide, and you'll be fine. And I think he is a hottie fo sho.

Ive taken 3 classes w/ Dorraj and I love the format of his class. Study your lecture notes which are easy to follow and reading isnt really necessary(i never did) Tests are straightforward but you must get some solid studying/prep for them. Papers are straightforward and hes not a stickler for grammar/structure. Visit w/ him in office hrs.

I'm a PoliSci minor, and the class is a lot of work (25pg research paper, 7pg book report, essay tests) but it really isn't difficult if you know how to take notes. Don't copy straight from the board as he's writing; instead, pick out what he emphasizes. Tests are very straightforward. Not nearly as difficult as many people are saying.

Do not take this class if you have a life outside of school! He seems to think his class is the only one you ever take with the amount of work he gives you. His lectures are almost incomprehensible because he has no organization. He keeps going back and forth between different topics and you're always getting confused.

He is a VERY smart man, knows a LOT of information, which is sometimes the problem. Tests are too long for the time given, and he grades hard, will take off a huge amount of points if you miss ONE detail. He probably thinks this is the only class you are taking at the time with all the writing projects he gives and the difficulty of the tests.

This was my favorite class, but i am a polisci major. He is incredibly smart and extremely helpful. It is worth your time to talk to him after class and let him know your name. Take detailed notes over his lectures and learn them for the test and you will be set. Once you become accustomed to his accent it i way to understand him.

expect a LOT of reading.. his lectures are hard to follow and you spend the whole time writing as fast as you can.. he gives a review... but very broad... i attended every class.. always studied.. and barely made a B.. I WOULDNT take this class again!

relentless on lectures, helps girls in the class more than guys, requires a lot of reading, liberal and will press his ideas on you, will not bump you up if you dont suck up! = knowledgeable professor, but WERE NOT ALL POLI SCI MAJORS!!!!!!!

Dr. Dorraj knows a great deal on his subject, but his lectures are often quite disjointed and hard to follow. He is quite liberal politically. One of my peeves with him is that he does not allow us to keep our blue books after the tests, so that it is hard to learn from previous mistakes in his class.

Expect to do a LOT of reading in this class. However, Dorraj is very nice and very willing to help if you ask for it, he also is very knowledgeable and open to different opinions, although he doesn't shy from expressing his own. If you want to debate with him, you better make sure you know your stuff though!

Very intellegent and has a very organized way of lecturing but is a very hard teacher. I'm an all A student and I studied my butt off for this class and made a high B...I'm pretty sure he only have one or two (low) As in the entire class. I learned A LOT but be ready to work. If you are a hard worker and value learning, this is a great class to tak

Dorraj has to be be one of my favorite professors at TCU. He is inspirational and incites interest in the subject even among non-majors. Hes a great teacher to get to know, cool guy and profesional at the same time. Lectures are not very structured, but youll find that with most POSC profs, but read and study hard...nothing can kep you from an A/B.
Great Professor. He is wonderful and loves teaching. you will learn a lot and want to do further research.very understanding of students difficulties. Highly recommend for majors and non-majors.
