You can never go wrong with a Dorraj class. There's a plethora of material to be covered, but his test review sheet covers whatever you need to know. Just follow his logic and argumentative structure in your papers. Hopefully you’ll have some greeks in your class, because they will make you look like a political science god.
An amazing speaker but talks over the heads of most non-political science majors. Though you may get a bad grade, you'll still leave with a lot of information.

nice guy, very smart.  his tests however are a bit ridiculous in that no one finished in our class and he didnt seem to care.  we were not ever given enough time to complete them.  highly reccomeded but come prepared to read a lot, work a lot, and learn a lot.  HARD, but worth it.

I studied my behind off for the first exam and did amazingly well. READ the chapters, it WILL come up. And take notes on ALL lectures, even ones that don't seem that important. Chances are it'll be on an exam.

Learned more abt Islam than politics in Mid East. Islam info was great; preferred much more on the latter. Professor was unorganized; tended to topic-hop and drone on. Nice guy, just can't focus. Class room presentations (done most of semester) were a waste. I'd rather learn from the professor. Seemed a way for class participation, but didnt work.

If you take a Dorraj class you WILL be challenged and need to rise up to the occasion. Very smart man who cares about his students. Material is hard no matter your level of interest. Good class for grad school preparation. Don't worry we all fail the first exam.
No Comments

Very good prof.  Opinionated but always listens to other views.  Usually has fact to back up his opinion and tries to get others to do the same.  Encourages class participation.  Very demanding with reading materials.  Very demanding with written projects.  Come prepared to work.

A great professor! Dorraj is a very knowleadgeable man, who wants his students to do well. Have to work hard and be consistent with his lectures for an A. He gives his students an opportunity to prve themselves. Highly recommend him.

I wish I would have tried harder on the first exam, if I had I would have made an A instead of a B+ for the semester. I recommend you READ everything he assigns. Very helpful in and out of class, after talking to him I did better in all my work. Everything is interesting, he does have a liberal bias

Nice guy outside of class, but condescending if you disagree with his views.  Lectures full of info, but sometimes boring.  Main text book is horribly boring and liberally biased.  Tests are mostly easy, but some questions are a bit vague...don't expect an easy A.

Dr. Dorraj is an interesting character and professor.  Honestly, there are times I want to kill myself in the middle of his lectures, but generally the course material is very interesting.  The tests are easy and his reading material is good, but the main textbook sucks.  Overall, his class is an A.

Was an extremely interesting professor. I would love to take him again. Has incredible knowledge in his field.Not an easy class, but you learn a lot! If you like posc take him! Very easy to talk to and you really get to know your classmates. Probably my favorite prof. at TCU.
Great teacher, great guy. Speaks very concisely and slows down so the class can take notes on important points. Tests are hard but gives a study guide. Recommend getting in a study group.

This was a difficult class, but my favorite. He is so helpful and will answer any questions you have. It is best to study in groups because he lectures so fast that you may have left something out. He is the reason I switched my major. But read...a lot.
Very intresting class. Made me change to a poli sci major. Study for his tests and ask previous students what the essay question will be.

He is a very nice man and he knows his stuff, yet the class is still very difficult. Some lectures are hard to follow since he moves quickly. He is willing to repeat himself, you need only ask. Dont recomend if you dont have to take it b/c of its difficul

Once you get past the insanely thick accent (we never did decide exactly what kind of accent it was), he is enjoyable.  Hard class, study thoroughly, but is definitely worth the experience - the first grade below an A I was actually proud of.

really knows his stuff, really really smart.  he's also one of the NICEST profs I've ever had - get to know him if you take him.  his teaching style is helpful, and you get to know your classmates.  study everything for tests!!

Difficult tests but passable if you study.  He can be confusing at times and may jump around a bit.  But he knows what he is talking about and it is obvious.  He is also helpful with any questions and discussions.
He does know his stuff, but grades hard.  I worked hard and still got a C.  Not a good elective option, but good if you really like PoliSci.

Not very helpful at all. Repeats a lot of stuff, and contradicts what you may have learned in many other classes. Also, doesn't seem to know much about some things, and is really hard to understand sometimes.
The man is ruining my life.
incredible teacher, its like having a CNN journalist for your teacher
Knows his stuff, will actually learn a lot
Dorraj is an awesome professor
Blah, Blah, Blah. Not an enjoyable experience.

The lecture were all over the place and it was hard to follow. Really nice professor but the grading criteria it's harsh especially on the essay. The final is open book but the questions are vague and you don't have time to finish

Overall good professor and even better person. Final Exam and most of the exams are unnecessarily hard. He does curve some of the exams, and could improve by just talking about how the work is done, instead in some classes he goes on history rants and doesn't explain math at all. It's either his way or the highway.
I do not recommend this class if you are actually interested in good grades and learning calculus.

Nice guy but he has his flaws. From time to time, during his lectures, he'll go on tangents about the history of math. He tells his TA to grade the homework strictly but doesn't specify what he wants on it. On exams, if you show work and get the right answer, but if you don't do it the way he wants it he will take off points anyway. Very tedious.

He's a nice person, but I would not recommend him as a professor. His lectures are really boring and doesn't really explain the problems how he wants them to look on the tests. I'm glad that I took calculus in high school, but if I didn't have prior knowledge, I would be struggling even more.

He's definitely one of the best calculus teacher there is in TCU. Very hilarious and conscientious when it comes to teaching and explaining ideas, tho I reckon his attention to detail might cost you some points when grading the test; That was what happened to my HW tho on all my test I got 100.
Had him for a mini lecture at tongji university in China, one of the best professors I've met. If you want to learn something, he is a great choice

Calculus 2 is generally not the most interesting course, but Dr. Dou did a good job. There is homework most nights, but you get two class periods to turn it in. The tests are challenging, but there he gives a lot of partial credit.

a really nice guy, but as a professor I did not enjoy him. I took calculus in high school so I did good in the class, but I felt bad for those who hadn't because he was not good at teaching. His lectures included barely any example problems and he would spend the first 40 min of class teaching the same thing he did the day before. really boring
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: One of the most dedicated professors I have ever learned. Exams are not hard, just basic knowledge. He always tries to make a comfortable learning atmosphere.

As an online teacher, he's not great. Lectures have been incredibly boring - I've been using the book and homework to teach myself. The tests were open-notes, but I didn't have enough time to finish. I feel like I understand the concepts well, but it doesn't translate to the exams.

Dr. Dou is one of the most genuine people I have ever met. I took him for an honors class, so I'm not sure how tough his math classes are. I definitely recommend taking him. He made every single class interesting, and he put more effort into crafting our lectures than any professor I have ever had.

Hard to understand what material you really need to know and what you don't. He does not let you know at all what to expect for tests and will throw random questions on the test that he did not even cover in class. Didn't even grade the final in my class and just assigned everyone a random grade.

He is really patient with all students. He doesn't gives aways extra credit, but he curves the exam grades by a lot. my first exam was a 10 points curve, then 8 points for the second time. there were no curve for the last exam, but he let us fix the mistakes and gives half credit back which turned my grade from 71 to 86. Not hard to get at least B.

I also agree that the the scathing review below is unjustified and extreme. As someone mentioned, the class material is difficult, but newsflash: college classes are supposed to challenge you. Dr. Dou is beyond generous with grades to accommodate the difficult material, is kind, approachable & personally offers his help to every single student.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: The absolute worst. Homework's aren't that hard. Gives absolutely no review and no information about the tests, so be prepared to go into the test having no idea what to expect. Jumps around in lecture, hard to know what is and isn't important. Prompts for the essays are kind of confusing. On the plus side, he wants you do to well and tries to help
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Dou is very dull. He tries to be funny, so that's amusing, but the class drags on like torture. He's very interested in the material though and cares about your understanding. His grading criteria is very vague for papers, and he doesn't tell you whatwhen you should be reading until it's too late. "Required" books we didn't use. Final is HARD!

Took him for my Abstract Algebra class. Really entertaining, good lecturer. His accent is heavy but easy to understand. He does go fast but has no problem slowing down if you ask. Tests were straightforward, though he doesn't give a review sheet. Homeworks were very reasonable
Homework everyday, lots of quizzes, good english but sometime doesn't make sense. On exams, even if you get the right answer he takes off for not showing EVERY step.

First, his English is easy to understand.  After lectures, read the section that was lectured. It will be easier to apply what he lectures after you read. He is very helpful after class and during his office hours. He is also very understanding of personal situations if you talk to him. He expects you to show that you understand your work on exams.
Great teacher. Very clear with assignments and examples. Must do the homework. Tests are easy if you have kept up with your work. Took some time but not that difficult.
I have taken calculus before so it was really easy for me. But you have to go to class if you want an A cause he moves quickly. If you study with people and review everything its easy,

Took him for Applied Calc - not a bad teacher at all. Takes a little while to get used to him at first, he's kind of a funny guy, but all in all he's very understanding and accommodating for every student. Tests are OK if you study, and he only collects homework at the end of the week. Very easy A if you see him outside of class.

Like said before, this guy expects you to know everything before you even sign up for the class.  His office hours are horrible, and tests are nowhere close to what he tells you to study.  Not to mention he is hard to understand and just flies through everything.

DO NOT take calculus from Dou unless you plan on attending EVERY single class, you've already learned the material, and you enjoy sitting through the most confusing and boring hour and twenty minutes of your life. Twice a week. I got a D in the class, but I got an A+ in precal the previous semester and i've taken calculus in high school.take RITTBY

his class is horrible. he always makes you stay the whole time and right up to end. you will be late to your next class alot. his class is boring all you do is take notes. his office hours are impossible to get to and is not willing to meet with you on your time. his does not give you study guides and his tests are impossible to say the least.NO NO

all the very good review are for PRECAL. For calculus, his class is a lot harder. The homework is very basic and simple, but the tests are a lot harder and the problems more complex. Try to get copies of old tests from people and practice/study

If you are not a math genius then do not take this class.  His tests are absolutely ridiculous and even my friends who took AP calculus in high school (and made A's) are making C's or failing.  He has horrible office hours so getting help is close to impossible.  I don't know why people give him good reviews, this class was a horrible mistake.

Very good teacher. Happy to answer questions &  loves class participation. Tests are exactly like study guide, except with some numeric changes. Do the homework and complete the study guide and you will do great in this class.

He's a great teacher. He really makes math interesting and understandable which was something I had never  experienced prior to taking his class. Homework and class attendence are imperative but as long as you do the work and study, you'll be able to get an A.
Best math teacher I've ever had! Was always happy to awnser questions even really easy ones. I acctually understand calculus! Seriously.
very clear, concise and extremely helpful. Highly recommend. Great professor.
He is very clear, and teaches you at a slow pace making it impossible to fail

He's a good math teacher and thankfully doesn't want to see you crash and burn.  If you are somewhat bright or already know Calculus this class will be a breeze.  If you have a dim lightbulb upstairs you're going to be a little lost.  He's definitely worth taking again for those math majors out ther
Very boring and hard to understand, but a nice guy. Grades homework.
He really seems to love helping people.  His class is kinda hard, but he really wants you to know it.  If you pay attention in class and ask for help when you need it, you'll get an A or a B.
Really great professor!!  He's helpful and truly cares whether his students understand the material or not.  This is a difficult class but he makes it fun and interesting!!
Dedicated.  Funny lectures (sometimes).  He loves to teach, and you can tell.
A very nice, very helpful teacher.  He seems to love his job, and he's very good at it.

I don't know why her rating is so low. For roles, she was really sweet and taught the material really well. The class overall is not hard at all. Just show up and do the in class assignments and you should be set for this course. Don't feel scared to take her, I promise if you just do your work and follow the rubric you will pass.

Dr. Dodd gets a bad wrap. This class was sooo easy and relatively enjoyable as well. She is an easy grader on all assignments, if you do it, you'll probs get 100. The only tough thing is the quizzes, but take notes and look at the blueprints, and you'll be fine. Don't listen to her bad reviews, I had a great experience with her.

class is super easy but don't take advantage of it. 2 group presentations throughout the year, every class period there's an assignment. 5 quizzes that are hard and you get a front and back cheat sheet but have trick questions. easy A if you put effort in. some days it seems like a lot but it's also nice when you're stressed about other classes

There is an in-class activity every day that is due by the end of class but they are graded for completion. Group projects are the majority of your grade, follow the rubric!!! Ask her questions if you are lost, she is not mean just blunt. She allows a sheet of paper for notes on the quizzes and if you take good notes you will pass the quizzes.

Going into this course I was terrified of the reviews. Dr. Dodd was super sweet and tried her best to be helpful giving feedback on projects/ assignments. Yes the quizzes are difficult but that is not a reflection of Dr. Dodd it is just the class. Quizzes are such a small percent of your grade they dont matter much. Show her you care she also will

Terrible Professor. I took her for Professional Nursing as a sophomore and she is a horrible represtative of TCU nursing for new students. Refuses to work with students, very rude and makes rude comments throughout class. She does not care for the students.

youd think after the reviews this professor would change. NOPE. I was nervous in the beginning but shes still rude, and theres no tests but I feel like she grades subjectively. Her criteria is not clear and takes points off without an explanation on the amount.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Such a disappointing course. I read the reviews on her before taking this class, but still thought if I worked hard and put in effort that it would all pay off. I still did well, but this class should be an easy A and she makes it so difficult. Follow the rubrics to the LAST DETAIL. She is rude and harsh and there is no room for small errors.

This course has changed since all previous semester. We had 5 quizzes that were 15 questions each. They were not easy but definitely easier than long exams. A bunch of group activities and projects, but plenty of time in class to work on them. Hardly any homework and if any its easy.

Dr.Dodd lacks empathy and consideration for students. Her tests do not correlate to her lectures, because she lacks being clear and concise in both. The class average for the final was 76.9% which should tell you all you need to know. For someone reaching professionalism, the hypocrisy is strong. Just know that it is not you- godspeed.

Well... this class was not hard. She made it difficult. lots of group work. she reads off the slides. She has the tone of a professor who couldn't care less about what she is teaching. Be warned, her exams do not correlate with her presentations and reading assignments.

Teaching analytics would already prove this professor lacks profiency in reaching learning outcomes for students. She fails to be clear and concise, reads off ppts, and tests coincide with lecture. Everyone FAILS. For someone teaching professionalism and how to be an example in Nursing, she is the exact opposite. How is she still at TCU?

I pray to never have to take a class with this professor. Her grading is very subjective and it truly depends on if she likes you as a student. She isn't understanding with emergency situations and expects you to email her about "late work" before the emergency happens? Her exams are tough and do not correlate to the PowerPoints she has you study.

The exam threw me for a loop. The lectures themselves were fine but the exams didn't correlate well with the presentations, ESPECIALLY the first one. As a person herself, she was super nice and funny. There was not too much interaction - as she only read directly from the PowerPoint. LOTS and LOTS of group work, which can be a downfall sometimes.

Truly one of the hardest classes I am in. The hardest tests I have ever taken, and the lectures are nothing like the tests. Not worth your time to study. She is rude, and won't answer questions. Really dread going to the class. Funny how I get A's on patho, and not this class.

Dr. Dodd is my favorite clinical instructor I've had. She makes Adult 2 very interesting and wants you to understand. She goes out of her way to connect concepts from class into clinical that week. She is very encouraging, approachable, and very intelligent.
A truly terrifying prof

Dr Dodd seems to show no genuine care for her students. She grades very subjectively. She is extremely defensive and just plain rude to students. Classes are simply her reading from a piece of paper and are so boring. Her tests are way too hard for the material/class. STEER CLEAR AT ALL COSTS.

Dr. Dodd is a wonderful professor, but this course is not something to blow off. The content alone is not difficult, the exams are the tricky part. These exams are lecture heavy, so take detailed notes and don't rely on the powerpoints. Dr. Dodd wants you to succeed in this course, but you need to reach out to her if you are struggling in the class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Its just very ironic to me how I made better grades on my PATHO exams than this class. This class has very easy material to understand and learn but when you get to the tests, she makes it ridiculously hard and contradicts herself on the powerpoints. I am so glad I never have to take this class again.

This class's material has potential to be interesting, but unfortunately it's a class I dreaded attending. Studying for the exams feels useless because even when you know the power points word for word, you still won't perform how you want. Dodd's test are very subjective and are 100% based off of her opinion and what she believes is right.

I will warn anyone that has this class that this professor unfortunately does not adequately prepare students for any exam. Lecture heavy, knowing the PPTs word for word will NOT help you. The tests are are very subjective. This could be SUCH an interesting class, but is deeply frustrating and makes you feel inadequate. Should be an A or A- class.

Overall I really enjoyed the information in the class. However, the tests are very opinion based and the right answers are subjective so it is based on what she thinks is the most accurate. She also takes points off people's presentations if their dress is too short or "revealing" so if you are a girl dress like a nun for presentations.

I had Dodd for Roles and I hope I don't have her again. I could tell she didn't like me, and I didn't know why, but I was graded much harsher on projects and papers than my peers, and this really bothered me. It was to the point where other people noticed. Her tests are also very hard, so take notes over every word said during her lecture.

Reads from PPs, tricky exams. The most condescending and rude professor I have had to date, which is amusing since she teaches Roles for The Professional Nurse. If you get her, good luck. Youll need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She reads straight from her PowerPoints. Her tests are so vague, full of trick questions, and some of the things she puts on them we never went over. I had an A- in the class up until the final. I studied about 3-5 hours a week for this class and thought I was prepared for every exam, but my test average was 78. if you can't trade her, GOOD LUCK!!!

I had Professor Dodd for Roles I, and while her lectures are pretty boring, as long as you go to class and study for the tests you'll do well. Her tests are easier than the other Roles professor, her lectures are just not as exciting. She does let you record lectures though, which is helpful to do because the tests are very lecture based.

Dodd is not my favorite professor, but I think she at least tries to make lectures interesting and engaging. Group projects are easy A's and her tests are poorly worded but definitely doable. Quizzes are all free-response and come mostly from in-class activities, tests are all powerpoints.
Avoid taking Dodd at all costs. The material presented is extremely vague and asks questions about specific scenarios for vague concepts.

Professor Dodd is easily the worst teacher I've had at this institution. She talks down to her students and treats them as if they are children. Ger grading criteria is NOT clear on any projects and she is the toughest grader. She took 10 points off of a project because my group "looked up at the board too often". Her tests were worded horribly too

Dodd is the worst. I had her for teaching strategies and had to miss class for a medical emergency and she would not work with me at all, took off 20 points of a semester long project because of the one absence and I was in the hospital. If you try to go up to her individually she will be very hostile and not helpful at all
Very hard to impress. Didn't enjoy her at all. Don't take her if you can avoid it!

Ms. Dodd was great.  Initially, I was a little afraid of her, but she ended up being one of the best clinical instructors I have ever had.  She expects you to know your stuff, and is very helpful during clinical.

I only came once during the whole semester he post all the slides on D2L the only times were supposed to show up is during 2 exams and the final but he post the exam early and the answer key and he just reuses the questions so overall I would take him and he adds his own twist to lectures like his personal stories and stuff.

He is a very funny and knowledgable professor but this class is extremely boring. His lectures are all pictures and he goes on so many rambles its impossible what to remember for the tests. He's a sweet guy but there's better science courses to take.

Dr. Donovan is clearly a very knowledgeable man, but this class was very boring. Attendance is not necessary for the lectures as the notes are all online and the tests are multiple choice. The lab was also very boring and tedious.

Professor Donovan is super nice and funny! He makes lots of jokes during his lectures and wants all of his students to succeed. His lectures however were not the most helpful. His slides he uses are a lot of pictures and not much information. I had to learn more in the lab than in the lecture. You can tell he really enjoys what he teaches though.

Went into this class expecting an easy A. If you need a lab credit take Sawey for biology. Attendance isn't mandatory but the tests were pretty brutal not gonna lie. Very attainable A but you gotta grind before the test. Nuff said.

Dr. Donovan really loves geology. His lectures are funny and he tells personal stories. His only grades are 3 exams he has, which he posts practice tests for which are identical to the tests. He also posts his PowerPoints online. Attendance is not mandatory, great class to get your natural science out of the way.

You can tell how passionate he is about geology!! There is only 4 grades for the entire class 25% exams (3) and the other 25% comes from your lab grade. Exams are Extremely easy if you go to class and use his study guide, he's also always willing to help and very nice.

I took this class because I heard it was easy, but the lecture test was very hard. Lab quizzes are easy if you study hard, but the lab tests are a little more difficult. He was very vague on what to study for the lecture test, and there was a lot of information. This class requires a lot of studying, but no other homework.

Donovan is a great guy, super funny. His tests are exactly like practice tests (which he gives you online) and there are tests from other years you can find online. Easy A if you study the practice tests and similar questions related to the practice test.

He gives interesting lectures but they are not designed to make you succeed in exams. He can be very helpful if he likes you. Otherwise, not so much.  I would recommend taking this course if you are really interested in geology. If you are looking for an easy A, I suggest you take someone else.

I think Donovan is a really cool guy, but often lectures are not related to tests. The students that get copies of the old tests get As, and those that don't, don't. You don't ned to go to class, but if you are interested in learning about geology- Donovan is a pretty funny guy, and does know his stuff.
Donovan is the bees knees. Post notes online, dont have to go to class, and he rounded my grade

Donovan is super funny and cool, I just didn't find the subject interesting. Took it pass/fail, and have about a 78% before lab final and class final without trying. Non-cumulative exams are great! Practice tests he gives online usually are directly from test. Fairly easy natural science
Super nice!
easy stuff. dont have to go to class posts notes online

Highly recommended. He was clear, concise, and straight forward. The material covered in class is the same material that will be on the exam, with little actually coming from the book. As long as you attend class, put in a bit of effort in studying, an A is easily obtainable. His tests can be a little tricky with the matching, but he's worth it.

took honors geology from him, the honors section is a debate you do at the end of the semester, its fun. his class was difficult for me but I met with him & he did everything to help me pass, he is EXTREMELY helpful, & he loves the subject & loves incorporating humor into it. GO TO CLASS, especially the review session! its where you learn!

Professor Donovan is worth taking. Knows students and understands that many people in the class have no interest in the subject. He's a good guy. He has a rock fetish - a Scottish accent, and a simple subject to teach. Provides study materials for tests and is willing to help you study more efficiently if you approach him after class.

I took this class for NSC credit, and it ended up being a nightmare.  Even though I made a good effort, the material was too difficult for me.  The first test is also after the Pass/Fail deadline, so I was screwed.  I had to work extremely hard for just a D.  Science simpletons, run away!!!

I went into this class thinking it was going to be easy.  It ended up that you really had to study the practice test and the study guide very indepth.Very interesting and fun teacher.  I recommend this class if you are willing to work.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. There are only two tests, so you MUST make sure you get a good grade!! I failed the first test terribly and he gave out the test AFTER the pass/fail deadline which was not helpful at all! The material is very difficult, and there are other professors for science who are MUCH easier!!!!

He's a very interesting teacher, but the class can be tough and sometimes boring. Easy B, but I fought hard for my A. The lab is also surprisingly difficult. Barely used the book. Make sure to do the study guides. Take the course, but take it pass/fail.
This man is THE SHIZ!!!! I LOVED HIM!!!! Easy science class, great fun professor. He has THE best Scottish accent ever, too.

His class isnt very hard. I managed to get a B in there and the only real studying I did was usually the day before a test. Hint: use the online practice exams, they are VERY useful. I didnt even use my book. Go to class too, its not as boring as you would think. He makes it fun. Great professor, take his Understanding the earth for natural science

I studied my notes and the review lecture and did the practice tests and got a B-. It depends on which version of the test you get. Some have these random questions that you have never learned before. He's a good teacher, somewhat interesting, but a bit full of himself.

Do NOT take this class if you aren't interested in Geology. You can find a much easier. Natural Science credit if that's all you need it for. Not that it's really hard. It is just way more work than what I wanted for in intro level class. Try Sawey's contemporary issues in biology

Dr. Donovan is great so far. He is energetic, fun, and comprehensible in class. Labs are easy and even sort of fun. I will update this once I have taken a test in the class, but I assume they will be fair. Great class for a science credit, take it over Astronomy, definitely. *update* His tests were very difficult for me, and I would not recommend this as a blow-off class.

he's so great!!  take this class if you need a science credit.  he is really helpful if you talk to him and he wants his students to do well.  he's really funny in lecture too, he makes what could be a really boring class fun!

the best class I took all freshman year!  great teacher and explains everything clearly and uses great pictures.  has a whole class for review the day before the tests.  test comes straight from review, he does not try to trick you on the tests.  class is not mandatory but very helpful on tests. great class
I received my degree thanks to Mr. Donovan.  I had a 1.4 GPA going into his class.  He gave me the A that I needed.  If you need an A, take his class!
Take his class. Made learning fun!

I very, very rarely attended class, which is unfortunate, because he was pretty funny.  The tests were of moderate difficulty, but, then again, I never went.  I got a B without going, I'm sure an A is easy if you bother to attend class.
He was great, but no longer teaches as he moved up to be in college administration.
Went to class all the time butI shouldn't have.  As long as you on on the review days you will be fine.
great class. You never have to go. Easy B, work for an A.
Dr. Donovan is great!  He is passionate about the subject matter, friendly, dynamic, and has a GREAT accent.  I'd definitely recommend him to anyone!
GREAT TEACHER!  Wants students to understand and is there to help at any moment.  Fun to be around.

Do not go to class I only went on test days, just get the old tests.  All the questions come off of them.  A couple of hours before the test and you are golden, butting getting an A depends on which Lab TA you have.  They decide how easy the rock test is.
The best schience lab at the school.  Class is very easy as long as you show up.  Its not all that boring either.  He is a great teacher.
This is the best science w/a lab to take! He is the greatest and funniest professor I've had to date.  His tests are fairly easy, but you do need to study! He's cool outside of class too!
This man is hilarious and knows college students a little too well.  Great teacher and actually made rocks fun!
He's off the chain!
As easy as they come.
No Comments

If you have perfect attendance for the unit she's teaching at that time, you get few bonus exam points for that unit exam. The content starts off easy but know how to apply it on exams. Exams are straightforward but don't make small errors. The content builds on itself so don't fall behind on it. She is great in lectures and office hours.

Literally the goat of math professors at TCU. She finds a way to explain really complex topics in a really easy-to-understand way. She's super forgiving; if you miss an assignment, she will usually let you make it up for a small percentage taken off. Probably the best prof I've ever had.

This class is difficult, but she makes it manageable as long as your put in the work. You can redo every homework and there are weekly quizzes, so the work piles up. However, the homework and quizzes are excellent resources for the exams. I felt very prepared for the exams as they were reasonable and reflected coursework. Excellent at clarifying.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: one of the nicest professors i have ever had. her lectures are very clear and straightforward. quizzes and exams are also straightforward (problems are similar to the ones in the notes). very helpful and caring in office hours. just a really great professor. highly recommend taking her.
One of the nicest professors at TCU math department.

TAKE DR TOMLIN. She is so organized and I love the way she does her exams. She sets them up as 6 "check points" so it's easy to remember it all. Not only was her class enjoyable, but she is such a sweet person, I highly recommend her!

This professor is terrible. If you have never taken pre-calc and are bad at math. Avoid. She is a tough grader and does not teach a single thing. She watches her students struggle because everyone is failing. It is a flipped classroom. Anything but Tomlin.

I am enrolled in Math 10033. Tomlin is an AMAZING professor. There are many opportunities to do well in her course, which I am super thankful for. Online homework. Five exams. Performance tasks. Final exam. Understanding checks at the end of each class. The final grade replaces the lowest exam grade. YOU HAVE TO TAKE TOMLIN. A literal blessing!

Dr. Tomlin is a very sweet professor, however, I was not a fan of how the class was set up. It is a flipped classroom, so you have to teach yourself everything outside of class. This was difficult as half the time I had no idea what I was doing when it came to quizzes. She is helpful when asking questions, but you are on your own outside of class.

If you have strong math background youll be fine. If you dont class will be incredibly hard. most of your grade based on quizzes, 100% self taught, tuff grading must be able to perform like a computer. Office hours and class time are very busy so hard to get help. Nice lady but doesnt get that some kids cant do math like others. You must learn fast
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: My entire class is almost failing her class and has had to teach themselves all year. She provides great practice material, multiple quiz retakes, and lots of easy grades, but if you get behind you are screwed. You basically have to teach yourself all of the material outside of class because she only teaches when you ask her a question.
Dr. Tomlin is the best!! Tests were broken up into 7 "checkpoints" so one bad test won't ruin your entire grade. She is so understanding and wants the best for her students.

Awesome professor! I think she is too nice and caring for her and the class' own good, but I'd rather have that as opposed to the inverse. Relatively easy weekly homework. Instead of big exams, she had smaller "checkpoints" with ample review material, it is on you if you don't perform well in the course. I am thankful to have had her!
DEFINITELY THE BEST MATH TEACHER I'VE EVER HAD. She's so caring. She's really really good at explainations. Also so cute and hilarious. I LOVE HER. IF YOU SEE ANY CLASS OF HER, JUST TAKE IT!

Definitely recommend this class! I did struggle in the beginning, but Dr. Tomlin is very helpful outside of class because of office hours. 10 modules with a test on each one. Grading is done on a mastery scale of 1-6. You are able to retake exams. At the end of each class is a daily quiz which is attendance.

Best math teacher I ever had. Very easy to get a good grade in her class. She teaches really well and not hard to understand the content because of the way she teaches. I would definitely take her again. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

She will be the nicest teacher you will have for a math class. Because of her mastery grading, you will never need to drop the class. I brought my grade from a 65-88 in the last week based on her retake policy. She teaches slowly which is good for a calc class and is always willing to help students personally. Best teacher that I will have.

She is the best math teacher I've had -  super understanding and accessible. After every lecture theres a "daily quiz" which is only 1 math problem and that's your attendance - she drops the 3 lowest daily quiz grades. She also lets you retake tests 3x if you got a 4/6 on them and you can argue your grade without retaking if you got a 5. TAKE HER!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Tomlin is the nicest professor I've ever met. She is very organized and straight forward. Teaches very clearly. Daily quizzes are there to help your grade.

Mrs Tomlin is a good professor for such a difficult class. You are able to retake your test However they are graded on a 1-6 scale and pretty difficult. In class it is all about lectures and theres an easy one question quiz at the end of class to show you are in attendance. Overall, Tomlin is a good teacher and is always there when you need help.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class is a difficult class on its own but Dr. Tomlin explains things very slowly and thoroughly. Sometimes she goes a little too slow that it gets confusing but she takes everything at a slow enough pace that if you attend class you will be able to understand what is happening. She is helpful and makes time outside of office hours if you need.

Tomlin is one of the best math professors I've taken a class with. She explains things in a way that's easy to understand, and the online textbook has lots of exercises that help with the material. She always makes sure to clear up any confusion that a student may have and cares about our success in her class. Highly recommend!

Professor Tomlin is great. She makes hard concepts easier to understand. You typically have a month to complete homework assignments. Grading is mastery based, so you can retake assessments to get a grade you are happy with.

Dr. Tomlin is a great prof. She teaches very well and will answer any questions. The lectures did get monotonous to me, and some concepts were very hard to grasp. The final is important so make sure you study.

Dr. Tomlin is AMAZING! She is so caring and she makes such a difficult class actually enjoyable. She does everything she can to make sure her students understand the material and do well. Because of her, I did better in the class than I probably would have with someone else. I recommend her to anyone who has the opportunity to take her!

I had a love/hate relationship with her class. Its set up as 8 modules and one final. You have a module quiz/week and in order to move on you have to give above a 75%. I like the way her class is set up except for the fact that you have to teach yourself ALL of the material. It is easy to get a B in this class, hard but not impossible for an A.

Tomlin is a great teacher for Applied Precalc (10273). I honestly liked the overall structure of her class (review module quizzes one day, take them the next). There are no tests until the final and you have 3 attempts on each module quiz to pass. She is very willing to help students outside of class, and is very good at explaining problems.

This class is 100% self paced and self taught. It was not what I was expecting. I am not a fan of this style of teaching but the class in and of itself is an easy A. Go to class on thursdays for the quiz and u don't have to go Tuesday. If you miss a quiz, she is lenient with makeup. She's super nice and wants all of her students to succeed.

Let me just start off by saying that I LOVE Dr. Tomlin! She is by far one of the best professors I have ever had. I usually don't like math, but the way she taught made me want to add a math major to my degree plan. She really cares that everyone understands the subjects, and will always do what's best for the students. 10/10 would take again :)
I took her PreCalc class and the course set-up was difficult to manage. It was self-paced so there was no lecture and lots of individual work.

I had Dr. Tomlin for Applied Pre-Cal. She had a flipped classroom setup which SUCKS for math! Essentially you read the text, do hwk/reading guides, meet Tuesday to review last quiz you probably failed unless you can teach yourself and take the next quiz on Thursday. I struggled the whole semester and had to attend all of her office hours to survive
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Not a difficult class. Homework isn't bad- there's a lot of problems but most are optional. The content can be hard, but she's pretty good at teaching it. She got behind schedule on the syllabus, so we never covered everything. We also get to take a 5 min break in the middle of class, pretty nice. Do the reviews!

Dr. Tomlin is extremely kind and truly cares for her students. The class I am in now is a reversed learning Pre-Calc course, which makes it a lot more difficult. You have to teach yourself through the textbook, but Dr. Tomlin lets you work at your own pace and will answer any questions you have in class. I definitely recommend taking her!

Best math teacher at TCU. so caring and is so easy to understand. Doesn't move on until everyone clearly understands it. You can tell she really wants the best for her students. The course is very difficult on its own but she makes it more than tolerable.

This class is work at your own pace. If you want to go slow you can, or you could grind through the class and essentially get 4-5 weeks off at the end of the semester. You're allowed 5 attempts on each Module quiz (take them until you get an A+, you'll thank me later). Took this class to prepare me for Calculus, not sure if it really did...
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The class is not a typical lecture style class, everyone goes at their own speed and works in group. It will be a little difficult if you have not taken Pre-Calculus before, but Dr. Tomlin is more than willing to help. Will always answer questions if you write them on the board during class or go in during office hours. Most of grade is 8 tests.

This class is based off modules. If you are not the best at math, like I am, it can be very stressful. You most pass the module with 80% or higher to move on. Therefor, the class goes at different speeds. Professor Tomlin makes herself available for her students for extra help and is very generous with her time.

Thoroughly enjoyed the class. Not very difficult and easy to learn. She lays it out very clearly and its very self-driven so its really all on you. If you need help she is more than happy to help. Very good at explaining concepts. Would highly recommend taking one of her classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The class in and of itself is very tough; however, Professor Tomlin was so helpful and one of the greatest professors I've ever had and I still ask for her help even though she no longer teaches me - would highly recommend for any of her classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I absolutely suck at math. Somehow I squeezed out a B. The homework kinda sucks and sneaks up on u. She gives partial credit and her quizzes and exams are not difficult either. Would definitely take her again A++++

Dr. Tomlin is an amazing professor and is definitely the choice for anyone who is not good at math. She takes the time to work out every single problem on the board so you can ask questions and not get lost. You can print the fill-in-blank notes ahead of time in order to focus on the examples more. Dr. Tomlin really cares for her students. 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: She talks through every single problem on the board in front of the class and is so helpful whenever you have a problem. If you suck at math like me, TAKE IT WITH HER!!!

Dr. Tomlin hands down best math teacher I ever had. You can print the notes ahead of time so you can focus on writing the actual work and pay attention more. Homework took about an hour and was only due Wednesdays and Sundays, plus you have unlimited attempts to get it correct. Its statistics so its difficult at time but she makes it so much easier

Dr. Tomlin was my favorite math professor I have ever had!!!! She is clear and will not hesitate to give you extra help or slow down if you need it. She has very simple notes online that if you follow and learn, you can come close to getting an A on every test she gives!! Take Dr. Tomlin, she is wonderful!!!!!

Dr. Tomlin was great at teaching topics, and her tests and quizzes were not too hard if you studied. I thought I would end the class with a B+, but finished with an A, because of my attendance. If you are taking her course, do not skip classes before holidays because she sometimes gives you a replacement grade for an entire quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Tomlin is one of my favorite math professors ever! She is so intelligent and was always willing to slow down the lecture if the class was confused. She is always accessible - both by email and office hours. Her overall goal is to ensure you know the material and she goes out of her way to ensure this is accomplished.

I am not very good at math to begin with, but she explains everything in great detail and is always willing to meet with you if you need extra explaining. You do have a lot of homework but she bases her tests off the homework so they end up helping you grade wise. Your overall homework grade counts as much as a test (free 100)!

Professor Tomlin is a great teacher! Her lectures are very easy to follow and the tests/quizzes aren't difficult at all if you look at the notes she gives you! She also gives really good study guides. Some online homework but it's not too hard. I'm not good at math, but passed her statistics class with flying colors!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Took Dr. Tomlin for Applied Calc and wasn't too difficult if your good at Calculus. Not an easy A, but if you do your work it's very achievable
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Tomlin is great! She's sweet, fun, and very clear. She creates her own thorough lecture notes that you can print and bring to class. You have online homework assignments, a few quizzes, and tests, but they are all pretty easy. She is more than willing to help you succeed. She created study guides for our class simply because someone asked.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Would take again

reviews.comment: She's wonderful. She always knows whether the class has understood a subject and will come up with vivid activities to further explain and illustrate the topic the next day. She would prepare 40 bags of candies for each student for an activity! Her tests are straight from her exam reviews, which always include answers and detailed explanation!

Professor Tomlin does a very good job of teaching statistics. Her notes are very clear with many examples and activities. She always tried to find ways to keep class fun and engaging. There are normally chances for extra credit on the tests and quizzes which is very helpful. As long as you show up and pay attention the class is not bad.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Lectures are great/engaging & the exam was online/open note but still hard. However, he had unclear directions/expectations when it came to assignments but was extremely harsh on grading. Goes extremely by the syllabus & has no room for grace. Frustrating to work hard & constantly receive grades that didn't reflect that. I wouldn't him take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Reading is a major part of this course. Read and study then you would pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Ledbetter is an amazing teacher and is lectures are SO interesting. Communication theories can be really difficult at times, but he gives lots of opportunities to ask questions and is willing to explain. Definitely read the book before tests and do the practice tests. They are open note, but still fairly difficulty.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Really good teacher! Lot's of reading and his tests are hard, but as long as you show up to class and read the chapters the test is fairly straight forward.

Was pretty difficult but an A is definitely possible if you put in the work. I enjoyed this class because he makes it very interesting! Read the textbook before the exams and you should be good - pretty much all the questions come straight out of the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Ledbetter is one of my favorite professors I've ever had. He is so reasonable with students, grading, and extra credit. His lectures are not boring whatsoever and he relates all topics in class to fun stuff! He truly wants you to succeed in his class. TAKE HIM!!! Quizzes and tests were open note, but still pretty hard.

Personally I'm doing the minimum in this class right now and my grade's alright. As long as you pay attention during lectures and are familiar with the textbook you'll be fine. The tests though are HARD so thank god it's online and he lets us use our notes and textbook. 10/10 would recommend because he keeps you engaged in lectures.

This is one of the most interesting comm classes I've taken. Dr. Ledbetter's passion is clear from day 1. His lectures are engaging and he always included examples about real life and a few nerdy jokes. His tests are hard yes, but not impossible. You can get a good grade. Ledbetter clearly cares about his students, which is awesome.

He was one of the hardest professors I had. His tests were incredibly difficult and I often felt like the tests were made to trick you. Definitely pay attention to detail and do all the reading extra prep quizzes that he mentions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Hardest professor I've ever taken. Wouldn't wish my biggest enemy to take any class with him
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: It's not easy, but if you put the work in and follow grading guidelines an A is doable. Lectures really help to understand the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very textbook heavy; he basically tests right out of the textbook that he co-wrote. Also, one paper was assigned during the mini-mester & while grading, he completely skipped over a section of my paper & gave me a zero on one part of the grading rubric. I argued for my points & he apologized but gave minimal points back. Kind of sucky.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the worse teachers I have had here at TCU. Does not really care about his students when they go to him for help. Only reason he is still there is because he is a 10 year. Many students do not enjoy or like his class because he reads off of the powerpoint and does not actually teach the class. You teach yourself by reading the book he wrote.

IM COMMENT 12/16/14, So I took again for SNS, best class at TCU yet. Must Tweet (Hint: Tweet @least 3x per deadline) 1st test made me cry, so ask for clarification about networks. REVIEW the PREZIs, most exam questions are directly from PREZI. Extra Credit questions too.  "ALMOST NO STUDENTS" hated this class inside joke for Dr. Ledbetter

This was the most practical comm class I have taken. Dr. Ledbetter is passionate about teaching, engaging and he is gifted at linking theory to real life. His tests are difficult but not impossible. If you are a dedicated student, you can make a good grade. Ledbetter cares about individuals and does his best to help them succeed. Take this class!

The tests are super difficult!!! The quizzes are pretty hard too. Even if you study a lot, it is super difficult to do well on the tests. He's a nice teacher but the tests and quizzes are way too difficult, in my opinion.

really sweet and goofy. I was nervous about the class because of the ratings, but ended up loving it. He tells you ahead of time when there will be a quiz, and many of the questions on the quiz come straight from the self help quizzes in the book.

If you are taking this class just to have an upper division credit, I wouldn't recommend it. His tests are super difficult. There's only one book, but read it otherwise you won't do well. There's a group project he did for the first time and if you don't do it all semester your grade will be terrible. This class is hard!

Very structured. Very passionate about Comm. Clear about grading and the book is A MUST!  A majority of the exam is from the book, lecture notes alone will not suffice.  Some tricky questions on tests. Proofread-Proofread-Proofread your paper! Funny lectures, funny rants, kinda goofy. WILL take again!
Tests are very difficult with material that only loosely relates to the subject matter. The class is interesting, though, and Ledbetter is an interesting teacher

Great prof, I enjoyed going to class. However, if you are not a good test taker, DONT TAKE THIS CLASS! There are three tests, six quizes, and a project. Tests are extremely difficult even if you read the book. Quizes are fairly hard. The project is hard and he grades it hard. Overall, wonderful class, but EXTREMELY hard to even make a B.

Well structured and very thoughtful, engaging class. Material is sometimes boring but Dr. Ledbetter does his best to keep it lively. As previously stated, textbook use is essential. Tests can be tricky and tough if you didn't read, but as long as you read and pay attention an A, is possible. Overall, a great class. Made me want to change majors.

Good professor. Will not budge on the rules so don't be late to class. I was 3 minutes late and he would not let me take the quiz for that day. The textbook is very important. I didn't even use my notes from the class. As long as you study the textbook you're golden for the tests and quizzes! Not an easy A, you have to actually work for it.

He's a great professor, interesting to listen to and you learn a lot in class. Take the afirstlook online practice quizzes, make the quizzes a cinch and really help with the tests. Read your textbook, listen in class, and do your best on the partner project and you'll do fine. Definitely not an easy A though, don't take it as a blow off!!

He is a nice guy, although he does get moody. Theory class is dull. Bring something to do. He gives pop quizzes on the readings instead of attendance. If you really study for the tests an A is possible. The book has a good online component. Check quizlet too.

Took Ledbetter for Comm Theory and SNS and Personal Relationships. Loved both of his classes and got A's in them. He's responds to emails quickly and explains the material well. There is a lot of reading for his classes and if you dont read, you'll probably end up doing horribly. So read!

Class is generally very entertaining and the material very interesting.He explains well in class however tests prove to be very difficult, even if you study. My highest of the 3 tests was a 70, but take advantage of the group project and application log and you can still get a B.

Ledbetter was a great professor in my opinion! He is really funny and kind and makes class really interesting with his real-life scenarios and video visuals! I really enjoyed coming to his class and learning about the theories. Pop quizzes and tests can be tricky, so keep up with the reading; however, this class really isn't that bad if you study!

Lectures are based on his powerpoint which is basically a broad overview of each theory/chapter. Attendance is necessary, at least for the 6 pop quizzes that are 20 points each out of a total 600 for the semester. Tests are hard and you need to know anything and everything out of the chapter. Tests are similar to Dr Schrodt's. 1 group presentation
Very hard/demanding.  Somewhat hard to follow lectures - be prepared to do lots of outside reading. This course is what you make it - and can be interesting. But the tests are REALLY hard!
very hard
Terribly nice, but there is absolutely no structure to his course. No textbook either. gives out a study guide the day before an exam, and all we've talked about is the border.

Dr. Drumm is a cool guy, but the tests are so specific and taken directly word for word from his powerpoints that are not posted anywhere and gone through very quickly. He likes to trick you on tests and it very hard to negotiate with in terms of clarity of test questions. There are so many other better professors in this dept., take someone else.

Be prepared to write really fast or type really fast for your notes. He goes through the lecture slides so quickly and he does not post them online AT ALL. He tries to trick you on your exams and is happy to do so. Is also no helpful when you have questions on something. Very very frustrating course!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I loved his intro to American politics class! Dr. Drumm wants you to succeed but you must be willing to put in the time and effort to do well. He did an excellent job covering hot political topics and the views both sides hold. His tests are very straight forward. If you show up to class and copy his powerpoints word for word, you will do well.

The key to this class is to give respect in order to receive it. You may not agree with the professor, but if you are respectful and well-spoken, he is an awesome guy to have a real conversation with. The first day is the scariest day and after that the class is a lot of fun if you love polisci

Dr. Drumm is the man. He is very smart and challenges you when participating in class, which helped me learn a lot. If you put in the work, take good notes, and study you will get A's on his tests. The term paper is really hard, but his point system makes it possible to get an A.

Really nice guy and refreshing to actually have a conservative political science professor. Not an easy class or an easy A however. You really have to study hard for the exams and he grades the final paper (15+ pages) hard. Tries to trick you on the exams. Attendance is not really mandatory, but is necessary to get all of the material.

Dr. Drumm is probably one of the best Profs. at TCU. I looked forward to going to his classes because they were always so interesting. He get the whole class involved on certain issues and he likes to hear both sides of what people think. He is conservative but he always likes to hear what others have to say. Take him if you can, you wont regret it

Dr. Drumm is a pretty cool guy...I usually enjoyed his lectures (though they were a bit scatter-brained), study for tests. The textbooks are only needed a few times to write two (?) summaries I believe. For the huge paper, just make sure your format is EXACTLY what he wants...I think I got a B simply because of that (not even sure if he reads them)

Dr. Drumm is a LEGEND! Most influential professor I have ever had. Make sure you have the right format for the paper and you will do just fine. He is fair and his class is super fun and goes by quickly!
Dr. Drumm gets the whole class involved in lively discussions on current issues.
Great stories and really cares about student achievement

Dr. Drumm is a nice guy and a great professor. His lectures are understandable and class discussions are beneficial. He does not know how to use ecollege, however, which can be frustrating because you never really know what your grade is. The tests aren't too difficult; just get used to True/False. Homework is minimal.

Great guy, loved the class he taught for me. He is a conservative which is rare for professors, but he would always listen to my points of disagreement. I hardly ever agreed with him in class or in my papers and I got an A-.

He's a nice guy outside of class but when you're in class you don't learn very much. He has notes on the board that aren't completely clear. You have to listen to his explanations intently. He calls on people randomly and makes them feel inferior if their answer doesn't align with his personal views. Tests are ok, but not what you would expect.

Great Proffesor! made class very interesting, and i never regretted going. There is a Huge paper at the end but if you format it well you can make a good grade. It is not an easy A but with a good work ethic it can be reached. I would Highly recommend this teacher!

Took Texas and American Government. Very interesting class. 4 exams... drops the lowest. Big research paper at end of class. Very understanding. Fun/interesting teacher! You have to stay updated on current events everyday...first 20 minutes of class are current events.  Great class...made an A but worked for it. I recommend!

Dr. Drumm is one of my favorite professors at TCU. He will challenge your beliefs and make you think about things differently. The class is pretty easy, and it's really fun and interesting. I would definitely recommend it to students of any major.

One of my favorite professors at TCU! I've never been interested in Poli. Sci. and this class made me love it! He encourages class interaction & discussion which makes the class fun. Seriously wish he was my grandpa or something...awesome teacher!!!!

Great Class. Professor Drumm always would encourage discussion on current events. He challenges different views towards issues in politics. Go to class as he lectures. I recommend you would take this course with Drumm.

Great professor! One of my favorites at TCU. His class is challening, but if you go to class and listen you'll be fine. He's very engaging during class discussions and has the best personality so class is fun. Tests are straight forward, but you need to sudy. He's willing to help you and truly cares for his students. Take him! You'll love him.

Great teacher! Don't buy the book, you can borrow someones for the one chapter you have to read all semester. Lots of class discussion. Straight foreword test, but you have to study. Make sure to go to class everyday, because he lectures and is more willing to help if you come every day. He is funny and keeps the class interesting!

Not alot of assignments but you do have to study for his tests. Not an easy A but you will do well if you go to class and take notes and his tests are directly from those notes. He cares alot about his students and I learned alot about current events. If you need to take a polital science, take this class!

Funny guy and very nice. The class isn't that hard if you take notes and go to class EVERY day. There are very few assignments. He allows the class to vote on how long the tests will be and things like that. If you need to take American and Texan Govt, I recommend his class.

This is class is not easy thats for sure. But with a little extra work you will do fine, and its totally worth it. Drumm is a great teacher, and cares about you. The class is so interesting and you learn about current politics which is nice. I would suggest it to others.

Absolutely great professor. The class wasn't exactly easy but Professor Drumm is awesome. The class is a lot of fun and a lot of discussion. I would recommend him to anybody. One of the best professors I've come across at TCU.

I absolutely loved his class. You will become much more aware of what is going on in your world. The debates get you thinking about your views on politics. Test comes directly from the notes. Pay attention and study and you should make a A. He is more than willing to work with you.

Mr. Drumm is a great teacher because he is organized, fair and genuinely interested in students. He is willing to tweak grades in your favor. His class is interesting because it is a lecture but has a lot of discussion and debate. You need to go to class because the tests are from lecture notes.

He is really nice and willing to help. His policy paper that is due at the end of the semester sucks b/c of everything you have to have in it but that's the only negative thing about the class. All his assignments are extra credit. Tests are really easy if you take good notes and go to class. I def. reccomend this class and professor.

Took for freshman writing at SMU and LOVED. You will NEVER stay for a full class and he will always make you laugh. Rarely homework. Grade is based off attendance, papers, and some in class work. He is a relatively easy grader and some of the papers are done with a group.  Easy A -- just show up and put effort into the papers
Great professor!

He is so funny and will never keep you for an entire class, like ever. Extremely light workload. Graded on essays but he makes them easy as he gives us resources and topics in class so that we can get started. Only con is I have no idea what my grade is/has been and this is the last week of school. TAKE HIM.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very easy class with a great professor! Would recommend taking if you're an upperclassman who needs some credits. If you participate and do your work, you get an A. Easiest class I've ever taken at college and best professor.
I am thinking of changing majors to creative writing. Brinnstool had a big impact.

funny, witty, and uses fun examples in class that lead into the essay prompts. the entire class is graded on 5 papers, but he helps you along the way, and you can always ask him for help, so don't let that scare you.

Brininstool is one of my favorite professors ever. The class is very cooperative and you get a ton of feedback on your few assignments to turn them in as a portfolio at the end. I am excited to come to this class, and Brininstool is a cool guy with lots of stories to tell. Everyone should have this guy at least once.
He's a pretty lowkey chill guy if you know what i mean. You should take the course.

Professor Brininstool is the best professor I've had at TCU. His class is awesome and we just talk about random things. He does a great job keeping you inspired to write and mediating discussions. I cannot express enough how much I love his class. I will say that he tells a lot of stories that are too crazy to be true.

Professor Brininstool is my favorite professors at TCU. He is very chill, there is no exams and there is only three papers the entire semester including a group one. There are a couple assignments given in class throughout the semester so going to class is important but not necessarily mandatory. I highly recommend taking Professor Brininstool.

This professor is very good. He knows what he's talking about and gives clear feedback. He makes this class very fun. It has a very light workload. As long as you turn in your work on time then you will get a good grade. This class is not too hard, but you still learn a lot in it.

The most clear professor when it comes to grading criteria- good amount of papers: structure of them is not hard to follow. Good man, makes jokes, gives extra credit for showing up sometimes, clearly loves and is invested in philosophy, wants to work with you (office hours). Interesting material, fair grader. Don't listen to any of these reviews.

He lectures every single class, the whole time, there are no class assignments or group work during it to make sure we are understanding. He writes slight points on the board, but most info comes from his mouth; each class is basically an info dump. It was tough to follow along if you don't do the readings (which there is about 50). overall dont.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: J.P. is my favorite professor I've had yet. As someone who has never taken a philosophy class, he was great at explaining concepts and very entertaining. The class load was light but I learned a ton. There'd be a reading before each class, and 4 2-page response papers. The midterm was a short answer response exam, and we had a 5-page term paper.

Philosophy of Modern Philosophy
Philosophy of Mind
JP is easily the best professor I've ever had! The content of the class may be difficult, but he makes sure everyone understands it. His lectures are super entertaining. He genuinely wants the best for his students and makes sure everyone knows his door is always open for extra help.

JP is extremely knowledgeable, hooks your interest, and is super willing to help you understand if you aren't getting it. His lectures are definitely long, but he tries to keep them entertaining and they are full of good information to take notes on. If you read and listen, you will do well. He cares a lot about the subject and his students.

You'll likely be fine if you have a prior understanding of the subject. Still, otherwise, this is a tough class compared to the other philosophy classes, philosophy's and I found him very condescending and hard to follow. Our exams consisted of FRQs and prompts you had to memorize, and you had to be specific. He did make good jokes here and there.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you show up to this class and take good notes it is so easy to get an A. The readings can be confusing, but he talks about them in class. He is a super easy grader and really likes engagement with the readings in papers. He will even give out extra credit for showing up to class on Fridays.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Andrew made a significant impact on me during my first semester at TCU in 2022 in moral problems. I highly recommend this class only if you are willing put in the work. If you do, you will feel so rewarded at the end. You might be thinking "screw philosophy, I don't need to try hard," but believe me, someone who tried hard: I am thankful I did.

Do not... DO NOT take him under circumstances. He does not teach, and is the most condescending "know it all" person. He does not care about his students, and drains all your energy just being in his presence for 50 minutes. Take Prof. Visser. This guy is a joke, his grading is awful and his exams are impossible to pass unless your a PHIL wizard.

The class is pretty reading-heavy, but you can get away with just skimming the readings because he goes over the readings the next class. The response paper is a single page and graded very easily if you have a basic understanding of what you are talking about. JP is also very helpful outside of class if you have any questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not a fun class. He talks the entire time and there is no open discourse. He writes on a board and just regurgitates stuff. Everyone is lost. He cares about philosophy but does not care about teachers. Low energy and low-quality educator. You're given a sentence prompt for response papers. Term papers are difficult. Test are insnae. Stay AWAY.

I have taken 2 classes with JP and wish I could take more. He knows a lot and most of the time presents the information in insightful and funny ways. If you are in a big class meet with him outside and your grade will drastically improve. Attendance isn't mandatory but sometimes he offers extra credit and all necessary info is in the lectures.

There's a lot of reading but he explains it in the next lecture so you can get away with not reading. The assignments are page long Response Papers, and the difficulty of the prompts varies for each paper. If you take notes and pay attention in class you should be fine, but he also posts lecture notes after class. Attendance option, EC sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very educated prof. Loved taking his course. Definitely challenging. Semester consists of 10-15 1-page response papers. Abstract concepts but if you pay attention in class, do the readings, and watch crash courses you'll be fine. Make sure you put in the work. Two big exams, just study. Two big papers.
This professor is one that I would defiantly stay away from. Don't waste your time taking this dorks class. During class he goes on and on and won't stop talking.

The reviews for this teacher had me worried, but after taking his class this semester, I thoroughly enjoyed having him as my teacher. There is a lot of reading along with weekly reading responses, but he doesn't ask for much in them. Very easy to get a B or higher on those. Expect free extra points if no one has been showing up lately.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I don't know what the other reviews are saying, but JP is easy to reach outside of class and is very ready to answer any questions. It's not the easiest core ever, but as long as you come to class and pay attention it isn't bad at all. Even though attendance isn't technically mandatory, the material is hard to understand without coming to class.

I loved this class, ignore all the negative comments. J.P Andrew was engaging and funny throughout the class. Attendance was not mandatory but you get extra credit if you attend. The class is definitely lecture heavy with weekly response papers due but it was easy to maintain a decent grade as long as you do the work.

The worst class I have ever taken. The worst professor. So hard and none of his grading is consistent. Many of his lectures make no sense and do not correlate with the class at all. He lectures the entire class and is so boring. I tried meeting with him regarding my grade and he does not care at all. His tests are so hard and impossible to pass.

One of my favorite classes. He goes in depth with his lectures and makes it easy to follow along by writing the notes on the board. There is a weekly response paper due, which is a detailed paragraph on the reading. Late work is NOT accepted, but he does offer extra credit. If you study and understand the material, the exam should be fine for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: he is impossible to understand and makes you feel like an idiot when you ask questions. I thought we would be debating/discussing important topics but its all about the facts and technicalities of the philosophers. I have learned nothing.

Always willing to give guidance on papers and such, but will not read your paper and give you direct feedback on what you need to do to improve your paper.

He is a great lecturer, gives mental breaks and makes the information really easily accessible. 

Makes jokes that no one really ever laughs at, but are funny.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This dude is seriously such a bozo. So "Know it all" and "matter of fact". Wanted to take this course to have in depth discussions about the meanings of life with other students. This man just stands up at the front the whole time contradicting himself. Philosophy in general is just a load of BS. avoid those classes, and especially this prof.

Dr. Andrew gets a bad rap, but he is genuinely a great guy and really cares about his students. His class can be hard to focus in as it is lecture-heavy without much of a break, but with some effort, his class really is not that hard to follow. He's always willing to help his students and will go out of his way to help them understand the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: A lot of reading, but you don't really have to do it unless there's a response paper. Being a good writer is important. There's 10 response papers, 2 essay tests, and 2 papers.
