One of the easiest class you will ever get! Assignments are just graded on completion, he does not grade hard in any assignments, just if you turn it in or not. It does require you to read the books, 5 different books throughout the semester. But, they are short and easy. Would recommend y'all to take him!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Literally so easy to get an A. Just do the work and the discussion posts, and you'll get a 100 on everything. This is a professor that makes you hate your other professors. He is a weird guy and talks about anime, but he's nice & the class is so easy, who cares? Lots of essays or projects and discussion posts, but he grades by competition.

AMAZING PROFESSOR! TAKE HIM WITHOUT QUESTION.  Easiest grader of my entire life- as long as I turned it in on time and it met basic requirements, I got a 100. Classes get out after 10-15 min / canceled often. If you can't get a 100/100 in this class, you have to either not care at all, or you're in 3rd grade playing a college student for Halloween.

Professor Eibel is pretty easy and gives no homework. Class is all lecture heavy, with one group presentation that is really simple. 3 tests that make up your grade and are 20-30 MCQ with 3-4 essay qs. Lots of notes, but she gives a good study guide for her exams. If you study decent and know the content you will do great. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took Critical Issues in Crime & Justice (CRJU 20423). Her voice can be hard to listen to and her lectures are dense, but all of the material is clearly laid out for you, and if you engage with it, the exams are completely doable. She does not try to trick you, and she fairly delivers both perspectives of every issue. Super interesting topics.
Class is very content-heavy but she makes it manageable and pretty easy. She provides study guides for the tests and if you just use those you will get an A. She has a great backround for the class.

The professor made the course unnecessarily difficult and would often lie about what she would test us over for no apparent reason. The class isn't hard but it didn't make sense why the tests were so hard. There are 4 exams and 1 paper. The professor is nice overall.

No homework. 4 exams on lockdown browser. I studied the night before or the day of and have an A. Easy class for credit. Professor Eibel is also very nice. She provides study guides that mirror the exams. Take the class
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Eibel is so sweet! She is very passionate about the subject of criminal justice and loves to answer questions about it/her role in the field. Most days are lecture but the lectures are interesting. Gives study guides but the tests are exactly the slides from class. Group discussion project was also really fun. Highly recommend this course!

The best professor! Every class beside exam days are a lecture but she is very engaging and explains everything in a way that makes sense and easy to digest. She loves to answer any questions about criminal justice and is very passionate about her job outside of teaching. Exams are straight forward and aren't trying to trick you. She is the best!

Eibel is the best. She is very good at explaining things. She offered two extra credit opps for us and they were actually really cool. There is one paper that gets introduced at the beginning of the semester and it is in place of your final. There are 4 tests, online, around 50 questions, in person, all multiple choice. really amazing/cool class

Ths is a great class. The classes are all lectures but the tests are online with no lock down browser. Attendence is rquired but I always got other work done during class. She was supper sweet and gives extra credit on her tests worth up to 6 points! The final is a paper but it is really easy and relevant to the class. Take this class and teacher.
Such a kind professor! Would definitely recommend taking her class.
Nothing more needs to be said. Professor Eibel is a great professor and has a very easy class. Take her for criminal justice.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof. Eibel is so sweet and very smart! She does lecture a lot but she really knows what she is talking about. There is a lot of material covered, but assignments and tests are totally doable and don't feel overwhelming. I took this class for a free elective and am so glad I did because it was a super interesting and manageable class!
She prepares her students so well and only has 3 tests. She gives amazing lectures that are actually interesting to listen to and brings in fun guests. She is also very fashionable.

This was such a great core class and it was fascinating too. Professor Eibel is super fashionable, kind, encouraging, and really cares about the well being of her students. She is flexible and gives very few assignments. Our grades were based off of 4 tests and a weekly reflection discussion post--you don't even have to reply to others.

Emily Eibel is a great professor! She is new to teaching I'm pretty sure but she is very respected by her students. She takes attendance every class so make sure to go. Lectures are pretty interesting. Exams are taken directly from the power point. Usually easy, 50 multiple choice. She's very passionate about her work. Would definitely recommend!

Professor Eibel is a great professor. She is very clear on what is going on during lectures and the lectures are very engaging. The only complain I have is that the exams are pretty tough. You really got to study hard to get a decent grade on them. Overall, though, she is a great person and I would take another one of her classes again.

She is super sweet and cares about her career. The class is lecture heavy but I think it is interesting. She lectures in a way that is not boring. She is super reasonable and will almost always let you out early. TAKE HER.

Attendance is mandatory, but the lecture material is what you will be tested on. Tests are online and she offers a lot of different extra credit opportunity. Usually get out of class early and super nice teacher!

I am compelled to write this in response to Dr. Ekas' complaint about a “group of students” using AI in her summer class. If you don't understand how AI works by now I'm genuinely concerned if you're qualified to teach in higher ed. Plugging a textbook into AI to help study is not cheating. Maybe be more aware of the changes within your lifespan(;

Professor Ekas is very passionate, hilarious, & caring. Graded on open-book chapter quizzes & 6 exams. If you are happy with the 6 exam grades the final is optional. She gives very useful study guides for exams & many extra credit opportunities. If you don't mind putting in a little extra work to study, take her! I learned a lot from this class!

Super fun class. Has a lot of personal advice for you. It is extremely test heavy. If you dont enjoy studying you will fall behind. However if you perform well on all the tests you can skip the final. She gives lots of extra credit opportunities.

Dr. Ekas is one of the best professors I have had in my time at TCU! In this class, she provided detailed feedback on every paper assignment, gave out detailed study guides, and was extremely easy to access and contact outside of class. She gives incredible lectures and genuinely wants to see students succeed. Everyone should take a class with her!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: SUMMER CLASS - We had quizzes everyday so you HAVE to go to lecture (isn't like this in regular semester). Having said this, if you have any underlying knowledge, common sense, and you study for the slightest bit, it is a very easy class. She gives extra credit and is very helpful. She wants you to do well.

Be prepared to study for her tests. Lots and lots of tests, but optional final if youre happy with your grade. Some tests are over 5 chapters. Depending on how short your class is, you may not get through all of the material, but you need to know it. I got burned out in the class because it was a lot of information and a lot of tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I LOVED THIS WOMAN! At first, I thought the lectures were boring but I warmed up to them and her personality. She has experiences with every country discussed seems like which makes the lectures interesting. The only assignments are 7 Homework assignments, the midterm, the paper, project, and final. She is VERY helpful and you can def. get an A!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Developmental Psych. 6 tests. Final is not cumulative. She goes over some major points in lectures, but all book material is also required. Sometimes asks super specific questions on tests, but they aren't too hard if you actually study. One 5 page paper, pretty easy. Offers SONA extra credit and a few others. Super interesting material!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Ekas explains everything to a T! She relates the topics to everyday life so it is easy to comprehend. She has a test every 2 chapters, so theres a test every other week. Make sure to read the book because she asks questions that are not mentioned in lecture but correspond to the chapter. This class and prof was awesome! Not too hard to get an A

Dr. Ekas is my favorite professor! She's funny and interesting despite it being a lecture-heavy class. I took Dev psych in the summer so this class was much easier than normal. We had daily quizzes instead of tests and the virtual child papers are so easy (it's basically a journal). She gives feedback on assignments so you know what you did wrong.

She is not always clear in what she expects from your papers and you will get points marked off for it, which seems unfair to me. There is lots of reading; long (20pg) articles & discussion questions due about each week. Take home midtermfinal & 2 papers, but not specific in what she wants (expect to get points off) and extremely hard grader!
Great professor, so quirky and fun. She makes the class very relatable. Definiitely not an easy A but it is worth the work you put into it
She's pretty easy ! Bunch of extra credit ! Go to the review session and do the SONA extra credit, it will definitely help your grade ! And her final is optional !

I had her for Developmental this semester and she was fantastic. She is so corky and has such passion for this subject. 2 take home tests, article summaries and a research paper is all you have to do for the class; all not very difficult. She grades her papers harder than tests. TAKE HER CLASS!!!

TAKE. DR. EKAS!!! She's absolutely amazing and was the reason I switched my major to psychology. Always go to the review sessions (if you can) and go to class because the clicker points are vital to getting a good grade. She's hilarious and not boring at all. LOVED her class, wish I could have her again.
Great class! Dr. Ekas was super helpful and made the class a lot of fun. Do the SONA extra credit because it makes a HUGE difference in your final grade.
She was a great! Her class was easy and she offers so much extra credit! Do all the extra SONA hours because it will greatly help your grade and it's easy. Overall, just a great class and professor!

Dr. Ekas is AWESOME.  Go to class because clicker points (or lack of) can change your grade by a test score.  A few homework and quizzes and the tests.  GO TO THE REVIEW SESSIONS she basically tells you EVERYTHING you need to know.  She is very nice and tries to make the class fun.  Take her she is the greatest.

Dr. Ekas is a great professor! She makes class fun and interesting! She gives many extra credit opportunities and is always there to help you in anyway that she can. There are three tests but she usually holds a review session before each to make sure you really understand the material. She also puts her powerpoints on Ecollege and grades so fast!

Dr. Ekas is an amazing psychology teacher. She's so helpful and will literally respond to your e-mails in a matter of minutes. She's very knowledgable in her field and actually convinced me to major in Psych! Overall this was my favorite class! Take Dr. Ekas for Psych!
Good teacher, very nice. Uses powerpoints each class and puts them up online.Quizzes, homework, and 3 tests plus optional final. Overall, fairly easy and would recommend Dr. Ekas

If you dont do well on your tests, there's no way to do well in this class. He didn't count our homework because there were problems with the book, and the final is worth 32% of your grade. There are three tests and the last one was really hard and kind of tanked my grade. Very sarcastic, so don't take if you don't like dry humor, super sweet tho!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Efton is a solid guy who makes class fun and he explained Discrete concepts relatively well. He is a fair grader and the class schedule was very consistent. One of the better professors I've had at TCU.

Dr. Park was the 3rd and final prof to sub in for our Discrete I class. He takes notes on his iPad but his handwriting is a little sloppy. Just mostly try to take in the information since he posts the notes after class. Overall knows what he's talking about, but can be hard to follow the material without proper understanding and practice.

I would only recommend if you aren't expecting much support from your professors. He is very cut and dry with what he will do. No test reviews, no dropped grades. The content of this course gets extremely difficult out of nowhere, and his teching style no longer sufficed for me personally. Wouldn't recommend unless you like to teach yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures were somewhat hard to understand, but you can get the material down through practice. Really helpful office hours.

I literally had to drop this class last semester because of how terrible of an experience I had. All tests are multiple choice, 12 questions, no partial credit. So if you miss 2 you already got a 83% on the test. He has no organized notes, can barely read his handwriting on the board as well. He was a really fun guy but stay clear.
Not a good professor at all. Tests were hard plus no half credit. He overcomplicated the material which it would be really confusing and hard to follow. Don't take.

Professor Park is a good STEM Professor but Business Calculus - not so much. No partial credit given on any problem and with only 10-12 problems on test, that made it very difficult. Im an a very high achieving student and he made this class way more difficult than it needed to be. DO NOT take unless you are a great math student on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Tough grader--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His handwriting is messy and small and he performs the math too quickly (he has more experience teaching STEM students). He graded partial credit on the first exam and without notice did not count it on the 2, 3, or final. This was detrimental to my grade. If partial credit was consistent, my grade wouldve been different by 2 letter grades.
I do not recommend because test are condensed multiple choice so its either get the answer or not. Calc is not a hard subject but his test are. Do not take him!! He over complicates simple math.

Dr. Park is a good professor. During class we copy his prepared notes and for homework we just do problems on my math lab. The only concern is that he is a bit vague when it comes to teaching, as he almost expects you to teach it to yourself. There are no quizzes, so midterms are extremely important if you want to do well in his class.
Worst
He used to be a stand up comedian, he is just too humble to teach at TCU. Math was never so easy people. ps he might be issac newton.

Dr. Park is wonderful. He will use his prepared notes for teaching and after class he updates them too, so dont worry if you miss some parts in class. If you spend time reviewing all the homework and notes, its easy to get 90+ in his exams because problems are nearly the same. He also considers for partial credits in some exams. TAKE HIS CLASS!

He is one of the best professors I have had at TCU. Lectures are easy to understand. The materials definitely helps you a lot in practicing. He's hilarious and makes classes very relaxing. Just take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Park explains the material very thoroughly and does plenty of example problems. If you show up to class and take notes, you shouldn't have a problem passing the class. His quizzes and tests are directly based off of in class example problems and homework. Do the work and show up and you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Park is the worst math teacher I have had a TCU. Made me feel discouraged and was arrogant when asking for help. Also forget about partial credit because you will get none.

Park's tests are mostly from his notes but changes the problems a little. However, he is a INCREDIBLY tough grader. It is ridiculous how harsh he is when giving partial credit. Also his humor gets old quick. Rude in office hours too. AVOID HIM.

Dr. Park is the best professor I have ever had for a class. He is very straight to the point and teaches things in a way that is easy to understand. He does give pop quizzes once a week, so study before each class a bit. But the pop quizzes are helpful because they are exactly like the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I love Efton Park! I took him for Discrete Math I and Graph Theory... Incredibly caring, funny, and smart guy. He's the reason I became a math major, went and got my masters in math, and now a college level instructor. Go to class (pop quizzes), you will learn some math and get a good laugh.

Great professor. Class is mainly him giving examples of problems exactly like test. He gives a lot of pop quizzes so you can't really miss class. His lectures are easy to understand and all homework is online. Tests are only 6-8 problems
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have had. Very fair and prepares you for the exams. Study over all hw and quizzes and you'll do fine on the exams.   He made the class so much more enjoyable

Dr. Park is one of the best math professors I have had. His class is challenging but he is very helpful in office hours (holds a lot, too). Lectures are really funny too and you aren't bored in class. Exams are hard so make sure to study a lot for those and beware of random pop quizzes

As long as you take notes and review you'll rock this class. He does give quizzes but there expected, the quizzes are the exact same as the test. Awesome class he's super funny, very clear and overall it was a good class. It does take some work but it's good!

Dr. Park was one of my favorite math teachers. I had to retake this class and did it over the summer. It was really simple as long as you study and do your homework. Expect daily quizzes if not weekly quizzes. But overall a great class.

Dr. Park is my favorite professor I've taken at TCU. His teaching style is very clear, and is always so helpful at his office hours! (Highly recommend going). If you do a lot of practice problems from the homework before the exams, you will do very well. He gives pop quizzes so study every day! (which will help come exam time!) Hilarious, too.

I never thought that the funniest professor I would ever have would be a calculus professor, but Dr. Park proved me wrong.  He is an absolute riot.  As for the class, do the homework and make sure you do it right, that alone will prepare you for pop quizzes.  When studying for exams, go above and beyond lecture notes and homework- exams are hard.

dr. park is an amazing professor. his lectures are engaging. hw problems are very helpful. you can get them done in 30 minutes. you know the hw problems. you know the exam. very good teacher. not a hard A.

Dr. Park is a great teacher. He explains all new concepts step-by-step. He might jump a few steps once you have moved beyond a basic understanding of the underlying concept he is teaching, but is always willing to explain all the bits and pieces if you ask. And his method is clear and I love his class! Calc 1...

he is so corny! I love this guy. He was such a nice teacher. he bumped my grade up to an A even though i had about an 88 but bc i was in class and did the work he gave me some extra credit for trying. He is really helpful and always tells silly jokes. Hes just weird but in a good way. A is very possible

Super nice guy, but not the easiest class. The tests are disproportionately harder than the homework, which he fails to realize. Hes always willing to help, and has a odd since of humor that will keep the class from every dragging too bad. Not a bad class, just be mindful of the tests.

Nice guy. However, if you take no other warning take this one. When he says that "if you are able to do the homework, you will do fine on the test." -- Just know that is a complete and utter lie. The tests are 50x harder than anything he gives for homework or does in class. If you have not had calc before I would recomend another prof.

This teacher incredibly evil. I took this guy based upon what I read from the other comments and it led me to a lot of pain. Hard tests, and doesn't know how to teach well. HUGE EGO PROBLEM!!! DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!! CHOOSE ANOTHER TEACHER. I HAVE TO RETAKE CALC B/C OF HIM!!!

Lectures are vary thorough. It helps if you have taken it in high school, or at least pre cal. The test are in the same format, but study hard because he likes to pull tricky questions. KNOW ARCTAN and eX.

Interesting class, decent teacher. He doesn't have the best understanding of the material, often questions were asked that he didn't know the answers to. Pop quizzes are annoying and it's hard to get partial credit. Jokes keep the mood in class light. I seem to remember that he's rarely in his office. Exams are straightforward, but long. Work fast!
I really enjoy the class, especially for an early morning one! Great teacher and explains things well. Tests are short and to the point!

Nice, funny guy who'd be a lot better if he relaxed a bit. Tries to make things too complicated, and grades pretty hard. He is a nice guy though, and he knows what he's talking about. Just give him a few more years...

I enjoyed this class very much.  I made an A and he was a great teacher, probably one of the best math teachers I have had. His jokes are corny, but he means for them to be, so if you like that kind of humor then go for it.  He explains lectures very thoroughly and doesn't assign too much homework.

Hard class, but he's very willing to help you. Doesn't give you time to work through his example problems which is annoying and only four exam grades plus homework after class. Made calculus fun with his corny jokes but didn't exactly make up for his 5 question tests.
Nice guy.  You can make an A if you stay with it.  3 tests, the final, and a slight homework grade is your overall grade.  Doesnt leave much room for error on any tests if you want an A.

He's a great prof. Lectures with sharp precision but sneaks in jokes that you won't catch immediately. Gives homework everyday and his tests are relatively easy if you do the hw (without having to look at the solutions0
This guy knows his stuff. He makes it easier to learn through lectures. However, there is a heavy HW load and tests are hit or miss with 5 or so questions. Overall, highly recommended.
He's nice and funny and he's accessable outside of class.  Take notes and the papers are pretty easy.  I made a 98 on one - the highest hohit grade I ever received.
Not a bad class, but hmwk is assigned every day, and the tests are a little hard.  He is a good teacher; funny but knows when to be serious.  Teaching style is good.
fun class...tests are very hard.  you def. have to study, but he is an excellent teacher
hilarious.  he's a hard grader, but an entertaining teacher - even if the information's boring you won't get distracted.

He's great!  He's really funny with such a dry sense of humor.  He explains things really well and does many examples and will work with you till you figure it out.  His tests are hard, but if you study you should be fine.  He doesn't give reviews though.
Extremely funny, homework everyday, but do it, then you will do good in the class.
One of the best teachers i have ever had!! will take any class he teaches! Class had homework every day but not alot test were very easy only 5-7 problems!! GREAT TEACHER!!!
Really good teacher, only complaint is that he goes too fast in lecture but gives good examples, tests are straightfoward nothing tricky, do hmwk problems and you will make an A
Awesome teacher that is extremely funny.  Gives out homework every night.  Test are really hard!!
great professor..funny and interesting..gives very effective lecture..
A hilarious teacher.  Gives daily homework.  Exams usually have 6-7 questions.
The funniest professor I've ever met.  Engaging, intelligent, knowledged.  Hard as hell.  Take him if you're a math major, otherwise avoid like the plague.
Professor Mendoza is very difficult to work with. She is not very understanding with personal situations that may conflict with your course work and is a tough grader.

Elva is a smart, hard-working and nice professor, but can be difficult to work with. She works to achieve democratic practices in class- allows students to make decisions about changing schedule, grading, etc. She can be frustrating come test time, as the tests are extremely comprehensive, specific, and difficult. English is not her first language.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Emphasizes a "democratic" classroom where the students have immense say in how the classroom functions. She tries her best to change the syllabus and take student feedback. Many pop quizzes about objective things in the reading, not relating to big ideas. Lectures are fine, discussion quality is based on the students in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: David is a wonderful design teacher who is easy-going, witty, and extremely understanding as a professor regarding your strengths/weaknesses. he also takes the time to clarify any discrepancies regarding assignments, grading, and overall workload expected.

David is the head of design at TCU and a great teacher if you can take him. This was an intro class but he had great lectures and advice. There were lots of small projects but he can be flexible if he notices that the class needs more time.
Ad design is a tough and time consuming class, but I learned a lot. David is great.
He's great! Gives great feedback and assigns interesting projects

this class is hard regardless of the professor. you will have to study but if you practice/study the exact questions he gives you to review in class, you will be fine. lectures are boring but aren't too bad and he tries to make everything easier. not the worst, not the best, but would take him again
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not sure why Mr. Gutierrez is rated 1 star, he's an efficient, fair teacher. Homework is easy and due at the end of the semester. No quizzes, just four tests, and the final can replace your lowest score. He's funny, helpful, and willing to work with students. I'd take him again.

Terrible teacher. Tests are completely different than what he tells you to study and final is so hard for no reason. Just told us topics to look over and review previous tests. Takes off so many points and gives partial credit when only one tiny detials is missing. Do not take him.

perplexing, terrible office hours, 21 pieces of paper that get mixed in the other papers for 1hr and 20min class. Spent 68hrs on a sections we were learning and studied weeks way before he could get to the next chapter, just for the exam to be completely different from what I have studied. He plays with your education, its not worth taking a seat.

Its a hard class and he isn't the easiest professor but it's doable. You will probably need a tutor for it but to be honest you might need a tutor for this class anyways. If you actually try to understand the material and if you rework the problems he goes over in class you should be fine.

Do not take his class. Tests are way harder and different than anything we go over. I sacrificed the majority of my time just to study and get help for his class from the start of the semester just to barely get a passing grade. No drops and no curves even when most people fail. Please find a different professor or take calculus next semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It is a hard class. Go find another professor. But if you do end up in his class it is do able. I would recommend getting a tutor and studying a lot than you will do good. Also, after the first test you will then understand exactly what he is looking for which is everything. The test is free response so do not forgot anything.

Actually probably one of the worst professors on campus, try's to be a good guy and is no where near. Has no respect for students, I emailed him three times over the semester and he never emailed me back. He shut down his email after finals so no students could email him asking for a round. Actually worth it to drop the class and take it online.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is the worst calculus professor at the entire school and he will screw you over any chance he gets. Do anything you can not to take his class. His tests are insanely hard and the final is 10x harder. he should be fired immediately. Never had a worse experience with a teacher.
Get ready to to grind when you take this class. It is no joke free up your schedule.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HIM. That's all you need to know.

Eliud gets a lot of hate, but much of it is misunderstood. He is ability to teach is not the greatest because of his inability to focus on the student learning rather than himself completing the problem. If you take notes and are able to do the homework without cheating, the class is fairly easy. There is also a TA right next to the classroom.

I was scared after reading reviews, but I ended up doing well tks to his guidance. Got 80 on the 1st exam (didn't know the format) but 98+ on the last 3. Write ALL steps for full points! Final replaces your lowest score. Caring prof, fun bonus question for busi students, and helps you see why it's applied cal. Must-take for econ or busi majors!!!
Horrible professor. Not sure why TCU hires teachers who have no motivation to teach students. He simply didn't want to see anyone in the class succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The exams in this class are outrageous and make up almost your entire grade. He is nice enough but rarely available outside of class. DO NOT TAKE HIM!!!

Not the worst, he's smart but is horrible at answering questions. We have 5 tests and a final which can replace a bad test grade. Tests are 10-12 questions free response, you must show all work, no quizzes, the homework is online due on the final, you get 100% on hw and it counts as a test. He gives extra credit if you catch him making a mistake

He's nice and will help but tests are outrageously difficult. HW is chill because it's due at the end of the semester at once but use it to study. He just grades test insanely hard and isn't very lenient on partial grading if you don't do the work his way. Class started at 38 kids and ended with 15 because 23 dropped.

He is a nice professor and has a sense of humor. His lectures go over the material so you cant miss a class or you will fall behind. Super test heavy, tests are 80%. Homework is only 15% and its due at the end of the semester. For tests you can only use your brain. No extra credit or retakes. You can pass if you study and ask for help!

Dr. Cantu is a really good professor, but the class itself is definitely hard. She truly does her best to make things as easy and understandable as possible. I highly recommend finding a study buddy because it helps so much. Also do all the extra credit she offers it really adds up and helps a lot in the end!
class content itself isnt hard but shes makes it really difficult to learn. I retook this course with a different professor and it was a night and day difference.

Although the class is hard, Dr. Cantu tries her absolute best to make the class easier for all her students. She wants you to succeed, but you have to dedicate a lot of time into the class since the class is mainly about memorizing stuff. Just make sure you stay on top of your stuff and you'll do great!
Super hard grader and not very lenient

Cantu was difficult, but worth it once you take a&p! She prepares you so well for future courses and has practical knowledge due to her profession. Quizzes were every week and we had 4 tests over 4 chapters, 20% was over the previous chapter. If you pay attention in class and know the objectives you'll do great! Gave 8 points of extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He is an excellent professor and genuinely a great person. I took this class randomly to fulfill my religious studies credit and didn't expect to enjoy it as much as I did. Attendance is important since his lectures directly inform exams. Engaging, clear, and absolutely worth taking. 10/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Elwell was a one of a kind professor who was entertaining and caring. Although the class was lecture heavy if you put your head down, take basic notes, and TRY you will do well (and get a lot out of this class). The tests are not "easy" but they are not difficult if you put in the time to study the main points (which he makes clear) in class.

Test are hard but the class overall isn't that difficult as long as you have some knowledge over the assigned reading each class and listen to lecture studying shouldn't be as hard. However, taking notes is extremely hard in his class since he talks fast. I planned to not prioritize this class and pnc but ended up not needing to.

I LOVE HIM. you get out what you put into this class. he's super funny and quirky and has a lot of life lore. his tests are pretty hard but if you study well and know the material you're fine. next semester he's switching to all paper notes and no computers which will be hard because he talks super fast but overall he's a great professor and cares.

Elwell is one of the most genuine human beings. I'm not a religion person, but enjoyed the class. Only homework is readings that I never did. Cannot skip class though or you WONT do well on the tests. Tests are so hard, all info is from his lectures where he talks fast. Must study for tests to do fine in the class. Such a sweet guy i love him
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Elwell is one of the best and most difficult teachers I've ever had. He talks very fast and every word matters, but I do not regret a single second of being in his class. He's extremely passionate and knowledgeable which means his tests are difficult. There's random pop quizzes, very few assignments, and assigned readings. not easy, but fun!

All information is taught to you is by mouth and he talks INCREDIBLY fast. I literally can only write down half of the stuff he says. Explains things in the most confusing way possible. I dread waking up in the morning the days I have this class. Time stands still in his class. Very caring and passionate though!

Very passionate about religion, I learned a lot from him. Tests are online at home lockdown browser but easy to get around. In class quizzes for a grade boost. Most of material is covered in lecture so be ready to take fast notes. Gets a little too deep into the details but overall is easy to follow. Good man who takes your life into consideration

Dr Elwell is a great guy who cares alot about his students, however the level of difficulty in this course is outrageous. I highly recommend another class to take as a RT credit. Exams are nearly impossible as he picks so little out of so much to know. I dont know how you could survive this class without using one of your P/NC's
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Elwell has been my favorite prof ever. The class is definitely hard and you have to work hard for your grade, but if you go to class, take notes, and study, you'll be fine. He is such a cool guy and genuinely cares about the students. I took this to get my religion credit out of the way but class was always interesting and I never dreaded it.
Dude is super cool, but the class is impossible. He is the department chair so kinda expected the class will be hard, but try and take a different professor if possible.

Dr. Elwell is an incredible guy and teaches religion from an unbiased perspective, which is really refreshing. His lectures are extremely interesting and you will learn A LOT very quickly. Attending class is a must, as he doesnt use a powerpoint. Lectures are fast paced but he will repeat anything if needed. Go to class, study, and you will be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Elwell is an amazing teacher! His lectures were extremely interesting, and he was always super interest in getting to know and establishing positive relationship with his students. I enjoyed going to his class everyday! The tests are slightly challenging, but they are not bad if you study the quizlet reviews that are online. 10/10 Guy!

Loved Dr. Elwell and the class. He made me work for the A+.  Grade is based off 4 unit exams + some extra credit which helped me get the A+. All the information you need comes from what he says so really pay attention. He's really caring, he actually sees us as people and conversates with us. Amazing prof. Put in the effort and you're fine.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Elwell is very kind and knowledgeable. However, this class was way too difficult for a 1000-level Intro to religion course. Your grade is pretty much based on 4 exams and extra credit. He doesn't use a PowerPoint to lecture so it is hard to follow the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Elwell is so awesome! I have lot's of respect for him. However, the class is not easy, and its hard to get an A. His lectures are interesting and he is also a funny professor. Just keep in mind, if you are looking for a super easy religion class, this may not be it.

Dr. Elwell is a super interesting guy and makes lectures interesting but this class is almost impossible to get an A in. His extra credit is very generous but if you are looking for an easy A for core don't take this class as it will tank your GPA.

Professor Elwell was the most fascinating and interesting teacher I've had in my academic experience. I never grew such an interest in a field that was not my major before him. That being said it is one of the hardest courses I've had in all my years and hardly squeaked by with an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class, however it was difficult to get an A. He lectures without a powerpoint so if you miss class you He also talks very fast so taking notes is a tad difficult. You definitely need to study to do well on his exams. This being said, he's really funny and he definitely knows what he's talking about.

I'm seeing amazing reviews but personally, I did not have a good experience in Elwell's class. Lectures and tests are so beyond difficult. I ended up doing pass no credit. A religion minor sits next to me and says the class is impossible. I would recommend taking your religion class outside of TCU but if it has to be here, do NOT take Elwell!
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
Dr. Elwell is a fantastic professor; he's very cool and holds profound knowledge of many things. He teaches religion unbiasedly, which is rare. You will do fine if you attend and pay attention to the lectures.
Honestly, a very inspirational person will treat you like an actual human.

Elwell is a great lecturer. He makes class very informative, interactive, and digestible. If you are offended by humor, dont take him...but I think hes a funny guy. It is not an easy class as there is so much material to cover in such little time but if you want to learn, take him. Save your pass/no credit just in case.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Elwell is a great guy, but personally wasn't a good professor for me. His classes are full lectures and he can go pretty fast, but he likes when you interrupt him to ask questions/slow down. The worst part about his class is the amount of reading and his tests can be a little confusing. There is not a lot of homework so tests & quizzes matter.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: AMAZING PROF! Was a seminar class-no test Had readings everyday that u have 2 type up a paragraph summary w/ a question at the end Has 20 page research paper due finals week Other than that pretty easy going class w/ fun intellectual convos! He is such a cool cat & definitely one of my favorite profs, looking forward 2 taking other classes w/him
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Elwell is a great lecturer, even if his lectures are a little all over the place. He tells you how everything ends up connecting together. You NEED to study for his exams - they are detailed and you need to know very specific information from lectures. His class is never dull and he makes class fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Take this class--he is the best professor I have ever had! He doesn't take attendance but if you skip his class you will fail; we have four exams and all the content is gone over during lecture. His personality/approach really made this subject fun and interesting; I looked forward to his class! He curses a lot so don't take him if you're uptight.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Elwell is the best teacher I have had here at TCU. He is very understanding and very cool. If you have any questions he is more than happy to stay after class and answer them. If he's going to fast he wants you to interrupt him and tell him to slow down. Hands down Elwell is the best Professor at TCU that I have had.

Great lecturer, very charismatic and entertaining no matter what the subject is. Weird and quirky guy, but class was always enjoyable. Daily readings, sometimes a quiz, hard tests where question wording is set up to trick you. Slight curves on tests and at the end of semester, would highly recommend Elwell if you want someone with passion.

Great guy and he tries to make class interesting. However, like all tcu religions, it is a very difficult class. The one thing that does really help is after finals he curves everyones grade by quite a bit. I'm a good student and had a C most of the year though.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Elwell is a very intelligent, and amazing professor. By no means was his class easy, but his lectures are very interesting and absolutely needed for the exams. He makes sure that you understand the material before moving on, and never fails to answer any questions that you may have. Overall he's an amazing personality and is very respectable
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Elwell's religion class thinking it would be a boring class I'd have to tolerate in order to recieve my religion credit. However, Dr. Elwell is a great professor and is always open to answering questions and leaving the floor open for debate. His tests contain all info from his lectures, so take good notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class is a lot of fun, but there's a lot of memorizing terms. We covered Hinduism, Buddhism, Judaism, and Christianity. Most of the focus is on the religions, not art. The final is really just a fourth test, which is nice. He does use profanity, but he never means to offend. I'm not religious, and I'm glad I took this course for my religion.

Professor Elwell is extremely smart and makes lecture very interesting for a class that could be super boring. The exams are very difficult though and it is not common to receive an A. He believes in working very hard for your grade. Only grades are exams and pop quizzes. Attendance is mandatory and affects your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Wonderful! Best class I've taken at TCU. Do yourself a favor and take this prof!

He's a great guy and I often enjoyed his lectures but the amount of reading and quizzes was very difficult to manage in my opinion. His test were challenging and very stressful. He does offer extra credit, but the class is a grind. I took his 8am class last semester and It was just too much to comprehend that early in the morning. hope this helps.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: My favorite teacher this semester. You will learn so much during this course and not even realize it. He brings abstract concepts and makes them understandable. Make a solid review for this test and you can make an A. Only downside is that it is a +/- class. Lots of reading but easy to get done.

Great lectures, makes tough subjects easy to understand AND entertaining. You do have to work for an A but that is part of college, right? For sure though- you will never be bored and you will learn a lot!

Honestly a very enjoyable class. It's all very basic information about a few specific religions so you don't ever have to get into super dense and confusing concepts. Dr. Elwell is light-hearted and makes a point to ensure all students are understanding the material.
This is honestly one of the hardest classes I've taken, you can study for weeks and you won't pass. His lectures are interesting but its hard to keep up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: First off let me say, this was a very informative and interesting class. That being said, this was the hardest class I have ever taken. I usually never make below an A and so far I have yet to make an A on a test. No matter how much you study, it never seems to be enough. Also be prepared, pop quizzes on all d2l readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Fantastic class. I had him for 8am, but he always kept it interesting. DO THE READINGS. I started off always doing the readings & then got lazy, that's where my mistake was. He doesn't check the test reviews so there are a lot of terms you don't need to know. BUY ANOTHER STUDENTS BOOK, it's expensive & can't be sold back (but you need it)

Although this class is early in the morning, it wasn't that bad because of Dr. Elwell. Beware of his grading though. Tests and research paper are pretty much 99% of your grade. The other 1% is attendance, pop quizes  and other in-class assignments/homework. If you come prepared this class should not be that bad.

Dr. Elwell's lectures are extremely interesting. They're fun to listen to and easy to understand. If you attend every class meeting and take notes, this class should be easy. Make sure to read the assigned readings because he loves doing pop quizzes over them (they're easy though). Tests are super easy if you follow the study guide he gives out.

Prof Elwell is absolutely amazing. His lectures are long but super interesting, and he really cares about his students and what is going on in their lives outside of class. Showing up and participating is necessary to do well, but he makes it a class you'll want to attend. Would recommend to anyone looking for RT credit.

I was scared to take religion at TCU but I'm glad I ended up with Dr. Elwell. Although I only made a B, he taught the course very well with fast paced, yet interesting lectures. There are readings due every class and pop quizzes over most of them, which were challenging. The tests were manageable despite the lengthy study guides. StudyParticipate!

He assigns reading every class and there are weekly reading quizzes but when it's time to take a test none of the material from the readings is on there. It seems like the material on the tests is pulled out of thin air, even after attending every class and doing the readings. There are no other grades. Thinks too highly of himself. Avoid him.

I took this class and he is a very nice teacher but he does't allow any computers and also he talks very fast. and he does give you study guides but those are very little to no help, also you barely look at art at all. Steer clear of this class studied very had and still did bad and I'm a great student. Also you have to get a 95% to get an A.

I went to every single class & took notes on EVERYTHING, literally every word out of his mouth.  He often talks way too fast that's its hard to keep up.  He doesn't spell things so when you're learning Hinduism, Budhism, and Judaism its all just a guessing game which hurts you on the test.  Do not take!! ended up with like a 70 and im an A student.

Taking this class at 8 in the morning one would assume that I hate it, but for the class being an hour and 20 minutes, the lectures are easy to listen and he tells them like a story. I would recommend this class to others. It's not one you can skip or you won't know what's going on, but the way he speaks makes it interesting to learn about
Challenging- I learned and learned to think

Only gives two tests, worth 40% each. Tests are extremely hard, materials in tests may be mentioned in class once. Talks very fast. Take religion at community college or another 4 year university if possible in the summer.

This class is pretty hard, but Elwell is a great teacher. There are plenty of extra credit opportunities throughout the year to boost your grade. Tests are typically 20-25 multiple choice questions with two essays. Sometimes he does vocabulary definitions too. An A is achievable with some work. Great class, great teacher.

He is the best teacher I have ever had! He knows exactly what he is talking about and really gets you thinking. Tests are easy if you take good notes and pay attention in class. I would definitely take this religion class.

He has been my favorite professor and class at TCU. He is an expert, very enthusiastic about the class & does his best to help you understand everything. Attendance is mandatory and there are quizzes, but a lot of extra credit opportunities, and tests aren't too bad. He is funny & young, keeps the class interesting, and is very fair. He's the best!

Digital Religion - Dr. Elwell is incredible. His course load is intense, but he is more than willing to help you understand. This is a professor who actually cares and WANTS to help you succeed. Enjoy it. Ask him questions. Take the reading seriously! Those random quizzes can be deadly.
Elwell has been my favorite professor at TCU. He is funny, keeps the class interesting, and is very fair. His expectations are clear, has lots of extra credit opportunities.

You have to work hard for an A. A lot of students complained about him, but the point is, do the work and you'll be fine. There is a lot of reading, I mean a lot. And if you don't prepare yourself you will be so far behind. I worked my butt off and got a B+. If your willing to work for your grade, he's awesome and gives a bunch of extra credit!!!
Fairly easy, Quizes are hard and random, but tests are fair. Easiest religion class at TCU:) TAKE IT.

Class is mandatory, approximately one pop quiz a week. his lectures are long and boring and i didn't understand the way he taught. He connects everything, so if you miss or don't understand one thing, nothing else will make sense. His tests actually aren't that bad if you study, but his reviews suck. I don't recommend this class.

He is a great teacher and never leans to one view or another. Makes you think a lot with his expertise...and he is an expert. The reading is the worse part and if you don't keep up you'll fall behind quickly. Random quizzes make up half of grade to motivate attendance. Best religion class here.

He is a cool guy and is very honest and straightforward, as well as teaching from a neutral standpoint...i got an A but i had to work...he was new this semester to TCU..in the future he might make the class harder...but all religion classes are pretty hard, i enjoyed this one though

Religion Society and Culture: So far it has been pretty easy. He is a pretty cool teacher & explains the material well. Lectures can be long though. He goes over the history of the main world religions & you have 5 point quizzes on each. Final: we will have to write a paper & take a test. This religion doesnt seem too bad compared to others

A nice professor but is extremely difficult to learn from, but will curve grades. Make sure that you take the time to seek resources outside of class to prepare for exams. Overall the class is easy, but his lectures and teaching style can make concepts confusing.

He is a little hard to understand in class, but he is super caring and is more than willing to help in office hours. The class is pretty easy, most of the calculations are done through the calculator so it is really just about doing practice problems.

He's a new professor so often it felt he wasn't well prepared to teach a class. His accent and the way he explains things are often hard understand which doesn't help. He's a genuinly a nice person but it is just hard to learn from him. If it weren't for that the class is actually easy since most of the questions can be done through a calculator.
has a VERY thick accent and is hard to understand. I ended up having to get a tutor outside of class in order to pass this class.
Easy class, very reading heavy and writing heavy. Do the work and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Ramsey is the kindest and most caring professor I have had at TCU. She TRULY cares about her students. She is happy to give extensions and is always happy to help a student. She answers emails quickly and thoroughly, which just proves my point further. Definitely take her if you get the chance.

Professor Ramsey's class was amazing! It's divided into 3 units with creative pieces, analyses, and a portfolio. Weekly quizzes are straightforward. Ramsey is nice, professional, and always prepared. She gives excellent feedback that truly helps you grow as a writer. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Ramsey made this class so fun. There are a lot of writing assignments, which would be expected in a creative writing class, but if you enjoy writing you will find it fun. She provides many examples of essays for each section so you know what she is looking for. You will use a lot of printer money, but the class is a good one to take.

I have had Emma for two classes now and both classes have been so easy. Mostly just papers that you do throughout the semester. Never got below a 94 on a single essay/assignment. Reading quizzes are online and free 100%. Take her

She is such a good, intelligent, chill teacher. I took Intro to literature with her and it was super easy but insightful. She knows her stuff. There are two major papers, but overall not test-heavy. There are some simple online quizzes every week. You can miss up to 2 classes. She is awesome and caring and really wants her students to learn!

absolutely loved Prof. Ramsey this semester as she's super kind and straightforward with the coursework. there are readings outside of class but they're extremely manageable and are inspo for the workshops and pieces you write throughout the semester. take her if you can!!

Prof. Ramsey is a very caring person.  Her class is solely based on participation and makes it very clear that attendance is mandatory (you can miss up to 3 classes).  You will be expected to read before each class but isn't anything overwhelmingly.

This class was super straightforward and easy. No exams, weekly online 10-question quizzes (open note multiple choice) that are so easy and you get multiple attempts. She is so nice and makes her lectures easy to participate in. Never picked up a book once and have an A.

Professor Ramsey is a great professor for a core credit! She wants her students to learn and get good grades. No tests, and all small writing projects with clear rubrics. She gives excellent feedback. Just go to class and do your writing assignments!

She is a very caring professor and the class is very manageable and not hard to do well. There were no exams just 4 projects with papers and checkpoints along the way where its easy to get full credit. If you spend time on the papers and the other work you will do well.There is very little homework that is not supposed to help with the projects.

She's so sweet and understanding. You will have to write a few longer pieces but it's definitely manageable and won't consume too much of your time. I loved her, she's so engaging! Please take her class, you won't regret!

Professor Ramsey is a very nice woman who clearly cares about what she teaches. I took Reading as a Writer and the class itself was great. You will cover multiple stories in non-fiction, fiction, and poetry. Reading the stories was never hard and the written homework is quite minimal. You will need to put in a little work to get an A but it's easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: Ramsey is a great professor who is consistently kind and caring towards students in any situation. Her lecture is based on types of literature including non-fiction and poetry, in which you write a couple of craft papers on and make your own poems and stories. Overall, the class is pretty easy and enjoyable to take.
such a sweet prof, genuinely wants to connect with students, lectures are kinda boring, but the class was overall very easy. only a few assignments throughout, mainly test based, very very sweet
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best professor and class, if you are an allied health major TAKE HER, if you're anything else and need an easy A, TAKE HER. She is clear about what material you need to know for the tests, Grade is based off of 4 tests and 1 project and all of it is extremely easy if you have any respect for her and the class. She gives good review for tests too.

I think this class is contains a lot of really useful knowledge for life. Mostly lectures. Tests were totally doable. Group project and a cumulative final exam at the end of the semester. Dr. McClelland is super nice and passionate about the topic.

This class is cake. Although every class is a lecture, she does a review game before every exam, which is the questions on the test. There is a presentation that you spend the last portion of the semester doing that is easy. Take this class, it's a free A as long as you go to class and study a little bit.

Class is mostly lecture and grades are based off exams and one project. Some guest speakers. Although lecture heavy, she keeps them entertaining. She does review before exams which really helps make the tests much easier. She is really sweet and caring and brings a lot of her own knowledge and experience to the course. Would easily take again!

Sweet professor but class was just her reading off of powerpoints. Coursework is 4 on-paper tests and 1 in-class presentation at the end of the semester. You HAVE to study lecture slides to pass tests. Lots of guest speakers. Pretty boring intro-level class overall and I wish the content was more interactive but if you study, you'll pass.

Dr. Lund is incredibly knowledgeable about her field. She teaches in a way that is easy to understand and is willing to re-interpret information to you so you understand. Exams are mostly MC and there is an interesting project you have to do that is split 50/50 (solo/group work). You can read the book if you want but her lectures are enough.

She is great! Class is just lectures, but she is very good. No homework, just fairly difficult projects and exams. 2 group projects, 2 individual projects. She is so intelligent and will help you if you have questions!

Dr. Lund is a great professor and is very passionate about her field. She is very technical and really pushes you to work hard. Don't take any of her courses and expect to do the work and get by. You need to understand how to apply the concepts that she talks about in class.

Dr. Lund is a wonderful professor who cares about teaching so students are able to learn and apply the information from textbook and research. She expects you to care about class, do the work assigned, and participate in class discussions. It is by no means a blow off class, but if you complete the assignments and study, your grade will reflect it.

Really funny and makes class worth going. Coursework may seem much at first glance but hw, essays, quizzes, and the one presentation were all easy. She also gives out bonus points and is an easy grader as long as you put in some effort.

Professor Engelhardt is awesome! She was funny, and she really cared. Every quiz you take she lets you know ahead of time, and she offers extra credit on every single one. All of the answers for all the quizzes and tests are pulled directly from her power points that she uploads to D2L. She's an awesome way to start your mornings and week (8am).

I loved Professor Engelhardt!  She was so funny, and even made the boring books of the bible interesting.  There is a lot of reading (but sounds like all of the religion classes), and her lectures cover most of it if you happened to not read that day.  Tests aren't too heavily weighted and everything else is open note.  She was truly amazing!

There are reflection questions due before class, but you only have to do 10 a semester. There's take home quizzes every unit or so. There's 3 writing assignments, fairly short & easy. Her lectures do require a little reading to follow along, & 2 exams do require some studying, but overall easy. Offers extra credit, is engaging and cares about you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: If you are struggling with which intro religion course to take, take Engelhardt's! She is hilarious and makes lectures fun. Willing to work with you and offers opportunities for extra credit. Wants you to succeed. One of the best religion professors at TCU.
Hated this class

one of the coolest teachers i have ever had! he gives good feedback, although can seem tough, but he wants everyone in the class to succeed, so you jut have to do your part. he is hilarious and gives great lectures so students actually don't mind or even enjoy going to his class

Mac was really helpful.  He's willing to work with you and is always available to help out.  Show up to class because you only meet once a week, so it's dumb if you don't go anyway.  He's got a lot of personal experience with journalism, so he knows what he's talking about.  Plus he's hot and his personality is awesome. TAKE HIM if you can.

really cool guy! though he grades on personal preference which will piss you off at times, but he gave me a's on some of my papers so he's made up for it. he's an actual beat journalist so you'll learn lots of things. definately take him.
Mac is a great teacher and really helpful.   I would recomend taking any of his classes anytime.

Dr. Enos is an incredible professor and person. He writes detailed notes and feedback on the essays you turn in, and welcomes the idea of meeting for office hours and keeping in touch after the semester. He is a professor I truly look up to and respect. He cares for his students and respects them all equally. Class discussions were upbeat and fun.

Dr. Enos is the best English professor at TCU, maybe the best professor period. He is very kind in his critiques of your writing, but still helps you learn. I believe he genuinely cares about his students. If at all possible, take his classes.

Dr. Enos is a fabulous teacher.  He really cares about growing his students as competent writers.  He gives you many useful "tools" to write your papers and the topics for the papers are very interesting and relevant.  I truly enjoyed this class.

Creates a comfortable learning environment for his students. His enthusiasm and intelligence make for a stimulating classrooom experience. Helpful and fair, gives numerous opportunites for revisions and extra credit. One of the best professors not just at TCU, but anywhere.

In my opinion, Dr. Enos is one of the best professors at TCU. He is very enthusiastic about his subject, and very helpful and accomodating if you have a question. He is also unusually quick about returning grading papers and returning them to the students.

Honestly the BEST English professor at TCU, hands down. He is friendly, intelligent, helpful and interesting. You read and watch many different things to write about. He challenges you to write your best with constructive criticism and encouragement. You can rewrite and there are many extra credit opportunities. Should be teacher of the year.

Prof Enos is WONDERFUL! By far my favorite TCU teacher! I have taken 2 courses with him, and recieved A's. Short writing assignments, lots of Extra Credit, and he is more than willing to help with anything! I learned so much about writing! TAKE ANY OF HIS CLASSES!

Dr. Enos is an AMAZING professor! He genuinely cares about every one of his students. You have to work hard and spend a lot of time revising your work, but it's well worth it. He's all about constructive criticism. He doesn't believe in tests or quizzes, only 2-page papers!! Your write 10 during the semester, but they're short and fun to write.

he's the nicest guy and wants you to work hard. you have to do the readings and relate them in your paper. he's really forgiving as long as he can tell you tried and read. you can get a B without reading though. he'll stay up all night trying to grade papers and if he warns you he's tired DO NOT speak during class because he's cranky!

Best professor i have ever had in Composition as well as on the overall english language.Very well read,excellent teacher in class,contributes to your writing skills as well as pertinent academic knowledge that helps for school.He's not the easiest,but he certainly is one of the best!!!!very humble yet profoundly knowledgeable and very experienced.
This class is fun and interesting. Enos has a lot of enthusiasm and a great personality. There are multiple extra credit opportunities as well.

Smart guy, but 20803 isn't his best class.  He really knows his rhetoric.  I took his rhetoric class and loved it.  His writing class wasn't as great and did not do much for me even though I worked extremely hard.
Good guy. You will have to work on what you wirte but not much else. He is big on extra credit!
Great Teacher! I learned so much in this class.  Easy to understand. Very Helpfull!!!!
Take him for any writing course you can, he is absolutely amazing.

So, who's my favorite teacher at TCU?  Dr. Enos is so incredible--the man needs a promotion.  He's really here to help the students, and he has the best personality.  He's so funny and laidback, yet such a genius.  He's changed my life and has reaffir

As an upper level writing class, he treats the class with cortesy and respect. Has a passion for writing and propaganda, and shows it. Wants students to succeed, and helps you want to become a better writer. A fun class with a great professor!
No Comments
He is great! Kind, understanding and very competent. GreaT with lending his books!
As a prof, Enos is tireless and enthusiastic. He is THE man in rhetoric and I have enjoyed three courses with him. The effort pays off--great learning experience, not too hard.

You have to do the study guides. Plain and simple. The study guides typically have 25 questions and 8 of those are on the test and worth 10 to 12 points a piece. Miss one or two and you're screwed. I loved his lectures though. You can tell he has a lot of passion for this subject and he really got me thinking sometimes.

This class is very enjoyable and can be very easy. His tests are 100% from the study guide he releases, so completing it is a MUST. If you do do it corrctly you will get an A, fail to do so and it will show in your test grades. Dr. Ingram loves what he does and it shows through his teaching and his lectures.
Great professor, he really knows his stuff! He makes class really enjoyable and loves what he does and it shows!

Terrible teacher, do not take this class. 3 test that are hard and the wording is very confusing. You get no feedback and she doesn't go over them. She yaps all class about unrelated info and will play a ted talk for 30 mins at the end. There are so many slides of material and formulas she just don't go over so get ready to teach yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lecture heavy class which makes class very boring. The quizzes and tests are all pretty easy. She is a good person but does not teach the material very good. Quizzes and test are online and quizzes can be taken anywhere. Talk about the material with friends to better understand it.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She likes to teach by lecture only, it is a very straight forward class. There are 3 tests, an online quiz a week and a final. All tests are allowed to be taken online, sometimes open note. It is tough material but straight forward and can take online, which helps grades.

Dr. Elliot get's a bad rap from most of these reviews, but I think she's an interesting, caring, knowledgeable prof. Yes, her email skills are not prompt. But she's a good explainer and most grades (tests & projects) are free response with 2-4 questions to just write what you know. I liked her and would take her again.
AWFUL!!!! stay away. its all I can say. need to practice Econ to be good at it, and you never do practice problems. quizzes and tests are impossible

The class is structured around nonsensical lectures where she talks for 80 minutes, occasionally writing random drawings on the board. The tests are extremely hard, and lack clear directions. I would avoid her and this class, I would guess that no one in the class will end up with an A because it is just set up that way.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: To start, My high school basketball coach was a better economics teacher than this lady. Her lectures are repetitive and disorganized along with her "notes" she provides, which are just sloppy PowerPoints. Ger ready to learn the vast majority of the content on your own, because it is the only way you will make it through this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She implemented a health care aspect to our Intro to Micro Class. Her quizzes and tests are impossible and it seems like she doesn't care about the well being of her students. Her lectures are boring and repetitive and to do well in the class you need to learn all of the content on your own.

She absolutely hates her job, students and economics. Has no passion towards teaching and students. Do not even try to have a conversation with her because its literally like talking to a wall. I don't know who make her the department chair, and on what bases. never heard anyone say anything nice about her. DO NOT TAKE HER!!
I think I have a better chance of emailing Mac Miller and getting a response back than emailing her and getting a response. #RIP Mac tho.

70 + reviews and 0% would take again. There is a reason for that. I seriously think I have a better shot at scoring a 36 on the ACT in German than passing a test in this class. Or passing my behind the wheel drivers test after TXR bottomless mimosas. Sitting in this class was the worst form of hazing I received on campus behind being waterboarded.

The WORST professor at TCU. Powerpoints make no sense, she doesn't answer emails (I had a family member pass and got nothing in return from her), her lectures are more like tangents on unrelated material and how she feels about the subject. My classmates and I brought this all to her attention and then she proceeded to tell us how it was our fault.

Conceptually the class isnt difficult but she is the WORST prof i've ever had at TCU. her class consist of powerpoints that make no sense and instead of teaching/explaining she asks questions about the content then gets mad when no one knows answers becuase she has yet to teach us it. never replies to emails or helps outside of class. DO NOT TAKE

This class was the worst teaching experience I have had at TCU. I'll give the benefit of the doubt as we were online most of the semester, but she lectured heavily about extraneous information and changed due dates constantly. It was a very confusing class all around and I would not recommend it to anyone wanting to learn.
Unorganized. Changes dates constantly. Can also be very difficult and rude.

Some of her PowerPoint were confusing and hard to follow. If you put in effort it will be worth it. I think she gives out 8 points of extra credit on your overall grade if you look for it. She loves it when people work in groups. I recommend talking to the people in your class and forming a study group, it helps!

My favorite teacher at TCU so far. Her lectures are brilliant and she explains the material very well. She is a little disorganized so you need to stay on top of stuff but if you show an interest and put in the effort, she will help you a ton!
She doesn't even give us the right due date for things and changes them randomly.  She is an extremely difficult teacher. Could be a great class but she ruins it.

Exellent teacher- definitely makes you work for your grade. If you do the work, have an interest in economics, and desire to succeed in her class, she will help you in every way she can. I loved taking a class with her, didn't get an amazing grade in her class, and would do it all again if given the chance.

Does not teach well at all. Handwriting is god awful and she doesn't even try to make it better. Very lazy, doesn't use ecollege. Says her teachings are solely from the book but expects you to know things that she doesn't teach. She should just not be teaching. Avoid her at ALL COSTS!!
The way she teaches is terrible. Avoid her at all costs.
worst teacher ever

Although difficult to understand the rants she can go on sometimes, she provides you with a very deep understanding on microeconomics and will be willing to help your grade if you put in the effort. Make sure to read the book and an A is defintely possible.

This class was definitely a challenge and you needed to attend class, thoroughly do homework, and read each chapter in order to receive an A. But Dr. Elliot is so nice and wants to help you if you try. She will always meet with you if you need help or any questions. Probably my favorite professor so far.
Tough teacher.Heavy accent. Poor at explaining things. Boring. Lots of HW. MEdium difficulty of tests.

Awful teacher. Homework is long and counts way too much towards final grade. Test questions are unclear and often misgraded. Expects way too much out of a freshman econ class; treats it like a grad class. Doesn't care to help and won't ever meet outside of class to help. Stay away!

Absolutely the worst teacher I have ever had. Her lectures are confusing and she gets mad when you take notes, and she will not help when you go to her office. First test for a freshmen intro class was 20 pages long. Does not really care about students either, there is less that 30 in the class she might know 4 peoples names.

Terrible teacher. She made micro more difficult than I ever thought possible. She writes her own assignments and her english never ever makes sense. She is a terribly hard grader and her homework assignments are next to impossible. Nice lady but awful class. Avoid at all costs.
Completely brilliant. Best teacher I ever had! The only people who have difficulties understanding this class are obviously not smart enough to go to a four year college.
Hard for a freshmen micro class. Must study and work hard on your own to understand and succeed because her lectures are confusing.

So here's the deal with this class... One of the most difficult classes I have ever taken, BUT if you are willing to work, then you will be rewarded with a superior knowledge of Microecon. Here's a hint: Read the book--OFTEN and MULTIPLE TIMES. Another hint: REFINE YOUR GROUP HOMEWORK TO GET ALL THE POINTS. In this class, every point matters.

Prof. Elliott is very difficult to understand.It is an intro class, but is taught as if you know a lot. Her tests do not always match the book, and she doesn't explain the concepts in class. She likes certain students and will show her favoritism. Often goes on tangents that don't relate to the material. If you can take another professor, do so.
Very hard to understand and follow - read the text book!!  The book will make studying make more sense.  Homework is very important, make sure you take that seriously and get a good grade.
if you want to keep your sanity, do not take this class...please

I had Elliot for an honors micro econ class. I LOVED her! She really cares about her students. You have to show that you care in the beginning.. she'll work as hard as you do. The A is there if you get on her good side and stay there. I learned a LOT in this class. She was my favorite professor of the semester!
