Professor Falcone is awesome! I didn't know much about Supply Chain Mgmt going in, but she made the class very interesting and engaging through her lectures. Make sure to take good notes, study Tophat powerpoints and quizzes, participate in class and you will do well. She truly cares about her students and seeing them succeed. Highly recommend!

Falcone is a great professor! She's very engaging during class and you can tell she actually cares for her students! Classes are lecture-heavy but as long as you pay attention and take good notes, tests are manageable. Also, very little homework! I would recommend her for Supply Chain!

Professor Falcone is an amazing professor. I did not know anything about supply chain management going into this class, but I was able to learn so much. She always made the class fun and interesting. Definitely take her for Supply Chain.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Ellie is an amazing professor! I felt like I understood all different aspects of supply chain. As long as you pay attention to the class lecture you will do well in the classroom. I've become way more proficient than in supply chain than I originally thought I would

Great teacher, she is funny and overall fair to everyone. Lecture heavy and the exams are somewhat tough since they are application-based questions. There is one presentation and a simulation grade for this class.

Felicity is a really sweet professor and very smart. However, lectures can be a bit disorganized at times and the pacing is quite slow. As long as you engage and ask questions in her class, you will succeed. This will seem like a composition class at times since she is a composer herself and enjoys composition-based projects.

Dr. Mazur-Park is a caring teacher. She is a well studied individual with quite a few degrees. She likes class involvement. She sets expectations the first class, so you are not caught off guard by anything. She likes to talk and engages well with the class.

Good luck if you are assigned her theory class. Learned very little over the year, mostly due to how incredibly dysfunctional and disorganized her teaching style is. Be prepared to teach yourself most of the material before going into this class.

I've had Ferrell every semester I've been at TCU. Brilliant guy! Very funny and respects students. If you attend class, understand the notes (very simple!) and do the readings, you'll get an A! Don't be afraid to speak up. One of the smartest profs at TCU hands down!

he is so engaging, knowledgable and just amazing all around. While attendance is not mandatory you'll actually want to show up he's so good. Clear grading, have to work but not ridiculously hard to get an A. Very understanding and accessible. You'll learn a lot and love the class. Not a ton of reading either

I took him for ethnography and cultural criminology. absolutely my FAVORITE teacher that I have ever had. really cares about his students and cares more about you learning the content, rather than just memorizing it.

The most inspirational, interesting professor I've ever had. Definitely got me motivated to learn and work towards a true understanding of some very thought-provoking topics. Every single class meeting was either mind blowing or at the very least, engaging.

One of the best professors I've ever had and one of the best at TCU. He makes class interesting and truly cares about each and every one of his students. Participate in class. His stories are awesome and the way he teaches will make you truly want to learn! Take any class he offers, you won't be disappointed! Great professor and great man!!
One of the most interesting classes I have ever taken. Very passionate and nice.

Hands down favorite professor at TCU! He is so passionate about what he teaches, is constantly engaging the class, and makes any material exciting. TAKE HIM for anything possible! I took pop culture as an elective, best class ever and pretty easy and interesting!

Ethnography. I've never had a professor so enthusiastic about his field. Really engages text. Will blow your mind sometimes. Engages each individual student equally. Personable. Assignments are short and fun, but not busywork. All three tests are short answer/essay, but he makes the material really easy to understand and retain. 10 page term paper.

He is an absolutely brilliant man and a fascinating lecturer, but if you're accustomed to objective tests/subjects, this class might throw you off your game. You've really got to understand the theories/concepts well to succeed on the tests. Definitely go talk to him about the ethnography project to make sure you're going in the right direction.

I honestly did not think I would find the content of the class interesting, but Ferrell proved me wrong. He is so passionate about what he teaches and is more than willing to help. I loved the in-class discussions and the historic information he brought up. Take good notes in class and read the book, and you'll do fine.

Easily the greatest teacher I have ever had. I HIGHLY recommend any one taking any of his classes. I gaurentee that you will enjoy his class whether or not you think you are going to enjoy the topic. His real world experience and work prove to be an amazing teaching tool that encourages your best work. A+ teacher. Only negative is that he uses + -

This prof. is the BEST! If you can get into his class, do it! I was a freshman when I took his Junior level class. There is a good amount of reading but his class is amazing! You will not regret it! He loves what he does and does it better then anyone!

A passionate and animated professor of sociology. I took his course on Popular Culture. He is a published author and respected among sociologist around the nation so his overall knowledge of this topic is extremely extensive! Attendance is a must because the exam questions come from his lectures so take thorough notes! Enjoyable.

I attended class everyday and was never quite sure what my grade was. He was a very passionate teacher and interested in what he talked about, but gave out random assignments  I felt like we went over a lot of the same thing and we only took two tests. I made an A on the first but the final came from nowhere and attending class was then pointless.

Interesting class, with one hell of a professor. One of the best TCU has to offer. Energetic,fun, funny and helpful. Totally willing to spend the time to make sure you understand, and loves class discussion. Cares about his students and what he teaches. Find a way to take one of his classes!!!

One hell of a teacher.  His tests can be tricky, but if you give some effort a B is attainable.  I am a business major and took this class as an elective, and I have never seen a teacher with more enthusiasm and passion for what he does.  A very interesting class made even better by an exceptional professor.

He is the most inspirational professor you will ever have.  His boundless enthusiasm and energy have inspired me to pursue cultural criminological studies in graduate school.  Not only is he is a clear, well-organized lecturer, but also a wonderful human being.  Take every class you can from this man.
Great professor. He is interesting, obviously knowledgeable, and has good stories. Sometimes gets over excited about some subjects... tests are kinda hard, but easy enough to make a B on.

This class is weird. Your whole grade is just three tests which sounds easy but his MC tests are VERY tricky and you can either get an easy A or bomb the whole class! He is an enjoyable professor who loves teaching but his lectures never match what is on the test. Class is best only for CRJ majors.

Best prof @ TCU, hands down.  Cares about the subject, willing to talk about anything, brilliant lectures.  Awesome professor + interesting topic = great experience. Work hard and get an A, slack and get a B/C.
This guy is better than pizza...and I really, really love pizza.

One of the best Professors I have ever had.  He obviously loves his job.  I felt like what I was learning was very relevant to the real world, and I learned alot.  His tests are not impossible, but I often disagreed with the way he graded and/or wrote them.

The best professor @ TCU! This prof. loves what he does and is great at it. He is very passionate so classes are extremely interesting.  You must read & take notes, but the content is not boring or hard at all. Easy B, work a little harder for an A (not too much harder).

Dr. Ferrel is a great Teacher, if you looking for a interesting but Fair class, take any from him.He is very helpful, if needed. Go to class for the notes that is about 50% of his test the other is 50% readings but they are not difficult or overly long.

Do not leave TCU without taking at least one class from this guy.  The way college classes should be!  Brilliant and a leader in his field.  Do your work for an easy B, study for an A.  I learned more from one class, than three years of others in college!

Best prof I've ever had!  He's clear, interesting, charasmatic, & passionate about his work.  He knows his stuff firsthand.  Know your text & notes and you'll be golden.  Don't skip class...you won't want to.  Come ready to think.

Dr. Ferrell is a brilliant professor.  His classes are very interesting, because he shows you a new way to view society in which you have never even thought of before.  Very big on class participation, but it doesn;t effect your grade.  Easy B.
great prof.

No matter what you do, take at least one class from Dr. F while you're at TCU.  This is what college is supposed to be, and this is what every professor should strive to be.  Read his books, take his class, sift through his garbage -- this man is amazing!

He is a great teacher,the class is a lot of fun.His tests are easy if you know your notes&the readings.The class is mainly theory but he makes it interesting.Take this class its an easy A plus he talks about how to become a marijuana user!

Great teacher! He was always cheerful and was great at answering questions.  I learned a lot from him, and thought his grading was fair.  Great guy, and great teacher.  Start EGUMPP early though! Start right away!!!!!

Super friendly and helpful professor. His lectures can be kind of tedious and repetitive but you learn from the work he assigns in class. Textbook is used for in class work. No homework. Overall, good class and good teacher.

Best professor at TCU.  He is a really caring and friendly guy, who will go out of his way to help you in any way possible.  His passion for news writing is contagious, and one of the reasons I have continued to take reporting classes, despite being an advertising/business major.
Very nice professor, you can definitely tell he cares what he does, note his lectures some times are confusing but he makes his quizzes and exam pretty easy since also their open note.
Awesome professor and everything was open notes! Definitely recommend taking him!
I am a veteran who was horrible at math before. This class is extremely easy, and Feghali is an amazing professor. Anyone who struggles is just lazy.

When I took his course a long time ago at M.U. he wanted me to pay him $ 75 an hour to help me with my homework; I refused. I was not surprised when I learned that he sent students to one of his friends for "tutoring" hoping to get a percentage of the $ 2,000 the friend asked for to do the assignements for them. He has no scruples.
Horrible teacher, but is super nice. Gives a lot of extra credit opportunities. Easy enough to get an A. 3 pop quizzes a semester which are easy just make sure to not skip class those days.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: he mumbles incomprehensibly during the lectures and is often confused and disoriented. Not recommended at all.
Horrible teacher but you can pull off an A with minimal effort.
Good teacher and makes his class very easy - also I cheated on every test and got an A
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: BEST PROFESSOR EVER! I can't recommend Dr. Feghali enough! You are truly so lucky to have him as a teacher and has taught me so much more than just math. I'm going to miss his class so much and would take it again if I could! He is the most caring, helpful and sweet professor ever and truly wants his students to succeed and do well! Best ever!

Dr. Feghali is a very kind, caring professor who is very passionate about math. There are only three homework assignments and three multiple choice exams. The homework is all online, and pretty easy to get 100%. The tests are all multiple choice and have around 20 questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: So SO kind!! He cares so much about his students and really wants us to understand. Most classes we just worked on 2 problems, but learned a lot from each. There's only 3 tests which are open note and 20 multiple choice. Homework is on Pearson my lab and due before each test. He always offers to buy his students coffee. Best prof I've had by far!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Feghali was one of the nicest professors! The study guide is the exam with different numbers and he gos over it in class and is very approchable if you need help outside of class.
Great teacher to fulfill Stats credit, pretty easy class by design and explains concepts well. Nice dude and cares about success of students.

Dr. Feghali is hands down one of my favorite professors. He was very kind and made the class very approachable. He also made it where it was so easy to approach him with questions or have a conversation with him.

He's super sweet and you'll grow to love him. You have to try in order to understand the material but it's totally doable. Go to his office hours if you have any questions and he'll give you tips that will be really helpful for the quiz! There's only a couple tests so take them seriously but definitely take him if you need a Stats credit!

Dr. Feghali was perhaps the best professor I've had at TCU. Weekly homework online that gives you three tries before the question is marked wrong. Three exams are open notes.  He is funny and caring. Attendance is not mandatory but he gives you points for coming to class. The class is not overwhelming but it requires attention. Take him if you can!

Professor Feghali is a great professor who cares for his students and cares for you to know the topic. The reason I made the grade I made was because of me and nothing he did wrong. He's a very knowledgable man who makes math sort of fun. If you need to take a STATS class take his.
Great professor with lectures, but only graded by 2 exams and the final. However, all exams are open note. Offers extra credit opportunities. Really nice professor overall.

Only one homework assignment per week. He is available by text and email fairly quickly. He likes to engage students in lectures and makes sure that every student understands the material before moving on.

He is one of the best/easiest Stats teachers, but is pretty boring. Weekly online homework but it is pretty easy to get an A. Tests are open notes. Takes attendance randomly for a grade. He is an understanding professor so if you need help or an extension reach out to him!

He is an amazing prof that cares about his students I definitely recommend taking his class. He lets you use notes on all exams so make sure you pay attention, you can even print the PowerPoint. If you correct any of his mistakes he also gives you extra credit so don't be afraid to speak up. He made lectures really interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Feghali is the best. He is so nice and really wants his students to succeed. He's also entertaining and funny too. I hated stats before this class but passed with a solid A because he's a good teacher. He lets you use all your notes during tests to which is great. If you participate in class he will like you a lot and help you more.

Prof Feghali is passionate about statistics, which makes the boring topic more interesting. Once, I slept right in front of him and he was still nice and explained things to me. If you pay attention and do the homework to practice, it's not too difficult. Def recommend printing the slides ahead of class 6 slides/pg and taking notes on that.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: LOVED DR. FEGHALI! He teaches the material at a good pace that is understandable, but not boring. He is extremely aware that online school and anything college and covid related is stressful and took time to check in with students. He is a great and interesting person.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: The class is extremely lecture heavy, but the lecture doesn't clearly relate to our assignments. Attendance is not mandatory, but if you miss class you'll miss him doing the assignments. Pay attention in class and it will help at least help on assignments. The exams are open note, but very confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Statistics Intro class. Self-proclaimed math hater here; Dr. Feghali was fantastic and gave us every tool we needed to succeed. Tests open book so we can APPLY the theories instead of just memorizing them. NEED to pay attention to lectures and not zone out; he gives very clear explanations and I took a LOT of notes from lecture that helped me
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: He is the sweetest man ever, if you are struggling, he will meet with you to help you, and most of the time, just give you credit. If everyone does badly on tests, he raises everyone's grade. He loves stats, but it's so boring. He does take attendance five times in the semester, and you don't know when that will be. Every test is an open book.

I took Applied Calculus with Dr. Feghali. He isn't worried about whether you can memorize the formulas and such, but rather if you can apply them. All his tests were open book. Really easy going, you shouldn't have any problem.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Feghali is hands down the best elementary stats professor. Gives less homework than other stats professors & will do everything in his power to help you understand if something doesnt make sense. If you show up to class most of the time and do the homework you should get an A. Also everything is multiple choice which is great

This is what I wish every math teacher was like. I highly recommend taking this class. Mr. Feghali is hilarious, caring, and is always willing to meet students outside of class for extra math help. He is very prompt in responding to emails. The thought of taking a Stats class terrified me, but it ended up being a pleasant surprise.

Although I received a B, i easily could've gotten an A. Mr. Feghali is an amazing human and should definitely be the choice if you're looking for a math teacher. This guy WANTS his students to do well. It should've been an easy A, i honestly just had to focus on other classes that i was slacking in. Would 10/10 retake again.

Take Dr. Feghali for stats!! He's so funny and nice. Every class is entertaining. All tests and quizzes are open note too so it's a very easy class. I am NOT good at math whatsoever and I am doing well in this class.

Class was not mandatory but even if you went it did not help for the homework assignments. Would show slides of code but not explain how they relate to the homework. Had to basically guess how to write the code. The actual class is very dull too as he stands and lectures for a straight 1 1/2 hours off a slideshow that isn't even his. Test open note
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Feghali is a cute old man that cracks dad jokes all the time. Open note quizzes, test and final so take good notes and write down examples he gives for reference later in exams. Homework due at end of semester but do not wait until last minute, because there's a lot.

Feghali should be your go-to choice for any math class you need that he's teaching. He's not only nice; he's also more than reasonable in allowing open-note everything (quizzes, tests, even the final). A good part of his courses tend to be calculator based, so nothing could truly be easier. Funny guy with a cool accent. I would definitely recommend

TAKE HIM FOR APPLIED PRECAL. You use your computer for notes - pull up the powerpoints - he lets you use your notes AND computer if your notes are on there. EVERYONE uses this opportunity to do well on the quizzes & tests i.e. cheat. He may be foreign but hes funny and very considerate towards your needs! Dont need a textbook. homeworks are online

MOST AMAZING PROFESSOR I'VE EVER HAD! All tests and quizzes are open notes and he posts the lectures on D2L. He is truly an amazing teacher, and I would literally take him for any class! This is my second time having him at TCU.
All tests and quizzes are open book, including final. The book has directions on how to do problems in the calculator, so I taught myself the subject during the tests. No homework.
Probably one of the best math professors I've ever had. Takes time to help you understand. He lets us use notes on our quizzes and our tests! Highly recommend Dr. Feghali!!

Feghali's class was open book and open notes class for every quiz and test. Before every "pop" quiz he gave out practice quizzes that were exactly like the graded quizzes. And before every test he did the same. He posted all notes online. Because of his accent he can be hard to understand sometimes but that's the only downside.
Easiest elementary statistics teacher by far. Everything is open note, open book. No need to read or do homework. Highly recommend

Fife is so sweet! Her class is all lecture. Not hard material but lots of memorizing when it comes to the exams. There are quite a few exams but she gives you a study with all the info you need to know. Online quizzes due before each class. Virtual baby and adult super easy and fun. Take her!

This class was definitely a relief from other courses taken this semester. The lifespan assignments are super easy and straightforward at your own pace. The study guide that she provides for the exams are pretty similar to the exam.
She is so sweet! She is very passionate and had a career in nursing. Take her class!
she is the best! so sweet and i find it to not be too difficult! take fife if you can!!!

Professor Fife is one of the nicest and most caring professors I have ever had. Lifespan is fun and not time consuming. She has a wealth of knowledge about the nursing world and gives great career advice outside of just the class. I've heard she is an angle compared to some of the other lifespan professors as well. 10/10

Dr Fife is a very caring and experienced professor. Her experience in the nursing field is strong and she is very passionate. She does read off the slides which is boring but you don't really need to pay attention to get an A.
Her tests are exactly like the study guides. You do have to sign in for attendance but she doesn't care if you are late and you are allowed a few absences

Very very boring class but she is so kind. I never payed attention to the lectures and would just fill out and study the review she would post and always got great grades on the test. The class is quite boring and is completely just lectures but not a hard class at all if you do the homework quizzes, virtual child, and tests.

Dr Fife is a very personable professor. Her work in the nursing field provided a strong sense of passion throughout her class. Her lectures are often reading off the slides, which gets boring. She has 5 exams and no cumulative final. You could skip class (we get 6 absences) and be completely fine for the exam. At home, open book quizzes. So easy.

LLLOOOVVEEEE. this class was very lecture heavy. But she just went over the book. Honestly if you have any background at all in nursing, this class will not be hard for you. Fife is so caring and genuinely wants you to succeed. Attendance is preferred, but she wont say anything until a certain amount of absences have been reached. xo

Mrs. Fife is awesome! She has so much experience regarding human development and her lectures reflect that. There are a lot of chapter quizzes, at least one or two due every week. There is also a my virtual child activity. The test are not hard if you just study the study guide.

Professor Fife is so kind and cares about her students. Because of her experience as a nurse, she knows much of what she is teaching firsthand. Attendance is mandatory and you definitely need to pay attention/do study guides for the tests but if you do that, the class is so easy.

This class is not that bad. Fife allows you to have 6 free absences before your grade is affected. Class is all lecture but tests are not awful as long as you look over study guide. Homework on quizzes on the textbook (if taking this class, make note of these quiz questions/answers because they are sometimes on tests)

Probably the easiest nursing class you will have to take. Dr. Fife has 5 exams (50 questions), 15 chapter quizzes (open notes), and an online project (my virtual child). She provides study guides for her exams and if you study those you will get an A. Her lectures are very long and can get boring, but she is very sweet and the class is super easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class itself is very easy. There are open note quizzes every week, 5 exams, and a super easy virtual child project. This is a very easy class to put on the back burner until an exam comes along. Going to the class can become very boring cause she just reads the powerpoint notes while you sit there. But she is super sweet and easy.

Awesome prof. She really cares about your learning and that you understand and truly enjoys what she teaches. Its not the easiest class due to it being a STEM class but Dr. Fife makes it as easy as possible to pass her class. There are 5 tests and one project. The tests are manageable and found that with an hour or two of studying you'll do fine.

SUPER easy class if you're nursing and also taking micro and nutrition and worried about the workload. This class is lecture heavy and there are 5 exams, but her exam review guides are super straightforward - nothing will be on the test that's not on the review. You get 6 free skips and she's really sweet!

If you are choosing between human development professors, TAKE FIFE. She is very knowledgeable in the overall nursing career and truly knows what she is teaching. She is very caring and really wants you to succeed. The class consists of 5 exams (no cumulative final), a untimed open book online quiz before each class, and a fun virtual child project

Dr. Fife is AMAZING. she's one of those professors that genuinely cares for her students and their success. She gives study guides for the tests, just make sure you read (or at least skim) the textbook because some of the exam questions come from there or are more in depth than her powerpoints. She does extra credit as well! Love her

Dr. Fife is a really sweet professor. If you are interested in the content it is fairly easy to stay engaged and do well on exams. Her lectures can get boring at times, but for the most part the information is useful. She is really easy to talk to and gives extra.She also reviews exams and SOMETIMES gives back points. Definitely would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Fife was awesome and very sweet! The tests and quizzes are a majority of the grade, but she has detailed reviews that helped me a ton. An easy course if you take the time to review and read the book. As a nursing student, Dr. Fife is the best. Take her for this class!
So much love for Dr. Fife. Such an amazing professor and mentor. Her study guides are literally the tests, so if you just study that you are guaranteed to get an A on exams

I loved Dr. Fife! She was very sweet and I enjoyed listening to her stories about when she was a nurse. Make sure to do well on the exams because there aren't many other assignments. Do the study guides in detail (some of the exam questions come directly from the textbook) and you'll do great!

Professor Fife is one of the sweetest professors I have had, and truly cares about making sure everyone understands the content and is doing well. Going to class is just listening to her talk over the powerpoint, but she has a 6 absence rule so it's not smart to miss. Tests are easy A if you do the study guide.

She is a sweet lady, but the class was a bit boring. If I skipped class I wouldn't have missed anything. All you do is read the textbook and take quizzes that go with it. Virtual child was fun. Tests are straight from her study guides. Pretty self explanatory class.

I look up to this teacher now. She was a great professor and mentor. She was able to give me feed back and sit down with me after every test. Definitely would take her. Test heavy but if you read the book and lectures you'll be fine. Such an inspiration!

Dr. Fife is a super sweet women, and cares about her students. The class is an easy A as long as you take the time to read the textbook, go to class, and do the assignments. She also tells good stories about her experiences as a certified nurse midwife.

Fife is a wonderful professor. She is SO sweet and truly cares about her student's well being. Her tests and quizzes are not that hard, and if you study you will get an A easily. You can tell she is really passionate about nursing, I really enjoyed having her.

Mrs. Fife get's really defensive if you come up to her to explain a question - on an exam, 3 of the 4 questions could all be from the book and be correct, and if you get it wrong, she'll ask you to have chosen the "best" one. How are you supposed to do that? Powerpoint slides are outdated, keeps recycling old material. Would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She taught a 3-hour lecture, and it was sometimes challenging to just sit in the class. She sometimes says some private stuff regarding her family and I got uncomfortable when she did. I didn't miss any lecture because she tells you what questions are going to be on the exam. She gives extra credit and gives points back on exams and quizzes too.

Don't even bothering looking at the powerpoints for this class. Although attendance isn't mandatory, I would highly recommend going because she gives out test questions. When doing the study guide, make sure to do it from the book! All questions are pulled straight from the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Be prepared to READ the textbook, and do the reviews. You don't need to go to class and honestly, her lectures are incredibly boring. Fairly easy, but was happy when the class was over. Her powerpoints are pointless, stick to the textbook. The weekly quizzes honestly take a long time, but you can get 100's on them.

Susan Fife - what a gem. Her Human Development course is the most ideal course there is. As long as you show up to lecture, do your online quizzes, and study for the tests, this is a guaranteed A. Make sure to come to class because she will tell you the key things you need to focus on which helps SO MUCH for the exams.

Easily, one of my favorite classes I have taken in college! Although I took this as a (once a week) Monday night class, she finds a way to make the class fun and enjoyable! She doesn't make her class unnecessarily difficult, so if you pay attention in lecture and actually study for the tests it is very easy to get an A!

The class consists of virtual child journals (really easy), online quizzes (can use book), and 5 m.c. tests. The fifth test is the final and it isn't cumulative. You can easily get an A in this class! Mrs. Fife is really nice too!
I took her class in the Fall semester and she was amazing. She graded the midterm and final project easily, gave a lot of extra credit as well!
Super easy class with one weekly homework, a midterm, and a final group presentation. Not the most approachable but makes it straightforward.
Take her. Easiest Blaw professor by

Keeps class relatively short. Her midterm is literally just the study guide she gives you, so super easy to do well on that. She is not the most friendly, but her class is really easy. Definitely would take her again.

She is a super chill professor and easy grader. You have weekly homework but it's super easy, a midterm but she gives you a study guide and the exam is exactly the same, and the final is a group presentation.
she is the best! by far my fav professor ever. had her for a night class, and she let us out an hour early every time. one assignment per week and it's super easy. take her!!!!

Dr. Fike is very straight forward. She might come off passive aggressive at times to the class just because of careless people who don't listen or pay attention and then blame her for that. She will work with you if you need help. She also curves grades for the exams and has an extra credit opportunity. You will have to be prepared to read.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is a really great lecture. Take this course if you want to build a strong foundation in Microeconomics.

Dr. Fike gives clear lectures with real-world examples. There are four exams including the final, and many questions are similar to homework and exam review questions. If you keep up with textbook readings and homework, you can do well. The class is not easy but you can learn a lot from it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: if you have her you will have to study and work hard but she is fair and knows the subject and curves tests. definitely reccomend doing extra credit (its an easy short essay which she always gives full credit for) and she is very open and willing to help you if you visit her office. hard class regardless of the professor but i would take her.

She is super passive-aggressive and will talk to you like you are 5 years old. She gives really hard tests, but does curve it and has extra credit opportunities. Study WAY more than you think you need to. She does like it when you go in for office hours and ask questions.

Fike is very passive agressive and if she doesn't like you early on you are in trouble the rest of the way. I Believe she gives you work like her class in the only one you have. If you can take another teacher take them
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is the hardest professor I've ever taken. I was a 4.0 student walking in, and I am no longer a 4.0 student. The work load is insane. Homework and quizzes would take me 4-5 hours to complete. We had multiple exams where literally no one got an A. Her exams are extremely challenging. She can be nice, but that's about it. Good luck.

She tried her best to make lectures engaging, and they were, but her exams were so so hard. They are multiple choice and short answer and they were really tough. There are other grades in the class though like online chapter quizes that help supplement the grade. She is a great professor just a tough class.

Intermediate Macro with Fike definitely had a good structure to it, the syllabus was explicit and we stuck it for the most part. Dr. Fike knows what she is talking about and is accessible outside of class, but the class is a grind. She can be extremely passive aggressive sometimes and it really puts a damper on motivation for the class sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: it's a hard class but she knows what she's talking about and focuses her lectures on difficult concepts (graphs and problems) that you need to know. she flies through all definitions and most other notes though so you'll have to do lots of work catching up. she's kinda mean when you go in for office hours but is pretty reasonable and is pretty fair
The class is hard and her exams are very brutal but she is a good professor.

This was a tough class but I would recommend taking it with Dr. Fike! She provides all the information needed to succeed and will help you if you need. Her lectures are helpful and she walks through practice problems. Get ready to put a lot of effort in and spend a lot of time on this class, but it is worth it.
you are graded on showing up to class everyweek. Good lectures but are very long. Tests are always online via lockdown brower in class, but all quizzes are taken outside of class online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great doing lectures, work for your grade and you'll be alright.

Lots of reading and writing. Nothing chat can't do, though. She is highly enthusiastic about economics and would be a great connection if you are interested in developing your skills in the field. You do have to do 3 -4 papers that are 6 pages each...

so so bad, if you have other options TAKE THEM. assigns so much stuff, had her for 2 classes at the same time, and my life was hell. I would think about stopping in the middle of the road when crossing the university so I wouldn't have to go to class. I'm not a bad student and got below 50% on the first two tests. I was an academic victim last sem

She has moments where she cares and is nice, and then she turns horrible and unfair. There was a classmate of ours who needed a 0.5 grade bump that her scholarship depended on but the professor didn't give it. It's clear that she doesn't like Macro and she makes it everyone's problem.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: she is willing to help in office hours, however, she is a very picky grader. I have taken both the intermediate macro and contending perspectives at different times. in her macro she doesn't seem like she wants to be there and is very snappy if you ask questions during her lectures. in contending, she is more passionate abt. Wouldn't take it again

Hardest teacher I've had in my life. Took contending and macro with her at the same time - Macro it seems like she just hates her life. Gives you tons of side eye, makes you feel stupid when you ask a question, and is the neediest grader ever. I do not recommend if you want to have a life still. Lots of assignments that take hours.

Dr. Fike is a really good professor, probably my favorite at TCU. This class was discussion-base which required a lot of reading ahead of time and minimal participation in the discussion. It initially seemed annoying, but it helps you understand the material. Fike makes an effort to help you understand the material. I hope to be taking her again!

Dr. Fike is a great and dedicated professor. She really cares about her students and has mastered the material. I am using this class as an econ elective and the content exceeded my expectations. Your grade is made up of handwritten notes, three exams, and the final group project. It is a very interesting class and she is a great teacher.

Definitely one of "those" professors. She is extremely passionate about the subject (Public Choice). However, this makes her an incredibly hard grader and I found a lot of her critiques unnecessary for a class of this caliber. The content is very dense and she makes no effort to simplify it so you'd best lock in. Oh and there's a brutal group proj
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Fike is a great teacher her class just has so much reading. Good course and you will learn a lot, but there is so much information. It made it hard to study for tests because I had no idea what to study. Very easy to contact and meet with at office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Fike is a wonderful professor! The lectures are informative and interesting, and although the class is reading-heavy, the work load is definitely manageable. Dr. Fike is also very accessible outside of class and wants her students to succeed.

Dr. Fike is one of the best econ profs I've had. As are definitely achievable, but she will make you put in the work. I've had her for 2 classes so far and she's consistently super knowledgeable and interesting. She's friendly and knows all her students' names. There are a lot of assignments to complete, BUT they prepare you really well for tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class was very difficult, but it was also a very interesting one. One thing to beware of is that there are always assignments. A standard week had two long discussion board answers on Wednesday, a response to those by Friday, and a quiz on Sunday.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Fike is amazing! Her lectures are engaging, and clearly she's passionate about Public Choice. I cannot stress this enough... the course shell on D2L is so clear, and the assignments occur with a regular cadence. There are no surprises, and you know exactly what to expect and how much to study each week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Fike is one of the best econ professors I have had at TCU. While she does grade tough and lectures have a lot of material, she always wants the best for her students and keeps them engaged.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took her for contending perspectives and she made an easy foundation course seem like a weed-out class. Better study each theory of thought, the exams you are expected to remember a lot of content.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr Fike is one of the best professors that I know. She is not only very good at explaining the materials but she is also very accessible outside of class. She has office hours  4 days a week and very helpful. She cares about students' successes and helps students with employment opportunities. The tests and quizzes are doable TAKE HER!!!!!!!

Let me start with this: if you don't put in the work you won't get a good grade. That said, Professor Fike is probably one of the best teachers in the Econ department. She definitely will make you work for your grade, so don't expect an easy A. She knows the subject well, is always prepared, and is always available for questions if you have them.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There is way too much information you need to know for this class and more work than any other class Ive ever taken. She also very clearly does not like certain students for no reason, and comes across as mean.

Fike is a great teacher and clearly knows what she's talking about. She speaks in a way that you want to listen, and class can be very engaging. If you listen in class and take notes, you can avoid reading the (lengthy) weekly assignments. The homework is easy. Exams should be studied for- essay questions test your actual knowledge.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is a ton of work but you can get a good grade if you put in effort. I was nervous taking this class, but Dr. Fike is awesome. She gives you credit where it's worth when grading. There's a reading quiz every week, but she gives you guiding questions (which you should answer), and lets you ask clarifying questions before you take the quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very good teacher, she is a tough grader but gives fair credit when you have the idea of what you are talking about, enjoyed going to her class made me want to never skip lectures. recommend to read and give her assignments a couple of hours to work on. Super accessible outside of class, will be very straightforward.

She does a good job teaching each school of thought, but be prepared to write/type a lot. Make sure to participate in class and limit missing class or being late. Exams are a mix of short answers, short essays, and a long essay.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Writes everything on the board, copy it word for word and you'll be fine. She gives a review for every test and the questions come straight from it. Tests are all short answer/essay so you can't BS your way through. Grades really nicely and wants you to succeed. Easy A if you go to class and get the info. Sometimes has reading quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Get ready to write; Dr. Fike hand writes everything on the whiteboard and talks as she writes. If you skip class it will be very hard for you to pass. She does a great job explaining the topics and making the subject interesting. The tests are strictly short answer and essay so that you can prove what you know; if you don't study you won't pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Solid professor... the class isn't too hard, although a lot of the work is sort of busy work. Participation matters and a lot of the class is based on group work. She grades fairly though and the material isn't overly difficult. The lectures are good, but sometimes they feel redundant and things are covered twice or for more time than necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: loved Dr. Fike!! If you go to office hours she helps you so much and she gives lots of partial credit on tests. There are quizzes in class but she drops the lowest grades and they are super easy if you read!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I had her for Intermediate Macro as a freshman, and honestly, though the course was tough, it wasn't impossible.  As long as you try, she almost never takes off full points on exams and is really very generous when it comes to grading.  The textbook has powerpoint slides that help with the reading A LOT, and really reinforce her thorough lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Shes nice if you put forth effort into the class. She will respect you if you make intelligent conversation or try to contribute. Being a smartass is not going to help you here. Go to lecture and study 2-3 days in advance and you will get an A-.

AVOID HER!! It's her first year and makes the class unnecessarily hard. She's always in a mood and hates people who work out. Her first test was so long that no one even finished. I've honestly learned nothing and dropped before the deadline.

She is flexible and willing to work with her students so that you understand the material and have enough time to complete homework and tests. The tests and quizzes reflect what's been covered in class so they aren't unreasonably difficult. Overall, she's a pretty decent professor.

First year teaching so it was a learning process for her too..... lectures are long and sometimes confusing. There was only a midterm and a final which is tough  for economics.... she is very nice and will help you out if you go to office hours

LOVED taking this professor. She made lecture fun and interesting. She was super caring and helpful, she also made class personal even though it was a lecture of 200 students. She constantly asked for feedback and would always listen to what was working/not working for us. Overall really enjoyed the class
She's a wonderful professor. Her class was tough but she made it interesting. I got sick during the semester and she was incredibly caring, understanding, and accommodating.
Kostelich is a very hard grader that thinks a C is a good grade. She is a nice person and good teacher, but expect an extremely hard class.
Definitely take any english class with Professor Kostelich! She is one of my favorite TCU professors!

Seriously one of the best professors, and one of the best persons I've ever had the pleasure of knowing and working with. I've taken two courses with her and managed A's in both. Does take work, but she is super approachable and always willing to help. Definitely take her if you get the chance.

I love Mrs. K! She's the best and her assignments are really fun and personal. This is definitely a class that will require a lot of your time (writing papers and researching.) She allows you to revise your papers at the end of the semester which is a great opportunity to raise your grade. She's very approachable and available outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: She is super nice and honestly wants to hear what her students have to say. She is willing to help you as much as you need with papers and has a lot of in class work shopping. This class has a ton of homework and you are constantly writing papers, but she grades accurately and is a great teacher.
She's super sweet and helpful! If you put in a decent amount of work you will do well!!

Dr. Kostelich is by far my favorite professor and goes above and beyond to help all of her students! I hated writing prior to her class and my perspective has changed so much that I am actually taking her next-level class when it is offered. A GREAT professor who wants you to succeed, and offers revision opportunities for essays. Take her class!

TAKE HER CLASS!! She is So sweet and always willing to help you out. She basically just leads a class discussion over what we read. The readings were always really interesting and pretty short. You have to write a couple of papers but they weren't hard and she lets you revise them a lot of times!
Great class, very good teacher who is always willing to help you with your work.  Grades hard though so listen to comments and you will be fine
Take any other Freshman Speech course
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Nice woman who is trying to give you presentation skills for the workplace. You work with one group for the whole semester on 2 large group projects, plus 2 exams and an optional final. Lots of easy reading quizzes, but you have to read in depth if you want to do well on exams. Not the toughest grader in the world, but the group projects take work.
Such a TOUGH and  difficult professpr :( I felt hopeless

I had Dr. Finn teaching my class and she is the sweetest woman ever. I loved having her as a professor but I absolutely hated the preps and how tough she graded on them. They seemed kind of pointless and so time consuming. She grades pretty hard on the two speeches and if you study for the the midterm and final, you should get at least a B.

Class was taught by Dr. FINN in person every time. I'm unsure what this TA stuff is I'm reading.  All lectures and assignments and even tests are available online from day 1!!! Easy  Must give 2 speeches which are difficult because there's a required way to do them.  The hardest part are midterms and finals which employ full trickery on topics.

Dr. Finn is so sweet and her classes are usually pretty interesting. She taught my Communications class, not a TA, and she was always very attentive to student needs and very clear in what she wanted from us. I got a lot out of this class, but prepare to do A LOT of homework and give a few speeches.

Taught by TA's, Derreck Lanier was mine- nice and helpful guy. No class on Fridays and you take online testslectures weekly at home instead. 2 tests and a final that are quite tricky- study the vocab and read the book. They grade speeches very hard, so make sure you do your best on those because they find ways to take away points!

Save yourself and passfail the class. The TA is awesome and grades speeches and assignments fairly. However, the course director must not realize what the TA's are actually teaching because her tests are impossible. You could read every chapter of the book and still not make higher than a C. Take notes on the online assignments so you can pass.
Literally hate this class so much. It's the worst, definitely would NOT recommend taking it at all...

Class taught by a TA, so class difficulty and quality vary. No class on Friday, but long online assignment every week. Tests were kind of hard, sometimes covered random statistics from margin of book or something. If you read for the tests, you should do fine. Easy B, A takes effort (At least on tests). 2 speeches that weren't too hard, but got B's

This class is taught by a TA. No class on Friday but an annoying 100 question online assignment due every Friday night. Tests are confusing speeches are graded way too hard. You'd be better off just taking a regular speech class than this online component one.

Do not buy the workbook. It is 20 pages of useless information, and then 60 pages of the same peer evaluation forms. Do not buy the text book, because you can find all of the information for tests online. Only show up to class on the days that assignments are due, and beware of TAs that overestimate how much anyone cares about the course.

You know a class is a breeze when the teacher creates incentive for attendance by grade bonus. Seriously, just check your outlines with the TA and do the online assignments and you've got yourself an A.

Dr. Finn is the best! I highly recommend taking her. She is so sweet & I learned a lot from her training class. It was one of my favorite classes in the comm department! Tests are multiple choice. 1 presentation.

The teacher for this class is a TA. Regardless of the TA, the class martial is the same. The speeches are easy, but the tests can be a bit harder. There is a good amount of homework, which counts heavily towards your grade. Overall, this class was easy, and there is an attendance bonus. I recommend this class.

Like everyone has already said, she doesn't actually teach the class. The course itself is super easy. The speeches/tests can be prepared for the night before. Take this class for an easy oral comm credit.

You will NEVER see this professor. Your not even allowed to email her. Only 2 speeches but the tests are actually hard. But I think if your getting paid maybe you should actually teach the class. She wouldnt round my grade from 89.69 or many others. Personally, I would choose another professor who actually gets off their butt and teaches students.

I have never actually seen Dr. Finn, her classes are taught by TAs. You only have to present two speeches, which are graded pretty easily. There is just lots of group work and annoying activities in the class and you have an online assignment almost every Friday.

Amber Finn does not actually teach this class, it is taught by a TA. The TA I had was Ben St. John. He is kind of a hardass, but he seems to be an okay guy and a fair grader. However, the class as a whole is much harder than it ought to be. Test questions are vague, and you're likely to get a B or lower unless you work really really hard.

This is a SUPER EASY class IF!!! you do the work. Just practice your speeches and you will get A's. Study some for the tests and you'll get B's. And then do all the homeworks and evaluations which are easy 100's and you will get an A. Simple!

DONT BLOW OFF THE ONLINE QUIZZES. SHE WILL ONLY BUMP YOU UP IF YOU ARE .5 AWAY FROM MAKING AN A AT THE END. TRIPLESPEAK IS THE BEST PART. TAKE THE 8 WEEK. ITS NOT EVEN HARD. DEPENDS ON WHAT TA YOU GET. SOME OF THEM AREN'T SO LENIENT.

T.A.'s teach the class, take the 8 week and get it out of the way, go to class because it hurts your grade if you don't. Not a difficult class at all. Just study for the tests by reading the chapters in book the night before. Practice your speeches at least twice and you will get an A. The podcasts are useless, no need to listen to them

She doesnt teach the class, but she is accessible and very nice.  The class is extremely easy, they constructed it for students to do well and get the credit even without an interest in public speaking.  Great class to take to get your oral comm out of the way
Doesn't even teach the class. TAs do.  She is available in her office regularly though.  She's very rigid in her grading rules.
Finn is pretty, but class is taught by a TA. Mine was good, class and tests are extremely easy. There are 2 speeches. Easy A if you just go to class and do the work.

Amber Finn does not teach this class. If you are someone who likes to see the ACTUAL teacher every once in a while, then do not take this class. Interaction with Finn is on the first day, and after that you can hear her annoying voice on the online lectures that are a waste of time. I had an excellent TA named Rachel! Other than that, easy A.

You never see the teacher except the first day of class. Then you winde up with some TA, that is young, and usually on a power trip.  I had the worst kinda of TA you can get, and she gave me a C when it was suppossed to be an easy A for me, mainly because of abscences.

Finn is the best! She will do a lot to help if you show concern. I got an A with the least possible amount of points thanks to her giving me a few points back on a test. Also take note that TA can make or break the class, because they do all the grading of speech's. Thankfully I had Rachel Lewis who was great! and super hot. Finn is pretty cute too
Honestly, The best professor I have ever taken. Such a sweet lady, who will be more than willing to go the extra mile for you. Wish I could have Amber Finn again.
Easy class- an easy A if you keep up with the reading/online lectures and prepare your speeches according to the outline.

This class is taught by a TA in class and her for the online component. This class is easy depending on who your student teachers is. Easy A with some work. The final is something you really need to study for but she curved it for my class

I took the 8wk course (online component).  The class is very easy.  Test are multiple choice/true false.  Just know definitions and the main skeleton outline of each chapter.  Just two speeches...not too bad.  If you take an 8wk course, you only see her the first day.  The labs are taught by TA's.  Really Easy B/A with a little effort.

You will only see her on the first day for 10 min. TA teaches the class. Depending on what time you take it, might have a harder TA. Tests are straight from the book, just read the terms and main points and you should be fine.  I took it at 8, not the best choice.
This class was not bad, and she wants you to get a good grade. And, she's goegeous, and this is coming from a girl. Great teacher.
Not the most terribly interesting class I've taken, but it's an easy B if you just show up, and an A for some effort.  Good teacher, willing to help out a lot if you are willing to ask.
she didn't teach the class, a TA did and he was hard! if you didn't know this was an accelerated course you're in for a big suprise.

She didn't really teach our class, we had a TA, who was AWESOME.  The class is really really easy, go, read for the tests, and then the grading is real straight forward.  This is on Par with Survey of Film for easy A's in college.  She is hot too...
She is fun and easy. She is so hot. This class should be an easy b or a for anyone who goes to class. She is cool and is willing to help.

She will not give you over a 93 on participation. She grades strangely and is rude whenever you try to talk to her about it. I would not recommend taking her. She tries to make an easy business class difficult and picks favorites.

One of the weirdest grading systems I've seen by far. It's possible to get an A on assignments, but not on participation. You can raise your hand to talk 10 times in one class period and still receive an 80. You probably have to have founded Google to get a 90. She's nice as a person, but not great as a professor.

I usually see one-sided reviews left here, so I want to leave an objective review. Her grading needs SERIOUS improving. She does not believe in A's. She gives everyone the same scores, whether you attend all classes or don't. Her baseline is 85%, but anything higher than that is nearly impossible. Worst yet, when you ask, she has no solid answer.

Teacher is absolutely ridiculous, she does not believe in giving 100s when asked why she said "I dont believe its possible the starting grade is a 85 and if you go above and beyond you can get a 94" even if you are absent and excused. all around worst teacher I have had at TCU. AVOID AT ALL COST!

I loved Mrs. Flahive. Her lecutures were amazing and her PP weren't too detailed. There were a lot of little assignments and projects but they weren't difficult. She has prepared me for my future as an SLP. Without a doubt she has been one of the best professors I have had at TCU. She offers extra credit and ultimately she sets you up for success.

Flahive is a teacher to be respected! She is very knowledgeable and really has so much to offer. She seems intimidating but truly is so motherly, caring and understanding once you get to know her. She expects a lot for her tests but if you study everything she went over in lecture you will be fine.

MEMORIZE. The tests are pretty difficult, but you MUST memorize the power points. Know everything. There is nothing you can skip over. Flahive is incredible as a teacher, but her class is difficult. She's very knowledgable, but you need to meet her halfway in order for her to help you out. You have to work hard for the good grade.

I absolutely love Ms. Flahive.  She deserves so much praise and respect for all that she does for her students.  She is very knowledgeable and is willing to pass on her wisdom to her students.  Don't think she'll just tell you the answers though!  She is tough and you will have to work REALLY hard, but the more effort you put in the more you'll get

I worked very hard in her course. I memorized the powerpoints and by the mercy of my memory I made an A, but no thanks to the teacher. From the class, I took away learning to memorize powerpoint slides. :/ Great.

Ms. Flahive is getting a bad rap from students who are not interested in her class and do not want to do any work. She is highly organized and is sure to be efficient during lectures, but she is NOT rude or hard to understand. You must make appointments to discuss questions, but she will help you.

This woman is not very nice. She has no compassion. I am surprised she is in a helping field of study. Classes with her are difficult, not so much the material, but having to be around her inflexible, close-minded self.
She makes you memorize everything in her class. She is rude and anal.

Take Dr. Flowers! She is so sweet, passionate about religion, and really knows her stuff. She gives handouts and study guides that are helpful for the tests. Yes, it's a challenging course but she makes it interesting. Be prepared for a lengthy amount of homework filled with videos and readings. If you want to do well in the class, do the work!
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Caring

reviews.comment: She made the class seem harder than it was, to me personally. None of the exams are cumulative, but there's a final essay included with the last exam that is cumulative and I felt it was unnecessary? The quizzes. They will make or break you along with the final which was 35% of the final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: If you actually thought this class was hard you should probably not waste anymore money on college... You're already a lost cause... You can show up hungover, high, dazed or otherwise and still pass. Just do what she says (read a lil and slightly pay attention) and you'll do fine. Easy A
Really sweet, but definitely the hardest class I've ever taken. Would not recommend if you don't have time to do daily readings and watch short films every. freakin. day.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Flowers is a nice teacher, willing to help you when you got trouble but I find her lecture really boring. She just talks and talks and there's not really material on class, everything tested is based on reading books and watching videos. So the knowledge is a little bit of confusing and you don't really know what to revise for test
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Dr. Flowers as a person, but honestly her class was a struggle. She makes you buy so many outside reading sources and would assign reading from them that was just too much for an intro class no one wants to take. She would also assign videos that were about an hour long. In class she would manage to cover virtually nothing  in lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Her lectures are pretty boring but she gives reviews for all of the tests. Go to class and make sure you do the homework readings carefully because her quizzes are very detail specific. Definitely possible to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: She was very nice and helpful but you have a pop quiz basically every class over long readings or assigned videos. If you miss a class for ANY REASON you don't get to make up the quizzes but she gives you 4 drops. I am an athlete and even though I was competing for the university I couldn't make things up. I originally had an A but dropped to a B+

She is a fantastic professor who shows a lot of enthusiasm and keeps the class engaged. It is a hard class and I took her at 8 am but she always made it fun! She is very helpful outside of class and will take the time to work with you as much as possible! Loved having her as a professor!

Maybe it's because I'm a senior, but this class annoyed me. It's clearly designed for baby freshmen timidly venturing into the terrifying world of college. Memorize the vocab words, go to class and be somewhat conscious for the lectures, and you'll probably get an A without breaking a sweat. Pop quizzes, so you might read for those, if you care.

Took her for honors class. Really hard class (for me), but she is extremely helpful if you seek out her help. Class was boring at times, and she went off topic often. Tests were multiple choice and essay based. Encouraged class participation and had pop quizzes often over the text book or the reading from the night before. Good teacher, but hard

My favorite professor by far! Her class is hard and requires a lot of outside work, but she does a great job at making the classes interesting and different each time.  Tests are hard and require a lot of outside preparation, but definitely possible to get an A on.  She is very involved with her students and gets to know everyone. Love her!!
Love her!! She is very nice. If you read and go to class, you can get an A. Her tests consist of essays, but she grades pretty lightly. Very knowledgable. Summer class is recommended!!
Great professor. Truly care about you and your grades. Very nice and easy to talk you. Have a bad grade? Don't hesitate to come see her to talk about it and do tons of extra credits!

class is challenging but she makes the lectures interesting. if you study and do all of your readings you can make an A. she pushes you to be a better scholar and wants deeper answers to essay questions
The class is very interesting.  Not an easy A.  The first test is the hardest but I still have not taken her final.

I took Flowers for World Religions and for a religion class it was extremely interesting and fun! Dr. Flowers makes the class get involved with discussion, and outside speakers. Love her and the class! By far the best/easiest religion class to take at TCU! If you pay attention and read the quizzes and tests are very simple to get A's on!
Interesting class. It was easy for me, but I also didn't miss a lot of classes. She's a good professor.

Dr. Flowers is a very nice and helpful woman. She is extremely knowledgeable on the subject matter and will help you if you need it. Quizzes are easy if you read and tests are easy if you study for a few hours the night before. She'll round your grade in the end if it is on the edge (79.51=80). Strongly recommended.

Great, interesting class, but the tests and quizzes were very hard. She requires you to deeply analyze, rather than just memorizing terms. Learned a lot. She has little quirks that are really annoying. But she is a good teacher and I enjoyed the class.

AWESOME!!! She is really good at explaining everything and that's what makes it easy. The class does what it's title says- helps you understand other religions around the world better. You learn basic term for every religion and for religion in general. Pop quizes but they're not that bad, just read. Love her.

Dr. Flowers is great! Despite these other reviews below, I think Dr. Flowers is very helpful so long as you put effort and show up to class. Do the readings and understand the study guide she provides and you will get an 'A' like I did! She has very interesting guest speakers, made the class that much better. Not an easy 'A' but very do-able.

She is hard. A lot of reading is expected, gives pop quizzes. Tests are hard with lots of vocab to learn and no word bank. Vocab is from other languages so sometimes hard to keep up with. Second part of test is multiple choice and third part is essay. She expects a lot on the essay. I worked really hard and only made a B-.

Probably the most boring class ever. There is a lot of reading and a lot of terms to know for the tests. All tests are fill in the blank (no word bank), multiple choice, and 1 essay (2 pages at least). She gives out a review before each test with about 30 possible essay questions and all of the terms (about 60). Class is really really really boring

I took her for world religion in America. While the class is interesting and she is extremely helpful in and out of class, her tests are extremely difficult when its not the essay portion. You have about 70 terms per test but only 8-10 are on the test so you study a lot for that and it was still really difficult. You have to study a lot just 4 a C
If you read the book and show up to class you will pass. She gives pop quizes at the start of class.

He is likely one of my favorite professors at TCU. So hilarious and cares about his students more than anything. Spring semester is his last semester at TCU, so take him while you can. He has hard tests but he's always willing to help. Go into his office hours and chat with him- he will have you laughing until you cry

He has a lot of pride because of his background and his story. So this makes him stubborn at times, and he has no patience for those who do not try. Even if you do not speak Spanish very well, he will give you an A for attempting to. If you try hard, email him, talk to him outside of class, he will give you an A. Its that simple.

Get to know him and you will absolutely love him. He's hilarious, super sarcastic though so if you are sensitive to that then don't take him. He will help you out as long as he knows you are putting effort into his class and take the time to go over things with him. Can't take things personally with him, but I thought he was great!

Refuses to answer questions...just tells students to look in the book. Begins yelling at the class randomly. If you take this class, be aware that you will be called on in every class. He may not learn your name, but he will point. Overall, this professor's teaching style and classroom environment are NOT conducive to learning.  Not recommended.

Clarification is the major issue in any class with him.  You either don't understand what he is saying, or get it after he explains the material 5 times.  Also, if you know what you're doing and know it's right, but he says something different the day of the test, usually go with what you were thinking to begin with.  Hard to get an A.
He's truly a shameful, pathetic excuse for a teacher.  One of the very worst.

Dr. Flores is an amazing professor who cares about his student's success, therefore, he is a tough one. He expects a lot from his students and is proud to see that their efforts produce the grade they deserve. I recommend him if you are willing to take your spanish skills up a notch.ATTEND CLASS!!! TAKE NOTES!!! READ READ READ!!

Very, very friendly & funny, but intimidating when you first meet him. Lectures is Spanish, but will still answer you if you speak in english. You MUST do the work that he assigns everyday bc you will go over it the next day. Losts of quizzes & deducts points when you miss class, but he is a really great prof with fun stories & good humor
He is really helpful.  I learned a lot in his class.  The environment is light and so it is easy to ask questions. He's a fun guy and I am definetly taking him again.

Dr. Flores is amazing! I feel like I learned so much from the conversations we had in his class. It's low pressure (unless you fear speaking in Spanish) and he is really understanding during tests. He's a great resource and I would definitely recommend taking any class he teaches!
I suppose it might be worth putting up with his masked hostility and inappropriate comments if he were a gifted instructor.  Unfortunately, he's not.

he is tough on attendance and he gives a LOOOT of quizes but it forces you to learn the material. He is hilarious and very easygoing, but be prepared for him to make fun of you... alot... especially if you are late to class. I would take him again and again.

He is very rude. he says what is on his mind and doesnt care if he hurts your feelings. GO TO CLASS!! Make sure you study because he will call you out and he has a lisp so its hard to understand his accent!
He sure makes alot of inappropriate comments.  I'm not sure how helpful or clear I would have found his classes if he hadn't made belittling and insulting remarks about my personal appearance.

Great guy... expects you to work hard and definitely show up prepared.  Do your homework ahead of time and be prepared to interact.  He will work with you on grades and assignments but requires more than just a simple show up attitude.  I didn't like him at first, but really enjoyed him at the end of the semester.  He was awesome
I loved this class and Dr Flores!  He's so entertaining, but he's a great prof, too!  He's very willing to help his students "get" grammar, even in another language!

Class was hard, but so it should be. Was always willing to help, and will work with students to make sure they get the most out of the class. Sarcastic sense of humor, but come on, not "rude" by any means! You will learn tons, but be ready to work, no easy gimme A's

He was rude, he will hold anything over your head to adjust your grade, he expects your respect but has no respect for his students.  i'll say that i did learn a great deal in his class, but it wasn't worth having him as a professor.

Very rude and unhelpful.  Yes he has a sense of humor but most of the time its by picking on students of the class, especially those w/ Hispanic backgrounds OTHER than Chilean (which he is).  Is not willing to compromise w/ students even when they're deathly ill.  His class is easy if you can overlook all the rude and biased remarks he makes.
No Comments
He made learning spanish fun. Was very welcoming to all students.

He is a very funny man. He has a heavy accent, so it's funny when he speaks english. His tests are hard, and there are really no other grades besides the oral presentation. he never said why he got kicked out of catholic school.
a wonderful little man. he has a great sense of humor and loves to teach. take him!

Dr. Flores is the BEST Spanish teacher that I've had at TCU. Even though I probably won't get a B in his class, I would totally take him again. If you participate in class and do the homework a B is definitely possible. MAKE SURE you come to class everyday. Attendance is 20% of your grade.
I hated him at the beginning of the semester.  he is very practical and really enjoy talking with him.  i now like him very much

Yes, he is very nice, but he can also be very intimidating and challenging.  It was difficult at first for me to get used to his native dialect.  He likes to put you on the spot so always be prepared for class.  He is an excellent teacher!
Two words: TAKE HIM!!!
He's one of my favorite professors.  If you try and go to class he'll help you out.  He's very helpful and entertaining.  Ask him why he got kicked out of private school...

Very nice and professional.  Sometimes the class might be a little hard if you are not a fluent speaker, however he is always willing to help and explains the material very well.  I would highly recommend him.
Very good professor.  One of the Best Spanish Professor at TCU.
He looks like Mario from the Mario Brothers.  Enough Said.  He is the coolest.  This guy tells hilarious, random stories and made me laugh the entire semester.  The tests are a breeze, just show up.

I asked a religion major for suggestions for the RT requirement and she told me Dr. Flowers. So glad she did! The class was incredibly interesting and the subject matter is approached in a way similar to a history class so that no one religion is given preference. She will give you study tips: LISTEN! Her tests are difficult but she is great!

really enjoyed the class. very challenging but she really tries to keep her students engaged. reading is mandatory and gives you quizzes on them to make sure you read (but pretty easy). tests aren't too bad IF YOU STUDY,the essays were the hardest part, very analytical and wants you to think outside of the box. keep up with the work to get a A or B

Dr. Flowers is great but the class is not. i DO NOT recommend this class to people who haven't taken a lot of religion courses. class is discussion based, but there are no lectures so unless you have knowledge about the topic prior to class, you won't be able to comtribute much to discussion. discussions are dominated by religion majors anyway.

Dr. Flowers is one of the sweetest people in the world! She really engages the class and is very interested in getting to know you outside of class. The class is completely discussion based and has a TON of outside work, online threaded discussions and several articles to read for each class. Be prepared to be completely consumed with this class.
she is boring during the lectures but if you do the study guides and talk during class or go in to ask questions then she will like you!!! i should have gotten a B but instead i got an A!!!!
