boring during the lectures if your not a religion focused person, but its probably the easiest way through your Religion credit at TCU, the person that rated her below me is correct on all his stuff
Easy professor of them all. There's usually reading for every class and a possible pop quiz if there's a reading. She only take the 10 best quizes. 3 tests (non-cumulative).
puts me to sleep at 8am. easy tests though if you do the study guides.

She is great.  Always willing to help you in any way possible.  Gives chances to recieve extra credit.  Gives a lot of quizzes which aren't too hard and only takes the 5 best.  Study tests from study guide given.
She is a really helpful. Gives extra credit, drops 5 quized. All you have to do is show up to class and listen.

Loved her! Difficult subject she makes very easy. I have an A in the class and never read. Extremely approachable and always willing to help. Drops two quizzes and gives you test study guides. Anything on the test comes from the study guide. Take her!
loved her! very nice! very helpful and challenging!

Dr. Ford is the best teacher I've ever had!! She makes it so fun and interesting. I look forward to going to her classes. You do have to go to class because she tells you stuff to write down for the tests, and there are in-class assignments. Her tests are easy if you study, and some of the online quiz questions are repeated. HIGHLY RECOMMEND HER!!

Dr. Ford really loves what she teaches, and I love how she incorporates her own life and family into her lessons. There are group assignments which are pretty straight forward. There are 5 exams and if you study the slides then you should be fine in the class. Overall, I loved her for this class, and I would definitely recommend her.

She definitely cares about her students. But, most questions you ask her are answered in a condescending way and she can make you feel stupid. I can tell she is a good nurse, but it seems like none of our work is ever good enough for her. She also stares at her phone the entirety of any presentation you give.

I thought this would be an easier nursing class, and as it was, the quizzes were near-impossible and really hard to study for. Instructions were often unclear, and whenever there was a question regarding them, she would pull up the rubric and point to it... Kinda backhanded sometimes and judgy imo

Dr. Ford is a great teacher, animated and engaging in lectures. Is a little strict and won't accept late work, will push you (in a good way) to improve. Deeply cares for her students. Only 2 exams, and a decent amount of assignments and projects to help your grade. Shes a little intimidating at first but shes really nice when you get to know her

Dr. Foran is exceptional at clearly explaining difficult topics and demonstrates multiple ways to work out problems. She is extremely accessible outside of class and willing to work with students. Course includes weekly quizzes and bi-weekly homework, but it is doable. Past exams are a good way to prepare for exams. Highly recommend Dr. Foran.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took this course and with Dr. Foran it was amazing! She makes sure you understand topics and always greets you with a smile. She attempts to make sure everyone follows along and is on the same page. Her lectures are the best I have ever experienced. She makes it fun, relatable, understandable, and incredibly friendly. Amazing professor!!!
Professor Foran is so sweet! She allows you to do test corrections on all the tests and is always willing to help students understand. I hate math and always struggle but her class wasn't as bad.
This class was great, she was very flexible as long as you were willing to put in effort. She is a great explainer and teacher. Definitely take her class.

I hated hated hated math when I was in high school. If you need precal before you can take calc, I recommend her! The tests are actually really easy if you just do the review and homework. I got b's in HS math and got an A in this one. I put in work, but she is there for help anytime!

Dr. Fortenberry is awesome and has so many connections within the industry. She can be tough and sometimes quite critical, but she cares about all of her students so much. Her criticism has made me a stronger writer in this course specifically. You MUST get a good group for the project, it is the majority of your grade. Get ready to work!

Ive had her many classes at tcu. She is a nice prof. and will really help you if you ask her for help & if she sees that you care! To get an A or A- you really have to write everything she asks for in all her individual & group papers, essays, test essays, etc. She will count off if you skip over parts. If you dont understand, just ask her!

Fortenberry is a great professor that really wants to see her students submit great work. She will push you to do better if she thinks you can. Be sure to get a good group for the business plan project because your group could make or break your entire semester. Be prepared to put in a lot of work. Tests were very common sense based/easy.

I have taken Dr. Fortenberry for many classes at TCU. Her entrepreneurship class is similar in structure to her other courses. Lectures, 2 exams and group project. The group project is a semester long project. It is not too bad because there are small sections due each week. However, it is a long class with lots of work!

Dr. Fortenberry is an amazing professor. Her lectures may seem long and tedious to listen, to but she knows her stuff. I was really worried about getting an internship for the summer and she definitely had my back. I even called her on a sunday morning for advice and she was completely available. Go to class, participate and you'll do well.

I LOVE THIS LADY! If fashion is your major, you should never get bored in class. Her tests are easy if you pay attention in class, but you will need to study some. Projects are super important, so take them seriously, don't wait till the last minute. Definitely possible to make an A! :)

Dr. Fortenberry is a great professor. She is very to the point, but she knows what she's talking about and is very helpful if you ask. Always very willing to explain her grading and help with questions about assignments. Her classes are hard and she does grade hard, but fair.

Fortenberry is a great professor. She can be very straight forward, though, which offends alot of people. Her class is not hard and assignments are actually fun! If you're a fashion merchandising major you'll be taking her no matter what(: ps. dont be late to class!

Dr. Fortenberry's class is sooo boring. I'm not sure about her other courses, but she makes attendance mandatory, her lectures are boring, and the tests are literally everything from the textbook. Besides the bore its not too difficult, stupid busy work assignments. On top of it she is extremely rude and condescending, i never want to ask for help

Great professor at TCU.  Always willing to help students.  She makes the information she teaches very interesting and she actually knows what she is talking about.  Actually try in her classes and you will do fine.

The class itself isn't very hard. The tests aren't too bad, but she does alot of true/ false. There is opportunity for extra credit. Class is BORING. She doesn't seem to like students much, she is kind of cold and unsimpathetic. Study and go to class, every missed class is points off
by far the best teacher in the fashion department. take any class she offers.
No Comments

Elisa Foster is one of the best professors I have had the privilege to have studied under. She is a great lecturer and has charming and charismatic personality. Her class was interesting and highly informative. She is highly recommended. She truly cares about her students.

Dr. Foster is by far the best professor I have had at TCU! Super nice, super knowledgeable and super helpful.  No tests just short readings for class with keynotes. Really interesting and relevant lectures. I wish she wasn't moving out of the country because I would definitely take another class from her! Just keep up on the work and youll get an A

Lots of reading, no tests, four large assignments (2 three-page papers, 1 response project, 1 final 7-9 pager), great lectures, and great discussions. Great honors class for freshman as her writing assignments are geared to help freshman get comfortable with college styles and expectations. Fun class but geared slightly towards art.

She gave a lot of busy work that was time-consuming and tedious, but her lectures were great. No tests, just papers, and she accepts drafts and gives great feedback on your work. She does a mid-semester teacher evaluation and actually applies the feedback you give her. Super sweet- I definitely want to take another class from her before I graduate.

At the beginning it was lots of reading. Teacher realized this, listened to students and made the class VERY manageable.  3 papers (two 3 pg. papers & 1 final paper (5-7 pgs.). NO TESTS. Always wanted to help. Class is half lecture half discussion. Very interesting. The teacher genuinely cared for students. Don't know why other review is so mean

Horrible class. It's supposed to be taken for core curriculum credit but she makes it out to be some sort of arts major philosophical level. Tons of reading and Keynote before each class. Grades are hard and it will consume hours and hours of you want to get a decent B. Lecturers are boring. She's nice but she expects way too much.

It was difficult to congratulate Fox's teaching on anything other than her intensity, which was what made the often parochial presentations interesting. Student comments or questions that deviated even slightly from the present topic were disregarded by her. She integrated her opinions into tests/assignments so open ended questions became closed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took Fox Fall 2021 and I really enjoyed her class. She made a 3 hour class still interesting and fun, and her assignments were easy and helped you understand the course. I was getting sick a lot towards the end of the semester and she never counted me off if I missed class, as long as I finished the module projects by the due date. High reccomend

Dr. Fox is a nice woman who seems very knowledgable in her field.

She is a tough grader so you will have to put effort in but I would still recommend taking her. Wish more people would have participated in my class, but that's not a her problem.

very useful. prepared me for the next course that i wanted to take. gave me the confidence that I needed to continue my studies. there were no quizes or exams not sure where the negative comments are coming from.
This class was pretty good. Not sure where people are getting the feedback on Quizzes and exams, the class didn't have any. Prof was very helpful when I had any problems. Found them fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Worst class I have taken at TCU. I almost reported her for being unbelievably biased when giving lectures. She is uninterested in hearing opinions other than hers, and her quizzes and exams are not easy by any means. Lots of reading and effort for a class I hated, and didn't even lead to a good grade. Would stay away 100%.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lectures were really informative. A little bit of reading but it was very interesting and the discussions were great. Would totally take again. One of my my favourite classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She uses a lot of group discussion, but if nobody talks, it will turn more lecture heavy. No exams, just projects that you turn in at the end of the semester. You can pick to do essays, videos, photos, or other things. If you turn them in early she lets you revise until you get an A. No reason not to get an A in her class.

Fox is great! I did her online course, she really knows what she is talking about but also grades pretty hard (on final portfolios). As long as you pay attention in class, ADD TO CONVERSATION, & read you will be fine. She didn't do traditional MC exams instead it's 4 projects due at the end of the semester. She just wants students to pay attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I do not know why Prof Fox has poor reviews, but her class is very interesting. You have to read and participate to get at least a B. Other than that, not a bad choice for core.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: very friendly, but the work load is a lot. tons of reading daily and if you don't do it you will absolutely fall behind in class. Her political bias slips into her lectures when given the chance as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Make sure to at least look over the readings, and show up. If you do both of those things, you'll be fine. If you're struggling, make sure to reach out to her early in the semester and she'll work with you, especially if you show genuine interest in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She gives great feedback on assignments and if you don't do well she will let you revise for a better grade. If you talk to her she will help you so go to office hours. Very accessible and helpful if you put in the effort. Skim the readings before class or during groups and you're fine. Great class as long as you show up
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Worst Experience at TCU yet. Reading and Quizzes every night and she takes forever to grade anything, so you won't know that you're failing the class until it's too late. But really my problem is that she is incredibly biased. She teaches opinion as if its fact and expects everyone to agree with her and then tests you on her opinions. DO NOT TAKE!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Its not a blow off class, you have to do the reading and take the projects seriously to get an A. If you do you will have a great experience. I learned a lot and she just wrote recommendation letters for me even though it has been years since I took her class.

Taking this class will be the biggest mistake you will ever make. Its a lot of reading, a lot of homework, and she takes her precious time grading assignments (think 6 weeks for one assignment). Even if you get a 100 on everything, you will not be able to survive the final and you will finish with a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Get ready to read 60+ pages a week. Her lectures are boring and she has a horrible turn around for grading. She grades the papers easy, but she waits until after you have taken the final to grade your homework assignments, so if you weren't doing well on them you would have no idea and would be given no opportunity to improve. Don't take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Reading assignment every night and pop quizzes almost every class. There are three papers during the semester and she does a horrible job at explaining her expectations for these. Her midterm is impossible even after extensively reviewing the class material. I asked for assistance multiple times and she was rude and not willing to help. DO NOT TAKE
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Took Intro Anthro for global awareness (GA) for core credit. Took her Monday night class. Reading assignment due every Monday and all the readings were over 25 pages of PDF documents, took forever to complete and she graded them tough. 3 essays which she wants done perfectly. And one final which covers the entire semester. No not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: You have to at least skim the readings and show up, if you do you will get an A. Go talk to her early in the semester even if you are doing fine. She will go out of her way for people who show some interest/effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: No joke, had a quiz every single class. Each night we had 2-3 readings, normally about 15-30 pages each. They're also over incredibly absurd topics like devil worshipers. This was my least favorite class at TCU so far.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Although you do have to read every night and be expecting a quiz in the following class over that material, the quizzes are typically only worth 3-5 points apiece and are in abundance so it helps pad your grade if you don't do well on the midterm/final. Lots of topics are class-discussion based which makes lecture seem like an after-thought.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Not a huge fan of her. She is very uninterested when you approach her with specific questions or are in need of help. Her midterm was nearly impossible. I studied all the lectures/notes I took in class and readings for hours and hours & still did not know 80% of the questions on the exam. She assigns SUCH long readings and there are always quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Do not take this class for core. Her lectures are super boring and her tests are not what she says they are. She is not cooperative with students AT ALL, and she doesn't care to help students out much. You have to read before every class, and even though class isn't mandatory, you pretty much need to go to know anything. 10/10 do not recommend.

This was the worst class I have ever taken during my college career.  She goes the full three hours, lectures on about irrelevant topics, gives you the strangest/longest/boring topics to read about.  There's an end of the year paper that you can write but  even if you go visit her she's not helpful in your topics or helping you decide a thesis
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Had a wonderful experience with this Professor. She is really kind and cares for the students success. She is a pretty easy grader on the papers and there are regular quizzes, but as long as you read the material you should do fine. Midterm and Final are not easy, but the quizzes and papers count for most of the grade to make up for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Show up for classes and do the readings and you will get an A. Quizes for every lecture based on the readings but they're super easy. She's the easiest grader for the papers (3). Kinda boring lectures but shes pretty cool.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Fort is a horribly condescending man. He has rambling lectures that are confusing and hard to follow. He grades his ALL ESSAY tests with an insane rubric and his syllabus is confusing because he has so many worthless assignments. If you try to do extra credit, you need at least 5 out of class papers to get a half a grade point.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Fort. He's the best professor I've taken at TCU, and really shows passion for the work he does. I have yet to run into a professor that gives better feedback and thought to your needs as a student. Would highly, highly reccomend.

I went into Fort's class expecting to be hit over the head with religious information, and while he did provide some facts about world religions, the class was mainly focused on HOW to study religions, which made it a lot more interesting than I anticipated. He's a funny guy and makes lectures interesting, but I recommend participating in class.

Dr. Fort is absolutely THE best teacher I've had here at TCU.  He is so incredibly wise, I could listen to him talk for hours.  As long as you make an effort to remain engaged, eventually his deep philosophical understanding of religion and his passion for some religions like Buddhism will make you want to become a Religion minor at least.

I think this class was good at helping me to expand my perspective on other worldviews. I liked the 6 dimensional model for religion and found it very useful. I thought this class was relatively easy at first, minimal reading and writing, but the tests are tough! He is a tough grader of essays! You definitely have to know what you are talking about

Dr. Fort is the best professor I have ever had at TCU. His class is so interesting. I have learned ;lots of fascinating things from this class. Totally recommend him! His tests can be a bit long but it's totally manageable if you listen in class and do the reading

One of my favorite classes so far. He takes attendance, so you need to go. Lectures are a little difficult to follow b/c he tends to go off topic. No power points or notes, so you really have to pay attention and take good notes. Tests are pretty difficult. He is passionate about his teachings and knows SO much. Not an easy A, but you'll learn alot

This class was surprisingly interesting, although somewhat difficult for a freshman level class. I really enjoyed Dr. Fort, he enjoys his subject, and is good making it interesting for his students. The tests are difficult and all writing, but he does give extra credit. There is a lot of reading, but most of it is interesting and easy. Good class!

Dr. Fort is extremely passionate about what he teaches, and his classes ARE fun to be a part of. That being said, his tests are mostly written and are always a challenge. He offers extra credit which is nice, but you will need it. It's a fun course to take, but it's probably one of the hardest the campus has to offer.

Definitely not an easy class. If you are looking to take a blow-off religion class do not take this class. Tests require alot of memorization and reading. MUST ATTEND CLASS and pay attention! Dr.Fort is very passionate though so sometimes class can be interesting.
I liked Dr. Fort as a person, but as a professor, it was Hell! He talks the whole class and does not tell you what all is going to be on the exam. All exams are written.

He is a very typical professor. But very good and loves class discussion, he is very passionate about what he wants to teach but does not force your to believe a certain belief. Tests are all written and hard but a good class to have.
Really good teacher who offers a lot of extra credit. Reading the textbook is a must and the tests are actually pretty hard. Not a class for a person who does not like to do a lot of work.

Take him no matter the class, he is so good! Very helpful, offers extra credit! Make sure you read because he wants you to know the stuff even if he does not talk about it! Tests are on the hard side but totally doable! TAKE HIM! You WILL LAUGH in class
interesting class.....hard test, but a good teacher........i had a C, studied hard for the final and made a B

I really liked Dr. Fort!!  He's not too clear on what the tests are going to be over, but he's VERY willing to help you and allows lots of extra credit. I made a B, but he's an honors teacher, and challenges his students! If you want to learn, take him!

Buddhism class.  Dr. Fort is AWESOME.  He is so intelligent and thought provoking.  It was interesting to watch him push the boundaries of the students.  He is not an easy teacher, but this class will change your perception of the world--and isn't that what it's all about?  On of my favorite professors.

Fort's teaching style is one of my pet peeves.  Most people really like the guy, but I found him to treat his students like they'd never considered anything but jesus.  He sits there with a smirk on his face like, "I bet you think that's CRAZY!"  but i guess that just means he's into it.  Nice man.
This class turned my thoughts inside out then back again. One of my favorite classes I've ever taken. His tests are tough, but the class is worth it.
Dr. Fort is of a different breed, that's for sure. Funny and quirky, and a great lecturer. Class is a riot. Tests are hard but its worth it just to be in his class.

Dr. Fort is a horribly condescending man. He has rambling lectures that are confusing and hard to follow. He grades his ALL ESSAY tests with an insane rubric and his syllabus is confusing because he has so many worthless assignments. If you try to do extra credit, you need at least 5 out of class papers to get a half a grade point.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is amazing! My favorite teacher by far
hard class!

Literally the sweetest, most caring teacher ever. There are weekly journals that are only 200 words and some reading, but it's super light. The midterm is a project, and the final is online. No essays, and she doesn't take attendance. The books are interesting too.
Hands down best teacher I've had

Literally the sweetest, most caring teacher ever. I had her for Intro to Native American lit, and I would 100/10 recommend. There are weekly journals that are only 200 words and some reading, but it's super light. The midterm is a project, and the final is online. No essays, and she doesn't take attendance. The books are interesting too.

Very kind and cares about her students, a fun conversational class. Class had a few grades: a literary event short paper, 2 writing workshops, and discussion post for critiques on others workshops. If you submit the assignments you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Furman is so kind! I'm surprised by previous reviews. As long as you follow her rubrics and read the case studies, it's hard to do poorly. She's very sweet and responds to emails fast. I would definitely take her if you can!

Don't take this class unless you have to. It's unnecessarily difficult- quizzes and tests are very hard and she goes through lectures very fast. Class almost always lasted the whole amount of time. Big projects too. I barely got by with an A in this class and had to work extremely hard for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is not super challenging. Majority of classtime is spent listening to lectures but can get boring. Weekly reflections, 2 papers, 1 presentation.

Professor Furman doesn't really know what she's lecturing on half the time. Her TA is more helpful than her as she has no clue how to work D2L at all. The quizzes are always hard and the questions are always subjective. She doesn't give clear instructions or clear feedback. 10 page research paper, brochure, and 6 page paper so get ready to write.

One of the most difficult professors I have had for CD courses. little to no explanation on assignments. she did not know what she was discussing most of the time.  given unclear instructions for our research paper and graded difficult despite lack of explanation. quiz answers were incorrect all the time. she was not good w constructive criticism

Dr. Furman is very kind, but she is extremely unclear on assignments. There is never a clear rubric, and she will often contradict herself in her explanations. She is extremely quiet and difficult to hear, so make sure to sit close. Technical difficulties (especially with the final) are quite frequent. Be ready for lack of clarity on her criteria.

Dr Furman is definitely I nice lady, but she does not understand how to communicate with students. Half the time she barely knows what she is talking about when it comes to an assignment and needs to double take and figure it out as she goes along. She's a tough grader and the TA is normally more of a help than she is.

DO NOT take her class. She has never once responded to any of my emails and doesn't fully answer questions when asked in class. Attendance is mandatory and it affects your grade if you miss. She is unclear and extremelyyyyy unorganized. I was excited for this course and was extremely let down. Absolutely terrible!

Awful at communication. Is not as empathetic as you think. She isn't clear on instructions and expects everyone to understand everything when she hasn't even explained what we're doing. She breezes by powerpoints - lectures on them for ten minutes. This information is a large part of our final when we barely went over some of the stuff in class.

It's by grace that I passed with an A in this class. I loved Dr. Furman, she is very sweet but boy is she a tough grader! Get a good hang of APA format because you will need it for the two papers. There are no exams, but quizzes that are straight from the textbook. There are group presentations that discuss the case studies that we read about.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof Fuenzalida is a great professor. She does multiple examples during class to ensure that we know what we are doing and usually gives a quiz to see how we are processing the material. sometimes she can move a bit fast, but if u ask questions, she will take the time and answer them. her test reviews are very helpful. take her!

Ms. Fuenzalida is a great math teacher. Everything is very clear and she does not make anything unnecessarily difficult. She is very helpful and you can always go to her office hours if you don't understand something. I would highly recommend her for Applied Precalculus or Applied Calculus.
She is a good teacher and is very smart. She talks very fast so be ready to pay attention and write good notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor Fuenzalida is a great teacher. She is very thorough in her lessons and will answer any questions. Although she does move quickly, she makes the concepts very easy to understand by offering quizzes and homework assignments (that do not take long to complete). The quizzes can be made up for full credit, so that is an easy part of our grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is a nice person in grading. show your work and you can get a full grade even if you have wrong answer
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: If you're good at math, you'll be frustrated If you are bad at math, you'll be frustrated. She is really nice BUT moves at break neck speeds. We are talking 3 topics per class. She also way over works problems when it is unnecessary. Dailey quizs and HW both CORRECTABLE (easy 100s) all in all, you will inevitably be self teaching in the course.

Dr. Fort was a great professor to take for my first semester! He's really interesting made religion fascinating. Everyone in class loved him. He is not an easy A, though. The tests are hard and include essays. I took the honors section and the last third of the semester was projects by the students. Take him if you have the chance!

Required readings before every class. I did them at the beginning of the semester but eventually just kinda stopped. It doesn't matter. Skim through them before the test. He gives you test reviews for all 2 of your tests. Then spend rest of the semester listening to presentations (which don't take long to prepare). Final exam is personal reflection

I took Honors Religion as a first semester freshman who wasn't initially interested in religion. Dr. Fort is an excellent teacher and his class is very interesting. There is a big project that takes up the last third of the semester, but even that isn't too hard. If you're trying to decide who to take, go with Dr. Fort.  Catch him before he retires

Dr. Fort is the trippyest teacher I've ever had. It's possible he did ALOT of LSD back in the 70's and his lectures are basically a drum circle. you aren't going to learn about religions, you're going to learn how to learn about religions. confusing? yes. But very fun and interesting! A's are difficult but B+'s are given out like candy.
His grading system is unusual-go talk to him if you want to know how you're doing in the class. You should read at least most of the time. Insight, insight, insight.

He was really awesome and tells great stories about himself when he was in college and they are incredible.  Really loves to engage students and tries to make his lectures as interesting as possible.  If you write well and are good at thinking abstractly and are open to new views about religion. You will get a B+ or higher.
Easy class! Very interesting and not hard to understand. Not the classic "TCU religion" class that everyone complains about. Gives you study guides that tells you everything on your test.

The class was discussion based and very interesting. You can tell he's really interested in what he's teaching and really wants you to think about the material. He can be a little confusing at times but he's very helpful when you ask. If you want an A you have to do all the reading but its an easy B.

Incredibly intelligent in regards to religion and theology, especially eastern religions, which he specializes in. Teaches each religion as if it were the absolute truth. Extremely thought provoking. Tests are almost entirely written, so studying is mandatory to get an A, which he does not hand out freely, though you will learn a lot.

Dr. Fort is my favorite professor at TCU. His Buddhism class was so interesting and really blew my mind. He has essay tests which require studying, but if you do the readings, participate, and show interest it's 100% possible to make a good grade. Take a class with him. You'll love it!

Prof Fort is very passionate about his class. He is a great teacher if you are willing to go to class. His lectures are easy to follow and enjoyable. I loved this class so much and am happy I took it! All tests are written, but it was a huge advantage to my grade. Pay attention and youll get an A.

By far the best professor I've had at TCU. I took honors World religions with him and the class was wonderful. Lectures are always very interesting- I looked forward to coming to class. The exams/ projects were not easy, but not impossibly hard either. Fair grading, very helpful. I would retake the class if I could.

This class was very interesting but Fort's grading policies were vague and it made it pretty impossible to make an A. (although a few people did). Exams are writing based and take the full 50 minutes he gives you.
Great guy.  The lectures will blow your mind, if you keep it open.  Lots of essays.  My favorite professor freshman year.

Buddhism: This class is better suited for religion and philosophy majors. The material was difficult to understand, but the assignments weren't hard.  This is a class where you have to show up and you have to participate in discussions.  He is a typical old-school professor.  He uses the entire class period.

Understanding Relgion: Worldviews. Dr. Fort is awesome! He's very laid back and keeps the class engaged. His class gave me a new outlook on religion. It's not the easiest religion but it's very doable and I recommend it because it's extremely interesting and makes you think in new ways. His tests are all essay. It's not an easy A but it's worth it!

Really awesome teacher, lectures are extremely interesting however the class is very difficult. I'd be prepared to work hard because the tests are all essay based questions. It is doable but not an easy class. I would highly recommend it because I learned a lot despite the difficulty. One of the best classes I had at TCU.
Great professor. Very funny, makes the subject interesting. Would recommend his classes to anyone. DO ALL THE READING. Tests were challenging.
Very interesting professer! Made me want to come to class! Tests are hard tho.. Make sure you read.

Assigns a lot of reading and makes you buy a lot of books.  I had his seminar class and it was relatively easy as far as the religion department is concerned.  Doesn't take a stance on many issues, but challenges students to think phenomenologically and to stay open-minded.  Corny jokes, but laid-back enough to have a good time in class.
very smart, very open minded.  wants you to think and make your own choices and have your own opinions.  not a class for someone who isn't interested in thinking outside the box.
Best religion teacher i have ever had.  Teaches the class in the right manner and is very easy to understand. Likes to get the class involved.  Should definately make an A or B.
there are only 3 tests and the homework that you have to do is not graded. the class is easy and very interesting but there isn't much room to improve if you mess up.

This is a great class.  As for his tests, I don't know what some of these other people are thinking--tests are straightforward, directly from the lectures and readings (blue, frogprints book), and the grading is fine.  I made an A, studying for each test for only 15-30 minutes.

Fort is a great guy and his lectures aren't that bad to sit through.  He's very entertaining and he will definitly make you look at things different.  Tests are VERY hard, but its pretty much worth it to be in his class.
Dr. Fort is of a differnt breed, that's for sure. Funny and quirky, and a great lecturer. Class is a riot. Tests are hard, but its worth it just to be in his class.

Fort is a quirky guy, way out in left-field, but you have to love him.  Freshman Seminar Finding the FOunders is little actual work and a bunch of class discussions.  Take this if you want to learn much about yourself.
This is a fun class that will make you think. It might be boring, but his passion for what he does really makes it stick out in your mind and makes you want to learn more.
Awsome Professor who will really make you think about religion and life.
There is a reason this guy likes Jimmy Hendrix and The Yeloow Submarine, he is way out there, but so much fun. Entertaining and informative at the same time. Hard tests, but you learn alot.
Very intellectually stimulating class.  I very much enjoyed the discuss boards for the class.  He is a great lecturer.
Interesting and entertaining in his lectures.  Hinduism is hard stuff to grasp anyway, but he tries to be clear about which world view and the history and such.  Good lecturer.
The most entertaining class of my college career! Dr. Fort can turn any comment into a live wire of discussion. When you leave class, you will be dizzy with thought. Amazing!
Dr. Fort is a blast.  We butted heads on many an issue, and he most certainly challenged me, but my experience in his classes were absolutely amazing.
He really made this 9 am class worth getting up for.  His class is not easy, but he makes it very interesting.  Go to class and you will do fine.  He is a character!
Very, very enjoyable class. He makes learning about religion fun. The man's a riot a minute, and a character you really want to know.
Makes you think. Not a lot of work involved. Open-minded. Excellent teacher.
Dr. Fort is one my favorite professors!  He is soooo smart and he expects a lot from his students.  It is all worth it though!

She's not at TCU anymore, but fyi If you put forth effort you can make an A. I bombed the first writing assignment and she gave me about a page of comments and let me make it up. Pretty interesting but can be boring here and there.

Shes clearly cares - tries hard to make the class interesting w/current events. But map test are ridiculous and the exams are hard (never made an A on one). But all assignments are straight forward and lots of options to make up points. She called me out for not submitting my best work and gave me a 2nd chance - totally turned my grade around.

Map tests are hard-hated these to the bone; article reviews are tough but she gives you more comments than I have ever seen any prof so by the 2nd you will know what you are supposed to focus on; tests are easy if you pay attention in class and take good notes (they are fill in the blank, which is nice); not boring but  covers a lot in one day
So enthusiastic, came away knowing more about the world and its issues. Take her, she keeps the class talking so its no as boring.
She is hot so take her.

Prof K is super friendly. She does cover a lot of information during the classes, but if you miss anything or need help she is more than willing to meet up with you during her office hours. I only got C's on the tests but was able to pass with an A, due to extra credit. The map quizzes are easy and the articles are not bad either. Take Her!

Great Class! I loved prof K and thought the class was really interesting. I came away with "eyes open" to whats going on in the world. Yes, there are tons of notes but but you can tell what she will put on the test. Easy A if you go to class and do the extra credit.

Don't take this class. So much busy work and you have to take 10 pages of notes each class. Most of the test come from lectuer not the book so you have to buy it just to copy vocab. Too hard for a 100 level class. And yeah lots of history.

Prof k is HOTT! I really enjoyed the class. I am a bad test taker so I loved having all the extra credit and muliple ways of grading (there are quizzes and writting assignments). The articles are cool but I did really bad on the first two. She will help you on them if you go into office hours. TEST ARE HARD!!!! DO THE EC!!

VERY HOTT.  Knows her stuff pretty well.  There are a ton of notes, and the tests are harder than you would think, but she gives you enough extra credit to raise your final average almost 15 points.  Would definitely recommend taking her.

Professor K is a great teacher. I went into office hours several times and it was so helpful. She is pretty understanding too if you have to miss something. You have to try to get an A but its def worth it. Movie extra credit is always a plus!

The class is really intersting, but the tests are hard. You have to take notes (most of the tests come from the slides) & do the extra credit to make a good grade. She gave us the slides with blanks which helped tons. The articles are hard--she wants you to cramp so much info into a page. She gives you tons of comments- look at examples on ecollege

Fav class this semester! I always felt like I actually learned somthing while I was there. It can get boaring at times but there are videos. She tries to get us to talk to break it up. I would take it, if you do the extra credit you will make an A.

Prof K is great! Lectures are intense but its interesting and there are movies here and there. You will have to do the extra credit but there is plenty. She changes things as you go so you have to check your email :( I liked reading the articles they are pretty short and since I'm a business major they are helpful. Tests are hard! Study slides!

this class was not what I was expecting. There is a lot of work but I really enjoyed it and learned stuff I had no idea about. I would take it but know you have to do a lot of work to get an A (but there is extra credit)
learned more in this class than in the last three years. The world is crazy. Good class

She's an awful teacher, more like a history class. Not very interesting, but if you take notes and do the extra credit (there's a lot) you can make a good grade. Don't expect to learn about geography though.
Majority of tests comes from slides. Lots of extra credit. Take good notes and study, you'll make a good grade
hard, lots of extra credit, take it
This class is realy hard, but she does all she can to help everyone learn and she makes the class managable. You learn a great deal from her, but you have to work hard and study to truly understand.

Her test are worded funny. There is a quiz pretty much everyday on 2 chapters.  She does not teach and her lectures consist of her copying the book.  She is a nice lady but that's not worth much when you are trying to learn a difficult subject
good teacher.  quizes arent bad if you study but the test are hard.  she gives homework for completion.  she is really nice and tries to get everyone to understand the material.
A terrific professor. Her lectures are always very easy to follow. If you do as instructed, you are easy to get a good grade. I highly recommend taking her class.
A terrific professor. Her lectures are always very easy to follow and tests reasonable.I highly recommend taking her class.

okay, if you actually study its and easy A-B, if you dont do anything all year its an easy C... she gives you powerpoints and drops two lowest quiz grades and homework grades... she also curved our final grades almost 8% and 20 extra credit points (so total of 13% added)... if you can sit though the class everyday definitley take her

Highly recommended. Not an easy class, so the material is difficult but Fu is a better teacher than the other financial acct professors. She says "ok?" and "right?" on average 130 times each per class. I know this because I kept a tally all year.
She is great! She is very helpful and always available to answer questions. All this made my learning accounting much easier.

Horrible teacher, is smart (maybe since she has a ph.d in accounting) but really doesn't do an effective job teaching. Assigns easy homework and projects. Never passed projects back and really does not care about students. Look for another teacher (I hear she might be leaving though)
AMAZINGLY EASY

DO NOT TAKE! First off...she wont tell you this until you have breezed through all the tests in the class and have a 95 average when she drops the bomb that the does a true bell curve...i had an 91 avg and i almost got a C! avoid!! evil!

Avoid this teacher at all costs. I have never hated a teacher so much in my entire life, besides the fact that she barely speaks English, she is a horrible teacher too. She rolls her eyes at you if you ask a question that she thinks is stupid, and she has no idea how to communicate her point to the class. TAKE COBB!

The music that is put in front of us in wind symphony is typically FULL of errors, bad writing, and not worthy of the players. In rehearsal, he doesn't have any artistic vision beyond a "warm sound," and "cleaner" technique, which results in so much artistry left on the table.
he is the reason the TCU wind ensemble is respected today
His music choice is a little abstract. Don't enjoy rehearsals at all. His has crazy "Scary movie 2" hands. He is ok, but not the best.
No Comments

The poor guy should've stayed back at Commerce.. doesn't know enough about the music to be useful.
All he cares about is himself. He is THE MOST self centered man that i have ever met.  Don't expect to grow as a musician at all in his class.
i think he's a really nice guy. he just wants us to be great musicians...yes he gets to the detail, but it's only to make you better.
Most poeple can't stand him, but the class is required for wind/percussion players
'nitpicky'...as opposed to some of the awful performances of the TCU wind ensemble in past years
I haven't been in one of his concert bands myself, but I've heard a lot of bad things from several people who have. Very nitpicky, apparently.
Just so he'll be available....

He was very accessible outside of class but his responses to questions often felt demeaning. He gave reviews for all the exams except for the final and they would be very similar to the workout problems on the exams but multiple choice was always HARD. Our final was all multiple choice and the average was a C. Definitely better options for FR1.

Fronk is nice and replaces lowest test grade and tries to help, but he lacks in various areas. He speeds through material, doesn't explain concepts well, and I always left feeling more confused and having to put in work outside class plus no review for the final. RIDICULOUS!!  If I had my old accounting professor for this course I wouldve had an A

Fronk is a really cool guy. However, he constantly prioritized following the schedule as opposed to making sure we understood what he was saying. He would speed through 5 slides to finish on time because we had a quiz the next class. We got reviews for all exams but the final which reflected in the average final being a C+. No idea what changed.

reviews.comment: Fronk is nice and gives one thing of extra credit and replaces lowest test grade with the final, but he just doesn't explain concepts well. I always left feeling confused and he didn't give a review for the final. The final was all multiple choice which was nice, but it was hard and the average was a C. I wouldn't take again or reccomend
SO BAD. DO NOT TAKE HIM. Average grade on final was a C WITH THE CURVE

Literally horrible at explaining things. Tests are too hard. Final was ridiculous 

DO NOT TAKE THIS MAN
Fronk is awesome. The subject material is boring but Fronk teaches it about as well as somebody can. He genuinely cares and he creates a great learning environment.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I like his teaching style. It's not exciting but it's not boring either. It's just straight to the point. After learning each new concept, you practice a problem with him, and then individually to solidify it. If you see him during office hours to clear up confusion, and practice on your own, this class will be fairly easy (or at least passable)

Like all accounting classes it is test heavy. 3 test and 1 final, he said he may change that to just 2. But overall, super nice guy, teaches well, and wants to help you. He is also just a chill dude, would 100% recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hands down one of the best accounting professors there is in Neeley, as long as you study and get to know him and visit his office hours, you're golden. He is willing to review with you and clarify any topics and is very accessible even if it's a quick question. Amazing professor, accounting is hard, but he makes it bearable!

This class is by no means easy. I practically failed the first exam, but I came out a stronger student than before. If you do his workout problems and do all homework without using AI, you will learn a ton.

This class is graded a ton on exams, but he is there to help. Clear structure for the class with straightforward reviews that are almost like the exams. Show up, put in a little time and this class is not that bad.

Whatever this guy learned from BYU needs to be studied. The former Big 12 track rival, now accounting genius for TCU's accounting department is ending his fall semester season with a BANG! Doesn't take attendance, but show up anyways because you will learn a lot and he tells you sample questions for the exams.

This class was extremely tough for me in the beginning, but he was there to help every time. This guy is my favorite accounting professor and why I decided to add accounting as my major. I wish all Neeley staff was like Fronk.

Take Fronk!!! FR1 is a hard class no matter what but his lectures are very clear, he gives particpation credit which can be about 2%  of your grade, he gives a study guide for every exam which is very similar to the actual exam, and there are quizzes on every chapter but theyre only 6 questions multiple choice and they help learn it periodically.

Professor Fronk is one of the best professors I have had. He genuinely cares about his students and gives us plenty of opportunities to improve our grades. Even though the class is difficult at times, he explains topics well and offers great examples in class. The final is also just a retake of our lowest exam grade which is optional. Take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor. TCU Accounting Legend
Loved Fronk this semester. His teaching style is kind of dry, but the exams are straightforward if you put in the work. He has lots of office hours before the exams as well.
Great guy, great professor. Super helpful with test feedback and lectures are straightforward. Make sure to do the practice problems he gives you.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The former track star has made himself one of the best FR1 professors at TCU. Has lots of office hours to review tests. Even gives an extra 5 points for just showing up and talking with him.

Great professor overall for a tough class. There are quizzes every few weeks that come from the lectures and exams that cover a larger portion of material. Fronk is super nice and always willing to help. Favorite accounting professor by far.

TCU has drafted a hidden gem into their accounting department! One of my favorite professors this semester. FR1 is a challenging class, but his quizzes and exams come straight from the Powerpoints and practice exams. Also gives extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Fronk is looking to cement his name in the Neeley Accounting hall of fame in his debut semester.  Accounting is tough, but Professor Fronk explains everything really well.  Exams are easy if you study, and you get to drop your lowest test grade. idk what they pay him but dude deserves a raise.

Prof. Fronk is putting up Money Manziel Freshman numbers right now. Winning heisman as a freshman teacher. He is letting us drop an exam. Tests are straight from review and quizzes. Take quizzes once every other week. Rarely homework. Lectures can get tiresome but it is accounting so there is not much you can do. My undisputed G.O.A.T.

The BYU alum by way of UGA had a CJ Stroud rookie season. Clear grading criteria with hints for quizzes, and tests drew heavily from quizzes and practice exams. Homework through My Business Course is annoying but he quickly responds to emails asking for help. March Madness bonus points were a big help too. Looking forward to an even better 2nd year

Professor Fronk is a nice professor and genuinely wants you to do well in his class. There is not a lot of homework and you get to drop your lowest quiz grade. Quizzes come straight from the notes and he usually gives hints. Also offers extra credit! FR1 is a hard class and can be a little boring but he makes it easier to understand. Take him!

Fronk is a great professor for FR1. It is a tough class with challenging topics, but he makes it straightforward with the practice problems. Quizzes are from the slides and he usually gives hints on the questions ahead of time. Also lets you drop lowest quiz and exam grade. Take him!

Easiest class ever. I had Van Hare as my TA and she was very nice and graded super easily. Class can be boring during lectures, but there are some activities that keep it interesting. 3 main speeches that are so easy. The final is optional, but make sure you have a good grade by the end of sem and you don't have to do it. Highly recommend.

I had a TA for his class, but Frolich makes the course. Very easy to do well in his class, and the speeches are a great way to practice public speaking without putting too much pressure on you. Many assignments throughout the year that are basically completion grades, which is nice. Both Frolich and my TA were super nice and flexible.

I had a graduate TA teach my class, but the course was designed by this professor. Both the GA and the course were amazing. I was not big into public speaking, but this course made me feel more comfortable and I would definitely take again.

LOVE this prof. Take him & you will not regret it! I hate public speaking & he made everyone feel comfortable. He is funny and does not assign too much work at all. The final speech is a group speech so that made it even better! Very difficult to not get an A!

I absolutely loved Professor Frolich. I absolutely hate public speaking but he made everyone in the class feel very comfortable and made this class surprisingly enjoyable. Hes fun and funny and explains everything so much. Wish I could take him again !

Zack is a great professor and is engaging in lectures. He is clear with grading criteria and structures the class to where you will actually improve your speaking skills. There are 2 minor speeches, 2 major speeches, and 2 tests. Tests are based off notes and textbook reading. He gives great feedback and allows for creativity in speeches.

Professor Frolich is great! The grading is based on daily in-class activities (attendance), 2 exams, 2 practice speeches, and 2 MAJOR speeches. Exams are based on the textbook, and he is a tough but fair grader of your speeches. Make sure you show up to class and practice your speeches. This class is an easy A.

Zack is awesome! Since it's a class about public speaking, you obviously have to do those to pass. But there are 2 "low stakes" speeches, and 2 larger ones, all of which aren't very demanding. He's super fun and makes his lectures funny, you can tell he cares about his students and enjoys teaching. I would take another one of his classes!

Im a transfer from community college and took Dr. Friedman for Diff Eq. I was nervous at first about taking his class because of his negative reviews, but I found out for myself that some (possibly most) of those reviews are exaggerated. He is a good professor and if you listen to his lectures and do the assigned reading and study, you're good.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The reviews are true.

Took Calc 2 but I had to teach myself the entire course on YouTube. His lectures were confusing and boring. My grade started to go up when I stopped paying attention in class and started teaching myself. However, he is nice about extensions on late homework and giving points back on quizzes or exams if you ask, and moves the grade cutoff down

HORRENDOUS. He is a terrible teacher. His exams are so hard and everyone did terrible on them with zero curve. That should show him how insufficiently he taught but it doesn't. There is so much homework and it's not like the tests at all. Take a different teacher at all costs.

Dr. Friedman was a solid professor, always willing to help. His class is very very difficult, but if you pay attention to his lecture and put the work in outside of class, you may not do well, but you will learn a lot. He is a bit odd, but I cant help but love the guy.

TAKE THIS CLASS WITH A DIF PROF. His lectures are the definition of herding cats, it hard to follow his train of thought and he doesn't give you back the homework in time for the exam. Homework is not easy, tests are even worse and he doesn't curve anything. My class had an average of a 55 on the first exam and said he wouldn't curve even then.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Friedman was awesome! I loved having him as my calc 3 professor. Weekly quizzes, tests were straight forward, doesn't post lecture notes but classes were fun to attend!

Cons: Lectures are fairly disorganized and homework was due daily and the grader for it was harsh.
Pros: If you actually go into his office with questions he will go through all of them with you and help you understand. Exams are straightforward and easily doable if you understand the material. Grades get rounded heavily at the end of the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I decided to give him a chance after reading reviews here. I should've listened. Very condescending when you ask questions. Spent most of class going over online homework (due every class). Unorganized and he did not spend much time on new material during lectures. I did not know what to expect on exams, and he did not help prepare. No curves.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Expect to do tons of homework (Mon-Wed-Fri class and new HW is due in every single class). Test is quite ok, straight to the point of what lectures were taught (not easy but not hard). And then the final test which accounts for 30% grade is on totally different level, very long and extremely difficult, new problems Avoid if you're not fast on logic
The exams are easy. I got almost over 95 for every exams. But the final is crazily hard. He will not give you any warning. Be careful. The best choice is not taking his course.

Dr. Friedman is not a very nice guy overall, but it would be okay if he was a good prof, but he isn't. He spends a lot of time explaining HW in class - useless. Doesn't give review for test, which is much more difficult than HW and everyday quizzes. You have to attend the class every day for the quiz, because he won't let you retake it.
He is sarcastic. Dont give partial credit and does not like to help students.
Not very interesting
DON'T TAKE DISCRETEMATH WITH HIM! Tough grader, good lecture style but exam is at another level. Literally no way to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Avoid at all costs. It's frustrating to have the right answers on homework and tests and not get credit for it, even if you do it "by the book." It's his way or the highway. Homework due every class. Very condescending. First overall bad experience I've had with a professor.

Greg Friedman is a very strange professor.  He has a very confusing teaching style.  I learn better from the textbook.  Homework due every class period besides test day.  And like the other reports say, he is condescending, and will unintentionally belittle you if you ask questions.  If you have the choice I would recommend not taking this prof.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Friedman is a very good calculus prof. He is very detailed and is open to try to help students. He tries to keep lectures fresh with some (albeit bad) humor, and he wants to be sure you get it. You can expect weekly quizzes and writing assignments to supplement the homework, but overall this class is manageable and you will learn calculus..

Not helpful and really condescending if you go in for help. Belittles in class if you try and answer questions.  If you don't understand something in class, he makes it 300 times more difficult to understand is you ask about it. Unclear in expectations, unsympathetic grader even if you're putting forth your best effort.

He is simply an awesome professor and helpful. He makes the class very interesting with jokes (though most of the time they are not funny) Gives lot of examples and helps you if you are facing problem with any topics.
No Comments

Friedman doesn't like teaching. Bottom line. He assigns homework problems without knowing their difficulty, struggles to communicate the concepts, and will belittle students when they ask simple questions. His inconsistency with problem demonstration (omits + C, dx, skips multiple steps at once) is alarming, especially for how strictly he grades.

Her instructions are confusing, it's hard to find information when doing homework. Her grading really depends on her mood because she's particular about the wording and will change her mind on what she originally told you to write. The first half of class was an easy A but after that solid 79's despite following her exact recommendations. Busywork.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Frable cares about your success as a student in this course. This is a WEM credit, so be ready to write and read. She is very thorough with feedback on any work you turn in, and is willing to explain things in more detail when needed. Reading research and appraising evidence is not everyones idea of fun, but she makes it bearable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: nice & helpful, but class & material is boring. WILL take up the whole 3 hours of class even though no one pays attention. She also assigns a lot of work that she doesnt give feedback on until the end of the semester
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

If I had the option of not taking any class, it would have been this one. She is kind, but after 2 semesters of her class I don't feel any more prepared to be a nurse.
Difficult to understand at first, but her willingness to help students was incredible!  One of the most intelligent and caring professors at TCU- if you have the chance,TAKE HER!!
An amazing professor...so genuine kind and brilliant. She is incredibly smart, go to her for help outside class. She works with you, she is fair and truly cares about you.

I really liked her as a person - probably the most fair/sane/mature/trustworthy teacher at TCU. I liked that she teaches in a unique way but I wish she would have been available more outside the classroom. Her knowledge is incredible & when I EVENTUALLY got time with her she was extremely helpful.
What a wonderful professor!  ONe of the most geniune instructors at HSN..Loved her!

Professor Frey is great. She does assign reading every class and there are pop quizzes but they arent a  huge part of your grade and she gives you extra credit opportunities. Shes a pretty easy grader and is great with office hours to help prepare for exams or understand readings. She's also very understanding with extensions or missing class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Frey is extremely passionate about the literature she teaches. She is always willing to help and has office hours almost daily. You get 5 excused absences but she does give quizzes and doesn't say the dates, they just happen. Light on homework, there's miniature papers to write throughout the semester (they are less than a page).
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Respected--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The workload is manageable but is not easy by any means. Lots of readings before every class and essays due nearly weekly. Very kind professor who is willing to work with you. Easier classes out there for core requirements but I would recommend if you're an English major or minor
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Frey was excellent in side the classroom and out. She does a good job facilitating discussions and providing feedback on papers and other assignments. She's very knowledgeable in her field and is very understanding of the feelings of her students, providing extra credit and rewrite opportunities. She wants you to succeed above all else.

Profesor Frey was a really good professor. This is an English class so it was a lot of writing but nothing unbearable just the normal amount. As long as you do the work youll pass and get a good grade participation in class also helps because it makes the writing easier since you talk about what you wrote about in class. Everyone did pretty good.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Frey was a really good teacher. This is an English class so you have to read a little but its not bad and she discusses the reading in class so if you dont understand you are fine. The class was mostly graded off your writing and a few easy annotations but overall it was great. I would definitely recommend taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: The reading is very dense, but the material is very interesting and Dr. Frey is very encouraging during discussions. There is a lot of writing, but it's easy to improve from assignment to assignment. Not a super tough grader, but won't give you an A if you didn't earn it. Great class/prof if you enjoy classic lit and lit analysis.

reviews.comment: Really nice lady, tons and tons of reading and writing and the content is difficult.

reviews.comment: Teacher is funny and nice and kinda dorky. The class sucks tho! Its about a bunch of English poetry and novels that I personally hated, idk if your into that? Have to do all the reading before class so that you don't fail the pop quizzes. Taking notes on lectures and then studying them is the only way to pass the essays(midterm/final)

The class is pretty easy overall. Takes attendance, but usually forgets. Her main way to check attendance is through pop quizzes which YOU MUST READ FOR. The quizzes are pretty easy if you read. I have never read so much in my entire life as I did in one semester of Intro to Nonfiction. Teacher is very awkward and nods her head up and down excessively and says "Uh huh, Uh huh" after she calls on you which made me feel very uncomfortable. Hard grader. Also very boring. DO NOT RECOMMEND unless you want to spend your semester reading.
Great teacher.  Gets really in depth on the knowledge of the subject.  However, this is a literature course, so be ready to read.
Good teacher.  just do your assigned reading

I took law&literature. Interesting class, but seemed to drag on forever. Readings everyday! If you don't like reading don't take the class. But the class brought up interesting points in our judicial system today. I skipped class a lot and still did fine in the class.

Dr. Frey is FANTASTIC. Never have been interested in English until I took her! She had such interesting class discussions and made the class so much fun! She helped me become a better writer and brought out a side of me that I've never seen before. She's great!

Dr. Frey is amazing!  Such a good teacher, you learn so much from her class.  Go to class; she takes roll at the beginning and towards the middle doesn't care as much, but it's based on class discussion.  AWESOME TEACHER!!!
