Dr. Lin is a great teacher & she really knows her stuff. She lets you have so many opportunities for extra credit. She doesn't do averages for grades, just adds. If you do enough extra, you don't have to take the final to get an A- it rocks! The class may be harder for ppl who've never had music b4.

Since it meets once per week, going to class is a must. Quizes every class and you MUST read in order to do well. 75% of grade is projects (you have one client all semester, working individually--not group) and other 25% is midterm, final, and combined quizzes. Projects: creative brief, magazine ad, billboard, radio, & social media paper.

GREAT CLASS! great learning technique, make sure to speak up and get involved. she loves having a back and forth with her students and will spend more time paying attn to you if you participate. the assignments are real world and so is her advice. The quizzes aren't hard-I don't own the book and got A's and B's  TAKE HER!!! SHE IS AWESOME

She has taught me pretty much everything that I need to know about advertising. Her class was very helpful and helps build your portfolio. She is funny and she doesnt keep you all of night class. Weekly quizzes, so READ!
Kind of a tough teacher, quiz every class and always a little tricky READ THE CHAPTERS is a must! Very nice person who loves her job and she is good at it!

This was by far one of the most useful classes I had at TCU. No bull, just real world info that you will actually use. I have been in the "real world" and out of college now for almost a year and I can say that her class is the one I reference in my head most often. She is very funny too. I took the night class for 3 hours, it was great. Take  her!

the Champion of Wow is just that: THE CHAMPION! She is a great professor. I never wanted to be in advertising but she made me believe that I could if I wanted. Weekly quizzes get tedious but they're sufficiently easy. TIME CONSUMING but worth it!
TCU needs more teachers like her especially if they want to be ready for the "real world" She needs to take over mike' classes

the BEST class i've taken in this department ever.  I wish there were more teachers like this out there.  Taught us so many things to help us build our portfolio as well as so many things to take with us into our careers.

Favorite Class in the Ad/PR program so far. She will make you know your stuff but teaches you everything step you need to know to get there. YOu'll work on your own project and help develop your portfolio. It's outstanding
She is wonderful.  I learned so much in her class.  She is funny and you will actually look forward to going to class.  This was my first class to never miss a session

You will learn so much in this class and come away with some great materials for your portfolio. She has a likeable personality and makes learning fun. As a bonus you hardly ever stay over an hour, and this is a three hour course.

Professor Golan means well, but he is such a tough guy to read. His sense of humor is very dry and will make it very clear if your answer is incorrect. It's almost like he enjoys correcting you and talking down to you. His assignments are often unclear, and the campaigns course is entirely group-based.

Going into a social media elective, you'd expect it to be fun and to learn a lot. No. The class has so much potential, but the way Golan teaches it is genuinely terrible. He is rude, condescending, and acts like he knows everything there is to know about social media as a professor who's never had a career that's not teaching. Do NOT take him.

At first I really liked him but throughout the semester I realized he seems to almost enjoy seeing his students struggle. He'll change the syllabus/grading policy without letting you know and not for your benefit. You actually learn stuff in the case studies class which is refreshing but his social media class is a waste of time and not an easy A

Genuinely...GENUINELY don't know why he has such a good score on rmp. He is such a terrible teacher. I didn't learn A THING! He is so confusing, never gives straightforward answers. Confused every time i stepped into that classroom. The only redeemable factor is that his class is easy cause he's an incompetent teacher.
Probably best option for supply chain. His instructions/assignments could be more clear also, along with going over material. But great guy who is passionate about supply chain. Super chill

Goodwin is a nice professor but makes the class super unclear. Over the semester you will have to figure everything out on your own, even his feedback is cryptic, but overall the class was pretty easy and he is a very lax professor.

Professor Goodwin really wants to help his students, it may seem a little unclear in the beginning, but it gets so much easier. There is a group project, but it is a super easy supply chain simulation. He really cares about your grade as much as you and will give LOTS of extra credit for participating in the supply chain challenge day. 10/10

Professor Goodwin is a great professor for supply chain. He really knows what he talks about and enjoys the content. The group simulation is not bad at all. He really cares about his students and wants everyone to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is super sweet and very understanding. Will move due dates around if people ask and is understanding about classes missed and making up work. Open-note take-home tests. Will do as well as you want to. Definitely turn everything in and there are some in-class assignments that you can only do if in class so know that.
Such a sweet person and great professor!

This professor has an extremely liberal slant to her teaching style. Very DEI/LGBTQ-driven and will test you on this. If you have convictions that lean the opposite direction, I would avoid this professor as she will deduct points on both quizzes & tests for presenting conservative answers to strictly-subjective questions.
All tests are online, at home, and no lock down browser including final. Minimal work, and she is a very easy grader. Would definitely recommend taking her class
It's a great class, and she is very passionate about what she teaches. It takes her a while to put in grades but she is not a tough grader. Great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Caring

reviews.comment: Probably one of the nicest teachers I've had. She is very interested in what she is teaching and overall, her class assignments and tests are easy. Every quiz and test is open-note. A quiz is due before the beginning of every chapter.

She's amazing! Super passionate about sociology, unfortunately not many pay attention or participate because it's such an easy class. Weekly reading certificates, but super easy and take about 20 minutes. Few essays and in class activities, but she grades super easily and super kind. Take her!

Gonzales is super nice and passionate about the subject, but was just so boring. I took the 80min class, and it was rough. She lectures the whole period and sometimes provides videos. She uses online textbook that we submit chapter certificates for every week which are easy. She tests are online and simple! She's okay!

Actually just the most boring class and horrible content. Very annoying about in class assignments and not telling you when they are. I can't even go to class because of how draining and boring it is.
I loved having her as my professor. Super easy and super caring. Only three tests, no final with one paper. She really is the best and is very informative.
She is genuinely one of the most caring and passionate professors I have met. She was always willing to help, and even gave me an extension on a paper when I asked. I would 100% recommend Gonzales.

Very easy class. The only homework is an online textbook and knowledge checks that can be retaken till you get 100%. Her class is just a lecture. Tests are in person but they are very easy. There's also a lot of extra credit opps. She is very passionate about sociology and it is clear she is very accommodating and understanding. Def recommend her!!
Super easy class; attendance is mandatory but she lectures the whole time; one reading assignment each week, tests are in class but all the info is from the slides; very caring about her students
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT DO NOT DO NOT take this professor. She is VERY hard to understand, she works problems way too fast in class that are no where close to the tests. This class counts for 2 hr but l've put in almost as much work into it as my 4 hr calc 2 class. Please save your self from this living nightmare with this professor and switch majors while ur at it
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Look, both options are bad. Dr. Gong is incredibly smart, but this comes at a cost. Maybe it's language or something else, but I learned a bulk of the material in TA hours. She will tell you at the beginning of the class that all the material will click, which is the truth, but sometimes this 'click' comes late; many students' grades reflect that.

great professor, the class isnt as easy as others but watch youtube and read the textbook (they are very short readings) and you'll be fine. Most of your grade is based 2 exams (if you are struggling she will help with your grade) and your final but they are still pretty easy. shes funny.

One class, 90% of my workload. Often multiple assignments due on the same nights. Pre-Labs due Saturdays at midnight, instead of a reasonable due time. Some assignments due at random times, very easy to miss, no late work accepted.
So much homework, and then some more homework. Graded homework months late and yet has no leniency on submissions even a minute late. Completely nonsensical deadlines.

She doesn't return quizzes before you take the exam because she takes forever to grade. She laughs at students in front of the whole class. She lectures until the last second and starts example problems after class ends. The list goes on, but with each of these examples, it's clear she has no respect for others. Do not take her!

Dr. Gong is by far the worst engineering professor I have had. She is unwilling to help you with anything, she takes forever to return assignments and provides little to no feedback. Her lectures are impossible to understand due to her very thick accent. Everything she says sounds exactly the same. Don't bother with office hours she won't help you.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Really nice, and quite frankly a genius. However, her enthusiasm for teaching is not matched by her skill. Excellent engineer, however a confusing lecturer, and difficult grader, as well as basically failing most people on most tests. tldr: very nice, hard grader, get it right or fail the class

She is incredibly smart which makes it very hard to learn from her. She doesn't really listen when you have questions and goes through material very fast. She is incredibly hard to get office hours with and even then she isn't much help. You have to read the book just to keep up. I always felt like I learned more from the book than I did lecture.

Vary helpful and inspirational. She's fun and easy to talk to. Of course engineering classes aren't easy but she makes them fun to learn. She attended Tsinghua University, otherwise known as MIT of China, and is brilliant at encouraging you to try harder!
She is good at both electrical and mechanical. Of course she received her PhD degree in M.I.T

For being so young, she was a good prof. Taught in a way that was easy to understand. Doesn't rush chapters & doesn't make you feel bad for having questions. office hours! I went several times for questions & she was helpful & would give me points back. You can tell she is new at this. A tad disorganized & sometimes would mess up problems. take!!!

As a grad student, you can tell how much Professor Goldman feels your pain at times, and she really does her best to help out. I'm not a math guy, but her advice in meetings outside of class helped me tremendously, and she clearly wants everyone to succeed!

Professor Goldman is a grad student. This means she is super super understanding of everything (As she's also sufering through college life herself). She is a GREAT explainer and makes herself VERY accesible outside of class. Take her!! Quizes not that common but super easy. Tests are short and easy to prepare for.
Class was very straight forward and he was always clear with instructions. Take him if you can.

Dr. Lehman is a great professor. I was initially nervous about taking Honors BLaw because the syllabus looked challenging, but it ended up being one of my favorite classes. His lectures are engaging and often include humor and interactive discussions. He uses clear, real-world examples that make the material easier to understand and remember.

Dr. Lehman is the funniest professor I've ever had. He's quick-witted and really funny. His entire grade is three written exams, which sounds daunting, but if you can figure out how he wants you to write then you're golden. Just try to think like he does and present the issues like he does. If you're paying attention in class, you'll figure it out.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He spends 20-30 minutes discussing topics that could be covered in 5, but he's sweet, highly entertaining, gives great examples, and is willing to explain things as thoroughly as you need. I took the three hour night lecture, and for the first half of the semester, he kept us for the entire time. It became really difficult to stay engaged.
Great professor. Weekly assignments, but very doable. The more he knows who you are, the better off you will be. Easy A if you make the effort.

Lehman is one of my favorite professors at TCU. He's so laid back but still cares about his students actually learning something. We don't have class on Wednesdays, so we only have to go once a week. Definitely recommend!

Easily one of the best professors here at TCU. He teaches to get you to actually think about the material not memorize. All you have to show up to the class and engage. Couldn't recommend more highly for BLAW.
Best Professor at TCU. Genuinely hilarious. Teaches the class so the students truly learn and your grade will reflect what you have learned over the semester.

Amazing professor! Just three tests and that is the only grade for the class. He gives amazing feedback on the test, which requires critical thinking. I had the 3-hour class, and he kept the class interesting. Take him, especially the 3-hour class. Meet with him and participate in class so he can get to know you. It will benefit you!

Funniest professor ever! If you get offended easily you might not want to take him, but he is hilarious and will treat you like a friend, but also keep the professionalism of a professor. I tried to give him a handshake and he dabbed me up, bro is him. Plus, he plays any music students from Zach Bryan to Juice Wrld. The Goat

The only grades were three exams (including the final). He did his best to make a night class interesting and is the kind of teacher who wants you to actually learn instead of using memorization, which is nice. As long as you read the case studies and use critical thinking on the exams you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lehman has been my favorite professor at TCU so far. His class is difficult because he truly wants you to think. However, it is not difficult to receive a good grade. He does not believe in failing, but rather in learning from mistakes. I performed poorly on the last test yet received an A- because of his grading system. He is also hilarious!

Professor Lehman is great! He is by far the best professor for the class. He's hilarious, very easy to learn from, and loves his job. Teaching is his 2nd job, so he does this because he enjoys it! One thing to note is that his tests are HARD but he accounts for that, for example, grades are 60-100=a, 50s=a-, 40s=b+, 30s=b, 20s=b-, and 10=c+. No HW.

Prof. Lehman is one of the best I ever had. His Blaw class is a 3 hour night class but super engaging, he always tries to elicit discussion and makes good (dark) jokes. The class itself is pretty manageable, you have 1 group exam, 1 group discussion (remember to call on people), 2 individual exams including the final.

Lehman is one of the best professors I have had. He has a great personality and experience in the business law world. He has very clear guidelines for the class and gives good lectures. He is an honors professor for a reason, if you need to take business law take Lehman.

Gregg Lehman is one of the best professors Ive had so far. Hes not only very funny and witty, but also very knowledgeable about Business Law and Ive learned a lot from him. Class is made of 4 Grades, a Group Discussion, and 3 tests. He also assigns weekly case readings that arent bad but be prepared as he calls on people to recite them. TakeHim

Gregg is the man! I never rate profs, but I had to this time. He makes the night class fly by and keeps it fun. His tests are essay based and you can use all notes/cases as a reference. He emphasizes application of material rather than just remote memory. My favorite class at TCU by far. Definitely take BLAW with Professor Lehman.

Dr. Lehman was a really interesting character that made the material easy to understand by having a conversational-based lecture. He will call on people and deduct points if you have no idea what's going on, but other than that he is a pretty easy grader that awards you for what you do know. Exams were essay style.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lehman is funny, very knowledgeable, and a fair grader. Makes three hours go by pretty quickly. There is a group presentation every class, followed by his lecture that is always entertaining and relateable. Grade is based on 2 exams, final, and group presentation. Only have to read a few cases for class but no other work. Highly recommend.

Lehman is GREAT! His night class flies by and the work is manageable. His tests are all essays which means partial credit! A great class taught by a funny and smart guy, maybe my favorite class at TCU!

It would be an absolute shame if you take Business Law with any other professor. This guy is the actual man, hilarious, and I still remember content from his class 4 semesters later. That's how awesome this guy is that I'm writing a review 2 years later because he had that big of an impact on my business school life

Loved this class. Although he usually just teaches a night class, he makes the 3 hours fly by. He is hilarious and makes up the best stories to help you remember the specific laws he's talking about. HIGHLY recommend.
Hilarious guy, easy to listen to and understand....... tests are in a paper format.   Grades tests like an actual attorney would grade them, but curves the test a ton

Lehman is an outstanding professor who makes the 3 hour night class actually bearable. He curves his tests a ridiculous amount and if you pay attention and go over the notes before class, an A is extremely achievable. All tests are open notes and first exam is a group, take home test. Definitely take him.

Professor Lehman is absolutely hilarious. He makes the 3 hours class go by fast. The class is somewhat difficult considering you can miss everything on a test. There is a huge curve on the test though. You shouldn't have a problem making above a B though.

Really good teacher. Managed to make a 3 hour night class somewhat interesting. Tests are difficult because they're entirely essay and you could completely miss the point and fail. He curves a lot though. One test a got a 50/100 and it was an A- with the curve.

Lehman is my favorite professor.  He made a three hour night class worth it because he is so funny. His tests are essays, so they were hard for some people. But if you get into a good study group, they aren't too bad.  Plus all his tests are open note! You don't actually have to read the cases either.  I definitely recommend the class!
Lehman is an excellent professor.  His classes are never boring.  The tests can be very challenging and they are all essay, but open note.  He will curve the tests ridiculously though.

Lehman might be one of my favorite professors.  He makes going to class a blast and always has great stories.  That being said, his tests can be tough, all essay and if you mess up one part, you could lose half the points on the test.  Grading system makes it next to impossible to get an A.

Honestly, he was my favorite teacher of the semester this year. He is very funny and picks case studies that are very interesting. I had him for a night class in Business Law, but not once dreaded going to class because it would be interesting. You can use your notes on tests and the first test is a take home test with a group. Take Lehman!!!
He's a good teacher and a goofy fuy.  You can use your notes on test to figure out the cases.  Tests are actually kind of fun.  Good class.

Very easy class. I only went to like 3 classes and I would go talk to him before a test came up and he would tell me everything I needed to know for a test. You dont need a book and I usually sat on facebook the whole class period. He is a cool guy willing to help.

Great Professor!! Class is always entertaining and fun to be involved in.  Class participation is important he keeps track when you discuss a case.  No book just case law studies, all interesting cases!!! Had the 8:00 class and even after Thursday and 3 hours of sleep I wanted to get up for class.  Highly suggested!!!

Great teacher!  The lectures are always interesting.  He makes you want to come to class.  Has a new interesting story every class and is good at relating laws to current events.  First test is a group test, after that you can use notes on all exams, even the final.  No text book needed.

He's funny, entertaining (though he has a very loud voice), and keeps things interesting. Very in touch with his students, know s they don't want to stay the whole time, (mine was a night class) and very open to suggestions.

FUN class! The professor is AWESOME! Very helpful, and best of all there is NO book required for this class. Prof. Lehman makes BUS LAW as interesting as it can be. He allows you to use the notes on the tests, and always comes to class enegertic and with some random story!
Professor Grohman is goated. He is such a joy to be around, so energetic and hilarious. You learn a lot through his experience and stories. Would take him for anything he teaches.
Amazing professor. Just take him regardless of what he teaches. He will give you plenty of opportunities to ensure you get a good grade as long as you make an effort.
Grohman is the best Business in Society teacher by far. He grades very easily and he's very accessible outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The structure of Grohman's class confused me a lot in the beginning but it's purely discussion based. He was very unclear with directions at times, he would say one thing during class and another in the actual assignment instructions. Overall, very easy class and manageable workload.
Awesome guy, super personable and practical with his assignments. High willingness to help. Great stories and real-life application. As long as you communicate for group projects it's an easy A.

Professor Grohman is a great professor who brings in lots of knowledge outside of the classroom. This class is awful though, the work sucks and it is pretty pointless. Grohman makes it entertaining and its an easy A but the work can get really boring and tedious.
Dr Grohman is a great lecturer who often brings interesting conversations into his class. Though some homework instructions can be a bit vague, he often lets us go early. Take him!

Professor Mike is amazing! He made having an 8 AM fun and made his lectures super interesting and engaging. There are a lot of group projects and most homework and workload are pretty long and time-consuming but easy as well. Amazing professor and very recommended business-wise!
super easy and good guy. very understanding and work was straight forward with some critical thinking.
TAKE HIM FOR BUSINESS SOCIETY

Moved to this class after a difficult situation, and Dr. Grohman was kind and accommodating. He welcomed me with open arms into his class. He was a fantastic Prof., hilarious, humble, and best of all, let his students answer incorrectly without berating or interrupting; he always let them try, validated their efforts, and kindly corrected them.

Professor Grohman was great! He cared very much about the subject and everything we were learning. You could also tell he was very experienced within the business field. Lots of busy work, but that is just the class in general. Can be a somewhat tough grader and instructions can be somewhat vague. Overall, a great teacher, take him!
This gentleman is set apart. Genuinely the best professor in Neeley.

By far the best professor I've had at TCU. Makes his lectures relevant and speaks to you as an equal. Not a heavy workload, and all assignments will teach you important skills. Prepares you for the business school. He is engaging and entertaining and gives strong feedback. Often lets out class early as well. Overall an amazing guy.

AMAZING PROFESSOR!! Knows what he is talking about and has a funny story for every topic. Very well educated and knows what he is doing all the time. Homework assignments are easy along with projects and gives clear instructions on what he wants to see in all assignments. Super funny and is making jokes here and there during class. Would recommend.

Take Professor Grohman! I will miss this class. Very engaging in class discussions and a very participation based class. He's very clear on grading criteria and how to make a good grade in the class. As long as you follow instructions and go to class you will make an A.

Grohman is my favorite teacher at TCU. I always look forward to coming to class because he is hilarious and his experience in business makes his explanations of business concepts super easy to understand. He does a great job at making everyone feel comfortable to speak. Assignments don't take that long and group projects are pretty easy.

You need to take him! He is a very educated guy in the business world.  His lectures are engaging and entertaining.  You will have one assignment a week and group projects.  His grading is very forward, and he gives excellent feedback.  If you ever need help with anything, he is always willing to help you.  Attendance is mandatory.

Gives clear instructions for projects and assignments and is engaging, knowledgeable, and passionate about what he teaches. He engages students in discussions and conversations over topics in class.The workload is manageable and gives students time to work on projects in class. Class is often let out early or canceled before breaks and holidays.

He's the best! Tough grader but gives great feedback. It's not hard to succeed in this class with some effort. Class is basically one big discussion every day so he cares a lot about participation but understands if public speaking is not your strong suit. He gives his students every opportunity to do well in his class, for sure would recommend.
He made the class very interesting and strongly encouraged participation but was very understanding of those who were less outgoing.

I appreciated how knowledgeable and almost OVER qualified Dr. Grohman was. His impressive track record of academia, military, and previous job roles, made him a very knowledge man that offered valuable advice to his students that I myself will remember for the rest of my life. He was truly one of the most influential professors I have had at TCU.
Great professor! You definitely have to participate in class, but he makes it very easy to and any class in this course requires participation. Would take him any chance I had to.
Overall very good professor. Easy to follow instructions and make an A on assignments. Attendance and participation are necessary.

Nice guy, but don't underestimate the workload. He's a tough grader when it comes to essays and building blocks. Moreover, be really careful because the participation grader will be random. Don't submit anything late because it will be an automatic 0.

Grohman is the best teacher in the entire school hands down. Ex-military guy is hilarious and does not have a filter sometimes which makes him even funnier. His classes are all discussions. You have one paper and one big group project with a bunch of mini-writing assignments that are easy. Take HIM over all other Business in Society professors.

Professor Grohman is a great guy who has really great lectures. The workload isn't too bad, and a lot of times, he doesn't even make us come to class. Lots of group projects, but it's not bad. Sometimes, his grading criteria tends to change or be unclear. Overall, he is a fantastic professor with a lot of good insight on the business world.
The best professor I've had so far at TCU. Actually looked forward to going to class + easy A if you show up and participate in group conversations

Professor Grohman is very knowledgeable about the industry and definitely takes him so you can understand more about the workforce. Personal experience, I do feel left out of the conversations of class and group projects even though I try to participate, but he seems to favor some students who are able to talk about his topic. Overall great class.
Awesome class, everything is spelled out from day one. Highly advise participating in class because it will make your life easier.
Take him, learned a ton, so kind. Fun class, take him
Such a great teacher. He really cares about his students and is so easy to talk to. Keeps lectures easy and fun, but you still learn a lot.

TAKE THIS CLASS! He's the easiest professor (easy A), but he's one of the best and funniest professors at TCU. He talks about real-world problems with the whole class and its really interesting. Hes a great guy and doesn't assign a lot of hw, ofc there's like 3 major papers we do but he's an easy grader and lets you do the last one optional. 100/10

Grohman is the best professor you can take if you're a freshman business student. He is well educated, informative, and very clear on the instructions. He is currently working as both a professor and a professional and has lots of insight into the business world. The class is broken down into participation, homework, and a few papers (about 2)

Grohman will teach you HOW to think, and not WHAT to think. He's chill and funny, and will help you become a critical thinker who can think for themself. He respects your time and doesn't give busy work. Assignments are straightforward and not overwhelming. Take him if you can!!

Take him! Very chill and understanding professor, you have two big papers and a final project with little other homework that isn't difficult. One of the few classes I actually looked foreword to going to.

Professor Grohman is as good as it gets at TCU, honestly. His class consists of no PowerPoints, but is very discussion based. He provides insightful feedback on the essays that allows you to prepare for the professional world. He did an amazing job at connecting the curriculum to real world business issues, through sharing his experience. TAKE IT!
HE IS THE BEST.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Business in Society is a pretty easy class no matter who you take but its just better with Groham, class is actually fun and we could spend the whole class talking about something random.

Professor Grohman acts like a college student. I mean that in the best way possible. He relates to people our age, unlike every other professor. He is straight to the point and lets you know his expectations. The lectures are really interesting, but it is important to participate. I look forward to going to class if that says anything.
Best of the best. Grohman is the goat
Great guy, very easy to understand and learn from

He is for sure a great professor. He keeps it real and talks about real-life business things that are happening. There are quite a bit of assignments, but nothing too hard. There are 3 essays instead of tests, but he is very fair on grading. It is a discussion based class so lectures are fun and engaging.

not sure why these reviews are complaining about an easy science credit. all his quiz questions are on quizlet and the final is a repeat of the quiz questions, which he literally "allowed" us to use our phones on. this class is an easy A and anyone that disagrees is not going to get through their 4 years of TCU

Terrible experience. Never answers emails (tried 4 times) Grades posted days before the final so no clue how you're doing. Shows up late, cancels class, plays long videos, and talks so quietly you can't follow. Labs make no sense. LockDown Browser quizzes weekly plus the final. I had to P/NC. Thought reviews were exaggerating they weren't. Avoid.
He is very monotone and hard to follow. He usually just puts on a video for lectures and doesn't really teach much. Easy A, but not enjoyable.

Literally the worst prof. ever. I stopped going to lectures a couple weeks in because he always showed up late (or not at all). Even when he did show up, he didn't actually teach. He played videos and then left to play games on his phone. Labs are easy and finish within 30 minutes. Easy class, but final was 30% of grade and you need a 94 for an A.

I'd purposely run out on university on the way to this class hoping I'd get hit by a car. “Easy” in this most unorganized way. Never seen a professor hate teaching as much as this guy does. Oh also I was missing a lab, he said email him to make it up , never responded, then the next week told me labs can't be made up (drops 2 lowest labs but still)

He is just a horrible professor. Cancelled many lectures, has input less than 5 grades and the final is tomorrow. Cannot teach, just plays videos. Oh, the final exam is 30% of your grade in class lockdown browser. Just unreal stuff. Hopefully I finish with an A, but no one knows their grade

Take this for natural science credit. Easiest class I have taken at TCU, but this dude could not care less. Was 15-20 mins late to every single lecture that I went to. Does not teach. Does not grade anything. (Labs are 40% of the grade and he has not graded a single one and finals are next week). Easy A, but professor is annoying. Labs Mandatory.

I have no clue how I am going to get through this class. This is the most boring class I have ever taken, but I need the credit. It's so obvious he doesn't care AT ALL. also, I sit close to the front and he speaks so quietly I can't even understand him half the time. yeesh.

Easiest science class ever! Def take him. I didn't learn anything, but it was an easy credit. Online, weekly, at home quizzes with a lockdown browser and weekly labs that he walks you through. Labs always get out an hour early and he cancels them often. No homework and he rarely ever takes attendance. He lectures every class but slides are posted.

Probably the most boring class I've taken. Most lectures he just plays a video and leaves for half the class. If you want an easy stem class this is one but definitely not interesting by any means. Labs are easy, quizzes are fine. If you are actually interested in stem I would take another class, professor was nice but didn't care much.
Very easy class. No tests, only online quizzes every week that are very easy. Labs are also super easy and always less than one hour. Definitely recommend taking for a science credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He used to be easy but was all over the place this semester. All questions for quizzes you can google but some you can't find and he doenst even know the answer. You just watch videos in class. He says he tells you when he takes attendance but he actually doenst so you never know when he will. The final was not open note but he doesn't use lockdown

Easy labs and quizzes with answers you can easily google and he dropped a few grades. His unpredictability made this class a bit unenjoyable. While most students felt confident in getting an A, he made the final closed notes, contrary to past quizzes. This forced me to P/NC. He was careless of students learning or communication. Take someone else.

DON'T TAKE HIM! The class is easy, you don't do anything, but the prof cares so little it becomes hard. He is disorganized, inconsistent, not understanding at all, and doesn't care about you. All he does is play videos in class, and the quizzes have info you can't find. People say it's easy but not worth it. Class is so messy that I have to P/NC.

DO NOT TAKE HIM. he never repsonds to emails. if you have an excused absence, he won't even check his email and won't excuse you if you miss a lab or quiz. he is so boring. he talks so quiet i cant even hear him. he is actually rude. he doesnt give out grades so you're basically clueless on how ur doing the entire semester. just stay away.
Easy class. Lectures are kinda boring but he is a chill professor. Take the class.

Very easy class. He will make group presentations announced at the beginning of class over one page of information about 3 times a semester, so make sure you go to the lectures. Tests are online, labs are similar to high school science labs but require more explanation.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Extremely easy class for an A. Dropped many quizzes and labs that were lower than 100. Lectures are extremely boring, so get ready for that. The only bad thing is he is terrible at getting back to emails (all mine are still left unanswered) so if that bothers you find another professor for this already easy class.

so easy. attendance isn't taken and you don't need to go its a waste of time. weekly quizzes that can all be found on socratic. labs are group work and are fast and easy. final is open note. just take him he's so easy man

Take this class to fulfill a NSC credit, but avoid if you're genuinely interested in science. Nice guy but class content is ridiculously easy so it makes it difficult to pay attention. Labs feel mundane and pointless.

very easy class. he is hard to get ahold of after class and kind of disorganized. but quizzes are easy and all from the notes. labs are easy and fun. and final is questions straight from the quizzes. take him for NSC
He's very monotone and talks so quietly you can barely hear him. The class is basically just graded off of lab and final. REALLY easy class but boring. Labs are pretty easy and interesting. Def take!
By far best NSC to take at TCU. No one ever went to class, and he just canceled lab for the rest of the semester. Easy A!
You already know what I'm gonna say: Easy A. Just take the class for your natural science class, there's a reason it fills so quickly

Very easy. Prof. Turner can be monotone, but he is funny. Class and lab content is actually really interesting if you show up and listen. I missed quite a few lectures, but my grade was not effected. Graded by 1/3 lab, 1/3 easy online quizzes (weekly), and 1/3 online final (which consisted of questions from his quizzes).

This class is probably the best college class I have ever taken. Very relaxed short lectures. He never really makes you talk a lot and he makes the criteria fun to learn about. For the labs, they are hands on and very interesting. From bridge building to black jack logic you will not have a bad time. If you need an A in a class take this one.

The class is easy as long as you go to the labs and take the quizzes. But Dr. Turner never answers his emails and it is so hard to get in touch with him. If you don't mind your professor not answering your questions, take it.
Lab was a little unorthodox. Professor Turner is nice but part-time so ideal if you need a quick science cred..
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Easy A.

The worst teacher I've had at TCU. Shows up to class 5-10 mins late, rambles about his personal life for 10 or so mins (gambling, Outlook, his phone updates), gets mad when he runs out of time, and tells you to look at it on d2L and teach yourself. Never answered any emails I sent him either. I pass/failed the class just so I didn't have to go

She's a very nice teacher and is very understanding of class absences. All of her tests are straight from her lecture. If you review them a few times, you should be fine—also pretty short lectures. Almost always a quiz is due right before class.

One of the rudest professor at TCU. She will try to fail you, so be extra careful. She is very detail oriented and if you are not doing what she is expecting, you are on your way to fail the class. Dont argue with her bc she wont listen!! Be careful with her feedback bc it will go against you. If you disagree with any grade, try to fix it asap
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She won't point out your mistakes during lab practices and later fail you in check off. She fails more than half of the class in the IV check-off. She set high expectation on you while not doing a great job as a prof to help you succeed. You can't argue with her bc she won't listen. Best of luck dealing with her!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very intimidating, aggressive, and try her best to fail you. Lab should be a place to practice what you learn, but she made it complicated. Her ego is so high that she won't listen or care about you. She said sth like she can teach a 7 yrs old how to do injection, IV, and catheter skills :) She is one of the worst nursing prof for sure
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As a music minor with a difficult, non-music,major, ear training has been very tricky. Dr.Gunter is a very nice, knowledgeable professor, but he doesn't put exam dates in the syllabus and will choose dates for what suits the class, making it difficult to plan for exams. Other than that he's a great professor.

Mr. Gunter is the best professor I have ever had. In every lecture I can almost feel my brain expanding. He is very knowledgeable, takes what he does seriously, but knows how to have a good time. It is near impossible to leave this class without a good laugh and a smile on your face. I am taking my 4th class from him, and I can't recommend enough!!

I took ear training with Mr. G and thoroughly enjoyed it. While the class is challenging, Mr. G is extremely passionate about the class and his students. He'll do anything to ensure you understand the content. He made me enjoy a class I've always struggled with.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Trey is really good at explaining music theory in a way that makes sense and never hesitates to answer questions. I really like the way that he shows us "pop" examples to help us get an idea of what stuff sounds like. There is a lot of homework, but no more than other sections. However, he grades pretty tough.

I took him for Theory and Ear Training, and he is great for both. Very insightful and clear. I learned a lot. Ear Training was difficult though, especially the dictation tests. For Theory, he gives out specially made pages for notes. He includes all kinds of music for examples. He's a really cool guy.

I took survey of pop and jazz from him and thought it was really interesting! He's funny and knows a lot about music. You get to listen to lots of songs but then have to remember small details about them for the tests which are pretty hard but not unreasonable. I definitely recommend this teacher but its not a classic breeze through elective.

GREAT professor! Although his Music Theory is difficult, I learned so much and now have a better grasp and appreciation of music theory. Very light-hearted and funny but serious about doing your work. Always willing to help. Uses all kinds of music from rock to jazz to classical. VERY FUN CLASS! =D
Great professor, very interesting class. DO NOT buy the textbooks. They cost $400 and anything important in them is covered explicitly in class.

Mr. Gunter is one of my favorite professors I've had so far. He is extremely intelligent and he makes class fun. He is great at finding different ways to help students understand and by incorporating jazz, pop, country, and rock into his classical lessons, he makes it easy to understand concepts. absolutely fabulous I highly recommend him.

Incredibly knowledgeable, will give interesting info on theory concepts in jazz, pop, and rock as well as in classical, which illustrates concepts much more easily. Very positive, fun person, willing to explain topics, emails class from time to time.Lots of homework, but gives you typed notes. Don't think he'll be teaching next year, sadly.

Trey Gunter is the best teacher I have ever had.  He loves what he does and his attitude rubs off on his students.  He is extremely helpful and will do whatever it takes to make sure that the students understand the material.  I highly recommend his class!

An excellent teacher! One of the best I've ever had! He provides alot of knowledge in a really interesting way. He is respectful and make sure that everyone in the class participates and understands. He makes funny facial expressions too!

Mr. Gunter is an amazing teacher. Truly gifted at what he does. His class is fun yet challenging at times. He's very good at clarifying anything for you and will work hard to make sure you fully understand whats going on. He makes the class interactive and fun yet he stays on topic. For an 8:00am class it's not too bad to wake up for.
No Comments
Text book heavy, easily get bored, text heavy, pick another professor! But she is very sweet and takable.

Her class in my experience was alright. I wouldn't say she's the best professor out there or even the worst. Her lectures are pretty boring, but all you have to do is come to class, pay attention, and take notes you should be fine, also the exams aren't bad at all, it's literally problems you solve in class!

As long as you go to class and pay attention, this class is not bad at all. I got a B in stats in high school and this was much easier for me. The tests are very similar to homework, which she does examples of in class. I will say the lectures are boring, slow paced, and a little unorganized.
She is such a sweet lady but she does not know how to teach statistics. You basically have to teach yourself and she kinda just goes over the textbook in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Y'all I am going to say it straight: do not take this woman for Elem. Stats. Super nice lady but she was always like 15 mins late, takes forever to grade tests, HW, and quizzes, not a very good teacher, (like TEACHING) and sometimes she doesn't even know what she's talking about she just looks lost. Please save yourself and take someone else. :(

Honestly, I thought she was a great statistics teacher; I cannot say anything about the other subjects. As long as you went to class, paid attention, and took notes, you'll be fine. Her homework looked exactly like what we did in class and on exams, and she explained things very clearly and patiently. She is one of the better statistics professors.

She was fully unprepared to teach our class. Felt like she knew just as much calculus as us and relied on the book for everything. IF you asked her a question most of the time she couldn't answer it. Very sweet lady but completely horrible professor that I would strongly recommend against taking.

Professor Gutierrez is very nice, but the class is extremely boring. She goes over an entire chapter in one class and does not practice that chapter again. She assigns homework every night and it takes a very long time to complete. Test are not terrible but requires lots of studying. She does, however, drop your lowest test grade.

This was the hardest math class I have ever taken. Ms.Gutierrez is so sweet, but the class made no sense to anyone. I ended up having to teach myself everything. The only reason I went to class was that attendance was mandatory, not because I learned anything. The lectures taught nothing. Take any other teacher possible, not her.

sweet and she cares a lot but this class gave me the most stress a math class has ever given me, I had to get a tutor. she is not the best teacher and the classes are pointless but you have to attend because she takes role call every class. she is flexible and will meet with you outside the class if needed. online quizzes and a lot of homework.

This teacher was not my definitely  favorite. She is not good at explaining things and I had to teach myself everything. Even when you go in for office hours she is still not very helpful. I had to work way harder for this class then I should have had too.

The only reason I was able to get a B in this class was because I took general stats in high school. She only shows examples in class, barely touches on how to use the calculator,  and when you do your HW on my lab it only shows you how to solve the problem by hand. The class was pretty contradicting and didn't really make sense.

The only reason to attend class is because she takes attendance. Not because its actually helpful to listen to her teach. Because she does not teach. I have not learned a single thing in this class. She is the most frustrating, infuriating professor I have ever had and is absolutely no help at all. Do not take any courses with her, save yourself.
zsfgsdgdgdg

Mrs. Gutierrez is a kind professor. Her class is boring and she sometimes teaches things that will not be on the exam. However, she wants to make sure you understand the material and gives you plenty of time/attempts to do the homework and the tests. Exams are on paper and in person. You can attend her office hours to do the homework with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Gutierrez is a very kind teacher, but not the best with technology. She made sure to give multiple types of examples during lectures. The different examples are identical to the homework/quiz problems and the problems on the test. She uses My Math Lab for hw and quizzes but gives you three attempts on each. Put in the work and you'll get an A.

It has only been 2 weeks and I am switching to another teacher. She is always unprepared and doesn't know how to use technology which wastes time in class. She goes over basic concepts but fails to demonstrate harder problems. She told us that there would be many application problems on the test but has not shown us how to do any.

She is completely unprepared for every class and is probably the most boring teacher you will ever encounter. Take any other teacher or your GPA will suffer. I studied hard for every test and still managed to only get a B- while all my other classes were A's. I regret not checking her reviews before enrolling, don't make the same mistake I did.

Unfortunately I only have 350 characters to talk about how you should NEVER take her. She's the most unprepared and incompetent professor I have ever had. Her lectures are THE most boring thing you can possibly sit through. You wont learn in class & will have to teach yourself. Considering the price you pay to be at TCU, her class isn't worth it.

Mrs. Gutierrez is a nice lady, but she lacks the ability to connect with her students. Almost everyone in the class is scared of failing but is so bored by the class that they don't bother trying to succeed. If you took AP Calc in high school, you will ACE this class; otherwise, consider taking another professor, bc it's gonna be a rough ride.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I didnt

Do not take calc with Professor Gutierrez unless you have a great understanding of calculus before taking this class. The actual class and homework is very manageable, but the tests are impossible to complete. Not only are they extremely difficult and unlike homework problems, but she also does not Give you enough time. 0/10 recommend

I went into this class thinking it would be just another credit I needed to graduate. This class however exceeded my expectations! Professor Martinez is awesome he really cares about his students and their success as well as having a passion for the material. There aren't tests and the homework isnt too hard. Highly recommend taking this class.

Had him for piano. As someone said above, taking piano with him is hell. I came in as a music major with very little previous piano knowledge and worked incredibly hard, and my efforts were mostly unnoticed; I typically got very poor grades within his class. ONLY TAKE PIANO WITH HIM IF YOU HAVE TAKEN PIANO LESSONS BEFORE/HAVE PIANO EXPERIENCE!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Mr. Martinez is a phenomenal pianist, but as a teacher, he can be extremely frustrating. He demands a lot from students doesn't teach them on an individual level. Instead, he patronizes students who can't do exactly what he wants the way he wants. He is especially hard on freshman because he's weeding out the people who "shouldn't study music."
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Mr. Martinez is a nice guy and the class is pretty easy. However, just a fair warning, he is a pretty eccentric guy. He is easily offended and can turn moods pretty quickly. It's really not a big deal if you are nice to him and keep quiet in class, though.
Mandatory attendance drops you one letter grade for every class missed over two.  Homework due every class.  Midterm and Final are very easy.

He was a fun teacher. I was in the accelerated class, and some days, we would just listen to music. He is very smart (but don't talk to him about modern music) and very helpful in teaching piano. He ios one of the funniest teachers I've had so far, and one of the best as well.

AWESOME!  Martinez is a major reason why TCU has the best piano program in the nation.  I learned a lot of technique in his class that has dramatically improved my piano skills.  Not only is he a great teacher but he's one of the coolest teachers I've met at TCU.

Great professor. Extremely helpful. Nice person. And excellent musician. Music Theory for non-majors is a very easy A class and you learn A LOT! He plays the piano sometimes during class which makes class even more enjoyable. If you have a question just send him an email and he answers pretty quick...I stronly recommend taking this class with him!!

Music theory for non-majors - Class was a blast.  We got into it and joked around with him while covering the material.  He's the nicest guy ever and is very flexible about his homework assignments and his tests are cake.  Take if you want to learn basic music.  I've heard his piano classes are hell, but he's a great guy.
Marty is cool but he runs his piano class like a dictator. He expects you to do a lot of work and care about the class. If you don't practice he might tell you you should just quit.
Rough at first, but always ready to give all his students a chance. A wonderful man.

He makes the material really easy.  Most of the grade comes from homework so if you do that you are in good shape.  He is very flexible with late work, if you get behind.  If you have problems he will help you.  Good class.
extremely easy class. he makes the course very easy. really sweet guy. do the homework. very helpful. one exam and project which is peanuts. good class for an elective.

Mr. Martinez was extremely helpful to me when I took this class! I have never taken music before, and his slower pace made things a lot easier to pick up! I felt like I actually understood. If you have had a lot of prior music experience this might not be the class to take, you could be bored.

Lighthearted, funny professor who will always help if you need it. Student opinions seem a bit mixed here at TCU, but my experience with him was very positive. He only tests twice and all the work is a breeze.

Easy, slow, works with students assuming they have no prior knowledge to music theory. Works well with students. Can work at a tediously slow pace, though. Cheerful, flexible, understanding. Really good for first year music students, and freshman.
Willy really wants to have control over students; best to be out of his purvue
Such a great teacher!  Very funny and SO nice!  he's helpful with homework and works with you to do well in the class.

Terrible time managementthrows a fit if youre late but never ends on time. Uses TCU orchestra to learn music for his outside professional gigs. Literally doesnt learn the score before the first rehearsal, although hes usually ready by the concert. Also, we play more terribly arranged Latin music than we do standard repertoire. D- conductor.

Dr. Gutierrez for conducting is pretty easy, but he's not a great teacher. He often forgets about assignments (which can be either nice or frustrating) and is very disorganized. The class doesn't have a very clear structure, either. It felt like we jumped around a lot. However, I did learn some stuff and it was very easy.

Dr. Gutierrez is a wonderful conducting teacher. His standards are very high, and he pushes students to prepare before class and do the work. He is extremely knowledgeable and he is one of the professors I respect most at TCU.

Picks people he hates for absolutely no reason at all. Really enjoys punishing people who are legitimately good musicians and rewarding the poor musicians. All in all, a terrible man. Poor conductor too...where is his beat? He just flails his arms around and expects you to follow that. I used to love orchestra before I came to TCU.
Maestro Gutierrez is very nice and cares about his students. If anyone dislikes him, it is because they think they know better and are arrogant and don't take the class seriously.
Very Passionate about music, very fun and interesting class.

Barely speaks English--sounds a lot like the Tasmanian devil.  He is very passionate about music, but has horrible conducting technique.  We play more poorly-arranged Latin music than we do standard repertoire.  Horrible time management skills--complains about showing up late, but never finishes on time.

Dr. Gutierrez is AWESOME! If you are a music major, take any class you can with him. He is always encouraging, though he expects a lot from his students. The time and effort you put in for him will be rewarding, though, both in what you learn from him and your grade in his class. Take a class from him if you can! It's WORTH it!

He's a completely wonderful person. His accent is so cute! Very nice, considerate, easy to please.If you wrote a negative comment, then either you're one of the people that didn't practice,didn't show up on time, or didn't pay attention. He never yells.  A wonderful professor!!!
No Comments

Gutierrez is a very very nice person, and does not just think about himself.  He cares about each and every member and seeks the success of individuals and the orchestra as a whole. -and a good conductor.

why is everyone doggin on german?? i love him, he's not a natzi about no talking and he loves music. he's not hard to please, the strings show up right at 330 and he gets upset, it's their own fault. learn proper rehearsing ediquette, strings!!! german rocks.
The guy is the dumbest musician in the history of music.Obviously the most uncompetent person I have ever seen, when talking about music.NOt a bad person, overall.
sometimes you can't understand him but he's a wonderful person, and who wouldn't love a german
One of the nicest guys in the department. Very helpful. Loves to see his students succeed. Like to treat his students to nice stuff when they do well and show proggress.

Hates percussionists.....When the section was clearly understaffed, he couldn't stop complaining about how they couldn't cover everything. As if it's percussion sections fault? It really sucks travelling off campus to practice at the old orchestra hal

Gutierrez cares about his students. Yes, Strong accent and all that, (who cares?)  but he achieves good performances almost miraculously. The problem lies in the bunch of slackers in orchestra that fill up room but never practice.
He really thinks ONLY about himself. Not very understanding with students. Class always is longer than it has to be, loooong orchestra rehearsals, don't give breaks every time.
Very strong accent!Think only about himself.Tries to show everybody that he is very helpful but the truth is that he thinks only about himself.Not bad person,though!Nice guy!

Chen Laoshi's really, really sweet, but Chinese is also pretty hard! Chen Laoshi is really patient and caring, and you can tell that she wants you to succeed. I've struggled from time to time, but I think it's just a reflection of the language. Would definitely recommend for any students looking to take language but not sure which language.

Chen laoshi is the best! She is so caring and kind. If you miss HW she is very understanding and gives you an extension. Chinese is a hard language but she makes it super fun and interesting. There is a good amount of HW, but it really helps you learn the language. Tests are also not that bad as she helps you a ton. TAKE HER!
Chen Laoshi is a really great teacher. Chinese is a difficult language to learn, but she is very patient and tries very hard to make sure everyone can succeed.

Chen laoshi is amazing!!! She helps so much to make sure each student does well and is so cute, caring and helpful! You have to go to class and out of class tutoring for credit but it is helpful. You will love her, i plan on taking her again and again.

Chen Laoshi is a great teacher. She truly cares about her students and the grade you make in her class. She is always there to provide extra help. She's really invested into the program and her students. I'll be taking her again next semester.
This lady is the best grandma ever

Harris was the nicest professor ever. Although at times she could be very straight forward and strict, she was so welcoming and nice. Put your best foot forward and she will help you succeed. If you are looking for a nice English teacher, pick her.

I really enjoyed Dr. Harris and her teaching methods. She deeply cares for each and every student. Always taking the time to say hi to each student and ask how they are doing. When there was forest fires in California she took the time to ask CA students if their friends and families were ok. She is a fairly easy grader and the class should be an A

Dr. Harris was a good professor. She is so willing to help students outside of class, and you have unlimited opportunities to revise your papers. The class is focused on science so that makes it a little more selective, but all papers were relatively easy & there's around 4. Final is to record a podcast. As long as you make an effort, it's easy.

This professor is probably the worse you can find at TCU. She would even be a horrible proffesor for a community college. I work so hard on her papers, the writing lab even tells me my papers are good, and she gives me C's and D's on all them. She just doesn't like me and she is just rude to pretty much everyone. Don't take her for comp 2
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Dr. Harris is a pretty solid teacher when it comes to giving you feedback and actually learning new material. However she treats the class like its a masters program. Be prepared to write, and write a LOT. she also is very influenced by politics, which makes the class I guess more interesting but also harder as you must select a topic for semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Harris is fantastic. She is incredibly knowledgeable and is clearly passionate about what she does. She can take a little while to warm up to, but by the end of the course, she was one of the best professors I've ever had. Extremely helpful in office hours. If you do the reading and demonstrate solid knowledge of the material, you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She is a nice lady just show her that you actually care about her class. She lets you have "writing conferences" with her if you're unhappy with your grade on her papers, which is pretty much an opportunity to get lots of points back. Actually show that you care and she'll respect you and try to help you.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Took this class for my LT core. Terrible idea. There are no breaks, at least 12 hours a week. Ridiculous. I took 18 hours so had no time to read Greek mythology. Didn't read, always read spark notes, but it was extremely hard to keep up. Tests and quizzes are hard, I don't know how I slid by with a B. Extra credit was the key. Get on her good side

Professor Harris is the sweetest lady I've taken at TCU.I took her Writing Arguments class and for once, actually enjoyed writing. You get to pick your topics of all papers and she is so engaged to every student - she sent me an article about my topic over the weekend. She is so passionate about her job and I had no problem making an A with effort!

Intro Comp with Harris was a bad idea because she only lets you write about science while other classes can write about anything. She gives good feedback & lets you revise papers at the end of the semester. She knows what she's talking about & is sometimes interesting but it seemed like a science class. Lots of opportunities to get help.

Dr. Harris is a very nice lady and is clearly very passionate about what she does. She uses up every minute of class so getting out early is not likely. Her lectures are hard to follow because she expects you to have a good base knowledge of the subject which is  annoying because she doesn't explain things well at all.  Always willing to give help.
She's a great teacher and is really there to help her students

I loved this class and Mrs. Harris is awesome!  Do not come into this class expecting an easy ride.  She has an unlimited revision policy on the papers you write too.  If you need an int. comp. take this course!  The poor ratings she has are probably the lazy people who put in zero effort.

Mrs. Harris is passionate about the subject matter but outside of that is not a particularly great teacher. If you are just taking English for core I wouldn't recommend her, she takes the course very seriously and is offended when students don't devote a lot of time and effort to her course.

I had Mrs. Harris for Intro to Comp the Science based course. She created this course along with other professors so she was passionate about it. Her peer edits were set up nice and very helpful. She knows what she is talking about and gives back your papers with comments all over them so you know how to improve. Overall great English experience.

I had Mrs. Harris for Intro Comp.  She knows her stuff and will actually help you with revising, contrary to what the previous comment says.  Yes, you have to seek help, but welcome to college. Peer editing is very helpful because she structures it well.  She does give you the opportunity to revise papers if you're not happy with your grade.
Didn't help at all with papers unless you went out of your way to seek it. All papers were peer edited, so she never looked at them until the final grade, which was wholly unhelpful.
The material was never explicitly taught, and we never knew what to study or prepare for assignments.

Harry is one of the kindest professors at TCU! He genuinely cares about his students and wants them to do well. There is lots of reading, quizzes and essays. None of them are super hard but he can be a tough grader. His lectures are funny, engaging and he shows lots of passion for the material.

Be prepared for having to spend your own money to go see every TCU theatre show, and one outside of the school as well for papers that are mandatory. Harry was very funny, and always called for engagement and cared about what was going on in our lives. You can tell his political and personal beliefs though on certain topics.

Art of the Theatre. Harry Parker cares deeply about all his students. The tests are pretty hard. You have to study quite a bit, but they're more memorization rather than comprehension. The textbook chapters are pretty long. You have to write a paper about every show TCU does in that semester. I learned soooo much though and will encourage it!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: He is extremely boring. Despite his love for the material i never failed to fall asleep. He is not kind if you talk about changing your major. Avoid this man.
He is one of the best speakers I have ever heard. Makes the subject matter so interesting because he loves it. VERY detail oriented test so read your book, but a great teacher!

Harry is awesome! I took 20th century theater thinking it was a blow off class. It was much harder than expected, lots of names and dates, but Harry made it interesting. You can tell that he loves what he is talking about. An A is achievable if you work for it. I really enjoyed his class! He is awesome!

Great teacher and you can really tell he loves what he does. Going along with class discussions and keep up with reading and you'll be fine. I got behind and it was hard to get back. 4 show reviews. Everything is equal in points on his grade system-even the final.
Awesome lectures, entertaining and useful, but beware detail oriented tests and essays.
Very fun and informative lectures.  He cares about students and has great insight.
No Comments

Excellent professor!  It is very helpful when you can tell the professor absolutely loves the material he is teaching.  I felt more like I was listening to a fun story than a lecture.  Make sure you read the book though, it is very helpful!  Doing the reviews will all but guarantee  good grades on tests.
Dr. Parker is very interesting to listen to and makes you want to learnt the material.

Dr. Parker really cares about his students. His tests are detailed and if you don't read but pay close attention and take good notes you can come away with an B or C. He is very passionate about what he teaches.

Dr. Parker is very passionate about what he teaches.  He has expectations of his students that he holds highly, but he is a very nice man and is more than willing to help you and wants you to come and ask... His papers are fairly easy and his test are straight from his notes

Harry Parker is an excellent professor. He is passionate about the theatre and his class. True, his tests are remarkably difficult, but as long as you take good notes and study them, you will do fine. He is not too difficult when it comes to the papers either. Just pay attention ( or at least ACT like you are paying attention ) and he'll like you.
Honestly, he is a great person. But teaching wise, i don't exactly like his style. His tests are fairly difficult, reveiws are insanely long and undetailed. Take good notes, you'll need them.
does not give a rip about students
No Comments
Good class, but a lot of writing and the tests are difficult. They cover a lot of information. Not so much reading though, just take very complete notes.

This class was so easy and interesting!  He takes attendance and part of ur grade is determined by that.  Tests were so easy, but be careful bc he shows some movies to help prove his point and asks u 3-4 questions(out of like 150 which r from the book) about the movie. highly recommended!

I hate musical theatre, but Parker's combination of videos & lecture makes it interesting enough. He's admirably passionate about the subject and is pretty entertaining. He's a very kind and caring professor. It's not too hard,just attend class, take notes, study.

great teacher...could possibly be found boring for the uncultured.  i, personally, thought the class was fun and it is unbelievably easy to get a 'B' (and im one of the five dudes in the class).  if you get a 'C' you shouldn't be in college.

He is not the best person to take for this class.Goes beyond the required material for an intro class and tests are not easy. He is boring but plays music during class making it abit lively. He isn't very helpful. Take Anne Healey instead she's the best.
Doesn't respond well to email.  His discussions are interesting, but sometimes long and boring.  I would not take his class unless you can't find another teacher.
Well, i must be 1 of the 4 guys in Dr. Parkers class. Everyone eles is obvioulsy a girl, i'm an athlete so i took this as a blow-off class, its not so much, but it is pretty easy
this is an easy class as long as your willing to show up. the subject matter is pretty interesting, but sometimes the lectures seem a bit long. overall though, he's a good guy and it's a great class.
He's a great teacher and his class is really fun, but he can sometimes embarrass you without knowing it.  If you get over those parts, which happen rarely, he's a good person.
Great class if you are interested in the subject matter. Pretty easy, and I loved it and would take it again.
Generally a good teacher. A fun class for the most part (lots of theater tours and easy writing) plus you learn the basics of theater criticism. The notes are simple and there is no text book.

Lets just say for a one hour course, this could quite possibly be the most unmotivating class I have ever taken. And I love theater....Harry is condescending and even had students give speeches so he didn't have to teach the class.
His thesis is now a doorstop, and he talked forever about how he got his PHD. O-yeah and our book was the department handbook! By far the most boring & un-motivating class that I've had in 3 yrs.
This is a great class, but honestly, sometimes his talks are hard to sit through. He's definitely a theatre snob, but that can be a good thing.
1 credit class feels like 3. Don't take him.
Can be a nice guy, but often acts lofty and arrogant. Some easy bonus quizes if you read the assignments. Overall a fun class. Take good notes and you are almost garaunteed at least a B.
She is a great teacher and I learned so much from her. Her grading is very fair and she is so kind and helpful.

I took Mrs. Hamon for Honors Public Address and made an A. She is such an amazing professor and I would 100% take her again, she is such a good teacher and you will grow as a speaker in this class. There is a decent workload between short readings and speech preparation, but with consistency, you will make an A.
Sweet professor! She cares about students. There is a lot of reading but take notes and you'll be fine. Speeches suck but they help a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I expected an easy public speaking class, but she requires more than most professors. Quizzes are now in class with Respondus, and you can't rely/manuscript style on flashcards or scripts after the second speech. If you want to grow as a speaker, take her—otherwise, a different prof. might be easier, especially if you're taking a mandatory class.

Grading criteria is super straight forward. If you just go to class and so what's on the rubric you will do good on the speeches. The exams aren't that hard, just review the study guide and you should do well.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Hamon was amazing! She makes the class enjoyable and easy to succeed in. The speeches aren't hard and were fun to give.

Disclaimer: I had Mrs Hamon, not a TA. I thought her class was pretty easy- if you do the chapter outlines and show up to class, you should definitely get a B at minimum. She's really clear on exactly what she wants for each assignment and the class is very structured (which I appreciate). Definitely recommend

I had Jordan Hamon as my actual professor in class instead of a TA, unlike many of my friends. She is caring and wants you to succeed. I did well on all my speeches and she gave good feedback for all three. Her quizzes are a bit difficult considering the information is straight forward. If you want her as your teacher and not a TA, take an 8am

Jordan Hamon is awesome! There is some variability in the TA you get, but the tests are the same. I'm not gonna lie, the homework was tedious, each lecture took me 3-6 hours. Though, I took extremely detailed notes. If you are satisfied with a B, you could get through the homework quicker. Tip: Take great notes and the tests are fine!

speech is taught by a TA, not mrs hamon. some TAs grade easier than others so maybe take a different professor for speech since you dont know who you'll get. homework every night is busywork and annoying, but easy. Midterm and final aren't hard if you read the book and understand the terms. No plus minus either
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I would recommend taking a different professor, simply because the chance of getting a TA instead is too much of a wild card. Each one grades differently. This isn't a terribly difficult class, but the busy work is exhausting (and not always relevant) and the midterm and final are pretty tough. This class is a popular one to P/NC (I used one too)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Mrs. Hamon is a fantastic professor who is really passionate about her profession. She is nice and caring and will try hard to help you. There is a mediocre amount of work as most classes there is something due, but it isn't very hard. If you follow the rubrics and instructions for assignments and review minimally for tests, an A is easy to get.

Now, I THOUGHT I was signing up for Ms. Hamon's class, but sometimes her classes are taught by a TA. Since there were lots of TA's essentially teaching the same class, grades were disputable. The midterm and final were both pretty tough. There was busywork homework every night too. This class wasn't hard, but was a burden. I used P/NC.
Mrs. Hamon is an awesome teacher and her lectures are engaging. Homework can be tedious but is easy. Very easy B and a doable A.

Ms. Hamon is a very knowledgable professor who knows what she's talking about in terms of communication. She's a pretty tough grader on speeches and her tests aren't easy.
