Put in a little effort in studying for them and you'll be fine. Make sure you go to class and do all the daily assignments cause they'll save your grade. Easy B, attainable A.

I know y'all probably read this on ratemyprofessors a lot, but Mrs. Hamon is literally the best teacher I've ever had...not only at TCU but in my entire academic career.  The only bad experience I had with her all semester was when she told us she was married ='(  Take her for any class, doesn't matter what it is, you will not regret it

Jordan is the best! I had her basic speech class & I'm so glad I took her. She is one of the best professors within the comm department. You definitely need to buy the book for basic speech. Tests are multiple choice. Take Jordan if you can!

Favorite Communication professor I've ever had, she makes class so much fun and really involves you as a student.  Interpersonal is so much fun as a class, you literally talk about relationships all class.  Work load is not too intense and never very hard, either! Take her!!

Dr. Harris was an amazing professor to take for my first semester at TCU! I took Death because it sounded interesting, and he did not disappoint! He brought a sense of humor to a very complicated and dark topic and I hope I can take another of his courses. The courseload is somewhat burdensome, but shouldn't exhaust you.

Can't recommend Harris enough! He has such fun personality and is very approachable. His lectures were super easy to follow and gave an in-depth analysis of readings while staying easy to understand. Obviously a very knowledgeable professor, one of my favorite at TCU!

Good choice if you want to P/NC a CSV double dip class. He is not the type to "go after you" if you're there to simply get the credit and dip. Clear and fair grading criteria substantiate this. Odd textbook with some hard to understand readings. Funny guy with decent lectures but he took FOREVER to grade our first major paper.

3 major papers, 12 response papers, and 12 quizzes. Prof Harris is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is a great teacher and extremely funny. The readings are quite hard, often long and difficult to understand, and a response paper eery week. He always explains the readings very well, but only after you have to write about them.

Professor Harris is a very passionate professor. I took his intro to philosophy class for core credit and loved it. In total, the coursework consists of 3 long papers, 12 response papers, and 14 quizzes (2 pages in length), so you definitely have to work for the A. Harris grades fairly and wants you to succeed, all the writing is worth it!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Took Dr. Harris for philosophy of law! He is super funny and the discussions are amazing in class! He has a pass/fail grading criteria and clearly outlines the requirements to receive a certain grade in the class. Very knowledgeable dude and HILARIOUS!!! Provides 6 "tokens" to complete in exchange for missed/failed assignments. Tokens are easy!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Approachable and funny prof! His papers and tests are a bit difficult if you're not a philosophy major/understand abstract thoughts so prepare to read more closely. Don't hesitate to visit him during office hours if you're confused about something. It's best to read ahead of time instead of after lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Definitely one of my favorite professors at TCU. Best in the Philosophy Dept. If you get the chance to take from him definitely do so! It's true, he's really funny and loves teachings - which shows in his lectures. Sometimes can be a bit hard to please with essays on tests, but overall a very fun teacher.
Best professor I've had so far! So funny and engaging with the class. Go to class and the reading isn't as necessary. TAKE HIM
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Prof. Harris is absolutely one of my favorite teachers. He is so funny and down to earth, and his lectures are entertaining. His lectures were easy to follow, and he made notes easy to take, so as long as you go to class and read you'll be fine. His test aren't hard if you have good notes. 10/10 would recommend.

Prof. Harris is HILARIOUS! You will get to laugh every session. However, he's not very clear in his lecture though. Thus, DO THE READINGS and you will be fine. The materials he chooses for his classes are also very interesting. He's also not a harsh grader.

John is great philosophy teacher and keeps the class interesting. It was one of the only classes I took that I never missed once because I wanted to go! I was a business major who shouldn't have taken the class and ended up getting a C. I regret not participating more in class. It helps a lot. Take him if you like philosophy

Dr. Harris is an extremely smart dude, and it shows with zero pretentiousness on his part.  He lays all of the concepts out for you, but encourages a lot of participation in class.  Quizzes over the current readings, so you have to keep up and stay prepared.  Some tough concepts to wrap your head around but hard work will earn you a good grade.

Prof. Harris is a very funny guy and knows what he is teaching. Attendance is not mandatory but it's best you go to class because he provides clarity to the readings. Composed of 4 grades, 3 tests (open answer) and the final consists of a written paper that can be done at home pshh! Amazing prof. take him for a good time in class
He is friggin' hilarious, so that make the class easier to pay attention to.

Prof. Harris incorporates enough allusions and violent metaphors to sufficiently explain basic principles of critical thinking. You could learn something in this class. He is entertaining, quick and super smart. Take his class for awesome humanities credit or for philosophic-good times... either way he won't disappoint.

John is definitely one of my favorite teachers of all time. He is tremendously funny, keeps the class entertained, and possesses the ability to intertwine his humor with his teachings. His class is probably the only class I've ever had in which I actually was pissed if I slept in and missed it. Take this class, and he will change your life.
No Comments
John is great! He makes philosophy so much more interesting and easier to understand. I never fell asleep!

Great teacher and funny as hell. Knowledgeable guy with the ability to translate upper level philosophical thought into terms anybody would understand. Brilliantly incorporates his humor and has a knack for one liners. Entertaining class and easy to understand. Learned the most during his time in intro phil class. Highly recommended

Nah Ray is a TOUGH teacher do not get me wrong. But, all things considered, if you try hard and stay on top of things, you can totally get an A. It is CRUCIAL that you read the textbook and take lots of notes. Studying is a must, and if you try to cram things in just a few days, you will not succeed.
I have no good things to say. DO NOT TAKE!!!!!!!!!!

There were two tests that were extremely hard and the study guides did not help at all (I've never gotten scores that low on a test before). She was a very tough grader on assignments. You MUST go to class. I liked her as a person but the hard tests and assignments ruined the class for me.

The tests are insanely hard no matter how much you study. Terrible ar explaining or answering questions. She asks a bunch of irrelevant questions on the test that even the textbook's author might not be able to answer.

Definitely do not take her if you can. 2 big tests the whole semester that cover so much material- she gave us a study guide but nothing from the study guides were on the tests. She grades things hard for no reason and just made the class more difficult then it needed to be.

Do not take her. Attendance is completely mandatory; grade is based on 2 multiple-choice 75-question tests. Her feedback never aligns with what she actually wants. Take any other teacher, but not her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 2 big tests and the study guide/practice quizzes do not prepare you at all. You will think your doing the right thing and than get feedback and it will be apparently be completely wrong. If you can take any other professor I would recommend anyone but her.

I have taken courses from Dr. Havens twice now, Law and Literature as well as the Medieval Murder class. Both experiences have been excellent. The only homework you will have is reading before each class (20-40 pages). 8 pop quizzes throughout the semester with 2 drops that you can use as you please in addition to two tests and a final. Great prof!
4 books to read. Very boring. 8 quizzes throughout the semester, all are 20 questions and short answer. 3 weeks in to class and I wouldn't wish this on my worst enemy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you want a law‑centered CSV or easy humanities credit, do NOT take this. Dr. Havens is super nice and knows her stuff, but the class is full of old Icelandic poems, random topics she likes, and endless pointless reading. She grades easy so you can get an A if you actually do the work, but you'll hate doing it. Felt like a huge waste of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Yes, there is a lot of reading, but she is genuinely a good teacher and if you read the books and listen in class, you will be completely fine

So boring and so hard for literally no reason. The material makes no sense and there's 50 pages of reading after every class, and you'll probably still do bad on pop quizzes even if you read. Take someone else for core.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I really like Dr. Havens, but wouldn't take this class again. Pop quizzes most weeks, HARD TESTS, lots of reading. She is very passionate but not the easiest class to do well in, even when studying. English class but heavy on medieval history.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Havens is a great teacher and cares a lot about her students. There is a lot of reading, homework, and beware of pop quizzes (even though she will tell you when they are generally coming and she will drop your lowest two quiz grades). The class is tough, but if you put in effort, you can get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Currently at midway of semester; do not take her. Shes super hard for a core english credit, there are way better options. Too much reading, several pop quizzes. Quizzes make up majority of your grade. Unless you like to read 40 pages, don't take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This class was stupid. the class started with 30 people and dropped to 7 by the end. if you miss one detail in the many readings due everyday, you will fail the pop quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Only two exams so STUDY, lots of readings but she is a fun teacher and loves to talk with students. Content is not as interesting as you would think, but it is still cool to learn about.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lots and lots of reading, and random pop "quizzes". I did the reading consistently and still got 70s on the quiz, and I wasn't the only one that did this. Big, 2-day tests also make up the majority of your grade, which is extremely unreasonable for a core credit. Think again before taking the Ghost stories class as part of your core.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Do not get me wrong she is a very passionate teacher and cares a lot, but this class (I am taking the ghost stories one) should ONLY be taken by english majors. The readings are so long, attendance is absolutely mandatory, her quizzes/tests are impossible even if you read, and UNDER NO circumstance should you take it for a core credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Havens is by far one of the most challenging professors in the English department, all I have to say is if your taking her for core don't please I warn you. Havens is made more for those that are actual English majors and minors, she's a tough grader, but her teachings are better for us that are in the department.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Havens is so sweet. She's really passionate about her classes and truly cares about her students. I took the ghost stories class and the reading was often really good and usually wouldn't be longer than 25 pages (and I hate reading). You have to write 2 papers and she grades them tougher than I was expecting, but it didn't kill my grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Tests are 2 open note essays, 8 pop quizzes (2 are dropped - usually got 90s..the lowest I got was a 66 and I didn't read that time so they aren't bad), and a group project. The group project was fun but I am worried she will grade it hard. She's hilarious & so nice. An easy LT credit but you definitely have to put in a little work for an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The Intro to Fiction Ghost Story class was very enjoyable and Dr. Havens is a very kind & down-to-earth person. It's an English class so there are readings which you will have to do for the pop quizzes. Plus, there's a large group project at the end of the semester. But if you come to class, do the readings, and actively participate you'll be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: its so BORING. heavy reading. be careful, pop quizzes typically on wednesdays. Dr. Havens is nice but the class may be as boring as watching paint dry. i took it because it sounded fun, but it could be the opposite of that. and plus the pop quizzes suck. The class is semi easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Group projects

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Haven's ghost story class. Super interesting content but kind of reading heavy for a core class. You have to do the readings for pop quizzes that happen pretty often and make up a good part of your grade. A nice lady but I P/NC the class. They put a lot of athletes in the class for a reason - super fun just a bit of reading
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This class is very reading and quiz heavy. Prepare for a quiz every week, usually on Wednesdays. I read every assignment and would still get 50% on quizzes. They are so specific and impossible to do well on. The 2 unit tests are 3 page essays open for 24 hours. Also prepare to give group presentations in class twice a semester. Enjoyed this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: You can tell she truly cares about literature and wants us to engage and learn along side her. There is a lot of ready and the pop quizzes are tough so make sure you read, but other than that the 2 tests are papers that she well prepares and lays out for you. As well as group/ house presentations.

This class is really easy but the teacher makes it hard. The pop quizzes are very hard as well as some readings. The class consist of a couple of online test and a massive group project that the whole class is revolved around. For what should be a fun and engaging topic this teacher makes it super boring and too serious.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Very nice lady, however, this should not be a freshman level class. Her pop quizzes are ridiculous and try to trick you, 25 questions all short answer. Some of the readings are quite confusing while others are very easy. Essay exams are very easy, however, you are only given 24 hours to complete them. There's better classes out there.

At first I didn't like professor havens, however, after a few weeks in the class, I started to really like her. She's really enthusiastic about the stuff she teaches and will work with you if something happens. There's a lot to read but it's not too bad most of the time.

ENG intro to fiction (ghost story)was a super easy class but very boring. She "requires" attendance but no one ever showed up unless it was for quiz day. Dr. H is super sweet and has a lot of amazing stories, but there is nothing motivating to actually want to make you show up. Overall pretty easy A, just a lot of reading and 2 papers+group project

PLEASE DONT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HER!! ITS SO TOUGH AND NOT WORTH IT. SHE IS A VERY TOUGH GRADER. THIS CLASS AND HER ATTITUDE are not good. Nothing about game of thrones, just boring medevial lit. Beware.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Really nice and responds quickly. A LOT of reading (it is a college lit class...), the quizzes can be tough, even if you do the reading, and the readings can be tough to understand/a lot of information to remember. While she is a tougher grader, she is very clear in her rubrics (can be good and bad).
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Topic of this class was obscure. Professor havens' Quizzes are harder than the tests and worth just about the same amount of points. Whether or not you read these quizzes are still very hard. As a Junior this is the only class that is giving me trouble anymore and would do anything you can to avoid it. Would not recommend Professor Havens to anyone
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: So much reading and pop quizzes on the details
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: You have to read a lot because it is an English class, but it's overall pretty easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You have to get a lot of books for this class. It's a lot of reading, but all you do is go to class and talk about it in student-led discussions. You are split into groups and make questions to ask the class about the previous reading. Very easy. Only two essays and a pair presentation for the final. Really nice lady, but she's a slow grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took her for Honors Lit & Civ: The Story of Troy. Very interesting class which tied various classical texts to the Trojan War. Shes a great professor that promotes great class discussion and cares about her students. The essays are hard, especially the second one, but still doable. Id recommend taking Dr. Havens for any LT you may need to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors! I took her Ghost Story class. Dr. Havens cares a lot about her students and helps out as much as she can. There's plenty of opportunities for extra credit plus an easy group project at the end of the semester to give you a grade boost. SPEAK UP IN CLASS & she'll like you even more!!

Very reading heavy but super interesting. The house presentations are fun and easy. I hadn't even watched Game of Thrones and did well in her class. Lectures are interesting. Always be ready for pop quizzes over the readings. Tests aren't bad if you do the readings and study the lecture notes. Very fun class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lots of outside reading. Quizzes and overall discussion make the class WORTH IT. If you have watched GOT you will thrive. You get divided into Houses on Friday for discussion. Tests are long and hard, but going to class and reading prepares you. Best class I have taken in college.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The game of thrones class is the best English class you can take if you like the show or medieval literature. The books assigned are not hard, and usually interesting. There are pop quizzes but just do the readings and you will get A's on them. If you do the work and read on time you will be fine, don't skip because every absence is points off.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I love Jill-she is the best & clearly loves what she does. She has a good system. There are 2 exams (the 1st one is challenging & the 2nd one is all writing but you can easily get an A). You don't have to take the final if you have an A. 2 extra credits, pop quizzes (only things I got a B on in the class). Never read any of the books. Go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She's a nice woman, just a tough grader. She's very specific about what she wants in a paper and grades according to the rubric, so follow it. Ask questions in class on exactly what she wants in a paper and run your ideas past her because she gives pretty good feedback and where to go with the paper. Also allows corrections on first 2 papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She is a cool professor, but is a tough grader when it comes to essays. There isn't too much homework, but she allows you to make multiple revisions on the essays.
It is definitely a pleasure to take Dr. Haven's class. I learn a lot. I suggest taking this class if you love reading. She always welcomes the students' ideas and comments.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Havens is one of the best Professors i've ever taken. I took her Game of Thrones class and it was a ton of fun. It is a tough class however, so be prepared to read, A LOT. She does give quizzes around every 2 weeks (unannounced) but if you did the reading you generally have no problem passing them. Gives extra credit as well!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Havens! She's a pretty cool person. I took her for the Game of Thrones class. Interesting and an easy A, I would definitely recommend for an LT or a humanities credit.

This was the best course that I took during my undergrad career. Imagine taking a class on your favorite TV serious/ book series. If you love Game of Thrones and you want to learn about the history behind it, you might as well get credit for it. I would recommend this class to anyone familiar with the series.
I took Dr. Haven's "Fable and Fantasy" class where we analyzed Game of Thrones. Best english class I have ever taken. Tests and quizzes were not hard if you study/read. Her class is interesting.
Dr. Havens is super nice. The projects are pretty lengthy and make you think, but they are doable. Make sure to read, and participate in class. She gives great help if you ask for it, too.

A word to the wise: don't take this class if you have a life outside of school work. You're reading 40-50 pages for every class period, and these aren't easy stories to comprehend. 10 pop quizzes, two tests, and a final. Dr. Havens is willing to help you out, but this is a TOUGH class and requires a lot of work on your own time.

I was super interested in Mythology. It's Greek, then Celtic, then Norse mythology, so NOT JUST GREEK! There was a lot of reading, 30-60 pages per class. Pop quizzes were easy if you read. Tests were mostly writing, theres a list of stories she'll use on the test. This professor was very passionate and fun, but took 1 month to return test grades...

The most difficult class I've ever taken. At least 50 pages of reading, not fun reading, read twice and take notes reading, before every class, 3 times a week. Pop quizzes, that feel more like exams, every week, 10 questions, short answer. Exams are difficult, require extensive knowledge and understanding of the readings. Attendance is for a grade

Awful teacher. Assigns 40-50 pages of reading for every class. Didn't specify format of tests until two days before the test. Gives eight pop quizzes that are ten short answer questions. When she teaches in class, you learn a lot. Unfortunately, tests and quizzes focus mainly on reading rather than in-class lectures. Avoid at all costs

Fable and fantasy is an extremely interesting class. Havens is very nice, helpful, passion about her teaching. Her tests are not so clear, she change the format of every test. Go to class and you will be fine. A is possible

Only 4 grades for the entire semester! The semester is now over and she still hasn't posted 2 of the grades or given any feedback. First grade wasn't posted until AFTER the drop date. Nice lady but very spacey, disorganized, and assumes a lot of prior knowledge in literature. Went to her for help mid semester and she was very vague and unclear.

This class was interesting at times and REALLY boring at others. Dr. Havens is a really knowledgeable professor. She has a passion for the literature which shows in her teaching. My only criticism is she is a really slow grader. Make sure you do the extra credit! Good class, I recommend.

Dr. Havens is honestly one of the best professors I've had throughout college. Her in-class lectures are really interesting, and she actually can motivate you to participate. She isn't the most timely grader by any means, but with a lot of dedication to reading you can definitely make a good grade in this class.

Dr. Havens is an excellent professor, though don't go in expecting an easy grade. If you attend class every day, do your readings, and get your papers in on time (with a fair amount of effort in each one, of course), you can get an A in her class.

Not like your stereotypical English professor. Teaches in a very clear and approachable way - you won't have to do any deconstruction or other nonsense. You'll have to read a lot for quizzes but it's worth it - her class discussions are the best I've ever seen. One of the few English classes that might actually help you enjoy a work more afterword.

Really nice professor. She picks favorites, but if you go to class and are active in the discussions she will like you. Gives pop quizzes. The reading is absolutely necessary, so keep up with it. She is an easier grader so as long as you show some understanding you will be fine. Tests are kind of difficult and require major knowledge of the text.

Dr. Havens is a great, very helpful teacher. I took her Major British Writers class and got an A. You just need to read, use sparknotes, and do any extra credit she gives. Also, TALK A LOT. She loves that. But her final is hard, so try to opt out if you can.

I took her Major British Writers and there was a lot of reading however Dr. Havens is such a good professor. She takes attendance and it goes towards your grade and she gives pop quizzes. Test are long with passage analysis but if you read the books she assings youll do fine!! I made an A and I used sparknotes sometimes. Good teacher. Very NICE!

Of all the English professors, she's my least favorite. She's not helpful at all, I could give more information but if you work with her, I'm sure you'll figure it out. Her class is easy, but the tests are far too long for the 50 mins you have to complete it. Not personable either. Deal with her if you must, but try to avoid her.

Major British Writers requires a lot of time to read... But Spark Notes is probably just as good. Havens gives pop quizes maybe every other week but she's an easy-grader. Attendance counts as part of the grade. The class is not too bad... But you have to read and study for an A.

Don't take this class if you aren't going to read.  The pop quizzes (at least one a week usually) are too hard just to spark note.  Class can be boring but she definitely knows her stuff.  I got an A (I bombed a few quizzes but she drops the lowest 2)  Lots of extra credit opportunities on test which are not too bad!

Dr Havens is very knowledgeable about the subject she teaches - she actually makes Brit Lit interesting! She does give pop quizzes that require you to actually read the text not just SparkNotes it. However she also offers extra credit opportunities. Overall highly recommended, especially if you hate Brit Lit - she will make it your favorite class.

Dr. Havens is very knowledgeable, however, she is also full of herself.  Be prepared to hear her discuss her experiences at Oxford and to be told that your academic experience is not up to par with hers.  Her comments are a bit strange. Overall, you can learn a lot from her class.  If you are taking an upper level course, you will not get an A.

I took her for Major British Writers and I loved it! She is a very good teacher! She does have pop quizzes but they are easy. Gives many opportunities for extra credit. Her tests aren't bad if you have read and stuided. I loved this class and you can def. make an A!

Havens is AMAZING! Anyone who has anything bad to say about her didn't try to do well. One of my favorite professors at TCU. I took her 3 different times and I'm not even an english major or minor. Get to know her, she's a cool lady.

Dr. Havens is great! I enjoyed her Major British Writers class. Classes are mostly discussion based and they were interesting. She gives 1-2 quizzes per book that are kind of hard, but her tests are not bad at all. She's a fair grader. Overall, a very nice lady and I'd recommend her.

I LOVE Dr. Havens. She is a very very intelligent lady. Her class requires that you do all the work and pay attention during discussion, but its not too hard. Get on her good side and she will help you a lot! Let her know that you are trying, and ask questions. She is a really great person to know on TCU campus, and very intelligent.

She is a good teacher but her grading is terrible. Her grades are opinion based and don't accurately represent your knowledge of the material. Even if you read every book and passage you are will probably make a mediocre grade on the test. She is extremely stubborn about her grades, so don't even bother trying to talk to her about them.
Dr. Havens is very helpful and lets you revise all your papers. She is really interested in what she is talking about and was always really helpful outside class. I'd definately reccomend her.

I had her for the Harry Potter seminar, and she was really interested in the subject but at times the lectures were  boring. Her grading is tough, but she gives  a handout that fully guides you through the assignment and answered all of my questions. While she is a hard grader, shes really helpful when you meet with her and lets you do revisons.
Engaging prof if you like Harry Potter or movies she's seen. But if you want read anything above sixth grade reading level, good luck.

I love Dr. Havens! Its certainly not a blow off class, but if you've already read the books you can get by without reading. She doesn't give reading quizzes, which is nice and has a passion for what she does.  She a pretty fair grader on the essays, and allows revisions for all of them! I really recommend her, and shes always there to help you!

She is a good teacher, I had her for Harry Potter seminar and she was obviously intrested. She is a hard grader, but if you go to her for help, she is really nice. Also she lets you re-do the papers and mine always went up a full letter grade. I would recommend her, but do not expect it to be a blow off

She is a good teacher, I had her for Harry Potter seminar and she was obviously intrested. She is a hard grader, but if you go to her for help, she is really nice. Also she lets you re-do the papers and mine always went up a full letter grade. I would recommend her, but do not expect it to be a blow off
Okay, grades papers differntly. Easy B.

Dr. H. is really nice and very interested in her teaching. The only semi-difficult part of the class were the papers. You do a lot of writing but go in for help and use the writing center. In class all you do is talk about Harry Potter and other Hero stories like the Matrix and Shrek etc. Recomended

Such and Interesting Class! i hope everyone can take this Harry Potter based siminar! Especially if you Love HP! She is very helpful, i got Bs on all my papers, and wrote them the night before everytime!

She may have made you want to be a journalist, butI'm a journalism minor and it's a completely different style of writing.  She sux, and if she's grading an english paper like a journalism one then she's in the wrong dept.  She never helped me, even though I was in her office every day.  Good person, bad teacher.

She is way too hard for Sophomore Comp!When you revise a paper you expect to get a better grade, right?Wrong!You'll get the same grade.Her attitude is stank and so is her laugh.She gives a massive end of the year group proposal that has to be 10 pages AND you have to give a presentation. 2 damn much

She does give A's, I got an A on every paper.  She's very helpful, very clear on what you have to do.  Class is sometimes boring, but there's only 4 papers, so it's not that hard. Her encouragement made me go into Journalism!
Really nice professor.  I goofed off everyday in class, did the papers and got a B+.  She doesn't give A's for some reason.  One of the better teachers to take for Soph.Comp.
Willing to work with you.  Very nice. A lot of reading but easy classes.
Tell you exactly what is going on (although you're not always clear) and what is needed but lots of reading and writing. Grades to her expectation. Tough A but B is do-able. Had a good experience.

I had her for Modern Medievalism. Day to day class is a breeze, but watch out for the papers! She is a TOUGH grader and you will work hard outside of class reading and writing endlessly, but she is a great professor.

I made an A in her class- not too bad, but lots of writing of course.  She's actually very interesting to talk to and gives helpful comments. A's are possible but not easy to get. Lots of revision and multiple drafts for every paper.
Makes you do lots of busywork. Hard grader. Definately get her comments b4 you turn the final papers in and work on those. On the plus side the class was pretty laid back.

If you want a B this is the teacher for you.  Unless you plan on kissing her butt, and then maybe you'll get an A or maybe you won't!  Most teachers will take in account how hard your tried or help improve, but not her.  She is also full of herself.
I got a High B on every single paper and didn't work long on them at all. She does not really give As but it is really easy to get a B in her class if you do the assignment and turn it in on time!

Dr. Havens is a fun teacher to have in class. Very laid back and likes to joke around. The assignments are not that difficult but she tends to be unclear of what is expected of us and can be a tough grader.  A's are not very common in this class.

Dr. Havens is a really nice person and she at least tries to be helpful when you ask. However, she grades really hard and she makes you think your paper is really good, and then you end up not getting the grade you had anticipated.
Pretty proud of herself.  Talks bad about other schools and people.  I do not think this is a good sign.

Good teacher, likes to help students.  She's a hard grader, but fun to talk to in class and likes to joke with the students.  Laid back about when assignments are due.  Ask her to help revise your papers and don't get offended if she insults your writing.

All you do is write papers, read short essays, and proofread fellow studnets papers.  Only 2 to 3 students will get an A on a paper.  She is a difficult grader.  I don't believe I'm any better as a writer because of this class
really bad

It is a pretty easy class. Make sure you go when new assignments are given, or you wont understand at all. No tests is great, just papers. She can be talked out of turn in dates by the whole class. Her grading is kinda hard however.

I don't know why she has a bad review on here, but she is a very good professor. She had guest speakers come to talk to the class and it was very interesting to listen too. I had her class as a night class on a Tuesday and it wasn't that bad. She is very nice and understanding.

Professor Hensley should stick to classes involving social work. All she did in class was read of a slide. There were many cases she didnt even know what she was reading. She would tell us what was in the test but ask questions she claimed she wouldnt.  Only 1 discussion and 3 tests. She was forced to curve tests due to poor test grades

Professor Hensley Is part time and is not very quick with email responses but she is very understanding. The course consists of four exams (final is not cumulative) two discussion boards and then one group project. The exam review tells you all of the material on the exam. Note heavy class but overall not too bad and is an interesting class.

Professor Hensley is super sweet and cares a lot, but she is a full time social worker so it is understandable where her priorities are, but she doesn't out her time into the class. Her exams are very difficult because multiple of the questions can be taken in multiple ways. She reads off slides then leaves after, which didn't teach me.

Dr. Hensley is very nice and knowledgeable but I would not recommend this class. I just felt like the class was not a priority for her so we missed a lot of preparation for tests (i.e. she said she would give us a study guide for the first test and never did). The workload is not bad (one discussion board class a week) but the tests are not easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I did well in his class, but I get why somebody would struggle. If you don't already have some knowledge on Islamic civ, you'll likely have to do extra studying outside of attending class on top of all of the readings we had. He also didn't really teach us the stuff on the final. He's generous with bonus points tho and I liked the novel we read.

Lots of lectures that are hard to follow, assigned a lot of reading, and multiple quizzes/week. Professor Hosainy doesn't make this class easy for students. Although attendance wasn't mandatory, it is easy to fall behind when you don't show up to class. Not enjoyable, difficult to keep up with, and would NOT recommend taking.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: For Modern Middle East, Professor Hosainy is sweet and cares. Don't think he knows most students use it as history credit. Very hard/frequent quizzes. Readings are impossible to keep up with, so use other sources to study. Go to office hours for anything, he is gracious if he sees you care. This was my hardest class as a business major. VERY HARD!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Would 100 Hadi Hosainys or a gorilla win in a battle?
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Only gave him a 2 because he is a nice guy. I was taking this class for a history credit, and it ended up being my biggest workload of the semester. i had this class every Tuesday thursday and it was rare that we had a week where there wasn't *at least* one graded in class assignment that requires loads of reading to do even decent on. just don't
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Freshman Seminar in History-Islam in Asia. No idea what i was getting myself into It was a room of 6 other students sitting with no laptops listening to him talk about Islam. Assigned absurd readings every week and was supposed to understand them. BRUTAL class to get through and had to participate. Gave the class A's at the end so might be worth it
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: take this class if you want to be unemployed, i mean seriously. Ruined my gpa and now i can't get a job.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: JUST DONT.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The professor's lectures were extremely boring and difficult to understand. The slides have hardly any information on them. There was a quiz almost every Friday, and often multiple quizzes a week. I asked Chat for a summary of the textbook pages and took notes on that instead. Chat wrote my essays and I memorized them for the exams, got As on both

BY FAR one of the best professors I have had at TCU. During the semester I took his Intro to Islamic Studies course, I was going through a lot in my personal life, and Professor Hosainy took the time to reach out to me and schedule a meeting outside of class to help me with his class. He truly wants the best for his students... TAKE HIS CLASS.

Overall, Hosainy was a relatively easy professor for a history class. There are weekly quizzes over a novel we read through the semester. His lectures can be long, but there are no exams, only a midterm and a final that are identical to the study guide, which he gives answers to. If you put in work, you can easily get an A. Interesting class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Honestly this professor is easy compared to other History Professors. Just take notes on what he says in class. There are quizzes every Friday for a book you have to read, but the book is interesting so it's not horrible. No exams only a midterm and final, plus he gives you the prompts before hand. Good professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Cannot recommend him enough! He is great and cares a lot! I have no idea why ppl don't like him on here. Other than reading (Which I didn't do once) there is 0 homework and the tests are writing (he gives you the prompts ahead of time). I used my P/NC because I'm an A student and B would tank my GPA. If that isn't you then he is a GREAT professor!

very lecture-heavy and lots of reading for weekly quizzes. he is a nice guy and knows what he's talking about. the content is interesting, but the weekly quizzes are hard to get 100s on. the tests are written questions that he gives you before hand and if you prepare for them they're not hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you do the readings, the weekly quizzes are easy. The exams include a few short answer questions over terms and then a longer essay. He gives you the questions about a week beforehand (he usually gives a list of terms of which a few will be selected, but he will give you the full essay question).
He is really not a good teacher; he doesn't understand that you have other aspects in life that aren't his class.

He ain't as hard as other students are claiming. Just read the textbooks and you should be all set for the in-class quizzes. It's a history class, what would you expect if not reading heavy class and lecture heavy... Take notes during lecture instead of using social media or playing games and you should be getting an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures on Monday and Wednesday with short, easy-to-prepare group presentations on Friday. Lectures can be boring but aren't vital to the class. Most of the substance of grading comes from the textbook. Midterm was an in-class paper that was graded tougher but assuming you do the assignments it won't tank your grade

He is a very nice guy but a terrible lecturer. His lectures are all over the place and hard to follow. He does use slides but they have very few words and the info you need to know is solely from what he lectures. There are few grades in this class. His TA is grades the exams which could be good or bad. Just a very confusing and disorganized class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hosainy is one of the best professors I've had here at TCU. This is my third class I've taken with him, and it was the most enjoyable lower-level history course I've taken. You have to read a little (which should come as no surprise, given that this is a history class), but the content is pretty straightforward. Lectures were interesting too!

This guy is excruciatingly boring. He lectures for 50 minutes every class on Monday and Wednesday. You do a group presentation every Friday. He banned devices so we had to sit through each class and hear him spew nonsense the entire class. I would not recommend taking this class. It is easy, but not worth your time.

Very boring class and professor. Lectures every class expect fridays where we do a group discussion. Grades all right, but gives little warning on when things are due. I wouldn't take him if I were you, he makes me want to get up and leave in the middle of lecture because anything else is worth more of fmy time.

Takes attendance on Fridays, and minimal homework. Midterm paper was difficult and kind of picky grader. His class is definitely doable, but lectures can be extremely boring. Group projects every week.
STAND UP FROM WHERE YOU ARE SITTING AND RUN AWAY FROM THIS TEACHER AS FAST AS POSSIBLE!!  BIGGEST MISTAKE EVER TAKING THIS GUY

His lectures are boring, but you don't have to pay attention in order to do well i class, there are HW assignments  that take 30min due every week and 1 discussion with a 5 min presentation every Friday. This class would be Great if it weren't for the midterm which is the hardest paper I have ever written.

Probably one of the easier history professors. Attendance is mandatory on Wednesdays and Fridays and you have weekly discussions. The midterm is a take-home essay style of 1000 words, and the final is also essay style. Weekly homework assignments that are super easy.
STAY AWAY!!

This teacher is awful. I would rather watch paint dry than listen to another one of his lectures. He asks you to elaborate on your papers but then will take off 10 grade points for every 100 words you go over word count. He also gives you a ton of sources you have to use in your paper. The expectations are ridiculous. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not a good teacher. Does not work with students that are struggling and the discussions are awful!!!

Little homework due every Friday with a quick presentation on that day. The whole semester you are part of a group for a semester-long project and discussions due every Friday. He doesn't give many instructions and grading was very picky which can drop your grade. No tests or homework but should be easier than it is. Good person and able to help.

Although there are no tests and minimal homework, there is a HUGE group project that becomes extremely time consuming. Often directions aren't clear and it's hard to understand what he's really looking for. He is reasonable though and doesn't grade too tough.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class should be easy but he makes it more complicated than needed. Lectures are almost impossible to follow. Same group for whole semester and presentation every Friday. Gave us a written midterm and gave unclear directions and graded tough. Asked us to include a million things in the paper but took off points for going over count.
He does not respond to emails. Has a hard to understand accent and has boring lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed having Dr. Hosainy as my professor. I took two courses with him and he's very passionate and knowledgeable about the subject material and very accessible for questions and comments outside of class. Even though his classes can be pretty focused on lectures he always welcomes student comments and input.

Lazy professor. Reuses the same exams. Has vague instructions, but grades strictly. Had a total of 109 extra credit quizzes that were mandatory somehow, but they only amounted to 1 extra credit point. Takes forever to reply to emails. Puts you in a group for the whole semester so that he has less things to grade. Loves to hear himself talk. Waste.

I haven't taken many classes over my K-12 and into college where I talk about how bad a class is as much as this. The class straight up sucks, attendance MATTERS, zoom camera MUST BE ON, and you can barely understand half of the stuff he says and on top of that its a boring class with a boring professor. My biggest regret is not dropping this class
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS. Although it wasn't super difficult the teacher made it unbearable. You get 20 quizzes a week and have to show up to class or fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: The worst class I have ever taken of all of my years of school. I didn't know much about applying for classes before the semester but now I do, and looking back on taking this class is my biggest regret. He is very passive aggressive, and attendance is very mandatory and keeping your cameras on too. If you can stay away from this class, please do.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I have him this semester for online and this man does not have any regards for anything outside of his class. He will be passive aggressive on feedback and he is very rude. I don't understand anyone who gives him more than a 1 because he doesn't deserve anything better. If you can avoid this course, do yourself a favor. You will hate him by the end
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Boring class but it was very easy. Attendance is graded so show up. The quizzes and tests are easy. Just take notes and show up to class and you will get an A. Just be ready for lectures but its not a hard class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Hosainy himself is a little quirky but very knowledgable. His class is kind of boring, just a ton of online weekly quizzes, and every Friday we had a discussion which was kind of boring and redundant. He has no exams, just a midterm paper, a powerpoint presentation project, and final paper. He counts attendance as a grade so just go to class.
Nice guy but lectures are boring. Midterm/final are essays and the prompts are given in advance. Attendance is mandatory, you only get 2 excused absences. Easy humanities credit if you pay attention
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Hosainy is 100% pro-student! His midterms and quizzes are straight-forward essay questions you receive in advance. He truly cares about each student and is always willing to meet outside of office hours. His is passionate about Islamic Civilization and is extremely knowledgeable!

Pretty boring class and wouldn't recommend unless you're very interested in Islamic civilization. Attendance is graded. Midterm and final are the only tests. There are a couple other assignments. Prof Hosainy is kind, understanding, and knows what he is talking about but lectures are drawn out and hard to pay attention to.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took this class for a core credit and the class is super easy. He is a great professor, and even though the lecture is long, he doesn't talk the whole time and lots of group work in class. Exams are multiple choice online and simple. Weekly discussion posts are the only homework assigned and take less than 15 mins to complete. Great professor

took his class for a core credit and even though it was a very long late night class, it was only once a week and wasn't too bad. always let us out early and was very nice. in class writings are pretty lengthy and the weekly discussion boards but v simple so def recommend
He is the best professor ever!!! Take this class even if it's not required. Work is interesting not too difficult and he really cares about his students.

Def take him for Criminal Justice. Such a nice guy. It is lecture heavy and long but totally worth it compared to how hard the other CJ class are. You do need to show up but its only once a week and he makes it fun

This class was very interesting and he is a great professor! Always has good stories to tell and class discussions are interesting. I'm not a CRJU major so the weekly assignments felt tedious at times but if you need this class for credit I would 100% recommend him as your professor.

Such a god prof! Very fun late night class and he used be be a detective/cop so he always had interesting stories. 4 take home tests and 1 final paper but all in all a decently easy class. Pay attention during class because homework questions are asked in it!! Def take for core credit.
This has been one of my favorite professors at TCU so far. He is so understanding and you can tell he really cares about his students. An easy A.

So interesting and an easy A! He was a cop and detective for 20 years so he has great stories that keep a 3 hour night class interesting. Weekly discussion posts and case studies in class are the only work you submit/ do every week. 4 easy online take home exams and 1 paper. definitely take his class for a core credit if you are not a crju major!
Worst professor at TCU by far.  Literally DREADED going to his class.

Hjamil doesn't know much about music from the 80's-90's, but he is an authority on Latino Religion. This class is no joke, if you don't want to work hard and show that you've learned, don't even try this course/prof. I found his demeanor to be unprofesh and immature. Sexual innuendo, profanity, mocks christians. I own what I say here - Andrew W:)

If you're looking for a good grade, DO NOT take this class from him. His grading makes no sense and he is very closed minded. You have to read all of the required reading if you want to pass the POP quizzes...but his lectures have nothing to do with the reading. The papers you write are about movies and nothing to do with the reading.

Respected both students and their ideas in a class discussion/lecture format.  He skillfully handled both the unkind and prejudiced comments expressed by some classmates. This is the ACADMIC study of religion and is not Sunday School so being open-minded and fair to your classmates helps.  He is a nice person and great professor willing to help.

This was my easiest A this semester. I don't see what the problem is. You spend an hour a week doing his journals, and he is willing to work with you on your papers/tests until he lets you know, "You have a 100". SKIM the reading (10 pages a night at most, just read the bold/italic words) See him outside of class and you have an A! Easy.
He is a great professor not hard at all really helps you if you ask for help looks a little tough at first but class is actually fun and an easy b and if you work hard enough an A.

If you're looking to have a high GPA, avoid this class at all cost. You will have no chance in getting an A. His lectures are nothing like his quizzes or tests, so you're going to have to read all the text that is given. Do not join this class.

Boring subject, once in a while it can be interesting. He has an accent, so he's not clear sometimes. Go to him for help because he really will help you.. I went to him for help and brought my grade from a C to an A.

Dr. Martinez-Vazquez made the class interesting and prompted us to all think not just about the course but about life.  Not always easy but turned out to be my favorite class of the semester. A religion class is required at TCU - TAKE THIS ONE!

Great teacher, I definitly recommend this class.  If you put in the work for this class you will get an A.  He is very accessible outside of class and wants you to do well.  I took this class 1st semester and I was not too enthused about it because it's a religion class but after taking it I will have to say it was my favorite class

He was a great teacher, yes the class was hard but we are in college. He will challenge your belief but only to make you think. He grades hard but give you the opportunity to take papers to him before and he will read over and make corrects before you turn them in for a grade. Take him only if youre prepared to come to class and do the work.

Very engaging teacher. His class is challenging to your beliefs, he'll question your morals and beliefs, but I think that's what makes it a great class. He will help you if you make the effort to see him outside of class. DO NOT TAKE HIM IF YOU DON'T LIKE TO TALK IN CLASS!!!

coming from an A student, it doesn't matter who you are, he gets off by tearing others down. His attitude was both immature, unprofessional, and condescending. It was almost as if he took pleasure in being mean. I will never forget my first semester at TCU and how much I dreaded this class because of how rude he was. I advise you not to take it.
No Comments

not an easy class - entirely discussion driven, so be prepared to participate!  but you will learn a lot, and you will come out of the class knowing how to apply everything to your own life.  I definitely recommend this prof.

I love this guy a lot. Very interesting topics brought around in class. I thought it was one of the easiest A's you could ever get. HOWEVER, if you are easily offended about being made fun of, then don't take it! You either like him or don't. He is very upfront about things, and you need to understand that HE IS MAKING A POINT, not out to get you.

This was one of the best classes I have ever taken. It might be the best. If you are Latina, or a woman, take this class. If you want to know about Latinas, or women in general take this class. Be prepared though, you will be pushed to contemplate things about your life that you may not be ready for.

There's alot of reading for this class, but if you pay attention to it, you'll do fine. (Sometimes he gives a pop quiz (5 or 6 Qs) on the reading) He likes class participation, & discussions are fun/interesting. Some people think he's mean, but he's just honest and will make you think about your beliefs. The 1st book is difficult; others are easy.

Here's the real story on Hjamil. He's very intelligent and loves to make you think and question your beliefs. Yes, you have to do the work it's college kids.Go visit him in his office, become his friend and class will be fine, I promise.

He expects you to participate so if you do not like to speak then do not take this class. He is very opinionated and does not care if he is mean or rude, it is not a hard class. If you take him, good luck, and hope you can put up with him.

Hjamil gets a lot of crap for his class, but it was actually one of the best I've taken.  His class isn't for the shy.  As long as you speak up and think for yourself, you shouldn't have anything to worry about.  Although the class wasn't easy I wouldn't say it was hard to make a good grade.

Hjamil is really a nice guy once you get to know him, and his class is pretty interesting. If you are too lazy to read a book for class, then I would not only recommend that you don't take his class, but that you drop out of college alltogether.

The professor was very informed and new what he was talking about, but he has no people skills and is unprofessional in the classroom. You do a lot of readings in books that are hard to comprehend. In the way he talks he is sarcastic in a mean way. I would not recommend this class to anyone.

This is not a blow-off class. He will challenge your beliefs and make you think about different points of view. Isn't this what college is supposed to be about? If your feelings get hurt easily, leave them at the door.  Be prepared to read quite a bit and focus on class discussion.  Not for everyone, but it was an interesting class.
I hate this man...do not take this class. It's your life...dont ruin it!!!! I wanted to kill myself every day in his class
No Comments
Do not take this if you dont like talking in class!! Be prepared to do a LOT of reading and work in groups!Make sure you see him outside of class, he will help you.
Very hard grader on everything. Grades you based on how well he likes you. Or how well you kiss up to him.

Don't be fooled on the first day of class; you may think he's a student...but probably one of the most informed people I have ever met.  The class is based primarily on discussion, and is NOT easy, but if you are open-minded and interested, it will definitely be worth your time...fair warning, he's tough, and has no sympathy.

I just took this class to get the core credit done. However, Mr. Alsleben had amazing lectures, and the class was a lot more interesting than I expected. Mr. Alsleben does not make the class harder than it needs to be and he curves tests +20% and posts clear reviews after each lecture which I studied to get an A. Overall, an easy enjoyable class.

Everyone who gave him a bad review on here just didn't study for the exams. If you study and understand the material you will do well. Not a hard class but could be a little easier. Dr. Asleben is very nice as well but his lectures can feel a bit boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mr. Alsleben is a great professor. There are five‑question quizzes before each class, with two attempts, and that's the only homework. He's understanding and willing to work with you. Attendance is bonus, iClicker is extra credit, and his detailed reviews prepare you well for tests.

I had this professor for Lab but it was a TA teaching it again I think it depends on the TA but mine was really chill and actually explained well overall the subject is boring but it was kind of easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Class is pretty much the same every day which gets repetative but it's not that bad. half the class fails each exam, and half the class gets over 100 on the exams. the exams are not hard at all if you just study. drops 5 of the 30 questions each test, so big curve. offers 6% of extra credit throughout the semester. those complaining don't study.

This class is so annoying because nothing that he gives us is on the exam, and if it is it's worded horribly and impossible to connect to the material he gives. I've gotten 100% on every quiz and still have a 69% in the class because of the exams. The only assignments are video quizzes and exams, do not take!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a rude dude.
Your entire grade is dependent on your exam grades. That is it. It's a good class that counts for a Nat Sci and GA credit.. as long as you P/C
Not a good teacher. In my opinion, he sets students up for failure.Tests are hard.

Dr. A loves geology and is passionate about it. He makes a class about rocks seem interesting which is super hard I imagine. Definitely take this class if you are willing to make an effort and study for the tests it's an EASY A. However the tests are difficult so a lot of people who aren't willing to just make a quizlet end up P/NCing the class.
greaaaaat prof def recommend, tests are kinda hard but he gives lecture reviews so just study, lab was fun if you have a good group, 2 online quizzes each week based on a video (so easy)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class has become harder and way more work is required to be put into this class than how it used to be. I never feel prepared for the exams. The weekly quizzes can be become repetitive yet often I forget to take them and lose points that are silly to miss.
Textbook not needed to pass the class. Lectures are boring but are an opportunity to ask questions over the slides. Great grader on tests

Lectures are not long at all and have all the details you need. make sure to watch the videos and do the hw quizzes. He also tends to cut off some test questions to boost your grade. There are iclicker questions
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: tests are insanely hard for being a core requirement. he is fully aware that no one in his class is a geology major and yet still, makes the class difficult. people say that if you do the "reviews," you will be fine on the test. the reviews are nothing but 7 pointless questions from online videos that are irrelevant. HORRIBLE
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I just don't recommend this class. Geology is a really boring subject, and all of the tests were multiple choice, yet they were all trick questions. Lab depends on the TA, but Dr. A's Lectures were fine, just boring. There are other ways to get your core science credit.

I took him for Understanding the Earth. He was extremely helpful whenever I needed to speak with him. His PowerPoint slides contain good and detailed information that will be on the exams. There are clicker questions everyday, but they are super easy. If you go to class and study you will make an A in the class.
Had to pass/fail this course. Not extremely difficult just lectures are very boring and test questions very specific. Labs can be hard too. He's a nice gut but not my favorite class.

So I wouldn't necessarily recommend this class if you can choose something different. Dr. A was very nice and passionate about the material, I just didn't find it to be interesting. The labs were difficult and didn't really match up with the lecture but with the right TA, you can pass. Def pay attention in lecture and FILL OUT THE REVIEWS.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Alsleben is a great guy. His lectures are interesting, which isn't easy for an intro class full of non-majors. He's very down to earth and a caring guy who seems to go out of the way to help all students. Honestly, if you pay attention in class and take average-ish notes, you'll be fine on exams. I would HIGHLY recommend him for your NSC credit

Geology wasn't my favorite class, but that was just a preference. Professor Alsleben lectured, and my lab was only good becuase I had a great TA. You have to go to class and study a lot to do good on the tests. Lab isn't hard, it is just a lot of memorization which takes time.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is very lecture heavy and impossible to get an A if you skip class. His tests are based 100% off of the lectures, not the textbook. As long as you go to class and take notes it's not hard to get an A.

Dr. Alsleben provides GREAT course materials, but you have to take lots of lecture notes to round them out, as most exam questions will come from your notes. He does weekly quizzes which are open-note, which is helpful. He is very accessible and willing to help students.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This dude is awesome. Lectures can be a bit boring at times but if you just skim over the book prior to class it makes engagement much easier. Great guy and is very good about answering emails. Funny and actually makes a course about rocks interesting!

If your a geology/ applied geo you'll def have to take dr. A, and thats not a bad thing at all. Can be a little hard to crack, but he does have a sense of humor (lots of dad jokes) and he LOVES questions. Would recommend recording his lectures and re-listening to them to prepare for exams. Fair grader, asks few questions that cover lots of topics.

Dr. Alsleben is a great teacher! He gives study guides after every lecture plus a final exam study guide.  If you know the bullet points you will get a 100% every test--I did! His lectures are clear, pay attention.  I would definitely recommend him and take him again.
Not a good lecturer.  The class is literally the most boring thing ever.  Do not take this class for part of your core credit.

Dr. Alsleben is an okay professor. His lectures are NOT entertaining. And the tests: Oh my god they are hard. This has been the only class in my life where i would walk out after taking a test thinking i did pretty well, and get my test back with a D grade. The lab tests are even harder- so unless you are a geology wizz, i dont recommend taking.
Nice, caring professor, but I feel he needs to  work on making the class more exciting and including more information.

He is a nice guy but i would NOT recommend taking his class. I am good at science but he didn't treat this class like an into class at all! The lectures were easy to follow along and understand but the test are extremely difficult.
Alsleben is a great professor. Take good notes, attend class, and go through his study guides semi-thoroughly before the test and you should have no issue making an A

Alsleben is the man! Class is not hard if you attend and take note. Tests aren't hard if you are in class to take good notes and study. Plus he makes the class interesting and is always open to helping students. I would definitely recommend Alsleben.

Alsleben is a nice guy, but I wouldn't take another class with him. This class is supposed to be an introductory course, and I was so lost on everything. I studied really hard for all the exams and never made above a C on any of them (I barely made that). I'd take someone else if you aren't all that into science. I didn't enjoy myself.
terrible teacher, reviews are thirty pages and every test question is either a trick question or way more in depth than anything explained in class DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS
Very good professor. Interesting and easy to follow lectures. Tests over the notes. Always ready to help.
Take HIM!!!! Very helpful and take the study guide to the exams very seriously
Pretty easy. Don't have to go to class. Two lab exams that are pretty difficult. Lecture exams you get a study guide and the answers are in the book.

He was a great professor! 4 Exams a semester and all the material comes from his lectures, not the book. He also makes study guides SO DO THEM because those are on the test. He also posts his powerpoints online. But go to class and take notes because he adds stuff on the board not on the pp. The lab sucks though.. You have to identify rocks
His class is easy to understand. Also, he's somewhat funny.
TAKE

Dr. Alsleben is so awesome! His class is a little difficult, but it is not because of his teaching. Geology is just kinda hard. He gives out reviews and notes for each of his lectures, and if you study the revies you should do very well on the test. Showing up for class is absolutely necessary to understand what is going on!

Dr. Alsleban is very enthusiastic and helpful, he really loves geology. All of the lectures come from his power points and the notes he writes on the board during class. Tests are all MC and the info comes straight from the reviews he gives and the notes from his lectures. If you attend class and take brief notes you are guaranteed a good grade.

Dr. Alseben is a pretty nice guy. He takes care to learn all of his student's names, even in a large lecture class, and he has some energy during his lectures. He is from Germany and has an accent, but it is light and his English is excellent. His tests are multiple choice, but they are not easy if one doesn't study. He is a good choice for a prof.

If you're not a science person, this class is difficult. I lived by the textbook because the lectures require understanding beforehand. Alsleben is funny and easy-going. I got help from him during his office hours frequently and he helped a lot. He doesn't curve grades but he's helpful on reviews. The lab pretty much saved my grade. :)

Nice professor. Treats everyone exactly the same. Will not curve your grade (not even if you have a 79). Good class. You will learn a lot. Things you probably wouldve never tought you would learn. If you get in this class please buy the book(it helps) and actually pay attention in class. Tests are pretty straight forward.
very nice and helpful!

Alsleben is a really nice guy. Easy to talk to, relates well to students. He's a good teacher because he thinks like a student and designs his lectures to be easily understood. His classes aren't overloaded with work, but are still challenging. I'd take a class with him again...

Really funny guy, but hard teacher. You have to attend class to get the notes and understand what is important, because it will be on the test. Just study and prepare for the rock cycle...it's a killer.

He can be hard is you don't understand the material. His multiple choice can be killer. You must be in class because he takes attendance and knows your name. You also get extra credit for good attendance. His power points are on ecollege. The lab is pretty easy though.

This class does take effort, and you pretty much HAVE to go to class or you'll be lost.  I actually used the book for my own studying, and it helped a lot.  However, I HATED the lab; that was the worst thing about this class.

really clear in his lectures with good slideshows for you to print off and study. tests are easy if you study the study guides well, but the lab exams (rock identifying) are kinda tough. goofy/fun guy and pretty easy class.
Alsleben is very energic, yet his accent makes things a little difficult if you aren't used to it/

Go to class, I worked way too hard to get a B. The information seems simple, but you have to know exactly what he wants as the answer on the short answer part of your tests. You never use the book. Study  A LOT for the tests, but he is a really nice man and will round your grade if you don't miss class!

the class is not all too hard, easy B, yet a difficult A.  What is taught lacks usefulness and is very dull. (Take Morgan as his class is more interesting) Make sure you memorize everything word for word, because when he grades tests, its apparent that a good understanding of the material just isn't good enough and he will count off.

What an awesome guy! Super friendly and a good prof. He makes a more difficult subject easy. Tests are easy as long as you know the material and study the study guide. Labs are kinda lame though, you have to memorize rocks. I highly suggest him over the others though!

he's soo funny! he's german and has a accent and says random stuff that doesn't make sense, but his teaching is wonderful. print off the power points and show up to class or have someone get you the notes. tests are exactly from the notes and nothing else. don't buy the book it's a waste of money. he never uses it! TAKE HIM!!!

I really liked Prof. Alsleben's class. He is always willing to help and email and he is subtly very funny. it always helps getting lecture notes, but most of the test quest come from book info. some of my friends never went to class and still managed to make a B...overall he's a really nice guy
This class was a complete waste of my time...aside from filling the core. If you need any explanation at all in order to understand a concept, this is not the professor for you.
Dr. Alsleben is really nice. Good dresser. class is burdensome because it is an intro- read the book- attend a few class- you are good!
Phenomenal professor. tons of real world experience. very easy class. highly recommend

Professor Hill is the best!!!! Take him for Money & Banking - he cares so much about students and gives great real-world advice and tips for the future. Graded by four tests that are 80% of your grade, but he does review days to help with test prep making it stress-free. My favorite professor I've had so far at TCU!!
Great teacher overall and does care about his students

Took him for Money & Banking. Although he had never taught the class before  he adapted quickly, and he taught well. There were 4 exams, all of which were incredibly easy if you studied even for a little bit. He also provided several extra credit opportunities. All in all, great class and great professor. Take him if you can.

Dr. Hill is a great professor and her class was my favorite at TCU. There is alot of heavy reading but it is used to discuss in class. Each week, a student will present over the chapter to faciliate discussions. There are 6 small journal entries and participation is graded in class. All the topics are very interesting and its a great colloquia!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is amazing!! Her lectures are very engaging and interesting. Her class is very lecture heavy and her exams are 95% lecture, so if you go to class, listen, and study you will do great in her class. She is very funny and always try's to engage the class and make everyone laugh. Would 100% take her again!

I took her for Sex, Evolution, & the Brain. It was all about the evolved psychology of partner choice. I LOVED it. You have to read each week, but it was never too much or too technical. Could finish in 45 min the reading and assignment. A different student will teach class each week with a ppt and planned activities, but it was like sex book club.

Dr. Hill is renowned in the psychology field, so if you need a good letter of rec, take this class. Study hard and actively listen in her lectures. If you do that, you will get an A. Her exams are fair and mostly from lecture. Very fun lectures! I worked as a Research Assistant for her as well. It was the best decision I ever made. She is soo sweet

Dr. Hill is very knowledgeable on the subject and gives interesting lectures. I ended up enjoying the class more than I expected. The course focused largely on combining biological basis with psychology. Her exams are straightforward and you can either skip the final exam or use it to replace the lowest of the other 3 exam grades.

Relatively easy class. iClicker points make up attendance portion of grade. Three tests and a final (lowest one dropped) and two pretty short journal entry assignments. A handful of in-class activities as well. Show up, try a little, and you'll be good. Dr. Hill is a pretty well-known professor.

I was looking forward to this class. However the lectures went so slow and were extremely repetitive. The material is not that hard at all, but the test questions did not come from the material she talked about. The way she acted during tests, made you feel like you were in jail. There was no trust towards students. Unlike any professor I have had.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things
