reviews.comment: Dr. Hill is amazing. Her class is the first class I genuinely have enjoyed and never want to miss. 100% recommend

Dr. Hill is one of my favorite professors at TCU. She always interprets research into her lectures, which I enjoy. I have taken her for evolutionary and social psych. She truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed. I highly recommend her.

The class is not hard but the lectures were so similar every week. Have to read the textbook every week to do well on weekly quizzes, no tests. Have to also pay for top hat, which is a complete waste of money, in addition to two textbooks. She only leaves the questions up for a minute, so it is easy to lose points.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is knowledgeable. But fail to show any sort of understanding to her students. Even during the pandemic, when the class was forced online, students with slower internet connections were not provided any compromise. Quizzes took place only in a 20 minutes window. Attendances were noted 1 minute into the class. If you are privileged, you pass!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Hill is amazing. She is so funny and makes lectures entertaining. Tests are a bit difficult as they are more concept based. Excellent class and really interesting!

She is honestly the best professor at TCU, even when you compare her to professors in the other colleges at TCU.  If you have an opportunity to take this class, take it.   She assists you in the devleopment of research ideas and should be nominated for a teaching award at TCU. Wish TCU would hire more like her, who are as down to earth.

This class was hard, but I loved it! It was SO interesting!!! And Dr. Hill gets really engaged in her lectures so they're never boring! The tests were pretty hard but she offers a ton of extra credit. She even offers an optional final (comprehensive) exam that can take the place of your lowest grade from one of the other exams! It saved my grade!

Dr. Hill is one of my favorite professors at TCU. Not only is she brilliant but she is also so patient about evolutionary psychology. Her class can get a little boring at times but most of the time it is really interesting and applicable to life. Sometimes her questions can be a little challenging on tests but she is so helpful.

Wonderful teacher and extremely interesting class! Class attendance is mandatory because she does iClicker but she posts powerpoints with blanks so class time can be pretty mindless. Very interesting topics and decently easy tests and writing assignments. A is attainable if you study!
Fun class! I thought that it would be really boring, but it was really interesting. Will definitely take her again.

I thought this class would be stupid, but I actually found it really fascinating. Dr. Hill gives great lectures, the tests are straightforward, and the final is optional! You can probably do okay without the textbook; you'll just miss a few questions. Definitely recommended if you're a psych major/minor or if you just need an interesting elective.

Dr. Hill is awesome! I've had her for soical psych and evolutionary. I was skeptical about evolutionary, but it was AMAZING! Take her if you can & do not bother buying the book; you do not need it. Tests are multiple choice; sona extra credit is given. Optional final!

Lectures are easy and clear, she gives lots of examples. Attendance is mandatory for participation portion of grade and for examples in lecture given on tests. Definitely do readings and study lecture for tests. Dr. Hill is very nice and understanding. FYI There is a part of grade that involves mentoring elementary students. Good class!
Great teacher! Very passionate and laser focus! She makes her class interesting.

Such a sweet and passionate lady! She is very excited about what she teaches and is very straightforward in her lectures and exams. If you go to class and study a little each test, you'll make a good grade.
Take Dr. Hill! I had Tiffany, the TA bc she was out on maternity leave, but it was still a great class! 3 exams & an optional final. Extra credit sona hours. Very interesting class!

She was a very sweet teacher who was very excited about the subject. She kept the subject interesting and was very straightforward with the tests coming from the reading and lecture notes. The only thing that bummed me out was that my group never got 100's on our homework grades, but I made up with that with 4% of extra credit.

Dr. Hill is great! The topic is really interesting and she works to keep students engaged. Attendance is necessary because there are lots of in-class assignments. Tests are straightforward & almost completely from the notes. Go to class & study and you'll get a good grade!

The class itself is pretty easy, his exams are questions exactly like the homework and in class lectures, if you study and actually try it's so easy to get an A. However he is kind of a confusing teacher, super hard to follow his lectures. He encourages you to contact him for tutoring and from what I've heard those sessions are extremely helpful.

The exams are easy for me. We are allowed to bring note card to the exam. Some questions are exactly the same to the review. He is very nice and grades everything easy. Get this class if you don't want to put too much effort in this class in senior year.

I hate accounting and struggle learning the concepts. That being said, I still managed to pass with a good grade despite bombing the first test. Lectures are very cut and dry, but test reviews are a big help. Overall, the material itself sucks no matter which accounting professor you take, but take him if you are bad at accounting like me.

If you suck at accounting TAKE THIS TEACHER. He reads the exam as a review so you have all the question types. Although he isn't a good teacher. He rambles, very confusing just reads notes to the class. I had a tutor so I had help w the homework but i recommend him for someone who just wants to get thru this class. He's a nice guy tho and is funny

I would not recommend this teacher. He does not teach and instead just copies and pastes the textbook. Lots of the things you will do in this class are made up or not factual. He will assign two group projects and everyone has to present, but he sits on his phone and falls asleep during the presentations.

He is nice, but I don't think I learned one thing in class. He rambled on and never made sense. I had to teach myself everything from the homework. His tests weren't terrible, but I had to study a TON to get a good grade on them. The homework isn't bad it's just a few questions. Be prepared to get a tutor or teach yourself.

Professor Hickman's lectures were long and hard to follow. He tends to ramble and lose focus. He also repeats himself constantly, which was distracting. He gave us the answers to all of the exams, so that was cool. It took forever to get grades. Overall, it was an easy class, but he's a lousy teacher. I would not recommend him.

Wound up dropping while I had a C+, not the worst class ever, but can get away from you if you don't take thorough notes in class, and tests are hard, not the worst option but some other org man professors seemed easier.

M. Hirst is the best! He's truly there for his students. I missed the scheduled time for one of our tests and he was very understanding and let me take the test anyway. If you go to class and pay a little attention you'll pass and learn something good along way. There's only a few tests that make up your grade but don't let that scare you.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Hirst is a great professor! He tries to make the lectures funny and interesting. Take him for organizational management. Tests are open book and open internet. I loved his class and it is apparent he truly cares for his students.

First time ill ever have an A in math. Most of your grade is made up of 3 tests, online, at home, open note. Test questions are directly from textbook hw which does a great job of teaching you the math. We met once per weeked but he cancelled several classes, bc of this he adjusted the amount of material on the test. group project at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hitte made stats way easier than I thought it would be. He knows what he is talking about. He has a job outside of teaching but is easy to contact and he tries to keep lectures concise while still working out plenty of examples. We were allowed to use our textbook, homework, and notes on all exams. You do one group project but it's not bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: For stats I would recommend this professor. The book is expensive and you WILL need it, its the reason I finished with a 98. All the exams are online except the final and he is very accessible outside class.
One of the best professor for stats at TCU. He is the easiest professor you can take for this class, very caring and always willing to help.

Had him for a night course and he's honestly the best professor I've had at TCU. He's pretty good at explaining how to use Excel to show work and it makes the class 10x easier than it otherwise would be, while adding an extra layer of practicality.

Took Hitte's night class in person. This is a hard weed out class for business majors and given your options Hitte is hands down the easiest/best choice. The class consists of tests every other week but they were online and open note. Recommend getting a good tutor who can help you as well. Really not bad but do have to put in work for an A.

Professor Hitte is a good professor. Unfortunately, I had to take his night class which lasts for almost three hours, therefor the lectures became exhausting after about an hour. However, for 50 or 120 minutes at a time, Professor Hitte would be perfect. Unless you want to teach yourself, you definitely want to go to class.
LOVED HIM!!!! Seriously if you get teh chance to take him please do! He loves what he teaches but is a very caring individual in general! The class is pretty interesting and he makes it engaging!

He is a nice professor who wants you to engage in the class. He won't get mad if you get the wrong answer, but he will pick you to answer often to stay engaged. He is a tough grader in the exams. You must go to class, and I would recommend that you read all the readings since class depends on that, pop quizzes and exams have the readings content.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Such a great lecturer and is extremely caring. He likes to cold call so make sure you actually do readings and attempt to understand the material. Normally I don't like cold calls, but it doesn't feel like that, more like an active conversation and he is good about not making you feel pressure to get the answer right.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS CLASS! You will not regret it. Dr. Hidalgo is so passionate about what he teaches and truly wants to get to know his students. He really wants you to take away something from this class, and I've been learning a lot. By far the best professor on campus. Would take again

Although the class is lecture and reading heavy, Dr. Hidalgo is great. He is enthusiatic, very knowledgeable, and will help you out if you reach out. He makes the subject and course fun and interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Takes a history class, and makes it extremely political. Not only do you learn less about history, you learn stuff through an extremely liberal lens which makes him very disingenuous.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hidalgo is so kind! He is very understanding and makes sure everyone participates. His teaching style is very interactive. I usually do not like cold calling but I never feel uncomfortable in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He has a little bit of political bias and pushes his agenda in the classroom. Lectures are very boring but the class is not hard if you apply yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Literally could pick so many other good things to say about him. History of museums and collecting was one of the most enriching classes at TCU. He really wants you to get something out of the class. It makes you appreciate how thins are collected and handled. Seriously take him, you wont regret it.

Outstanding Professor. He inspired me to make this account so others would know about him. Dr. Hildago knows his content extremely well and is able to create an environment through discussion in which everyone can learn and contribute. He doesn't grade easily so be warned if you want to make a certain A, but overall his class is well worth it.

What a genuine, charismatic, and natty type of professor. Lectures were outstandingly amazing, and Prof. Hidalgo pretty much keeps you engaged from beg. to the end. However, this class is not easy! lots of reading, pop quiz's (35% of grade), an essay, 2 midterms, and a final. He is generous and provides study guides a week before test. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: He is by far my favorite teacher so far at TCU. I took him for Latin American History, knowing I hated history, and wow he was just awesome. He takes time to learn your names, really knows how to engage the class during lecture, and while yes there's reading before every class and quizzes every other day, it's doable and worth it. It's a must take!

Love love love this class and the professor. Initially was dreading taking a history class, however I ended up loving this class. Readings are fairly easy and not required but highly recommended to do well in the course. Reviews are exactly like the test. He is the best professor I have had so far. Take this class for any core requirement.

There's a good amount of reading due for each class but most of it is easy and you can honestly skim it to get the general idea. Tests are essay style but he tells you exactly what to expect on the test. He has honestly been my favorite professor at TCU.

He was probably the hardest teacher I had at TCUFor  a survey class.  The tests are almost 100% essay and everything that's graded is an essay.  I love writing and I'm a history major, but the readings are long, all primary sources, and he calls people out to answer questions that leave you confused.  Would never take again. Best grade on test 89%

He has an amazing interactive style of teaching.  He's passionate about the subjects and relates them to present-day life and social issues.  He makes you work for your grade but is always available to help and give feedback.  His tests are essay based but if you do the reviews you will do just fine.  He's nice to look at also, very charismatic.

Best History professor I've ever had! He makes History into what it was intended to be, a story. Some don't like his teaching style, but I guarantee you that they really learned something in his class, rather than regurgitating dates and forgetting them when the semester is over. Would, and am taking him again.

Reading is VERY important, but never difficult or long. He plays music before every class that is relevant to lecture. He's very "hip", I guess. Cool guy. Really cares about his students. There are 2 essays, 3 exams, and a debate in this class - all moderately hard but you'll do well if you try. Take this class & go into see him! He's awesome.

He is an extremely intelligent professor! He is probably the most intelligent teacher I have ever had. He tells you exactly whats going to be on your test and if you have any questions before or after, he will gladly help you and answer your questions thoroughly. He also constantly offers office hours. He offers in depth responses as well.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!! He thinks that everyone is a history major. My least favorite class ever

This class is very hard, avoid this class, since he is the only one teaching it. The tests were essay based and does not do a good job explaining what is going to be on the exams. There is also a lot of writing for it not being a writing emphasis requirement.
She is the best professor ever!!! If you show up to class you will get a good grade. No tests and no hard deadlines

THE BEST TEACHER EVER! Gives great lectures and knows what she's talking about. My favorite class at TCU. I would 100000000% recommend. This class makes you think and she keeps you engaged and interested. I could see Amorette becoming a very influential individual in society today. She needs to start a podcast. GOAT.

BEST PROFESSOR! She is an example of how college lectures should be. She clearly cares about educating her students and is very passionate. Her classes are fun and exciting. Never felt bored for a second! 10/10!

Dr.Hinderaker is an outstanding professor in this department. She is extremely accessible, very passionate about her area of study, and provides relevant material that is easily digestible. There is a case study that is a major grade, and she guides you through the whole process. No busy work in her class.

She is one of the best profs here. Her exams are extremely straightforward. If you attend class and pay attention, you will be successful. She will tell you exactly what you need and will is transparent. There is NO busy work! Honestly, take any comm reqs with her or Schrodt!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Hinderaker is a really good professor. She is to the point and doesn't waist your time, but is informative and the lectures are interesting and clear. She is a pretty fair grader and prepares you and helps you with assignments if you need. I would definitely take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Definitely my favorite professor at TCU. She tells you exactly what she wants for everything and wants you to succeed. Two semesters with her and only have two assignments that weren't a 100. Take her if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Hinderaker is one of my favorite professors I have ever had. She is so helpful with anything you need and she is completely straightforward about what is on her tests and what is not. Org comm can get a little boring sometimes but she really wants to make it interesting. Taking another class of hers because she is the best lol.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: It's not easy, but if you put the work in and follow grading guidelines an A is doable. Lectures really help to understand the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: One of the best teachers I've had at TCU. She's super intelligent and straight forward with material that you need to study for exams. Seems intimidating at first but she's really nice. Cares about her students and is willing to help you if she sees that you are trying. There's a case study but she's VERY helpful with it in and outside of class.

Dr. Hinderaker is fantastic! She seems intimidating at first but trust me shes great! She doesn't use powerpoint but you'd be surprised how much information you retain without it. Her papers can be fun and she goes pretty easy on grading. Tests are hard if you don't study but shes gives an extensive review the day before. TAKE ANY CLASS SHE GIVES!

Best teacher I have ever had in the TCU comm department. Genuinely cares about her students and is there to help them when they need it and will help them pass if they are showing up to class and showing effort. She talks fast but she knows she does, so just take computer notes of everything. Helps you out a lot with the case studies!!

such an intelligent and caring professor. also one of the easiest graders I've ever had. she knows so much about organizational and crisis comm that it makes the lectures very interesting. I highly recommend taking her. very easy A, while also learning valuable information

Dr. Hinderaker is my favorite teacher in the communication department. You can tell she really cares about the content when she's speaking. She lectures almost the entire class and she talks fast, but it isn't very hard to keep up with and she's happy to answer any question. Her test are straight forward, no confusing application questions.

Dr. Hinderaker is hands down the best professor I have had at TCU. I had her for introduction to university life, and she was the funniest, most enjoyable professor I had. Her UNLF is the easiest, so if you are going to take it, definitely take it with her. All you have to do is do the campus activities and present your forgfolio. 11/10

Dr. Hinderaker is nothing short of incredible. I took her for speech and debate, and this is unequivocally the most interesting and applicable class I have taken at TCU. The knowledge you will receive in this class can be used for the rest of your life, and Hinderaker's teaching style makes it palatable and fun. 11/10 would recommend.

Dr. Hinderaker is one of the best professors at TCU. All comm majors should take her for Org Comm. It is really interesting and not very difficult. She's very nice and willing to work with you on anything. She coaches the debate team at TCU so class is cancelled sometimes and you have to keep up. Overall a great professor that TCU is lucky to have.
One of the best professors I have had.  I was not  interested to begin, but by the time I left the class I was in love with Debate.  I highly recommend for all Comm. Majors
Dr. Hinderaker is amazing. One of the best professors at TCU. Highly recommend for her  Argumentation and Debate class. She coaches TCU's debate team, and she is great at what she does.

Probably worst class I have taken. Assigns multiple random books and quizzes you every class about the ~1.5-2 hour reading assigned from the last class. Not super work heavy besides all of the reading but you could probably learn everything in this class from a YouTube video
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: You have to read every night and there are quizzes at the beginning of every class. You actually have to read to do well on them. There are 2 tests that are super easy. It is not like this class is necessarily hard, but there is a lot of work that goes in to it. Also, class is boring and lectures are long and unnecessary.

Ugh this class is one of my least fav classes.  
You read at least 20 pages before class and there is a quiz every single class and besides that, going to class is pointless.  The lectures are very boring; there is a few assignments and 2 tests that are easy.  The reading is where you get all of the material and content of the class

Professor Hmieleski offered an amazing class to which I learned a lot. There is a bit of reading, yet each book relates to entrepreneurship and is effective in understanding the course and group project. He cares about his students and offers help whenever anyone needs it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Readings and a 2 question quiz every class. He does let you check your answers with him before you turn in + try again if you're wrong which is nice. Exams are pretty easy, theres also a group paper thats worth 30% of your grade. His aura is so confusing to me, something off about the guy idk. Overall not a bad professor or class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: It's impossible to ask a fish to teach you how to walk. This is because the fish has never walked on two legs before. Just like this, I would never ask someone to invest my money for me that has never invested before. Moreover, why would someone that has zero entrepreneurial experience be teaching it? Makes no sense, horrible class.

I do not recommend taking Professor Hmieleski's class. This is the first entrepreneurship class I took at TCU. We read 4 books throughout the semester and had quizzes every day about the readings; some were easy, others were unreasonably hard. He was very harsh on new venture ideas and they were graded based off both his and the class' thoughts.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: My favorite ENTR class so far at TCU. You read 4 books, but they are really easy reads and honestly super interesting and applicable. There's quizzes on the readings at the beginning of the class, but you don't have to read for more than an hour before each class in order to get an A. He is the kind of professor that wants you to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Awful experience. Classic PhD with zero experience as an entrepreneur. It is all theory, all made up. I'm sure he is a great guy, but pick a different professor. I got an A in the class, and did not learn anything I could have not learned on Youtube. I have to be honest here... terrible experience

This was the most disappointing course of my MBA. Dr. Hmieleski is clearly an accomplished academic of the study of entrepreneurism, but he seems to have very little experience or even interest in the actual practice of it. If you are interested in being an entrepreneur, do not waste an elective on this course. Easy class, but empty of content.
A bunch of quizes, but papers are easy, if you read and study guide gives you the test!  Take for an easy A!  Great teacher!

Hmieleski was a great prof in my opinion. All you have to do is read two pretty easy books and take a quiz on them for almost every class. Readings take about 30 minutes. The tests are almost directly from the study guide. There are 3 projects which can be challenging bc of their length. The last one is with a group;good deadlines to not get behind

This class was a walk in the park. All you had to do was go to class and read the book for an easy A. He tells you exactly what to study for the tests, gives you a study guide, and grades easy. Project is time consuming but not impossible at all. Got an easy A
Mandatory near daily quizzes. Professor has no real world experience and can be aggressive. This class made me switch out of the entrepreneurial management major.

Attendance mandatory because there is a quiz (3 questions)every day but it is easy if you read the text. Get participation just for showing up. Great prof up until the project. Had an A all semester and then got ****ed on the project and got a B for the semester.
very very good
Great class, great professor, can't recommend him enough

Amazing professor! His lecture is very fun and example based. He's very understanding towards students and willing to chat with them after class. The exam is not very difficult and focuses more on application rather than memorization.

One of the best professors at TCU, always available to help students and give feedback. His teaching method is great, he engages all students and explains in detail. I highly recommend taking his class.
Great professor - really cares about his students

The review below says it all. Love this guy. He clearly knows his stuff and wants his students to succeed. Provides a study guide and only tests on that and his ppts. Tests are challenging but you just have to put in the work and you will succeed. If you engage with him, he will reward you. No HW. Take him for MKTG Management!!!

Dr. Houston is one of the nicest people I have ever met. Very Understanding and approachable, willing to help any way he can. Exams are very straight forward, gives all the notes in handouts, it if is not on the notes it is not on the exam. Gives a study guide of additional terms needed to be known for test if it is not on notes. High recommend.
Will pick favorites in class early on and then name grades for rest of semester

She is very sweet but takes a long time to grade any assignment with little to no real feedback. Some of the assignments don't even get graded at all, so it's a waste of time. The readings are interesting and lead to good discussion, but they become overwhelming easily. Reading and lecture-heavy class. Be prepared to not get grades back for weeks.

Professor Hogg is the best I would recommend taking any class that she has. You have to do the work but she is a pretty easy grader and I got high A's on every assignment. It is important to go to class but she is so nice. There are readings but you can get by without really reading them.

I took this class because it was a required Dr. Hogg has helped me actually enjoy writing. She gives good feedback on writing and is clear about what she is looking for in the papers. She is a pretty easy grader and offers revision for the big papers to help you improve your grade.

I've immensely Dr. Hogg's Creative Writing Nonfiction Workshop II course. While there is a lot of reading and writing, the assignments are consistent and she works well with you if you communicate with her. All of her reading assignments are relevant and enjoyable. She is very open to feedback and offers caring and constructive feedback.

She is the BEST teacher I've had at TCU. Very understanding, truly cares about her students. You can always revise your projects, her D2L page is very well-designed and grading is super clear. She grades fairly, respects opinions, and does curve your grade if you put the effort into revising. Very accessible.

I took Dr. Hogg for English 1 and she was amazing. You're gonna be a better writer with her guidance. English isn't even my first language and I did super well in that class, just make sure you do projects review to improve your grade (she has pencil grade so you can curve it later). Also she's super flexible with accommodation.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great teacher! Provided so much feedback and opportunities to fix your papers. The class was very interesting and she is so nice!

This was absolutely in my top three favorite classes during my college career (senior with 9 hours left). Lots of class discussion about the readings. Felt as though the class was one big family by the end of the class. She was hilarious, helpful, and made me excited for class each week. We were even given cute toy trophies on the last day!

At the beginning, I thought Dr. Hogg was a tough grader and she wasn't my favorite but by the end, I think I became a better writer. I like that she gives us a general topic for what we are to write about (whether an argument paper, or 'this i believe') but we get to choose what specifically we write on. Helps you a lot if you go to her office hrs.

I took comp 1 from her and definitely had to work for an A. It's a lot of writing and your whole grade is based on your essays but there's a lot of group editing and she's very willing to help. She's extremely sweet and really loves teaching and writing.

She is intelligent and knows how to teach, but you're going to work in this class I promise you. You get to re-do your essays for a better grade which is really helpful on your final grade. No tests. Just 4 essays and 4 shorter responses make up your whole grade. Strict grader but I promise you will be a better writer when you leave! Approve.

I poured hours into The Essay, learned to love creative non-fiction and personal essay writing. Because I  had no prior exposure or experience in personal essay writing, I got a B and ruined my 4.0 in my major GPA. Absolutely subjective grader, grades on talent, ability and experience rather than effort, application of new skills, or improvement.
I had Dr. Hogg a few  years ago for Creative Writing and a class on the Western (i.e. Cowboys and pioneers). Her teaching style is engaging and she has a great rapport with her students.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS UNLESS YOU LIKE RECEIVING POOR GRADES FOR YOUR HARD WORK! Just as the person above me stated, you work twice as hard in this class in comparison to other English classes to simply receive half the grade you should receive.

This teacher is ridiculous. It helps you become a better writer but be prepared for gpa hit. I could have had an A with any of the other teachers.  I did twice the work my friends did and they got As while i had a B-.  Its not worth the work you have to do its impossible to get an A. Dont take this class unless you want alot of work for no reward

The Essay--great professor, funny, caring, nice.  It was difficult producing weekly drafts every single week for workshop.  Basically, you are forced to write whether or not you are inspired.  I guess that's what writing is all about:  hard work. oh, there is a difference b/w creative fiction, and creative non-fiction.  This class is the latter.

This was one of my favorite classes at TCU. Dr. Hogg makes writing really interesting, fun, and creative. I highly recommend this class to anyone interested in writing at all. She is a great teacher and hilarious.
Really nice teacher. She genuinely wants people to be interested and do well. It requires some work but you can revise all your papers for better grades. I def recommend the class!

Honestly the best teacher I have ever had. She is so helpful and really does want her students to do well. This class is not easy but it is definitely not hard if you put the time in to go talk to her about your work. I would HIGHLY recommend this class.

Expects a lot from you, but because of this I've walked away from this class having learned so much and feel that I have grown as a writer. Willing to help you in her office hours, so although there is a lot of outside work, if you put the effort into it you should be fine.  Very fun and witty, really fun class.

I heard good things about her, but she exceeded expectations. She grades tough (meaning a C is average, B is above average, and A is exceptional) but it's worth it for what you learn. I grew so much as a writer. Now obviously I wanna keep my scholarships, but just make the changes she tells you to, and you'll be fine. GREAT class, GREAT teacher!
Dr. Hogg is AMAZING.  The best prof, I've ever had.  Love the class love her.

I really liked this class! You have to spend a lot of time working out of class, but my writing really improved. Go to class, pay attention, get your writing done on time and you will do great in this class. Dr. Hogg is the best!

It is not an easy class.You'll be working hard every night to get all the things done, but at the end if you work hard and do all the homeworks you can get an A. Be carefull with tardies and abscences,I didn't got an A because she took 1 whole letter grade from mi final grade because of absences
I like writing and literature, but I didn't care for this class.

She is an amazing professor!  Very funny, easy to talk to, helpful, and always there if you need anything.  The class wasn't stressful at all (like some English classes are).  I would take her again in a heartbeat!
No Comments

I absolutely love writing and this class made me hate it.  Terribly unfair teacher. If you're liberal you make decent grades, otherwise its all Cs and Bs.  About 85% of my class hated her so it must be the english depatment liberals who are posting this and making the grades.
Dr. Hogg is a really good Prof. Her class requires a lot of work, but you will become a better writer. Dr. Hogg is great overall.
This chick rocks! I've grown more in my writing in this one semester than i have in four years of high school--take her, work hard, have fun, and you'll do great!

Dr. H is one of the best teachers I've had.  She requires a lot of writing, but she grades fairly, and always makes helpful comments.  She really helped me find my writerly niche!  I'd say take her for every class you can!
Awesome teacher.  A little hard at times, but overall the coolest teacher I've had.  Always makes time for her students.
best class I ever had at TCU
No Comments
This teacher is high voltage and you WILL pay attention and you WILL learn.  She'll challenge you, so expect to work, but she's fiar and will go way, way out of her way to help you.
great teacher. wanted her to create the essay II just to take another class with her.
A great teacher!  Makes class fun and has helpful comments about students' writing.

She is the best teacher I've had at TCU. Professor Howington explains things in ways that makes you understand them. I left class KNOWING the material. She is so personable, and is confident in her student's ability to do well. The tests are challenging, but if you UNDERSTAND the material, and memorize the pp slides, you will do well.

Dr. Howington is a nice professor and is always there to help you out if you make the effort. She can explain things more thoroughly if you go to her office hours. Advice: remember the slides, then apply your knowledge by taking the self-made quizzes on Sherpath, utilize any AI if you can, and ask it to generate test questions about the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Howington is an excellent instructor. While extra credit would have been helpful, I highly recommend meeting with her after exams to review any mistakes. The 5th exam covers 25% of the material from the first four exams, focusing on cardiac and pulmonary topics. Her medical stories made the content memorable.
Great, inspiring professor. She made patho doable and enjoyable. I did better in this class than I thought. Beware that you only have 5 exams and those are the only grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr.Howington is an absolutely wonderful professor. Throughout the entire semester she continued making efforts that benefited students. She material is difficult, but when you go back you will realize how much you have learned. Do not hesitate to meet with her outside of class, she is more than willing. You will enjoy her!

AMAZING AMAZING AMAZING. The BEST professor I have ever had. She relates a lot of her lectures to family or past experiences which makes everything so digestible. She is respected by everyone! The class is not as intimidating as I thought it was going to be. Read the book with the lectures in a timely manner and everything should be fine.

Professor Howington is a girl boss. She is an amazing professor and explains things so well. She genuinely wants you to do well and will help you anytime you want. I wish I could take her for every single nursing course because she is that good of a professor. Tests are 95% of your grade so you have to do well on the exams.

Dr. Howington is so impressive & knowledgeable. She incorporates personal stories in her lectures to help you with the material. The grade is pretty much just taken from exams so STUDY after every class and do not try to cram.

Dr. Howington is a wonderful person. I loved her lectures for patho, she goes very in depth and tells lots of personal stories to help relate to the content. Super accessible outside of class and highly would recommend to chat with her about any grade concerns. Such a great professor! Study ppts and book and you will do great.

Everyone know Patho is hard, but I did so much better than I thought I would. If you put in the work, it will pay off. It's a ton of work and yes it kind of killed my social life but it was worth it in the end. Howington is a great teacher, she explains things very clearly. She is also very accessible outside class, so take advantage of that!

the class is very difficult but Dr. Howington is great at explaining things & telling stories that will help you understand the concepts. Shes always willing to listen to feedback from students & is very easy to get ahold of out of class. Hopefully she keeps recording her lectures because its so helpful to re-listen to what she said in class

Dr. Howington makes a difficult course very do-able. She explains things clearly and is very accessible outside of class for extra help. The class grade is mostly determined by the tests, which makes things a little difficult but a few quizzes do help your grade. Overall, she works hard to make things fair and wants her students to be successful.

Patho is a tough class. Dr. Howington takes the time to give real life events to help you remember. She takes the time when you go to her office to listen and to try to give you tips on how to improve. Her lectures are straightforward and prepare you for test. Her and Dr. Cheeck teach the class together. I always did better on her portion than his
Confusing grader. A really nice guy but grades based on random criteria. Participation matters. A lot of writing as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Hill was super passionate about the class and cared about his students. Read before class because there are pop quizzes. Follow the guides exactly and you will have an easy A. Has an extra credit paper option. Attendance is mandatory but you get 1 skip. Has two breaks during class so it makes it manageable. He doesn't allow technology.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Hill is awesome! I'm a senior pre-med student and was always interested in his lectures because he clearly knows what he's talking about. Do the readings because there are pop quizzes, and prepare to take hand written notes because he doesn't allow computers. This was an easy A for me but I truly enjoyed the class. Take Dr. Hill if you can!

Christian Ethics: The material is very pc, which makes it a bit dull. Core Christian values are watered down. You're asked to work on a semester-long paper on a topic of your choice, and my favorite part was listening to other students' presentations on their topics.

Dr. Hill is an amazing professor. He gives great lectures. He gives in class quizzes so be sure to read your text daily. 3 exams, and an extra credit assignment. Dr. Hill is accessible, and very understanding. I enjoyed his class greatly. I would definitely take his course again. overall, great professor! One advice-Take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Very nice guy and very passionate about religion. Tends to lecture on and on while the whole class is lost and confused. Attendance is mandatory or he'll drop your letter grades after two absences, pop quizzes, assigns an average of 30 pages total each class, exams are mc, fill in the blank, matching and two essays. Grades easier than expected.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Ideal class for people with busy schedules that are fairly adept at taking good notes and memorizing. Do the reading since quizzes are unannounced. Exams are straightforward and come straight off the study guide.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This teacher is the best I've had on campus. I'm a senior PreMed student with absolutely no free time to study for other classes. This class is SUPER manageable, not to mention SO interesting. Jack Hill is the man! He cares so much about his students and wants them to succeed! He gives you extra credit and you know EXACTLY what's coming on the test

Dr. Hill is a great professor. He has a lot of knowledge about world religion and is fun to talk to, and doesn't just lecture the whole class. You do need to buy the textbook and read since he has pop quizzes, but his tests and quizzes are straightforward and he provides extra credit. Overall wonderful guy. Take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This guy is the worst. Get prepared because its WAY harder than you expect. He is a nice guy in general, but if you enroll in this class, BACK OUT NOW WHILE YOU STILL CAN!!!! None of his stuff makes sense.

There are only two tests, participation is a must as it is part of the grade. He does tend to be scatter brain and hands out supplemental information one, by one. He tends to talk past class time every so often, and he gets off track. He does make himself available and helps clarify. Tests are not extremely hard, but you will need to read.

One of the most disappointing courses I took at TCU. If you are willing to conform to HIS expected ethical views, its an easy A. However, if you aren't willing to drink the kool aid and actually put forth ideas that might challenge others to think, expect to be graded harshly. Don't expect to grow as a global citizen in this class.

Dr. Hill is one of the nicest professors I have ever had. He is extremely helpful and will help you in any way he can if you go in and talk to him about what you need as a student. He gives pop quizzes so you HAVE TO read what he gives you. If you have a really busy schedule I would suggest not taking this class. I took 18 hours and it was crazy.

You will be expected to read the textbook before class because there are pop quizzes. However, that's the only homework you have. Also, the test are very easy if you read, take notes in class, and do the study my guides provided. The test are almost identical to the study guides. Attendance is not required to pass but he does take roll everyday.

Dr. Hill is a very knowledgable professor and creates interesting class discussions. He does give pop quizzes so you have to keep up with the reading, but always gives good study guides for tests and the test questions are straight from the guide. Super nice and always willing to help. One of my favorite teachers so far!
The worst! Back out now before you go any further

Dr Hill loves what he does and is an amazing professor. He was always willing to help and his lectures were awesome.  They were an hour and a half long but that didn't seem it because he made them so interesting because he talked about his travels and you could tell he has a passion for teaching. Take his class!

You'll never get out early from night class, but an A is very possible if you put some studying into the tests! For the first test, know all the people from the readings and make sure you look up other unfamiliar topics in the reading. For the second test, don't read-all you need are the ethicist handouts. Grades the final paper easy.

In general, very nice person and cares about students. Interesting lectures that really help with studying for tests. Have to do a lot of out of class reading, as he has pop quizzes over the reading. But reading goes hand-in-hand for the lecture the next class period. Gives study guides before tests so it's clear what is or isn't on the test

THE BEST RELIGION PPROFESSOR HERE AT TCU!!! must go to class for attendance but classis very interesting. every lecture test is easy due to the study guide that he gives out before every test and if it is not on the guide then its not on the test. must do readings because quizzes come from them. really undrstanding prof and always willing to help!

Religious Communitites- Pretty easy. He gives a study guide for the tests and never puts things on the test that aren't on the guide. He talks a lot though about things that are totally irrelevant. Lots of stories. Can get frustrating. MUST GO TO CLASS.

On the whole, not too bad for a writing emphasis class, except for the final exam. He's a nice guy, but attendance is mandatory, and you must be on time! This was a night class, and it never ended early. But overall it was not too hard to achieve an A or B.

Dr. Hill was such a great teacher! I had to study a lot for the tests but he gives you study guides for each one. You have to keep up with the reading because he gives pop quizzes, but I really learned a lot in the class.

I had no interest in taking this class but i ended up loving it. Dr. Hill is very entertaining and made coming to class fun. His tests arent too hard as long as you do the reading and take good notes. Once in awhile he offers extra credit. He give 5 pop quizzes but sometimes he hints when they are coming up.

Very intelligent professor. I anticipated coming to class, one of the most stimulating and intellectual classes I've taken. Dr. Hill is very good at what he does and I highly recommend his class, esp global ethics.

Dr. Hill is SO awesome! I'm a B student and I came to class and took notes and got 100's on the tests! Not because his class was a blow off but he is so fair and gives you all the information you need! Take this class for religion, you will learn so much and get to meet an awesome teacher at TCU!

This professor is the God of all religion professors. He teaches a great class, just take notes and show up on time that's about it. This man saved me hard core... I showed up 2 hours late for my final and he was still in the classroom waiting on me and let me take it in entirerty. Also lived with the Rastas so he knows a little about the Ganja..ya

Dr. Hill is a good prof. The class covers a lot of material in a helpful and non-bias way. Tests and paper are not too bad because you write on your topic of choice. One negative is that class was boring at times because of the lecture style.

GREAT TEACHER!!!! i will miss him next semester. he's really endearing, and will help you out whenever you need it. go in before tests and talk to him about the questions on the review sheet and you will be fine as long as you study. go to class everyday because he takes attendence!

Dr. Hill is definitely one of my favorite professors. He is really a kind-hearted old guy, very sweet-natured, and kind of dorky. :) The readings are actually interesting and his lectures are clear. Exams aren't too hard, and are mostly over the lectures, so don't miss class.

Jack's an awesome guy and the class was amazing!  He takes a very balanced stance on the religious and political views of his students and appreciates a diverse class.  The reading was quite light for a religion class and the tests and papers weren't bad at all because you can tailor them to your own interests.  I highly recommend this class.

The nicest teacher ever! The class is really diffult, but he always willing to help you. Ask questions! He likes people to participate in class. Study really hard for tests! Keep up with the daily reading b/c he gives pop quizes!

Interesting class.... I learned a lot.  Watch out for test 2, it is pretty rough.  You will have to memorize lots of weird Buddha/Hindu names.  Other than that, I studied 3 hrs for each test and made an A in the class

I'm not a religious person, so I was surprised I enjoyed Dr. Hill's class so much. Interesting diversity of subjects, non-judgemental delivery, excellent way to study religion and life. Take him if you get a chance! Tests are easy if you can write!

A very nice guy.  Tests are a little tricky.  The defintitions of key terms on the test, do not match the defs. in the book. Put any effort into the class you will get a B.  He has pop quizes, but gives hints ahead of time. Read the books. He likes to tell stories. Go in there with an open mind.

he is nice. but, i ddint undrstand why he gave me a C. i had 2 A and 1 B in three final exams. i had strong class participation and a speacial presentation. so, you better clear the class policies with him before the class.
Very nice guy.  Tests are kinda tricky, though.  Take good notes and always read.  B is normal grade and you must work hard for an A.
Dr. Hill is so awesome. Very helpful, you learn alot, and the tests are fairly easy if you do the review sheet. He is so nice, I changed my major to Religion because of him!
Very nice guy. Pretty easy class if you study the notes, tests are not bad at all. He gives you a review and really wants you to do well. Good class.
interesting guy.  Some awesome stories from his experiences in Jamaica.  great lectures but essays are hard.

Not a good teacher if you really want to learn about world religion, he is more focused on just talking about christianity all of the time. Pretty easy tests if you memorize the material. NOt the most interesting class- very nice guy though
THIS GUY IS AWESOME! He's down to earth and seems to have an experience for every lesson. The class is easy enough if you study, and he wants you to get good grades (extra credit). Take him.
Interesting class to go to.  NOt easy, but if you go and participate you can get a good grade.  Nice man, who really does care about students
Great guy, genuinely nice person, makes material interesting, read and keep up and its an easy A, if you study for the tests. Wants to give you an A or B, gives extra credit.
He is a funny teacher. I loved coming into his room and learning because he wants you to learn. He is so willing to help but you have to study a bit.
His lecture are very interesting. His tests are kind of hard. Do not rely completely on the review-it doesn't always help.
An enjoyable class, likes student participation.  Test are harder than they look.

I was not looking forward to taking a speech class, but Mr. Hunter made taking the class fun with the in class activities. He also provided really good feedback on the speeches which will help me with future classes. It wasn't an easy class and you have to keep up on the reading and follow assignment requirements.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Hunter is a very caring and supportive guy. I was really nervous to take a speech class but he relaxed everyone before the speeches. He is not the easiest grader, usually took points off for small things in speeches and the tests are not the easiest either. Although he is not the easiest grader in this class, he is a very caring professor.
Good course. It only meets once a week so if you don't stay caught up on the reading or skip class you will struggle.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: tests are hard, super hard grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class as a core requirement and he treats this like everyone is going to be a professional speaker. Extremely difficult for no reason and I know any other teacher is almost a free A. DO NOT TAKE HIM!!
The exams are rough!! He grades speech outlines rough!! but he is a nice guy just will let your grade be low

Dr. Hunter is very easy-going and friendly. As long as you show up to class, listen and participate a bit it's a breeze. I took it as a night class and I would recommend. You don't really have to read the textbook. There are tests and speeches but tests aren't on lockdown browser.

Take anyone else for your Oral Communication credit. For a core requirement that is known as an easy A, it sure does not feel that way in this section. I ended up dropping because I know I can get an A with a different professor. There are exams in this class, which I have never heard of being in this course from other professors.
this professor was amazing i definitely would take his class again!

I took this as a night class which I would recommend. The tests for the class were relatively easy as long as you study. However, he was pretty tough when grading the speeches which hurt my grade. Overall, he's a funny and nice guy, but the class is not an easy A by any means.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Fun class. Very interactive.

Basic Speech pretty much just sucks, but at least he tried to make it suck less. You give two speeches, do a group project and take 3 tests. The speeches and project are easy and he doesn't grade too hard. The tests are pretty difficult in that they have random info on them that you never go over in class. There is lots of group activities.

The class sucks as it is but he doesnt help. Tests are pretty hard, class is boring because he just goes over slides from the text book. I was in a night class so that made it hard. Really just a boring class
Most heartless man you'll ever meet. Tests are too hard for a BASIC speech class. He doesn't do +/- and i ended up with an 89.4 and refused to bump my grade. I hated him!

Not an "Easy A" intro class, definitely need to study to finish the course with a "B" at least. Also go beyond what is told in the lectures, because come test day there is material that is never mentioned.

I really liked this class because it allowed you to interact with your classmates. He's a sweet man with a good east. You must study for the tests to make a B, making an A is next to impossible but a for sure B. he grades easily on the speeches and its just an overall fun class.
funny guy, liked the class. not an easy A or anything but if you work hard you'll do fine.
Speech was easy. Not a bad prof.

So, you may be thinking, "Okay, he seems alright." But a class consists of non-stop unless power points (with way too much text). Then, speeches are made for two classes. Then a test that has nothing to do with the material or readings. No one in my class received an A. Pick another professor.

A really nice guy, but a pretty useless teacher.  TAKE THIS GUY IF YOU WANT AN EASY A.  Seriously, easiest class I've taken in college.  There's a ton of reading, but the only time I ever opened a book was before the test, which was multiple choice.  He requires you to give a few speeches; don't worry.  They're not bad, just pick something you like

I truly believe Dr H is a kind person who has no idea what he is expecting of students. I was in an Honors undergrad class where he assigned multiple papers and sometimes documentaries a week, NEVER provided rubrics/guidelines for assignments, and was ALWAYS late getting feedback/grades to us. Class was student-led and participatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was a good professor, not much guidance on papers which can be different at first compared to other classes. The essays were not too bad, they required reading but it was easy. Final took some time but it was just a normal presentation with a group. Good guy who promotes creativity and thinking outside the box.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: I only took his class for a couple weeks before I decided this class was not for me. EVERYTHING is centered around theater and drama. Unless you're into acting and the arts, this class is NOT enjoyable.

The final exam is a 5 act play that you have to write and perform in a group. He will give you no rubric, no direction, and next to no guidance. There will be assigned readings and writings every week that seem to make no sense because he doesn't explain how they relate to the focus of the course. 10/10 would not recommend.
Great professor who really cares about her students. Comes with a lot of knowledge about Developmental Psychology. Would take again!

Professor Hunsley is by far the nicest professor and knows a lot about psych. She gives out spontaneous extra credit and the exams are easy as long as you study. Also there is no need to buy the textbook, all of her exams are based on lecture.
Honestly an amazing professor. She is super nice gives a lot of EXTRA CREDIT in random days and test are fine if you study. For sure take her!!! she is not hard

Professor Hunsley is an amazing lecturer. She knows what she is talking about and helps prepare you for her tests very well. Pay attention in lectures and you will do good on her tests. The main grade in this class is based on the tests and class activities. She also gives you a lot of extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very nice and will work with you. There are a good amount of assignments but they are very quick and done in class (you aren't required to go to class but it's better if you do). There are a lot of extra credit opportunities as well. The class is mostly just lectures but they are interesting. There's also basically no homework.
She is super nice and cares a lot about students well being. She gives a lot of extra credit opportunities and does not want to fail students.

Professor Hunsley is a great professor for Developmental Psychology. You go through PowerPoints each class and have 3 exams total with the final included. Each test is worth 20% but if you study they aren't that difficult. Would take again!

I LOVED Jamie!! I took her class as a summer course and it was the best decision ever. There were weekly quizzes but super easy. She truly cares about her students and encourages discussions in class. She does not want to waste your time so we never went the full time. She normally responded to my emails in less than 1 hour. 10/10 recommend!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I loved Jamie! Though it's a 3-hour class, we never stayed the entire time, and in one class she took time to ease our minds by reading us a children's book :'). No book required, the lectures are all you need to know for the two exams (plus the final that is optional). I will say her exams are worded weird but its essay format!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Although a 3 hour class, usually only about an hour & a half. She does not want to waste your time & posts power points to follow along. Tests are essay questions which you have a week to complete pulling from past lectures & assigned readings. Super enjoyable and content is interesting! She is the best.

Really liked this prof! Made class very easy going & makes sure expectations are clear. Has great guest speakers and is very knowledgeable herself. Had a group project but she didn't want anything too crazy, just wanted to make sure you knew your topic and presented it to the class clearly. Would definitely take a course from her again!

She has a glowing personality who is very engaging about the material. She makes it fun to come to class and learn. I would love to keep taking classes with her. Ask questions when you don't understand something, and she will surely help clear things up. Really interesting class too!

Dr. Hurst is awesome! This class is interesting and she makes it very fun.  Tests are reasonable, just read and go to class.  She doesn't post lecture notes & will test you on things she only goes over in class.  Interesting class & Dr. Hurst makes it very applicable.

Shes awesome. Very good teacher. Lectures were fun. Tests were easy if you take notes and study. Gives lots of in class extra credit. Absolutely loved her and this class! easy A if you go to class and do assignments.

I took her for Child Psychology, and it was a great class! Very interesting and she really seems to love the material. A group project goes through the semester, but nothing too bad. I would definitely recommend taking this class to anyone even if it's for an elective.

Dr. Hurst is a great teacher! Attendance is not mandatory. You MUST buy the book if you want to pass! 3 tests, all multiple choice, plus an optional cumlitive final. Offers lots of extra credit, but no sona hours. 5 in class activities, lowest grade is dropped. I would highly recommend her child psych class. Great teacher-I would def take her again

Professor Hughes really likes her class, which is a good thing and makes this class better. But, I recommend bringing homework to do during lectures. This class has very few things to be graded on, and she can be a really tough grader. For a class I took for credit thinking it would be easy, this became my lowest grade for the semester.

Mrs. Hughes is very passionate about poetry and it shows in her class. She is very encouraging and makes poetry interesting. She is a tough grader and does grade on just a few things but she gives good feedback so you can do better on the next assignments. Gives extra credit opportunities. Overall great for your writing core.

Doctor Hughes is brutally difficult. I advise steering clear of Intro to Poetry. This class should be an upper division class with how she grades. Also learned nothing the entire year. Was rather a waste of time so I suggest you save yours by not taking her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As a STEM major, I was skeptical about taking a poetry class, but Dr. Hughes is incredible! Her passion for literature showed in every class. Don't be afraid to speak up, because she wants to hear from everyone.

Dr. Hughes makes you work HARD for an A in her class, but I honestly learned a lot from her. I wouldn't take her again for a core class because the workload was so heavy, but I definitely will go to her in the future for advice as she gave great feedback on papers and other work. If you are ready to work hard, take her class. Otherwise avoid.

Dr. Hughes was one of my favorite professors in the TCU English Department. She is incredibly passionate about what she teaches and creates an engaging environment in class. However, expect a lot of work. There are at least 4 or 5 different major assignments/papers plus exams. But even though she was tough, I gained so much from her course!
She is a good teacher and very educated about her topics but she can be overwhelming and is obsessed with women's rights. she is a very hard essay grader but if you ask for help she will help you

If you have ever considered going into a liberal arts graduate program, take Dr. Hughes. She gives you SO MUCH work to do and expects you to be experts by the end of the semester. This is not a bad thing. She's incredibly fun to take classes from. Take this class to challenge yourself and work your butt off for the A. It will teach you so much.

She is extremely condescending towards students and is very strict on attendance policy. Her grading techniques fluctuate from paper to paper, so it is extremely difficult to please her. I would not take this again if you paid me.

I took her western lit class and loved it. She assigns a ton of reading and gives quizzes once a week. I sparknoted the readings and got 95 on almost all of them. She is a tough grader but if you see her one on one she is extremely helpful. I've never had a teacher so passionate. She is a must take teacher. Harder but in the end worth it.
Hughes is one of the best professors at TCU, and I would HIGHLY recommend her. I took "Why Read Literature" with her,  which is an easy class as long as you read the stories and pay attention.
She was an amazing professor! This "Why Read Lit" class was not easy, but she made you feel & really think about why Lit is so important. I highly recommend!
I LOVED Dr. Hughes' class!! She's the sweetest, most helpful professor I've had at TCU. She knows her stuff and you can tell she really loves what she does. I will definitely take her again!

Honestly one of the best English courses at TCU. Dr. H is incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about the material which by the way is incredibly interesting. I cannot remember a day when the entire class wasn't laughing due to some "Wilde" joke.She can be tough and expects the most of her students but honestly no one in that class would complain

Lots of reading, but an incredible prof. She grades tough on the papers but tells you what she wants on her tests. Be prepared for reading but if you enjoy English you will love her class. She tries so hard to make every class interesting and her passion is obvious. DEFINITELY take her if you're an English major/minor!

Dr. Hughes, is an excellent professor.  She will value your opinions, which encourages your participation.  She makes the class interesting with her knowledge of her subject and she inserts little known tid bits.  If you need an English class, TAKE HERS!!!  Even if you're not really interested in the subject, you might be pleasantly surprised.

One's "TCU experience" would not be complete without taking a course from Dr. Hughes; she is without question one of the top professors at the university.  She is exceptionally intelligent, passionate, and motivated:  the best teacher with whom I've ever had the privilege of working.

Amazing teacher. Lots of reading, but she makes it well worth it. Grades VERY strict on style and polish on essays. Hughes is very enthusiatic and makes everyone feel like they have something unique and smart to add to the class. One of my best professors at TCU.

This class is interesting but there's a LOT of reading and the quizes, which are unannounced, are usually over the most obscure readings. Honestly, sometimes the discussion gets a little ridiculous. Be sure to have a LOT of free printer pages for this class, you'll need to print 20-50 pages for EACH lecture.
Best Prof at TCU.  Very understanding.  Very kind, and will explain anything to anyone.  Makes everyone feel smart and appreciates participation.  Awesome teacher.

She is a very hard teacher. Her paper requirements are broad, but yet you can tell she is looking for something specific. She is a very tough grader and the class is boring. You have to read like 5 books plus a lot of papers. I took my papers to the writing center 2 for every paper and I got a LOW C on them. THe class is BORING too don't take it!!
SO MUCH READING!!  Fun class, very smart, but beware of the reading.
Great Teacher!  a very intelligent and well spoken prof, she really knows her stuff and truly wants you to 'get it' as well.  easily one of my top 5 fav. prof's ever!  overall, she's a great lady
Undoubtedly the best professor I have had at TCU.  She does assign a ton of reading, but everything is worth it in the end.  Her energy and general knowledge is amazing.  Love her !

King Arthur is fun stuff except that there is a heap load of reading, like three hundred pages per week and she does pop quizes to make sure you know them. In lecture she gets this voice that can be hard to hear when she is making a fascinating point.

I had professor Huggins this semester and it was by far my favorite class. She made the content really fun and I can actually say I genuinely enjoyed going to class. There is a lot of reading but it is not bad at all if you stay on top of your work. Awesome class and awesome professor, I would highly recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: The BEST professor I have ever had here. She is so sweet, understanding, and genuinely wants you to succeed. We had 3 main essays over the semester and little activities in between. Very easy to do well if you do the work and go to class. She also (almost) always ends class early. I wish I could take her again

Mrs. Huggins is a great Professor! She will work with you instead of against you and really wants to see her students succeed. There is a lot of reading and writing in this class, however she give you plenty of time for assignments, and is very reasonable if you need extra time. Her class really helped be become more organized and a better writer!
Assings 80+ pages of reading for each class period and gives a difficult quiz on them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Park for Ear Training, and every class was the same: sight-singing, chord ID, and dictation. Students who struggled were just told to practice more, with no strategies to improve. There was also a language barrier that made it even worse. If you already know theory you'll be fine, but if you're new to it, I would not recommend Dr. Park.

Shes a super sweet teacher and she was really excited about what she was talking about. She understands if youre not a music expert and answers questions excellently. Two midterms and ten listening exams which were a little troubling so just make sure you know about what youre listening to. Overall a great class and pretty interesting too!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Park is an awesome professor. She understood we weren't music majors and so she lectured accordingly. Two exams -open notes/book, two CD analysis that might take longer to complete but very relaxing, basically just listening to music and analyzing what you heard. Asks hundred times if there are any questions during the class. Take her!!!
He is very nice and easy to communicate with. Very interesting course
Always helpful and full of wisdom. Very talented artist with a wild variety of experience.
Offers one-on-one time and frequently checks in on each student during work days. Very interactive, discussions are enlightening.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I get why people don't like him because tends to not have a filter sometimes & has hard tests, but he is honestly the sweetest man I have ever met. He REALLY cares about his students & wants nothing more for them to succeed. Go to his office hours, he will take his time in helping you. Read the chapters & do practice problems and you'll be fine.

LQ relies on your having read the book to do well. His tests are pulled directly from the online homework with little care if topics tested have been covered in class. Lectures are confusing, surface level explanations at best. Assumes students' economic knowledge is already beyond introductory level. Be prepared to be called on and do HW often.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor LuQuette is an amazing professor. He is very knowledgeable about what he teaches and that is always helpful. My only complaint is that sometimes the tests are too hard, considering this is a beginning economics class. I was up many late nights doing the pre-tests, post-tests, and quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tries his best to let students achieve their academic potential. Very funny and has lots of real life examples for topics discussed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tests? Not many--Would take again

reviews.comment: This was SUCH a great economics class he Organizes his lectures in the flow of the book, which is a very accessible text to read Teaches using real life examples, makes the class very applicable to real life Doesn't use powerpoints writes everything on the board You definitely need to know the material for tests but if you go to class your good!

Super, super easy way to get your GA credit. TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN. The class is mostly athletes and you are only graded by 4 tests, but if you listen in class you'll pass easy and probably get an A.   DO NOT buy the test book and always do the 1 page extra credit before the exams. Write down all the current events discussed in class.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I found Dr. Iles and his geography class to be super boring. He has a monotone voice and drags on and on through powerpoint. However, the class was a super easy A. Four map quizzes, four exams, and a non cumulative final. Vocab out of the book is extra credit. He does sometimes take attendance, but he gives a review the day before the test.

To do well in this class you have to go to class and take good notes. Always uses a powerpoint in his lectures, but the test material is based on the current-event facts about the countries that he says aloud, so you have to pay attention in class and write that stuff down. SUPER EASY class if you pay attention
Ken's a great professor. He is very accommodating and a very easy grader, I highly recommend taking this class. I learned a ton in this class despite it being very interesting, he's a smart man.

Class is very boring. Sit in the front so that you will pay attention because the tests have random things that he will mention but won't put in the power points so be sure to hear them. Very nice teacher. Very easy. And pretty interesting.
Really easy teacher, just lectures but his test aren't too hard
Awesome teacher!! Gives you everything you need to make an easy A on tests plus tons of extra credit. I have made over 100% on both tests so far.

Professor, gives lot of extra credit, easy to make A or B at least. He explains a lot of stuff during  class,  He is awesome professor. If you need to take geo, definitely take with him. Do the extra credit it will help a lot!!!!!!!

This class is actually really interesting. Teacher can tend to be monotone, but if you listen to what he is saying, its actually really interesting. He offers extra credit... DO IT. it really helps. I liked him because he wants his students to do well in the class. He is a really nice guy and he knows his stuff.

Like the other posts said, very monotone. Of the 30 students I'd say 20 were on Facebook the whole time. His lectures are boring but the review the day before the test is where he gives the test answers, so make sure and soak all of that up when he has it. Do the extra credit and study your maps and you'll get an A.

I'm a straight A student and this should have been an easy class but he is really confusing and test questions are not in book or lecture. He does give extra credit but it doesn't help. I don't recommend it if you are looking for an easy teacher.
He is very boring and monotone, but he is very nice and a great guy. If you do the extra credit you'll get an A.

Dr. Iles was a great teacher in my opinion. He really opened my eyes to a lot of issues going on in other countries around the world & made me appreciate & understand different cultures a lot better. He is really nice and likes to tell jokes! A little monotone & a faster talker, but great nevertheless. You'll have to come to class to do well!

To be honest, I didn't know his name until about a month into class.  His classes are straight lectures.  He is so monotone it makes you want to fall asleep, but you can't because your notes are your only help for the test because his reviews are confusing. He gives good extra credit opportunities and his map tests are easy.  Get your points there.

you will have palsy after every class from the amount of notes he requires. grade is based on 3 exams that are confusing at best. dude rambles on and on and his jokes are not funny. at all. i think dude makes up words as he goes along. 10+ FULL pages of notes each class and the test questions never matched up with the notes. DO NOT TAKE.

HORRIBLE!!!! The lectures were soooo boring. he lectured the entire night class. LOTS of reading and would pick the smallest things to test you on. I went to the class every time, read the book and all the supplements, and studied and I still failed. So many people failed, the class was misserable, he needs to be fired!!!!!
