Never take this teacher if you can help it!! There is way to much reading and lecture material on every test.  The average on our first test was an F and there were no A's and only two B's.  When asked about a curve he laughed and said a bad grade is an incentive to do better next time. Worst teacher i have ever taken. Do not take him if you can!!!

DO NOT skip class. Mon is all lecture and you fill out code and complete assignments with him, and on wed he assigns homework and you work on it in class. The homework gets super complex near the end of the semester and class time is crucial especially if you want to get a good grade on the HW. No tests, quizzes are super easy and common knowledge.

All of the exams are take home, however they are very hard, and if you don't devote a lot of time to it don't expect to get an A. If you do, you will be just fine. Every single thing he says in the lectures are the slides he posts before class so you don't really need to show up. I would reccomend still coming to class though to maintain face w him

Lots of test- which was the only thing going into our grade. I didn't feel like I could do well until the last test after taking a few to get used to it. Test were like he would give us a list of 50 or so questions and you need to remember the answers and your test will be like 6 or 7 out of those 50.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I have never coded in my life and this course was quite challenging for me at times but Dr Frinchaboy was helpful. Can complete all homework in class time, while having him at hand to ask questions. Not a lot of explaining, a lot you have to figure out or make sense to yourself on your own. He does want you to understand and do well tho.
Dr. Frinchaboy is a great professor. He clearly cares about his work and enjoys teaching. Lots of reading and group work, but exams were pretty easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Frinchaboy is great, and the course was awesome. lots of very interesting lectures, even if I was not always following. Not much grade stress ever, homework could be hard but he was willing to help with everything or accept late work.

He's a pretty nice guy but can be condescending. He's also impossible to reach outside of class and terrible at accomodating students. If you get an A in the class you can skip the final, but that's crazy hard to achieve when each test is worth 14% of your final grade and is 7 questions taken from a bank of 60, and the questions are all essay.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took this as a last option for NSC credit. Got a better grade than expected, but this is not an easy class. Took fewer hours than normal this semester, which is what saved me because it gave me the time I needed to get this grade. Only grades are exams and labs, which were horrible. If you put effort into studying module questions you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great teacher if you are trying to get your science credits out of the way. Classes are lecture-heavy, but room for questions at the start of every class. grades are heavily determined by your test grades, but the labs and extra credits allow for a heavy boost. His exams are fair and not too challenging if you pay attention in class or study.

The sweetest man! Dr. Frinchaboy just wants to see his students succeed. He's super smart but makes all of his lectures very understandable even though he will cover a ton of information in every class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Frinchaboy is very friendly, always open to help students in any way in or out of class, as long as you turn in the small amount of work assigned you will be fine.

I took Scientific Analysis with Dr. Frinchaboy and really appreciated how he gave us lots of class time to practice the coding techniques we were learning. He was very helpful and answered any questions we had.

As long as you take notes during class, do the labs (which are easy), and do any reading which may be assigned, youll get a good grade. You dont have to take the final if you have a B or higher. There are in class worksheets.

You don't have to go to class which is nice. Readings are required for a couple questions for the exam. Overall Frinchaboy is a good professor and tries to make students (most who are taking the class for the double dip in core) enjoy learning.

This class was not what I expected. If you want an easy A, this isn't it. This isn't astrology, either... in fact, you barely look at the solar system. And the lab feels like a total waste of time, it's all stupid worksheets. Supplementary labs were fun, though, I recommend. And if you like where your grade is, you don't have to take the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Well. This professor obviously thinks we are all genius astronomy majors because his tests reflect that. They are 10X harder than the "thought questions" we are given before classes. Do not take this class.

Good luck ever seeing him after class because he will never return your emails no matter what. His tests are hard and pointless. He plays major favorites and uses his favorites to give you important grades like participation. overall would not recommend this teacher at all.

Very easy class. He gives you "thought questions"  before all exams which are basically the exam. If you take the time to memorize the questions you will ace the exams.  Also if you have a high grade at the end of the semester, you can opt out of the final.  Labs and class participation are also a  high percentage of the grade.

Pass failing because the exams aren't proportional to how he teaches and how the labs are - they're significantly harder and he even tells you this. Dr. Frinchaboy's a lazy professor and there's no motivation to go to class. Also your last test is the week before the final.

Frinchaboy is all over the place. His lectures are unorganized and do not apply to the tests. Labs are super easy, but the tests are impossible. Thought questions can be helpful, but unless you know the answers forward and backwards, you will not do well. Ended up using a P/NC to get the historical tradition and natural science credit.

I'm usually an A student, but this class was rough for me. Lectures are all over the place. Attendance isn't mandatory and the labs aren't bad. Had to take this class pass/fail. Try another science class for your NS credit.

This class is super easy, not really the math-heavy science course I was expecting. All you have to do to pass is fill out the "thought questions" he gives out for review before each test. Some of them aren't covered in the lecture so you'll need the textbook, but if you can answer all those you'll be fine.

The class overall is pretty easy because the participation, online quiz grades, and lab grade help balance your grade. He gives you "thought questions" before the test, which is basically a review, and he pulls a lot of questions from those for the test. He does, however, include other questions, so studying the power points definitely helps.
Cosmic Origins in maymester. Good professor, reasonable expectations and grading.

I love his lectures. No need to take notes in class. No homework. The "weekly" quizzes we have only had 4 of are mega easy. Tests are easy because they cover thought questions he gives you before hand. If you have a high grade at the end of the year you can skip the final. A+

This is my second time taking astronomy and I really enjoyed Frinchaboy! He's very clear in what he expects. He does have weekly quizzes but answers are easily found online. Questions on the exam are similar to his study guide so my suggestion would be to complete the study guide and discuss it with a study group. DONT BUY THE BOOK!
I did not like this teacher at all and I emailed him for help one time and he never responded. I would not reccomend taking this class in general. It is not easy

This is a huge lecture class so attendance is not required and you just go over the power points in class which are online. Class is pointless, the online weekly quizzes are really easy, the tests you really need to study for and are all short answer, but if you do study you should be alright. I was interested in the class, but now I despise it.

Class was really easy. Class itself was boring, but if you go to class and take notes, an A will be easy. Gives reviews for all tests, and questions are straight from it usually. Lab was completely pointless, but you only had to do like 10 of them and there were opportunities for alternatives. Never read, ended up with high A. Douglas is harder...

He was always disorganized, his thoughts weren't fluid, and even if you copied the thoughts word for word from the lecture onto the test, you would get it wrong. The only redeeming quality is the ability to retake the final to get a better grade, but that's it. I recommend this class, but I do not recommend this professor.
Easy teacher, straight forward. Tests are pretty easy too since he gives you the though questions. I reccomend taking him.

Very disorganized. Most of what he talked about in class wasn't even on the tests, it all came out of the book. Tests aren't too bad, because he give you a review that basically word for word. You don't have to take the final if your grade is high enough. Interesting class, but take it with a different prof.

First semester for this class so it was kind of unorganized since both professors teaching had never done this class before. Easy, just do the thought questions and go to class and you'll do great on the exams. Curves tests if class does poorly. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
Lots of trick questions on his tests, but if you watch the thought questions, its an easy A.

Go to class, take the weekly quizzes, and do the thought questions in advance (not the day before an exam). If you do these things, you can easily get an A. He is a lenient grader on exams, and he gives plenty of hints about what exactly will be on the exams. Plus, he may even add extra points to exam scores as a bonus. Great professor.
Tests are simple if you do the thought questions. Has options for extra credit. Great professor. Overall easy A as long as you do all the assignments, go to class and pay attention. TAKE HIM!
Just don't take him. He doesnt know how to teach, he doesnt answer questions, and he seems to absolutely hate the fact that he's teaching at all.

Quite simply, he is a bad teacher. I have no doubt that he knows the subject, but he can't teach it at all. Students ask valid questions which he deflects, he breezes over difficult concepts, and he spends copious amounts of time explaining things he tells us we dont need to know at the expense of important information. Take Ingram for this class.

I've gone to every class, goes through his slides very fast, but posts them online after classes. Have to do weekly reading quizzes for wednesday, only posts them on monday night. I feel like he thinks he's smarter than the students, and doesn't teach very well. Tests take study guide into account somewhat, but I would definitely advise taking Ingr

Took his PHYS 20083 Astro course in '10. New Prof. His email policy limits the # of ?'s you can ask a week, he doesn't have good office hours, he is knowledgeable about the subject, but not good at teaching to a student level. Has no concept of an intro course. Take Ingram's class for this course. Tests are hard, because he doesn't teach well.

Exams and quizzes are just like the in-class problems you do. The multiple-choice sections can be hard to study for. He is super funny and engaging, but can be difficult to understand and isn't very good at answering questions. Super super easy grader. Overall, it's an entertaining class and isn't too hard to get a good grade.

in mu haw is hilarious. he is so caring and always wants the best for all of his students. most of this class is just review from fundamentals so even the content is not bad and he teaches it very well. quiz once every 2 weeks but very easy. gives half credit for any multiple choice question you get wrong. best prof at tcu

Dr. Haw is an amazing professor and a must take for FR1. Not only does he teach the topics in an applicable manner, but he also is very funny and keeps the class engaging. He tells you what topics and examples will be on the quizzes/exams, so an A is quite achievable.

TAKE HIM FOR FR1!!! Dr. Haw is the reason I switched my major to Accounting. There are quizzes and homework at the end of each chapter, two exams, and a cumulative final. He essentially tells you exactly what to expect on the exams and will point out specific examples or quizzes to study. He is a very fair grader and offers partial credit.

Dr. Haw is hands down the best professor I have ever had. He is so sweet and truly cares about all of his students and their grades in the class. He is always available for help and makes the concepts seem easier than they are. TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN!

he is the sweetest man on the face of this earth. He cares about each of his students and wants everyone to do well. I would take his class 100x over if i had to. i love him. TAKE HIM FOR FR1!!!!!!!!!!!!

Dr. Haw is BY FAR one of the best professors I have had in Neeley. His course is super structured so you will always know what's going on. His is also very clear about what he will put on quizzes and exams, doesn't throw you any curveballs. Very passionate and cares about his students a lot; he wanted us all to succeed.

Took him at TCU for FR1. Absolutely great guy. Travels the world giving companies stock advice. Usually a quiz once a week, but are only like 2 questions and if you pay attention in class and do the HW its easy. Very great guy, and loves to talk to you and will help you out if needed.

I have nothing but good things to say about Callum. He cares about the topics and he cares about his students. He's also hilarious and super smart. If you like this kind of material, take Callum because he is simply the best. Also, if you have any questions at all, go to his office hours. He's always super helpful.

He gives "pop quizzes" random days which will account for a final grade of 100% at the end of the semester so make sure you go to class... You have 3 essays so reading is mandatory in order to write clearly. Spark notes is recommended, he provides the reading online so thats nice that there wasn't a textbook needed. Very approachable and funny guy!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Callum is easily one of the most passionate professors I have had to date. He is an extremely dynamic and engaged teacher who genuinely cares about all of his students. The topics that he chose for us to read were difficult, but if you complete the readings it will build an incredible foundation of political philosophy.

Callum is a great guy. A lot of reading (would recommend SparkNotes for the first part of the semester), but if you go and take really good notes during class you will be fine. His lectures are really good as he knows what he is talking about and gets very excited. You have 3 essays but he grades pretty easily. Would definitely recommend to anyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dude is GOATed. Test heavy but if you study the powerpoints and practice tests you'll be fine. His lectures are pretty good and he tries to be funny.

Professor Irvine is very smart but I think sometimes it is hard for him to see how the things he is teaching could be confusing. The exam scores are historically bad, but the final class grading is "subjective". He provides "reviews" for his exams but they do not guarantee if the info on them will be on the tests or not.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This man has no kindness in his sole. He treats people like absolute horrible.

Professor Irvine is great! His tests are very challenging, but it is clear what they will and won't cover because they are all based on his Powerpoints. You need to be willing to put in the work for this class because it takes ALOT of time. I also highly recommend going to his office hours before a test.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a great guy and keeps my attention in class but if you come in not knowing much about investing or finance it is really hard to follow his lectures. They are mostly him rambling and he is funny but the tests are nothing like his lectures.

For a investment starter, or finance students who have zero experience in investment, it's a disaster to take investment 1 with him. He doesn't teach according to the book, and his slides are written with few words or graphs. It's really hard to understand everything. Do not take his class if you are foreign students, his Canadian accent is hard !

Irvine's a cool guy, but his class is a tad hard. Projects are group driven. He has study sessions before tests. GO TO THEM. Will call you in class, but you can pass if you don't know the answer. Makes funny comments in class. Book was rarely used, so know his slides. 3 tests. Awards a half letter grade bump if you beat his portfolio in StockTrak.
I loved Amanda and her women's studies class! I definitely recommend more students at TCU take this course. It always kept me on my toes.
She's awesome ! One of my favorite professor at TCU ! She's passionate about teaching and she keeps the class interesting ! She grades pretty easy too  Definitely take her for sophomore comp

I loved her Women in Lit class it was great! We came to class took a quiz and sat in a circle and talked about the books we read. Only bad thing about the class is all the books you HAVE to read because there may be a quiz. She is also a really nice teacher because she is close to our age.

I absolutely loved this professor. Her teaching style is all class participation and discussion based, but instead of it being grueling, she makes it interesting. She is inventive with her assignments and gives you freedom to be creative. I loved this class. Definitely need to go to class, but if you do your grade reflects it! Made an A :)

Hate to pull this card, but if you are in a fraternity or sorority you can just forget it. Her teaching style is more enjoyable than most professors, but her assignments are not clear and she grades extremely hard. She will say your rough draft is great, and then you'll end up getting a C. Avoid this class if you can!

Don't take this class. Grades papers based off no merit or any sort of system. Is no help in revising papers. Will tell you your paper is great and give you a C.She is bad at explaining things and turns English into misery. She has a chip on her shoulder and her class is draining and annoying.

I had Amanda Irvin for English 20803. She will scare you the first day and the course will seem intimidating, but she's actually really cool and nice. She's pretty young so it's easy to get along with her and relate to her. The assignments were lengthy, but she helps you get through them. I really enjoyed her class and recommend it to anyone.

I love investing and am interested in the subject but Dr. Silver does not test over his lectures, slides, or the book. I don't know where he comes up with exam problems. He grades extremely hard, too. When I would go into his office hours he would be noticeably annoyed with me and did not want to take the time to help me learn. Avoid him!

arguably the worst class & teacher I've ever taken at TCU. Incredibly boring lectures, usually take the whole time. Every powerpoint is unorganized and usually 50+ slides, really boring w white background & black font and too many words. Test questions come out of nowhere but you can do well if you teach yourself from the book. Take another prof!
The only reason to go to class is for the quizess, tests are straight from the slides he posts online and he gives 4 page cheat sheets and drops the lowest test. useless professor but an easy A.

Do not take this professor. Learned absolutely nothing. His class is so hard. Basically, he lectures straight from the powerpoints and does not explain them. He is not helpful outside class. He gives pop quizzes where I basically guessed. His tests are super hard, even with the reference sheets. Drops lowest quiz and test grades. Waste of my time.

Had Dr. Silver for MBA Econ in a summer session.  Professor has a lot of real world experience that contextualizes a lot of the more abstract theories comprising the course material.  Good New York sense of humor (dry, quick, sarcastic) just take it with a grain of salt.  Also loves orange soda and drank it through every class.

Investments I. The guy isn't dumb - he knows his stuff. But I would appreciate it if he could teach SOMETHING relevant to the course (read: EXAMS). I spent days memorizing the textbook, and taking notes in preparation for the tests, and still felt like questions were coming out of nowhere. Ridiculous expectations as far as workload & participation

Mana. Econ. ('07): Dr. Silver is very well-versed in economics and seems to care about his students.  Pay attention in class (don't blather-on with your pals like a moron while he lectures---He WILL bust you and entertain the rest of us who are trying to learn!), know the slides, do the projects well, ask questions and you'll likely get an "A".
Not a bad class.  A little boring, but he's passionate about economics.  Just read the book and that's it...

Boring, the class is easy but it seems that he only follows the slides and that is it. He doesn't have a strong background in investments. I feel more comfortable reading the book than listening to him.
Great guy, fabulous sense of humor. He made economics fun.

The Costanza funny comment is dead on. He's bright, but confuses himself - funny to watch in action.  Lectures can be boring, but overall he is a great prof and class is good. Tests are a little difficult, but if you study and read you should be okay.  Great hair - would be interested to see him walking outside on a windy day!
Thoroughly enjoyed his class.  Would recommend him to anyone taking Econ.
No Comments
Unorganized, confrontational, however, very funny.  Constanza funny.  Great hair!!!
AWESOME!!!
Very unorganized and hard to talk to.

He does not grade anything fairly and does not specify what he is looking for in his assignments. He is also impossible to get ahold of. He laughs at students who answer his questions wrong in class. Do not take this class with him!!!

He's an awful teacher, do not take him! He makes everything more difficult than it really needs to be. You can get an answer right on the test and show work but he'll take off because it didn't live up to his standards. His lectures are all over the place and the homework takes forever. Only good thing I have to say is he prints out his notes.

The syllabus does not list when homework assignments are due and half the time he won't let you know when he has posted one or when it's due. He is not very clear when explaining things. If you are not good at math, DO NOT take him.

Chavarri wants you to understand, he will explain something over and over again for you if needed and fine ways to help you understand. Although homework is quite time consuming you can do it multiple times to keep getting a better grade since its online. He gives you a clear study guide for the test, know everything on it and you should make an A.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Chavarri is lost in the sauce. New to the teaching profession. Tries hard to be nice, but super awkward. His lectures are difficult to keep up with. When asking for help outside of class, he doesn't directly help with the problem. He throws curve balls on quizzes and expects you to know the answer. Take another prof. I feel bad for future students.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Chavarri is nice but he makes the simplest things very complicated. He tries hard to make everyone in the class happy but he is very awkward and can be rude w/o trying to be. If you study for the tests you will do well but his lectures are hard to follow. I feel bad for him because he works hard but I think he is trying to figure out how to teach.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Islam tried really hard and you do learn some stats in his class. But there is definitely a language barrier and he can be very hard to understand sometimes. Also no control over the class and they don't have any respect for him as a teacher. Final is worth 30% of your grade which really makes you study for it regardless of your grade.

Islam is a good teacher, nothing special, but you will learn stats if you go to class. The biggest problem lies with him not commanding much respect from the class, which leads to apathy and boring lectures. The biggest hold up in elementary stats isn't Islam, it's other students who don't care and do horridly on tests.
Doesn't speak english well Horrible at explaining material lots of homework thinks we are stupid Doesn't help when the whole class is lost Almost cried during the first test  PICK A DIFFERENT TEACHER
Michelle is such a great professor. Her personality makes class fun and she connects with you on a personal level. She is very eager and genuinely wants you to do well.

She cares soooo much about her students and is more than willing to meet with you whenever you would like.  She explains all expectations and answers all questions throughly. Also understands the college environment and allows extensions on papers if you let her know ahead of time.

She is God's gift to college English courses! Honestly THE BEST professor I have ever had in my life. She is the nicest most helpful person I have ever met and cares more about her students than any professor on this campus. Just going to her class brightens my day. I've learned so much from her. She makes class enjoyable and high grades attainable

If you are looking for an easy class to earn the credit, I would suggest you steer clear of this class. Professor Irgens is a very sweet teacher and passionate about what she does but assigns a loathly amount of work for what's supposed to be an easy class. Great if you are a music major but if not, do not take this class.

I forgot about this instructor and was recently reading through my coursework on my google drive from years ago.  I still can't believe the level of busy work I did for that class.  Don't usually make class reviews, but my advice is to remain clear of this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Don't make the same mistake I did in selecting this class ESPECIALLY if you're not a music major or any of that sort of thing. This class was not meant for you especially if you were just trying to get an easy fine arts class. I was studying and doing way more than I was doing for my major and minor combined and I think that should say enough.

Professor Irgens thinks the entire class is majoring in music I could not recommend this class less. She is very passionate and knowledgable about what she does but if you are just taking this a core class requirement pick absolutely anything else. This was my hardest class and it's a music class. DO NOT TAKE.

Mrs. Irgens is very passionate. I think she believes everyone in the class is a music major which is just not the case. The work load is absolutely not fair for a non honors class. This is a class I took for the fine arts credit. I took AP Music in High School and didnt have this much work. It is a bit ridiculous. Dont take if not music major.

Do not take this class. Such an unnecessary amount of homework that will pile up the entire semester. it is just about impossible to stay on top of all of it the whole semester. I had my most homework in this class. Just wait to take survey of rock or survey of jazz honestly.

Mrs. Irgens is an amazing professor and is very knowledgeable in music. But, she expects a lot from her students and gives a lot of tough homework. If you are a music major, I highly recommend taking her class. I would advise non-music majors or people who don't know anything about music to not take her class. But overall she's very kind and cares.

I took this class then dropped because It was so much work for a fine arts class. Professor Irgens is such a nice lady but she makes the class difficult for no reason. The homework is busy work but so time-consuming. Unless you are genuinely interested in music I would take a different class.

Really nice lady but gives way too much homework for a music class. We had exams about every 2-3 weeks with about 10 assigned music pieces you had to recognize and know. You got to collaborate with groups on the exams though and she gives out extra credit. Attending performances for papers were also mandatory.

This class is horrible. I took it because we are required a fine arts but have had to do more work in music class than in my biology classes. She grades unnecessarily hard and the amount of homework you have to do is actually insane. Do not take this class unless you LOVE music or need it for a music major. She is very nice and though.

If you want a lot of homework for a MUSIC class, then sure take this class. This class I have more homework in then my core classes. She is very nice and loves what she does, but just so much homework.

Professor Irgens is very passionate about her work and is very knowledgeable about music. She wants all of her students to do well. The course does have a lot of homework but if you keep up on it and try hard you will succeed. The tests in this class are heavy on lectures and listening. Listening to the pieces and taking good lecture notes is key.

I was forced to take this class as it was one of the only classes left during orientation and it is extremely hard. I have 4+ assignments do every week on Friday and other papers during the week. Super time consuming and just a pain to go to. Extra credit is offered and she tries to help during tests but overall, a bit boring and hard class.

Mrs. Irgens is super passionate about what she does but the class itself is just AWFUL. You have to memorize over a hundred song (piece) names, composers (and dates), and movements and then be able to listen to the music and identify everything about it. Don't take this for your fine arts credit, its hard. also attendance is sometimes mandatory
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Irgen definitely makes you work hard to do well in the class, but it is do-able. Her tests are never multiple choice, but as long as you start studying and listening to the pieces of music well ahead of time you'll be fine. You'll also have to do a few concert reports which boost your grade and are fun to attend.

The class itself is fairly easy if you pay attention during the lectures. It has daily assignments due before class that can be bothersome. The tests on the other hand have listening parts (identify the piece, movement, composer, and birth and death), a terminology section, and a short answer part. The final is 1000 times worse. I don't recommend!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Do not take this class if you are looking for an easy fine arts credit. Her exams are all written along with listening to pieces and being expected to know who composed it and when they lived. She doesn't give study guides or study direction for tests, and don't ask because she will just tell you to check the syllabus, but it won't be there either.

Irgens knows what she is talking about, and her class isn't that hard to get an A. You have to go to three concerts and write a report, which is relatively easy. The tough part is she requires you to be able to recognize specific musical pieces upon playing and memorize the composer's birth and death dates for the test. Not too bad
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Some parts were challenging since I'm not a music major nor have any musical skill. The journal entries and concert reports aren't that bad, maybe a little time consuming for the concert reports.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mrs. Irgens's class ended up being one of my harder classes, you have to memorize a lot of pieces, and yes her exams are primarily written. But if you go to class and turn in your assignments on time, it shouldn't be too difficult
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Irgens is one of the best teachers I have ever had, she was caring and as long as you do the homework and keep up you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Great teacher, enjoyed her class. Minimal homework and easy to understand

Professor Irgens definitely knows what she is talking about. If you enjoy music history and are good at listening tests, take it. If not, this might not be a good idea for you. This was my hardest class this semester and the final was also very difficult. If you miss more than 2 classes, she will take points off that hurts in long run, so show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hated going to this class everyday. Dont take her for survey of music. She doesnt believe in mulitple choice exams and you have to memorize how to spell the whole song, composer, and how long they lived. Shes super nice, but trys hard to get you to like her, so its really annoying. Easy class, but other professors are better for this credit.

Heidi is such an amazing lady She is so passionate in her teaching subject and really wants her student to succeed Tests require studying a lot b/c it is a lot of memorization but is not hard to get an A. There are assignments before every class, take about 10 min to do but help prepare you for the test and give you lots of extra points!Take her!

This is a difficult class, but Professor Irgens will go out of her way to help you achieve the grade you want. She is very nice and if you go into office hours for help on tests, you will get an A in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: hardest teacher ever for such a simple class . my hardest final out of all my classes

reviews.comment: She is really nice and has a lot of extra credit. But I'm failing and it's the hardest class I've ever taking. I took it for an easy class and it is so hard especially if you know nothing about music. However, there's a lot of extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: If you are unfamiliar with music prior to this class do not take it. There is homework every day and the tests are extremely hard. Extra credit is offered, but prepare to spend lots of hours doing it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She is very passionate about teaching music, but sometimes goes over stuff a little too quickly. Other than that, do everything that's assigned and you'll get an A in the class. It's not an easy A, but it's achievable!

She's an awesome teacher who is very passionate about music. It is a pretty tough introductory course. You have to go to class to pass. She does offer extra credit which saved my grade. She is very helpful and extremely nice. Expect homework and a lot of studying.

Take this for fine art credit! There's daily homework but they count for study points that are added to your tests/finals. There's also a lot of extra credit that definitely boosted my grade. The class has several papers due over the semester but they aren't too bad and are based on concerts and practice ensembles you need to attend.

Mrs Irgens is very nice and passionate about music. During some classes, she showed us videos to help us understand stuff. However, on few occasions she was not very clear when explaining things. But, her tests are not bad as long as you spend time studying for them. Also, she gives a lot of extra credit. Generally, I really enjoyed this class!

This is by far the worst professor I have ever had. When asked questions, she is rude and does not help students whatsoever. This is a very hard course if you've had no music background. She expects students to know a lot about music, when in reality, everyone has no idea what's going on in her class. Do not take this teacher. This is not easy.

Absolutely the worst professor and class of my college experience. Does not give clear understanding for what will be on the tests and quizzes. If you don't have any music background it is impossible to pass. She does not help when asked questions. Good luck.
She is pretty nice but terrible at communicating instructions and being clear. Her quizzes which count as tests are much harder than she says they will be.

This class is difficult and extremely boring class. My least favorite class I've ever taken. No one ever knows what is going on and the quizzes (which count as tests) are HARD. she's willing to help you out but theres not a good chance you will do well if you don't have a music background. I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.

If you don't know a thing about music I wouldn't suggest taking this class. It is not a very interesting class either. The quizzes she gives are mostly short answer (which are detailed and difficult) and then the listening section which requires a lot of practice. If you aren't doing well in her class she is good about giving extra credit.

I LOVE HER! She is the nicest person ever and she's willing to help you get to an A! She just wants you to understand and will do whatever she can to get you to understand and get a good grade. She seems odd and like she doesnt know what she's doing at first. Just do the listening do the concert reports and go to class. Seriously nicest person ever

I ABSOLUTELY LOVE HER! She is the nicest person you will ever meet and she's willing to do what ever she can to help you understand what she's talking about and help you get a good grade. She wants you to do well! She seemed like she didn't know what she was doing in the beginning but the class is super easy if you listen to the music pieces.

By far my least favorite professor and class of college. She is extremely confusing, doesn't know how to teach, and her expectations of students is way too high. She expects you to know everything about music even if you're a first time music student like myself. Tests are hard. Mandatory Journals everyday. overall terrible class. Don't take it.

Very caring man, but I dreaded having to sit through his lectures, which would yap about stuff not related to the class and get mad at students for being on their laptops, though a majority of us were taking notes so we could do well on his weekly quizzes. I would've learned more from ChatGPT, teaching me the material probably.

Caring Professor and great man, but man, I dreaded sitting in his lectures. I didn't learn anything from his lectures, just used the textbook, and he doesn't like kids using laptops cause he knows students don't pay attention to his boring lectures and would treat the class time as a study hall, but he's really nice and helpful If you need help.

He is an extremely caring professor. His lectures are very dry, and he pretty much just reads from the textbook. Our class was not allowed to have our computers open during lectures so we could not take any notes. He talks a lot about things that don't matter to what we are learning. Talks about making his bed and crossing the Rubicon a lot.

Professor McCormack is the sweetest old soul! He genuinely cares SO much about his students. The content is not easy though. There is weekly homework and weekly in class quizzes (lockdown browser). However if you pay attention and do the homework you will be fine! He is also very accessible outside of class and wants every student to succeed!!!

I had him for financial planning! He pulls questions from the textbook, and some are word-for-word on the quizzes and exams. He is helpful during office hours because I was having trouble with some calculations. Just practice using the calculator and work the questions at the end of each chapter and you will be fine.

Overall pretty good professor for money and banking, teaches you how to use financial calc. There are weekly quizzes that are difficult if you do not read so MUST read txtbk but the readings are not long. Gives extra credit and there are only two exams. Nice guy, likes to ramble a bit but he does love to help with internship/job advice too.

Professor McCormack is a person who truly cares about his students and their well-being and futures. There are quizzes every week. Two exams and two briefs. None are particularly tough, but they do require effort. The lectures can be a drag sometimes - the slides are pretty much copy paste from the textbooks, and sometimes he will go on tangents.

Dr. McCormack really cares about his students. His class is very well organized so as long as you keep up with the readings, you'll get a good grade. The weekly quizzes that are not hard if you prepare the night before, but only 10 questions so you have to do the reading. Two briefs, a midterm, and final exam. An easy class if you put in effort!

Such a sweet guy. There is a quiz every week, but if you read the textbook (not too much if you keep up with it each class) and study before each quiz, you will be just fine. Definitely take advantage of his office hours, he wants you to succeed.
Very sweet Professor, cares about students very much. Offers extra credit as well. The lectures and reading can be pretty boring but the class itself wasn't super hard. Read and you'll do good.
Very sweet Professor, cares about his students ver

Quizzes every other day, pretty boring lectures, and long textbooks. He obviously cares a lot, but he doesn't work on many of the problems in class or discuss the calculators. I wish the class directed more of the attention towards the calculator, but other than that, the class is pretty easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He's an incredibly nice guy but the content of the class can be very dry which can lead to class being a bit dull at times. Overall I would say its an easy class and he is very easy to talk to outside of class.

This class required a lot of outside reading as he has weekly pages assigned and a quiz every Thursday that is lock down browser. He pulls very specific details from the text, so it is important to understand the readings. He is very sweet and genuinely wants everyone to succeed. There is a lot of reading, but it is easier than the other M&B class.

This man can yap. He is so sweet and has lots of stories but he goes on lots of tangents. It's weekly quizzes with lockdown browser but if you read the chapter you should be fine. He is always availible to meet and work with you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Sweet and understanding, but quizzes and exams are overly text-specific, requiring you to remember direct textbook quotes. He favors nitpicky true/false questions. For his lectures he often gets off-topic for 50% of time and the other 50 is him reading straight from the textbook. 3 papers, weekly lockdown in-class reading quizzes, and two exams.

Bro is a D1 yapper. His weekly quizzes are all lockdown and the material is pretty tough atleast in my opinion. Barely gonna pass this class good luck. Nice guy but cares too much for a business minor class

He is the nicest professor, so sweet, and genuinely wants to help you. He has really great advice. Office hours are helpful. There is a quiz every single Thursday on lock down browser that you have to read and study for. The calculator problems aren't as hard as they seem once you figure it out. Only a midterm and final exam, 3 papers
He is a cool professor, but he grades extremely hard. I usually do not rate professors much, but this class has genuinely woken me up from my slumber.
Such a great professor. Really cares and has a lot of real world experience. 100% recommend taking his class.
Easy class but I still learned a lot
Best class ever. I will miss her. She's awesome. 10 minutes of free discussion beginning of each class. A break half way through. Hilarious and easy but equally informative. TAKE HER.

Such an awesome professor. So engaging and easy to understand/relate to. Makes the work easy and is always trying to give students As. Classes are usually large group discussions which are very fun. Definitely take a class with her if you can. Would take again for all of my poli sci classes if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: My favorite professor ever! She's very entertaining and engaging and her tests are clear and she provides study guides for each one.
Dr. Jackson was awesome. She is super funny and makes lectures enjoyable. Study guides for tests were very helpful and the projects were a lot of fun to work on. Take her if you can!!
Professor Jackson is amazing. She is very clear with instructions and is always willing to help. She always let us out early and the exams were fairly easy. Highly recommend.

TAKE DR. JACKSON! Whether you are a political science major or not, you will NOT regret taking a course with her. One or two short papers, two exams (she gives you a review that IS the exam). I cannot stress enough to take this woman!
This guy is awesome, i think hes leaving tcu but hes awesome. If you go the day before tests he literally gives you all of the answers. You have 9 skips allowed. So light and hes so nice

Professor smith is honestly just such a nice guy. His class was usually always interesting and he tied the reading into other things in the world. He is extremely generous and understanding and will always help you out if needed (you probably wont need help). In my class we read The Hunger Games and it was great!

You will have pop quizzes however they are based off of the reading that is assigned for homework. He takes votes on what books you read in class. He gives you nine absences per semester (WAY more then needed) however if you miss more than that you will fail that course. Overall great guy and very good at communicating!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: he is the sweetest person ever. He is super relatable and understanding. You review the exams as a class and will receive all the answers if you go to that class. The reading is not too much. Best professor I have had!!
Super easy. Lots of absences available to use. Use your resources. He gives you all the multiple choice exam answers in class. Exams are take home, no lockdown.

The best professor I've ever had..there is a good amount of reading, but the books are too bad and not too difficult. He's extremely understanding and you get 9 unexcused absences. TAKE HIM!! Any low reviews are probably due to a personal problem.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great guy, he wants you to learn the material and honestly the reading material is not that tough. You also have one movie which is not difficult to follow either. The few papers and assignments due are not crazy long or have exaggerated word counts. Just keep up with attendance and the weekly discussion posts and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: LOVED him!! This class was easy and I learned a lot, he really cares about his students and wants them to do well. Take him if you can. He is really into and knowledgeable about the material- which makes the class so much better. Online exams, class review sessions where you go over the questions on the exam. Couldn't recommend him enough.
not horrible but take someone else if you can
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: He's okay. He doesn't leave any good feedback other than grammar; he likes to play down the difficulty of assignments and lectures are super boring + irrelevant. You are allowed up to 9 absences (anything more is an F). Takes points off for small details such as incorrect citations (missing a comma), incorrect format, etc. Take someone else 4 core!
Horrible, as a professor otherwise he's fine.
Professor Smith was genuinely so helpful throughout the entire semester. Would definitely recommend taking his class
He is the best professor at TCU and genuinely cares about his students. I would take any class he teaches because he puts so much effort into teaching.

You'll write 3 papers, an annotated bibliography, and reflections for each. The work is spread over weeks with manageable deadlines. Feedback can be generic but if you do the assignments you will do well in the class. He lectures over random things not necessarily needed for the class. You're allowed up to 9 absences without issue.

Mr. Smith has been a breath of fresh air in my classes at TCU. He is the best professor I have taken so far. I learn from his lectures and projects, but I don't feel overwhelmed by the course content. He is easy to talk to and doesn't look down on his students for not knowing things. He truly wants us to succeed and enjoy his course. Best class!

Even though his class is easy he will make you do lots of tedious assignments you wouldn't need to do if you took with a different professor, nice guy but overall be prepared for a very boring class with lots of unnecessary work

reviews.comment: he's a super chill professor who clearly cares about his students. definitely some busy work but not hard and the quizzes are super easy as long as you skim the readings. not a hard grader and just cares about you trying. would def take him again!

reviews.comment: Really chill guy who is just starting out at TCU- our "quizzes" for this class were easy 4 question Kahoots. Almost all speeches are graded on participation and the ones that aren't are extremely easy to get an A on. Take this class if you get the chance!

He is sweet, but needs to retire from teaching. Lectures are not engaging and not sure if he knows what he is talking about half of the time. He really is passionate about investments, but would take a different class if you actually want to learn. Got an A on the first exam and failed the second one, so don't know what you're going to get.

He is not a good professor if u struggle or really want to learn. can get away with missing days, besides the homework review days, and he curves a ton for exams. super boring guy though, and the class is just exams basically so no room for error

reviews.comment: just dont.

reviews.comment: This professor just does not know how to teach. You will likely suffer through the lecture due to its boredom. He's not that organized, and the way he takes attendance is horrible. He will randomly assign 6 in-class group exercises, and if you're not there on that random day, you will lose a lot of points. Extremely long and hard tests.

Most boring class in Finance, he is not entertaining. has a very poor teaching style; gives a participation grade at the end of the semester, but not sure how, bc he doesn't even take attendance. He will occasionally cold call from a list of names to see if someone is there. Test HEAVY, hard conceptual questions, test prep is not helpful at all.

reviews.comment: Should not be teaching here. Waste of time class is so boring and professor doesn't even know what hes talking about. Only get curve on tests if you are there to answer on the 1 or 2 days of the year he calls on you.

Honestly his class is pretty easy if you're used to finance concepts. If you're confident in your ability already I'd say take him since you basically never have to show up to class. His tests will be hard if you don't know the material but he curves generously. If you need extra help I'd say take someone else, but I thought he was fine.
People rating him low just want things handed to them. Really not that hard if you put in slight effort.
I'm not sure why he is teaching at TCU. I don't think he knows anything about investments. He doesn't lecture - he reads off textbook provided slides. He can't explain concepts when asked.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hands down the worst finance professor I've ever had. You will be teaching yourself the entire class and suffer through every test. He curves every test because most people fail.

Sweet guy, but his class was so hard.  All he does is read off the slides and doesn't teach the concepts. Tests are impossible to get above a C on but he gives a decent curve.  Always let us out 20-30 min early.
AVOID AVOID AVOID - the tests are impossible and he just reads off the slides. No note sheet on the tests and there are a million formulas we are supposed to memorize.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Such a nice, innocent guy. But this class is pretty ridiculous. Exams are unreal. Kids are happy getting a 50% on the exams because there's such a big curve at the end of the year. Nice guy but take someone else if you can

Dr. Smith is a great professor! This class is extremely easy but so much busy work. None of it is hard it just takes a long time to complete. The attendance policy is bad. 2 free misses (even if you are sick w a doctors note) then -3 points to your final grade. Great teacher and easy class overall, just a lot of busy work and attendance policy bad.

Literally the easiest class ever. no tests and quizzes, just projects. There is a lot of homework reading books and doing weekly annotations on articles, but the its not hard, just very time consuming.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Smith for children's lit. Literally the easiest class ever. no tests and quizzes, just projects. There is a lot of homework such as reading picture books and doing weekly annotations on articles, but the its not hard, just time consuming. I definitely recommend taking her class  for your CA. I literally have a 100 in the class.

This has been my all time favorite class, and I am not even an education major. Dr. Smith is so kind-hearted and is very passionate about children's literature. Even made me consider changing majors. I wish I could take it again just for the relaxing class that I truly enjoyed going to.
Nicest professor I have had and super easy and fun class!

Dr. Smith is a joy and I never wanted to miss her class! Although I am not an education major, I still learned so much in her class that I will use with my family one day. Attendance and participation are a must, and there is readings but they're good & easy reads! You will make an A as long as you try. Take this class you won't regret it!!

Dr. Smith is, hands down, the sweetest professor! Her class is a joy to attend and she really cares about her students. There are a few group projects and papers, but they are actually fun to do. Her passion for children's literature really shows in how she teaches the class and picks books for read alouds and lit circles. She's the best!

Attendance&HW completion is important but the HW is easy(just busy work). No tests/quizzes in this class. Read 3 books,discuss with groups. Final project @ end of semester, its individual and group, not hard to do. Love the class and professor! She's super niceganized. Has rubrics for everything so its easy to get an A if you follow it!
DON'T take her she is the hardest grader ever and there are pop quizzes. Trust this should be your absolute last resort.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Jackie is a WONDERFUL professor. As a teacher, she is kind, funny, and engaging during her lectures. The material is not complicated bc she uses multiple, easy to understand examples for every concept taught. Use quizlet and the textbook to study for exams. She gives take home quizzes and is a fair grader. attendance is recommended for quizzes!
Nice professor but extremely hard class. Tests are very difficult and she gives pop quizzes. Would not take again
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: great professor. exams are hard, but if you go to class and take detailed notes it is not too bad. semester long group project and the presentation is your final

Dr. Jackie does an excellent job. I look forward to her lectures and have gained a lot of knowledge about effective communication. Every student's name is stored in her memory, and she fosters a collaborative learning environment. One of my favorite TCU professors. Her exams are challenging, but that is typical in a college setting.

Super nice and cares abt her students. Difficult class though and u really gotta work to get an A. Her tests are difficult (and she'll tell you) so make sure to study for at least a week in advance. READ THE TEXTBOOK!! I recommend her cause she's super sweet and good at explaining things but if u don't wanna put in a ton of work don't take her
Dr. Jackie gives very interesting lectures making it easy to learn concepts and engages well with everyone individually.
This professor is great, if you participate and show interest she will really help you. Very clear and straight forward with everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Jackie's class is not very difficult. I showed up every day and payed attention during class, and made an easy A with a 97 on the midterm. She has "pop quizzes", but they occur at the end of every chapter and are two multiple choice and a short answer. She gives you time to study before. Dr. Jackie has lots of office hours, and is very nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Zhuang is a sweetheart. There was never a dull moment during her lectures as well. She gives (easy) pop quizzes at the end of each chapter so you must show up to class. English is not her first language so some of the material will seem confusing. Her exams are extremely difficult and she will warn you. Not taking her class again...
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Jackie's lectures. They are amazing! With that being said, the quizzes are fairly easy. Her tests are extremely difficult. The reviews for the tests are not helpful at all either. I'm a communication major but will definitely avoid taking her class if I can. Nice professor but her tests are the worst I have taken in my college career.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Zhuang is one of my favorite professors in the communication department at TCU! She makes lectures interesting and has the most fair and clear grading criteria of any professor that I have had. Her tests are of average difficulty and if you study, you will succeed.

Honestly, would not wear my seatbelt on my way to class in hopes that I wouldn't have to take this class anymore. Do not take Jihoon Lee. The tests are on computer in class with no lockdown browser, lets just say AI would at best get me a 70 on the tests. Grades slap harder than my Uncle. Stay away!!! His lectues were so boring I wish I was deaf.
Worst teacher I've had so far, never told you what would be on tests, didn't learn anything, and the tests were extremely difficult. Was not accessible outside of class either.

HORRIBLE CLASS. I learned nothing from Lee, he has a very boring voice, doesn't teach and explained nothing. The entire course grade was based on tests that were so difficult half the class couldn't pass. He explained nothing. Would not recommend, most frustrating class I have ever taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Seems like a great guy but really didn't know how to actually teach. Everything is through pearson (tests and HW) and you are not able to know your final grade until after you take the final. Tests are hard, especially bc he doesnt teach us anything. Wouldn't reccommend if you actually need to learn this stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: LONG LECTURES.your grade in this class is mostly based off of 2 tests and a final and group project that does not count heavily towards your grade. the concepts are not explained or taught in the class, they are applied, and as a intro class it is almost impossible to succeed. i took micro and macro in high school, but i am still struggling. AVOID
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take Prof. Lee for Macroeconomics. Oh my god it was SOOOO Boring he has the most monotone voice and he's a little hard to understand. The tests were so hard and he is a teacher that assumes you have either taken Micro or some type of economics class beforehand which most of us in the class hadn't. HE DOES NOT KNOW HOW TO TEACH!!!
Dan is a very good artist and has many tips on how to become a better artist. She has taught me so many things about myself and about art. As long as you are trying, you will get a good grade

Dan is a very caring and engaging professor, she loves the arts and shows that through her lectures. The class was fun and kept me invested with new projects. The projects didnt allow me to express my creativity as much as I wouldve liked, and sometimes, it gets hard to compete with other students experience in the field. Overall a great teacher!

Professor Dan is very caring about her students. She also gives great demos and help when you ask for it. This class was really fun and distressing. There is some practice homework but most is done in class. Attendance is a grade in her class. She is really passionate about art and great at teaching it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Jenkins is a great professor but is a tough grader. Do not skip class, attendance is mandatory but class is engaging. There is one big group project and lots of essays/quizzes on the book. Overall I would recommend taking Dr. Jenkins sand she is a great professor, but you do have to work for your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I really did enjoy her class, but she is a very tough grader. Some of the analysis I spent hours on to barely get a B on them because they weren't up to her standards I guess. She's been in the industry for a long time so it's understandable, but still it is an introduction class. She will give a lot of feedback which can be nice.

If you are serious about filmmaking, Dr. Jenkins is your person. She is one of the coolest professors, has a great attitude, gives great lectures and will help you along your journey if she sees your effort. Quizzes, test, readings, screening and essays are apart of the course. Skip class and you'll fail. Go to class and study, you'll do well.

READ YOUR BOOK!!!! There are a lot of quizzes and they take up a large percent of your grade. There arent a lot of questions on them, so if you miss one question in each quiz, it will be very hard to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is the best professor I've ever had. Her lectures are engaging and concepts are well taught. The reading is light, and she grades a little hard but gives very thorough feedback that helps you a lot on your next assignments. She is also super nice, and every assignment is enjoyable to do (at least for FTDM 10143). Take her for aesthetics!!

Jenkins is great! There's a lot of reading, so be prepared for that, but she tries to mix discussion with lecture in class. The reading quizzes are tough, but the questions are mostly fair. She cares about your learning and that you get something out of the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I loved her! As long as you read, you will do well on quizzes and be able to participate in class, which is an easy grade even for shy folks. She makes a very comfortable learning environment and I retained a lot of what she taught. Also a great connection to have for your future.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Awesome prof. Will learn a lot. Cool projects.
Shes tough and has high standards but you learn a lot!

She isn't a bad person but out of the teachers I've had at TCU she's probably been the worst. The quizzes will only have 4 to 9 questions but they will be based off a reading of like 30+ pages. For me, thats too much information to try and retain just to then be questioned on such a small portion. Her graded participation system is unstructured.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof Jenkins is an amazing professor and has real insight into the world of broadcasting. I would definitely take her again as I learned so much! But, do not take this class if you are lazy! There are assigned readings every week and pop quizzes on them typically each class. This is NOT an easy A but an A is definitely attainable if you put in work
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Jenkins is a great professor and I think every problem with her media adaptations class is that this semester was the first time she has taught it. MAKE SURE YOU GO TO CLASS. Every absence after the first two is 3% off your final grade. Lectures are super interesting and the group projects are easy if you take your time. She grades hard. 8/10
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Jenkins is a phenomenal professor with a genuine love for students. Intro to Film Aesthetics is not an easy class, and she makes you work for the grade you get. Be aware that threaded discussions are essential to a good grade. Pay attention to lectures and go to class. and every missed class after three is 2% off your final grade. Great class!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Jenkins is an amazing person and genuinely cares about what she is teaching and about her students. Only tests are the midterm and the final, all other grades are pop-quizzes from the reading (not too hard if you read, but you HAVE to read the book) and the threaded discussions from the lab. Grades those really hard, but just follow the rubric.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I spent a month with her in London. She's got a tough exterior but she's actually super interesting and nice. Lived all over the world. Does cool stuff with the CIA. My advice is to make an effort and get to know her! If you had her and never got to really know her, it's your loss. She's kind awesome. She will help you so much once your in too!

Only exams were the midterm and final, all others are just pop quizzes that are from the readings. Grades pretty hard on threaded discussions about the films watched in class but follow the rubric closely and you'll do fine. Participation matters, you get a point a day if you say something but overall concepts in the class are really easy
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: You will read A LOT, but I enjoyed this class. Learned lots about TV history. Tough though. Not gonna lie.
She gives out a lot of reading and her quizzes can be pretty confusing!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Do not take this class if you are just seeking the credit and an easy A. Exams are over 60 questions, quizzes weekly, and some of the readings were over 10 pages. Class was supposed to be for non-majors and it was extremely over done.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Jenkins's history in the movies class. Not a lot of grades, just semi-regular readings quizzes, a group project, a paper, and the final. Need to do well on those projects as they make up the majority of the grade. She is a tough grader on essays, but nothing unmanageable. I would recommend taking her!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Took her film festivals class. A LOT of work but if you're serious about working in the industry definitely worth it. Good experience to add to a resume. Jenkins is a nice professor but she is a tough grader. Participation is graded and there are reading quizzes but they're not that hard.

My favorite college class by far. Dr. Jenkins structures the class really well, and we have a great time watching movies and learning lots. Definitely take her class if you need to take intro to aesthetics for a film major or minor.

She was pretty cool I guess. I hated that it was required you had to speak or it will hurt your grade. A lot of the assignments and quizzes she grades pretty hard on. She only has 2 tests and they are really easy, which saved my grade. She was pretty good looking and cool. I would take her.
Jenkins is awesome. She brought cookie cake to class. That's all you need to know.

I really enjoyed the class. It was interesting and entertaining, and Dr. Jenkins was always very helpful and full of insight. Be sure to speak up in class as points are given for participation. I would recommend this class and Dr. Jenkins to anyone interested in film personally or as a major area of study.

She was good in Media Analysis. Was more than open to helping. Kind of a hard grader on the 1 paper. You can only get a certain number of points on her tests (no more than 40), so if you miss a couple questions, it hurts your grade. Overall a good professor. I wasn't interested in taking this class, but she made it very interesting. Take her!

Really loved her Aesthetics class. She is a great teacher, but a really tough grader. If you go to class, pay attention and participate in class it's a really fun class. I have gone back to her for help on papers and presentations for other classes and she is super helpful and very approachable. She's awesome!

Good professor. Helpful and understanding. Papers might destroy your grades if you don't pay attention though... Otherwise fun class and she's willing to listen to your opinion. Talk in class to get grades for participation, which is high!
Great professor!
Loved that she teaches a vampires film class, but I heard she is not going to teach it anymore. Too bad. Fun class with good discussion.

Jenkins is a brilliant woman, and has interesting points to cover. Class is loaded with media clips. I highly suggest her but be ready to show up on time and do the class readings. Study test material thoroughly. Get to know her and show interest in the subject if you desire an A.

Dr. Jenkins is not an easy professor. This is the third time I have taken a class with her and I still haven't learned her teaching style. She was very knowledgeable about the material and help make hard concepts clear. You have to write two papers in the class plus other short papers for homework assignments. Take her if you can, otherwise take Mc

Good teacher. Have pop quizzes over the readings, so you better make sure you read them. Her test questions can be tricky if you don't study, and she does ask some vague questions. However, as far as the content goes the first section is dry, but after radio things get interesting and you watch a lot of interesting clips/movies.

History of Broadcasting. Good teacher but she likes to be tricky.  The tests were not that bad, but the quizzes were difficult!  Pop quizzes just about every other class period so be sure to keep up on your readings.  Attendance is not required, and she usually posts the powerpoints online.  Tests get easier as the semester goes on.

Hist Broadcasting. Great professor! Always has a lesson plan and never boring, even when doing the most basic history of inventors, etc. Quirky personality. Quizzes every week, so reading is a must, but they keep you on track. Her M/C is straightforward but her short answers are challenging. Gives study guides! Overall great prof, highly recommend!
I actually liked her b/c she didn't lecture at us the whole time like a lot of big classes do. She did have some mistakes in her PPs but I felt like she knew 90% of the material well.
Loved her for reality TV! Great discussion leader; keeps things interesting. We even watched Shot at Love with Tila!
I actually liked her a lot b/c she didn't lecture at us for 1.5 hours like other big classes. She did have some mistakes in her PPs but she was still knowledgable about 95% of the material.

Nice but wouldn't take her again. Her quizzes have vague questions on them, and had many that had more than one right answer. Her test aren't bad expect for the essays. I thought they were easy. She says explain in detail then tells you that's not what she wanted. If someone else teaches the classes I would  suggest taking it with them instead.
Jenkins is great and very likeable. Discussion based class, very insightful. Great class. Take her!

She is absolutely wonderful. Print out her notes from ecollege and all the test questions come straight from there. The test aren't hard, just familiarize yourself with the information. You don't have to go to class but her stories are really good and helpful so I suggest it.

Sweet lady. So fun to listen to. She doesn't take BS from you so don't try. Great lectures! Tests can be hard, but you have to study for your grade. If she tells you to remember something, it is on the test 90% of the time! Don't flake in this course as it is IMPORTANT FOR YOUR NURSING CAREER! You have to know this stuff, duh!!!

Great teacher, just make sure you go to class and follow along with the powerpoints. Also, take advantage of reviewing your tests, even if you did well, because the material will be on the final and you dont want to miss something twice

Pretty straight forward everything from the printout, use text but not much, be prepared to answer sometime during lecture, discuss questions you missed because you will miss those again on final, she is nice talk to her even about other classes or social life how to get through difficult times, school stress,

Wow. This lady is a trip. Make sure your prepared for class because she watches your every move. Print out all the papers, bring your book, wear the uniform in the right way, and act like your doing something or else she'll cursify you.
I loved Mrs.Borum's class! She is a great teacher. A bit sarcastic, but in a good way. Know the notes and you will do well in the class. Skim the chapters in the book.

Borum is AMAZING!!!  She is a bit intimidating at first but you just need to make sure that you know the material before you go into clinical and lab.  She makes sure that you are prepared and wants you to pass!
She really wants you to pass and do well. She is an awesome instructor!
She is a great instructor.  She makes the information clear and makes sure your ready to continue on to Adult 1
She makes sure that you know what you are doing before you get into Adult I.  You kind of work your butt off, but it is SO worth it
Mrs. Borum is very helpfull and really want you to learn the materail, she might embarrass you somebut she makes sure that you learn the material, she's a great lady!!
She is so awesome! 3 quizzes are take home and lectures are interesting.  Just one paper to write but it's really easy. Great class!
Can be VERY rude when its not necessary.
Very laid back and funny. She doesn't take her class too seriously, all she wants is for you to get your A and get your health credit. Tests are taken from review sheets. No book to buy. Easy A.
I never had her for a class, but I've been in the lab with her. She is nice to me some of the time, but she can also be extremely RUDE!
EASY A!!! Take this health class. Borum is the sweetest lady ever and tests are super easy. Class is fun too.
Very nice instructor whose class is really an easy A.
Borum is the sweetest lady. She truly wants to make this class interesting and wants you to do well. Definitely an easy A!
She made this class super easy.  You have to have a health class so take this!

Speaker Wright is so knowledgeable and caring, every Posc. major should take this class! Must study for tests, but there are several grade enhanceres so no one should get below a B. He wants you to understand politics and the presidents, and it is so cool that he was personal friends with LBJ, Nixon, etc. One of the best classes at TCU!

This class is a must for anyone who is a Political Science major. He is difficult to understand because of his age, yet if you pay attention it he is more than understandable. There are so many "grade enhancers" that it's ridiculous to think that some people fail. Very knowledgeable and has alot to share- take this class!

A class with a former speaker of the House is a real treat for any TCU student. The class isn't hard and there are so many extra credit opportunities. We got to hear from guest speakers such as Kay Granger and Martin Frost. Great subject matter too. He's VERY hard to understand and hear considering his age so you really have to focus.
Take his class!!! It's the biggest blow off class you can take. I put minimal effort and made an A. He gives you a million extra credit opportunities and he's a great guy.

Very interesting, nice man. Taking a course from an ex- speaker of the house is a great experience. He does mumble, but just sit near the front and you should be able to understand him fine. Tests are pretty easy, just take notes in class and look up the things on the review!

Speaker Wright is amazing! Any person with a passion for Political Science should take advantage of this opportunity--not many can say they had a class with a Former Speaker of the House. I would take his class again in a heartbeat! His political career speaks for itself. By far one of the best courses I have ever taken at TCU
Definitely a must take class. Interesting class.
Speaker of the House!!!! Enough said. Highly recommend bc it is an unforgetable experience.
