Not nearly enough people appreciate having a former Speaker of the House for a professor.  Yes he’s hard to understand, but if you pay attention you might actually learn something

Wright is a very nice and interesting guy.  However, 3 hours of his mumbling is way too much for me.  His grading system sucks and his exams are ridiculous. You have to know the stuff from the review AND pretty much every other word that has come out of his mouth the whole semester.  Very frustrating class.

Great teacher, tells very interesting stories and is fun to listen to. Knows his stuff. Is very hard to understand and hear but if you sit near the front its not too bad. Notes are sometimes pointless but overall an easy A. Everyone should take this class!
More like Jim Wrong

I LOVE Professor Johnson. She is by far the best anatomy and physiology lab professor. She helps with every question I have and is more lenient than other lab professors. You take graded quizzes every lab, but she helps you prepare for them. She's always smiling and helps all the students understand, and points out things for us to notice.

So so kind and caring which is great to have in a content heavy lab. She is easily accessible outside of class and was always accommodating. Made lab more fun and made it a safe space to make mistakes and ask questions.
Kind and caring. Lecture always ended 20 minutes early and tests were take home, making this a super easy way to get science credit. She genuinely wants to see students succeed

Prof Johnson is great! She is super caring and gives good advice. The class itself is entirely self taught and if you don't study a lot you will not pass. Clear grading criteria but the class is hard.

Johnson is very caring and approachable which makes learning the difficult material much easier. I just personally didn't learn from lab and found it more of a nuisance than anything else. However, Johnson herself is really sweet and I would highly reccomend.

I took A&P 1; the course itself is super intense and difficult. Johnson, as a teacher and person, was amazing. I did not do the best with keeping up with the material, so I struggled a lot. It felt like I was teaching myself; the lab was basically to reinforce that I've memorized the names of bones, muscles, nerves, cells, and more correctly.

very nice person, but not a great professor. She is new to TCU so she doesn't really know what she's doing. She doesn't know much about anatomy and often she would go to the other lab room to ask the other professor answers to our questions. Very vague and didn't share information about the exams. She is nice, but doesn't know what she's doing.

I had Professor Johnson for lab and she is very passionate about A&P. She goes through slides and is very detailed about what we need to know for the quizzes at the end of class. Sometimes she takes the time to create a practice quiz and it helped a lot.

Have Professor Johnson for the Lab and I would say I love her so much. She explains the content clearly and makes sure you understand thoroughly. She loves her students and would like to know more about you. She is close to everyone. This Lab is hard initially, prepare before attending if you want to get a high score on 7 weekly quizzes and 2 exams
10/10 Loved her.
Loved this professor. SUPER chill. Took him on Tuesday nights and the class never lasted over an hour and a half.

So helpful when you ask questions before/during exams. Lecture heavy and the lectures can get kind of boring at times, but it's worth it for the feedback you get one on one. Also very funny and chill.

Professor Mathewson is the man, definitely recommend! I took the Monday night class and it rarely went longer than an hour and a half. Most of each class was a lecture followed by an assignment for practice. He allows notecards and tells you what to expect before each exam. Exams are not too difficult as long as you study and do practice problems.

Teacher reads slides each class which are posted online. The class before the test he goes over everything that might be shown on the test which is super helpful to know what to review vs what not to review. Tests aren't too hard if you know what you are doing.

If you want an easy A, take him for into to accounting! I am a business minor and am horrible at math but did very well in the class. For exams,  He allows you to use your phones for a calculator you can bring in a notecard with formulas/extra information. The test reviews are very similar to the tests and he gives extra credit opportunities.

The BEST accounting professor especially for students only taking the class for a minor requirment. He seriously is the most flexible professor I have ever had. Gives us a specific review before each test and if you study that you will get an A. I came into accounting horrified but it ended up being my easiest class all semester.

If you want a good grade in accounting take him. The night class was never longer than 1.5 hours and he's so chill. He is really funny and actually tries to help everyone get a good grade. He also offers a ton of extra credit and is very flexible about the schedule.

Literally the chillest professor I know. I think it might be impossible to get below a B in this class. He really understands his students. I took his 6:30 pm class that was supposed to last three hours, and it usually only lasted half the time. He is always willing to explain concepts and level with you if you don't understand.

Its an accounting class so that should be enough to say why its hard. I really enjoy having him as a teacher because he is understanding that we are in our college years. He explains things the best he can but sometimes it comes easier to him than to us and it shows. Highly recommend taking him. He is a cool guy. He tries his best and it shoes too.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is extremely taxing and frustrating when it does not need to be. He makes the assignments more confusing then necessary and often repeats himself during lecture time making the class feel pointless. Is open to giving extensions and changing deadlines, but still not worth taking this class. Would not recommend at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: He seems like a caring guy, but he will not be nice. He cold calls, and he trys wat to hard to be nice. He overcomplicates things to another level, and it's basically impossible to understand what he is saying. Doesn't provide feedback on why you got that grade. This isnt a hard clas,s but he made it impossible.

Mr. Kim is the most caring teacher I've ever had at TCU. He actually want us to learn and succeed. He can grade hard at times and gives some hefty assignments but he listens to the class about workload. He is SUPER responsive by email and accessible outside of class too. He is a very good teacher but teaches a tough but doable class.

Mr. Kim is a very knowledgeable and nice person, however he makes it impossible to like him. He teaches nothing but level 1 to level 2 written composition core classes that are required by every major here at TCU. He thinks he is teaching a graduate level/masters course, making the class impossible for absolutely no reason. He just sucks I am sorry
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Mr. Kim is one of the most caring teachers I have ever had. Yes, his classes are very difficult but he is very flexible and will help you out if needed. It was definitely more work than I was expecting but I think taking his class was worth it. He is very respectful to all of his students and he truly wants every student to grow and do well.

Professor Kim is a very kind and flexible teacher. He provides clarity when necessary regarding assignments and is clear on where to find instructions and information. The class becomes a burden when the drafts build up for the different projects and it's hard to find time to complete them.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Lots of work to do. Reading responses are tough
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: She is very kind and passionate about what she teaches. She does assign lengthy readings for each week, which you need to take notes on to be able to reference in class. However, she is an easy grader for assignments.

Do not take her. She has no respect for our time and assigns us hours of readings, movies, and videos every class. She will call on people to talk about the readings and videos and grade our participation. There are also a lot of extra expenses she has us pay for throughout the class. Class was more about Ethiopia than anything about business.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Her class can be hard to navigate and unclear instructions. Always nightly readings and videos (usually over an hour long). Come to class having done all the hw and taken notes since participation is expected and she will call on you every day. A lot of unnecessary work and extra expenses. Very ethics and Ethiopian-focused, not so much business.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: By far the most energetic, caring, and enthusiastic professor I've ever had. She is not only a great teacher, but also a great person through the way she cares for her students and how involved she is in Africa and in Fort Worth. There is a bit of outside reading you will have to do and complete "journals" but 100% worth it, she's incredible.

Very caring and wants you to learn Spanish. Lots of talking and writing, so if that's not your thing then you may want to take a different class. He really wants you to learn and I feel a lot more confident in my ability to have conversations in Spanish.

Overall would not take Morillas class due to the fact that he does not teach. His class is lecture based and will just read off the slide and not explain anything. You will teach yourself everything for this course if you are not a native Spanish speaker. Also Morilla is a very tough grader with little to no leniency. Overall avoid Morilla classes.

Prof Morilla's class was great! It's easy as long as you do the work: study for quizzes & tests using textbook and lecture slides. There's also homework assigned to prepare you for class- takes little time. He's great at ensuring you understand grammar & are natural in conversation, even if you're not a native speaker. He's also a pretty funny guy!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love Profe Morilla! He really cares about his students and his lectures are really engaging. He tries to make them relevant to everyone's majors and the real world. He is funny and as long as you stay on top of the homework assignments (usually one super short one for each class), the class is not too hard. A few exams but they are short.

Spanish For Business Professions! He does a lot to make this class interesting! He cares so much about his students. There is homework every class, but it is relatively easy. He is such an easy grader on tests and quizzes although the schedule is not the most organized. He really likes when people participate in class.

Professor Morilla is a great professor who shares very valuable experiences. I am a native speaker, so I'm biased in terms of difficulty (Span for Bus Prof 1), but if you put in the work, you should be fine. A discussion based class with group work, writing assignments, and vocab quizzes. His teachings broaden your world-view approach.

I LOVE HIM. His class is very organized and very followable. There is homework after every class that's easy to forget. Class is all participation and conversation based. He is very funny and sweet. The homework is very similar to the quizzes and exams. Go to office hours and get to know him. He is very passionate and cares. Easy with effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I loved his class and looked forward to it each day. he made it just very fun and enjoyable. He makes his quizzes and exams pretty easy. There's a few homework assignments due before each class but it helped me understand the topics better. Don't let the others scare you he is very nice just talk to him if you need literally anything!

Dr. Morilla is one of the best professors I've ever had. He really understands what it takes for a student to learn a new language. His assignments are designed to help you practice the language. Overall, it's an easy class with a nice professor if you genuinely want to learn Spanish.

He is a new teacher to TCU. He had many quizzes that he created himself and would only give a day in advance for them. They were extremely hard and he expects us to know more than we have learned so far. He is funny, but not very approachable in his office hours. He is also a very hard grader and sometimes has favorites.

Dr. Morilla really is a great guy, but he made the class extremely confusing. I have never struggled with spanish until I had him. Its a MWF class and we had at least 1 quiz every single week of the semester. he also makes at least 5 assignments due at 8am the day of class through VHL and it's so easy to forget about them which tanks your HW grade.

I never went to class a single day. Every slide and question he asks is uploaded to D2L. Most of his tests are online and all of the work in the class is open note. This is the same for both Micro and Macro with him.

He is very chill in his class. If you want to have an easy class for your core, take him, but if you want to learn something and have econ as your major or sth, you need to go to class. He only have night classes but he always sends us out soon. There were only 3 tests (final included) and they all gonna be online and no lockdown browser.

TAKE HIM. he is a super chill guy, no attendance needed, no lock down browser, hw deadlines until the end of the semester. still it is worth it to go to his lectures if you have time, it's really good trust me. best professor ur gonna have.
Great professor! All his assignments are online, at home, no lockdown browser on the exams. Lecture lasts about 2 hours.

This professor has changed a lot. Attendance is now mandatory, and I didn't get out early once this semester. We had in-person tests, and they just kept getting harder and harder as the semester went on. Honestly, at this point, I'll be happy with a B.I would recommend taking another professor; there are many better options
Best professor

I only went to class once, and that was on the first day. His slides are all posted online and he puts everything on the slides in his quisses and tests. You take tests online and as long as you have the notes your good, even though its open to the internet.

Professor Sheffield is cool and down to earth. The class itself was tough for me because of a busy calendar and only had him once a week for a 2.5 hour lecture. Very few grades in the grade book, so it's hard to recover from bad grades. Wouldn't recommend it if you don't have the time to study, but if you do, you'll be in good hands.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I could not recommend Professor Sheffield more. His class is fun and very engaging. He creates a very laidback setting which makes me excited to show up. He assigns only a couple of graded homework's throughout the semester and there are only three online exams including the final. He posts everything online and everything is easy to understand.

Loved loved his class. He is so funny and really engages in the course. He only teaches night classes, and if you are put off by that, I promise it's not bad. He doesnt take attendance, and everything is posted online. One thing I really appreciate about him is that he treats everyone as responsible adults and lets us make our own choices.
lowkey fade

Pretty long lecture so it can be hard to pay attention the whole time, but he is hilarious and makes it interesting! Always available for zoom call to ask questions. There is very few assignments so they count a lot. If you've taken an econ class before the material isn't too hard to digest. Would recommend for anyone needing micro or macro!!!

3 tests online no lockdown, same with 10 homework quizzes. I took this class because you dont have to go but the tests are lowkey hard even if you look at the notes/ look them up. maybe take a different professor if you generally care about the subject.

AMAZING professor! I am so happy I took his course! His assignments consisted of three exams and ten homework assignments. Homework and exams are both online, and you are able to use open resources. Homework isn't due until the end of the semester. He always lets class out early.
Our total grade was from 3 exams. The examsI got a 90% in the class and he gave me a B. This class tanked my business gpa and the guy makes very inappropriate jokes about women. Would not take again.

Professor Sheffield does a great job at explaining the course material. He actually gets up and explains how the graphs operate and created slides that helps us study. He engages the whole class and everyone is paying attention to what he has to say. He is one of my favorite professors here at TCU.
Made sure that each lecture was entertaining and funny even though they took place at night and lasted a while. This made the class much more enjoyable and easier to pay attention to.
MY DAD

Best Econ professor. TRies to make econ interesting. Only graded from HW/tests which are all online. The tests are pretty hard tho as you don't get a lot of time. Super good guy and he is funny. If you argue a question on the test it's likely he will take it off.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His class was very easy, attendance doesn't matter and all the material covered in class will be online. He tells good stories. 10/10 recommend!

Sheffield is a good teacher as long as you pay attention. He reads off the slides but if you ask for clarification or help he is extremely willing to help you succeed. The exams are online so obviously, people will cheat and do well because of that. But learning with no background is difficult.

TAKE THIS CLASS!
Supper easy, no attendance is taken, homework isn't due till the last day of the semester and exams are going to be EASY. On top of that, he is very cool and tells interesting stories, great man!

Professor Sheffield is great! His lectures really help you understand the material and he makes them very interesting. He always lets you go early which is nice. Your whole grade is made up mostly of tests though so you have to do goo on those. Definitely worth taking for an easy class though!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Justin is a great professor. I have his 3 hr class and it is quite long, but he makes it more enjoyable. There are only 3 tests, and the homework does not count for much. Because of this, it is a good idea to study, and if you do your grade will be fine. Other kids I know have bad experiences in micro and I believe Sheffield is the best option.
Great professor, he knows how to keep the attention of a large class.

Professor Sheffield is great! He does a great job of making long lectures fun. However, each test is 30% of your grade so be prepared for some difficulty. If you happen to make a bad grade on one of the tests it's noticeably difficult to make up your grade. If you study and attend most of the lectures (especially review days) you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loved the class, a really cool guy. Tests aren't bad, but you have to study a bit to do well. Only 3 tests, so one bad grade and it can put you in a rut. I loved him as a teacher, made it fun. I know he is one of the best micro teachers, from talking to my friends. Very real uses econ to measure the real world, not just useless math stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This guy is great, lectures are long and boring but class is so easy. He is a cool guy with funny stories.

I had the pleasure of taking him for both Macro and Micro, and have to say he is awesome! I would highly recommend him to other TCU students and am sad that he doesn't teach more classes here, but regardless, he made me laugh in class a couple of times over Zoom, which is honestly impressive, considering how dull Zoom classes can be. 10/10 prof!
I honestly don't think he prepares for you enough for the tests. So unless you are really really good at self-teaching, the exams will be quite hard. However, great professor with great lectures.

Mixed feelings about him. I liked him at first because his lectures are funny and interesting but I dont feel like he helps you study for the test enough. We just have 1 class a week so it feels like he isnt doing much to review with you. Tests were easy since I could look up every answer with class being online. Overall easy class tho

I took Prof. Sheffield for Macro and he definitely lived up to the hype. Like his Micro counterpart, Canas, its basically all online and he makes it a breeze. The lectures are never boring and he can also be really funny. Attendance isnt mandatory but everyone showed up anyway. Take anything Sheffield teaches, hes a true TCU Gem.
Take him. Best prof at TCU. But be prepared for some hard unexpected exams

If you don't take this class/professor for your Micro or Macro credit you are doing a disservice to yourself. Advertised as a 2.5 hour class. He cuts it to 1.5. Tests/HW are all online taken outside of class. You know that meme with Oprah, where she's like "you get a car, you get a car"? Its like that except instead of a car its an A.
AWESOME
Professor Sheffield is such a cool guy! He is super laid back and relatable. He is also super funny. Take him for an easy A and learn a lot. I loved him and he made a difference in my life.
All tests, homework, and Final are taken online.

Take him for Macro or Micro. You wont regret it. Best class at TCU. I have no idea why his class doesn't fill up first and have 200 people on waiting list. Even though its one night a week take this class. Anything he teaches.

I am going to miss his class. He is a great professor who made three hour lectures funny and engaging. He does not take attendance and all the power points are online but showing up is helpful and entertaining while learning the material well.

Most time consuming elective I have ever taken. Spent every other day for hours working on semester group project. He is a very strict on attendance. Even if you show up 30 seconds late it will affect your grade. He is a nice person in general but expects way too much from his students. Would not recommened this class.

At some point, all STCO majors will have to take research. While the class seems daunting, it really is manageable. Jung wants you to succeed and can be very helpful if you show him you're trying. Participation is super important and can set you apart in the class since he grades it. Stay organized, show up, give HONEST effort, and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: I do think many of these reviews are dramatic. This course is hard point blank, and that just comes with the major. Dr. Jung was organized and clear about the course work which I think helped us produce our best work. It is a LARGE work load and you HAVE TO TRY but alas we are in college so thats expected. Class mandatory helped me prep for test.

Ok so definitely one of the hardest classes I have ever taken in my life, however, I do think I genuinely learned a lot and gained something from taking the class. You cannot slack off you have to do everything on time, and does want us to do well even though it may not seem like it. Such a nice guy as well. Is not mean just hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: There is two days until our final and no one has any idea what their grade is. The coursework is tedious and honestly just unncessary. I have never done poorly in any class and have taken what should be a lot harder classes but in this class I struggle. There is SO MUCH work and extra time outside of class that is needed.

Genuinely feels like 2 full course loads that are impossible because everyone is 1st sem junior year. GIANT semester long group proj that is painful, quizzes that  take years and every question is so insanely worded. MUST be at every class, every minute in this classroom was a burden. He somehow wants to be liked while ruining ur life! DON'T TAKE!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Genuinely feels like 2 full loads of coursework and is almost impossible because everyone is taking it first sem 3rd year. Giant semester long group proj that is painful, and quizzes that take every minute of my days twice a week. He somehow wants to be liked while also making your life he11. also must be at EVERY class. DO NOT TAKE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Great teacher, I feel like he does genuinely want everyone to know and understand everything and is good at explaining things. However, his class is insanely hard and time-consuming. At least one or two things due every single class. Felt like I was literally drowning in work. Normally get A's and I am just hoping for a passing grade at this point.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Don't take his class, just trust me. You get put into a group for the ENTIRE semester and working on a group project that whole time. It is SO SO time consuming, my group would have to meet very often for hours on end just to get the assignments done. His grading makes zero sense and he is super picky when you present your project.

Hard. ALOT of work. ALOT of time put into this class. He is a nice guy, I'm just not sure if he wants the best for his students though. Kind of feel like he wants everyone to fail sometimes. Quizes are at home and open note but SOOO much reading to make the notes so dont wait until last minute. year long group project. so excited to be done with it
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Hardest class I have ever taken. He is a nice guy, expectations are incredibly high I genuinely question if he knows we have lives outside of his class. He makes his lectures day of, some big assignments got left to the last minute. You get put with a group for a project for the ENTIRE semester. All lockdown assessments. SO happy to be done.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Ok, Jung may seem like intense and strict. but he just puts on a front. He actually told us that during the last class. He's honestly easy on grading - my group got cut off on our presentation and I thought we would get a C but we got an 85%. I honestly loved his class and Im a student that wants to do the minimum for my work. lowkey gonna miss him
WARNING. DONT TAKE HIS CLASS!!!! If you do, good luck. Horrible spring semester I had, not understanding at all and expectations surpass normal.

My favorite teacher in the STCO department.The class is no walk in the park but he is the best at explaining things and providing examples so you can really understand. Hard work pays off in this course. Semester long group projects are rough and his feedback can be vague but just wants you to learn. Take him and you will learn so much!!!

Dr. Jung has to be one of the best professor in STCO department. He sure is intimidating at first, but when you get to know him he is so funny and super friendly. He is extremely smart and knows the answer to every question. There's a lot of homework and don't leave the semester long project for last minute!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Pretty solid class, an A is definitely attainable if you put in the work. The weekly reading quizzes are super easy, there are 2 tests that are kind of hard and the group project counts for about 35% of your grade. Start the group project early, listen to his feedback and you will be fine!
He may seem intimidating but he's actually very nice and cares about his students. He wants us to do well. Just pay attention to details, do the readings, and you will be fine.

This class is naturally boring and hard because of the subject matter. However, Jung goes out of his way to make the class more challenging. Tests are directly from his study guide and aren't too bad. His semester long project is very time consuming and worth a lot of your grade. Lectures are really boring too. STUDY THE MATH FORMULAS WELL!!

Jung is very difficult to understand, and for someone who has a masters and doctorate in Communication, makes too many grammar and spelling errors on lecture slides, but expects perfection from students. Get ready for a whopping semester-long group project where he won't offer any specific advice, only general, over-arching, class-wide comments.

Bark is worse than his bite. He is strict but actually a very awesome professor. He is smart as hell and actually takes the time to help and get to know his students. He even took the entire class out to lunch and picked up the tab. His Global branding class is very structured but you learn a lot of helpful info if you want to go into marketing.

Professor Jung is scary at first but then you find out that hes not as bad as he makes himself seem. The test are hard but if you study you will pass easily. He lays out everything that will be on the test. Also the projects are hard but worth it when you see all your hard work at the end.

I took Jung  for channel planning and global branding and I'm so happy with my decision! He's incredibly helpful and wants students to succeed so go into his office hours! His bark is much worse than his bike. Projects are intensive but manageable.

Dr Jung is SO nice and has a vibrant personality, he's just really hard to understand and his class is so boring. I know a lot of people scraped by his class but if you read before the tests it's easy to get a B+/A- in the class. But lecture itself is miserable and he fails you if hes sees you with your phone/surfing the internet

Zhang laoshi is an amazing professor! She is so engaging and cares about each one of her students. This class involves a lot of in-class speaking and activities, which help you learn Chinese. Lots of homework and exams, so you are not graded by only a few things. One of my favorite classes ever!

I had absolutely no knowledge of speaking Chinese but I learned so much especially the nuances of business in that culture of China. She was the best part of the class because she was so energetic and passionate about what she teaches. A pocket full of sunshine ahh

Professor Zhang is a fantastic and supportive teacher. She's easy to reach and truly committed to helping students succeed in learning Chinese. She'll even support your learning after graduation if you stay in touch. The Asian Studies community at TCU is also strong and encouraging—perfect if you're up for the challenge of the language.

Zhang Laoshi is a really caring professor, who makes herself available outside class. The class is pretty fun, (unique, calligraphy is something I haven't done before), and she's really helpful and patient. I've really enjoyed the class, and it's made me look at the other TCU Chinese courses.

Zhāng Lǎoshī is an incredible professor—gracious, understanding, and deeply invested in her students' success. She fosters confidence, making learning both encouraging and enjoyable. BUSI CHIN was more challenging than expected, with extensive Mandarin and demanding exams. However, she is highly accommodating if you communicate your struggles.
The professor is very nice. The class was fun and engaging, it was my favorite class. You will have to put in some work on your calligraphy skills and buy your supplies.

Professor Zhang was one of my favorite professors! She was very interactive throughout each class. She truly cares about helping you improve your calligraphy skills and developing baseline skills of the Chinese language so you are prepared for an intro Chinese class if you choose to take one. She provided me with feedback on all of my assignments.

She is a great professor but a tough grader and her grading is not consistent. There is a language barrier so it can be difficult to understand what it is that she wants in your assignments and how she wants them done. It's a fun class, definitely not a blow off though. There is a bunch of assignments which take a lot of time to do.

Zhang laoshi is full of energy and cares a lot about students' learning. I swear if you've ever been in her classes you WON'T regret it. Chinese calligraphy isn't easy A like what some might say, but definitely aceable as long as you do the weekly homework, go to class and get a friend to help you if you're struggling with the brush.

Calligraphy is a fun class. She's super sweet and cares a lot about what you learn from her class. 94 for an A, you have weekly journal and brush practices that are pretty easy, unit quizzes, art projects and portfolio. Overall it's an easy class if you do your homework and follow the deadlines, but I wouldn't call it an effortless A.

professor is nice and she tries to make sure everyone learns from her class. ASIDE from that I took this class thinking the workload would be minimal, wrong! Every week there is a quiz which you have to study for. There is additional homework and discussion posts due. She grades closely and never lets class out early. Don't take if u want easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Everyone in the class did the bare minimum & did well. Not a ton of calligraphy work and was more in-class participation repeating Chinese words: weekly reflection, quiz, worksheet, and one group project, and a final portfolio. If you need an easy A for Humanities credit, take her!

Class is only her going over the notes, which she goes through very fast. 3 exams & the final, if your final grade is higher than your lowest test grade she will replace it. She says that you have to make sure she graded your test correctly before you leave the class or she won't change your grade (she gives us 1 min to look over exams).

She is not an extremely difficult professor, but she does go through notes fast and it is VERY lecture heavy. Exams are worth 50% of your grade and you have to look over your tests before you leave the class bc if she graded it wrong she won't change it if you left already (she has given us 1 min to look it over).

When I was signing up for this class there were zero good options. She is not bad or difficult but she does go fast during notes and her lectures and it will be hard catching up when your lost because she also goes over it once and moves on. All assignments and quizzes are on a website and then 3 tests and a final is what makes up your grade.

She was really nice and willing to help and negotiate your grade. It was STATS, so obviously lots of homework, but for math, I think that helps. Also, a lot of exams are a big portion of your grade, but not a crazy amount. I would suggest going to class, and you'll pass. She was super great!

Literally my favorite Language Teacher ever. She is so funny and kind, and an excellent professor. I learned so much in my semester with her. Not the easiest class to take, but it will push you to be better with only a moderate workload. She also loves it when you ask questions, so don't be shy!
An awesome person and awesome professor, take her for every foreign language/spanish credit you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Martin is so kind and taught me well! She cares about every student and will spend 20 minutes asking each individual how their weekend was. She wants you to succeed and the tests are easy, as long as you study. The textbook is fun to work with and homework is easy, too. I wish I could take her again, she's so awesome!! 10/10 recommend.

She was awesome. She WILL help you before tests and quizzes, and wants everyone to succeed. She talks a lot in Spanish during lessons and asks questions to all students, giving us all good practice. She never gets mad and is very understanding.

Professor Martin is very sweet, but if you really want to learn Spanish well, I wouldn't recommend her. She is a bit too easy, and just gossips during class. If you just need Spanish for credit and not long-term, then she is the professor for you!

Classes were very chill and the culture of the class was nice. Classes relied on participation working on things from our textbook. Quizzes and exams required studying but were not too difficult. If you are looking for a class to meet language requirements, take this class.

Amazing professor that knows her stuff. The class is very interactive and entertaining. Material is what you expect. Her tests are average difficulty. Dr. Martin makes sure you know all aspects of Spanish, including grammar, listening, and speaking.

This is my second semester with her and I can't recommend her enough! She really wants to make sure everyone understands the material. Class is engaging because there is constant participation and she's hilarious. Her exams and quizzes aren't too difficult. She does take attendance every class.

Professor Martin made the class seem like it would be manageable but towards the middle and end of the semester she became less clear on what was expected for test specifically. When her students were struggling she made it seem like it was their fault and got frustrated when there was confusion in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Martin is a good professor. Her class is fun and engaging. She's always willing to help. Take her.

Very caring professor and is easily accessible/helpful if you reach out. However, she seems to get frustrated at the class if we don't know the answer and she regularly will on people even if it's obvious that we don't know the answer.

I love that Professor Martin is very excited to teach every time we come to class. She makes lectures and lessons exciting and includes real conversation in every class. I feel that I have learned a lot of Spanish in her class, and I am excited to continue learning more of the language.

She's great! Class consists of some lecturing, lots of conversation/class participation, and in class activities. Attendance is taken every class but you have a few free skips. Only homework is online due every few weeks and can be found online if you need help. Exams and quizzes are not hard at all. Overall would reccommend!

Martin is a sweet woman, but not the greatest teacher. If you haven't taken many Spanish classes previously, I wouldn't recommend taking her. She doesn't teach a lot during class, rather just talks about her life. You'll be teaching yourself from the textbook. If you've taken a Spanish classes before, her class is extremely easy.

Super sweet and caring teacher. For the right student, this class is great, personally realized I was burned out of Spanish so I found the class to be really difficult. Lot of repetitive work but for some that may be right for them. Super nice to every student and would always try and connect with us. There is an oral exam so be prepared for that.

Professor Martin is the best spanish teacher. I look forward to going to her classes. She always makes me laugh and is just an overall genuine person and teacher. If you have the opportunity to take her definitely do. She is the best!

Hands down one of my favorite classes at TCU I have taken (and I don't even love spanish that much) because of Prof Martin. She is so patient and connects with all of her students. I actually looked forward to her class and learned a lot! She prepares you super well for quizzes/tests. I wish I could take her for all of my spanish courses.

Best Spanish professor at TCU by far! She genuinely cares about her students and their progress in her class. She is a fair grader and is easy to access outside of class. Would highly recommend her for any Spanish course.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Professor Martin. She is extremely caring and while may go off in tangents sometimes she relates them back to spanish and is just trying to get to know her students. She was a great teacher and I would take her class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Sra. Martin was great. I came into the class a little behind and left the class with an A+. She explains things so clearly and really cares about her students success inside and outside of the classroom
Professor Martin is a very caring and sweet person. She's always in a good mood and is very personable with her students. She is very accessible outside of class as well.
Definitely take Sra Martin! She is absolutely hilarious and a good teacher. If you remotely pay a bit of attention you will do just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Señora Martin is by far my favorite teacher at TCU. I suck at Spanish and struggle with Foreign Languages, so going into the class I knew I would hate it. It turned out to be favorite class! I LOVE Señora Martin. She is hilarious! Easy grader. Wants students to succeed. Study the reviews for the test and you will be fine. Take her!

Very nice and caring professor. Wants to get to know her students and makes the class very doable. Classes are fun and enjoyable, which makes them go by fast. Goes through the lessons at a good speed so it is easy to follow along. Prepares students very well for all tests and quizzes. Highly recommend, will be taking her again.

Dr. Martin is great. She is very kind and typically starts the class by going through the roll and attempting to have a short conversation in Spanish with each student, subtly introducing concepts as she talks. The tests are derived from the textbook, so know the vocab and grammar for the chapter and you will do fine.

This class (Int Spanish 2) was very easy. Martin is a little quirky but is very nice. The only thing I had to do outside of class was the online book assignments that are required by the department and study the night before a test. She's very understanding and an easy grader. Very few projects or writing assignments. Take her if you can!
She is a professor that genuinely cares about her students and their well being. In terms of academics, she is a really easy grader. However, at the same time I learned a lot from her class.

Super easy and nice. we never did a lot in class, and she doesn't have an attendance policy. Only a few short essays and online quizzes over short stories, and a final essay. Really nice and caring teacher, but barely learned anything about writing in Spanish.

Intermediate 1 Spanish is super easy as long as you listen to what she has to say! There are 2 quizzes each chapter: one vocab quiz and one grammar quiz. She gives you plenty of opportunities to ask questions. She's super funny and gives a lot of hints of what will be on each exam! Take her class if you need to take Spanish!

Karen Martin is such an amazing person. I struggled a lot in this class, and she always was there to lend a helping hand. She is so sweet and a great teacher, and I really recommend her to anyone going into intermediate one. Go Martin or go home ladies or gents. Buenas Fuertes!

I adore her. She makes the class very personal and cares more about learning how to use the language rather than being a super nit picky grader. She gets off topic sometimes and can be a bit of a pushover, but as a whole I wish every Spanish teacher had her passion for language and for her students. I highly recommend her for Intermediate Spanish.

Dr. Martin is an amazing professor.  She is caring, and makes lectures interesting.  Quizzes and tests are straightforward, and if you put in effort, you will get a good grade.  I definitely recommend taking Dr. Martin's class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Karen Martin is so sweet, and her class was very reasonable. Previous comments may say that her quizzes are hard and she's a tough grader - not true. The real thing is that she understands we are college students and is very lenient. Her quizzes are easy if you study grammar and vocab, and tests are modeled the same way.
Not hard to manage at all, only 4 essays and 6 online quizzes and a final.

Not an extremely difficult class, but not super easy either. Most of the work you have to do on your own time teaching yourself. A couple pop quizzes that many students fail, and she doesn't drop any quizzes. Overall, a fun class though. I loved going, I just had to do a lot of outside work.
Great professor and a great person. Take her

Yes, she is very nice. But when it comes to tests, most of the material is not gone over in class enough. She expects you to remember everything from your previous Spanish years or learn from the online homeworks. Not an easy A but it is possible

Very sweet lady who genuinely cares about her students. she drops a ton of grades and you would have to TRY to fail her class. that said, i wouldnt classify it as an easy A either. shes very scatterbrained, which can make her lectures a little hard to follow at times, but overall a good prof. shes very accommodating to students, so take her for spa

Good class. She does everything she can to make your grade good, and you would have to REALLY try to fail this class. she drops tons of grades and her tests are easy. also, if you have a 94 or better you dont have to take the final. shes very friendly and always willing to help, although she is very scatterbrained.
Great Teacher!!! Take her for any-level spanish she teaches!!! Review before each exam!!!

She is very helpful. You shoul show up to class everyday since in foreign lang. it'll be new material. You'll need to buy the Claro Que Si book. Her tests are not hard but there are 10 pop quizes and those can sometimes stump you. Mention that you love your mother and she'll love you forever.
she's very nice and is willing to help you with any problems... class isn't as hard as it could be because shes tries to make sure everyone understands

Useless teacher, tries to be something she is not and is rude and ignorant. Does not teach during class. Final is very difficult with material that is never gone over in class. Might at well buy the book and teach yourself that is how helpful she is. The icing on the cake... she grades the the final and then leaves campus
great teacher! I recommend her for spanish if you get the chance. She makes the material easy to learn and remember. Ive had her for 3rd and 4th semester spanish and would take her again if i could.

Amazing professor! I have taken her for Spanish 1, Spanish 2, and will hopefully have her for Intermediate. She is so nice and is always willing to help, as long as you attend class on a regular basis. If you go to class, you will be fine! She is the best Spanish teacher I have ever had!
Class is difficult but not impossible. DO the homework and go to every class and you'll do fine. Tests are straight forward and she's a nice lady
i really loved her, she made spanish a whole lot easier than most other teachers here. not a hard class to pass at all, just be sure to tell her if you get confused and she'll help you out.
The course work is simple and if you study for a half hour before all the quizes (which happen daily) theres no reason why you shouldn't get an A.  Great Teacher!
Great Teacher! She gives lots of opportunities to make an A. Be sure to study your vocab when she says because there is most likely going to be a quiz about them in the next class.
she is really nice and fun. i really enjoyed the class
Extremely helpful and nice.  I would take her agian if i could.  I got a B in the class but really didn't put forth that much effort.
No Comments
she is a great teacher and as long as you put minimal effort into the class passing should be no problem.
Easy class, though the tests can be harder than they appear.
She is a good teacher. Her online class is the best.
Best Spanish teacher I have ever had!
Funniest professor at TCU.

Dr. Lovett is awesome! His lectures are very entertaining and easy to follow. His tests are straightforward and relatively easy. Unfortunately, he is retiring this year so people will only know him as a legend unless he returns.

Dr. Lovett is a fantastic professor, I've had him for two semesters now. He's kind, caring, and makes class genuinely fun. His humor keeps lectures engaging, and he truly wants his students to succeed. He also offers plenty of extra credit. Take him! You won't regret it!

I have had Dr. Lovett for two semesters, soon to be three, and he is the best! Show up to class, take notes, and you will do well. Daily online quizzes but they help your grade and the exams are so similar to the review. He is very understanding if you need to miss class also!

I've taken his class for two semesters now and I love his class so much. His lectures are funny and he genuinely cares about his students. As long as you pay attention in class you will do well. He also offers a lot of extra credit. His classes really remind me why I love economics.

I don't know why his rate is bad like this bc I think it is an easy A class when you can have a lot of extra points by raising your hand, which one extra point = one point in your exam. The test is similar to the guide for each test. You have to practice it and GO TO CLASS if u want to get good score.

Professor Lovetts class is very lecture heavy and often doesn't correlate well with his textbook. Attendance is mandatory and you will have homework quizzes after EVERY CLASS. No matter how much I study for these exams I feel like I'm never prepared and do very poorly. He does offer a bonus for participation but overall wouldn't recommend it,

Professor Lovett is a great professor! Take him! I took ap micro in high school and was nervous for macro but this class was so much easier. He is funny and goes off on tangents often but is very engaging. I never dreaded going to this class. You can get bonus points everyday if you answer a question. Exams are easy if u study. Best prof! Take him!
While Prof. Lovett has a unique teaching style, his ECON10223 class is engaging and rewarding. The workload is manageable, and Unstuck study proved helpful for exam prep alongside the textbook.

Too much work. 3 exams + final on paper. A semester long research project  that requires 2 papers from group work and a final 4000 words paper. 3 quizzes a week and extra credit only for watching his 2-hour historic documentaries outside class time. P/NC because I don't want to spend that much time on history research for an ECON course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr Lovett made every class interesting and engaging. The workload was relatively light and mainly revolved around reading a textbook chapter and discussing it in class. Test reviews were always direct examples of what the actual exam was like. Overall the class was very enjoyable, and made me very excited about being in the business school.

Professor Lovett was a caring and intentional instructor. His lectures were engaging and he created an environment for students to interact with the class and ask questions. This class did involve a lot of reading outside of class, but it was beneficial. Overall, I recommend Professor Lovett and would take his course again!

Professor Lovett is a great guy, however, he is not the best professor. He gets side tracked and off-topic very easy. Attendance is mandatory but you would be better off never showing up to class. He is a funny guy but it is hard to stay focused and he gets so off-topic it is hard to understand the material and do well on exams.

Dr Lovett is a great professor who wants you to succeed and you will 100% do well if you show up and listen in class as well. Reading ahead of time can guarantee extra credit points every class and going to office hours to review before an exam is super helpful! Lectures are easy to follow and engaging.

Lovett is a great professor he truly cares about his students. He's hilarious in his own way and really wants everyone to succeed. Prepare to hear a lecture most of the class time but he prints out packets each week to help with note-taking to make sure you have the info you need.
Makes you buy and read the textbook he wrote. Easy class, easy A, fun teacher although he may be strange with his demonstrations, I enjoyed my time in his class.
Cares for his students. Clearly loves what he teaches. Values input and participation. Great professor. I would take a class of his again, if possible.

I was one of those people who failed economics in high school but Lovett has a really fun way of teaching and although he does rant quite a lot his class is never boring, I think he's a great econ professor and I would take him for even micro if he taught it.

He is a weird guy... but I liked him a lot and very genuine! intro to Macro isn't too bad just pay attention and do the study guide and you will do great. I don't dread his class bc he's a great teacher, gives examples which are weird but actually helpful and makes a boring subject bearable. just make sure you go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This guy doesn't help at all. Me and my other friends who are in the other class all are experiencing the same problems. he doesn't put the quizzes up till late and so you end up missing them receiving a zero then when you email him and ask if he can let you make it up he either doesn't respond or rudely tells you no even though it was his fault

This teacher is the weirdest and most uncomfortable person . He doesnt help you when you straight up tell him you are struggling. It is hit or miss wheether he post your "daily" quiz or not causing you to miss them and fail them. Then he wont answer and extend things when he messes up. Dont know how this teacher still exist here.

I love this professor! It's an ECON class, so you are used to reading a lot! He does quizzes every week, and attendance is mandatory (you can only miss three classes, or your grade will be affected). He is funny, but you must pay attention in class to get a good grade. There is only a big paper at the end of the semester and four exams. TAKE NOTES!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I love Lovett! His classes are so entertaining because of how odd he is/ how bad his constant jokes are, but he is aware of it which makes it funnier. He wants everyone to do well & is always available to help. class material is kinda boring (as is every econ hist class) but somehow teaches it in a way that is engaging and easy. 11/10 TAKE HIM!!!
Talks about weird things during his lectures, he replies email several days later or doesn't reply at all. His textbook is very confusing and readings are very long.

Lovett is an awesome guy, took his Industrial Revolution class and loved it. He brought in awesome models for technology from the Middle Ages to demo topics and all the tests were based entirely on the lecture material so you don't have to read. 2 papers, one 3,000 word and one 5,000, but you can use most of the 3,000 word one in the 5,000 word one
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: John is great. He loves coal and steam punk. Real honest about what he knows and doesn't. Fair grader.  His sense of humor is an acquired taste but if you appreciate cringe humor he's funny.  Don't expect him to remember your name let alone pronounce it correctly.
Dr. Lovett is the man. Easy tests and easier grader if you show up to class everyday. Also tells quirky jokes that are so bad they are funny. Highly recommend taking him at TCU.

AVOID!! Expects you to be there for every class, otherwise it's -4. Class is very dull and boring, he is not very structured either- can be all over the place. Overall, he isn't very hard, but I would avoid if possible.
Asks a lot for a class most people are taking for core.

Dr. Lovett is great. Yes he does tell quirky jokes during class, but he's a nice guy that will help you if you ask. He's a little slow with emails sometimes, but when he does answer, he's pretty thorough. Take his class, he's great!

My favorite teacher this semester! He is hilarious and made me absolutely LOVE Econ! TAKE HIM! He genuinely cares about his students and holds review sessions before all his exams. He made me laugh out loud every class but also taught me so much! Highly recommend this professor.

Very confusing when trying to explain topics..tells horrible and jokes. One positive is that he holds review sessions and has practice exams online. Attendance is mandatory, but he is very flexible if you are sick or going to miss with a legit excuse.

Pretty nice guy, but awful communication skills. Never answers emails, jokes (he immediately calls bad) distract from lectures, and he doesn't handle questions from students very well. Not too hard of a class, but definitely not one I look forward to every day.

Incredibly easy class...sometimes too easy to the point that I can't believe it is a college class and not high school. Lectures are pretty slow as he takes a long time to explain elementary theories and formulas. He makes class entertaining with his odd sense of humor, plus provides review sessions and good study materials online.

pretty easy class as long as you read the book which isn't hard at all because he wrote the book! he sometimes goes off topic and it gets boring but its not an impossible class. definitely one of the better macro teachers. easy A if you study and work hard

Dr. Lovett is a cool dude. Despite this, I really did not enjoy his class. He always went off on tangents completely unrelated to the topic at hand. Also, the book we use was written by him and there are multiple errors in the book. Nevertheless, the class is extremely easy and one should be able to make a B no problem.

I have no earthly idea how anyone can ever get anything below a B in Lovett's classes. Tests are easy,no need to read the book. He often digresses, and he is an awkward, corny, guy in the best way possible! Go to class and get an easy A, as long as you can stand cheesy jokes.

This professor, mark my words, is absolutely horrible.  I signed up for Intro to Macroeconomics.  I am an Econ major.  BELIEVE ME. He doesn't even teach macro.  He just rambles on about random subjects that have NOTHING to do with macro.  His jokes, while at first quite hilarious, get seriously annoying as he doesn't even do his job. DON'T TAKE

(Macro) Dr. Lovett is very funny, which kept me alert during his class.  He was available outside of class and his tests were not hard.  You do miss points if you miss class more than three times.  I highly recommend him for introductory macroeconomics.

Great guy, wicked funny in that awkward guy kind of way. He really does care and will be more than happy to help you. You don't really have to pay attention in class, just show up for attendance, and read the book. Also take the quizzes he puts on his website and you'll be fine

He's a good guy, but he can be offensive to his students.  Several of the jokes he attempted to make were at the expense of his students. Super-easy course, I think I opened the book twice, but I wish he had better personal (and spelling!) skills.

I loved Lovett's class! I am never bored during his lectures. He's very quirky and funny! There's 4 tests and some problem sets, but it's all relatively easy. I study 2 hours max for each test. I would recommend.

His MacroEcon course has been great to attend. He's a bit disorganized and often shifts tests and assignment dates, but outside of that, he does a great job. Very clear and takes just the right amount of grades (as well as plenty of extra credit opportunities).

Dr. Lovett is HILARIOUS! He makes going to class fun. The one problem he has is he's EXTREMELY disorganized! He'll spend half of class handing papers back and has to rush through class to cram everything in. His problem sets can be challenging, but if you read, you'll do well in the class.
Very nice guy who knows what he's talking about. Very helpful. Definitely try to take him
He is a very loopy teacher. He knows his stuff but he uses very confusing examples to teach the class. At times the class is very boring and his corney jokes tend to get annoying after awhile.

Lovett is really quirky and can get off topic, but overall a good teacher. His book is really well written and gives tons of examples to help. He drops your lowest test, quiz and problem set score. Really nice guy and easy enough class. I would take him again. You have to go to class though! Mandatory attendance!

Mr. Lovett is AWESOME! this is a great class. He is very quirky and funny which makes class easy to sit through. he wrote the textbook, and its not boring. He drops a test grade which meant I got to skip the final. I definitely recommend this class!

He can be confusing, but he is really good with clearing things up if you meet with him during his office hours. He's really funny, which keeps the class interesting, and it's not too hard. He drops your lowest test grade, as well as your lowest quiz and homework grades. I'm in his Macro class and I would recommend him

Very wierd/ADD teacher. GO SEE HIM IN OFFICE HOURS!!! If you see him in office hours, he will clarify things a lot and will give you the right answers for your reading quizzes. The tests are almost all multiple choice, and pretty easy.  You have to go to class (he gives points for attendance), but I would definitely reccomend him.

Ok I am in his into to macro class and I honestly think he is the most confusing teacher I have ever taken. He is so ADD on everything and jumps around ALL the time I find it nearly impossible to successfully take notes. Its very difficult to tell what is actually important in the lecture.

This guy is weird. Weirder than weird. But he is a very good prof. Not the most interesting class, but he does a good job at teaching it and he tries to keep the class interested. He uses lots of good examples that will stick with you. His tests are pretty difficult, especially compared to what is gone over in class. but not hard to get a solid B.
He has a quirky sense of humor which makes the class much more enjoyable.

Entertaining professor but the lectures rarely teach more than the book (and usually a lot less). He wrote the text book: it's around $80 but it's a workbook so you can't return it at the end of the semester. Overall he's a great guy and it's an easy class.

Dr. Lovett was a fantastic professor!! His class made Econ kinda fun. He gives you old tests on his website to help you study and can answer any questions during his office hours. In fact, all I did was read and do some sample questions and I got a 100 on the final! Great teacher and highly recommend him!

Great teacher!  Extremely helpful in and out of class.  Teaches lessons in a way we can all understand.  He makes silly jokes a lot in class (funny jokes, not "hey let's laugh so he doesn't hate us" jokes) which helps to lighten up the lecture.  DO THE HOMEWORK!  Not just for the credit but because it really does help you understand the material.

I really enjoyed this class.  The teacher is hilarious, friendly and approachable.  He wrote his own textbook, so its free and online.  His tests are harder than he prepares you for but the average test grade is still a B+.  I highly recommend this class

He is knowledgeable and his lectures are entertaining because he makes the goofiest little jokes here and there. Class is easy. His book is online and he wrote it. Your grade (+/-) depends on exams, quizzes, problem sets, and attendance all of which he drops one or more of the worst grades. HIGHLY RECOMMEND weather you like econ or not.

Good professor- knows his stuff. slightly disorganized but very helpful. you get points for attendance so go to class! Puts old tests online to study- these are helpful. Makes macroecon interesting and is a funny guy. Take him for economics!

Very knowledgable about economics but not that great of a teacher. He is a pretty awkward guy but that makes class somewhat entertaining. Tests are pretty tricky if you havent read or studied. Go to class and do assignments

Very funny and interesting. The way he teaches you feel u didn't learn anything till you are in class but once you think abt the class u'll realzie u learned so much. easy grader, go to class and do the assignments u'll b fine.
He is slightly boring but his class is easy. Half of your grade is online quizzes that you can use your book on and can take multiple times. Old tests are online. Easy A

Great professor! He's crazy and eccentric, but in the best way.  Makes class time interesting, although his notes are somewhat confusing.  Puts old tests on internet for you to study.  Gives you many opportunities to improve your grade...worksheets, reading quizzes, extra credit. Take LOVETT!
Fairly easy as long as you take notes and attend class. He takes questions directly from his old tests which he gives you. He's very entertaining and I would definitely suggest taking him.
hilarious, interesting class. he's hard but i always enjoyed going to class. all in all i think i learned a lot
You got to Lovett!

I have taken two classes with doctor Lovett, Intro to Macro and U.S. Economic History II.  Dr. Lovett is a great professor and with some studying his test are bad.  He is a professor that   wants to see his students do well, he even post his old exam on his website.  He's very easy to get a hold of and returns emails quickly.  Great professor!

He is all over the board during his lessons. Very hard to understand most of the time. Def isn't the worst teacher I've ever had, but very difficult to follow and know what to learn. He's nice and a little strange. I wouldn't recommend him personally. I was dissapointed in this class.

For every test, he post the questions from the previous years test that you should look at. There are problem sets that count for one fifth of your grade and they are easy A's that take 5 minutes each. I studied the old exams that he post online and got a A in the class. Study the old exams and you will be fine. I talks about his daughters alot, bu

He was hard to understand! i just guessed my way through the class on his tests...the problem sets are kind of hard and he takes attendence! You are only allowed 3 absences or u get 10 points off! Tests are hard unless you really understand macro!
Funny guy. Hard tests. Office hours are helpful for the problem sets. Pay close attention to his lectures.

I would strongly recommend against taking Dr. Lovet unless you absolutely have to.. make sure you go to his office hours to get help with problem set is that is really the only thing that will help your grade.. his tests get harder as you go along and his final comes out of no where.. look elsewhere for micro or macro if at all possible.
Terrible.  Worst teacher.  Do Not Take, even if you have to.  It's not worth it.
This is the worst teacher I've had at TCU. He will waste your time with pointless subjects you could have figured out in high school. My homework has Barney on it. Nuff said.

Took him for US Economic History  1790 to the present. He barely got past the Civil War. Terrible prof who's lectures mean nothing and teaches wacky stuff mostly from the book. Don't take his classes if at all possible.

He's a great teacher and never fails to keep things interesting. He rambles a bit but other than that, he is a great teacher who really promotes class participation in arespectful way. If you read the book, go to class and look at old exams online, you definitely get an A.

This was on of the easiest classes I have ever taken. Dr Lovett is a little goofy sometimes, but in general he's a very good teacher, and does his best to make things interesting. If you read the book and do the quizes assigned, you're almost certain of a good grade.
i honestly don't see hwo this guy could get any bad reviews, he clearly tells you whats going  to be on the tests and he tells really dorky jokes all class period. Very possible to pull an A in

If you can get past his stupid humor and not let that distract you from the class, he's a good teacher.  You need to know stuff out of the book, but it's not that bad.  He really knows his stuff and is really willing to help, he's just not always clear.  Good grades are very easy to come by as long as you do the reading and homework

He's a cool guy! He uses time to kind of explain what you were supposed to of read ON YOUR OWN! He uses his website often and is very willing to help. He's entertaining! If you want to do well in the class, you can! I'm taking him again next semester for Macro!

his tests are written while orbiting an unearthly place. if you go to class, you may have a chance, but he goes off topic a lot and tests over mostly book stuff (which is a chore in itself to comprehend) old tests are online, so thats a plus. advice-shop around for another econ prof.

He is one of the worst teachers I have ever had. His careless errors are endless in his teaching, and they left me with little confidence in what was factual and what was a typo. Nice person, not TCU quality though.

Hard class. Takes attendance every day which counts towards your grade. Material he teaches is different from what is in your textbook; tests are very difficult and tricky. I would avoid this professor.

Very hard class but nice professor! The tests are extremely hard but if you go over old tests that it helps a lot. Also if you go to his office hours he is very helpful. He has problem sets, participation points, and attendance points so those help your grade a lot. I would recommend this class but requires a lot of effort.

Coming into this course I was very excited and had an awesome experience in Macroeconomics. I soon found out that Lovett doesnt know how to teach, and doesnt test on what he teaches, doesnt test from the book, or any of the provided material. He teaches and tests on a level that isnt introductory.

This class in by no means easy, but he gives tons of extra worksheets and online assignments to really help you understand the material. Can act childish in class, but it's usually funny and can keep it entertaining. If you put in the studying and the work you can get an A.
i dont consider him a teacher, he didnt teach

I am am education major, not Econ.  The hisory part was great, but the Econ was more details than I needed.  The tests are hard, study a lot! but he will pull the essays from the study guides- know lots of details, and how to gererate and explain any graphs.  Attendance is a must, take detailed note and read the book twice!!!, you
No Comments
this class is terrible. terrible teaching and tests suck. homework sucks as well. do not take lovett's class. class is boring. i studied so much and still barely managed a C. worst class ever.

He is a nice guy but he doesnt teach that well.  I got an A in micro b/c I studied alot.  Macro on the other hand was pretty tough!  I would take him only if you like econ. and are willing to go to class.

AWFUL CLASS!! It just gets to the point where you don't even want to go to it anymore. Tests are impossible.. whoever wrote the above reviews are crazy. I read the book.. studied old tests.. got a tutor.. and managed a 69.3.. but heaven forbid that be a C. Dont take him !!!!
Lovett is a nice guy, but his tests are ridiculous.  He teaches like a kindergarden teacher and then you get the test and it is like a foreign language. Do not take him if you want to keep a good GPA
No Comments

Took this guy and did aweful in the class. He is really nice though!  I am not a math person and his tests consist of a lot of it and reasoning!  I am taking this class again under someone else.  he gives out online quizes though and HW assignments.  These should help the grade too.
No Comments

I actually took him for micro and macro. I made a 79.3 in his class and went in and i went in and talked to him all the time and he still gave me a C. class was pointless but you had to go for points. his test were really difficult. i dreaded the class everyday.
Helpfull teacher, not very clear on class material but do the chapter reviews and look over old test and you can get an A.
No Comments

Always have to read something that he still hasn't taught in class. However, easy multiple choice exams. If you read the book and look over previous exams, you will definitely get an A. Lot's of extra credits, and very easy online quizes.

Nice guy tests cover material but not what he has taught. No real point in attending class other than he takes attendance everyday. But here are some hints. Take the practice exams, and show up because you get points, but you must be able to use critical thinking to pass the tests.

Well, the guy is different... I don't think I have ever heard anyone say "pretty cool" as many times as he did, and if you had him you know exactly what I am talking about. Decent professor, just off the wall with his random comments. I thought the class was pretty tough.

Definitely a space cadet and he even admits it. His tests are very unclear and frustrating but the old exams at least give you an idea of what to expect. The problem sets are boring when you try to sell chickens, but what can you do. He is a nice guy, but his style of lecture doesnt work for me.

well...i love the guy!! But economics is not for me! His test are a little frustrating, and his lectures are not that helpful.  But you cant be mad at him. hes a really nice guy. i have a c, but i know others with an A.  So its possible...if your good at that kinda stuff.
This guys sucks, he is very hard and doesnt really know what he is talking about.  Dont take him Matt

This class was easy for me. He drops the lowest test grade and has lots of bonus. The lectures help some, but reading the book is a must. He puts old versions of the tests online and they are the exact same as his test. Highly reccomended.

Very nice guy...but his lectures have nothing to do with anything! Drops lowest test grade and has lots of daily grades. He tries to help, but it really does not work! MUST GO TO CLASS..TESTS ARE FROM LECTURES

Funny, interesting, an ENORMOUS econ nerd... but is off topic 75% of the time.  Test are a B****,  def. look at his old exams, and STAY UP WITH YOUR WORK, no joke.  I dropped this class!!!  Take Quinn!
Very wierd but laughable. He gives lot of opportunities for grades and hwk. Some material will appear out of nowhere on the tests. Always smiling. Overall, a good experience.
He is a really nice guy, but a little weird. His tests don't reflect the class at all and it's frustrating. And you will fall asleep in class...guaranteed. Don't take this class

Well, he thinks he is really funny, he is NOT. The class isnt so bad if you look over old tests, thats all I have to say. You dont have to listen to him, but he throws the same problems at you as he threw at last year's classes....old tests, and he posts them for you!
will be lecturing on ch 6, taking quizes on ch 7 and reading ch 8.  Very hard to follow.

his class is hard and so are his tests. you have to work REALLY hard to get an A. he is a big econ nerd BUT he is genuinely a nice guy. always willing to help but not good at explaining. i actually learned a lot from his class.

Need to study old tests and look over book.  Requires some work, I got an A in both macro and micro.  He also gives you many chances to bring up your grade and drops a test.  Serious cheeseball jokes, but he is always willing to help.
Goes off on many tangents and tests aren't necessarily from lecture. Definately look over all of the old tests that he posts online because some questions repeat.
Difficult teacher, many helpful grade boosters to take weight off of tests, lectures are often random and not too informative. Definitely read the book and study old tests.  Questions often repeated.

Took him for both classes. Overall a very good guy. Classes are early in the morning. Don't have to get A's or high B's on his tests to get an A in the class. Lots of online grade inflators. Has old tests on web site and often cut/paste.
he's a strange one, jokes suck, giant nerd, hard class, hard exams suck but when do they not, and did i mention he's strange

He is not the best proffessor. Jokes way too much and talks about his family alot so you end up learning less. My advise is to study on your own using old tests & reviews coz he puts those on tests.He doesn't do a very good job when explaining. Hard class

One word: Horrible!!! Avoid if all possible! He intentionally tries to trick you on tests (which are impossible). Definitely one of the worst teachers I have ever had! He is a huge dork and tells the worst jokes during class.

His class is not very easy, because you do not understand what he is trying to teach in class. Many people tend to sleep off in his class cuz it's so boring. His humor sux!!! Study the old exams, it's one of the ways to help your grade.
Hard to follow. Tests are difficult; there's 6 of them (you can drop one). Avoid if possible. Class time is wasted.
the lame joekes get old FAST! i fall asleep almost every day in this class. he makes absolutely no sense and goes off on random tangents. i would definitely take someone else!

This class is awful. There is no point to going to class. The only thing that you need to study for the test is the review and the old tests.  Don't take notes and don't read the book. This class SUCKS! I fall asleep in this class almost everyday!

He is a computer dork.  The opening 5 minutes of class are spent with him starting up his computer.  Old exams are posted.  I made an A in Dawn Elliots microeconomics class.  While she is much more difficult you will learn the material much better from he
One of my favorite teachers at TCU; made me decide to minor in Economics because I loved the class.  Prof. Lovett is interesting, fun, and great, even though the subject can be hard.

His jokes are really lame, and he never goes over anything thats on the test.  If you actually read the chapters and study and make sure you understand the old tests, then the tests are a breeze and you shouldnt have to go to class.
