He's crazy!  The class takes a lot of work on your own because he doesn't really teach it in class...also you get to play games that he creates himself (MonkeyKong).  Doing well on those will help raise your grade.

He's not bad at all.  He does go on several tangents, but if you take a MWF class, he's harmless.  His tests aren't that bad, and he posts old tests on his website anyway.  Take him; you'll thank me later.
I hate him!  He was so rude and snide with me!  I asked for help and he turned his back on me and did nothing.  His tests are out of another world and has horrible teaching methods!
Great Prof. Really funny.
No Comments
This class was easy...a lot of people expect it to be so, so they dont do well.  The teacher is nice and helpful.  I got a B.
tests are really hard, and he goes off on alot of tangents in class so do alot reading, and the problem sets and experiments are hard to keep up with.
Dr. Lovett's class was easy and informative. He managed to keep the class interesting even though economics is usually a boring subject.
Tests are real hard...
He is a nice guy but definitely a nerd.  Spends too much time in class on stuff that isn't on test.  Tests are pretty hard.

Almost all of the test questions come from old ones that are posted on his website. He tries to be funny, but it is funnier to laugh at him than with him. Don't buy the study guide. You can easily get an A or B by going to class/studying old tests.

this guy is the worst teacher ever.  he spends probably less than half the time of the class actually teaching, and his tests are freakin hard. if you plan on getting a good grade, you better be able to teach yourself.
He is really funny in class. I enjoyed it.  The tough tests are offset by the problem sets that he assigns.  He told us the first day that "(He) is leniant towards people who sleep in class."

No attendance taken. Coming to class not needed at all. Lectures have nothing to do with test. Simply study his practice test and you will pull a B easy. At least 15 out of 30to 40 questions come from practice test.
Tests are impossible, becasue he expects you to know things that he never talked about.  I would not recomend him

This guy is a moron.   It is extremely difficult to follow his lectures because he will go off on little, insignificant tangents (suffers from add).   His tests are extremely difficult and simply reviewing lecture materials will not help.  I pulled a B.

He was an interesting teacher.  I learned a lot, its not so hard to get a B with his study materials, but to get an A it is really hard.  His tests are more trying to read his mind than understand the material.  DONT BUY THE STUDY GUIDE
Funny, dedicated.  He memorized every student's name even though the class was fairly large.  Makes interesting handouts.
He does a good job of relating a potentially boring subject.  Highly reccomended!
Make sure you memorize the old tests and you will probably do fine.  His jokes get old and he has a hard time remembering names, but class is worth going to.
If you go to class and study the old tests that he gives you, you'll do fine...he keeps class kind of entertaining with his corny jokes
good teacher - you must study.
Read the book and use the past tests he puts online. He expects you to know a lot more than what he teaches in class.
Test are hard...class is easy.  Dont fall into the trap your going to have tos study hard.
No Comments
Great Teacher!  Tough tests
No Comments
every chapter you have to read a chapter from his textbook, though it is very interactive and not brutal at all. gives study guides. Theres work but you will actually learn in his class

Dr. Witworth was easily my favorite professor during my freshman year. He is super passionate about what he teaches and loves to discuss topics with the class. He assigns you a table group the first week of class. Its a great way to make new friends especially if you are a freshman! The tests aren't bad as long as you pay attention in class.

One of the harder sociology teachers, his exams are extremely difficult and you need to work pretty hard in this class to get a good grade. Attendance is mandatory and you can only miss around 4 classes. Try to take a different teacher if you are only taking sociology for credit

Absolutely loved his class. He is so passionate about what he teaches. He is super understanding and always willing to help. Attendance is mandatory, but you will have four free passes. Tests are a little tricky, but you will be fine if you study. Highly recommend taking him.

The professor created his own textbook, which was helpful and aligned with the lectures. Weekly chapters are due on Sundays. Take thorough notes during class (they're fill-in-the-blank), as they are crucial for exams. There are four exams, 15 chapters, and one assignment, all of which make up your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: In this class there is a lot of memorization for his test which are about 40 questions each. Dr Witworth is super caring though, make sure to do the extra credit he gives every month DO NOT wait until the last month because he will only accept two. On his CA paper I think he was pretty flexible plus he is willing to look over all our papers.

Dr. Whitworth is so nice. The class is very reasonable. He wrote the textbook you use and it's online and interactive. Easy to miss class and still get an A. Tests are open note and assignments are quick and easy. He is so sweet and really cares about his students and what he teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: He is super nice and has a good class. I would recommend him. He is easy and his class is the same the whole year. Easy to miss and still get a good grade.

Dr. Witworth was a great professor! Not too much homework and it took very little time. His tests are not bad as long as you review the study guide and take the practice exam. Also, he is accessible outside of class and very eager to help his students do well.

Took him for sustainability, and found it incredibly interesting. He's obviously passionate about the subject, which was really refreshing. He offers a lot of assignments, which makes it almost impossible to NOT get an A. Also, randomly takes attendance for points. Great class for a GA credit - I recommend it!

Very nice man. He was my very first college professor and really provided a warm and friendly environment. Easy class too, just do the explorations online and come to class and take notes. Simple. No reason you cant make an A in his class.

Overall Professor steele does care about her students but she is a very hard grader and takes no mercy on her exams. She prepares you with what you need to know but each exam is very difficult with an essay, multiple choice, and short answer. The book you read is basically in another language like old irish language and is very hard to comprehend.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!! You will have a quiz EVERY single class and the 3 exams are beyond impossible. Nothing makes sense in this class and the final is a group acting of a play, that she gave everyone 70% on even tho everyone did exactly what we were supposed to do. The worst.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: be prepared to have a quiz EVERY single class on weird Irish plays that make absolutely no sense and are super long. she is a sweet teacher but her exams are borderline IMPOSSIBLE no matter how much studying you do. Please just do not take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's passionate about what she teaches and prepares you well for exams. She gives multiple with extra credit opportunities and will basically tell you what to say in your exam if you go to her office hours. Lots of studying though...had a quiz every single class. Great if you don't mind the subject and are willing to put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This professor was my worst. We had to read before every class and it was long boring Irish dramas. She grades so harshly and claims she just wants our opinions but clearly wants us to say something specific. I studied my butt off and still didn't get an A on the exam because my essay(worth 50% on exams). Do not take this class. It's so boring!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Her Children's Lit class was probably the most boring class I ever took at TCU, and that is incredibly sad considering the genre. If you must her class (which you shouldn't) don't even think about using the rest room because she will send you a passive aggressive email or embarrass you in front of the entire class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I had Professor Steele for Intro to Drama and it was terrible. She can be nice but very petty. She took off points on my project because I went to the bathroom one time during class. Attendance is mandatory as she gives quizzes during every class. This class was just beyond boring and unnecessary.

Dr. Steele is the SWEETEST! I am not a reading/writing person but yet I loved her children's lit class. Was so kind every class and gave great feedback on the papers. We did read about a book a week in her class but it really isn't bad. Also the whole class is discussion but (as someone who hates that) it somehow was one of my favorite classes
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: I would definitely recommend taking her if you are an English or Writing major. No tech allowed in the class and heavily discussion based. Weekly quizzes and a few papers. Not the easiest grader but it is more than possible to get an A in this class if you put in the work.

I was in Professor Steeles class for one day and I dropped it. This class is extremely heavy in reading. If there is a play to read, it also includes background reading for the play. At the end of the class a play is to be preformed. She also does not allow technology to be used. Yes, this means no computer for notes. Hopefully you have a pen+paper
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Tough grader and kind of intimidating but great teacher. I loved her.

Irish Literature- Not a bad teacher.  Head of the English department, so she is a tough grader.  I got an A+, but worked my butt off to get it.  The quizzes are usually open-book, but you should actually read the assigned readings thoroughly before class and you'll be fine.  Research papers are tough, but it was a good class overall.

Worst teacher I've ever had in my entire life. She hated certain students and it was very obvious. I ended up with an 89 and she wouldn't change my grade because she didn't like me... Took off 10 points from my final essay for being "loud and disruptive in class".

She is a very hard grader and does not give out A's unless she thinks you deserve it. I've gotten 89s on every essay. Little time to read the books, max of 1 week to read. Grade is 2 individual essays, 1 group essay, inclass assignments, final video project (each worth 20%). Calls people out in class daily. Not recommended.

Had the potential to be fun, but she is not a very objective grader. Some of us felt like our grades were based on her mood at the time. In class group work felt like a waste of time, just more work than was needed. Also, she is obsessed with grammar. Don't look at your cell phone she will freak out and kick you out of class. DO NOT TAKE HER!

She is very smart, but expects all of her students are on the same intelligence level as her. A hard grader. lots of in class group work. You are not given much time to read entire books. 3 essays, one being a partner one. No final, but instead there is a partner digital video project. interesting class, but lots of reading and she has high expectations from her students.

She requires you to devote your life to this class and have tons of prior knowledge about the topics covered. If you don't, she takes it personally, embarrasses you in front of everyone, and takes it out on your grade. GOOD LUCK.
Do not take her Intro to drama class. It is A LOT of reading and she is very difficult. I went into the class thinking it would be an easy A and had to pass/fail the class. DO NOT TAKE IT

Dr. Steele is a very hard professor.  Unless you have serious interest in women's studies, I don't recommend this class.  It's a hard class overall and Dr. Steele just makes it more difficult than it has to be.  I don't like her or the other professor but I also don't like the subject material.  A lot of people I knew really liked her and the class

Very knowledgable and interesting professor. By no means are her courses easy, but you will learn a ton and the subject material is very interesting. She tends to treat her class like it is the only one that exists, but it is still manageable. She is always available to help and is a GREAT professor.

VERY difficult.  She expects A LOT and sometimes it feels as though she thinks her class is the only one you're enrolled in.  However, she is willing and ready to help when there are questions.  Nice, but intimidating as HECK!  Good luck if you take her for anything...

she is amazing, she expects A LOT from you but is willing to always help. her calsses are very interesting and you can mak ean A but you have to do work. Work in college? YES! she is really a good professor
Dr. Steele expects a lot from you, but that's her job: to make you expect a lot from yourself. This class is not an easy A, but I recommend it to everyone. Both professors want you to do well.

Not what I expected...it's all about Irish drama. BUT it's not that bad. So what if you have to read? Gog forbid we read in college! Anyway, the readings are easy and some of them are not that long either. There are only like 2 that are arounf 100 pages. The tests are easy because they are just like the reviews she gives. Not bad at all.

C'mon people your in college, did you think you weren't going to have to read? Yes, Dr. Steele expects a lot but she is also there to help you a hundred percent and really cares about your writing and helping you improve. No other teacher will be as honest with you.

Dr. Steele is tough, but good. Even years after I have graduated, she always has time to talk to me when we run into each other. She is very passionate about her subject area. She is very willing to help you with papers if you take the time to ask.

London Sem: Sounds like an easy class, but don't be fooled. DO NOT get behind in the readings (expect many reading quizzes), because the essay grades will NOT save you. She told me I was one of the best writers in the class, but I only received an A on one essay. RIDICULOUSLY ANNOYING ESSAYS.
Great professor. Really knows her stuff. Class is hard and she's a tough grader but you learn a lot. Stay caught up with the readings and you shouldn't be too bad.

NOT what I expected.  She is really big into Irish Drama and Ireland.  You have to read one play a week and there are weekly quizzes.  Must do the readings to get a decent score on the tests.  Do not take this class if you don't have a lot of free time to read the plays.

Dr. Steele is very organized and clear in her assignments. One has to read a play once a week, which is not difficult. She is always willing to help and very passionate about the subject. Talking in class from the begining will help a lot! Learns names! nice lady

unrealistic about her assignments, it's like she thinks you dont have reading or studying for your other classes. if you dont mind reading A LOT,  then you'll be alright. does not assign a lot of writing, maybe 3 hw essays, 1 in class, and 1 take home final essay.
She's unrealistic with the assignments she gives out.  If you are a fast reader who has a lot of time and loves books and don't mind essays, then I guess this class is for you

Prof. Steele is no good.  If you are a male, do not sign up far any class she teaches; she does not like men.  She is not very helpful and is quick to tell you that you are wrong.  If you need a ENGL class, take Spiller, Gaul, Harris, or Enos.  They don't bring their personal beliefs into the class.

Dr. Steele is by far my favorite professor!  She is so interesting and incredibly knowlegeable about what she teaches--you can tell how much she loves the subject.  She is amazingly helpful and has spent a lot of time working with me individually.  If I ever have another chance to take her, I will!

i thought this was gonna be a really fun class, but it's not! unless you really like writing, don't take it. she's really into the books& expects a lot,w/o a lot of inst. she offers to help, but sometimes makes you feel dumb. she has a scholarly attitude&forgets you are right out of high school

Most clear and concise prof I have ever had. Made Brit Lit exciting. Never missed a class all semester, even after all-nighters, because she is interesting and passionate about what she teaches. And she does give A's if you earn them.

Ok, intro to drama, not what you think. All Irish plays (1 per week) and you have to analyze them. weekly quizzes, be prepared to write like 15-20 pages in a bluebook for tests. Very opinionated, will boost your test grade if you've talked in class.

She expects way too much from her class.  In addition to writing 4 essays, you are expected to read basically a book a week, attend movie screenings, and attend lectures and turn in work there isn't even a grade for in the syllabus

She teaches the same books over and over.  My roomate took an honors course with her when I took a different course from her; we read same texts.  She's into her thoughts.  She claims to be open-minded but disses those who do not think like her .

She is one of the best teachers I have had.  She really takes into consideration what the students think-she asked us what we thought of the first test and completely changed her tests after reading our comments.
SHe was by far the worst teacher I have had at TCU, she made her class impossible and acted like we were all Enlish majors for an into to poetry class..she sucks.
never gives As and just a boring voice

I had Dr. Steele for a seminar class.  On the first day she told us only 1 or 2 As would be given.  Her grading scale seemed somewhat off and even going to her office hours may not seem to help improve one's paper grades.
she is mean as hell
One of the best professors I've ever had!  She's great at leading discussions and is very helpful and friendly.
professor steele kinda just lectures the whole time and doesnt really give us chance for discussion
She likes her explanations of texts.
No Comments

Dr. McCormick is an incredible teacher who values her students' success and thoughtful discussion. Her class was full of content, but she made it accessible. There were reading assignments with mild comprehension quizzes, but all were very manageable. Her way of lecturing is very engaging and easy to follow along with. I would highly recommend!

Very Very tough grader. Might be biased on a couple of philosophical topics . Puts her view out there. 1st paper feedback will shock you but gets to the point. Is really really aiming for the specific details. 2 debates in the course. Might get confusing at times. Pretty hard to understand at times. Don't recommend taking if you can't think good.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: professor McCormick was the best! there are weekly quizzes but if you go to class and pay attention, you're pretty much guaranteed an a. not very hard and lectures were interesting. she explains everything really well and breaks it down to the simplest level for non-philosophy majors. 2 papers but she offers feedback before you submit. take her!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was a freshman-level philosophy class, however, it felt way harder than a first-year course and she was not prone to help you. Notes were incredibly vague, weekly homework assignments were graded harshly and when asked for extra help or assistance she just said buy the textbook, didn't help at all. Don't recommend for an easy core class.

I loved this class! The content was so interesting and I was genuinely excited for class every time we had it! My advice would be to keep up with the readings and make sure that for the weekly quizzes you are responding with detail.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor McCormick is a great professor that is really passionate about her subject. Lectures are very interesting and engaging. All quizzes are take home and straight from the notes and exams are open note. Papers can be challenging but SEND YOUR PAPER IN BEFORE to get an A. Readings are helpful but are not required to do well! Take this class!

This class is not too hard if you actually read the assign reading and pay attention and participate in the lectures. The daily quizzes are graded pretty harshly if you don't add what she is looking for. Fun professor and very understanding if you email her.

Very easy class if you show up to class and do the readings. Only read 10-15 pages before each class and she goes over it all during the lectures. She does a great job explaining the content and gives great feedback on quizzes and papers.
Dr. McCormick is a great professor. She explains things clearly and clearly loves philosophy. She can be a challenging grader but is also a fair grader. Would recommend taking.

Took Professor McCormick for a freshman philosophy class, and I don't regret taking it at all. The lectures were very interesting, and the weekly quizzes were straight from the notes. There were weekly readings for everyone to do before each week, but a I stopped doing them pretty early on and did just fine. Send both your papers in for revision.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I recommend this class to every incoming freshman. Dr. McCormick makes class super interesting and will give you really good feedback. You have two major papers and you should turn in you rough drafts because she will give you really good criticism to make it better. Quizzes are easy and you can have a cheat sheet on midterm + final.

This class was a lower-level philosophy class, but I would recommend not taking the class unless you have taken an introductory philosophy course. Dr. McCormick is a hard paper grader, and she expects you to already understand how to write a philosophy paper when entering the class. Quizzes in the class were easy, just make sure you read.

Shes nice but when it all comes down to it she is not a professor who is eager to help outside of class. An in-and-out kind of professor. I took 2 classes with her and in the intro she was good, but the 2nd class i took (moral responsibility) she was all over the place. She wasnt very understanding when I had a family tragedy happen during finals
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. McCormick really wanted us to succeed. All of our quizzes were open note and our on tests we could bring in a sheet of paper. We had a book, but the reading was not really mandatory, because she would explain it during class. Attendance was not mandatory, but because philosophy is so conceptual it was basically mandatory in order to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: For Intro to Philosophy she does a really great job teaching the material but all of her assessments are out of 15 points or less so if you miss 2 points you automatically don't get a great grade. You have to go to every class for notes and pop quizzes to pass the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: For Intro to Philosophy McCormick did a really good job of explaining the material and she made her lectures interesting. Make sure you go to class so you have the lecture notes to write you essays, it will be impossible without. I went to her office hours and she wasn't helpful and seemed like she didn't have time for me, came off a little rude.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She is super helpful and makes philosophy interesting. Everything is open note, so take good notes and you're good to go
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Good professor who knows what she is talking about. Extremely easy class. Lets you use notes on all pop quizzes (just show up and you'll get a 100 on them if you took good notes) and one page of notes for the tests. Papers are simple. The only issue is lectures are insanely boring, and it was painfully hard not to fall asleep in her class. Easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Kelly will grade you hard but provide substantial feedback to improve on later papers. Good professor and interesting subject matter.

Dr. McCormick is a really good professor. I took her for critical reasoning, which is a pretty boring and very easy topic, but she tried her best to make it interesting. By the end of the semester I knew the material very well. There were three tests (plus the final) and weekly homeworks, but I made an easy A. Would recommend her class!

Philosophy can be a very hard subject conceptually, but she does a really good job explaining. Had to write 2 papers for this class and she offers to proofread them. Pop quizzes are open note and very easy. Show up to class and you'll be fine.

She expects you to read the textbooks, but she actually goes over the material in class through packets for each chapter. She is an excellent teacher who is organized and goes the pace of the class. When I have questions she makes sure to visibly show me every step of how to get an answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing! She wants you to do well in her class and helps you get a good grade! Really accessible outside of class. BEST teacher ever would take her all over again. She makes the class engaging and entertaining. Basically an angel who came down from the sky to teach accounting. Im sorry if you didnt get a chance to be her student.
The content itself is difficult, but she makes it as accessible as possible and will explain as many times as you need. Truly such a kind and caring person in the right field of work.
Kelton is the absolute best, so sad she is leaving next semester. She is the most helpful professor and will do anything to make you succeed. Can't recommend her enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kelton is the goat

Kelton is the best intro accounting teacher at TCU. I took a different teacher last semester and couldn't even get a c on any tests. With the help of kelton and her weekly study groups I have gotten 91 and above on every test. She truly wants all of her students to do well and does everything she can to help everyone pass.

Kelton is the absolute best! Accounting is very difficult, but she wants you to do well and succeed. She curves every test and is very accessible after class for help. She is the sweetest lady ever! Take if you can!!!

Professor Kelton is THE best professor I have ever had at TCU. Accounting is hard regardless of what teacher you have, but kelton gives you every ounce of help you need to succeed. She is the most caring, kind, helpful teacher i have ever had. I could not reccomend her enough. Do whatever you need to do to get into her class.
