Dont miss class bc youll miss a lot!! Decent grade is possible if you have the time to put into it.. But hes a decent guy... No sympathy for you though!

Studied my butt off and got a D. It's not that the tests are hard but the way he grades them. You MUST give him EVERY single piece of information that exists for every test question. That means if John Gotti scratched his butt during his trial you better know about it and let Kinkade know you know it. When I asked for help he said, Study harder!!!

Kinkade was much nicer than people had told me.  This was the most enlightening class I've ever taken. Tests are kind of difficult, but it's worth it for what you'll learn. I worked hard and got a good grade. Great teacher.

GREAT professor. The best I've ever had at TCU, and I'm not a CRJU major. Tests are tough to study for b/c they're essay form, but he doesn't trick you. His lectures are clear cut and organized. He knows what he's talking about. You'll learn a lot!

Yeah I came for a higher education too but that doesnt require all essay,50 minutes to answer, & lectures that provide little organization for note-taking.Im a graduating senior, grad-school-bound, w/ a better-than-decent GPA, & even my study habits werent always up for the challenge. Throw in some m.c. Q's- just a few! (& I'd say cocky, not rude.)

This is avery difficult class, so be prepared to work you butt off. He is not clear with what he wants in class, but if you go to his office he is very helpful. He is a very interesting person if you get the chance to know him. You will learn a TON if you apply yourself. Also a very tough grader.

That is not true at all, he is very willing to help all you have to do is ask. he tells you straight up what he wants, yes it is a hard class, but college is for learning and getting a higher education so you are going to work, that is the point.

Forget the other posts.  I came to college to learn, and because I took Kinkade's class I learned to take notes, outline study material, and study for tests.  Thanks to him, I learned and retained more in his classes more than any class before.  To you others who expected different, suck it up!  It is up to you to know the material, it is up to you for the work.

Patrick Kinkade, along with Dr. Burns and Dr. Ferrell, is one of the best professors on TCU's campus.  As an alumni from TCU, I recommend CRJU majors to take his class.  If you can't take his jokes ("rudeness" as one called it), take a joke and g
He was my favorite professor at TCU.  I have never worked so hard for an A in my life - and thus never been so proud of an A once I made one.  He is the best!
He is awful!! He never wants to help and he is just an awful teacher who is always in a bad mood. Don't take him!

Test/quizzes very difficult.Alot of material to know.You have 4 out of 5 questions to answer in 50 min. and he expects a page for each.That's quizzes. Tests are the same & add a summary over a film.Hard grader, need to study alot and make sure you know your stuff.But it is an interesting class.

Worst class I've ever taken.  He refuses to help students who come to his office asking for help.  He is very unprofessional. And he will tell you that sometimes studying 2 hrs a day for his class isn't enough, you may need to do 10.
Hes a nice guy, test are a bit hard but if you take notes youll be ok. I learned alot in this class and his lec are very interesting.
his tests are hard but he gives you a chance to appeal b/c he knows they're difficult...his lectures are very interesting and he knows what he's talking about...take good notes and read the book
His tests are very hard. do not take this class with him.  He is cool and laid back but his tests suck!!!!

Kincaid is a funny guy and laid back. I thought the class was not that hard. It is a really interesting class and does require reading the chapters if you want to do well in his class. Do that and go to class and take notes and you'll do fine.

The class was by far one of the most interesting I've ever taken. It makes you realize how often you buy into common myths and misconceptions. No work outside of class except for reading 3 chapters per test and a term paper that you know about from the first day of class. B made with strong effort.

I have learned a lot in this class.  He is overall a good professor, willing to work with you if you have any problems.  His tests are kind of tough, but you get to appeal questions you miss and justify why you  chose that answer and can gain points back.
STAY AWAY! His tests are very hard and are cover way too much material. He talks very fast and doesn't explain things very well in lectures. He gets joy out of failing students.

I have taken Kinkade for Org Crime, Victimless crime and sociology of corrections. His classes are hard but forces you to study and actually learn material.  I dont recommend his classes as electives(not an easy A) but if you want to learn interesting information from a qualified professor take him

Test were multiple choice, the hardest multiple choice tests, first 3 answers are good then D. is A and C only, D all the above. 5 chapters from book on each test, which is every 4 wks, plus lecture. Very tough class, but he knows he's a **** so it's ok
Tests are impossible, small details will get you.  A bit of a smart alec.  Grades hard on papers.
The hardest class I have taken at TCU. His tests are very hard and he tests over the most minute details such as numbers and specific dates. I do not recommend taking him.

This is the hardest teacher I have ever had.His tests are mainly essay and you have to know everything in the book.About half the class will fail, so be prepared.He is interesting though and you do get to visit the prisons, so it is fun though.

big sis vibes If you invite her to your events, shell show up and cheer you on. Sooo much extra credit events. Plays old timey music in class. Really wants you to make friends and take care of mental health, she talks about that sooo much. Gives TONs of hw but wont make you buy useless expensive textbooks and doesn't lecture a lot but group work !

So much extra credit, every one was a whole % in your grade. Discussion based. Attendance required for first quarter. Group project or test for final your choice. Tests were multiple choice and easy to do well. Such a caring and down to earth teacher. Actually interesting information focused around health and wellness.

This was such a chill class. She really cares about students and gives several mental health days and does meditation in class almost every day. She drops the lowest exam grade so if you do well enough on the first 4 exams you can skip the final. The material in the class actually pertains to the real world. Definitely recommend!
She was chill.Once she had us circle up and talk about our stressors. She dropped the lowest grade so I skipped the final exam.
He puts a heavy emphasis on experiential learning. He has a wealth of experience and makes his classes feel like the real world. Neeley's best professor and an even better man.

Best prof in Neeley by a mile!  Bummed it took me until senior year to get to take him, but I'm really glad I got the chance. His content and life advice was awesome. TAKE HIM!!! 
PS: Best dressed dude on campus!

Professor Kirchner made a HUGE impact on me. Not just academically, but in many other aspects of my life. I can't overstate how lucky I felt to have been in his class. The environment he creates for collaboration, innovative thinking and creativity set him far apart from any other professor I've taken. He's the best. #dadadvice #circleoftrust

Every Neeley student should be required to take Professor Kirchner for SOMETHING. I had him for a THURSDAY nite class, and I'm still surprised i looked forward to it each week. The "dad advice" he gave our team after the final was inspiring. So caring, genuine and sincere. He wants the best for his students, and is the best professor ever.Take him!

Professor Kirchner is the best professor Neeley has to offer. Some teachers go through the motions and just want to cash their check. Kirchner treats students like actual humans and not children. He is realistic and caring. I would take him for every class if it was an option. I cannot say enough good things about him.
Best professor ever! Wish i could take him again

He is my favorite professor I've had at TCU. I loved his "Dad advice" and "circle of trust" moments. He has high expectations, but gives you all of the tools to meet them and is generous with grading. All of the subjects covered were really interesting and good to know in order to have a comprehensive understanding of business.

AMAZING!! participation is most of the grade, however i talked alot and still never got a 10/10, so he is alittle harsh in that area. Overall super nice and knowlegeable, but he is alittle blatent on some subjects, so if you dont have a tough skin dont take his class, or go into business.

I had Kirchner as a freshman (Bus in Society) and was lucky enough to have him again as a senior (Strat Man).  He had not taught it before and it was my favorite class. He made it so relevant, and the practical, real world discussions were amazing! No matter what he teaches, TAKE HIM!! He's a GREAT professor and an awesome human!!! 10/10!

Professor Kirchner is one of the best professors I've ever had. He cares so much about every student and he tries to make class the best part of your day. 1 homework assignment each week and 3 group projects throughout the year. He offers multiple extra credit assignments and provides good feedback. TAKE KIRCHNER!!!!!

Dr. Kirchner's lectures are so entertaining and engaging. At first I didn't understand his style of teaching, but then I realized how much I was actually learning from him. He has a unique and participatory way of teaching, and I gained a ton from his class. He's super cool and funny. He is a bit of a harsh grader, but not too bad.

Professor Kirchner was absolutely incredible. It was his first semester teaching Strategic Management and it was great. He genuinely cares about his students and their success. You do have to show up to class, but it's entertaining and not just a drag. I would highly recommend him.

Very discussion based, participation matters. He is very humorous and applies his corporate experience to the lecture when relevant. Must do reading assignments and 3 group projects but the last 2 are presentations. Tough grader, grading policy can be direct, but your work must be above standards. Interesting icebreakers beginning of class.

Kirchner provided the best 50 minutes of my day every class. He's Passionate. Energetic. Smart. Funny. Love him as a professor, and he's a great guy. He challenges his students to think critically, but gives us the tools to be successful. Hard grader but so worth it. GOAT

I learn more interesting things in this class than any other course I've taken. He has great insights from his time as CMO in the business world, and shares real life advice and stories that make all the difference.  Really smart guy. Caring. Funny. And yes - it really is the best 50 minutes of my day!! 
I always look forward to his class!

Kirchner is the best professor I have had - hands down!!  He challenges you to make sure you can articulate your opinions in a thoughtful way. He leads great conversations! How I look at things has changed significantly, and what I am learning has already helped me so much. Just the coolest guy. Easily the best 80 minutes of my day !

Great guy. Awesome teacher. Tough grader. I feel like all Business in Society teachers grade difficult for no reason. Content should be what makes a class challenging, not just being hyper-critical for no reason. Considering the content taught compared to other upper-division courses I've taken, the level that the course is graded at is a joke.

He does a good job of making a boring class interesting. He is very critical and can come off as mea but he really just likes to challenge his students' ideas. He is a tough grader, so you have to be diligent about those small assignments. Otherwise, I don't mind the class. He is lenient on late work and will work with you on your grade if needed.
Very nice professor, but a tough grader. Sometimes grading criteria isn't clear.
If you can take his class do it! Awesome life advice and wants his students to grow. Be prepared to participate.

There is a reason he is the most popular professor in all of Neeley. He cares about his students and wants them to learn. All of his classes fill up instantly because his reputation is well known. Take him if you can! The practical life lessons he shares are as important as his academic content and that's what sets him apart. My favorite prof EVER.
The goat. I would retake this class just for fun. Prof Kirchner is awesome and if you can take any of his classes, do it.

If you're looking for a professor who offers life-changing advice, take this class! I gained so many valuable lessons that will benefit me during my time at TCU and beyond. He can be a tough grader but his detailed feedback helps you grow and improve for future assignments. AMAZING 10/10!!!

YES! YES! YES! Prof. Kirchner is a fantastic professor. Although this class is participation-heavy, it is SO worth it. I wish he could be my professor for every class; he is one of the most supportive professors I've had. I truly benefited from taking his class. The best 50 minutes of my day!

Best Professor ever!!! Take him for business in society. He cares so much about his students and wants them all to succeed. Super smart guy and can make anyone laugh. He clearly outlines his expectations and makes it easy to succeed in his class if you put in the work. Has amazing real world experience as well.

Best professor in Neeley by a mile!  Such a cool guy who loves his students and wants them to learn. Hard to get an A without participating and doing the work, but you'll want to engage and he'll push you. soooooo good- take him! 
Best 50 minutes = Professor Kirchner! :)

The things I learned in his class will help me in so many ways. He is the most genuine, smart and caring professor ever. From music and reindeer games, to "5 things" and the "circle of trust", Kirchner was amazing. He's REALLY in tune with his students. You work hard but he keeps it so interesting that the time flies. He's that good - take him!

TAKE HIM!!! You must participate to do well in this class, otherwise, expect a B. Professor Kirchner is a great guy and really wants you to help and be an active learner. As long as you participate and talk to him you should get an A.

BEST professor ever! I loved everything about his teaching style and the "best 50 minutes of my day" flew by!  You need to participate, but he makes it easy to engage.  Discussions are amazing, relevant and I learned so much! Such a cool guy.

The professor was great and funny! The class was ok. I feel that the group projects could have been better for new business students, but that is out of the professor's control. Although Kirchner did change some of the aspects of the projects. Weird when it comes to grading and heavy on everyone participating. He is supportive of all students.

Favorite professor I've ever had. Participate and buy into the class and you will not regret it. He gives amazing "Dad advice" and teaches in a way that applies in the real world. Best professor and an even better person.

Kirchner is the nicest man ever, and the class is very fun. Expect an A-, as most things are graded at a 93 max (Not sure why), but he is super cool, the class is fun, and it's not a very heavy workload.
By far and away the best professor I've had at TCU.  Super funny and engaging and makes a boring class so enjoyable.  Overall just an amazing guy I cannot recommend him enough.

Best professor I've ever had! First day of class he said this would be the best 50 minutes of your day and it was. You learn a ton, engage, and have great conversations in class. I always looked forward going to class.

I'm a Non traditional student just here for a degree, and never liked school. I went into the class not respecting higher education until I took his class. He has a professional background, not a career professor which I love. Having him first semester after transferring here was a blessing. He turns a fluff intro class into a valuable experience.

Professor Kirchner is the BEST!!! His background as a CMO enables him to bring real world insights to  class. You have to participate in discussions to do well . The activities challenge your critical thinking skills - I learned a ton!  It was easily the best 50 minutes of my day!!  TAKE HIM!  You will not regret it.

Simply the BEST professor in Neeley--hands down! I looked forward to going to his class every day. The learning environment Professor Kirchner creates is amazing, and the class dynamic is something I have never experienced before.  TAKE HIM!!  PS: Best dressed Professor on campus (just sayin') # Drippin'!!  #Smart  #Genuine  #GOAT

MY FAVORITE PROFESSOR EVER! He is so funny and really gets to know you. It is a discussion-based class so there are no quizzes or tests. There are three group projects with a memo and presentation. It was the best 50 minutes of my day.

BY FAR my favorite class I've taken. I was excited to get up and go every. single. day. He is the best business in society professor you can take, hands down. Not only is the class engaging, but you make great connections with your peers. Some of my closest friends to this day are from this class. Take him, you won't regret it!

Take him, he's a former CMO (very knowledgeable) and has a lot of great insights to give. Also does reindeer games at the beginning of every class which are fun, and the lectures are just overall engaging and not boring.
take his class it will be the best 50 min of your life

Professor Kirchner is the best! I learned the most and actually enjoyed everyday in his class. He thoroughly tries to make an impact and a connection to each student while still making the class very enjoyable. He is so caring and always willing to meet outside of class. The workload is very manageable and it's easy to do well if you try. TAKE HIM!

Professor Kirchner is an intelligent professor who wants his students to succeed. He gives his students real-life advice and makes them expand their knowledge and give their opinions every class to prepare them for the real world. You have homework due every Monday and group presentations but other than that the workload is minimal.

Easily the best 50 mins of my day! Professor Kirchner's former experience in the business world contributes to his insightful discussions. Homework isn't bad as you will get the hang of it. He is funny and truly wants everyone to do amazing! Although it is somewhat difficult to get an A, it's absolutely worth it! Mandatory participation/attendance.
Best professor I've had at TCU. His business in society class is practically all discussion based. Lots of reading for homework but so does every other class

I LOVE THIS MAN! Made class so enjoyable and funny and he literally looks like Paul Wesley. No tests or quizzes, so he naturally grades homework and project assignments harder. He truly cares and wants his students to learn. Hard grader, but so worth it. If you put effort in, you will receive an A.

Professor Kirchner was an excellent professor. His teaching style was amazing and different because he incorporated his long experience working in corporate America and shared his experiences. I would definitely recommend him for Business in Society.

Professor Kirchner is the best. He really loves his students, and is super funny. He is a tough grader, as in you can't just half do your work, but it's because he wants you to succeed and learn. I learned a lot in his class and would take it again. If you go into office hours he loves it and you will probably get better participation grade.
Kirchner is a great professor and super engaging in class. He is funny and cares about his students. He wants everyone to do well. He isn't the easiest grader but totally worth it.

Favorite class 100%. 5 things you learn throughout the semester are so simple yet perspective shifting. For projects: take the initiative, follow the prompt, and ask QUESTIONS to him and with groups. Learn how to efficiently do building blocks, contribute to discussions even if you don't think your input's good enough, bc it prob is. Best 50 mins

He's a decent teacher. No test or quizzes. The homework assignments are hard and take a long time and he grades them hard. Hes a really hard grader but his average grade is a A-. He does a participation grade every week. I liked him as a teacher you just need to be on his good side.

Professor Kirchner is one of my favorite professors I've had at TCU. The work is one assignment a week which can take some time the first few times but once you know what you are doing it's much simpler. He can be a tough grader but for the most part I got the grades I deserved. You have to show up and participate to do well in his class.

I recommend taking him. One of the kindest and funniest professors on campus and makes class fun. Be engaged and actually talk and you'll do well in his class. The work can be a bit tedious at times but not too hard. He made class fun while also having real-life experience in the high-up business world which made his stories even more interesting.

Hands down the best professor I've had. He's fun and actually keeps you engaged, also makes it very easy to participate. The class is super close and I made one of my best friends through his class. I would take him again if I could. The assignments are relatively easy especially compared to the other professors teaching. I learned while having fun

Amazing Professor. If you have the option to take him... DO. He's a tough/inconsistent grader, but he has a detailed rubric for each assignment and project. If you follow that in high quality, you'll make an A on assignments. Participation in class matters. Make sure you talk. No test. Group projects, but they are not hard. He's a cool guy.

TAKE HIM! Professor Kirchner taught me so much. He requires attendance and gives weekly participation grades, but he's accessible in and out of the classroom. There are no exams, just group papers/presentations. He's a tough grader, but I've kept an A throughout the semester. He also requires less on the projects compared to other professors :)
take him, he really care about his students and make the class interested.his class were the best 50 minutes of my day

Professor Kirchner is awesome! I would take his class again in a heartbeat. He does do participation grades so you should at least talk once during discussions daily. Kind of a strict grader but provides excellent feedback. Take him!!!
Definitely recommend taking Kirchner, he made class fun by always being engaging. I liked that he had personal experience in C- suite level jobs so he could take about his jobs.

Discussions rule this class, Kirchner does a great job of engaging people and of starting conversation. He also uses his experiences in the business world to help and teach the class. He grades a little unusually and at points you may be annoyed but in the end it will help you and you should finish with at worst b+ and an A is very attainable.

I took Kirchner in Fall 2021 and he was a great professor who gives good feedback. He really wants you to grasp the concepts covered and makes coming to class fun. Just weekly bullet points over article readings give you an easy way to make a high grade, while still picking up the facts from the article. Really is caring and wants you to succeed.

Professor Kirchner was probably my only B in freshman year and he still was my favorite professor. He is funny and really nice. He is a great professor who really cares about all his students. I would definitely take him again.

BUSI: No lectures, quizzes, or tests. Homework is a weekly building block, it took me about 1-2 hours a week to finish. Other than that, a couple group projects and papers, but nothing big. For being a freshman class, he has high expectations for performance and participation.

Professor Kirchner is my favorite professor I have had so far! He has real world knowledge and is interesting and fun. I looked forward to going to his class and really enjoyed the content. Take him for Business in Society!

LOVES to talk about himself, he is a  non-traditional business teacher and keeps class fun but grades essays hard which are 50% of your grade. Attendance and participation are strict and you need to talk a lot every day. No powerpoints ever or taking notes just discussions!
One of the best professors I had during my freshman year. Attendance is mandatory and affects your grade. Participation matters.

AWESOME!! I absolutely love his class and how amazing of a teacher he is. Definitely take his class if you want an A. He has 3 papers and some building blocks, but overall super easy class. Best one of all the Business in Society professors. TAKE HIM.

I am in professor Kirchner's business in society class and very much enjoy it. He creates a classroom environment that promotes discussion, participation, questioning, and collaborating. He very much treats his students as equals to him and is always open to listening to you. He encourages students to have their own opinion.
Professor Kirchner truly cares about his students. He makes classes engaging and fun. He seeks feedback from students and is very helpful. Definitely recommend

Professor Kirchner was a fantastic professor! He brings both real world experience and various class activities that keep the class engaging and interesting. He is very straightforward with his expectations, and emphasizes group work. If you stay on top of your work, participate in class, and put effort into your assignments, you'll do well.

Dr. Kim is the GOAT. He is incredibly kind and genuinely supportive. The class includes three exams, a high number of online open-note quizzes, a few individual assignments, and a final group project that you present to him one-on-one with your group.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: JUST TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!!! He knows exactly what his students need, and he always helps them no matter what.
Honestly, I truly wish he could teach every single class at TCU

Professor Kim was great for data mangement! Tests are difficult, but as long as you really study the review lecture (which he videos) and the review packet you will be okay. He really was a kind professor and ordered by class wingstop and pizza on in-class work days for the final project! Great class and would take again!

Every class is a lecture followed by an activity. Offers lots of help. Online quizzes at home every week, tests are fine if you study, there are plenty of things to get graded on so the tests don't end up weighing as much. I took the night class and had a great time - he brought us cookies a lot and DoorDashed dinner for the entire class twice.

He's so sweet and caring! This class will get challenging at times but he'll help you get through it. Do the work, assignments, and quizzes and you should be fine. In-Class activities also help a lot. 3 exams, lots of quizzes (online, open-note), a few individual assignments, and one final group project that you present to him individually.
ABSOLUTELY AMAZING
Best Professor in Neeley School of Business, Period.
He's the best, genuinely cares about your success and will help you on whatever you are struggling with. Make sure to ask for help as the semester goes along
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Kim is such a sweet guy and really cares about his students. He brought us food, was always available if you needed help, and really just wanted us to succeed. Strongly recommend him.
Really nice guy, who makes cookies for us, engages with us and cares for you. I wish he taught every class in this school, some of these professors are god awful.

David's lectures were very thorough, with real-life examples, and he gave time in class to practice the concepts in the lecture. During this time, he gives additional guidance as needed and is available outside of class. His class is more casual, talking to us after class about restaurants he has been to.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The content is all over the place and the only exam is the comprehensive 100 question final. There are quiz grades and labs that are easy grades that balance out your grade at the end of the semester. He is very helpful if you reach out to him. He is good with makeups as well. His lectures are a little boring bc of the content. Would take.

This professor talks SO MUCH. Like lectures are the entire class and you get tired of taking notes bc half of his slides are formatted so strangely. The labs are so chill and take at most an hour each time.  The quizzes are what got me and add up after the whole semester, but only 10 multiple choice questions. Show up for extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is so kind and really cares. Python is hard considering I have no computer science background, but was able to learn. Lectures may not be the most exciting, but he sometimes cracks a joke.

Most boring class I have ever taken. Lectures the entire class and gives weekly quizzes which require studying lectures. Grades labs easy which bumped up bad quiz scores (the only reason I got an A). Honestly, it wasn't even that hard, just super boring, and he is the least helpful professor I've ever had.

The quizzes are on the most random details from the two 45 slide long slide decks you get each week. A quiz weekly, usually the average is a 6/10 because of how detailed the questions are, and on a lockdown browser. The labs are easy, and he gives a 100 on those but do not take this if you are looking for an A because it's impossible.

This is a class most people take to achieve their science core and he somewhat realizes this. Every other class there is a quiz on the lectures/ slides and these are tough they are out of 10. He gives 100s on most labs and is pretty easy on that. This is an easy class to get a B and hard to achieve an A. He is a nice enough guy but a bit awkward.

This class is supposed to be relatively easy as it is an NCS core credit class. However, you really have to put in the work and study for the 10-question quizzes every week if you want to get an A. To keep a semi-good grade do not miss labs as the quiz grades will bring the overall grade down. Labs are interesting, easy, explain the subject, & fun!
Unbelievably Bi-Polar. Needs to lose her job.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Cook is amazing. I had her for Team Dynamics and it was very fun. There are a ton of team activities both inside and outside of class. Be prepared to do an escape room and a cardboard boat race :)

Dr. Cook is one of my favorite professors at TCU, she teaches her students a different way to approach problems and has meaningful discussions with the class on real world topics that have changed the way I look at things. The hw and group work is clear and easy to get an A on if you follow the instructions and ask for help when needed.
She is nice but the class in general sucks. Tough grader but thats how business in society is either way

She is a very nice woman and the team dynamics class she teaches has no exams and is graded on mostly weekly online quizzes and then a few presentations/papers. She includes lots of activities in her teaching style
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not the worst but the presentations are stressful and you have to participate a lot. The amount of times you talk is tracked everyday. It can be interesting but she is a harsh grader.

Dr. Cook was my favorite teacher I've had in my entire life. This class took hard work, but she is so helpful if you ask for feedback. The toughest thing about this class is that she requires you to use critical thinking that forces you to switch the way you think for hw which is difficult at first. Also, PARTICIPATE in discussions if you want an A

Dr. Cook is a great professor, I enjoyed business in society thanks to her. The discussions in class always kept my attention and she added a lot to the convos. You do have to talk around 2-3 each class but its honestly easy and youll have plenty you want to add since the convos are interesting. She just overall rlly cares about what she does

This is not a hard class its buisness and society everyone does fine. She harps on participation alot and thats worth alot. Tough grader on group projects but besides that she is fine and a understanding lady. Would take again.

She shouldn't be rated highly. She picks favorites, and can be rude to groups who didn't do what they were assigned "exactly right," even though the class itself is built on critical thinking and how you interpret prompts and ideas. For being a class that is taken simply because its a requirement, there's no reason for why she grades so harshly.

Participation is a must! She is a great professor and her instructions are clear. Weekly assignments and participation are a lot of your grades, but the group projects are very important to do well on. Not an easy A, since she never gives out 100's, but you can do it.

I LOVE her!! She is so inspirational and passionate about her work! No tests, but assignments are a lot of work and the 3 big group projects are stressful. If you want to actually learn in the class and work to get the best grade you can, take it. I am very appreciative that I took her class.

Good, passionate teacher. Not the best Business in Society option but not the worst. Would not take if you don't like participating - Every class someone tallies how often each student talks and its worth a lot of your grade. The homeworks are a lot of reading and writing. Group projects are all major grades but not super hard.

Dr. Cook is a really great teacher. Attendance is mandatory for participation and you have to talk at least 3 times to get a good weekly participation grade. There are no tests, but 3 group projects that have a lot of weight on your grade and she grades very harshly. Great to talk to outside of the classroom, wants to help in whatever way she can.

This class was not easy by any means as it was heavily graded on discussions and participation throughout class; however, I have heard that other teachers for this subject are way worse. I enjoyed this class even though I don't particularly enjoy public speaking - We had two group presentations and a paper for major grades!

Heavily graded on participation. 3 group projects. 1 weekly homework assignment that takes forever to do. Final is a group project, but be ready for her to be a rough grader. Easy class environment. Easy A if you participate. Cannot miss class. Be careful on the way you approach her if you don't want to get yelled at.

Dr, Cook is an outstanding professor. She is very welcoming and likes to engage with her students. Attendance and participation ARE A MUST if you want to get above an A as it counts for 20% of the grade. 2 group projects and one individual paper for the big grades.  You learn about various sectors of business which can help for your other classes.

Participation is extremely important in this class (need to talk at least 3x a class to get an A in participation) but the class environment makes it easy especially if you're shy. There is an assignment 1x a week which doesn't take long and 2 group presentations. There is also 1 essay. Overall this class is very interesting and I've learned alot!

I look forward to this class! It's based on class participation and discussion, so if you want a good grade in class all you have to do is talk! The assignments are fairly easy, and all readings are given to you on D2L. There are no tests, but there are group projects and a research paper. The final is also a group project. Highly recommend!

Professor Cook is very informative and will help you whenever you ask for it. You will have to do assignments out of class but you will be prepared for them because professor Cook always makes sure her students are understanding what is going on in class. Overall, a good class that will introduce you to business in general.

Dr. Cook is a great professor. Her Business in Society class is a fun and relatively easy class if you put in some effort. Her classes and participation grades are based on how often you contribute to class discussions which is great and makes the class fun. The building block assignments get pretty annoying but really aren't too bad.

Very good professor. If you do not come to class you will not pass. Make sure you do your homework and participate in class and you will enjoy the class and learn a lot about business that you need to know. This class is all participation and group projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Recently, I had the opportunity and privilege to take Business in Society with Dr. Cook and I really enjoyed the class. Although this class has weekly homework, the class discussions are very rewarding and test your ability to apply critical thinking to different business applications. Make sure to attend every class as there is participation grade
Great professor. There's a decent amount of homework but not too much to handle. Participation is a grade in every class.

Overall great intro business class. Participation is graded and very important to class when it comes to daily lectures. Cook provides great feedback on assignments and is fun to talk to in daily discussions. 100% recommended taking this professor.

Dr. Cook is a fantastic professor. She cares about her students and wants us to learn as much as possible. She gives good feedback and helps us excel in our work. Dr. Cook makes class interesting and exciting and encourages all of us to participate. If you are willing to participate and do about two assignments a week you will thrive in this class!

Dr. Cook has been my favorite professor this semester, and made my transition from high school to college a breeze. She does assign weekly homework and some projects, but overall the homework load is very manageable. The mandatory attendance also helps get me out of bed in the morning, and provides free points just for showing up and talking!

The teaching style is innovative it is a discussion-based class with lots of participation. There are weekly assignments. She teaches the subject very well very engaging. Would take the professor again.

Coming into this class as a freshman I had low hope, but this is one of my favorite classes.  Dr. Cook is incredible she is very understanding and flexible but will hold you accountable.  Her class is based heavy on discussions and engaging in conversation with your peers.  I strongly recommend taking this class!!!

Dr. Cook is one of the best Professors I have ever had, as a 9am class she keeps everyone engaged and motivated. Group projects are the key component of this class as you don't really have tests and as a freshman it is great to be forced to meet the people in your class. My only complaint is the Building Block homework takes forever sometimes.

Dr. Cook is a very kind professor who makes an effort to get to know all her students. Classes include a lot of discussions, and she does a good job of leading those discussions in a positive manner. She is a tough grader, however, the grade you receive always seems to be fair and equal to the effort you put in.

I was so thankful to have Dr. Cook as one of my first professors at TCU. Her class is incredibly interesting, and has a moderate amount of homework. You do get a participation grade every day that gets averaged every two weeks, so if you don't like to talk in class, I do not suggest that you take Dr. Cook. Required attendance and a fair grader.

Professor Cook is a solid professor, her class is easy but her building blocks assignments are cancer. You have to get started on them a few days before or you will be stuck doing it for a while the night before.

I really enjoyed Dr. Cook's class! A lot of the class was based on discussions, and if you don't participate, you will lose major points. She lays out the class really well, with a few big papers throughout the semester and a group project for the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: If you're more reserved like me, steer away from this class. Participation is weighed heavily & it's almost impossible to get above a 90. 2 papers & final is group presentation. She's a nice professor but there are other, easier ones that I would take. I am sitting at a low A due to participation soooo
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Cook is nice and very helpful if you have questions and the class itself is pretty easy if you show up and follow instructions. Participation is a large portion of your grade so if you arent a big talker I would avoid. She also assigns two tough research papers and a group project at the end. Basically like Business in Society but harder.

I feel like any Business in Society class is pretty easy. Dr. Cook likes you to participate so say whatever thing you can to get that participation grade. Papers aren't too hard, focus on grammar and citation. Go to office hours she's super willing to help ya. I didn't put that much effort into this class and still pass with an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Class itself isnt too hard, theres a bunch of homework and reading in the beginning. Theres two papers and a final group project. Shes a very tough grader on grammar! And she gives participation points on whether it not you speak in class. Its not a hard class but the grammar and participation brought me down
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: At first she gives you lower participation grade so you have to be involved, but that grade will improve later in the sem. Critical thinking papers arent hard, just make sure u focus on diversity pivot point too. Weekly building blocks but its not that bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: You should expect to be engaged in any Neeley class. She makes the class so fun and everybody gets a chance to speak (or else, your participation grade is gonna be not so good). 93 for an A but she grades fairly. Make sure you cite your sources the proper way in papers, she cares alot about citation!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is a personality herself! I never thought I would talk this much in a class (but I did, in her class), and the activities were fun! The only downside is that sometimes you got into bad groups and other members just don't wanna help you.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Cook is probably the nicest prof u can take for Business in Society. Get ready to speak in class because participation matters. Discussions are the main thing of the class and there are 3 papers, 1 final presentation, and building blocks for every module. Go to her office hours and she will help you for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Graded on 1 assignment per week, 3 essays that count for half the grade, a group presentation, and participation. Participation really matters you need to participate in every class about the assigned readings. Skip one day your participation grade is down to a B. Fun class but if you don't like to participate all the time then avoid if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: One of the nicest professors I've had at TCU, she is accessible, and although the class was more group discussion-based, she did have some meaningful lectures. Also, she did have flexible office hours, and they are useful. The only downside is she does display a bit of favoritism, but that is usually towards the people who participate the most.

Professor Cook is a fun and engaging professor who cares about her students. The workload for this class is pretty average and it involves a lot of writing. If you do your homework and do well on the papers you will probably get an A. She will like you more if you participate in class as well and she has the power to round grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: 10/10 recommend taking Mrs. Cook! The class is mainly discussion based on the assigned content, which personally I enjoy. There isn't too much graded work, but enough to keep your grade up if you just do the work. Overall, a very interesting class, not too difficult, and Mrs. Cook is one of the nicest profs I've had so far.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: TAKE HER!! Such a great professor! Not lecture heavy at all - more group discussion based. The topics are interesting and the professor is very engaging. Highly recommend! Assigned reading and 1 discussion post due every week. Easy A if you follow instructions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Kleiser is my least favorite prof I've ever had. She calls herself "witty" but she's just rude and makes you feel bad any time you ask a question. She moves quickly because it's more convenient for her. Her tests are so tricky and hard. DO NOT recommend her. I learned nothing...
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If you take this class hoping to learn anything about marketing analytics, you are going to be very disappointed. Everything we do in this class is about SPSS which, if anything, has gotten more confusing during the semester. You won't learn anything helpful about what Marketing Analytics really is, the entire class is based off of surveys and SPSS
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I LOVE prof Kleiser! She's definitely a difficult professor and makes you work for your grade, but she is absolutely hilarious in class and keeps you engaged through the most boring content. The tests are pretty difficult but she gives you the opportunity to go to her office and look at your test and appeal the ones you got wrong!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Kleiser is one of the best profs within Neeley. The lectures can be dry, but she's funny and tries to make them entertaining at times. Show up to class - she will do random attendance checks. You will hear how hard the main group project is, but it's not that bad. One major con: HATED her exams. Hard to study for and they are unpredictable
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Kleiser is one of my favorite professors I've ever had at TCU. She can make lectures interesting when the material is not. I never opened the textbook, come to class and take notes on what she says because that's where the test comes from. Group project is a lot but she is fair on grading and will get you to the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Kleiser is one of my favorite professors at TCU. She has a great sense of humor, which makes classes really interesting. She occasionally gives attendance quizzes, so it is important to go to class. She also likes it when students participate in class lectures! Overall, a great professor who really cares about her students.

Kleiser makes her lectures interesting and she's a very nice lady. You have to come to class because she will go over things not present in the textbook that will be on the exam. You'll also have to read the textbook because tested over things only in textbook. She gives very minimal instructions on assignments but tries to give you best grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Kleiser is a difficult professor, but nonetheless amazing and a great teacher! I have had her for 3 straight semesters (1yr and half). I took her for Marketing Research, SPSS, and Ethics. I cried over SPSS but the rest - I can't complain! I'd absolutely recommend her - she's very witty.

I love Kleiser. She was my favorite professor of my undergraduate career. She definitely cares about her students and absolutely wants you to learn. She will make sure that you don't fail, but her class isn't easy by any stretch of the imagination. Looking to legitimately learn something? Take her classes. Looking for an easy A? Go elsewhere.

Very difficult class but Kleiser is a great teacher. Print out powerpoints and take good notes on them, You can get an A without opening the book but it does help. Make sure your team works hard on the project and does a good job of proofing and polishing it before your turn it in. Also she gives out random quizes just to check for participation
She is a great teacher. She won't put up with anything though and can be very strict. She follows the rules to a T but as a person, she is super nice. Fun and Funny.
Great professor. Very thorough and detailed. Make sure you come to class and take notes.

I like Kleiser. I've had her for Ethics and MKTG Research and the subjects are terrible, but she makes it fun. She grades unbelievably hard because she is overly analytical and will expect the same out of you. Multiple choice sections on her exams always killed my grades!

She is really knowledgeable but she can get distracted during class way too easily, which distracts everyone else too. She is a really tough grader and she never puts grades on eCollege. The class is helpful though and she enjoys teaching it.
Class isn't that bad. She enjoys it and makes lectures fun

Kleiser is awesome she really is. Her marketing management class is super fun. But come test time, you'll find yourself relying on teaching yourself from the book. Her tests are hard, lots of vocab and inferring from long paragraphs. Would I have rather taken from someone else? Probably not, but be ready to work and go to class for the pop quizzes!

I took kleiser for Business Ethics to begin with. She is very opinionated when it comes to that class. I also took her for a couple of upperlevel mktg classes. She really knows her stuff and is very helpful. Tests are a little tricky but overall I would recommend taking her for anything upperlevel (just not bus ethics!)

Dr. Kleiser should stick to upperlevel marketing. She is given the material for Ethics. She is a nice lady, but very tough for the class. Make sure to go to class, and do the homework. The tests are somewhat difficult, study from the slides. Got a C instead of a B for missing one homework assignment.

I loved her class. She kind of grades hard which sucks... go into a lot of detail in your homework assignments and short answers on test. No textbook. Actually read the articles she assigns cuz she asks detailed questions about them. I liked her class discussions. Take her!

she is very opinionated which is not good for an ethics class. she rates you on what she thinks is the right decision. the multiple choice on her tests are impossible and she never gives full credit on homework. i don't suggest taking Klesier

I genuinely like her. She is very smart, and funny; she makes class fun. Her classes are informative & useful. attendance and participation in class is very essential to a good grade. She fosters a good class environment. However, she is frequently unfair and inconsistent in her grading. I like her, but the unfair grading ruined the class for me.
If you dont care about ethics then dont take her...she takes her job seriously even though ethics is worthless. She would be a good teacher for another subject though and has experience.
not bad but test arent easy...if you make an effort you can get a B somewhat easy

Not as bad as many would make her out to be. She has her funny moments in class to make it interesting, and the class itself is a B for sure if you show up and pay at least some attention. A is difficult, but attainable.

Great professor!  I have taken her Marketing Management course and it is STRAIGHT out of the book.  Every class is taught with power points that she makes available online.. they make for a great study resource.  Tests aren't hard with a couple hours of studying.  Take her.
She was a great teacher. Do your work and go to class.
Trying to learn and make a decent grade in Marketing Research from this woman is impossible. You will regret taking this class from Kleiser.

This is an easy class but she is inconsistent with grading. Just show up to class and talk every now and then and you should be fine. Don't buy the book because she posts all readings on e-college. The bottom line is ethics is impossible to teach. In the HW/short essays, just write what you would want to read if you were a business ethics teacher.
She is horrible. Avoid at all costs. Don't say I didn't warn you. She is super inconsistent and moody with all facets of her class, especially grading.

Class is entertaining, especially if you have a person who always feels the need to express their opinion...there is far less work in this class than any other I've taken at TCU, but you have to read alot for the first 2 tests.  It's easy to get B's on the tests, but I'm not sure exactly how you can get A's.  She's cool.
Do I have to say anything else

stingy on the posins, but she is a good prof. make sure u turn in ur articles when she says bc she shows no grace on late papers. she gives u one page to write the answers to 5 questions which doesnt seem to be enough. then she asks u to expand. i really like her, but it's not an SUPER easy. class.
Good class, turn in all homework and article summaries, easy B tougher A

Class is complete discussion! No book because she gives you powerpoints every week. All tests and homework must be VERY detailed and EVERYTHING thoroughly explained to get credit. Can be frustrating because she stingy with points but an overall great professor. SHES HILARIOUS

Great professor! Nice lady who knows her stuff and is incredible at teaching it. She honestly wants everyone to understand the material. Keeps the class interesting and engaging while fully explaining everything. Also, really not difficult if you put in a slight effort. ABSOLUTELY RECOMMEND!
awesome teacher, she clearly goes through everything and wont continue if there are questions. quizes are easy and her class is interesting.

Dr. K is a great professor. She makes economics fun and interesting. Take the practice quizzes.  You never have to read the book. The online hw is reallllllly easy. Take this class (and actually attend it, you are only allowed 2 absenses).

she's a great teacher. she explains everything so well that i never needed to open the book.  study for the quizes. use the practice quiz, it helps a lot.  they get harder as you go through the semester. final is your only test. do well on quizes and you should be fine. you have to go to class.  most of the hw is online and will only take 15 min.

Great professor, one of the most helpful I've had.  Explanations are very clear, much better than the book's.  I didn't read much of the text, just because she did such a good job of explaining the material.  Takes work, but overall great class.

She is a great teacher! Really makes you understand the material. All of the homework and practices quizes are really helpful.  The final is NOT that hard, it is basically just a summary of the homwork and quizes. Her office hours are really nice and helpful aswell.

Easy class to take, she is a nice teacher but the lectures can be really boring and repetitive.  She gives out practice quizzes and most the time the actual quizzes are exactly the same. No reading for this class.
She's a great prof but the quizzes are graded a little harsh. But overall economics is an easy class which involves little studying.
She's a fun teacher, but very thorough. She's tough, but she cares about her students. I would recommend her.
she is real coo but if you don't like being called on and a unch of quizzes don't do it to yourself. do the homework and study for the quizzes you shold be good.

Amazing pofessor, awesome person.  Has a lot of quizzes instead of tests.  She is always in her office willing to help and offers tutors names.  The only set back is there is too much class involvement instead of her lecturing to the class, which makes some topics very confusing!
TAKE HER. She is a great teacher and explains things very well! She is very willing to help people when they ask. If you dont understand she is very quick to clear things up! TAKE HER!

TAKE HER!! shes a great teacher. yeah, some of the topics are tough, but its college. she is ALWAYS willing to meet with you. GO IN AND MEET WITH HER!! i went about once a week. shes awesome. by far the best micro teacher on campus.
Discussion-based and interesting class.  I'd recommend her for this and for econometrics.
Her lectures are pretty interesting and she makes the corniest jokes! Her quizzes are fairly easy and homework is a cinch.
She's helpful and she is a goofy/smartassy which makes it fun for me. Not too bad lookin either. Be ready to work for your grade but hey you should expect to do that in college anyway.
Dr k is great!  She really explains this confusing stuff well!  Her class isnt too easy but not too tough
Teaching is very structured and once you figure out what to study it is a very easy class.  She is definitely very nice, but sometimes a little unclear in her lectures.
Pretty difficult class. Leads you to believe you will do well on the final, but it is completely different from reviews.
Worst teacher at TCU...Save yourself from this class.
she is a nice person but her final is IMPOSSIBLE.......do not take this course, i went to every class and took notes and did well on the quizzes but the final brought me wayyyyy down
Take someone else! She grades your quizzes based on how much she likes you.  Her final was very hard!!!!!!!

I retook econ afer her.  I went in a couple of times for help and really didnt get much. She pretty much sucks!  Any other econ teacher would be a 100% improvement.  I dont think more that 10 or 15% of her students get A's.
i retook econ after her class and trust me there are way easier teachers...timed quizes suck and you only have a final.
amazing teacher! hard but you'll learn a lot. definitely work the problems in the book and practice quizes

Dr. K knows more about statistics than anyone I have ever met. Her class was extremely difficult, however.  This is because she is so brilliant and it's hard sometimes to keep up with her. But, all you need to do is find her during office hours for help.

This class is so hard. Only 15% of her students get A's. If you want to learn a lot, but don't care about your GPA, stay in her class. If you want a good GPA, get out while you still can! She explains well, but is a REAL technical grader.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!! Very confusing and she never explains anything completely. No test, only 7 quizzes that are impossible (she's a very technical grader). You'll be miserable in that class.
She is hard don't take her intro class unless you really have an interest in econ.  She is a great lady who loves to help, but she is demanding.  I loved her.
This class is very hard.  You have to go to class and study a lot!!!  Do not take this class unless you plan to study all the time!
take some else!!
The class is hard, but Dr. Klopfenstein is really nice and if you go to her office hours, she will answer any questions that you need.
she picked favorites but she was nice

Dr. Klopfenstein is the most professional statistician I have ever met.  Really nice and happy to talk with a student by email/after class. She expects a lot out of a student to earn an A, though so don't slouch in Dr' K's class!

the class starts out pretty easy, but then gets harder.  she is very nice though and the class isn't too boring; she keeps it interesting. you don't have  tests - you have 7 quizzes and then a final that counts 30%.  so it's pretty spread out.

Dr. Kojola is really nice and talks about interesting and relevant topics in class. He gives you the textbook for free. There is only one test that requires a lot of studying and then the final is an 8-12 page research proposal. He gives a lot of feedback and I highly recommend going to office hours to get a better grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Really nice guy, cares a lot about this class. Dont really need to attend class to get a good grade, but everyone does out of respect. Would take again if you want a decent teacher (not the best but definitely not the worst)

Dr. Kojola is very caring & passionate about sociology. I personally took this class because I thought it would be interesting and relevant, and it was, but the subject matter was overwhelming at times. Like any honors class there is a good amount of reading, but nothing too overwhelming. Great professor and definitely take him!

Class based on reading quizzes, discussion posts & tests mostly. Lectures are helpful and explain what can be confusing content. Can do well if you are willing to put in the time and pay attention. Straightforward, smart, entertaining professor, recommend for this class!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Loves what he teaches and very entertaining. Go to office hours hes really helpful and wants you to do well. Attendance isnt mandatory but its helpful to go bc tests are over class info
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: You can tell JJ really loves what he does. Only like 55% of the grade is tests which is nice, attendance is optional but being in class is really helpful, especially b/c he doesn't test over book material not covered in class. This class is a lot more math than I thought but we do a lot of examples in class and he gives optiona practice homework
Very good teacher. Enthusiastic about his work and seems to care about his students. Class material can be tough but it is definitely doable. Highly recommend.

This class is extremely boring, but Kovach is very passionate about what he teaches. He also doesn't grade too hard and as long as you study the powerpoints he gives out, the tests come directly from those so you will do well on the tests.
This professor is extremely hard. If you are not at all interested in supply chain, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. His tests are hard, and he has pop quizzes in 90% of his classes. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: JJ is awesome, he is very passionate about teaching and wants you to love what he teaches even though he knows you might not. He gives about 15 pop quizzes which are a little difficult if you don't review material after every class, the 2 lowest are dropped and we've had a few purely attendance quizzes. Tests are okay if you study really well.

BEST TEACHER EVERRRRRRRR!!  About 15 pop quizzes throughout the semester about the lecture from the class before. Really loves to teach and passionate about supply chain. Tests are completely manageable if you study hard.

I think she is a great teacher. I had her for Theories of Mass Communication. She has great feedback and is willing to help you if you ask for it. Try to be friends with her. She loves participation. We hardly used the book except for class.

Reporting is demanding of time but you learn a lot about the field and get great experience. Dr. K seems intimidating at first but is very helpful & always makes time to help her reporters. Pace yourself and you'll be fine - you'll come out a better reporter and you'll feel more comfortable writing after it all!
Dr. Kowalewski's class is not easy, but that's because she wants you to have some real world experience. It's demanding, but you'll come out a better reporter.

Reporting, super hard and I have learned nothing, obviously only take it if it is your major and get ready for a semester from hell. She is useless when it comes to help and super misleading HUGE workload, good luck

Lauren is incredible! As someone who was dreading my art credit, I am so happy this is what I took. You get to work with children and develop a variety of skills. It will seem like a lot but it really isn't. TAKE BASICS IN ART!
this course is beneficial for an education major

Lauren is awesome! She is super helpful and all you have to do is ask if you are confused about something! Basics 10803 is an ART ED class. you get to learn about teaching kids and its awesome and so much fun!
She always takes the time to be sure that our questions are answered. She is genuine, accessible and knowledgeable.

I thought Professor Knarr was an amazing teacher, he requires you to have pretty good attendance and to absorb at least some of his instruction. His class was one of my favorites and was quite easy. Definitely take his class!

Professor Knarr's class is very much a challenge.  If you don't show up to class he gets upset and it shows on your grade. He is very helpful but it is a very high standard class. I didnt show up enough to pass though. Overall he is a good professor, but the class is for those who want a challenge.
I loved Professor Knarr! His classes were itneresting and fun to be in.  Hes a jokester and really loves what he does. The tests are easy if you put in the appropriate effort
His class was tough to say the least. His expectations of his students are admirable, but surely detrimental to their grades. I recommend him only for those that like a challenge.

She grades some assignments tough, but if you do what she's asking, you will get 100% on them. Two tests aren't that hard if you study. Yes she goes through lectures too fast, but you can tell her to slow down and ask questions. She gives way more time in class for group project now. If you read the articles you get a great participation grade.

RE Valuations: Great at lectures, answers questions, material isn't easy but I don't think that's a reflection of the professor and I think she makes it easy with great lectures. Doesn't answer emails so knock out any questions you have in class, and participation is key. READ THE ARTICLES.

Unfortunately, she is the only professor for RE Val. Rushes thru slides so fast that you won't learn anything. Project is awful. You have one week to do something that takes 12-15 hours, with no explanation on how to do it, on a platform that doesn't work. She is accessible outside of class, but she is EASILY THE WORST TEACHER I've had in Neeley.

Had her for RE val. Smith is super knowledgeable and well connected in the DFW CRE world, but her class was terrible. Super disorienting, unclear and minimal instructions on assignments that were then graded harshly as if she gave specific details of what she wanted. Lectures? Good luck. Like you put youtube playback on 2.5x speed for heaps of info
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: I don't understand the bad reviews. Had her for REV last semester and yes, the class is a lot of work, but if you do it, you truly will learn things that you will carry on for other classes and the real world. Is she passive aggressive, yes, but in this class that works. She is accessible, it is a lot of work, but it is a great class.

Had her for RE Valuation. I don't understand all the bad reviews. She shows up with energy every day, cares about her students, and wants everyone to get the most out her class. If you pay attention in class, it's really not that hard.
Avoid if possible

Professor Smith is Amazing and very friendly, super easy to talk to. This is just a difficult Neeley class in general. One of my favorite professors I've ever had. Genuinely interesting and easy at the same time. Take her she is the sweetest!

TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!! Easiest A ever. Just do the assignments and you'll get a 100% on everything pretty much. Very funny and very nice professor.

Best Literature Professor you can choose from. reviews.comment: Super easy and interesting class. Shes a great professor and really seems to care for her students.

She offers plenty of extra credit and make up days for you to earn back points you may have lost. IF YOU TURN IN EVERYTHING YOU WILL HAVE A 100.
