reviews.comment: HE IS MY FAVORITE TEACHER!!!! His office hours are GREAT. He is SO HELPFUL if you ask questions He does have a heavy accent although it is not an issue. The powerpoints are clear and not too long. Attendance is a grade although it a great grade buffer. He goes over questions in class that are exactly on the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Korie is passionate about sociology and cares for the success of his students. I learned a lot about sociology in his class and I will recommend him to my friends.

Dr. Korie is one of the best professors at TCU, and I am happy that I am taking a sociology course from him. The power points he provides makes it easier to follow along with his lectures. Although he has an accent, he explains his lectures in a way its easy to understand. Hes great a professor!

His lectures are interesting, and he provides clear expectations for his class. Class attendance is mandatory, and if you study the power points and take good notes in the class, you will do well without the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Korie is very funny, however he speaks poor English and his tests are also in broken English. So Many lectures and class participation is something you have to do every week. I wrote him an email about my grade and he sent me a nasty and super rude email. Do not take Dr. Korie.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Did not use the textbook once, all the tests are based off his powerpoints. If you don't show up to class he will make it very hard for you to get a good grade. Overall, show up to class and study his powerpoints for tests and you will do just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He says the textbook is required for the course but I didn't buy it since his tests pull info from the lectures. I was able to make a B without the textbook. He takes attendance everyday so you have to come to class. Participation grades are taken once every week. There is a research paper at the end of the course & he made the final exam optional
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Korie was a great professor. The Intro to Sociology class I took for him was harder than I expected but I still managed to get a high B in the class. He really does care about his students, but make sure you come to class because he does take attendance. And don't hesitate to participate either because he does give credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Kids take him for SOCI 20213 definitely best option at TCU. Don't buy textbook its a waste of money and you are not required to use it (another TCU professor wrote it thats why they push it). He is kind, and although VERY strict on attendance will be understanding if you have a legitimate excuse. Do amazing on paper it will bump grade!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is very knowledgeable and uses different examples and scenario to simplify his teaching. I like his class. However, he is very strict when it comes to attendance, and you will lose points on class assignments for skipping class. It happened to me.

Professor Korie does a great job of using questions in the middle of his teaching to make sure we understand his lectures. Open discussions in the class were very helpful. His guidance and support in the research paper helped me to make 95 percent, and hes very fair in his grading.

I took Professor Kories class based on a recommendation from a friend. I am glad I took his class. His teaching is very dynamic and engaging. He is also a very nice person. Hes one of the best professors I have had at TCU. I highly recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Korie teaching style is amazing! Hes very good at explaining things to everyones understanding. He has built-in questions in the power points to make sure that we understand the material. The class discussions and videos helped me to expand my understanding. Hes one of the best professors I have had at TCU.

Lectures were interesting and easy to follow, and power points are very helpful. Professor Kories knowledge is well rounded, and he incorporates some other elements into his class discussion, helping his students become more knowledgeable. I really like the fact that his exam questions are based on what he taught in class.

How this very poor quality community college teacher got a professor's job at TCU is astounding to me. My class only had 1 week to write our research paper while the same class an hour later than us and on the same schedule had an extra month to write theirs. His test questions are incomprehensible and arbitrary. Good luck, you'll need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Korie is a great teacher. His teaching is very engaging and easy to follow. He's very approachable and willing to help students to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The class itself is very easy as there is not much work to be done outside of the exams and the research paper, however, the exams are quite difficult and based heavily on material said in class, rather than on the powerpoints.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Caring about the inability to attend class, as long as you email him. His strong accent may be hard to understand at times, but tests are not complicated. Research paper restricts writing freedoms, and he grades based on the use of correct sources rather than actual argument within the essay. I got a bad grade due to this essay.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Bailey is an amazing teacher, and she makes it very clear what is expected during class. She has helped me a lot in figuring out how to learn about different outlets on campus during her UNLF class. I would highly recommend this class and Professor Bailey as the professor.

I LOVED Bailey!! She is so funny and you can tell she is super smart and educated on the topics she teaches. She encourages really good class participation and is just the coolest! No essays or super hard assignments too!

Professor Bailey's dedication to the class and passion for sociology was apparent throughout the class. I enjoyed her teaching style and how much she encouraged class participation and diverse ideas. The tests weren't too difficult but look out for extra credit opportunities at the beginning of the semester.

She is amazing, her lectures are incredible. Explains in a way that I can remember and understand the topics. And as a professor she takes care of her students in all aspects not just academic. For sure you need to study before class and quizzes but worth it.
She puts music and the golden girls before class

Professor Bailey was an amazing professor! She is really good at engaging the class with questions that can sometimes be hard to answer. I am not one to normally speak in class but she made students feel like they should express their thoughts on different topics so that the class could discuss. I would definitely recommend taking this class!!

Professor Bailey is an AMAZING professor! This class has been my favorite this semester and in my opinion this class was one of the least heavy I've had. Reading the textbook is very important and is needed to take weekly quizzes. Extra credit opportunities are also available, show up to class because she doesn't provide PowerPoints and take notes.

Professor Bailey has really good lectures that are understandable. You do definitely have to read the textbooks to do well on the exams, but overall the class it pretty interesting. She also has hidden extra credit to do so pay attention to that!

I love Professor Bailey! I had her for intro to sociology and then social problems the following semester. I wish she taught more sociology classes for me to take! Definitely need to show up and participate in the conversation, but not a ton of out of class work other than readings and quizzes on readings. 10/10 recommend her classes!
Bailey is the sweetest! Tests are not difficult if you study exactly what she said in class. Make sure to be in class to take notes because she doesn't post power points online.

Professor Bailey's intro to sociology class is a good class. She is very clear on what she expects out of you and how to succeed. Attendance is not mandatory but it is very beneficial to attend all the lectures because she does not post the PowerPoint. Take notes and stay focused. Not a lot of homework either.
I loved professor Bailey's class! Yes you must participate and attend class to do well, but she makes it easy as her lectures are interesting. Just take notes and you will do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Kurk Gayle is a great professor! His course provided room for critical thinking in the readings/annotations and collaboration with fellow peers in class discussions. I would definitely register for another course taught by him!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Gayle is a very kind and caring professor. His class was really interesting and made me challenge some of my long-held beliefs, which I consider a great thing.
DO NOT TAKE DR. GAYLE
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Gayle taught a very engaging master's level course that I thoroughly enjoyed. Despite knowing little about translation when I entered this course, I leave it with confident knowledge and successful application of this skill. Class followed a seminar format where classmates peer-evaluated and learned from each other. Highly recommend taking!

Dr Gayle crafted an amazing course that was appropriate for a graduate level course. It focused on theory in the beginning then practical application in the second half. Everything in the theory portion set the students up well to put their translation skills to work on the poem project.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He may be tough, but he clearly explains on why you made a bad grade. Very engaging, and understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He's very literal, and Google Translate does infact help in the end. Best to write everything in MLA, copy and paste the body and cited work inside the section you write in, then add the .docx file to the attachment. His introduction videos do not help and lack a lot of instructions and understanding about our assignments. Take lots of screenshots.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: When he said 2 full pages he means 2 full pages. You're not allowed to be a sentence, a word, or even a letter off. The syllabus is general, but not as general as his rubric. Expect to fail in the first half of the semester. Take tons of screenshots of emails and instructions that he gives you, and forward them to your advisor if needed.

Professor Gayle is a tough grader. Everyday there is an assignment due. You will utilize the discussion board everyday and he does expect a lot of participation with proof to backup what you post. Gives chance for extra credit. He cares about his students and will email you if he feels you forgot about something. He is always available to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: There's a lot of outside work to do for the class, but he's super helpful when it comes to discussing project ideas and making suggestions for improvement. The projects themselves aren't too difficult. He's fairly flexible and will make sure enough time is allotted for each one. If you put in any effort to work with him, you'll do just fine.

Took this class for a humanities credit that double-dipped and I enjoyed it a lot! Until the new media project he assigns in mid October, lectures in class go by sort of slowly, but if you pay attention to his analysis of the poems you go over and study for the first test, you'll make a good grade. Only tests are the midterm and the final. No book.

This was my senior seminar. Dr. Rode is an excellent professor, very helpful, and let  you develop an idea tailor made for you. If you are an English/Writing major, you'll probably be taking him. No need to dread him.

Very knowledgeable, patient, supportive. Intelligent and thoughtful input and guidance. Personable. Talented poet himself. Taught new media for poetry (video, PowerPoint, PhotoShop) and allowed class time to learn and practice it. Even if you?ve never written or read poetry, I highly recommend his class.

I took his american poetry class in the summer for the WEM credit & am so glad I did! I hate writing & there was hardly any writing in this class. Must buy text books & go to class. Very interesting class. Highly recommend it for a summer class & WEM credit!

He is my overseeing professor for an honors project. Great professor! Always trying to give me ideas to make my project better! Doesn't attempt to step on your toes, but he isn't afraid to throw his ideas out there. Very knowledgeable. Have no idea what he is like in the classroom, but he seems like a great teaching professor.

I took his intro to poetry class & absolutely loved it & him, he made my respect for poetry so much greater, his class isnt very hard esp if u show him u care. You get to make really cool movie projects and only have to write one paper so its really not that bad, esp compared to the other lit classes.Loved it great teacher he makes funny jokes too!

Has a very high-and-mighty attitude and tells students that they don't know anything about poetry. I could not stand his demeaning attitude towards his students. Also just FYI most poems are available online.

Dr. Rode is a good professor. His lectures are very in-depth, and he comes off as a very honest person. However, the times I have met with him one on one have felt a bit awkward. He is a fair grader, and I would recommend him to anyone looking for a good English professor.
I'm a writing major because of this class. If you need any tips on your writing Dr. Rode will help. Very easy class otherwise.

For the most part its an easy class. But on the first day he randomly chooses a couple students to hate. I was one of them & all my other teachers like me so he is just weird. He ignores students when they ask for help and is biased in grades depending on if he likes you. DO NOT TAKE HIM!!!!!!!!!!

Hottie!!! Great teacher, amazing guy. Possibly the best teacher I've had so far. Do the work, and write like you mean it. He's soooo much fun, and whether or not you have a real interest in writing poetry, his critques will improve your work substantially. I can't wait to take another one of his classes.
Loved the class. I'm not an English person but the class was very interesting for me. I love how people analyze the poems. I HIGHLY recommend him.
Took hjim for American lit over the summer. Great class!
Rode is one of my all time favorite profs. I highly suggest that anyone interested in a poetry class should hit up Rode. (He knows his stuff!)   I give Rode an A+

Good choice for Soph. Comp.  I also took him for poetry and liked that one just a little better.  He's pretty easy-going and helpful.  Just do the work in this class--which isn't undoable--and you should do fine.  He tries and does a good job to make class interesting, even if it is Soph. Comp.
He is really helpful, he will make you come see him about papers and help with revising. He also plays the bass guitar, so if you do also, take him.
probably the best english teacher you can take if youre looking for a small amount of work, not difficult to make an A
Great teacher, if you arent afraid to speak up in class you will get an easy A/B, really likes for students to think out of the box.  One of the best teachers on campus, just work with him.
yes
sexy sexy sexy sexy!

Dr. Rode is truly a great professor.  He is very willing to help you with every assignment. You have to put SOME effort out in order to make the class enjoyable. Tests are fairly easy and there are two papers which are fairly easy, too. Make sure you are there on the day that he discusses "Wishes for sons"!! You will die laughing!

really great professor! i HATE writing papers & was not looking forward to this class, but he made it enjoyable. considers pushing back deadlines, is flexible with students, will really work with you if you ask for advice, is humorous & really tries to relate to students. i strongly recommend him.

I was apprehensive about taking this class, I hate english. I am a staunch republican, but found the class worthwhile during an election year. It was cool to write about what was actually going on in the world. He relates very well with students and that makes him pretty cool.

lots of essays, changes syllabus a lot, topics are very vague, and talks a lot...very boring class. if you want to get your money worth and learn something then don't take this class but if you need an easy blow off class then by all means take it.

I really liked his class. As long as you participate in class & discussions, he's an easy A/B. He didn't give tons of work & I did fine on the papers b/c I went in & got advice alot. He likes to know that you're interested & willing to work hard.

Class has mostly been a giant debate of bush vs. kerry. (ill let you guess what this liberal arts teachers leans towards.)All we have done this semester is what partisan documentaries supporting his candidate.unclear about what he expects of you, but an easy grader. mixed feelings about this class.

Possibly the best English professor I have had thus far.  Extremely interested in what he is doing, always willing to help out.  Stresses ideas.  May not like particular styles, but never grades unfairly against them.
This class SUCKED . . he is the most boring teacher ever..i thought i liked poetry before this class.... i hate it now.  the quizzes and papers suck and he never makes sense.  dont take this class

NICE GUY! But, I HATED his class. He is very hard to understand and does not clearly communicate what is expected. He taught INTRO poetry like a graduate course. I DO NOT think this class is an easy A or B. Also, you will never make a 20/20 on homework.
Dr. Rode is the bomb. Sooo incredibly easy and understanding and nice.  I felt like I was writing for one of my teachers in Middle School.  TAKE THIS GUY--YOU ARE GUARANTEED AN A !!!!
He is an interesting teacher, who doesn't grade too hard, but can be a little unclear. Participate in class discussions and voice your opinion a lot! He is and easy B!!!
He makes you love poetry and challenges you as a writer thats amazing!
Y'all missed out. He's retiring after this semester. So glad I took him. He is a fantastic professor.

If you need a lit credit, TAKE THIS CLASS. Super easy. He gives you the questions that will be on the test and the answers too. all you have to do is memorize and regurgitate. You have to do all the readings though because there are daily quizzes. totally worth it though.

Dr. Kuhne is awesome. Hes really funny and tells you EXACTLY what will be on the tests. Hes really nice and usualy lets you out early but skipping class lowers your grade because there are daily quizzes he gives out..which are easy if you have done the reading

I took Major American Writers with Dr.Kuhne and it was so easy! He tells you the exact questions that are going to be on the test. He is also really funny and really loves what he does. The only thing that sucks about this class is if you skip class it tends to lower your grade because you have quizzes almost everyday.take this class if you can!

I took Major British Writers w/ Kuhne. Worst mistake ever! The professor talks w/ his eyes closed and sweats profusely. Students doze off even when the readings are interesting. A complete disaster! Take a different professor if you want to enjoy this class (and get a decent grade).

I have now taken 2 of Dr.Kuhne's classes. Freshman comp seminar and intro to fiction. He's awesome. Basically what everyone else here says is right. He's a really funny guy, usually in a sarcastic way. You cant go wrong with him.

Dr Kuhne is the nicest guy ever!!! kind of clueless at times and opinionated but if you get on his good side, you will be set for life.  Just be responsible, come to class, and engage in discussions.  He's an easy grader and I thought the material was interesting.  Really understanding too. No tests or quizzes EVER!!! TAKE HIS CLASS!

I loved his class. I took his freshman seminar and love his teaching style.  We read 5 books and wrote a paper after each of them. Attendance is important to him so make sure you go, or let him know if you cant be there. Skipping class lends to a lower grade.  he is very helpful! I would take him again in a heartbeat!

Dr. Kuhne is amazing! He will go an extra mile to help any of his students on an assignment! I would HIGHLY recommend taking his class! He cracks funny jokes from time to time that keep class interesting.

Horribly boring class...I took a Brittish Literature class before so I thought it would be a great class to take. Very easy assignments and quizzes, but he doesn't seem to know the readings very well.  Classes consist of quizzes and summarizing what we already read--nothing special.
Great guy/class, helpful, easy quizzes (if you read), great test setup (if you like essay format), gives you test questions before test, one 1500 word paper, EASY B, fairly easy A.

This guy has one of the easiest Literature classes ever. If you do not ace this class you are either too lazy to read 15 pages a day, or too stupid to go to class and write down what the test questions are before the test day. His research paper is easy, I turned in my first draft and recieved a B on an F worthy paper.
nicest guy ever! several quizzes but they were EASY! tests are easy, he gives you the questions beforehand. 1 paper, easy. class is a tad boring, but hes so nice it doesnt matter. take him!!!

He is the nicest teacher  I have ever had in my life. He really cares about his students. I think he is one of the best teachers at TCU and I cant say enough great things about him, He is awesome. I hate Literature and he made it not bad.

Dr. Kuhne is the MAN! Anyone who is going to take a sophomore or freshman comp class should try and get into his class. His is soo cool. If you work hard and come to class, he will help you out. He is always willing to help, and I really learned how to write a research paper.

Dr. Kuhne was awesome!!  He was funny, always on mark, fair, and really helpful.  Try to get into one of his classes.  This one was especially an easy A.  Go to class, read some fun books, and have good grammer=A in the class.  Highly Highly Recommend!!!!!
Real easy just have good grammer he will say the content is good no matter what you say.  Take his class even he will tell you its a easy A.

Dr. Kuhne is very nice and understanding.  If you need an extension on a paper just email him with a lame excuse, he'll believe you!  He's very easy, and on top of that he's a very nice and funny guy.

Dr. Kuhne is so funny! He's such an awesome prof. his class is so easy and he gives you as much time as you need to do any paper he assigns. He always has something interesting to say. he tends to go off on tangents but over all, fun and easy!

You need to apply yourself to get the grade you want, and understand the topics to an extent to where you can apply it on an exam. He makes it seem like the exam will be over few things and vocab words but also everything he says verbally is what will be on the exam. Really nice and attendance is mandatory however it did take so much work for an A
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hard class.

I have to agree with everyone that he's an amazing teacher and nice guy… but that's about it. The grading is so iffy and I'm considering using my first pass/credit. Really nice lectures and I enjoy the class and the topics, but the grading. So bad.

He's nice but is a horrible grader. He acts like he's really chill and not a super tough grader but he is. He is extremely lecture heavy, and even taking notes and paying attention I get bad grades. Be warned

He is a really awesome teacher, but such a tough grader. I study around 5-6 hours for the tests, take notes and pay attention in class. I still end up with 75-80s and I do exactly as he asks etc. and typically I go above and beyond in his tests / mapping assignments.

A lot of dense information, but if you apply yourself, then it shouldn't be hard. Assignments have clear instructions and there isn't something every week. Attendance is just a simple assignment that's a completion grade.

The class is straightforward, just sit, listen, and take notes everyday, which is my preferred style of learning. Lectures are interesting, and in-class assignments are easy credit. I appreciate the detailed instructions for the mapping assignments. Easy class, got an A on all three exams. Dr. Walker is also kind and has a great sense of humor.

The class is easy if you actually pay attention and show up to every single class ready to learn. I did not do that as you can tell by my grade. Great guy but had to use my first P/NC which really surprised me looking at the other reviews. Each test is 25% of your grade - no room for a bad grade!
He's great! super passionate about his class and makes lectures easy to understand. He also assigns "lab time" where he lets us work on our homework for the week. Would take again!

An Urban World was super enjoyable because of Dr. Walker! He is such a sweet, nice guy who genuinely cares about his students and is extremely interested/knowledgeable in the course material. If you do the mapping assignments, pay attention during lectures, and show up to class, you should get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Walker for Urban World was pretty good. Fascinating course subject, imo. Mostly consists of tests and a few mapping projects. Attendance is a huge part of your grade (20%) and each day missed is 1.25% off your final grade. Lectures are very polished. Tests are very easy. Doesn't care about electronics in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great intro to GIS class. No textbook(s) needed, he provides links for the required readings. Labs are fairly easy to complete with his lab walkthroughs. Assignments were a challenge, but not overly difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The class wasn't that difficult as long as you attended class and took notes. His presentations had the basic topics, but most information needed for the exams were spoken in class. Textbook isn't required.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Good class... really useful skills that you can put on your resume pretty much immediately! Dr. Walker is really sweet and definitely knows his stuff. Lectures arent the most riveting, but the labs are generally useful & he walks you through them step-by-step. His tests are very straightforward. Projects are a lot of work, but satisfying to finish
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Walker's an all time favorite. Ask him about coaching youth sports.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: Dr. Walker is a real gem. I have taken every class that I've been able to from him (most of them have been requirements for my major). He's one of the biggest reasons for why I got interested in the geography department. If you're a student who is considering taking one of his classes I would strongly recommend you to do so. You won't regret it!

Dr. Walker does a really great job of making the material interesting and he seems very knowledgeable! The 3 exams are pretty easy- some terms, map identification and a couple of short answer. If you pay attention in class, they shouldn't be a problem. And the final is not cumulative! Also, never opened my textbook

One of my favorite classes I've taken at TCU so far, Dr. Walker made world regional geography an actually interesting topic. There were a few homework assignments and 3 big tests, but the final was not cumulative and as long as you go to every class and take notes you should do well on the exams. Highly recommend this class/ professor.

This class consists of very vague powerpoints with heavy spoken lectures. You have to be attentive from the minute class starts until it ends to get all of the information you need down. He is a super cool teacher. The online mapping assignments are the worst and are time consuming but other than those this is an easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He just lectures all class, so write everything down then go from there. He does random in-class assignments and just lectures so you CANNOT skip class
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I am a geography major and have taken all of the classes I can from Dr. Walker. Great teacher who really knows his stuff and cares about student success. Graded material is not difficult if you do the work. 10/10 would recommend to a friend.

He is very clear since the beginning of the semester: If you go to class, you'll have a good grade. In-class assignments are easy points and his lectures are online but not specific, so you need to go to class. The mapping assignments are straight-forward and his exams are easy if you answer all of his study guide. Format is constant which is good.

Professor Walker made me interested in Geography, something I thought could never happen. The class is easy if you go everyday and take notes. Yes prepare for the tests, but I'm sitting with a 95% in the class right now. Don't waste your money on the book, I have not opened it once.

Dr. Walker was one of the easiest professors I have taken at TCU! World geography is a bit of a dry subject but he tries to make it interesting with cool videos and charts. Tests are super easy and right off the study guide. Must go to class, as test material comes from lectures. The easiest class I've taken at TCU.

Walker is an amazing professor! He loves the subject & has his PhD in it but looks 23. There are only 3 tests, and a handful of assignments which are clear- cut. Make sure you go to class because all the information for the test is in his lectures. I bought the textbook but never even had to open it so save your money, you dont need it.  Take notes

Professor Walker is very excited about geography. MUST PAY ATTENTION IN CLASS. Although there is a study guide provided (3-4 days before test), tests are hard! If you do not pay attention in class and take your own notes, then you will fail. Hardly opened textbook. Do not rely on his powerpoints online - vague!
Great class and excellent teacher!

Kyle Walker is a great teacher and I would recommend him if youre going to show up to every class because although he has powerpoints, you won't know what they mean unless you take notes about them in class. Doesn't really repeat himself during the lecture. Super nice, helpful, clear speaking, easy to understand. Tests are a bit challenging
Kyle is the best. He is utterly awesome. That is all I need to say. Take him and you will not regret it.

Easy class, not much from the reading. Exams and projects are easy. Go to class because he gives in class assignments for attendance and they help your grade. Also, he is very nice to look at for the full hour and 20 min class. Take him!

Took him for media milestones. He showed some of the most inappropriate shows and movies I have ever seen, things that should not be allowed in a college classroom (or anywhere frankly). If you don't talk at least 3 times a class, you will get a bad participation grade. Avoid taking him if you can.

Dr. Hart is an expert in his field and it shows by his text, questions, and class material. American Cinema is the most interesting class I took at TCU. Do the reading, participate in class, put forth effort in the papers, and you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Must Participate. Lost 3 percent in class grade for not talking in one class period. Terrible movie selection, if you take this for an elective choose another one. He does not care how you contribute to the discussion, but you must contribute. Do not take if you will not talk in class. Chill teacher, but terrible movies and papers made it a no-go.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Hard, Weird and Interesting. BIG on Participation, judgemental at times.  This is prof worth meeting with outside of class if you wan to succeed.  Really wants you interact in class discussions. Grades you every class on discussion so speak up. Pop quizzes, Weird and disturbing choice of films but thats the point of the class.  MALA 60970

Weird movie taste, but a pretty good professor. He's very organized and a fair grader. He allowed us the option to choose two out of four assignments to complete for the second half of the semester. Grades fairly on papers as long as you're providing insightful analysis. There are random pop quizzes and he can be harsh on participation.

I was expecting this class to be difficult because he is the head of the department, but in reality the class was not too bad. The films we watched at the beginning were fairly boring, but towards the end of the class they get better. Dr. Hart is very helpful and will read through the drafts of the papers you write and gives useful feedback.

Fantastic teacher but very hard. His class is laid back and easy going but you MUST participate and speak up in class, in order to do so you MUST read the packet he gives you, since the class in only once a week its not a difficult task but the things you learn in this class as so interesting and helps you to think critical about film
I had him for Media Analysis. He is super funny and has a great personality. He shows some controversial films and is a tough grader, but he's fair.

Carmen is super fun and energetic about what she teaches. I took Digital Blackness with her and as long as you did the assignments you got 100%. I would go to class as much as you can because she will lower your grade. She is very understanding though!

reviews.comment: Such a fun class. Not hard at all. It's all about creativity and she gives a lot of busy work assignments, but there are two deadlines per semester. No tests just participation. She gets to know everyone right away so she does notice if you are gone and you can lose points for not coming to class. She does take the whole hour.

Amazing teacher with great insight. The class isn't hard at all, you have 2 deadlines to turn work in, extra credit, attendance doesn't affect you, and late work isn't counted against you. Keep an open mind in this class and you'll do great. You will read a lot and be prepared to do a group assignment
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Loved Professor Carmens class this semester! Although online she made the class if like we were connected! Its a fun class to be in and you learn tons of new things. If you like music & writing this is the class for you!

Weekly quizzes and homework (homework is basically completion), but I'm not sure what else you would expect from a math class. Moves slowly through lectures, often pauses for questions, and provides extra examples; very accessible via email. Provides exam reviews. Very sweet, and effective teacher. Great choice for MTH credit.

One of the best math professors at TCU - quiz and test questions are straight from the lectures - she does a really good job at going through notes slowly and making sure she answers any questions you have - gives a review day before exams so you get to ask questions - super easy to ask questions outside of class - course material isn't impossible
You have a quiz EVERY single week. You also have a homework assignment every week with 30+ questions each with different parts within it.

Best math teacher I have ever had. I took her for Applied Calc. She is so kind and caring, and really wants you to understand the material. She is great at her job, and in the event you don't understand her lesson, she is so helpful in office hours. I highly recommend her.

Mrs Tierney is a great teacher. There is homework online every week and a quiz a week but if you do the homework and study then you will be fine. 3 tests and a final. The test were challenging but I didn't prepare well but I got an A on the final. She is super nice and super helpful. Take her. She is the best calc teacher and loves teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof Tierney is an ANGEL! I love her so much! I took her for Topics because I didn't need any math creds beyond that, but she teaches Calc as well, to my knowledge. She is so sweet and obviously really cares about her students' success. Very clear when she teaches, and is always making sure everybody understands. Absolutely no complaints!

Mrs. Tierney is the best math teacher I've ever had. The course overall isn't too challenging and Mrs. Tierney is extremely clear when explaining each topic. She is almost always available for office hours but one time she wasn't, and she answered all my questions over email--BLESS. She obviously cares so much about her students and their success!

took this class thinking it'd be easy, not the case. his lectures are boring, just reads off the slides, labs are even worse. I studied a lot of for the first test and got an A with the curve, after that I got lazy and the tests got harder, he's an ok person, but he's the hardest bio issues professor at TCU. lots of clicker questions over reading
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Really salty how this class ended up. I thought this class would be an easy class for non science majors, however, turns out not the case. I absolutely hate the false format used in the tests. Lots of lectures covered in a test, on top of the fact the tests are difficult and even with fair amount of studying still didn't pass his tests.

I took this class because I heard it was easy... NOT the case. All of the tests are which of the following is false format and the questions are super specific. I study a lot and still barley have a B.

Professor Rittby's class is no walk in the park, but if you put in the work, you can succeed. The material is challenging, but she explains it well. Alongside studying the textbook, using tools like Unstuckstudy really helped me prep for the frequent tests and stay on top of the demanding workload.

Prof Rittby's teaching style is a mix of confusion and suffering, where even the Pythagorean theorem feels personally insulted. If you love being miserable than I would highly recommend this class. It blows my mind that she is still employed. She has turned simple pre-calc into rocket science. If you take her, enjoy the blow to your GPA.

I had no other choice but don't believe the rating, Her tests are impossible and you can't get an A. She tells you to study from the Problem Set given but you could study for hours and it's impossible to know what's coming on the tests. Her exams are awful and she doesn't care about her students, WORST TEACHER. If You like failing take her.

I've never met a professor who can be condescending through email, but Rittby somehow manages to do it. Rittby is a "My way or the highway"  math teacher, where if it isn't done exactly how she wants it, you're failing. Tons of homework & quizzes on multiple websites, which quickly becomes overwhelming. Exams are 10x harder than classwork.

Shes not a terrible teacher, she moves extremely fast and her examples are absolutely 10x easier than test problems. Shes the pickiest grader in the world and will take any tenth of a point off that she can make an exucse to do so. literally harderst grader I have ever experienced.
I ended up with an A with little effort and only going to class once a week. Highly recommend her!!! She may give you a lot of homework but it's just because she want you to succeed.

reviews.comment: This class is difficult but manageable. Office hours are a must as everything in this class is accuracy based even written homework. Very picky on work so go over it with her before submitting. Some tests are difficult and some are easy. An A is very achievable but you have to work hard to get it. Very nice teacher though and is there to help you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took her for my freshman year of Applied Precalculus. She gives clear notes on all of the separated courses that are needed to know. There is however lots of homework, and sometimes it get overwhelming because theres so much content. I personally struggle in math, I'm just terrible at it, but she does give you lots of resources to do better.

There is a lot of homework and attendance is crucial in this class.  Despite the material being difficult, she tends to explain things well and cover the necessary material needed to complete the homework.  I would recommend her class but you have to be committed to succeed in it.

I love Rittby. Any calc class will have some tough content, but she is always willing to help you when you're struggling. Go to class, pay attention and go to office hours if you need. I took Rittby for pre calc and calc and I love her for both. Highly reccomend!

Rittby is really good at explaining content. Her lecture notes are always posted after class and have lots of examples, if you can't figure it out from that she is also easy to reach. Yes, attendance is optional but she is very helpful in person.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Be wary of negative reviews. The material is hard, but teaching and communication is superb. This is not just a math class - but a mathematical reasoning class. The professor expects you to demonstrate your understanding... not every problem will look exactly like the practice test. She gets to know her students well in office hours, go to them!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I would recommend Rittby for Applied Calc because her lectures are very thorough and really helps me understand better than what I've heard about other professors. However, there is a lot of homework and lot of tests. It seems like I have a new test every couple of weeks. She also takes points off for every little detail like notation.

Lets just put it this way. I haven't taken this class since I was a freshman (graduating senior now) and my friends still talk about how awful her course was. We go back to reviews from at times to see if she has changed and this is awful. Brutal class, she was extremely rude to us. Looks like still half of each of her classes are still dropping.
Do not take Professor Rittby. This class is hard, and I mean HARD. She teaches well, but she goes extremely fast! It is hard to keep up sometimes, and she grades super tough! I do not recommend!

She is a great professor. Gives a lot of online homework, no textbook. I didn't have to take the final at the end of the year because I had an A in the class. Go to her office hours. Super friendly and willing to help, and will reopen online quizzes if you run out of attempts but know what you did wrong.

1.nice in person but completely rude over email, groupme, and feedback 2.extremely unhelpful if you simply do not understand, she'll make you feel stupid asf 3.the huge load of homework is hard to keep up with due to the fact that she uses 2 different online turn in sites 4.tests will have problems 10x more difficult that youve never even seen b4

Hi, I just got an A+ for this class. To be honest, this class will have a lot of homework to do. But for me it is very easy and don't take a lot of time to complete. In this class, you will need to finish 6 tests and the final. But if you have an A for 5 or 6 tests, you don't need to take the final. This is the great class ever. Take her.

Professor Rittby is a decently nice lady, but her standards are hard to meet. She gives a ton of homework, with six tests and a final in one semester. She grades very tough and takes points off if the work isn't exactly right. If you don't show up to class, good luck. If you aren't willing to work hard, you'll probably fail.

Loads of annoying homework. Gives 0 credit for work that isn't done exactly how she wants it. Horrible at explaining concepts in class. About half the class dropped because it is impossible to get a good grade. You should take any other math teacher if you can. This class kept me up at night because of the tremendous amount of stress it caused me.

Professor Rittby was an incredible Pre-Calculus teacher. She's super understanding and was extremely helpful when I went to her office hours. She's uplifting and it isn't hard to see that she really does care about each and every student she teaches. Definitely recommend her from Pre-Calculus.

Professor Rittby is very nice, and she tries to help you out as much as possible. However, it is impossible to have an A in this class. She grades extremely tough, and there is homework almost every night. Tests are also extremely hard. If you are not willing to put extra work into this class, do not take her.

reviews.comment: Lots of work. If you miss a class you won't pass.

Avoid rittby at all costs. She assigns a ton of homework and its all unrelated to class material and is graded on accuracy. If assignments are turned in a minute late you get no credit and no chance to correct homework. Super strict and hard to communicate with outside of class. Doesn't respond to emails. Hardest grader I've ever had. Stay away.

She is a brutal grader and does not care if you do well. She does not go out of her way to help you. Tests are very difficult and the homeworks are also graded very hard. Even if you get the correct answer you will not get full credit unless you do the problem the exact way she showed in class.
Just choose another teacher

I took Prof. rittby for precalc as well as applied calc. I feel that she is the best calculus teacher at TCU. At first I was in another teachers class but dropped. Prof. rittby goes slow which I love.The class itself is difficult but she gives a ton of partial credit and is very understanding. 2 test plus final, mylab and written homework.

Rittby is a good professor, but a VERY precise grader. The homework is always 10x harder than what she goes over in class. The tests are extremely difficult and gives hardly anytime to study. Avoid taking her for applied calculus if possible.

Lots and lots of material, not a lot of explanation. Be ready to use Khan Academy and have a private tutor on the side. This professor does not curve anything, no matter how the class is doing as a whole.

I reccomend professor Rittby to everyone. I took her for pre calculus this semester and am planning on taking her for calculus next semester. TAKE HER !!

reviews.comment: horrible class, half of my class dropped and I barely passed. I know more than 10 kids that failed the course and have to retake it. Does an awful job of explaining material and grades exams extremely hard. Surprised she still has a job.

she talks all day and gives easy problems in class. the practice tests are not too difficult but they never seem to match the test in terms of degree of difficulty. the test are 10X harder than the practice test which screws a lot of people over because they know the concept but the questions she gives are difficult.

She is a great teacher I'll give her that much. The lectures, and million homework problems come in handy. She made learning Pre-Calc super easy.  My favorite part of the class was that she actually explained why we use specific formulas and rules on the white board.  For the first time in my life I get math.

Took class in summer. I would not recommend this if you want an A. I only received a low A and I worked my tail off to even do that. Work with a group to study and help each other. From what I understand the class is much easier if taken during the normal school year.

Professor Rittby did a really good job.  She explained everything really well and graded leniently.  Overall, she made this class understandable for everybody. Homework isn't very hard and tests comes altered versions of the homework problems.  Take her class, you won't be disappointed.

Class 10054: Really easy class... too easy really. Lost interest quickly because the topics discussed during class were infinitely more basic than some of the homework; led to a few skips. If you're bad with math, though, she's a great teacher, incredibly thorough and really nice.
Take her topics in math class! I am awful at math & she was SO helpful. I took this class for the math credit & am so glad I took it with her. She is so sweet, patient, & will help you out.

Had her for calculus.. so helpful and did a great job at explaining the material. you need to go to class to understand the material..  Im not too good at math and ended up with a B+ definitely take her!

Mrs. Rittby is the best math teacher ever. She explains EVERYTHING and she is very organized and loves all of her students. She will also help outside of class

Mrs. Rittby is a good teacher. I has her for Pre-Calc and am having her Calculus class nest semester with her. It is always clear on the test dates and what assignments are due and when. She is always willing to help you if you need help.

I do not know what the people below are talking about or if she is self-rating, but please listen to this. DO NOT TAKE HER!!!! she is for sure the worst math teacher ive ever had, i know about 8 kids in my class, 7 of which are failing... this class is a waste of time as is she, AVOID if you can
I loved her class she is very organized and helpful.She is clear about the material. Please take her!

I love her! I took calculus the year before and didnt understand anything.  Once taking her class it was a breeze.  I really understand everything that she teaches and the way she explains things makes it enjoyable to learn!

Topics----Amazing Professor! My favorite at TCU! Our grades were the opposite of a bell curve, basically some students got A+'s on all tests and others failed all the tests. There are 4 tests and homework due the day of each test. Helpful and clear professor! Amazing teacher! So nice!
Good teacher, fun and keeps the class going. Tests can be difficult, but they are ok if you study. She is also very helpful out of class if you need help. I would definitely recommend taking Rittby

She is a GREAT teacher, it was my second time taking this class after receiving a D in the first one and with Dr. Rittby as the teacher I got an A-, not too shabby!! Amazing teacher! So willing to help if you come to her. Explains all of the lectures very well. HIGHLY recommend going to class bc you can easily get behind. Go to class and do hw and should get an A!

She is very nice, very smart. She does not care if you do not go to class or not. It is easy, but I like math. I think it is still easy for people who don't. There are 5 tests, so your grade is evenly given. I would recommend her for pre-calc or calc. I would defintely take her again.

I enjoyed this class very much.  She always has her office open if you need help and doesn't make you feel like you're hopeless.  This class is not an easy A, you're going to have to do the homeworks and take notes.  I highly recommend taking any math class that she's available in.

I love Dr. Rittby she is so helpful and so nice.  My class wasnt so great but she handeled it very well.  I would def recomend this prof to anyone!  Nice looking teacher too.

Took it my first semester to get it out of the way because I loathe math.  She's very helpful, easy to understand, and the class really isn't very difficult.  Do the work, study a little for the tests, and you'll do fine.

She's pretty much the best teacher ever! Loved her class. She really simplified instructions so that I sometimes caught myself spacing out but I know it helps a lot of people who do not just love math and struggle with it.

Milos is genuinely one of the nicest people on the planet and he grades easy and is very understanding of you come to him with a problem or a question. Cannot recommend taking his class enough.
MY KINGGGGG I love this man he cares about his students and is soooo interested in this subject. I learned so much in his lab and the activities are always so fun. He is the best. Take his class!!
Very chill guy, show up to class, participate, and do the lab reports, and you should be fine
nice guy, I cried to him after stuttering during a presentation and he was really understanding with me. he's funny but we have essays due every week (not too hard of essay, 500-750 words)
Best prof I've ever had
The BEST professor! He understands school-life balance! His teaching style & instructions are clear from day 1. There's noway anyone could fail this course.

BEST TEACHER AT TCU! Just show up to his classes, and please participate he loves it. He is so so so kind and understanding and makes life so amazing. One of the most genuine people we have left on this planet. I highly recommend it for POB 1 and 2. His assignments are straightforward, the lecture is straightforward, and the final is easy.
Such a kind and intelligent person. TAKE POB if he is the lab teacher. Such an easy class that isn't hard to sit through and is so interesting.

BLESS UP for Milos. He is so kind and personal. Lectures are straightforward and he always tries to make them interactive and fun. You can talk to him about anything and he is so understanding and will meet you where you are. Lab reports and final project.
Very funny and interactive lectures! You can tell he enjoys his job and cares about his students I would definitely recommend

Lack is an AMAZING professor! he is very engaging, funny, and friendly. I took him for POB 1 and now I am retaking him for POB 2 and he is awesome. Very informative and fascinating materials, yet easy. There are lab reports due each week and a final presentation. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
such a fun class! super interesting and very engaging. He cares about his students. Easy class to pass as long as you attend class
Super great professor. I love how interactive his classes were. Really brought pysch to life with physical activities. Very funny and a good lecture  experience.

DON'T TAKE. Refuses to learn how to use D2L or anything online. he has given me a 0 on 3 homework when I had them turned in and it took over 20 emails for him to figure out how to change the grade. I am a straight A student and he is going to give me a B for no reason. he will not respond to emails and is not open outside of class.

Dr. Bradley cares a lot about what he teaches. It is just a challenging course regardless of who is teaching, but he does a good job of being clear and explaining in simple/relatable ways. He is understanding of problems as well. Lots of homework and project milestones though. Really nice guy!
I loved this teacher, He seemed bad at first but once you get to know him, he is a kind human being

his demeanor seems like he would be an easy grader but he is not. exams wanted us to "list the 7 things talked about in this article..." and were lowkey hard. thought my group did great at the final project and we still got a low B. attendance was a sign in sheet

The lectures are extremely long and disorganized, and he does not explain the material clearly. You are expected to teach yourself almost everything for exams and projects, yet projects are graded kind of hard. The lack of guidance makes the course unnecessarily confusing. I would not recommend this class, take someone else if you can.

Drones on and on, his lectures just covering what the readings covered. He never really teaches or explains anything. His tests are hyper specific, so you have to memorize random niche terms and lists from the readings. Also takes forever to get anything back out.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND- Super sweet man! If you ask questions and stay organized, you should be good. He wants you to succeed and he wants you to enjoy BIS. Yes, the lectures are boring, but you'll survive. Homework was a free 100 and exams were a tad hard. Nelson gets all of the good credit, but this is the exact same class, only this one is more chill.
Such a sweet professor, just an unorganized class. But overall super easy and would take again.
Professor Bradley is a very sweet, nice person who is willing to help you. Make sure to follow the schedule and syllabus to do good in class, always ask questions

Not organized with technology at all, locating things through D2L is a headache and you often only find things at least a year old. He doesnt teach material at all either, so if you are interested in the course, take someone else. However if you wanna do the bare minimum and show up twice a week it's a pretty easy B at minimum.

He might not be the best teacher if you really want to learn BIS, but the class is very easy. Homework is super easy, a few free response tests, and semester long group project. You get out early from class very often. Very nice guy if you miss something or are absent.

Sweet old man but no clear instructions. You have to teach the concepts to yourself but honestly they are pretty easy. Really confusing when it comes to due dates but he will work with you if you email him. Overall, kind of annoying class sometimes but super manageable.

He doesn't give clear instructions on assignments and is very confusing on when things are due. The class is manageable however grading is inconsistent. The three exams are easy if you can teach yourself. Really not a bad class and he is a fine professor

Bradley cares a lot about his students however some of the criteria for assignments were confusing and at times unclear but he would always clarify when asked. He sometimes even could even be too accomodating to students who were trying to take advantage of his leniency, but overall he means well. I wouldn't recommend but his class is survivable.

He doesn't really teach anything, you mostly have to figure out SQL, Tableau, and the semester long project on your own. Grading felt very inconsistent, and the schedule/due dates would change about every week which was frustrating to keep up with. But if you and your group are proactive, it will still be pretty easy to get an A.
Doesn't teach much but easy class. 2 free response tests and big group project. Very caring and considerate.

Professor Bradley is an easy professor for Business Information Systems, although he can be unorganized at times he truly cares about his students and them succeeding. Attendance is mandatory and there is a long semester project throughout the course. He is a great teacher to have for BIS!!!
Doesn't really teach much but is very nice and understanding. 2 free response tests and a big group project, you get 100% on all the HW for doing it. Get out of class early every day. Pretty easy
He is nice but doesn't offer a lot of help with the material. You have to teach yourself abt Tableau and SQL. The group project depends on now good of a group you are assigned

Professor Bradley is a sweet man but he is old so he gets confused easily. Overall, the class was pretty easy with 4 tests and weekly homework. The main grade of the class is a semester long group project. Attendance is mandatory but he lets you out early of class almost everyday.  I would take this class is you want an easy BIS class.

I liked Bradley for BIS, but it just depends on whether you get a good group, as a large part of your grade is based on a semester-long group project. You have to do an individual PowerPoint presentation, weekly HW discussions, there are two essay exams that relate to your discussions, an exam on tableau and SQL, and the group project.

Professor Bradley is nice, but BIS is a hard class.  Your course grade largely depends on the group you get assigned to, and how much work each member is willing to put into the group project.  There are tests throughout the semester; they are not too hard as long as you study.  The SQL exam is the only one that is really hard.

Sweet guy but does not know what he's doing. No tech policy, deducts points even tho obvious ur taking notes but doesn't deduct the people who sit in the back of the class on their phones everyday so it all depends on where ur sitting. Grades the final hard & takes off for everything possible so you don't get a good grade. take. someone. else.
The rating on him is not fair for his entry level BIS class. Professor Bradley is extremely nice and is flexible with schedules and grading. Show an effort and receive an A.

Take another BIS professor if you can. You definitely can do well in this class, but you really never know what to expect. I am a really good student and struggle to get an A. He does not teach one thing the whole semester. There are four tests which he does not grade for content, but rather spelling. He is a nice guy, but horrible teacher.
He is so sweet and chill, you work with your group for majority of the class but he is always willing to answer questions and help you

Amazing guy! He fosters an environment that makes you want to learn. Super understanding guy. No exams. Graded on labs (they are actually pretty cool), couple assignments, and a group project. I would take him in a heartbeat :)

Professor Bradley is such a nice man. He loves seeing his students in class every day and loves to discuss what he has been up to. His lectures do not have much structure, written exams, you just need to read the online articles he posts. Class is dependent on who is in your group for the project, but deadlines are still generous. Highly recommend.

He is a very kind man who cares about BIS and doesn't make the class too difficult. The homework involves discussion posts and most the semester is used to work on the semester project which is a digital transformation. I highly recommend taking Professor Bradley for this course!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Bradley cares about his students and will say hello to you each class. The class has 3 tests & one  group project as your final. The last SQL Exam he doesn't teach, and it's quite difficult to learn independently. He takes FOREVER to put in grades which is a hurdle. Our midterm was graded during finals week, so hard to tell your grade.

Professor Bradley is a kind man that is approachable if you have any questions. He will say hello to you at the beginning of every class and will engage in conversation to get to know you. You can tell he is passionate about the class and wants his students to succeed. With that, he does not grade hard and responds to emails quickly.

My friends all took Gray for BIS and they passed without struggling like I did with Bradley. Worst professor I've ever taken, good man but bad at teaching. He's boring and makes the class much harder than it is with other professors and you basically have to self-study for everything. BIS is not easy but Bradley just doesn't make it any better.

Bradley is a kind man just the class kinda sucks. If you don't get in a good group for the semester project and you end up doing the whole thing by yourself the class will be miserable. Getting in a good group with kids who want an A will make this class just fine. Bradley proly the best option for BIS tho

Tbh there are no good BIS teachers here BUT if you go to class, get in a good group for the semester-long project (randomly assigned so it's all luck) and have him know your face you'll do good. BIS classes are bell-curved for Neeley so most kids will be in the B to A- range.

Bradley is a super nice guy. His class influenced me to switch my major to BIS. There is a semester long group project with predetermined groups, so if you have a bad group, you will have a bad grade. Exams are difficult, need to write 1000 words in 50 mins. He probably shouldn't be teaching a tech class, but he is passionate about the class.

I've never had a teacher like Mr. Bradley..he honestly had no idea what he was teaching and was all over the place with due dates and homework. I literally had to teach myself Tableau and SQL because he taught us absolutely nothing. Honestly, just avoid this professor. There are 3 main tests, 1 big group project, and one individual project.

I had to teach myself every aspect of this class. He lectures about material irrelevant to exams. It seems like your grade is based on his feelings that day about you. He ruined the Business Informations System major for me.

Professor Bradley is very nice. The way things are set up in class are very poor though. 2 tests over online readings where you have to type 1000 words in a 50 min class. 3rd test SQL not taught in class have to use Google. Group project 33% of grade not hard but very time consuming. Try a different teacher.

reviews.comment: Layne is a good person to take for BIS. He is not a hard grader, if you see him and talk to him he will try to help you. Also, he's an incredibly nice man so that is always enjoyable to be around.

Professor Bradley is the sweetest and nicest man. Attendance is mandatory, however, you don't do anything in class. Homework and the quizzes are the same as the other BIS professors and are challenging but if you do it with friends you're good. He is the weirdest grader and has you come argue points back. Overall, super nice guy and not too hard.

Bradley is a good guy, just not the best teacher. He takes a while to put grades in and often time he enters them in wrong. You also have to go in and argue your grade for every group project as he counts you off for things you did correctly. He's very knowledgable about the subject, but overall can be a boring and frustrating teacher.

He's a really nice guy, but not the most organized or communicator.  If you do the homework (about 1 longer reading assignment per week) you will pass.  The majority of the grade comes from the group project.  If you get a bad grade (which my group did originally) but go to see him he almost always gives points back.  Follow the class schedule!

reviews.comment: BIS is a group project heavy class so pick your team wisely. For the tests and quizzes go over the hw assignments again multiple times. Docks 5 points for each class missed. Definitely take advantage and meet with him during office hours and he will help you with whatever you need. Definitely  recommend taking him if possible for BIS.

reviews.comment: Easy grader but be prepared to put in the work. If you fulfill all the specific guidelines he will give a decent grade.

Bradley is the best professor for this class! His tests are all vocabulary from the book. As long as you study the vocab they are an easy A. The project is the most difficult part, they key to getting a good grade is getting a good group who is willing to put the work in. Bradley is very open to questions and will clear things up when needed

I don't understand why anyone would rate Bradley badly. He's extremely nice and gives back points within reason. Choose your semester long group wisely. Exams are mostly vocabulary, so pay close attention because it can be tricky. Show up to class because its -5 pts every time you don't show. Midterm and final, strictly points based class.

Class time was pointless other than to take daily quizzes that you don't have to read for and can still pass. Lectures are boring and unnecessary. Grading for projects and tests is very subjective and arbitrary at times. Easy enough class but not very engaging or exciting.

I usually give teachers good ratings, but Professor Bradley is the worst teacher I've had here. Very inconsistent with his grading. The guy does not know what he is talking about. Truthfully, I'm surprised he is a professor here on campus. With all that being said, he is a nice guy.

The worst part about this class is the mandatory attendance. I could've gone to class 3 times and learned just as much as I did going to every class. There is a semester long project and he isn't very clear about the due dates or what he wants. He assigns all these things to attend like the night before they occur. He was alright.

Worst teacher ever!!! Last year he was known to be the easy push over teacher so he got a lot more strict. Very hard grader, yet on unnecessary stuff; talked to him about some projects and he clearly didn't look over my stuff well, basically just took off points to clear up his reputation.  The class is boring and don't buy the SharePoint book.

I took him for Consulting so I'm not sure if he's going to teach it again or if Mackay is. You better hope it's Bradley if you're taking Consulting. His tests are ridiculously easy, the group project is a pain, but he grades easy, and those are really the only grades. Lots of guest speakers so that got pretty annoying. Bradley is a really cool guy!

Dr. Bradley is such a nice guy. Go to his office and he is willing to help you with anything. He takes attendance. Fair grader if you put time into your projects. Tests are basically vocab from the book. Take him!

Bradley's class is fairly easy. Review for the daily quizzes and read over the chapters before the test. Rinse and repeat for the Final. Put effort into your project and act like you know what your talking about. Just take the chapters from the book and summarize them verbally in application to your company. Boom. Easy.

Great professor,  review material for  mini daily quizzes, then just review your final paper for any mistake , he is really  good in proofreading and will find ur mistake. The final was insane with all the concepts so just do ur work and  easy A-, study hard easy A.
He's awesome, easy quiz everyday to boost your grades, I didn't read once and ended up with an A, just talk to him and get to know him he is a cool guy, and much better than the other BIS teachers

INSC 20153: Bradley is a OK professor. He is not very clear in class, sometime reschedules his syllabus and make us confused. Ask him when you are unclear. There is no quizes and the tests is not hard, some answers you can guest.

Professor Lawson is such a kind woman. She is so understanding, and helpful if you need anything. She will take the time to go over things with you. Attendance is mandatory, and taken every class. Exam's are open book. She's very knowledgeable. Great professor! I recommend taking her class.
This was such an easy A, There are a assignments from the textbook, but you can do them till you get a 100, tests are taken outside of class, and there's only one paper.

Such a sweet teacher. Attendance is not required and the only tests are the midterm and final which are both open note online. Very easy to do well in this class as long as you follow her rubrics for assignments you will get an A.

class is not mandatory. one midterm and a final and she gives you the answers to the questions.

Lawson was such an easygoing and chill professor. all the tests were online and open note and there was only one writing assignment that was a reflection. she takes attendance through submitting notes which you could do without actually being there. 100% recommend.

If you need an easy class take her!! Every single test is take home, open notes, open anything.  Attendance is taken by submitting a Google doc, the only assignment is an online text book not even once a week.

The Social Problems class with Professor Lawson is hands down the easiest A I have ever gotten. The occasional Essay and watching videos with class discussions is literally all you do. Solid elective for STEM majors overwhelmed with other classes already.

Professor Lawson is genuinely the most sweet and kind woman. A short assignment is given every Sunday, online midterm (she gives answers) and the final is an exam, paper and easy presentation. She responds to emails quickly and listens to all of her students needs. I went to class barely once a week, but her lectures are so fun when I did go.

This woman is absolutely amazing. She has such a great heart and is truly enthusiastic about teaching sociology. Take her, attendance is not mandatory, and very straightforward assignments (once a week or every two weeks). Midterm and final online

My favorite teacher at TCU so far... Truly goes above and beyond and will meet with you before tests and quizzes on Zoom, even on Saturday nights. You need to put in the work to succeed, but over not terribly difficult. 6 bonus points if you complete every homework from exam to exam.
I never considered myself a math person. Pat made every class engaging and easy to understand.
Pat is the best. Never in my life have I done so good in a math class until him. You have to put in hard work to study and understand the material but Pat sets you up to succeed. He's truly awesome.

I loved pat. Stats is a hard class but he did everything he can to help you. He was very caring and allows you to take quizzes and exams early during his office hours if you want to get ahead. Go to class or you wont do well/ understand material. Make a lot of funny jokes!

Pat was a great teacher; he cares about his students and wants them to succeed all around. When I had homework questions, he was extremely helpful and took time to ensure I understood the problem. On every exam, you get bonus points for completing homework and attending class; this boosted my grade a ton.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Pat is a really nice guy who makes lessons engaging. He breaks stats topics down well and it's very manageable. You get 6 bonus points on exams if you do all the homework which is super helpful.

Took him as a professor a decade ago at TCC

Woah, Baby! He's awesome!

Professor Lause is the man. He made a somewhat difficult topic easy and not dreadful. He uses guided notes that are all on online and if you happen to miss class, the lectures are all recorded on D2L as well. You can take any quiz early or exam early and his office hours are soooo clutch. He's also hilarious. Definitely take him!

Truly an amazing professor!! He really wants to help you succeed! Go to office hours!! Ask questions, get direct help, and take quizses/exams early. Lectures are engaging, participate and shout out answers as much as you can, it really helps. Weekly quizzes, homework grade for completion, 6 bonus points on exams if all homework done on time.

Mr. Lause was an excellent professor. If you go to class and pay attention to the lectures you will understand each lesson. He is always available to help you whenever you need and explains the concepts very clearly. Before exams he gives you, old semesters exams which are pretty much the exact same to the actual exam. Very useful to study.
Super easy great teacher

Pat was honestly incredible. I haven't taken math in 10 years and he gave me more confidence than I could need to be successful. The lectures are very engaging and clear. The math itself is not very hard but it can be complex if you don't follow how he's trying to show you. Learn the pieces!!!!

Pat is THE BEST! I was worried about taking stats because it has many formulas, but the way he creates his notes paves a clear path for what you need to do. The worst math student can get an A in his class if you go to his office hours and engage. He has the best analogies and lets you take quizzes early (like whenever). Truly is amazing!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love Pat so so much. He is hilarious, and he knows how to make the class more interesting through many stories he told us. If you finish homework, it will be automatically 10/10. Exams aren't hard at all if you study. He is caring. I became a tutor of this course for my friends because he teaches so well! Would love to take him again

Best Prof I've had yet at TCU. So funny, always in a good mood. You would be stupid to not want to take this man's class. It's a challenge and requires works ngl but he's a good guy and will help you. 10000/10
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Lause is great. The class itself is difficult, but GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS, he is so understanding and helpful. He also gives so many opportunities for extra credit on exams which helps a lot. I am not a math person, but Professor Lause makes the class easy if you just do the work.

Great teacher that is invested in the whole class's success and will do anything to make it easy as possible. If you get a bad grade in this class you simply are not trying. Lots of extra credit on exams if you do all the homework which is one assignment a week.

I succeeded in the class because of the way he has the class structured. You get 6 bonus points on the tests if you do all of the homework. The tests are exactly like the practice tests he gives you so you know what to expect. He could be a little rude sometimes and would get mad at us for not participating but overall I would 100% take him!!!

Mr. Lause is a great professor. He makes it very clear what you need to know and makes the material as simple as possible. There are weekly homework assignments and quizzes, but they are short and pretty easy. He is super quick with email and pretty lenient with dates as well. Overall, I would definitely recommend him for elementary stats.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hands down Dr. Lause was best professor of my fall term. As hard as this class was for me, he was extremely helpful both with being clear in class and during office hours. You can take quizzes and tests as early as you want, and he is ALWAYS willing to help and genuinely wants you to do so well. He's quirky and has great dad jokes. 10/10 professor.

Pat is a top tier professor. He simplifies his lectures so that they're easier to understand and he's VERY helpful in office hours.
