He's a very understanding professor and you can take quizzes and exams as early as you want, which makes his class so flexible. Also a plus, he throws in lots of extra point opportunities throughout the semester!

Professor Lause is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is so helpful if you go to his office hours. It is important you understand the homework because the homework is identical to the quizzes and the quizzes are identical to the exams. You will know what he is going to ask before you take the exam.I would 100% recommend Lause for stats!

Lause is one of my favorite professors. Its really helpful to go to class, but you can watch videos on D2L that he posts. There is one hw assignment weekly due on thursdays and then a quiz on fridays, but you can take the quiz early or late. He was super flexible. Three unit tests and one final with a notecard. Easy to get an A if you pay attention

Professor Lause is a great teacher. You will be able to memorize formulas and facts throughout lecture just from the way he teaches. Go to office hours if you are confused about something. He is happy to help. He gives you all the tools you need to get an A in his class. Just don't fall behind--quizzes are weekly.

Pat is the best stats professor ever! Although I've never been the best at math and had a couple rough grades, he always tells you exactly what you need to know. He is also very accessible and will help you with anything you're struggling with. He is also HILARIOUS and isn't too serious. Overall I highly recommend him and would easily take it again

Pat is an amazing professor, I could not say enough good things about him. As long as you pay attention in lecture and take notes, the class is not difficult. I am not great at math, but this class made it easy for me. Also, if you complete all your homework assignments, he gives extra points on your test to help boost your grade.

Lause is a great teacher and a funny guy. The class is very fast paced but super thorough. If you miss a class it can be hard to catch up. As long as you pay attention and do the notes in class, the homework and quizzes are pretty easy. He does a good job of making the lectures entertaining and gives a ton of extra credit if you do homework.

Probably one of the best professors at TCU. I am not a math person, but this class was a breeze because he is so nice and lays out all of the material so simply. You an tell he cares about the wellbeing of his students. The structure and schedule of the class is laid out very nicely, and it very rarely changes. Homework is long but worth it.

I highly recommend taking Patrick for elementary stats at TCU. His class is not hard as long as you study and attend lecture. There are weekly quizzes every Friday they are not bad as long as you pay attention in class and follow his notes. Also, he gives extra credit on the exams for turning in all of your homework.
Quizzes, homework, and tests are almost all identical. He is very clear on exactly what you need to do to do well. Doesn't take attendance but has weekly quizzes.

He is a great professor and knows how to teach statistics in an easy way! Very understanding, deadlines are made clear from the beginning, and only 3 exams and 1 final in total. He gives extra credit for completing all homework, too. Overall, he has made learning statistics easy and approachable, highly recommend.

He yelled at our class and told us that he knew we didn't like him due to negative rate my professor ratings. He's not horrid, but there are easier people to take for stats so I don't recommend taking him. Not a terrible teacher, just moves super fast and gives few examples.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Pat is a good teacher, he explained the material in a way that made it easy to understand and if you didn't  he was easy to access outside of class and I always felt encouraged to ask questions. Only downside is that there is a lot of homework and tests and quizzes can be a little hard, but overall this class was great.

Yes, I ended up with a C, and yes I wrote a brutal review a while ago when I was rlly angry with him. But I'm so thankful I took him. Take this class if you want to actually learn statistics. I just finished the final and I feel so much more confident in myself when it comes to stats. Thank you Pat, you were actually a really great professor.

I really enjoyed Pat. He cares about his students and is available outside of class. He responds to emails fast and will try and help you over email if you can't see him in person. Attendance is not always taken but if you want to learn the material you have to go. His high energy made the class easy to go to. Def take him.

Pat is an amazing teacher! there is Homework, but if you complete it all you get 6 points added to every test! he is an extremely good teacher and he is so good at what he does! TAKE HIM YOU WON'T REGRET IT

Funniest professor ever. Many opportunities to practice the material between practice tests and quiz keys, and if you participate and follow along you'll be just fine. Stats is hard and confusing but Lause gives you many resources to help you succeed. Answers his emails fast and in-depth and promotes office hours to help you.

Terrible. So unprofessional, and gives way too much homework and projects for a class that is supposed to be for a core class math credit that nobody really cares about. His class is the bane of my existence this year. When you don't understand something, he just yells and mansplains. 0/10.

Pat is one of my favorite teachers by far! For every test, if you did your homework, you get 6% added to your test grade. He really cares about helping every student and is very assessable for help after class. He makes class fun by making jokes and his homework models questions that will be on the test.

Professor Lause is my favorite professor this year. He makes sure everyone is engaged and throws in a couple of jokes so class is never boring . I thought this class was gonna be hard, but he simplifies things and explains everything really well. He also gives extra points on exams if you do your homework.

Pat's a funny guy who cares that his students do well. His teaching style may seem odd at times and he can teach kind of fast, but overall he breaks things down to the simplest level. He is understanding and willing to help you outside of class. If you are willing to put in just a little effort to succeed you'll do great.

I LOVE PAT!! I am normally really bad at straightforward math like geometry and I thought I was gonna be literally awful at stats but if I didn't have Pat I would have failed. Dumbs every topic down to very very simple terms and if you do the homework he gives you and participates in class he'll make it a breeze. Top 5 teacher in my books!

If you do all the homework, which is pretty easy to complete, you get 6 extra credit points on your exam. He does expect verbal responses, but honestly, it helps with memorizing everything. His lectures are thorough, if you pay attention and go to class you won't have to spend any time outside of class, besides a little homework. Enjoyable class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Pat is one of the best. I think these bad reviews are from people who didn't try at all. I had no stat background coming into this class, but I now have an A+. It is easy to do well in this class if you come to class and pay attention. His quizzes and tests are exactly what you do in class, everything is super straightforward and there r no tricks

I was optimistic due to all of the 5/5 ratings. Boy was I misguided. He does not have a consistent homework or quiz schedule. He teaches the course as if you already know the material, and gets frustrated & shouts if students cannot recite formulas he went over moments before. He has office hours, but is not helpful and dismissive when you attend.

He's a nice person and willing to explain, but he moves way too fast in his lectures. He gives few examples and expects you to "get it" at the rate in which he explains the material. Doesn't explain concepts fully and you have to do the work outside of class. There's easier statistics professors, don't make it harder on yourself.
Not sure why there are so many high ratings. Gives homework from the book that is not even tested on top of other hw that is on the quizzes and tests. Does not explain the material that well.

I get that this guy is highly rated, but honestly, I don't see why. He assigns homework, quizzes, projects (super tedious projects by the way), and exams that aren't difficult but take WAY too much time. The class I'm in that he teaches is topics in mathematics. Which shouldn't be this challenging but he is making it so. 0/10 would not recommend

Pat is one of my all-time favorite teachers. At first, I was dreading taking math class, but he made it so enjoyable. He made me want to come to a night class! He is hilarious and caring. Just go to class and I promise you will learn the material. Not the easiest material but he really cares about you learning and succeeding.

Mr. Lause is my favorite teacher this year. i have this as a night class but he does a great job of keeping us engaged. he has detailed videos over the lessons on d2l that he makes which are super helpful. sometimes he gives random 100's to everyone on quizzes too. he really wants u to succeed in his class & gives u many opportunities to get there
This class was not easy but if you take notes during lectures go to every class and actually do each homework assignment you will succeed. There is also quizzes after each lesson in the class.
Overall a tough class, but if you go to class and pay attention it is not bad at all. Completing the homework on time and understanding it is key to the weekly quizzes.

I took stats with Patrick this year after taking Applied calc. The class wasn't necessarily straight forward easy and there was work involved but its not that hard. Do the homework, study a little for test, easy A. He gives extra 6 points on test for homework completion.  Would take again. Also super funny!

I didn't do very well in this class, but to be fair, math isn't my strong suit. This professor is very caring and really does want you to succeed. Not only is his grading criteria clear, but he gives you good study advice as well, & if you do all your hw on time, you get bonus points for your tests. He's very funny & makes class entertaining.

I love Professor Lause, he made a night stats class so fun. Also the way he teaches stats is very simple to understand and if you put in the work you will get an A. He really wants everyone to participate, but as a group which is not bad at all. Tests are a lot, but if you know the material you will be 100% fine. If you have to take stats take him

I absolutely loved him! All you need to do is study for the quizzes and listen and take notes in class and you will be perfectly fine. Do the practice tests and homework supplements because it's basically the test and what to expect on quizzes. If you miss class he has videos for you online on the chapter. Great guy and enjoyed his class.

Super enthusiastic, really cares about students' success, the best teacher I've had at TCU. Shows quizzes and tests beforehand so you know what to expect. As long as you study and show up it's an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Awesome professor overall. Clearly explains every concept in class and makes sure we all understand, he's also pretty funny. I struggled with math in high school and his teaching helped me a ton. Would 100% recommend for Stats.

Professor Lause is a very sweet professor, but not a good teacher whatsoever. This may have been because it was online, but he expects you to learn all of the content on your own through videos and doesn't actually teach you it in class. The tests are SO hard (even with studying) and he grades them very harshly. Do not recommend taking his class.

Prof Lause is amazing! Very thorough in lecture, goes over everything you need to know. Weekly notes, quiz, and homework. Does collaboration groups and you have to submit logs. Reviews old exams and prepares you very well for exams. Gives 5 points on exams if you submit all the homework for that section. Notes and reviewing old exams help a lot!!!

I went to like 4 classes the entire year. In class he reviews the homework, usually before most people have even taken notes (prerecorded online), so going to class isn't worth it unless you have finished the week's workload by Monday. Other than that, the routine is pretty set in stone, and tests aren't easy but not terrible. He's a great prof!

Patrick is the best! If you have to take statistics, you might as well take it with him. He makes it fun and more interesting by using humor and easy to understand analogies. I dont think I would have done as well with another professor. Tests are not easy and you do have to study and do your part. If you do the work and try and youll do good.

Lause is such a cool teacher! If you want to pass the class, you have to show up, and you have to do your homework or else you probably won't do well. He is funny and his teaching style makes statistics seem really easy. I didn't think I would do well in stats but I ended up doing much better than I expected.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Lause is a great professor! He makes the lectures really understandable. If you do all of your homework he'll give you 6 extra credit points on each test, which goes a long way. He never takes attendance, but I'd recommend going to every class to understand the material. You have to work a little to master it, but overall it's not that hard at all.
I thought this class was going to be easy but its very hard. I went to talk to him several times and he was rude and very patronizing! This class requires way too much work for what it is!!

Professor Lause is an amazing teacher! The class is hard but he is hysterical. If you struggle with math just go to his office hours and you will be fine. He wants everyone to do well and is always accessible to help! He gives you a practice exam with almost identical questions to the exam so if you can do those problems you can ace the test.

Explain a problem like a high school teacher do. He makes sure that you get the necessary material while you are in class so, will make the read an important equation for multiple times until everyone know it by heart which takes off your study load. There's homework. It comes out exactly like what he taught in class and very few are different.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I'm so glad that I took Patrick's class. He is very smart. Statistics is different from the normal math classes, so a lot of the concepts are pretty new, but he is amazing at giving real-life examples to help us understand. You only use the textbook to do homework. They are for extra credits, but I recommend doing them to practice the problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very nice and funny and will try to make class less painful. However, he speeds through lectures so he can try to fit in as many chapters as possible into one class. He does not explain concepts well, which can you leave you totally confused and behind. The textbook is a MUST for his class, that's where the homework comes from.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Truly wants all his students to do well. He deconstructs the material really well to make it easy to understand; I've heard of some pretty tough stats profs at this school, but he doesn't make you do anything that isn't necessary. Put in half the work with Lause, get an A, & actually retain what you've learned

One of those people who was born to be a teacher. He helps you patiently and for as long as you need. You repeat things in class and do have homework due Sundays, but he's very forgiving and will work with you. Do the homework for 6 extra points on tests. Funny (super dry humor), which helps lighten the mood. I hate math but he's the absolute best.

He made the material super easy to understand and is very willing to help in office hours. Super nice and understanding too. Book is used pretty much only for homework which is easy, a completion grade and extra credit for tests. He requires a lot of active participation, repeating phrases, which is annoying but helps with remembering the material
he's very funny and super nice and willing to help you. but he talks about the material way too fast! there is a lot of vocabulary that is talked about but he doesn't go over it nearly enough.

Professor Lause is the best. You get extra points on your exams for turning in homework. If you have any questions he's always available to work through problems with you in his office. He makes super corny jokes in class and expects you to participate in class, which I found fun. As long as you study and do the homework this class is the best.

Patrick is very easy to understand and accessible outside of the classroom. He is willing to sit down and work out problems with you individually. I am not great at math, yet I did pretty solid. He is hilarious also. However, the tests are brutal (especially the 3rd one).Do the HW for extra credit and you will be fine!
Very fast teaching and sometimes even says " you won't finish this test". Expects answers exactly how he wants them and does not teach in a way that most students learn.

Mr. Lause is very funny and very helpful but if the class doesn't participate (he asks a lot of questions), he will start to yell. There are assignments due every week, quizzes every Friday, 3 tests and the final. If you turn in all of your hw on time, you get 6 points added to each test you take. He gives you practice tests and an 88% is an A-

Most favorite professor at TCU! super-hilarious, an easy grader with plenty of extra credits and gives interesting lectures. You can skip, but you woud regret because he always has good joke everyday. You'll need the book for homework&quizzes (yeah quizzes are from book!), but his lectures are much more inspirational and clearer than the book.
Seriously pay attention, or you will not do good!
Best Calc teacher ever !! Manages a great line between professionalism and being engaging. Would definitely reckomend
I would suggest another class if possible. Wasn't insanely horrible, but definitely one of my few not-so-good experiences here.

He requires that you do homework for each unit and it is graded however it really helps you on tests. The homework he gives you is not harder than the problems he does with you in class. Don't skip more than 2 classes as he gives you quizzes every day. The quizzes are not hard if you do the homework. ASK QUESTIONS he is super helpful. He's funny.

Prof. Lause (Law-see) rocks! No, his class is not for sissies. You have a quiz every Friday, which helps you retain what you've learned. You have homework due every Thurs but you get 100 for completion and it adds 6 pts to your exam and preps you for the quiz on Friday.  He makes Statistics rather enjoyable if at all possible. Highly recommended!

Overall this is the hardest class I have ever taken. His lectures are long and monotonous. When students ask questions he would raise his voice and treat us like we were children. His test were extremely hard and the homework was dense. He  would come to class about 45 minutes early to answer homework questions.  I would not take him again.

Homework due every week, but if you do it you get 6 points added to your exam. You have to go to class everyday or you will be so behind but he is an amazing teacher and very good at making it all make sense.
Patrick is the best! Go to class (He'll explain everything best). Do the homework (it's where your quiz questions and points for extra credit come from). Ask for help if you need.

Patrick is the best! As long as you go to class and do the homework, the class is very manageable and he makes it interesting. He's hilarious and always willing to help if you don't understand something. By far one of my favorite  teachers I've had at TCU

Patrick, as he prefers to be called, is the best teacher I've had at TCU.  He's really good at explaining the work and before each quiz on Friday he would answer any specific questions we had.  Also homework was graded for completion so it was really easy.   He's also mastered the art of dad jokes.

Dr Lause is one of the best professors I've had. I am not a math person and loved his class. However, you do need to go to class and pay attention, he can sometimes be very fast. DO YOUR HOMEWORK, its graded on completion and counts towards extra credit for tests. All the problems in quizzes and tests come from the homework. He is a hilarious guy.

Mr. Lause was by far my favorite teacher I had all semester. I took Stats in high school and honestly I don't even know how I passed, but after taking it with Mr. Lause, everything was so much clearer. He's amazing at explaining concepts, repeats things several times, gives multiple examples, and is hilarious. Best professor hands down.

Lause is a great teacher! He likes to repeat questions and makes you repeat the answers. Might be annoying but really helps when it comes to the tests. Tests are not harder than they should be. As long as you do your homework, you should be good. Give extra credit for doing your homework, which is completion grade. Take this class with him! Loved!

If you aren't a person that will keep up with the homework, this professor is not for you. Along as you stay on top of the homework you should get the grade you want. He makes you repeat almost every concept so he knows that you know it.
Nowlin is way better, i should have taken stats with her, but I listened to someone else and took Lause, He has no mercy there's easier ways to learn stats! The final was impossible.

I am not a math person and I enjoyed having Lause as a professor. If you keep up with your homework, you will do fine in this class. He is very helpful if you go to see him and he is willing to put in the time and energy to help you. Overall, Lause is a great teacher!! don't be scared by the comments you read. You just have to be willing to work

Lause needs to learn that you can't just say part of the book is right and part of it is wrong.  He teaches in his own, weird and uncharacteristic way, and he is rude and I learned nothing.  He confused me and his tests look nothing like his homework.  He is 6 foot 10 and intimidates everyone.

I took this class based on the reviews that were posted and they were WRONG! This class is fast paced. Insane amount of homework, examples and explanations weren't helpful when it came to doing the homework. The calculator was only rarely used only for plotting. Some of us are not in the 18-19 yr old range and expected more respect. Arrogant guy!

Lause is a nice man, and I can understand why people like him.  However, one thing when having Lause that you need to know is it is much more difficult if you have taken Stats in high school.  Lause teaches very quickly and in a way that was difficult for us who had already learned stats another way. For me, it was difficult with the transition.

Professor Lause is my favorite teacher ever. He is very helpful! If yo have any questions go to his office hours and he will explain it and make sure you understand. He is also really funny! There is a quiz once a week that are very easy if you do the homework. DON'T get behind on the homework or you will be VERY lost.

Patrick Lause is an incredible professor. He explains concepts really well and he is funny. He really wants everyone to succeed. Yes, this class is hard but he will help you! It is a lot of work but he is such a good professor that it is worth it.

Such a great teacher!!! Really Helpful, I actually enjoyed the class. I just don't understand stats. Go to office hours because he will help you. Quizzes are super easy but the tests are a different story. They wouldn't be that bad but he doesn't give enough time.

I highly recommend Patrick Lause. He is an awesome, and quite quirky teacher. His class never gets boring and he even will do the homework problems in class for everyone. He teaches in a way that is easy to understand no matter what level of math you are coming in with. Just stay on top of your homework because it can be lengthy.

Lause is a great teacher. Im not especially great at math, but if you use office hours and study the concepts, not the mechanics of the questions you will be good.  I walked out with a A- after getting a C on the first test. Do the HW and study it.  Test He is willing to put in the time to help you understand everything, but not if your a slacker.

Patrick is super chill. Makes funny jokes a lot that keep math class interesting. Late 20's early 30's. STAY ON TOP OF YOUR HOMEWORK DO NOT GET BEHIND OR MISS CLASS. Things move extremely quickly. Pat is suuuper helpful and always has office hours. This saved my grade b/c I'm not a math person. Won't help ppl too far behind b/c they're a lost cause

He is an AWESOME teacher! So helpful and explains everything very clearly. Truthfully, I don't like math and am terrible at it. I took statistics in high school and hardly got by, but Lause has made me absolutely LOVE the class! He's great! Definitely take this class if you need a math one. It's more interesting than Topics in Math.

Elementary Statistics is an incredibly easy class if you are decent at math. Lause is a very helpful teacher as well. He is clear, concise, and offers plenty of office hours if you're struggling. Keep up with the homework and the class is a breeze.

If you have a hard time in math, like I do, then I wouldn't recommend this class. If you're good at math tho, then I would take it. He is hilarious and really nice, but he moves fast. HOWEVER, if you're struggling use office hours! He really tries to help you and usually clarifies things. Great guy, but I'd rather have him as a tutor not a teacher.

There is no reason for you to make a bad grade in this class. DO THE HOMEWORK OR U'RE STUPID! quizzes straight from homework, tests long but exactly same stuff as practiced in class and on homework. He will help u in class and office hours if u want. Ask for help if you don't get it. Don't miss class, be awake, answer when he asks questions!

For me, the class was almost insultingly easy.  He yells at us all day because we don't yell out the answers. But you have to go because he uses different procedures than the book.  But you have to get the book because his quiz questions are straight from it.  Easy A if you do the homework, but he is infuriating.

Typically writes one example on the board, quickly explains the process by vaguely asking the class what he did, then says its the student's responsibility to figure out the homework and do well on the exam. Annoyingly arrogant, not helpful at all, ridiculous amount of homework.
Went very fast and was not clear at all. Went to him for help, but it was a waste of time.

He is such a great professor! Keeps you laughing the whole time, and has all these tricks to remember things. His tests are a little hard, but I'm not a math person. You definitely need the book. I would recommend this class to everyone, AWESOME TEACHER!!!

The material for this class is challenging, but possible. He is the hardest of the other professors ive heard about, moves quickly and assigns more work, but its all for your benefit. DO YOUR HOMEWORK if not you fall behind quickly. Great guy, very helpul and very funny.

He is such a nice guy! I would definitely recommend taking his Elementary Statistics class. He is always in his office when he says he is and really explains things well. Criteria isn't hard, but you need to keep up on your homework for your own benefit!

Great guy, presents the material well! He is sort of like a broken record, repeating the important parts. You MUST do the homework or you will fall massively behind and fail. If you are willing to take the time to do the work, it's a fairy easy class. He's always available to help, too.

Class started out great, but went down hill. I got lost and he goes so fast that I never got the opportunity to catch up so my grade dropped. I went in to him for help, and he told me that he couldn't help me until I learned the material, which is why I went to him in the first place...

As a former US Marine I have PTSD and a hard time remembering steps. Pat was very patient, understanding and did his best to work around issues. Although I failed the class by points, I feel I walked away learning so much more. He does go fast which was part of the issue. DO THE HOME WORK! If you are horrible at math do not take him do the speed.

Really funny and nice guy, also a very good and clear teacher. Makes the material easy to understand and if you are having trouble he is extremely helpful in office hours. He wants everyone to do well in his class. Make sure to go everyday and keep up on the homework and you should be fine! Take him for Stats!

Amazing professor, makes stats understandable and easy. If you pay attention in class and do the homework it's hard not to do well! Very helpful in office hours, and a great class for non-math people.

Awesome teacher.  He is funny and he really teaches the course material really well.  He makes it easy for you to memorize the important stuff and he constantly repeats what you need to know.  Don't miss class! The material is cumulative over lecture. You never use the book for information, only for the homework problems.

Started out as being one of my favorite professors then quickly changed. He went way too fast to try to cover vast amounts of material in too short of amount of time. Tests are too lengthy for the amount of time allowed and most students don't finish. Also, his tests are over a lot of material that was not covered. Good luck!
Make sure you take good notes and review for all tests. Tests are hard, but Lause will help you out during office hours
Very easy and logical professor, but dont miss a day of class or you will be behind and it is hard to catch back up

He's a good teacher. Math is really hard for me and they moved so fast. I was not a good student in his class. I had a lot of personal stuff happen and got way behind. He was understanding and patient and really tried to give me every chance to pass. He wanted me to pass. He is a cool person.

I have always been a pretty good math student,so I went into this class thinking it'd be simple.However, it was not at all.He went very quickly and I ended up teaching myself everything out of the book.His tests were long&over much material that was not covered.I've heard of many better stats teachers

Yes, Mr. Lause is tall and funny, but he is a little rough when it comes to teaching. He gets sidetracked and scatter brained easily. Overall, his class was pretty useful: quizzes directly from homework, but his tests are crazy. Did we even LEARN that? is the question you'll be asking yourself. I recommend another teacher.

Professor Lause was great! Do the homework, go to class, take good notes, and you won't have any problems. Quiz questions come right from the homework, and test problems are very similar. He was more than willing to give help to anyone who needed it.

Very unclear in his lectures. He does not know what he's talking about. His tests are ten questions and impossible if you don't do your hw and go to class every day. I would not recommend him. I did all of my hw and went to class every day but would still leave class not knowing what he said. I had to teach myself straight from the book.

He's awesome! He has to duck his head to get in the classroom! Best advice I can give: do all your homework. That's where he gets his quiz questions. He's very clear and does not try to trick his students. I highly recommend him!
By far the best math teacher I have ever had. Took him for pre-cal. He is very clear, moves at a good pace, and is very willing to help. He's funny and makes class interesting. Take this class.
All you have to do is be willing to put in the time to do all the homework he assigns. Do that and you'll get an A, no problem. He's a great teacher and always available if you need help.

Mr. Lause is one of the most laid back professors, and knows how to teach.  He is available after class, do the hw, take the quizes.  Be warned the tests are 25 q's in about 50 minutes, so know the material.  You can get an A in this class, but a solid B is pretty much a given if you take it serious!
he is tall. his tests are longgg so expect to finish quick b/c there are no extra time. do your home work and you're good to go.
AMAZING. he's extremely lenient, and understanding. all around good guy

Hes pretty much awesome and so easy to get an A. I enjoyed and wanted to go to class everyday, but going to class is must to get answers on homework questions you have. His quizzes are super easy because they are problems straight from the homework. His tests are super easy, kinda long but I always finished before class was over, but most didnt.

It was his first year so that was difficult on him. The tests are not hard but there were too many questions to finish. I had a B- average but got an A on the final which cam from the previous three tests so i ended up with an A. IF you unerstand the homework you can get an easy A.

New prof, obviously 1st time around is tough on both us and him, but he seems to know the material well enough, just not always clear on it. Very nice guy and helpful if you come to his office hours. If your final exam grade is higher than your semester grade, he'll give you that for the class. Good way to get an A if you were slow out the gate.

New Teacher who does not have a handle on the material. Definitely go with someone else unless you enjoy making Precal (a generally easy class) a struggle for survival.  Assigns about 60 problems a night for a 4 day-a-week class. He doesn't take it up but holds you responsible for every problem unless you ask questions about it.
New Teacher who is still finding his "rhythm".  Very willing to help.  Not always clear but is very willing to stop and answer questions.
Great Class it was hard to sit through lectures sometimes but he would let kids out early also he replaces exams with writing assignments by far the easiest neeley course I've taken

Fs recommend taking him. Great guy who really cares about the class and his students. Few at-home quizzes and discussion posts, the meat is 5 papers you write. Min 2 pages each, to get a good grade, you need 8-10, which is what they end up anyway. I got 90-94s on all and usually had 9-page papers. Doesn't round grades, but overall not bad at all.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The course is graded by a few discussion post and 5 long papers, the papers say 2 page min (No Maximum) but mine were usually 8-10 and they should be, The papers seem really daunting at first but once you get the hang of the structure they are SO EASY. Definitely would take again!

Professor Lewis is very caring, and he wants every student to succeed.  There are five major essay assignments, but he makes sure everyone is well prepared.  If you go to his class and participate, you will be successful in this class.

Very sweet professor. Goes over the material in class from the textbook, so read for understanding. No tests, just papers graded at very high detail. Make sure you understand the content for the papers and class discussion, and you'll be fine. The papers need to include a lot of detail, so be aware of that. Quizzes are easy as well.
Amazing professor who is clear during class about exactly how to learn the concepts and how to do well on graded items. I would take any class he offers!

Pretty easy class for the most part. All tests including the final are papers. Weekly quizzes on the textbook readings aren't too bad. Attendance is required but the lectures aren't too long. I would definitely recommend Lewis for Org Man.

Overall, I really enjoyed his class. Very informative and knows what he is talking about, given his experience. The work is very manageable, and it is not hard to get a good grade. As long as you show up and do the few things he asks, you will do well in the class. He is also very flexible with his students. I would recommend his class to all.

Professor Lewis is a kind professor, however, this is not a blow-off class. He doesn't give exams, only some combination each week of quizzes, discussion posts, and assignments (which are papers). In the assignments, you need to write and explain everything and use examples. Many of my papers were over 10 pages and I got mid to low A's on them.

Professor Lewis is genuinely kind and truly cares about his students. His paper grading sounds daunting but he really just wants you to write out everything you learned and apply it to some examples - so write a lot more than the minimum and you'll do great. I really enjoyed his class.

Essentially everything about this class worked well. Due to the way this class was structured, I feel as though I could learn and retain the information in a productive manner that could not be achieved through traditional means like exams.

Very good for Org Man. He is very brief with the lecture and will tell you exactly what to expect. The workload is very light, quizzes and discussion posts are free points. Writing assignments do require more time but are fairly infrequent.

Professor Lewis is a great professor! The summer class requires a lot of writing and reading but aside from being a little intensive, I did not find it difficult. Paying attention and participating in class is definitely a requirement.
Professor Lewis is one of the best professors I have had at TCU. No complaints. Very knowledgeable on material, he provides great examples. I absolutely loved his class.

I really enjoyed going to class - amazing professor! Assignments are hard, but use material learned in class and follow the grading rubric and you will do just fine. I would take any class professor Lewis teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He lecture style definitely takes some getting used to, but I really enjoyed this class. There are no exams, just quizzes, discussion posts, and assignments. For the assignments, take good notes in lecture and just regurgitate everything he says back to him with examples. You can tell he enjoys teaching.
Very paper heavy, but no tests and really fun professor.  You will know exactly what he wants which is very helpful!

Professor Lewis is a great teacher. You are only graded on discussion posts, quizzes, and papers. Show up to class and listen, he is a pretty interesting guy. He cancels classes sometimes and gives you plenty of time ahead to turn your work in. He is actually pretty funny and you will get something out of his class. Highly recommend taking him.
Professor Lewis is a great professor and teaches lectures. He doesn't have any exams in the class and instead replaces exams with assignments, quizzes, and discussion posts. I recommend his course.

The structure of the class overall was really effective. From the class presentation to discussion posts and assignments, everything flowed really well and helped me learn better. My favorite course! Best teacher I have had!

Occasionally cancels classes and is understanding of the fact that students have things to do outside of the classroom. There are no tests in this class, instead he assigns certain to have quizzes, essays, and discussion posts (sometimes its 1, sometimes its 3). He is a very kind and passionate teacher, I recommend getting into his class.

I think constantly having discussion boards, assignments, and quizzes all in one week really helped me to gain a better knowledge of the course material. This course was very engaging where everyone got to participate and that helped me learn a lot more, so I think that was absolutely amazing. My favorite course!

Professor Lewis is an interesting man. Nicely put, he's very ready to retire, almost every class he'd start it with "wow, I wish I could retire & go fishing", which is funny but not when he says it daily. He's very monotone! I read his reviews but ignored the "monotone" reviews because I thought I could take it. Little homework though and no tests!

I took Lewis in Fall 2021 and this was coming back from Covid, so he took away the test for the whole class. Just papers, some small projects, and participation. His lectures were always good and his slides were straight forward. He also has speakers come in some class times and that creates networking without leaving the classroom. Great teacher!

Professor Lewis was awesome and so was the class, the assignments were laid out perfectly for us to succeed. I think constantly having discussion boards, assignments, and quizzes all in one week really helped me to gain a better knowledge of the course material. This course was very engaging where everyone got to participate.

One of the easier classes I have taken in Neeley. Professor Lewis is clear with his expectations when it comes to grading. No exams. class grade is made up of participation (discussion posts/attendance, you get 2 free absences), quizzes, and papers. If you want an A on the papers write at MINIMUM 1000 words, that got me a 93% on every single one.
Professor Lewis states pretty clearly what he wants from you per each assignment, if you follow these guidelines and attend the class you will do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would recommend taking his class because I gained so much valuable information. He is a great professor and really wants his class to engage with the lecture.

for each chapter you can have of combination of three things due: quiz, discussion post, or 2-page paper. A lot of times you will have all three due which is not ideal, but there are no tests which makes up for it. He cancels class a lot which is really nice.

Mr. Lewis was a privilege to have! He is one of the kindest and caring people I have ever encountered. He handled the online switch to COVID amazingly. Class was graded on 3 basic things and NO exams. He really allowed us to just have a breather and enjoy some learning while turning down the stress. I highly recommend him to anyone!Such a kind soul

If you are undecided about taking him during the summer, I highly recommend it. He has one Quiz (2 attempts/UNLIMITED time), or/and Discussion Post (1st post due on Wed & two replies on Sun), or/and Assignment (one page). Easy/funny lectures. Always turn your camera on for participation grade. Due to Covid, he has a very enjoyable online class now.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Lewis is a very caring guy. The other reviews were based off of his past teaching method, but due to covid-19 he really made the class easier for all his students. Spring 2021 he taught the class all online and substantially made the class funner and easier. He teaches this course during the 5-WK June section if anyone is interested!

As long as you show up, do not be on your phone, and pay attention, I PROMISE you will finish the class with a 75% minimum. It is very hard to fail his class. He does take attendance. He doesn't give reviews for his exam.

Partcipation is 15% of the grade, and you get two absesnes but he doesn't allow phones. Other than that, there are three tests (50 MCQ) that make up 85% of the grade. Pretty simple class and he helps you out as much as he can. Take good notes and follow the lecture slides and the class shouldn't be much of a problem.

Having the slides available on the first day of class was very helpful. I enjoyed being able to work ahead then come into class and solidify what I studied. Having the group discussions helped immensely as well, Professor Lewis was excellent at getting students involved.
Lectures were very detailed and easy to follow along. Examples were excellent, they really helped me relate to the topic more. Professor Lewis is great one of the best professors I have had at TCU

Lewis is a nice guy and professor. But the class material is really vague and hard to understand so it makes it hard to do well. Your grade comes only from tests and participation so you gotta do well on those. Really study notes for exams cause his questions are weirdly worded. Not bad but dull class.
I actually really liked this class and thought it was taught well. Study class notes for exams.

Terrible prof! I enrolled in this class a few years ago and dropped, hoping I could take it with a different professor, but no luck because he's the only one who teaches it. Loves to talk about himself and rich past students. I learned nothing, yet it was super hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took Lewis for management and it was pretty straight forward. The tests were based off his power points and articles, so you knew what was going to be on it going in. If you memorize the power points, you should do fine. We only used the textbook once, and you're only allowed to miss two days of class or he starts taking off points.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took him for management and really enjoyed his class. He puts all of his power points online with detailed notes on each slide. Grade consisted of 3 tests and a participation grade, but all tests are multiple choice. Very reasonable guy and I recommend taking him

All he talks about is himself and the past students he has that are now out there making the $. Terrible teacher, doesn't care how you do, and there are only 3 tests, so it is super high. If I could take any other teacher beside him for management I would.

I took Reading as a writer over the winter session with Prof Lemon and it was by far the easiest class I have taken. Minimal work and he is very clear with expectations. He expects you to engage in class, but does a good job of not making you feel singled out. He genuinely cares about all his students

Class is easy. No exams. Just class reading, and you buy two books for pretty cheap, one being his to stroke his massive ego. Mandatory attendance. The real issue is the professor himself. He kind of crashes out regularly over minute 'issues.' It's always completely unwarranted. He'll yell and demean students randomly. No idea what his problem is.

In class you write and read a lot of poems as well as short stories which is pretty easy. However, the professor didn't use d2l so no one knew their grades and didn't go by the syllabus at all. He often cancelled class an hour or even a few minutes prior to it starting. Overall, it was just boring and not well organized. can find a better FA credit

Fairly easy class but be prepared to write poems and short stories and revise your work. Also be prepared to read and discuss poems and short stories in class, but Professor Lemon will help prompt you and guide you. Attendance is mandatory, but you're allowed to miss a couple of classes and class is canceled a decent amount.

Class is based on analyzing texts and he wants your participation about what you think. You will have to write poems and a story but not difficult whatsoever. Be sure to participate and go to class because your grade depends on it. Your final is a portfolio of what you've completed.
Professor Lemon is awesome. He is the funniest guy I have ever met and the energy you give him he will give back. Super chill guy and will help you get an A just participate and have fun in class.

Professor Lemon is very outgoing and supportive of his students. He is clear about deadlines and is always there when a student needs help with or extra time on an assignment. The class is mostly discussion-based and he likes to get everyone included, creating a very positive environment.

Prof Lemon is my favorite teacher at TCU. Hands down. He's funny, caring, kind, and generally a great person. He teaches a bunch of classes, but I never felt like I was begging for his time. he gives thoughtful and thorough responses to everyone and gave everyone a chance to have their work be the center of attention. He's the best teacher I've had

(June 4-week) Prof Lemon was awesome. He might be my favorite teacher here at TCU. He was energetic and creative, funny and just made the class great. He does not use TCUOnline, but be a grownup and ask for your standing. He favors creativity and participation. He wants to help those who want to write or at least interested. Take this class!

Great teacher. Helped my writing A LOT. However, he sometimes seems to pick favorites. He does not put grades into TCU Online, so you are basically left clueless on how you're doing until the end of the semester. Be ready to write.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Lemon gets the nod as my favorite professor. He is super smart, funny and caring. I learned a lot about writing during this class, more than I expected. The class was fun. There is a lot to read, but everything we read was carefully chosen to expand our knowledge beyond the basics. I WILL certainly take another class with Dr. Lemon.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Lemon was really great and funny. Class was really chill but he really wanted us to participate. Sometimes he or his expectations were unclear but you just need to ask! He's really funny. He understands that many students just take this for a fine arts credit, and he just needs to see effort.

Alex Lemon is probably one of- if not the- most incredible professors I have ever had. He's crazy smart, hilarious, and helpful; his class is work, but your writing WILL improve, and you will have a great time along the way.

He's a really good professor and it was not difficult to get an A as long as you show up and turn in the assignments, but you have to go because workshoping and participation are important to him. Very funny and easy going and has good feedback advice to improve your writing. I took this for a FAR requirement and don't normally do a lot of writing.

I loved Intro to Creative Writing with Alex. His class is not very stressful- just a weekly writing assignment due every week and a final portfolio. He really cares about your writing and wants you to improve. I'm taking another class with Alex next semester. Strongly recommend.
BRILLIANT writer and had really good comments... When he would get them to you. He just didn't seem invested in teaching and was very slow getting assignments back, if he got them back to you at all.

Intro to Creative writing: Great professor but this is not a blow off class! You actully have to work hard and is not an easy A! That being said it was one of my favorite classes this semester and I really think I have become a better writer! For majors and non majors alike.

Lemon is a very energetic, caring professor. Lots of discussion. He was very helpful with feedback on my papers, and I think he has helped me become a better writer. However, he is a little spontaneous. He does not always go by the syllabus and does not use eCollege, so I never knew specific grades. Read well and work hard, and you'll do fine.

Great professor, tons of fun, incredibly supportive of all writing even if it doesn't neccessarily fall into a genre he prefers. Make sure to do all the work and during critiques do not attack but provide criticism that can actually be helpful. Being supportive of fellow writers is key in order to have a positive class and experience! good luck!

Alex is a wonderful professor, one of the most amazing people I've had the pleasure to know. He's incredibly talented and interested in his work and students. He's hilarious, laid back, fair, and incredibly helpful. You appreciate him as a professor and love him as a person. Give him what he deserves: effort, attention, participation, and respect.
Great writer and somehow and even better person. Best professor I've ever had.
great teacher; really wants to help; enthused about writing; humorous

He is an EXCELLENT professor and hilarious as well!  He cares so much about helping his students and will always meet with you.  He's always well-prepared and very fair.  Just make sure you read and come to class.  If you make an effort, your writing and reading WILL get better!  Probably my favorite professor at TCU.
He's the coolest guy you will ever meet

Alex is an amazing teacher. I went into the class not knowing about the creative writing subject, but he made it easy for me to enjoy and understand the material we were using. He expects you to participate, but doesnt penalize you for not giving the answer he was looking for. Excellent teacher!

He is one of the best professors I have had. He is fun and so is his class. He is very laid back and easy to talk to if you have any problems. He loves what he teaches and it makes it easy to enjoy the course. I highly recommend him!!!
Best professor ever. Cool, interesting, down to earth and way laid back. He emails you like 50 times a week, but they are interesting.
Alex was my favorite teacher! He is awesome! You have to do your readings, but they are actually easy and interesting to read! He is very laid back and down to earth! He is just awesome!!!
No Comments

Oh great heavens don't do this as a core if you are not IN LOVE with anthropology. He's very knowledgeable about what he teaches, but the class is very lecture heavy. Doesn't allow computers and tests are multiple choice.

He was such a sweet professor who really cares about what he teaches. He is very lecture heavy as well as quiz heavy. There is a quiz almost every week on either a reading or a video. The tests are manageable, there are quite a few things you are required to read.

Prof. Leatham is the sweetest, and genuinely cares about each of his students. In intro to anthro, there is a lot of reading, and is extremely lecture heavy, but as long as you go, you should be alright. The tests are all multiple choice, and so are all of the quizzes, so like said, doing well in the class depends on if you actually pay attention.

Take if you are in anthro, avoid if you just want to get the core curriculum done. You absolutely need to attend every lectures since there is no way to get the resources outside of class. We finished 3 books in this class. Topic is interesting but requires you to invest a lot of time reading and reviewing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Extremely kind, easy grader, and passionate about the material. But physical anthro is a LOT of memorization of specifics like dates, names, etc. Lots of readings but they do help for exams. Lectures can sometimes get dull when it's just him talking, but osteology lab was fun and hands-on. Overall if you like anthropology, you'll like this class.

He is so nice, but do not take this class unless you are really interested in anthropology. I took it as a core credit and was so bored during lecture. The exams a re really difficult and a lot of people in my class had to pass/no credit. Do not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Leatham is a kind and caring professor. However, his course includes a lot of reading and is very lecture-heavy. It is vital to pay attention in class. His lectures are sometimes interesting but can get a little boring. He is a good educator. It is important to go to class because that is the only place you learn what is on the test.

Very nice professor and amazing lecturer, you have to take extensive notes on basically everything he says in class though to make a good grade. If you go to class and pay attention though you'll be fine. He is very easy to meet with outside of class and willing to clarify important lecture points.

He is SO caring and really wants to help everyone do their best in the class. As long as you attend, pay attention, and take notes during lectures, the course is very easy. There are a lot of readings that you have to do, but he gives plenty of time and the questions pertaining to them are fairly straightforward.

Dr. Leatham's class was very enriching! I really enjoyed taking his class this semester! I feel like everything you learn opens your mind. It was very interesting to know more about topics we've heard about before like Scientology. I loved that he included a lot of information about his own ethnography! He is very intelligent and wise!

Class is lecture heavy and the slideshows are mostly pictures so take notes as tests cover only the lecture material and quizzes cover the readings for class. If you're confused or want a recap his office hours are great as he can give you the basic important points from lecture. This class takes effort but Dr. Leatham makes it fun and interesting.

This guy is super nice but if you need core credits, do not be tempted. This class has a lot of different core attributes affiliated with it but you will end up pass failing, messing up your GPA, and/or wanting to pull your hair out in every lecture. I studied so hard and none of the content made sense. Squeezed through every exam with a B or C.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Leatham is super passionate about anthro. He really likes what he does; if you are kind to him, he will be kind back. Taking notes is critical because the powerpoints are not really what he tests over. He spends more time lecturing. He doesn't allow computers, so bring a spiral or notebook for your notes. If you pay attention, it's an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a really nice guy, but if you are looking for an easy class this isn't it. I took this took to fill a core and ended up pass failing it. Lectures are all over the place and he is so smart you don't understand half of what he is saying. He doesn't post anything on TCU Online other than exam reviews. Be ready to read and teach yourself.

He is so passionate about anthro and it makes lectures engaging. Super nice guy, and he provides study guides for all the tests. All the quizzes were over readings, but they're not difficult to comprehend. Always willing to talk about grades or class material. Easily one of my favorite classes and professors!

Very passionate professor, always willing to answer questions. Can use notes on the test, difficulty is due to the sheer amount of material. He lectures from slideshows of just pictures, so write EVERYTHING he says. There are two books you have to read, but if you take notes on the readings and lectures, you should do fine on the test.
He's really nice and a super sweet guy. His lectures are hard but is an amazing guy. Fascinating prof and get ready to work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hes a really great person. Very nice and very accessible. However, he doesn't have words on any of his powerpoints and his lectures are very hard to follow. And this is coming from someone who had a history teacher just like him and passed with a 93. I would not recommend taking him, however, if you do, read, read, read and pay attention in class
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: one of my favorite professors at TCU. Do the readings and pay attention in class!

He's a good professor, you can't really complain. Yes there is reading, but it's nothing too long and they are usually interesting, and the quizzes are based on the reading. He does only lecture, and there's no power points, so you have to have taken good notes over his lecture to pass exams. This isn't stressful, just show up to class and listen.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hes very well respected and is a great instructor. For this class he gave out reviews for the tests and let you know what was to be on the quizzes, so you are able to prepare well. That being said the material is very extensive and requires a lot of reading. Also show up to class because he monitors attendance!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Leatham is one of my favorite professors at TCU, and I will be taking him for the fourth time next semester. He is very passionate about what he teaches. He is always available outside of class, and is willing to work with students to raise their grades. I highly recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Leatham was always accessible outside of class to help you understand the course material, which is needed. The course is extremely difficult and best to study in groups of which most will also be in the same position as you (confused). Confusing daily lectures which he usually trails off. Lots of reading. I studied extremely hard and made a C.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Please avoid taking this teacher at all costs. I will regret the class forever. There is no structure to the course and Leathem avoids the use of any technology, so yea that means no d2l, nothing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One of the smartest people I have ever met and highly respected in the world of anthropology. That being said, this class is not easy. He doesn't use powerpoint (only pictures) so you are responsible for writing everything down that he says which make the tests hard. His study guides are helpful but this class isn't easy unless you love anthro
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took this class because I thought that it would be an easy A, boy I was wrong. This class was very difficult and lacked structure. The teacher is a nice guy and funny but his lectures are very confusing and my classmates and I were confused the whole semester. You HAVE to read, go to class, and study hard if you want to get an A. NOT AND EASY A!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Cultural Anthropology wasnt a bad class overall, just the lack of structured notes made it hard. Tests aren't too difficult, as long as you have good notes. There are no power points or notes handed, it all depends on your note taking skills. He does hand out review guides a couple of days before an exam which were quite helpful.

Mr. Leatham is such a nice professor. Very helpful, will go out of his way to help you understand his lectures (which are interesting for sure). He will also make time to help you understand the reviews he hands out before tests. Really enjoyed his class. You will use your books, he does offer extra credit questions on tests.

I have enjoyed this class, and this is a professor that you can tell loves what he does. He gets excited sometimes in class and starts rambling about his experience with the material. There are no powerpoints other than to show pictures so taking notes is up to you. This was a night class so you need to come or you will miss out on information

Intro to Cultural Anthropology NOT AN EASY A. He has no structure to his class- no ppts, he just speaks & often gets off topic. The only time you have an idea of what you will be tested on is when he hands out the review (given after 90% of the material has been covered). I record his lectures and that helps. Passion doesn't cut getting a B for me
Hard and talks a lot and has a lot of stories but so helpful.  If you go see him in office hours your grade will easily go up a full grade.

Professor Leatham, is one of the most passionate teachers I've ever taken. Simply being in his class you can tell how passionate he is about this subject. The class isn't easy. There is a lot of reading, but I worked hard and am receiving an A. Definitely the best professor offered for this course! Take him!
Dr. Leatham is so overqualified to be a professor and anyone is lucky to take him. He is brilliant and cares so much about all his students and loves what he teaches.

Dr. Leatham is very passionate about anthropology and is extremely intelligent. He's a solid prof. but his lectures lack organization and his tests are much harder than they should be. If you want an A prepare to be frustrated

He is very Passionate about his work, but his anthro class was still difficutlt, i went to every class studied for every quiz and test, did all the readings and still made a C. i wouldnt recommend taking this class with him.
If you are lucky enough to study Ethnology of Religion with Dr. Leatham, it will be life-changing. My fav TCU prof so far!

I had Dr Leatham as a professor when he was at Texas A&I 1990s. Learned so much, very passionate about his work. If you sat near the front, took notes and paid attention, you could ace his class. We Javelinas taught him about not giving 1200 pgs of reading per week. I taught part of a folklore class because of cemetery paper I wrote.

Had him for both cultural anthropology and physical anthropology. I absolutely loved Dr. Leatham! He's the reason I made anthropology my minor. His tests aren't that bad. You have to go to class and read the textbook. If you do that you will get at least a B if not an A. He's the head of the department so he knows what he's doing. Great teacher!

You have to go to class and do the readings, but he's a very nice professor. The quizzes and tests are easy if you study and read the textbooks; it's just multiple choice. Definitely take it if you need GA/CA and SSC or just an interesting class and a GPA boost.
Amazing professor and passionate about his work. I recommend this guy! His tests are not hard and he goes over readings in class. The field trip to the Yerberia was my favorite part!

Great professor. Very dedicated and passionate at what he does. Has even done field work himself! Reinforces lecture material with photos and videos. Easy quizzes if you do the reading. Loves to help students during his office hours. Syllabus very clear and laid out. Would recommend as an intro to anthropology course.
Wonderful teacher and class. He's very passionate about his work so he really wants to get his students involved. Literally one of most sensible and understanding professors ever at TCU!:~)

Fantastic Prof! recommend strongly. extremely passionate about material, very easy to listen to. not boring. straight forward exams. very NICE! extremely generous and understanding. Great course to take at any time.
One of the nicest and most polite people I have ever met. Very well read, and super smart.

Incredible teacher, one of the most passionate professors you will ever meet. Highly knowledgable in his field and incredibly high amount of handson experience.  Fulfills cultural awareness and global awareness core requirements. Very helpful and if you do the reviews for the test and study well an A is attainable. Those who disagree are idiots!!!!

I had his Class for Intro to Anthrop. (Cultural Antrop). It was a very interesting class. His lectures may be a little boring at times, but he is very passionate about his field. His films are also very interesting! His exams are difficult, however, go to him and ask for him before the exams. He's very helpful!!

Really knows his stuff. Doesnt do a good enough job of keeping students interest. Also isnt very clear in lectures. Dont ever study the reviews he hands out, nothing on the review makes it on the test.

Had him for Anthropology and Religion.  He is very passionate about what he teaches, and is quite possibly the most intelligent person I've every met.  His lectures reflect that, often becoming detailed and lengthy, with lots of information.  Attending class is a must, because he assigns a TON of reading.  Hard A.  Dont take if you slack.
Very helpful and nice although lecture can be a little lengthy at times

Dr. Leatham founded the Anthro department at TCU and did field work with an apocalyptic sect in Mexico.  He's extremely passionate about teaching.  His lectures are intense because he has so much to say, but very engaging.  The class is a challenge but rewarding because you won't learn material anywhere else. Recommended.

He is extremely passionate about his work.  I had to work just to get a B.  I was always shooting for an A, but never came close.  The tests cover everything and often details you would not expect would matter.  You learn quite a bit, but if you are looking for a class to help your GPA do not take this one.  If you just want a challenge here it is.

Probably the worst lecturer I've ever come across. Lectures are random and rambling. Constantly mumbling...but he has a good heart. Really into anthropology. His first test will scare you. Do NOT listen in lectures/attend every day. You will die of boredom. Show up for quizzes and tests/reviews. READ THE BOOK(S)! Everything on test comes out of it!
boo

I had so much difficulty trying to take notes in this class--it's the end of the semester and I still haven't figured it out.  The tests were also very hard for me, you REALLY need to know the book material.  Maybe I didn't do well because I spaced out in class so much . . .I got bored, what can I say.

He is a GREAT guy and a really good teacher. If you dont understand just ask him during his office hours and he will fill you in. And he will tell you what you need to know for tests if you visit him in his office hours....Bottom line....take him, he's guaranteed for a good grade if you study.

One of the nicest, most intelligent teachers I've had. You can have an 2-hour conversation with him and he will treat you with nothing more than respect. His tests are very fair, and he is even sympathetic and helpful if test averages have dropped. He is extremely passionate about anthropololgy!
This guy is very nice.  Willing to help.  I thought class was interesting.  A bit nerdy looking but very intelligent.  Study notes and read and you'll do fine.
Very good teacher, has a revenge of the nerds air to him, but none the less he truly tries to help students. No attendance taken, but going to class is highly recommended.

A brilliant man,incredibly intelligent, but NOT meant to be a teacher. Lectures jump from topic to topic without notice--very confusing.Extremely boring!  He also mumbles and is difficult to understand sometimes. Highly not recommended!!

an amazingly smart man. and he is so nice. absolutely adores anthropology and could tell you ANYTHING about it. one of the most intelligent men here. be willing to put forth effort and read and go to class and you will do fine. hes very willing to help.
probably the most boring guy in the world...

The material is interesting; however, the class is nearly impossible, as the exams have little to do with the lectures and cover the most insignificant details, making it difficult to know what to focus on. Be sure to brush up on your Portuguese, too.

Leatham is probably one of the smartest people on campus, but he does have a weird factor that turns many students off. He's passionate about his work, and has some hilarious stories. He taught me that it's okay to pray for (and to) a refridgerator.
Best teacher I've had at TCU. Tests are straightforward, final not comprehensive. He is so enthusiastic about the material.
No Comments
Nice guy who knows his stuff but he's really boring. Don't take this class early in the day. Also, beware his  pittage.
He is a nice guy and is really smart, but let me warn you...he is so completely boring.  Only take him if you are intesly interested in Anthropology.

He is one of the nicest guys I've ever had the pleasure of meeting.  His tests and lecture are straightforward, and he has to be the only professor I know that lectures straight out of his head!  No notes or anything...at least not that I can ever see
His intro class is really interesting, clear and manageable, one of the best I've taken at TCU. Highly recommend. Tests are short and over specific material, no cumulative stuff. Great guy.

He is an insanely intelligent man with a zest for anthropology. He loves teaching and loves the subject and is willing to help anyone who wants it. Take at least one class from him. I can't say enough good things about it.
Love this guy. Take him for FR1 in fall and FR2 in spring.

I'd overall recommend. Can be a little annoying cause he makes up his own terms (like can't say "debit" have to say "left side".) But he's nice, funny, and grades pretty easily. The class is set up to help you do well

Genuinely baffles me that anybody can rate him less than a 5. AMAZING prof who is kind and cares about his students. Super funny, which makes FR1 more enjoyable. Grades tests himself and gives partial credit. FR1 is hard, but I'd take it with Lim 100/100 times. Finished with an 89, and he rounded me to an A- before I could even ask. Just take him!
I LOVE SLIM!!!!!! he cares so much and tries to make a complicated class fun. TAKE HIM!!!!
Slim is a pretty chill professor. Class can be hard at times but he's one of the best options for FR2. Exams look just like the in-class group projects so study those and you'll do fine.

He's a good guy and solid teacher. If you get past the accent and start asking questions, then he's a great resource for FR1 and FR2 (had him for both). FR2 is just hard as hell material. I think he's one of the best teachers for both classes. Great guy, don't miss out cuz of these mid reviews like actually.

Prof. Lim isn't the best but also not the worst. He is a bit hard to understand and his lectures are pretty brutal but he is a nice guy who is pretty funny at times. FR 1 is a tough class in general but Lim's tests are not too difficult. There is minimal HW, some classwork and only 3 tests. He shouldn't be your 1st choice but he is a decent option.

"SLim" is a very funny professor and makes the lectures enjoyable in a very tough class. He gives you group projects to complete and these are your best study tools for his 4 exams. He gives you a one page cheat-sheet but some of the questions on the exams you will have never seen before which makes it tough to give him a good rating.

WORST teacher ever. Does not teach well at all and gives you graded problems in class and literally tells you to not do what's on the notes from something we just learned. The tests are only 6 work out problems. You only get 1 sheet front and back for notes while the other class got unlimited notes, including for the final. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!

He gets too bad of a rap. He has three tests that make up the majority of your grade that you definitely do have to study for. He explains things well and if you study the HW and Group Projects closely, you will do well. You have to study hard for those, but I did, and never got below an 87. A little hard to understand but way better than Cobb.

This was one of the toughest classes I've taken. I did great in my other courses so this one didn't hurt as bad but, wow! His teaching does not prepare you for the exams at all. If you aren't where he feels you should be on understanding the material, he will be no help to you. I barely passed, thankfully, I'm just glad to be done with acct courses
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Stephen Lim aka Slim was a very funny professor. Make sure to sit in the front of the class because he tends to teach to those in the front and it's easier to understand him. The test questions come directly from the in class assingments or Connect hw. Just study those and ask lots of questions and you'll do well in this class.

He means well, but he is an abysmal teacher. He can barely speak English, and doesn't really get the more complicated material through to people easily. Test 1 is easy, but the following are all very difficult and pull heavily from the connect assignments and group assignments. If you are good at FR, go for it. If not, it is going to suck with Lim

This guy is the living embodiment of a joke. He can barely speak English, and he uses odd analogies and comparisons to try to get you to Ni understand the material through his thick accent. He will give you the prior year test before each test, but they are not accurate to the specific questions he will actually ask. Study connect and teach yoursel

He is a great professor, but really stubborn. He relies a lot on his slides and guides the class to self learn among groups. However, you do learn a lot of as groups and weights heavy fro the cumulative grade from these assignments. It also takes the boredom out fo the class to an extent. Just beware it is accounting so it is still challenging.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I absolutely LOVE this professor! Initially, I took this class because it was the only one that worked with my schedule but I am so glad I did. I learned so much in this class and I especially appreciated his prompt email responses.

I was hesitant at first because of past reviews. This guy was great!!! One of the easiest classes I have taken at TCU. I took the summer class and it was straight forward and the tests are pretty easy. He gives you homework questions and last semesters tests. All the test questions come from the homework or previous tests. An "A" is totally doable.

Professor Lim is very willing to help in any way possible and is very open to suggestions on how to better teach the class. Intermediate II is filled with tough topics but if you go to class, work the connect problems and ask questions it is possible to do very well in this course.

Intermediate Accounting II is a very difficult topic regardless of the course instructor. He is by far my favorite professor in accounting I have taken thus far at TCU. His lectures are interesting and he ties theory to accounting problems. He is available and approachable to his students whenever you need him! He wants you to succeed.

Very good professor with clear explanation on some important terminology. The exam is not hard, if you finish your homework by yourself. I like his leads and clues to some hard topic in intermediate II.

He is a very good professor and is very attentive to his students. It is a harder class and students don't particularly like harder classes, which is why he gets lower ratings. If you study and apply yourself the class becomes much easier. Steve is a great professor.

I had him for a summer Inter II class and it was probably the easiest Acct class I've taken at TCU. He isn't a great teacher but he wants you to learn. All of the test questions came from either the homework or last year's test which he gives you. It really wasn't that bad
