That being said, there's A LOT of material and her tests were extremely long (don't underestimate that). Most found her challenging, but I think it's worth it. No homework, 3 tests

Profesor Munson is very passionate about art history and made learning it great! She gives you a lot of information, but as long as you go to class and take notes you should do fine. Her tests though were extremely hard, but she gave really good feedback, and was always helpful. We had two museum visits which were my favorite parts of the class!

One warning: when he says he takes attendance seriously, he really isn't kidding. I was counted tardy for being 1 minute late. Otherwise, he does a great job of teaching ear training. YOU WILL HOWEVER, LEARN TO HATE AURALIA. It is a department wide thing though, not just him. His stories are very entertaining :)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Mr. Murrow is a nice guy. However, he has perfect pitch, so I think it is harder for him to teach ear training. Once you figure out how to practice for him, though, he is pretty easy. This was my third semester with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Some people like Mr. Murrow for Ear Training because it's easy. But I didn't feel that I learned anything. He rambles and lectures when Ear Training is supposed to be us participating. I swear I heard the same stories over and over. He's a nice guy, but I wouldn't recommend him unless you just wanna get through Ear Training without learning.

Mr Murrow is amazing!!! He knows a lot about a lot.  Our class was really loose and we had a lot of fun.  He has a great sense of humor and tells really good stories. Very supportive and cooperative if you make an effort.  If you have to take ear training, take Murrow's class! You will learn a lot more than just ear training
LOVED Murrow!  Keeps class entertaining, hardly any homework, knowledgeable and caring... if you have to take ear training, take it with mMurrow!!!
Great prof if you show enthusiasm and actually care about your lessons

Knows quite a bit, has a great ear, doesn't sympathize much if you don't. Will tell you to go to the listening lab,but usually doesn't help much. Requires a lot of learning on your own. I was lucky. Is helpful if you have a good ear and enjoy learning, but otherwise, you're better off with Carter, Gunter(may not be teaching), or Blessinger.
One of the nicest men I've ever meet.  Very helpful in lessons and cares about your success. Don't slack off tough, or he'll get on your back
expects way too much. do not have time enough to do everything required. if you miss anything, you loose your head, no matter what its for. i don't like work as it is... this is just ridiculous.
One of the smartest people in the school of music. I love his class. He'll also teach you cool things about different learning styles.
way hard... give too much stuff to work out during a week. I never have much time as it is, and this just swallows up what free time I did have. horrible.

Dr. Slattery is the goat. He wrote his own textbook so it matches exactly with the slides and lecture material, and he gives pretty good study guides, so studying for the exam is straightforward and doable. Super engaging lectures with great visual aids so I was rarely bored, I loved the material. Great guy, super qualified, great NSC credit.

Took as a science core class thinking it would be easy. It was not. The tests are extremely hard and based on exact facts stated in the lectures. Lab quizzes were easy, but the class exams brought down my grade. I had taken this class in high school and still got 60% on all exams. If you don't go to lecture and take extensive notes you will fail.

VERY lecture heavy. There is not a lot of info on slideshows, so being in class for the lecture is essential. Your grade is entirely based on exams, and there is only 1 homework assignment for the whole semester. He is good at making complex topics simple in lecture. He always responds to emails and is available outside of class to talk to.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This guy cannot correctly pronounce "Costa Rica" or the word "schedule".
Test are nearly impossible basically just very exact stuff in the lectures. Lab is easy quizzes are easy not mandatory but the test are very hard. Fade
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: TERRIBLE!!!! I am a business major and needed a science credit and he taught this class as if everyone in there was an environmental science major. He has a strong accent and I couldn't understand him most of the time. Tests are unreasonably hard and there are quizzes every week. RUN WHEN YOU CAN!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The professor is amazing. But DO NOT TAKE this class if you're expecting an easy A to pass the core requirement. I spent more time studying for this class than my major ones. Tests are long and hard, need to read a lot and attend class if wanna get high grade. There's also a lab which requires lots of studying for the weekly quiz and final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Slattery is outstanding and his class is fascinating. I had no issues with the content but I know a lot of people that did. You have to attend lecture, pay attention, and take good notes or you will not do well on the exams. The textbook is very helpful. This class does take some work but an A is very attainable.

This class is not hard besides the in-class exams your only way to study would be your notes. In his lectures, he VERY rarely puts words on the screen and it is very hard to keep up with just his voice because there is nothing to look back to. The tests were very hard and even people that were very smart in science were having issues in my class.

I used a pass no credit on this class, granted I don't pay super great attention because the class is very lecture heavy and hard material to understand if you're not into science. Labs are not hard, but annoying busy work. I prob would get a B but didn't want that on my transcript. if you paid good attention and studied a little an A would be easy

Despite the class being easy, you must show up.  Since there is a quiz every lab that is over the previous lecture and lab pages, attendance is basically mandatory.  With this in mind, if you apply yourself and take notes during the lectures and listen you should do well.  Homework is light and this is one of my least stressful classes.

Tests were incredibly difficult, studied for hours and still failed them because they are so specific and he wants exact numbers. Got an A in lab which saved my grade, but lecture was unnecessarily hard.

Professor Slattery is great! His passion for what he teaches makes the class that much more enjoyable! His exams are fairly easy if you take good and detailed notes in class. His slides consist of mainly images that he then explains so paying attention is crucial! I would definitely recommend him if you are needing an Environmental Science credit!
Giant lecture with in person scantron tests. Not too difficult and Professor Slattery is nice.

Slattery is an amazing, amazing professor. So passionate about his work and wants you to succeed. If you go to class, he will let you know what you will see on the exam. Textbook is necessary to catch some details you may have missed in class. There is not a better option for NSC. Also, he is very unbiased politically.

This is an AMAZING and EYE OPENING class. I did not expect to enjoy it so much. It is not easy, but it isn't extremely hard either - it keeps you honest. You MUST go to class and lab to succeed. Do the readings before tests! You need to UNDERSTAND the material to succeed. I used the study guides as discussion guides. Getting an A is very doable.

I do not doubt that he is an expert in his field. But, showing up to class, reading the book and studying on your own time is not enough. His exams were so detailed that going over his guide was not good enough. Also, his textbooks are ridiculously expensive and even then *I* did not find it helpful

He is a great professor! The tests are hard but there are quizlets online to study with. Attendance is not required, but you HAVE to go to class to do well. USE THE TEXTBOOK TO STUDY! HE WROTE IT! All the diagrams were in the book and powerpoints so I followed along in the book while he lectured.

The class was very easy and honestly a breathe of fresh air from the last two years of the business school. If you go to every single lecture, listen, and take notes, you will easily get an A. It's really that easy. The lab is definitely annoying though. Also, DO NOT BUY HIS BOOK, it is a waste of money and unnecessary. Just go to class and review

Kind prof and SUPER knowledgeable! I think this course is very important to take (because the topics are so relevant) and I found it to be quite interesting. If you don't go to class and don't put it any effort it'll be difficult, but if you attend class and study before the exams you'll be fine. The labs are kinda annoying. Overall, I recommend!

Slattery is amazing. He is so knowledgeable in his work, and you really respect the guy. No homework, easy quizzes, and all of the information you need is in his lectures (which are great). And, if you miss a lecture, all of the information is in the textbook, which he wrote. He is easy to talk to, funny, personable, and willing to help.

Dr. Slattery is a really good professor. There are three exams throughout the semester, and the third one is the final so it's not cumulative. There are weekly quizzes but those are taken at home. You HAVE to pay attention in class in order to do good. He does not put information on his slides, they are just pictures and then he talks about them.

I took Professor Slattery's class in Fall 2021 and he just all around seems like a good guy. I didn't mind getting up early to listen to his lectures, and he always explained things in a way that made sense. Just write down what he says (he'll emphasize if something's on the test) and it's relatively easy to get a good grade!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Slattery for Contemporary Issues in Environmental Science and really enjoyed the class! He loves hearing students' perspectives when they share in class and encourages his students to engage in critical thinking about the environmental issues we face today. His tests are based on quizzes and lectures and he gives test reviews.

Dr Slattery is very lecture intensive, and his slides are often confusing. They often have nothing to do with what is being spoken about. Quizzes and tests are way too specific, so much so, that it felt ludicrous when taking tests. Useless percentages are needed, instead of actually fully understanding process.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: It's probably the easiest natural science class I've ever taken at TCU (I know it can be difficult for someone who isn't into sciences, but you just gotta go to class to get the contents that are going to be featured in the exams). Weekly quizzes are easy, lab requires some work but only accounts for 10-15% something. Slattery is a nice guy.

Professor Slattery is the nicest man ever. He is so passionate about what he teaches and has lots of real-life experience. His lectures are interesting, but the tests are hard. He is very approachable and definitely cares about his students. Even though I did not get the grade I wanted I really enjoyed his class!

Dr. Slattery is a real lecturer, very knowledgeable, and knows what he's talking about. Attend class or else you gonna miss out on important information (which will be featured in the exams). The lab requires some work but is graded pretty easily (depending on who's teaching). Overall I think the environmental class is the easiest for NSC core.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Slattery is an excellent lecturer and makes the material interesting to learn about. The class is not that hard at all but does take some effort. If you need a natural science credit you should take him!

Comes at each topic from a neutral and scientific standpoint. SUPER clear about what will be on exams. Read for the quizzes and study your lecture notes for exams. Super open to questions and feedback. All around great prof and great class. Wouldn't say it was an easy A but it for sure isn't the hardest natural science to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class was harder than I expected. It is very test heavy and to do well on his tests, you have to pay attention in class and study.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is straight forward, but the test content is lecture heavy. If you pay attention in lectures and study, you should do well, and Professor Slattery is super helpful and knows what he is talking about.

This class is on the A/B system and not the +/-. I don't know how but at the end of the semester I had a borderline grade but was somehow able to make it out with an A. The Exams seemed really hard while you were taking them, but when you got your grade back it would be higher than you thought. Slattery is by far one of the best profs @ TCU.

He is a super great guy and very educated on the topic. He has a lot of travel and world experience that is interesting to hear about. His lectures are a little hard to follow sometimes but he posts them online after so you can rewatch them and take more notes. Overall a great teacher and is usually understanding about some late work.

Unless u r into learning about the environment this class is super boring. Lectures put me to sleep. Professor is a good and very knowledgeable. Tests even being online no lockdown weren't that easy. Not the hardest core but definitely not an easy one. If you want an A make sure you put in effort from the start. Records & posts lectures online.

This class is really interesting and Dr. Slattery is very passionate about the subject which makes lectures even better. There are a lot of graphs and math to memorize which was annoying but it is doable. Quizzes are pretty easy and tests are easy if you study. he provides review sheets for exams

Definitely recommend taking professor Slattery for Environmental Science. Attendance isn't mandatory but a lot of the information he talks about in lectures is on the test and won't put on his PowerPoints. Slattery is so passionate about the topic which makes his lectures a lot more interesting.

Dr. Slatterly is great. He wrote the textbook you use but I enjoyed it and its an easy read. He gives out study guides before the tests to make it easy and there are quizzes you take online before each new chapter. He is very passionate and it shows. You come out of the class with a whole new sense of knowledge. Take his class!

Definitely take Dr. Slattery's class!! He is very well versed in what he is talking about, and he even wrote the textbook you will use for his class. If you go to lectures and pay attention, you will do very well in the class. His exam reviews show all of the topics that will be on each exam. Overall, Slattery is a great professor and a great guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: GO TO CLASS! If you miss a class, you won't have all of the information needed for his tests. Also, take good notes because even though he gives you a test review, you will need to know other information. Overall he is a really solid professor who is passionate about what he teaches and makes class very interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Although attendence is not mandatory, I would highly reccomend it for content. Make sure to study for exams as they are the only grades, except for a writing assignment and lab grade, a good experience overall, Dr. Slattery is a professor who cares about his course, and content, and makes it interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Slattery is very passionate about the topic and he makes it so interesting, he genuinely cares about his students. Great choice for non science majors and easy core class. Attendance isnt mandatory but definitely helpful for tests. 3 tests and one minor essay. Lab isnt that bad!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Slattery is passionate about his work and interesting to listen to. His class is in a 200+ person lecture hall so he doesn't take attendance, but it is useful to go because he gives out a lot of test questions during lecture. Labs are easy. Only 2 test and a final which are 100% based on the textbook. Just need to read all the chapters before tests

This is a really good core class to take and is an easy A as long as you show up. Doesn't take attendance but you should go because a lot of test questions are from what he says in class and not on the powerpoints posted online. You only have a couple exams to determine your grade along with your grade in lab. Lab was the worst part but very easy.

Dr. Slattery is the best! As long as you go to class this should be an easy A, he doesn't take attendance but it will help you understand the material! Dr. Slattery is an expert in this field but he really helps you understand the material and doesn't expect you to be as smart as him. Easy lab too!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Slattery is the best. I'm a biology major, took this class for my minor, learned a TON but did have to study a decent amount to get an A(but still way less studying than a Bio class requires). He's a generous grader. This class made me wish I was an ENSC major. Cool class, easy lab.

THE BEST PROFESSOR. he is very passionate about wind and rhinos. grade is 3 tests and lab. you need to go to class to do well and all the bad comments on here are just because after the first test, people stop coming to class. HE IS ONE OF THE BEST PROF. keeps his opinion out of teaching and admits where he is biased. go to office hours before test

Not a terribly hard class, but you have to go to class to do well on the tests. Grade is only dependent on 3 tests and then your lab (labs are easy). Nice guy, not hard tests but you just have to memorize and learn all the information to do well
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors at TCU. He is clearly an expert in his field and always answers questions very well. Your class grade will be 75% tests and 25% labs so make sure you study and attend lectures.  If you're interested in learning the science behind Climate Change you will walk away from this class very pleased.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: It is lecture heavy and you need to go to class for sure. Dr. Slattery welcomed comments and questions during lecture. I loved that he provided reviews that were not ridiculously overwhelming! If we don't understand what he is saying he clarifies and makes sure we get it. You definitely have to work hard, but it's not impossible to get an A!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is good at explaining things and he knows a lot. But his tests are ridiculously hard. You have to memorize all the statistics and specific details from the book and from the slides. He makes you draw graphs or diagrams  or even both. If you want to get an A:read, take notes, go to class, memorize, and get good grades on the labs. Labs are easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Slattery is a good dude but if memorizing charts and graphs is your thing take this class. Awesome lectures but the test are nothing but regurgitating information that you hear during lectures.

You have to go to class. He goes over material in class that isn't in the book and will be on the exam. He is extremely helpful and will go over the material with you. Very interesting subject, but you will need to read, take notes, and study to pass. The only grades are 3 tests and the lab grade.

Super passionate about his subject, which makes it easy to listen to his lectures. Attendance is critical because he mentions specific questions and diagrams that will be on the tests. The only grades are 3 tests and the lab grade, so you won't have much homework, just study hard! If you go to class and take good notes, you'll be good!!

People are really tough on Dr. Slattery. He is an extremely smart man and knows everything about his subject. You have to go in and talk to him often and he will help. Most people that don't attend lectures perform poorly on tests. ATTEND CLASS, write down everything he says and take notes out of book. He's helpful with grades if you worked hard!!!

After getting an A+ in contemporary issues in Bio I figured this class would be about as easy. WRONG. Lectures were BEYOND BORING and monotonous. The tests were more about solving scientific equations or explaining the molecule reactions in the different layers of ozone ect... Ruined my GPA by barely passing with a C so now I have to retake it! :)

I really liked this class and Professor Slattery!! He's really well informed about the subject, but understands that you aren't and doesn't expect you to be a genius. The lectures are interesting, but there are only three tests and a lab grade, so you have to do well on the tests. They aren't hard though, if you go to class and pay attention.

Slattery is the most intelligent teacher I have ever had. He is basically a master in this subject but his classes are extremely fast paced and can be overwhelming. Tests are incredibly difficult even after hours of studying. Worth taking because I did learn a lot but by no means is it easy

This class is difficult but it is not if you put a lot amount of time studying and attend his office hours if you are lost. This is a fast paced class and if you go see him in his office hours, he explains with more clarity. However, labs are easy and they help!

Class is not as hard as everyone or some people say. It depends on how much you put in to it. Getting a A is not hard as long as you attend lectures and take good notes. also read the book to gain more insight into the lectures since he wrote the book. Dr. Slattery is really nice and he will help you if he sees you are driven.

This class is pretty easy. Just go to class and pay attention and you'll be fine. Dr. Slattery is really smart and his lectures are really interesting. The class is really cool and a great science credit. I highly recommend this class.

I don't understand why everyone says this class is so hard. You just need to show up to class, take some notes, and do the study guide. Slattery is one of the best professors at TCU. He teaches in a way that is extremely interesting. Getting an A is not very hard, especially since the class isn't +/-. Plus the lab is easy.
Great lectures but difficult tests if  you don't put in a good amount of time studying.

Went to every lecture, studied my butt off and ended up with a D.  Tests are ludicrous, asking trivial details such as dates and numbers.  I would bomb the multiple choice sections of tests but would get perfect scores on the short answer sections, that tells me that I understood the concepts but couldn't remember trivial, useless information.

This class was totally ridiculous. Study guides were vague or nonexistent and the prof was constantly out of town or otherwise unavailable. Tests included minute details from the text and the class average was around a C. Prof wrote the book which is way too wordy and full of gramatical errors, worst experience I've had at TCU. Only C on my script.

Without question, the best professor I've ever had. The man is a genius. But the great thing about him is that he doesn't expect you to be a genius too. He just expects you to get a general understanding of the material based on what he teaches. He's extremely clear in his explanations. Grading is fair. You have to study, but he's by no means hard.

Alot of people dont go to class becasue his lectures are off of powerpoints that are posted online. I never went and jsut studied the night before tests and ended up with a B. If you work hard getting an A isnt a problem. If you get Abby for lab you will get an A which is 25% of your overall grade.
awesome
This class was very low maitenance but hard. You must attend class and pay attention to the lectutres in order to know whats on the test. I studied hard and still ended up with a C

He is extremely knowledgeable and his class is very manageable. You don't have to read. Just attend class and watch his slide show notes and bring your copy of them. His tests are somewhat challenging, but if you know your notes, it's a breeze. Not the easiest class, but he keeps your attention, and it's enjoyable.

I love Dr. Slattery! I took his class Weather and Climate this summer and learned a lot. Pay attention and go to class and you will be fine on his tough tests. He is very good at explaining stuff, and he's got an accent, you can't go wrong with that...

He is a really good professor, encourages discussion in class and loves feedback during lectures.  His tests are application based multiple choice with 1 short answer. Study hard and you'll go far.  He also "reconsiders" one test grade so you can fail one, and get 2 A's and still make an A
Incredibly boring.  I never missed a class, I went to study sessions, and I worked so hard, yet I still made a D.  He is extremely unhelpful.

Weather&Climate-No doubt this class is hard (mostly because of the material) but Dr. Slattery's explinations are clear and concise.Print out handouts for each lecture and take good notes.Tests are hard.Mostly short answer & essay.Dont flake out on class or you will fail!He is the best prof I've had!
He is a great prof, nice guy, but hard.  His tests are tough.  Must attend lectures and pay attention.  Very passionate about the subject.  Lab is easy.  Take the class if you need another PS-L.
Nice, funny guy. Be sure to go to lectures! Tests can be tricky...STUDY!!

I took this class thinking its was going to be an easy A. it was not. you have to understand all his graphs and be able to use them in the exam. the lab is an easy 96%. lecture material is not too bad but the exams r not the easiest. if u understand his way of asking questions, u r damn lucky.

He's a good man. He allows you to print out powerpoints so you can focus easier on the lecture. Is interested in teaching so you will learn. Most everything from lecture appears on the test. You will work to get an A but you can easily make a B. Good experience.

MAKE SURE you go to class, and definitely to lab. Lots of statistics and graphs. Would not recommend if you're bad at microeconomics/business courses. Interesting stuff. Plus, when do you ever get to take a field trip in college?

He really wants to help you and always extends his help. If you need help after the first test make sure you go in for help! But even when you study it is always a little hard to predict what will be on his tests. Lectures: a lot of charts and graphs.
Very good prof.  Forgets what he covers, so sometimes he puts past info on exams.  Interesting lab science, but if you can't get copies of old tests, don't bother taking it.
Very smart man.  Knows what he is talking about.  Going to class is a must b/c the tests are based heavily on the notes.
Slides available online, but actually have to go to class to get the notes. Tests aren't horrible if you study. Lab is extremely boring, but fairly easy.
I went to every single lecture and took notes, and studied.  I have a C.  He forgets what is on the tests from previous years.

Lectures are a must for this course. his lectures are online for printout, so that you can follow in class.  everything is presented, you just have to pay attention in class.  tests are pretty straighforward, he gives you a heads up-YUMMY!

Pretty difficult tests that cover material not gone over in class (he uses past tests, and apparently he forgets what he covered that particular semester).  But interesting, funny in class.   Here's a Yummy question for the final!  he'll say

Extremely hard. Test were out of this world hard. Never talked about half the things on the test in lecture. Lab was not too difficult, but the lectures were boring, and the class was increadibly difficult. I would recommend Understand the Earth over this

I took this class for Survey of Rock. There is one daily listening per class, which takes about five minutes. Then you can do whatever for the rest of class while he lectures. All tests are online, and if you do the three extra credits, then you are exempt from the final. Should make a 100 in this class.

This class put me on a lot of new artists/songs and it was pretty cool overall. Daily listening assignment every class, but they're basically completion grades. If you do all the extra credit assignments then you're excused from the final. All tests are open-note and not lockdown browser. It's honestly hard to not pass this class - take it :)

By far the easiest class I've taken at TCU. All exams are online, open for a week, and not lockdown. iClicker attendance but you get some excused absences (for formals and stuff). Weekly homework assignments but super easy. TAKE THIS CLASS

He's a super easy professor, and you can tell he's very passionate and knowledgeable about what he teaches. Exams are online and open-note. He uses iclicker, and there's a ‘song of the day' assignment every class. There were extra credit opportunities. I mostly listened to him while doing other work during lectures.
Attendance isn't required and tests are all online.

Professor Philipp is a phenomenal teacher with very engaging lectures. The only assignments are daily listening exercises that are done in class so there is never homework. He also offers extra credit

It's hard to not get an A in this class. Do the assignments and take home tests, you get unlimited attempts. Do the extra credit assignment so you don't have to do the final. But genuinely loved going to the lectures, interesting class if you need an easy elective.

So easy. Just sit in class and fill out daily listening that he tell u the answer to most of the time. 4 open everything at home exams. 1 super easy paper due at the end of the semester. If you do the extra credit u don't have to take the final

Simply put, his class is like listening to a podcast about music. If you do the 3 extra credits, you don't have to attend the final, but the final is just like the extra credit assignment (video + fill out a paper). The daily listenings are really easy too.

He cares about msuic but understands others dont. Tests are open note, online at home. Daily writing assignment he does for you. Attendance is taken but small part of grade. Final paper at end of year but is given out in october. Not great at teaching you how to understand music but goes over history well. Easy A to boost GPA

easiest class ever. don't have to go to class, just sign in with i clicker. tests are online and open notes. i did the extra credit and didn't even go to the final. he is really funny and i actually learned a lot from listening to him give lectures. the class material is fun and you get to listen to new music!
TAKE HIM!!! Short writings each class, online tests, final paper, show up for the final, and answer questions from a video. Plus he's funny and accepts late work.
Super nice guy, super interesting class, super easy. Probably the easiest class you'll ever find at TCU. Highly recommend.

Take this class! Hard to not get an A. Professor Philipp is awesome, and the grading is super lenient. As long as you follow the basic requirements of assignments (which there aren't many assignments) you will get 100%. The tests are online, you get infinite attempts, and a full week to do them. An awesome course where I learned a lot!

Very easy class and an easy way to get your fine arts credit. Attendance is mandatory but its also online so you can do is from anywhere. He is really laid back and an easy grader. He gives a lot of extra credit but you don't really need it. I think it requires a book but you also don't really need that either.

He's a funny guy but his lectures are pretty long and can get boring if not interested in the material. You don't have to buy the book. There's a small assignment for each class and very easy exams. Honestly easy A.

He carefully explains and derives new concepts and formulae. Not much homework after every unit but it prepares you for quizzes and exams. Textbook is not required but recommended for self-studying and revision problems. Helpful during office hours. Attendance is not required but there are always potential quizzes so make sure to attend his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Naumov is great. class is tough, but he will go out of his way to help you if you ask for it. Accessible at any time. You will have to study or you will not pass.

Dr. Naumov is the best. He cares about all his students and makes sure they all succeed. He's a great teacher for physics 2, he encourages questions and will take extra time to explain things if he needs to. He does lots of demos and keeps the class interesting. By far one of the best professors in the physics department.

Dr. Naumov is one of my favorite professors I've ever had. He is very caring and clearly loves teaching. He is always available for help outside of class (in fact he pretty much insists that you reach out to him).  The course is tough but if you work hard and read you will pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Naumov is a gem! He's so excited about what he teaches and loves to give his students hands on experiences to keep them engaged. He is super clear with what he requires for a good grade and is always willing to talk about literally anything. LOVE HIM!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Naumov was amazing!! I was super scared to take this course, but it became my favorite one of the semester. He is super fun, and he loves to teach physics. He will do his best to make sure that everyone understands a subject and will challenge you to think really hard!

Makes class fun and responds quickly if you email him with questions. You can tell he's passionate about the material and cares about the students. Definitely had to work for an A, but its doable if you focus on understanding the material, not just memorizing formulas. Focus on reviewing lecture slides and some practice problems for the tests.

I thought this teacher always was willing to help his students learn the material. He wants to give as much partial credit as he can and wants to alleviate as much pressure as he can during tests even if he builds it up a little bit before tests. He is a sweet guy and does care for his students even though he may seem intimidating at first.

I don't think I have ever enjoyed a lecture more than I have in her class. There are a lot of guest speakers, which is always exciting. The course load is not bad. You have one main paper, a couple of quizzes and exams (open-note), and a group project a the end of the year. A lot of information is common sense so the readings were not necessary.
Her class was a lot of work but she didn't grade terribly hard. She really cared about her students but beware... there is A LOT of writing.

Dr. E gives a lot of feedback on your work which can be very helpful, but she can be a tough grader. She gives funny lectures and is great to talk to, but likes that the class engages in the discussions a lot as well.

Being a male in her class will change your mind on the topic of domestic violence and rape. She is VERY passionate about the subject. She is generally ok. Every year the class puts on a Take Back the Night event. Sometimes it can seem like its her event and your doing the work but its for a grade and its important to her. Great experience!

Dr.Mcmillan is better for general chemistry, but she has to teach the course for engineering students, her effort is indicative to this fact, just go elsewhere. As a TCU engineering student, ask your advisor about Oregon State's Chemistry course over the summer. Dr. Gong (IYKYK) suggested i take that instead and I was too hard headed to listen.

Can be a hard a class, but you will leave with a solid knowledge of the material and will not be confused if you put in the work. Also a very nice and personable professor who makes an effort to connect with her students. After taking her class, I still make an effort to visit her office and catch up.
Great professor, very invested in her students success. Helped me understand chemistry! If you put the effort in, she will help you succeed.
if you want to be happy please dont take this class with her. she makes everything make no sense and lectures horribly and tends to actually get her own work wrong.

Dr. McMillan is the best! I took her Gen Chem II class over the summer, and her expectations were super clear. As long as you listen in lecture and do adequate practice outside of class, you will be successful! Dr. McMillan is my favorite professor, and she does a great job of covering the material that will be on the exam. Take her!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. McMillan is one of the best professors at TCU. She explains things very well and her office hours are very helpful. She helped me understand chemistry!
She's pretty chill.

Do not take her!!! Take any other chem professor!! Extremely rude and not forgiving. Does not explain things very well and favors students over others. If you struggle in chemistry, do not take her...

If you don't have to take her don't. The other chemistry teachers are way more forgiving and Nelli holds high standards. If you do have to take her prepare. I took the summer boot camp and it helped me tons.

Be ready for a tough semester and not knowing what is gona be on the quizzes and tests. Class average for tests are anywhere below 70%. Id try and find another teacher than her. She's nice and all but there's probably better.
Bad teaching style. Sits in the back and lectures. Skims over material and expects you to know it. Test way too difficult.

As an engineering student with 16 credit hours,I spent 80% of my time studying for this class and the rest of 20% to get A's on the rest of the 5 classes and still got a bad grade on her class. She gives good lectures,is easy to reach during office hours,but her expectations for exams and quizzes are insane to put it mildly. Choose at your own risk
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very rude, makes fun of student's grades. Homeworks and reviews have little to do with what pops up in the quizzes. Thousands of slides and barely any of the information is important for quizzes.

Such a funny professor, who makes the lectures very interesting. This course was mainly exams and quizzes, so she provided a lot of textbook practice problems. Her lectures were easy to follow, but chem 2 is a hard course, so practice a lot outside of class. Dr. McMillan is very accessible during office hours and really does want you to succeed.
He's so sweet and his quizzes and tests are fairly easy. Never had to study more than 30 minutes for his class. Allows cheat sheets too

He is very sweet and funny. He does a good job of explaining how to do things during lectures. He posts the slides with his work on them after each class. We had 1 online homework a week and you could redo questions 8 times. We could have a notebook paper front and back of notes for each test (3) and quiz (5). We could use 4 pages on the final.
He was a nice guy but I really didn't like his class the best. But he did give an alternative final that we took to get out of taking the actual final on friday

He starts off slow but can definitely fly through the notes. He does post all slides later though so you can catch up whether you were too slow or missed a class. He let us have full page of notes or a "cheat sheet" for each test and one side for quizzes. Sometimes things aren't fully explained, but are most of the time.
So inflexible, doesn't full explain lectures, writes fast and doesn't wait for class to keep up

The class is lecture based, good amount of homework, but he prepares his students for the tests. Just make sure to pay decent attention in class and do the homework with intent.

If you pay attention and work with him, you should easily pass the class. He is a good professor for the intro course

Take Elementary Stats w this professor! Homework is due Tuesday & Friday nights and a quiz Friday nights (online). As long as you pay attention and follow along with the class PowerPoints you will do good in the class because you can use notes on the tests. Tests are reasonable and you can gain more points on your tests through another assignment.

I took the advanced statistics course with this professor and although the course is already hard this professor made it way harder than it needed to be. It took him forever to grade the homework and sometimes wasn't done prior to upcoming exams. When questioned about it he argued with the class and even left mid class when the topic was brought up
Professor Potgieter moves quickly during class, but he is very helpful outside of class if you need clarification. He gives very helpful reviews for the tests, and is always available for questions.

I don't know why professor Potgieter is getting such bad reviews. I think he's a great person and teacher overall and I liked him for my elementary statistics class. The PowerPoints are clear and he goes through them at a good speed. He won't hesitate to help you with any questions you have and he responds fast to all my emails.

Professor Potgieter is a nice man, but he makes elementary stats much harder than it should be. He moves through notes very fast and it feels all over the place. The tests do not reflect the homework which makes it very difficult to study because you don't know how to prepare.
He moves very fast through the material and can be hard to understand. Especially if you don't pick up math easy it would be very difficult to follow him and learn.
His lectures are hard to follow and tests do not relate to content.

Tough exams and no exam review. The homework only reflects 60% of the tests. He tends to have a super hard question on the test that he had never showed any examples like that in the class and that question worth around 30-40% of the test. Super Hard
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Potgieter makes Elementary Statistics so much harder than it needs to be. The test questions are far more complicated than what he shows and class and if he doesn't like you, you're done for (however, he's hard to interact with). Tests are open book and open note but it doesn't help the difficulty. A lot of my class almost failed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He wants to teach a harder class, but got stuck with statistics so he makes that as unenjoyable and unpractical as possible.

Dr. Potgieter is a nice professor. In terms of grading he is extremely picky about what is on your work. For example, brainstorming on paper would often cause point loss even if the answer was correct. Exams you are given less time then scheduled and they are open note. This course was unreasonably tough. Much easier professors can be found.

I love Dr. Narain's class! I switched into this course at the last minute and had no idea what to expect, and the class was great. Dr. Narain is extremely entertaining and knows the content. I was able to easily reschedule and make up things when I got sick. There's some reading, but honestly, if you pay attention in class, you're good.
So much reading-pop quizzes weekly-dont take.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: While she is a very nice professor, she is also one of the strictest. Participation is a huge factor in the class as she relies heavily on it to lead her lectures, meaning you need it for notes. Additionally, she will give pop quizzes after almost every chapter of a reading that are HEAVILY text referenced and cannot be made up. A VERY hard grader
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Amazing professor who wants to have good discussions. I found her classes engaging, but do not take if you don't want to spend a lot of time reading. There's a quiz for every novel that is VERY text-specific, a short paper, research paper, presentation, and two exams. Definitely an upper-division class but worth it if you are willing to put in work
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Narain is an amazing professor. She's very sweet and learns all her students' names quickly. However, she is also pretty strict and specific with her expectations. I think overall this just pushed me to worked harder, and it paid off because I learned so much from this course. It's not an easy class, but I would definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Narain is a pretty entertaining lecturer and encourages debate. There is a lot of reading, but it is an English class. She has quizzes after sections of books, so make sure you keep up with the schedule. The quizzes are not too hard and she lets you argue for your answer. The tests can have super specific questions so study beforehand.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Narain is a nice professor, however, she is the toughest grader I have ever had in college. Doesn't provide useful feedback and takes a long time to respond to emails. She regularly calls on students and you have to participate to get a good grade. There are pop quizzes and you are not allowed to make one up. Overall, would not take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Narain is amazing and I've never learned more from a single class. Yet, I have also never taken a harder class - coursework included reading several books, 50+ page packets, writing several extensive research papers, a huge presentation project, reading quizzes, and exams. Participation is also a MAJOR factor of your grade. You have to read.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Overall, I enjoyed the class. Reading is really important for the class, and there is quite a bit of it. There are occasional pop quizzes, participation is important, there is group work, and tests are closed note so you really have to know the material. If you read and participate, an A is readily attainable and the class can be really enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: A sweet teacher that makes going to class enjoyable! You will read a lot so split it up into small portions every day or you will get behind. Quizzes at the last discussion of each book. Three papers each over 4 pages with heavy research. She wants more of your argument than a commentary on the sources! She's an amazing teacher I would recommend!

I love Professor Narain. This was my favorite class of the semester. I learned a lot, and the tests weren't too hard if you read the material. Feedback was clear and helpful for the next test. Show up to class because there are pop quizzes. I really enjoyed the lectures as she is passionate about British Literature.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Narain is the best professor at TCU. She makes everyone in class feel included and never belittles her students. She appreciates any comment made in class and isnt afraid to encourage and praise her students. I thought this class would be dreadful but it ended up being my favorite class of the semester. Would take her again any day. Love her!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Narain is amazing. She is an genius who doesn't use it to belittles her students. Have a question? ask it. She won't put you down. Very reachable outside of class. Insanely passionate about what she teaches. Grades papers fairly and welcomes criticism about herself. Welcomes challenging of her own ideas- open to new ideas. 10/10 recommend.

Such an nice lady. The course is pretty easy just read the novels and poems before the exams and that's it. The tests are essay based, but again they're easy if you rad and if you are a decent writer.

Dr. Narain is so smart and helpful. She really makes the class interesting. If you go to class and take lots of notes during class discussions you will be fine. I would definitely recommend this class with Dr. Narain.

Dr. Narain is incredibly intelligent. She will pump your brain full of more knowledge than you realize. Due to her immense intellect, she can be intimidating to freshman. A good introduction class for the reality of college.

Took her for maymester Maj. Brit Writers. Great! Had no interest prior to taking class. Tests are essay, theres pop quizzes which are really simple, class is discussion based but you can pass if you dont know an answer. You have to read (I supplemented with sparknotes). Somehow read 4 books and a few sonnets in 3 wks but not bad. ENded up with an A

She is smart,knows her stuff and is very excited about the content. It's a little funny in a cute way how she'll try to get everyone excited too. She has a complicated vocabulary. You have to read 6 books/semester (that's hard to do). 6 Pop quizzes easy, good discussions, only 3 absences allowed, hard grader for papers and tests. I'd take her again

she is very intelligent and loves what she teaches, but she had extremely high expectations. She makes you read 6 books and she makes you talk in class. she has a difficult vocabulary so it is hard to understand her. she has a few quizzes (not hard) but you have to be good at writing for her papers and her tests (pretty hard).
Dr. Narain is very intelligent but this class was not my favorite. Difficult and VERY BORING.

Dr. Narain has a challenging class because you must you read the book -it's an English class, you're GOING to read! Quiz after each reading!- and because she has intense class discussions about the material. She's very on-topic and her discussions always have a point. I loved her class, though it was a lot of work. Take if you're a strong writer!
She is verrry hard. You must read because she likes to give pop quizzes. She also will call you out in class to give an analysis. I am an English major and I hate this class...

Dr. Narain's class is very difficult. I had her for Major British Writers and if you don't read every single day you can't keep up. If you are not an English major I do not in any way suggest taking this class.

Dr. Narain is great. A little eccentric, but most good professors are and she loves what she teaches. Grades semi tough on essays but is always willing to meet and discuss grades and assignments. Good books and discussions. I recommend her!
Very easy, all you need to do is read the books. If you don't, you will probably fail.

Really dread taking LIT, but after class started got way into it. She made it very interesting by being so enthusiastic about teaching the subject she obviously loves. As long as you comprehend what you read and pay attention in class, no way you can't make an A.

Professor Narain is an intellectual in the highest sense of the word.  Her class is a little difficult, but that's to be expected from a senior seminar.  Her vocabulary is HUGE, and her topics are interesting.  Her accent is very cool too and not hard to understand if you just pay attention.  I loved the class and got an A.  She's very likeable too

She is very easy, you must read she gives quizzes every class over the previous readings. Her test and quizzes are easy, pay attention to detail. She is hard to understand because she has an accent but she has a TA that is real good too. She doesn't like people to leave class early..she yells.
the teachers assistant is named sarah rodriguez, i think. well, she is smoking and i loved looking at her for two hours and forty-five minutes!

prof narain is a very lively intelectual woman w/ a great attitude. she gives quizes about once a week so always bring a small scantron. she gives 3 tests all sem. which are not that hard at first but get progressively difficult. would strongly recommend!
The only thing that kept me going to the class was Sarah the hot teachers assistant.. other then that.. narain sucked ass

For a 2 hr and 45 min class, I thought Narain did a great job keeping her lectures interesting and understandable. Go to class everyday, it's not that hard if you take the once a week class. I don't know why there are people complaining about her bc the material was really easy to interpret, EASY A if you pay attention and don't slack a lot.
She's a freak who's way too excited about Literature. It's so weird. I can't stand the woman, and don't understand why on earth anyone here liked her so much.

The absolute most boring class I have ever experienced. Full of lecture...and jsut lecture. I would doodle on my notes the whole class! However, if oyu can stand being soooo bored, the class is easy. I read majority of the readings, but not all of them. I made an A. Just go to every class b/c attendence is taken everyday.

Dr. Narain is awesome!  She teaches a great class is always smiling, happy and loves to hear the opinions of her students.  She is passionate about Literature and excellent at illustrating the perspectives of the authors.  I only wish I could spend more time talking to her.  She's a real hottie!

Prof. Narain is very passionate about what she teaches. This is a pretty easy class but you cannot miss any classes. Attendence is taken everyday and there are alot of quizzes. The material is not hard to understand and there are class discussions on all of the reading.

She's a tool, class is a repeat of Highschool Eng & a waste of time unless u need someone to tell u SpECIFICALLY what to think when u read something. I'm a chick, & even I am tired of her feminist bull. She's NOT understanding towards emergencies, but if u can stand the lecture's it's an easy A.

She is fantastic.She is clear helpful and made studying literature fun! Those who complain about assigned seating should figure out how to return test reports to 180 students all the time without it. Don't take her if you want to get a college degree without attending class and getting an education

Prof Narain is a good instructor very knowledgeable in her field. She is however very strict and assigns seats like in elementary school.. She usually has large classes and still takes attendance. You won't escape her. She has easy tests and quizzes, but you MUST READ. Never dismisses class early.
No Comments

takes attendance faithfully-sometimes both at the beginning and end of class. lectures after you take a test. have to attend all classes to assure an A. multiple choice tests. almost no homework beyond reading.

Good class.Interesting readings & discussions.Very helpful;if you need to leave for something or take your exam at a later time,she'll help you.Quizzes count a lot so do the readings and pay attention to the discussions since they tell you what's on the quiz & the answers.Have scantrons handy.

Dr. Narain is an excellent teacher. She is very clear and opens up for class discussions. Even if you do not normally speak up in class, she makes you want to in this course. I learned alot.Test are straight forward.
you'll do great if you do your reading ( 2 hrs a week), go to class and take notes. I enjoyed the class and found her to be very centered and open to all perspectives> lots of class discussions.

I took her Classicism and Enlightenment class and really enjoyed the reading.  She's passionate and is very excited about teaching.  She also teaches Women and Gender Studies classes.  I recommend her.

I loved her!! She was SO sweet and her class is relatively easy. She gives pop quizzes, but right before them she  goes through the quiz and hints towards what the questions and answers are. She also gives test reviews that outline everything you need to know, and the tests are application based. Also a group final project.

Queen of Neeley. She cares about her students, lectures are straight-forward but still interesting, and she gives "hints" about pop quizzes (if you could even call them that). The material is super interesting too. Definitely recommend!!!
Great professor, I did not do well on the first exam and she gave me all the tools to get better. The project really helps your grade also. I would take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Highly highly recommend. No need to purchase/read textbook, quizzes/exams (all MC) are from her Powerpoints. Super straight forward, tells students exactly what they need to know. Uses real world examples to keep class engaged and lectures interesting. Occasionally gives easy pop quizzes, you get a note sheet so review powerpoints before class.
She is the nicest professor at TCU that I have met so far. I would recommend her any day.
She really is a super great teacher. Extremely nice and will help you whenever you need it. Is also super good about responding back to emails.
Lectures are interesting and I learned a lot. Not a hard grader but I still feel like the class challeneged me to learn. 100% would recommend.

I really liked Professor Nethery! As long as you go to class and listen to her lecture, and review the powerpoints, her tests are easy A's.  She's really nice and very clear, so you know exactly what you're going to need to know.  I also feel like I learned a lot, so I'd definitely recommend taking her class!

I took Neri for the Morals and the Ethics graduate classes. All quizzes are online you have two group cases for each class. Nothing is hard at all if you just read or watch the assigned cases and take notes based on the framework he gives you. Participate in group discussions so you don't have to do discussion posts. Overall loved this class!

Accounting is hard in general but he makes it enjoyable. He has a clear criteria for the exams and tries to give as much credit as possible. He also allows a written cheat sheet for the exam. As someone who almost failed intro acct and now has an A in this class, I really recommend taking him!!

Neri made accounting enjoyable. I enjoyed his class and didn't get bored with his lectures very often. He is very understanding as a professor. The exams are very straight forward and he prepares us well for them.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Neri's May Mester class, and I really enjoyed it. He is very caring, has funny jokes to crack, and overall wants everyone to do well. As long as you put in the time, you will do well. He's very accessible outside of class and is always happy to answer questions. He also gives very generous partial credit. I definitely recommend him!

Dr. Neri covers a challenging subject with remarkable teaching ability. He is available to provide guidance, thatI appreciated. His interest in getting each person to do their best improved the course results. Group projects are central so choose your partners wisely. Class contribution is important.
The negative comments in other reviews are lazy.

I took the Accounting for Decision Making and Control in a Maymester, so there were only 7 students and the class was only 3 weeks so it may be very different than the regular semester but for this class he was great. The tests were hard but he was very generous on partial credit, & practice questions given were basically the same format for test

Dr. Neri is great. Walks through accounting problems very slowly to make sure everyone gets it. Also likes to joke around in class. If you put just a little bit of effort into his class and/or ask questions, you should be fine. Lots of the negative reviews are from a while ago, and if those are true, I'd say he changed for the better a ton

Dr. Neri is an incredibly smart man when it comes to accounting. However, I would make the argument he is too smart to teach. The stuff he goes over in class is not anywhere close to what is on the test. In order to succeed, you need to read every single word in the book because he will not explain it. VERY Generous on partial credit though.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Its not a hard class. Class sucks but you can just sit on your computer the whole time and take the pop quizzes when he gives one. Theyre group work and easy. Going to class is pointless but he does take off a little bit off your attendance grade when you skip. Grind the textbook and practice problems for like 10 hours before Tests and get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I'm convinced that anyone who dislikes Dr. Neri is just lazy and unwilling to put the work in. You're required to watch videos outside of class and come prepared, but if you do that, then you'll get an A. He's a great teacher who thoroughly wants his students to succeed, and is extremely gracious when grading. I'd easily take him again if I could.

Dr. Neri is extremely generous with extra credit, and designs his class so that you're successful. He practices real life application and explainis concepts thoroughly, and I would take him for every accounting class if I could. Be prepared to practice problems through class. I hate boring lectures and there are none in his class so I learn a ton.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Neri taught Principles of Managerial Accounting for MBAs. For someone who has never taken accounting or a lot of finance, he does a great job at simplifying the topics. And if you are like me and have a strong foundation in Financial and Man. accg, then definitely take him! His personality makes lectures very enjoyable and entertaining!

Sooo if there are any positive ratings for Dr. Neri, I am convinced he posted them himself... lol.... seriously. I dropped my Accounting Minor after taking his class. I would take ANYONE over him. There are no lectures, just a bunch of practice problems done each class. Test requirements are so unclear. He posts INCORRECT answers to practice probs.

I enjoyed Dr. Neri's class a lot and found him to be a great professor. He makes a boring subject interesting. His lectures are engaging and discussion-based; there are lots of opportunities to participate. He's also really good at making complicated subject matter easily digestible for those of us who won't be accountants.

Dr. Neri is a great professor. He makes accounting interesting (no easy task) and creates an engaging environment. His class is not easy and his are expectations high, but not any higher than should be expected for a graduate level course. His expectations are clear and fair and he is always happy to help students.

Dr. Neri is a great Professor. He really cares whether you know the material. He is funny and engaging. You have to do the work but he is a fair grader. Anyone that has the opportunity to take Dr. Neri should.

I took this class the entire semester and did horribly. Yes accounting is hard but now that I am retaking it with a new professor, everything is so clear and easy to understand. Neri talks about random things all class and doesn't know how to teach. He does give partial credit on tests at least. Take a different teacher!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Please avoid taking this class by all means possible, unless you like teaching yourself accounting and then taking incredibly difficult quizzes and tests.

Tests and quizzes are very hard. Practice problems in the book are very easy and do not prepare you for what you will see on the test. Fill in the blank no word bank tests as well. He does a poor job at teaching the material and makes it harder than it should be considering it is supposed to be an entry level class. Would not recommend this prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Hands down the worst teacher I have ever had in my life. Attendance is mandatory but be prepared to teach yourself the entire class. It is actually impressive how inefficiently he used class time. Take another teacher.
Pretty sure he made us do research for his actual client one time.  I should be getting paid for this.

He would be a great professor in the literature department, but has no business teaching accounting. You will have to teach yourself everything. He is unprepared for most classes, and doesn't know how to do any of the material himself. Cool British accent though (still not convinced it's not fake...)
The worst professor I have ever had in accounting. A majority of the students in class knew more than he did... My one word to describe him: incompetent.

Accounting is going to be rough any teacher you take at TCU. Not clear, very unorganized, late on exam days. Really nice guy but can't teach. Also British so that's a plus? Responds to emails quickly. The textbook is your life saver. I studied 10+ hours every quiz/exam and made it out with a B. I would highly recommend taking another teacher.

Prof nelson is the best! FR2 is VERY difficult but she breaks it down in a way that's easier to understand. She's the fairest grader I have ever met as well. You get 1 front page of notes which is a lifesaver, I wouldn't pass without it.

I learned more in Nelson's class than any accounting class I've ever taken. I loved her teaching style and very rarely got lost. Exams are very doable as you get a full front page of handwritten notes to use. She's extremely smart and while she's not the most personable, I would highly recommend her for any accounting classes.

Dr. Nelson is a solid choice for FR2. She wrote the book for the course so she knows the material like the back of her hand, and she was great at answering questions. The class is quite challenging and you do have to work very hard to get the grade you want. But you are allowed a sheet of notes on exams and she gives extra credit for participation.

Dr. Nelson is one of my favorite professors Ive had at TCU. Financial Reporting 2 is a tough class itself but Dr. Nelson does a great job of teaching it to where everyone understands. Her tests arent too difficult if you study well and if you participate in class she will boost your grade up. If you plan on majoring in accounting take her!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Karen is an amazing professor and she is the best professor that you will ever have at TCU. The class itself is very hard and she will make you work for it, but overall one of the best class experiences I have had at TCU.

Dr. Nelson was an incredible professor. The material we covered in class was difficult, but if you go to class and put in a little effort outside of class, you should be fine. She printed off the slides and practice problems for the class, and they are all you need to study (plus the practice problems online).
Professor Newton is very clear about how to succeed in her class and supports you through words of encouragement and different ways into the information.

Mrs. Newton was very charismatic, welcoming, and very encouraging. She expected students to participate in class activities, and gave helpful feedback on assignments. Students wrote lesson plans, and taught them to the class. This class had 3 rotations, with 3 different professors, Mrs. Newton being one of them. She was my favorite out of the 3.

I danced for 16 years and took this class to stay connected to dance in my first semester. I loved coming to class every week. Sarah is excited to be teaching and makes all her students feel welcomed, no matter their dance background or skills. Quizzes are easy and there are many extra credit opportunities. Participation is mandatory.

A large portion of the class you are actually up and moving around, so this is not a boring class by any means. You meet in the multipurpose room in the rec and sit in a circle to take notes, so it's a nice break from the traditional classroom setting. You learn so much about lesson planning from this class and by far the most helpful for ed majors
I loved her. She was a super easy grader and super fun to be in class with. Attendance is graded, but its an easy grade. All of the assignments over half of my class got a 100. She is the best!
She's hilarious. Class is always entertaining. Easy A and super fun!!

She is an awesome teacher! She made this class fun, and I would suggest taking it with her! She gives lectures that you are able to use on the tests, which are online. There will also be social dance classes where you learn moves from different cultures! Very easy class and a great teacher.

Nina is so unhinged I love her. Can be frustrating because she's very unorganized and assignments aren't very clear. I thought this class was gonna be harder than it was but she grades super easy. Shes very understanding but there's a bit of busy work in the DWC course. Just show up often and talk to her, she likes making friends

NINA IS MY SHAYLAAAA! She is crazy in the best way and insanely wise. I love her so much. She invited our whole class for Nachos with Nina as an end of the year party. Her modern class and improv/choreography class is so fun, and we learn while still having fun. If you get it you get it. NINA IS THE BEST!

Took her 1 month Dance in Culture class in the summer. Most amazing professor I've ever had. There was very little work, it consisted of just a Chapter or two a week. Plus a 200 word discussion board. Super easy. She's extremely caring and flexible and overall just seems like a super kind woman & human being. HIGHLY RECOMMEND her class for art cred
Professor Martin is very clear about how to succeed in her class and supports you through words of encouragement and different ways into the information.

Professor Martin is the WORST professor I've had at TCU. I took her dance class during the summer and she was more than absent. She takes days to respond to emails, directions are confusing and incomplete (also placed all over D2L- nothing is organized) and she does not really communicate with her students. She gives tons to do and grades unfairly.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Nina is such a cool teacher! She has a passion for what she is teaching. I highly recommend taking her classes!

Best class ever! This is one of the easiest fine arts credits at TCU. Nina is hilarious and class isn't boring. There are no exams- just online quizzes on the textbook reading and a project. You will have to read the book but it's short and simple. Take this class!

This class is pretty boring and Nina may be literally crazy, but it's easy. The chapter discussions are really tedious and pointless but after Thanksgiving there's literally nothing left in the course which is really nice. Plus, you take some dance classes which are easy and fun. Definitely an easy fine arts credit.

She's so nice!!! Super easy class, but I did learn a TON! It's all super interesting and she brings a lot to the conversation - she still dances as a professional and brings her experiences to the class.

NO TESTS. But a weekly assignment online. 2 projects, a final and a midterm group project. The class is fun. You discuss videos and dance styles and you even go to real dance classes! Very fun for a fine arts credit. The book is boring, but the class can be fun! She's definitely zany!

she is super hilarious and always seems a little frazzled. NO tests, all the work is easy if you just read the text. attendance is kinda important. easy A if you just show up and do assignments. we watch movies or youtube pretty much every class. you NEVER know what nina is going to do though, she's hilarious.
She is a little loopy. But the class is easy and she makes it interesting with hands on experiences with dance classes that the entire class just laughs together on.

shes funny in that weird way. I enjoyed class. All you have to do is write a summary of each chapter- she can get picky in this part. The videos that go along with the chapters can be interesting and the days in which you actually get to dance are really fun. She can be a bit picky and critical when grading but nothing you cant handle.

EASY EASY CLASS! You just have to read each chapter and write a 200 word response on ecollege, and respond to 3 other people's responses. She's a little bit weird, but you get used to it after a while. Classes are kinda boring when you just watch a video, but not that bad when you actually go watch classes or dance. BEST PART...NO TESTS!! = )
Best professor ever!!! 100% recommend taking her. All you have to do is participate in class discussions and turn in your work on time following the rubric. Additionally, the class is very enjoyable.

Dr. Nixon was by faaaaar one of my favourite professors. Her classes are very discussion based so you'll have to participate, but I truly enjoyed going to her class. All you have to do is submit your work on time and follow her rubrics on assignments and you'll do well.

Love her!! She really gives the class a chill vibe. There is 1 group project, a final paper, and a final presentation. You have to go to lecture so you can do a good job on the projects (there are no tests). Also, she sends out things to read and watch for homework: you don't have to read/watch all the materials (she said this explicitly one day).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Nixon for Honors College Life and Identity and thoroughly enjoyed the course. Interesting discussions and easy projects. Overall, an easy A for an honors class. However, she did wait until the last few days of the semester to input all major assignments.
Good professor. Easy grader. Works with you on deadlines. Easy a, take her

I took Dr. Nixon's Honors College Life and Identity class, and it was great! Project heavy, but the projects aren't hard, they just take some effort. Participation is a really big part of your grade. The class overall is really interesting, too if you have any desire to learn about mindfulness.

Professor Nicole, love her! She is honestly the best professor at TCU she really wants you to learn, I learned so much about children and adolescent development. She is super caring and understanding, bless her heart. TAKE HER! She has so many visual presentations and she is very articulate trust me you will learn but in a fun way. TAKE HER !!

Love prof Nicole she really knows what she is teaching and she is a really passionate person lover her to heart I learned many things from her. Take her if you can she is so sweat and you WILL LEARN. HER WAY OF TEACHING IS WONDERFUL !
Truly an awesome teacher. The lectures are interesting and she is a very kind, understanding individual. I would take any class she offers. She is very relatable to my generation. GOAT.

I took the Law, Justice, and Social Control class, expecting an easy elective, but it wasn't. There was a lot of reading and papers, and grades depended on those and participation in discussions. The professor often told stories instead of focusing on lectures, which made it hard to stay engaged. Not worth my time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: they need more teachers to teach this course he is the only option and unfortunately I would have to agree with the other ratings.

Nhan is great! He definitely ruffles feathers sometimes when discussing sensitive topics but he really does know what he is talking about. His paper prompts can be confusing sometimes but he is more than willing to explain them and he has even helped me craft my outline and thesis which really helped. You have to participate to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Nhan was by far one of the worst profs I have ever had. He is very disorganized and knows that he is yet refused to do anything about it. Very tough graded when it comes to papers we wrote this semester. Never made below a 90 on a paper until I took him and every paper I wrote was obliterated by him. Paper prompts are very unclear.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: One of the best CJ professors. Gives great lectures and is not afraid to dive into controversial topics with students. Would definitely recommend his classes to any CJ majors or minors.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took Nhan for his Law and Society class. I understand that this class is meant to be political but he just crams his ideology down your throat. If you bring up any point that goes against what he believes, he will take points away from you just for thinking differently. His philosophy seems to be "disagree with me and you will fail".
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Nhan! His classes are so entertaining,  but you HAVE to attend class to get a good grade. His exams are based solely on lecture material, but you'll do fine as long as you listen to him. Amazing professor, super cute, too.

Great teacher.  Funny, uses lots of real-life examples so you get what's going on in the justice system, confesses to little things that he's done in the past that are straight hilarious.  The class was a lot more interesting than I thought it would be.  Highly recommended, just make sure to go to class because his test is based straight off class.
