Super great professor, he really cares about his students and helping them succeed. He keeps lectures interesting by telling stories and showing videos that are (normally) relevant to the material. There is quite a lot of reading that is absolutely necessary if you want to succeed in his class, so make sure you do it!

Taken 2 of his classes! He is willing to help, if you do the work! Read the book and participate! His tests are essay and short answer but easy if you pay attention. Favorite teacher at TCU, I would take all of his classes. And he's super cute so looking at him makes it even better :)

Really cool guy! You will be fine if you just put in the effort. Awesome class, and he's really funny. Extra credit is there, you have to read (easy novels), and if you need it he will make sure you get the grade. Tests are like 25 MC and 2 essay. WRITE EVERYTHING YOU COULD POSSIBLY WRITE. Really down to earth guy. Treats you fair.

He is straight forward and comes straight to the point. The exams aren't hard, and is nothing but memory. Usually the exam has 10 short answer, 5 from lecture and 5 from book. You get participation points on friday, bit if you don't come on friday you get -1 point.

Really cool guy, has an interesting way of approaching teaching. If you don't study for the tests, you won't do well. Study and you should be fine. He will not change grades, what you get is what you get. Show up on Fridays and you'll get 5% of your grade for answering questions on the reading. He's willing to change test dates if you'll be gone.

Very nice, down to earth guy. I run into him outside of the classroom at the Rec sometimes, and he's nothing but nice. He does a pretty good job of keeping the lectures interesting. My only complaint is the reading. Lot's of reading for such an intro level class, and it's terribly boring.I also feel like the tests are more difficult than necessary
super nice guy thats easy on the eyes. could easily pass as a college student.

pretty easy prof if you GO TO CLASS. loves to have "secret" extra credit q's that you only know if you are at lectures. definitely has a left-wing bias on things, but is a nice guy and very approachable. plus, if youre ever bored, you can entertain yourself enough by looking at him- hes not too bad on the eyes (in a geeky/cute sorta way)

BEST TEACHER AT TCU!!!! love him!!!!! puts things so that you can understand them. You have to read the book but the books are interesting and the tests are really easy. you have to write one paper that took some time but easy A if you spend time on the paper
He was great! I would love to take another one of his classes if I had any interest in CJ. Super easy if you keep up and go talk to him in his office he is really cool!

Johnny Nhanny is great! At first, I wasn't a fan because he required A LOT of boring text. Go to lecture + take good notes + read some = A. VISIT HIM IN HIS OFFICE HOURS! Seriously. That's the best part about him; he is SO helpful. He will go over anything with you & wants you to succeed. Cool guy! And he wanted a chili pepper.

He's a cool guy and I would definitely take him again. His lectures aren't boring, he explains new concepts well, and he always breaks up the class with some random story, video, etc. which always make you laugh. Plus, in the world of senior citizen professors he's young, relatable, and frankly, not that bad to look at.

Really nice teacher and he really wants you to do well. Tests are semi-challenging and he usually curves them by a fairly good amount. :))))) Just read the text, take notes, go to class and you will do fine! I got a B+ but I didn't study a whole lot so an A is definitely possible. :P

Johnny Nhan is a super cool guy and I really enjoyed his class. There is lots of discussion in class and you just take notes of his powerpoints. Take notes, read the chapters and study the study guides at the end and you will get an A on the tests! Really nice guy and super helpful, just go to class and pay attention! Super easy right? :)

He's a really good teacher! I had him for Intro to Criminal Justice and I found him really nice and helpful. Everyone complains about him for absolutely no reason...study your notes and then you do well, and if you don't then you don't do well at all. Logical right? Another plus is he really wants you to do well, which is amazing!

one of the worst classes i ever taken. the only professor i know of that refers to Wikipedia in class and gives very inconsistent info throughout the different classes which makes tests harder. the whole principle of the "secret extra credit" is borderline against school policy- since when do students need to solve riddles to get better grades?

Tests are hard, no doubt about it, but try to go to class, that only helps. Go to office hours adn get to know him, because he does want you  to succeed. READ ALL THE BOOKS... there are 3 different books for the semester, 1 per test and then a group paper that is individually graded. Good class overall but you must work for your grade

The class is very interesting if you have a liking for criminal justice. He is a good teacher and keeps you entertained with interesting stories and examples. The tests are kind of hard though, but if you study you should at least make a B in not an A

class is really interesting, but pretty liberal. if your extremely conservative you'll sit there with your arms crossed like half my class did. dr. nhan is really nice though, sometimes you get to watch youtube videos. tests were suprisingly hard, but a an a is very possible. you get to print notes off line. i enjoyed the class very much.

AMAZING PROFESSOR! I have learned so much and he is very helpful when it comes to understanding the language. His lectures and conversation are really good and it helps to hear the language constantly throughout class. He gives a lot of extra credit opportunities as well. Overall 100% recommend.

Great professor but be prepared to read a lot and have quizzes over the readings. Quizzes are not hard at all I was able to skim through the readings and still make a solid A/B every time. His lectures are great and he is very passionate about what he teaches, however he can move a little fast, but makes up for it by posting his powerpoints online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I LOVE THIS MAN. He is funny, kind, and loves what he does. There's a good amount of reading and quizzes to follow but we watch many interesting movies that help. He is accommodating and a semi-nice grader.
Amazing teacher. I have already learned so much this year and he is my favorite teachers I have ever had. Definitely take Italian if you can!

I took his first semester Italian class and had so much fun. He wants people to do well and makes the class pretty easy. I would suggest taking it, the only downside is that there is multiple homework assignments a night that he does not grade so it is cut and dry.

Decent teacher and hard to understand sometimes. Offers a lot of help outside of class. Will look over your tests before you hand them in and let you redo problems you got wrong before turning your test in. Just a lot of homework, but that helps your grade.

He was an okay professor. A lot of his lectures were him solving the math problems and not walking step by step, NOT allowing students to fully graspg. His english is not the strongest and often would get bothered during office hours, but very accessible and homework-heavy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: His English is not very clear and if you don't understand something he will not explain it clearly again at all. Very understanding but not patient and leaves quizzes every week. Also if you're not paying attention in class he will call you out mid lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This man has my utmost respect. The nicest man I've ever met in my life, and he will make an effort to help you as best as he can, all you have to do is ask. He is lecture heavy, however his lectures aren't just taking notes, they're telling stories and are highly intriguing, and his English accent makes it sound like you're watching Planet Earth.
Great Prof! Helpful, clear, and knows the material very well! His accent, stories, and jokes keep you engaged throughout lectures. You will not regret taking this class!!!

Amazing professor!! Absolutely loved "Understanding the Earth," made me want to become a geology major. Really engaging class, attendance not taken but lectures are really important. Tests aren't too difficult if you study well and the lab's actually pretty fun! Would absolutely recommend this professor.
An excellent professor. He is able to make subjects that would otherwise be difficult easy. I would recommend this class (Understanding the Earth) to anyone.

Dr. Donovan is a very fun teacher. He doesn't take attendance at all, but I went to almost every class and that is really where you learn. I never once opened my textbook. Only 4 grades: 2 tests, Final, and your lab grade, all worth 25% of your grade. Study for tests.

She's extremely nice, but there is almost no structure to her classes, and people are often confused about what is due and when. On the bright side, she lets you make up literally everything you may have missed, so it's quite possible to get an A with little effort.

I took her conversation class. She does give you a lot of handouts, and you definitely have to ask questions to stay on top of things, but I love how she gives you a low stress atmosphere to just speak French to each other.  As long as you show some effort and interest, it is not difficult to get an A in the class, and overall I thought it was good

Avoid her at all costs! The class can be easy but you will have no idea what's going on. She gets angry if you try to ask for help and she is unfair and arbitrary in the way she grades. If you want to learn French, don't take her!! I worked really really hard in this class and ended up with one of the lowest grades I've ever gotten.

Awful. Only hard because you have no idea whats going on. She doesnt know what shes talking about and hands out at least 20 handouts a class and none of them have anything to do with what shes teaching! Avoid her at all costs. you will hate french after taking her class.

She is really nice but doesn't really know the best ways to help you learn a foreign language.  Tests and quizes are always more difficult than expected.Always expects to get a lot more accomplished in class than possible. Study vocab a lot
She's really nice, and always willing to help. Though the class can be easy at times, some of her tests can throw you off. Study vocab quizes b/c they are the hardest. But its a fun class.

I'm not a fan. She was too easy, which may seem like a good thing, but not when you actually like French. She didn't really know what she was doing, and didn't make you want to learn anything. I got 90's on all the vocab tests because I didn't study and knew most of the words from high school French. The class was a waste of my time.

I know she is a really nice person, but I have to agree that it is an awful class. I had to teach myself everything and just when u've thought you failed, you get an A. It makes no sense. She is unorganzied and does not teach anything.

She seems really unclear about most things and you may think that you will fail, But as soon as she hands back the test you have a A. The presentations can be in english or french, and she gives you all of the research material.

If it wasn't for the fact that I had previous French studies, I would have failed. Makes NO sense. Has no idea how to teach beginner French. I ended up tutoring half the class because she sucked so bad. Might be better with upper-level students with previous experience with the language. Would NOT recommend for first year French students!

Professor Katcher's tests are a bit difficult, but she gives a lot of handouts that explain every assignment, and she talks about relevant issues, like politics and crime in France.  She makes you participate, but it actually helps you learn French (imagaine that!).
She is nice and will to work with you BUT she skips over things, because she expects you to know information from previous years of experience.

This lady is an evil spawn of satan.  She is mean and awkward.  She doesn't have a point system and if she works for more than 2 hours in oneday and you are her last class, the woman can't handle it.  I could see her kicking her dog a lot when she goes home.  HORRIBLE!!!  don't listen to the others.
She is an interesting professor to have since she is a native French speaker. Her class is realitively easy if you have had french in highschool.

I've taken French in high school, but decided to pick it back up as an elective. This woman has NO idea how to teach basic French. She just skips over everything and assumes you know it. REALLY unorganized, too. I would not recommend at ALL!

Very sweet, nice professor.  The class isn't too hard, and for 4th semester we studied modern topics (such a space, cloning, unemployment) in French... so it was pretty interesting.  She doesn't grade hard... very nice lady.

Wonderful professor who is very understanding that there is more to college than her class!! She helps when you need help and is willing to discuss your grades.  You can pull an A if you are willing to work.
She's disorganized and the course doesn't have much continuity, but she's nice and helpful.

She leaves behind those new to the french language, and pushes those who are familiar with french. she speacks so dang fast, you can't understand her. Be prepared to jump into things, she almost always only speaks french in class. HARD TESTS!!!

Really good teacher.  she works with you if you're having problems with work or dates.  is very flexible about speaking french.  makes sure you know more than just the book---she tells you about things in the world.

I'm a spanish minor and took french just because one semester.  She definitely doesn't teach a class that is geared toward people who have never had french before.  french 1 with her is not really an introductory class.  I pulled an A, though
Excellent professor, very fair and clear.  Easy A if you had french in high school. She's cool, too, so get to know her outside of class!

Katcher is as good a french prof as you're gonna get at TCU...She's very helpfull, and the assignments she gives are pretty easy...she's not a nazi about making you speak French all the time, but she encourages it. She's a pretty easy grader
She is very very nice! Willing to help student understand. She is a native French speaker so be prepared!

I'm not the best at math, but I ended up with an A. The notes are all fill in the blank and it makes it easy to follow along. There's homework due every class but you can redo it until you make a 100 and Nowlin always offered to go over questions in class. Tests were fairly easy, but you need to study! The course was calculator based which helped.

She's one of the best teachers I've had. She's super clear & straightforward with the material. It can be repetitive, but it definitely prepares you for the tests. Homework after every class, but you can do it as many times to get a 100 on it to boost your grade! She has a notebook you get with her notes & you fill in blanks, which I found helpful

She rocks. Lets you use a note card for each test, and all the work is done on a calculator. She actually realizes that Statistics can be done on a calculator. What I mean by this, is that other stat classes force you to memorize everything, and you don't get to use a notecard. She is super sweet, understanding, and the online homework easy!

She is the best math professor at tcu, TAKE HER AND YOU WONT REGRET IT. I cannot stress how easy it was, it takes a lot of effort to fail this class, & Im not a math person. Before this class I had never gotten an A in math. She is such a sweet young lady & cares about her students. She lets you omit the final if you come to every class. online hw.

Margarita rocks. She is simple, the best math teacher I've ever had, nice, fun, and understanding. I thought calculus would be difficult, but it was basically a repeat of Pre-Calc with one or two new concepts. Grade is made up of 4 tests and daily homework. She seriously is the best, take her. No textbook, buy her notes packet from FrogPrints

I loved Professor Nowlin, she's so cute and very nice. This was the easiest math class I've ever taken and I hate math. She is super approachable so if you need to ask a question, theres no question that she'll help you. She can be kinda scatter-brained during her lectures, but if you can keep up with her you won't have a problem!

Mrs. Nowlin is a very nice professor and, in my opinion, a great teacher. Her class is not easy (it's statistics after all) but she does a good job of expelling the topics. I was in her 2:00 class so by that time she had figured out how to explain the day's lesson in an effective, concise way so we often times got out of class 15-20 minutes early.
this class is super hard. she doesn't give extra credit. her tests are not multiple choice, and she's confusing. this class is hard all around.

I have not met a nicer teacher than Professor Nowlin while at TCU. As a rising Soph I was very lucky to have her for Elementary Statistics. She will take the time to help you if you need it and all the homework online can be turned in for 100% if you just put in the short amount of time. If you have taken this class in highschool, prepare for an A.
THE BEST TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD. I am horrible at math but I made a 98 in this class with ease! She is so sweet and willing to help and has test reviews. TAKE HER!!!

She was amazing! Really sweet/funny personality and was always willing to help. The online homework was directly correlated to her lessons, and she makes a fill in the blank notebook so during class you can follow along with her examples. I'm not a math person, but Nowlin makes it easy.

Mrs. Nowlin is a very nice lady, but here class is very boring, and it was EXTREMELY hard to pay attention in. Found her pre cal class to be pretty tough, for a class that was not mandatory for me to take. If you think you can just get an easy A in her Pre Cal class, your very wrong, it takes a good bit of work.
this is STAT it just should not be easy. somehow this professor makes it easy and interesting! I definitely recommend taking the class

terrible teaching style. Goes way too fast, tried to teach Calculus methods in a pre-Calc course, over complicated processes while teaching them and explained things to class as if we were already had our PhD in mathematics.

Take this class, it's so easy.  If you do the homework, and go to class you will get a good grade.  She makes it super easy to do well.  She gives you lecture notes, and if you don't miss any classes you are don't have to take the final.

She was such a sweet teacher! i loved her teaching style with involved a notebook with notes already in them. Mandatory isn't mandatory but if you only miss one class you don't have to take the final. Make sure you get to know her and that she knows you and it will pay off! I highly suggest taking her for topics.
She is very sweet, and if you speak up in class shell like you. Just make sure she knows who you are so if you need help she can do her best. She's great and the class was fun
good teacher helpful and friendly and is generally awesome.

Extremely nicee.very helpful. you can tell she wants everyone to succeed. The textbook/online work/workbook don’t follow along with each other at all, this makes the class harder than it needs to be. Get a tutor. Go to class, if anything SHE is reallyy easy to look at!

Extremely nice and fun professor.  You print out outlined notes, homework is online and easy.  The tests are easy too.  This class was a easy A for me.  She takes attendance but not every class.  I took her for Applied Pre Calculus.  If you show up to class and do the online homework and review your notes before the test this class is an easy A.

I took her for Topics. She's super nice. I felt like she was very good at explaining things. She has outlined notes that you print off before class which is super helpful and keeps you organized. I thought it was an easy class and I suck at math.

She's nice, but she can be unorganized. She can get mixed up when she's explaining things. The homework is all online, which is nice, but it's a pain to print off the notes and take them every time. The tests aren't too bad. I would definitely take this class over a stats class.

I love her!! you do all your homework online and have to print your notes to take to class which can be a hassle. But over all I think she is a great teacher and really helpful and is so nice!! Definitely take from her!

Her notes are confusing.  She doesn't really know how to explain what she is talking about so you have to teach yourself most of the time.  She can't really meet with you often because she has strict time scheduling with her kids.  Thank goodness for the math clinic

I really liked Prof. Nowlin. She is a sweet lady and teaches pretty well. The work is pretty easy to understand if you go to class. Homework after every class. She is kind of unorganized, but is very helpful if you need it. You don't need to buy the textbook. You do all of your work online and the textbook is online if you want to read it.
So sweet and helpful. It is hard material and you have to keep practicing it to get it. The homework she helps you with and gives you an extra day to do it and answer questions about it in class.

Her rating should really not be this low. Mrs. Nowlin was one of the best teachers I've had so far. She explains things so that they seem very simple and easy to comprehend. The homework isn't too bad, and the tests are not too hard if you study a little. She is very caring towards her students and she wants you to well in her class.

I completely disagree with the previous comment. One of the sweetest, most patient professors I have ever had here at TCU! She is extremely willing to help you with whatever you need whenever you need it. As long as you come to class and pay attention when she teaches the lesson you will be fine! The notes are very straightforward and easy to get!
Fairly hard class with lots of material, but if you put in the effort and do your homework it will pay off.  Also-understanding/helpful teacher

I can not believe she got such bad ratings!!! If you go to class u will get an A on the test I neverrrr did my homework and still have an A in the class she is the sweetest thing and really understanding of conflict etc shes a mom and u can tell!
LOTS of material for a short amount of time.  confusing tech methods.  lots of homework and frequent tests/quizzes

The class is not hard, but her teaching method is horrible. She doesn't follow the book and is often very vague in class. Multiple quizzes and homework. Very hard to meet outside of class...preaches to use the math clinic. Studying the book outside of class will help out a lot.

Sometimes she taught us the wrong formula and it seems like she doesn't really know what she's doing. She's a nice lady and her class is laid-back. The t.a. grades the work and often grades it wrong. You have to do the homework and study for the daily quizzes. Take the class but get a tutor
Go to class, do the homework, study for test...make an A!!!

Really confusing teacher.  I think she doesn't want to be here that much so she doesn't seem to care.  In class when we asked for help a lot of times she didn't even know how to answer our questions.  If you read the book and do the practice problems you should be ok.  If you only rely on her, good luck.
She's fine, but her teaching method is convolted. I found that I learned better when I read the textbook outside of class.
Class starts out at a fast pace, but if you do the homework and study for the test, the class is a breeze.  She will help you out a lot if you go to her office hours.
Well.....at least she barely check your homework....just check like three or five times in a semester....
Mrs. Nowlin is a good teacher and a very nice lady.  I think she is shy because she knows most people in the class don't want to be there.  Study outside of class: The Final is Cumulative.

I don't know why this lady has a sad face...she was a fairly decent teacher. I even made a D and I'm not whining. Maybe you people should stop getting on this website and go study instead. Good advice.

This class wasn't bad at all. I dreaded it after reading reviews, but was pleasantly surprised. She is nice and helpful. Do the homework and review for quizzes and tests and you're fine. Problems on the quizzes/tests are usually very similar to homework questions. Class usually gets out early too.

Although she is somewhat pleasing in appearance, her class and teaching style leave much to be desired.  She presents the material in a way that makes it harder than it is.  You will teach yourself.  Good News - Four Point Curve.
Horrible teacher. She makes the class so much harder then it should be and doesn't really offer much help. Don't take!
She is really boring and only does the examples from the book. You will teach yourself!

Ok, class if you need it or need a math.  There are other teachers who are better.  She is always late to class and not very well prepared.  Starts out way easy and then get way harder.  She is great one on one but in the class not very much help.
don't take. It's way harder than it is suppose to be.
Hard and boring. She makes easy math hard to understand
Very hard. Do not take!
The class starts out really simply but definately gets harder. As lond as you do the pratice problems she gives you will pass the tests. Not a lot of office hours though.

I was a CS grad at TCU.  I had several classes with him and I believe he means well, but I concur with most of the other postings.  He gets off topic too frequently and is ill-prepared for class.  Various exams had mistakes discovered by students and on one occasion he forgot we had an exam scheduled and made one up on the markerboard on the fly.

A very poor professor.  He does not appear to be prepared for any of his classes, and most lectures only last 5 minutes before he gets off topic and rants about something irrelevant for the next hour.  You will not learn hardly anything from this professor, you will HAVE to teach yourself.  Lastly, the lab assignments are not clear at all.

Disasters and Failures is a very easy class. I never really studied and came out with and A in the class. He is a very nice man just not always prepared for class. The labs are super easy so you must attend those. Drops lowest lab and lowest quiz. Final Exam is a piece of cake.

Dr. Nute never teaches anything that isn't already in the powerpoint notes. If you don't mind teaching yourself EVERYTHING, then go for it. Over half the class just shows up for the quizzes and leave afterwards. He doesn't seem to put much effort into the class and puts a pretty generous curve on every quiz, though.

I majored in CompSci at TCU.  Dr. Nute is pretty is a pretty interesting guy.  Unfortunately he does not prepare for his classes or teach you anything meaningful.  Prepare to teach yourself everything on your own if you have one of classes - I would avoid him and Dr. Hannon, but the other compSci profs at TCU are outstanding.

If you want to teach yourself everything you need to know about programming than go right ahead and take this class. He does not know how to teach, and has lost my assignments on multiple occasions. He was asked not to teach this class in the past, and he should have kept it that way.

No one ever went to class except on quiz days. He only gives grades for quizzes and labs. If you go to class, pay a little attention, and glance over the notes you will do fine on the quizzes. If you show up to class and pay a little attention he will be more willing to help you out when it comes to grading. He's really funny too.
Disasters and Failures 10003--Prof has a sense of humor but all relevant material can be found in the notes. Quizes once a week, half the class just shows up for the quizes and then leaves.
he says a lot of "Jokes" in class, be careful to distinguish the parts of the class that are worthy to pay attention to or you are toasted
He offers challenging classes, but if you don't understand just go to his office. Most of the time he's there and is very helpful.
this guy blows..... im not sure what else to say.. he should have been fired a long time ago, but hes a 10 year.. so what are you gonna do. DO NOT TAke this class

awfully boring... i always studied for other classes while in his class.  he goes on the most random tangents that have nothing to do with the class and you aren't sure what the hell to study for b/c nothing is ever explained.  good f***ing luck!

This guy is the biggest blow hard I have ever met.  He doesn't teach and he doesn't know what he's doing.  DO NOT UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES TAKE HIS CLASS.  We were asked question on the test about our presentations and I missed the question about my presentation b/c the answer was not something i covered in my presentations.  He's an ****.

Don't take any classes with Nute. He's unorganized and rambles on during the whole class about .. nothing. Also, an 11 pg book report, a term project, chapter quizzes suck. The students pretty much have to teach the class.. we take turns doing presentations.

Well, it's an experience to say the least.  Be prepared to not know where you stand with your grade until the last day of class (if not later).  Good luck to those poor CoSc soulds that are required to take this class.  GODSPEED.
Terrible...scatterbrained and disorganized.  No teaching style to speak of, falls asleep often, and a real jerk.

Never take a class with this teacher. He lectures all class, yet does not cover any material, ALWAYS goes off topic, and gives out tests that are ridiculous. He asks you to communicate with him through e-mail, but never responds. ~very bad teacher~

Haven't been graded yet... and he still doesn't know how he's going to grade us for the freshman seminar... warn your friends not to take any classes with him, he doesn't really teach anything and then gets frustrated when material isn't covered.
constantly off task, and inconsistent with grading leaves you pissed and bored.  Takes attendance
Im not sure this guy's head is quite there.  Be prepared for an entire semester of random rablings and pointless stories.  Wake up 5 minutes before it starts, grab a newspaper, and enjoy...

Has never actually covered any class material in class.  Talks instead about his arrest record and his crazy family.  Makes students teach for him.  Leaves 84% of the semester's work load until the last 3 weeks, literally.  Sweats something awful.

Completely incapable of making a handout unless it has at least one mistake.  Covers class material half the time - the other half is filled with anecdotal trivia.  Still, somewhat entertaining despite the frustration.
One heck of a teacher.  This is one professor that I will not forget.  Likes to get off topic a lot to talk about...other things.  Not the most dedicated professor around.
Very disorganized and rarely makes it to class on time, but extremely funny and intelligent, and he stimulates a good learning environment.
Least favorite teacher.

He really is one of the better Intro professors. The simulation is a lot of work and worth a lot of points so make sure you get a good group. He is a spelling and grammar phonetic. If you follow the handouts exactly you will do well. Don't procrastinate. Memorize the terms and an example for the exams.
He is an extremely tough grader, tests are near impossible, and if you don't like group projects you're not going to have a good experience.

This class is tough. The business simulation can either make you or break you, and he doesn't really give you any direction in it. It's more take guesses and cross your fingers. Lots of group work, so make sure you have a good one. The tests are tough as well. 11 quizzes over reading articles. A few homework assignments and 3 exams.

Quizzes are easy if you read article (always about 7 pages). Simulation is time consuming, picking a great group is crucial. Tests are VERY HARD. Basically need to memorize the book in order to make a good grade. He tests over everything in the book. Also, VERY picky with grammar. Deducted 6 points even after taking it to the writing center twice.

Very interesting (and useful) class for business; his tests are very specific and somewhat difficult, but the quizzes are easy grade boosters if you read the articles. BE CAREFUL ABOUT YOUR GRAMMAR IN WRITTEN ASSIGNMENTS THOUGH. All-in-all, I would recommend taking him for foundations.

Nice guy! Homework is easy! He is very nitpicky abt grammar/spelling. Quizzes are easy as long as you read the articles. They are usually about 10 pgs. Exams (4 of them) are HARD. Study the book in detail. Simulation isn't terribly bad, but its not easy either.
Study the vocab, the online quizzes, and read the book for the tests. The tests can be hard. Pay attention to grammar on written assignments!
very interesting class. however he grades really hard on the project. study really well for test and do not depend on projects to boost grade.

Business foundation !! He knows a lot about business and he's a pretty smart guy too. However, his grading is tough, the simulation project is kind of confusing. I would recommend him over Matthis though

very bad. has has a lot experience in business, but seriously, he is not suitable for teaching. he can't even answer student's question - "i can't answer that question right now." WHF! it's really hard to get an A in his class. i don't recommend his class, take another foundation

Very smart man but a very bad teacher. Nit picks and plays favorites and is unable to ever explain himself. Quizzes are easy and over readings, textbook is necessary, I would advise taking another teacher.
Knows what he's doing & very serious about the class. Not easy, but not impossible. Make sure to do well on larger homework assignments or it's almost impossible to get an A

Hard, so hard... I wonder why he made me feel it wouldn't be easy to get an A. Seriously I didn't think my points were deducted this easily. Be extra careful of grammar and spelling mistakes, they'll kill you! Simulation is not bad but boring enough to make a presentation about it. Why was everyone so obsessed with it (Simulation)?

I love Mr. Nuss! Make sure you read the book (both BUSN and the simulation book) and you'll breeze by. THe Simulation isn't bad at all if you have a good group - so chose wisely. Content isn't hard because most of it you learn in previous business classes. He designed the course so definitely take him for Foundations.

eh. Not a bad class. Business basics taught from a book. If you are junior level or higher class is a breeze because chapters involve finance, acct, marketing etc. ONLY hard thing is the simulation. It takes a lot of time and the presentation is lame. Nuss loves IBM also.

Really? This class is really not bad at all. There are a bunch of quizzes that are on the schedule that are GRADE BOOSTERS. The simulation/project can seem like a lot and I consider that the only drawback. Book use isn't too excessive, but if you print out the vocab flash cards online you will ace the tests.

disagree with them.take him,interesting class you learn alot of business basics that YOU WILL USE LATER IN LIFE.if you read the articles the quizes are easy. tests arent bad.thgroup project is kind of cool.the only thing i didnt like was that he takes alot off for mispelling i almost got half off on a 25 point HW.spellings Import but not that much.
Nuss makes this class impossible...the class is already a bore and he makes it worse...do not take him if you dont have to

This professor will do everything in his power to keep you from getting an A!! He hates students that do well apparently. I STRONGLY SUGGEST YOU TAKE SOMEONE ELSE. His grading is ridiculous and there is pretty much no room for error. Very nit-picky man. Hated this class.

Nuss is obsessed with IBM! Go back! He is the most digrading teacher at TCU. If you in a sorority he starts off as cool and then turns creepy. It's impossible to get an A in this class with the simulation "game". try to take any other teacher than him!!

Go back to IBM! He comes off as a really nice teacher, however as the semester progreses you relize he is not so nice and more of a degrading teacher. He doesn't like girls who are in sororities, and only likes people who do well in the simulation "the game" This class is ridiculously hard to get an A in even if you get A's on the test. DO NOT TAKE

He is honestly a very mean and degrading teacher. I think that many times he graded my group down because we are all girls in sororities. The simulation is worthless. If you are a male athlete you will probably get an A even if you don't do any work.
You will think this class will be an easy A, but it isn't. He finds ways for you to lose points and get a B. The whole class is busy work, and I didn't learn one thing.
Good professor, but can be a stickler at times when it comes to grading. If you get a good grade on both test. Then you should be able to make an A. Just do the work and you will be all right.

Most worthless class I have ever taken.  You are graded on your ability to play a computer game (which is very easy to mess up) and read Harvard Business Review articles.  Also, he is a terribly unfair grader.  Copy his assignment templates exactly, even if they conflict with what is actually correct.  Don't waste your time trying to make an A.

A little cold at first, but ended up pretty friendly. Class is pointless, though.  Tough grader. Tests are frustrating, because he tests more on word choice, and less on actual comprehension of material. This class could be much better as an 8-week class. No actual final--just a big presentation last week of class. Easy B, definitely possible A.

Most pointless class ever.  I hope you enjoy paying for a class you won't learn anything in because I know I did. Lectures are pointless so don't go to class unless there is a quiz or test. It's impossible to figure out how he grades HW assignments so just make sure you spell everything correctly. Really easy B. Nearly Impossible A. Enjoy!

He is the male version of Beata Jones. a person too in love with himself to notice the needs of the students. Picks favourites and they will be the A so if you are a frat idiotand tell stupid jokes..Well congrats! Tests are ridiculous Simulation useless, like the whole class. He definatelly kissed some ass to get to teaching. Useless and unhelpful

Unbealivably, this class is still part of the curriculum in the business school. Useless, I didn't learn anything new and the simulation is cool because you compete, not because you learn something from. I think that anyone that cannot teach some serious subjects has been assigned to teach Foundations
Good teacher, gives alot of freedom with the business simulation. Tests are just over articles and the topics covered in class.
Irritating.  A million little grades worth alot and tons out outside work to do.  My most time consuming classes ever.  Best words to describe are irritating and frustrating.

This class is a joke.  The material is so vague, and such common sense, that it becomes very difficult to study for. I found the simulation easy and somewhat interesting, but i know plenty of people who stuggled mightly with it.  This class is an easy B, extremely tough A
Easiest B. However, he won't let you make an A so don't bother tryin
yeah, he's impossible/ random...pointless subject matter
tests are pointless and just bring down your grade. he grades hw so that you cannot get an A. he sucks.

This class is a joke. He picks the randomest questions for his tets, some we haven't even talked about. Never curves and gives no extra credit. The way he grades assignments makes absolutely no sense. He takes off for the randomest stuff. You would think it'll be an easy A but it's not. Class sucks a**. Take with someone else if possible.

Nuss will try his hardest to not give you an A. The simulation is also the biggest joke in the business school, if you want an A you MUST know the simulation inside and out. Don't bother paying attention to speakers, because he only test on that piece of crap simulation, and it WILL be on every test! BOO FOUNDATIONS BOO!!
I loved NUSS....just keep up with your reading and you should be fine....I have no idea about the favorites thing......

really liked him, but he does pick favorites, so just be one of his favorites, sit on the front row and show up on time (I found that out too late), its not that important, just do the work. He is vague, but I think he does that on purpose. Do well on the projects and look at the grade point values.

READ THE BOOK! This class is an easy A if you take the time to read the book and understand the material. The website project sucks but Access is the worst (so you need to pad your grade at the beginning). Nuss is a good teacher. He definitely picks favorites but grades fair. Take him if you can.

he is a nice guy, but he picks his favorites. if you dont get in good with him it feels wierd. his class can be entertaining, and its not hard. i actually enjoyed them in some ways, and disliked them in others. his tests are all memorization from the books, i dont think he even writes them.
Nuss is very helpful, if you ask for help. Don't get behind, it is hard to catch up with the assignments.
Not as hard as you would think. Just read the book and know vocab for tests. Do all the homework and study for test and itis an easy high B, low A.
Study the book for the quizzes and you will do OK. The project is ridiculous, but if you actually work on it, you can get a high A. Easy B, hard A. Nice guy.
The quizzes are hard, but you will learn valuable knowledge.  I would take him again, but spend more time studying for the quizzes.

Nuss was great! If you need help he's there by phone or office. Tests are tricky if you didn't read the chapter, but otherwise very straightforward. Granted, project is a bit time consuming, but I loved what I learned from it. Take him for Mgmt too!
Take Doll this guy is no good. He gets his favorites and doesn't like anyone else. Doll will curve unlike this guy. GO BACK TO IBM and quit telling your stories
No Comments
nice teacher. very friendly. quizzes are hard. project is a pain.

This guy is the most terrible thing to happen to this university.He is a computer geek that thinks everyone cares about databases. The class is way to hard and time consuming for an introductory class.He grades tough and doesn't bump grades,out to get you
go back to ibm, we dont want you. what is with the bracelet? come on.  the project is a killer, the little "tests" are a joke, and dont even think he will bump your grade.
Awesome teacher!! Best I've had at TCU... easy, fun, and interesting!

Obrien is an amazing teacher and person. Get your work done on time, work hard, and participate in class. participation is a huge portion of your grade. The assignments are graded hard in the beginning of the semester then you get the hang of it. set up an apt. to talk and meet with him if you are not understanding/getting bad grade.

Great professor! Love him, and he is very professional and funny (sometimes lol). He works at the PDC, so he is qualified. The class has almost weekly assignments that can be time-consuming, and he grades heavily on three group projects. He loves critical thinking and likes to see how students think.

Every business student has to have Kelly at least once. If you participate and come to class and offer insightful comments you'll get a good grade. There is a lot of homework that is harshly graded, but only because he wants the best for his students. He is such a wacky person but his class is so enjoyable to go to.

Mr.O'Brien is caring of his students.  Grading got more tough at the end of the semester, but if you do the readings and your best on the assignments, you will be fine.  Participation is a large part of your grade!  Class assignments are participation based, but very low-key.
You will be in class 50 minutes once per week so attendance matters, very easy class. helps you to get ready before applying to Neeley
Easy class and very laid back person. He is a good guy.

Kelly is a good prof, you just have to be very detail oriented with what is needed to complete assignments. For example, he has taken points off for not opening every link for an assignment. Participation/Professionalism is a large part of the final grade so keep that in mind. Overall interesting class with good help explaining programs in Neeley.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good professor its only one class a week with barely any homework and very insightful lectures on business paths. But attendance is mandatory and calculated to final grade so show up and youll be fine.
Hes a good guy, should be an easy A but I've heard there are better options.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: O'Brian is a great guy and very easy to talk to. As long as you show up to class, turn in everything on time or early and participate here and there you are pretty much guaranteed and A. He loves professionalism so always be respectful, and pay attention and you will be fine.

This Professor cares more about students learning and development than their grades. Showing up to class and turning in assignments on time will essentially guarantee a good grade. He is very knowledgeable and lets students now what he thinks they need to be doing now to be successful in the future.

Prof. Ofe cares about the success of his class. He takes the time not only to teach the concepts but also to apply them to real life. The class is really easy as long as you attend class and complete the homework.

Professor Ofe is a super nice guy and really does want to see students succeed. It really helps if you go to class, but is not mandatory. If you have a problem or need help, reach out and he will get it taken care of. He is overall a good professor with easy to follow lectures and really good study guides.
Class is easy to follow if you go to class. Environment is interactive and the pace is followable. Keep up with lectures and ask questions, and you will make it

Take this class if you want a relatively easy pass in a math class. The class is lecture heavy but will help you be well prepared for the tests. He posts his lectures online so attendance is mandatory. The tests are easy if you understand the material and study the practice questions he provides.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This teacher sucks so bad!!!! Her tests are absolutely impossible! U have to know every single stupid formula from the book! Cant speak English and doesnt know how to teach!!! DO NOT TAKE HER!!!!!!!!!
Cannot understand her.  Does not give details on projects prior to their due date.  Can learn just as much teaching myself.

Pathetic teacher. I'd learn the exact same amount if I was handed the text book and asked to read it. She takes attendance but class is pointless because you can't understand a word she says. Take a different professor if at all possible.

can't understand what she says. Class is hard but she makes it harder. I got a B and worked hard for it. peer reviews were useless apparently for the project. quiz's every week. labs blow. i had people with the same exact numbers for the lab who got lower percentages so watch her grading. she is nice tho if that counts for anything.
Very difficult class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Nice lady. Alright lectures. Very political (liberal). More of a gender studies / race studies type class, rather than drama. She assigns too much work. Way too much work for a non drama interested student and just for a core class. Kind of unreasonable / annoying at times. Easy/moderate grader.

DONT TAKE THIs CLASS!!! She seems to be nice but if you have a problem she WONT HELP AT ALL. She expects us to memorize long Shakespeare passages and gives a bunch of reading Its just not worth the time, money, effort and grade. Choose and other easy lit class. This class is hella tough and the professor is just not it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Honestly, her class was one of those I had to lock in on, and I walked away with an A. Once you figure out the general structure of all her tests, you are good. She keeps her classes engaging and often makes reading relevant for in-class discussions. I heard that in her class now, she lets you take a notecard into the tests, that's so free.

Disregard the other reviews on here. They are garbage. This is an EASY religion class. The homework is not difficult, and it takes about 5 minutes to complete. The readings she assigns are incredibly long, but I did not read a single one and I still had a 97% test average because you get a 3x5 notecard on exams. Teacher is very kind. EASY A.

She's alright. She cares about her students. Lots of repetitive lecture, talks a lot. Made us stay after class time was up. Also makes you stay after exams to start new units. Units are crammed and felt like we tested every week. Some group discussions that are boring and pointless. Overall though not a difficult class and she's personable.

Very repetitive lecture always goes the full hour-twenty and when she says she'll let us out early at the beginning of class she means like 5 minutes early. She talks a lot and it drags on the whole class. It felt like we had a test every week over content that we barely learned and only memorized. Plus, group convos that weren't very helpful

Soooo much time spent in this class doing absolutely nothing. Also 5 exams a midterm and a final essay. After you take the exam that you spend hours and hours studying for she keeps you until the end of class to talk to each other in groups. For no reason.

This class is interesting, but requires a LOT of reading outside class to be prepared for lectures/discussions. Exams aren't too difficult and regular online quizzes help boost your grade if you're struggling. Class lasts the entire time and lectures can drag on, but Dr. OP is super sweet and makes an effort to know and check in on her students.

Very kind caring prof...get ready to read 20-30 pages per night and then sit in the full hour twenty for a lecture the whole time. Quiz for all reading so two quizzes a week but drops ur lowest 3 which is nice. Again very nice but very long class and lots of work for not very interesting/engaging lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I would recommend taking any of Dr. OP's religious courses. Mine was much easier than other religion classes I have heard about at TCU. The final grade is made up of a lot of assignments, so nothing is weighted too heavily. She gives you a review of everything that will be on unit exams. Class consists of lectures & small group discussions. Easy A

Professor Olvera makes every class session fun. She cares so much about her students and will do anything to help them succeed. Class consists of homework, short projects and 3 exams. Read the book and go over notes from class and it's pretty easy to at least get a high B on the exams.

I took Professor Olvera for a summer class and was pleasantly surprised! I saw reviews and wondered if it was going to be a super challenging class before hand. Her exams and quizzes were open note and open book. Group projects were done with others. Exams were only worth 40% of the grade and she really cares about her students. Highly recommend!!
Great prof and a real poa - loved going to class ! Wish she taught all the accounting classes !

Dr. Olvera is a true gem. She makes even the most boring material interesting. I took her for Risks and Controls (AIS) for a Maymester and she really knows her stuff. Class consisted of 3 tests and 3 group projects. The material isn't that difficult if you have taken Auditing before but if you haven't it can be challenging. Would recommend her!!!

olvera is one of the coolest accounting professors. she's hilarious and finds a way to make even the driest material fun. her exams are all cumulative and pretty difficult so I would make sure to study hard! I don't think her exams are unfair or overly specific, not sure why a lot of students are saying that. I would recommend taking her!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Olvera is an amazing teacher. She has worked in the accounting field herself and tries to bring in real life examples to the classroom. She also cares deeply about each one of her students and will work with you to make sure you succeed in her class as well as in life. Wonderful lady.

Tests are tough and tricky. Chapter sliders are sketchy and unorganized. Did not really learn much in class. Always require critical thinking for not only paper but test also. That's where she takes points off ridiculously. Try to avoid this class as much as possible. Feel more frustrated for career path in audit.

She is an awesome person and truly wants you to learn. You have to go to class because of class-assignments each day. Her tests are difficult, but if you study you can at least make a B on them. She is willing to help
Very hard

Olvera is an interesting character. Very energetic. Great teacher. Actually- excellent teacher. She makes sure we truly understand and keeps the class as fun as possible for a boring subject. However, its ridiculous how hard the tests are. Multiple answers are right and you pick the best one. Could argue why your right and she won't change it.

She is really fun in class. A lot of energy and lots of in-class activities to help learn. However, her tests are really hard. Questions have multiple right answers and you have to choose the best. Can succeed if you work really hard though!

Olvera is very enthusiastic about accounting. Definitely do the homework as it is almost a 1/3 of your grade and you can get 100's on all of them. Tests are very difficult. She tries to trick you often to see how well you know the material. Homework boosted my grade tremendously.

She is very nice and enthusiastic, but many of the tests and quizzes were tricky and different from what we had gone over in class. She also would get defense when asking why we to something wrong. Ive heard other teachers are hard, but that they actually understand accounting after the class. I wish i would have taken the other teachers!

I have heard horror stories about other accounting professors, but I can honestly say that she is one of the best teachers I have ever had. Very enthusiastic about her subject, incredibly patient, and VERY helpful. TAKE HER FOR ACCOUNTING!
Guy doesn't know his ass from a hole in the ground and can't relate to college students on any level.  I dropped.  We deserve better
Class was worthless and boring. I usually had to leave after thrity minutes just to keep my sanity.  Do not take his class if at all possible you will regret it.

Extremly hard class. not helpful professor and do every week quiz, which is very very hard some I all class 1 or 2 out of 5. He use text bold points and too boring pover point. He just push next and next. Two extra books reading and review papers. Mutiple choice q are rediculous. Too much work don't take it.
Very dull and dry. Death by powerpoint. His answers on his quizzes are all right but one is more right than the other. Tests suck, and really anal grader on essay portions

Grad student who was very nervous most of the semester. Test and quizes VERY hard. You'll watch a couple movie clips, which are ok. His multiple choice questions are impossible!! I usually like history but i HATED this class!

Dr. A is one of the best chemistry professors I have ever had. His lectures are organized, and he is very approachable and helpful during office hours. The labs themselves are short, but lab reports are lengthy. Still, overall, this has been my favorite lab at TCU so far!

Great professor who cares about students. He's understanding and funny but this class is a lotttt of work. Very homework heavy but it helps more compared to other teachers that only do pop quizzes. Best chem teacher I have had so far, but I do love math.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Annunziata is very helpful and patient. He would treat the class like none of us has taken chemistry before and carefully breaks down difficult concepts. I had him for pchem lab and the reports were the hardest part, with a lot of excel calculations. If you do well on the lab problems, the final exam will be manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: He is very intentional and really eager to help you succeed! He is an amazing lecturer and great at explaining concepts clearly. That being said, p-chem is a beast, especially after the first exam. He takes off a lot of points for very small errors, and the final exam is comprehensive and worth 40% of your grade, so the stakes are really high.

He is funny, and willing to spare time going over the lecture in his office if you are enthusiastic. P Chem is hard with concepts, and he says it himself that he is not picky about calculations and maths, but he will make sure that you understand what is needed for the test. He gives his own outlines to students and improves them every year.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: enthusiasm, helpful, clearly explain in depth, nice, mostly can find him when you need help. Great handout. Test come from what you are study. extremely recommend for who need PChem. Fantastic.

Not an easy class, but fascinating material. His accent is hard to understand, but his notes are very thorough. If you're having trouble, talk to him about how to study, it will help you a ton. My favorite thing about him is that he'll talk to you even if you're seriously pissed off about your grade. He understands your stress and isn't offended.
If I had only an hour left to live, I would spend it in this class, because it felt like an eternity.
awesome professor... not many surprises in the test
He is realy cool. If you study little bit and check ur homework before exam easy A. He'll help u with HW.

Lab is not difficult, but the reports take FOREVER to write.  Don't put these off!  You can easily make an A on every lab report if you just put some effort into them.  No tests, but the lab final is all your homework problems.  Make sure you can do the problems and this is an easy A.

He may hide the fact that it is JUST AS DIFFICULT as organic with a nice smile and an Italian accent, but STUDY.  Despite the difficulty, the prof is extremely helpful and wants everyone to at least PASS, so don't stress too much.  Befriend him early on, study a lot, and you'll survive with an A or a B.

One of the toughest class ever but the way we (students + Dr. Annunziata) handled the class was amazing. I am one of those people who hate math and this class being the so heavy on math was very stressful for me. But Dr. Annunziata kept me interested to the subject no matter what. I recommend to take this class.

P Chem is a hard class, doesn't matter who you take it with. His lectures were fine, just expect to dedicate some time out of class to do some studying and working for your grade. Labs can be tedious but at the end I enjoyed the class. On top of it all he is very helpful is drop by his office.
Class is hard but very helpful teacher.
Toughest class I have ever taken. Lectures are confusing, Lab problems are impossible. He is always there if you have questions, but dont expect it to help much. Final is cumulative!
His lectures are a waste of time. He just winds up confusing you more. You would be better trying to teach yourself. Kinda makes you want to change your major.
No Comments
No work except a couple of reflection papers on guest speakers and her tests are all online and open note. Super nice and easy class
she should get best professor of the year award, very few assignments, 3 freebies absences, definitely recommend take her for core!

I loved this class and Professor Ortiz so much. Her lectures were always entertaining with her usage of videos and personal experiences from working with law enforcement and the FBI. She is very understanding and funny. There were 4 guest speakers, all with incredibly interesting presentations. Three open note exams and two reflection papers.
best class I've ever taken at TCU

She truly is an amazing professor. Her lectures are easy to follow and keep you super entertained. She has amazing guest speakers throughout the semester, and even though she takes attendance, you don't want to miss class. She is very understanding, though when things come up, and gives great feedback on assignments! Would definitely recommend!

She was such an amazing teacher. She really cares about her students and she is so understanding when it comes to turning stuff in late or if you have other commitments during class time. Tests aren't hard and the content is interesting. Great teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I highly recommend this professor. Interactive lectures where you fill in the blanks based off her lecture and even brings in fbi agents that give presentations. There are 2 papers based off these presentations and then 3 exams that are online. Lockdown browser but open note. She's really knowledgable and loves this subject. TAKE HER!

I LOVED HER CLASS! I took criminal justice as a core but her lectures made me concider switching my major. She is so passionate and brings in really cool guest speakers. Class is so easy, lots of people skipped but I recommend going to class I was always entertained because shes also hilarious!
Dr. Ortiz is AMAZING! Her lectures were engaging and she brings in cool FBI guest speakers. All exams are open note/online so it's definitely an easy A.

Dr. Ortiz is the BEST for criminal justice. Everything is open note so it's an easy A for sure. She does her best to keep the class engaged and give good examples during the lectures. She also has her friends from the FBI come give super interesting talks which is so cool!

Professor Ortiz is so funny. She makes the class very enjoyable and interesting. She is very easy to work with and is quick responding to emails. Mainly graded on 3 reflections about guest speakers (who are very interesting to hear from), and a few exams. Highly recommend Ortiz for this class!!!

Oritz is a retired FBI agent and brought guest speakers. Attendance isn't mandatory but answers for the guided notes are given in class. There were only 3 tests including the midterm and final. Tests are pretty easy as long as you show up to class. She is really good at providing examples for everything and making terms/concepts easy to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Ortiz is an amazing professor! She is retired FBI and talks a lot about her experiences as she lectures. She brings in awesome speakers! Her tests are pretty easy, usually a couple of questions that are tough but nothing outside of what are in the study guides. Reflection assignments are super easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Ortiz is the best!!! Easy class as an elective even if you are not a criminal justice major. No homework, just 2 tests and a final that are all open note and take home. Got a 98 on every single one!

Professor Ortiz is amazing. She is a former FBI agent, and her class is so interesting. Made me consider adding a minor in criminal justice. There was only about 5 short assignments, and 3 exams all at which are taken from home and completely open notes. She brought in guests almost every week. Worth it even though it's kind of late! TAKE HER!

Professor Ortiz is literally the best professor I have had at TCU. Super laid back, ex FBI Agent, and SUPER lenient! Don't need the book, just show up to class. Sometimes has guest speakers, super cool lady.

Professor Ortiz is an FBI agent so during her lectures she would tell a lot of stories about cases she has worked and brings in guests which made the class really enjoyable. she provides a study guide which is verbatim what is on the exam, makes studying easy. dont worry about buying the book, no one really used it bc she goes over everything

She is a badass! Shes been an FBI agent for a long time and knows her stuff. I loved her white-collar crime class so much. She made coming to class a joy because of all the interesting guest instructors she brought in. Tests were straightforward and there was one long essay towards the end. Would take again. 10/10

Professor Osbourne is such a sweet lady. I would highly recommend her for Writing as an Argument. Her grading isn't super tough, and honestly I didn't put too much time into this class and still did fine. She genuinely cares about her students and wants everyone to do their best.

Dr. Osbourne's class was really easy, however the work load seemed a little much. I did not feel like I learned anything. I felt like most of the work we had to do was repetitive and useless. She is very flexible with deadlines.

Lacie Osbourne makes students work for their grades, but genuinely cares about their success and wellbeing. She is an angel and my favorite professor that I have ever had. Cant say enough good things about her. Yes she requires a lot of reading and work (expect to write papers nearly daily), but she is always available to go over your work and help

Dr. Osbourne is one of the best professors I've had at TCU. She's genuinely so nice and is eager to help you improve your writing. The workload is super manageable if you pace yourself and she even pushed back a few deadlines when the class was struggling. I would HIGHLY recommend taking her class for the writing core requirement.
I LOVED Dr. Osbourne. She is truly caring and wants to make your writing better. I recommend her 100%, and I hope you all get a chance to take her.

I loved Dr. Osbourne! She was a really interesting person to share thoughts with and she is SUPER helpful. I sent in one of my final papers in early, and she reviewed it so I would get a higher grade! Pushes back due dates/ exam dates quite frequently, and she appreciates when people speak up in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Osbourne is amazing when it comes to paper advice. You can email her and she will respond almost immediately with great advice. She will also arrange to meet with you at anytime. She has a very structured class and being present is necessary, the book isn't needed. The midterm and final are difficult, but the papers will help your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr Osbourne is truly the nicest professor I had this semester. She is willing to work with you and is always there when you need her. When I missed two classes in a row, she emailed me to make sure I was okay and even extended my deadline for my assignments missed without question. We took no tests, only did essays. Our final was a presentation.

Professor Osbourne, is very kind and helpful. She's is always wheeling to help and revise your essay before the due date. She also allows revisions where you can improve your grade. Definitely take her!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Osbourne is awesome. She is so kind and caring and she is very passionate about literature. She allows test corrections which helps and participation is key in this class so you definitely have to attend class regularly. Highly recommend taking her for lit!

really nice lady and always accessible in office hours! but extremely hard grader. test questions and paper prompts are worded weird and confusing. allows for paper revisions but feedback is minimal. way too much material for tests and expects you to know it all. expects a lot in class discussion. wouldnt recommend for an easy core class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She was a great teacher with great context! Throughly enjoyed the class material and class time.
If you're looking for a literature credit you can't go wrong with Dr. Osbourne. Just make sure you are following all of the essay guidelines which can sometimes be confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: This was definitely Professor Osbourne's first semester at TCU. She is a very kind person and definitely cares about her students; however, she needs to revise her paper assignments. They are very unclear and too broad. The tests are not too hard as long as you study.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Osbourne is super helpful. She is an extremely easy grader especially if you send her your essays to have her proofread or if you go into office hours. She is also very flexible with due dates and pushed back almost every assignment if she sees the wholes class working hard. If you have to take any English class, take her!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. osbourne is really caring and sweet. She is willing to help you in any way possible so that you can get good grades. There are a lot of essays in her class, but she isnt a tough grader. She just expects to see you work and not slack off. Get ready to work but she really does want you to do good in her class, which helps a lot!

Dr. Osbourne is the type of teacher who really cares about each individual student. She grades fairly and allows for revisions. She says you have to read the book, but you really don't. Would highly recommend her as a teacher. She makes things fun and interesting. If you have to take an English class, she's the teacher you'll want!!
My second time taking Dr. O. She is amazing, her lectures are informative and fun. She is a tough grader but gives great feedback and is very loose on deadlines.

Dr. O is one of the most caring professors I have ever met. She is extremely passionate about teaching. Class moves at a really rapid pace because there is a ton of content to cover, so attendance and notes are crucial. Test aren't too difficult, if you don't study, you'll fail, if you study, you'll succeed. What you put in is what you get out.

I love this teacher. She makes everything so interesting and fun! Her lectures are amazing and if you ever need help she is there. I would say the exams are pretty hard but there are only 3 of them. If you show up to class and TAKE NOTES you will get a good grade. I believe my grade I received was on my part. All quizzes open note. Exams on paper.

Dr. O is amazing! She is super nice and really cares about her students. Lectures are pretty straightforward, but there are a lot of reading quizzes and screening posts. She requires you to read a lot of material every week which can be hard to keep up with, especially when class material, screenings and readings are all tested on each big exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. O made this class so fun! You can tell she cares about her students and what she teaches. She is flexible about due dates and class work as long as you communicate. She is a rather tough grader but if you use her feedback you'll be fine.

Dr O is THE BEST! By far my favorite professor. She has great lessons planned, and is always engaging and passionate about every topic. She is flexible with deadlines, as long as you communicate. I have emailed her several times to which I got quick and helpful responses that answered my questions perfectly. Plus, she has study guides! I recommend!
Best film teacher. Head and shoulders above the Schonig guy

I loved Dr. O this semester, she was truly the best! she makes history of film so enjoyable and I loved the experience so much. Tests are kind of tricky and I would definitely recommend going to the lectures. She is so caring and understanding, and also super funny.

Dr. O was amazing! She's a wonderful professor and very personable. The lectures are interesting and you get to watch movies for free on Tuesday nights. It's a must-take if you are interested in film at all and will absolutely be worth your while. The writings assignments are fun, and even if they aren't, you don't have to do every single one.
Best teacher in Moudy. She puts enormous work into her lectures and provides more than enough feedback on assignments to to every single student. Also very friendly and personable
Dr. O made history of film fun! She is a great and entertaining teacher and creates a very comfortable environment. She is ready to help with whatever you need.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. O's section of HCOM was great! She is so kind and accommodating with students - she wants to help you. We watched lots of TV/movie clips and wrote 2 short papers. Her teaching style is great because you're learning a lot (about interesting topics) without even realizing it.

Dr. O is one of the best professors I have ever had. That being said, I took this class as an elective and it ended up being one of my hardest classes. The tests are difficult and she is a really tough grader, but I think it is worth taking the class because it is so interesting and she really cares about each individual students understanding.

Dr.O is super funny, entertaining, and knows her stuff. I really enjoyed her class. She's very understanding and will give you extensions if you ask for them. Her tests can be hard but if you watch the films, read the book, and show up for class you'll do pretty good.

Dr. O history of broadcasting was a great class that teaches you how to earn a grade in college. Skipping class and not going to office hours and not going to screenings will land you in bad water. Good attendance, active participation and going to office hours will be the difference. Bring food to the screenings on Monday nights.

Dr. O is the best!! I loved business of media with her. The feedback she gives on assignments is very clear and detailed. She is willing to work with you outside of class and really knows what shes talking about!! Take business of media with Dr O!!

Very awesome professor, but you won't be handed an A on a silver platter. If you stay off your phone and pay attention during every lecture and go to every screening, you'll learn a lot and you'll also have a lot of fun. She explains the material extremely well but do NOT doze off, since there is a lot to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: There were four papers but she gives very thorough feedback. There are lots of small assignments and online quizzes to help boost your grade. Tests can be tricky so you need to know everything on the study guide. She's happy to explain stuff if you email her. She's very accommodating to extenuating circumstances.

Dr. O is a great teacher who legitimately wants to see her students do well. I took this class as an elective and did very poorly on the first exam, because I thought it was a blow off. DEFINITELY NOT. Dr. O did everything I asked her to help me with. Great teacher and even sweeter lady. Tough but definitely worth it for how much you learn.

Dr. O is the best! She's one of the most fun and brilliant teachers I have taken. She loves class discussion but it's actually over topics that us millenniums enjoy such as Netflix or movies. She's such a great teacher and I would recommend her to anyone who asks.

Dr. O is great! She tries to make the class interesting and she is more than willing to work with you. Weekly quizzes are open book and basically boost your grade, while for tests you get a review sheet. Make sure to do the reading and go to the screenings and you'll be fine!

My favorite professor at TCU. She is really interested in what she is teaching and I like her teaching style and powerpoints cus she gives lots of examples. She assigns lots of reading but you can get around it and still pass. Her assignments are pretty easy and helpful. Tests are pretty easy. TAKE DR. O!!!

LOVE Dr. O! She's so fun and loves what she is teaching.  First unit is boring because its all radio, but is definitely worth it in the end! Assignments are easy but make sure you put work into it. Weekly online quizzes can be annoying, but help your grade and you can access the readings! I'm definitely taking her again!!
Assignments and tests are graded very strictly.

Love, love, love Dr. O!!! She makes her class soo fun and interesting. I never skipped a class because I loved going. Dr. O is funny and treats you like a friend, rather than student. Her class is a lot of work with weekly quizzes and weekly research papers. But they are not difficult at all! Her tests are pretty simple too.

Really nice professor! Her grading sucks and she reads off her powerpoint slides every class. There are a lot of assignments and quizzes you have to do as well as take home tests. Its not that bad but it is a fair amount of reading.

Dr. O is a great woman, very understanding and always be there for you whenever you come to her office! Online quizzes are fantastic and class is interesting. She's very down-to-earth and you can't go wrong with the assignments. Take her class!

She's a really great teacher. You definitely have to put in some effort. There's screenings of some cool movies and you write a paper on 3 of them (she's a pretty easy grader). She is really helpful and wants you to do well. I took her for History of Film and Broadcasting. Weekly online quizzes are serious grade boosters. An A is very possible!

Dr. O is great! History of Film was really fun. You have weekly screenings and every class has at least a few clips that are very useful in understanding concepts. Super easy ONLINE quizzes every week, great grade boosters. Take Dr. O!!! You will need to study some, but it is certainly manageable.

Dr. O is great! She loves what she talks about, and doesn't give test. You have to write two papers during the semester and then there is a final that is cumulative. Her class can be dry and she does lecture the whole time. However, she is better and easier than Timmer. Take Dr. O if you can!
