Had her for FR3. She is pretty all over the place. Very unorganized and does not give clear instructions. She doesn't really teach, just assigns us projects and has us work on them. Her feedback will completely contradict what she says in class. She also didn't grade anything until the end of the semester.

If I could give zero stars, I would. FR3 teaches how to write memos, but she gives minimal amount of instructions & assignments are graded w/ the consistency of a coin flip. Email responses were curt & unhelpful. Questions are met w/ eye-rolls & condescending explanations. Avoid her at all costs unless you enjoy self-inflicted academic torture.

The most disrespectful professor I've ever had! She literally made multiple people cry during their final presentations. She doesn't teach anything effectively, gives no instructions, awful grades, and embarrasses you any chance she gets. She doesn't know how to use technology but will blame you for it.

Boring and she is not good at teaching. Makes frequent mistakes during her own lectures. The first few weeks you'll be lost because of how she teaches. The rest of the semester, everything is on paper. Quizzes and exams are doable (and open note) but her inability to teach effectively makes them harder than they should be. Would avoid if possible.

She made accounting harder than it actually is, often making mistakes during class demo, not beginner friendly. Her lecture style was dry and she assigned textbook with little connection to class content. She answers your question convolutely making you feel more confused and sometimes mocked. Plus, no laptop allowed in a class that requires Excel.

DO NOT TAKE! She is very disrespectful to her students and is SO UNORGANIZED. She also teaches a very outdated version of accounting and has a very outdated teaching style. We barely get anything done in class because she is very slow. She is hard to reach outside of class because she has too much on her plate. Very mean.

Patricia Walters is an extrmely difficult person to deal with. She gives the same lecture over and over, isn't clear whether there's homework, class, or a test or not. I literally have to either guess or email her. She is not coherant and extremely disrespectful/ mean to students. I'll give her credit for knowing accounting code.

DO NOT TAKE WALTERS!!! She plays head games in class, is outright disrespectful and rude to students, and does not give grades until the last week of the semester. Every single student was failing the class as of the last day of class, and grades seemed to be randomly assigned to people. Pure chaos. AVOID HER AT ALL COSTS!!

Walters is the most UNDERRATED FR1 teacher - if you have to take it take her!! Our tests were way easier than any other professors that I knew of. She also provides extra credit opportunities (up to 2.5 points added onto your grade!) She likes to pick on people and sometimes does problems wrong so you have to tell her but way easier than others.

Patricia Walter's is one of the worst professors I've ever had. She never explains anything. She's hostile & condescending to questions. She's scatter brained, and actively teaches incorrectly, so even people with prior accounting experience don't understand what she's trying to do.
I feel like I know less about accounting after having her class.

If you are wanting to take a repeat class of fundamentals, she is the professor to take. Did not learn anything new in the class whereas other sections with different professors were actually learning new things. She is VERY unorganized and it can be hard to tell when and which homework assignments are due.

Every single question on every test is free response. Yes, FR in general is hard but Walters makes the class impossible. Her examples in class are extremely confusing and she often makes mistakes. She also can not hear at all so when you ask questions or try to fix mistakes you get ignored. Worst Neeley professor ive had during my time at TCU.
Professor Walters is not the best or worst choice for FR1. The class and tests are hard. She is nice but her teaching is average.

She is a nice person, but her class is extremely unorganized and taught very poorly. Maybe if she was in-person it would have been better, but she has been probably my worst business school professor yet.
She is a very hard professor, do not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Take Dr. Walters best professor by far for accounting. She explains everything that you will be tested in during class dont need the book other than online HW and gives extra credit to your overall grade. Also, she allows you to make up other grades if you do the work and turn them back it to show you understand your mistakes and how to fix them.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Walters is extremely knowledgable on accounting. The class is obviously hard just because of the material covered. But she tries to make it as easy as possible. Go to class and write down her examples she does in class and you should be alright. Definitely recommend taking her.

She relies a lot on participation, do the examples she gives you.  Tells you exactly what she's looking for on the tests, never tricks you.  I actually enjoyed accounting for the first time in this class.

She's really nice & helpful, but her class is REALLY HARD. She has EC opportunities called QuizMe's. Do all of them (2 points on final grade). Sometimes makes mistakes on board and you need to correct them. 3 tests, though she dropped the 2nd one as almost everyone failed. HW is online. Class participation is earned through speaking up. Wasn't bad.

Dr. Walters is a great teacher and is extremely intelligent in the field of accounting. Intermediate II is a very hard class no matter who teaches it, and Walters gives enough examples and problems to help you understand it. She can be hard to follow in class sometimes, but is very willing to help and meet outside of class. Overall good professor!

She is so confusing in class so plan to teach yourself a lot of the material. Tests are long and many people don't finished. However, she is super nice outside of class and will meet with you whenever if you need help.
she is a nice lady. her class is boring. very willing to meet outside of class. her test are hard

So nice and so funny I love her! Great teacher who really knows what she's talking about. I wish I could take her for Managerial. Tests are not too bad if you study the problem sets she gives you in class.

TEACHES BY EXAMPLE. If you understand the examples she explains in class this will be an easy A. If you are lazy and do not get the examples explained you will easily fail. If you do not understand something or wish for more examples to be better prepared go to her office hours. She is almost always there and will help you. Made an A.
A lot of work for a core credit. Does her best to explain material in readings since it can be confusing. aligns herself with students to ensure she is doing her best.

She is the sweetest and really wants her students to succeed. Every assignment had thorough instructions, so as long as you prepare and study for the midterm and final, you're golden. I would really recommend taking her class as the homework is very manageable. As long as you take notes on the key concepts, you're good!!

Miss Patterson is SUCH a good professor!! She always made coming to class a fun time and conversation was super laid back and easy to have about the content we were covering. She doesn't force you to participate but she encourages it. We had 3 poem responses, a mini poetry unit, an annotation, extra credit, and the final project for grades.

We read 3 books during class, which were all interesting and short reads. Her class is mostly lectures with test days and class discussions. Participation is a major part of the course and has a huge effect on your overall grade (specifically, class discussions). If you don't mind a little reading and like lectures, take her!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: professor paschero is probably one of the best professors i have ever had. she has sat down with me for hours helping me grasps concepts i needed to learn. i now know so many studying and note taking skills that i will carry with me forever. i am so glad i got to experience her class.

Professor Paschero genuinely cares about her students' learning and performance. She had class discussions instead of papers and all quizzes were based on what was talked about during the discussion. She's very clear about what to study and how to get a good grade, and is super willing to help you individually. She's so sweet and funny. Take her!!!

She is a great teacher!!! She treated us with respect and expected us to conduct ourselves as young professionals. You must be on time to class, use your time in lab to work on photography, and submit your work on time and neatly.
Isn't considerate or lenient with any issues you may be having. If you aren't at every single class and have every single piece work on time, she can make things very difficult for you

Tuba gave me a C because she just felt like it too. She only likes you if you say you don't like other people's pictures during critiques. She doen't like it when you compliment other's work. She wants everyone to be as harsh as she is. She is by far the worst professor I've had. Don't take her.
Tuba is awful. Don't take her, it's not worth it.

Tuba is the worst professor I've ever had. She gave me a 79.9 for my final average and wouldn't bump it up to a B. The reason I got that grade was because she counted me absent 3 times instead of two. Then when she caught her mistake she said "oh well I just feel like giving you a C." HORRIBLE PROFESSOR. Also she's rude and just not a nice person.

Although after the first session or two I thought I was going to hate the class, I ended up loving it. It's not that expensive if you already have a camera that you can manually control. I learned a lot and made an A even though I am not really artistically inclined. Tuba is nice and helpful. Attendance is mandatory, textbook not required.

I have a love hate relationship with this professor. If you're not prepared to work hard don't take this class. I took it for fun and it ended up being my most time consuming class. It is also VERY expensive. Tuba is a good teacher but she's very demanding and picky. The good thing about this class is you can really see visual progress. BE PREPARED

Tuba is really nice. She has a turkish accent, but it's not hard to understand her. The class is expensive, but rewarding. The assignments are mostly interesting and if you put effort into making meaningful pictures you will do well.

I hate this class and I can't wait to be done with it. Tuba is crazy and teaches the class like we're in elementary school and not college. She won't let you leave even if you have absolutely nothing to do. It's an expensive class, so be ready to dish out a lot for supplies you will only use once. She grades assignments on how much she likes you.
A wonderful, wonderful person!

Nice lady, but not helpful at all. She can teach what she is supposed to, but don't expect anything more than that. I suggest Lane over her for sure and wish I could of had him.  Class is expensive, have a camera and be prepared for purchasing supplies. Class overall is great for learning, just not with her.

Very sweet teacher.  Whether you're taking Photography for your major or just out of curiosity, you can easily make an A if you do your assignments.  However, you will NEED to buy a new digital camera if yours isn't Manual, which can be pretty costly (we're talking over $300 for a decent one), and supplies can be costly.  Nonetheless, great class.

she's a wonderful teacher.  she really enjoys what she does and helps you out when you have a problem.  this class takes up a lot of time and you have to be willing to work outside of class.  By far one of my favorite classes and teachers i've even taken
i absolutely love this lady. she is from turkey and is a very good and passionante photographer/teacher. my favorite class and teacher by far!!!

Mrs. Owen has such a kind heart and wants to see you succeed. Unfortunately, she had a lot of health/medical issues this semester so watch for that. She canceled a lot of class but tried her best to communicate with her students and is quick to correct her mistakes - ex. she put in 100s for all of our quizzes because she took a long time to grade

Professor Owen was great. Very nice and kind teacher. I took calc in hs and got by with an A very easily. She reached the material exactly how she wants it done on test and quizzes. Quizzes are online which are nice. And tests are easy. She gives good feedback and advice for and on tests. Definitely take her if ur looking for a good calc teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Ms. Owen is the BEST math teacher! TAKE HER! She makes concepts clear, works tons of problems in class, and ensures everyone masters the material. She's very accessible after class, during office hours, and by appointment. Her test policy boosts grades by replacing the lowest score with 75% of the final if higher. With effort, an A is guaranteed!

She goes step-by-step to teach the concepts and makes sure to slow down if anyone needs to. She posts the blank notes and the filled out notes online. Her homework is online, but it's pretty easy to do and quizzes are take-home. She's very sweet and understanding, I need to eat during class to stay awake and she accepts it.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Owen is a gentle and caring professor. The course itself is a little challenging, but not too bad. Although, she is a tough grader. She is very picky about the answers you give and how you give them. She is a good teacher though and is clear about what steps you need to take to solve problems.

The homework is pretty easy but the lectures can be extremely boring. She goes pretty slow which is good and bad. Overall the class isn't hard, you just need to put in the work on studying for exams and you will be fine.

Ms. Owen is one of the sweetest and most caring professors out there. Attendance is not mandatory, and lecture notes are posted on D2L for every class. The lectures are slow and boring but are worth going to. The tests are worth many points, and partial credit is given. I realized many points would be taken off for minor mistakes. Take her!!!

I had her and she was never available outside of class and then we would skip important lessons that built up to our next material. Was overall confused and she was hard to follow because of how slow she teaches. Had to drop even though I went to tutors because of how much she skipped around. Hw was hard to do bc it would always reset.
She is an awesome lady but teaches very slow. I kept zoning out and found it hard to focus.

This professor is very kind and cares about her students. I had taken AP Calc AB before this class, so it was extremely easy to pick up on the lessons. She also has note outlines for every class, which makes the class super organized. Tests are also pretty straightforward and are mainly like examples from notes.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great teacher, lonnggggg and boring lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Extremely kind person. She is willing to spend time with students in and out of class to get them to understand concepts. She does not lecture too quickly, so it is not too difficult to keep up with the material. Quizzes are done at home, and Exams are outlined before they are taken. You'll succeed with her as long as you keep up with the work.

She is one of the sweetest professors ever. She responds to emails promptly and really cares about her students. The class grade is test heavy, but she offers bonus opportunities and zoom/in class review times!

She's fine but I turned in all my homework and still wound up with zeros in the grade book because my homework would be "too dark or sideways." That's not my problem if you don't know how to turn up your brightness or rotate your screen.
SHES THE BEST TEACHER EVER!!! HIGHLY RECOMMEND FOR CALC!!!

Teaches you every single point to the brim. Tests are not that hard and quizzes are easy provided that you do the homework (that is to be completed online). 3 Tests; 9-10 Quizzes (Each quiz takes 10 minutes). Really helpful and caring. She is sweet to her students and you will not regret taking her class. There are many extra credit opportunities.

This class is great for people who don't need upper level math. She's good about partial credit and cancelled class about once a week. The practice problems taught me most of the info, as her lectures only cover the absolute basics of each section. If you are going into Calc 2 or 3, you probably won't feel prepared unless you study on your own.

Ms. Owen is amazing. I went to office hours for this class often and she will easily clear any concerns. I love math and at points it was so easy I wished I would've taken a harder class. She gives partial credit on tests so if you mess up it does not hurt you that bad. Homeworks were super short and easy and you could go over them in class often.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: Ms. Owen is one of my favorite professors so far. As long as you put forth some effort at all you will do fine. Quizzes and homeworks are great grade boosters and the tests are reasonable as long as you study. If you need any help at all go to her office hours! I really enjoyed her class and am taking her again for a different math because of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Prof. Owen is so cute. She reminds me of Phyllis from the tv show The Office. You have a quiz almost everyday but they're super easy, some are even take home. Her lecture examples are odd No textbook necessary. Tests are easy and get a little more diff. throughout course. Not hard class at all if you go each day. Easy A. Also I'm terrible at math.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Mrs Owen is a really nice lady and her class was a breeze. You do have to study and put in effort, but just redo the practice problems and you will be fine. Her lectures are kind of hard to sit through, but she goes very slowly to ensure everyone understands. Great class

Take Professor Owen for Applied Calculus, you will pass. She is such an incredible professor who is willing to help, fair, understanding, kind, humble, and grades accordingly. She gives you note packets during class that match the tests. You take a quiz usually every class. 5 lowest quiz grades dropped. Final replaces lowest test up to 75%.

She is very patient and very helpful. Sometimes her grading is a little frustrating with partial credit. It was the first time she's taught Calc in a while so this year was a little rough. I don't recommend you take her unless you have a little bit of background in Calculus!

ElemStats: She's a very patient person, very helpful. All notes, lectures, answer keys, study guides, etc are posted online. Homework is optional. The tests can be a little more difficult, but she's always willing to make time for you in office hours and you can ask review questions at the start of each class

Very longboringhard to pay attention lectures. Drink some coffee before, take all the notes, and pay attention (attendance taken daily) if you want a good grade. She is very sweet, willing to do anything to help, and is a classic old school teacher. Do the homework (not graded) to stay on top of things. Uses graphing calculator daily!! Work hard.
Professor Owen makes this class very easy. She prints out the notes for you and the class is very organized. I never opened my book. She explains everything in class!
Easiest Stats teacher there is. She prints out the notes for you, homework is not mandatory, and she provides plenty of bonus opportunities. There is no excuse to not get an A in her class.

Best Elementary Stats teacher hands down. So easy to understand, and that's coming from someone who hates math. Makes notes, drops quiz grades, reviews for each test and help sessions before each test. Come to class and pay attention and you will get an A! She genuinely cares about her students and their grades. Come to class, take notes, email her

If you need to take elem stats defintely take her! She is extremely clear and breaks down math at such an easy level! She is also very nice and is very willing to work with her students! She also gives pop quizzes so make sure you're in class. :)

Ms.Owen is a great teacher. She explains well. You will need to pay attention and work through the problems as she does in class, especially if math isn't your thing. Your final can replace lowest exam. Only 5 quizzes count. Colorful handouts help you keep organized, and have great info. Work through these and you don't necessarily need the book.

She's okay. Class is interesting and everything but, she talks through some of her tests! She talked, quite loudly, through the third test and did it again through the final! I emailed her and told how it distracted me through it and she didn't even apologize. I'm an A student and got a C in this class. Her class is fun, she can just be annoying.

Teaches for everyone to understand. Best Stats teacher at TCU. Lots of extra credit and she is sweet. Just do the practice problems off of her printed notes and the test review sheet and you will get 100% on the test. Also practice old exams that your friends may have.

The material is what it is.  She teaches it in such a way anyone can understand. Does not check homework and has random pop quizzes that count as bonus points on your lowest test.  Gives handouts on what she teaches and is very easy to work with.  If you don't understand something, attend her office hours - she will answer any question you have.
TAKE HER STATS CLASS!!! She makes it so understandable and is extremely willing to help you. Even if you aren't a math person, you can definitely make an A in her class.

I was horrified of taking stats, especially after looking over the text but Ms. Owen made it very doable. Go to class and write down everything she does. Dont get behind and even the math challenged can make an A with effort. She was available outside of class and offered significant extra credit. This is the one to take!

She's really nice but she cancels class a lot. It might seem nice for that day it really hurts in the long run because it becomes harder to build on each lesson, esp for those of us who are bad at math. She's willing to help including extra credit which helped me get an A even though I only made an A on one test. I'd take her over the others.

She explained it to you like a little kid and everyone understood. Such an easy A. She took attendance but she didnt take off for not going to class. She really tries to make sure everyone understands. Take her she is great!

Take Ms. Owen!!  She explained the material to the class like we were a bunch of kindergardeners, but it worked!!  She was also always available outside of class and always wanted to help.  she also gives a lot of extra credit. Take her, its an easy A if you keep up with the homework.

Really nice, good professor! I'm not good at math but I'm pulling a strong B right now and will have an A by end of semester. Always willing to help and she really makes Stats as easy as it can be. Stay on top of homework and go to class and you will do really well. Also, try to get ahold of test from previous years, they will really help.

Great Teacher! She is so nice and always so excited about stats. If you keep up with the H.W. the class is very easy and her reviews help soo much. If you arent a math person, TAKE HER! she explains really well and 95% of the work is with the calculator.

She was always missing class and seemed to not be at all interested in helping students really learn. I had to correct her several times because she was wrong. A lot of people like her cause she is easy and happy, but that doesn't make her a good professor. Her lack knowledge in the class was not only obvious, but distracting. Take STAT at TCC!

The easiest course I have ever taken.  All her notes are straight-forward and color coded to make life easier.  All her quizzes are for extra credit.  3 tests and a final make up your grade.  It gets boring at times but that's expected from about any course.  HW took minutes to do.  It is an extremely easy A if you put some effort into it!

Very well-taught class; even if you have difficulty catching on, she will do enough examples until you get it, and is more and willing to help you outside of class.  One of the best, most understandable math classes I've taken. And as long as you practice a few of each kind of problem before a test, you'll ace the class.

Great prof!  Pretty easy class, too, but that's because i've taken stats before in h.s.  However, just because the class is easy, it doesn't make her a bad teacher.  I actually understand stats now than ever before.  I would highly recommend her.  And save your money; don't even bother to buy the book.  Everything you need is given in handouts.

Great Math teacher. Explains everything with clear instructions and gives you tons of handouts and mini quizzes to help your grade. Just do the problems in the handouts before the tests and you'll do great.
Most horrible class I've ever taken; it was extremely boring. As a junior, easily the worst professor I've taken.

Gives you as many opportunites as possible to make an A with the bonus quizes, going to class is the only way to make an A, all the notes are given out before she starts the unit, just do the practice problems in the notes and you will be fine.
she's very available for her students and wants everyone to walk out with A's....grades fairly...is nice....but sometimes the lectures get slooooow
I think she is a great teacher.  This was the second time i took stats (cuz i failed it the first time with another teacher) and i got an A in her class.

Very tough subject.  Extremely fair instructor. She gives credit for the most minute effort. Lots of handouts and is always available for assistance. I passed, barely, but I know I passed because of the instructor.
TAKE HER! She is such a great teacher. If you go to class and take notes you shouldn't have ANY trouble! Also, do well on the quizzes because they will help you out in the end!
it was very horrible, nothing better than a teacher who interupts students while they ask questions, avoid this class like the plauge.
Don't believe anyone that says that this is not an easy class.  If you pay attention you will do fine.  She is a very sweet lady and really wants you to succeed.
I loved her...she was so helpful and very sweet!She is willing to make accomodations and she really wants you to succeed!
She is soooo EASY! You should definitely take her!!

Take her.  She spells everything out for you.  Gives you every chance to make an A. The most helpfull prof. I have ever had.  You can email with any questions and tries her best to get back to you as soon as possible.  Gives partial credit on tests.  Not the most exciting class, but she tries.
Go to class, take notes, do the homework. If you do those three things, you're money on the tests, which will make you golden for the class.

Dr. Owen obviously knows what she is talking about. Too bad she can't explain it to a normal human being.  I failed the class and I am not an idiot.  I never missed a day of class and did all the extra credit.  She is a liar!  Avoid at all costs!

I got more credit for problems I got wrong than I did correct. You really have to show your work regardless of whether or not a five year old could do the problem in their head. Take a different teacher who grades like a sane person.
i loved her.  she has a young son so she makes class easy!  gives lots of partial credit.  if you miss a class though you are skrewed.  very helpful and considerate

A very good professor. VERY willing to help outside class if you make an effort. Don't know if this class helps with real-life applications like Behavioral Research. Handouts are very helpful and clear. The class is organized well. Homework optional.

Great professor, she is always willing to help if you make an effort. She loves if you ask questions and at least seem interested. I couldn't sit in the front cuz she sweats a bit and that distracted me. But nonetheless, take her she is great for stats
hard..very hard...doesn't explain anything..boring...

Mrs. Owen was one of my favorite teachers at TCU.  She gives really detailed handouts over everything she covers and does a complete job of explaining every example.  She is open to questions and problems, willing to help before any test.  Great Prof!
Very helpful and open to questions.  The class is tougher than expected, but an A is a very real possibility if you work hard and go to class.
extremely helpful, gives you answers with explanations for all tests and homework, daily quizzes that count for extra credit on exams, EASY A
No Comments

She was always helpful but also confusing. I left the class with no idea about how statistics related to psychology and it's a required course for psych majors. The first week of behavioral research made the class make more sense. Take Dollar instead
Dr. Owen is a very good statistics teacher.  Go to class and do your homework and you will have no problem understanding the material and getting a good grade.
Pretty freakin confusing. Takes off for every little detail in your work on the tests.

I took her elementary stats twice.  Made a  D  the first time because I slept through class and didn't do my homework but I liked her so I took her elementary stats class again, did my homework and stayed awake and got an  A
Very unhelpful, very confusing... and I did go to class and do homework. unless you like math or actually want to take elementary stats twice, don't take Owen!
No Comments
very nice, very good prof....GO TO CLASS THOUGH AND YOURE GOOD TO GO
go to lecture and you're golden
No Comments
Very nice. Extra credit quizzes, so do your homework. Drops lowest test grade.
Shouldn't have trouble if you pay attention, take notes, do homework.

Professor Porsche struggles to teach.  He is one dimensional in thought and his ability to reason or take the time to comprehend outside of that one dimension does not exist which creates frustration for students. He seems more concerned about quickly grading assignments than actually understanding what students wrote to give proper feedback.
Took him online through Liberty and had a great experience. Was receptive and helpful. Gave amazing feedback. Genuinely wanted to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
I had the pleasure of being in Dr.Porsche's first ever class at DBU.
Dr.Porsche made it clear from day 1 that HE KNOWS HIS STUFF; he teaches in the form of stories and uses a lot of class engagement which is the best part

Assignments, projects, tests, quizzes where all clearly communicated. Grading and feedback was clear and fair.

Great Professor
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Porsche is an excellent teacher. He is extremely easy to approach. He gives great feedback for papers and tests. He is always happy to help you and wants you to do well. His lectures are easy to follow, he truly cares about his students, and he has a passion for the subject. I would recommend him to anyone. My favorite teacher by far.
Very very good

Peckham is a super nice guy and loves to give you real world advice which is great, but he doesn't do a good job of teaching the material that you are tested on. Come test day, you are going to have to teach it to yourself if you want a good grade in the class.

The best guy EVER. Class consisted of a five min presentation, 2 assignments, and 3 exams. Exams are sometimes specific from the slides but you get to bring a double sided notecard for each exam. Fast responses and even wrote me a letter of rec. Super awesome guy and wants you to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loved this class. Markham is the goat. Interesting lectures, good stories, and no homework besides a presentation and two papers. He prepares you well for the tests as well so that shouldn't be a big concern. Tbf I came into this class with a strong background in investing and finance and as a result never really struggled with any of the concepts.

He makes this class pretty simple and the exams are not full of trick questions like other professors. still have to study a lot. easy presentation. only thing that i didn't like was that he teaches the class as if you already have a good understanding stocks/investing. if you don't know a lot you might get confused (like me).

He's a really great professor and probably the best I've had at TCU! His grading is very fair and tries to give you partial credit! His lectures don't only cover the text but also gives real life examples and real life advice! Definitely take him if you can!

Took him for Fin Man and Investment I, best bald finance professor. He is very knowledgeable about what he's teaching. Favorite activity in class is looking at the financial market at beginning of class and gain insights (or make fun of it). Honestly, just take him!

I took Peckham for Fin Man and Investments. Take him and you won't regret it. He easy-going and understands the life of a student. Wish I took advantage of talking to him more because he truly has so much wisdom to offer.

Had him two semester now, by far one of the best in Neeley. Super down to earth guy, 2-3 tests depending on the class, you get a notecard and tests are pretty fair. Take him over anyone else if you can!!!!!!    '89 Magic Johnson type professor

He was the only thing keeping me from smashing my head through a wall during this course. I hated every bit of the actual material but got more useful/practical life knowledge in this class than any class I've taken at TCU. 4 exams YOU WILL HAVE TO STUDY. Gave partial credit for showing work on exams, very generous with grading. High expectations.

He is a great guy and very nice, but he struggles to thoroughly explain test material. He often gets off topic and decides to focus on finance news. He designs his tests to be harder than the practice examples, expecting you to apply your knowledge to unfamiliar problems. It is difficult to do well if you do not have prior knowledge of finance.

Ryan is a great family guy who always shares nuggets of gold for your personal finance activities. I never learn very much in any of my classes but actually felt like I learned a good amount in his even though we didn't have nay homework and attendance was not mandatory. Only graded by 3 tests

Peckham is always trying to make his lectures more engaging. He tries to connect the topics of the lectures into real-life uses and emphasizes smart investing for the future. He allows for notecards for all of his exams, even allowing us to use all of them for the final. There is also a semester-long investing simulation that is fun to do.
Total chiller. W prof. If you have half a brain you can do fine in this class. No attendance and tests are straightforward. quizzes are hard but count for less

There is only 3 exams, a final and quizzes that we are graded on. It's 20% quizzes and 80% exams which makes it really tough to get a good grade. His lectures don't help me at all and I have to teach myself everything. He is extremely knowledgeable and nice but its hard to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Most of the class we talk about the news if you want to learn in class that is not going to happen. You have to teach yourself everything in this class. My main issue with this class is the homework has almost nothing to do with the material we learn in class which in turn takes hours on hours and drops your grade.

He could have been a great professor, if he actually decided to teach what's on his slides. Often, we would spend about 30 minutes talking about the market, which didn't leave a lot of time to go over the content, so it was a lot of self-teaching. He does curve, and he is knowledgeable, but get ready to teach yourself all semester.

Financial management is hard in general. Professor Peckham is very smart and knows what he is talking about but he doesn't teach the content that is on the test very well. I do most of my learning outside of class and then just enjoy my time when I am in there and soak in his life knowledge. Would recommend but get ready to study.

Super smart financial guy. The class lectures are very interesting but don't really help you on the tests. Does a stock Market game. Uses Pearson as a textbook which has impossible quizzes you have to take. Most interesting FinMan teacher but not the easiest.

Professor Peckham's class is not easy, but worth taking! He does curve exams and allow a note card. If you study the slides from the deck he shows in class, you will do well. I went from and B- on the first exam with days of study to a A- on the 2nd by only studying the lecture slides he actually went over in class for a couple hours.

Financial management is a hard class I got an A in accounting and still ended this class with a B+. I would take another professor like Tom Seng because his tests are open note. Peckham is hard and does not curve. Test averages were normally 78-82 range. 80% test and 20% quizzes.

His lectures are interesting and he really wants you to do well!

Peckham is a really good professor who cares about his students. Fin-man is a naturally hard class but he lectures and make sure people understand the material before giving tests. Tests are pretty heavily weighted but he writes them and doesn't throw any curveballs and is not trying to trick you. If you understand the material you will do well.

Dr. Peckkham is one of the best option for Fin Mana. The class itself is already hard no matter who you take, but Dr. Peckham helps you learn the most practical stuff when it comes to investment and stock. He's very accessible and wants you to succeed in and out of class. Only grades are 4 exams (evenly graded) and quizzes (after every 4 chapters).

This guy is an A+. He is very fair grading and cares about student's success. He will help you get into investment business since it's mainly his thing. Trust me mates,if you are reading this because you are not sure to take him or not. GO TAKE HIM NOW

RP is the best! A teacher that cares for his students, and wants you to succeed. Fair when it comes to grading and understands that as a student you have many classes. Don't be discourage by quizzes. Gives great personal finance and stock advice. Your knowledge + awareness for $$ will grow in this class - serving you well much past the course.

reviews.comment: Peckham has great enthusiasm and is a financial advisor as his other job. Tests are straight forward if you listen to lectures and do the homework (not graded).

reviews.comment: Nicest Professor ever! Im usually scared to ask for help or extensions but he is soooo understanding and makes you feel very comfortable. Class topic is hard but he works hard to make sure all students understand before moving on

Prof. Pfeiffer is the best professor at TCU! He's funny and really friendly. He really appreciates hard work and effort, but given how dedicated he is, he deserves all of your hard work and effort. Although I did not have him for a core class I truly enjoyed having him as my professor. I feel as if I have another friend on campus and one that I can rely on for help. Very cool guy.

One of my favorite teachers I have ever had. He keeps class interesting and never hesitates to help you out. He will often play jazz music before his class which is pretty unique. I would for sure take another one of his classes

Pfeiffer the best teacher to take financial accounting from. He is the head of the department so he knows his stuff. The class itself is hard but hes there to help. I slacked the first half of the semester and had to work  hard at the end to barely get a B but if you are consistent, hard working and do the HW an A or B is well within reach.

Pfeiffer typically teaches classes where the material is hard. As a result, the class probably won't be easy. But Pfeiffer is a great professor, and just a great guy in general. He is very nice, and he is always willing to help. Pfeiffer is one of the few people in life that actually love what they do, and it shows. Very refreshing. Take his class.
Great Professor. Very caring, and always willing to help. Typically the subject matter is difficult and therefore the class is hard.

loves the sound of his own voice, literally felt like I had to talk over him to answer the questions HE asked. also creepy with the stuff we read. everything is about s*x to him. there's a crap ton of abuse and sa in the stuff you read, and it feels taken lightly. regularly left the class disturbed and uncomfortable and mad.

reviews.comment: Pitt was pretty cool. The class was pretty easy, and as long as you do your work and show up you'll be fine. He's really talented at writing. A few after-class hours things (live oak readings) are required that kinda sucked, but it was fine. Take this class.

Show up. Particpate. Share. Take feedback from professor and workshops and rework. Build your portfolio and you're golden. No excessive reading. No tests. No pop quizzes. No bs. Just show up and participate in assignments but get things done by deadlines.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Would take again

reviews.comment: Prof Pitt is a real swell professor. Really wants to help everyone succeed and become a better writer. reviews.comment: This class was amazing! i wish i could have taken another class that he taught! He really helps you, is willing to meet with you, and grades you on participation. If you show up to class, do he papers and the critiques you will do well! He is a great teacher, very very friendly, and always happy to be in class! I would recommend this class to all!

BEST.PROFESSOR.EVER! He is such a nice person and his classes are amazing. I wish I would have known about his class before my senior year. Amazing professor. Intro to Creative Writing was the reason I changed my major to writing. Easy class, but very fun. Very lax on attendance. Only 3 big papers for an entire semester. The class is all discussion based and he loves everyone's comments.

English 10203: Creative writing was so fun/easy. Majority of the class is a writing workshop, where we critique each other’s submissions. HIST41913:Afro-Latin History

Don't take this class if you're not disciplined.

Loves and knows what he is teaching, and wants his students to learn it too. You have readings assigned and will tell you when you have a quiz. You're allowed to miss three classes.
He gives you the test in advance on the study guides, so as long as you prepare you will do well on the tests. It is just a lot of preparation.

Attendance is taken, and only a few absences are allowed before they affect your grade. Very clear. He gives the tests away in his test reviews. Reading are assigned often, and expect quizzes (usually group quizzes) over it. Optional final.
Hard but interestng class.  He gives you all the possible questions on a study guide but there s a lot of them and he s really picky about how you write.  I liked the lectures and the discussions.

Szok's class is a writing class more than a history class, so be prepared. He has you read both books quite a bit and will quiz you regularly. His review sheets give you a heads up of what to expect on the tests. If you write out the whole review and memorize it, you've basically got the test memorized. You can send him what you wrote. I got an A+.
I've taken both of his Central and Latin American history courses. Great professor who delivers concise lectures and helps students understand material. Also has a good sense of humor
one of my besrt classes at tcu. he talks about che in the context of modern la. there s a lot of reading butits pretty interesting and he gives lots of chances to improve and a lot of feedback.

Pretty clear about what he wants on test but he wants a lot.  Assigns a ton ids and essays and is very specific about how you write. I did a lot of work with a group. I like the lectures - he tells some good stories.
A good class although I kinda feel like I have a LA history concussion.  This guy is challenging and has too much energy at 8 am.  makes you read every day.

He is very organized and gives lots of examples on how to write properly for the essay tests.  Daily reading quizzes that are extremely easy--sometimes just one word or one sentence answers.  He is obviously passionate about his topic.  BUT, he can be somewhat rude and arrogant.  He lacks empathy.

I really like this class.  His powerpoints are very good and he spends time each class to discussion.  You have to read for all the quizes but it's not that hard to do well.  I learned a ton in his class.

This class is all about analysis  and writing, not exactly what I expected in a class about history.  The class spends a lot of time picking apart readings and then he puts these things on the tests and asks you to do the same.  All Its interesting but kind of tough.  I didnt do as good as I expected.
Szok assigns a lot of readings that you have read, plus three tests and a paper.  He quizzes almost every class.  Lectures are interesting and encourages students to talk

Wonderful class.  Szok keeps it interesting with lots of videos and discussions.  He's spent a lot of time in the region and tells a lot of stories.  Assigns a research bibliography and all essay tests.  Lots of reading.
Szoks really demanding about writing. his assignments are all esay and he can be a pain about grading. but its a interesting course. hes nuts about latin america.
Interesting class.  Know his stuff and makes you think.

Wouldn't suggest taking this class if you aren't a history major. Much easier classes with better professors. The subject is interesting and you know exactly what will be on the test, but the lectures are unorganized and there is hardly any participation from students.

This is an easy class if you are needing it for core. I hate history and have no interest in Latin America, but he gives you study guides with the exact info needed. You read a lot but it pays off with quiz grades. He is kinda scary at first, but eases up later. Tells you exactly what he wants on test, do it an you will get an A or B.

I have to admit, I was scared of Dr. Szok at first. He is tall with a shaved head, and his opening lecture on the first day was a bit scary. However, his class is very manageable; he encourages discussion in class, gives few quizzes, and really shows enthusiasm for his materials. His tests are all-essay, but he grades them fairly. Give him a shot!

He's a knowledgeable and helpful prof but you'll be bored in class because its just one long lecture with no powerpoint.  I'd say it's an fairly easy B but a harder A.  Grammar counts a lot with him...a lot...even more than in some of my english classes!

This is the hottest teacher.  I am taking him again because not only is he smoking hot, he is also a really good teacher.  There is a lot of information but if you study hard and learn the material you should be fine. Take his class!

I really enjoyed this class- you def have to work/study hard but he gives you plenty of chances to raise your grade.  He's kind of an interesting character which makes it fun- he will periodically run out of class for about 2 min. then come back and start talking super fast-no idea what thats about but get ready to take notes. Has awful handwriting

He is very straight forward about his tests, but there is probably about an extra 70% worth of material, than what is acutally on the test. He is really nice, but his lectures are boring and he goes pretty quickly. You never discuss anything- he just lectures. Really hard- I always feel unprepared. A lot of required reading that you HAVE to do!!!!

He says it himself: He is anal about his procedures. But learn his procedures (which he goes over TIME AND AGAIN) and you will do great. Tells you EXACTLY whats on the test. I mean he gives you the questions word for word! Advice: get a study group to split up the work load, and study together. It saved me. This class is hard alone, great in groups

Dr. Szok is one of the most demanding and anal professors I've ever had, but he's awesome! I have learned so much from him, he really knows his stuff.  His tests are tough, but he tells you exactly what you need to know in advance.  Tough grader, but just do what he says.

Excellent professor.  The girls seem to like him, although he looks pretty dorky to me.  He has a wealth of experience and is willing to inject humor into his LECTURES.  He grades relatively tough but his class is very interesting and he will open your mind.
Awesome professor!! He's so intelligent and makes the class fun. Challenging and demanding, but still very interesting.  He made me shift my political focus to Latin America.  Take his classes!!

Great class and awesome teacher! He's a great lecturer and tells you exactly what will be on the test, even the essay.  There's a lot of reading, but its worth it. I learned so much, and it opened up my mind. Very interesting. DEFINETELY TAKE THIS CLASS! BEST CLASS I EVER HAD.

He is very interesting, pretty cute, and a relatively easy grader. He assigns a lot of reading but its not all necessary to do to still make a good grade. It gets easier as the semester goes on  and you realize whats important to do and what is not. Tells you exactly what is on the tests!

Challenging but fascinating class - he's very intelligent and a great teacher, but his test are hard with long, but thorough, reviews - all essays and short answers. Lots of reading. by no means and easy A or B, but worth the work! Class time includes lecture mostly, but also video, music, and discu

A very challenging but interesting class.  He is a wealth of information and a great lecturer.  You will have to do more than just show up, but if you already like the topic then you will absolutely love the class.  Funny guy, very nice.  Take him!
This class was so hard, but you come out knowing a ton about latin america. maybe too much.......
I love Doctor Szok. His classes are so interesting, and if you ever get bored, he is totally hot. He has glasses and no hair, but is young and has a hot body.
I was really impressed with how much he knows. There was a fair amount of reading from those long, boring jstor articles. But I learned a lot in his class.
A great lecturer, and encourages class discussion. Teaches history in a relaxed yet very informative manner.
Very good professor.. and very HOT!
Great teacher. Really knows his stuff, entertaining and informal. Expects good work, but is very helpful.
Knows his stuff, tells cool tales about Latin America.  Tests aren't too hard.
Ummm... it's a bit boring. Dr. Szok talks in circles and is bound to repeat the same topics 4 or 5 times each class period

She's the best teacher I've had here so far. She lets you choose what topics you want to write about or do a project within the project criteria. She really listens to her students and loves feedback. Attendance is part of your grade, but you can do assignments to boost your grade back up if you miss one or two classes.

She is very caring and understanding. The grading scale is based on what the class decides is fair and she will take your papers whenever as long as you tell her you will be late. She makes class personal and loves joking around. She will let you write about whatever you want. As long as you show that you tried you'll get a good grade.

I love Ms Pilcher! She was one of my absolute favorite professors and I would do anything to take another one of her classes again. Deadlines are relaxed and the  different projects are all very unique and fun to dive into. You will get an A if you give adequate effort in her class and she tries to have a good personal relationship with everyone

Honestly I did not read a single one of the assigned readings but still got a B by using spark notes. She is very specific when it comes to writing so make sure you rewrite and edit. Overall, she really tries to make the class fun and interesting.
I don't know where that other person was coming from. What engl tchr doesn't want papers in a certain form? But this teacher makes sure you know what form and why. Good class.
She is a BIG waste of time. Wants papers to be exactly like her form. Incapable of adapting to. Rewrites acceptable but are very long and tedious. Choose another teacher.

This professor is not an easy A. BUT I probably learned more about writing in this class than I have ever learned in all my other writing classes put together. She was really concerned about whether the students were learning and making progress. She was willing to work to help her students. It made me willing to work hard in the class, too.
The GOAT-Hilarious

Dr. Jenkins was extremely kind and has many fun stories to share about his past jobs and experiences. He is also very knowledgeable about COMM and gives great feedback. Unless you're giving speeches, you will never stay the whole class time. The only difficulty is that he does not always make the assignments clear and you will need to go check D2L.
I actually love him so much he's so sweet and kind and an amazing human being he is always there for you and will help you with anything. He will open up late assignments and grades easy. Love him

I love him! He's such an amazing and caring teacher. He always checks in on me because of my social anxiety for public speaking, which is horrible for a communication class. He often lets the class out early, and just email him if you are accidentally late for an assignment. TAKE MY KING!!

Professor Jenkins is just an awesome guy. He cares for every student and makes class a great time, and we got out early pretty much every week. His grading is super chill - really all you need to do it get up there and speak and you're good. Great professor and an even better man, would highly recommend him!
He is actually so nice! We got out of class very early every single Monday. He is very clear about what is needed on speeches. It is very easy to do well in the class.
Dr. Jenkins is an amazing professor. Super nice guy and genuinely cares about every student he teaches. Group projects are super fun to work on as well. Take him if you can!
Very hard grader, you go in under the impression it is a free A and you honestly have to work harder than a chem class.

Dean Pitcock's Giving class was the most impactful course I took at TCU in four years. DP will challenge you, make you write a lot, and require a lot of work. A lot of the time all I did was think about giving. This class can consume you. DP is an amazing professor and knowledgeable about philanthropy and so many other subjects. Changed my life.

This was my favorite class of the semester! Dr. Pitcock truly wants his students to learn, and his lectures are very engaging and interesting. He also gives great feedback on papers. If you take this class, make sure you read and put effort into the assignments. You'll take a lot away from this class if you put in the work!

He is a very seasoned professor and is cognizant of all of his students. His lectures were interesting and engaging, I never got bored in class. Make sure you participate and read before class. He enjoys getting to know his students and will be very helpful if you need it. This was by far my most interesting class all semester and I learned a lot!

Pitcock is known as one of the top professors on campus and inside the classroom his class is top notch. He was a tad slow w/ grading, and there was a lot of work. Weekly writing prompts, 3 ethnographies, and a final paper/presentation. Take this class for the interesting material and to get to know him, but keep the other stuff in mind.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Best professor and course I took at TCU. I learned to solve difficult problems that impact real lives. What I learned mattered more than the grade. Its a lot of work and being in class with people not concerned about grades helped make the class better. Pitcock is caring but will let you struggle with difficult questions: he will not make it easy.

I was expecting way more from this class, but it sadly didn't live up to the hype. It was hard to get over his arrogance. You can work your hardest in this course or you can do nothing, both will end up with an A. Super frustrating if you actually tried in the course. The work was meaningless, although the actual process was interesting.

SUCH AN AWESOME TEACHER!!!! He is so inspiring and he really makes you get fired up about the class that he teaches. I had him for an Honors Colloquium course called On Human Nature and absolutely loved it! Take him if you can!!!!!!!

I'll take any class DP teaches because he motivates me to be a better student & person. Class time moves quickly, and I've never had a professor push me to think, talk, or read as much. He graded our first paper & then met with every student for 30 min to explain comments and grades. Other teachers hand back at the end of class and run away scared

Dr. P is such an amazing professor/role model. I have studied abroad with him as well as taken this course and on the spring break trip that accompanies this course. this course is heavy reading, but lectures are engaging and fun. do NOT take this class if you don't plan on doing the work. You MUST do the work, but it will pay off.

TAKE THIS CLASS. Not only is the class one of the best offered at TCU, but Pitcock is an outstanding professor. He genuinely cares about his students and wants you to do well inside and outside the classroom. I cannot rave about this class enough. Take him!

I was really intimidated to take Dr. P's class based on the amount of reading but he makes it so worth it. He is so intelligent and funny, and he cares about his students. He makes you see things in a different light. His Cultural Memory class changed my view of the world. If you ever have the opportunity to take one of his classes, JUST DO IT
literally best class i have ever taken pitcock is the best and you literally are excited to go to class there is a lot of reading but its easy and interesting stuff so its worth it

Dr. Pitcock is, hands-down, the best teacher I have ever had. Seriously, he's the  epitome of the perfect teacher. He's serious about what he teaches, so you can't be a "slacker", but as long as you participate and he knows you're trying, then you will be good! He'll make you actually look forward to each and every class!

Phenom professor & even better human being. Class organization was so smart and timely. He made me want to participate and do all of the work and the class required a lot. Dr. P is the smartest in the room but he never makes that an issue or makes students feel subpar. He is uncanny at teaching you how to make connections and think through issues.

This is a non-graded class, but it was THE BEST class I took freshman first semester. Dr. P taught me how to make an ePortfolio but he taught me so much about life. I feel like a better college student, a better version of myself, and I formed goals for the future with his guidance. If you're lucky enough to get him freshman year DO IT
Dr. P made me want to become a professor. It seems like the best thing in the world!!!
Dr. P made me want to become a professor. It seems like the best thing in the world.

I visited TCU and heard Dr. Pitcock speak. He was amazing and seemed to really know his students. I've been at TCU for a year, and he continues to impress me. He works to know as many students as possible and everyone loves him. He often talks about being authentic. That's what he is! I hope to take a class with him someday but they fill quickly.

Dr. P is I'd say one of the best professors around. The assigned readings for his class were challenging and I went into the discussions having only a 40% clarity of the reading. But just give the man and hour and twenty minutes. At the end of the class, you'll be sitting there wondering how he made that idea so easy to understand. AMAZING!
Dr. P is one of the best teachers I've ever had. If you have the opportunity to take him, TAKE HIM! Taking his class is life changing.

My favorite professor! I took four courses with Dr. P and wish I could have taken more because I learned so much. He's honest, hardworking, and loves teaching. He will challenge you with difficult question. He really embodies everything about TCU. This is why he's one of the best 300 profs in US! Two years after graduation, he's still my mentor.

The best!!! I've taken multiple courses with Dr. Pitcock and have loved each and every one of them. He really cares about each student and does eveything he can to help them out. However, he expects it to be a two way street, so he'll call you out if he notices you not putting in the effort. Super nice, honest, down to earth guy. Again, the best!
Nature of values was the most fun class I've taken and my first class with Pitcock. I will try and take him again before I leave TCU because it was so enjoyable and he is such an awesome professor.
Master teacher.  Best class.  I took Cultural Memory 2 years ago and that course was epic. I have taken 4 courses with RP.  Each one has impacted my life for the better and given me purpose.

Dr. Pitcock is not only the best professor/teacher I have ever had, but he also loves what he is doing. Dr. Pitcock goes out of his way to make class entertaining and interesting! Take as many of his classes as you can and you won't regret it!!

BEST Professor at TCU, and probably in the U.S. He really takes the time to get to know his students on an individual level which is refreshing. He is honest, great and listening  even if you don't agree, and funny! He is by far one of the most influential people I've had the blessing to have in my life. I aspire to be a teacher like him.

Best professor at TCU.  He is an honest, no bs guy who makes honors at TCU special.  Try to get into his classes but realize that everyone else is too.  Dr P could teach 10 classes and they'd all fill in under 5 minutes.  He's that good.
Best teacher I have ever had. Looked forward to class every day. Very interactive and discussion based.
Special.  Amazing.  The reason I love Honors at TCU.

I can't say enough good things about Dr. Pitcock.  His Cultural Memory course changed the way I think about life and TCU.  I wish I could take more courses with him.  He respects and cares about his students.  he treats us like family.  And you learn a lot from a professor NOT interested in proving how much smarter he is than the students.

Dr. P is the best professor I've had at TCU. I went on spring break to Hawaii with him and some people from our class. We had an absolutely amazing time! I'm taking him for my 3rd semester straight. If I could, I would take him every semester until I graduate. He is by far one of the best professors at TCU. You must take at least 1 of his classes!

I really, really like Dr. Pitcock. He is the head of the Honors College, and for good reason. His lectures are never boring, he is an incredibly nice guy, and he manages to wring interest out of materials that a person might otherwise think boring or antiquated. The discussions we have in his class really stay with me afterward.

Best teacher I have ever had. The class is so much fun. I learn so much and it's not boring at all. He is an amazing teacher and cares about every student. He knows your name by the end of the first week. He wants to give out A's so put in a solid effort and you will do well.

Went to Europe with Dr. P as my professor.  He's fun to spend time with and did things like canyoning with us in Switzerland.  Really cool-- Dr. P is a really smart teacher who gives good advice and cares for students like they are his family.  Awesome!

Dr. P is my favorite teacher, by far, at TCU! He makes learning interesting and honestly is one of the only reasons I stayed with the Honors program. TCU is blessed to have such a great professor! Honors Colloquia is so much fun and we read some of my favorite authors every week.

Take Dr. Pitcock for Cultural Memory!  He is what all professors should be like!  He doesn't care about tests and grades, he actually just loves learning and cares about students!  Wonderful and interesting!  An engaging and discussion based class.  This one will make you think!  Grade mostly from 1 paper and 1 project.
For an honors class it was fairly easy. Rewriting the same papers over and over again was a bit repetitive. Nice guy but seemed to care more about the Honors Program than class.

This is such a cool and smart class.  I find myself actuallly thinking about what the class is talking about instead of daydreaming.  It's smart, fun, and different than any other class I've taken at TCU.
Best teacher who can challenge in a relaxing way.  Made me a better writer.  I actually now care about revising and not writing papers the night before.  Great class and great prof.

You must attend class, and you must participate. Weird grading system (contract) and interesting content- almost a marketing class. He's kind & respectful and you need to maintain a dialouge with him so he knows what you're doing. Don't procrastinate in turning in your essays, because you need time to change your paper based on his feedback.

HORRIBLE CLASS! Hes funny, but doesn't help you actually write anything. He has favorites, and if you don't continually turn things in, its because you just didn't do anything, NOT because you working to make it better. I got an A, but only because I worked extremely extermely hard, and for what??? I didnt learn a single thing, DONT TAKE THIS PROF!

I took this class and found it very helpful.  The teacher uses a contract and expects students to work to make an A.  I turned in drafts, got good comments, revised a few times, and met my contract.  Do the work, and the class works well.  Don't do the work, and the teacher is smart enough to see through people.

didnt help me one bit, hes funny, but doesnt help your writing. prove everything or he'll drill you about your work and even then, will think your lying and assume you havnt worked at all. hes not mean or rude, but the things he says have a sharp edge that can be taken either way. My advice, DONT TAKE THIS PROF!

This class was horrible!! Actually being in the class is fun, but you have to work so hard, and when you turn stuff in, hes condecending. He grades on a contract and plays favorites. If you take him, dont listen to him, turn in every draft to look at, or he'll think your not doing anything. Prove everything, or he accuses you of not working. HATED!

I wish there were more like him.  He made me work but taught me to like writing.  He is cool in his own unique way but don't be fooled because he is intense and will make you work.  Still, you'll learn a lot and learn to love the man.  He has good character, and I respect him alot.  I'm not the only one who raves.
HARD HARD class. Amazing professor. By far the best at TCU.

Dr. Pitcock changed my life. Not only is he the best prof at TCU, he quite possibly is the best ever. His way of teaching is unique as is every student. He truly cares for all and is willing and able to help when and wherever needed.

"RP" is a great prof - gets to know his students, plenty of personal attention. Interesting papers and projects. Very knowledgeable, does a great of making a class a community.  My best friends came from his classes.  All this and he's caring, kind, selfless, and intoxicatingly charismatic.
Class and professor changed my life.  He taught me how to teach.  Pitcock made me want to teach.  In his class you had better be "pumped" about teaching writing.  GO!  It''s great.

A cool guy and class.  He expects you to work hard but is always willing to help.  I think he really cares about me as a person and he does not treat me like some stupid student.  It's a real experience.
TAKE HIS CLASS when ever you can! he's a really awesome prof who really cares. he really wants to help you and makes class fun; his class is really worth while.

I hate English classes, so that should say something when I tell you that this is one of the BEST classes I have ever had. Original style. Open discussions. Intriguing topics. Makes sure class is a close group. DEFINITELY would recommend!

Pitey is amazing! He is still helping me after graduation! I am so glad to have met this wonderful man. He will do everything possible to help you, you have to put in time but you will get so much out of this class.
Dr. P's classes are life-changing experiences.  Take him for the experience.  Getting a B or even a C from him is worth it.

Best course and professor I have taken at TCU.  The teacher prepared us for writing like real people and did not waste our time.  All the work was focused on real assignments and learning.  Professor did not waste time and made course worth our while.
I had the opportunity to spend an afternoon with Pitcock, and he could single handedly take over the whole English department. In fact that would help matters.

I have never taken a class with him but heard Pitcock speak at the Honors Dinner.  Students sitting at my table said great things.  His talk was hilarious and interesting. I will take a class with him before graduating.

Professor sets up projects for students.  Students take over and, with great anxiety, actually learn.  I love my project and am learning more than any other English class.  Professor will not force you to agree with him, is flexible, and respects all
Luv him! Luv him! Luv him!  Works well and understands students.  Makes writing not so scary and kind of fun.  Actually listens and cares.  Not full of lip service when he asks if students are well.
Intelligent, helpful, creative, and humble.  The type of professor you admire because they can teach and treat you like real person too.
Dr. Pitcock is awesome, best teacher and nicest guy you'll ever meet! Plus he's a hottie!
In one phrase: HE ROCKS!!  I worked my rear end off and never felt like I was doing busy work.  This teacher practices what he preaches.  You must take him.

Many professors taught the course and Pitcock is the only unforgettable one. He knew his material but taught through discussion. He asked questions and got students to talk who had not talked all semester. I learn more from his talks than others lecture
He's an awesome teacher! He really cares about helping students improve in their writing along with telling them what they are really good at in writing.
I wrote the last post.  All I am going to say is that he understands and respects students.  He cares about our learning how to think and write.

He is a hard grader.  I just got back a paper and never has a teacher given me so many comments.  He cares and will do whatever he can to make you a better writer.  Just be prepared to work.  I am glad I have him to help me become a better writer.
Best class at TCU.  He is my favorite professor because he understands students and expects them to work.  No day in the course is the same.  He keeps you on your toes.

My roomates hated their writing section, and I loved mine with this teacher.  He is very smart and respects students.  He listened to me and did not force me to write things I didn't want to write.  He is patient, will help you, and push.  Not easy.
No Comments
AMAZING teacher!  Class was never boring.

Pitcock rules.  He's smart and funny and makes stuff relevant to life.  When i took his class, i could bring in all the stuff i was learning from my other classes, and it all kinda made sense and melded together in his class. my best professor so far.
If you want to improve your writing, take Pitcock.  Both him and Easterbrook seem to be the most committed professors when it comes to improving your writing.  Give this man tenure!
One of the best professors I have had at TCU.  I had him for summer school.  He motivates students, and truly is a great teacher.  Haven't run into many like him in my 4 years here.
I agree--best prof at TCU.  He enjoys teaching and wants students to learn.
The best professor I have had at TCU, hands down.
Respected me and made me want to learn.  Amazing and gifted teacher
Smart and funny/ makes learning fun/ learned a lot
Most amazing professor at TCU.  He is brilliant and motivates people.

Dr. Phillips is ABSOLUTLEY horrible. This class is based on how well you can memorize her power points WORD FOR WORD. Her test questions are extremely hard and most of the time students find errors and mistakes within her exams. Dr. P does not give you the time of day and is so unorganized!! If you need at least a B in Anatomical DO NOT TAKE HER
She is pretty good about answering questions in office hours, but she isn't super clear about what will be on each exam. I studied really hard and wasn't able to get the grade I wanted.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: THIS CLASS IS HARD! take it with some easy classes. Best way to get a decent grade is to do all her readings, they're repetitive but it will help you remember things better. DON'T DO THE FINAL PAPER LAST MINUTE!!! you should try as hard as you can to finish sections of the final paper even before the due dates.
I failed all my other classes trying to pass this class and still couldnt.. it is WAY too time consuming and she will take off points for everything possible. Do not take this class!!!

Dr. Phillips is the worst Sports Pharm professor that you could get. She literally expects you to focus on her class solely regardless. She gives tons of readings, the exams are ridiculous(i.e Of the following, which one is most right?). She is a very meticulous grader. If you must take her class, take it only because you must be focused on hers.

She is the worst professor i have EVER had. She makes everything more difficult than it needs to be and tries to use big words she can't prononuce to sound smarter. Her slides have way to much information on them and she basically expects you to focus only on her class with the amount of reading. the writing emphasis doesnt help your grade. AVOID!!

I gave Dr. Phillips a chance even after reading her reviews.. After the 2nd class I had already figured it was the worst decision ever! She is a terrible professor. Contradicts herself all the time. Must memorize her definitions and slide by slide. Definitely not an easy class. She also takes off TENTHS of points on exams. Save yourself: AVOID!

Worst teacher ive ever had in my life. Doesnt know anything shes talking about & doesnt teach basics. She pretty much just reads off her slides and tells u to memorize them if u ask 4 help. Makes tests as hard as possible and makes pharmacology (a interesting subject) look bad. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

Absolute, worst teacher I have ever had in my life. Just reads off her slides and makes her tests as hard as she possibly can. Doesnt teach basics. If you ask for help, she pretty much tells you to memorize her slides. It seems she thinks her class is the only class your taking. Class average on 1st test=70%. AVOID AT ALL COSTS. Terrible teacher!
Can't stan this teacher. She had no idea what she was talking about. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!

Entire class is PPT and the only reason to go to class is so that you know which parts she messed up when making it (a ton of typos and misinformation). Will take .2 points off a test for not being specific enough even though its obvious which body part you are talking about.  Gave a 0 on HW that she didnt even hand out.  Terrible teacher and rude.

Awful. She doesn't know what she is talking about, she mixes up words all the time. Students are always wrong, and she is always right. The only way to learn in her class is to learn her powerpoints word for word. Stay away if possible

this professor has no idea what she is doing. very unethical. incompetent and can't lecture without her book. would not be able to ace her own tests. interesting that she is still teaching with the evaluations that she gets from her students year after year...
this lady is an idiot. if you must take this class, I recommend you take it Pass/No Credit.
Avoid at all costs. When people say she mixes up her words they really mean that if she left for class one day and ended up in Oklahoma nobody would be surprised.
I don't know how this lady has a degree. She forces you to make flash cards and has essays on human anatomy. Don't take as an easy A.

Horrible teacher! Do not take her! She didn’t lecture once and never really told us what she expected. Her tests are hard and the only thing you have to study is your book. She doesn’t listen to her students at all. IMPOSSIBLE CLASS. DON’T TAKE HER!

Arrogant, rude, stupid, worthless, and judgmental.  These are some of Mrs. Phillips excellent qualities in life.  If you feel like having her call you out and ridicule you about everything you do just to “make a point” then be my guest.  The class is impossible because she does not teach and you have to teach yourself through the book.

basically she should not be teaching this class. she told our class that the epiglottis covered the esophagus...twice. she reads off the slides, and even still messes up and confuses people... when i asked her about a correction on a quiz, she tried to justify her answer and didn't give me credit for it... this lady is terrrrrrrrrible
She simply can not teach Kinesiology and she does not understand the subject at all.  She is absolutely terrible and quite possibly the worst teacher at TCU ever!

She is smooth terrible.  Never once did she take a single effort to help us understand or learn any of the difficult material and all she does is tell you what to learn and to do it on your own. This class lost my entire interest in Kinesiology and she is my least favorite teacher ever! Only 6 people out of about 40 passed!!!! Avoid at all costs.

My least favorite teacher this semester. I don't know why I even go to class, all she does is read straight off the PowerPoint slides, which are posted on eCollege. The skeletal system practical test is one of the most difficult things I've ever attempted, and she did not prepare us for it. Expect to rely on the book and your own initiative.
