She must have gotten better since the other comments were made because she is easy to understand, sometimes gets her words mixed up, but that's just being human. She is really nice and appreciates hard work. Just show her you are willing to work and she will help you. Makes hard subjects easy to understand.

so you think she sucks at teaching anatomical kinesiolgy??...shes even worse at sport and exercise pharmacology...class was boring...could have been interesting but she sucks at teaching...nice lady overall but not meant to teach personally ....you know wat they say, "those who can't do, TEACH!"....dont take unless necessary

AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!! This teacher is the worst teacher i have ever had. She does not make it a point to help you if necessary. Her lessons are very straight forward, yet her tests are very in depth and ask a lot. One test we had, not a single person in the class finished. It is absolutey ridiculous, and i would avoid her at all costs.

liked the class, anatomy isn't easy and there is no trick you just have to remember the stuff. she is helpfull, don't blame her for teaching a hard subject.  quizes are hard, but tests are not too bad.

Could be difficult class if you don't study regularly, but she doesn't try to trick you.  Read the book, it helps.  Nice lady but not very good at teaching material.  Sometimes I wondered how much she even knew the material.

A rather annoying teacher that seems to have an understanding of the material but has trouble getting to the point. If you like having 2 and 3 tenths of a point deducted off of questions because she doesn't 'feel' you addresed the question 'totally' be my guest. Take only if required.
Dont take her!!! She isnt very organized!!! She knows the material but has no idea how to teach it. If you want a hard class, take it!
Class kicked my butt. Pretty tough. DEFINATELY have to study for it. She is a really nice lady. Teaches class like an upper level course.
Moves way too fast to be even close to understanding the material...would be better as an upper level teacher.

Class is really hard, she moves really fast and doesn't cover everything for the tests. Tests include WAY too much info, and she goes into very specific details! She is nice and funny but the class is very difficult!

Professor Phillips really isn't a bad professor to take for financial accounting. His night class can get very, very boring though, and he has a tendency to talk slowly and shakily. As far as grades go, it's not too difficult as long as you go to class and take notes. He's a nice guy, but the subject should never be taught for 2 and a half hours.

Not horrible or too difficult, but there are definitely better options. Very boring class, especially at night. Probably as easy as accounting gets, but I'm very worried about being prepared for managerial accounting. Overall, a really nice guy, pretty easy, but BORING!

Quiz before class every week, I took the night class so this was be4 every class time. He is nice, a little monotone but overall it was a class that was pretty good. He explains things well, and they are what are on the test. Study the quizzes and everything he tells you to for tests. I made an A+ but I only missed the 1st week of class.

have a daily quiz over the the homework prior to class. the quizzes are easy and simple. the class itself is boring but all accounting is anyway.  tests are not bad they come straight from the book and the problems that were on the daily quizzes. i recommend him for financial accounting. A is possible if you attend class and study hard
Great guy.  Tests are easy if you study.  Attendance quizzes every class but you can leave after.  I will be getting an A.
Very nice and helpful guy, I learned accounting and made a good grade at the same time.
He is a very nice and helpful professor. He also is very boring. Probably one of the better accounting classes and professors at TCU. Definitely better than Barkman or Nichols.

This is a long class being a night class, but Phillips is a very nice guy and his class, though challenging, can be one you can make an A in. Quizzes are very easy, tests are more challenging, project is not too hard, and final isn't bad.
Really nice guy, really boring subject matter.  the class is a joke, half way through most people walk out.  Not hard to make a good grade if you study a little though.

Steve is a great guy!  If you work hard, you can get an A.  Class is long, but you can't blame him, it's accounting.  I would definately take him again for financial!  Study for the quizes because if you do, they are easy.

This guy is about as exciting as dry toast. Accouting already is boring, and his monotone voice doesn't help that at all. Teaches so slowly and repeats things over and over again. Quizzes and tests are cake. As a night class it can get long.

Professor Plummer is one of the best teachers I have had. She is the MOST FAIR professor at TCU and is very understanding. There are attendance quizzes weekly. Take her if you need a history credit, you will not regret it!

If history is not your thing, take Professor Plummer! She is very understanding and teaches the material very well making it easy to follow. She gives "pop quizzes" at the end of every other lecture so make sure you pay attention during the lectures. Quizzes and exams are all matching with a word bank. Lots of extra credit to improve your grade.

Plummer is a great teacher for history. The notes for class are so easy, its all fill in the blank from slides and she grades easy for the 2 book reviews that you have to do. if you somewhat pay attention and study for the tests you can easily get a good grade. There are easy quizzes every week, 5 questions and all the tests are matching
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took Genetics with Hartman. He's a great guy. Absolutely knows his material and loves to teach it. Even when he became the dean he was great about letting you come in to his office whenever. He tests hard, but not anything insane.

Hartman is a tough tester, but great guy. Very easy to talk to and will take the time to explain anything to you. Very clear in his lectures as well, but he will expect you to know every detail of them. Good luck!
Very helpful, but challenging

Dr. Hartman teaches the third section of the introductory biology course and focuses on genetics. I thought I would hate this section, but I ended up liking it. I did better on his test than the others because the questions were very straightforward with a lot of "Which one of these is false..." type questions. He uses the board a lot.

Genetics is not easy. The material is hard and can be confusing. I was able to do well but I really invested a lot of time. In fact, I literally wrote everything he said in my notes (the mp3s were really helpful). Make sure to get all the details to do well. 3 exams (one of them cumulative) + 3 quizzes (no scantron)
Save yourself and don't take genetics

Great Professor! You really learn a lot from him. To study for his test record his lectures and go back and listen to him-I did just fine on his test by doing that! He picks out small details to test u over, so listen to everything he says!
WARNING: This class is EXTREMELY HARD!!!! I suggest you don't take it unless you absolutely have to.
Great faculty and advisor.  He really cares about you and how well you perform.  Great sense of humor and he really makes classes interesting.

Terrible professor- has his favorites especially if he knows your parents are "somebody"- Will not be a good a advisor if you stuggle your first semester with pre-med.  My first semester he told me to switch my majors since i made a C-never went to him again for advise.  I re-took it got a B and graduated pre-med-even though he told me I couldnt.

Be ready to take LOTS of notes, but if you do then you will do very well. An 'A' is do-able if you put in the time. Class is always interesting and we take a break each class with Trivial Pursuit. Hartman is super helpful in his office hours, so go directly to him if you don't understand something.

Dr. Hartman is one of my favorite professors. Is he the hardest, probably. Attendance is mandatory because he will ask you questions about something that he mentioned one time. Study a little everday and his class is do-able.

Very nice man.  Not a very good professor.  Lectures are very laborious and too much time is spent on needless detail which makes the tests and the class in general more difficult than it needs to be.  It seems that this is done to spread out the grade distribution, but it also takes away from the quality of the information 'learned' in the course.

I've had POLS, Micro, Cell, and Genetics with him. He doesn't take roll, but he WILL test you on little comments he makes in class, so attendance is pretty much mandatory. LOTS of info to remember, and remember it ALL! POLS & Cell = all multiple choice =  about a 2 on easiness. Genetics = All Essay questions/fill-in = a 1 on easiness = MUCH HARDER!

Hartman is hard but if you go to lectures and take really detailed notes then he is a lot easier.  I recommend recording him and slowing down the recording when you listen to him again because he goes really fast.
Everyone told me he was really hard but I felt he was one of the easier ones. His test questions come from only his notes but you have to take good notes in class. He is really helpful and nice.
This is the hardest class ever and although you learn its basically upto you to ALL THE WORK! Hartman is cool but he has favorites and is strict when it comes to grading and tests no sympthay.

an AMAZING professor! he has so much knowledge, its crazy! his questions are very difficult and he expects you to know the information like the back of your hand.. i would definately recommend him- very very interesting!

He is an amazing professor. He has so much knowledge. It is incredible, but the downside is that he expects you to know the stuff up and down. I really recommend him though if you are a serious student. You will definitely learn a lot and it is all worth it in the end.

This class wasn't hard just a lot of memorization.  His tests are fill in the blank and short answer so studying the night before won't cut it.  He was very helpful if you approach him and the labs were fun!
pretty interesting, i learned information but tests are hard
Hart but interesting
He is a good lecturer but his tests are hard. You have to study hard to do well in this class.
Very challenging class.  He makes it enjoyable and his clarity is very good.  Watch out though, the exams require lots of preperation.
Very hard but one of the best profs at the school.  Know all the details and be able to apply them.  Great advisor also!!
Definitely the best instructor of the course.  The test was VERY hard, but I learned a lot.
Good instructor
Very hard professor. Expects students to know everything he even mentioned in class backwards and forwards. Extremely tricky test questions. Great and very intelligent professor but HARD! Good Luck!

He offers up a lot of information and expects a lot out of his students when it comes to retention for his exams. Please remember this is college and not a walk in the park. You work hard in his class, you study and LEARN, and you come away with some satisfaction and knowledge along with your grade.
This is team teach course.  He is better lecturer than others, but test is hard.  Prepare, you learn lot.
Very informative... I learned a lot in this class.  This man's classes may not be easy, but they prepare you for medical school.
Harder than I expected.  His essay tests are not fun and very detailed.  Some facts are minimally important but show up on the tests.
WORST professor!!! He's the most arrogant man I've ever met, and he tries to intimidate.
good teacher, difficult tests, did not like team teaching approach in his class. failure rate 50%

I personnaly like him the best of all the Bio teachers this semester (Akkaraju and Britton good too).  Some people find him really hard, but most of them don't keep up, so it's their fault they don't like him.  I kept up and got A's on every test.
Hard professor so you have to study a lot but you end up learning a lot also.  He is also very good at answering and taking questions. overall id say hes a great prof but youre gonna have to study
No Comments
Maybe one of the harder accounting professors I have had, yet she is the best. She genuinely cares about her students and wants to see them succeed once they get into the workforce.

One of the toughest teachers I've ever had, but I learned a ton. She knows her stuff and can communicate it very well. There is a lot of homework, but you definitely learn a lot in her class. Very respecting and nice. Didn't really use a book (mostly ppt slides), but make sure you show up for class.

Plummer is one of the nicest accounting professors.  She really knows her tax and teaches it in a way that is very easy to understand.  As long as you attend class, you will do well.  She is very lenient with partial credit and really wants her students to do well.

she was a great teacher! she is very explicit in what she is looking for, but tax is a complex class. you can never stop learning in tax. was always there to help, and really cares about her students. you actually learn in this class, compared to other tax teachers.
No Comments

Awesome professor. Take this class for Intro to Social Work. Open note quizzes and tests, one paper and one group project. Not a hard grader and gives feedback. Great attitude and is engaging. Attendance is required and try to participate in class, but easy A.

She is awesome, easy core credit, you will get an A if you particpate and try your hardest. Tests are quizzes are online at home with no lockdown, and there is one paper and one group presentation. You must participate in class but she makes it so easy to talk and there is no pressure.
Easy credit.
Very easy Intro to Social Work class few essays but not a harsh grader and 1 group presentation

I took her class for a core requirement, and I am so glad I had her for intro to social work. She is very caring, professional, and always happy to help. Attendance is required, but it ends up helping your grade a lot if you go and do not miss class. If you take good notes and read the textbook, it is very likely you will do very well in the class.

Absolutely amazing class!!! She is very engaging in her lectures, and cannot complain. 10/10 recommend this class whether it is for your major or just for credits. The more you participate the more you understand.

I took UNLF, and obviously, since it's once a week and requires participation, it's big on attendance. I wouldn't care, but he tried to fail me by missing 2 days when sick and after getting into a car accident since it wasn't university excused. I would have gotten it excused if he had asked me to, but he didn't mention it until finals week. Weird.

Took the basic ceramics class in Fall 2020 and now advanced in 2021, Chris is a gem of a professor and truly loves his students. I mainly work in photography, but I got a ton of skills and confidence after working with Christ for the past two semesters. Get ready to put a lot of work in, but it's worth it!

I really like Chris! There is a lot of work to be done outside of class and over the weekend and he is pretty serious about ceramics as a whole. It's a really fun class though! And I feel like I learned a lot, even though the second half of the semester was over Zoom.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I loved taking ceramics with Chris! Just be aware that he grades projects super tough and it requires a lot of work outside of class in order to finish a lot of the projects. Overall, I enjoyed the atmosphere of the class and would take it again!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Chris is a great teacher. Hard work and a positive attitude will take you a long way in this class. I was not an art major and had never taken ceramics, but I went in on the weekends and talked to Chris multiple times. He ended up giving me an A even when I had gotten A- or B's on all of the projects. As long as you work hard, he will reward you.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Chris is great!!!

Chris was my favorite teacher my first semester at TCU. He was so funny and the class isn't as hard as everyone says it is. I took ceramics in high school so I knew what I was doing, but all my friends were new to it and they did really well. As long as he sees you try and really do your best it is an easy A. My whole class got an A. GREAT CLASS!

if you aren't an art major or minor don't waste his time or your classmates time signing up because you will prob just complain about the amount of effort that is expected out of you.  This class is an amazing introduction to working with clay and teaching you the basics, Chris understands that not everyone is a master artist, just try your best!

Ceramics was my hardest class this semester thanks to Chris Powell. The class is NOT making animals all semester, it's actually super hard. This class took up literally all of my time. You have to go in on weekends and days you don't have class if you're ever going to finish the 5 overlapping assignments he assigns!

Best professor at TCU! He's hilarious and a fun professor. The course takes up quite a bit of your time. Nearly impossible to make an A if you don't come in after class/on the weekends, or go to any art shows. He really grades you on how much effort you put in to the class. He's awesome!

If you like hand-building miniature clay animals, this is the class for you.  By the end of the semester, you will have made almost a hundred animals.  He charges you for every bag of clay you use and you have to buy your own tools and some glazes.  He leaves class and rarely comes back so if you need help, good luck!

Chris is the best professor I've ever had. I fell in love with ceramics in his intro course and took several semesters of advanced. He cares a tremendous amount about all of his students and is more than willing to help you. He really likes to be involved in your projects, so it's to your advantage to let him know what you're up to.

Chris seems nice and the class appears easy in the beginning, but the projects get harder and the grades get lower.  I had never had under a B+, but on the final projects, turned in on the last day of class, I got grades that made my overall a C+.  I deserved a B maybe even an A!

Chris seems really nice and the class appears to be very easy in the beginning, but the tasks become harder and the grades get lower.  I had never had under a B+ until the final projects that were turned in on the last day of class.  There were 5 projects due and I ended up with a C+.  I definitely deserved a B or maybe even an A. He is subjective.
He favors the art students in his class and grades too hard for an intro class. Would not take this class again it took up too much of my time.

I LOVE CHRIS.  HE IS EXCELLENT TEACHER AND A GREAT PERSON.  HE WOULD HELP YOU WITH ANYTHING.  HE IS THE HAPPIEST PERSON I HAVE EVER MET.  HE IS ALWAYS IN A GREAT MOOD.  ANY HE MAKE EVERYONE FEEL LIKE THEY ARE HIS FAVORITE STUDENT.  ONE OF FAVORITE TEACHERS EVER!!!

This guy rules. I was very unsure about him at first, but now its like hes your friend in class. He will help you out with anything. Always ask his imput on your projects, he likes to be involved in what youre doing. Learn the wheel early on, or it will bite you in the butt in the end. Highly rec.

Chris is an awesome guy who will help you with your projects. He can get very upset though if people arent enjoying his class, but he never gets mad. He is a very imaginative guy and its hard to sort of understand what he wants with projects sometimes, but just check with him and you will make grade

Awesome professor who loves to connect with students and wants you to succeed. Exams can be difficult but she allows you to retake the questions you get wrong which means its really easy to get above an 85 on all exams. Wants the class to be fun and gets to know each students individually. Not the most fun subject but she makes it better. Take Her!

Not the most fun class, but a fun professor. She did a really good job at being engaging and interactive to get through the time. The class was very lecture heavy and there were a lot of quizzes and four exams, but she genuinely cares for her students and will try to help. You also get to use printed notes and the textbook on quizzes and exams.

Literally the worst professor I have had at TCU. I had her for a night class and she literally probably spent 30 minutes of the class actually teaching. The rest of the time just playing games and laughing. We never had in-class work that had anything to do with the class. She never prepared you for exams or homework.

DEFINITELY take Professor Pollard for Survey of Jazz. She is the best! Going to class is extra credit. There is a lot of work in the class, but once you hit 800 points you automatically end with an A. She is very nice and makes class interesting.
Super easy and chill class. Pollard is very nice and understanding.

Great professor. If you just need a fine arts credit, take Pollard for sure. Her Survey of World Music class is the easiest A ever. If you submit all of your work by mid-November, you don't have to go to class or do any more work for the class for the rest of the semester. Also a really kind and fascinating woman. Definitely take her.

TAKE DR. POLLARD!! the sweetest most passionate professor. if you finish your assignments before thanksgiving break, and you have enough grading points, you're don't for the whole semester and get a 100 on the final. So kind and a very fun class.

Dr. Pollard is a great professor. She is very understanding of her students and is willing to work with you if necessary. She says her class should never bring you stress. She offers extra credit and the work outside of class is minimum. If you show up to class and do the work, it is a definite A.
Easist A you could ever make at TCU ever enough said.

Dr. Pollard is the absolute best teacher I have ever had and Survey of Jazz was an easy A. She is SO cool. There is no textbook, no homework. Tests are online at home and she ENCOURAGES you to take it with other people. Projects are easy. She will give you an extension on anything if you ask. She is the sweetest human being on this planet!!

Even if you study hard, it is very difficult to do well on his exams because the class does not prepare you for them. Many exam questions cover material that was barely explained in class. The level of difficulty on the exams is much higher than what he taught. Projects are graded very harshly, and his feedback is very vague and unhelpful.

Solid Prof to be honest. For some reason, the final was absolutely brutal. I had an A- going into the final and then ended up with a C+. Are you kidding me?? Besides that, really cool guy who knows his stuff. I would recommend for BIS.
Solid class. Lol the "Bitcoin CEO video" was supposed to be a joke. Everyone knew that

Really enjoyed Dr Preston's class. I thought the content and way he explained everything was helpful and interesting. I thought the group project was graded pretty harshly. I had an excellent group and I thought we were pretty thorough in our report but only managed to get a B. Otherwise, great class!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wonderful fellow, that Mr. Preston. Not very knowledgeable, (he thought Bitcoin had a CEO) but class was not too challenging. Interesting topics. Cool class, solid teacher. Just could have prepared a little better, but he is a busy guy.
very boring class, but have to take it as bis major. he doesn't teach. final is ridiculously hard. it dropped my grade from a- to b+. study really really for final, you will get at least an a-.

He's a really cool professor. If you're a BIS major you need to take him anyway, but just know that you'll have to study really hard for an A. I spent all of my time studying for programming and still got a B
Preston is amazing. He doesn't teach it if it's not necessary and he doesn't hold class if there's nothing to do. Easy B... you'll have to study hard for an A

THIS GUY is awesome. Class is easy. Good, interesting material that applies to real world. MS Project is easy program, but STUDY ALOT FOR DFDs!!! project is graded hard and requirements are not clearly stated.
I took Business Process Management during the winter and it was a great course. Highly applicable.
The first half of the sem is a bit challenging because it's a lot of new concepts but the second half is pretty easy. Just do the work. Group proj was fun.
MBA Managing IT: This was a really good class. I thought the class would be overly technical but it was more about IT management and strategy. Dr. Preston was very knowledgeable. Highly recommend.

Dr. Preston is such a cool guy. He doesn't teach BS that you will never learn like most of the other classes at TCU. Everything is straight forward. Just read the book and know all the terms before the tests and you should get a really easy B. Tougher A.
Nice guy!  Is happy to help you out!  There is one big group project and two smaller individual ones.  You can probably do about 25% of the work without going to class.  Recommened!

Highly recommended. One of the best profs in the Business School. He's really helpful and will go out of his way to get you to understand material. Speakers are interesting but class is sometimes boring. Tests are ok & right from the text book so read it & class discussions & speakers. Get good group for project & u'll be good to go. A/B possible.

He is such a great guy. He'll go out of his way to help you with anything. Just a super nice person overall. Definitely recommend him. Tets are not hard as long as you read and make sure you know the material. I did horrible on the Access exam but otherwise would have made an A in the class. Take him if you can.

He's a really good professor. The class is kind of boring since it lecture mostly but that can't be helped. The speakers are pretty interesting. He's willing to help students out & will even go the extra mile to get you to understand stuff. Tests are fair but definitely read the book. Project is ok but confusing at first. Liked the class.

One of the nicest professors you will have.  He goes out of his way to help his students.  While the project takes up time right before it is due, this class does not have much busy work and is interesting.  He is a good teacher and really nice man.

Good Class. Preston is not an easy teacher, but Isn't difficult either.  He challenges every student.  One big project and a couple little Homework assignments.  Good teacher that can help you relate to the material
Great class
Dr. Preston is fantastic. He gives interesting lectures in addition to very thorough tests. He makes you learn the material, but you'll enjoy it while you learn. One of the best professors out there.
Great professor.  Makes lectures very interesting.  Is always available for help.  Very good eBusiness professor.
Great teacher.  Knows a lot about REAL world e-business stuff.  He helps a lot with the website project, seems to me to be the best e-bus professor. he will help you with your grade too.
Awesome teacher. makes pretty boring stuff seem interesting and very easy to understand. likes to interact with the class and makes his lectures worth listening to.

He is very sweet if you get to know him, but very disorganized. His lectures don't match the textbook or the exam. However, he gives you many opportunities to retake tests and get the highest grade possible. If you want to learn, I would not take this class because I learned nothing.

To do well you pretty much have to teach yourself everything, there is a textbook but his lectures are based on what he thinks, so the tests make no sense. He's very nice and accommodating but very disorganized, takes a while to answer emails and his class is extremely hard to follow, dont take!!!

Even though we get a help sheet on exams and get multiple retakes, it is hard to do well. He is extremely disorganized and often changes his mind about how things will be graded so you never know your grade. His lectures rarely connect to what's on the exam, so you have to teach yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He isn't the best in lecture and he disagrees with textbook but he gives you soo many chances to do well. There is retakes, office hours basically anytime, and you can bring notes to tests. He cancels class a lot and the class attendance is not mandatory by any means. He curves everyone above a D at the end of the semester.
dude is not the best look on TCU. Hes a nice guy, but the his lectures are pointless to go to, he disagrees with the textbook even though our test is based off of it. I would not take this guy again.

By far the worst professor I've ever had at TCU. He's a great guy, but when you're over 80 years old it's difficult to engage college students. His lectures are painful to sit through, he makes up his own test questions, and the answers that HE believes are right. There is no text book, he pulls the content he wants to teach out of his head.

I will say that the best parts of his class is how he grades. His policy allows you a chance to do very well if you are willing to sink time. I believe that his benefits, if you can handle his negatives (rambles, reschedules test dates, lectures with no PowerPoints, semi-confusing grading policy), make him an effective teacher that tries his best.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: still finishing up the course, but if you are planning on taking him: don't. He does not follow a syllabus or grading style, making it extremely hard to keep up with what your grade is in the class. He stopped creating power points, just talks in class, and expects us to learn 5 chapters in one week before finals because he got so behind

Professor Prescott cares a lot about his students and is a super nice guy. He changes the assignments and grading policies a lot which is pretty confusing, but it's usually in student's favor. Quizzes/ Tests are always pushed back. Tests are hard but there are always retakes and/ or a generous curve. If you try, he will help your grade.

He is a great guy, but rambles on about the same stories pretty often. Not a great grader, but if you come liked by him, you are guaranteed an A. Do not forgot to do OLQs, those can help your grade a lot.

Nice professor. The class was the hardest class I have taken. Lectures are hard to follow. Read a textbook, a chapter book, and lectures. Multiple-choice quizzes are based on the textbook. Had to teach myself everything. Only professor with an SAQ's which are hard. Tells lots of stories and gets confused with his own work. Grades really hard.

He is a very caring teacher and will stay after class to help struggling students. Also, He will let students retake tests and assignments if they do bad on them. Even though his tests are very hard it is worth taking his class.

Professor Prescott cares so much about each and every one of his students. His tests can be hard, and the assignments can be graded hard, but he lets you retake both. His lectures can definitely be confusing, but it is really nice because his exams are pretty much exactly like the practice quizzes. Overall, he is the sweetest man!!

he has favorites and if you are not one of them you are SOL.  everyone fails all the tests and then he curves. you pretty much never know what your grade is until the registrar posts it at the end. he is hard to get in contact with and he cancels class a lot but never tells you so you show up to find a note on the door and no one there
A genius at economics... can learn more from him than any other class if you try and put forth effort. Pretty hard though.

great teacher. this man is a genius. his tests are pretty hard, but he curves big time. at the end of the class, he takes the test grades and averages them three different ways and gives you the best grade out of the three. hes confusing if you dont read the book before and/ or you arent inclined toward economics, but hes always willing to help you
Very helpful. Always wanting to help students succeed and will do whatever it takes to do so.

He is confusing in class, but if you get a 50 on all the tests thats a scaled B, and then the final is huge, and then just be his friend and youll get a high b or a, but if you hate ECON then dont take becuase he will confuse it more

Wow, I thought he was really tough at first. I got below 50% on all the tests (Scaled gave me a C) but at the end of the semester he threw an A at me. RADest dude eva! TAKE! (If you can become a favorite)

Put it this way, the average on his tests are around 50%, he has to scale them so much that a 55% is a B. He grades word for word on your definition of topics. If you become the teachers pet you will get a good grade, otherwise prepare to be lost. STAY AWAY!

Worst teacher i have every had! Please do not take his class. He tries to help but does help at all. He is adjunct so he is never on campus. If you want an A or B you have to be his favorite. He is so off the wall and does nothign but tallk about his son. I thought by goign to every class and review session make him think highly of me no, I got a C

Great guy. Knows Economics well...but cannot clarify the material in a way I could understand.  Many of the students I talked to felt the same way except those who are Economics majors or those who had tutors.  He doesn't go over the material efficiently and tries to use graphs to illustrate points but repeats what he said differently every time.

I forgot what class number it was but anyways, I took his micro class. The book he teaches from are very interesting. I made the highest grades in his class but then again I am a Economics major. If you really wanna learn something, take his class. I you dont care, take another professor but Prescott is a awesome teacher in general.

Prescott is one of the nicest guys. The material is so hard and it is hard to understand the way he teaches( meaning he understands it, so he goes over it fast). But he is more than willing to help anyone and if you try hard he will give you a better grade. He is a goofy guy but a great teacher... he is one of the easiest for economics.

Prescott is one of the nicest guys. The material is so hard and it is hard to understand the way he teaches( meaning he understands it, so he goes over it fast). But he is more than willing to help anyone and if you try hard he will give you a better grade. He is a goofy guy but a great teacher... he is one of the easiest for economics.

Mr. Prescott is a great person. He's nice and very caring, and he understands and notices when people try in his class. Microecon is hard, but you either get it or you don't. Many find his teachings difficult, but if you know how to read and interpret graphs, and know common sense in the business world, you should be fine. I got an A

He doenst really know how to teach but wont give u a bad grade if he knows you care.  He tells u what u need to study for the exam and if u look at it then u do great, easy A.  He is the most confusing guy when it comes to teaching so dont listen to him, just study for like an hour before the exam on what he tells u to study and there's your easy A

Prescott...when he showed up to class, just confused me and based everything off priniciples that we were supposed to just plain know, which I didn't. I went to class everyday and would still leave just as confused as I walked in. Available for help, but only when it's a good time for him. But, he tries, when he's there.

Prescott is the most confusing professor I have ever had.  He has the inability to teach.  The man is too smart for his own good.  He will weave in concepts that he mentioned for 30 seconds on the first day of class.  If you ask him a question you will come out more confused that before.  He is very available for help, but the help sucksDO NOT TAKE

Very nice man,makes him self available to anyone who needs outside help, but he seems to learn the material or at least how to teach it as he goes along. "I find it hard to give anyone a C who puts forth the effort." I got an A and didnt put forth any.

Professor Pruitt is a very nice teacher, and her course is straightforward. All your test and quiz questions come from her slideshows, but the problem is that the slideshows are very long and filled with a lot of info so it can make studying for these tests pretty difficult. Will always find time to answer your questions and give extra credit.

She is an amazing teacher, who will give feedback and help you if you just go talk to her. I would not say attendance is mandatory, but she does do random in-class participation for credit. There are not very many assignments and she helps you out. Do SONA hours early. I did all 15 hours and got a lot of extra credit for it, so it was worth it.

Professor Pruitt has very straightforward lectures and is very engaging. She gives lots of extra credit opportunities and rarely has any homework and is super sweet. Overall, I definitely would take this course with this professor again.

Mrs. Pruitt was an amazing professor that really cares about her students. She has 7 quizzes (but takes 5 and they are easy) She prepares you for tests well and is always dropping hints on content. She made psych very interesting (attendance wasn't mandatory but I enjoyed going). Just get SONA hours done early! 10/10 recommend!

An enthusiastic professor even during the 8 classes, lectures are enjoyable. Word of advice, knock out the SONA projects ASAP, they creep up on you. The exams are a bit more difficult than expected Didn't open book once. 10/10 recommended

Megan is a great teacher. She is caring and will work with you. She goes above and beyond to help you succeed. She does have quizzes, yet she tells you about them a week in advanced. Dont need the book. Only study the PowerPoints and you'll do fine. GET YOUR SONA EXPERIMENTS AT THE BEGINNING OF THE SCHOOL YET. Highly recommend taking Megan!!

Megan was honestly the best professor I had ever had in my life! The class was suuuper early in the morning but she made it interesting enough for no one to fall asleep. Do your work and you will be fine. Attendance helps but it not mandatory. Also super funny!!

Awful. If he doesnt like you, he will punish you by grading you how he feels about you. Wont show you your test mistakes or which ones you got right. Terrible professor. Should stick to being a therapists he cant teach. Uses jargon, no one understood his lectures. He only cares and talks about his Cycles Approach he was apart of
He is so stylish! So hilarious! One of the most prolific scholars at SFA! His knowledge is profound! His swag is hot!
Dr. Prezas is a great teacher and person in general. He is very funny and keeps you interested throughout the class. He is very clear when reviewing what will be on the test.

He gives extra credit before every exam or on every exam. He's so helpful and reviews literally everything that will be on the exam. Like he says "know this slide" or "know this diagram". Take really good notes, come to class, and pay attention, and you'll get a good grade. Simple as that.

LOVE HIM! Offers extra credit on all exams and tells you the exact things you should focus on for the test. Very funny and understands that the class is boring and tries to make it as interesting as possible. Take good notes and you will do well!

His voice is monotoned and he is very unclear with his explanations.  Tests come straight from the notes.  Used textbook mostly for the pics.  He offers lots of extra credit to help with your grade.  Biggest complaint was that he takes FOREVER to get grades back.  He will make you take a test without knowing what you made on the previous one.
Great Professor!

He does not give extra credit to help you get the grade you want. He may give a few points to add to a test but that is it. He is robotic and does not show emotion or concern/"genuine care" for his students.

Dr. Prezas is respectful and considerate. He is genuinely interested in how well his students understand the material. This class can be dense and boring, but he really tries to make it interesting and relevant to non-majors. He is always willing to give extra opportunities to earn points to get the grade you want.
This teacher is very hard to follow. He does not explain very clearly.

Purvis is great! She rewards people for attendance directly with class-specific exam questions, which is so refreshing. Her exams are not hard if you study and listen to her. Just show up every day and you should have a cake walk. Plus, she tells some great stories.

You have 5 test that's it for the course. She is a great teacher who cares about real estate and actually does it outside of class. She is a student's teacher not being over the top or excessive outside of what you need to know. Wish more were like her and I respect her!

Graded by 5 exams, including a non-cumulative final. It's a very easy class, and she is very knowledgeable about the content. I would say if you're looking for an easy finance elective, this should be your choice. How much you really engage with the content is also up to you.
Super easy class based on only 5 exams that are taken out of class. Exams are easy overall but can you only miss so many questions to be out of range of an A+.
This semester she cancelled class a lot and all of the tests were taken at home

Pretty easy teacher and the class isn't bad but professor Purvis is bad. She goes on and on about absolute nonsense. She thinks she is some real estate mogul when in reality, she is not. One of the worse off real esate agents in the DFW area.

Real estate principles was super easy. The majority of your grade is tests and they are not hard at all. The downside is that lectures can be boring but she does not take attendance. If you are looking to get into real estate! She is a must take. She is very connected to the real estate industry in Fort Worth.

Her lectures are just her going over powerpoint slides of material and telling similar stories. She's a good person and interesting to talk to outside of class but her lecture style makes it very tempting to fall asleep in class or simply not go.

She will literally ramble on for an hour about nothing and won't relate it to the course. Tests are hard because she doesn't teach. Need to memorize slides and read book to get a good grade. She's so old (70 yrs. old) and claims she's a real estate tycoon but lives in a $250k house....

Took her for Real Estate Valuation. Course structure is the same as Principles except we also have a group project where we have to determine a Highest and Best Use for a tract of land in Fort Worth. You can choose your group mates so as long as you get a good group you will be fine, otherwise good luck.

Professor Purvis is really knowledgeable and likes to explain all aspects of the material. Our grade consisted of 4 exams, equally weighted. The exams are a bit tough, so you will need to spend some time studying for each, but she does give several extra credit opportunities. If you show up to class and do extra credit, you will do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof. Purvis is awesome! Shes passionate about Real Estate and she has a lot of experience and awesome stories to tell as well. The only grades in this class are tests but if you study they are a breeze. She also provides numerous extra credit opportunities to boost your grade. Take her if you can, youll learn a lot!

There is nothing I can say that hasn't been said already, professor Purvis is the best! She wants to treat the class as a discussion and was always willing to meet outside of class to help when you needed it. She is the best and you should 100 percent take this class!
Only 3 tests, not great at explaining. Tests are more difficult than lectures. Need to read the book
I got a 60 on the first test and ended with a 99 in the class. Enough said

Purvis is my absolute favorite. She is so straightforward and truly wants you to learn the information. Her tests are easy and she is one of the nicest professors at TCU. It is a night class and we always get out early. 12/10 Would recommend. Take this class.

Purvis is one of the best professors out there. She makes the tests very straight forward and tells you specific paragraphs in the book to read so that you dont waste your time. You will do group  presentations before every test to teach the class a certain topic. These presentations are super easy and worth very little of your grade. Tests are eas
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She is so sweet. There are 4 main speeches that are not too bad. She really cares and connects with the students. She is not super strict at all. Attendance is only mandatory on speech days and group projects. Definitely take her!!

Would highly recommend her class for communicating effectively! She is so sweet and really makes an effort to communicate with students. There are group projects and 4 main speeches (2 shorter ones, 2 longer ones) Participation is required on speeches and project days. Made the class enjoyable even if you're an anxious speaker!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I really loved her at first and she had such great reviews, but once things started picking up, she got tough. At first her class did not seem tough so I never worried about it but then suddenly I had to worry about it which sucked. She graded speeches so hard for no reason, I never got an A on one and I thought I was well prepared and did great.

I have never rated a professor before, and likely won't ever again, but she is the best professor I have ever had. Her class is easy if you put in effort, and she really understands her students. She makes time to talk to us after class if we have any questions as well, and she wants to be your friend. Such an awesome person!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I LOVE HER. She was a DG at TCU and totally understands the life of a student. If you are not prepared for a speech, she gives you time. Online reading and homework but she makes class fun. highly recommend

I would one hundred percent recommend taking Professor Pulliam. She grades easy for speeches and gives you extensions whenever you need them! All of the tests are open note/book and you take them at home. Group projects are easy and fun to discuss. She is also very kind and shows fun movie/tv show clips in class.

She's a new professor and truly great. It's an easy A if you just do your work. She generously grades speeches and really wants everyone to succeed. I went to every class but some days are definitely skippable. She's super nice and makes the classes fun. Please take her if you want an easy A and a good time.

She is such a great professor, I wish I could take her class again! It is made up of 15 tests online from book, a couple easy group discussions and three speeches which are super easy. I recommend to everyone.

You dont even have to show up that much. Just try your best on the online quizzes/exams as thats most of your grade. Your grade is a few in class group projects, like 4 easy speeches, and the online stuff. If you show that youre trying then youre fine, shes such an easy grader. i wouldve done so much better if i tried on the online stuff

Dr. Proell is the best professor I have ever had. I got a C+ in his class and my statement still stands. He does not teach for the grade, he teaches you how to LEARN. He is an incredibly tough grader, pushes you HARD but you learn so much. He cares deeply for his students despite seeming cold. Take his exact advice on how to learn the material.

Dr. Proell is truly an exceptional professor. Much of the course is based in your effort, but Professor Proell is more than willing to meet with you and teach you anything you are struggling on. Cannot say enough good things about this man.
Great professor. Must work to earn your grade. Would recommend taking his class if you can. He really cares and will listen to your feedback.

If you put the effort into this class, you will see that Accounting is a very interesting and useful subject. Dr. Proell really makes this class mind-blowing to me. He is smart, hilarious, and willing to help everyone. His lectures are very appealing too. If you want to know in-depth Accounting, TAKE HIM - you will not regret it!!

Proells class is not walk in the park. Probably the hardest I had to work for a class, thus far. He truly invests in his students and just wants us to succeed and understand the concepts. His test are difficult, because he asks questions in a different way. If you understand the underlying concepts and practice 10 hr per week, you will do great!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Chad is seriously the man to take for accounting. This class was a TON of HARD Work but he really wants you to succeed. He has awesome lectures and with him you'll kick butt on the accounting final. Highly recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Proell is awesome. He tells you your grade is up to how hard you work but his class is super hard. However, he has great intentions and wants everyone to learn, and he is lowkey very funny. Highly recommend.
I LOVED this professor.  Amazing lecturer and wants you to succeed.  His tests are pretty difficult but I did way better than my friends in other classes on the department final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: TAKE HIM. If you want to really understand accounting and go into the final exam very well prepared, please take his class. He works hard to make sure all of his students understand the material and he will work with you one on one if you are still not understanding. Cant say enough good things about this guy.

He is the best professor I have taken at TCU! It is a really tough course but he explains the material well (if you read before class, when I didn't, I was lost). He really wants students to succeed and is always willing to help.  The material is pretty tough and I put more time in than other classes but it was worth it.  He can be funny.

ALWAYS willing to help - genuinely wants the best for his students and prepares you FULLY. Definitely get ready for homework and reading, but it's so worth it because by the end of the class you truly understand the material. His accounting jokes aren't bad either.

I took intro with him and he is one of the best professors I have had.  He can be pretty entertaining.  I actually found the class pretty easy.  He is pretty clear about what to do to get an A.  Just read and attempt HW before class .
Do not take him. His test are impossible and he expects you to know things he didn't went over in class. His test are tricky, as well as his quizzes that are worth the same as a test.

Incredible Professor! Class is really tough and you have to read and study a lot (I easily did 8 hrsweek) but he give out precise instructions on how to study for the class. Class environement was actually really fun.  Kind of intimidating at first but actually real nice and easy to get help from if you ask.
Awesome professor! Gave me 2 points on midterm for telling joke to class.  Make sure to read before class.  Gave extra credit.
Recommend. Sort of followed his 'stdy plan' easily got B+. He cold calls and tracks attendance but not sure what is used for. Really nice guy. Sometimes funny

Had him for negotiation, the negotiations are fun, but then he says that most of the work will take place at the beginning of the semester and then in October a group project appears out of no where! It's frustrating to have another project so late in the semester but the negotiations during class are great and definitely learned a lot!

Real nice guy. Homework is hard at first but is a great study guide for tests. The tests are pretty hard and have many questions that he doesn't specifically go over. The best thing is he give a "pretest" that is worth a percentage of the real one. This test helps a good amount though.

He's a nice guy, but his method of teaching just wasn't for me. He rushed through classes, and his homework problems were much easier than the test. The difficulty of the test is always unexpected because he fools you into thinking you know the subject by using simple and easy problems during class.
Great professor, but hard subject, follow his directions and you will be fine, you just have to study a lot out of class
Think hes a real nice guy I would say hes a cross between Eddie murphy in "coming to America and the kid in Doogie Houser, I enjoyed his class...just wish there less tests and homework

Managerial accounting, very hard, you don't learn much in class and his test are confusing if you don't teach yourself from the book... managerial accounting is hard no matter which teacher you choose but proell is probably harder than most... but if you if your good at teaching yourself out of the book (and some are) then you might like his class

Not a bad teacher at all.  Had him for cost.  Mainly lectures on readings related to accounting, and splits you into groups for actual accounting problems.  Not a hard class to teach to yourself assuming you've already taken managerial.  Overall, a smart, nice guy, just needs to lecture more on how to work out the problems.

He really cares about the class and tries really hard to teach the material in the best way. He isn't the best professor and his final is ridiculous, but he can be really helpful! It's just a hard class in general, and sometime his expectations are a little too high.
i believe that he knows the material, but he doesnt put it in a way that is easy to understand. Relied HEAVILY on the book. He openly admits that the average should be a C. I gave sufficient effort.

He expects a lot which is fine but he does not give good guidance on how to get you there. He is all conceptual and that's the only thing he talks about in class which makes it difficult to work out problems.

Required class, the Chancellor never taught anything. A different professor handled the whole semester. When the Chancellor arrived, he only discussed TCU instead of teaching. Grades were posted right before finals, giving students almost no time to ask questions or fix missing work. Overall, very disappointing course. 

ENTR 20263

Some things learned in this class were helpful, but most came from guest speakers, not President Pullin. He was very uninvolved in his own class and had the TAs and guest speakers teach the entire semester. Very unclear grading criteria, I swear they would just put in random grades with no explanation. President Pullin was also unreachable.

The class structure is basically a guest speaker who comes to class, or a day of students presentations, hardly ever does President Pullin even teach the class. Also, the grading and communication is done through the TAs that lead the class so its not really Pullin's class at all. Projects and speakers can be informational, but wasn't my favorite.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not the best class. It fulfills no credit, and he has people teach the class for him. He has not taught us in months, and his TAs basically do all the work and teach the class for him. It's an easy class but its early and its 3 hours.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I do not remember the last time our actual professor taught us. He just sits in the back of his class on his phone and either has a guest speaker or us watching a video. This class is an easy A besides a couple of papers and sitting through a three-hour class. I honestly just don't think the professor wants to even be there any more than us.

Daniel Pullin sat in the back of the class as people taught his class more than he did. He's a nice guy and the speakers were fun and entertaining, but you will write meaningless papers every few weeks. No tests or quizzes. Sitting through the almost 3 hour class was the hardest part. Waking up for this 8am hurt. Not for credit, but fun sometimes.
awesome class. most classes are led by entrepreneurs so it was very interesting to hear from real world experiences. not a ton of homework and no tests

Show up and you pass. Do all the work you get an A. All assignments are group projects and take around 1 hour. A lot of guest speakers with a lot of good information to tell. This class will actually teach you real-world knowledge and introduce you to ideas that will help your career.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: this class was very interesting and i enjoyed going to it every week. you have a ton of guest speakers who have great information to share and i learned a lot.

Daniel Pullin has been one of my favorite teachers. Not only does he come in charismatic and ready to start the day but he gets to know you for who you are. I had him for ENTR 20970! The level his class requires you to think at is top tier. The people Dean Pullin brings to class add such a perspective to the topics discussed. Highly recommend.

As the Dean of the business school, many would expect him to be a hard teacher, but Pullin's class is one of the best classes I have ever taken. He is a very smart and respectful individual who drives the class through student participation and interest. 8am is early, but the class is very interesting, and you get as much out of it as you put in.

Plenty of assignments, but they require less time than other classes. Students are always involved in the lectures, and guest speakers appear frequently. It also touches on social attributes. Quizzes are not in class, and consists of 2 questions each requiring a one page long answer. Neuroscience may be my major, but this might be my favorite class

Professor Punko is a great guy, but his classes are so boring. He talks about himself half the time, then lectures from the book in a very confusing way. However, he does tell you what will be on the exam so it is a very easy A. If you have perfect attendance, you get 20 extra credit points. I used his class as a study hall and did other homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Punko is the best. Being engaged in class gets you an A.

Dr. Punko is an incredible person. The experience he brings to class is unrivaled. He is a self-made millionaire and an inspiration to listen to in class talking about his real-world business experiences. Very caring and extremely fair. Just show up to class, put in the effort he expects and get an A. 100% a must take class at TCU.

Mr. Punko self-made millionaire. Don't miss more than 5 classes or it will hurt your grade at the end. All exams are take home and you will get an A if you do them. Group project is easy, do the presentation get an easy A. You will get an A if you show up. Lectures are boring, but for an A they are worth it.
Best professor at TCU.

Punko is SUPER EASY. 4 Tests, but he does "reviews" where you're told what's on them. He starts the class by asking  about articles people have read, and after that, just talks until it's time to leave. There are papers, but he isn't a strict grader. Also have to write a hand written review about yourself for class participation.  Take him. Easy.

EXTREMELY EASY. He tells you exactly what you need to know for the test and you can just find it in the book and memorize for the test. You won't learn about the test material in class but he has some amazing life experiences to share that are interesting to listen to. Attendance is part of your grade but  you get out of class early everyday

He's crazy but a good crazy. always happy and thinks all his students are geniuses. you never feel stupid even though he's really smart. he loves bragging but he's funny and has good stories. does everything he can to make sure everyone gets an A. a little boring at times but totally worth it

The size of his ego never fails to amaze me... Constantly talks about how great his achievements in business were and how he broke records. Lectures are pointless, tests are all book-based (and thus SUPER easy). Want a painful - but easy A - org mgmt class? Take him.

I took communicating in your profession with him. He is so nice, helpful, and understanding. His class is so Easy and I actually enjoyed going because he made it fun. He's is not a hard grader. The test is fairly easy. If you need help with a speech he will help so much that you won't even realize he practically wrote with you.

TAKE THE SHORT ANSWER VERSION FOR HIS TESTS!!!!!! This is truly the only way you will do well in this class. MC version is extremely hard. Test 3 throws a curve ball and he grades super hard on assignments. Go to him before turning it in and have him correct it. He really is nice, but not my favorite class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Dr. Putnam is very straight forward and the criteria for this class is not difficult at all. He gives reviews for his exams, and you can even choose if you want to take all multiple choice or short answer. He gives good feedback, and as long as you follow the instructions on assignments, you'll do fine. Would definitely take him again.

Really enjoyed this class. He was a great teacher. He posts all of his powerpoints and lecture notes online. There were a good amount of tests, which weren't impossible if you take the time to study. And there were also two papers that were interesting and not bad at all. He is a great guy and will like you if he sees you are trying!
really sweet and funny. will give you a good grade if he knows that you are trying. some material he says in class aren't always on the notes but are on the test. defiantly take him

Really awesome and helpful teacher! He cares so much about each student and wants them to succeed. He honestly gives you everything you need to get an A. Just pay attention, which isn't hard to do because the lectures are really interactive and everyone discusses things and asks questions. Highly recommend him!

He is a professor that fools you. At the beginning he seems very open to be helpful. Towards the middle to end, his tests become harder, as well as his grading for his papers become significantly knit picky. If you do not have to take him, DO NOT.

Super nice guy, but a little unrealistic when it comes to expectations. Be prepared for TONS of reading- if you get behind your done for. Not a hard class to pass, but very hard to get an a. Has a noticeable accent, but not too hard to understand. He will try to help you outside of class, but is a little unorganized, so it can be frustrating.

Horribly boring class, unfortunately. Very nice guy who works hard and expects the same from students. A lot of reading and several pop quizzes to keep you accountable. Took it to get some core requirements and elected pass/no credit. Definitely the best option, as it is very easy to get a 70 percent, pretty hard A though.

A very nice guy who has a genuine interest in the subject and wants his students to share his enthusiam. He assigns a lot of reading, gives weekly quizzes, takes attendance every day, and has 3 tests.

This professor does NOT answer emails, grade papers in a reasonable amount of time. It is very repetitive and a lot of irrelevant content that never gets to the point. Would not recommend this course, maybe select a different professor.

Professor Quinn is by far one of the BEST professors out there! She wants to get to know you as a student and is very knowledgeable. She will be there for you if you ever have a concern or need help! We had mainly homework, papers, and projects for Developmental Psychology of Adolescence, but no tests. Take her classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: In this course, you will complete a lot of assignments which are graded pretty easily. The midterm is hard, though. You have to come to class every day.

Dr. Quinn is an amazing professor who takes the time to get to know each of her students. She wants everyone to succeed and do well in her class and in life. I would take this course again if I could because Dr. Quinn is the best!
Not difficult at all as long as you engage in class. There are no tests and she gives plenty of time for assignments.

I was on exchange at TCU back in 2018 and had Dr. Quinn. Shes a good teacher who always makes sure that you understand the basic and have the opportunity to ask questions. Dr. Quinn is besides being a good teacher also very helpful and understanding!

I enjoyed Developmental Psychology of Adolescence with Dr. Quinn! She gives a lot of lectures and we only had three tests. The test reviews are really helpful -- make sure you're there for those. She's really knowledgeable and does a great job of connecting with her class!
Great professor! Works with you if something is going on! Great at teaching and including students in the lectures! This was a fantastic class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: She is such a great teacher! Lots of reading, but there are self-checks online in each chapter, and her tests are basically identical to these so studying is a breeze! Her lectures can get a little long but she always incorporates videos to make them more interesting. She always asks for feedback on her teaching, which I think is really cool!

Her class is not too challenging and an A is possible with consistent hard work. She allows revisions on your 1st two exams, which helps your grade if you take those opportunities. She always keeps the class up to date with the schedule. Tests are not too hard, as long as your study the study guide. Highly recommend her!

There is a quiz EVERY week, but they're easy. Exams are not hard if you read, by read I mean complete the study guides she gives you. The things I didn't like were the group project, and the observation assignments. I was so lost about what to do for observations and she asks for a lot of things, got a D on the first assignment. Overall, alright.

Dr. Quinn is a great professor! She is so nice and truly cares about her students. Exams are not hard AT ALL if you do the study guide (I made a 106 on the final). Paper is long but if you do it early she will give you feedback. Does all she can to help you excel in her class. She is very organized and tries to fit each student's individual needs.

One of the many things I liked about Dr. Quinn is she always emailed us to keep us up-to-date on what to expect in class and what she expected out of us. There's a lot of reading but not all of it is necessary. She's respectful of us as students and helps as much as she can. There are 2 big papers but she helps you along the way. I recommend her!!

Do not take her! I have her for Child Development and feel like I'm in an intensive reading/writing/research class. So many papers, the shortest being 3-5 and the longest being 8-10. The amount of research is insane. Plus she gives you huge reading assignments, which she does not go over in class. The tests are hard and count 25% of your grade.

SO MUCH HARDER than it needed to be! She talks way too fast making it hard to take in what she's saying before she moves to the next thing. Only time I understood material was when we had a sub. Pretty difficult exams, ton of homework, harsh grader. She has good intentions but moved through course way too fast. Take another professor if you can!!

She's not a bad teacher, but she can definitely improve. Study guides sent out like 4 days before the exam. Exams are hard, and there are 2 versions given out. 2-3 activities a month, and most can only be done if you attend the class so if you don't show up you get a 0 for that assignment. She's a tough grader. Optional final that's 100 questions.

She is intimidating but if you take the time to know her and also email her she is very nice. There is alot of work but it is very manageable. Exams are hard and there are different versions of them. Have to go to class to see videos for the homework assignments. Sometimes is contradicting in information. Study more than  you need to for exams

I had a good interest in this class before taking it. However, her teaching made it hard to actually enjoy the material. In lectures, she will call out students that she knows. She is also a tough grader when it comes to what she observes in class (if you're paying attention or not). She also does not give out study guides till days b4 the exam.

Shes not a bad teacher and if you make an effort in her class you'll do well. Very unorganized. Talks way too fast and can be kinda unclear in her wording. She gives an annoying amount of work for a class that require this much work. Doesn't give study guides for the exam until like 3 days before. good teacher j needs to get it together.

Lectures are super important in this class. She talks fast, so I definitely recommend recording them. Reading the textbook also really helps. The class isn't super easy, but if you take good notes and keep up with the book, you'll be fine. Usually 1–2 homework activities a week, and they aren't too hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Jose is the sweetest human being to exist! He cares so much about his students, and really wants to help you learn and succeed. There are weekly practice logs that can be very time consuming due to its requirement of an hour a week, and you have to give proof of completion. The class is really only hard if you can't sightread music well.

You MUST go to class. He says it's not mandatory, but your attendance is your starting point for participation. Super boring class but easy A if you GO. 3 online quizzes a week with unlimited attempts. GO TO CLASS or your A will turn into a B or C

Class was so easy, just show up and thats it. Had quizzes that were due every Sunday, but so easy to pass and don't have to study for them. It was boring, but he is also a rly nice prof who made the class worth going to. Recommend for a core to get an easy A.

Boring class but you can just do whatever you want on your computer the entire time. No tests, only quizzes that are online, at home, and unlimited attempts. 2 projects both very easy. He gives you 6 unexcused absences. Easiest class ever.

Easy is the word. All grades in the class are online quizzes due at the end of each week, including the final. Lectures can be boring, but that is partly due to the material. One group project and an individual presentation is worth 20%, but he is a light grader on those. Definitely take for the core credit.

Professor Quesada was AMAZING. I would absolutely recommend him to anyone looking for an easy fine art credit. He lectures for 10 mins and then you listen to music the rest of the time. Attendance is mandatory but he doesn't care if you do other homework in his class. He's super understanding and very easy to communicate with.

This prof is sooo easy. All test are online, open book, open notes, unlimited time, and unlimited attempts. Attendance is mandatory however, you can do other homework or like play on your phone the entire time.

If you are taking the class to learn the material take someone else. Every class is a lecture and does not brood a question asking environment. You will definitely be called on multiple times. Saw several students get yelled at for seemingly not paying attention.

Despite all of the negative reviews, his class is not that difficult as long as you are prepared for the exams. He gives you all of the test questions before the exam, and all you have to do is memorize the answers. The thing I did not like about his class was the group project, I was paired with people who did literally nothing.

Professor Quesada is the worst professor I have ever had. He does not care about his students' success and is instead more obsessed with the power he has as the instructor. I dropped the class because of blatant disrespect and disregard I experienced. He also has no idea how group projects should work. Horrible person in general. Won't enjoy life.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is the worst teacher I have ever had. Very inconsiderate of students. Would never recommend to anyone at TCU.

Professor was nice and straight to the point. Exams are open note, and the discussions throughout the semester aren't as bad as I thought, and I had public speaking. Attendance is important though! Great class for a fine arts credit

I am extremely confused by a majority of the bad reviews for this class. Although the lectures tend to be quite mondain, the class itself is very interesting. Exams are online and open note. You also get two attempts at each exam. There are also 3 minor group discussions which are very manageable.
Quesada was an amazing teacher

If you take Survey of Music as a non-music major, tests  open book open note. And all the answers are on quizlet. Easy 98s on tests. As long as you do the few assignments you get around test-time, you'll do fine. Classes can be decently boring but it's fine ..
He is super boring and his tests are ridiculously hard for this class which is meant for non-music majors as a core credit. So many better and easier options for your music credit so DON'T take this.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very long lectures, but Mr Quesada is very kind, funny, and likable. Not much homework ever. If you pay attention you'll pass

Quesada is a really nice guy, but I hated this class so much. It took everything in me to go. I studied fairly hard for this class (considering I did it for my fine arts credit) and I ended up having to pass/no credit it. The tests are so unnecessarily hard and nothing at all like the lectures. I wish I had just dropped it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. I have never been so bored in a class, if you can stay awake you might get a B. More people used their pass or fail in this class than any other I have been in. It's super hard and insanely boring. The content is okay but I have never seen anything taught so badly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I have no experience with music but Dr. Quesada was awesome. He gives you all the material needed for exams during lectures. Pay attention during lecture and write down everything he says (not just the blanks on the worksheet!) and the exams will be very straightforward! Attendance is worth a lot and EC available. Plus Dr. Quesada is super funny!

Dr. Quesada has a strong accent but it does not impede one's ability to understand what he is saying. Besides that, he is a great professor and the class is very easy if you put in just a little bit of effort. There are 2 online "quizzes" a week that are very easy and participation in the class combine to be an easy 40% of your grade.
He has a pretty thick accent but knows how to speak English very well. Not like some teachers who you cant understand at all when they lecture.

The class size is small which makes it overall more fun and comfortable. Homework is due at the end of each class day but its so easy and you take it as much as you want until you get 100%. Every day there is lecture but we listen to music which helps. 1st test is easy, the rest can be if you study. Easy A if you don't treat it like a useless class

I have no musical background at all and was able to get an A in this class. Dr. Quesada's class is by no means easy but if you are willing to put in work and ask for help when you are confused you will definitely see results. Definitely recommend him for Survey of Music. Also extra credit project at the end of the semester worth 5% of final grade.

Dr Quesda was an awesome professor but Survey of Music is just a very hard class. I thought it would be a blow off class but it definitely was not. I recommend Survey of Jazz with Joseph Carter for your Fine Arts credit instead. Way more interesting and fun.

Definitely study for the exams, and pay attention to the musical pieces. There will be listening portions to the exams so you have to be able to recognize and talk about a piece just by listening to it. There are weekly online quizzes that are due SATURDAY at midnight. Attendance is 20%. Extra credit project worth 5% for your final grade is given.
Dr. Quesada was a fantastic professor for ear training! While there were times when our class was more difficult than the other sections, it truly paid off as I felt more prepared for the future.

I love Ms. Sharpless! It's a super easy class. There's always a reading to do before class, but she provides the pages from the books, so you don't have to buy them. There are no exams, but there are a lot of reading questions, journal entries, and a few easy presentations. It is a seminar class, so you will participate.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof. Sharpless is very sweet and you can tell she genuinely cares about her students and history. She assigns reading assignments each week but there are no quizzes or exams. There is little to none outside work, but there are a few projects but they aren't bad. You have to talk in class considering its a seminar but its easy. Overall I suggesther
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Sharpless is awesome! The class is super lecture-heavy, and she doesn't allow technology, but she gives you a phone break halfway through every class. It's def a lot of reading but you can skim through it and still get a good grade, and there are no tests. Overall, really great teacher and class! Take good notes; it makes the essays easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Sharpless is such a sweet prof! Class is lecture and discussion-based. There are essays instead of tests that you can rewrite. She is super helpful in and out of the class. Technology is not allowed in class but you don't need to take notes in class. I reccommend taking her!
She is amazing!!
