To begin, this is an Upper-Level History Course; which means there is a good amount of reading and writing. There are no exams, instead Evaluative Essays throughout the course. If you pay attention to the readings and write decently, this is a great class for WEM. Dr. Sharpless truly cares about the success of every student and is very personable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is a great teacher but she assigns a lot of work. We had 5 3-5 page essays 30 total discussion questions and a 12 page final to do with weekly reading and 2 books. Not hard to get A/B just alot of writing and reading would take wem with another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved this class and Dr. Sharpless. She cares about her students!! I have never liked history, but she made this class so interesting. Attendance is mandatory, but her lectures are engaging! There are no exams and no textbooks, but we read two historical novels and have multiple papers that are not too hard. Definitely take this for HT credit.

I would highly recommend this class as your HT credit! Unlike most history classes, this class isnt memorizing a textbook and taking multiple choice tests. You read books throughout the semester and have essays over them. If you are a good writer, this is the HT credit for you. Get to know Dr. Sharpless, shes super nice/understanding. Easy A or B
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Sharpless is awesome!!! I never liked history, but she definitely made it fun and I looked forward to her classes each week. 1 small group project and she gives extra credit. No tests, just take home essays that you get two weeks to work on. DEFINITELY RECOMMEND.

If Sharpless is teaching it, TAKE IT. She's an amazing lecturer and overall teacher. Never have I seen student engagement in class discussions like in this class. Class is essay exams, but they're not bad if you know your info. Again, Dr. Sharpless is amazing, take any of her classes and I can assure you that you won't regret it!

This woman teaches for the right reasons. Class in mandatory but it's never boring. She is always interested in the opinions of the students to lectures are often casual discussions. Easy grader but expects basic knowledge of writing (it's college, duh!). She's always there for students even if you just need someone to talk to. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

Even though attendance is mandatory, Dr. Sharpless makes each class interesting and promotes class participation. Alot of essays and outside reading, but she is a fair grader. She is a sweet lady and is willing to help however she can. Highly recommend her!

An extremely sweet, nice professor who will help you in whatever way she can. If she can't, she knows exactly who in the department can help you with your project. Class is mandatory, but is also intriguing and very helpful, so it balances out. Hopefully, I can get another one of her classes.
Dr. Sharpless is the best teacher in the history department hands down. Her class is never boring, you do a fair amount of work and she is a fair grader. All I can say is she is an Awesome Woman!

I LOVE DR SHARPLESS! Seriously, she is the best. I took her for TX hist and Hist of American women. Sweet lady, always understanding and will do anything to help you out. All test are essays and take home. Work hard and you'll be rewarded. In her WEM courses she even lets you rewrite your papers. She is my favorite professor ever!

I love Dr.Sharpless! A great class to take. She loves teaching & it comes across in her lectures.Reading before class is a must & as long as you do that, you should be set for her exams. She grades a little hard on her essays but all of the test essays are take home so you have no excuse to not write a good one. If you love history you'll love her!

She is a great teacher, but she gives out a lot of work.  I spend almost as much time for her class as I did for the rest of my classes.  She also grades really hard on all your essays.  But she is willing to help you out and you will learn a lot in her class, but it will come with a heavy burden of work.  Normal grade is a -B, A's are rare.

Dr. Sharpless is a Great Professor, she does a great job teaching and trust me you will learn a lot. But she is probably the hardest professor I've ever had, be prepared for a lot of reading and writing assignments. But other than a monstrous work load she is a great professor.
TAKE SHARPLESS. She's fun, knows her stuff, and really will help you if you ask for help. One of my favorite professors I've had so far - and I'm a senior!

Dr. Sharpless is a great professor and truly cares about her students. Random pop quizzes over chp readings. Likes paper/essay assignments(got her undergrad degree in English). 3 novels to read. Essays count 60% of your test grade. Very organized. If you hate writing this class isn't for you. Tests are easy if you pay attention in class.

Dr. Sharpless's Womens history class is very interesting but there is no way to prove your understand except thru written papers. Besides your textbook you have to read 3 other books. You have to write 6 papers 5-7 pgs long and a 15 page research paper as well. The amount of writting in this class is over the top! No other example of what you know.

She is a definite take for history at TCU. Lots of quizzes and papers but are easy if you read! Tests are not too bad but you go to class and pay attention. I enjoyed going to every class cause she makes them very fun and interesting. She is extremely helpful and crystal clear on how she wants the papers and whats on the tests. good luck

I love her! You have a lot of reading and quite a few papers to write but she is amazing and makes sure you understand everything! She is very interesting and makes an effort to clarify anything you may have a question on. You have multiple quizzes, but they are very fair if you read and she drops your lowest one. I would recommend her!

Love this lady, she make me proud to be myself. She has excellent input though is always ready to listen. She is well read, well versed, well rounded. You have to do A LOT of reading and write several papers but all is beneficial to the individual. I adore Dr. Sharpless. TAKE HER!! (especially for women's studies classes)

As long as you participate in class and show that you care, you will do well. I seriously would take this class 100 times again. She cares so much for her students and it is obvious she is passionate about her job. The exams homework and labs were all easy to do well on if you just put in the effort. She is seriously the sweetest human.

She's down to earth, knowledgable, and sweet. She lectures the entire class unless it is a lab day. The labs are very informative. There can be a bit of a language barrier when she is explaining things and on the wording of tests and quizzes, but it isn't too bad. There is a quiz and study guide due every week and 4 tests. final is not cumulative.

Dr.Reddy is such a sweet lady. However, you must put effort into this class or you will not succeed. There is 5 tests, which require a lot of application. There is a tremendous amount of homework, and it takes so long. She is so passionate about textiles, which makes it exciting going to class.

Dr reddy is an amazing person but her class is incredibly difficult. Her tests are really hard and you will have homework assignments every week. Most of her class is spent lecturing for 2 hours which can be really hard to lock in for that whole time. Be prepared to study a lot and pay attention.

She doesn't grade your labs or study guides till the end of the semester. If your a fashion major there is no way around taking her. She is a nice person but the class is painfully boring and hard. The averages on my classes exams were between a 65-70 and she does not curve. NGL this class made me want to change majors.

This class was hard. You have about 5 assignments due a week, which are very time-consuming. A lot of times you don't retain anything from the lectures and are forced to relearn it all by yourself at a later time. All in all, not an enjoyable class and leaves very little time for free time, especially with all the studying you have to do.

This class was awful. I had to teach myself everything to prepare for the hard exams. She often has two right answers in the exam due to the way it's worded. For example, she will have the correct answer as option A, then say on option C "Only option A is correct" making both answer choices correct. Also, the lectures are long and pointless.

Dr. Reddy is very sweet, but this was the worst class I have ever taken. For being an elective, it is WAY harder than it should be. Her instructions for the unbelievable amount of assignments are never clear, and despite trying to ask for help, she would never give any helpful feedback whatsoever. Going to class felt pointless.
Dr.Reddy is a great person but a hard teacher. If you do all your homework, study for the tests, and attend the extra credits you should be fine.

This class is tough! Be engaged in class and stay on top of your study guides! Tests are multiple-choice! She doesn't put grades in (for study guides, labs, etc.) very quickly. She is a great teacher with lots of knowledge, and truly cares about her students! Her instructions are sometimes hard to understand but not too hard to figure out!

Dr. Reddy is a great person but her teaching methods aren't for everyone. I took Textile and Sustainability with her. In Sustainability, lectures are boring (mostly videos). Homework is heavy (2-3 assignments due every week). She gives mostly discouraging feedbacks. Vague instructions but high expectations. Never answers your questions directly.
Very sweet lady but her expectations for assignments and projects can be very vague. A very tough grader and it is important to participate in class discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Such a nice person although not the best teacher. Very disorganized and unclear with expectations and very follows the class plan or schedule. Her tests are hard and include random questions that you have never talked about in class.
Dr Reddy is a very nice person a person and teacher, however, her class is very difficult and it consists of a n absurd amount of reading. She is very demanding and a very tough grader.

Dr Reddy's class is very difficult, she uses up the whole class time and rarely makes sense. When you ask a question she usually does not even answer what you asked. The tests are very hard to study for because she does not teach for the test, when I look at the tests it feels like she never taught it.

As a person, Dr. Reddy is awesome. As a teacher, she is not always clear with her grading criteria and can be difficult to please on tests, quizzes, and in class assignments. She assigns study guides twice a week; they can be time consuming, but they are easy As. Her tests are multiple choice and her tests require a decent amount of studying.

Professor Reddy is the so so nice and she tires to make the class fun. Lectures are long, she explains things well but you have to take notes and pay attention. She lets you use your study guide for the quizzes, tests are pretty hard and she is slow to put grades in. The material is challenging but if you study/ask questions youll do great.

Interesting course content, but ridiculous amount of work due on Friday nights. Additionally, she doesn't grade anything until the end so you have no idea how you are doing. She is also very hard to communicate with as she doesn't respond to emails and if she does respond it normally doesn't actually answer your question.

She's a sweet woman who is passionate about sustainability- I love her as a person. However, this sustainability class was unnecessarily hard. At least 2-3 assignments due every week, and she grades too hard. Lectures are just looking at websites and watching videos. Take any other elective for fashion & learn about sustainability on your own time.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Very very very unorganized. grades unnecessarily difficult for the course work she assigns. I never knew when assignments were due and she provided us with a course schedule from 2019.
She is hard to understand and communicate with. The study guides are super long. The long study guides are due everytime you have class, so it takes up a lot of time.
really sweet professor but there's a lot of homework. test are hard
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Sustainability issues elective. Very easy grader, expect weekly assignments. Very interesting course, I learned a lot through assignments and required reading. Lectures are kinda boring though, as they are long and you arent tested over the material. Dr. Reddy is so nice, a little disorganized but very kind and passionate about her field.

Dr. Reddy is sweet and passionate about what she teaches, but wow she is unorganized. Her directions are extremely confusing and vague and whenever someone asked her for clarification she'd go on a long tangent that didn't make much sense or clear anything up. Appearance and Dress is a writing emphasis class so lots of papers and response sheets...

Reddy is very invested in her students and wants to see them succeed. Pay attention during lectures (they can be pretty dry, but that's just the subject) and you will do fine on the tests.  She knows a lot about her subject so take the time to learn what she has to offer!

Dr Reddy is a GREAT teacher. Dont let the others deter you. She knows a lot about her topic and is really excited by it. You HAVE to go to class... and actually pay attention! Always do your study guide before class. Sit in the front and pay attention when she passes around samples. Its tough but an A is doable.

Dr. Reddy knows a lot about textiles and that shows in class. This is not an easy class. Tests are hard and there are quizzes almost everyday. However, if you go to class and study for the exams, it is a manageable class.

Incredibly unorganized. Powerpoints misspelled with incorrect info. Doesn't seem to know or care about the class. Only used the book for the writing assignment. Tests are hard, do well on the writing assignments for a good grade.

This class is pretty boring, but you learn a lot. Do the study guides-they help on quizzes and tests and you turn them in for a grade. Tests are hard but not impossible. Study the powerpoints and the chapter quizzes.
She is a great professor. You have to do the readings and prep for the in class essays but they are pretty straightforward. Two tests and you just have to study the study guide. She's awesome

Such an interesting and easy class. Writing heavy but it is on similar topics through the entire semester. Group project podcast is final. In class reading quizzes make you have to understand reading in order to participate and receive credit. Deep lectures but shes super knowledgeable and willing to help with all assignments and projects. Enjoyed!

Definitely not the easiest history class, but I loved it and Dr. Reynolds. Tests are pretty general and not a lot of out of class HW besides reading. You do need to show up and take notes, but if you do that, you'll do great. She is SO sweet and keeps the students engaged. Provides good questions during class to prepare you for the exam.

The lectures were really engaging and easy to follow. Many things factor into your grades, and she's super clear on grading criteria. Wants students to succeed and the tests are very straightforward. It is not an easy class but has little homework outside friday discussions/readings. If you put in work, you'll get an A.

One of the best teachers I've had at TCU. He's super funny and engaging. It's very easy to get an A in if you go to class and study exactly what he tells you. He offers a lot of extra credit, is very accessible outside of class, and even brings you breakfast at the final exam! Definitely take him :)

Professor Reed is hilarious, cares so much about his students and understands that students have other classes to manage. His lectures are very understandable, the homework can be tough sometimes but it allows you 3 attempts online.

If you have to take accounting take it with him! He's so nice. Sometimes he can get confusing when explaining concepts but you just have to study hard and it'll be ok. He gives you the exact facts that'll be on the test which makes the tests better.

He is very direct into what needs to be known, he will tell you what is on exams during lectures and overall tries to make class very engaging. Make sure to go to class, especially for review days. He cares a lot about his students, knows their names. You can legit text him for help and he may straight up call you to help
He is so awesome

I absolutely flunked the first exam because I was not locked in and didn't go to the Review Day the class before. GO TO REVIEW DAYS and you will be fine. He goes over exactly what will be on the exam. Very easy to listen to and offers extra credit. He made going to an 8am not bad at all. #BoltUp

HW is so easy, Test are given to you prior, you don't really have to try very hard just show up. he loves to talk and sometimes hard to follow but if you just study with the material he gives you, you will get an 100. knows everyone's name and will randomly point you out but id rather have that than a hard accounting prof
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you need to take acct he is a good choice. Try and keep up the homework. His reviews and online notes are very helpful. He's a good professor and acct is not easy but if you put in the work you will be fine.

Attendance is not mandatory but he knows and remembers faces really well and factors how often you show up into your final participation grade. Material for what will be on the tests is VERY clear but the questions themselves can be tricky so it definitely takes time to study for if you want an A, but the bonus questions on the exams help.

He cares about his students and is the biggest sports fan ever (you will see why). He does yap quite a bit, you will have to teach yourself a lot of things, but he does give an extensive study review that helps a lot. Be prepared for trick questions he likes to throw some in

Such a sweet professor, he truly cares about each of his students. He does ramble a lot in class which is fine but you do end up teaching yourself accounting. He makes it up for it though by giving you reviews with whats going to be exactly on the exams.

Professor Reed is one of the best professors I've ever had! He teaches using powerpoint slides and is VERY clear about what will be on the test. He tells you exactly what to study before every test. Homework is doable with the textbook but if you need help, he will explain everything to you. He's super funny and made accounting enjoyable! Love him!

Before every exam he gives a review with which PowerPoint slide each question comes from. The PowerPoint slides are the same as the book and the book website has videos explaining the slides if you needed more clarity. The homework is easy and it's only a couple questions per chapter which is all due the night before the exam. Hes RLLY funny

I love him so much!! He cares about me loves his students so much, is absolutely hilarious and half of his classes are spent laughing. He made me wish I was an accounting major hahahah. He literally tells you exactly what is going to be on the test. I wish he could be my teacher for every class. He is so full of joy!!
Professor Reed explains concepts well and is  helpful when you ask questions. He gives great reviews. The hw are tests are very manageable.

Professor Reed Organized the material well and explained it in a way that was understandable. There's some homework but it's not too bad. He really helps if you ask. The test were pretty straightforward and I did much better than I thought I would going in. Definitely a solid choice if you're looking for an acct professor.

His RMP was really good when I was picking my classes. I see now that he reports the bad ones. Great test reviews, tells you what exact slide to know for each exam question but bro does NOT know how to teach. Get ready to teach yourself accounting.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He did not organize his teaching schedule. There were several weeks where we rushed through everything. I feel like I did not really learn. I had a lower grade in this class than in FR2 the majority of the semester. Get ready to stress and study. Also gives you a project that you will not feel prepared for and will take forever to do. Good Luck!

Rate my professor please do not take this down. This is a fair warning to anyone taking his class. This is not offensive or anything. This teacher is not very good at his job. I got my worst grade of college in here. This is the only one you should listen too since he reports all the bad ones to get them taken down. Stop reporting your bad rate myP

Rate my professor please do not take this down. This is a fair warning to anyone taking his class. This is not offensive or anything. This teacher is not very good at his job. I got my worst grade of college in here. This is the only one you should listen too since he reports all the bad ones to get them taken down. Your busted Professor Reed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Reed is a great guy and teacher. He keeps the class interesting by telling relevant stories from his industry experience. Also is really good with names - so I wouldn't advise skipping.

Professor Reed is INCREDIBLE, I can't recommend taking him enough! Although tax is a difficult course, Professor Reed is extremely caring about his students and wants everyone to succeed. He's always available outside of class for assistance, as well. Study hard before exams, participate, and do well on the project and you will finish with an A!

NGL this is a tough class. There's lots of information to remember. He does reviews but it does not really narrow studying down so be ready to study. Sometimes he goes through the material/ in class problems pretty fast. The project is also very time consuming, no one felt prepared to do a whole tax return, but will give feedback before turning in.

Prof Reed makes tax class actually enjoyable to go to. He takes pride in getting to know every one of his students and is always available to answer questions. DON'T MISS EXAM PREP DAYS! He tells you all of the topics on the exams and everything is on the slides. This class does require you to study but if you pay attention in class you're good!

This is supposed to be a difficult class, but professor reed makes it fun with different stories! Main things to know going into this class are 1) even though attendance is not mandatory you should go every class sometimes he gives info that is on the exam that are not in the slides or book 2) be prepared to memorize A LOT. It's hard.

Reed is a good teacher who is teaching a hard class. His tests are difficult but he gives lots of help on what to expect from the tests and basically asks questions straight from his power-point slides. The class is mostly memorization. He also curves is tests a decent amount and cares about his students.

Reed is a really good teacher who cares about his students more than most professors I've had. Tests are challenging and he does throw in a lot of curveballs, but once you learn how he writes the tests, they are easy to study for. Don't miss his exam review days and the class will be very managable

Professor Reed truly cares about his students. He is willing to work with you to make you successful in his course. DON'T MISS THE EXAM REVIEW DAYS!!! He doesn't surprise you with what he asks and gives multiple attempts on the chapter quizzes too. He talks about his life and makes a boring subject fun. Take him for tax if given the option.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER! He makes class so engaging and really enjoyable. He is very understanding and cares about each and every one of his students -- he also makes it a point to know his students more than just by their names. Attendance isn't mandatory, but everyone still goes to class because of how much fun he makes it.

Professor Reed is an awesome dude. He is like a breath of fresh air for someone taking a heavy course load. He knows you have a lot going on and tries to make his class as easy as possible for his students. He does a great exam review and quizzes are online with retries. If you can TAKE REED, you wont regret it.

TAKE THIS CLASS!! Dr. Boxwell is the best professor and I loved attending her class. Spanish is not an easy class to take, but she explains the material very well. Attendance is mandatory. Exams and quizzes are in person, but she prepares you well for them. If you put a little effort in you can easily get an A.

This class was fairly easy, but she took a lot of liberty with the course. She proposes great debate topics, but grades you on your ability to recite back her own opinion on them. For college, it should be about growing in your own thought pattern, and not having the same political views as professors to succeed in a course. Very concerning.
She was a good teacher and was often lenient and gave chances to make up work.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Boxwell is very sweet and gives very easy assignments. There are 2 compositions that are written in class that are very straight forward. There is a group project that involves cooking and the final is a pretty simple round table discussion.

Profesora Boxwell was an AMAZING teacher! She has been teaching this course for some time, therefore she knows the material very well. She is always prepared for class and is prepared to answer any questions you have. Attendance is not mandatory but I don't recommend missing too many classes. She is caring and loves her students! Easy class.

Love her!!! Her teaching style is a bit all over the place, but she is super fun and makes learning a new language tolerable. Always offers extra credit and tells you what you will be tested on and how before the exam. Definitely an approachable and helpful professor that wants you to succeed.

Professor Boxwell uses a lot of English to explain things. It's a very structured class, so it's easy to prepare and know what's happening each day. You read the 1-2 pages of grammar explanation in the book beforehand, then go over it more in class. Not too much homework. Dr. Boxwell is caring and keeps class relatively interesting. Take her.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Boxwell! She's an incredible professor and very dedicated to her students. She's happy to help with anything you don't understand and uses a variety of activities to make class engaging and fun. I highly recommend her! If you study the materials (usually only a few pages) and ask when you have questions, you should do well in the class!

I love this woman. If you know basic spanish from high school or precious classes this class wont be hard. Do the homework which takes 15 minutes max and is given rarely, she is so understanding and will help work with your schedule. She truly cares about how you are doing if you show up, work with her and respect her.
Terrible teacher. Not cool, very hard to understand what was happening. Constantly late. Would inform of quizzes hours before class started. Awful. Not a fan at all.

He's now an emeritus. I took him back in 1981 or 1982.

As a premed advisor, he was malignant. Dr. Reinecke tried to destroy my career before it began. Despite him, I trained at UCLA in Psychiatry, and have specialized in underserved populations---Maori and Ojibwe being two of them. My MCAT was higher than the average at Harvard Med in my year.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment:
Did his best to ensure I didn't get into Med School, despite my having a GPA of 3.7 and a higher MCAT than the average at Harvard Med School.

Despite him, I was accepted to Illinois and UTMB schools of Medicine. Did my Residency in Psychiatry at UCLA Olive View Program. In July, I will have been practicing after residency 30 years. Fair grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: When I took Dr. R's class forty years ago he was very demanding but I learned alot.
Had no idea what I wanted to do with my life when I took Organic Chem from Reinecke.  He instilled in me a passion for chemistry that carried me through Ph.D
Can be a boring lecturer, but overall a great guy.  Easier prof than minter.

Lab will take you all 4 hours - no joke!  Like already said, rambles on about other crap than in lab b/c he has to fill up time - and NO, none of it was on the final. **Take your time in lab b/c your grade is determined by your product and it will pay off in the end** --> I got an A in the class
This guy rambles on and on about nothing, then low and behold it ends up being on the test... WTF? Also has the worst handwriting for a professor.
I don't like him - you won't either. For him teaching is what he has to do because he's not as famous as he thinks he is
No Comments

Rambles in lab lecture about crap that has nothing to do with lab simply to take up the hour and a half cause it only takes him about 15 minutes to lecture on what we're actually doing in lab. The rest of his notes don't help at all but he'll probly test on them.

His teaching strategy is insane.  4 weeks before a test he will go on and on about absolutely nothing you need to know.  Then in the last week he will attempt to throw in 2 whole chapters.  It will blow you away.  Great guy though.

He covers 3 chapters a day, and will throw in tons of crap in the last 5 min. of class...and that's what is on the test. Definetly the lesser of the 3 teachers....however, he is a nice guy outside of class

You can't read his hand writing at all and he goes to fast to ask him what he wrote.He gives a lot of busy work that takes forever and assumes that you know a lot. He seems mean but if you go talk to him he'll help you and he's nice and understanding.
He has been teaching here since WWII, scribbles on the board just dont make sense, kills you on tests.

Dr. Rhea is great, however her tests for stress management stress everyone out. They are short answer, matching, multiple choice, and T or F; her tests are extremely hard. Attendance is not mandatory, but it is a trick to go to class! Her lectures are long, and she just reads off the slides the entire time.

Dr. Rhea is a great professor and explains concepts thoroughly in her lectures. She's very passionate about what she's teaching and makes the longer class time feel shorter. 3 exams, a few small assignments, and 1 cumulative final. Exams were harder, but if you take good notes before the exam, you should get an A. I recommend this class to anyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She genuinely cares about her students! Extra credit is huge in class so make sure to attend each class lecture. The textbook is provided in the course digitally. I recommend reading the textbook to get a better insight to understand her PowerPoints. Listen to her lecture to get "fine" details to each PowerPoint. There were 2 exams and one final.

Dr. Rhea has a lot going on. Her class was not very organized and the lectures were all over the place. The "labs" were always a good time but were not useful for exams. She gives LOTS of assignments!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She will do anything for her students. I have had her for the past 2 semesters and I have truly enjoyed having her as a teacher! If you get an opportunity to have her I would recommend taking her if you have the option. Her class is a lot of work. Make sure to follow the directions on her assignments and you will do well in her class.

I took her summer stress mgmt class, and it was great! I agree her tests can be kind of hard - you will have to study! But she was always well prepared and very interested in her students.  Although attendance wasn't mandatory, I would recommend showing up for class if you want to do well.

Dr. Rhea is AMAZING! If you are a PE major, you have to take her classes, but I can honestly say that she is my favorite teacher at TCU. She is so compassionate and helpful. I know I will be a better teacher because of her! If you can, take her class.
great teacher, she will jump through hoops to help you, love her classes
i love her! she is an amazing teacher. her test are sometimes hard but her classes is always fun and you can always get help! TAKE HER. she is a great teacher!
Awesome - very outgoing during clas

Extremely tough grader, a TON of writing assignments, and a ton of reading. gives pretty clear feedback but has weird preferences for writing (not MLA or APA, weird mix of the two??). No quizzes or exams, most of your grade comes from labs, writing assignments, and the massive final project. Got to be self motivated with this class or you WILL fail
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She makes it super easy to ask her about anything! Going to class will benefit you because then she will know who you are and want the best for you if you're trying!

Professor Mayne is so nice. She does checkups weekly asking how everyone is, and try's her hardest to help everyone succeed. The class can be difficult, especially if your aren't interested in science, but Rhiannon has open office hours all the time. 3 exams all year, so they have a heavy impact on final grade.

Rhiannon is a stellar human being. She has evident passion for her work and passion in being an educator. She is approachable and desperately wants students to succeed; she cares about your personal life and tries to make things easy for you.
Took her during the May semester. Her lectures are very long. She is fairly neutral with her lecture and doesn't seem to show political bias which is a good thing. Exams are hard and very long.
She provides great Quizlets to prepare for exams. Quick response to emails. Tests are designed to trick you, but she allows you to ask her questions, providing clarity. 10/10! Would take her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took Explore the Solar System with Dr. Mayne, which focused on planetary geology. I didn't have any background in geology, but she explained the concepts well and made the course accessible for non-geology majors. You'll do a lot of writing in the class, but she's very specific about the grading criteria and happy to answer questions!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mayne's class was all lectures with 2 exams plus a final. She posts a study guide before the exam which is all you need to study. Attendance is not mandatory but it is helpful to hear the content from her. Her exam questions can be worded to trick you so read carefully. Overall, she is very caring for her students and wants them to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is pretty easy. Attendance is mandatory. Perhaps one of the easier Natural Science classes here at TCU. For those who skip lectures, do not take this class. The first two exams are multiple-choice, third exam is short answer + multiple choice. Dr. Mayne is one of the nicest professors here at TCU.
She is an amazing professor and is very knowledgeable, classes are very lecture heavy but she posts a quizlet before every exam so its so easy to learn the material without going to class.
Dr. Mayne is very nice and caring. Class is all lectures, but if you pay attention you will do well on the tests. Tests are in class, but the material is not too difficult.

Dr. Mayne is generous and respectful of her students and was willing to give us grace on deadlines and assignments. She also provided great feedback. History of Women in Science was very interesting and a lot of work - we created museum exhibits about famous women in science and wrote a paper and reading summaries. Very discussion-based course
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Mayne is a very good professor. Basically, it's all lectures and there are study guides given for each chapter so fill them out as she is lecturing because she answers each question instead of taking notes. 3 Test and a Final. Go to the review because the questions she puts up are on the test. Very caring and nice!

Dr. Mayne is AMAZING! I HATE science, but contemporary environmental issues with her was amazing. It helps that the content is relevant to everyday life, and Dr. Mayne is one of the most caring professors I have ever met. She truly wants to be there for all of her students and make sure you get what you need. Lots of easy assignments too.
Lectures are boring. Tests are too long given the time allowed to take. Attendance doesn't matter, so honestly forget about this class.

Great professor but there is a lot of material covered and the reviews are very long so do not procrastinate on them. Allows available to talk to. The first part of lab will be difficult b/c mineral and rock identification

Overall, she's a good professor. She'll summarize the details in the textbooks in her powerpoints. Her exams are multiple choice, but tricky though. She'll give you a review sheet with all the terms and concepts to go over, but I highly recommend you to go during her office hours and work on the review in case you have any confusion.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She was one of the MOST helpful teachers at TCU that i've ever had. Very kind and will help you if you seek for the help, hard class and a lot of studying. did not open the book once but make sure you know power points front & back

She is a great teacher. I learned a lot from her. She is from England, but is not difficult to understand. She puts her slides on eCollege, and is willing to help you with anything you need. I will recommend her for anyone who is willing to put in a little effort, if you do, you will get an A.

SO HARD! Attendance isn't mandatory and all of the powerpoints are online but she throws in the occasional pop quiz every now and then to make sure you come.  Studying for the final is near impossible.  Dr. Mayne is really nice but doesn't seem to remember this is just an intro class.
I miss you dad.

Dr. Rhodes is an incredible guy and really does care about his students. However, his grading criteria is very unclear. It is quite confusing how to succeed in this class, because you can't really study for the tests because they are open book essay. I love him as a person, but wouldn't take a class from him again.

Rhodes doesn't believe in using powerpoints or D2L. All of your assignments are emailed to you and you have to keep track of your own grade. There are only 4 tests and the final is worth 40% of your grade. For hw, you read and analyze court cases and then he cold-calls to recite cases in class. Tests are all essays. It sucked.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Rhodes is one of the two best professors I have had at TCU. He will make you think critically . By no means is his class easy, and you have to read the case studies he provides, but if you pay attention and attend class, you will learn a ton. His lectures are very detailed and organized. He is helpful outside of class and full of wisdom.
I absolutely love taking his class! He has great lectures and when I had questions about my grades he sat down with me and talked me through it. I would 10/10 recommend this instructor.

Rhodes makes the class come to life and does a fantastic job of getting people engaged in class. He truly makes law easy to understand and cares about his students. He also respects your pocket book by not making you buy a textbook and just sending you articles/cases to read. I would take him again in a heart beat if it fits into my schedule.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Rhodes is the cutest man ever and genuinely cares about students learning. His class is hard but he makes his grading criteria very clear and so students are fully aware of what is expected of them to do well. This class is so interesting and he truly is the embodiment of actual learning rather than just memorization.

Classes B law & adv legal problems taken in'80s. 30 years later I am still using what I learned. Great teacher. I have a daughter at Clemson majoring in Mkting and I wish she could experience what I did in Rhodes class. 8 AM has never looked better. The material taught is as relevant today as it was then. Can't say that about many things in col
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Rhodes is the best professor I've had so far in TCU. I would take his class 10 times again if I could. He gives amazing lectures, really funny and is really straight forward when grading. It's a really interesting class and he literally tells you what he wants you to write on the tests. Go to class, pay attention and get an A!

Dr. Rhodes' class is one of my most memorable classes in my undergraduate education. He is incredibly knowledgeable and wants to teach his students how to think critically, not just about law but about life. His class is truly incredible and worth a hit to your GPA.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Rhodes is my favorite teacher I've had at TCU. It was a definitely a hard class but I don't even care that I didn't get an A because I learned so much and he truly wants you to learn and ask for help. Your grade will partially reflect how much effort you put into the class, and he definitely cushions it a lot from your actual test scores. TAKE HIM!

Probably one of the best, if not the best, teachers in the business school. There's a reason he's been teaching at TCU for over 30 years. He loves what he does and his students love him too. Lecture heavy class so prepare to take notes. He cares about each student's success and it shows with the passion and enthusiasm he exhibits during  each class
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Rhodes doesn't use PowerPoints or textbooks, and it's wonderful. He tells you exactly what you need to know for the tests. He's testing understanding instead of memorization. You still have to participate and do the work to get a great grade, but he's fun, emphatic, to-the-point, and easy to work with.

Very enjoyable class. He is engaging and energetic every class period. No book, but you study cases, which is how a law class should go. He calls on students randomnly and expects them to be ready. If not, points are taken off. Tests aren't easy, but they are open note and first two are group efforts. Got a low A.
potentially the best prof ive ever had at TCU i wasnt planning on going to law school and he has helped me plan my whole way! He's really passionate about what he does, super inspiring!

Very loud and active professor. Class is interesting and never lasts the full three hours. VERY VERY HARD TESTS!!! I went to every class and took very detailed notes and got a B in the class. But I learned a lot and had a great time in that class.

Energetic and loud. Keeps class interesting with his teaching methods. Lets you bring outlines for the tests. First two are group efforts, last two are individual ones. Always answered emails in a timely manner. Doesn't take attendance, but if you show up, be prepared or he might call on you and take points off for being "unprepared."

Business Law:  Genuinely nice person, tended to shout in class due to excitement.  Had a definite grading and interactive preference for people who went with him on his Germany trip.  I kept a 15 page outline, attended every class, asked frequent questions, got a "B".  Set-up an apt. for 5:45 PM on night, he arrived at 6:05 PM and told me to hurry.

Great Professor!  Not so sure if I will use this information in the business world.  However, I think I am more knowledgable about law from a personal perspective now that I was previously.  This professor loves to teach and actually uses our time in each class to the maximum.

Dr. Rhodes is a very engaging, energetic professor. He can get loud when lecturing, but he comes to every class with a positive attitude. You can tell he loves to teach. No textbook! Do your homework, because he will call on you and if you don't know the answer, you will get points off (like a Law school class!) The tests are open note.

Excellent class- I learned so much!  Also, Dr. Rhodes will help you with any material you did not understand and he always checks his e-mail.  You have to come prepared every day, but you can use one pass day and he will not call on you that whole class.

Great professor. Nice guy. Class was great, but I'm not sure how useful it will be. If you want to suceed in his classes figure out how to make logical sense of his materials. It's all if X then Y type stuff. If logic isn't your thing, find someone, or go to him, and have them help you. I got an A, but never read the cases.
Very engaging presentation and teaching. Great quality. I learned a lot. Very hard tests.

i LOVED this class. Rhodes is the best teacher i've had. He teaches without a book, you only read cases and the tests are analysis' of cases instead of multiple choice stuff. I learned so much in his class, I would recommend him to ANYONE!!! loved it.

Very interesting class.  You will learn more in this class than any other class you take during the same semester.  Go to class because you won't understand your friends notes.  Write down EVERY example he gives during his lectures. It will help you when it comes time for the tests. First 2 tests are a group effort...pick smart people.
Great class, you'll learn a lot, the tests are all essays analyzing law cases, don't have to go to class but if you don't go and get the notes you'll fail

He is the most amazing professor I have ever had.  I took him for 3 MBA classes...2 of which were international.  You do have to prepare and show up, but it is very worth it.  He makes it interesting and I highly recommend taking his course.

Whoever is giving this professor bad reviews probably got a poor grade that they deserved due to lazyness. Rhodes is an amazing professor. Energetic, enthusiastic, smart, clear and helpful. Not to mention Neeley School of Business professor of the year multiple times. I loved this class. Open note tests.

Anyone that rates this professor poorly is an absolute MORON. Out of the 48 hours required in the MBA program this class was by far my favorite. Dr. Rhodes is energetic, caring, and most of all an expert in his subject matter. I would highly recommend this class, along with the two international trips that he supervises.

He is an amazing teacher.  Just read the cases and you will be fine in class. His lectures are interesting and the notes he writes on the board are exactly what you make your outline out of.  He's willing to help if you ask him, I made a B and I didn't even go to class all the time.
seriously this guy does suck. his classes are interesting but have no clue what he wants in his test.ull prob get an F even if you study a lot.

Teacher is aweful.  You read cases before class and he calls on you.  If you dont know it four points off you final grade.  Exams are essays where you fail misserably.  I dont know what people are talking about he must have changed his course.  If you want an F take him

He may be the best teacher I have had at TCU.  He is very enthusiastic and into class.  I have a tendency to fall asleep in classes and his style kept me awake.  His tests aren't exactly easy, but he basically refuses to give people bad grades.  If you read the cases, come to class, and take notes there is almost no way you won't make a B.

Badass teacher! Take notes (which are easy and clear). read ur court case every day for class which takes like 5 min. The grades are all tests. 3 tests are group, 2 are individual.All worth 20 pts each.The group are take home.Soo much easier than all the other ones. Trust me take this class! idk what anyody says just take it! final is NOT cumlative
Great prof, really knows his stuff and how to articulate it. Great if you prefer analytical/essay over objective testing.
Way overrated...  enthusiasm and hyperactivity can only get you so far.
What's all the hype?
Best professor I've ever had, undergrad or MBA.  Very fun, energetic, and best of all he keeps this boring subject interesting!!  Read the cases before class or you might be called out.

goes out for smokes more than teaches.  a "fun" teacher, but about as useful as watching Judge Judy.  only covers a few areas, because he keeps going over and over the same things (but often with contridictions).  doesn't lack for energy, but at the cost of TCU, the joke in the end is on you when you actually try to use the limited amount tought
Probably the best professor in the MBA program.  Smart, enthusiastic, helpful.
Pretty hyperactive and loud, but such a good professor. Very cool too, as he was in a rock band and also has one of the nicest cars on the TCU campus.
Loves law, so if you liked that you'll like the class.

One of those teachers I hated, but have grown to appreciate. He really makes the law interesting.  You have to come to class, otherwise you will be lost b/c there is no book.  Read the cases, or he will call you out and make you look like a fool. Take great notes, make good outlines.
Has won Neeley Professor of the year award multiple times... enough said. Amazing professor.

This guy made me fall in love with law. I now am studying for the LSAT next semester and plan on Law school after TCU. Amazing teacher with lots of enthusiasm and passion. You can tell he loves his job.
AWESOME guy! i love this class! he is so passionate and so easy to understand. i love reading real cases too, he makes it very easy to get what he's talking about. take him!!
Great class...love that guy, he's the best!
He is the best teacher ever - if you have to take BLaw, take Rhodes, if you don't, take it and take Rhodes.

One of the best teachers I've had in college. The man really cares about what he teaches and he wants you to learn it too. Tests are all essay (as every law class should be). Go to class, take notes, do good outlines for the test and you'll do fine.
He is wonderful!  Very passionate about what he does and he makes class interesting.  I definitly recomend this class.

Very interesting course.   No textbook, no tedious homework assignments...Just case reading and reciting in class.   Tests are open note, goto class and write down everything he says then just analyze the information on exams.
awesome teacher!  really enjoys the subject.  He is a bit loud sometimes but really makes class interesting.  No textbook.  Go to class, make a good outline and you will do well.
This is the B-law Rhodes, not accounting Rhodes. Great guy, great class, you learn a ton.
gives out problem solutions and old exams. study the solutions (go through them several times) and work the old exams. study. you're ready to get an A.
No Comments
Excellent teacher who is passionate about what he teaches. Open note tests and little homework are also pluses.
Pay attention and a llittle studying will get you an A
great class! I really enjoyed it.
excellent lectures, no excessive outside work, open notes tests
Awesome class, you don't mind an 8 o'clock class with him

She's hot because of her wiseness and intelligence. You will learn tremendously!! I took survey class and was super addicted to her class! It's because I love philosophy and all those deep meaning stuffs. I made a A+ for this class.

She is very fun and lovely in lab. I also had her in survey. I didnt like her quite as much in survey. She is not very clear. Her test are not from the book and not from anywhere. English being a second language for me, it was very hard for me to understand her test. She takes forever to grade the paper and the grading is not fair
She does go off on long tangents but she's very funny and has a great attitude towards life. She curves grades on the tests!

She's a funny one, super friendly and is always willing to help if you're confused. She does go off on long tangents, but has funny personal stories. Rough to understand for lectures, but amazing in the clinical or lab setting. She's a great person!
Always very unclear! You never know whats going to be on test, material is super easy but there is no organization! Papers take over a month to be graded. Overall very frustrating class

Keen is really nice and funny but like the previous ratings said, its really difficult to know what your suppose to put down in your notes and study. While going over tests she will drop questions if people find it difficult, so tell her if you didn't understand! It will help your grade

She's really funny and super nice, but her lectures were rarely on topic.  I was always confused about what to write down, and the test questions came out of nowhere. However, she usually would end up dropping some test questions for a curve. The class is reqd for nursing majors, and from what i hear she's better than Allander.
super easy! i never studied and made an a. random lectures and goes on many tangents, but overall very interesting. would definately reccommend!!

She's great! I really, really recomend taking survey of nursing with her. In the beginning I sometimes got confused on what she was talking about, but as the year went on I really got it and she was an educational and easy class.I feel like I really learned a lot in her class and I didn't have to nearly have a heart attack doing it. Great times.
No Comments

Couldn't get her stuff together at first, but definitiely improved.  I did well because I ignored her confusing lectures and taught myself from the book.  Very understanding that students have a life.  Curves tests a lot and is a fair grader. Very wonderful lady who is very personable and easy to talk to.  Ask her questions if you're confused.

I love Dr. Keen!!! She is the one of the best teachers I have had so far. She is very understanding with grading and understands that this is not the only class that you are taking. Take her! You learn a lot without all the added stress because she usually curves (c:
She is the most awesome human and professor. I am her biggest fan.

SHE IS AWESOME! I came into this class nervous because I have never been artistic, and she does such a great job of teaching us how to draw. Everytime I go to class I am impressed with how much I have learned. This class requires a lot of work outside of class but it ends up being so worth it because you really do learn so much and it is rewarding

Rima is a really good person but sometimes she would provide feedback in a backhanded way. The final project took about 3 months and a lot of the homework assignments that were done in between were not needed.

This class is tougher than it seems and demands a lot of time in and outside of class. Attendance is a MUST, as the professor covers new material each session and doesn't pause for absences. Make the most of class time; she's very helpful IF you're present. Overall, it's a great class with a supportive teacher—just harder than expected.
Rima is seriously so awesome. She helps so much with drawings and is very understanding. There is a lot of work and the final is time consuming, but Rima is very chill with grading.
Seriously one of the best teachers ever. Such a nice person and gives clear directions. Attendance isn't necessary but its an easy class to go and just participate and work with her.

This course is time consuming and mind numbing, but Rima is lenient. The drawings and final project takes a ridiculous amount of time, but everyone I know got an A on the final project even though it is awful. Take Rima for this course though because she normally lets everyone out a little early and tries to make it fun!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: All her good reviews are from before 2017 so Im not sure what she changed. there are just nicer professors who understand most kids taking calc are in neeley and don't need to memorize long long formulas but rather the concepts. Stay away or take at a comm college.
I finished with a C- last semester and she wouldn't round 0.4 to a C. Extremely tough class

makes lots of errors in notes so calculate along with her. She is very nice I will say that. Calc is just such a BS class for Neeley kids. The formulas are actually ridiculously long and you have to memorize them. She wasn't great and my friends had easy A teachers that allowed cheat sheet on tests so yeah pass on her if u can. She is very nice tho
Some of the concepts can be difficult to understand, but the notes are online, which is great. You're only required to show up for quizzes and tests.
The tests were graded hard and you could miss a lot of points for little things.

the final was worth 33% of my grade. had an A all semester never missed class but she wouldn't found my B+ to an A-. she goes through examples and notes in class. class problems always seemed a lot easier than what would come up on homework. she did give reviews. makes lots of errors in notes so calculate along with her. nice and quirky professor.

Grading:17% for 3 exams (doesnt offer points back or extra credit), 33% for the long long final. 8% free points homework, 8% IN PERSON quizzes that should be free points but its so easy to get points taken off because you do that given HW the night or day before so its still hard. Hard class but ik profs who allow lowest test drop, EC, online quizs

Dr. Hatcher's lectures are clear. However, the class is mainly graded by the exams. Her final was nothing like anything we had ever seen before and it dropped several peoples' grades. Just frustrating when you leave an exam feeling confident then you can't even go back and see what you did wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: worst calc teacher at TCU stay away
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hatcher is a sweet lady, will meet with you whenever wants to see you succeed BUT there are better calc options. Calc is hard but just ask around and you'll find better professors. Recommend taking it at a community college or another 4 year school online if possible.

Hatcher reads straight out of the textbook and is very spaced out for the majority of every lecture which is what every class consists of. Very boring and does not offer good feedback but is fair with her grading. Easy 100% on homework but if you understand it you will actually do well on tests.

she is one of the greatest professors ever!!! made me realize my love of math & helped me switch to a BS in mathematics! kind of talks fast, but she's super funny & loves class participation. show up, say the right answer, and you'r golden. she gives a couple of examples of the work you're doing -- hint: these are similar to the ones on the exams

Elementary stats is super easy and straightforward! Definitely take her!! She is a bit jumpy and may go fast sometimes, but the content is not hard so it's fine. Average of only one online 30 min hw assignment a week. One quiz a week (2 questions). 3 tests during semester (questions look just like in-class notes). Gives formulas. Cumulative final.

Dr. Hatcher was one of the best professors I've ever had! Her class wasn't too easy nor overwhelmingly difficult, if you studied adequately and did the homework exams were a breeze. Made the topic of discrete mathematics very accessible. Would gladly take again for another course.

Would only recommend for Stats. For linear, the only students who got A's were those who are very theoretical-brained (they like Proofs and Real Analysis). She graded very harshly, and did take off up to 7% of a test grade for a single missed negative. She is very scattered and often forgot what material we were covering that day.

Hatcher is a very smart professor and is knowledgeable about all math. The lectures were a little scattered and there was homework pretty much every day. The tests were graded hard and you could miss a lot of points for little things. Beware of proofs

The quizzes and homework will be pretty easy but if you don't study for the tests you will fail. She makes lots of mistakes while teaching. I don't know if she doesn't care about kids passing or what but she will not curve/give extra credit. I was a point away from a C- which I need to advance. She wouldn't round my grade up. DO NOT TAKE.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: From reading some of the other reviews, it is clear to me that Dr. Hatcher is a good stats professor, but I would not recommend her for Calc 2. She is very scatterbrained with her lectures and since Calc 2 has difficult material it is hard to follow when she jumps all over the place. She only gives 3 tests and manageable amounts of HW
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Dr. Hatcher is super nice! She does a great job of explaining stats, which is already pretty easy. The tests are very fair and her examples in class are pretty similar to the tests. The only problem I have with her is that she started to speed through her lectures at the end of the year to the point that it was kind of stressful.

During class Dr. Hatcher goes through exams that are very similar to the tests and quizzes. There were 3 tests, 11 pop quizzes, online homework every class, and a final. She is not that great at answering questions during class, but she had lots of office hours. I would definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Really great math teacher in how she explains things. When learning new concepts she walks you through every step. But for that reason, you should show up to every class and take notes. Small amounts of homework due each class. Definitely would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's a sweet lady and this class is very very easy. The lectures can be a bit all-over-the-place, but generally make sense. The tests are pretty simple. I wouldn't recommend skipping every class, but you can definitely miss a bunch and still be okay.

Dr. Hatcher is awesome! TAKE HER!! She is clear and caring and her class ROCKS! It's pretty easy if you come to lecture. There's no textbook so you do need to come to class. I had her for Elem Stats nd would HIGHLY recommend. She gives a quiz once a week but they are short, from the HW, and resemble the exam. She also happens to be great at math...
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She provides a great blend of theory/explanations and examples, which makes learning from her pretty easy. Tests are essentially the same as the examples she provides and the homework. Not at all as hard as I expected the upper-level statistics class to be.

Dr. Hatcher is a great professor! At first the class is easy/slow but it definitely gets tricky as the semester goes on. Gives great explanations. There is nightly homework but it never took too long. Her "pop" quizzes can usually be expected. Also she bumped my grade at the end of the semester which was much appreciated.
Dr. Hatcher is always willing to reexplain her lessons if you don't understand them. Do the homework!

Dr. Hatcher is a great professor! Calc 2 is tough but she organized the material well and explained it well. Tests are medium-hard. If you get an A on the final you get an A in the class. Be careful because the final is tough and she puts some tricky questions on there. I would totally take another class with her!

I enjoyed her class a lot because she is extremely helpful and goes over most questions people have on the homework before class. She is a fair grader and gives partial credit on tests. The tests are not too hard. Study, do all homework assignments, and practice problems before the tests.

Acted like she was teaching kindergarteners college level curriculum, so she went over the same things over and over again. It was easy material, and she babied us making it even easier. Homework every night (takes 10 minutes), pop quizzes to take attendance, and a few (short and easy) tests. The easiest A you can get from the math department

I ended up going back to Dallas to my old calculus teacher for help because I just could NOT understand her. I got a 5 on my AP exam in Calculus AB so math isn't something I'm afraid of! She makes a lot of mistakes and is all over the place; homework will prepare you for tests though! I'd recommend looking over the material before class too.

I had a great experience in Dr. Hatcher's class!  She is fun and helpful in and out of class.  She's a fair grader and understanding of students who have extracurricular conflicts.  Great for verbal learners- others had trouble with her teaching style though.  Watch out for the final!  It drops most everyone a half letter grade.

The professor is extremely excellent. She is very clear and always willing to help. Though the tests are not extremely easy, you will do really well if you do your homework and study (unless you are just a genius).
Hatcher was so nice and easy going. I've never actually enjoyed math classes. I HIGHLY recommend taking her. If you do the homework and pay attention this class is an easy A.

Amazing teacher!   She is very nice and funny, and I really enjoyed taking her class.  She will work with you on missed home works and test rescheduling.  Make sure you study and practice and you'll do fine!
Hatchers class is pretty easy. Show up, do homework, and tests are not hard.
OMG, this prof rocks. I hate math but I had a great overall experience in her class. She is very specific on what she wants and more than willing to help out. TAKE THIS CLASS!!!

Discrete 1 & 2: (our discrete 2 class is amazing!) I love Dr. Hatcher. She's definitely my favorite prof at TCU. Great sense of humor, always in conversation with her, clear lectures, fair tests (but be careful--each question is worth a lot of points!), and always a fun class. Gotta love Math For Spies!

I don't if it was the teacher or the course material but I hated this class. Granted calculus is a pain, I still felt she was not at all focused on teaching and more so on her job with the NCAA. Everything seemed okay until the last test and final where my grade plunged from a high A to a B. She's nice but very scatter-brained. Did NOT enjoy...
Just go to class, take exact notes, she is brilliant and you will totally get statistics! If you are a social science major this professor is for you!
Awesome teacher. I have been bad at math my whole life, I mean I've really struggled...then I got into her class and came out with an A, go figure. Take her class!!

I had Dr. Hatcher for Discrete I and II.  Probably the most down to early professor in the Math dept.  She concentrates on the most interesting and relevent topics.  If you go to class, take notes, try the homework (she'll go over any questions), and study maybe an hour before the tests an A is definitely doable.

Nice teacher who will try her best to help you with any questions you have! May seem to be a little scatter brained at times but she usually corrects her mistakes quickly, be sure to write your notes in pencil and carry an eraser.

She does not expect anyone to have a PhD from Harvard (although she does) to excel in her class. In fact, she wants people who have generally feared math to find an interest in it, without the added pressure of a "math" class. I am a math major so not in that category, but I want to someday teach math and she is my inspiration. Dr. Hatcher ROCKS!

Dr. Hatcher is a good teacher, but a bit ditzy. She is easy to get in touch with and eager to help her students. If you show up to class, she'll do anything she can to help you out. Overall, she is a good professor and knows her stuff.
She is a genuinely nice person. She usually spends the first 10-20 minutes of class reviewing last night's homework. May appear a little ditzy, but is in fact very smart and courteous.
I am not good with numbers, but Hatcher's class is very easy for me to understand.  Very clear and concise.  Short, straightforward exams.  Highly recommend her.
This class was easy at the start but the Professor is all over the place all the time! She knows the material just not how to teach it. Find another class.

She is so nice and helpful; she goes out of her way to help you if you need it. Tests not too bad. Do your homework!! If you are going to take a math class, take this one. You won't find a nicer teacher or easier math course at TCU
Anyone at TCU should take her once. She is an amazing teacher and you will take with you not just learning math but a respect from a  teacher that you will never forget.

This i the best teacher I have had so far! She explains things very well and she makes sure you have an understanding of the material. Tests are a little tricky but if you review the homework problems you will be fine.Its easy to get a B, and possible to get an A.

I was very concerned going into this class but she is so helpful that she really reduced my anxiety.  You have to keep up with the homework but can get a good grade if you do the work. I highly recommend her for anyone.  Excellent teacher with a very caring attitude.
Great prof.  If you don't like math and have to get a math credit take her.  Very helpful and gives easy tests.  Easy A.
Excellent teacher, the work would be difficult if she wasnt so good at explaining it.  Prepares you for test and very kind person.
I thought she was a good teacher; not hard.  To get an A on the tests, just practice the problems she gives you and know how you did them.  Tests aren't really that hard either.
Very easy teacher. If you want an easy A take her. You also learn it well
Very nice teacher and very helpful too. If you go to class and do homework, should be an easy A
Very nice person! Her tests are extremely hard and require a lot of studying... But she goes over any homework problem before you turn it in. And is always willing to help outside of class.
Very easy class because of Dr. Hatcher. She is so nice and knows how to teach effectively.  Difficult concepts don't seem too bad, and she answers questions on hmwk before you turn it in.
She is easy going, fun, and makes things very clear.

absolutely loved her! she's incredibly nice, even to the dumbest football player, willing to help, kind of flakey though.  In HHIT you really get to see how much depth there is to her, very personable.

BEST dang teacher at TCU...took me from not liking math and not being very good at it to getting a B in her class.Material is very clear and easy to understand. Guaranteed A once you do the Homework....Test are pretty much same as HW
Easy A--but you do have to put forth some effort.  She's a lot of fun, and when you do have the occasional question, she's all over it.  Great professor!
She is an extremely nice lady. Entertaining as well, especially when she gets the chalk on her face and doesn't know it. I tough course for beginners though. Lots of work.
This woman is SO nice, especially with some of the MORONS that are in this grade-school level class! Very easy  A  if you have an IQ above 50.
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments
Her class is like kindergarten.  Make sure your calculator has Tetris, otherwise don't even bother going to class.
No Comments
No Comments
Excellent professor

TAKE HER!! Prof. Rice is awesome! Attendence is not required, but I would definetly advise going to class. She is interesting and very invested in her students as well as very knowledgeable. She has written several books, and enjoys keeping class engaged. Many classes are discussions that have optional participation but she is awesome! Love her.

While attendance isn't mandatory I highly suggest attending class. Her lectures are interesting and she likes to get the class involved. She's extremely understanding, personable and funny. By far the best professor I've had yet, take her class you won't regret it.
Best teacher at this school. Will make any other teacher look mid. She is such a understanding and good person and classes are very fun.
Seriously the most caring professor ever. Responds to emails very quickly and offers really easy extra credit (not that you will need it). Loved this class you should take it.

She is new and genuinely one of the sweetest professors I've ever had. Attendance isn't mandatory, but honestly, going to class was actually really interesting because her lectures are fun and engaging. You can tell she truly loves interacting with her students and is just genuinely happy to be there, which makes the class environment so welcoming.

If you need a sociology core credit, TAKE HER! Only assignments were 3 papers & a podcast, one of the papers being the final exam/assignment. Class is actually pretty interesting + attendance isn't mandatory but encouraged/helpful if you want to succeed. She is so nice, easy to talk to, and genuinely wants to help her students.

Dr. D'Souza is a great professor. For EOR, he is very transparent and truly cares about everyone's ideas and what they mean to you personally. Class is mainly presentations, no exams or quizzes. He gives great feedback on everyone's work, would reccomend him for anything!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very cool professor with a lot of really cool connections, and he is happy to share them with you. If you take advantage of his wealth of knowledge, he can really help you out. I wouldn't say he is a "professor" in practical terms, but more of a mentor/resource for his students. No attendance, but you should show up and get to know him.

If you want an easy class, go for it. I would not spend my money on this class. You get placed in a mediocre internship and learn very little. They sell it to you as a great opportunity, but not worth it in my opinion. Most of my classmates think the same. The professor is ok, but the class not so much. I do not recommend this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. D'Souza is inspiring and really cares about who you become. He's very resourceful and accessible if you need help with anything related just ask him and he will surely help you. The Internship class pairs you with start-ups to intern for them, paid through a scholarship. If you have any issues with the company just tell him too, he'll help!
Take his courses if you can; he is the best in the CS department at TCU. Awesome lectures,
Best professor to take a database course in TCU. Take his classes if you can, he is the best in the department,

Always gave bonus points on exams (even on the final exam), usually up to 10. Questions aren't hard, just tricky. Always took time to explain concepts deeply. Don't be afraid to talk to him, as he will recognize the effort you put into the class. Literally the best professor ever to take for intro to programming!

He is very organized and caring. The lectures were amazing. Hearing from the other students' experiences, he is by far the best CS professor at TCU. I would take him again, but unfortunately, he is not teaching the techniques course next semester.

I realized I didn't want to be a data science major anymore, so I gave up halfway through, but he was truly a great professor and explained things really well. Easy class structure and easy to follow along. Takes attendance throughout the semester, but gives a 100 on it at the end if everyone completes the spot survey. Quizzes can be hard.
Came in with zero programming experience and still loved the class. He explains things clearly and makes learning fun.
Hands down the best CS professor at TCU. Explains everything clearly, cares about students, and makes databases actually enjoyable.
One of the best professors I've had. Explains databases clearly, cares about students, and makes even hard topics feel easy. Passionate, organized, and always willing to help. Truly outstanding!

took him for intro to programming, if you can take him, DO IT!!!!!!!!! he is a great professor and made this course a breeze. super beginner friendly and posted all of the slideshows we reviewed in class. labs and hw is not super difficult (if you pay attention), same with tests if you use the slides. overall would 100% take this professor again.
BEST PROFESSOR. PLEASE MAKE HIM THE CHAIR. He's very knowledgable, very caring, respectful and considerate, one of the best professors I've taken at TCU.
He is an excellent teacher who explains concepts clearly and makes the class engaging and informative. Their dedication to student success and approachable nature truly stand out.
Kind hearted and genuinely caring professor. Very easy grading and easy exams with proper reviews!
Best professor you can ever have at TCU. Really interactive and he loves what he teaches!!

This is a tough class. Homework (30% of your grade) took me hours every week. Exams had a tricky problem, but doable if you put in the work and make sure you fully understand the content. No one should have to go through Real Analysis, but if you do, Russell is not the worst choice.

The best Math teacher I ever met. He's actually so chill and nice during lecture. On exams, it's mostly problems from homeworks and review sheets that you can expect to see on the exams. 10/10 definitely take for Diff Eq

Definitely my fav class of the semester- Russell is very kind, offers extra credit through attendance, posts practice exams that are similar to actual exams (& goes over them during class), allows a notecard for each exam. 10/10 I love Russell he's so pookie and silly. OH also he drops an exam! So overall not a difficult class to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Take Dr Russell. He is a really nice grader and enthusiastic mathematician. There are only 3 exams and though Discrete Mathematics is a tough class, he makes it way more accessible to average students. Good professor!
