Great teacher to take, I would take him again in a heartbeat. He only has two exams and a final so the class is kinda exam heavy. However he gives practice exams that are super similar in length and style of the real exam. He is also very fair if you go to office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Russel is a nice guy. His lectures are a bit boring and move slowly but he lets you use a notecard for each exam and is a nice grader. The website for hw is a bit of a pain but it does give you multiple re-trys and he is helpful if you go to him with a question about it.

He is a great professor. Lectures are interactive and you do practice problems which help. You're allowed a notecard for the exams. He is sweet and helpful if you have questions. Exams aren't super difficult if you put in the effort and pay attention. He drops lowest exam grade. The website he uses for HW can be annoying but he helps if you ask.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was super helpful and very supportive throughout the whole group project. I wish the midterm and final related to what we actually talked about in class rather than it being on the textbook. She is really great and I would take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I thought that Dr. Daniels was really helpful and wants you to succeed. It is important to have a good group for a semester long project. She is always wants to help so its important to reach out to her for questions on the project. The only annoying thing is the tests are over the book that we do not talk about in class and read on our own.

She is extremely caring. The semester-long group project can be a pain but if you work with her I promise it becomes so much easier. She will point you in the right direction of what she wants. She is super accessible outside of class. The midterm and the final are difficult but as long as you make an effort to read the textbook it is doable.

Very tough grader on group project that runs the entire semester, if you don't get a good group you'll have a terrible grade. Midterm and final exam are difficult and cover lecture material, textbook, and Excel. For the final you also have a lot of work to do for group project. Overall just a ton of work, and difficult exams

She is not nearly as bad as the other ratings say. She really cares for her students and does her best for you to succeed in her class. The tests are textbook-heavy, and there is an Excel portion, but she gives a mock test for you to practice. There's no homework except working on the project, which, if you have a good group, it's an easy A.

Take any other teacher for this course. I have never had a teacher like her in my life. I will never take her again. She gave my group such low grades because we didn't meet with her before turning in. Her tests are absolutely absurdly hard. AVOID HER!

go the her office hours, she will walk you through everything. test is highly specific and overly involved with the textbook which we barely go over in class but you are expected to be reading. She does give a study guide which you should follow. We get an excel prep which is almost the same as the actual exam so that's good. Try and you'll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: this was the most annoying and hard class for no reason. she made us read 16 chapters of the textbook by the time when had to take the midterm. she is such a hard grader and will nitpick little things and give you points off. she makes the midterm and final unnecessarily hard asking you specific questions from portions of the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Missing one class can significantly impact your participation grade, as I experienced with a 12-point drop. The instructor offers little to no preparation for the midterm and has yet to assist with final exam prep. Be ready to dedicate substantial time to a demanding semester-long group project that requires extensive work and collaboration.

Dr. Daniels is a nice lady but is extremely nitpicky over a lot of things. She treats students like kindergarteners sometimes. Honestly the class concepts overall were not challenging, but it was a pain to sit through and the workload is very heavy regarding the project.

Missing one class can significantly impact your participation grade, as I experienced with a 12-point drop. The instructor offers little to no preparation for the midterm and has yet to assist with final exam prep. Be ready to dedicate substantial time to a demanding semester-long group project that requires extensive work and collaboration.

The class is based on a project for the whole semester, and it is in groups. She is not a hard grader, but her projects take a lot of time and effort. There is also a midterm and final. She uses iClicker to track your attendance.

Professor Mack is such a great teacher! He uses his own personal professional experiences to teach his lectures. I think he has really prepared me for my future through his teaching, more than any professor I have taken. He can be a tough grader, but it really is for you to learn and become better, and it really has helped me be a stronger writer.

Mack is one of the most, or the most, influential teachers that I have ever had. I genuinely think that I have learned more in this class than any other class at TCU. I would 100% recommend him to my classmates. Attendance does matter and there is a no technology policy, but if you are willing to listen you will learn a lot. Amazing profesor.

I loved Mack, but do not take him if you have to miss class from time to time. He is very strict on attendance and doesn't really realize that students have a life outside of his class. Besides that, he is very passionate and you learn a lot from him. he tells you exactly what u need to do to succeed, you just have to hold yourself to it.

BEST PROFESSOR IVE HAD AT TCU. You will learn so much from him. You will get a good grade if you listen to what he wants in every paper. He is very knowledgeable about communications and will tell you real-life stories.

Professor Mack is one of the best professors I have had at TCU. LISTEN TO HIS GRADING CRITERIA! He gives you all of the tools needed to succeed in his class, you just have to use them! He is always available for help outside of class as well! Take his class and I promise you will come out with more knowledge and increased writing skills!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Mack is one of the best professors I have had the privilege of having at TCU! LISTEN TO HIS GRADING CRITERIA! He gives you all the tools you need to succeed in his class... you just have to use them. He is always available to help outside class too and will give you extra pointers to succeed!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Gives great feedback and tells a lot of stories.

Professor Mack is a great professor! If you want to develop your writing skills and become an overall better writer take Mack. He's a tough grader but provides clear guidelines and gives you ample time to complete each paper.

Professor Mack is awesome. He is the kind of guy who makes you feel proud to be going into the PR and marketing field. Applies a ton of his real-world experience to class and is incredibly knowledgeable. Not to mention so kind, interesting, and understanding. Take him! I loved this class with him, it felt super easy. Not too many assignments.

Professor Mack is the best. Truly the best professor I have had a TCU. He gives great feedback and is always willing to help. It can be a challenging class but you really learn and take away a lot. Professor Mack has a lot of cool experience in the Strat Comm field and always tells stories about his past jobs.

Mack is a tough grader, but its because he actually cares for your success. He is super accessible outside of the classroom and will give you every opportunity to succeed. This class is a requirement for STCO, so if you want to truly learn a lot and have a good experience take Writing and Editing with Mack!
the best Professor that ever walked this earth. Tough grader but you learn a lot.
Professor Mack is a wonderful teacher but has very specific guidelines when it comes to papers and assignments. As long as you participate and work hard you'll do great in this class.

Professor Mack is my favorite professor here at TCU. He truly cares about his students and wants to see them succeed, therefore; the amount of difficulty is completely worth it. I know there is an easier professor for this class but if you have the chance, taking it with Professor Mack will help you so much more in the long run.

Professor Mack is articulate and respectable. His assignments are relevant to the public relations industry and he offers great feedback. I reached out to him for career advice and he was very helpful. He is a great person!

Professor Mack is by far my favorite at TCU. He is so knowledgeable about PR and has such an interesting background! I took him for writing and editing & strategic writing and genuinely learned so much. The bulk of the class is writing assignments of course, but he gives a lot of time & hands out examples in class so they aren't bad! TAKE HIM!!!

This guy is awesome. Has the coolest career background. He incorporates real-life situations into his class which helps make it feel like you actually need the content in the future. He is a great teacher and cares about your success.

Prof Mack is the best professor I've ever had at TCU. He has amazing real world experience that he shared with us that really made the class come to life. He's so kind and genuinely cares about all of his students. He makes himself available and encourages you to ask questions. In my time at TCU, I've learned the most in his class. TAKE HIM!!

I love this man. He is an excellent professor. While there was a fair amount of work, it definitely wasnt overwhelming. You knew what was coming way in advance. He really prepared me well for the papers. The hardest things are the quizzes. I advise actually reading and taking notes when theres a quiz over a section. He knows what hes talking abt

MY FAVORITE PROFESSOR AND CLASS! I genuinely looked forward to this class every time because it was so interesting. Professor Mack always tells stories and bases his class work on his real-life experiences. I liked him so much I decided to take a more advanced writing class with him in the future. He is a tough-grader but you learn a lot

LOVE PROFESSOR MACK!!! He's by far one of my favorite teachers ever. He has a TON of amazing stories from his previous jobs in communication. You can tell he really cares about getting to know and help his students. Please take him if you have the chance. He's not the easiest grader but I know my skills are improving and that I'm learning so much.

Mack is one of the best professors that I've taken at TCU. While the class isn't easy, he's not an extremely harsh grader. If you go into his office, it will help your grade. I've learned so much from his class!
The best professor I've ever taken at TCU!!! I have never learned so much about being in the world of PR from anybody else. The class was not easy but I am a better writer because of it. TAKE HIM

Professor Mack is one of my favorite teachers I have had at TCU. He cares about his students. Although he is not the easiest grader, he will work with you to make sure you understand the material. He has a ton of expertise in the area and is all around a nice guy.

Mack is a great guy who really cares about student input. He has a ton of experience in the business world and does a great job of applying it to his class. He is flexible and responsive to both student performance and feedback on how the class should be structured. His lectures were mostly powerpoints, but still interesting. Assignments manageable
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Mack has a lot of experience in his field and is very helpful. His class was so interesting and he is very understanding of a students time. He works with students outside of class and is a reasonable grader.

Professor Mack has so much experience in this field. He's the perfect professor to have for this class. You have a few papers throughout the semester and five quizzes over the readings from your textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Russell Mack is by far one of my favorite professors at TCU. He truly cares about his students and makes the material applicable to the "real world." There are weekly assignments that can seem daunting, but he gives great feedback and is always accessible outside of class. I would highly recommend taking a class with him

Russell Mack made class fun and engaging! Although there were small pop-quizzes, if you do the readings you will be fine. Each week there was one homework assignment, it's all writing - hence the name of the class, "Strategic Writing". He is a bit of a hard grader at times, but a super fun teacher. I would take the class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Inspirational--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Mrs. Thompson is the sweetest lady! Study the book and online quizzes for the tests--a lot of the questions come straight from the online quizzes. Class could get boring, but that is just the material. Mrs. Thompson does her best to incorporate different medias to make it more interesting. Easy grader on concert reports and final project. Easy A!

Incredibly easy. made an a+ w/o hardly trying, but still think I learned a lot. just show up for the weekly quizzes, study the online quizzes and an A is practically guaranteed. definitely recommend for fine arts requirement. Concert reports and final project are also easy
Daily work is a big part of your grade and if you do that it helps you study for the tests. Just use online quizzes to help you study and the tests wont be hard. Projects are relatively easy as well.

Ruth Thompson is a great teacher! She is super nice! Most of her class is just her lecturing, but sometimes she throws in some cool stuff to learn the material in other ways. There's a lot of work required and a lot of material covered, so just be prepared to work. If so, then an A is easily yours!
Really easy. Do online quizzes before quizzes and tests and you will do well. Tests are a total of 20% of grade. The rest is attendance and presentations

Dr. Thompson is such a sweet lady who will go out of her way to help you achieve! Her class can be a little tedious at times, because she mostly just reads and explains each powerpoint, but she's still great. She shows a lot of videos that help with visual interpretation. She offers a lot of extra credit, & tests aren't too bad if you study.
Great teacher, 30% is attendance, tests are based on online quizzes, the class can get very boring, but she tries her best to make it interesting. Easy A. Highly recommend this teacher.

This class is really boring but its sooo easy.  Youre basically graded to come to class.  The tests are made up of the online quizzes.  You take the online quizzes until you get 100% super easy class.  And she is a sweetheart
Very easy professor, come to class, do the assignments and you will get an A
EASY GRADE....attendance is 40%

survey of music - love this class! very easy A. class can be boring at times, but hey--it's survey of music. she does all she can to make the class exciting. videos, etc, usually lets you out a little early, easy to talk to. tests are open note, quizzes online are retakeable so you'll always get a 100%. take notes in class.

Boring class!! She reads off the powerpoint while you frantically copy her unorganized notes off the screen. Some tests are open note...generally a easy class gradewise, but lots of pointless homework and boring classes

Easy enough class, just didn't find it very interesting. She reads right off her powerpoints and you basically just copy right off those the whole class. She takes role every class, shes very nice but I would recommend taking a different Fine Arts course if possible.

Possibly the nicest grandmother figure at TCU...at the beginning you don't think you will do well but even if you bomb the three open note tests the online quizzes which you can take until you get a 100 and concert reports are automatic 96's unless you are stupid so take her!

Her class is not hard if you go to class and take notes. All test are open notes. The final we have a choice of open notes or a test off all our quiz. 3 concert reports due, and one presentation. Quizs are online and can retake untill you make a 100. If you dont make a A in the class you didnt go to class and take notes.

He is the nicest person ever. Take him for any class. The quizzes are straightforward if you attend class and listen to what he says. This was a class I looked forward to going to. He takes the time to get to know you. There is 1 paper, but it is easy. Offers extra credit and is just such a great teacher! TAKE HIM!

Richard Allen is one of the best. His film class is interesting and an enjoyable experience. He cares deeply about his students, their class success, and their personal lives (if you need it). Richard is kind, calm, and has clear passion and rich experience in the area of film.

This class is fun and easy and great if you need a fine arts credit! Allen is so funny and genuinely cares for his students. There are two tests, which are straightforward if you come to class, and two essays, essentially just movie reviews. I suggest taking this class even though a 3-hour class can feel long.

Professor Allen was a great professor. He did a great job of keeping the class interested in the movies being played. He was very funny and provided great insight on the movies. His exams are not difficult but definitely look over your notes and handouts a few times. Class is definitely a good time!
Prof Allen is great. The sweetest, most caring guy. So flexible on assignments and accommodating students.

This class was awesome. No homework outside of two big papers. Watched a movie every class and not just boring "classics" but a wide range of film genres and time periods. Professor Allen is a really nice guy and appreciates it a ton when you participate. Best way to fill FA requirement imo.

Makes class easy and entertaining if you're willing to put in the work. 2 papers and 2 multiple choice tests based on the movies you watch and in-class lectures. Would definitely recommend taking his class

Such a sweet and funny professor. He is really understanding and let me leave class early when my head was hurting. He is really passionate about film and makes learning about it entertaining. The class was very late to me but other than that he always made sure that we were comfortable. He also gave a lot of extra credit opportunities.

Mr. Allen is my favorite Professor at TCU. He genuinely wants his students to succeed and understands that students miss class (attendance is not mandatory but if you don't show it makes the exams 10x harder) His exams are over the class discussions (about the movie you watched) so just write down everything he says and you'll be good!!

Professor Allen is so nice!!! He is so sweet and has lots of knowledge of the film/tv industry. Tests are mainly over lectures and discussions about the films, so be sure to take notes. The workload is very manageable and he's accommodating if you need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Allen is awesome. His class wasn't as easy as I thought it would be, but boy did I enjoy it. He has this very funny awkward sense of humor and is so so nice. Wish he taught more film classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Mr. Allen is amazing person and he is super passionate about the subject. His lectures can be a bit confusing but if you ask him to clarify, you'll be fine. For the most part, the films screened are interesting. He doesn't take attendance but if you don't go you won't do well because so many quiz questions are from class discussion.

Professor Allen is the best. Super friendly and approachable, funny, and easily accessible outside of class. Definitely read the books before the tests, but they're only over the textbook and what he talks about in class. Pay attention and participate, and he will give you a percent extra credit. Also super fast with grading, up in less than a day.

Allen is a great professor, definitely one of the best in the FTDM department. Aesthetics was so enjoyable, and you could tell he really was passionate about what he was teaching. Weekly labs, quizzes about lectures and readings every other week, a midterm, a final, and one paper is the work, but it is very manageable. Take Allen!

Professor Allen is very witty, kind and his classes are entertaining. If you attend class, his quizzes and tests are easy. Though he doesn't grade attendance, it is hard to do well if you don't show up. I genuinely enjoyed his lectures.

Allen was an all around good teacher. He specifies exactly what will be on every exam, but he it's easy to miss things if you don't pay attention. The films we watched were (for the most part) interesting, and I learned a lot in his class. I definitely recommend taking his class, but attendance and paying attention are key.

If you want someone who will truly prepare you for the realities of the film and TV industry, take Professor Allen. He has a great personality and is easy going, but he also is quite observant and knows which students truly want to work in show biz. He'll go out of his way for those students to have them prepared. Terrific mentor and professor!

TV Aesthetics is such a great class! It is probably one of my favorite classes I have taken at TCU. Professor Allen is so funny and always makes going to class enjoyable. The grade is made up of tests and quizzes, but they are very easy if you go to class, listen to lecture and watch the films. Easy A, definitely worth taking with Professor Allen!

TCU is lucky to have him. He goes above and beyond just teaching you textbook material, but prepares you for the realities of the Film/TV industry. If you show your passion and dedication to this field by participating in labs and attending FTDM extra curricular events (which he often gives extra credit for), you will earn his respect and an A.

Allen's 'TV Studies for Non-Majors' class is one of the best at TCU! I took the class in the June-mester for Humanities credit and it was awesome. You have to go to class but all you do is watch tv shows. In between shows, he has funny anecdotes. He has won 2 Emmy's and is a great professor! Take his class if you get a chance. Usually a wait list.

Professor Allen is a great teacher. He has a great sense of humor and knows his stuff. He is an Emmy Award winning writer so listens to what he tells you if you are interested in writing. This class does have a 4hr. lab, which usually goes by quick b/c all you do is watch movies and talk about them. Take it with Allen if you can.
Mr. Allen is the best teacher ever! great personality and awesome sense of humor! The class has a four hour lab, which is long, but overall it's a great class! Valuable information!

This professor is the man. Best one in the entire department, hands down. He has a bit of a sense of humor that is able to make anyone laugh. I'm not sure what's not to like about the guy, especially because he seems to care about the students. If you don't do well, it's because you're not trying. I made an A, and you can too, with effort. Take him

My people. You are making this guy a scapegoat. Jon and Derek did not leave because of him. He can be quite helpful and welcoming. He has great credentials. And as to professors having quirks, remember, there are none without sin.

Richard Allen is one professor who is hard to read. In class he is an okay professor. He isn't terrible or terrific, but does just fine. He is an award-winning writer, so he has talent. However, he is very condesending and two-faced. He is very judging and makes verdicts about students very early in their college careers. Watch out for that.
No Comments

ignore all negative comments below.  he is the most helpful teacher in the entire radio tv film department.  for reviews for tests, he practically gives you the test.  there is nothing anti-student about him and he is a great and fun teacher.  i love all of his classes.

Be very careful with Richard Allen. As a teacher he is nothing special, not bad but certainly not great. The problem is he is the department chair of a department that is very anti-student. He is in the position to do something about this but he does not.  If you kiss up to him you will be fine, if not do not expect anything from him.
No Comments
Would be nice if he was more concerned with what would help the students rather than his personal attitudes toward them
Do not be late to his classes! He is one of the best teachers you'll ever have, though!
No Comments
the best prof i have ever had!!!  ake advantage of his knowledge while you can!
No Comments
Professor Allen needs a chili pepper!!  Greatest class ever! Labs are three and a half hours long...but it's always interesting material.

What a great teacher! He makes his class very fun and interesting. People who complain about his class are absolutely LAZY, and probably shouldn't be RTVF majors to begin with. Honestly- to make an A all you really have to do is come to class and take interest in the discussions. Mr. Allen rocks :D!
hes so crazy...its awesome. he complained about not having a chili pepper by his name so here you go allen
hes so crazy...its awesome. he complained about not having a chili pepper by his name so here you go allen

Professor Allen is so cute! Class is very easy. you have to be a dumbass to make below a B in this course. Tests are straight from class lectures so make sure you go to class everytime! but he's so funny and interesting and the material is great so you'll want to go to class!!

Great guy all around, which makes you enjoy the class. you can get an A just by going to class, readings are important, but most of the tests are on the labs and lectures. CLASS CLASS CLASS, its the only way to get an A

OK professor, he is clear on material and what is going to be on tests, etc. He also conducts himself well in front of the class with lectures, mixing humor and stories when needed. Outside of class, can sometimes be hard pressed to get help from or talk to.
Good, but a bit condescending

This man is a hero -- he takes the time to help any student who comes his way, and is full of advice that is both intuitive and highly positive. A two-time Emmy award winner, Professor Allen knows the highly competitive biz inside and out! Take it from me -- this professor is something special. :)
He's the best prof. in the department...not only is he an intelligent guy, but he's also funny.  The subjects he covers in his classes are also very interesting. Take him!

If you fail this class you didnt do any reading and are a dumbass. This class is super easy if you go to class and take notes and do the readings (do not miss though, or have a very good notetaker friend) Very helpful for me outside of class. He even let me keep him as an advisor.

He seemed cool and such in class, but he is very condesending. Outside of class he was very unhelpful and rude when I had a question about class. I don't know if he studies records or something, because he knew a lot about me that I was kind of shocked.

Allen was a really funny guy, interesting to listen too, but sometimes the material on the tests was uncovered.  Take notes and attend class and you should be okay.  He wasn't the greatest but the class was fun.
AWESOME class. Really easy and interesting. Stay for the films and take down his notes (not many) and you will get an easy A.

Great class, make sure you sign up.  Tests are easy if you pay attention to what he says and don’t fall asleep during the movies.  Make sure you stay in class when people leave for boring movies, because he would give extra credit. Easy A.

Allen is a great and funny teacher! Easy A! I skipped two weeks of class, never studied for a quiz, and still managed to make a B. But go to class because he knows you better than you think he does.  He makes learning fun and has won two Emmy's. Great teacher!!!!
Look, I don't know what your problem is, but prof. Allen ROX. You just have to get to know him and talk to him and things will be fine. Trust me on this, I KNOW!!
Stingy and closed minded, won't accept new ideas. Tests are IMPOSSIBLE!! I almost failed the class!!
What a loser. Very unhelpful. Accusationary and unwilling to help, though he tries to make you beleive otherwise
He's hilarious, and he's a great teacher. Really nice. Really helpful.
He rocks my face off!! Fun class!

His non-writing classes are much easier than his writing classes (writing is what he is passionate about.) Very funny guy who you can tell loves teaching. One of the 50 most influential Jews according to IMDB!!!!!
So easy!  He makes class fun because we laugh at his jokes that he says aren't for us, but instead to entertain him.  lol  He rocks!  Just go to class everyday, and you've got an easy A.
Funny and nice guy. Class is fairly easy if you go to the classes because most of the quiz and test questions come from movies or lectures. Prof Allen is my favorite teacher in the film department.
AWESOME!!!
Mr. Allen rocks!
GREAT teacher!

Participate in class, it helps. Grading on projects is not clear, but she takes your input into consideration. She is super sweet and tries to make class fun. I would take this again with her, it pretty much is what you make of it. end of semester gave lots of extra credit opportunity. just takes a while to grade
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class was painful, although she is a good teacher.
I like Ms. Wheeler and she is super nice but she is a very tough grader. For all the work you do in this class, it is very hard to get satisfing grades.
Overall just ok, essays are graded pretty hard for a core class. Imagine the typical millennial and their humor.

Takes a while to grade CEA's/put grades in. Didn't get graded until the last week of the semester. Pretty tough grader for a core class. Syllabus isn't very clear on grading. I'm still not sure if she does A-. She's very nice though. The big thing is that it's a core class that is taken a little to seriously.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Stay on top of work and use her as a resource. She is very understanding and easy to reach. If you do your small assignment that is due each week you are fine. Only 3 papers the whole semester, but they weigh heavily your grade

Class is very easy if you actually work and go to class. Ryan is one of the most chill teachers and all major assignments are self graded and she works through your grade with you. She gives a lot of in class work time and is always available outside of class if you need help. Great Professor, take her class.
Fun teacher just a little disorganized
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: great teacher and very funny

I am obsessed with her. (but not in a stalkers way). She is so kind and caring and makes students feel like they are worthy and smart. She never once made me feel uncomfortable, and I would approach her about anything and everything. If youre reading this, youre SLAY!!

SHES THE LITERAL BEST!!!!!!!!!! Professor Ryan provides great feedback, all the materials you need to understand the concept, and reinforces teaching so you understand. Her lectures are a lot of info but she makes class fun and engaging. She doesn't make you feel bad and she is always there for support so ask! She's the most understanding/caring.

I love her sooo much! I wish I have her for lab as well. I learn a lot from the class and actually enjoy what I learn. She is funny and she laughs a lot. Pay attention in class, study everything on the PowerPoint and you will do great. Exam is cumulative, so you need to review old material from previous exam. I felt lucky to have her as my prof

She is one of the best professor in the nursing program. I love her so much!! She is the sweetest and willing to help you succeed if you come to her office. Her lecture is never boring. She always have fun class activities that help you learn and stay focus in class. Exam is harder than Concept, but she offers 1-2 points extra credit on every exam

I loved having him as a professor!! I took him for Personal to Public. The class was a lot of discussions on readings done before class and talking about things like marriage and relationships. The grading consisted of written compositions, quizzes, and oral presentations. He's very nice and willing to help. Loves native speakers.

Extremely caring and accessible outside of class. This class was very content heavy and at times it felt overwhelming, but there are many quiz opportunities to get your grade up. Participation matters, but as long as you are trying you will easily get a good grade. I learned a lot and felt improvement throughout the semester.

Dr. Schmitz is a great professor! He is so happy to help as much as you need outside of class. I will say that you are graded on very few things, this can make it difficult to recover from a bad grade, but as long as you attend class and put in a little effort on the areas he directs you, you can succeed in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Schmitz is very passionate about the information he teaches. He cares about his students and is very helpful in answering any questions. Culture of Spain was a great class- you learn a lot and the work is very manageable. The questions that go with the readings are your study guide for the exams. Pay attention in class and you'll do well!

Dr. Schmitz is a good professor. This class does require a lot of reading and there are quizzes after finishing each reading which they're typically short answer based. In every lecture you review what the reading was for the day of so it is key that you read before coming to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: this professor wants you to succeed and gives you a lot of materials in order to do so. he is very understanding of events that may come up (ex: illness) and responds to emails very fast. he lets you use english was confused and is understanding that everyone is learning and will make mistakes.

Do not take culture of Spain with him! His quizzes and exams are extremely difficult, and even with putting all the work in you will most likely feel lost and confused. There's just a lot of information. IF you love history take it!! But if you need span credit and suck at history, look for another course. The course is difficult not the prof.

Clear expectations for work. He works with you as best as he can, but be warned that you will have to put the work in. The course is intended to challenge you, and you must be ready to work hard for your grade. He is very funny and his course was extremely enjoyable.

Professor Schmitz is a very caring person and a decent instructor. He gives good feedback but grades hard. He is easier on latino/a students. Daily group work, a lot of papers, quizzes, and presentations. He definitely has favorites, and if you are not one of them- good luck. I would only take him again if there were no other professors available.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Disclaimer: The class I had him for was 32003 Culture of Spain. Do NOT take this course. Do Cinema of Spain or something else. I was excited to learn in this class, but you just go over sooo much material in a short amount of time. My study guides were 20+ pages and I barely passed. I'm a straight A student and this was hard. Must be native speaker

Dr. Shmitz is honestly the BEST! He is such an amazing guy and I would take his class again in a heartbeat. He explains concepts super well, and homework is minimal. Tests are kind of hard since they have a lot of material, but quizzes prepare you well. He's a hilarious guy who keeps lectures interesting. Take Dr. Shmitz if at all possible!

Ad Sp Grammar- Homework is not mandatory, but highly rec'd, can earn XC for doing it sometimes. Difficult material, but if you ask, it becomes clear specific content for each quiz/test. He likes you if you participate. Play the game, do well. Funny side tangents about Minnesota and his Spanish experiences. Bottom line- put in work do well. 8/10

After getting behind in Spanish because of a bad teacher, he helped me so much. I sought him out in office hours frequently and he was really generous with his time. Class was hard because we just talked in Spanish the whole time. Lots of papers. No tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: He's hands down the best Spanish teacher I've ever had, but he's tough. He truly cares about his students.

If you aren't fluent in Spanish, good luck. He was a good professor, but his lectures were definitely tailored to students who perform better, and he is very condescending when you ask for help. I personally wouldn't take him, but if you are fluent, it's an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Advanced Spanish grammar is really really hard and he is not very approachable in office hours. Grades quizzes and then doesn't let you keep them so hard to improve for the tests.

Not very approachable when you ask for help. He tends to give more attention to and be more inclined to help those who are basically fluent in Spanish. Very tough grader... takes off points for every mistake no matter how minor.

I loved Schmitz - I had him for Oral Communication and will continue with him to next semster. He truly cares about his students - speak up, participate, and ask questions and he'll be more inclined to help you/be kinder when grading you. He's been my favorite teacher here so far - that being said you should definitely have a strong background
Native speaker, and took advanced grammar, good class but not easy, hard A, Easy B
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Advanced grammar is a difficult class in general, so be sure that your Spanish is ready for an upper level class, but Schmitz attempts to make it as doable as possible. He keeps explaining things until the class understands, and he allows you to ask questions in English if you aren't understanding his Spanish explanations. Helps in office hours too

He is a fantastic prof and his passion for Spanish is quite obvious. It is important to talk in class and show him that you are really working on your own Spanish. You also learn about cultural aspects of the Spanish speaking world in this class and he tells stories about his own experience.

Schmitz is no doubt the best professor I have had at TCU. He relates so well with his students, and is really funny. His passion for Spanish really shows, which makes his classes very engaging. He is challenging, which changes you for the better. I loved having him for 20103, and took 31103 this semester so I could have him again. TAKE HIM!!!

Extremely difficult. If you are not 100% in your Spanish abilities, choose another professor. He acts like his students should know everything. He is willing to help, but is very standoff-ish. I would not take another class with him.

Schmitz is a great teacher. His classes are interesting, and you learn a lot. I liked it because we had real conversations and learned about real things instead of busy work. Dont slack off on your participation in class because he will give you a bad grade. Keep your phone put away and act interested! Overall friendly, interesting and easy grader

Great Professor! Isn't super picky if you forget an accent or misspell something (ex: only 1/4 a point off instead of all wrong). Nice guy who cares about his student and seems to enjoy his job. Definitely participate in class, if he sees you putting in effort your grade will hugely reflect that. Highly recommend him even if you're not good at Span

If you are not really good at Spanish, consider another teacher. Intermediate 2 was a challenge for me. He moves quickly and assumes that the student has A LOT of prior knowledge to everything he teaches. He gives the students who are good at Spanish most of his attention. I felt like I was hardly given a chance. Nice guy, though.

I had Prof. Schmitz for Int. Spanish 2 and he relies very heavily on the textbook. How much effort you put into the class reflects your grade. It isn't a difficult class but you do have to work for your grade. He wants to see his students succeed. I recommend him.

Great Prof! He really seems to care about what he is teaching and he is very available outside of class should you need help. Not an easy A, but you really learn a lot!!! He seems like an all around nice guy and he's a good teacher... recommend him!
If you are not proficient in Spanish or fluent, I would highly recommend a different teacher.

Paranorma of spanish lit- he has online questions to fill for more understanding and we go over them in class. He really expects a lot from his students but you do learn alot if you put in some effort. He is an expert in his field. 3 quizzes and 2 exams and 2; 5 page essays (that he will peer edit for you)
He is a great professor!  Very knowledgeable about Spanish literature. Cervantes and the Renaissance class was great! If you work hard, and A is very possible.

Advanced Spanish Grammer was SO hard. He is a really cute and nice guy (he loves native speakers) but he makes the tests super difficult. I think everyone who wasn't a native speaker in this class got a C.

Kinda easy.  Material is pretty easy so far, tests are mostly fill in the blank, not much writing.  Very helpful during office hours. Would reccomend him to anyone.  I don't study much, but I still have a B+

He is amazing! It's just Spanish 1 and he makes the class so entertaining and fun. At first I thought I would hate doing all the little partner excersizes but they really help! His tests are pretty easy, and you don't even need to study for his quizzes. He does everything exactly from the book. Def take it :)

I loved taking from Brother Sharp. You can tell he has experience being a seminary teacher because his lectures are engaging and geared towards spiritual experiences. He was behind on the lectures most of the semester, but adjusted the reading for it. Very clear on what is on the test, and understanding of his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: His syllabus was very unclear so no one knew what was due and when. He also grades his papers extremely harshly. He also did not put grades in until after the pass/no credit deadlines and that made my grade drop a lot. He is great in lecture and very nice, but he offers no extra credit and is not very willing to work with students

Dr. Sharp is a great professor and lecturer. most of the assignments are readings or watching documentaries, there are 2 major papers which he grades pretty harshly, and the final is a portfolio of campus events. if you are a busy student this isnt the class for you. he is somewhat lenient on late work, but will dock major points for attendence
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Dr. Ryu's biochem lab. You get to work in groups for every lab, which made them easier. The hardest part of the course are the lab reports themselves, as they are very time consuming to write. However, Dr. Ryu is lenient on your results and really only focuses on if you understood the material rather than if you got perfect results.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He only gives quizzes and exams that are specific to his standards/interests. Very tough grader and focuses more on biology research related topics instead of biochem topics. Doesnt offer any additional practice even if you ask and doesnt use the textbook. Do not recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Ryu is the hardest grader on the planet. Make sure to exactly regurgitate everything he wants or else youll get more than half the points off on the test. He means well, but worst class Ive ever taken. Dont even try to negotiate points with him because hell completely shut you down. Worst class ever currently hate my life taking it

Very poorly structured class. Dr. Ryu is a funny guy, but he has a thick accent and many times I couldn't understand what he was saying. He gives out his PPTs, but they are a generalized version of what he says in class. He assigns a textbook but never references it. The only reason I passed was from old quizzes and tests that he copies from.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: With the curve, about half of the class makes an A. The material is somewhat difficult, but the tests are pretty straight forward. With his accent, he can be a bit difficult to understand at times, but the book is ppt notes and book are helpful. Overall, good class. It really connected the dots between a lot of bio and chem that I had learned.

Quizzes once a week, tough class with a curve, but it's a small class and the students tend to be cream of the crop. If you don't understand something, he tries to explain, but his explanations aren't that helpful. His accent makes it harder to understand an already difficult subject. Nice prof, but be prepared to do a LOT of independent learning.
This was one of the best classes I took at TCU. Dr. Ryu is a great prof - very willing to help/accomodate stdents. I would definitely recommend his class.

His accent is difficult for me to understand. However, he is very clear and logical. The slides he makes available online help a lot. Grading is fair. Manner in which material is taught and tested is excellent - emphasis on concepts instead of details. Awesome professor and great class.

This class was more difficult than organic chemistry, if that tells you anything. Small class, not much of a curve because it consists of very smart seniors and people who have already graduated. My least favorite class to date.

This class was made really easy, essentially a high school-level class. She literally gives you an outline for your speech, and speeches themselves weren't even that hard, tbh. She grades on a point system, and if you've passed the 900-point threshold, Sarah gives you the option to be exempt from the final b/c you got an A. I recommend her 100%!

She is a great professor. The class is honestly really easy, I felt that she didn't grade too hard. For the midterm it was a storytelling card game (super easy and fun), the final is an impromptu speech that you most likely wont even have to do. Would definitely recommend.

She's super nice and really wants you to succeed. Attendance matters because there are about 8 in-class activities worth 30 points (usually random). You can easily get an A. There are 3 speeches the first is easy but the other two take real prep and follow a format. She's very supportive and offers 30 points of extra credit. Final is a speech

She is really nice and sweet, however I felt that the speeches we had to do in class were a bit rushed as we had almost no time to work on them during class time. Communications is a boring subject but she tries her best to make it fun. There's 3 speeches that make or break your grade.
She is a very caring teacher, gives you great feedback and is very accessible via email. Take her!
Ms. Salmeron is super funny and I'm glad I had her as my professor. Make sure you turn in hw on time because she does not take late work. She is very easy going and easy to talk too!

Professor Sofia Salmeron may seem strict at first, but she's actually very outgoing, approachable, and an easy grader. The class is speech-heavy, with frequent presentations and only one easy exam. She offers flexible deadlines, easy extra credit, and clearly outlines what's on exams. I'd definitely recommend her.

Ms. Salmeron is really up front and honest about what needs to be done for her class. Very little homework, a few group projects, but the main thing is the 4 speeches throughout the semester. If you focus and put even just a little effort into the speeches, she will give you a good grade. I couldn't recommend taking her class enough.

This was by far my favorite class of the year! I LOVE PROF SALMERON SM!! She was a little intimidating at first but she's actually so funny and chill. Not a hard grader at all as long as you submit something and will give you more opportunities to make up for it if you don't. Randomly cancels class and leave early most of then time.
She is so awesome. Highly recommend taking Communicating Effectively if you want an easy A.

She was very clear with the course schedule for the week and tells you when class is mandatory. Only had 1 test all semester and all assignments could be completed in class. Speeches every few weeks, but you could pick your topic and she grades very easy. Gives multiple extra credit opportunities and wants you to get a good grade!
Would recommend

TAKE HER SHE IS THE BEST. Extra credit is offered at the end as long as you try, the only thing you have to do is show up for speech days and turn in work on time. Best teacher of the semester hands down
hands down my favorite professor of this semester! I cannot recommend her enough
She is the best professor easily at TCU. You need to take this class. She makes learning fun and easy. Its so easy
She was awesome and was a very fun teacher to learn from. Favorite Professor i've had here at TCU

CSF is an incredibly difficult class. However, Dr. Scherger put in the effort to help us learn and get us through the class. He may not be the nicest all of the time, but he genuinely wants kids to learn the material. Do every little ounce of practice he gives you, and you can pass.
Just don't take his class
im tired of pretending like scherger is evil because hes actually the goat and it balances out

Unsure if Dr. Scherger will teach this class again.  Dr. Scherger was very personable and fun in class. The assignments were very few. We had 2 homework and 3 projects. The class was just a fun time. The exams were pretty decent and reasonable. I will say reading the textbook does help in this class. RTFM! Maximize your expected utility!

Dr. Scherger might seem intimidating, but he really does know his stuff. Dr. Scherger will truly test if you have what it takes to be a computer scientist. I enjoyed the class despite it being very hard. If you actually devote time to this class, you will pass no problem. Exams were very hard, but the questions were always reasonable.

Really bad teaching, the materials he teaches are directly copied from other universities and all he does is read the slides thoroughly in class, whenever asked a question related to it, he'll say i'll get back to you within couple of days which he wont. Will take forever to reply to an email and he gets really annoyed whenever you go to his office
the deal is on

He knows his stuff, no doubt, but don't get me wrong—this class is tough, and you have to put in the effort to pass. Start preparing early, both mentally and academically. Stay on top of the homework and labs because they'll save your grade in the end. Exams are hard, but if you keep up and don't slack, you'll make it through. Good luck!

To be completely  honest I never took this class but my roomate did. I have never seen someone so miserable everyday dreading a class because of how awful the professor is and how difficult he made the class. The average test scores were crazy low and I had to stop him from jumping off a cliff. Dont take for the sake of your roomates PLEASE.

I would cross University without looking both ways in the hopes I would be hit by a car and wouldn't have to go to this class. If you try and go to his office hours, he will act annoyed that you even came in. He just reads off of stolen slides and you'll have to teach yourself. If you don't want to be miserable DO NOT take Scherger.
THE DEAL IS ON!!!!

Dr. Scherger's courses have a reputation of being very difficult, but you will find that your agility and thoroughness as a programmer will both improve greatly in the long run once you accept and try to meet those expectations. He is also an entertaining lecturer when it comes to algorithms and it was clear that he cared about the course material.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I've taken multiple classes with Dr. Scherger. Although he is a smart person, he's not best at teaching materials. This becomes an issue when you're taking high-level abstract concepts. It's possible to pass his class, but at the end you don't remember anything.

Not a bad teacher in terms of educating, but his grading give me nightmares. His tests are notorious, as he likes to introduce you to completely new concepts during tests. He is very accessible and helpful in office hours, but his A's being a 93, plus no curve is ridiculous for some of the hardest classes offered at the university.

I've taken 3 classes with him and every class I've taken with him i have had to increase my anti depressant dosage. He steals almost all of his slide and assignments from other professors and just reads word for word from slides. Very slow grader and his tests are very hard. Id say at least 1/4 of his classes fails/drops out of the class. -1/10.

This class is terrible- the only reason you would want to take a scherger class, is because it's required to graduate. To do well in the class, do all the homework but more importantly, set aside a lot of time to go over the study guides he provides... a LOT. His tests go over quite a bit of information and they're not fun :(

2/10 not take again

Every class of him is mentally exhausting. You CAN get an A though, but not accessible as the other comments. He does not reply to emails and gave us 6 homework (40% total) instead of 15 as in the syllabus, late grader. Everything. If TCU offers more courses and professors for Computer Science, nobody would ever take him. We don't have a choice.

If you put in the work, you will do well in this class. Scherger was an accessible professor that made the course material come to life and was readily available to answer any questions. Really takes his time to explain concepts and help his students out. Exams are challenging but if you study thoroughly you will be fine. Would take again!

I took Computer Organization with Scherger, and this was his first year teaching this course so I am going to cut him a tiny bit of slack. but MAN he sucked at it. Everything he did was copied from other schools, and hard af- he didn't teach us well and we really had to put in so many hours just to understand what in the world this guy is talkingab

Worst professor I have ever had. He is rude, unwilling to help, & avoids problems. Class average on a test was a 40 and he refused to talk about it. When asked for help he just tells you to Google it. He assumed everyone knew how to code in an intro class & refused to slow down. Even friends who have been coding for years had no clue how to help.

If you take Disasters and Failures, do NOT take it with this professor. While supposedly one of the easiest classes at TCU, I got all A's in my senior-level work, like Econometrics, but got a B in this "intro" course, despite studying for hours every week. The quizzes contain material not in the notes and are unnecessarily semantic.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Scherger might be the worst professor that you can take at TCU. He fails half his class in every single one of his classes and doesn't care about how much he destroys every single student who takes his courses GPA. He did not grade half of our homeworks until after we took the final and each hw assingment was worth 12 percent of our grade.

This professor is the worst tcu professor ever . He has no work ethic . Doesn't even follow his own syllabus . Exams are super hard and undoable . He grades homeworks like they are exams so you might get F on homeworks .He doesn't know how to teach . If you ask him a question in class he will choke and wont be able to answer the question.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He didn't know my name until the end of the semester. Quizzes every Monday sometimes contain info not in the notes. Attendance is mandatory but you will find all his class is, is him reading the slides word for word and not elaborating. The labs for this class are boring but actually carry your grade. Class Quiz Average was a D, final Average was C

Not an intro class at all! This has to be the hardest class I have ever taken. He doesn't explain well, goes too fast, and expects us to know everything. The average class grade was 40% for the 1st test.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I had to take an Intro to Python course for my minor. I didn't think it was going to be easy, but I definitely thought it was going to be doable with some effort. Code became so hard and it was so hard to follow along his monotonous lectures. There was nothing introductory about this course.

He is enthusiastic about the topic and also a nerd about Computer Science in class. However, as other students said he doesnt use his own material. At the middle of the semester I found out that his whole class notes are taken from a popular book. That makes the class less interesting, he could have done better.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Doesn't teach well. Not good at explaining tougher topics in a simpler to understand manner. Overall worst COSC professor at TCU.

All of lectures are straight from other online powerpoints. He reads the textbook word for word during lecture and does not add any of his own knowledge. If you ask him a question in class it is likely that he won't know the answer. He gives very difficult homeworks that are not doable unless you look elsewhere from his teachings.

Every three hours in class required two in office hours. Dr. Scherger is very accessible, and that's the only reason I was able to pass. He was willing to work with me on the projects. Fact is, programming is hard, but Dr. Scherger tries to make it easy. Nice professor and if I have to take programming again, I would take it with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Keep up with reading. Go to class. Do all your assigned work. His lectures teach a lot, but they don't always cover everything he expects you to know.
he's cool
Took him for intro to programming for engineers and scientists. Very hard programming projects. Definitely not an easy intro class. However, you learn a whole lot about programming.

Do not take this class if you have never taken Geography she is not helpful at all. She will not let you do an assignment if you miss the date she has no sympathy for her students or what they might be going through. Her slides are pointless and there is no study guide for her tests. No way you will make an A if you don't go to every class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Class is an easy B at the very worst. Exams can be challenging, but not too difficult if you attend class and take good notes. Extra credit is available on almost every assignment.

This teacher gives absolutely 0 resources for students that have never taken a GEO class before. Her lectures maybe have 10 words max on each slide and doesn't provide a study guide for exams. Shes is strict, rude and non supportive. Do not take Sarah Schwartz because theres no room for struggling in her class she will not help you.
alright teacher 80 minutes of straight lectures in the morning

Took 8am Tue/Thurs. Attendance not req. but there's 5 easy IN class assignments on random days, they're usually abt whatever class was abt that day. Map Quizzes are online, open internet, timed ~1 hour. There's a textbook, didn't need it. Tests have material that's said in lectures, so pay attention. Lectures were long but interesting,LotsExtraCred

Dr. Schwartz is one of the smartest people at TCU. I had her at 8 am Tuesdays and Thursdays and her class was my favorite, because she was genuinely so engaging and always kept me awake. She gives a lot of extra credit and is really nice to her students. Take her if you can!

The whole class is her lecturing. She is very knowledgeable and often includes anecdotes and personal experiences in her interesting lectures. Tests are based solely on information from lectures, so although attendance is not mandatory, show up to class and take good notes. If you do this, it is an easy A. She gives lots of extra credit as well!

Dr. Schwartz genuinely cares about the subject that she teaches, and makes sure that her students understand the concepts before moving on. Her quizzes and exams are not hard if you keep up with the lectures and engage in discussions. I would 100% take her class again, even at 8AM.

She is so sweet and if you show up to class and take good notes, you can get a 100. She offers a lot of extra credit questions on exams based on personal anecdotes, so write those down in lectures. Easy online quizzes that are open internet, so they're a good grade boost. Definitely lecture heavy, but I found them interesting. Would take her again.

Amazing professor! Very lecture heavy but the content is very interesting and presented in an interesting way. Tests are over 3-5 chapters each so take good notes! Offers lots of chances for extra credit and the final is open note. You can also retake certain quizzes. Map quizzes are tedious but use Google Maps and you'll be fine.

Dr. Schwartz is very nice and her lectures are really interesting and she makes them not boring, however, this class is mostly graded on 3 exams (the first 2 are in person paper exams worth 40% of your grade and 1 exam as the final that's online and worth 10%) and the exams are super difficult and if you want an easy class then don't take this one

This class was great, however, the exams are in person and very challenging. You are graded off of a lot of homework like weekly online quizzes that are really easy and a grade boost. However, these exams will tank your grade and expect them to be a lot harder than the in class lectures. Otherwise, I really liked Dr. Schwatz she is very nice.

If you don't go to class and listen to every word she says for the entire hour and 20 mins, you'll probably fail the exam; if you DO go and listen to everything, you'll be lucky to get above a B. She's honestly really sweet but strict and makes her exams way harder than they would need to be for an entry-level geography class.
She gave few assignments and tests that covered months of lectures. She gave extra credit though.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I absolutely LOVED her! This ended up being my favorite class! Go to every lecture and write down everything she says(including personal stories because they are extra credit questions. She offers ALOT of extra credit. 100 is possible in this class. I could not recommend her more. Only study your notes for the test.

This class was surprisingly super hard especially for the level. I thought she was a sweet person, but the tests were so brutal even with me studying I almost failed the class. Definitely wouldn't recommend unless you're going to every class, study like crazy, and are naturally smart and good at geography.

worst class ive ever taken. do not take her. she talks the whole class and expects you to be responsible of all material for the test without any preparation or review. horrible horrible class and professor

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!!!!! I have no clue why she has such good ratings. This class was unnecessarily hard and she was extremely rude and not helpful when I had a family member pass away before finals. Again, do NOT take this class.

One of the easiest core classes you can take IF you go to class. Classes are super lecture heavy and can be boring, but if you go to every class and somewhat pay attention you should get an A. So much extra credit is offered, final is online. Just go to every class and you will get an A.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!!

Attendance not mandatory
info in lectures relates to real world
knowledge is applicable and useable 
Easy Tests 50 multiple choice (Final is open note online)
Very little work outside of class. 1-2 quizzes onlne max. very easy
Professor is excited to teach and passionate about material. Has visited many of the places she covers.
I recommend

Dr. Schwartz was a great professor. She is very passionate and knowledgeable about what she is teaching. Lectures are fast paced so I do recommend that you go to each class as most information is spoken and not on the slideshows. There are three tests including the final exam. Pay attention and you will be fine.

I enjoyed this class because the material was relatively interesting, but every class was just a long lecture. You need to pay attention to the lectures to do well on tests because that's where all the exam questions come from. There was 1 quiz per week that you were allowed to use resources on. Not a bad class you just have to go

Lovely professor, take if you can. Very nice and lectures are quite interesting. The class is easy if you have a history background. Specifically with her, there is not that many specific dates/locations to master, rather facts and more general terms. Map Quizzes are very easy as you can "use your resources," and the tests are not bad either.

Great professor. There are weekly map quizzes, and three current events quizzes, all of which are online and open note. Her lectures are very informative, but you need to take a lot of notes. Final is online and open note. As long as you're engaged in class and do the map quizzes, you'll do pretty well.

I took GEOG 30533 with Dr. Schwartz and it went great! The course is made up of a few in class discussions, quizzes, and 3 exams, and a research paper throughout the semester. All heavily based on the lecture material and a few supplemental readings Dr. Schwartz help students however she can and is very supportive. Great class and professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
I see a lot of reviews about the exams having nothing to do with the lecture material, and that's not true. Focus during the class, take good notes, AND YOU WILL DO WELL. (Never went to office hours)
Do the extra credit!! Map quizzes have few points extra credit, as well as the exams, and out of class credit too. 
A 100 is possible in this class.

This is one of the worst professors at TCU. She is smug and could care less about her students. She tries to make her tests as difficult as possible. Taking notes from her lectures is 100% pointless because they never show up on her ridiculous exams. I truly hope that TCU will wise up and fire this useless elitist professor. She belongs at TCC.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The class consists of lectures. Every week there is a map quiz to do and occasionally News Quizzes. There are three exams that are closed notes, and then the final is open notes. Go to class to take good notes, and study well and you will do great on exams. If you can memorize things then you will get an A.

The class is lecture heavy, while its all based in the textbook there is some information she will only go over in class. The lectures themselves are easy to digest and the information isn't particularly hard to understand. Dr. Schwartz is great at answering questions and helping students, the grading policy is pretty set in stone though.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Schwartz was an amazing professor! I highly recommend this course and professor. This class is all lecture but the information being taught is actually very interesting, so I enjoyed it a lot. Professor Schwartz gives many extra credit opportunities also. Map quizzes are easy and tests are easy when you go to class and take notes!
Really really really hard. All you take notes are of no use on tests. I can not breathe in the class.
TESTS ARE EXTREMELY HARD. The quizzes are easy but the tests make up the great portion of the grade. DO NOT TAKE
Tests are EXTREMELY HARDDD. Quizzes are fine, u will have quizzes every single week. She is nice, her lectures are really good and easy to understand but nothing to do with the TESTS.

She is super tough! The tests are just so hard and has nothing to do with the notes. If you do not want to feel hopeless do not take this class at any cost. She is not supportive on changing the bell curve at all.

Terrible. You can go to lectures take notes on every single thing she says and not get an A on the test. Quizzes are super easy but the test takes up most of the grade. Tests are EXTREMELY confusing and half the time have nothing at all to do with the notes. Avoid this class. Had to pass no credit the class
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Avoid taking this at all costs. Map quizzes are easy but tests are very confusing. Not responsive to emails and not helpful.

DO NOT take this. I was SO close to an A instead of A- & emailed her many times asking for help/tips on how to do better & she never answered. During finals I found out a parent was very sick and had to fly home. Had no sympathy & still made me take the final. Would not help/acknowledge my questions about my grade even after my parent passed away.

I personally wouldn't recommend this class to people because she has no compassion for students' grades. I ended 0.004 points away from an A- and she wouldn't do anything to help. I understand not rounding the entire grade but for it to be that little of a point, it's just cruel. If you don't care about your grades, take this class if not, don't.

Dr. Schwartz is an AMAZING professor! So sweet, intelligent, she just knows what she's talking about. That being said, you HAVE to go to class if you want an A. Her test is 95% lecture from class so although you aren't graded on attendance, you need it. Do all of the extra credit and don't skip! Should be doable (super easy pass/no credit class)

Every class is a lecture, but she makes it super interesting to learn about. Has the powerpoint from lectures posted to D2L, but still take notes because she says things that aren't on the powerpoint, that are on the test. Strict on late work, but very easy tests and quizzes. Can use your notes/google for both. LOVE her.

Dr. Schwartz is the BEST! This class was one of the easiest I have ever taken and would def take it again. The lectures can draw out, but if you pay attention you are basically guaranteed an A. Quizzes and tests are open book and open note and the lectures can be interesting when she talks about her personal traveling! Love her <3

Reading heavy & I mean heavy like people on "My 600-Pound Life" heavy. I forgot to do a few assignments simply because there were other classes I was taking that were also reading & writing heavy. She s a good professor, talks a lot & makes sure to engage with students. I just genuinely didn't care for the class, so don't let my grade dismay you.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof Schwartz was great. Not a blow off class by any means, but totally doable. She is an easy grader and responds quick. Really sweet lady and has super cool experiences. Lectures on tuesdays, discussion on Thursdays. Nothing to be worried about. 10/10 recommend her!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Schwartz is such an amazing professor! I really had low expectations for this class, but I ended up looking forward to lectures! She's extremely kind and hilarious. The passion she has for teaching the material is unmatched too! She tells you exactly how the class will be laid out and stands by her promise!

I thought this was going to be an easy class, I was so wrong. Do not be fooled this class is so so so hard. I would not wish it upon my worst enemy. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Took this class for fun and absolutely loved it!! Super interesting material and Professor Schwartz is an awesome lady. Only college class I've ever gotten a final grade above a 100 in. Don't need to buy the textbook, just go to class and take notes and you are fine. Open book tests and tons of extra credit. Wish I could take her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Scwartz is a great professor. All she has is 2 exams & the final, map quizzes that are so so easy, some other quizzes that are not that hard, & that's really it. I would recommend taking really good detailed notes because 9/10 the answers to the exams are from the notes, but just make sure they are in detail. Put in the effort & you'll be okay!

She might be an angel. All tests and quizzes are open note, there is a lot of work for this class but so worth it and not hard at all. It's an easy A, but I also really appreciated her and went to every class, so it's up to you to do your job. Best geography professor ever, I swear I've learned so much and loved the entire class.

Amazing professor who makes a boring subject very interesting & understandable. A few simple map quizzes but they're easy points. there are also some online activities that are very basic. although she posts lecture slides online, u need to go to class to get info. study ur notes for tests & u will do fine. lots of extra credit to get an easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Schwartz's World Regional Geography is a fun and easy class. If you pay attention, you'll do well, simple as that. Be aware that there are map quizzes about every other week and some take home assignments, but she sticks to the syllabus so you'll know what's coming up. I'd definitely recommend Dr. Schwartz!

I loved this class! It was a break from my harder classes. Dr. Schwartz is a fun person who really likes what she teaches. There are map quizzes about every two weeks and three exams total. She gives you powerpoint but they normally only have pictures on them so you need to be in class to get the information. Highly recommend though.
Very easy class if you go and take notes. The tests are literally the notes, so if you study them you'll be fine. Dr. Schwartz is very kind and funny.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Amazing professor!! Show up to class and take detailed notes - tests are based off class lectures and are multiple choice and free response (with a word bank). Easy A if you do the work. Very interesting class!

reviews.comment: Great professor, lectures are interesting. Make sure to write great notes since test is based on notes, Powerpoint based but cant rely on them.
