reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Schwartz provides really clear guidelines and making an A in this class is easy if you follow them. Lectures are interesting and each week is a different aspect of tourism so it's always something new.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Schwartz is great! She has an obvious passion for the geography of tourism and really knows her stuff. I am definitely hoping to take another one of her classes. The class is about half discussion/half lecture which is a nice balance. FYI: you have to do the readings because she gives frequent pop quizzes.

Professor Schwartz is awesome! She is great and loves what she does! Everything is powerpoint based, but just looking at the powerpoint won't help, you have to go to class to get the actual material. She has map quizzes and in-class assignments that help your grade a lot.

The class in itself is very hard but she makes it better because she is so helpful. I would say shes the easiest AK professor so if you have the chance I would definitely take her class. She literally can meet whenever and is hilarious.

I took her my freshman year for Anatomical Kinesiology and she had really good class activities that actually helped me retain the concepts. It is a hard class, especially if you have no prior experiences, but overall really good teacher, gives great feedback and wants you to do well.

Took anatomical kines with her my freshman year. If I could tell you anything, wouldn't recommend taking this already really hard course with her. If you have the opportunity take it with other professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Ms. Scoggins was absolutely amazing!!! She has an amazing class structure and very passionate about all things kinesiology. She makes class enjoyable as much as possible and is there to help you succeed.    She gives clear instruction and assignments are easy to follow. She is kind, funny and extremely helpful. She loves her students and this field

literally one of the hardest teachers I've had. she has little time urgency so class usually runs 5-10 minutes after the scheduled ending time. goes on a LOT of rambles and is honestly kind of mean. she's very unapproachable and I was always scared to ask her questions. I got a good grade but there's reading homework almost every night. do not take
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The most intimidating professor I've ever had. Not approachable, will straight up call you out in class, excessive homework with no clear instruction. Some of the material on exams was something I had never even seen before. Do not take!

If you have anxiety, you should probably not take this class. She's very knowledgeable and nice if you ask for help. However, she isn't clear on assignment instructions and often changes big assignments at the last minute. This class gave me so much anxiety.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I've had Mme. Schein for several classes. She's kind and knowledgeable. However, I've never had a prof as unclear or unpredictable. She often doesn't mention big assignments until the week they're due, and completely changes project requirements last minute. If you're a French major/minor you'll have to take her classes, but prepare to be confused.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Madame Schein was an overall good professor, but she tends to be a little unclear when it comes to due dates and assignments. You also have to pay attention to the grammatical homework to do well on the tests. She is a good grader though.

I took this class without taking French 1 first and I would recommend against skipping classes despite your language speaking level. VERY unclear grading policies and assigned a huge project that was not on the syllabus too weeks before finals. NEVER responds to emails. Tests and homework were not horribly difficult and extra credit is everywhere.
She is very nice and will do her best to help you succeed

Mme. Schein is very caring, but don't take her if not having clear deadlines or grading criteria stresses you out. She usually won't tell you the exact criteria for the essay until the day it is assigned, and due dates change often (but she never moves them up, so don't worry about that). She is a generous paper grader if you participate in class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Shes understanding if you need to miss and asks each person how they are doing at the beginning of each Zoom. She LOVES when you participate and it is a big grade in the class. The tests are hard but she is organized and tells you what is on them. Lots of homework but I learned a lot and I'm going to keep going to get my minor!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mme Schein is a great professor. She really cares about her students and wants to make sure everyone understands the material and is ready for the next level. She can be a tough grader, but its always to your benefit.

She is very disorganized and has no respect for her students time. Which is in my opinion an unforgivable offense to waste a persons time when life is so short. She is a terrible teacher you may as well just learn French on your own for as much as she actually teaches. TCU is terrible, with teachers who aren't worth your hard earned money.

Schein is a very good professor and cares a lot about her students. Participation is a must, but also helps the learning process. She is very helpful during office hours and will work with students as much as possible.

She is a fantastic teacher and does a great job of working with people if they miss class for legit reasons. She also does a good job at getting you to a level of knowledge to prepare you for upper level French classes. My only complaint is that she sometimes is a little disorganized when it comes to what your homework is, so just check D2L a lot

Dr. Schein is a great prof and a great person. Lots of reading but she's very understanding and helpful with it. It's manageable but don't procrastinate. You will learn French even if you don't want to!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Putting in a good effort is essential to doing well. If she sees you genuinely trying, she will be that much more willing to work with you. Not always the clearest professor with her expectations, so participating and communicating with her is a huge part of the equation if you want to do well.

I took her for two semesters and was dispointed both times. She changes the syllabus half way through the semster, responds to emails late, and takes off points for small gammaticall errors. I lam a native french speaker and I ove French but she made me hate it which is unfortunate ,  definately would not recommend.

Mme. Schein is the absolute best professor I have ever had. She taught me French from the ground up--I took her all the way from freshman year to completing my minor as a senior. I was just as intimidated by her on my last day of French class as my very first, but she is literally the best prof I had in all 4 years. TOUGH love but it is so worth it

It's easy to see she loves teaching this class. It's a very engaging class and not too difficult at all as long as you do the assigned readings. She does a great job pushing students to improve their reading and writing skills.
Took forever to respond to my emails and did not show interest in helping me when I begged for it. Do not recommend- I will not be taking one of her classes again.

She's very good at getting students to improve their speaking abilities, and class time is generally pretty engaging. She's very nice, but sometimes can be very unclear about how she wants some assignments to be done. Aside from that, she is a very good prof.

I love Madame Schein.  She's willing to meet with you to help with any concept you don't fully understand, and is lenient if you forget an assignment or something.  I've taken French for years and she's taught me so many new things this semester.  Definitely take her if you have the chance!

She's a very helpful teacher and is willing to work with you if you're willing to try. She will help you to become a better speaker, but the syllabus is not always accurate, which can lead to confusion on what she expects from her students. She does do a great job teaching in class, though, and there isn't an overwhelming amount of outside work.
Taken her for multiple French classes, and she's by far the best French teacher at TCU. So nice, and genuinely cares about her students and wants them to do well. Take her over anyone else!

Madame Schein definitely has a French attitude. She is no nonsense and can seem very "tough love." At first I didn't get along with her, but eventually I grew to love her. She helps you learn to speak French better, grades extremely fairly based on your level and cares about her students. She gives pop quizzes, so be sure to go to class! <3 her

Mme. Schein is so sweet! She is a great teacher, and always encourages student participation. She is very lenient about late assignments, and is willing to work with you if you're having trouble. I am going to take my third class with her next semester, and I highly recommend her for any French class!

French I. Schein is great! She's from France so you really couldn't ask for a more knowledgeable teacher. Take her! Attendance counts so you have to go to class, but there isn't too much outside work.

I love Madame Schein. She is very nice and incredibly helpful. She's very patient and does not pick favorites. If you're looking to become fluent take her because she speaks in mostly French and only in English when something needs to be clarified.
It's a pretty bland class.  If you liked high school French and want more of the same, you'll like it.  Easy A.

Mme. Schein is absolutely the best instructor at TCU.  She is empathetic and extremely helpful.  She truly cares about her students and is always available to help.  By far one of the nicest professors on campus.

This class is a foreign language. So it will take effort. But this prof helped me so much. I loved the class, and found myself hearnig music on commercials and being excited I could recognize the french.  You have online assignments. But as a prof, she is so amazing!!! So helpful!

If you a prof that genuinely gives a damn about her students, who respects you as an individual, a prof who doesn't laugh at you or rudely intterupts you to correct you... if you basically want the opposite of Dr. Fairchild then take her because God knows french is hard enough as it is without dealing with a CHIENNE.... DR SCHEIN IS AWESOME!!!!
let's face it, without Dr. Schein the french department would empty itself out of many students. She is a ray of sunshine in a horrible storm of fairchildness.... TAKE HER SHE ROCKS!!!

I took her selected genres class and she is one of the nicest people ever. She  cares a lot about her subject and pours her heart into her French class,is always willing to help and tries to get people involved in French activities around the metroplex. The class itself is not too difficult, and I strongly recommend it to those who love French

She is a very helpful professor.  She makes the class fun and interesting.  She makes the students participate, speak French, and learn.  She helps as much as she can and is very easy to get along with.  Outside of class she will speak to you and French and ask how you are.  She is a very great woman and a wonderful teacher of the French language.
My first year I dreaded taking an English class. But this woman kicks  a**. I liked it so much I ended up with an English minor just from following her around.
If you are going to take French, take it from her. She is such a good teacher and an interesting woman! She is very nice and willing to help you, she makes the class feel like a family. I loved her!
Not a bad class...lighter reading load, goes relatively quick

Not as bad as other ratings make him seem. Class has 3 big test worth most of your grade. It is important you show up every second class of the week as that is when he does the practice problems. These are basically what you should expect to see on the test and some are in the test. He lets you use excel for the test and gives you equations.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is the least caring and understanding professor at TCU. As a student who has had great relationships w all teachers this speaks loudly. I've taken multiple classes with him, and the class AVG for the midterm and final was always below an 80. I dont wish my experience on anyone. also will crash out in public often. very huge ego.JUST DONT TAKE!

Tom does NOT teach his class well, so you'll have to learn the info yourself. He's a good dude though and he'll be nice to you as long as you don't cheat or use your phone. He's a smart guy and he's clearly knowledgeable but he just doesn't lecture in a way that's conducive to learning.

Please whatever you do, do not take him for this class. All of his tests are like 90 questions and the time limit is about a minute per question. They are physically impossible. He does not teach at all, he just reads the textbook out loud during class. The tests are also nothing like the homework and quizzes so you have no idea what to prepare for
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do Not take this class. Honestly, the fact that Neeley allows this is insane. Good luck teaching yourself the whole class; the lecture revolves around reading the textbook. A 90-question final in 105 minutes is insane.
His test are in class 90 questions with only 105 minutes to complete. Don't take test are in person mostly everyone failed the final.
I hope you like witch trials. Professor Seng is a good teacher but he's GOING to accuse the entire class of cheating. It's apparently been multiple semesters in a row.
Good professor, not a very hard class. He isn't the greatest at teaching but the content is pretty self-explanatory. Tests aren't too bad. Do your work and should be an A
IGNORE OTHER REVIEWS! As soon as you cannot take exams remotely (which will happen), taking 90 question exams in 90 minutes is difficult. So if you thought this was going to be easy, think again...

If you reach out, he will help. Definitely picks favorites. He just reads from the textbook, so there are no notes. Tests are very long (at home and online), but he will give you extra time; they are usually pretty straightforward and similar to homework/quiz. Will probably accuse the entire class of cheating at some point.
Not the best teacher; he kind of just reads off the textbook and isn't the best option.

He is a nice guy and genuinely will help you if you care. There was one guy in my class who he didn't get along with because the kid just was on his nerves a lot. He lectures all class straight from textbook. Sometimes all over place but he isn't the worst.

He's not the best teacher for Fin Man as he doesn't really explain the concepts or teach you how to work out the problems. Weekly homework and quizzes aren't too bad. Tests are somewhat hard but are manageable if you study. You have to be able to teach yourself the materials to do good in this class.

Seng's class is interesting. He doesn't do online exams anymore because of AI, so be prepared for paper exams. He doesn't really teach but reads form the textbook and does a poll review every week. He is very kind and smart, but I don't think he teaches that well.
Easiest finman teacher. Online tests! No final. Weekly Hw's and quizzes on mylab but pretty simple stuff. He's willing to help you if you need it too.

Best FinMan option by far. All homework and tests are online. Attendance isn't mandatory at all, but would definitely recommend showing up because he knows the people who come and its the only way to actually learn the material.
By far one of my favorite professors at TCU!!! There were three take-home exams, and the third exam was the final. Weekly homework and quiz. Take him for Fin Man!!!
I loved him! He is so passionate about the industry and you could see that through the lectures! Take him!!
THE BEST. He's very passionate about the oil industry and you learn a lot in his class. Show up to class and you'll get an A.
One of the kindest, coolest, most amazing professors. Really engaging lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Such an amazing professor. I've taken her twice now and anytime I want to take an art history class, i always look for her. She is super funny and her lectures are great. She is very helpful and responds quickly to emails. You can tell she genuinely cares about her students. Make sure to take notes during every lecture for tests.

I only have 1 semester left at TCU and Professor Sepponen is without a doubt my favorite professor I have ever had. You definitely have to work hard in her classes, but it is obvious that she genuinely cares about her students. She is entertaining, smart, and always willing to help. She truly wants to see us succeed. Take her class!

Easily my least favorite class. If you want to learn how to do stats, don't take him. You are ultimately graded off of how well you can cheat on the exams which is very frustrating. He gets upset when he cold calls on you and you get the answer wrong and will embarrass you. If you miss 2 questions on the exam you get a B.
Wonderful professor. He cares about his students a lot and wants them to succeed. Work is very manageable, and Professor Seth should be everyone's first choice.

Funny guy but really does not teach the material well at all. Very hard to learn and transfer course material onto the exams. So few grades too. The 3-hour class is always less than 1.5 hours which is nice tho.

Doesn't take much time to get through a whole lecture, usually around 60-90 minutes for a 3 hour night class. Is super chill and can be funny, material is not hard but not too easy. Would 1000% take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Deepak is the guy. Has a good sense of humor and makes class enjoyable. I had him for a night class and he always took only 1/2 of the time. There were a couple tests and quizzes most weeks. I would recommend taking him. I took him for stat analysis.

For visual journalism I feel like there was a lot of ground to cover in a short amount of time. With Jim I felt not confident in any work I turned in simply because we were shown how to do something once, and never practiced how to do it again before turning in an assignment. That being said, he is an easier grader on assignments than expected.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hes alright
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Mr. Seeley's Intro to Visual Journalism is definetly not easy, but definetly worth it. The class is slpit in two sections with photography in the first half and video in the second half. Seeley is a former professional in the industry, so he knows his stuff. LOTS of projects throughout the semester and each section has a final project and test.

Professor Sears is genuinely one of the nicest and funniest professors I've had at TCU. I took his Sports Communication class, but it wasn't a very beneficial class if you actually want to go into that. However, his assignments and instructions were often unclear. He would make you feel bad for not understanding something never taught.

He is truly the nicest man, but the design of the course really decides your grade, so if you don't do well there is not much hope for recovery. I think you have to be uber commicative and CAN NOT be distracted in class to do well in the beginning. I LOVED all the projects and got above 90% on all. He is always willing to help too!!! .

I have had Professor Sears for two classes now and would happily take him again! Both Diversity and Sports Communication were interesting and fun! He is very clear on his grading and is very understanding if you talk to him when you're having trouble! Sometimes he cancels class or even lets us out early which is really nice! Highly recommend him!
Professor Sears is by far the best professor at TCU. He is the most caring man, and this is extremely apparent in his teaching style. Everyone should have the opportunity to meet Broc Sears!

Broc is a really nice professor but his exams at the begging of the semester sadly make or break your grade. I have a B- and have spent the majority of this semester on this class alone. I understand how to use the platforms we do design work on, however the tests have very tricky questions that are meant to trip you up.
Take this man's class every chance you can get. This is my third class with him and he is the best, more genuine professor I've had, also hilarious.

I've taken 4 classes with Broc because he is the BEST and ALWAYS will be. I learned the most in his classes because instead of lecturing, he gives you the tools to teach yourself. Trust me, his method works for 99% of students. He is always available to help you out with anything you need because he cares about his students.

Broc has been my favorite professor at TCU by far! He is very understanding and always puts his students needs first. Ask him questions, go to his office hours, and participate and he will know you are making an effort. This is my 4th semester taking one of his classes and I am telling you take him if you get the chance!!! The best for STCO!

Mr. Sears taught me in the University Life class. While this class is an easy A, he provided us with advice and tips to navigate our first semester of college with. He is always willing to help you and is only a text or call away. He is a tough grader on reflection papers but always offers to read it before you turn it in! High recommend! Sweet man

Professor Sears is the absolute best professor ever! He is the sweetest, most compassionate professor I have ever had. Class is actually fun to go to and allows you to question things in the real world. Take him if you have the chance!!

A lot of people love Sears but I don't really think he's the best professor. He's a super hard grader and is rude or sarcastic if he messes up on his end with grading. So many stupid assignments and class time is useless. He seems nice outside of a class setting, but is kinda rude in class.

Take Broc, his class is easy and you will pass with flying colors if you just show up and do the work. There are no test and no book to read from, just class participation and hand outs. I loved his class.
I was able to be creative with my assignments and have fun in this class.  There are no exams or quizzes, which is great.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Grades a bit hard but very doable.

I've Broc for Interactive Design, and Publications. Nicest and most helpful professor I've had at TCU. Truly cares about his students. He's a tough grader but he is up front about what he expects. Great guy.

Absolutely LOVE Broc. Who doesn't?! He's a tough grader, but he tells you exactly what he wants in advance. Half the reason I took this class was to have him as a professor again. Sweetest guy you'll ever meet and extremely understanding. If you ever get the opportunity to take his class it'll be a decision you will be happy you made.

Professor Sears is so so smart, and he is such a sweet teacher. Sometimes he brought candy to class. He is hard grader though. His class wasn't mandatory, so a lot of people don't go. If you go and talk to him, he will definitely help you. Your grade will be a lot better if you actually attend.

Broc is a great fun and helpful teacher. You really learn a lot in his class and he helps you to develop professionally. I learned so much in his class and  he dedicates time to give you good tips for your resume and things like that. I come to him for help with other classes and he's a good reference. His class is fair and he is a fair grader.

Interactive Communication Design. Projects are difficult and programs are tedious to work with. They do take a lot of time put into them. Broc was a fun teacher, he is always helpful. I thought he could do a better job of clarity of grading projects.

Interactive comm design was a very interesting and helpful class! Be prepared to spend a lot of time on your projects, but Broc is very helpful (he gives you his cell # so you can call him anytime w/ questions) and often will give extensions if you have problems. He is a really nice guy and you get to design your own personal website, which is cool

I learned more in this class in one week than in other classes all semester. It is not an easy class but I can get a page designed and put it on the web. I am going to take another of his classes. He is very helpful and wants you to do good. Unlike some of other teachers here he wants me to succeed not trick me into a C with tests anf lame papers.
study for the tests and do the projects a day before they are due....just in case of things.....broc is super sweet
Best, most useful class I've had.
Loved the pub design class!! He's so helpful and is always wanting you to do better. I would definitely take him!

this was one of my fav classes. i loved broc and i love design. u couldnt ask for a nicer more friendly easygoing prof. he is really nice about your designs, even if they are lacking. class is very time consuming, i wont lie. but so worth it. dont underestimate his tests, take some time to study. be prepared to spend time on your designs.good class

a very helpful and knowlegable teacher with a very good class.  take this class if you have any interest in the design aspect of ad/pr at all.  you will learn lots of applications for the tools you have learned like photshop and quark.

Good class, 10 designs, 2 tests. All fairly easy just study the powerpoints. Very accessable, but doesn't really help to better design. All in all, it is a really good class. I'm glad I took it, but FYI it is very time consuming--there is a design due weekly.

Good, helpful prof who always finds something good to say. Biggest problem is that he sometimes is not critical enough. Class is very laid-back and he's understanding if you can't make it sometimes. I learned quite a bit.

The lectures are a little boring, but he gives you a disk with them on powerpoint so you don't have to take notes in class. Although, it is kind of annoying that more of your grade comes from written tests rather than your design work. Still enjoyable.

Class - Art History Nazism and Looting. She's very kind and understanding. I will say you do need to take notes because you can't find it online (correctly) but I think it's worth it and she sometimes lets us out early and is always willing to help and talk after class or on zoom

her class was in this big movie theater room, she talks like Jodie Foster, so calm and you can really tell she knows what she is talking about. does not care about attendance. my favorite class would recommend anyone taking

Matthews is a good professor! She cares about her students and wants everyone to succeed. Clear about everything you need to know for the tests, mostly memorization based off discussion questions (do them, it gives you extra credit). Final was a group project! Even though her class is 3 hours, it's worth it if you need an art credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Matthews is so accommodating towards her students, and makes lectures interesting. For tests, you must memorize the material in great detail (which can feel like a lot), yet she explicitly tells you what pieces of art will be tested, so it is definitely manageable. Around half the time she lets class out early too.

Shelley Matthews is a great professor! She cares about her students and wants everyone to succeed. She is clear about everything you need to know for the tests and she grades very reasonably. Even though the class is 3 hours, her lectures are very interesting and she is very engaging. Definitely take her class if you need to take Art History.

Professor Matthews is super nice. Most of her classes are lecture heavy, but she makes them super interesting, and fun. She cares about her students, she is willing to help them if they need anything. The tests are not easy but if you study and do the Online discussions you will do good.

I absolutely loved Professor Matthews's class. Her class is by no means an easy A, but if you work hard on the papers and projects and study for her tests - you WILL do well. I found her class extremely interesting; if you lean into the material and put in the effort, you will do well. She is very willing to help with anything and give advice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Matthews is awesome!! The class is lecture heavy but she makes it interesting and engaging. Never have work outside of class and don't need to do the readings. Exams take lots of studying but if you study you'll do well. Doesn't take attendance but need to go to class to take notes. Lots of extra credit and smaller easy grades.
Tests are long and graded harshly. Study up.

Take this class, she is amazing! At first you will want to drop (just because it seems like a lot) but I promise you you will pass. She does not want to fail anyone (she says that would be too much paperwork, lol). Her grading rubric is extremely clear and offers plenty of extra credit! Attendance does not affect your grade, very little homework.

Great lectures! Very clear on what she expects. She provides study guides for tests although if you follow the class posts on TCU online you wont need them. She is approachable and really goes out of her way to help if you ask. Shes also quite attractive which helps keep your focus!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's awesome! class was all about power point lectures so don't skip, tests based on online responses. DO THE ONLINE STUFF EVERYTIME, and you'll get EC at the end of the year. Great teacher, knowledgeable and personable. Content was super interesting too!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: You have to show up for class! She doesn't take roll but her class is heavy on lecture. Miss a class, miss a lot. The text is dull. Her lectures are not. Grading is straight forward. Plenty of opportunities to recover from a stumble. Only three tests. Stay for the reviews. Final is not comprehensive. Taking her class is a positive experience.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Mrs. Matthews is a great teacher. I had no interest in art and only took this class for a credit. Although the lectures are long and the power points are all pictures, it's easy to follow along. I'm a terrible writer and got above an A- on all my papers in this class (50% of papers is format). If I had to take another art class, it'd be with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I seriously had no interest in art history prior to this class, and only took it for an fine arts credit. Dr. Matthews is awesome though! yes the class is 3 hours long, but totally worth it. lots of extra credit and tests are straight forward.
Take her for intro to art history! I wish she taught more art history. There's no excuse not to get an A....Unless you are incredibly lazy and don't study or you don't go to class.

Mrs. Matthews is AWESOME!!! If youre going to take art history, TAKE THIS CLASS. You should go to every class, but she doesn't take role. Otherwise you'll be screwed. Stay for the reviews and study what she tells you to, and the tests will be EASY! Very possible to get an A.

I took Intro. to Art History with her.  She is very kind and fair with grading.  She gives you credit for the work that you do, so just do your work.  Attend class so that you answer the randomly placed writing assignments (1 pt each) and make sure to complete at least ten discussion q/a on eCollege.  She is very available, even by cell. Learned al

She is AWESOME. favorite class of the semester.  she is so passionate about art history and easy to listen to. she is younger and very chill.  if you take good notes you'll be golden for tests. try to use her wording and terms on analysis as much as you can. TAKE THIS CLASS
She is an amazing teacher. Take really good notes and you'll do fine on the tests. She inspired me to minor in art history!

Great Teacher. She never got annoyed with me even though i emailed her constantly for help and advice. Failed first test but pulled it up with extra credit and the other 2 tests. This is a must take course. She really cares about her students and about the subject making the class great!

Wonderful professor!  Really wants her students to learn the significance of the art and because she has a passion for it, it made me like history!  Tests aren't all bad if you are good at memorization.  She is a very understanding and reasonable person and does her job very well.  Make sure you attend class since it's only once a week.

Great teacher! Tests are easy - memorize artist, date, and title - 4 short answer essays, 10 matching of terms, and 1 5 paragraph essay.  Writing assignments in class are a completion grade. Loved the class so much I decided to minor in art history. I would deffinitly recommend her. Be sure to show up to class and write down everything she says.

The class was very cool. Learned a lot about art. Covered almost all types of art. Tests were pretty easy...just straight up memorization of painting, artist, and date. She is extremely hot and I wouldn't mind having her again as my teacher!

She was really nice and entertaining but just overloaded us with information and then didn't really care to explain it all in a conceptual way. Her test reviews were substantially easier than the tests themselves and the homework assignments weren't helpful in prep.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. I do not recommend taking this professor although she is very funny. I appreciate her as a person and she makes classes enjoyable because of the way she teaches BUT this class is ridiculous. Her tests are significantly harder than any of the homework. This class is awful

I did study quite a bit for this class, but studying the provided material directly translates to the exams. I'm not even good at math or accounting and I got an A in the class. If you don't get one of the "better" professors, you will be more than okay. Study at least 3-4 days before exams, ask her questions, and find a friend to study with.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Basically, what the other 5.0s say, she's highly underrated on here because people don't care about the course and thought it was the teacher's fault. She's a good person once you get to know her, but some people don't care enough for that.

Not worth it. Literally graduate a semester late to avoid. Although Accounting is a difficult subject, Simpson is the worst option available. Try to take Troutman/Kelton for your social life not to be ruined. For those who have her, good luck. You will need it
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Ms. Simpson is like an onion—layers to peel before you see her fun side. She sets high standards and doesn't budge, which I respect. I took her class for two semesters and did well. I liked how the blended course was structured and clear. Great teacher if you put in the effort.

The whole ACCT department talks bad about her behind her back. Nice lady but the spawn of satan as a teacher. Tells random stories and doesn't get to the point of anything. The grad students can teach 10x better. Try to get Troutman/Kelton... godspeed
MAHSIVE FADE.
