reviews.comment: Super condescending - offers no help and makes you feel stupid if you ask a question. States that she "does not believe" in curving tests even though all the other professors do. Try to take someone else.
do not take
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is easily the hardest class I have taken yet at TCU. Although many Accounting teachers at TCU curve their tests, Simpson is the only class I have heard of that does not. After getting a tutor for this class and studying multiple hours a day for tests, a C was barely manageable. She is also not great with one on one help. Avoid if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very unnecessary during her lectures and talks about things that are not relevant. She is kind but that doesnt make up for the fact that she can explain things better. I feel criticized when asking her a question. She is not terrible, but really try and get someone else.

Avoid if possible. She makes everything 10x harder than it has to be. 3 exams and the final make up 85% of your grade. She moves very fast and expects that you've mastered the chapter before she even lectures about it. Be prepared to spend a ton of time studying and still not get good test scores. I had to get a tutor for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Definitely avoid taking at all costs. She is not an effective teacher, as her lectures are not effective. Expect to teach yourself fundamentals of accounting. Prepare to study for 40 hours and get a bad grade on the tests. Her practice problems are not indicative of what is on the test
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I actually didn't mind her class or her lectures but the tests are insane. Very unlike the homework problems and doesn't curve at all. Hard to learn from mistakes on tests because if you reach out to go over it she'll say, "We go over it in class." which is just her saying the right answers. Just memorization rather than understanding it.

ACCT is brutal but Professor Simpsons outlines are clear and she teaches effectively and helps set you up for success. Professor Simpson is kind and accomodating. She made the material easy understand and set clear expectations for the test. Make sure to do the not required pratice tests because they will help a great amount. Would take her again

Don't understand how she has bad reviews. Prof Simpson was one of the best professor's I have ever had. Her notes and lectures are helpful. People complain because accounting is a hard subject but the reality is she gives you everything you need to get an A, you just have to put in a little work.

Simpson is a great professor. Most of the bad reviews are given because of accounting being hard. She gives her students every opportunity to succeed in the course. Lectures are clear and she makes herself available for office hours. There are three exams and a final which are a majority of your grade. There are only two assignments a week.

Accounting in general is a tough class. This teacher in particular is not bad. I was able to learn a lot and perform well on exams. The exam average is typically a B- so if you study and do the homework you will do well. Only negative is that she talks so fast it scares me because she has to gasp for air.
Worst Accounting professor at TCU

Underrated professor getting bad ratings because accounting is hard? Clear lectures, willing to help, and her personality is pretty funny. 1 class day of notes, 1 class day of problems per chapter. This isn't Marketing Management people. Do the readings BEFORE class, complete ALL the practice problems, and STUDY several days in advance for tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Simpson is the reason I decided to pick up an accounting minor. I've noticed people complaining about her fill-in-the-blank notes, but I honestly find them incredibly helpful for the homework/tests. Her lectures are fast paced but she's happy to slow down and explain something if you ask. Tests are direct reflections of the HW/Notes.

ACCT is hard in general, but Simpson does her best in explaining it. Even if lectures don't make sense sometimes, practice the SB and HW problems weekly, look at solution/explanation. Building logic in ACCT is done with "practice" and repetition. Email/Office Hrs will help you know her better and understand when you make mistakes; look over notes!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I would avoid this class by any means possible. The homework and reviews do not help with the tests much at all. Expect to study for 40 hours and still end up failing the tests. There are much nicer and easier professors at TCU so I would recommend just doing that. Also, watch out for trick questions, the tests are ridiculously hard!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Do not take her if you can avoid it. She is a horrible lecturer and painful to sit through. The homework and provided practice material do not reflect the exams at all. She is not clear on material and he test questions make it ten times harder even if you know what you're doing.

Jaye Simpson doesn't adequately cover topics in class. Compared to other professors who do the notes with the students and engage, i could not say the same for professor Simpson. Her powerpoints are not engaging, she expects you to grasp important concepts without clarification, and she words test questions to confuse you. I wouldn't recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Jaye Simpson kept me up at night when all I wanted to do was catch some sleep. She is a disgrace to the TCU business school. If your looking for an accounting teacher, pick literally anyone else. It is better to avoid accounting entirely than to take this teacher. Get ready to study 24/7 and still get a horrible grade.

Stay away at all costs. She is such a tough grader. I hope you like F's because thats all your receive on your tests. There is no possible way to prepare for her tests because they are criminally hard. She also talks nonstop during class. Be prepared to listen to her ramble the whole class.
Super hard teacher and does not teach class well at all. Honestly embarrassing tcu would hire her. You fill in the blanks like you are in third grade for the in-class notes. Must avoid this one.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: For such a difficult class, Professor Simpson does a great job of making sure you have the materials to be prepared for the quizzes and tests. Lots of homework, quizzes, and tests, but we are given plenty of class time to get the work done and ask any questions we have.

The class is very test heavy but she tries to give you easy homework and participation that can help balance out your grade. She is a really good teacher and is always willing to help the students. If you do the in class problems before the test then you are set up to make a good grade. Absolutely love her!

She was so great, this is a super tough class but she makes it so much better, she is straight forward and explained everything very well. I would absolutely take her for accounting she is great! Homework is not too much, exams are the same through the department

Professor Simpson is a really great teacher; she wants her students to succeed. Accounting is a difficult subject so you'll have to work to learn everything; definitely the most demanding class of my semester. The exams can be difficult especially if you're underprepared, but she does a good job of reviewing for exams and quizzes.

Professor Sims is a great teacher; she truly cares about her students! Her course was pretty reading heavy with on average 3 readings a week every MWF there was usually a reading or assignment due. Also be ready to participate in class discussions based on the weekly readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: super hard and specific grader.

Super sweet lady. A bit of reading for each class accompanied by a quiz, but they are generally easy, with only 5 questions. In class participation counts big time, but she makes discussions super engaging and free flowing. The papers, which are only 2 in number, are very easy to get done, and she grades mercifully. Must take class for the credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is a very nice and understanding professor. There is an assigned reading every class for homework but it's not too bad. She does grade on participation so it is important to talk during class discussion time. There is 4 essays and two are pretty long but she doesn't grade on how good your writing is. Pay attention and do your work. Easy A!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Love love love. 100% recommend
I understand that professor simon has left TCU, but he taught so well and made class so fun that I would take him again in a heartbeat
Best professor I have ever had. This man cares about you and your education, always going above and beyond for his students.

Professor Simon is a former FBI Agent and an amazing professor. He is very accessible outside the classroom for any questions regarding the FBI or class. I went to almost every office hour to talk to him about his career in the FBI and he was more than helpful in providing me answers about it and helping me. Could not recommend him enough!
funny stories about his time in the FBI, really cares about you understanding the material, his CSI (Crime Scene Investigation) class is definitely the coolest class I will take at TCU

I've had Simon for 5 semesters in a row, he is that great. His lectures are all very exciting and he has great stories to go along with it! His tests and quizzes are very straight forward and as long as you take decent notes on the power point you'll get an A. I could not recommend him any more for anyone taking any Criminal Justice classes.

HE IS AMAZING. Lectures are interesting and he always adds a story from when he was with the FBI to give examples. Very approachable and responds quickly to emails. He wants you to pass. Super down to earth. Quizzes are directly from powerpoints and test questions are directly from quizzes (you don't really need the textbook).

Simon is one of the best professors I've had at TCU. His quizzes/exams come straight from his ppts, so attendance isn't necessary to do well in the class. He makes class enjoyable and tells interesting stories about when he worked with the FBI. Practical exercises in small groups are simple and fun, and nothing like group projects in other classes.

Favorite theatre professor I've had- Michael really cares about all of his students and makes a lot of effort to help everyone out.  I knew nothing about lighting and was able to succeed with his help.
one of the few professors in the department who truly cares about the students, not just their grades. projects are easy if one pays attention to the directions step by step.
Really great guy and is just fun to be with...
He really cares and helps nd teaches!! Great guy!!

Michaels is a good professor, he explains all that you need to know.  and dudes, lighting wasn't ath hard.  I mean, seriouly.  The man TEACHES you everything you need to know.  Michael is a cool dude.
No Comments
No Comments
Great guy, willing to help you and work with you.  The class could be hard if you dont try, but you learn a lot.  If you put forth an effort you will make an A.  Micheal is a great guy

Thompson is an amazing professor, one of my favorite classes by far. Show up on time, stay off phone, pay attention and keep up on assigned readings, and you got an easy A. He's humorous, at times this class was a little boring, but if you actually try he will give you more than enough support. He cares and loves his students!!! i reccomend taking
He is a great professor! There is a lot of reading that comes with the class, and a lot of quizzes over the reading. If you read, the class is super easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr Sidney Thompson is a successful author who is veyr knowlegable on english and writing. Your grade will bve fully based on tests and quizzes. There are quizzes everyday on reading and we red a lot of books, maybe 7, and you need to purchase 3.

Dr. Thompson is a nice guy, but the workload is overwhelming for a core class. With a quiz almost every class over 50-70 pages of reading, attendance is basically mandatory. Lectures are very boring- no slides, just him discussing elements of the reading. The quizzes overall aren't too hard, but there's a lot of them. 1 midterm, project, and final.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I imagine the lectures may be boring if you do not find learning about creative writing to be interesting in the first place. But if you are actually interested in learning, I would encourage anyone with a passion for learning to take Dr. Thompson. If you show up, do the work, and actually put forth effort, it should be an easy A. He's a nice guy.

This class was boring, we would spend the whole class period talking about homework, we never learned topics to enhance our writing. Grades things VERY tough, very few things that go towards your grade. I would not take this class again as it was boring and I thought it was a waste of time. He did not want to give out As.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy A if you can write, super boring lectures though. Every lecture was just talking about the homework readings. Papers were easy though, only three big writing assignments. Take him if you want an easy writing class that you could write about anything, but beware, the lectures are truly boring and I hate to be mean but they are. Nice guy though
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Dr. Thompson's class because he focused on developing our writing skills through different smaller writing assignments. His class is not difficult. As long as you stay up to date with the writing assignments every other week and attend his class, you are good! He takes time to write comments on your papers, so you know what to focus on.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class and this professor but be ready to write and read. There are reading quizzes (taken online and at home) after each reading assigned for homework. He is also kinda tough on grammar but is super willing to meet and help you.

He always put an effort to make everyone feel comfortable. He is very understanding, and wants students to succeed. If you complete the few assignments, participate, and attend to class, you have an easy A. 
As a side note, he is part of the writing center, I highly recommend it for any papers you have, is really helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you do most of the reading, the quizzes are easy. Thompson was a funny and great professor. Easy to get an A if you put in some effort. He likes when students talk to him during lectures, could be about the material or anything at all. Our class would applaud for him at the beginning of lectures just to be funny and he loved it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Thompson's a nice guy. Go to class, read a little, and you'll get a good grade. The readings are super short too. Don't know why anyone would dislike him lol. This was definitely not a challenging class. If you try at all, you'll be good. But I guess if you're expecting a blowoff class, you might be little disappointed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Thompson is an amazing instructor. He genuinely cares, and if you communicate, you are sure to improve as a writer over the course of the semester. This course was not work-heavy at all, w/ very short readings to go over before class and the occasional homework. Even his attendance policy is fair. If you put in any effort at all, easy A!

I took this class in an effort to get away from my major classes and this was perfect! There was minimal work involved outside of class but I actually was able to learn a lot from this class and even got my work published! He is a very caring professor and anyone who says otherwise is literally not putting in any effort. Take him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Dr Thompson is one of the best professors at TCU. Tremendous at explaining how stories and poems work and helping you adopt the strategies in your own writing.

Dr. Thompson is one of the only professors at TCU that I have ever had an issue with. The class has tons of wasteful busywork, and he can be extremely unkind to students. This class took away any love I had for creative writing, and I would not recommend this course or professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I have taken at TCU. He is incredibly passive aggressive and grades way too hard for a basic level course. He is not caring or understanding at all when it comes down to not having certain resources due to COVID-19.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Thompson is an amazing professor, poet and novelist. He knows how to engage the class and teach you how to be a better reader and writer. His class was my favorite every week. But maybe I'm biased. I wanted to learn and be inspired and Dr. Thompson didn't disappoint. He's generous with time one on one, funny, and wants to see students improve.
Worst professor I have ever taken in TCU. He thinks everybody in his class is a professional writer. Don't take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: If you have a great grandmother that is in and out of the hospital, health issues to where you have to see the doctor often, or any other legitimate reason and you have to miss class, then do not bother taking this class. He does not care. I was on track for a passing grade but he failed me because of attendance despite my circumstances.

Dr. Thompson is an amazing professor who just wants his students to succeed. There is a book (an easy read) that you are assigned to read a chapter for the following class. No tests, but the quizzes are based on the book & grammar lessons (easy points). Easy project at the end of the semester & final is a paper about the epilogue of the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Easiest class I ever took. Weekly homework could be BSed during class if you didn't do it. Only write 2 poems, one nonfiction story and one fiction. Easy easy A and you get 4 skips. Take Thompson if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Thompson is a cool guy and his class is pretty laid back. Monotonous busy work due each class but isn't challenging at all. Do the daily assignments and go to class and you'll be fine. No tests.

Would highly recommend for Sociology majors and non-majors alike. She is  incredibly clear and knowledgeable, cultivates a fascinating curriculum, has great rapport with students, and is overall great just to chat with! She has great energy and is just generally a lovely person.

Smith-Tran was one of the sweetest and most enjoyable teachers I've had. She gives homework readings of the textbook, but I never opened the book and finished with a high A since her Powerpoints just cover the book information she wants you to know. Everything was open note. A couple of weekly assignments but they required minimal effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Smith-Tran is probably my favorite professor here at TCU. I absolutely loved her class, too. She was a very fair grader and if you do all the work and participate in lecture, it is definitely a class you can get an A in. She was always a very fair grader and wasn't afraid of giving you a 100 if you met her criteria. A wonderful professor!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I took this class during my sophomore year. Dr. Smith-Tran is an amazing professor and has become one of my favorites at TCU. She's well-versed in Sociology and knows her stuff. As long as you attend class, do the reading, you'll be fine for her exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Smith-Tran is really sweet, and her class is not hard. If you want a sociology credit where you only have to read a few pages a night to get an A, I would recommend her. Yes, you have to study a little bit for her exams but she is very helpful and really wants you to love sociology! Her class is by far the easiest and is still interesting to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Smith-Tran is a good teacher but her tests are very hard which makes up the majority of the grade. She does give extra credit but will not round your grade up no matter how close it is. You will have to study a ton to do well on her tests. I would not recommend.

Dr. Smith-Tran is kind and knows her stuff. She has a good balance of lecture to discussion, and wants students to be engaged. She's super down for students during office hours, and is really just trying to get everyone to care about sociology as much as she clearly does! Definitely do the reading if you want those quiz grades to stay high.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I took her my freshman year and she is a great professor. She really cares about your learning and the tests are not hard at all as long as you pay attention in class and red the material she tells you too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Smith-Tran is such a great professor and really cares about her student. I took her intro to sociology class and enjoyed it. Shes very understanding and is always willing to help her students. This class in particular is extremely easy and definitely recommend to take it as a core.

Dr. Smith-Tran is a wonderful woman with a huge depth of knowledge, especially in medical sociology. She handles conflict in class well, and she's got a ton of sources to back up whatever stance she goes for. It is important to know that this is NOT an easy A in any way and should not be taken as such.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I think this is your best choice for sociology classes, but I will say that her class is very lecture-heavy. She gives little room for discussion which I think should be a vital part of a sociology class, but because she is so straight forward with her study guides, I would say she is a good choice for an intro sociology credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor and really cared for his students and there success
Learned a lot about photography from him which I find very valuable.
This class is a great learning tool for studio photography more so than learning to shoot people. Really enjoyed it though. There is a lot of freedom in choosing subjects and creativity.

He is an expert with the camera photoshop. You will learn the basics, but he is willing to teach you more if you want. Projects are ARTISTIC based, not commercial so feedback is a bit murky. 1 test, 1 presentation, 9 photo assignments. Can be a jerk but, do what your suppose to do and you will get an A. Gives alot of class time to finish projectcs

I thought this class was very interesting and made me want to photograph more. I tried really hard and made a B, but I talked to him about my grades and he bumped me up four whole points to get an A. He can be moody, but get on his good side and you will be on joking terms with him. I would definitely recommend him!

If you're not good at photography to begin with, I wouldn't necessarily suggest taking this class. However, if you want to take the time to improve and take tons upon tons of pictures, then you can pull an A. Seriously, you can't miss a class or you'll get a B. But he's a nice guy, moody sometimes (WATCH OUT) but overall great class!

Honestly, I came in to the class expecting him to be horrid based on the reviews I read, but I haven't found that to be the case at all. He does get a bit moody sometimes, but he's not an awful teacher, although it is annoying how specific his taste is and the fact that it's an objective grade. I still managed an A though.
I love him! he is a great teacher. he is really helpful and if you put in effort you will get an A!!
He is an ass... one time he started cussing at me and i was like wtf. I almost sued him but not worth my time. He feels like he is so good but not even close.

Horrible teacher. He is very moody, somewhat condescending to students and it is impossible to tell what in the world he wants from you. Also- every day you miss a class or are not there before he starts teaching, your grade suffers. Don't take him if you can help it.
This guy must be bipolar. He is very testy, I never new what mood he was going to be in. I loved the class but didn't like the prof.
No Comments

awful teacher unless you ONLY want to photograph trees.  the only thing he knows how to teach is the "shine fluke theory".  he refused to teach me how to use the studio because it wasnt landscape and spent 4 years staring at my chest.  he's a bit
awesome.  he is so helpful.  If you go to class everyday, and do all of the critiques, you'll get a B.  If you show improvement, you could get an A.
He has his moods (and avoid him during) but he is insightful, full of suggestions and will always help.  Worth the work, knows his stuff and loves what he does.
HE IS A GOOD TEACHER. BUT VERY MOODY.  BEWARE.  STAY OUT OF HIS WAY WHEN HE IS IN A BAD MOOD!  MAKE SURE YOU DON'T USE ILFORD PAPERS IN HIS PRINTERS.

Brandon was super chill and made macro very easy to understand. Very nice and often talked with him after class about global macro concepts. Make sure you study for the test or at least understand the concepts form the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a good professor but your grade is based off of only exams and quizzes. the exams are so hard and I felt like I was making an educated guess on every question, I studied a lot. The quizzes are pop and are 1 or 2 questions so if you get one wrong you fail the quiz. There aren't that many quizzes. I don't know how to feel tbh just be warned.

Best macro professor to take. No homework. 4 exams all year that are challenging. As long as you study a little bit and pay some attention, you'll definitely pass. Honestly watched college basketball the whole time and I have an A+. Take the guy
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: NO homework so test and pop quizzes matter. Also doesn't let you miss class- you lose points at the end of yr to you need to go to class. Tests are super easy and you do review before each test. Rly easy class and chill teacher I think like everyone gets As.

FAVORITE professor i've ever had!! Took him for micro & macro... wish he taught more classes so i could take his class again. Try's to keep his lectures interesting and is really funny. Try's to get to know his students and treats you like a friend if you get to know him. Optional homework, no projects, just have to do is do good on tests.

Great dude. Loves to make jokes and side chat in class. Mandatory attendance. Tests are worth 80 percent of your grade so you do need to do well but can be accomplished easily if you study a little bit. Pop quizzes but mostly common sense.

Well, he's a good professor and his exam is kinda chill. But I had a problem with the first exam and one pop quiz even though other tests and quizzes I have more than 90, my score still dropped from A to B =(
So, exams matter a lot and you won't have any extra credit.

Explained microeconomics and information extremely well in lectures. He is encouraging, kind, and funny. I would highly suggest him for a microeconomics professor. Few quizzes and exams. Exams are major part of grade so study well. I was always excited to go to his class. :)

He is a very funny teacher who explains economics well. The tests are all multiple-choice and as long as you take notes during lectures and review the posted questions you should excel in the class. There are not a lot of assignments in his class, so every test/ pop quiz matters a lot. Overall, great teacher, easy course, and he is the best.
Brandon is one of my favorite professors I've had. Test heavy though.
He's amazing, just be ready to take notes during lectures.
He was very enjoyable and exiting, and made the content easy to understand. Always willing to explain things further and help. Had a handy little toolbelt with markers so he can draw graphs anywhere.
Brandon was a really nice and funny teacher. He made lessons really easy to learn but overall he was one of my favorite professors

Brandon is such a cool guy, he is always willing to hear you out about your test grade, and if you have a reasonable answer as to why your answer was right he'll give you the points. You still have to work for it in this class, but I have thoroughly enjoyed his class. He has made Macro fun, even when its at 5:30 pm.

One of the best professors I have had at TCU! He has a great sense of humor which makes his lectures engaging and fun. He is willing to adjust exam grades if you present a good case in class. Is easily accessible over text, email, office hours. If you don't necessarily love macro but want to be engaged take this professor!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Brandon was a great teacher, funny and really explained economics well. He does have a couple pop quizzes but they are easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Definitely take him for econ! He is very funny and lecture can be kind of boring but he tries to make it more interesting. He does not give any homework, but there are occassionally pop quizzes, though you don't need to study for them because they are 1 question and pretty easy. For exams, just study your notes from class and you'll be fine.

Take him for Econ! He is super personable and funny. Lectures are engaging. Tests and quizzes are the only thing that impacts your grade so you should study. Tests are very fair with what you learn in class but sometimes difficult. Take notes in class and on the power points he sends out and practice the hw. Overall I enjoyed this class.

He is the best, so funny, and great class environment . I really enjoyed going to his class. I definitely had to study for the tests, as they could be difficult. But he really works with his students and will always be there for them. I recommend him!
Mr. Smith was very responsive to emails. Economics is a hard concept for me, but his class was very helpful to me.

I wish I could take Professor Smith for all my classes. He is engaging and really cares about his students. I truly learned a lot, but also had a great time doing it. He really breaks down all the concepts really well so they are easy to understand. If you do your reading and go to class, you will do well and probably have some fun too.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Very easy teacher, he gives a one question quiz at the beginning of each class, but there's no need to study for them. Never takes attendance, and never goes the full three hours of the class. He's always willing to explain things to you, and meet outside of class. Very easy and basic intro micro class
love love love him. it's an easy class if you read and keep up. he is so helpful and makes himself very available to his students

I had him his very first semester and there was a little learning curve between teaching middle school and college. However, the class itself was nice and easy. Quiz every class (MC and impossible not to get a 100 so go to class) and three major tests. Really listened to all feedback and wanted to get to know us as people. Recommend if pre-business
Pretty good professor. Quizzes are so easy that it's impossible to not get a 100 on them. Tests are easy as long as you read the book. Also is pretty funny. Definitely take him again

I must say for a professor's first semester teaching, he did an amazing job. He always offered help, and he would keep you interested in the lectures. There was a quiz every single class period, but there was no homework due. You really have to study for the tests to get an A, but again, he offers a lot of help. I would take him again!

Mr. Smith was so caring and truly wanted his students to learn! I loved his class so much so showing up wasn't hard. We got 3 skips. Typically there were reading quizzes every 1-2 weeks but they were easy. Papers and tests as well but they weren't too hard.

Professor Smith is an amazing professor! He's very passionate about what he teaches and also provides a great deal of healthy feedback for improvement. Quizzes are very doable and easy if you are keeping up with the readings, participation also matters if you are a frequent skipper because it will reflect on your grade.

Great professor with very interesting content. There are reading quizzes but they are very easy if you have done the reading. The assigned reads are easy and interesting and I am one that doesn't particularly like reading. He clearly cares for all students and I enjoyed his class. If you skip more than 3 classes it will affect your grade.

PLEASE TAKE SMILOR!!! He is an absolutely amazing professor who genuinely cares for his students. Homework is light to none depending on the week. Participate in the activities he creates, they're so much fun. I can say I've learned more in this class than any other I've taken so far.

You want to take this class! It is just a business elective, but probably one of the most fun classes you will ever take. Smilor is hilarious and just fun to be around. Do activities that have business learning points to them. TAKE!!

I don't care what you have to do. Take Smilor. Even If his class is on a Friday night, I would have rather gone to his class than 90% of any parties. He is hilarious and jokes around with the class like he's a student himself. Light homework and fun projects. In all my years in school, he has been my favorite professor. I REPEAT: TAKE SMILOR!!!!!!!

Smilor is the best! You can tell he loves teaching. There is a lot of reading, but the books are actually fun to read. There's always something interesting to do in class whether its building paper airplanes or coming up with a music piece with instruments out of a bag. Super fun class and great teacher!

Intelligent, professional, and has great insight on today's "critical issues" in politics and the law enforcement system. One paper due every week based off one chapter reading. The paper's aren't difficult because he gives you a guideline of how he wants the paper set up. Encourages class participation and makes you feel heard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: He was nice and made the class fun.  He treated each student with respect and encouraged participation.  We rarely got out early though.

I thought the class wasn't that bad. I took it at night and he usually let us out early. Also we had about 3 guest speakers that were interesting. Easy A if you read the book. Which isn't hard to keep up with (not much reading) he assigns only one chapter at a time.

Terrible class! Boring-even if you're interested in the subject.  Hard to stay awake b/c he talks about pointless stuff that's not in the book or on his tests. Don't need to take notes, just read the book and you'll be fine. Pretty easy A but you have to do all the work on your own outside of class, only reason I went was b/c he took attendance
He is pretty easy, and very nice.  But he isn't really willing to help your grade out all that much.  BEWARE: this class is very long and he rambles.  pretty easy B though
this man rambles about nothing. read the book and you will be fine. he takes attendance but there is really no reason to be in class because you have no idea what this man is talking about!

I took Deep Learning in Fall of '25 and Dr. Slaughter is one of the best professor's I've taken at TCU. He has deep knowledge of AI from staying up-to-date on current trends to line-by-line coding expertise, and explains it really well. I now have a deep understanding of how LLMs work and it is awesome. Weekly Assignments are short but enriching.

His AI course was tougher than Blockchain for sure. The course is evolving, so this review will probably be irrelevant soon. HW, Labs and the Project are easy. His classes are just lectures, but his exams can be tough to study and prepare for, as his study guides are limited. You really need to understand how AI works for you to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a brilliant person. If you are interested in what he is teaching, you will understand his classes. He is super available (has replied to my emails at 11 PM before submission). You can learn a lot from him - I had 4 classes with him at TCU.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Slaughter is a very straight-forward professor with 2 exams, a group project, and homework. The homework is weekly and easy. The exams are a bit tough, but he provides a study guide beforehand. The group project is simple as well, if you split it up correctly. Overall, he is a very intelligent and passionate professor who loves to teach
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Slaughter is a great professor really knows his stuff. Probably would be good to know some python beforehand, but if not you'll be fine. Just got to study and get hands on with the coding to get a good understanding, and review the PowerPoints. Put the work in early to get a good base understanding if you get behind you will get lost.

His AI class is super tough. He is honestly too smart. For the average business student, this class is way to coding-heavy. The exams are super difficult with a timed coding exam. Probably one of the hardest classes I've taken and its an elective.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Slaughter is the man. Good guy, just try and you'll do good. Chill class, fintech certif is the move

he's an amazing professor who genuinely cares about the success of his students above all else. data man was a hard class and the powerpoints weren't much help, but he's such a nice guy who gives credit wherever possible. he's super lenient and despite me thinking i'd do poorly in the class i ended with a good grade

Really great professor. Genuinely cares for his students and very willing to help outside of class. Likes interaction with students and values people who speak in his class. Power points are typically vague so going to class is important.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Grading system was so whack. He aid that he had to keep his classes at a 3.02 average GPA, so only a couple kids get As. I don't understand that but everyone was so concerned with how the grading worked and what you had in the class, it kind of took away from the actual learning. Good class, good teacher; it was interesting & I learned a lot.
Everyone in this class was more worried about the grading system than the actual work that needed to be done. Great material, but its hard to concentrate when everyone wants to talk grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class gives you MBA-like experience. Teaches with real-world experience and is respected by all students. Great professor! Would take again.
Easy A, and very fun class. I never read textbook, but the quizzes are over it so never made an A on a test. But still got A+ in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Sloan's class is very straightforward. There are open book chapter quizzes from weekly reading assignments, dance movement days, a few small group projects, and discussion posts with replies. The midterm and final do take a lot of work, but Dr. Sloan sets you up with the tools you need to succeed! Definitely take Dance in World Cultures!

Professor Sloan is amazing! She's very understanding and is very passionate about dance. The class is pretty simple. There are weekly discussion boards and quizzes. The textbook is required and there are no test, only 2 projects (1 for midterm and 1 for the final).
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is very nice and caring. Textbook needs and lectures for weekly quiz. The quiz might be a lil challenging, but there are other projects and extra credits opportunities to bounce back the grade. Strongly recommended!
She is very kind and helpful, the class is very easy attendance is mandatory. lots of extra credit
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I loved Dance in World Cultures with Professor Lily. She was easy to talk to and made class enjoyable! The tests are online and open book, and movement days in the rec center are actually a lot of fun. Take her!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Professor Sloan. She is super nice and really accessible. You get to have movement days in the rec for an hour or less and they are actually fun. I loved this class! TAKE HER!

Great great class highly recommend very easy A. Show up to class for attendance, after that take a nap, play on your phone, do whatever it doesn't matter. All the quizzes are online and straight out of the textbook.

You watch a lot of movies. ALL tests are online. The midterm is a group research project/presentation. The final is a research project you do by yourself. Its a pretty easy A as long as you do the work. Lily is pretty laid back. There are also 2 movement days where you go to the rec and dance which is pretty cool!

Very nice teacher. She seems pretty young but her class was interesting and very laid back. She gives you two absences and all of her tests are online and open book. Overall it was a pretty good class and easy A if you do your work. She also offers extra credit

Such a sweet professor and an easy A.  There are weekly online quizzes which can be intense, but I got 70s on most of them and still have a 97 in the class.  Papers and presentations are easy 100s.  Only thing kind of tough is you need a 96 in the class to get an A and you're only allowed two absences.

Professor Slocumb is such a nice and good teacher!! You have about 3-4 assigned books, but they're actually really interesting. You have daily quizzes over the pages you read the night before, but if you read them you'll do well. I asked her what I needed to get on my final paper to make an A and she ended up giving me the grade. 10/10 recommend!

Nice person, mediocre professor Lectures could last 10-15mins max but she likes to hear herself talk the entire time Lectures consist of her talking about homework/syllabus for over half the class Homework is pretty much quantity>quality. Its busy work that is extremely annoying Honestly the most useless class I have taken. I dont recommend her
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Wonderful person, average professor. Most of your grade will come from quizzes every class that are very specific, a couple of papers, and a lot of group work. The group work is honestly my biggest complaint- it just felt so pointless, like busy work. Lectures are dry, but that's not her fault. The books we were talking about were just boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Slocumb is really a sweet teacher. The class discussions are a lot of fun. She grades a little tough on the essays. There really isn't much work for the class. Just take the simple quizzes, keep up with the readings which aren't very much and turn your essays in on time. :)

Great professor! She's very nice and understanding. As long as you keep up with the reading, study class material for tests, and attend class, you will do fine. However, you must handwrite your notes and she does not post grades online.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She randomly throws out quizzes over the readings which are super specific, won't post grades online, and won't post lecture slides while expecting you to hand-copy paragraphs of information down in class. The books you read are pretty easy but still sucks when you have 100 pages to read every two days.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Hard grader he doesn't clearly communicate his expectations. I went in to get help from him and he had no advice to give. I would not ever recommend taking him.

He grades tough, but he is really nice and genuinely wants to make you a better writer. He speaks very slowly, but is pretty funny. The AP Quizzes are hard, but they get easier eventually. He grades you more on how much progress you've made in the class. It's kind of boring and stressful, but it helped me become a better writer.

Media Writing and Editing should be called how to write newspaper stories. BORING. He talks slow, but he's a nice guy, however, AP quizzes are kind of hard for nothing... If you dont want to be a news reporter, this class feels like a waste. You wont get an A unless you're a natural reporter. No homework, go to class, grades are based on writing

Dr. Slater is a nice man who wants you to succeed. The AP quizzes are hard if you don't study, and his writing assignment are fairly easy. If you don't understand what he wants go in and see him. I went from having a C to a B+ in about two weeks. He didn't grade anything until half way through the semester. He is easy I would strongly reccommend hi

Nice old man who really cares about what he is doing. He knows his stuff and has been around a long time. His class is easy except for the AP quizzes, which you really need to study for. He is very helpful and wants everyone to succeed. Take him if you get the oppurtunity.

Horrible professor. Teaches you nothing, unclear on what will be graded. Makes you write stories daily, but never discusses the assignment to say what you did write/wrong. Hard grader. Doesn't teach. Expects everyone in the class to already know what they are doing, and thinks everyone wants to be a journalist. NOT TRUE.

Professor is not helpful at all. She does not provide much guidance with homework. DEFINITELY read and participation is important. 
One of the worst professors taken. AVOID.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee is excellent! I was a bit scared because of the reviews; however, she is an incredible professor. Her class has lots of readings, discussions, and writing; however, if you do what you are supposed to, you will definitely have an A. She is accessible outside of the classroom and answers emails quickly. Don't be afraid; she is great!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: cinema of spain was the hardest class I've taken at TCU so far. it felt like I was expected to have film knowledge about theory and cinema (which I did not). lots of reading and multiple essays on movies, documentaries, and academic papers. this class required a lot of energy. the content was difficult to understand. pop quizzes.

Worst professor I've had at TCU. She will humiliate you in front of the entire class for any tiny mistake. She is not approachable- the one time I tried to go to her office hours it was a nightmare and her emails to any questions I have are rude. She does not provide clear instructions/expectations for any assignment, yet is a really harsh grader.

If you don't think like her forget it. Very critical and demanding. Also, if you ask for help, she will turn you away. DO NOT take if you plan on reading heavily every day, and every class is mandatory. She will make sure to pick on you, but make sure is something that she agrees on, because if not she will disregard your input.

Professor Lee isn't clear on what she wants or what will be on the tests. The test content never pertained to anything from her lectures. She wouldn't allow me to use my testing accommodations and is a very tough grader. The class averages on tests were often in the 50s and she never specified the reasons why we weren't doing well. Avoid her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Sra. Lee is a great Spanish professor. Her classes are very difficult and she is a tough grader, but if you show her that you are putting in the effort and improving during her course, she will grade fairly. I would recommend any of her classes if you genuinely want to improve your Spanish speaking and writing skills.

Best Spanish teacher I've ever had, truly. I was so intimidated by her at first and she is allllll business, but I learned Spanish like never before in a Spanish class. Do your work, show up, speak in class, and you will be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: At first she seems tough and hard but once the class settles in and you get to know her and she see's that you try hard, care, and want to succeed she will help you as best as she can. Sometimes is hard grader but can be forgiving if you ask for help. Don't be afraid to ask questions as she is very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: oral comm every day we do the same things. one day each student must have a short anecdote prepared to recite to the class. the next day is a dialogue with a partner in which you prepare a conversation for homework and present it to the class. teacher picks favorites and does not explain clear grading criteria for assignments/projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's tough, but helpful if you ask for it. However, my biggest problem is that she definitely seems to favor girls over guys. This transcends from how she treats you to how she grades. Girls - have at it. Guys - look elsewhere first. Don't believe me? Take a look at the literature in her office.

Ms. Lee is a very nice professor and she is always trying to help you out. She is funny and her class was pretty relaxed. Not a hard class, and you should get by with an A because she lets you rewrite the essay and pretty much gives you every opportunity to get an A with participation and easy tests. Wanting to take again.
She's a sweetheart!

Lee is the best teacher I've had this semester. She is super funny and outgoing and makes class interesting. She is super helpful if you don't understand the material. She only speaks in spanish which freaked me out at first but you get used to it after a week or two. Definitley take her.

Senora Lee is very interesting at first - hard to get a hand on. Once you get used to her though, she is really helpful with spanish. She speaks a little fast but it really helps in the long run trying to comprehend her. Tests can be a little difficult but if you visit her outside of class, she walks you through everything. Very sweet lady.

GREAT TEACHER!! She really helped with Spanish. I would try to take from her again if I could! She's phenomenal. The class isn't easy but you learn a lot and I maintained an A throughout the whole class. She's awesome and fun!

Oral Comm in Spanish is fast paced with several presentations, but the classes are relaxed and conversation based so it's easy to get her off topic :) Nice professor, very funny at times. Speaks Spanish better than English. Class is taught in Spanish but it's easier to understand than you think. No tests.

She is a very helpful teacher. She tries to do what she can to help students understand better. She is fair when she grades, but you also have to do the work to figure out what you got wrong. If you have questions, she is available and helpful during her office hours. A great redeeming quality to the class is her leniency on the oral exam.
Shouldn't be a spanish teacher. Very hard to understand and isn't clear about certain instructions. Would't recommend taking her class. Isn't helpful with your mistakes

Very hard class. Extremely hard grader. Very theoretical thinker and she doesn't like the obvious answers. If it isn't philosophical, don't bother. Barely made a B-. Participation is key. If you don't, you're screwed. If you do, make sure it is worth while or else she will shut you down. Take this professor with caution.

Great professor, not an easy class but very straight-foward. Have to work for an "A" and she takes attendance, but is very good at going over tests beforehand. It's a fast-paced class but if you keep up with the online assignments and study outside of class, doing well is definitely possible!
Hard Class. Killed myself for a B

Hard to understand her English, but wonderful in Spanish. Really strict about attendance and tardiness. The class has WAY too many tests, but it's required by the university. Heavy online portion, but manageable. Very helpful whenever you need her.

Very interesting class because you are able to watch movies but there is a lot of reading and homework and you are expected to have read for each class because she will ask you questions and you get a participation grade. Some what easy B very hard A
Hands down the easiest class I have ever taken. Sosa is extremely caring and understanding and there is hardly any work in the class. Easy A, definitely take her if she's available
Just take her! Even if its an 8am-- just take her i promise you won't regret it! Again, just do it!

This was probably the easiest class I have taken so far. There was only one thing due a week on Sunday nights, but it was so easy. There are a few papers but she grades super easy. Attendance was mandatory at the beginning of the semester, but she changed that around halfway through.
SHE IS AWESOME! Take this class. So easy. You don't have to ever go to class, but she is so sweet and passionate that you will want to.

The easiest class I have ever taken. Attendance not mandatory because you could complete it online. Open book tests and you did them on your own time. She is incredibly caring and sweet and wants the best for her students. Got a 100 in the class...

TAKE THIS CLASS! This is probably the easiest class I have ever taken. It was very interesting, and we barely had any assignments. Attendance is mandatory, but it is taken through a question in D2L, which is open all day, so you don't have to actually go to class as long as you do the question. I would recommend this class 100%

This is the easiest class I have taken this semester, and it fulfilled my SSC credit. If you need an easy credit, you should ABSOLUTELY take her! 

She responds to emails, moves deadlines if needed, makes everything due on the weekends (usually Sunday), and she is so so sweet.
Truly the easiest class I have taken at TCU.

Prof Sosa is so sweat, take her so class! Intro to sociology is super straightforward easy SSC AND CA credit she is really caring, attendance is not mandatory, her exams are open book and notes, and there is a presentation however she makes it feel safe so nothing to worry about TAKER IF YOU CAN!
Professor Sosa is the nicest and most caring teacher ever! Definitely take her for Intro into Sociology. Not much homework and all tests were online & open resources.

Professor Sosa is very understanding and accomodating! Take this class if you need your SSC credit. Each test was open note, the textbook readings are easy and insightful, and the cultural presentation was very straightforward. The lecture slides are uploaded before class, and the participation assignments are also in them. Highly recommend!

PROFESSOR SOSA IS THE BEST!! All open book online exams, and low homework load for Intro Soc. She is super kind and understanding, but also makes content and expectations for the exam very clear. TAKE HER CLASS!

She is amazing! I took her for Intro to Sociology. She is so caring and also very passionate about what she is talking about. Tests are super easy and open note, open browser. She is super understanding and always takes input from her students. She makes it super easy to succeed. Take her!!!!

Professor Sosa is the best! I took her sociology class and loved it, it was very easy and interesting and she is so nice and is so helpful if you have any questions. All of the exams are online no lockdown and on ur own time which is nice and the exams are pretty easy and straightforward

This class was extremely easy and had very little outside work. Professor Sosa is very understanding about your life outside of school and was more than willing to compromise with you. All tests were online, open-book, open-note, and open-internet. Highly recommend this class!

Best professor I've ever had. So understanding of your time and personal lives. Made all tests online open note, and one time gave a 15% curve because she made a technology mistake. Basically no work other than weekly textbook quizzes that take 5 mins. TAKE HER CLASS.
Mrs. Bekhit has got to be (one of the) professors of all time.
Awful. Discussion posts are basically essays. Even if you hit the rubric points, marks poorly. Unfair and unreasonable when grading. Gives text book and uses Khan Academy to teach.
Incredibly tough when grading, even if you follow prompts and rubrics exactly. Will not give valid feedback or allow resubmissions.

Professor doesn't accept late work unless you say you're dying. She grades pretty harshly on discussions if you don't specifically go in depth of the prompt, practically have to write an essay. Received an F on a discussion even though I answered the discussion questions in depth, and even looked at other resources to see how I should respond.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a nice guy. Class is based on presentations over countries. He makes an effort to get to know his students. You cannot miss a class because there are quizzes over presentations. Go to his office hours for help with papers. The syllabus is confusing so talk to him if you need help. If you put in the work you will do well.

Dr. Sola is lowkey a tough grader. I showed up to his office hours to edit my presentation, and he looked over it for like 10 seconds and said it was good but took points off on it anyway? But the class was pretty straightforward, all presentations, and some zoom interviews, also some papers at the end of the semester. Interesting class overall...

He will not follow his rubrics and he completely makes up point values. He will not be clear about how he chose your grade, only condescending comments. Takes forever to grade and there are not a lot of assignments. Takes off for things such as saying the header of a slide. Class discussions were dull and very harshly grades participation.

You'll have to put in a lot of work, but as long as you do it, put in effort, and ask for feedback, you'll get a good grade. Dr. Sola is one of my favorite professors at TCU, and I don't even like history, but he is so fun and engaging. Would highly highly recommend taking him and any of his classes

Class was relatively easy for an HNRS class. Lots of presentations, couple papers, and lots of small quizzes. Overall pretty manageable and tends to be student-lead. Understanding and kind overall when it comes to assignments.

The class really is not easy but mostly felt like a waste of my time. I did not learn a single thing and listened to the presentations only to do the 3 question quizzes. Nothing against the professor, he's great- but I just felt like I could have made a better use of my time. Presentations are graded toughly and there is no clear grading criteria.

I really enjoyed this course. You do 3 presentations over a country, 4 mini presentations, and two papers. It is very stress free and you learn a lot about Europe. Sometimes it does get repetitive, but it is a great class if you are interested in learning more about Europe and don't want a super difficult class. Great course if you are a freshman

Dr. Sola-Corbacho is clearly very passionate about this class. However, his grading can feel arbitrary at times. There are 3 big presentations on assigned countries and 4 small presentations of your choice. The class is very repetitive though, and showing up to class made me feel like Bill Murray in Groundhog Day.

I love Dr. Sola and this was my favorite class this semester!! The class is very casual with student presentations on different European countries each class. You take a 3 question quiz at the end of each presentation which are questions from the presentation. There are also 2 essays. I look forward to coming to this class and highly recommend!

Great professor! He seems to really care about his students and gives very valuable feedback. The class is presentation-heavy, but they're easy to create/ present. Two essays, but they're super easy and write up pretty quickly.

Most people really love Dr. Sola and I chose to take him because I heard good things about him. I was pretty disappointed, because in a class that requires sharing of opinion, he very obviously had those he agreed with and those he didn't. Even some of my written assignments were marked off due to my political and moral views.
Course comprised of primarily student presentations. Dr. Sola rarely lectures, but when he does, its always great and interesting. Beyond caring and kind. Highly recommended!!

Dr. Sola is obviously a genuine and caring professor who wants his students to love the subject matter as much as he does. If you're looking for a professor with clear grading criteria, he might not be the one. This class is very presentation-heavy, but your presentation and paper drafts to his office hours and he will help you. Super sweet man!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Sola is amazing. He genuinely cares about his students and is always making sure they get the help they need. There are no tests, and three 15 minute presentations, 2 essays, and 1 interview.

I loved Dr. Sola! He was one of my favorite professors this semester. The class itself, Cultural Contact Zones, was pretty work-heavy, though. You do tons of presentations, but no tests! Most of this class was self-research, he didn't give any long lectures. The class discussions and interviews were really interesting!

Took Cultural Contact Zones: The Americas with this prof. DO NOT TAKE!! 5 one-minute "bite" presentations, 2 major "country" presentations, 2 group presentations, one 7-page research paper, one 4-page comparative paper, and weekly news chat article discussions. Grading is very vague. Office hours at the crack of dawn. Take another!!! Save yourself.

Dr. Sola is such a nice guy. No tests-3 big presentations and a paper comprise 60% of grade. Go into office hours to get feedback! Discussion and 8 mini presentations make up other 40%. Does not have clear grading criteria--seems to be whatever he is feeling towards you at the time. The class hits you in chunks, but overall not a difficult course.

Professor Sola is awesome. He is so nice and is always willing to meet with you to check over things and make sure you get an A. The class has no tests, but is mainly comprised of three projects over countries. With a little bit of effort you will be set to get an A. The class is discussion based, but you don't need to talk every class to get an A.

I really like Dr. Sola, and he clearly knows a lot about Europe.  When he did lecture, it was great because he's really interesting, but unfortunately this class was mostly presentations, which were super boring and you didn't need to pay attention to.  No tests, only a term paper and a few other shorter papers.  Overall he's good.

Great teacher! Attendance is a must, test info comes from his power points, copy them & you will do well. Test are pretty easy & the final is cumulative with open notes! He is really funny &  loves it when students interact with him. He is very helpful and approchable, all you have to do is ask & he will go above and beyond to try to help you.

He is hilarious! Loved him as a teacher, but I ended up doing a Pass/ NC, getting the Pass (ended up making a B) just b/c he is a difficult grader on his tests BUT go to class and soak up his humor! Recommend him but NOT if you're looking for an easy A.

GREAT PROF! clear, precise, and interesting. He is passionate for what he does and it shows. Exams are easy, and you can retake them all again for a better grade at the end of the semester. Easy A-B if you pay attention and study! He's a great human as well
TOTALLY IN LOVE WITH HIM!!! he is so helpful and the class is so interesting. he has a weird sense of humor but it works! 3 easy tests short answers and essays and one term paper.

Soo much to study, his Teacher aid doesn't make it any easier when grading papers on exam. Maybe an easy C but if you want a B you have to attend and study constantly. It is a written exam. Must include almost every point if you want an A. Notes are about 20 pages each exam only 3 total, and a midterm paper. I would look elsewhere

European history 1789-present. Great professor, teaches well, a little hard to understand at first but you get used to it. I hate history andhemade it interesting. However he is VERY strict when grading... It's an amazingly easy B but if you want the A you might want to look elsewhere. It's almost impossible.

Dr. Juan Carlos Sola Corbacho is an expert in his field, I thouroughly enjoy going to class even though it's at 8am. His lectures go by really quickly and he gives you opportunities to make up your grade through extra credit and make up exams at semester's end. Good double dip, I'd recommend him.

Good professor. His lectures are fun to listen to, particularly when given in his Spanish accent. Class attendance isn't mandatory, but is highly advisable if one desires a passing grade on the exams.

Dr. Sola is a great professor with a good sense of humor. His accent can take awhile to get use to. His test are all essay, but they aren't that bad if you study. He doesn't take attendance,but you need to go to class or you'll miss a lot. Take him if you can!

Dr. So is a fun professor who manages to keep fairly dry material pretty interesting and fun. He has a thick Spanish accent, but it's not too hard to understand. He is surprisingly funny as well (don't get him started on bagels and zucchini)! His tests are all essay and rather challenging, but he is a fair grader.

Really great teacher. Does not take attendance. However, you need notes from classes for exams, literally all of the notes. Exams are essay but it's all in the notes, just study them. With some effort, an A is not hard to get.

Dr. Sola is a great professor. He is very knowledgable and passionate about the subject. He does not take attendance but if you want a good grade you NEED to go to class. Tests are essay but they arent too bad as long as you have studied. Overall great prof and class

He is an amazing teacher, he knows what he is talking about, but you NEED TO GO TO CLASS!  He goes slow and accent takes some getting used to!  Go in there willing to learn and will end up with an easy B, and work a little and get the A!!!

I really enjoyed his class. although he is a little hard to understand you can easily do well in the class. the secret is going to talk to him. He will help you if you ask. 3 essay exams 2 papers and a presentation not bad for a history class.

Nice guy, but I haven't learned anything from him all semester.  Sorry.  HE also speaks with the most ridiculous spanish accent I've ever come across, which makes listening in class a struggle.  His points are always vague.  He spends way too much time stressing minutia that doesn't always matter.  I'm a history major.  Some people like him, but...

If you ever have to take a history class, take it with this guy! He is fun and his lectures are very interesting. He grades easy and is very helpful outside of class. He is certainly the most popular of the history teachers because he's such a good guy and his classes are always fun. Try to get to know him outside of class, its worth it.
He doesn't fail you if you don't come, but the tests go mainly off the notes, so you should show up. He is an amazing teacher, funny, and one of my favorites. I'd recommend him to everyone.

best and easiest teacher in the whole school. you actually go over the questions you see on the exam and he gives you a chance to take one again if you fail. he's interesting, funny, AND from spain. he doesn't take attendance so i skipped more classes than attended and i still got a b. though, he's a really awesome teacher.

I absolutely love him!!! I just changed my major to history and because of his class I couldn't be happier with my decision. He's a great professor. His class isn't an easy A so if thats what you're looking for don't take him. But if you want a nice professor, who actually cares, is interesting and organized take Dr. S.
he is the best prof at tcu!! he really does care about his students. all of his classes are super easy!!

He is funny, nice, and easy. You don't have to go to class, but it usually entertaining. He gives you and outline of what is important for each chaper, this is the guideline for the days topics and also the test questions. He is an easy grader. Take him, he's one of the best prof's at TCU!

not a hard class. GO TO CLASS and it is much easier, though attendance is not taken. paper topics are hard to understand and write, but write them from notes and you will be fine. essay tests are not that bad. nice guy, i felt bad for only going half the semester

hes really funny-hes from spain so you have to get use to the way he talks but then hes really awsome. If your good at essay questions then take him. He gives you the questions and answers in class all you have to do is memorize them and then he picks 3 of the 10 u memorize. Then of the 3 u pick 2... its really straight forward.
Dr. Sola-Corbacho is extemely knowlegeble about history. This was a great class to take. My only objection would be the all-essay tests. They could make you or break you.

Real nice guy and tries to get to know you if you put the effort. Tests were all essay and semester was divided into 3 sections: a test and paper each section. Lots of material on each test.  I would recomend if you like essays
dr. sola is a pretty cool guy. he is really funny and he made a rather boring class somewhat enjoyable through his good nature. i would tell any friend to take his class
He is a wonderful teacher, never tries to trick you on the test or make the class too complicated. He's very enthusiastic, which makes the class even better. And hes extremely organized.
Great prof. class is pretty boring in itself, but he's really cool.

Whata badass. Has a nice accent and easy to listen to. If you take notes in class, or from the book, either way you will cover the material. You know the questions assigned on the test beforehand, its all about preparing for the essays a few days before taking the test.
He is very helpful and is pretty easy. He has a strong accent but tries very hard to prenunciate and speak clearly. Good teacher, I recommend him.

He is so much fun! He may not teach this class again, but if you can, take Spanish with him.  He makes you feel really comfortable speaking and is so nice to talk to.  He's so funny when he speaks English and has a great sense of humor.  Easy class, but the movies get really annoying after a while.

He is an excellent teacher.  He gets into the material and explains the cause and effect of everything.  There is a good amount of work, but you have the oppurtunity to retake the 1st and 2nd exam along with the final if you want.  With any kind of effort you will make an A or B.

Is very excited about history. Although he tends to just talk through the whole class. He assigns the days topics to students to help augment his lecture. Primary document research occurs 6 times, and there are 3 tests. The good thing is that you can take all the tests again @ the final.
This was my favorite class AND my favorite teacher. I had fun and learned a lot! Best part: he'll make you think, and you'll like it!

Best teacher i have had at TCU! will sit and talk to you about anything. encourages students to visit him because he loves teaching and will help you with all the assignments. Awesome! takes a week to get used to his accent
Great teacher!  Hard class.  Requires a lot of hours of work.  But he is very helpful and even though i had him at 8 AM, his class was very enjoyable.

This class was the hardest class I have ever had, the tests were essays, the 10 page essay wasnt the worst but pretty bad. It makes it even harder since its an 8a.m. class. Dont take it if you have the choice, i was put into it without choice, dont do it

Good teacher, 2 essay tests and a 10pg final on the topic of your choice. He's also got questions on primary sources which you answer in short answer every week or so.  But only issue is he has this thick-ish accent which can throw ya.

reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof. Hamirani is great. easy, but boring class. i brought my laptop everyday to facebook, because otherwise i would fall asleep. his tests aren't too bad, if you have the basic understanding of each religion. papers are easy if you write positively about his religion (islam). easy b... but you do have to attend class. easy extra credit too (if you ask him for it)

he's a very nice man. the first test was so easy but the second test was way harder bc it was over his religion (islamic). not much work but the class is pretty boring to sit through. got a B without much work. hes VERY soft spoken and has an accent. tests are some mc/true false then 2-3 essays and 10 free response.

this was the easiest class i had taken.just remember to read the text. and studyn for the quiz does help prepare for the test even tho the quiz itself hardly affects ur grade. he isnt tht hard to understand, yes he has an accent and he speaks softly, but he is coherent. Hard to understand, tests are mostly essay. Attend class, do readings, not to bad.

Prof. Sodiq is very nice, but tends to push his own religion's (Islam) ideas on students. He does so very subtle though. *Calls everybody his friend - lol*

He is a very nice guy, hard to understand at first. Because of the language barrier true/false part of test is harder than it is meant to be. I made an A, but it took some hard studying the night before tests

Dr. Sodiq is not nice.
Dr. Sodiq is from Nigeria and can not speak proper English. He is UNFAIR in his grading and will NOT help when you ask for it.

don't take it if you don't plan on working hard and really learning the material.  tests are insanely long and study guides are ridiculous.  work with your classmates but really study.  he rewards effort and will definitely work with you if you need help.

Hard to understand and take notes every day! I would say this was my most boring class and was hard for me to stay awake. His test are pretty hard and gives no direction as to how to study for his tests. I earned a B but it was definitley a hard class!

He is very hard to understand because of his African accent and he doesn't help you if you need help. Amazing guy.. he actually wrote the entire class an email telling us he was proud of our hard work and that we were taking his class.  Very genuine man who really cares about students. He even encourages calling him at home for help.  Tests are extremely hard though.. all essay format.
He is very hard to understand with his accent but he is very funny and very nice. It is an easy class to get a B.

world religion was hard, no doubt about that, Dr. Sodiq is a really cool open minded guy, who is funny, knows his stuff and some americans might not understand him, his tests are really hard, you can t pull it our of your A$$ so study work hard have fun and you ll get the grade you diserve

his tests are impossible and his class is super boring- DO NOT TAKE IT

HE IS NOT HARD AT ALL. IF YOU TAKE A LOT OF NOTES, ITS AN EASY A OR B. I GOT AN A.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. TAKE PLATE instead. Cant understand this teacher and test are impossible.Got a D in his class and A in Plate. You have been warned

Content is pretty confusing sometimes but she does a good job giving tests and quizzes based on the examples she provides in class. She works through in class problems so that's very helpful. No homework grade but you can get extra credit by completing homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class is no walk in the park, but it is able to be done. She will work with you. If you really put in the work you will see a good outcome. I bombed the first 2 exams and asked for help I was able to overcome and get a B in the course.

you need the textbook for the online access code, other than that you don't use it. There are quizzes after each chapter. She goes crazy fast through powerpoints so its kinda hard to keep up. She does work through problems for each chapter in class so that is very helpful.
