Professor Squyres showed a lot of passion for Accounting and you could tell that she tries really hard to explain the topic. There is no homework and attendance is not mandatory. However, if you do come to class you can get an easy 5 points toward the next exam by participating. Exams were similar to problems in class.

Terrible teacher. If you have to take her just wait until another semester. She doesn't know how to grade and is literally unavailable to meet with her students if you need help. Doesn't respond to emails often, and didn't have any office hours. Passed this class because I hired a tutor because she is unable to speak clearly. Doesn't know equations

She is a terrible professor. Grades very inconsistently and does not explain anything well. She won't explain when she's wrong or correct herself. Taught two classes entirely different ways on how to do a problem. It is almost impossible to get help outside of class. Don't take her if you can avoid it

This is a difficult class but that is how all accounting classes are. I do not think anybody can make accounting easy or fun. However, I felt like Prof. Squyres was fair and explained material very well. I only supplemented her lectures with the book when I was practicing problems. She also was easy to get an appointment outside of class to review.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HER. If she's the only teacher available that semester, wait. Homework is easy but counts for nothing. She is Russian and hard to understand, and she goes through lectures so fast you can't keep up. Tests are LONG, and 80% of your grade. She also laughed at my face in front of the whole class and is passive aggressive towards students.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Kayla Sparks is the best, she actually shows me my love for writing. Highly recommend I think she is the best English comp two class you can get at TCU.
Sparks is the GOAT. Nothing more to say. Great class. Take her for comp2.

Professor Sparks is amazing!! The book she uses is interesting and the lectures are engaging. There are only a few assignments and if you complete them you get an A. She gives you a lot of creative freedom which is awesome. You can tell she really cares about her students and cares more about learning than grades.

Professor Sparks is definitely the best English professor at TCU. She gives great feedback on the writing assignments and helps everyone in growing as a writer and a person. I would love to take her classes every semester if I had a chance to do so.

I have no idea why Kayla has such bad ratings. She is easily one of my favorite professors this semester. There aren't harsh due dates, she just tells you to have everything done by the end of the semester. She gives you a lot of feedback on your writing. She is so realistic and goes on her own schedule. There's never a "right" answer 4 her papers
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: She doesnt put any grades in and its very stressful. Do not recommend taking a class with her.

Not an enjoyable class. She's a bit quirky and doesn't make her lectures interesting. Honestly, half the time I wasn't even sure what we were talking about because it was not relevant to the papers we were writing at the time. She offers decent feedback, but I had to spend a lot of time trying to figure out what she wanted. Would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: At first I really hated this class, but I just kept asking her questions and trying to work on my writing. She always replied to my emails, and seemed to want to help me. The class isn't easy, but I would take her again.

It's her first year teaching so I don't blame her for following the exact rules. Overall she loosened up over the course of the semester and although she is a tough grader, I did end up learning throughout the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Afwul. That is the best word I have to describe this teacher, and that's me being nice. She is so confusing and is not even remotely clear about what she wants from her students. There is no structure to her class at all which at times can be nice but is mostly very inconvenient. I paid $115 for the textbook and never even cracked it open. Not once
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: She is a grad student and has clearly never taught a class before. I can honestly say I learned nothing from this class. She shoves her political views in your face. I have no idea what she wants in my papers because she isn't clear on the prompt at all. It is in your best interest to NOT take her class trust me.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Definitely one of the worst classes I've taken thus far, she is a grad student and has no idea what she is doing. Avoid her classes at all costs; she is extremely scatterbrained. There is no structure to her class and half the time when I'm in class I feel like there is no point to being there. She is not clear about what she wants from you AT ALL.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: You will write 4: 700-100 papers as well as 1 300-500 word paper and 3: 1600-2200 word papers. Is a lot of writing and a lot of work. She grades pretty harshly, but if you make sure to do every single part of the prompt, you will have a higher success rate. Hard class but it is manageable.

Hardest math class Ive ever taken. Attendance is mandatory and thats really the only way youll learn. Homework twice a week and a quiz every week. Reviews for exams are pointless. Go over each lecture and problem sessions for exams! Shes very nice but gives barely any partial credit. Material on exams seems like stuff never mentioned before.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Linear Algebra. She is God-sent. Her class was informative and I enjoyed going, even though it was at 8:30 in the morning - and that's saying something. She makes sure you're constantly reviewing so that come test time you're well-prepared. Homework wasn't bad (frequent, but not bad), and she's SO willing to help you if you'll just talk to her.
she goes either very slow or very fast gives reviews but then throws curveballs on the tests and homework usually has stuff we didn't go over.

This woman is a gem. I had her for Ancient Greek and Roman Traditions the last semester she taught at TCU. By far my favorite class & professor at TCU. She made the class a blast & you'll actually remember the stuff you learn (auspicious chickens). She made the 3 hour night class worthwhile & showed genuine interest in her students. TCU misses you!
Taking her RELC 1220 Class at UVA and she is an extremely approachable, intelligent, laid back professor!
She is THE best. I am terribly upset she won't be teaching at TCU next semester. If you ever see her anywhere else, please please please take her. You won't ever regret your decision.

Dr. Spittler is the best professor I have had in college. She has a mastery of Greek but is fully capable of explaining concepts, both simple and difficult, to students who have no experience or much experience with the language. She is very approachable, and it seems that she wants more than anything to help her students understand.

Dr. Spittler is so far my favorite teacher I have had at TCU. Her class readings, though long, are interesting and her class work is minimal. Her tests are essay and she gives few of them. her lectures are interactive and interesting and has an open table approach to them.

Probably one of the best teachers in TCU. all you have to do for her class is do the readings and show up. she pretty much tells us when our pop quizes are and you can replace any quiz grade with a some random easy assignment she gives you. I got to replace a pop quiz grade because i showed up for class !!!she doesn't believe in grades!!!

Greek is fantastic. Dr. Spittler is a genius & works hard to make sure you understand the material. Class is very enjoyable. EXTREMELY kind & laid back. If you're struggling, just go talk to her. Very approachable. If you want the A study & do all the translation assignments. VERY fair grader & does her best to give you as many points as she can.

Dr. Spittler is by far one of the chillest professors I've had at TCU. She is very insightful and her passion for the class makes it difficult not to enjoy it. For the A go to class (mandatory) and do ALL the readings. She is very helpful outside of class and very approachable. The class is always interesting, enjoyable. HIGHLY RECOMMEND HER.

I love Dr. Spittler! Religions of the Ancient world is my favorite class this semester. She is such a good teacher and so funny I always enjoy class. Dr. Spittler truly wants her students to succeed and she really helps you prepare for the tests.
LOVE HER!!!!! Class is all discussion but she never forces you to speak up.  Super interesting topics and Paul & the Early Church is one of my favorite classes as a religion major.

I'm a relgion major and classical studies minor and I have 4 classes with her this semester, and have had atleast 1 class with her every semester at TCU. She is a phenominal teacher and truly wants you to learn and will help you succeed in her courses.

Dr. Spittler is one of the best teachers I have ever had at TCU!  Her class is not hard, but you actually learn some interesting stuff. She is very straightforward about what she wants on tests. If you pay ateention in class and review for test you will do great!!

I am a classical studies minor and have taken lots of courses with Spittler, including study abroad to Greece! She is one of the best professors at TCU and you will NOT be disappointed if you take any of her classes. Discussions are interesting and she really knows what she's talking about.

She is one of the best professors at TCU, hands down. Take any and every class she teaches. Participate in class discussions and you'll be fine. Tests are extremely straight forward. No tricks! Interesting topics and delivery. You won't be disappointed!

My favorite teacher! She makes the material very interesting and is extremely helpful. She gave us reviews and the tests were basically straight off the review. Easy 100 everytime! Attendance is mandatory but there are some freebies and I recommend buying the books just because she does reference them a lot and you do have to write a bit on them.

Dr. J is one of my favorite professors at TCU and definitely my favorite in the religion department.  She knows her stuff and loves what she does.  She is great at facilitating conversation in the classroom and does not teach from a biased stand point.  She's wonderful!!!
Wonderful professor!!! Encourages class discussion, but doesn't rely on it exclusively.  Her class is a great way to start off a college career.
Spittler is tight! Red Sox fan. From Boston. Easy class, interesting too. Easy grader and will help you with whatever you need. Enjoys her subject and knows a lot of outside info.

Spittler is one of the best profs in the Religion Dept. She makes things interesting, knows tons of random history, and makes everything easy to understand and relate to.  The homework is easy and you can get away with skipping it here and there.  Plus, she's really nice and a pretty easy grader to boot.

Prof Thirumalai really knows his stuff. This class covered a lot of material. The amount of reading assigned was overwhelming at times, but luckily the final was open note, which made it a bit better. You didn't have to memorize everything; just understand it.

Intro supply chain at TCU is ridiculously hard for no reason, but Thirumali does a good job of making it bearable. He will go over any topics the class is struggling with in detail and accommodates the needs of the class. The exams are hard, but not impossible, and the final was open notes, which helped a lot as it was cumulative.

You definitely need to pay attention to lectures and study in order to understand the concepts, but Dr. Thirumalai does a great job explaining it. He has a lot of patience and is very helpful and understanding. This class does have many assignments (10 quizzes, 4 exams, 5 easy group projects) but overall it wasn't too difficult. Just put in work.

Pretty chill professor. Quizzes are a little tough, but exams are doable as long as you know how to do the problem sets and know the vocab. Quite a few group assignments but they're not too bad. I enjoyed supply chain with him.
Supply Chain is a hard class regardless of the teacher you take, but Prof Thirumalai is the man. Pay attention in class and work on the problems he gives and you will be fine.

His first test was easy and it got progressively harder with no warning. Some group work, but it's nothing major compared to the tests. Basically know how to solve each type of problem like the back of your hand. Write down examples as he goes through them in class. Cramming won't work for the last two tests and final. Office hours help a little.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Not a very good lecturer, most of the material is straight out of the book. The tests are extremely challenging but he weighs them pretty easily. You'll have to self teach a lot but if you actually do the practice problems (DO THEM) and go to him at office hours, you can do well. Tough subject, but put in the work and his class is "A attainable."
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: His lectures do not add anything to the material. I taught myself most of the material. He teaches math pretty well, there is a lot of basic algebra. Tests are very difficult and he doesn't give very clear idea of what will be tested on. Lots of material for short tests. Take someone else for supply chain.

She is really a sweet woman but there is just so much busy work and I honestly wouldn't recommend this class if you don't absolutely need it for credit. A lot of the stuff we do in class I could just do at home on my own time at a more convenient time. A lot of the stuff learned is common sense. There are a lot of projects and discussion boards.

She always strives to help you in any aspect of the class. She will look into information for you even if she may not understand a technological question you have. She truly has a passion to teach young students how to be successful and it truly is just lots of in class projects.
So many projects and lots of long lecturing/overexplaining. She is a sweet person but a very boring professor. It was a very easy A but painful to sit through.

Every month we had a new project to work on but most of them were the easiest things to do, I would get them done in class. Attendance/Engagement is graded based on what you give yourself on her engagement sheets, I missed quite a few and still have an A. She takes late work for full credit. Very sweet and caring, would 100% recommend, easy class.
Great teacher, work is easy, just very time consuming. But overall she is very understanding and nice.
Dr. Anderson is very caring and sweet! There are lots of projects but they are very easy! Even though this class needs more engagement from the professor, it's a very easy A.
Dr.Anderson is very caring. Her class is super easy as long as you put in a little effort. Attendance is not necessarily mandatory, but is part of your final grade.

Professor Anderson cares about her students and wants us to become great teachers as leaders in technology. There is always an online discussion - due every other week (make posts, reply to others). Projects that are easy and creating a lesson plan towards the end of the year.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: This class is very easy but also very boring. There are SO MANY assignments and homework. Dr. Anderson is very nice and flexible and is willing to work with students. This class is just not it for me because of all of the pointless assignments (I may have learned 2 things in this class).
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Whole class is group projects. You get time to work on them so they're super easy and you can finish them in class. There are readings but I never did them, she has quizzes on them for e.c. that include the whole class. Bi weekly discussions that are super easy.

There were just projects and group discussions in this class. It was super easy and it was nice because at the end you could just do the projects pretty much at your own pace. She was really nice and she was very informative about digital literacy. I would take again! Easy class just projects.

This is probably the easiest class I've ever taken, but it's really boring. It's for sure an easy A though. There's a ton of little projects, and it's pretty much impossible to get 100% on them. There are no tests except the final. Dr. Anderson is really nice, too.

Honestly one of the most boring classes ever but a very easy A. No textbooks needed, but there are a lot of projects. They're very easy and if you work quickly in class you can leave early and not have homework. Easy A just annoying to show up everyday. Very nice woman though and if you are confused or behind she will want to help you.

Took as a 8-week summer class and got exactly what you expect. Discussion based distance learning. Dr. Anderson was attentive and helpful throughout. Her grading criteria was clear and she was accessible for questions. Most of the work was tedious busy-work, but I did learn a few things. She allowed late-work without penalty except for quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class is very easy if you keep up with your assignments. Late work is accepted (1-2 days) and although attendance isn't necessarily mandatory, it is always good to go to class. Dr. Anderson wants her students to do well and succeed and will assist her students in doing so. One of the many great professors at TCU College of Education.

Literally the easiest class offered at TCU. Her lectures are kinda boring but you can just work on your projects while she's talking. Lots of projects but they are so easy, you can probably get them done in under an hour.

Dr. Anderson's class was not hard at all, and I feel she grades fairly easy. The digital portfolio was kind of annoying, but it's doable. I don't know why the person below me gave her such a rough review, she really is not bad at all. If you write academically on the discussions, you should receive full credit. Super easy A and enjoyable to talk to

She literally takes points off for minor typos. She treats her students like elementary school students and is very disrespectful.  Thinks WAY too highly of herself.  Her class is just busy work and she thinks it's important.  Class isn't hard, she's just really annoying and has very little self awareness.

She is very helpful and nice. There are only two "exams" which are really quizzes. The second one is the final at the end of the course. You actually have to go to class but it really is not bad and most of the time you just have time to work on projects. You only need the textbooks for the quizzes and one searchpath quiz.
Excellent prof. Makes things crystal clear. Super organized. Very helpful. Let's you make up work. Learned a lot.

Really easy class. Reading isn't a must as long as you at least know where to find information in it for the final. The assignments aren't tough. She is incredibly helpful if you ask. You spend a large portion of the class working on projects rather than in lecture which is nice.

Dr. Anderson is a very nice lady. She is very flexible with your assignments and tries to help you. You only have one test (the final) and it is open book. All of the assignments are easy and she helps you to understand how to use technoloy in the classroom. Great teacher!
Okay so she is a very easy teacher.... she makes the class interesting...really nice lady oh and her class helps you when you start teaching in the real world it really does
It is a fun, easy, and helpful class. She makes you come to class. The projects are interesting.

She thinks she teaches a real subject. Hello! we are making PowerPoints and other useless crap. Sucks because going to class is totally useless. Everything is organized on e-college, but she takes a friggin' attendence grade. Nice lady. Just sit in the back and bring a magazine to read. She takes your computer screen over when she is speaking. Bori
class is ok, too much work for intro class, assignments pretty easy. teacher super boring. dont take her in the morning, you will fall asleep. nice woman

Decent professor.  The class can get kinda boring, but there are a lot of projects which require you to use your imagination to make things up.  You will have the opportunity to redo assignments if needed.  Education majors have to take this class, but it's nothing to dread.  Just remember that the assignments will always take longer than you think
Boring class, but she was fine. Required to make a large portfolio and keep track of fieldwork and she grades them hard. Other than that, learned a lot about computer programs in education. Not bad.
She is a good professor and it is an easy class overall. There is not much teaching required anyway. TAKE THIS CLASS

Take her for Intro into Tech Education. She's really quiet and the class is boring but it's required for Education majors so take it with her because she's really nice. The projects tend to pile up so make sure you keep up with the due dates. You will have to stay late some days to make sure you're caught up. Easy A!
LOVE MRS ANDERSON! Class isnt uber exciting but its interesting and you get to work a lot on your own and go on school visits. dont leave everything to last minute and you should make an a.
Her clothes drive me crazy...but she is really nice. If you are good with computers, you will do well. Don't miss any- hard to make up!

Easy class but you have a lot of busy work.  She is not very helpful and really plays favorites.  If you know the basics about computers you could teach the class.  Crams a lot of projects at the end of the semester.
She treats the class like 5 year olds, but it is an easy 3000 level class.  If you know basic computer skills it is an easy A.

Her way of teaching is very easy to understand and she is easy to reach outside of class for any questions or help. The exams are very similar to homework problems and examples given in class as well.

Best professor I've had, seriously the most awesome lady ever! I go to her office hours all the time and she's so helpful, will tell you exactly how to do a problem. So funny and kind love herrrrrr :)
Amazing professor hope she teaches more outside of actuarial science courses

I hate math and have never been good at it. Professor Staples was amazing and made everything so simple and to-the-point. She gives out printed packets for notes, which I wasn't sure about at first but ended up loving. I didn't have a textbook or notebook- just a folder and calculator! Quizzes work as points just added to whatever test is next!

Dr. Staples is great, she doesn't put any surprises on the exams (most of the questions are similar to in-class examples), and is great at responding via email to answer any questions you have. Really a great professor and you can tell that she cares about students succeeding in her courses.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Staples is literally the bomb. She can take any difficult concept and show you how it works/apply it to your life. She's always willing to meet with you and talk outside of class. If you have issues in the class she's VERY understanding and VERY helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Staples is, without a doubt, one of the best profs in the math department. In addition to being super helpful and nice, she makes harder concepts easily accessible and ensures that students are prepared to take the actuarial exam that corresponds to the course.

I took Dr. Staples for discrete math and she was a great teacher to have. It's rare in the math department to find a teacher you can enjoy attending class with, but Staples is that. She is a pretty strict grader on tests when it comes to proofs, so watch out. I wouldn't advise taking her just for fun, but if your degree requires discrete take her!

She's an awesome teacher. Great at explaining things so they're easy to understand and very enthusiastic. Not only is she focused on students succeeding in her class, but she also helps them look for outside employment opportunities. Not too difficult at all if you make a sincere effort to understand the material. Take her if you can.

Dr. Staples is one of the best math teachers/professors I've ever had (and I'm a math major). She cares about her students so much, is funny, and always more than happy to help. But beyond that, she is brilliant, yet knows how to explain things very clearly. She's very reasonable with the amount of homework and difficulty of tests.
Tests reflect almost exactly what is in the notes and homework.  Attendance is mandatory but the class is not boring, so more than likely you won't feel the need to skip class.

Great teacher, great class. I took Calc 2 after having taken AP Calc in high school and loved the class. Dr. Staples is super helpful and she teaches the material very well. Homework is graded for correct answers, but as long as you put the time in there are no curveballs.

Interest Theory 1 & 2 - best teacher ever! Great preparation for the actuarial FM exam. The class is not easy so don't take it just for an elective, but if you're serious about the actuarial field this is the class to take. Very helpful in office hours too! If you work hard on homework and study, you will get an A.

She is a really good prof. Her exams are easy if you can do the review. If not... ask her and she is happy to help. I don't recommend missing any classes because zeros on homework will add up. Quizzes count as extra points on your tests. I recommend her for Applied Calculus.
Best mathematics course taken so far and TCU and best professor by far. Extremely helpful especially if you go to office hours and attend class

Very nice professor who will go out of her way to help you. Daily homework assignments, but they're not too difficult. Definately go to class to understand the material, but attendence isn't mandatory. She mostly teaches repeats, so she is a very thorough teacher. Kind of talks to herself while lecturing. Overall, I would recommend!

Great Professor! I am terrible in math and i would go to her office hours almost everyday before class and she was more than willining to help me! Very caring teacher and want's her students to do well. If you show that your trying she will give you a good grade. Go to class and do the homework. Definitley recommend this class!
shes definitely boring. but a sweet sweet lady. shes just a normal professor... i would reccomend her!

Dr. Staples is mind numbingly boring but is a really good teacher. She always goes over homework from the day before, reviews for tests, and is very helpful. I haven't heard much about the other applied calc. professors, but i would recommend taking Dr. Staples

She explains everything (sometimes that's a problem) and answers a few questions from the homework at start of each class. 2-3 Quizzes for each test are short and bonus for upcoming test. Tests aren't impossible but require studying.
talks to herself when she lectures

DO THE HOMEWORK.  I would of had an A but I never turned in the homework almost dropped me to a C.  She is by far one of the best math teachers TCU has, super helpful and truly cares about how u do in class.  As long as you show your working hard and trying she will help every step of the way.  Reminds me of what a teacher is supposed to be like.
Very nice teacher goes over questions you had for homework and reviews very thoroughly.

Teacher is very helpful if you talk to her. Do the review sheets for the test, and take notes. I'm horrible at math, but I did well in this class. Also, Dr. Staples is extremely funny--she's constantly making jokes but they're very subtle. Most of the class misses it. I recommend taking her.

The professor is new to teaching but her class is a lot better than any of the intro classes for CS. She gives extra credit for exam which help a lot with grades and sometimes she is lenient with late work. If your new to CS, I suggest you take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She is a software developer turned COSC professor but has yet to learn how to teach. This was an INTRO to programming class and day 1 it felt like I was behind. She would show you how something is done, and then quickly move on. She reads from slides for her lectures. If you take her intro class be prepared to teach yourself how to code.

Intro to Program, not an easy class for someone new to coding. All she does is read from the slides. Gives extra credit if you retake the test after you do poor. Nice lady and attendance not mandatory. Be prepared to self teach.
Just horrid.

Intro to Prog - Spring 2023. Lectures did not add to the already hard-to-comprehend slides and were not worth waking up early for. Slides contain everything for tests and labs, but the theory behind programming were not explained at the beginner level. Self-studied the whole semester instead and did well on exams with some help from extra credit.
Don't take her! This is an intro comp sci class and is harder than any class I've taken. The exams are also insanely difficult, and I'm trying so hard just to pass right now. Trust me. Don't take it.

Prof probably don't know how to teach. All she does in class is go through ppt slides that probably aren't hers. 
Labs and assignments questions aren't covered in class and are extremely difficult to grasp if you don't have prior experience. AND IT'S INTRO CLASS.
Tests are hopeless.
DON'T.
Dr Widjojo is very accessible outside class but her tests and lectures are extremely hard. Do not take her!

This professor is amazing. He is so scaring, sweet, and genuinely cares for his students. He gives out a lot of homework, but he is helpful and understanding about it. Assignments are not hard and beneficial to teaching!

Dr. Switzer taught two of my graduate-level courses, and I enjoyed learning from him! The classes are loosely structured and usually revolve around class discussions. Depending on the class, there may be a lot of reading and/or math tasks to complete. He's an understanding professor who cares about his students and is eager to support them.
Nice teacher, understanding, a lot of work and coursework is confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Sitting in this class for 3 hours is painful. Switzer is a nice guy, but I really am not sure what I was supposed to be learning in this class. The homework feels like busy work and feedback is not provided at all. If you do the work and show up it is easy to get a good grade, but I just really find the class a waste of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He does not give good or clear feedback on work. He's a very boring and not engaging professor. Sitting in his class for 3 hours is a huge pain. If you have the opportunity, try and get the other professor that teaches the section, because chances are it will be much better with the other professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is the second class I have had with this him and it is beyond frustrating. Your grade is 25% journals, 25% problem sets, 25% assignments, and 25% midterm and final. He believes in never giving you the answer.u take the midterm and final and u do poorly because u dont know what u got wrong on the problem sets since u get 100% if u do them
This class sucks. The whole math criteria for the entire year is repetitive and not helpful at all. You won't learn anything just learn to hate math and hate him with his class. 0/10.

I took Methods of Teaching Math with Dr. Switzer, which was a very discussion-based class. He has a lot of insight about teaching from his own experience and research, which I learned a lot from. There isn't a very clear structure/schedule to the class, but the assignments weren't too difficult.

The absolute worst class I have ever taken! Assignments were extremely repetitive, the book was useless, and he never taught anything. The class was based on student discussion and he just sat and listened. It took him weeks to grade assignments (those that he did grade), but never gave any feedback.

He was always very helpful and willing to meet with me. I learned a lot in class and there were lots of engaging activities. There are a lot of journals that can get annoying to do, but it's an easy 15% of your grade. if you do everything you're supposed to and if you actually try, you'll do fine in this class

This class was horrible. The whole class complained about it. It is a waste of time and tuition! It is suppose to be an effective teaching class but was completely ineffective. You read articles and talk about them. That is all we ever did in class. The assignments are pointless and he gives you a bad grade even when you follow directions.

Investments II is a difficult subject. Our grade consisted of 3 equally weighted exams. Dr. Kalpathy provides practice questions and a "topic sheets" for each, which are almost exactly what you will see on the exams. Lectures can be a bit dry, though he stays very enthusiastic about everything. He is also a VERY fair grader. Great course.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very amazing professor and explains everything thoroughly, but it is a hard subject nonetheless and it is very dry. Regardless test are not difficult if you study and he is available to answer all your questions. Group work graded very generously.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Loved this class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Stephanie was one of my favorite instructors, and is a visionary in her field. I would recommend taking any of her courses! She will push you to think outside of the box, and is a really just overall nice professor. She's wonderful, TCU is lucky to have her
Professor Sunico is awesome in class and awesome if you need help after.

She does understand the material she is teaching.  However, she can be rude and superior acting at times.  She speaks to people as if they are beneath her if you are not one of her favorites.  Hard test, extremely laid back lectures.
Epic, inspirational and knee buckling

large lecture class with lab component. labs taught by TA and are completely separate, but count for a percentage of your grade. stephanie is a super awesome teacher and makes the information relatable and interesting. her reviews for the exams aren't very specific to the questions so take good notes and review the powerpoints often.

Extremely easy course, especially with Sunico. I always went over the material once the night before exams and received  easy A's. Very helpful when needed. Don't be intimidated by her gorgeous looks, just go to her office and ask for help if you need it. Did I mention she's gorgeous ;)

Stephanie is so smart! She definitely knows what she is talking about. You don't need a text book! Go to class and you will do fine! She made this class very interesting and I learned a lot of random things about the environment.

Such a nice lady! Definitely NOT an easy A. I worked my booty off to make a good grade.  Study guides are relatively helpful, as there is no book.  Study power points and google anything you don't understand.  GO to her office hours if you have questions. She's very nice and helpful there.

Don't take this class if science isn't your thing and you're looking for an easy A. It's not an extremely difficult class, but it's not as easy as I wanted it to be. You don't need the book as long as you go to class. Study hard for her tests becase their really hard - espcially the final!

Honestly, this teacher is really nice and smart but the structure of the class drives me crazy. Attendance is not mandatory and her lectures can be too laid back. Tests are really hard and thats all that your grade is made up of. If you like structure I would take someone else
shes attractive and smart. a great class to take if you need a good grade

Great professor and makes topic interesting. Be sure to tape record her lectures! Tests are super hard. Take her in the fall or spring but not summer because the course is harder in the summer than it was during the school year. Overall, she is good at helping you understand the material.

I love this class. She is such an upbeat, helpful, caring teacher -- is willing to help her students. Tests are challenging, but if you go to the lectures and take good notes, you can get an A. Labs are super easy, but boring. Overall, I highly recommend this class!

She is such a wonderful professor. So upbeat, so helpful, and really makes the class interesting, even if this is not a subject you are particularly passionate about. If you go to the lectures, ask questions, and seek help when needed, you are going to get an A in this class!

An absolutely amazing professor. Upbeat, happy, and extremely helpful. Plus, she's gorgeous. I totally recommend her! I had to work hard to get an A, but it's doable. Labs are easy, tests are somewhat difficult. If science isn't your strong area, this is the class for you. It's interesting, inspiring, and totally applicable to day-to-day life!
class is pretty easy, I didn't really go to them and made a B. Lab attendance is necessary to pass. Teacher is extremely hot.
This is a pretty good class. Tests are pretty difficult but Sunico keeps the class pretty fun and entertaining. Labs are SO boring but easy. Good class!
I love this teacher! She made me want to minor in environmental science! She loves her class, and made really complicated issues really clear and will often ask us how we're keeping up
She's an amazing prof. Just read the power points and pay attention in class. Her tests are about half multiple choice and half short answers.

Amazing teacher with totally interesting powerpoints. Granted the exams are difficult, but if you show up to class to learn the information than it's not bad at all. She is super helpful and really smart. I loved all of the cartoons and interesting facts that she threw at us. Lab was boring, but aren't they all. I'd take her again forsure!

Love this prof! She is excited about what she teaches and makes it interesting! Very laid back, she would sit cross legged on her teaching table.  Answers any of your questions and always up emailing you back in the middle of the night! there are like 2 quizzes and a writing assignment. These are only two tests so make sure you do well but their no

Love this prof! She is excited about what she teaches and makes it interesting! Very laid back, she would sit cross legged on her teaching table.  Answers any of your questions and always up emailing you back in the middle of the night! there are like 2 quizzes and a writing assignment. These are only two tests so make sure you do well but their no
Kept things interesting.  Liked to throw in a pop quiz or two if attendance was low.  Study hard for the tests and you'll do on.
Professor Tallman is the best. His class was a breeze. The lectures are very interesting and you can follow them online. He is the best. Take him. He is also so chill
I would take him for every class if I could. Amazing.

He is AMAZING! Might be the best professor I've had at TCU so far. He cares about his students and really wants everyone to succeed. Lectures are great and interesting and you can succeed if you do the work. 100% recommend taking his class.
Utilizes book and you can be successful in reading the PPTs and doing high level overview of the book.  He does care but is best reached via text as he works full time.
Save Your Money

Professor Tallman is a nice guy who does not want you to fail but he does not prioritize this class at all. We had about 4 lectures the entire semester where he read off the slide word for word and did not explain further so most of us did not feel as though we learned anything about supply chain at the end of the semester. Complete waste of time.
Communication is key to success in course.

He is a great guy, but the lectures during class are him reading off slides. Tests and quizzes aren't horrible, but a lot of material. You are assigned a group that you will work with the entire semester to complete papers, workshops, Excel spreadsheets, etc. He usually didn't lecture to full class time. He is hard to reach and isn't always clear.
Professor Tallman is an industry guy whose goal is to teach students the foundations of Supply Chain Management.
Easy as long as you do the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Evening Adjunct professor that is available via text message or before class. Group assignments and are works with you on assignment due dates.
Easy to work with, cares about students' success.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Firm but fair
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: One of the worst professor's I have ever had at TCU. He does not respond to emails or text messages. He is unreachable. He uses class to talk about his past jobs but then tests on material not discussed. Class wasn't hard but was not worth being confused every week what is due, what is tested on, what the assignments are, and what he is expecting.
A lot of real world experience, wants us to do well. I would take him for every class if I could.
Provides industry experience and is easy to work with.

Professor Tawil is very knowledgable and passionate about this course! She truly wants the best for her students. Class focused mainly on the nuances of migration. Short lecture then class discussion over assigned readings was the usual class setup. 1 easy book review project and 1 easy paper. No tests.
If you need a GA credit definitely take this.

SUPER EASY!! TAKE THIS CLASS! She has this "ungraded system" where basically you only have to do a few assignments, and you can pick and choose which ones u wanna do (it'll make more sense once she explains it). No tests or anything like that. U don't have to put in like any work but just show up to class and sorta pay attention and you'll get an A
Easy class, recommend to take, but I was not really engaged in her lecture, so I was pretty bored
Awesome Professor and would recommend as an option for a good CA/CSV

Dr. TS was so caring and sweet. I was really worried about it because of her reviews but she ended up being great. She always rounded on test or offered extra credit. She really cares for her students. No tech rule but wasn't that bad and kept me engaged.

I honestly was a little worried when i saw her rating, but I soon realized that the rating didn't reflect. She reduced the readings significantly. Two tests and 3 group projects that you don't even present to the class. Participations matters as it is large part of the grade. She encourages no technology during class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: The class is really dumb, but professor TS is super sweet and wants you to do well. 2 exams, the second is online and open note, 3 different group projects, and participation is really important. Take her for Org Man if you want an easy A.
She is literally the nicest, sweetest prof ever. I love her and would definitely take her again. She really cares about her students and us having good grades. 100% take her

Dr. T is a great professor. She is one of those teachers that cares about each student on a personal and professional level. She is willing to accommodate for real life situations and willing to do the work of a good professor to help students succeed in a course. The information is dense because she is actually passionate about the topic!

The professor is really easy to get along with and is always there to help. The lectures were explained well but it is heavy with A LOT of information. Her group assignments are very straightforward and simple. Exams are hard bc you need to remember a lot of information but they aren't complicated. Trust...DO NOT study last minute lol.

In my TCU tenure, I have never had a professor treat a class more like hs. Do not take this class, she will treat you like you are five and grade you like you're a PHD candidate. Avoid this class at all costs. Taught as if students are taking three credit hours and are all OrgMan majors. Not worth the tuition $. Nice lady, but take other prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the hardest classes at TCU hands-down. Tomova is actually pretty nice, but the class is too hard.

Professor TS is an extremely knowledgeable, sincere, and passionate professor. While the class itself it is challenging, it is not impossible to get an A. Participate, complete all the assigned readings, and study hard before the exams and you will pass! There are group projects and extra credit opportunities that will help your grade, as well.

Dr. Tyler is one of my favorite professors! One day a week is lecture and the other is class/group activities and interactions. Short weekly discussion posts on textbook readings, but they are super easy. Only a handful of outside assignments, and you basically just get credit for completing them. TAKE HIM!

Tyler is the BEST. He makes this class super easy; his assignments are chill; tests and quizzes are open note. He often says how he wants it to be a low stress environment and just wants to foster an understanding of social work. He is heavy on participation in class, but it's easy to follow along and understand. LOVED this class.

Dr. Tyler is a great professor. He is heavy on participation which makes him call names out. The content is pretty straight forward with lots of presentations and guest speakers on different topics. Overall, he is really easy on grading and just wants to see all his students succeed.

Professor Tyler is a super caring guy who just wants to get to know his students. Participation is big and he calls on people throughout class. Assignments are minimal and you will get full credit as long as you follow the syllabus and format guidelines. Final is just a paper on what you learned.
Professor Tee Tyler is very clear about how to succeed in his class and supports you through words of encouragement and different ways into the information.

Dr. Tyler is one of the best and easiest professors I have had at TCU. There are three exams and weekly quizzes that are all at home. Every exam day you have to complete a movie review, and there is an APA training you must complete sometime during the semester. The final is just a paper talking about what you learned throughout the course.

I am taking his Intro to Social Work class over the summer on Zoom. It is from 9:40-11:20 a Monday-Friday for 5 weeks. We go into breakout rooms quite a bit to discuss some of the material. He is a really great professor that keeps everyone engaged.
One of the best professors and classes I have ever had. He truly cares about his students and also grades very easily.

Tayag is a great lecturer. Unfortanetly he doesn't think so. So be prepared for a flipped classroom, and if you're lucky, you might get a lecture during class if he thinks you are struggling enough. Tayag really does care, and if you pay attention and do the homework, you will struggle through.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Tayag is a great professor despite what many people say. The only thing is he runs a flipped classroom, so you need to read the book and teach yourself the homework. But he explains everything in class if you didn't understand the homework and he grades the homework on completion. He actually cares about you understanding the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Other than the tags that I give him, I would 100% take Tayag again for my Circuits II class. Giving out lots of homeworks, labs and quizzes on the daily DOES NOT make him a bad professor. Instead, he's what you call a real professor who actually cares to teach you properly while giving you tough love so you can be prepared. He's kinda silly tho :>
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Tayag is reminiscent of the song "Gnarly" by Katseye - he kind of grows on you, but this class did make me lose my sanity. RAT (quiz) every class, hw due every Sunday night, exams make you wish you just slept instead of wasting time studying. I now attend weekly therapy and am on antidepressants and anti-anxiety meds! :D He's kinda silly though

He runs a flipped classroom. People say he doesn't teach, but he does. You need to have an idea about what you'll learn because he has small quizzes at the start of his classes. He goes through the problems in which people had the most difficulty. Homework are sometimes long and take almost a day to do. Overall good professor, great person!

Worst class I've ever taken. Tayag uses a flipped classroom style that just didn't work. We had to teach ourselves, or it was "search it up". Material was confusing, and it made me drop engineering. Would not take again. If you want to actually learn and not struggle, take a different professor. Huge regret.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Do not take him if you are able to. About a third of the class dropped and the rest held on by a thread. He does not teach the class, instead he does a 'flipped classroom'. Quizzes every class and 80% is tests. It is really not a hard class, but the way he runs it makes it unbearable. Test scores ranged from 50-70%.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is a truly caring prof, however his "teaching" style of a flipped classroom requires you to teach yourself, on subjects that are hard to conceptualize. I was not a fan. Most of the class fails the first and second exams. Take the other prof if you can. I would put in 16-20 hrs for this 2 cred class...
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He does a flipped classroom except when we are in class he just quizzes you everyday and has never done one type of lecture or teaching. You are fully teaching yourself entirely a college level class and his exam was a 43% average. At some point the blame needs to be put on a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is a flipped classroom, where you are expected to watch videos and read the textbook on your own time. The class instruction is wasted reviewing quizzes (that take place every day). The first exam averaged below a failing grade and instead of curving, or reviewing the material, we were instructed to "look it up on google".
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His lack of excitement for students is appalling considering he has kids in college as well. Teaching style is you read a book/teach yourself and take a quiz every class. In the lab for this class if you ask for help he'll just repeat the question back to you. Also if he's your advisor just ask someone else as he's not helpful at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, believes in his students, offers great help during office hours. Doesn't teach at all, expects students to learn from the textbook before class.Hard quizzes every class, weekend homework and group projects graded by effort. 3 tests worth 50%. Half of the class will drop but if you keep studying, you'll eventually succeed. Curves.

Runs a flipped classroom, which is great if you are easily motivated to learn or if your looking for a class that will force you to do the work. Plenty of office hours, but you have to have a specific question or he wont answer. "I don't get it" is not an acceptable question for him. This class was tough but it did kickstart my learning at college.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Tayag runs a flipped classroom, meaning you have to teach yourself before class. You have to take a quiz (he calls them RATs) almost every class. If you actually want to learn, you have to go to office hours - especially if you have no background in electrical engineering.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Tayag is a great professor but you have to show that you want it. Go to office hours and read the textbook BEFORE class. The RATs help give you a feel for how well you know each section. Be able to do the hardest problem of each RAT before exams. He is extremely helpful outside of class and takes lots of questions right from the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Refuses to teach the class, basically you have to learn everything on your own through the textbook
Hey don't hate on the Tayag-ster! All jokes aside, he is very fair and helpful. If you ask for help you get it. You must do you're homework too because it really helps.
I truly enjoyed his Digital Logic class and I don't even plan on pursuing engineering. The exams are easy because there aren't any surprises.

Good teacher, makes class as interesting as possible considering it's based on ones and zero's. Interesting class, makes it very difficult to make an A though. study and come to class, you will get a B, hard tests, ask older engineers for help on them they know what he will be asking. also he is very helpful and dedicated to his students

You can't fake your way through this class like you can in other Engineering classes. Tayag will hammer you on exams if you show you don't understand the concepts...and these concepts can seem nebulous the first time. Show that you understand what is going on and you'll be rewarded...partial credit king! Know your calculator well! Labs are long.
hard to make an A, but a good teacher
I learned a LOT in this class!  Make sure you know complex on the 89
No Comments

Since you don't have a choice, you're stuck with him... If you struggled in digital logic, good luck.  He teaches well, but his tests are all the hard questions you were hoping weren't on there.  Read every day or so and do the problems he assigns and it's not so bad... key is to not get behind!!! Get a TI-89 and know how to use it, it helps a lot!
He always shows up 5 minutes late and teaches 5 minutes long

He's a great teacher, very clear about all the concepts.  As long as you don's procrastinate on the projects, they're not too bad.  Just make sure to take your time and ask him questions.  He loves to help!

What is so hard about this class?  Dr. Tayag is very informative and if you pay attention in class it is a breeze.  I made an A on all the tests, B's on most  labs, and an A in the class.  One key to the exams is full utilization of the TI89.  If you do not have this calculator, buy immediately.

His class is very hard. He tries to be clear and precise but it tends to make it harder for students who are trying to grasp concepts in a simple way. He encourges students to be "professional". For most students, the effort you have to put in is way more than other classes. He's not mean though.

He's a good professor. He doesn't give away grades. You have to put in 10-times more effort than people our age are used to, but part of his goal is to prepare you for "the real world". You probably have no choice but to take him, so learn to appreciate it. And get ready for C grades after A-effort.

Probably the hardest teachers/classes you'll have in the ENGR program, partly because the class is hard and partly because he's a bad teacher. He's very unapproachable for help. Just be ready to study very hard for the first month or so. It levels off after that. Don't have ENGR because of him.
Class is amazingly hard.  Study hard, dedicate lots of time to it, and just make it through with a passing grade.  Don't get frustrated with ENGR because of him.
No Comments

Very easy class! I would recommend, attendance is not mandatory and she canceled class half the time. In the beginning of the semester there are weekly assignments, but they are very easy and as long as you turn it in she gives you a 100.

Had her for creative writing!! loved every second. shes great with feedback and we only had a couple of real assignments that didn't involve workshopping other people's poems/ short stories. lovely class super easy a+ if you actually do the work

Easy English grade and intriguing but incredibly easy. You do have to read a lot and write a solid amount, but she is an incredibly easy grader. She is very understanding and works with you also. The class can get boring and there is a discussion but you don't have to participate. I like her and would take her again for a different class.

The worst. Acts like she is better than everyone, and is extremely unprofessional. Be ready to talk about feminism and why men are bad for every class. One 250 word page paper due before every class and a mean grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Frank is extremely unprofessional. You will not receive an email back from her and she takes forever to grade essays. She is also very one sided and you must conform to her beliefs if you want to get a good grade in the class. With this said her class is very basic and takes little effort.

Almost 20 single page essays that are 250 words minimum each and other useless assignments that are extremely annoying and also 250 words each. Also 4 main essays over the semester. Easy grader but a ton of busy work.

This is a teacher that was very helpful and made her class not too difficult. She always helped me and many students when they needed help. I found her class to be enjoyable, but also useful as we learned many writing skills. She has many assignments and projects that are grade boosters, and they will help you to learn.

Prof. Frank is extremly caring and understanding. She normally grades pretty quickly and gives feedback. She also gives you freedom when it comes to picking you essay topics and likes to give extra credit.

I had Prof. Frank for Intro to Comp and enjoyed her! She is very organized and clear about what the assignments are and how they will be graded. You journal 1 page each class and turn them in at the end of the semester for a grade boost. Gives feedback on essays and willing to help. Would take her!
Absolutely love her and the way she clearly explains what you need to do to get a good grade. Would highly suggest picking her!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Overall the class is not too daunting, however, it is lecture heavy as many English classes are. Prof Frank does a good job of being available for students whether that is for questions or meeting outside of class hours. Sometimes her grading of drafts can take long, slowing your writing of the final draft as you wait for the revised paper.

Professor Frank is the best teacher i have ever had. Amazing open class discussions , and if you don't feel like participating its ok too. She give very clear instructions for the essays and reviews for your drafts and gives great feedback on what's good and what to fix. If you don't take her your really hurting yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's pretty nice, ready to answer any questions, and incredibly helpful during office hours, however, she doesn't know how to teach and the lectures are kinda boring. Many hw assignments. get ready for weekly reading responses and journals. Attendance is mandatory, the participation accounts 5%.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really liked taking Prof. Gonzales' class, she is really sweet.  If you don't already know sign language, my sole piece of advice is to pass on this course. You may fall behind significantly due to how quickly we learn the chapters.The test consists of phrases, sentences, and a difficult lecture section that requires exact word for word responses
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It took her 4 days to respond to me, even though the syllabus says a 24 hour turn around time. Difficult to contact. We only had 4 grades, which were all exams. You basically have to teach yourself everything. Difficult to study outside of class. If you fail one exam, say bye to your grade. Regardless if you go in person or miss, you will be lost.

Mrs. G is awesome! Her exams have three parts, her signing sentences (which she literally gives you and goes over with you), her signing phrases which are very simple, and then a PowerPoint section. Beware of the PowerPoint section because she wants it to be almost word for word and I lost a majority of my points here. Overall, she's amazing!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Mrs. G is so kind and passionate about what she does. Whoever said the class is harder than a 4 years of classes was WAY overexaggerating. You learn important material and its not overwhelming. Shes very talented at sign and is a calm professor. Study the lecture portions for exams because shes specific about wording, but take her class!

This is supposed to be a BASIC sign language class, but it is anything but. For every exam you need to learn 3 chapters worth of signs. My friend who has taken 4 years of sign language at a different university said that we surpassed what she learned and are now learning things that she hasn't learned yet. Way too much to memorize for a basic class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Gonzales is a gem. She cares deeply about her students and learns everyone's name within the first two weeks. She's incredibly knowledgeable about sign language and makes the class fun. Attendance is not mandatory, but if you don't go, you won't learn the signs for the test. I would def take another one of her classes again! Love her.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Mrs. Gonzales is an amazing teacher! She is a detailed grader on the short answer portion of her exams. The exams aren't impossible but there is a lot to memorize always. But she is an amazing, funny, and thoughtful teacher. I would love to take her again. She gives an extra credit opportunity at the end of the semester and is super fun.

I have had Mrs. G for 2 semesters in a row, Basic Sign Language and Intermediate Sign Language. I absolutely LOVE this woman! She is so caring for her students and is just so incredibly happy that you are interested in learning Sign Language! I would take any class Mrs. G offers over and over again.

She is really nice but she's very hard to grade your test. She signs everything and gives you an answer sheet where you have to write your answers. She can go fast, but repeats 5 times every word or sentence.

Dr. Moeller was a great professor! His exams matched the reviews he posted. He grades participation but mainly wants students to ask questions without him having to call you. Class was once a week for 3 hours, with 1-2 Pearson assignments due before class. Exams are curved, with formula sheets provided. He's very helpful via email and office hours!
Just dont take him

He is not a good professor. Apparently, his class has changed a lot since previous semesters. He goes in circle and DOES NOT prepare you well for his tests. He has explained that only a few people in each of his classes will get A's. I truly feel like I have learned nothing this semester.

I think he was great, very easy to access outside of class and he grades generously. You get to use unlimited notes on all exams and they are not hard. The homework is really time consuming and they are from mylab so they are kinda difficult, but they are nothing like the exams. The final is curved generously & participation matters.

A quirky and kind professor. Generous with points and fun lectures. Homework is very time-consuming but they are doable.  MAKE NOTES OF LITERALLY EVERY QUESTION HE TEACHES IN CLASS/SLIDES - The exam is open note with similar questions. Final exam is tough but he curves generously. No extra credit. Participation/attendance is 20%.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Nice guy who gives good lectures. Main problem with this class is that the questions he puts on exams are very difficult, and ones we have not gone over in class. I attend every lecture and do all HW, where I feel I understand. I am a pretty good student who has made great grades in college so far, but have yet to make higher than a C+ on a test.

I took this class as a 3-hr, once a week, class. It was a LONG 3 hours of lecture, but convenient to have just once. He uses real-world examples for his problems which help to understand the concepts. We had 4 group projects which seemed kind of excessive, but were graded fairly. Exams seemed much easier than the Connect HW. He was ok.

Had Dr. Moeller for Corporate Finance (MBA).  Great sense of humor and good understanding of the material.  Dr. Moeller genuinely cares about teaching and about the subject material.  He is easily approachable outside of class, and very responsive to emails with questions about the homework.  Need to study; class is fair, but a challenge!

Yes, Dr. Moeller teaches a difficult course (for those without a FINA background). Still, his quirky humor leads to enjoyable lectures. He encourages classroom participation, and uses real-world examples often. He provides good notes and is more than willing to answer questions. I greatly enjoyed his class - one of the best profs I've had!

Don't take him if you have a choice. The lectures are boring and not very helpful. He is a fan of pop quizzes. You end up having to teach yourself how to do all the problems yourself before each test. His final was really hard, but he curved it a lot which did help out.

Professor C's rigorous grading completely threw the class off from the beginning. He is incredibly nitpicky with the work you send in, taking off points for quite literally anything he can find. I just found him all too serious for an intro-level fine arts course.

Professor Chavira is very flexible and understanding throughout the class. He gives many extra credit opportunities, so taking advantage of them will be very beneficial. He is also very passionate about theatre, which makes the class enjoyable and easy to be successful.

A good class to get fine art credit! You will read plays and then we read A Midsummer Night's Dream with assignments for each act. He does take attendance in every class but it's just signing a sheet of paper. His lectures usually do not last the whole class. If you do the work, you will get an A. He gives lots of extra credit opportunities.

He's pretty funny and is a very easy grader. He offers lots of extra credit to use instead of taking quizzes. He'e really passionate about what he teaches which makes the class a lot more interesting. Definitely take him for a fine art

He is one of the sweetest professors. He is in with the times and makes fun assignments in place of quizzed. You have to come to class and sign in but it never lasts the full hour and a half. If you need an easy fine arts credit take this one. Lots of group projects so take with a group of friends if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He is so sweet and nice!! I love him. You have to sign in for class but somebody else can do it for you. The quizzes are online and so are the tests. He just lectures the whole class.
Did not sound confident when talking. 3 major group projects so take this class with friends. Read a play a week and take an open note quiz on it.
Easy A and offers extra credit. Take him for your fine arts credit.

Professor Chavira is great. He cares for his students and his class is really easy. His quizzes can be challenging at times(if you don't read the plays) so make sure you do. The assignments are easy and their are a lot of group projects. Attendance is mandatory but I missed more then the allowed amount and still got an A but I emailed him everytime
I had Professor Chavira for Survey of Theatre. It was the easiest class ever, you only have to put in a small amount of effort. Chavira is so kind and really is passionate about what he teaches
Not gonna take again
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Did not like it for an easy religion class. He doesn't let you use anything like notes or PowerPoint for exams also at he had a no technology policy. But exam questions are really simple and straightforward like any other class just listen to lectures and u pass.
So free, learnt so much about ancient Israel.
good professor learn a lot about ancient israel
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Sandoval is an amazing and intelligent professor. His lectures are very insightful, and you can tell he cares about the content he's teaching. Although some of the content may be complex, if you do the required readings and pay attention to the lectures you should do well in the class.
3 exams in the semester, then quizzes (that are not lockdown browser). Reading is optional, very manegable religion class.

I have nothing bad to say about him. Probably the best professor one can get in religion and has the absolute most passion and care for his teaching and students. The class can be challenging to some, but if you put in the work, you should be able to easily succeed.
Such a great professor, one of my favorites. In my opinion the content was very difficult but if you listen you should be fine. The final exam was online take home with no lockdown browser

Such a nice guy! I was really nervous going into this class because I'm not religious, but he really was great at teaching the subject. Really nice guy, and is very communicative outside of class and is always understanding. If you go to class and do the couple of short assignments, you're gauranteed an A (coming from a super average student)

He talks at a good pace and is easy to understand. I definitely recommend taking notes during the lectures and review days because most, if not all, the questions and answers he presents in class are going to be on the quizzes, and a lot of the quiz questions are on the exams. Just a heads up, he doesn't upload slides before class.

One of my favorite classes I've taken at TCU, a great professor who really tries to keep everyone participating and engaged. He gives you opportunities for extra credit and is understanding if you email for help. Attendance is mandatory, but there's outlined notes to follow along in class and if you use the review docs for exams, you'll do well.

This has been my favorite class this semester. Professor Sandoval is so kind and intelligent. He tries to make the class engaging and fun. He really cares about what he is teaching. I highly recommend taking him. Have to study but he provides exam prep questions that are similar to the exam. 3 quizzes on D2L, 3 exams, 3 reflections Take his class!
I really enjoyed this class and the way that he taught it. Pretty intimidating guy who strives to be respected but he's a great teacher. Show up and be engaged and you'll enjoy it

Professor Mabry is amazing! He is a police officer and is very knowledgeable about criminal investigation. His tests are very straightforward, and he makes sure to review the material before them. 2 written assignments that are also straightforward. He is a very engaging lecturer, and he occasionally brings in guest speakers. Take him!
Knows his stuff. Fair and knowledgeable.

Dr. Thompson is the funniest lady ever. She makes class so fun, she cracks herself up, and class is always a trip. It is lecture heavy and the content is difficult. Don't expect to get an A+ but also don't expect to get a C+. The class isn't hard but it isn't free. Study for the exams but don't pull an all nighter. Would absolutely take her again.

Dr. Thompson is the best. Her lectures are so entertaining. She's so excited to teach and brightens your day with her energy and smile. I never thought I'd appreciate ancient old theorists as much as I do now after taking her class. She connects the content well to modern-day. Exams are achievable to get an A if you go to class and review material.

I did not enjoy this class at all. She is extremely confusing and her lectures make no sense. Her exams are very hard and all on scantron. She lectures about pretty much everything except sociology and I could not pay attention in class. I dropped after the first exam. do not take Carol

I took Dr. Thompson for Theory which was not a super interesting class. She was fun and did her best to keep lectures fun by playing music and telling stories. She is super helpful during office hours. The class wasn't easy b/c there were so many research papers with lengthy requirements and confusing theories but she wants you to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Thompson is extremely passionate about sociology which makes the lectures engaging, but it can also cause her to get off topic and push the class off schedule. She cares a lot about her students and isn't a very hard grader, but grades VERY SLOWLY!! Lots of assigned readings but trust me, the book is NOT WORTH buying. Great prof. overall!

She is literally all over the place with her teaching. Slides make no sense you will need a thesaurus for all of them. And she takes a month to give you any grade back. Dont take her if you dont have patience

Wonderful teacher. She really does care about students and will work with you. She's kind and super supportive (always asked me how I was after class and asked how my other classes were going). She can go a bit off-topic sometimes, but she's entertaining. If you're very serious and don't like snark/brash humor you won't enjoy her lectures.

There's a LOT of essays and papers involved in this class. So be prepared to write. However your success is dependent on you researching on your own or watching a bunch of external videos and documentaries in order to know what to write about.  Lectures are great and to the point with humor and style. No tricks that require you to be in class. nice
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class was great. No tests, only 2 major papers. Tough grader but if you work with her she helps out. Loves animals, LETS YOU BRING YOUR ANIMALS TO CLASS. Had a different dog in class like every week, it was great. Really interesting stuff and kind of just watched movies and chit chatted about stuff. Also bought us pizza on the last day

Great teacher! Really Nice and actually keeps the class interesting! Loves animals and would let me bring my dog to class! The long papers aren't fun but there are only 2! Final Test is not cumulative!
Lots of reading and writing, but getting an A is doable if you keep up. A lot of material in a summer school class, but a wonderful experience. Would take Dr. Thompson again!

Summer session online; copious reading, which isn't a problem. Assigned "annotations," which is a poor term for what she actually wants. Instructions say "don't summarize" but feedback indicates that she actually wants a summary. Imposes a word limit for said "annotations" and then posts examples that are twice as long. Sorry, but boring overall.
Great professor! She can grade hard, but she'll help you out if you go to her office hours. Definitely one of my favorite professors here!

This teacher is well liked by students, but grades VERY hard. You should definitely go in to talk to her if you have a problem/need help. The way she grades is VERY particular. Lecture did not seem to help much, readings are essential. Tough class, would not recommend it.

Interesting course and lectures held my attention for the 3 hour class. You get study guides and she read a draft of my paper for me. Extremely helpful and funny. Doesn't take attendance but don't let that fool you, you have to go to class if you want to do well on tests.

Dr. Thompson is a brilliant professor with a true passion for what she does. Her classes are interesting, and you learn a LOT if you're willing to listen. Her tests aren't easy, but she adds points to exams if you can rationalize your answers. Attendance is mandatory! Not an easy A, but definitely worth the experience! She rocks! :)
Awesome professor! Great legs! Made every class fun and exciting. She is tough though.

Took theory--Dr.T. is a great prof. Clear notes, helps you if you need it. Reasonable amount of work. go to class lectures are great.  One of the best courses i have taken - so good I may add soci BS degree as a 2nd major.

Law&Soceity I highly recommend. Best prof teaching this course. Material is more interesting than it might be because she gives the controversial sides in lectures. Respects her students. Not hard if you stick to the study guides and go to class. Most important to me is that she kept us all awake in a three hour night class

it is sick how much i love this class. my fav class this year i go to class bcz i want to & the course applies to evrything. not easy but not 2 hard, prof is funny and nice gives some chances for xtra credit.
Do NOT skip class.  Be ready for essays and mult. choice.  CANNOT miss class!  An A is not easy at all!  Keep your butt in the seat and read your book!
