Tracy is an amazing teacher and she makes what we learn in class make sense through her criminal justice background and also relating it to Current day events. She's sweet and she responds to emails very quickly. If you attend class regularly, she will be a lot more lenient with moving around exams for you. I would definitely take her if I were you

Professor Walder is AMAZING! I took this course because I was interested in changing majors, and I am so glad that I did because I absolutely loved her and her class. She is very organized and ensures that her students are understanding the lesson. Pay attention and you will ace the few exams that she gives you. No quizzes and very few homework.
Tracy is great and her background is super interesting. Homework is an easy 100 to boost your grade. Exams are a lot to study, but she grades pretty easy.

The best professor I have ever taken! She is super engaging and has so many amazing stories to tell since she was in the CIA and FBI. The class is not hard, and she bakes the class cookies sometimes too!

Professor Walder is one of the best professors. She's very easy going and explains the material(slideshows and movies) really straight forward. Their are no exams or quizzes and only a few papers and class assignments. It is a night class but she lets you leave early every class. She also brings snacks for the class which is really nice too.

One of the best professors! The class was very easy, as long as you do the work and put in the effort you should get an A. There was one group project but not crazy at all! All the test are online and open note. She is so sweet and made the class manageable and low-stress. Definitely recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Wagstaff is one of the best professors I have had and makes this class fun and interesting. I highly recommend taking her class if you have the chance. Tests were all online and use your lecture notes, as she explains test material during class. Many opportunities for extra credit at the end of the semester.

Professor Wagstaff is a gem! Currently taking her for a minor course and love it. Lecture heavy with 5 exams and 5 discussion boards. If you go to class, take notes, and pay attention, it is hard to do poorly. I recommend taking her for an elective if you need hours!

Took this class as a random elective and ended up loving it. Professor Wagstaff is super sweet and is very helpful at office hours. Class is not super hard but it is important to show up to class and take the notes. She tells you exactly what you need to know for the test and her lectures are super interesting. I learned SO much! Take her class!!
Great class. Very entertaining. I learned a lot. He's a great guy.

I took this class online to fulfill a core credit and didn't expect much going in, but I ended up loving it!! Professor Walsh is respectful and loves what he teaches, which makes the course so enjoyable. Even though I'm not a theatre major, I found the material very engaging. I'd highly recommend this course to anyone!

Such a good fine art credit! The class is super simple and basically is just listening to him lecture. You have 4 reflection journals and 4 discussions that are super simple. 3 take home exams and a written paper due at the end of the semester. He truly is a wonderful professor and really cares about what he is talking about.
Write your name on name sheet for attendance but can have a friend write for you. Super easy class take it.
Professor Walsh brings infectious passion for theater to this easy A class. Tests are open-note, and unstuck study was a great study aid. Highly recommend for a fun, stress-free credit.

TAKE HIM!!!! Easiest fine arts credit ever. All test are online and not on lockdown browser, there is one paper that you get the whole semester to do, monthly discussion posts that are basically a completion grade, and a monthly reflection submitted to him that is also a completion grade. Attendance is mandatory but his class is super interesting.

Vey fun teacher and he really cares about theatre. He is very understanding of students(survey of theatre students at least). Exams are all online including the final. He was great and if you need the credit take him!

Take this class! Dr. Walsh is very passionate about what he is teaching and only hopes that he can inspire his students. There are discussions, short written assignments, and a few open note tests along the way. The classes can get long sometimes, but can also be interesting. Overall, an enjoyable class and a very easy A.

Great teacher overall. If you need a fine arts credit, take this class. Show up and pay attention. He doesn't allow computers, but it really isn't that huge of a problem at all. The tests are online on your own time. Very chill class.

Walsh is my favorite professor ever. He is so passionate about theatre and makes the class so engaging and interesting. The workload is very light and easy. he takes attendance through as sign up sheet.

Best professor for Survey of Theatre!! He offers a 20 point extra credit assignment. Throughout the entire semester, there is only 5 discussions and 5 small journals. All very easy. There are 3 exams and they are all take at home, open note. You do not have class on exam days. Attendance on regular class days is mandatory and he has a sign in sheet

Professor Walsh is clearly so passionate about theatre which makes his class so interesting. There are few assignments, only a couple discussions and self-reflection journals. Super easy, just turn in on time! All exams are taken from home, and are open notes. You do only get 3 missed classes, and he has you sign in on a attendance sheet everyday.

Dr Walsh is intelligent loves to show his passion for theater in his class, however the class itself is not super hard because of this. He makes an easy extra credit assignment at the beginning of the year which I highly recommend doing, but the tests and the reflection and discussions in the class are simple, however make sure to turn in on time

Take Walsh for Theater; he is definitely the best. Very caring and respectful of students. You get three free absences so use them wisely. 

Few tests that  are online open note, the rest is discussion posts which are extremely easy.
Very easy class you won't have to stress about. But he does take attendance every day through a sign in sheet, and few minor assignments. Highly recommend!

Easy A! Didn't pay attention in a single lesson but the tests are open note and open internet so it's nearly impossible to do poorly. You have to try to not get an A in the class. My friend wrote a journal on the wrong thing and still got a 90 on the assignment just for turning it in. His goal is to give all A's because that means he taught well.
Professor Walsh is very passionate about his teachings and is very knowledgeable of theater. Professor Walsh has many stories about the subject, which I found quite intriguing.

Professor Walsh is one of the best professors I've taken at TCU so far. He's understanding and you can tell that he really loves what he does. I genuinely loved going to his class and listening to his lectures. If you have the option to take him for anything, DO IT. You will not regret it.

Dr. Walsh was by far one of the best professors I have had. I took his class for a core credit, and it is very manageable. His lectures are always full of stories and are entertaining, and he typically lets class out early. Work outside of class is very slim and he does not grade hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class for a core credit and dont regret it one bit! Easiest A you will ever get. Walsh is super friendly and funny. His lectures are fun to attend. You get 3 free absences for the semester. Definitely recommend.

Walsh is so passionate about theatre and his passion leads you to want to do well in the class. He is understanding and it is obvious he cares about his students. He is a great storyteller and keeps class interesting and not too difficult. I would 100% recommend taking Walsh for theatre.
TAKE THIS CLASS EASIEST A EVER

Survey if Theatre is a great class. Dr. Walsh is very friendly, funny, cares about his students, and tells amazing stories during his lectures. You are allowed a couple of free absences throughout the semester but going to his class is enjoyable. Even if you are not a theatre major or in the fine arts, this class is still very interesting.

Dr. Walsh is a true legend of the TCU theatre department. He is very knowledgeable in what he speaks about during lectures. The class is catered to freshman students adjusting to college classes. Dr. Walsh's class is based heavily on lectures with occasional reflections, discussion posts, and exams. Highly recommend.
He is one of the greatest professors at TCU. I just love him.
Greatest story-teller at TCU! Take him and you'll never regret! I don't know anything else to say honestly, he's just amazing!
Take Walsh for a fine arts credit. Survey was easy, but really interesting too. Each exam reuses questions from the previous ones, so you're guaranteed a good grade. Don't buy the textbook!

Great for survey. You can pass without going, but his lectures were entertaining to attend. 3 tests reuse questions from previous ones, only one paper and extra credit opportunity. Wonderfully knowledgeable and had a good time sitting next to my friend laughing at the tangents he went on. Definitely take for FAR credit, super easy.
Easy money. Best class I have ever taken.

Joke class so don't buy book. Teaches from his notes. 2 tests and final. Each exam contains questions from previous exam (around 40%). Hilarious guy who always wears fishing shirts. You do write a critique which I recommend working hard on. Calls you out if you leave early but he cuts class most of the time anyway. Take him. Also not a a+- class.

This is probably one of the easiest classes to take at TCU. Professor Walsh is a nice guy and wants everyone to get A's. All of the tests are online and he even acknowledged this in class. Take him, you won't regret it!

100% take take take!!! He is amazing and fun. He has an attendance policy but its pretty lenient. Only 3 exams and practically gives you the questions and answers and then a play critique. Offers extra credit but I didn't even end up doing it and still got an A.
So funny and kind, comes off harsh just to scare you. Go to class & listen and you'll get an A. He gives all tests back so for the next test you have 30-50% of the right answers!

Walsh is one of the funniest teachers I've ever had. He knows this class is easy and that most people want to pass and he makes it very easy to do that. Tests are all multiple choice  and true/false. You have to do one short paper and that's it. The only thing is if you're on your phone or falling asleep he will call you out. Great, easy fun class!

Prof Walsh is amazing! Easiest class I've taken at TCU but you must go to class,  just take some notes and you'll be good to go. 3 tests but half the questions on each test come from the previous test which you get to keep! Final comes from all previous tests which he gives you so you have all the questions for the final :)

Professor Walsh is always entertaining in class. If you show up and pay attention you'll get a good grade in the class as long as you go over notes before tests. I would actually study for the tests. A lot of people think this class is so easy they don't  have to study, but they end up getting a B in a class where they could easily get an A.

Go to most of the classes, he will count of for participation. Tests are easy if you study (on quizlet). Classes are entertaining for the most part and it is a really good fine arts credit for a non-arts major.
Great professor! Rounded me up to a B!

Survey of Theatre with Dr. Walsh is must-take class for every student at TCU. The class is super easy and interesting - best fine arts credit by far. Walsh loves giving life advice to his students and is entertaining to listen to. There are two tests, a typed critique over a play, and a final. There is also an extra credit opportunity.
Loves the Theatre!! You can see his passion in class.  Take notes and it will be an easy A.

Dr. Walsh is an amazing professor and made Survey of Theatre both easy and interesting. If you go to class and pay attention, you will do well. Also, there is a paper you have to write on a play and a 30 point extra credit assignment. I thoroughly enjoyed the class. DO NOT BUY THE BOOK. I didn't even open it.

Probably the best professor I have had at TCU. He is funny, energetic, and nice. He wants you to like theatre, not just succeed in his class. If you do well on the tests, which you should if you show up to class and read the book, you'll do well on the test. He uses class time well and makes the paper and tests easy. Awesome class.
Easiest class I've ever taken. TOok survey of theater with him for my fine arts credit. Two tests and the final. TAKE IT.

Nice guy with a fun attitude. He knows this class is required and makes it interesting and enjoyable. All he asks of students is to show up (After 3 absences, points are taken off) and pay attention (Will throw balls or do other things to students that are sleeping). Class is let out early almost every time. Tests are easy if you study.

I can't even describe how easy this class was. If you take notes every day in class, you will get a high A. Don't mistake "easy" for "you learn nothing." Plenty of interesting information...worth your time!

I took Walsh for survey of theater. Super easy class. Just copy down the notes he puts up on the board and you'll be fine. Try to find previous tests, they're very similar, but not identical. Easy A for sure.

LOVED his intro class. Easiest A ever. Show up, take notes, and pass. He is really funny and just wants everyone to have a good time in his class. Honors with him is really easy as well! His tests are a piece of cake!

Took him for survey of theater. Easiest class I have taken! Takes attendance but allows 3 abscenses. Tests come straight from notes. Gives you back your old tests because alot of questions on the 2nd test come from the 1st test. Final is so easy because you already know half of the questions that will be on there. Walsh is a good teacher!

Very good teacher! He is such a nice guy and genuinely wants you to do well. He designed his class to make it nearly impossible for you to make anything lower than a B. Just take good notes in his lectures and you will breeze through this super fun class!
He was seriously the best teacher i had all year. This class is a must take if you want an easy A and a fine arts credit. Also a great honors class to take! Very Easy! Always out early as well!

Great teacher, made class bearable with stories and lectures.  Fairly easy tests if you study a little bit.  Best teacher I've had so far at TCU.  Class is semi-important since some test questions come from what happened in class.  Overall easy course and great prof.
Good teacher go to class its fun
He is a great story teller and his random storys are on the test so you need to attend class! You dont have to read the book to make an A.

Dr. Walsh is really funny, especially when he cracks himself up. He knows that people are just taking this class as a blow-off, and tries to keep the work at a bare-minimum. Basically, go to class and you're pretty much guarenteed an A. He cancels class a lot anyways, so just plan to attend.

Easiest class I have EVER taken! Go to class, take notes, and study tests from previous semesters. The tests get easier because most of the questions are from previous tests that he hands back to you. I hardly studied for this class and walked away with an A.

Great Prof! Must go to class because most of his examples end up on the tests. Tests get easier as the semester goes on because he puts some of the questions from past tests on future tests. You get to watch movies like Shakespeare in Love and Finding Neverland. His stories are really entertaining, too. And, you learn a lot about theater.

Walsh is hilarious. I loved his class it was so much fun. Really easy A. Going to class helps b/c some examples end up on exams. this theatre class is for everyone! if you hate theatre chances are you'll like this class.
Good teacher...watched "Shakespeare in Love"...tells interesting stories and is funny.  Honors...have to write a 2 page analysis each week over a play read and take an easy 5 question quiz.
Good teacher. Funny guy! Tells lots of stories and they are actually interesting! Take this class!

Dr. Walsh is extremely interesting. So far he has shown Shakespeare In Love, and clips of Jesus Christ Superstar and Legend of Bagger of Vance. Don't ever fall asleep, but you shouldn't because it is pretty intersting. The class consists of note taking and lecturing. Take Walsh
Best fine arts credit available! Extra credit available.
Easiest class i've ever taken!  I never studied and I never opened the book and I made an A+

Great Class!!! Best class i have had yet. He is an interestign guy with alot of stories and always expect to be out of class at least 15 minutes early every class. He is just a lovable guy and reallyw ants you to succeed. His test are extremely easy and comprehensive. Ex the first test of course has all new stuff, the second test has 50% of the sam

He's a good lecturer. Don't ever fall asleep, or he'll embarass you! I took him for Survey of Theater arts, and as long as you show up and take notes.. you'll get an A. The final is cumulative and he gives all your tests back! Easy A.

Dr. Walsh is a very interesting man to listen too. His class is soooo easy. There are 3 test, plus a few movies here and there. The class consists of note taking and you almost always get out 25 min. early. I definately recommend this GPA boosting class. Plus, Walsh is fun to listen too and learn from. My favorite class this semester, and I'm a business major!
Awesome!

I have an interest in theatre but I'm not a major or a minor and I did fine! Just watch out for your points, and put some effort into it!! Easy A. Very interesting person, very easy to get along with, and yeah he does have a bit of an elitist streak but thats cuz he is good at what he does. Love this man. A hidden treasure at TCU. All hail Walsh!

Great teacher.  Makes class fun and interesting.  Research paper's kind of rough, 3 easy quizzes, 3 easy creative papers.  Loves to go on tangents during lecture and doesn't care.  Works with students' schedule.  Read the text, its not that bad, and just go to class.

OMG! Fascinating man! I could listen to him talk for hours! He's so helpful if you just approach him.  He's very kind and enthusiastic and knows just what to say to guide you on the right track.  His constructive criticism is very helpful!

Wow! Dr. Walsh is an amaxing teacher! And honestly, this class is so easy and he makes Theatre history so intriguing and interesting! I caught myself actually talking about a lecture of his the other day. You will also be able to use this information that he teaches in the future. He is AWESOME!

Dr. Walsh is AWESOME! I have never had a professor like him...He makes me love theatre more and more than i ever have. I can't even begin to express what an impact he has already made on me - and I've only been in his class for 4 weeks!
i have a tremendous amount of respect for this man
Had him for Survey of Theatre, Acting 1, Directing, Theatre History I & II.  Great teacher.  If you get a chance to take one of his courses do it.

Easy class! Take for Fine Arts credit! Huge class so he will never know you personally. Takes attendance so go to class or have some1 sign you in. Class is pretty boring, you copy notes from overhead.  Get test files from some1 in a frat/sor. Uses same tests every year.
easy class, try to show up for most of them and there wont be a need to study before tests. funny guy, good stories, movies sometimes in class.
Good guy, good stories, great entertainer, easy A.
Great class, easy A.
Who doesn't Like Dr. Walsh?  He is great, take him.

I really liked the guy. He's interesting, funny just go to class and definitely take notes. Have to do good on tests, there are only a few grades for the semester. Class is pretty easy just a lot of note taking.

extremely easy class. this guy is awesome and fun. he literally gives away As if u do the review sheets, play review and do extra credit stuff. anybody getting a B in this class is an idiot. just pay attention in class and u shud get an A.
Best teacher at TCU.  Loves his job, so funny. Get's everyone as excited about theater as possible. Makes class painless and great teacher.
What an awesome prof. He's helpful, hilarious, and the classes are really entertaining. Go to class, take notes, and study and you will make an A. (But serisouly make sure you study) Great guy.

EVERYONE LISTEN TO ME. Take the honors section of this class, it is insanely easy and its just an extra 50 minutes a week. All you do is read one short play a week and discuss it in class after the regular class gets out on friday. Seriously, very easy A in an honors course, looks good on transcript
Very easy.  Take good notes and study the review sheet.  He sometimes talks about himself too much, but he's funny and entertaining.

Awesome professor, understands that we are in here for credit and realtes theater to film and other interesting things. He has a man crush on Gene Hackman so watch out, he is in love with his acting! It is cool and funny!
Extremely easy class.  Don't buy the book it's a waste of money.  Just study your notes and its an easy A.  Don't miss more than 3 classes because he'll start docking your grade.
The easiest class at TCU!

Great teacher, just make sure no one dies in your family. If your out of school for a funeral he will give you a zero for days you miss and then not tell you about until after you take the final. I had a 96 test average but i got a B in the class. WTF!
the easiest class at TCU. Dont buy the book!! I didnt open it once.  Easy A.  Just look over the notes and the study guide a couple of times.

cool prof, loves teaching, very enthusiastic, very respected, easy class because he is very clear... go to every single class, study the notes, do extracredit and like me you will get a 101% average before having taken the final!
Awesome teacher.  Very interesting.  Easy tests.
This class is so easy. If you have access to test files, there is no need to go to class; Same questions, different order. I highly recommend his class for an easy A.

What a cool guy!  He is funny and his stories are hilarious.  He does, however, ask that you treat the subject of theater with respect just as you would with a subject that interests you.  Tests are basically common sense, but do take notes!
Class is easy, just study notes and previous tests. I never cracked my textbook.

He's a REALLY good teacher!!  As long as you go to class and pay attention in the least, you can pretty much get an A.  Don't buy the book. . . waste of money.  Just come to class-that is the key.  Great teacher.  Glad I took this class.
He is so damn cool! Very easy class, but you cant miss more than 3 times! But, it is worth the EASY A by going to class!

Walsh RULES! Amazing teacher! I ENJOYED going to his class. The exams were so darn easy and Walsh is a funny professor with a passion for his subject. Incoming freshman, THIS is the class you want to take!
great teacher, great class
very easy tests!  just go to class and listen and you will do well.  he is a funny guy.
Good class, funny guy, excellent teacher. Material is interesting and goes by fast. :)
THE BEST CLASS EVER!  I LOVED IT AND IT WAS SOO EASY

Easiest class. Even though eh does take attendance, only 3 exams including the final...give syou review for them...tells you to look at old tests...only 1 essay which is very short and easy...and lots of extra credit. 90% of people get an A!
Its easy if you go to class, study old tests.
He is very understanding.  He wil help you out, and he hates having to give poor grades.
No Comments
Very funny guy. Interesting class. Study the old tests and your golden. Many extra credit opportunities and only ONE essay homework assignment.
Knows most people are just in there for the UCR credit and don't really care about the subject. He's a funny guy and class time goes fast.
Wakes you up in the morning, always friendly and has a smile on his face...more profs need to have his attitude
very funny guy, easy class
You dont need to buy your book. It's all off the notes. Funny guy.

Dr. Walsh is always interesting, usually pretty funny.  You get 3 absences with no penalty, and coming in late = 1/2 absence.  He won't put anything on the test that wasn't discussed in class.  Study your notes & put thought into your essays.  He's great!
Amazing professor. Lets you assign your own grade at the end of the semester. Discussion based and not a lot of writing. Take this class!
Awesome Professor! Makes the class interesting and fun while approaching it with a fun mindset. I had a great time in this class and learned some new topics!

Mat is an absolutely amazing person. His class structure is definitely not typical but it's extremely functional. Not a lot of work at all. Clearly cares about his students and others. Mat takes a very different approach to composition writing but it works perfectly. Class was enjoyable and he wants you to engage.

This class is a guaranteed A if you complete the basic work required by Mat. Mat is a kind teacher who is laid-back and understanding. However, the class has absolutely no structure, and you will find yourself learning or participating in far-left ideas that have no real-world application. Attendance is required but you get 6 unexcused absences

I took this class because of the amazing reviews I saw on here, and they were right. This class is super stress-free, except you will be called on to speak a lot. As long as you are open to participation, you will get an A no problem. There are no tests; just do what he asks. He is also super funny, so seriously, he is a great teacher.
Not a hard class with him at all. Graded by a presentation and creating a website. Easily accessible outside of class and grades very easy. Take his class

Such a chill and easy to talk to professor. Class was mainly doing podcast episodes in a group, but even as someone who doesn't always like group work, the class is structured so you get comfortable with your group as you go. If you turn in everything at the end of the semester, you get an A. If essays aren't always your thing, take Mat's course!
Wenzel was awesome! You have up to 6 free absences and he is the easiest grader.

Mat has by far been my favorite professor at TCU. He makes learning english so fun and engaging. Even though attendance isn't mandatory i never wanted to miss a class because of how great he was. make sure to complete his checklist which you mostly do in class. If you're planning on taking English take him you will not regret it.

Mat is a great professor. He has a great sense of humor and is just here for a good time. He doesn't take things too seriously and doesn't see this class as an "end all be all" kind of thing. He's actually so great. I am so glad I took this class with him. Highly recommend.
Mat is the best! So understanding, hilarious, and makes lectures interesting. Homework and class work is very minimal and easy.
Mat is seriously the best English professor I've had at TCU. His classes are always enjoyable and I've never not wanted to go to class. He's hilarious and hardly assigns homework. TAKE HIM!
Mat's class is very probing. He takes a unique approach to teaching. He is very real with students, which makes for a good class dynamic.

Mat is a great teacher for writing comp 1. He is hilarious and he does not set specific times for when things are due so all that matters is that you complete the work. There will be a few presentations. You can skip class a couple times if you want to if you have other work. There are in class discussions. Definitely take him

If you have the chance to take his class, TAKE IT!!! He is absolutely hilarious, fun, caring, and the best professor I have ever had. His class is fun and I always looked forward to going. He is there to help you with anything in his class and is there to help you with life cause he truly does care about all of his students.

Mat Wenzel is the BEST professor to take for intro to composition. He is funny, cares about his students, and does not give homework. There are no tests, essays, or books. You get 7 free absences and he will give you whatever grade you want at the end of the semester as long as you complete the checklist.
Mat makes class very interesting. You are allowed 6 absences. Assignments all due at the end of the semester, so you can work at your own pace.

Mat is honestly really easy going. There's no hard deadlines for homework besides the final project and one easy presentation. He doesn't care about attendance unless you miss more classes than you go to. Your final project is basically your entire grade, but all you have to do is what he asks for and then you give yourself the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He was the best teacher and 100% plan on taking him again. Attendance is not mandatory- he builds in three weeks of absences into the syllabus and provides a log for days you missed. Pretty confusing instructions but one of the best teachers and if you go to office hours he helps a ton.

Mat was one of the best professors I had in all my life! If you struggle he is always there to help, and has great availability for office hours. If you miss class you are responsible to catch up, but he is really flexible. Looking forward to taking another class with him. Definitely take him, you won't regret it.

Wenzel is an amazing professor that teaches you so much about writing with Inquiry. He is always available for office hours and anything via email. Attendance is optional but you'll be completely lost if you don't attend. I highly recommend this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

You only have to do 10 reading responses whenever you want to and you have 4 big papers that he basically helps you write they are super easy. class seems very open ended and heavy on your own opinions and thoughts and structure, yet grades opposite of this. Told you can write about any community you want but then critiques it when he doesn't agree

The exams are difficult, and most of your grade is determined by the exams, but everything else is fine.

There are two mandatory exams, with an optional final, along with simple weekly quizzes and a group project at the end of the semester. The workload is very manageable, the grading is fair, and overall it's a low-stress class that's easy to succeed in.

Dr Weizi is a new professor, this being her first year teaching. She is a sweet lady and very caring but I quite literally learned nothing. It's the easiest strat comm class/teacher you can take and almost everyone got an A.
Liu is the best!!! All exams are open note and all quizzes are online! She truly cares for her job and is inspiring.

Class assignments and projects really make you feel like an advertising professional. There are a few writing assignments, online quizzes, and 2 exams. They are all open note, there's extra credit for attendance, an optional replacement exam! She's honestly so nice and inspirational to me. Dr. Liu 's class is well constructed you'll love it!

Take this class!! She's easy to reach, gives clear instructions, great feedback, and wants you to succeed. She gives real examples related to each concept and has in-class activities related to the content. There are weekly reading quizzes on McGraw-Hill and two open-note exams, and a third optional one throughout the semester.

Lecture heavy, reads off slides heavy. In class participation activities and gives extra credit for showing up. Two big group projects, relatively easy. Exams online, not pronctored. Used Mcgraw hill for weekely quizzes. Overall easy and interesting!

Truly such a nice professor!! This sem was Liu's first, she was learning w us = lecture's were kinda boring, but I think they'll get better. She is so willing to help, is extremely understanding, and wants the best for her students. Offers ALOT of extra cred, tbh impossible not to do well. Exams were online, and assignments were not difficult.

There are just too many good things to say about Wendy Hermes. She is an amazing professor, you will learn so much from her. You can tell she is passionate about the topic and is excited to teach. Make sure to take good notes for the tests and read the cases she assigns. Not a hard class if you pay attention. Take this class, you won't regret it.

Professor Hermes is a phenomenal professor. I had her for Con. Law in the spring
The way she talks about the Constitution really shows its strength and her passion for it makes you appreciate it in a way you didn't expect. I won't ever forget her class!
As for the class work...pay attention, engage, & do the readings - you'll be just fine.

One of the easiest classes I've taken at TCU. Simple material, short classes, no assignments. 
Four tests that are so straightforward idk how you could not get an A, even if you missed every single class. 
Study guide is basically the test.

One of the easiest classes I have ever taken. You don't really need to go to class, the tests/material is no harder than a high school civics class. No assignments really, and when you do go to class we maybe were there for 45 minutes. Took it last fall, totally recommend.
I took her in the fall and it was not a hard class just boring. Very few grades but she is a very interesting person! Seems like she is passionate about the subject.
Only grades are four tests.
Nice woman, just only graded on four things which is hard but doable. Let out early literally every class. Put this class on the back burner and still did fine.

reviews.comment: My favorite professor I have ever had at TCU. She is very thoughtful, kind, and respectful of her students. I adore her and would do anything to have her again. Take her class!
The absolute best, I would take her every semester if I could. She is so passionate and resourceful. Her lectures are amazing.
I loved having this professor. She is extremely engaging and the content she covers is super entertaining. I have zero complaints, the tests were straight forward. Highly recommend this class.

She definitely cares about her students and engages with everyone. You do not necessarily have to attend class to pass but it helps a ton. She's also pretty straight to the point with hardly any rambling so class goes by fast. Take her courses if you can.

Wendy is one of the best professors I have ever had in my college experience. She has an engaging voice and personality. She will not drag class out and is very direct and straight to the point. I love listening to her lectures she really knows how to engage the room and make class enjoyable. I learned so much in her constitutional law class.

Professor Hermes is one of my favorite professors that I've had at TCU. She is super nice and cares about her students and cares about their success. If you have a chance to take one of her CJ class take her!
Honestly, research is unbaringly boring. he is very nice and obviously cares a lot about psych and teaching. lectures are just a little hard to get through.

reviews.comment: Dr. Weise is an awesome teacher who wants everyone to succeed. He is very accommodating and makes time outside of class to meet and discuss tests and any other questions. Amazing professor who truly wants his students to do well. The tests were a bit difficult due the class being restructured, but he offers extra credit through SONA and a research paper. There's also group projects that are super easy because you do them as a class, so they're an easy 100. Definitely take this class. Professor Weise is amazing!

He gave us a lot of extra credit, curved our exams, and even dropped the final to make up for being unorganized at times. The exams are tough but the group projects are easy, just follow the instructions

reviews.comment:
Classes are on Zoom too and are on d2l for to watch later if you want to, so you don't have to go, but it's an important class, so I would recommend going and paying attention or watching the Zooms later, but taking notes.
He's a good professor, and it's really easy to understand everything that he explains.

reviews.comment: Great professor. He was super chill, very easy, and willing to answer any questions you may have. Tests are all open-book and there's easy extra credit offered. You do have to go to class (online, in person, or watching the lecture later) though because his slides just have broad topics in them, which he elaborates on in class. 10/10, take him.

You can also get feedback before submitting the paper, which helped me a lot. There are 10 easy assignments and two bonus ones, including one worth 30 points.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love taking classes with Dr. Weise. He is extremely helpful outside of class and offers extra credit. The exams are easy if you study the slides. He recorded lectures and also allows you to zoom if you want. No attendance needed. The exams were written and multiple choice and there were two but it all comes from lecture. Besides a few video assignments there was only a small essay to do about a topic you select.

reviews.comment: Dr. Weise was a phenomenal teacher. He absolutely understand what to teach and how to teach it in a way that was not confusing and understandable. reviews.comment: Take this class. He is extremely flexible, you should listen to the lecture but can do so by going to class in person, on zoom, or watching zoom recording afterwards. I highly recommend this professor. Even though attendance wasn't required, I was excited to go to his class every day. great professor. Makes sure you understand every topic. Clear about what he expects and grades fairly. No final, just a research paper at the end of semester. Not a ton of feedback on assignments.

Best professor I've had at TCU.  If you're a psych minor or major I would highly recommend getting into as many classes with him as you can.  He is extremely helpful and his lectures are immensely interesting.  If you put in the effort to study, you will get an A.

Dave is the coolest teacher ever. His lectures are really interesting and he does a great job speaking to an audience of young people and keeping their attention for the whole class period. If you go to class, it's an easy A. I took every single test hungover and never got below an 88. Tons of extra credit opportunities too. He's hot too.
I would take this class again. Go to class because even though he says that he only offers extra credit at the end of the semester he gives you opportunities during lecture. Very approachable

He seems to think that his class is hard, but it really isn't. I read before class, listen to the lecture and take the occasional note. I study for 1-2 hours and do great on the tests. This is my easiest class this semester. The proposals are tricky. Be sure to ask lots of questions on format, they are the hardest part of the class.

I literally ended with a 104% in the class, it is CAKE. You need to remain dedicated to doing the extra credit labs, they are annoying but do them. He offers tons of extra credit if you go to class, and if you study the tests are easy. He is also really young and funny! Take this class!
Really easy going and funny professor. Work hard and you'll do well. very very helpful with anything you need
Dr. Weise is a great professor. If you must take behavioral research be sure to get in his class. He seems to really care about the subject and will do anything to make sure you understand.

my boy Dave, cool guy. Great class. You can tell he enjoys the subject and wants to help. Go to class. He gave a lot of extra credit, especially when people don't show up. Fall 2013 was his first semester at TCU, so he might change.

Dr. Weise is really funny and an easy going professor. His class was not only super easy, but also really interesting. Lots of videos in class, and LOTS of extra credit for just showing up to class. Loved his class!! :)
Class was very easy, never had to read the text book. LOTS of extra credit and is an easy A if you show up.

Dr.Weise is really young so he's pretty fun and easy going. Tests are easy if you do the study guide he gives you. Haven't read the book since the first test and I've always made A's. NEVER PUTS IN GRADES!! She is a fine teacher, nice outside the classroom, but never responds to emails.

No feedback, no grades, complicated grading guidelines, no responses to emails.

Do not take her.

Entirely unavailable outside of class, does not respond to emails (apparently she reads them but ignores them intentionally), does not enter grades at all (even when many people asked, she apologized and then didn't even do it), syllabus missing info we were expected to know.

Waste of a pass / no credit.

She did not have a organization for this class. Even forgetting to upload grades till the very final of the semester! She barely sends emails notifying class meetings or make up days. She grades really rough on your essays and lots of lectures. Definitely I do not recommend this professor.

For a communicating teacher, she doesn't communicate effectively. Lectures all of the class she says a lot of words but doesn't really say anything. She might respond to your emails if you are lucky. Compared to other teachers she is difficult. If you want an easy class do NOT take her.

She is genuinely so kind and understanding, and really wants you to succeed. She is a tough grader on speeches, but there are plenty of extra credit opportunities, and the grading criteria is very clearly laid out. Her class page can be confusing and it can be difficult to find materials, but other than that she is a wonderful professor.
Takes the freshmen required class way too seriously. Grades extremely tough.

This class is not difficult. The midterm and in-class assignments are easy if you come to class. Her speeches on the other hand are graded so hard! If you are taking her as an easy communicating effectively credit, don't. She is exponentially harder than every other professor for this class. She is not nice at all, and asks of you to do things that she does not prepare for you to do. She has more work than any other communicating effectively teacher by a mile. REQUIRES that you come to class. Ms. Weinzapfel is a full time doctoral student and full time professor this semester so sometimes it takes her a while to grade things, but she gives great feedback. Quizzes before each class, 4 speeches, and 2 exams but if you do the work, its a fun class!

Professor Weinzapfel is a good professor. She is understanding of emergencies and will work with you on grades. Shes very sweet but grades excessively hard. If you are not word for word on exams then you will fail. Overall her class isnt super difficult and she is very nice.

Ms. W is awesome! You definitely have to work in her class but she is super approachable. She gave me good feedback for my speeches. Even though I made a B, shes still a really good professor. She is engaging and makes classes tolerable.

Macias is a fraud. She spends class time giving fake, passive feedback until she gets online and gives you 70s on assignments that don't have a rubric or outline. She's a bully--only online. STAY AWAY! I took her for Campaigns & she ruined mine & everyone else's senior year. The worst professor I've had at TCU hands down. ok so she almost made me want to change my major. don't get me wrong she is a ice person but if It was my choice I would just read the book, instead of wasting about four hours a week doing absolutely nothing! the tests are too long ad hard. just thankful I actually passed the class!
