Woodworth makes class soooo much more fun than history really is. Tests are straight forward from his lectures, attendance is a must if u want a good grade. He knows his stuff and adds remarks to his everyday lectures..funny guy

Great prof., i had never taken his class before until i took the civil war class. He knows his stuff when it comes to the civil war. i believe any one that likes history should take his civil war class.
One of the best professors here at TCU.  He knows the material inside and out.  I actually looked forward to going to class because it was SO interesting!  He makes history fun.
great teacher!  Knows a lot more than the text, and shares interesting facts, conspiracy theories, and scandals that you just dont get to hear about in the books!

The lectures are the test, must be willing to go to class if you want to do well but he doesnt take attendance of anything.  Great teacher and has the ability to make the time go fast.  If you go to class you should have no trouble with an A or B.

Great prof. Great class. He's entertaining, too, which is hard to find in a history class. It's clear why he's respected in his field nationwide. But he has hardly an ego. He's really in class to share his love of the Civil War with others. No papers and few books to read, but you'll learn a lot.

Wonderful lectures. He keeps you entertained with cool facts and stories. Knows his stuff. No papers. Multiple choice section of test is easy, essays are graded hard though. Overall great class, the man makes history interesting.

He grades fairly easy for a 4000 level class. The class is interesting, and his tests are straight off the lecture. The tests are essay and id (gives you a person or event and you have to talk about it) and you get to pick say 5 out of 8 of the id's and 1 out of 2 essays. Take it if you enjoy hist.
Lots of very interesting material, grades really easy for an upper-level. Great professor, very energetic and sometimes funny.

Hes a nice guy, but is it just me or was his grading a little difficult. Actually it was the T.A. grading our tests, and he could be verrrry stingy with the points. almost no one gets the full amount of points for the essay, you apparently have to write and research a seperate paper for that.
Great teacher, no papers just test. goes over all the information in lectures
makes the history come alive, very exciting and makes alot of jokes. not a hard course, just come to class and take good notes. i would love to take another one of his classes agian.
Knows the Civil War like you wouldn't believe. Great lecturer. Doesn't take time to learn names, though. Tests all essay, but light on grading. Take Civil War class -- will open your eyes to events.
No Comments

Lectures are entertaining, he really knows his stuff. Tests are not bad at all, just make sure you know what he's looking for on the essay portion or it may hurt you. All-around good guy, helpful and understanding. TAKE THIS CLASS!!
Definitely knows his us history, class is good if you can stay awake. Go to class, take notes and keep facts straight on the essays or they'll kill you.
Class is long but he is a great teacher. Really knows his stuff. Tests can be difficult becasue of essays. Really cool guy, but class is long.

great teacher. make sure it is clear how to write the essays on the test because they can kill your grade. you must read the textbook!!! it's a very early class so make sure you get plenty of sleep and stay awake because he is a great teacher.
Extremely smart man and a great teacher. I would recommend him to anyone who is going to take history. His tests can be a little hard but overall he is great.

One of my favorite teachers of all time. I loved going to class. He's entertaining and knows his stuff. He's fair in grading and always makes time for questions. I'm disappointed I can't take another class with him. No papers, and his tests are decent.
Great teacher... knows what he is talking about, you don't really have to buy the book-- go to class and take the notes! fun... Take this class~

Wooodworth is a great teacher, very flexible, knows alot of cool facts about u.s. history, an all around great guy. Ive taken many history classes and he is by far the best history teacher ive ever had, one of the best profs at tcu.

I had him for the Civil War.  He took a semester off the next semester, so I was sad not to have another opportunity to take a class with him.  Man, he makes the civil war so amazingly exciting.  If you have an opportunity, take his class!  No papers!

He moves quickly and his tests are challenging. He knows what he's talking about (author of like 20 books) and doesn't even use notes. Reading the book is overrated. He's always willing to help. Very conservative and outspoken.

This is a very easy class, however, it is extremely boring. If you are not musically inclined you may struggle on the tests and quizzes as they are extremely specific. If you miss a quiz she reopens them at the end of each unit  for about a week and is quick with email. Overall, I would still recommend this class for an easy fine arts credit.

TAKE THIS COURSE!! Professor Lee is very chill. Only homework is quizzes which you get two attempts at. Then you have online exams and also group discussions. As long as you do the minimal work and go to most classes (5 unexcused) you will get a hundred in the class. I recommend this as a Fine arts credit.

Dr. Lee is great! I was skeptical about taking a music course but I'm so glad I decided to take her class. It's fairly easy if you keep up with the reading and really pay attention during her lecture. There are listening quizzes (weekly), group discussions, and 4 exams including the final all of which are pretty easy. Attendance is required!
She is a good teacher and it is an easy class, just pretty boring and she is not very understanding if you miss work.

Professor Lee is a fantastic professor. I'm not a music major, but she made BUSI 10153 enjoyable. Her lectures thoroughly explain the material. There are a few tests and weekly listening quizzes. Highly recommended for fine arts credit.

Professor Lee is an amazing professor. Her passion for music made lectures actually engaging. Work for class  consisted in easy short quizzes of 2-3 questions, 4 group discussions (which they are simple and interesting), and 4 exams. All questions are straight forward so if you study, you will pass. I would definitely take another class with her.

I LOVE THIS WOMAN. Take her for your fine art credit if you get the chance. She cares about her students, her class is easy, and if you have any musical background (even middle school choir) it's a cake walk. She let our entire class retake a test after going over the answers bc we did bad the first time. As long as you don't skip, you'll be fine.
Quizzes are easy, take them at home, and are only 2-3 questions. Tests are hard because they are on a lockdown browser in class. MUST STUDY!

Dr. Lee is a very kind professor. She clearly cares about the topic she is teaching, and she wants to share her knowledge with the rest of the class. The class is not challenging, but attendance plays a role in your grade. Overall, I would recommend taking Dr. Lee for Survey of Music for an easy and enjoyable fine arts credit.

She's passionate, teaches just enough knowledge. Most of her tests answer are from her ppt slides. She does have activities and quizzes in her classes so you won't get bored. Attendence is important! Also there are graded discussion questions so make sure you keep track. For finals you should focus on the biggest chapter. Overall a great professor!
PROF Wood is the BEST! I wish she could teach all of my finance classes. If you pay attention in class and work through the practice problems to practice it'd be hard to not get a 90+ on the tests.
She is seriously the best. Take her take her take her. Only a little bit of HW, attendance isn't mandatory, and tests are relatively easy.

Dr. Wood is the best professor I have ever had at TCU. She is very nice and understanding. She is always accessible outside of class, so go to her office hours. Her class had 3 exams and she lets you use 1 sheet of notes for the exam. If you have a good sheet of notes and understand the material you will do well in the class!

She's fabulous, truly - I wouldn't have wanted to take any other professor for such a hard class. HW is 3 tries per question and has a help me tool in case you are lost. 1 Sheet per test - get ready to understand the concepts.

I don't love fin man, but she does the best job out of all the professors. Everyone else was struggling but Mrs. Wood teaches you how to use the financial calculator and you get a one side sheet of notes so that you don't have to memorize formulas. Tests are about 15 conceptual questions from the chapters and the rest are workout.

Dr. Wood's Advanced Financial Management class is great! You'll learn a lot of valuable information and practical application. Her exams are exactly like the example problems you work through together in class. As long as you have those concepts down, you'll do just fine. You are also allowed a sheet of notes on exams. A solid choice!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great class, super easy A, and much better than other finance professors. She reviews the exam in the class period before each exam and goes over the type of problems you can expect. allows you a sheet that you can write notes on and take with you (can be typed). Very lenient and overall one of my favourite classes at TCU.

Dr. Wood is the goat for FinMan. You can tell she loves her job and is dedicated to ensuring her students succeed She explains the concepts clearly but is happy to go over things if need be. She tells you exactly whats on the test and she lets you use a full sheet of paper with notes on the test. Ill be taking her next fall for Adv. FinMan.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Wood is awesome!! Its super clear whats going to be on the tests and there really arent too many surprises. The class goes by quickly and youll learn a lot!
Amazing professor truly cares about her students and an amazing teacher. You will learn about financing in her class and enjoy the subject while retaining the information.

Run-of-the-mill class and professor. She was very nice and knowledgable about the subject material. The tests are fine as long as you know how to do the practice problems. Definitely go to class, because the problems we did in class were pretty much the whole test. She is reasonable about missing homework and having to miss class.
Raging liberal but good professor and very clear. I enjoyed her classes but don't get her on politics. A bit grandiose about her previous job at Allergan, but it's palatable.

I love Professor Wood's finance class. She is helpful, clear, and a good lecturer. Her tests can be hard but if you prepare well enough, B is achievable, A if you actually really understand the material. Participation does not matter so that's nice. Overall, Ms Wood is a very nice person and I will definitely take her again for Advance Finance.

Dr. Wood is awesome. I absolutely hated ACCT so I was afraid for this class, but she's super helpful and her tests aren't bad. Take her for Financial Mgmt if finance/acct isn't your strongest subject.
She is a great professor! She will always answer e-mails regarding homework questions, and will go out of her way to help you learn the material!
Dr. Wood is SO nice and helpful, and she just wants her students to do well. Definitely one of my favorite teachers at TCU!

She is a nice professor but her class format is so complex...you have to buy alphia case, buy discussion cases, buy ebook. you have to set up lots of accounts which are a waste of time and which can make u frustrated...and u have to pay all of the cases and HWs...
She is easy and available to answer questions!!!  I believe if you take seriously for the entire semester can finish with an A; but slack off and you will get in the Bs.
the class ended up being harder than i expected...for the most part if you go to class and study before the exams you will do fine...wood is very nice and helpful

For sure one of the better teachers at TCU.  She makes class very interesting and her tests are not hard at all.  The capital budgeting project also helps to boost your grade.  BUT, the final is almost impossible, possibly because everyone's grades were so high but everyone I talked to received very low grades

One of the best teachers at TCU.  Some of these old reviews are not accurate as things have changed.  You have 3 tests- the first is extremely easy, second is pretty tough, third is easy.  Do well on the capital budgeting project and you will have a cushion going into the comprehensive final.  It is extremely difficult.  Dr. Wood however is great!
Could be one of the greatest teachers at TCU. Very clear and precise on everything. She is the reason I switched from a Fina minor to major.

Financial Management class was one of the best I've taken mostly because she is a great teacher. She tells you exactly what is on the tests and she is very clear when explaining topics. She's really nice too if you go in to see her.

B Wood was a good teacher. She was very quick and fair with her grading and with all of her policies. Make sure to do the homework before the tests because most of the problems come from there. The projects are easy and a great way to boost your grade. She will probably try to cram a lot of chapters in at the end of the semester so be ware.

B Wood is a good teacher! She is willing to help you out and wants everyone to do well. She lets you keep your tests which makes the final alot easier. Get to right everything on a note card for the tests. Watch out though for the online portion can be tricky at times. Overall is a good teacher and has "motherly" influence on everyone.
very clear teacher. fair and straight forward. notecards for tests make them easy. lots of grading opportunities so it doesn't all ride on your tests too.

Great Teacher.  Know the practice tests and you will Ace tests.  Very helpful and is willing to help you whenever.  She also has some real word expierence with the material which makes it interesting.
Very fair. Very helpful. Teaches everything you need to know to Ace the tests. I thought this class was supposed to be a beast. But Prof. Wood really helped us all through it. Glad I took.
you have to study, good teacher, understanding, helpful
Great teacher!  Took during Maymester and she made things easy for all of us.  Very understanding and gave out old tests from her other classes she taught in the past.  I would take again!
She is a part-time instructor and she's working on her doctorate so she's pretty leniant because she knows how crazy things can get.
This class is discussion-based, and she makes the discussions really interesting. Self-graded participation is useful. She is very accessible outside class if you have any questions. Must take!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Professor Wren is a great teacher! Her classes are mostly discussion based and she really cares about her students' opinions. You are required to read the novels assigned, but you really only need to know the basics and can read summaries to understand. There are occasional reading quizzes. I would highly recommend taking her class.
Dr. Wren is awesome. Her papers are all easy, and your grade your own projects. She's a beast. Awesome class!

Dr. Wren is the nicest and most caring teacher ever! She is super genuine and wants to get to know all of her students. I took The Women of Netflix, English 10803 online and it was a very interesting class and was so much better than reading books. She is a very easy grader and I definitely recommend her class.

I took Professor Wren for Intro to Shakespeare and I loved her. She made class fun and entertaining. You are graded on participation, but as long as you do the reading it's easy to talk occasionally in class. The tests were also easy as long as you read and attended class. She's also a reasonable grader.I highly recommend her for any English class.

I took her last semester & loved her, she makes a class interesting, plus she's helpful/understanding. Taking Crime Through Detectives Eyes: No tests/quizzes but there are often short assignments that u have to read/write about but they are graded for completion which is a big grade booster; a few short self-graded papers & rubric made by the class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: young &relatable professor who made intro to shakespeare a fun class despite there being a lot of reading& i dont like reading. 10 pop quizzes but as long as u look at summaries beforehand online at no fear shakespeare u will be fine. midterm is the exact same as the study guide. a few short, easy A papers if u do what she asks, final is same way.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Sweetest human being ever. As long as you do the readings before class and show up and contribute to the discussion, you'll have an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She is an awesome teacher, shes understanding and picks very interesting topics to talk about. She gives good feedback on papers and the readings are very interesting. There is homework assigned before each class and sometimes a quiz over it but the quizzes are easy and the reading is light. Highly Recommend.

I took the Victorian Murder, Mystery, and Mayhem class and I actually really enjoyed it, even though it was at 8 AM. She is a great and encouraging professor who is always willing to help. Participation is mandatory pretty much every day of class, and you have a few papers due throughout the semester, but overall not too bad at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Great prof! she really cares about each student individually. GO TO HER OFFICE HOURS for extra advice on papers. there is a lot but what else would you do in comp? group papers ahead! really sweet!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: There is a ton of reading and writing which is expected with an English course. She does do pop quizzes on the readings from the night before so attendance is key, because she only drops one quiz grade, but she does give an extra credit opportunity at the end to help. Professor Wren is super fun and energetic, making the class fun.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: There are constantly papers due in this class, but it is intro comp, so that's how it has to be. Go to her office hours and have her look over your papers before the due date and you will make a better grade on them. The final exam was just making a video, presenting it to the class, and writing a short paper about it. She is a nice lady.

Young professor so she relates to students really well and is an overall nice lady. However, she tends to grade very hard. You can get a B but really makes you work for it as it seemed like I needed to type a RAP or Essay every time I showed up for class

Professor Wren is super helpful! Her class is easy to get a B in if you do all the assignment, but you do have to work for an A. She made this class fun! Because she is young in age, it is easy to relate to her. She grades papers fairly but this class is a big time commitment, especially in the beginning of the semester.

She is one of the coolest teacher at TCU. Hilarious as a person and amazing teacher. Her test are literally the review that she does in class, or the one that gives as homework. All she asks for is to do her work and respect her and you'll do great.
Go to class, participate, do the homework, study, and you'll do just fine.

The reviews below are old and she has definitely changed since then. She is those types of teachers who looks nice but at the end will give you a B+ with an 89.5. I would not recommend taking her. I arrived 3 times about 2-3 min late and deducted half of the the participation grades.

Robin is the perfect language teacher. She makes class incredibly interesting and the language fun to learn. Books are mandatory and you have regular homework from them, which you must do! She tells you EXACTLY what's going to be on tests, so it's easy to study. Participate in class and she will love you. Very easy to get an A and actually learn!
Robin is the perfect professor to teach a foreign language, she makes it fun.  She is very fair and you know what to study for tests.  One of my favorite teachers of all time.

Great teacher! Chooses favorites so can get annoying but always offers help to everyone.  Offers extra credit and lots of ways to make grade better.  Teaches in ways easy to learn and understand.  Funny and entertaining while teaching through conversation and daily homework that actually helps and isn't hard.  Take her and take italian!

LOVE HER!!!  She's one of my favorite professors.  I randomly chose the class and now I'm minoring in Italian.  The class is so much fun--I never mind going to class.  I highly recommend taking this course for at least one year!

I love love love this professor. She makes an effort to get to know you, and really tries hard to make sure you understand. If you try then you can definately get a good grade. She offers Italian conversation hours and other outside extra credit opportunites that can really help your grade and language skills. Loved this class.
love her
Very nice woman who really wants you to speak Italian.  She cares, gets to know you, and is always willing to help you more.  Take Italian for language credit, she will make it worth it.

She makes Italian easy to understand and fun! I reccomend her for your language course whether you are just taking it for credit or if you are really interested in languages. She is a cool person and a great teacher!

Dr. Yale is my favorite professor I have ever had at TCU. I am a member of the TCU Sales Center, and having him for Foundations made me want to take him again for Practicum. He cares so much, and his stories are great. I am so grateful to have been in his class because of how much I have learned from him and about myself.

I took his class for Foundations of Selling. I was so bored during his lecture, I sewed a stuff animal just to stay awake. I wish we did more class exercises to retain the concepts better. We did some in the beginning, but then he stopped and started giving a lot of presentation assignments with different teams. It was hard to keep up.

He is a nice guy and has a lot of good examples from his work experience. However, he is extremely boring in lectures and jumps around a lot. There is a ton of writing and requires way too much work from you for a business core class. Grades extremely tough on papers.

He loves ethics and that's great for him but he cannot teach. His lectures go absolutely nowhere and attendance is mandatory. He is a very tough grader, no one gets a 100% on any assignment. Don't bother asking for help, he won't answer your email. This is the longest class I have ever taken, each class feels like an eternity.

Yale is open for any possible discusstion in class. HOWEVER, he is a tough grader. The lecture encourage the discussion, but it means nothing if your grade is poor. He is an adjunct, so there is no way to meet him outside class. He said in his syllabus that you schedule an appointment with him, but believe me, he's very irresponsible for the email.

Yale is a good guy who really cares about Ethics and obviously loves teaching this class. However, he grades a bit harsh. He expects near perfection from his students and focuses on specific theories rather than how to act ethically in business settings. Can easily pull a B, but really have to work to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Tests were multiple choice but not always straightforward. Liked to use trick questions or answers that were very similar, so it was very detailed. The group project was really fun and you get to pick your position in the group. He was funny and kept you engaged in the class. A great person!! Always gave examples in class.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This professor like to have debates in class. He also likes when you write your own personal opinions. However, you will mostly likely not get full credit if your stance varies from him. Makes up his own statistics so don't be afraid to fact check him!

This is the second semester I've taken Professor Wong and he is without a doubt the best professor I've had in my 3 years at TCU. PARTICIPATE IN CLASS DISCUSSIONS and you will do well. He cares a lot about each and every one of his students-- a truly upstanding man.
Inspiring professor that pushes to think differently  about the world.

Dr. Wong is a wonderful person but I wouldn't say the same about his teaching methods. The tests are extremely difficult, and about 75% of the material he's never even talked about in class. The class is interesting but I'm glad it was PNC for me because it could've been a GPA downer.

Dr. Wong was an outstanding professor. I looked forward to coming to class & learning something new & applicable to my life. Very funny & made class interactive & discussion-oriented. Tests were extremely difficult, but he is more than willing to help you & gives extra credit/makeup opportunities. Kind & understanding, one of the best I've had.

Based on the other reviews on here, I thought I would hate his class, but I actually thought it was really interesting. Yes, you have to go to class. Yes, you have to read very carefully for the tests (lots of questions on specific numbers/statistics). Yes, you have to study. Weekly 2-3 page papers. Not necessarily easy but definitely interesting.

Good teacher, not an easy A. Attendance isn't mandatory, but he rarely stays true to the syllabus so it' important to come to class to keep up with exam dates. Hope to take again. Very entertaining and educated professor.

You have to come to class because his lectures help understand the material you are reading and fifty percent of the test questions include lectures. He offers extra credit papers to replace lowest test grade and offers three tests. Be sure to READ! Overall, he is vague with instructions for your research paper.

I took him last year. Wonderful stories that make the material clear in real life. If I had not done the reading before coming to class, I would be lost. But the reading plus his material created understanding for me. GREAT PROFESSOR! HIGHLY RECOMMEND to those who really want to learn.

Wong tells great stories during his lecture but teachers little of the actual material on the tests. His tests are all about the book, so basically you teach yourself. Definitely do the SocLab that comes with the book and memorize those questions. Try not to take him.

I took Dr Wong's Intro to Soc class and LOVED it. The material was relevant and engaging. His study guides were great and he clearly outlined his expectations of his students. He also has some great stories and he's funny.

Dr. Wong loves the topic he teaches and is good at having discussions in class over issues that can be interesting. His tests do not follow the lectures necessarily, though, and lean much more on the book. Make sure to read, and take the quizzes on the online supplement, he usually puts some questions from there on the tests.

Not worth taking. You can study and study but his test questions are tricky and not worded well. He doesn't lecture over anything and you have to read and retain everything in the LONG CHAPTERS in the book. His lectures are boring and force you to spend more time on the class than anyone should if you want a chance of passing.

SAVE YOURSELF THE TROUBLE, NEVER TAKE THIS CLASS.  YOU DO NOTHING IN CLASS THAT IS WORTHWHILE. YOU MUST TEACH YOURSELF EVERYTHING. THE TESTS ARE RIDICULOUS NO MATTER HOW HARD YOU STUDY. I WISH MORE THAN ANYTHING I HAD DROPPED THIS CLASS. SAVE YOURSELF, THIS IS NOT AN EXAGGERATION!!!!!!!!
Terrible!! all he does is talk about his life stories and then exspect you to know what the meaning behind them are. DONT TAKE HIS CLASS

Must read the book. That is the test. Class isn't 100% necessary for an A but he has a lot of interesting stories and debates. Lots of class discussion. Tests seem to be somewhat tricky. Only 3-4 hours of studying for the tests though. Plenty of extra credit opportunities. Text book feels biased though. can be frustrating to read.
He is so nice but a very tough teacher. You MUST attend class and do all the reading or you will not do well.

i think he made a really easy subject harder than it had to be. he has a lot of great stories and experiences.. you will learn a lot but might not get the grade you want. the tests are long and mostly from the book. all in all a cool guy and great teacher but i dont think i will take another class of his.

Lectures usually had nothing to do with what was on the tests except maybe 1 question from his lectures. Everything is straight from the book but its hard b/c of the "all" or "none" choices & b/c its applied. Read all details because he asks very specific questions about populations. Do the EC papers, they're easy and you get full credit.
He was the worst teacher! I never could figure out what was going to be on the test! He doesn't test over anything he says he's going to! DON'T take this teacher. You most likely will regret it!

Extremely boring, and very little of what was said in class was mentioned on the test.  Be sure to thouroughly read your book because that's what he tests out of.  One advantage, however, is that he doesn't take attendance and absences do not affect the final grade.  Also, be sure to take advantage of the plethora of extra credit assignments!

Hard teacher!! None of the questions for the tests came from the lectures.  Extremely hard tests and picky with the book material. Do the extra credit ten page paper, only way to help your grade.  Would not take him unless required.

Interesting class, learned a lot! But i got an A on the first test and than after that i got all c's, and did not change my study habits for the tests at all! He offers a lot of extra credit it, so do it! I earned a B in this class, and would recommend it!
Class was very repetitive and tests were fairly difficult. He curves grades at the end though so it's not too bad. Just read the book and study the website for tests

Wong's lectures can be interesting at times but his tests are rough. He asks lots of questions about statistics that he gives in class or that can be found in the book. Do the weekly extra credit. I did and now I only have to make a C+ on the final instead of an A- to get an A in the class** His final is not comprehensive :)

Great professor. Interesting lectures but the tests are extremely hard! Study the book hardcore and many of the random statistics are on the tests. He Gives lots of extra credit papers which help a lot. Tests are really hard though.
READ THE BOOK!! if you only study your lecture notes, you cannot pass this class. he is funny and sometimes interesting, but the tests are extremely difficult.
his test are confusing and have nothing to do with the lecture...make sure you read the book or you'll be lost on the tests
Wong is WRONG. Got to be the most boring guy ever, doesnt say a single thing worth writing down. Tests are hard. DONT take his class.

DR. WRONG!!!! DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. WILL MAKE YOU WANT TO GUAGE OUT EYEBALLS WITH A RUSTY SPOON. I TOOK IT TWO YEARS AGO AND STILL HAVE NIGHTMARES OF THE LUMPY ARMS COMING TO GET ME. I WILL GRADUATE SOON AND THIS WILL BE THE WORST CLASS I EVER TOOK. JUST DON'T DO IT. DON'T EVEN THINK ABOUT IT.
Worst teacher ever; rambles on about useless nonsense. Tests are very hard and do not cover anything he talked about. Nice guy, though, just bad teacher.

How are you supposed to take notes on randomly endless bantering? I didn't learn a thing, and his tests are confusing. Boring lectures. Sounds like the catepillar from Alice In Wonderland. Would not recommend, at least not without caffeine and ADD med
IMMENSELY interesting!  Fun professor!  However lecture has nothing to do with the tests.  Questions are difficult than you would expect.
Dr. Wong was a great prof. No tests, books, or a final-just a lot of papers and one final paper/presentation.  Great class is you are interested in Mexico and don't mind speaking quite a bit.

Prof Wong has a good sense of humor with LOTS of interesting (and sometimes pointless) stories to tell. I enjoyed the class, but the tests are hard. You really need to read and understand the book, but he does have some extra credit.

His tests do not reflect what you take notes over or bother to read in the text book. His tests are not objective over what you have learned but rather questions cloaked in confusion mean to trick you. DONT TAKE THIS CLASS. All tests are True/False
great guy with some great stories to tell, likes discussions, kind of regurgitates the book with a few new terms, but an easy B-lots of extra credit, i would get a crossword to do in class though.
Mori was the best professor I had at TCU. He challenged me to reconsider ideas I had about myself and the world To me, that's the definition of a great teacher.

He is a great professor with a passion for teaching.  He is very fair and unbiased in his lectures, very funny, and very understanding.  His exams are not too difficult if you read and pay attention in class.  I recommend this class to EVERYONE!!

As ARE RARE!!! Dr. Wong is an exceptional teacher who is a takes a very honest, unbiased approach to educating.  Like I said, his tests are hard to make As on, but the vast majority of his kids end the semester with a B or C.

Regardless of the effort I put forth I was stuck with a C. You either understand the material or you don't. Lectures are vaguely intertwined with the test. He loves to pull percentages out of the book and make them questions on the test.
No Comments

tests someon application not just definitions, funny, nice guy, honest about grades and class, can write paper to replace test grade, lots of extra credit that is easy to do, reading isnt too killer, just know the definitions from the book

She is not the best teacher but her class is very easy. She provides practice tests that are very similar to the tests. The classes are lecture-based and she has a thick accent. There is no homework, only tests that are pretty straightforward.

Literally the nicest person ever and the most helpful teacher, I think she got a new job though. The only thing I'll say is she can be a little hard to understand but if you pay attention it's not hard and I think she presents the material in a way that's super easy to understand. Also she posts all the powerpoints from the lectures online

Professor Yuan is really nice and you can tell she cares about what she is teaching, but this class is so so so difficult. The tests feel impossible and you are going to have to teach yourself a lot of the material. Good things in class include easy 100%s on quizzes because you get 2 attempts and the group assignments aren't bad with a good group.

Yuan is a very sweet professor but her accent can be very hard to understand at times. The only reason to attend class is for group assignments. Her tests were not too difficult, just make sure you do the study guide and have her check to make sure your answers. It is a shame people give her a bad rating because she is really caring overall

Professor Yuan is not very clear on what she wants. It is hard to understand her, and she gives many difficult tests. She gives you study guides for the exams but won't give you the answers to them. But she is helpful when doing the class assignments. Overall it was very hard to keep just a B in this course, and I would not take this class again.

Yuan is a very nice professor but be prepared for some hard exams. 3 including the final which is cumulative and worth 30% of your final grade. She does have chapter quizzes which are online and group assignments in-class that can help your grade, but tests make up majority of it. She is also very lecture heavy, so just be prepared to pay attention

She's a little difficult to understand, but she has no issue repeating herself. If you receive a bad grade on an assignment, she offers intelligent and intentional feedback if you ask for it. She posts exam reviews before the exam and offers to provide feedback on it. Overall, Dr. Yuan is a great professor and I highly recommend taking her class

she gives you study guides but doesn't post the answer keys and then we you ask for help she doesn't really explain and makes you feel bad for being confused lollll. would not recommend this professor especially for how difficult the tests were. LOL.

One of the best Econ professors at TCU. Super kind and cares about all of her students. Even if you miss a quiz or assignment she'll let you make up for it almost all the time. The tests are tough but you'll do good if you go through the study guide that she provides. Would definitely recommend taking her for Micro.

It's a lot of lectures, and the only reason to attend class is for the group assignments she gives and you have to do. But for me the tests weren't hard, but I think I just really get Economics. The class average was wayyyyy lower than my grade so I tend to say it was just since I understood econ.

Meh professor but I actually learned a decent amt.

Professor Yuan is a supper nice lady. The class isn't the most engaging but it's not much work. You get two tries on every chapter quiz and it shows you which ones you got wrong. The exams are pretty hard but there's only 3 including the final and she takes a lot of questions directly from the study guide so do the study guide and you'll be fine.

Yuan is not very engaging but she is a super nice lady. You will not do well if you don't read. Tests are a large portion of the grade and reading is the key to success. There was nothing special about this class to me, but it got the job done. There are better micro professors but Yuan is okay. Just be ready to read and show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Im taking this class for my core and a lot of people recommended her. I don't like micro to begin with so I'm doing bad. Shes a nice person but her tests are HARD, she teaches but its kina difficult to understand and its already a hard class. Dont take her unless you really understand econ.

Professor Yuan's Microeconomics class was one of the best classes I have taken. Although sometimes she can be difficult to understand, reading along will help a lot. If you go to class and pay attention the quizzes will come easily. She gives very detailed study guides. The study guide will be very beneficial when studying for her tests.

She's hard to understand. She tries to trick you sometimes with her wording on quizzes and tests. She requires the textbook and expects you to read it and then she just teaches everything off of it in class so there's really no point in having the textbook.

Honestly not that difficult. Bombed the first exam and that is why I did not get an A. You could literally not go to one class and your grade is not affected. Just study for exams and you will be fine.

Dr Yuan is a very nice lady, however you cannot understand her which makes life harder. Her test are also very difficult. She gives a review but no answers so you do not know if your answers are right before the test. I do not recommend this class.

Overall this class was terrible. The class is basically quizzes and test. Although their are group assignments and are easy they do nothing to your grade. If you don't do well on the test, you wont do well in the class. Quizzes are easy but don't do much to your overall grade. I tried going to her for help many times, but was not helpful.

Take Yuan if you can. I hated this class at first because she is very difficult to understand but she is probs the most kind professor here at TCU. The exams are exactly the same as the quizzes and study guides. She records all her lectures and keeps them up. I taught myself most of the material but read the textbook and go along you'll get an A.

DO NOT TAKE YAN YUAN. I have taught myself each chapter & do awful on every test no matter how much I study. There's 2 tests plus the final and quizzes for every chapter (at home & 2 attempts). Study guide is similar to test but she does not give you much time to look over it and does not provide the correct answers. Also cannot understand her

Highly recommend! All quizzes are online and get 2 tries with no time limit or lockdown browser. Exams have the same multiple choice as the quizzes with short answer that is almost exactly the same as the study guide. DO THE STUDY GUIDE and you'll do great on exams. All daily grades are in groups and super easy. only thing is she' hard to understa

She is an amazing professor. Students need to pay attention in the class and they are easy to go. Would recommend taking her class again. THE BEST PROFESSOR IN ECONOMICS. SHE IS AMAZING. ABSOLUTELY LOVE HER

Yuan gives weekly quizzes and group assignments that are fairly easy. She is willing to help if any student have any questions. There is only a midterm and a final. Participation is also accounted for in your final grade. I took this class online and put in minimal work for an A, so I would recommend. Professor Yuan is a nice lady.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I ended up P/NC her class. She lectures throughout the entire class and you really have to pay attention in order to understand. There are quizzes either once or twice a week. The only exams are a midterm and final. If you don't do well on those, you probably won't end up doing well in the class because your grade is mainly based off of exams.

Dr. Yuan is not someone Id ever recommend taking. She is very difficult to understand, and goes way too fast. Eventually I gave up on lectures and read the book (which improved my quiz scores). I dont think anyone had a clue as to what she was talking about, and she didnt even understand some of her own questions. Pretty bad class...
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Yaun is such a sweet lady, you can tell she really cares and wants students to learn. She was very hard to understand at times, lectures are boring. She reads the PowerPoint word for word but does go over active learning problems in class. She gives weekly homework which usually isn't too hard, and it's important to do the practice exams!

She is a good person, but very hard to understand and bad at explaining. Only take her if you want to teach yourself. She gives a lot of homework, which is annoying because it is only worth 30% while the midterm is worth 30% and the final is worth 40%. There are no other tests. I really do not recommend this teacher if you want to learn something.

She really knows economics but you have to pay attention to lectures or you will be lost. She is super sweet and wants to genuinely engage with the students. When you do the homework questions, I recommend copying them into a word document. She uses all the homework questions on the midterm. If you study a decent amount it's an easy B.

Such a sweet, kind, Chinese lady. Weirdly understands American humor and genuinely wants her students to succeed. Not really accessible outside of class but this was her first semester at TCU. Struggles with pronouncing some words but you can understand. Grading is 30% midterm, 40% final, and 30% homework quizzes that you get two attempts on.

You cant understand her, she doesnt speak good English, her lectures are AWFUL, she does not teach you anything. Worst professor I have ever had. Do not take the professor, I repeat, DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She does not speak english, very hard to understand, doesn't review and doesn't help out much
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: don't learn anything from lectures. you have to do it all on your own.

Barbara is extremely passionate and well versed in ASL. She does have high expectations for each student, however, these expectations are achievable. If she notices that you are falling behind, she will personally reach out and offer assistance. She wants everyone to succeed! Expect one or two quizzes and a presentation almost every day.

Mrs. Yount is the sweetest woman. She is very kind and caring and wants to make sure all of her students succeed. She is always willing to help you if you do not understand something and gives you a lot of opportunities to raise your grade.

Mrs. Yount is an absolute gem! She is the sweetest lady and will do anything to help you better understand and learn. She actually wants to get to know each and every person which is pretty cool. She does a lot of quizzes, so each one doesn't count for very much. 1 test, some presentations, quizzes, and an optional final--show up and you have an A!

I absolutely adore this woman. She's incredible and truly interested in her students. Very easy A if you come to class, and it's a very very interesting class! She's an amazing teacher and is always there to help. I definitely recommend this class! Loved it!

Mrs. Yount makes learning ASL fun and enjoyable.  She was truly interested in the success of her students.  Very little to no note taking in class. There was a book, but we never used it.  I would highly recommend this class to anyone who knows basic sign language. Easy A if you make the effort to be in class and participate!

Marching band with Mr. Youngblood was not at all as difficult as I expected. The band is fairly laid-back and you never are punished with running or push-ups. He does a great job of making band a positive community!
Mr. Youngblood was a great professor. Took him for instrumental techniques and was very descriptive and the tests were open-book.
He doesn't seem prepared for rehearsals. Standards are low, so students either don't practice or never learn their parts, even by concert time. This has been an extremely frustrating experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's the man... just dont try to contact him in any method except in person and expect any kind of timely response
Excellent professor. I didn't think I could love marching band and symphonic band so much!
Awesome
Wonderful.
You don't have to be in band to be in marching band, and Mr. Youngblood welcomes everyone. He's very encouraging, fun, and easy-going. I never thought marching band could be this fun!
He is one of the greatest profs I know. His drills are pretty interesting, and so is the music. Has unconvential conducting methods in symphonic band, but the music he chooses is great!

Easy-going, fun, and well he has just made college band a great experience. If anyone reading this is considering getting into marching band at TCU I say do it! But if you want to work 20 hours a week or keep a 4.0 GPA think twice. 6 hours a week practice not including sectionals. Ouch!
Absolutely amazing!  Possibly the most enjoyable teacher I've ever had.  So talented, friendly, and fun.
Awesome guy! Definitely makes it worth the time and energy.
Awesome guy! Knows how to have fun but still get work done. Easy to talk to and makes all the extra work worth it.
should be director of bands
Coolest band director ever!
This guy is the****

Seems to be the token conservative in the music department - great director, makes band fun,willing to help with anything, even non-band related stuff. Lax on discipline until works stops getting done, then tightens up.
he's adorable! he skateboards too! GREAT band director, good sense of humor; he wants us to enjoy band, really nice guy. he makes band really fun.
Most awesome guy at TCU.  AMAZING drill writer!  He's so great and very willing to help with anything you need.  Very very nice.  Makes it GREAT to be in band.

Best director ever. Famous for his drill writing. He's a real nerd. Pays more attention to perfecting the drill than the music during rehearsal. Gives us plenty of breaks during rehearsal when it's hot.
No Comments
No Comments

Youngblood is a very good band director, and made marching band more fun for me than it ever was in high school. Any professor that enjoys what he/she does as much as Youngblood is going to be a good teacher.
Band just wouldn't be the same w/o Youngblood.
Creative, easy to follow, positive, and cares for his students.
Afraid to be disciplinarian.  Avoids solving problems that really should be dealt with.
what an educator should strive to be
No Comments
I wouldn't be in band if it weren't for him...
Take Yvonne, the best professor in the program.

Great introduction class,I learned a lot, it was definitely eye opennig. The assignments are actually fun and inspirational, and made me see designs in a different way. The professor is very nice, truely cares for her students.She would always stay after class to chat with us. I think she is pertty clear and fair with her grading.

Yvonne is the best professor I had at TCU. She literally would reply your email at 12am and come early to help you. She is very easy to approach and truly cares for her students. She is very knowable and professional. I learned the most from her class.
Love her. Ive learned so much, more than with any other teacher at TCU. LOTS of work. But shes great
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Not always clear on instructions. Expects too much in a short time at end of semester

She is always there to help us, even way after hours when she is replying emails from home. I have never had a professor that was so eager to help her students learn and be passionate about it. She was consistently positive, encouraging, and uplifting, no matter how hard the course material became. Yvonne is the best professor I have st TCU.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very Wishy Washy with instructions. If you do exactly what she says, you'll get a C which is fair. However, she is very unclear about what she deams the minimum level and what's better that that. If you want to fail a class, take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He wants you to succeed. He will do anything he can to give you a good grade. I would litterallt get an answer completely wrong and as long as I wrote something he would give me some partial credit.

Strict way of teaching the material. if you look down at your computer or text someone important to you, he will get after you. I'd take him for Gen Phys 1 for the summer due he curves a lot if your class avg. is bad. If you walk in a little late, he also calls you out. I think he has too much of high a standard sometimes. Not sure if it's his ego.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Yuri is by far my favorite professor at TCU. His passion for Physics can be seen in his teaching style. He really pushes you to ask questions if you have while during the lecture or outside the class. If you want a high grade, I suggest you do all the practice problems he gave.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The class wasnt that hard, but this professor is ridiculously hard to deal with. The quizzes are the homework and the tests are just random problems. However, do not take this professor if you can avoid it. He is quite abrasive when you ask questions and his lectures dont really do anything but read the textbook which you could do on your own.

I got a 2 on AP Physics 1. I took this class over the summer, worked hard and got an A. Quizzes are just the hw w/ different numbers, tests are harder but if you put in decent effort you'll be fine. Dr. Yuri is super patient and wants to help you succeed if you care. Be ready to complete 50+ (non-mandatory) practice problems to study for exams.

Dr Yuri is a nice guy. I love the way he structures his class- even if you're not a physics whiz you can get an A with hard work and practice. Quizzes are the HW so do it. My only complaint is that for some of the more basic concepts he won't go in depth/assumes you know it because it's in the book. Just read beforehand/for clarification!
If you're just in it for the grade, good luck to ya. Emphasis placed on understanding as opposed to memorization.

I've had him for 2 classes, he's my advisor, and a great professor. As others have said, if you show interest and try, he also goes out of his way to give you a really high grade. Really awesome professor that loves the subject and the students.

Teaches a difficult subject, but teaches it well. The lectures cover the material in brief, but you'll do most of your learning from the book. He seems to be looking for any excuse to give you an A, so give him one and you'll be fine. The only possible gripe is that he works to hard to make the students succeed and makes the class too easy.

Don't expect him to hand out answers - go to office hours! He loves it when people show interest in his class, and he'll help you learn how to do the problem rather than just tell you. Do the homework and this class will be an EASY a for you.

Love him. He wants all if his students to succeed. If you how interest you will do fine. Quizzes on Fridays will be one of the problems on the assigned homework that you don't turn in. If you put any effort in you will get a b. Alot of effort you're almost guaranteed an a. He is one of my favorite professors ever.

Pretty good teacher in my opinion. Powerpoints give good general info but you must read the text to understand in detail. He is very helpful in his office because he actually gets you to understand the problem rather than showing the solution. People who don't like him are generally non-majors who don't like Physics in the first place.

This man is so ridiculously mean. Sure you'll get an A if you do all of the work, but it was the most painful experience of my life. He is loud, impatient, rude, sarcastice, and expects everyone to know as much as he does about basic physics. I basically cried everyday, and almost changed my major because of this man.

PHYS 101 - Pretty good prof. I never took physics in my life before and I got an A. He is sometimes hard to understand but was willing to take extra time to explain. Allowed index card of notes for tests. I did study extra for his tests and worked lots of practice problems. If I can get an A, anyone can.

Not the most fun I've ever had, but as long as you work the homework problems, you'll be fine. For the notes, pay attention to the formulas you actually use on the homework, don't just copy the slides and expect it to help. Go to class even if you think it's boring because the solutions to the in-class problems aren't posted in the PowerPoint online. If you have a question, he'll give you hints all day long but you have to study until you can figure it out on your own.

See, if you dont like Physics, none of the Physics professors are going to make any sense. On the other hand, for the ones who are really into Physics, he is the best professor around. He is a very knowledgeable person and leaves enough room for more than 50% of the class to make an A. Take him if u love Physics otherwise dont take Physics at all.
AMEN to EVERYTHING the person before me said. DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS

terible teacher,uses the powerpt from the book,goes through material fast & gets frustrated and loud if u ask a question or dont understand something.allows notes on exams,wont help.nor will the hw that he doesnt grade,exams are random facts,essay ?s & problems.ex cred if u write 8-15 pg paper on an absurd topic he picks related 2 quantum mechanics

While disliked by some, Professor Youngblood's Business Ethics class is not hard. Follow the instructions for his essays (e.g. Use T-chart for first one) and participate. If you conform to his teaching and cite the assigned textbook, an A is relatively easy to earn.
Takes half an hour to explain a simple vocabulary term.

Not even half way through the class and I can tell this is pointless. He likes to talk at the class the whole time and skips around from story to irrelevant story. One of the worst prof at Neeley ...Thanks again TCU

Worst teacher for the Ent Mana major.  Had him for the Ent Leadership class.  He just sits in front of class and tells stories like he's some kind of prophet and has all these revolutionary ideas about how to become a leader.  He prob wrote the review posted below mine lol.  What a waste
took him for Ent. Leadership. SAY is very helpful, approachable and respectful. Put in the effort, and more than just the grade you will learn lessons for life.

Took him for Ent Leadership.  Probably the worst class I have ever taken in my life.  Class was so boring and painful. It was more of a human resources class than a leadership class.  The only thing I actually learned from was the extra credit book "Three Cups of Tea".

He genuinely cares about the material and his students.  His grading is like high school - what's a check or check plus mean? He expects you to be psychic a lot. His emails are novels. Do your work, actually reflect and you should be fine.

Mana Ethics:  Nice professor, knows his material.  I think he cares.  However, he does tend to pontificate on random points.  Just read your books, speak only concisely, relevantly, and profoundly in class (class participation is 10%), do your reflection papers and thank your favorite deity that this is only a three-week class and get 1.5 hours.

I have a lot of respect for SAY. He is a Crucial Conversations and 7 Habits LORD! He has a way of putting you into a spell of non-sense and you start to get really jittery and you can't stop looking at the clock. He genuinely wants to know that you are learning and that part is great. Learned a lot, but at times it was very painful. SLOW GRADER!!!

Genuinely good person, but his class is BORING! Slowest grader award at TCU goes to SAY. Just try to get Jordan for Ethics, not Stu. If you need to learn how to fix a sink, this class may be relevant. Peace.
this class added no value.
Good prof.  I would agree that grading is arbritrary.  If you do your work you will be fine.

Class isn't that difficult, but grading is arbitrary, so it doesn't matter.  If you're an attractive girl or an elitist guy, you'll get an A.  Don't follow his directions on papers, just cut/paste and quote with no original thought and you'll do well.  Also, we received our third reflection paper 8 weeks after he said they were graded and ready.

Absolutely useless professor. Extremely boring and lazier than your deceased grandma. By the time he grades your paper, you'd have already graduated and started work. Counting the tiles on your bathroom floor would be more beneficial than taking this class.

do not take this class..it is hard and boring, and the teacher is boring as hell, keeps talking about the same topic for days. The final is impossible (17 chapters, 200 MC) and counts for 30% of your grade. Do yourself a favor and do not take it.
No Comments
Worst class EVER!  talks about the same**** for 2 weeks.  and whats worse....he has a twin brother running around somewhere messing up people lives too!
worst class at TCU. He is absolutely horrible. The tests are hard and the final was a comprehensive (17 chapters), 200 multiple choice test. Do anything you can to avoid taking this class.

This is THE WORST class I've taken at TCU or elsewhere. He doesn't care about his students at all and I do believe this guy teaches just for money and fame. If you look for personality in professors like I do, DO NOT TAKE HIM - complete waste of your time. His lectures are pointless.
worst class at TCU. Do anything you can to avoid taking this professor. Test are hard and the class is pointless.
when he asks questions in class don't anwer them because it will never be right.  he is a complete moron and never shuts up.  this guy is a straight clown.  dont take him, he blows
No Comments
Monotone. He makes me want to kill myself every night class. Biggest clown award of '04 goes to Mr. Stu Youngblood. Most worthless class.

Boring? Yes.  But the guy is intelligent and makes you think.  Good writers do well in the class, bad writers do poorly.  I'd love to hear the guy talk at a conference for no more than an hour.  Objective in class discussions.  Smart man, may not equate to the best teacher.
Bad about giving back papers and the test questions come from either old tests or thin air.  Pretty arrogant as well.

Yeah, this guy is a real clown. The fact that TCU allows him to teach a class, muchless several, makes me really question the degree I am getting. If you have to take him, I hope you don't have anger mangement problems. One suggestion- utilize the knock under the table(you will understand this later
just awful
No Comments

Worst teacher I've had.  Won't get any papers back.  Tries hardest not to let you get an A.  Very unorganized.  Rude to students.  Asks your opinion then tells you its wrong.  Questions on tests come from no where.Studying wont help you on quizzes.

Is this guy for real? He loves to hear himself talk.  Don't expect to get anything you turn in back.  He will pull your grade out of thin air just like he does with test questions.  He has to take attendance because he is so boring and no one would sh
Horrible teacher...test questions come either from old tests or from thin air.  Very stubborn and really likes himself!
Loves to hear himself talk. To get a good grade must not miss more than 3 classes, which sucks because his is boring.
Quite possibly one of the worst teachers I have ever had.  If possible, do absolutely everything you can to not take him.
good teacher.  tends to be a little long winded in his discussions.  not the most fun teacher, but he does a good job overall.

LOVE PATTY! She is the best professor ever. Her lectures are amazing and she posts them on D2L. If you ever need help with anything she is happy to help and give feedback. So excited to take her again next semester!

One of the best professors on campus. It's rare that you find a professor who can teach you material so effectively and at the same time make the class super easy and fun. She loves handing out extra credit and is super understanding. Took her class as a core, and she almost makes me want to change my major.

If you see Patty is teaching a class you need, TAKE IT! Patty is an amazing professor her. She is very knowledgeable and is very caring to her students. Patty understands that students have lives and if you need an extension or life help, she will 100 percent give you that help.

Couldn't get better than her. She is awesome. I get excited to go to her classes and she gives amazing feedback on projects. She's the sweetest and so much fun. Cares so much about every single one of her students. TAKE HER!!

I took the MOJO Journalism class with Patty and it was such a great experience. Not only did I learn a lot about mobile journalism but I also had fun while doing projects on my own and with my classmates. Patty is a wonderful professor and you can't go wrong taking any of her classes.
She is very fun and caring. We watch movies frequently, do group projects, and she lectures most days. Very fun class and easy to get an A. She tells you what will be on the mid term and final.

Patty is an incredible teacher. You couldn't find a better teacher if you tried. She is extremely caring and tries to make the class as fun and engaging as she can. She also helps you if you have something going on, so she will work the class around it, so you're too stressed or dealing with too much. She made the transition to college really easy

Do it if you're thinking about enrolling in Patty's class! She is not only extremely educated about everything journalism-related, but she also continues to work for a news station. It is priceless to get the chance to pick someone's brain who is an expert in the area of study you wish to pursue. One of my favorite TCU professors!!

Patty is an angel sent from Heaven. She is so caring for her students and really does her best to ensure a fun and supportive atmosphere. Most of the grades are group projects but they are super chill and easy and she grades very clear and easy. She is by far my favorite Professor so far at TCU.

Patty is like a second mother to me. I have known her for three years now, and she is one of the greatest professors/people in the world. I genuinely don't think I would be where I am without her. I have never had such a sweet, special relationship with a professor before--everyone needs a Patty in their life!
Patty cares so much about her students in and outside of the classroom. She wants you to succeed. She truly is the best professor I've ever had.

Patty is the best that the journalism department has to offer. Literally the kindest prof I've ever had, genuinely cares about her students and wants to connect with them. If you can take a class with Patty, DO IT!

I would not have made it through virtual learning and using my phone as a stand-in for the camera without Patty's continual support and adjustment of assignments to fit my circumstances. She cares so much for her students. Don't ever hesitate to ask for clarification or help if you don't understand something!

Patty is so kind and accessible. She will do whatever it takes to make sure we have what we need and feel comfortable with the assignments, and even advocates for her students to the department. I would not have survived virtual learning without someone as supportive as Patty. Put in the work and communicate with her and she will respect it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Ive taken 3 classes with Patty so far and shes an amazing professor. Very flexible with deadlines as long as you talk to her ahead of time and genuinely cares about her students. Reviews are pretty much identical to tests.

I absolutely LOVED Patty's class. She was always there to help me when I needed help and I would 100% take her again. The class is easy if you are okay with writing (there's just a few small papers). The topics we discussed in class were interesting also. I would recommend going to her office hours if you have any questions or concerns.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Great teacher, makes learning language fun and manageable. She gives homework and quizzes, if you do everything she gives you and study for exams, you'll do fine!
LOVE THIS CLASS! Yumi-sensei is an amazing professor!! Easy A, but you still learn a lot.
2nd semester, and she's still awesome. The material gets more difficult obviously, but it's definitely doable. I definitely recommend taking Japanese for your foreign language credit.

You must get the textbook and workbook, and I highly recommend going to class. Other than that, she's a very great teacher. She makes a difficult language easy to learn. A little bit of studying, and you'll be fine. Some homework, but not much, and it's a completion grade. Overall, very easy if you just go to class and study before each test/quiz.
You won't believe how easy it is to get an A.
She is absolutely amazing! I suck at learning languages but she made it so much fun...definitely definitely take her class! She's one of the kindest people ever!

Yumi Sensee is wonderful.  I was a little freaked out going into class  (never having taken Japanese before)  but she made it easy to understand and I learned a lot.  She's a great teacher that no student wants to disappoint.  I even found myself studying during the summer just so I could stay in touch with my Japanese side!
She really likes everyone to have a good time, and everyone gets an A!

She is a really sweet teacher and grades super easy! as long as you do the homework shell give you full credit. Tests are easy. I hardly ever went to class and still got a B and all my tests were B+s. Loved it!

Great comprehensible class.  It's basically a review of what you learned the last class, then new stuff the other half of class.  It makes learning easy.  Easy A.  Easy to get embarrassed in a foreign language though.  Japanese is supposed to be very difficult, but the welcome environment makes it surprising how much you have learned by the end.
You won't learn anything. It's basically a review every single class. If you're looking to really understand the language, this isn't the class for you.
The best teacher at TCU

Really nice. She WILL talk about you when you're not in class, by way of teaching the people who are in class how to call you dumb and whatnot. If you are really sensitive about that then don't enroll or don't miss class. If anything she's too easy. You can get an A and not learn anything if you don't put in any effort.

She is very sweet and makes learning Japanese fun and easy.  I loved this class!  Easy to get an A as long as you attend most classes.  She is not strict and very easy going.  I would highly reccommend if looking for an easy language credit that's enjoyable!
Yumi is a very warm teacher.  Her excitement about the subject provides a welcomed learning environment.
the course is easy, which seems to be her only goal.  It would have been nice to learn something.

Yumi-sensei is so sweet. Please don't take advantage of her. She's also very, very easy, because she wants you to succeed. She is very cool. I went to Japan with her and she was so awesome, buying me fruit and giving me medicine when I had a fever! She makes Japanese, a supposedly very hard language, easy. And she's always positive and happy. Be nice to her or I'll beat you up!

Yumi-sensee is so wonderful! She is always there to help, and tries to make sure everyone understands (which may be the main reason why sometimes the class can go TOO slow). She's hilarious, the nicest teacher EVER, and makes Japanese fun :).
Yumisensee is the best teacher ever.  Take her class and you will understand.
Yumi-sensee is so nice, but she goes too fast in class.  Many things are left unclear.
by far the best teacher here....i have no criticisms of this professor. her class is interesting, and she is extremely helpful.
I got minor in Japanese and all of her classes were great.

Both the language and culture classes for Japanese are awesome, thanks to Yumi-sensee. She's very nice. I've never, ever, heard about her EVER being in a bad mood. She kind of goes a little too easy on you with grading, but you still learn a lot.
Easy A, but require effort.  Definitely a great teacher.  Everyone should take this class.  And, oh yeah, TCU need to give sensee a big raise.  I demand it!

A fabulous prof, she's always understanding and goes out of her way to make sure everyone understands what's going on in the class. Japanese is hard, but this class is fun and worth all the effort you put into it.

Sensee is awesome. I think she is the best language teacher at TCU. She makes Japanese fun. I, too, am a Japanese minor convert. She loves to teach and she really cares for her students. Class starts out a little slow but picks up quickly. Memorize!!!
Yumi-san is the funniest/nicest teacher I have ever come in contact with. Homework isn't so bad, and she mostly grades on your effort. Great teacher, makes me want to minor in Japanese.

Fun and easy class, but a little too easy. I'm all for a blow-off class, but progress is slow in this class and it makes me not look forward to going to such a fun class. LOTS of focus on speaking when I'd rather be learning more kanji.
So fun!  I've always loved the Japanese language, and she really makes it easy and fun to learn.  I can't wait to study abroad in Japan with her!
So fun! She makes a difficult language very clear and interesting.

Yumi is a wonderful professor.  Japanese is a difficult language to learn, mostly due to the kanji, but she makes it extremely fun.  She also led me to minor in Japanese, which I do not regret for a moment!  She promotes student participation a lot.

After taking her Japanese class, I decided to take Japanese minor because her classes are fun and informative. Her class makes me feel that Japanese is so easy. She's a very funny teacher and very helpful.

I would be lying if I said Japanese was an easy language to learn (darn you kanji!), but she makes it a lot of fun for everyone.  Great clas participation and she really cares about her students.  She is extremely cheerful and nice!
The Japanese culture class is REALLY easy. Hardly any work and you really get the feel for what life is like in Japan.

One of my very favorite teachers.  The class is so much fun.  And she is very dedicated.  She grades REALLY easy.  Really cares about the students.  Late homework with no penalty.  Easy tests, if you at all study.
She is the best and nicest teacher you could ever have. Japanese is not an easy language but she really teaches it clearly. One of the best teachers at TCU. :)
No Comments

Dr. Hall is really just a big teddy bear when you peel back a few layers. Amazing guy and will do everything he can to make sure that you are successful. He doesn't align with everyone's style of selling but he is truly amazing!

These reviews need to be updated because ever since Dr. Hall became the Director of TCU Sales Program, everything is different. Consultative Selling is a hard class but can be very rewarding. Dr. Hall gives students tons of growth opportunities and experience with companies hiring sales students. Very accessible outside of class. Great guy!

I took his intro to marketing class. Two tests and a big group project is about all you get graded on. Attendance is mandatory, there are pop quizzes, but lectures are pretty engaging. Overall a good teacher and a good class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I was dreading this class, but Dr. Hall makes it fun--and relevant. He understands we are not all Marketing majors, but wants us to leave the class with some applicable knowledge. Tests are HARD but no surprises. Emailing/meeting for feedback will improve your grade. Study!! Material is not that hard but be ready to apply concepts to real life.

Dr. Halls class was always interesting and fun. Its hard, but if you actually study, listen to his feedback and participate you can do really well. I feel more prepared for the real business world after this class then any Ive taken. Id recommend Dr. Halls class to anyone who wants to truly be successful in life and their career.

Do not take this class at all costs your GPA will suffer. Grades on the Bell Curve so you are constantly competing against peers. His group project has no detailed directions and his feedback is lacking. Cares about his class but he is making it way too hard. Even if you do well on a quiz your grade will be reduced based on how others did.

Dr. Hall is a fairly nice guy and cares a lot about the class. His grading is super tough and is not very clear. Grades on a bell curve and seems to play favorites with who gets the better grade. Can be particularly inconsistent with feedback and expectations.. you can do exactly what he suggests and it will still need work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Great professor! Truly cares about his students excelling in and outside the classroom. His class is difficult since he does expect you to read and be prepared... However, this was one of my most valuable classes while at TCU!!

Extremely tough grader! Grades on a curve so you MUST study and meet with him outside of class. I would not recommend taking him. I am not satisfied with my final grade after all of the work that was put into the project and tests.
Grades on a bell curve, so you are competing with the class. Very helpful if you go by his office. Attendance and participation are required.

Young professor with a cool personality, but EXTREMELY hard grader. He grades on a curve, with a C+/B- being "average". Tests ended up being all fill-in-the-blank, short response, and essays. No multiple choice or T/F. Group project requires exsessive work outside of class, AND you must talk with him a lot to get a good grade because he's ambiguous
Group project required a lot of work outside of class. Even after talking with him the expectations were unclear.

He did a project that was different this year- Huge part of the grade and required a lot of time out of class with a group and must talk to him to do well. Nice guy but strict with grades. Likes giving extra credit which saved me.  Not the easiest class like I thought.

Pretty fun and interesting class. Big project at the end. Tests are over information from the book and aren't very hard. Random quizzes that can be hard if you do not read assigned chapters. Keep up with the reading and show up to every class and you can get an A. Very helpful professor who will work with you to make sure you succeed.

Although this class tended to drag on at the end of the semester, it is really easy to get an A in here and satisfy your fine arts requirement. Stoughton had an excellent sense of dry humor and was really approachable. His lectures were easy to follow and there was only one big assignment (a paper) in the class. I recommend this class.

Easiest but yet most boring class of the semester! Take this guy for survey of music you wont regret it! I mean, apart from being boring, this class is pretty good to boost your gpa or to make an easy A.

I'm only giving him a 4 on difficulty because if you want to make an A you will have to study (but just a little). He is real easy to reach via email if you have help. The lectures were kind of boring but I took notes and communicated with him and got an A

Great Teacher! I came to class just to hear his dry wit. Take notes in class and the tests pretty easy. I know of someone though that didn't do well, but a little studying goes a long way. I know so much about music now!!!

He is THE nicest professors I have ever had.  He really respects his students.  I am so glad I took his class being that I am not interested in music at all.  He knows what he is talking about and obviously loves music.  I would take him for an easy A. Also, attendance is not mandatory but being that he is so nice, out of respect would be great.
