He is SO easy. You don't use the text book. Everything you need to know is on the power points. He asks you to attend class but does not take attendance. VERY nice guy and super laid back. His class is extremely boring but he's the nicest prof I have ever had. LITERALLY
Easy class! He is very friendly and makes the class so interesting! I DEFENETLY RECOMMEND HIM. You don't even use the book.

You can tell he loves music and wants to share it with everyone. He has an extensive knowledge of music which is impressive for someone so young. I really don't know how old he is, but he looks like he could be in his twenties. He was very flexible with class work and understood that I have other classes aside from his which was nice.
Interesting
Dr. Zerda is a nice guy, and he's probably a great research scientist, but I don't think he's a very good teacher. I did not find his lectures very understandable.
Funny, mostly easy, will try to help you during office hours, grades graciously, no lab or lecture quizzes! no lab reports! if you have to take the course, take this summer one.
boring class, but easy tests if you know how to do the homework

Not a good teacher, but the material and tests aren't difficult. If you have a good tutor that can clear up the concepts, an A is definitely possible. If you are an engineering major, you probably won't have any trouble.
that man has style!  i couldn't get enough of his highbrow Polish dress sense.  He should be given a raise.  His lecture on metaphysical diversification of electropods was stimulating.
No Comments

Don't be fooled by how quiet he seems;  very bright and really interesting to listen to.  Grades fairly, very reasonable to work with. Tells great stories if you can get him off topic; just don't go into his office expecting a chat.
You'll be fine as long as you learn all of the formulerrrrrrs and make sure to check in IClickerrrrrrr every day.

His lectures are easy to understand and take notes over. He gives assignments on TopHat for every chapter but theyre easy. He gives short pop quizzes and tests but theyre easy as long as youre paying attention and studyign.
He is a very nice guy.  He does take attendance, but lectures are easy to follow. If you can, I would highly recommend taking him.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Good choice for an Intro Macroeconomics! Attendance is necessary, but lectures are easy to follow. Lots of assignments through the online book, but they don't take lots of thinking. Tests are manageable if you study. Dr. Z definitely cares about what he teaches and you can tell!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I often felt dismissed and uncomfortable due to annoyed tones and disapproving looks that made it hard to ask questions. I also noticed clear differences in how students were treated, with some receiving warmth while others, including myself, were overlooked or spoken to sharply. VERY RACIST! ALWAYS GIVES NASTY LOOKS TO PEOPLE OF COLOR.

She's awesome. all you gotta do is pay attention and go to class. she really helps if you go out of your way and ask her questions, and I barely know english and i got an A just go to class and study; she cares she grades hard but it makes sense for the profession.

I actually really liked Dr. Z! I had her for lab and lecture. She is a really nice person if you take the time to get to know her. She is also really funny. If you show up to class, do your work, and PAY ATTENTION to lectures, she will like you! If you don't listen and don't pay attention, she won't. Her tests are difficult, so make sure to study!
she is great I highly recommend taking her

she knows her stuff for sure yeah but the attitude doesnt slay. shes sooooo rude and will fail if its not her way. Wont admit shes wrong. she makes you feel dumb and gives you these stupid looks. she plays favorites. shes the only instructor that hands out Fs more than the others so good luck if you have her!!!!!!!!

She is soooooo mean!! She will try to fail you in check off if you missed any steps. You cant argue with her because she wont listen to you. She will make you resubmit your panopto videos several times before she gave you that Successful grade :) If you had her, be extra careful. She will fail you with no mercy. Good luck with her you may need it!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Taking this course was not as easy as expected. The content is not hard however Dr. Zimpelman doesn't prepare you for the exams. Luckily, there are easy participation points and homework assignments to boost grades. In addition, she is slightly condescending. I know we don't choose our professors for this course, but I would not recommend.

Dr. Zimpelman is pretty unprofessional and hostile. I would not recommend taking this course by her based on her attitude and how condescending she has shown to be in the past. Her class is not very fascinating, and tests are pretty difficult. With all of her experience, I don't believe that she prepares students well for the real world of nursing.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Zimpelman is very clear about her expectations and is thorough in her explanations. She is very honest and even a little funny at times. She does not teach you things in a more complicated way than what you need to know, and she is a fair grader. I definitely recommend her.

Dr. Z has a lot on her plate, which was kind of obvious during this course. She was not very helpful outside of class. Her lectures were good, but tests were a little tough. She is a very sweet person if you put in a lot of effort to get in contact with her. I was expecting the tests to be pretty easy, but you really need to study for them.
When in hostile environments, Zimpelman can be quite unprofessional. She fails to maintain civility within the classroom and does a poor job in teaching exam material.

Professor Zimpelman is a good person. If you do your work and put in effort, you'll be on her good side. However, if you screw around and don't do your work, she may not like you very much. Also, if you are going through a hard time, Zimpelman will go to bat for you. She cares about her students, and I saw that firsthand this semester.
Everyone loves Professor Zimpelman, she is just a sweet person.
I LOVED Prof. Z!

Mrs. Zimpelman is awesome. She genuinely wants her students to pass. Class is lecture heavy, but there are a few interactive days thrown in there so thats fun. She takes attendance, so show up! Overall, I loved her and loved her class. Oh, and she brought candy everyday!

Love Leslie. She is so nice and sweet and wants you to do well in her class. I had her for both foundations and lab and wouldn't have it any other way. Despite her lectures being pretty common sense, her tests can be kind of difficult so know your stuff. She also brings in snacks and candy to every class!

Class is very lecture heavy and pretty boring, but she is extremely nice and you can kind of do whatever you want during class. Tests are kind of all over the place, some are easier than others and feel like they're written by different people. Attendance is part of your grade and she does take attendance every class period.
Not the best clinical professor at TCU. Very scatterbrained. She really likes to text during class and take coffee breaks! So, you can kind of do whatever you want during class.

Best fundamentals clinical instructor I could have asked for. Consider yourself lucky if you get her. She's not easy or a pushover but put in the effort and she'll reward you. She really connects with her students and is an overall great nurse

WARNING about Game Theory. The class itself is very interesting and Professor Hawley is awesome.

However, if you are not proficient at deep analytical thinking, backwards reasoning, applying theories and strategies in an abstract way it will be a difficult for you unless you are a fast learner. The class teaches you to think differently.

Professor Hawley is very funny and engaging. I only did well on the first two tests because I studied the tests from prior semesters, but he doesn't give the third one back, and so I didn't do well on that one. The final is optional, and he replaces your grade whether you did better or worse, so choose wisely.

Hawley is such a tough professor and the exams were very difficult but the lectures were very engaging for being about such a boring topic. You will have to put in a lot of outside time to study, he does not give out extra work for practice which I found very annoying, but he is very good professor that will challenge you.

The first day, expected a C in the class. He seems very strict, and you might not like him at first. He's a great person, however, and teaches super great lectures. Outside of class though you have to put in the effort. Studied about 5 hours for each test and the payoff was huge.

No quizzes, homework is graded by completion, but 3 tests with an optional final to replace a bad test grade. If you miss a class, you're a bit screwed since tests are stringent upon Hawley's lectures. Hawley is a great lecturer and there is never a dull moment in his class. TAKE HAWLEY - I'm considering getting an economics minor because of him.

Really great professor, hilarious, extremely intelligent! But extremelyyy test heavy, not many students could adjust to his teaching style including myself. Even after studying for endless hours, tutoring, office hours, exams were extremely difficult. Wouldn't recommend at all if you have no prior knowledge in Microeconomics.

Super great guy, but he moves fast and there is no resource to learn the material he will test over besides the lectures. There are no videos or supplements for missed classes besides classmate's notes. No study guides and hardly any HW so you don't really understand what's going on, especially because so much is covered.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a great teacher but the class is so hard if you aren't good at econ I wouldn't recommend.

He's funny and knows how to keep class engaging. No technology at all even D2L or ipads for notes. Weekly quizzes are similar to lecture notes and weekly homeworks are only marked for completion. 3 exams but you can drop the lowest. I found the materials easy but there were quite few others said his exams are hard.

THE BEST. He doesn't use any technology and you MUST attend class. Homework is for completion, and most your grade is from exams. However, he curves and let our class make up points for certain tests. Gives extra credit. You have to put the work in for an A, but it is definitely obtainable. He cares that you genuinely understand the material.

HAWLEY IS THE BEST! This class is so hard but so worth it. It genuinely is my favorite class at TCU. Hawley cares so much about his students and goes above and beyond to make sure you understand. Tests are difficult, so get ready to study hard, but you will learn SO MUCH. The experiments he does are also very fun and HW is not that bad.

Hawley is a really good and does a great job making lectures interesting. That being said, this class is challenging and requires studying to do well. Reworking the homework is really helpful for the tests and there are three exams plus an optional final if you need the grade booster. Usually has office hours at 7am
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took macroeconomics with Hawley over the winter session (9 days). We had 9 quizzes after each lecture, but the 2 lowest were dropped. If you pay attention to the 2-3 hour lecture you will get an A on every quiz.  If you can take Hawley, I 100% recommend it (I got an A and I'm very lazy).
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hawley gives great lectures - he is very knowledgeable about economics and is able to make hard concepts make somewhat sense. With that said, his class is very hard to get a good grade in. There are only three DIFFICULT exams throughout the semester that cover content that is not on the homework. Bottom line, don't take if you want an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great smart guy, but don't take unless you are an econ major or have a good understanding of econ prior to class. Lectures move fast and tests are difficult. With extensive studying and office hours, an A is possible. ONLY take Hawley if you are actually going to put in work. He will make you thoroughly learn the material, or else you will fail
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
If a genie gave me 3 wishes: 
1) Wish Hawley would retire
2) Never have taken Hawley
3) Never see Hawley win again so I could watch him lose over and over and over again forever.
Lectures were so hard and tuff to follow. Was horrible at communicating. Any time someone would ask a question he wouldn't answer it and make a corny ash response. NO
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Taking Hawley is either a hit/miss. He's a great guy, super nice but very particular. He doesn't do ANY tech so no 2DL or anything like that. Three HARD tests throughout the semester. He's a pretty good lecturer but this means if you miss a class YOU'RE SCREWED. If you want to learn and don't mind a bad grade take him. Otherwise, DO NOT TAKE HIM.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very nice and funny teacher. Wants you to do your best and will try his best to help. That being said, this was a very difficult class. Only 3 hard tests that make up most of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
HAWLEY IS AMAZING! yOU will cry potentially and yell at him because the content is difficult but you will leave this class being okay with being wrong and failing and that's a life lesson! 
but hey: IF YOU DO NOT NEED TO TAKE THIS CLASS, DO NOT TAKE IT FOR FUN. If you need Econ, TAKE IT! Hawley will grow on you and you'll never forget this class.

Hawley is the best Econ teacher! He does not use any Powerpoint or technology, but is able to keep you engaged with his lectures. The experiments also provide a better understanding of the topics. Only three exams, so make sure you study for them well in advance. Final is optional, but is a grade booster if you need it.

Awesome! You learn just from his amazing lectures and fun experiments. He also is one of the funniest professors I've had. The class by the end felt like a family. He didn't use D2L and the final was optional. almost 90% of your grade was based off of 3 exams which could be nerve-wracking but it was similar to the homework. TAKE HAWLEY

Clearly understands economics & how to teach in a way that makes sense for students coming in with no prior knowledge. Class is entirely lecture-based, so as a student-athlete who had to miss class a lot this made learning the material difficult. Was not super accommodating for office hrs so taught myself most material; HW & test are very similar.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hawley is awesome! Homework is participation, and his lectures are engaging and applicable. Game Theory is an interesting class. It's fun to think about the things we learned in class and apply them to the real world!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: TAKE PROF HAWLEY for IntroMicro! You'll learn so much. He's super interesting. Never a dull moment. The tests are hard. But the homework and class should prepare you well. The tests have some choice (ex: do 5 out of 7 questions). Don't skip class EVER or you won't understand. No laptop notes. Definitely go to office hours if you need clarification.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Hawley's class is difficult but he makes the material fun and engaging. He often brings food to class or gives out opportunities for extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took the honors section of intro micro- Would NOT recommend this class if you didn't take Econ in high school or are not a business major (or both). Definitely one of the hardest classes I've ever taken. He's a good professor, just a lot of material and you need to know it really well for the few exams given.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hawley is the best professor I've ever had at TCU. He's not only a hilarious professor, but he engages you in class by breaking things down and making you think intuitively. His teaching style is very unique. He knows the material is difficult and expresses the need for math practice and model practice outside of class. Homework is completion.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Honors econ 101 was fantastic with Hawley. He truly wants you to succeed and understand econ. Classes are mainly lectures but they are super interactive and allow you to participate fully. Experiment days are SO fun and you really get to bond with your class. You need to study and know the material well. You need to work for your grade but so worth

There were a lot of opportunities for extra credit. He also had 3 super fun experiments and required to write reports, but he just checked your effort and did not grade the report. To do well on the test, students must understand his lectures and know how to apply it efficiently. Overall, highly recommended!

If you want to really learn Microeconomics in an interesting and an engaging way then you should take Zack Hawley's ECON10223 class. He is really funny and the tests for the most part are easy if you just follow the material and your intuition.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Only 2 Grades in the class (other than final) and no text book to get info from, only from the lecture. No rhyme or reason to the flow of the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hawley is a great teacher and an overall great guy. The material can be hard, but he does great experiments and will go above and beyond to help you out if you put in the effort. One of the funniest professors I've ever had, and I will definitely get in his class again at some point. Best choice for Intro Micro, especially for honors students!

Game Theory is the hardest class I have ever taken. I can't say I would recommend at all. Hawley is a nice guy and funny in class, but it doesn't really make up for the material's harshness. He does curve generously though. However, all tests are "played" against your fellow classmates for grade which contributes a lot to the stress of the class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He's so inspiring. Definitely will take another of his class

I always looked forward to going to Hawley's class. Lectures were engaging and kept my attention, not just notes read from a powerpoint. Homework isn't graded for correctness, but make sure you know how to do everything. A isn't impossible, but you'll definitely have to work for it. Overall great prof who cares about you and wants you to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: He makes lectures fun and engaging, but you must go to class to understand the material. Even if you feel clueless the entire semester, tests are manageable if you can apply and not just memorize your notes. Light homework load. He lets you take the final to replace your lowest exam. Phenomenal professor who truly cares for your lifelong success.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: best teacher in TCU!!!  teaching is very good! not only can learn a lot of knowledge from the class, but also you can learn a lot for your future!! worth to take this class!!

Very hard subject and his teaching style doenst make it much easier. You will struggle and be uncomfortable 80% of the time but you'll turn out fine if you give an honest effort. Made it out alive but wouldn't take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hawley is so fun to be in class with. The material is difficult and you have to work hard to get a good grade. His honors class can get very competitive but find a study group early and stick with them. He replaces the lowest test if you take the final. Homework assignments aren't graded for accuracy, but do them or you'll fail. Don't miss class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Hawley is a fantastic professor. His lectures are top quality and very interesting. Experiments were both fun and informative. Highly recommend his honors section if you have the opportunity to take it.

Smart, funny, and engaging professor. He says himself that Intermed Micro is his most boring class, but he still made it fun. 3 exams, keeps best 2 grades. 10 quizzes, drops 2. There is a participation grade. Hw is graded basically on completion. His class has a good balance of math, models, and intuition. Def take it, especially for grad school.

Zack was AWESOME. I took him for maymester so it was A LOT of material to cover quickly and in a short amount of time, but he made it very understandable and would re-explain anything you were confused about. He is very engaging and I actually enjoyed going to class! Ended with a B+, but f I had had a full semester with him I could have gotten an A

He did not take class attendance but if you skipped class, you wouldn't pass. He's a very engaging teacher; he breaks down the hard things into smaller pieces so that you can master them more easily. Take good notes, review what you have learned regularly, do the home work and you will be fine.

From the first day, Hawley's class had been one that I enjoyed going to. He is very thorough in his lectures and makes material that can be tough for some to understand very easy to grasp. I felt like I was leaps and bounds ahead of my friends in other micro classes because I understood everything so much more.

Hawley is a great teacher. Show up to class and take Good notes with multiple colors and you will do fine. He wants you to succeed. Most of his tests are very similar to his Hw problems, and he give out a lot of EC.

Tough is you're not kind of good at math.Still very do-able. Clear notes in class.Very much cares of intuition. All that said, he's one of the better professors in the department. Willing to go above and beyond to help you out.

Hawley is a very good professor and his lectures are very clear. His tests are based off the homework and lectures so you have to go to class if you want to do well. An A is achievable if you go to class and do all the homework and pay attention

Hawley is absolutely the guy to take for freshman micro. No textbook, just everything straight from his brain. Brilliant in class, makes things interesting, tests from notes and homework. They are very tough, but he's willing to help and doing well in his class is very satisfying.

Hawley is the man!! Young teacher who is very intelligent and really wants his students to do their best. He is a great teacher and very interesting with his lectures and examples. Not too difficult of a class and all his tests come directly from his notes and homework question. Barely any homework though. Definitely take him!
Take notes and get extra help and you'll do wonders better. It's a difficult class but you can do well if you try hard. Must go to class and take notes/listen to what he says.
Easy notes

Homework and tests were very, very difficult. I took one of the assignments to an off campus tutor and they said they couldn't help with graduate econ work... only it wasn't grad econ, it was undgraduate intermed micro. A ton of calculus, and a very difficult class.  Really cool guy though, grades with huge curve.
Really cool guy who makes class interesting. Tests are next to impossible and homework takes far too long.

You HAVE to attend class. During class he gives you great notes that make the tests and homework much easier. His lectures are engaging and he does his best to make class interesting and exciting. He's doesn't use ecollege and his grading system is a little weird BUT he's always willing to help. Take good notes and go to class

If you do the work, and pay attention in class you will do fine.  Makes class interesting.  The only problem is he isn't good about updating grades, so it's kind of frustrating.  But he's super helpful, and is always available if you have questions.
Must go to class if you want a good grade. His notes are clear and precise. Awesome guy, worries about his students.
Great professor

Beginning Chinese 1. Lama Laoshi is THE MAN! He's ineffective as a teacher, so you might as well get used to teaching yourself by reading the book, but he's a really cool dude. He gives extra credit to boost your grade 6 points overall. If you ask him to push assignments & tests back he will.  Easy A, as long as you show up, study, do extra credit.

Have known him since he came to TCU. I love Chinese and he is a great teacher. It is basically self taught but that is the best way to learn a language. If you are motivated and want to learn, you will do great. His teaching style just compliments the textbook. So, you have to do most of the work. I am now halfway conversational. Great class!

Overall a fun class! Very nice guy. Accent takes getting used to. Study and memorize your characters! Tests are usually concepts from quizzes and the final was questions from previous tests/quizzes. You should only take this class if you have a desire to learn Chinese(not simply bc you need a FL credit. Otherwise, you're wasting your time!)

most people in this course are not physics majors & do not have any physics background. he moved very fast & did not explain things in depth/clearly enough for beginners. hard to understand & lectures were all over the place. when our whole class was confused, he had a condescending attitude & made us feel bad or dumb for not understanding.

I took Dr. Gryczynski for How the Human Body Works, which is mainly for non-physics majors. I already had a physics background so the course was easy for me, but he seemed to assume that everyone was pretty familiar with the topics, which was frustrating for my classmates. He's a fun person and I think he would be great in a physics-major class.

Dr. Gryczynski is a very engaging and genuinely interesting teacher who clearly understands the material he is teaching. Tests can be difficult but he is very generous with rounding at the end of the semester. He often puts people on the spot with very specific science questions in lecture, but he means no harm. Super nice man, would recommend.
